theorem branching_capacity {w : ℕ} (hw : 9 ≤ Nat.log 2 w) :
    16 * branching w ^ 5 ≤ w := by
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by intro he; simp [he] at hw
  rw [branching, ite_eq_left hw, ← pow_mul, show 16 = 2 ^ 4 by decide, ← pow_add]
  exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)).trans (Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hw0)

private theorem word_le_branching_pow (w : ℕ) : w ≤ branching w ^ 14 := by
  have hupper := (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self Nat.one_lt_two w).le
  unfold branching
  split
  · rename_i hw
    rw [← pow_mul]
    apply hupper.trans
    apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide)
    have hdiv := Nat.div_add_mod (Nat.log 2 w - 4) 5
    have hmod := Nat.mod_lt (Nat.log 2 w - 4) (by decide : 0 < 5)
    omega
  · rename_i hw
    exact hupper.trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega))

theorem height_build_branching_le {w : ℕ} (hw : 2 ≤ w) (xs : List ℕ) :
    (Tree.build (branching w) xs).height ≤ 14 * (Nat.log w xs.length + 1) := by
  apply (Tree.height_build_le _ _).trans
  apply (Nat.clog_le_iff_le_pow (show 1 < branching w by have := two_le_branching w; omega)).mpr
  calc
    xs.length ≤ w ^ (Nat.log w xs.length + 1) :=
      (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self hw xs.length).le
    _ ≤ (branching w ^ 14) ^ (Nat.log w xs.length + 1) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_left (word_le_branching_pow w) _
    _ = branching w ^ (14 * (Nat.log w xs.length + 1)) := (pow_mul _ _ _).symm

theorem highestDiff_mem_relevantBits_of_lt {n w : ℕ} {keys : Fin n → ℕ}
    (hsorted : StrictMono keys) (hbound : ∀ i, keys i < 2 ^ w)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) : highestDiff w (keys i) (keys j) ∈ relevantBits w keys := by
  suffices h : ∀ d (i j : Fin n), j.val = i.val + d + 1 →
      highestDiff w (keys i) (keys j) ∈ relevantBits w keys by
    exact h (j.val - i.val - 1) i j (by omega)
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro i j hgap
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨⟨i.val, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, by
      congr 2
      apply Fin.ext
      change i.val + 1 = j.val
      omega⟩
  | succ d ih =>
    intro i j hgap
    let k : Fin n := ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩
    have hik : i < k := by change i.val < i.val + 1; omega
    have hkj : k < j := by change i.val + 1 < j.val; omega
    let p := highestDiff w (keys i) (keys j)
    obtain ⟨hp, hdiff, habove⟩ := highestDiff_spec (hbound i) (hbound j)
      (Nat.ne_of_lt (hsorted (hik.trans hkj)))
    have hprefix := shiftRight_highestDiff_add_one_eq (hbound i) (hbound j)
      (Nat.ne_of_lt (hsorted (hik.trans hkj)))
    have hkprefix : keys k >>> (p + 1) = keys i >>> (p + 1) :=
      Nat.shiftRight_eq_of_between (hsorted hik).le (hsorted hkj).le hprefix
    have hkabove : ∀ b, p < b → (keys k).testBit b = (keys i).testBit b :=
      fun _ hb => Nat.testBit_eq_of_shiftRight_eq hkprefix (by omega)
    by_cases hbit : (keys i).testBit p = (keys k).testBit p
    · have heq : highestDiff w (keys k) (keys j) = p :=
        highestDiff_eq_of_testBit hp (by simpa only [← hbit] using hdiff)
          (fun b hb => (hkabove b hb).trans (habove b hb))
      change p ∈ relevantBits w keys
      rw [← heq]
      exact ih k j (by change j.val = (i.val + 1) + d + 1; omega)
    · have heq : highestDiff w (keys i) (keys k) = p :=
        highestDiff_eq_of_testBit hp hbit (fun b hb => (hkabove b hb).symm)
      change p ∈ relevantBits w keys
      rw [← heq]
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      exact ⟨⟨i.val, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩

private theorem sketch_lt_query_of_prefix {n w cut q : ℕ} {keys : Fin n → ℕ}
    (hsorted : StrictMono keys) (hbound : ∀ i, keys i < 2 ^ w)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) (hprefix : keys j >>> cut = q >>> cut)
    (hne : keys i >>> cut ≠ q >>> cut) :
    sketch (relevantBits w keys) (keys i) < sketch (relevantBits w keys) q := by
  let p := highestDiff w (keys i) (keys j)
  have hp : cut ≤ p := by
    by_contra h
    have heq := (highestDiff_lt_iff_shiftRight_eq (hbound i) (hbound j)
      (Nat.ne_of_lt (hsorted hij))).mp (by omega : p < cut)
    exact hne (heq.trans hprefix)
  obtain ⟨h₀, h₁⟩ := highestDiff_bits_of_lt (hbound i) (hbound j) (hsorted hij)
  apply projectBits_lt (relevantBits w keys).sortedLT_sort.pairwise
    ((Finset.mem_sort _).mpr (highestDiff_mem_relevantBits_of_lt hsorted hbound hij)) h₀
  · exact (Nat.testBit_eq_of_shiftRight_eq hprefix hp).symm.trans h₁
  · intro b hb
    exact (testBit_eq_of_highestDiff_lt (hbound i) (hbound j) hb).trans
      (Nat.testBit_eq_of_shiftRight_eq hprefix (by omega))

    (hsorted : StrictMono keys) (hbound : ∀ i, keys i < 2 ^ w)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) (hprefix : keys i >>> cut = q >>> cut)
    (hne : keys j >>> cut ≠ q >>> cut) :
    sketch (relevantBits w keys) q < sketch (relevantBits w keys) (keys j) := by
  let p := highestDiff w (keys i) (keys j)
  have hp : cut ≤ p := by
    by_contra h
    have heq := (highestDiff_lt_iff_shiftRight_eq (hbound i) (hbound j)
      (Nat.ne_of_lt (hsorted hij))).mp (by omega : p < cut)
    exact hne (heq.symm.trans hprefix)
  obtain ⟨h₀, h₁⟩ := highestDiff_bits_of_lt (hbound i) (hbound j) (hsorted hij)
  apply projectBits_lt (relevantBits w keys).sortedLT_sort.pairwise
    ((Finset.mem_sort _).mpr (highestDiff_mem_relevantBits_of_lt hsorted hbound hij))
    ((Nat.testBit_eq_of_shiftRight_eq hprefix hp).symm.trans h₀) h₁

theorem lt_upperRank_iff {n q : ℕ} {values : Fin n → ℕ} (hsorted : StrictMono values)
    (i : Fin n) : i.val < upperRank values q ↔ values i ≤ q := by
  constructor
  · intro hi
    by_contra h
    have hsubset : (Finset.univ.filter fun j => values j ≤ q) ⊆ Finset.Iio i := by
      intro j hj
      apply Finset.mem_Iio.mpr
      by_contra hji
      have := hsorted.monotone (le_of_not_gt hji)
      have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
      omega
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
    rw [Fin.card_Iio] at hcard
    exact (not_le_of_gt hi) hcard
  · intro hi
    have hsubset : Finset.Iic i ⊆ (Finset.univ.filter fun j => values j ≤ q) := by
      intro j hj
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
        (hsorted.monotone (Finset.mem_Iic.mp hj)).trans hi⟩
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
    rw [Fin.card_Iic] at hcard
    exact hcard

theorem exists_sketchNeighbor_min_highestDiff {n w q : ℕ} {keys : Fin n → ℕ}
    (hsorted : StrictMono keys) (hbound : ∀ i, keys i < 2 ^ w) (hq : q < 2 ^ w)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hmiss : ∀ i, keys i ≠ q) :
    ∃ j, IsSketchNeighbor w keys q j ∧
      ∀ i, highestDiff w (keys j) q ≤ highestDiff w (keys i) q := by
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))
    (fun i => highestDiff w (keys i) q) ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hprefix⟩ := exists_sketchNeighbor_prefix hsorted hbound
    ⟨i, shiftRight_highestDiff_add_one_eq (hbound i) hq (hmiss i)⟩
  have hle : highestDiff w (keys j) q ≤ highestDiff w (keys i) q := by
    have := (highestDiff_lt_iff_shiftRight_eq (hbound j) hq (hmiss j)).mpr hprefix
    omega
  exact ⟨j, hj, fun k => hle.trans (hi k (Finset.mem_univ _))⟩

private theorem min_highestDiff_of_sketchNeighbor {n w q : ℕ} {keys : Fin n → ℕ}
    (hsorted : StrictMono keys) (hbound : ∀ i, keys i < 2 ^ w) (hq : q < 2 ^ w)
    (hmiss : ∀ i, keys i ≠ q) (j : Fin n)
    (hbest : ∀ i, IsSketchNeighbor w keys q i →
      highestDiff w (keys j) q ≤ highestDiff w (keys i) q) :
    ∀ i, highestDiff w (keys j) q ≤ highestDiff w (keys i) q := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hmin⟩ := exists_sketchNeighbor_min_highestDiff hsorted hbound hq
    (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt j.isLt) hmiss
  exact fun i => (hbest k hk).trans (hmin i)

private theorem le_iff_sketch_le_lowerBoundary {n w q : ℕ} {keys : Fin n → ℕ}
    (hsorted : StrictMono keys) (hbound : ∀ i, keys i < 2 ^ w) (hq : q < 2 ^ w)
    (hmiss : ∀ i, keys i ≠ q) (j : Fin n)
    (hmin : ∀ i, highestDiff w (keys j) q ≤ highestDiff w (keys i) q)
    (hbit : q.testBit (highestDiff w (keys j) q) = true) (i : Fin n) :
    keys i ≤ q ↔ sketch (relevantBits w keys) (keys i) ≤
      sketch (relevantBits w keys) (lowerBoundary q (highestDiff w (keys j) q)) := by
  let p := highestDiff w (keys j) q
  have hjprefix : keys j >>> (p + 1) = q >>> (p + 1) :=
    shiftRight_highestDiff_add_one_eq (hbound j) hq (hmiss j)
  by_cases hiprefix : keys i >>> (p + 1) = q >>> (p + 1)
  · have hne := testBit_ne_of_min_highestDiff hbound hq hmiss j hmin i hiprefix
    have hi : (keys i).testBit p = false := by
      change (keys i).testBit p ≠ q.testBit p at hne
      cases h : (keys i).testBit p
      · rfl
      · exact False.elim (hne (h.trans hbit.symm))
    have hlt : keys i < q := Nat.lt_of_testBit p hi hbit
      (fun b hb => Nat.testBit_eq_of_shiftRight_eq hiprefix (by omega))
    exact iff_of_true hlt.le (sketch_le_lowerBoundary hiprefix hi)
  · have hiboundary : keys i >>> (p + 1) ≠ lowerBoundary q p >>> (p + 1) := by
      rwa [(boundary_prefix q p).1]
    rcases lt_trichotomy i j with hij | rfl | hji
    · have hshift : keys i >>> (p + 1) < q >>> (p + 1) := by
        rw [← hjprefix]
        exact (Nat.lt_iff_shiftRight_lt_of_ne (fun h => hiprefix (h.trans hjprefix))).mp
          (hsorted hij)
      have hlt : keys i < q := (Nat.lt_iff_shiftRight_lt_of_ne hiprefix).mpr hshift
      have hslt := sketch_lt_query_of_prefix hsorted hbound hij
        (hjprefix.trans (boundary_prefix q p).1.symm) hiboundary
      exact iff_of_true hlt.le hslt.le
    · exact False.elim (hiprefix hjprefix)
    · have hshift : q >>> (p + 1) < keys i >>> (p + 1) := by
        rw [← hjprefix]
        exact (Nat.lt_iff_shiftRight_lt_of_ne (fun h => hiprefix (h.symm.trans hjprefix))).mp
          (hsorted hji)
      have hlt : q < keys i :=
        (Nat.lt_iff_shiftRight_lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hiprefix)).mpr hshift
      have hslt := query_lt_sketch_of_prefix hsorted hbound hji
        (hjprefix.trans (boundary_prefix q p).1.symm) hiboundary
      exact iff_of_false (not_le_of_gt hlt) (not_le_of_gt hslt)

private theorem le_iff_sketch_lt_upperBoundary {n w q : ℕ} {keys : Fin n → ℕ}
    (hsorted : StrictMono keys) (hbound : ∀ i, keys i < 2 ^ w) (hq : q < 2 ^ w)
    (hmiss : ∀ i, keys i ≠ q) (j : Fin n)
    (hmin : ∀ i, highestDiff w (keys j) q ≤ highestDiff w (keys i) q)
    (hbit : q.testBit (highestDiff w (keys j) q) = false) (i : Fin n) :
    keys i ≤ q ↔ sketch (relevantBits w keys) (keys i) <
      sketch (relevantBits w keys) (upperBoundary q (highestDiff w (keys j) q)) := by
  let p := highestDiff w (keys j) q
  have hjprefix : keys j >>> (p + 1) = q >>> (p + 1) :=
    shiftRight_highestDiff_add_one_eq (hbound j) hq (hmiss j)
  by_cases hiprefix : keys i >>> (p + 1) = q >>> (p + 1)
  · have hne := testBit_ne_of_min_highestDiff hbound hq hmiss j hmin i hiprefix
    have hi : (keys i).testBit p = true := by
      change (keys i).testBit p ≠ q.testBit p at hne
      cases h : (keys i).testBit p
      · exact False.elim (hne (h.trans hbit.symm))
      · rfl
    have hlt : q < keys i := Nat.lt_of_testBit p hbit hi
      (fun b hb => (Nat.testBit_eq_of_shiftRight_eq hiprefix (by omega)).symm)
    exact iff_of_false (not_le_of_gt hlt)
      (not_lt_of_ge (upperBoundary_le_sketch hiprefix hi))
  · have hiboundary : keys i >>> (p + 1) ≠ upperBoundary q p >>> (p + 1) := by
      rwa [(boundary_prefix q p).2]
    rcases lt_trichotomy i j with hij | rfl | hji
    · have hshift : keys i >>> (p + 1) < q >>> (p + 1) := by
        rw [← hjprefix]
        exact (Nat.lt_iff_shiftRight_lt_of_ne (fun h => hiprefix (h.trans hjprefix))).mp
          (hsorted hij)
      have hlt : keys i < q := (Nat.lt_iff_shiftRight_lt_of_ne hiprefix).mpr hshift
      have hslt := sketch_lt_query_of_prefix hsorted hbound hij
        (hjprefix.trans (boundary_prefix q p).2.symm) hiboundary
      exact iff_of_true hlt.le hslt
    · exact False.elim (hiprefix hjprefix)
    · have hshift : q >>> (p + 1) < keys i >>> (p + 1) := by
        rw [← hjprefix]
        exact (Nat.lt_iff_shiftRight_lt_of_ne (fun h => hiprefix (h.symm.trans hjprefix))).mp
          (hsorted hji)
      have hlt : q < keys i :=
        (Nat.lt_iff_shiftRight_lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hiprefix)).mpr hshift
      have hslt := query_lt_sketch_of_prefix hsorted hbound hji
        (hjprefix.trans (boundary_prefix q p).2.symm) hiboundary
      exact iff_of_false (not_le_of_gt hlt) (not_lt_of_ge hslt.le)

theorem exists_spread_shifts {r w : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (b : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hw : ∀ i, b i ≤ w) :
    ∃ m : Fin r → ℕ,
      Function.Injective (fun p : Fin r × Fin r => b p.1 + m p.2) ∧
      StrictMono (fun i => b i + m i) ∧
      (∀ i, w < b i + m i ∧ b i + m i < w + 2 * r ^ 4) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hsep⟩ := exists_residue_shifts hr b
  let m (i : Fin r) := spreadShift w (r ^ 3) (b i) i.val (a i)
  have hm (i : Fin r) :
      w + 2 * i.val * r ^ 3 < b i + m i ∧
        b i + m i < w + (2 * i.val + 2) * r ^ 3 :=
    spreadShift_bounds (by positivity) (hw i) (ha i)
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p q hpq
    change b p.1 + m p.2 = b q.1 + m q.2 at hpq
    have hj : p.2 = q.2 := by
      by_contra hne
      apply hsep p.2 q.2 hne p.1 q.1
      have he := congrArg (fun n => n % r ^ 3) hpq
      rw [Nat.add_mod (b p.1) (m p.2), Nat.add_mod (b q.1) (m q.2)] at he
      dsimp only [m] at he
      rw [spreadShift_mod, spreadShift_mod] at he
      simpa only [← Nat.add_mod] using he
    rw [hj] at hpq
    have hi : p.1 = q.1 := hb (Nat.add_right_cancel hpq)
    exact Prod.ext hi hj
  · intro i j hij
    have hs : (2 * i.val + 2) * r ^ 3 ≤ 2 * j.val * r ^ 3 :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    exact (hm i).2.trans_le ((Nat.add_le_add_left hs w).trans (hm j).1.le)
  · intro i
    have hs : (2 * i.val + 2) * r ^ 3 ≤ 2 * r ^ 4 := by
      calc
        (2 * i.val + 2) * r ^ 3 ≤ (2 * r) * r ^ 3 :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
        _ = 2 * r ^ 4 := by ring
    exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (by omega) (hm i).1,
      (hm i).2.trans_le (Nat.add_le_add_left hs w)⟩

theorem merge_perm [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (depth : ℕ)
    (ascending : Bool) (input : Fin (arity depth) → α) :
    (List.ofFn (merge key depth ascending input)).Perm (List.ofFn input) := by
  induction depth generalizing ascending with
  | zero => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | succ depth ih =>
    let compared := compareLayer key (n := arity depth) ascending input
    have h := (ih ascending (compared ∘ Fin.castAdd (arity depth))).append
      (ih ascending (compared ∘ Fin.natAdd (arity depth)))
    have hsplit : Fin.append (compared ∘ Fin.castAdd (arity depth))
        (compared ∘ Fin.natAdd (arity depth)) = compared := Fin.append_castAdd_natAdd
    rw [← List.ofFn_fin_append, ← List.ofFn_fin_append, hsplit] at h
    exact h.trans (compareLayer_perm key ascending input)

  induction depth generalizing ascending with

      (ih false (input ∘ Fin.natAdd (arity depth)))
    have hsplit : Fin.append (input ∘ Fin.castAdd (arity depth))
        (input ∘ Fin.natAdd (arity depth)) = input := Fin.append_castAdd_natAdd
    rw [← List.ofFn_fin_append, ← List.ofFn_fin_append, hsplit] at h
    exact (merge_perm key (depth + 1) ascending _).trans h

theorem IsBitonic.min_le_max_halves [LinearOrder κ] {n : ℕ} (first second : Fin n → κ)
    (h : IsBitonic (Fin.append first second)) (i j : Fin n) :
    min (first i) (second i) ≤ max (first j) (second j) := by

    {first first' : Fin n → α} {second second' : Fin m → α}

    (hcross : ∀ i j, key (first i) ≤ key (second j)) (i : Fin n) (j : Fin m) :

  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp (hsecond.mem_iff.mp (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨j, rfl⟩))

theorem merge_sorted [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (depth : ℕ) (ascending : Bool)
    (input : Fin (arity depth) → α) (hbitonic : IsBitonic (key ∘ input)) :
    if ascending then Monotone (key ∘ merge key depth ascending input)
    else Antitone (key ∘ merge key depth ascending input) := by
  induction depth generalizing ascending with
  | zero =>
    cases ascending <;> intro i j _ <;>
      have h : i = j := Subsingleton.elim (α := Fin 1) i j <;> simp [h]
  | succ depth ih =>
    change Fin (arity depth + arity depth) → α at input
    change IsBitonic (n := arity depth + arity depth) (key ∘ input) at hbitonic
    let left := key ∘ input ∘ Fin.castAdd (arity depth)
    let right := key ∘ input ∘ Fin.natAdd (arity depth)
    have hpairs : IsBitonic (Fin.append left right) := by
      have hsplit : Fin.append (input ∘ Fin.castAdd (arity depth))
          (input ∘ Fin.natAdd (arity depth)) = input := Fin.append_castAdd_natAdd
      simpa only [left, right, ← Fin.comp_append, hsplit] using hbitonic
    let compared := compareLayer key (n := arity depth) ascending input
    let first := compared ∘ Fin.castAdd (arity depth)
    let second := compared ∘ Fin.natAdd (arity depth)
    have hfirst : key ∘ first = if ascending then min left right else max left right := by
      funext i
      dsimp only [first, compared, left, right, Function.comp_def]
      have h := congrFun (compareLayer_keys key ascending input) (Fin.castAdd (arity depth) i)
      cases ascending <;>
        simpa only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Fin.append_left, Function.comp_def] using h
    have hsecond : key ∘ second = if ascending then max left right else min left right := by
      funext i
      dsimp only [second, compared, left, right, Function.comp_def]
      have h := congrFun (compareLayer_keys key ascending input) (Fin.natAdd (arity depth) i)
      cases ascending <;>
        simpa only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Fin.append_right, Function.comp_def] using h
    have hbfirst : IsBitonic (key ∘ first) := by
      rw [hfirst]
      cases ascending
      · exact hpairs.max_halves left right
      · exact hpairs.min_halves left right
    have hbsecond : IsBitonic (key ∘ second) := by
      rw [hsecond]
      cases ascending
      · exact hpairs.min_halves left right
      · exact hpairs.max_halves left right
    have hf := ih ascending first hbfirst
    have hs := ih ascending second hbsecond
    have hpf := merge_perm key depth ascending first
    have hps := merge_perm key depth ascending second
    change if ascending then Monotone (key ∘ Fin.append
      (merge key depth ascending first) (merge key depth ascending second)) else
      Antitone (key ∘ Fin.append
        (merge key depth ascending first) (merge key depth ascending second))
    rw [Fin.comp_append]
    cases ascending with
    | false =>
      apply monotone_append (κ := OrderDual κ) hf hs
      apply perm_cross (κ := OrderDual κ) key hpf hps
      intro i j
      change (key ∘ second) j ≤ (key ∘ first) i
      rw [hfirst, hsecond]
      exact hpairs.min_le_max_halves left right j i
    | true =>
      apply monotone_append hf hs
      apply perm_cross key hpf hps
      intro i j
      change (key ∘ first) i ≤ (key ∘ second) j
      rw [hfirst, hsecond]
      exact hpairs.min_le_max_halves left right i j

private theorem bounded_instruction (hsource : source < N) (hi : Invariant N edge bad source s)
    (hb : Bounded N width s) (hc : ChoiceFits N s choice) :
    Bounded N width (instruction N width source s (answer edge bad s) choice) := by
  have hpow : 0 < 2 ^ width := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  have hN : N + 1 < registerBound N width := by
    have hp : 0 < 2 ^ width := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
    unfold registerBound
    omega
  have hw : width < registerBound N width := by unfold registerBound; omega
  cases hp : s.phase with
  | round =>
    simp only [instruction, hp]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all only [Bounded, and_true, true_and] <;> omega
  | target =>
    simp only [Invariant, hp, RoundCorrect] at hi
    simp only [instruction, hp]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all only [Bounded, and_true, true_and] <;> omega
  | candidate =>
    simp only [Invariant, hp] at hi
    simp only [instruction, hp]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all only [Bounded, and_true, true_and] <;> omega
  | walk =>
    simp only [instruction, hp]
    split_ifs
    · exact hb
    · exact bounded_reject
    · simp_all only [Bounded, and_true, true_and]
      omega
  | guess =>
    simp only [instruction, hp]
    split_ifs with hz hv
    · exact hb
    · exact bounded_reject
    · have hg := hc hp hz
      simp_all only [Bounded, true_and]
      constructor <;> omega
  | edge =>
    simp only [instruction, hp]
    split_ifs
    · simp_all only [Bounded, and_true, true_and]
      omega
    · exact bounded_reject
  | observe =>
    simp only [Invariant, hp] at hi
    obtain ⟨_, hs, hu, _⟩ := hi
    obtain ⟨S, hsub, _, he, _⟩ := hs
    have hcard : s.selected ≤ N := by
      rw [he]
      exact (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans roundSet_card_le
    simp_all only [instruction, Bounded, and_true, true_and]
    constructor <;> omega
  | done =>
    simp only [instruction, hp]
    split_ifs with he hf hh
    · exact bounded_reject
    · exact bounded_accept
    · simp only [Invariant, hp] at hi
      have hf' : s.finalScan = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hf
      obtain ⟨⟨_, hm⟩, _, _⟩ := hi
      simp only [hf', Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hm
      obtain ⟨_, hv, hn⟩ := hm

        rw [hn]
        exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans roundSet_card_le
      have hhit : s.hit.toNat ≤ 1 := by cases s.hit <;> decide
      simp_all only [Bounded, and_true, true_and]
      constructor <;> omega

theorem exec {w L M : ℕ} (hw : 2 ≤ w) (x : Data 21)

    (hb : Multiword.Bounded (radix w) (x.comap embed) (Schoolbook.rightRegs 3 3))
    (hM : Multiword.value (radix w) (x.comap embed) (Schoolbook.rightRegs 3 3) = M)
    (ho : x.regs offset = w - 2 * (w / 2))
    (hD : x.regs retained < 2 ^ L)
    (hL : L + (w - 2 * (w / 2)) ≤ w / 2) :
    ∃ y, Exec w code x y 94 ∧
      y.regs out = (((x.regs query &&& x.regs positions) * M) >>> w) &&&
        x.regs retained ∧
      y.mem = x.mem ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 21, (7 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < 10) ∨ (16 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < 20) →
        y.regs i = x.regs i := by
  let z := Workspace.setupResult w x
  let u := splitResult w z
  have hzq : z.regs query = x.regs query := by
    simp +decide [z, Workspace.setupResult, Workspace.base, Workspace.zero]
  have hzp : z.regs positions = x.regs positions := by
    simp +decide [z, Workspace.setupResult, Workspace.base, Workspace.zero]
  have hzbase : z.regs 2 = radix w := by simp [z, Workspace.setupResult,
    Workspace.base, Workspace.zero]
  have hez : Exec w Workspace.setup x z 6 := Workspace.exec_setup hw x
  have heu : Exec w split z u 6 := exec_split z (by rwa [hzq]) hzbase
  obtain ⟨hua, huav⟩ := split_left hw z (by rwa [hzq])
  have hur (i : Fin 16) (hi : i ∈ Schoolbook.rightRegs 3 3) :
      (u.comap embed).regs i = (x.comap embed).regs i := by
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hi
    fin_cases j <;> simp +decide [u, z, Data.comap, embed, splitResult,
      Workspace.setupResult, Workspace.base, Workspace.zero]
  have hub : Multiword.Bounded (radix w) (u.comap embed) (Schoolbook.rightRegs 3 3) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hur i hi]
    exact hb i hi
  have hum : Multiword.value (radix w) (u.comap embed) (Schoolbook.rightRegs 3 3) = M := by
    rw [Multiword.value, List.map_congr_left hur]
    exact hM
  obtain ⟨v, hev, hvb, hv, hvm, _⟩ := Schoolbook.exec_fixedProgram hw 3 3 (u.comap embed)
    hua hub
  rw [huav, hzq, hzp, hum] at hv
  let t := v.extend embed u
  have het : Exec w ((Schoolbook.fixedProgram 3 3).rename embed) u t 80 :=
    hev.rename embed_injective
  have htd : t.regs productDigit =
      ((x.regs query &&& x.regs positions) * M) / radix w ^ 2 % radix w := by
    have ht : t.regs (embed (12 : Fin 16)) = v.regs 12 :=
      embed_injective.extend_apply _ _ _
    rw [show productDigit = embed (12 : Fin 16) from rfl, ht,
      ← third_digit v hvb, hv]
  have htcaller (i : Fin 21) (hi : 16 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < 20) :
      t.regs i = x.regs i := by
    apply (hez.seq (heu.seq het)).regs_eq
    have hp : ∀ i : Fin 21, 16 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < 20 →
        (Code.seq (B := .standard) Workspace.setup
          (.seq split ((Schoolbook.fixedProgram 3 3).rename embed))).Preserves i := by decide
    exact hp i hi
  let d := t.regs productDigit >>> t.regs offset
  let y := (t.set out d).set out (d &&& t.regs retained)
  have hdigit : Fits w (t.regs productDigit) := by
    rw [htd]
    exact (Nat.mod_lt _ (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one (one_lt_radix hw))).trans (radix_fits hw)
  have hd : Fits w d := hdigit.of_le (by
    dsimp [d]
    rw [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    exact Nat.div_le_self _ _)
  have hmask : Fits w (d &&& t.regs retained) := hd.of_le Nat.and_le_left
  have hey : Exec w (ram[out ← productDigit >>> offset; out ← out &&& retained]) t y 2 := by
    ram_eval [y, d, hd, hmask]
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hez.seq (heu.seq (het.seq hey))
  · change d &&& t.regs retained = _
    dsimp only [d]
    rw [htd, htcaller offset (by decide), htcaller retained (by decide), ho]
    exact window_eq hL hD
  · exact hvm
  · intro i hi
    apply (hez.seq (heu.seq (het.seq hey))).regs_eq
    have hp : ∀ i : Fin 21, (7 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < 10) ∨ (16 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < 20) →

    (hxc : x.regs copies = queryMultiplier b n) (hxg : x.regs guards = guardMask b n)
    (hxb : x.regs bits = b) (hxm : x.regs middle = 2 ^ ((b + 1) * (n - 1)))
    (hxr : x.regs base = 2 ^ (b + 1)) (hxn' : x.regs count = n) :
    Exec w code x (result x b n s q) 8 ∧
      (result x b n s q).regs out = ((Finset.range n).filter (fun i => s i < q)).card ∧
      (result x b n s q).mem = x.mem := by

    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (b + 1) (show 1 ≤ n by omega)
    simp only [mul_one] at hm

  have hrep : Fits w (q * queryMultiplier b n) :=

  have hdiff : Fits w (packedDifference b n s q) :=
    (packedDifference_lt s hs).trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hpacked)
  have hmask : Fits w (packedDifference b n s q &&& guardMask b n) :=
    hdiff.of_le Nat.and_le_left

    rw [guardFlags, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    exact (Nat.div_le_self _ _).trans Nat.and_le_left

    rw [← pow_add] at h₃

private theorem compression_injective {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Function.Injective (fun p : Fin s × Fin s =>
      (s - 1 + p.1.val * s) + compressionShift s p.2.val) := by

  dsimp only at h
  have hj : p.2 = q.2 := by
    have hp := congrArg (fun a : ℕ => a % s) (compressionShift_add hs p.1 p.2)
    have hq := congrArg (fun a : ℕ => a % s) (compressionShift_add hs q.1 q.2)
    simp only [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_self, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_mod,
      Nat.add_zero, Nat.zero_add, Nat.mod_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt p.2.isLt,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt q.2.isLt] at hp hq
    have hm := congrArg (fun a : ℕ => a % s) h
    simp only [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_self, Nat.mul_zero,
      Nat.zero_mod, Nat.add_zero, Nat.mod_mod] at hm
    exact Fin.ext (hp.symm.trans (hm.trans hq))
  have hi : p.1 = q.1 := by
    rw [hj] at h
    exact markerPosition_injective hs (Nat.add_right_cancel h)
  exact Prod.ext hi hj

theorem exec {w n q a : ℕ} {keys : Fin n → ℕ} (p : NodeParameters w keys)
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hs : StrictMono keys) (hk : ∀ i, keys i < 2 ^ w)

    (ha : Fits w (a + 18 + (n - 1) * 2))
    (hxq : x.regs query = q) (hxa : x.regs pointer = a) :
    ∃ y, ExecWithin w (code w) x y 201000 ∧ y.regs out = upperRank keys q ∧
      y.mem = x.mem ∧ y.regs query = q ∧ y.regs pointer = a := by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hw : 3 ≤ w := by
    have hb := branching_capacity hlarge
    have hB := two_le_branching w
    have hp : branching w ≤ branching w ^ 5 := Nat.le_self_pow (by decide) _
    omega
  obtain ⟨u, heu, hru, hum⟩ := exec_readHeader p x hr (ha.of_le (by omega)) hxq hxa
  obtain ⟨v, hev, hrv, hvm, hcut, hz, j, hj, hd, hnear, hbest⟩ :=
    exec_initial p (by omega) hn0 hs hk hnB hlarge u hru hq ha
  have hcorrect := NodeSemantics.correct hs hk hq j hbest
  by_cases hhit : keys j = q
  · have htest : (Cond.eq divergence zero).Holds v := by
      simp only [Cond.holds_eq, hd, hz, hhit, Nat.xor_self]
    let y := v.set out (sketchRank w keys q)
    have hey : Exec (B := .standard) w (.op (.copy out cut)) v y 1 := by
      simpa only [hcut] using (Exec.copy (B := .standard) (w := w) (d := out) (s := cut) (x := v))
    have hefinish := Exec.branch_pos (neg := correction w) htest hey
    have hry : Ready p q a y := hrv.set_scratch out _ (by decide) (by decide)
    refine ⟨y, (heu.within.seq (hev.seq hefinish.within)).mono (by decide), ?_,
      hvm.trans hum, hry.query_eq, hry.pointer_eq⟩
    simpa only [y, Data.set_regs, Function.update_self, hhit, ↓reduceIte] using hcorrect
  · have htest : ¬(Cond.eq divergence zero).Holds v := by
      simp only [Cond.holds_eq, hd, hz]
      exact fun h => hhit (Nat.xor_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
    obtain ⟨y, hey, hy, hry, hym⟩ := exec_correction p hw hn0 hs hk hnB hlarge v hrv hq j

    simpa only [hxa] using (Exec.copy (B := .standard) (w := w)

    simp [u, ReadHeaderProgram.pointer]

    (hv : (spec w capacity).valid vs o) (i : Fin 9) :
    Fits w ((implementation w capacity).encode o i) := by
  cases o with
  | push v =>
    change Fits w (if i = tag then 0 else v)
    split <;> first | exact fits_zero w | exact hv.2
  | pop =>
    change Fits w (if i = tag then 1 else 0)
    split
    · exact h2.of_le (by decide)
    · exact fits_zero w
  | size =>
    change Fits w (if i = tag then 2 else 0)
    split <;> first | exact h2 | exact fits_zero w

theorem successor_call {d w base stackBase₀ query : ℕ} {tree : Tree d} {s : Data 32}
    (hs : s.Bounded w) (ht : tree.Valid) (hr : Rep tree base s.mem)
    (hstk_lo : base + span d ≤ stackBase₀) (hstk_fit : Fits w (stackBase₀ + 4 * d))
    (hroot : s.regs root = base) (hstk : s.regs stackBase = stackBase₀)
    (harg : s.regs arg = query) (htag : s.regs tag = 2) :
    ∃ z n, n + 1 ≤ 65 * (d + 1) + 22 ∧ Exec w program s z n ∧
      z.Bounded w ∧ Rep tree base z.mem ∧
      z.regs root = base ∧ z.regs stackBase = stackBase₀ ∧ z.regs sp = stackBase₀ ∧
      (if z.regs found = 0 then none else some (z.regs out)) = tree.successor query ∧
      (∀ a, a < stackBase₀ ∨ stackBase₀ + 4 * d ≤ a → z.mem a = s.mem a) := by
  obtain ⟨z, ⟨n, hn, he⟩, hans, hrep, hsp, hframe⟩ :=
    successor_dispatch_spec ht hr hstk_lo hstk_fit hroot hstk harg htag
  refine ⟨z, n, by omega, he, he.bounded hs, hrep, ?_, ?_, hsp, hans, hframe⟩
  · exact (he.regs_eq (by decide : program.Preserves root)).trans hroot
  · exact (he.regs_eq (by decide : program.Preserves stackBase)).trans hstk

theorem dispatch_spec {d w base stackBase₀ : ℕ} {s : Finset ℕ} {x : Data 32}
    (hstk_lo : base + span d ≤ stackBase₀) (hstk_fit : Fits w (stackBase₀ + 4 * d))
    (o : Operation) (hx : SetRep d base stackBase₀ w s x) (ho : (spec d w).valid s o) :
    ∃ y, ExecWithin w program ((dynamicProgram d w).prepare o x) y (65 * (d + 1) + 21) ∧
      (dynamicProgram d w).decode o y.regs = some ((spec d w).step s o).2 ∧
      SetRep d base stackBase₀ w ((spec d w).step s o).1 y ∧
      (∀ a, (a < base ∨ base + span d ≤ a) →
        (a < stackBase₀ ∨ stackBase₀ + 4 * d ≤ a) → y.mem a = x.mem a) := by
  obtain ⟨t, hvalid, helem, hrep⟩ := hx.tree
  have ha : Fits w (base + span d) := hstk_fit.of_le (by omega)
  have hprep_bounded : ((dynamicProgram d w).prepare o x).Bounded w :=
    (dynamicProgram d w).prepare_bounded hx.bounded
      (fun j _ => arguments_fit hstk_lo hstk_fit o ho j)
  have hprep_root : ((dynamicProgram d w).prepare o x).regs root = base := by
    simpa +decide [dynamicProgram, DynamicProgram.prepare] using hx.root_eq
  have hprep_stk : ((dynamicProgram d w).prepare o x).regs stackBase = stackBase₀ := by
    simpa +decide [dynamicProgram, DynamicProgram.prepare] using hx.stackBase_eq
  have hprep_rep : Rep t base ((dynamicProgram d w).prepare o x).mem := hrep
  cases o with
  | insert k =>
    have hprep_arg : ((dynamicProgram d w).prepare (.insert k) x).regs arg = k := by
      simp +decide [dynamicProgram, DynamicProgram.prepare]
    have hprep_tag : ((dynamicProgram d w).prepare (.insert k) x).regs tag = 0 := by
      simp +decide [dynamicProgram, DynamicProgram.prepare]
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy_rep, _, hy_frame⟩ :=
      insert_dispatch_spec hvalid hprep_rep ho ha hprep_root hprep_arg hprep_tag
    have hrun := hy.mono (by omega : 39 * (d + 1) + 15 ≤ 65 * (d + 1) + 21)
    have hy_root : y.regs root = base :=
      (hrun.regs_eq (by decide : program.Preserves root)).trans hprep_root
    have hy_stk : y.regs stackBase = stackBase₀ :=
      (hrun.regs_eq (by decide : program.Preserves stackBase)).trans hprep_stk
    refine ⟨y, hrun, rfl,
      ⟨hrun.bounded hprep_bounded, hy_root, hy_stk,
        t.insert k, Tree.valid_insert hvalid ho, ?_, hy_rep⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [Tree.elements_insert hvalid ho, helem]; rfl
    · intro a ha_tree _
      exact hy_frame a ha_tree
  | member q =>
    have hprep_arg : ((dynamicProgram d w).prepare (.member q) x).regs arg = q := by
      simp +decide [dynamicProgram, DynamicProgram.prepare]
    have hprep_tag : ((dynamicProgram d w).prepare (.member q) x).regs tag = 1 := by
      simp +decide [dynamicProgram, DynamicProgram.prepare]
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy_out, hy_mem⟩ :=
      member_dispatch_spec hvalid hprep_rep ha hprep_root hprep_arg hprep_tag
    have hrun := hy.mono (by omega : 28 * (d + 1) + 17 ≤ 65 * (d + 1) + 21)
    have hy_root : y.regs root = base :=
      (hrun.regs_eq (by decide : program.Preserves root)).trans hprep_root
    have hy_stk : y.regs stackBase = stackBase₀ :=
      (hrun.regs_eq (by decide : program.Preserves stackBase)).trans hprep_stk
    refine ⟨y, hrun, ?_,
      ⟨hrun.bounded hprep_bounded, hy_root, hy_stk, t, hvalid, helem, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · simp only [dynamicProgram, spec, hy_out, ← helem]
      congr 1
      have hiff := (Tree.mem_elements_iff hvalid q).trans (Tree.member_iff_contains hvalid q).symm
      cases hmem : t.member q <;> simp_all <;> rfl
    · simpa only [hy_mem] using hprep_rep
    · intro a _ _
      exact congrFun hy_mem a
  | successor q =>
    have hprep_arg : ((dynamicProgram d w).prepare (.successor q) x).regs arg = q := by
      simp +decide [dynamicProgram, DynamicProgram.prepare]
    have hprep_tag : ((dynamicProgram d w).prepare (.successor q) x).regs tag = 2 := by
      simp +decide [dynamicProgram, DynamicProgram.prepare]
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy_ans, hy_rep, _, hy_frame⟩ :=
      successor_dispatch_spec hvalid hprep_rep hstk_lo hstk_fit
        hprep_root hprep_stk hprep_arg hprep_tag
    have hy_root : y.regs root = base :=
      (hy.regs_eq (by decide : program.Preserves root)).trans hprep_root
    have hy_stk : y.regs stackBase = stackBase₀ :=
      (hy.regs_eq (by decide : program.Preserves stackBase)).trans hprep_stk
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_,
      ⟨hy.bounded hprep_bounded, hy_root, hy_stk, t, hvalid, helem, hy_rep⟩, ?_⟩
    · change some (if y.regs found = 0 then none else some (y.regs out)) =
        some (OrderedSet.least (s.filter (q < ·)))
      rw [hy_ans, successor_eq_least hvalid q, helem]
    · intro a _ ha_stk
      exact hy_frame a ha_stk

private theorem DfsConst.of_regs_eq {base d : ℕ} {s s' : Data 32} (hc : DfsConst base d s)
    (hregs : ∀ r ∈ ([zero, one, two, three, four, five, root, depth, payload,
      tableBase, stackBase, low] : List (Fin 32)), s'.regs r = s.regs r)
    (hinv : TableInv (base + span d) d s'.mem) :
    DfsConst base d s' := by
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, forall_eq_or_imp, forall_eq] at hregs
  obtain ⟨r0, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, rr, rd, rp, rt, rs, rl⟩ := hregs

    r4.trans hc.2.2.2.2.1, r5.trans hc.2.2.2.2.2.1, rr.trans hc.2.2.2.2.2.2.1,
    rd.trans hc.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, rp.trans hc.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1,

private theorem dfs_clusters_spec {w base d ptr k : ℕ}
    (hk : k + 1 ≤ d) (ha : Fits w (base + span d + 4 * (d + 1)))
    (hptr_end : ptr + span (k + 1) ≤ base + span d)
    (ih : ∀ {p₀ : ℕ} {s₀ : Data 32},
      DfsState base d p₀ k 0 s₀ → p₀ + span k ≤ base + span d →
      ∃ s₁, DfsState base d (p₀ + span k) k 1 s₁ ∧
        Rep (Tree.empty k) p₀ s₁.mem ∧
        (∀ a, (a < p₀ ∨ p₀ + span k ≤ a) →
          (a < base + span d + 2 * (d + 1) + 1 ∨
            base + span d + 2 * (d + 1) + k < a) →
          s₁.mem a = s₀.mem a) ∧
        (∀ z T_cont, ExecWithin w dfsLoop s₁ z T_cont →
          ExecWithin w dfsLoop s₀ z (8 * span k - 15 + T_cont)))
    (cnt : ℕ) {m : ℕ} {s : Data 32} (hm : m + cnt = universeSize k)
    (hs : DfsState base d (ptr + 5 + (m + 1) * span k) k 1 s)
    (hcnt : s.mem (base + span d + 2 * (d + 1) + (k + 1)) = cnt)
    (hprev : ∀ i : Fin (universeSize k), i.val < m →
      Rep (Tree.empty k) (ptr + clusterOffset k i.val) s.mem) :
    ∃ s', DfsState base d (ptr + span (k + 1)) k 1 s' ∧
      s'.mem (base + span d + 2 * (d + 1) + (k + 1)) = 0 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin (universeSize k),
        Rep (Tree.empty k) (ptr + clusterOffset k i.val) s'.mem) ∧
      (∀ a, (a < ptr + 5 + (m + 1) * span k ∨ ptr + span (k + 1) ≤ a) →
        (a < base + span d + 2 * (d + 1) + 1 ∨
          base + span d + 2 * (d + 1) + (k + 1) < a) →
        s'.mem a = s.mem a) ∧
      (∀ z T_cont, ExecWithin w dfsLoop s' z T_cont →
        ExecWithin w dfsLoop s z (cnt * (8 * span k) + T_cont)) := by
  induction cnt generalizing m s with
  | zero =>
    have hm_eq : m = universeSize k := by omega
    have hptr_eq : ptr + 5 + (m + 1) * span k = ptr + span (k + 1) := by
      rw [hm_eq, span_succ]; omega
    refine ⟨s, hptr_eq ▸ hs, hcnt, fun i => hprev i (hm_eq ▸ i.isLt),
      fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun z T_cont hcont => by
        simpa only [Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_add] using hcont⟩
  | succ cnt ih_cnt =>
    have hm_lt : m < universeSize k := by omega
    have hu_le : universeSize k ≤ span d :=
      (universeSize_le_span k).trans (span_mono (by omega))
    have hcnt_fit : Fits w (cnt + 1 - 1) := ha.of_le (by omega)
    have hstep := dfsBody_next_cluster_exec hs hk hcnt ha hcnt_fit
    let p_m := ptr + 5 + (m + 1) * span k
    let lw := base + span d + 2 * (d + 1)
    let s₁ := dfsNextClusterData s base d k cnt
    have hs₁_away : ∀ a, a ≠ lw + (k + 1) → s₁.mem a = s.mem a := by
      intro a ha_ne
      simp only [s₁, dfsNextClusterData, Data.set_mem, Data.write_mem]
      exact Function.update_of_ne ha_ne _ _
    have hp_m_end : p_m + span k ≤ ptr + span (k + 1) := by
      have : p_m = ptr + clusterOffset k m := by dsimp only [p_m, clusterOffset]; omega
      have hce := cluster_end_le_span k hm_lt
      omega
    have hs₁_state : DfsState base d p_m k 0 s₁ := by
      refine ⟨hs.1.of_regs_eq (by simp +decide [s₁, dfsNextClusterData]) ?_,
        by simpa +decide [s₁, dfsNextClusterData] using hs.2.1,
        by change k + 1 - 1 = k; omega, rfl,
        by simpa +decide [s₁, dfsNextClusterData] using hs.2.2.2.2⟩
      apply tableInv_congr hs.1.tableInv
      intro a _ ha_hi
      exact hs₁_away a (by dsimp only [lw]; omega)
    obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂_state, hs₂_rep, hs₂_frame, hs₂_cps⟩ :=
      ih hs₁_state (hp_m_end.trans hptr_end)
    have hs₂_p_eq : p_m + span k = ptr + 5 + (m + 1 + 1) * span k := by
      dsimp only [p_m]; ring
    have hs₂_cnt : s₂.mem (lw + (k + 1)) = cnt := by
      rw [hs₂_frame (lw + (k + 1))
        (Or.inr (by have := hp_m_end.trans hptr_end; dsimp only [lw]; omega))
        (Or.inr (by dsimp only [lw]; omega))]
      simp only [s₁, lw, dfsNextClusterData, Data.set_mem, Data.write_mem, Function.update_self]
      omega
    have hs₂_prev : ∀ i : Fin (universeSize k), i.val < m + 1 →
        Rep (Tree.empty k) (ptr + clusterOffset k i.val) s₂.mem := by
      intro i hi
      by_cases him : i.val < m
      · apply rep_frame (hprev i him)
        intro a ha_lo ha_hi
        have hce := cluster_end_le_clusterOffset k him
        have hce_span := cluster_end_le_span k i.isLt
        have hp_m_eq : p_m = ptr + clusterOffset k m := by dsimp only [p_m, clusterOffset]; omega
        rw [hs₂_frame a (Or.inl (by omega)) (Or.inl (by omega))]
        exact hs₁_away a (by omega)
      · have hi_eq : i.val = m := by omega
        have hp_eq : ptr + clusterOffset k i.val = p_m := by
          dsimp only [p_m, clusterOffset]; rw [hi_eq]; omega
        simpa only [hp_eq] using hs₂_rep
    obtain ⟨s', hs'_state, hs'_cnt, hs'_all, hs'_frame, hs'_cps⟩ :=
      ih_cnt (m := m + 1) (s := s₂) (by omega)
        (hs₂_p_eq ▸ hs₂_state) hs₂_cnt hs₂_prev
    refine ⟨s', hs'_state, hs'_cnt, hs'_all, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a ha_tree ha_cnt
      have ha_tree₂ : a < ptr + 5 + (m + 1 + 1) * span k ∨ ptr + span (k + 1) ≤ a := by
        rcases ha_tree with hlt | hge
        · exact Or.inl (by omega)
        · exact Or.inr hge
      rw [hs'_frame a ha_tree₂ ha_cnt]
      have ha_tree₁ : a < p_m ∨ p_m + span k ≤ a := by
        rcases ha_tree with hlt | hge
        · exact Or.inl hlt
        · exact Or.inr (hp_m_end.trans hge)
      have ha_cnt₁ : a < lw + 1 ∨ lw + k < a := by omega
      rw [hs₂_frame a ha_tree₁ ha_cnt₁]
      exact hs₁_away a (by omega)
    · intro z T_cont hcont
      have h1 := hs'_cps z T_cont hcont
      have h2 := hs₂_cps z (cnt * (8 * span k) + T_cont) h1
      have h3 := ExecWithin.loop_iter (dfsState_cond_holds hs) hstep h2
      have h5_le := five_le_span k
      have hmul : (cnt + 1) * (8 * span k) = cnt * (8 * span k) + 8 * span k :=
        Nat.succ_mul cnt (8 * span k)
      exact h3.mono (by omega)

and reaches `DfsState base d (ptr + span k) k 1 s'` in at most `8 * span k - 15` instructions,

theorem insertLoop_spec {d w base key : ℕ} {tree : Tree d} {s : Data 32}
    (hs : InsertEntry base key s) (ht : tree.Valid) (hr : Rep tree base s.mem)
    (hkey : key < universeSize d) (ha : Fits w (base + span d)) :
    ∃ z, ExecWithin w insertLoop s z (39 * (d + 1) + 2) ∧
      Rep (tree.insert key) base z.mem ∧
      (∀ a, a < base ∨ base + span d ≤ a → z.mem a = s.mem a) := by
  induction d generalizing base key s with
  | zero =>
    have he := insertBody_exec hs ht hr hkey ha
    cases tree with
    | leaf b =>
      cases b with
      | none =>
        have hempty : s.mem base = 0 := hr.1
        have hmem_eq : (insertNext s base key).mem = writeBounds s.mem base (some (key, key)) := by
          simp [insertNext, hempty, writeBounds, Data.write_mem, Data.set_mem]
        apply insertLoop_finish hs he
        · simp +decide [insertNext, hempty]
        · rw [hmem_eq]
          simpa only [Tree.insert, Tree.withBounds] using rep_writeBounds hr (some (key, key))
        · intro a ha'
          rw [hmem_eq]
          exact writeBounds_away (some (key, key)) (by simp only [span_zero] at ha'; omega)
      | some bounds =>
        obtain ⟨m, M⟩ := bounds
        have ⟨hpres, ⟨hm, hM⟩, hq, _⟩ := hr
        have hle : m ≤ M := by
          have hext := ht.extrema
          simp only [Tree.Extrema, Tree.bounds] at hext
          exact hext.1
        by_cases heq : key = m
        · apply insertLoop_finish hs he
          · simp +decide [insertNext, hpres, hm, heq]
          · have hmem_eq : (insertNext s base key).mem = s.mem := by
              simp [insertNext, hpres, hm, heq]
            rw [hmem_eq]
            have hins : (Tree.leaf (some (m, M))).insert key = Tree.leaf (some (m, M)) := by
              simp only [Tree.insert, heq, min_self, max_eq_left hle]
            rw [hins]
            exact hr
          · intro a _
            simp [insertNext, hpres, hm, heq]
        · have hmem_eq : (insertNext s base key).mem =
              writeBounds s.mem base (some (min m key, max M key)) := by
            rw [← writeBounds_update_min_max hpres hm hM hle]
            simp only [insertNext, hpres, hm, hM, hq, splitSize, Option.isSome_some,
              ↓reduceIte, one_ne_zero, heq]
            split_ifs <;> rfl
          apply insertLoop_finish hs he
          · simp only [insertNext, hpres, hm, hM, hq, splitSize, Option.isSome_some,
              ↓reduceIte, one_ne_zero, heq]
            split_ifs <;> simp +decide
          · rw [hmem_eq]
            simpa only [Tree.insert, Tree.withBounds] using
              rep_writeBounds hr (some (min m key, max M key))
          · intro a ha'
            rw [hmem_eq]
            exact writeBounds_away (some (min m key, max M key))
              (by simp only [span_zero] at ha'; omega)
  | succ d ih =>
    have he := insertBody_exec hs ht hr hkey ha
    have finish (hk : (insertNext s base key).regs runFlag = 0)
        (hrep : Rep (tree.insert key) base (insertNext s base key).mem)
        (hframe : ∀ a, a < base ∨ base + span (d + 1) ≤ a →
          (insertNext s base key).mem a = s.mem a) :
        ∃ z, ExecWithin w insertLoop s z (39 * (d + 1 + 1) + 2) ∧
          Rep (tree.insert key) base z.mem ∧
          (∀ a, a < base ∨ base + span (d + 1) ≤ a → z.mem a = s.mem a) := by
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hr', hf'⟩ := insertLoop_finish hs he hk hrep hframe
      exact ⟨z, hz.mono (by omega), hr', hf'⟩
    cases tree with
    | node bounds summary cluster =>
      cases bounds with
      | none =>
        have hempty : s.mem base = 0 := hr.1.1
        have hmem_eq : (insertNext s base key).mem = writeBounds s.mem base (some (key, key)) := by
          simp [insertNext, hempty, writeBounds, Data.write_mem, Data.set_mem]
        apply finish
        · simp +decide [insertNext, hempty]
        · rw [hmem_eq]

theorem memberLoop_spec {d w base query : ℕ} {tree : Tree d} {s : Data 32}
    (hs : MemberEntry base query s) (ht : tree.Valid) (hr : Rep tree base s.mem)
    (ha : Fits w (base + span d)) :
    ∃ z, ExecWithin w memberLoop s z (28 * (d + 1) + 2) ∧
      z.regs out = (if tree.member query then 1 else 0) ∧ z.mem = s.mem := by
  induction d generalizing base query s with
  | zero =>
    have he := memberBody_exec hs ht hr ha
    cases tree with
    | leaf b =>
      cases b with
      | none =>
        have hempty : s.mem base = 0 := hr.1
        apply memberLoop_finish hs he
        · simp +decide [memberNext, hempty]
        · simp +decide [memberNext, hempty, Tree.member, hs.out_eq]
      | some bounds =>
        obtain ⟨m, M⟩ := bounds
        obtain ⟨hpres, ⟨hm, hM⟩, hq, _⟩ := hr
        have hk : (memberNext s base query).regs runFlag = 0 := by
          simp only [memberNext, hpres, hm, hM, hq, splitSize,
            Option.isSome_some, ↓reduceIte]
          split_ifs <;> simp +decide
        apply memberLoop_finish hs he hk
        simp only [memberNext, hpres, hm, hM, hq, splitSize,
          Option.isSome_some, ↓reduceIte, Tree.member]
        split_ifs <;> simp_all +decide [hs.out_eq]
  | succ d ih =>
    have he := memberBody_exec hs ht hr ha
    have finish (hk : (memberNext s base query).regs runFlag = 0)
        (hout : (memberNext s base query).regs out = (if tree.member query then 1 else 0)) :
        ∃ z, ExecWithin w memberLoop s z (28 * (d + 1 + 1) + 2) ∧
          z.regs out = (if tree.member query then 1 else 0) ∧ z.mem = s.mem := by
      obtain ⟨z, hz, ho, hm⟩ := memberLoop_finish hs he hk hout
      exact ⟨z, hz.mono (by omega), ho, hm⟩
    cases tree with
    | node bounds summary cluster =>
      cases bounds with
      | none =>
        have hempty : s.mem base = 0 := hr.1.1
        apply finish
        · simp +decide [memberNext, hempty]
        · simp +decide [memberNext, hempty, Tree.member, hs.out_eq]
      | some bounds =>
        obtain ⟨m, M⟩ := bounds
        obtain ⟨hpres, ⟨hm, hM⟩, hq, hspan⟩ := hr.1
        by_cases hmin : query = m
        · apply finish
          · simp +decide [memberNext, hpres, hm, hmin]
          · simp +decide [memberNext, hpres, hm, hmin, Tree.member]
        by_cases hmax : query = M
        · have hn : M ≠ m := by simpa only [hmax] using hmin
          have hmem := member_maximum ht rfl
          apply finish
          · simp +decide [memberNext, hpres, hm, hM, hmax, hn]
          · simp +decide [memberNext, hpres, hm, hM, hmax, hn, hmem]
        by_cases hlt : query < M
        · have hi := (member_descent_safe ht hr (by simpa only [hM] using hlt)).1
          let i : Fin (universeSize d) := ⟨query / universeSize d, hi⟩
          let next := memberNext s base query
          have hqne : universeSize d ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (universeSize_pos d)
          have hentry : MemberEntry (base + clusterOffset d i.val)
              (query % universeSize d) next := by
            obtain ⟨hz, ho, ht, hthree, hfour, hfive⟩ := memberNext_constants hs
            refine ⟨hz, ho, ht, hthree, hfour, hfive, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>

                hs.out_eq, hs.runFlag_eq]
          have hrep : Rep (cluster i) (base + clusterOffset d i.val) next.mem := by
            simpa only [next, memberNext_mem] using hr.2.2 i
          have hfit : Fits w (base + clusterOffset d i.val + span d) :=

          obtain ⟨z, hz, ho, hmem⟩ := ih hentry (ht.2.2.1 i) hrep hfit
          refine ⟨z, (he.loop_iter (cond := .lt zero runFlag) ?_ hz).mono (by omega),
            ?_, hmem.trans (memberNext_mem _ _ _)⟩
          · simp only [Cond.holds_lt, hs.zero_eq, hs.runFlag_eq]
            decide
          · simpa only [Tree.member, hmin, hi, ↓reduceDIte, ↓reduceIte] using ho
        · have habsent := member_eq_false_of_max_lt (query := query) ht rfl (by omega)
          apply finish

            hz, ho, htwo, hthree, hfour, hfive, hsp_eq, hp, hx,

private theorem successor_some_spec {d w stackBase₀ sp₀ base query ans : ℕ} {tree : Tree d}

    (hr : Rep tree base s.mem) (hans : tree.successor query = some ans)
    (hsp_le : stackBase₀ ≤ sp₀) (hdisj : base + span d ≤ sp₀) (hfit : Fits w (sp₀ + 4 * d)) :
    ∃ s₁ s₃, ExecWithin w successorDescent s s₁ (44 * (d + 1) + 2) ∧

      ∀ z T, ExecWithin w successorUnwind s₃ z T →

  | zero =>
    have ha : Fits w (base + span 0) := hfit.of_le (by omega)

    have hheader := hr.header

    | leaf b =>
      cases b with
      | none => simp [Tree.successor] at hans

        have hconst := successorDescentNext_constants hs

          simp only [s₁, successorDescentNext, hpres, hm, hM, hq, splitSize]
          split_ifs <;> rfl

          simp only [successorDescentNext, hpres, hm, hM, hq, splitSize, ↓reduceIte]
          split_ifs <;> rfl

          simp only [Tree.successor] at hans
          simp only [s₁, successorDescentNext, hpres, hm, hM, hq, splitSize, ↓reduceIte]

          split_ifs <;> exact hs.sp_eq

          hsp₁, hfound₁.1, hfound₁.2, rfl⟩, ?_⟩

            (by omega)
          · simp only [Cond.holds_lt, hs.zero_eq, hs.runFlag_eq]
            decide
          · simp only [Cond.holds_lt, hconst.1, hk, lt_self_iff_false, not_false_eq_true]
        · intro a _
          rw [hmem₁]
        · intro z T hcont
          simpa only [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_add] using hcont
  | succ d ih =>
    have ha : Fits w (base + span (d + 1)) := hfit.of_le (by omega)
    have he := successorDescentBody_exec hs ht hr ha hfit
    have hheader := hr.header

    | node bounds summary cluster =>
      cases bounds with
      | none => simp [Tree.successor] at hans
      | some bounds =>

        have hconst := successorDescentNext_constants hs

            have := hans

          have hk : (successorDescentNext s sp₀ base query).regs runFlag = 0 := by
            simp +decide [successorDescentNext, hpres, hm, hlt_m]

            simp +decide [next, successorDescentNext, hpres, hm, hlt_m, hans_eq]

private theorem synthesis_stage_succ (t : ℕ) :
    Synthesis (interp K n) (inputs (n * n) ∪ (constants K n ∪ stageSet K n t))
      (stageSet K n (t + 1)) (n * n * (3 * n + 3)) := by
  set s := inputs (n * n) ∪ (constants K n ∪ stageSet K n t)
  have hA (i j : Fin n) : (fun x => entries x i j) ∈ s := Or.inl ⟨finProdFinEquiv (i, j), rfl⟩
  have hF (i j : Fin n) : (fun x => stage t x i j) ∈ s := Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
  have h0 : (fun _ => 0) ∈ s := Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inl rfl))
  have hm1 : (fun _ => -1) ∈ s := Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inr rfl))
  have hentry (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
      Synthesis (interp K n) s {fun x => stage (t + 1) x p.1 p.2} (3 * n + 3) := by
    obtain ⟨i, j⟩ := p
    have hD := Synthesis.arith_sum (constant := C) (Finset.Ioi i) (fun k x => stage t x k k)
      (fun _ => 0) h0 fun k _ => Synthesis.of_mem (hF k k)
    have hnegD := Synthesis.combine (Synthesis.of_mem (I := interp K n) hm1) hD
      (Synthesis.arith_mul (Set.mem_insert _ _) (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))
    have hP := Synthesis.combine hnegD (Synthesis.of_mem (I := interp K n) (hA i j))
      (Synthesis.arith_mul (Set.mem_insert _ _) (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))
    have hT := Synthesis.arith_sum (constant := C) (Finset.Ioi i)
      (fun k x => stage t x i k * entries x k j) (fun _ => 1) h0
      fun k _ => Synthesis.arith_mul (hF i k) (hA k j)
    have hE := Synthesis.combine hP hT
      (Synthesis.arith_add (Set.mem_insert _ _) (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))
    refine hE.mono Set.Subset.rfl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (funext fun x => ?_)) ?_
    · simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', BirdDet.Spec.stepEntry_eq, Matrix.of_apply]
      ring
    · have hcard : (Finset.Ioi i).card ≤ n := (Finset.card_le_univ _).trans (by simp)
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
      lia
  have := Synthesis.family _ _ hentry
  simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin,
    smul_eq_mul] using this

private theorem synthesis_stages (t : ℕ) :
    Synthesis (interp K n) (inputs (n * n)) (constants K n ∪ stageSet K n t)
      (2 + t * (n * n * (3 * n + 3))) := by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    have h0 : Synthesis (interp K n) (inputs (n * n)) {fun _ => 0} 1 := by
      simpa only [map_zero] using synthesis_const (n := n) (0 : K)
    have hm1 : Synthesis (interp K n) (inputs (n * n)) {fun _ => -1} 1 := by
      simpa only [map_neg, map_one] using synthesis_const (n := n) (-1 : K)
    have hA : Synthesis (interp K n) (inputs (n * n)) (stageSet K n 0) 0 :=
      Synthesis.of_subset (by rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨finProdFinEquiv (i, j), rfl⟩)
    exact ((h0.union hm1).union hA).mono Set.Subset.rfl
      (by rw [constants, Set.insert_eq]) (by simp)
  | succ t ih =>

theorem exists_circuit_pow_two_pow (n : ℕ) : ∃ c : Circuit (arithSignature K) 1 1,
    c.polynomial 0 = (powTwoPowFamily K).poly n ∧ c.size ≤ n := by
  have h : ∀ t, Synthesis (arithInterpretationWith K C) (inputs 1)
      {fun x : Fin 1 → MvPolynomial (Fin 1) K => x 0 ^ 2 ^ t} t := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero =>
      simpa using Synthesis.of_mem (I := arithInterpretationWith K C)
        (show (fun x : Fin 1 → MvPolynomial (Fin 1) K => x 0) ∈ inputs 1 from ⟨0, rfl⟩)
    | succ t ih =>
      have hsq : (fun x : Fin 1 → MvPolynomial (Fin 1) K => x 0 ^ 2 ^ (t + 1)) =
          fun x => x 0 ^ 2 ^ t * x 0 ^ 2 ^ t := by
        funext x
        rw [pow_succ, pow_mul, sq]
      rw [hsq]
      exact ih.trans (Synthesis.arith_mul (Set.mem_union_right _ rfl) (Set.mem_union_right _ rfl))
  exact (h n).exists_circuit_polynomial

    have hM : (((majorityDeMorganCircuit (K + (K + 2))).mapOp deMorganToUnbounded).depth) ≤

      rw [Circuit.depth_mapOp]

    change (modCircuitOfMajority (Signature.Hom.id _) q

      _ = 2100 * (max q 1) ^ 3 * (n + C.size + 1) ^ 4 := by ring

  rintro L ⟨c, s, hs, hC⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := PolynomiallyBounded.exists_clog_le_mul_log
    (s := fun n => 2 * max q 1 * (n + s n) + 3) (by fun_prop)
  refine ⟨(23 * e + 6) * c, fun n => s n * (2100 * (max q 1 * (n + s n) + 1) ^ 3),
    by fun_prop, fun n => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hCc, hCd, hCs⟩ := hC n
  obtain ⟨D, hDe, hDs, hDd⟩ := Unbounded.exists_unbounded_simulation_modGate q C
  refine ⟨D, fun x => (congrFun hDe x).trans (hCc x), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hmono := Nat.add_le_add_right
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * max q 1) (Nat.add_le_add_left hCs n)) 3
    have hclog : Nat.clog 2 (2 * max q 1 * (n + C.size) + 3) ≤ e * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) :=
      (Nat.clog_mono_right 2 hmono).trans (he n)
    have hlog : 6 + 23 * Nat.clog 2 (2 * max q 1 * (n + C.size) + 3) ≤
        (23 * e + 6) * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) := by nlinarith
    calc D.depth ≤ (6 + 23 * Nat.clog 2 (2 * max q 1 * (n + C.size) + 3)) * C.depth := hDd
      _ ≤ ((23 * e + 6) * (Nat.log 2 n + 1)) * (c * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) ^ i) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul hlog hCd
      _ = (23 * e + 6) * c * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) ^ (i + 1) := by ring

/-- **Simulating `SIZEMod q` in De Morgan `SIZE`**: a circuit with `MOD_q` gates of size at most
`c * (n + 1) ^ k` is simulated by a fan-in-two De Morgan circuit of size at most
`(2100 * (max q 1) ^ 3) ^ 2 * (c + 1) ^ 8 * (n + 1) ^ (8 * (k + 1))`. -/

theorem SIZEMod_subset_SIZE (q c k : ℕ) :
    SIZEMod q (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ k) ⊆
      SIZE (fun n => (2100 * (max q 1) ^ 3) ^ 2 * (c + 1) ^ 8 * (n + 1) ^ (8 * (k + 1))) := by
  intro L hL n
  obtain ⟨C, hCc, hCs⟩ := hL n
  obtain ⟨D, hDe, hDs⟩ := Unbounded.exists_deMorgan_simulation_modGate q C
  have hDc : D.Computes Boolean.interpretation (single (L.slice n)) :=
    fun x => (congrFun hDe x).trans (hCc x)
  refine (complexity_le_of_computes D hDc).trans (hDs.trans ?_)
  have hn1 : n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (k + 1) := by
    calc n + 1 = (n + 1) ^ 1 := (pow_one _).symm
      _ ≤ (n + 1) ^ (k + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (Nat.succ_pos k)
  have hk1 : (n + 1) ^ k ≤ (n + 1) ^ (k + 1) :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (Nat.le_succ k)
  have hsum : n + C.size + 1 ≤ (c + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (k + 1) := by
    dsimp only at hCs
    calc n + C.size + 1 ≤ (n + 1) + c * (n + 1) ^ k := by omega
      _ ≤ 1 * (n + 1) ^ (k + 1) + c * (n + 1) ^ (k + 1) := by
        rw [one_mul]
        exact Nat.add_le_add hn1 (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c hk1)
      _ = (c + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (k + 1) := by ring
  calc (2100 * (max q 1) ^ 3) ^ 2 * (n + C.size + 1) ^ 8
      ≤ (2100 * (max q 1) ^ 3) ^ 2 * ((c + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (k + 1)) ^ 8 :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hsum 8)
    _ = (2100 * (max q 1) ^ 3) ^ 2 * (c + 1) ^ 8 * (n + 1) ^ (8 * (k + 1)) := by
        rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
        ring

theorem PPoly.of_advice {L M : Language Bool} (hM : M ∈ PPoly) (α : ℕ → List Bool)
    (hα : PolynomiallyBounded fun n => (α n).length)
    (h : ∀ x, x ∈ L ↔ frame (α x.length) ++ x ∈ M) : L ∈ PPoly := by
  set q := fun N => complexity interpretation (single (M.slice N))
  have hq : PolynomiallyBounded q := hM
  refine PolynomiallyBounded.mono_of_le (g := fun n => q (2 * (α n).length + 1 + n) + 2)
    (by fun_prop) fun n => ?_
  let a : Fin (frame (α n)).length → Bool := fun j => (frame (α n))[j]
  have ha : List.ofFn a = frame (α n) := List.ofFn_getElem
  have hslice : L.slice n = fun x => M.slice ((frame (α n)).length + n)
      (substitute (prependInputs a) x) := by
    funext x
    rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, Language.slice_eq_true_iff, Language.slice_eq_true_iff,
      substitute_prependInputs, List.ofFn_fin_append, h, List.length_ofFn, ha]
  have hc := complexity_substitute_le (prependInputs a) (M.slice ((frame (α n)).length + n))
  rwa [← hslice, length_frame] at hc

theorem computableInPolyTime_evalAdvice {γ : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {s width : γ → ℕ} {w x : γ → List Bool} (hs : ComputableInPolyTime s encIn encUnary)
    (hwidth : ComputableInPolyTime width encIn encUnary)

      encBool := by

/-- **Advice strings for `P/poly` up to a polynomial length bound.** For any language `L ∈ P/poly`
and polynomial `N : Polynomial ℕ`, there exist polynomials `S W P : Polynomial ℕ` (for the circuit
size bound, block width, and total advice length) and an advice family `α : ℕ → List Bool` of
polynomial length `(α n).length = P.eval n` such that `evalAdvice (S.eval n) (W.eval n) (α n) x`
decides `x ∈ L` for every `n` and every word `x` of length at most `N.eval n`. -/

theorem PPoly.exists_evalAdvice {L : Language Bool} (hL : L ∈ PPoly) (N : Polynomial ℕ) :
    ∃ (S W P : Polynomial ℕ) (α : ℕ → List Bool),
      (∀ n, (α n).length = P.eval n) ∧
      PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => (α n).length) ∧
      ∀ n (x : List Bool), x.length ≤ N.eval n →
        (evalAdvice (S.eval n) (W.eval n) (α n) x = true ↔ x ∈ L) := by
  obtain ⟨C, s, hs, hC⟩ := mem_PPoly_iff_exists_circuits.1 hL
  obtain ⟨c, d, hcd⟩ := polynomiallyBounded_iff_le.1 hs
  let S : Polynomial ℕ := Polynomial.C c * (N + 1) ^ d
  let W : Polynomial ℕ := S + (N + S) + S * (3 + 2 * (N + S))
  let P : Polynomial ℕ := (N + 1) * W
  have hS (n : ℕ) : S.eval n = c * (N.eval n + 1) ^ d := by
    simp only [S, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_pow,
      Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_one]
  have hW (n : ℕ) : W.eval n = certLength (N.eval n) (S.eval n) := by
    simp only [W, certLength, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_ofNat]
  have hP (n : ℕ) : P.eval n = (N.eval n + 1) * certLength (N.eval n) (S.eval n) := by
    simp only [P, hW, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_one]
  have hsize (n : ℕ) : ∀ m ≤ N.eval n, (C m).size ≤ S.eval n := fun m hm =>
    ((hC m).1.trans (hcd m)).trans (by
      rw [hS]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right hm 1) d))
  let α : ℕ → List Bool := fun n => familyAdvice (N.eval n) (S.eval n) C
  have hlen (n : ℕ) : (α n).length = P.eval n :=
    (length_familyAdvice (hsize n)).trans (hP n).symm
  have hα : PolynomiallyBounded fun n => (α n).length := by
    have hfun : (fun n => (α n).length) = fun n => P.eval n := funext hlen
    rw [hfun]
    fun_prop
  refine ⟨S, W, P, α, hlen, hα, fun n x hx => ?_⟩
  rw [hW, evalAdvice_familyAdvice (hsize n) hx, (hC _).2, single_apply,
    Language.slice_eq_true_iff]
  simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, List.ofFn_getElem]

polynomial size has polynomial advice. -/

theorem PPoly_subset_PAdvice : PPoly ⊆ PAdvice := by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨S, W, _, α, -, hα, h_eval⟩ := PPoly.exists_evalAdvice hL Polynomial.X
  refine ⟨α, hα, {p : List Bool × List Bool |
    evalAdvice (S.eval p.2.length) (W.eval p.2.length) p.1 p.2 = true}, ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨fun p => evalAdvice (S.eval p.2.length) (W.eval p.2.length) p.1 p.2,
      ?_, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
    have hx : ComputableInPolyTime Prod.snd (encPair encBits encBits) encBits :=
      ComputableInPolyTime.snd _ _
    exact computableInPolyTime_evalAdvice_eval S W (length_bits.comp hx)
      (ComputableInPolyTime.fst _ _) hx
  · exact (h_eval x.length x (by simp)).symm

private theorem initialState_W_le (C : Circuit (fullSignature 2 Bool) n 1) :
    (initialState C).W ≤ 2 * C.size + 7 * n := by
  have hs : (initialState C).s = C.size := by
    simp [State.s, SemiCircuit.size, initialState]
  have hq : (initialState C).q = 0 := by simp [State.q, initialState]
  unfold State.W
  rw [hs, hq]
  have : ∑ x ∈ (initialState C).unpaired, weight ((initialState C).deg x) ≤ 7 * n := by
    calc ∑ x ∈ (initialState C).unpaired, weight ((initialState C).deg x)
        ≤ ∑ _x ∈ (initialState C).unpaired, 7 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => weight_le_seven _
      _ = 7 * (initialState C).unpaired.card := by rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      _ ≤ 7 * n := by
        have : (initialState C).unpaired.card ≤ n :=
          (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans (by simp [initialState])
        omega
  omega

theorem Reduction.wt_add_le_fixInput {S S' : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) (hN : S.Normal)
    {G x y : ℕ} (h : S.MinimalAnd G x y) (h7 : ¬ S.SharedSecondChild G x y)
    (hred : Reduction f S S' {x} (.inl G :: (S.fixInputDeleted G x).toList)
      (S.fixInputDeleted G x).toList) {u : ℕ} (hux : u ≠ x) :
    S'.wt u + (if u = y ∧ S.deg x = 2 then 1 else 0) ≤
      S.wt u + (if S.IsolatedBelow G u then 1 else 0) := by
  by_cases huy : u = y ∧ S.deg x = 2
  · -- `y` keeps only its second child
    obtain ⟨rfl, hx2⟩ := huy
    have hy2 : S.deg u = 2 := le_antisymm (hx2 ▸ h.deg_le) h.deg_y
    rw [ite_eq_left ⟨rfl, hx2⟩, ite_eq_right fun hg => by
      have := hg.2.1; omega]
    have hT : ∀ N ∈ (S.fixInputDeleted G x).toList, N ∉ S.children u := by
      intro N hNL hNy
      rw [Finset.mem_toList, fixInputDeleted, Finset.mem_union] at hNL
      rcases hNL with hNx | hNG
      · exact h7 ⟨hx2, N, Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hNx, Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hNx, hNy⟩
      · obtain ⟨K, hK, rfl, hKG⟩ := h.eq_inl_of_mem_children hS hNG
        exact (h.children K hK hKG).2 ((SemiCircuit.inl_mem_children _).1 hNy).2
    have hcard : (S.children u \ (Sum.inl G :: (S.fixInputDeleted G x).toList).toFinset).card
        ≤ 1 := by
      have hsub : S.children u \ (Sum.inl G :: (S.fixInputDeleted G x).toList).toFinset ⊆
          (S.children u).erase (.inl G) := fun N hN' =>
        Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨fun he => (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hN').2 (by simp [he]),
          (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hN').1⟩
      have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem h.mem_children_y] at this
      change _ ≤ S.deg u - 1 at this
      omega
    have hwt := (hred.wt_le_weight (fun N hN' => hT N (by simpa using hN'))).trans
      (weight_mono hcard)
    rw [weight_one] at hwt
    rw [wt_of_mem h.unpaired_y, weight_of_two_le hy2.ge]
    omega
  · rw [ite_eq_right huy]
    by_cases hg : S.IsolatedBelow G u
    · -- an isolated parameter below `G` gains at most one
      rw [ite_eq_left hg, wt_of_mem hg.1, hg.2.1, weight_one]
      have := S'.wt_le_seven u
      omega
    · rw [ite_eq_right hg]
      by_cases hu' : u ∈ S.unpaired
      · refine Nat.add_le_add_right (hred.wt_le_wt hu' fun N hNL hNu => ?_) 0
        rw [Finset.mem_toList, fixInputDeleted, Finset.mem_union] at hNL
        rcases hNL with hNx | hNG
        · exact hN.exclusive.two_le_deg hu' hNu h.mem_params_x (Ne.symm hux)
            (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hNx)
        · have h1 : 1 ≤ S.deg u := Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨N, hNu⟩
          by_contra hlt
          exact hg ⟨hu', by omega, N, hNG, hNu⟩
      · rw [hred.wt_eq_zero hS hu' fun w hw hwu => by
          rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hw; subst hw
          exact (mem_unpaired.1 h.unpaired_x).2 hwu.paired]
        omega

isolated parameter lies below `G`. -/

text:
theorem Valid.step_fixInput {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) (hN : S.Normal) {G x y : ℕ}
    (h : S.MinimalAnd G x y) (h7 : ¬ S.SharedSecondChild G x y) (hbot : ¬ S.Bottleneck G x) :
    ∃ S', Step f S S' := by
  have hxu : ¬ S.Paired x := (mem_unpaired.1 h.unpaired_x).2
  have hx2 : 2 ≤ S.deg x := h.deg_y.trans h.deg_le
  obtain ⟨S', hred⟩ := hS.exists_reduction_fixInput h
  refine ⟨S', hred.step hS (by simp) (by simp) ?_⟩
  have hW := hred.W_le (fun u => if u = y ∧ S.deg x = 2 then 1 else 0)
    (fun u => if S.IsolatedBelow G u then 1 else 0) fun u hu =>
      hred.wt_add_le_fixInput hS hN h h7 (by simpa using (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hu).2)
  have hgain := hS.card_isolated_le h.mem (S.params \ {x}) Finset.sdiff_subset
  rw [Finset.card_filter] at hgain
  have hk : 1 ≤ S.deg G := by
    obtain ⟨K, hK, hKG⟩ := h.has_child
    exact Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨_, (SemiCircuit.inl_mem_children _).2 ⟨hK, hKG⟩⟩
  have hym : y ∈ S.params \ {x} := Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨h.mem_params_y, by simpa using h.ne.symm⟩
  have hloss : ∑ u ∈ S.params \ {x}, (if u = y ∧ S.deg x = 2 then 1 else 0) =
      if S.deg x = 2 then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hx2' : S.deg x = 2
    · simp only [hx2', and_true, ite_true]
      exact Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem' _ _ _ hym
    · simp [hx2']
  rw [hloss, Finset.sum_singleton, wt_of_mem h.unpaired_x, weight_of_two_le hx2,
    hS.card_pairsMeeting_singleton, ite_eq_right hxu, h.length_fixInput hS] at hW
  rw [Finset.card_singleton, hS.card_pairsMeeting_singleton, ite_eq_right hxu]
  by_cases hx2' : S.deg x = 2
  · rw [ite_eq_left hx2'] at hW
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 (S.deg G) with hG2 | hG1
    · omega
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun u _ => ite_eq_right
        (h.not_isolatedBelow hS hbot hx2' (by omega))] at hW
      omega
  · rw [ite_eq_right hx2'] at hW
    omega

private theorem QuadOK.wt_add_le {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) {x y z G D : ℕ} {α β γ c : Bool}
    (h : S.QuadOK x y z G D α β γ c) (hx : 2 ≤ S.deg x) (hy : 2 ≤ S.deg y) :
    ∀ u ∈ insert D S.params, (S.quad x y z G D α β γ c).wt u + ((if u = x then 7 else 0) +
      (if u = y then 7 else 0) + (if u = z then 6 else 0)) ≤ S.wt u + (if u = D then 7 else 0) := by
  have hDp := hS.wf.notMem_params_of_mem_gates h.mem_D
  have hDz : D ≠ z := fun he => hDp (he ▸ h.mem_z)
  have hDx : D ≠ x := fun he => hDp (he ▸ h.mem_x)
  have hDy : D ≠ y := fun he => hDp (he ▸ h.mem_y)
  have hpaired : ∀ {u}, u = x ∨ u = y → (S.quad x y z G D α β γ c).Paired u := fun hu =>
    ⟨(x, y), Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, hu.imp Eq.symm Eq.symm⟩
  intro u _
  by_cases hux : u = x
  · subst hux
    rw [wt_of_paired (hpaired (Or.inl rfl)), wt_of_mem (mem_unpaired.2 ⟨h.mem_x, h.unpaired_x⟩),
      weight_of_two_le hx]
    simp [h.x_ne_y, h.x_ne_z, hDx.symm]
  by_cases huy : u = y
  · subst huy
    rw [wt_of_paired (hpaired (Or.inr rfl)), wt_of_mem (mem_unpaired.2 ⟨h.mem_y, h.unpaired_y⟩),
      weight_of_two_le hy]
    simp [h.x_ne_y.symm, h.y_ne_z, hDy.symm]
  by_cases huz : u = z
  · rw [huz] at hux huy ⊢
    have hdz : S.deg z = 1 := by rw [SemiCircuit.deg, h.children_z, Finset.card_singleton]
    rw [wt_of_notMem_params (show z ∉ (S.quad x y z G D α β γ c).params by
      simp [quad_params, hDz.symm]), wt_of_mem (mem_unpaired.2 ⟨h.mem_z, h.unpaired_z⟩), hdz,
      weight_one]
    simp [hux, huy, hDz.symm]
  rw [ite_eq_right hux, ite_eq_right huy, ite_eq_right huz]
  by_cases huD : u = D
  · rw [huD, wt_of_notMem_params hDp, ite_eq_left rfl]
    have := (S.quad x y z G D α β γ c).wt_le_seven D
    omega
  · rw [ite_eq_right huD]
    by_cases hu' : u ∈ (S.quad x y z G D α β γ c).unpaired
    · obtain ⟨hup, hun⟩ := mem_unpaired.1 hu'
      have hup' : u ∈ S.params := by
        simp only [quad_params, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_erase] at hup
        exact (hup.resolve_left huD).2
      have hus : u ∈ S.unpaired := mem_unpaired.2 ⟨hup', fun ⟨pr, hpr, hu⟩ =>
        hun ⟨pr, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hpr, hu⟩⟩
      rw [wt_of_mem hu', wt_of_mem hus]
      exact Nat.add_le_add_right (weight_mono (Finset.card_le_card
        ((quad_children_subset S x y z G D α β γ c u).trans
          ((Finset.erase_subset _ _).trans (Finset.erase_subset _ _))))) _
    · rw [wt_of_notMem hu']
      omega

degree at least two, is a step of gate elimination: `Δa = -1`, `ΔW ≤ -14`. -/

private theorem Valid.exists_reduction_bottleneck_and {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) {G x y D : ℕ}
    (h : S.MinimalAnd G x y) (hD : D ∈ S.gates) (hDG' : D ≠ G)
    {δ c : Bool} (hc : ∀ val : ℕ → Bool, val G = δ → (S.gate D).eval val = c)
    {x₀ y₀ : Bool} (hδ : (S.gate G).eval (Function.update (Function.update (fun _ => false) y y₀)
      x x₀) = δ) {Bx By : ℕ ⊕ ℕ} (hBx : Bx ∈ S.children x) (hBy : By ∈ S.children y)
    (hBxG : Bx ≠ .inl G) (hByG : By ≠ .inl G) (hBxy : Bx ≠ By) (hBxD : Bx ≠ .inl D)
    (hByD : By ≠ .inl D) : ∃ S', Reduction f S S' {x, y} [.inl G, .inl D, Bx, By] [Bx, By] := by
  have hxG := h.ne_gate hS h.mem_params_x
  have hyG := h.ne_gate hS h.mem_params_y
  obtain ⟨φ, -, hGφ⟩ := h.exists_op
  rw [hGφ, Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne h.ne.symm, Function.update_self] at hδ
  have h₁ := hS.reduction_fixConst h.mem_params_x x₀
  have h₂ := h₁.valid.reduction_fixConst (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨h.ne.symm, h.mem_params_y⟩) y₀
  have h₃ := h₂.valid.reduction_deleteConst (J := G) (c := δ) h.mem fun val _ => by
    rw [fixConst_gate, Gate.eval_subst_const, fixConst_gate, Gate.eval_subst_const, hGφ,
      Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne h.ne.symm, Function.update_self]
    exact hδ
  have h₄ := h₃.valid.reduction_deleteConst (J := D) (c := c)
    (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hDG', hD⟩) fun val _ => by
      rw [deleteGate_gate, Gate.eval_subst_const, fixConst_gate, Gate.eval_subst_const,
        fixConst_gate, Gate.eval_subst_const]
      exact hc _ (by rw [Function.update_of_ne hxG.symm, Function.update_of_ne hyG.symm,
        Function.update_self])
  obtain ⟨S', h₅⟩ := h₄.valid.exists_reduction_deleteAll [Bx, By] (by simp [hBxy]) (by
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
    rintro N (rfl | rfl)
    · exact h₄.deletable _ (by simpa using hBxD) (h₃.deletable _ (by simpa using hBxG)
        (h₂.deletable _ (by simp) (deletable_fixConst_child hS _ x₀ hBx)))
    · exact h₄.deletable _ (by simpa using hByD) (h₃.deletable _ (by simpa using hByG)
        (deletable_fixConst_child h₁.valid _ y₀
          (by rw [fixConst_children _ _ h.ne.symm]; exact hBy))))
  have hred := (((h₁.trans h₂).trans_delete h₃).trans_delete h₄).trans_delete h₅
  rw [← Finset.insert_eq] at hred
  exact ⟨S', hred⟩

/-- **Case 9** of [Mishra and Santhanam, Section 4.3][MishraSanthanam2026]: in the bottleneck
configuration with `D` AND-type, fix `x` and `y` so that `D` becomes constant and delete `G`, `D`
and the second children of `x` and `y`; `z` becomes unused: `Δa = -2`, `ΔW ≤ -28`. -/

theorem Valid.step_of_bottleneck_xor {S : State n} {d : ℕ} (hS : S.Valid f)
    (hf : IsAffineDisperser f d) (ha : d < S.a) (hN : S.Normal) {G x y D z : ℕ}
    (h : S.MinimalAnd G x y) (hDiff : ∀ K ∈ S.gates, (S.gate K).Reads G ↔ K = D)
    (hD : D ∈ S.gates) (hz : z ∈ S.unpaired) (hz1 : S.deg z = 1) (hDz : (S.gate D).Reads z)
    (hDaff : IsAffineOp (S.gate D).op) : ∃ S', Step f S S' := by
  have hDG : (S.gate D).Reads G := (hDiff D hD).2 rfl
  obtain ⟨hcG, hcz⟩ := h.children_of_bottleneck hS hDiff hD hz1 hDz
  have hzp := (mem_unpaired.1 hz).1
  have hDargs := Gate.args_of_reads (h.ne_gate hS hzp) hDz hDG
  obtain ⟨c, hDc⟩ := exists_xor_form hDaff
    (fun hun => hN.no_deletion (deletionAvailable_of_unary hD hun))
    (by
      by_contra hconst
      push Not at hconst
      exact hN.no_deletion (deletionAvailable_of_const_op hD hconst))
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hGφ⟩ := h.exists_op
  obtain ⟨α, β, γ, hform⟩ := exists_and_form hφ
  refine ⟨_, hS.step_quad (x := x) (y := y) (z := z) (G := G) (D := D) (α := α) (β := β)
    (γ := γ) (c := c)
    { mem_x := h.mem_params_x
      mem_y := h.mem_params_y
      mem_z := hzp
      unpaired_x := (mem_unpaired.1 h.unpaired_x).2
      unpaired_y := (mem_unpaired.1 h.unpaired_y).2
      unpaired_z := (mem_unpaired.1 hz).2
      x_ne_y := h.ne
      x_ne_z := fun he => (h.children D hD hDG).1 (he ▸ hDz)
      y_ne_z := fun he => (h.children D hD hDG).2 (he ▸ hDz)
      mem_G := h.mem
      mem_D := hD
      G_ne_D := fun he => hS.not_reads_self h.mem (he ▸ hDG)
      eval_G := fun val => by
        rw [hGφ, hform]
        cases val x <;> cases val y <;> cases α <;> cases β <;> cases γ <;> rfl
      eval_D := fun val => by
        rcases hDargs with ⟨hl, hr⟩ | ⟨hl, hr⟩ <;>
        · rw [Gate.eval_of_args hl hr, hDc]
          cases val G <;> cases val z <;> cases c <;> rfl
      children_G := hcG
      children_z := hcz
      out_G := h.not_out
      out_z := hS.not_out_reads_param hf ha hzp }
    (h.deg_y.trans h.deg_le) h.deg_y⟩

/-- **Cases 9 and 10** of [Mishra and Santhanam, Section 4.3][MishraSanthanam2026], the
bottleneck configuration: the unique child `D` of the minimal AND `G` reads an unpaired isolated
parameter `z`; its elimination is a step. -/

theorem Valid.exists_minGate {S : State n} {d : ℕ} (hS : S.Valid f) (hf : IsAffineDisperser f d)
    (ha : d < S.a) (hmov : ∀ J, ¬ S.Movable J) (hdel : ¬ S.DeletionAvailable) :
    ∃ h : S.gates.Nonempty, ¬ IsAffineOp (S.gate (S.gates.min' h)).op ∧
      ∃ t₁ t₂, (S.gate (S.gates.min' h)).left = .node t₁ ∧
        (S.gate (S.gates.min' h)).right = .node t₂ ∧ t₁ ≠ t₂ ∧
        t₁ ∈ S.params ∪ S.aux ∧ t₂ ∈ S.params ∪ S.aux := by
  have hne : S.gates.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hempty
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hempty
    rcases hout : S.out.arg with b | t
    · refine hS.out_not_affine hf ha (b ^^ S.out.neg) (Finset.empty_subset _) fun val _ => ?_
      simp [Lit.eval, hout]
    · have hlive := hS.wf.out_live t hout
      simp only [SemiCircuit.live, Finset.mem_union, hempty, Finset.notMem_empty, or_false]
        at hlive
      rcases hlive with hp | hv
      · exact hS.not_out_reads_param hf ha hp hout
      · exact hS.not_out_reads_aux hf ha hv hout
  set G := S.gates.min' hne
  have hG : G ∈ S.gates := Finset.min'_mem _ _
  have hmin : ∀ i, (S.gate G).Reads i → i ∉ S.gates := fun i hi hig =>
    absurd (hS.wf.reads_lt G hG i hig hi) (not_lt.2 (Finset.min'_le _ _ hig))
  have hand : ¬ IsAffineOp (S.gate G).op := fun haff => hmov G ⟨hG, haff, hmin⟩
  have hpa : ∀ i, (S.gate G).Reads i → i ∈ S.params ∪ S.aux := fun i hi => by
    have := hS.wf.reads_live G hG i hi
    simp only [SemiCircuit.live, Finset.mem_union] at this ⊢
    rcases this with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h (hmin i hi)
  refine ⟨hne, hand, ?_⟩
  rcases hl : (S.gate G).left with b₁ | t₁
  · exact absurd (deletionAvailable_of_degenerate hG (Or.inl ⟨b₁, hl⟩)) hdel
  rcases hr : (S.gate G).right with b₂ | t₂
  · exact absurd (deletionAvailable_of_degenerate hG (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨b₂, hr⟩))) hdel
  refine ⟨t₁, t₂, rfl, rfl, fun he => ?_, hpa t₁ (Or.inl hl), hpa t₂ (Or.inr hr)⟩
  subst he
  exact hdel (deletionAvailable_of_degenerate hG (Or.inr (Or.inr (hl.trans hr.symm))))

input; when no preliminary reduction applies, `x` is unpaired of degree at least two, and `Q` has

theorem Valid.step_of_andOnIsolated {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) (h : S.AndOnIsolated) :
    ∃ S', Step f S S' := by
  obtain ⟨G, hG, z, w, hand, hargs, hz, hz1, hw, hzw⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hGz, hGw⟩ := Gate.reads_of_args hargs
  have hcz := children_eq_singleton hz1 ((SemiCircuit.inl_mem_children _).2 ⟨hG, hGz⟩)
  obtain ⟨b, c, hc⟩ := Gate.exists_const_of_not_isAffineOp hand hargs
  obtain ⟨S', h⟩ : ∃ S', Reduction f S S' {w} [.inl G] [] := by
    have h₁ := hS.reduction_fixConst hw b
    have h := h₁.trans (h₁.valid.reduction_deleteConst hG fun val _ => by
      rw [fixConst_gate, Gate.eval_subst_const]; exact hc _ (Function.update_self _ _ _))
    rw [Finset.union_empty] at h
    exact ⟨_, h⟩
  refine ⟨S', h.step hS (by simp) (by simp) ?_⟩
  have hW := h.W_le (fun u => if u = z then 6 else 0) (fun u => if S.IsPartner w u then 7 else 0)
    fun u hu => by
      by_cases huz : u = z
      · subst huz
        rw [h.wt_eq_zero_of_subset (by simp [hcz]) (by simp), wt_of_mem hz, hz1, weight_one,
          ite_eq_left rfl]
        omega
      · rw [ite_eq_right huz]
        by_cases hwu : S.IsPartner w u
        · rw [ite_eq_left hwu]; have := S'.wt_le_seven u; omega
        · rw [ite_eq_right hwu]
          exact Nat.add_le_add_right (h.wt_le hS (by simpa using hwu) (by simp)) 0
  have hzw' : z ∈ S.params \ {w} :=
    Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨(mem_unpaired.1 hz).1, by simpa using hzw⟩
  have hgain := hS.sum_partner_le w (S.params \ {w}) 7
  have hk := hS.card_pairsMeeting_singleton w
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' (S.params \ {w}) z, ite_eq_left hzw', Finset.sum_singleton] at hW
  simp only [List.length_singleton] at hW
  rw [Finset.card_singleton]
  by_cases hwp : S.Paired w
  · rw [ite_eq_left hwp] at hk
    rw [wt_of_paired hwp] at hW
    omega
  · rw [ite_eq_right hwp] at hk
    have hwu : w ∈ S.unpaired := mem_unpaired.2 ⟨hw, hwp⟩
    have := six_le_weight (show 1 ≤ S.deg w from
      Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨_, (SemiCircuit.inl_mem_children _).2 ⟨hG, hGw⟩⟩)
    rw [wt_of_mem hwu, Finset.sum_eq_zero fun u _ => ite_eq_right fun h' => hwp h'.paired] at hW
    omega

/-- When Case 2 does not apply, an unpaired parameter read by an AND-type gate together with
another parameter has degree at least two. -/
