theorem Valid.step_of_degeneratePair {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) (hexcl : S.Exclusive)
    (h : S.DegeneratePair) :
    ∃ S', Step f S S' := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpp, hdeg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨r, hpr⟩ := exists_partner hpp
  have hnot : ∀ x u, S.IsPartner x u → x ∈ ({r} : Finset ℕ) ∨ x ∈ ({p} : Finset ℕ) → u ≠ r →
      u ≠ p → False := fun x u hxu hx hur hup => by
    rcases hx with hx | hx <;> rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx <;> subst hx
    · exact hup (hS.isPartner_unique hxu hpr.symm)
    · exact hur (hS.isPartner_unique hxu hpr)
  rcases hdeg with hdeg | hdeg
  · -- fix the partner `r`; `p` becomes unpaired and unused
    have h := hS.reduction_fixConst (hS.partner_mem hpr) false
    refine ⟨_, h.step hS (by simp) (by simp) ?_⟩
    have hW := h.W_le (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) fun u hu => by
      obtain ⟨-, hur⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hu
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hur
      by_cases hup : u = p
      · subst hup
        have := h.wt_le_weight (u := u) (fun _ hN => absurd hN List.not_mem_nil)
        rw [Finset.card_eq_zero.1 hdeg, Finset.empty_sdiff, Finset.card_empty, weight_zero] at this
        omega
      · exact Nat.add_le_add_right (h.wt_le_of_exclusive hS hexcl
          (fun x hx hxu => hnot x u hxu (Or.inl hx) hur hup)
          fun _ hN => absurd hN List.not_mem_nil) _
    simp only [Finset.sum_singleton, wt_of_paired hpr.symm.paired,
      hS.card_pairsMeeting_singleton, ite_eq_left hpr.symm.paired,
      Finset.sum_const_zero] at hW
    simp only [Finset.card_singleton, hS.card_pairsMeeting_singleton, ite_eq_left hpr.symm.paired]
    omega
  · -- fix `p` and delete two of its children; only the partner `r` may gain weight
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁, N₂, hN₂, hne⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.1 (show 1 < (S.children p).card from hdeg)
    have h₁ := hS.reduction_fixConst hp false
    obtain ⟨S', h₂⟩ := h₁.valid.exists_reduction_deleteAll [N₁, N₂] (by simp [hne]) (by
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
      rintro N (rfl | rfl)
      exacts [deletable_fixConst_child hS _ false hN₁, deletable_fixConst_child hS _ false hN₂])
    have h := h₁.trans h₂
    rw [Finset.union_empty] at h
    refine ⟨S', h.step hS (by simp) (by simp) ?_⟩
    have hW := h.W_le (fun _ => 0) (fun u => if S.IsPartner p u then 7 else 0) fun u hu => by
      obtain ⟨-, hup⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hu
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hup
      by_cases hur : S.IsPartner p u
      · rw [ite_eq_left hur]; have := S'.wt_le_seven u; omega
      · rw [ite_eq_right hur]
        refine Nat.add_le_add_right (h.wt_le_of_exclusive hS hexcl (fun x hx hxu => ?_)
          fun N hN _ => ⟨p, hp, Ne.symm hup, ?_⟩) _
        · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx; subst hx; exact hur hxu
        · simp only [List.nil_append, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hN
          rcases hN with rfl | rfl <;> assumption
    have hgain := hS.sum_partner_le p (S.params \ {p}) 7
    simp only [Finset.sum_singleton, wt_of_paired hpp, hS.card_pairsMeeting_singleton,
      ite_eq_left hpp, Finset.sum_const_zero, List.nil_append, List.length_cons,
      List.length_nil] at hW
    simp only [Finset.card_singleton, hS.card_pairsMeeting_singleton, ite_eq_left hpp]
    omega

input, so (D1) applies. -/

theorem Valid.eq_insert_of_mem_terms {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) (hdel : ¬ S.DeletionAvailable)
    {e p r : ℕ} (he : e ∈ S.eqns) (hp : p ∈ S.params) (hr : r ∈ S.params) (hpr : p ≠ r)
    (hpe : p ∈ (S.eqn e).terms) (hre : r ∈ (S.eqn e).terms) :
    ∃ v ∈ S.aux, v ≠ p ∧ v ≠ r ∧ (S.eqn e).terms = {v, p, r} := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvp, hvr⟩ : ∃ v ∈ (S.eqn e).terms, v ≠ p ∧ v ≠ r := by
    by_contra hno
    push Not at hno
    refine hdel (Or.inl ⟨e, he, (Finset.card_le_card (t := {p, r}) fun i hi => ?_).trans
      (Finset.card_le_two)⟩)
    by_cases hip : i = p
    · simp [hip]
    · simp [hno i hi hip]
  have hterms : (S.eqn e).terms = {v, p, r} := (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    (by simp [Finset.insert_subset_iff, hv, hpe, hre]) (by
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [hvp, hvr]), Finset.card_pair hpr]
      exact hS.wf.card_terms_le e he)).symm
  refine ⟨v, ?_, hvp, hvr, hterms⟩
  rcases Finset.mem_union.1 (hS.wf.terms_subset e he hv) with hvp' | hva
  · refine absurd (hS.terms_eq_empty_of_subset he ?_) (Finset.ne_empty_of_mem hv)
    rw [hterms]
    simp [Finset.insert_subset_iff, hvp', hp, hr]
  · exact hva

/-- The configuration of Case 4: two partners have a common child. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

theorem Valid.step_of_partnersShareChild {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f)
    (hdel : ¬ S.DeletionAvailable) (h3 : ¬ S.DegeneratePair) (h : S.PartnersShareChild) :
    ∃ S', Step f S S' := by
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr, H, hHp, hHr⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hp, hr, hpr12⟩ := hS.pair_mem pr hpr
  set p := pr.1
  set r := pr.2
  have hpp : S.Paired p := ⟨pr, hpr, Or.inl rfl⟩
  have hpart : S.IsPartner p r := ⟨pr, hpr, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  have hcp := children_eq_singleton (deg_eq_one_of_not_degeneratePair h3 hp hpp) hHp
  have hcr := children_eq_singleton (deg_eq_one_of_not_degeneratePair h3 hr hpart.symm.paired)
    hHr
  have hrp : Arg.node r ≠ Arg.node p := fun h => hpr12 (Arg.node.inj h).symm
  -- restrict `p = r + c` and delete `H`, which becomes constant
  obtain ⟨S', h⟩ : ∃ S', Reduction f S S' {p} [H] [] := by
    have hrestrict : ∀ c : Bool, Reduction f S (S.restrict p ⟨.node r, c⟩ (S.pairsAvoid p))
        {p} [] [] := fun c => hS.reduction_restrict hp fun y hy => by
      cases hy
      exact ⟨hr, Ne.symm hpr12, by rw [hcp, hcr], fun _ => hpart⟩
    rcases H with G | e
    · obtain ⟨hG, hGp⟩ := (SemiCircuit.inl_mem_children _).1 hHp
      obtain ⟨-, hGr⟩ := (SemiCircuit.inl_mem_children _).1 hHr
      obtain ⟨c, d, hd⟩ := Gate.exists_const_of_diag
        (fun hun => hdel (deletionAvailable_of_unary hG hun)) (Gate.args_of_reads hpr12 hGp hGr)
      have h₁ := hrestrict c
      exact ⟨_, h₁.trans (h₁.valid.reduction_deleteConst hG fun val _ => by
        rw [restrict_gate, Gate.eval_subst_update hrp]
        exact hd _ (by simp [Function.update_of_ne hpr12.symm, Lit.eval]))⟩
    · obtain ⟨he, hpe⟩ := (SemiCircuit.inr_mem_children _).1 hHp
      obtain ⟨-, hre⟩ := (SemiCircuit.inr_mem_children _).1 hHr
      obtain ⟨v, hva, hvp, hvr, hterms⟩ := hS.eq_insert_of_mem_terms hdel he hp hr hpr12 hpe hre
      have h₁ := hrestrict false
      exact ⟨_, h₁.trans (h₁.valid.reduction_deleteEqn (v := v) (ℓ := Lit.const (S.eqn e).rhs)
        ⟨he, hva, fun val => by
          rw [restrict_eqn, Equation.holds_subst_update hrp, Lit.eval_const]
          simpa [Lit.eval] using Equation.holds_update_iff hterms hvp hvr hpr12 val false,
          fun t ht => by simp [Lit.Reads, Lit.const] at ht⟩
        fun t ht => by simp [Lit.Reads, Lit.const] at ht)⟩
  refine ⟨S', h.step hS (by simp) (by simp) ?_⟩
  have hW := h.W_le (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) fun u hu => by
    obtain ⟨-, hup⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hu
    by_cases hur : u = r
    · subst hur
      rw [h.wt_eq_zero_of_subset (by simp [hcr]) (by simp)]
      omega
    · refine Nat.add_le_add_right (h.wt_le hS (fun x hx hxu => ?_) (by simp)) 0
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
      subst hx
      exact hur (hS.isPartner_unique hxu hpart)
  rw [Finset.sum_singleton, wt_of_paired hpp, hS.card_pairsMeeting_singleton,
    ite_eq_left hpp] at hW
  simp only [Finset.sum_const_zero, List.length_singleton] at hW
  rw [Finset.card_singleton, hS.card_pairsMeeting_singleton, ite_eq_left hpp]
  omega

/-! ### Case 5: a paired parameter in the affine system -/

/-- The configuration of Case 5: a paired parameter occurs in the affine system. -/

text:
theorem Valid.step_of_pairInSystem {S : State n} {d : ℕ} (hS : S.Valid f)
    (hf : IsAffineDisperser f d) (ha : d < S.a) (hexcl : S.Exclusive) (h3 : ¬ S.DegeneratePair)
    (h4 : ¬ S.PartnersShareChild) (h : S.PairInSystem) : ∃ S', Step f S S' := by
  obtain ⟨p, hpp, e, he, hpe⟩ := h
  have hp := hS.mem_params_of_paired hpp
  have hcp := children_eq_singleton (deg_eq_one_of_not_degeneratePair h3 hp hpp)
    ((SemiCircuit.inr_mem_children _).2 ⟨he, hpe⟩)
  obtain ⟨r, hpr⟩ := exists_partner hpp
  have hr := hS.partner_mem hpr
  have hrp := hS.partner_ne hpr
  obtain ⟨Hr, hHr⟩ := Finset.card_pos.1 (show 0 < S.deg r by
    rw [deg_eq_one_of_not_degeneratePair h3 hr hpr.symm.paired]; omega)
  have hHrp : Hr ∉ S.children p := fun hHp => notMem_children_of_isPartner h4 hpr hHp hHr
  -- fix `r` and delete its child
  obtain ⟨S₂, h⟩ : ∃ S₂, Reduction f S S₂ {r} [Hr] [Hr] := by
    have h₁ := hS.reduction_fixConst hr false
    obtain ⟨S₂, h₂⟩ := h₁.valid.exists_reduction_deleteAll [Hr] (by simp) fun N hN => by
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hN; subst hN; exact deletable_fixConst_child hS _ false hHr
    have h := h₁.trans h₂
    rw [Finset.union_empty] at h
    exact ⟨S₂, h⟩
  have hpu₂ : p ∈ S₂.unpaired :=
    (h.mem_unpaired_iff hS).2 ⟨hp, by simpa using hrp.symm, Or.inr ⟨r, by simp, hpr.symm⟩⟩
  have hcp₂ : S₂.children p ⊆ {.inr e} := by
    have := h.children_subset (mem_unpaired.1 hpu₂).1 (by simpa using hHrp)
    rw [hcp] at this
    exact this.trans Finset.sdiff_subset
  have hW := h.W_le (fun _ => 0) (fun u => if u = p then weight (S₂.deg p) else 0) fun u hu => by
    obtain ⟨-, hur⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hu
    by_cases hup : u = p
    · subst hup; rw [wt_of_mem hpu₂, ite_eq_left rfl]; omega
    · rw [ite_eq_right hup]
      refine Nat.add_le_add_right (h.wt_le_of_exclusive hS hexcl (fun x hx hxu => ?_)
        fun N hN _ => ?_) 0
      · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx; subst hx
        exact hup (hS.isPartner_unique hxu hpr.symm)
      · rw [List.mem_singleton] at hN; subst hN
        exact ⟨r, hr, Ne.symm (by simpa using hur), hHr⟩
  have hpr' : p ∈ S.params \ {r} := Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hp, by simpa using hrp.symm⟩
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' (S.params \ {r}) p, ite_eq_left hpr', Finset.sum_singleton,
    wt_of_paired hpr.symm.paired, hS.card_pairsMeeting_singleton,
    ite_eq_left hpr.symm.paired] at hW
  simp only [Finset.sum_const_zero, List.length_singleton] at hW
  have ha₂ := h.a_add hS
  have hm₂ := h.m_add
  have hs₂ := h.s_add
  rw [Finset.card_singleton, hS.card_pairsMeeting_singleton, ite_eq_left hpr.symm.paired] at ha₂
  rw [Finset.card_singleton] at hm₂
  simp only [List.length_singleton] at hs₂
  have hdeg₂ : S₂.deg p ≤ 1 := (Finset.card_le_card hcp₂).trans (by simp)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (S₂.deg p) 1 with h0 | h1
  · -- `p` became unused
    rw [show S₂.deg p = 0 by omega, weight_zero] at hW
    exact ⟨S₂, h.valid, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩
  · -- (D4) on `p` and its equation
    have hcp₂' : S₂.children p = {.inr e} :=
      Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hcp₂ (by rw [Finset.card_singleton]; exact h1)
    rw [show S₂.deg p = 1 by omega, weight_one] at hW
    obtain ⟨S₃, hS₃, hm₃, hs₃, ha₃, -, hW₃⟩ := h.valid.unit_delete hf (by omega) hpu₂ hcp₂'
    exact ⟨S₃, hS₃, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩

/-! ### Case 6: an AND-type gate on a paired parameter -/

/-- The configuration of Case 6: an AND-type gate reads a paired parameter `p` and another
parameter `w`. -/

theorem Valid.step_of_andOnPair {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) (hexcl : S.Exclusive)
    (h2 : ¬ S.AndOnIsolated) (h3 : ¬ S.DegeneratePair) (h4 : ¬ S.PartnersShareChild)
    (h5 : ¬ S.PairInSystem) (h : S.AndOnPair) : ∃ S', Step f S S' := by
  obtain ⟨G, hG, p, w, hand, hargs, hpp, hw, hpw⟩ := h
  have hp := hS.mem_params_of_paired hpp
  obtain ⟨hGp, hGw⟩ := Gate.reads_of_args hargs
  have hcp := children_eq_singleton (deg_eq_one_of_not_degeneratePair h3 hp hpp)
    ((SemiCircuit.inl_mem_children _).2 ⟨hG, hGp⟩)
  obtain ⟨r, hpr⟩ := exists_partner hpp
  have hr := hS.partner_mem hpr
  have hrpaired := hpr.symm.paired
  obtain ⟨Hr, hHr⟩ := Finset.card_pos.1 (show 0 < S.deg r by
    rw [deg_eq_one_of_not_degeneratePair h3 hr hrpaired]; omega)
  have hGr : Sum.inl G ∉ S.children r :=
    notMem_children_of_isPartner h4 hpr (by rw [hcp]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
  obtain ⟨Hg, rfl⟩ : ∃ Hg, Hr = .inl Hg := by
    rcases Hr with Hg | e
    · exact ⟨Hg, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨he, hre⟩ := (SemiCircuit.inr_mem_children _).1 hHr
      exact absurd ⟨r, hrpaired, e, he, hre⟩ h5
  have hHgG : Hg ≠ G := by rintro rfl; exact hGr hHr
  have hwr : w ≠ r := by
    rintro rfl; exact hGr ((SemiCircuit.inl_mem_children _).2 ⟨hG, hGw⟩)
  have hwpart : ¬ S.IsPartner r w := fun h' => hpw (hS.isPartner_unique hpr.symm h')
  -- an unpaired `w` is not isolated, else Case 2 applies
  have hwdeg : w ∈ S.unpaired → 2 ≤ S.deg w := fun hwu =>
    two_le_deg_of_not_andOnIsolated h2 hG hand hargs.symm hwu hp hpw.symm
  -- fix `r`, fix `w` so that `G` becomes constant, and delete `G` and `Hg`
  obtain ⟨b, c, hc⟩ := Gate.exists_const_of_not_isAffineOp hand hargs
  have h₁ := hS.reduction_fixConst hr false
  have h₂ := h₁.valid.reduction_fixConst (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hwr, hw⟩) b
  have h₃ := h₂.valid.reduction_deleteGate (J := G) (ℓ := Lit.const c) (T := [])
    ⟨hG, fun t ht => by simp [Lit.Reads, Lit.const] at ht, Or.inl fun val _ => by
      simp only [fixConst_gate, Gate.eval_subst_const, Lit.eval_const]
      exact hc _ (by rw [Function.update_of_ne hwr, Function.update_self])⟩
    fun t ht => by simp [Lit.Reads, Lit.const] at ht
  obtain ⟨S', h₄⟩ := h₃.valid.exists_reduction_deleteAll [.inl Hg] (by simp) (by
    simp only [List.mem_singleton, forall_eq]
    exact h₃.deletable _ (by simp [hHgG]) (h₂.deletable _ (by simp)
      (deletable_fixConst_child hS _ false hHr)))
  have h := ((h₁.trans h₂).trans h₃).trans h₄
  simp only [Finset.union_empty, List.nil_append, List.singleton_append, ← Finset.insert_eq] at h
  refine ⟨S', h.step hS Finset.card_le_two (by simp) ?_⟩
  have hW := h.W_le (fun _ => 0) (fun u => if S.IsPartner w u then 7 else 0) fun u hu => by
    obtain ⟨-, huF⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hu
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at huF
    by_cases hup : u = p
    · subst hup
      rw [h.wt_eq_zero_of_subset (by simp [hcp]) (by simp [hcp, hHgG])]
      omega
    · by_cases hwu : S.IsPartner w u
      · rw [ite_eq_left hwu]; have := S'.wt_le_seven u; omega
      · rw [ite_eq_right hwu]
        refine Nat.add_le_add_right (h.wt_le_of_exclusive hS hexcl (fun x hx hxu => ?_)
          fun N hN _ => ?_) _
        · rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hx with rfl | hx
          · exact hup (hS.isPartner_unique hxu hpr.symm)
          · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx; subst hx; exact hwu hxu
        · rw [List.mem_singleton] at hN; subst hN
          exact ⟨r, hr, Ne.symm huF.1, hHr⟩
  have hk : (S.pairsMeeting {r, w}).card = (if S.Paired w then 1 else 0) + 1 := by
    rw [hS.card_pairsMeeting_insert (by simpa using hwr.symm) (by simpa using hwpart),
      hS.card_pairsMeeting_singleton, ite_eq_left hrpaired]
  have hgain := hS.sum_partner_le w (S.params \ {r, w}) 7
  rw [Finset.sum_pair hwr.symm, wt_of_paired hrpaired, hk] at hW
  simp only [Finset.sum_const_zero, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hW
  rw [Finset.card_pair hwr.symm, hk]
  by_cases hwp : S.Paired w
  · rw [ite_eq_left hwp] at hW ⊢; rw [wt_of_paired hwp] at hW; omega
  · have hwu : w ∈ S.unpaired := mem_unpaired.2 ⟨hw, hwp⟩
    rw [wt_of_mem hwu, weight_of_two_le (hwdeg hwu),
      Finset.sum_eq_zero fun u _ => ite_eq_right fun h' => hwp h'.paired] at hW
    rw [ite_eq_right hwp] at hW ⊢; omega

/-- A state in which no affine gate can be moved and no preliminary reduction applies, recorded by
the consequences used to restructure and eliminate the minimal AND. -/

theorem trans {S₁ S₂ : State n} {F₁ F₂ : Finset ℕ} {D₁ D₂ T₁ T₂ : List (ℕ ⊕ ℕ)}
    (h₁ : Reduction f S S₁ F₁ D₁ T₁) (h₂ : Reduction f S₁ S₂ F₂ D₂ T₂) :
    Reduction f S S₂ (F₁ ∪ F₂) (D₁ ++ D₂) (T₁ ++ T₂) where
  valid := h₂.valid
  subset := Finset.union_subset h₁.subset ((h₂.subset.trans h₁.params.le).trans sdiff_subset)
  params := by
    rw [h₂.params, h₁.params]
    ext u
    simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_union]
    tauto
  pairs := by
    rw [h₂.pairs, h₁.pairs, Finset.filter_filter]
    exact Finset.filter_congr fun pr _ => by simp only [Finset.mem_union]; tauto
  size := by rw [List.length_append, ← h₁.size, ← h₂.size]; omega
  children u hu := by
    have hu₁ : u ∈ S₁.params := (h₂.params.le hu |> Finset.mem_sdiff.1).1
    rcases h₂.children u hu with h₂' | ⟨N, hN, hNu⟩ <;> rcases h₁.children u hu₁ with h₁' | h₁'
    · refine Or.inl fun N hN => ?_
      have h₂N := Finset.mem_sdiff.1 (h₂' hN)
      have h₁N := Finset.mem_sdiff.1 (h₁' h₂N.1)
      simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, List.toFinset_append, Finset.mem_union, not_or]
      exact ⟨h₁N.1, h₁N.2, h₂N.2⟩
    · obtain ⟨N, hN, hNu⟩ := h₁'
      exact Or.inr ⟨N, List.mem_append_left _ hN, hNu⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨N, List.mem_append_right _ hN, (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 (h₁' hNu)).1⟩
    · obtain ⟨N, hN, hNu⟩ := h₁'
      exact Or.inr ⟨N, List.mem_append_left _ hN, hNu⟩
  deletable N hN h := by
    rw [List.mem_append, not_or] at hN
    exact h₂.deletable N hN.2 (h₁.deletable N hN.1 h)

theorem trans_delete {S₁ S₂ : State n} {D₂ T₂ : List (ℕ ⊕ ℕ)} (h₁ : Reduction f S S₁ F D T)
    (h₂ : Reduction f S₁ S₂ ∅ D₂ T₂) : Reduction f S S₂ F (D ++ D₂) (T ++ T₂) := by
  have h := h₁.trans h₂
  rwa [Finset.union_empty] at h

theorem wt_le (h : Reduction f S S' F D T) (hS : S.Valid f) {u : ℕ}
    (hpart : ∀ x ∈ F, ¬ S.IsPartner x u) (hT : ∀ N ∈ T, N ∉ S.children u) :
    S'.wt u ≤ S.wt u := by
  by_cases hu : u ∈ S.unpaired
  · rw [wt_of_mem hu]
    exact (h.wt_le_weight hT).trans (weight_mono (Finset.card_le_card Finset.sdiff_subset))
  · rw [h.wt_eq_zero hS hu hpart]; exact Nat.zero_le _

/-- A used parameter that is not the partner of a member of `F` gains at most one in weight. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem wt_le_wt (h : Reduction f S S' F D T) {u : ℕ} (hu : u ∈ S.unpaired)
    (hT : ∀ N ∈ T, N ∈ S.children u → 2 ≤ S.deg u) : S'.wt u ≤ S.wt u := by
  by_cases hu' : u ∈ S'.unpaired
  · rw [wt_of_mem hu]
    by_cases hN : ∃ N ∈ T, N ∈ S.children u
    · obtain ⟨N, hN, hNu⟩ := hN
      rw [weight_of_two_le (hT N hN hNu)]
      exact S'.wt_le_seven u
    · push Not at hN
      exact (h.wt_le_weight hN).trans
        (weight_mono (Finset.card_le_card Finset.sdiff_subset))
  · rw [wt_of_notMem hu']; exact Nat.zero_le _

/-- In an exclusive state, a parameter that is not the partner of a member of `F` does not gain
weight when every deletion that may reroute to it deletes a constraint with another parameter as a
parent. -/

theorem Valid.reduction_restrict {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) {x : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ S.params)
    {ℓ : Lit} (hℓ : ∀ y, ℓ.Reads y → y ∈ S.params ∧ y ≠ x ∧ S.children x ⊆ S.children y ∧
      (S.Paired x → S.IsPartner x y)) :
    Reduction f S (S.restrict x ℓ (S.pairsAvoid x)) {x} [] [] where
  valid := hS.restrict
    { mem := hx
      reads := fun y hy => ⟨(hℓ y hy).1, (hℓ y hy).2.1⟩
      subset := Finset.filter_subset _ _
      avoid := fun pr hpr => (Finset.mem_filter.1 hpr).2
      drop := fun pr hpr hP => by
        have hprx : pr.1 = x ∨ pr.2 = x := by
          by_contra hc
          push Not at hc
          exact hP (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hpr, hc⟩)
        refine ⟨hprx, fun y hy => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨pr', hpr', hxy⟩ := (hℓ y hy).2.2.2 ⟨pr, hpr, hprx⟩
        have := hS.pair_unique hpr hpr' hprx
          (by rcases hxy with h | h; exacts [Or.inl h.1, Or.inr h.1])
        subst this
        rcases hxy with ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
        · exact Or.inr h.symm
        · exact Or.inl h.symm }
  subset := Finset.singleton_subset_iff.2 hx
  params := by
    ext u
    simp only [restrict_params, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_singleton]
    tauto
  pairs := Finset.filter_congr fun pr _ => by simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, not_or]
  size := by rw [List.length_nil, add_zero]; rfl
  children u hu := by
    refine Or.inl ?_
    rw [List.toFinset_nil, Finset.sdiff_empty, restrict_children]
    have hux : u ≠ x := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hu
    by_cases hℓu : ℓ.Reads u
    · exact (SemiCircuit.children_subst_subset x ℓ u).trans
        (Finset.union_subset le_rfl (hℓ u hℓu).2.2.1)
    · rw [SemiCircuit.children_subst hux hℓu]
  deletable N _ hN := by
    rcases N with J | e
    · exact ⟨hN.1, Gate.degenerate_subst hN.2 _ _⟩
    · exact ⟨hN.1, Equation.card_subst_le.trans hN.2⟩

theorem Valid.reduction_deleteGate {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) {J : ℕ} {ℓ : Lit}
    (h : S.DeleteGateOK J ℓ) {T : List (ℕ ⊕ ℕ)} (hT : ∀ t, ℓ.Reads t → .inl J ∈ T) :
    Reduction f S (S.deleteGate J ℓ) ∅ [.inl J] T where
  valid := hS.deleteGate h
  subset := Finset.empty_subset _
  params := (Finset.sdiff_empty).symm
  pairs := (Finset.filter_true_of_mem fun _ _ => by simp).symm
  size := deleteGate_size h
  children u hu := by
    by_cases hℓu : ℓ.Reads u
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, hT u hℓu, (SemiCircuit.inl_mem_children _).2 ⟨h.mem, h.reads u hℓu⟩⟩
    · refine Or.inl ?_
      rw [List.toFinset_cons, List.toFinset_nil, insert_empty_eq,
        Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]
      exact deleteGate_children_of_ne hS h hu hℓu
  deletable N hN hdel := by
    rcases N with K | e
    · have hKJ : K ≠ J := fun he => hN (by rw [he]; exact List.mem_singleton_self _)
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hKJ, hdel.1⟩, Gate.degenerate_subst hdel.2 _ _⟩
    · exact ⟨hdel.1, Equation.card_subst_le.trans hdel.2⟩

theorem Valid.reduction_deleteEqn {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) {e v : ℕ} {ℓ : Lit}
    (h : S.DeleteEqnOK e v ℓ) {T : List (ℕ ⊕ ℕ)} (hT : ∀ t, ℓ.Reads t → .inr e ∈ T) :
    Reduction f S (S.deleteEqn e v ℓ) ∅ [.inr e] T where
  valid := hS.deleteEqn h
  subset := Finset.empty_subset _
  params := (Finset.sdiff_empty).symm
  pairs := (Finset.filter_true_of_mem fun _ _ => by simp).symm
  size := deleteEqn_size h

    by_cases hℓu : ℓ.Reads u
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, hT u hℓu, (SemiCircuit.inr_mem_children _).2
        ⟨h.mem, (h.reads u hℓu).1⟩⟩
    · refine Or.inl ?_
      rw [List.toFinset_cons, List.toFinset_nil, insert_empty_eq,
        Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]
      exact deleteEqn_children_of_ne hS h hu hℓu
  deletable N hN hdel := by
    rcases N with K | e'
    · exact ⟨hdel.1, Gate.degenerate_subst hdel.2 _ _⟩
    · have hee : e' ≠ e := fun he => hN (by rw [he]; exact List.mem_singleton_self _)
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hee, hdel.1⟩, Equation.card_subst_le.trans hdel.2⟩

theorem Valid.exists_reduction_deleteAll {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) (l : List (ℕ ⊕ ℕ))
    (hl : l.Nodup) (hdel : ∀ N ∈ l, S.Deletable N) : ∃ S', Reduction f S S' ∅ l l := by
  induction l generalizing S with
  | nil => exact ⟨S, Reduction.refl hS⟩
  | cons N l ih =>
    obtain ⟨S₁, h₁⟩ := hS.exists_reduction_delete (hdel N List.mem_cons_self)
    have hl' := List.nodup_cons.1 hl
    obtain ⟨S', h₂⟩ := ih h₁.valid hl'.2 fun N' hN' => h₁.deletable N'
      (by rw [List.mem_singleton]; rintro rfl; exact hl'.1 hN')
      (hdel N' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hN'))
    have h := h₁.trans h₂
    rw [Finset.empty_union] at h
    exact ⟨S', h⟩

theorem Valid.swap {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) {x Q : ℕ} {c : Bool} {T : Finset ℕ}
    (h : S.SwapOK x Q c T) : (S.swap x Q c T).Valid f := by
  have hTx : ∀ j ∈ T.erase x, j ∈ S.params.erase x := fun j hj =>
    Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj, h.affine.1 (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hj)⟩
  have hnx : ∀ pr ∈ S.pairs, pr.1 ≠ x ∧ pr.2 ≠ x := fun pr hpr =>
    ⟨fun he => h.unpaired ⟨pr, hpr, Or.inl he⟩, fun he => h.unpaired ⟨pr, hpr, Or.inr he⟩⟩
  let σ : (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → Bool := fun val =>
    Function.update val x (val Q + c + ∑ j ∈ T.erase x, val j)
  have hσ : ∀ val i, i ≠ x → σ val i = val i := fun val i hi => Function.update_of_ne hi _ _
  have hσx : ∀ val, σ val x = val Q + c + ∑ j ∈ T.erase x, val j := fun val =>
    Function.update_self _ _ _
  have hσid : ∀ val, S.EqnsHold val → σ val = val := fun val hval => by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : i = x
    · subst hi; rw [hσx, h.affine.solve h.mem_T hval]
    · exact hσ val i hi
  refine hS.of_transport (σ := σ) (hS.wf.swap h.mem h.aux h.affine h.mem_T)
    { pair_mem := fun pr hpr => ?_
      pairs_disjoint := hS.pairs_disjoint
      phi := fun _ => rfl
      congr := fun val val' hv j hj => ?_
      inj := fun val val' hv j hj => ?_
      affine := fun k τ hτ htame => ⟨fun u => σ (τ u), ?_, fun pr hpr => ?_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
      consistent := fun val hval => by rw [hσid val hval.1]; exact hval
      out := fun val hval => by rw [hσid val hval.1]; rfl }
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h12⟩ := hS.pair_mem pr hpr
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨(hnx pr hpr).1, h1⟩),
      Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨(hnx pr hpr).2, h2⟩), h12⟩
  · by_cases hjx : j = x
    · subst hjx
      rw [hσx, hσx, hv Q (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _),
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => hv i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (hTx i hi))]
    · rw [hσ val j hjx, hσ val' j hjx]
      exact hv j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hjx, hj⟩))
  · rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hj with rfl | hj
    · have h1 := hv x h.mem
      rw [hσx, hσx, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi =>
        (hσ val i (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi)).symm.trans
        ((hv i (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (hTx i hi))).trans
          (hσ val' i (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi)))] at h1
      simpa using h1
    · have := hv j (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hj)
      rwa [hσ val j (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj), hσ val' j (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)] at this
  · refine isAffine_update hτ x fun u v w => ?_
    simp only [congrFun (hτ u v w), Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    generalize τ u Q = a₁; generalize τ v Q = a₂; generalize τ w Q = a₃
    generalize ∑ i ∈ T.erase x, τ u i = b₁; generalize ∑ i ∈ T.erase x, τ v i = b₂
    generalize ∑ i ∈ T.erase x, τ w i = b₃
    cases a₁ <;> cases a₂ <;> cases a₃ <;> cases b₁ <;> cases b₂ <;> cases b₃ <;> cases c <;> rfl
  · obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := hnx pr hpr
    rcases htame pr hpr with ht | ht | ht
    · exact Or.inl fun u v => by dsimp only; rw [hσ _ _ hx1, hσ _ _ hx1]; exact ht u v
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl fun u v => by dsimp only; rw [hσ _ _ hx2, hσ _ _ hx2]; exact ht u v)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr fun u v => by
        dsimp only; rw [hσ _ _ hx1, hσ _ _ hx1, hσ _ _ hx2, hσ _ _ hx2]; exact ht u v)

/-- Along an affine family on which the pair `(x, y)` is tame, the product
`(u x + α) (u y + β)` is affine. -/

text:
theorem Valid.false_of_fix {f : BooleanFunction n} {d : ℕ} (hS : S.Valid f)
    (hf : IsAffineDisperser f d) (ha : d < S.a) {x : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ S.params) (c : Bool)
    (R : Finset ℕ) (hR : R ⊆ S.params) (hxR : x ∉ R) (b : Bool)
    (hout : ∀ val, S.Consistent val → val x = c + ∑ j ∈ R, val j → S.out.eval val = b) :
    False := by
  classical
  let rep : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ := fun pr => if pr.1 = x then pr.2 else pr.1
  have hrep : ∀ pr, rep pr = pr.1 ∨ rep pr = pr.2 := fun pr => by
    by_cases h : pr.1 = x <;> simp [rep, h]
  have hrepx : ∀ pr ∈ S.pairs, rep pr ≠ x := fun pr hpr => by
    by_cases h : pr.1 = x
    · simp only [rep, h, ite_true]
      exact fun h' => (hS.pair_mem pr hpr).2.2 (h.trans h'.symm)
    · simp only [rep, h, ite_false]
      exact h
  set F := S.params \ S.pairs.image rep
  have hF : F.card = S.a := hS.card_sdiff_image rep hrep
  have hxF : x ∈ F := Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hx, fun h => by
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 h
    exact hrepx pr hpr he⟩
  set F' := F.erase x
  have hF' : F'.card = S.a - 1 := by rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hxF, hF]
  have hF'p : F' ⊆ S.params := (Finset.erase_subset _ _).trans Finset.sdiff_subset
  let σ : BitString (S.a - 1) → ℕ → Bool := fun u =>
    Function.update (spread F' hF' u) x (c + ∑ j ∈ R, spread F' hF' u j)
  have hσx : ∀ u, σ u x = c + ∑ j ∈ R, σ u j := fun u => by
    simp only [σ, Function.update_self]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj =>
      (Function.update_of_ne (by rintro rfl; exact hxR hj) _ _).symm
  have hσ : IsAffine σ :=
    isAffine_update (isAffine_spread F' hF') x (isAffine_const_add_sum (isAffine_spread F' hF') c R)
  obtain ⟨u, v, val, val', hcons, hcons', hval, hval', hne⟩ := hS.exists_out_ne hf σ hσ
    (fun pr hpr => by
      have hnot : rep pr ∉ F' := fun h =>
        (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase h)).2 (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hpr)
      have hconst : ∀ u, σ u (rep pr) = false := fun u => by
        simp only [σ, Function.update_of_ne (hrepx pr hpr), spread_of_notMem hF' u hnot]
      rcases hrep pr with h | h
      · exact Or.inl fun u v => by rw [← h, hconst, hconst]
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl fun u v => by rw [← h, hconst, hconst]))
    (fun u v h => eq_of_spread hF' fun i hi => by
      have := h i (hF'p hi)
      simpa only [σ, Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi)] using this)
    (by omega)
  have hfix : ∀ w : ℕ → Bool, ∀ u', (∀ j ∈ S.params, w j = σ u' j) →
      w x = c + ∑ j ∈ R, w j := fun w u' hw => by
    rw [hw x hx, hσx, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => hw j (hR hj)]
  exact hne ((hout val hcons (hfix val u hval)).trans (hout val' hcons' (hfix val' v hval')).symm)

/-- Part of **Lemma 2.3** of [Mishra and Santhanam][MishraSanthanam2026]: if `d < a`, the output
of a valid state for an affine disperser for dimension `d` is not an affine function of the
parameters. -/

text:
theorem Valid.out_not_affine {f : BooleanFunction n} {d : ℕ} (hS : S.Valid f)
    (hf : IsAffineDisperser f d) (ha : d < S.a) (c : Bool) {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ⊆ S.params) :
    ¬ ∀ val, S.Consistent val → S.out.eval val = c + ∑ j ∈ T, val j := by
  intro hout
  rcases T.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨x, hx⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : S.params.Nonempty := by
      rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
      rintro h
      simp [a, m, h] at ha
    exact hS.false_of_fix hf ha hx false ∅ (Finset.empty_subset _) (Finset.notMem_empty _) c
      fun val hval _ => by simpa using hout val hval
  · refine hS.false_of_fix hf ha (hT hx) c (T.erase x) ((Finset.erase_subset _ _).trans hT)
      (Finset.notMem_erase _ _) false fun val hval hfix => ?_
    rw [hout val hval, ← Finset.add_sum_erase T _ hx, hfix]
    generalize ∑ j ∈ T.erase x, val j = e
    cases c <;> cases e <;> rfl

theorem Valid.isPartner_unique {S : State n} (hS : S.Valid f) {w r r' : ℕ}
    (h : S.IsPartner w r) (h' : S.IsPartner w r') : r = r' := by
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hr⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨pr', hpr', hr'⟩ := h'
  have := hS.pair_unique (w := w) hpr hpr'
    (by rcases hr with h | h; exacts [Or.inl h.1, Or.inr h.1])
    (by rcases hr' with h | h; exacts [Or.inl h.1, Or.inr h.1])
  subst this
  have h12 := (hS.pair_mem pr hpr).2.2
  rcases hr with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> rcases hr' with ⟨h1', h2'⟩ | ⟨h1', h2'⟩
  · exact h2.symm.trans h2'
  · exact absurd (h1.trans h1'.symm) h12
  · exact absurd (h1'.trans h1.symm) h12
  · exact h2.symm.trans h2'

private theorem Valid.exists_step_aux {d : ℕ} (hf : IsAffineDisperser f d) :
    ∀ k₁ k₂ k₃ (S : State n), S.gates.card = k₁ → S.auxIn = k₂ → S.childIn = k₃ →
      S.Valid f → d < S.a → ∃ S', Step f S S' := by
  intro k₁
  induction k₁ using Nat.strong_induction_on with | _ k₁ ih₁ => ?_
  intro k₂
  induction k₂ using Nat.strong_induction_on with | _ k₂ ih₂ => ?_
  intro k₃
  induction k₃ using Nat.strong_induction_on with | _ k₃ ih₃ => ?_
  intro S hk₁ hk₂ hk₃ hS ha
  -- move affine gates into the affine system
  by_cases hmov : ∃ J, S.Movable J
  · obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := hmov
    have hp := hS.preparation_moveAffine hJ
    have hcard := moveAffine_gates_card (S := S) ⟨hJ.1, S.freshEqn_notMem, hJ.2.1, hJ.2.2⟩
    obtain ⟨S', hstep⟩ := ih₁ _ (by omega) _ _ _ rfl rfl rfl hp.valid (hp.a_eq ▸ ha)
    exact ⟨S', hstep.of_preparation hp⟩
  push Not at hmov
  -- the preliminary reductions
  rcases hS.step_or_normal hf ha hmov with hstep | hN
  · exact hstep
  -- the minimal AND
  obtain ⟨hne, hand, t₁, t₂, hl, hr, ht12, ht₁, ht₂⟩ :=
    hS.exists_minGate hf ha hN.not_movable hN.no_deletion
  have hG : S.gates.min' hne ∈ S.gates := Finset.min'_mem _ _
  -- an auxiliary input is exchanged with a parameter
  by_cases haux : t₁ ∈ S.aux ∨ t₂ ∈ S.aux
  · obtain ⟨S₁, hp, hgates, hlt⟩ : ∃ S₁ : State n, Preparation f S S₁ ∧ S₁.gates = S.gates ∧
        S₁.auxIn < S.auxIn := by
      rcases haux with h | h
      · exact hS.exists_preparation_auxIn_lt hN hne (Or.inl ⟨hl, hr⟩) h ht12
      · exact hS.exists_preparation_auxIn_lt hN hne (Or.inr ⟨hl, hr⟩) h ht12.symm
    obtain ⟨S', hstep⟩ := ih₂ _ (hk₂ ▸ hlt) _ S₁ (hgates ▸ hk₁) rfl rfl hp.valid (hp.a_eq ▸ ha)
    exact ⟨S', hstep.of_preparation hp⟩
  push Not at haux
  have hx : t₁ ∈ S.params := (Finset.mem_union.1 ht₁).resolve_right haux.1
  have hy : t₂ ∈ S.params := (Finset.mem_union.1 ht₂).resolve_right haux.2
  obtain ⟨-, hxdeg⟩ := hN.and_param _ hG hand t₁ t₂ (Or.inl ⟨hl, hr⟩) hx hy ht12
  obtain ⟨-, hydeg⟩ := hN.and_param _ hG hand t₂ t₁ (Or.inr ⟨hl, hr⟩) hy hx ht12.symm
  -- a child of the minimal AND reading one of its inputs is rerouted
  by_cases hch : ∃ K ∈ S.gates, (S.gate K).Reads (S.gates.min' hne) ∧
      ((S.gate K).Reads t₁ ∨ (S.gate K).Reads t₂)
  · obtain ⟨K, hK, hKG, hKt⟩ := hch
    obtain ⟨S₁, hp, hgates, hauxeq, hlt⟩ :=
      hS.exists_preparation_childIn_lt hne hl hr ht12 hx hy hxdeg hydeg hK hKG hKt
    obtain ⟨S', hstep⟩ := ih₃ _ (hk₃ ▸ hlt) S₁ (hgates ▸ hk₁) (hauxeq.trans hk₂) rfl hp.valid
      (hp.a_eq ▸ ha)
    exact ⟨S', hstep.of_preparation hp⟩
  push Not at hch
  -- eliminating the minimal AND
  obtain ⟨x, y, hmin⟩ := hS.exists_minimalAnd hf ha hN hG hand hl hr ht12 hx hy
    fun K hK hKG => ⟨(hch K hK hKG).1, (hch K hK hKG).2⟩
  exact hS.step_of_minimalAnd hf ha hN hmin

theorem eval_cnf (f : BitString n → Bool) (x : BitString n) : eval .and (cnf f) x = f x := by
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.2
  rw [cnf, eval_gate_and]
  simp only [eval_excludingClause]
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases hf : f x with
    | false => exact (h ⟨x, hf⟩ rfl).elim
    | true => rfl
  · intro h y he
    subst x
    exact Bool.noConfusion (h.symm.trans y.2)

theorem exists_depth_two (f : BitString n → Bool) (op : AltOp) :
    ∃ g : AltFormula n 2, size g ≤ 2 ^ n + 1 ∧ ∀ x, eval op g x = f x := by
  cases op with
  | and => exact ⟨cnf f, size_cnf_le f, eval_cnf f⟩
  | or =>
    refine ⟨neg (cnf fun x => !f x), ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
    · simpa only [size_neg] using size_cnf_le fun x => !f x
    · exact (eval_neg _ .and x).trans (by simp [eval_cnf])

  (Circuit.depth_append_le _ _).trans (max_le (by simp)
    (Circuit.depth_pi_le _ fun _ => (Circuit.depth_oneGate _ _).le))

theorem depthWith_literalsCircuit (n : ℕ) :
    (literalsCircuit n).depthWith Unbounded.andOrCost = 0 :=
  Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero <| (Circuit.depthWith_append_le _ _ _).trans <| max_le
    (Circuit.depthWith_wiring _ _).le
    (Circuit.depthWith_pi_le _ _ fun _ => (Circuit.depthWith_oneGate _ _ _).le)

with root `op` is a circuit over the unbounded fan-in basis of AND/OR depth at most `d`, and of

theorem exists_circuit {d : ℕ} (op : AltOp) (f : AltFormula n d) :
    ∃ c : Circuit Unbounded.signature n 1,
      c.Computes Unbounded.interpretation (single (eval op f)) ∧
        c.depthWith Unbounded.andOrCost ≤ d ∧ c.depth ≤ d + 1 ∧ c.size = size f + n := by
  refine ⟨(toFormula op f).toCircuit.comp (literalsCircuit n), fun x => ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Circuit.eval_comp, eval_literalsCircuit]
    funext j
    rw [Formula.eval_toCircuit, eval_toFormula]
    rfl
  · refine (Circuit.depthWith_comp_le _ _ _).trans ?_
    rw [depthWith_literalsCircuit, add_zero]
    exact (Formula.depthWith_toCircuit_le _ _).trans (depthWith_toFormula_le op f)
  · refine (Circuit.depth_comp_le _ _).trans ?_
    have h₁ := (Formula.depth_toCircuit_le (toFormula op f)).trans (depth_toFormula_le op f)
    have h₂ := depth_literalsCircuit_le n
    omega
  · rw [Circuit.size_comp, size_literalsCircuit, Formula.size_toCircuit, size_toFormula,
      Nat.add_comm]

theorem two_rpow_lt_size_of_eval_eq_majority {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∀ (op : AltOp) (f : AltFormula n d),
      (∀ x, eval op f x = majority n x) →
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (ε * (n : ℝ) ^ (((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)) < size f + 2 * n + 1 := by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, N, hN⟩ := not_solvesKW_strictMajority.{0} d hd
  refine ⟨ε, hε, max N 1, fun n hn op f hf => ?_⟩
  have hP := solvesKW_kwProtocol hf ⟨0, le_of_max_le_right hn⟩
  -- a protocol for majority gives one for strict majority
  have hneg (z : BitString n) : (!majority n zᶜ) = strictMajority n z := by
    simpa using (strictMajority_not zᶜ).symm
  have hQ : ((kwProtocol (size f) ⟨0, le_of_max_le_right hn⟩ op f false).swapPlayers.comap
      compl compl).SolvesKW (strictMajority n) := fun x y hx hy =>
    hP.swapPlayers.comap_compl x y ((hneg x).trans hx) ((hneg y).trans hy)
  have h := lt_of_not_ge fun hle => hN n (le_of_max_le_left hn) hle _ hQ
  simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_bool] at h
  push_cast at h
  linarith

theorem synthesis_atLeastUpTo {s : Set (BooleanFunction n)} (k : ℕ) (hf : ∀ i < k, f i ∈ s) :
    ∀ i ≤ k, Synthesis interpretation s (atLeastUpTo f k i) (2 + i * (2 * (k + 2)))
  | 0, _ => by
    refine ((Synthesis.const true).union (Synthesis.const false)).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_
      (by omega)
    rintro g ⟨i', hi', j, -, rfl⟩
    obtain rfl : i' = 0 := Nat.le_zero.1 hi'
    rcases j with _ | j
    · exact Or.inl (by rw [atLeast_zero_right]; rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (by rw [atLeast_zero_succ]; rfl)
  | i + 1, hi => by
    have hprev := synthesis_atLeastUpTo k hf i (by omega)
    have hmem : ∀ j ≤ k + 1, atLeast f i j ∈ s ∪ atLeastUpTo f k i :=
      fun j hj => Or.inr ⟨i, le_rfl, j, hj, rfl⟩
    have hlevel : Synthesis interpretation (s ∪ atLeastUpTo f k i)
        (⋃ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), {atLeast f (i + 1) j}) (∑ _j ∈ Finset.range (k + 2), 2) := by
      refine Synthesis.biUnion _ _ _ fun j hj => ?_
      have hj := Finset.mem_range.1 hj
      rcases j with _ | j
      · refine (Synthesis.of_mem (hmem 0 (Nat.zero_le _))).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ (Nat.zero_le 2)
        simp
      · have h := (Synthesis.of_mem (hmem (j + 1) (by omega))).or
          ((Synthesis.of_mem (Or.inl (hf i (by omega)) : f i ∈ s ∪ atLeastUpTo f k i)).and
            (Synthesis.of_mem (hmem j (by omega))))
        refine (h.mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ le_rfl)
        rw [Set.singleton_subset_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        funext x
        rw [atLeast_succ_succ]
    refine (hprev.comp hlevel).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ ?_

private theorem referenceCode_bounds (n : ℕ) (op unit : Code) (leaves : List Code) (k B : ℕ)
    (hop : codeMass op ≤ B) (hopBits : WireBitsLe op B)
    (hk : leaves.length ≤ k)
    (hcodes : ∀ c ∈ leaves, codeMass c ≤ B ∧ WireBitsLe c B) (hne : leaves ≠ []) :
    codeMass (referenceCode n op unit leaves) ≤ (2 * leaves.length - 1) * B ∧
      WireBitsLe (referenceCode n op unit leaves)
        ((2 * leaves.length - 1) * (B + (encNat n).length + 3 * ((2 * k + 1) * B) + 2)) := by
  let M := (2 * k + 1) * B
  let D := B + (encNat n).length + 3 * M + 2
  change codeMass (leaves.balancedFold _ unit id) ≤ _ ∧
    WireBitsLe (leaves.balancedFold _ unit id) ((2 * leaves.length - 1) * D)
  refine List.balancedFold_induction
    (p := fun l c => l.length ≤ k →
      (∀ a ∈ l, codeMass a ≤ B ∧ WireBitsLe a B) → l ≠ [] →
      codeMass c ≤ (2 * l.length - 1) * B ∧ WireBitsLe c ((2 * l.length - 1) * D))
    (fun _ _ h => (h rfl).elim) ?_ ?_ leaves hk hcodes hne
  · intro c _ hc _
    have h := hc c (by simp)
    simpa only [List.length_singleton, Nat.reduceMul, Nat.reduceSub, one_mul] using
      ⟨h.1, wireBitsLe_mono h.2 (by dsimp [D]; omega)⟩
  · intro left right c d hleft hright ihleft ihright hlength hc _
    have hlpos := List.length_pos_iff.mpr hleft
    have hrpos := List.length_pos_iff.mpr hright
    have hll : left.length ≤ k := by simp only [List.length_append] at hlength; omega
    have hrl : right.length ≤ k := by simp only [List.length_append] at hlength; omega
    have hcl := ihleft hll (fun a ha => hc a (List.mem_append_left _ ha)) hleft
    have hcr := ihright hrl (fun a ha => hc a (List.mem_append_right _ ha)) hright
    have hcm : codeMass c ≤ M := hcl.1.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right B (by omega))
    have hdm : codeMass d ≤ M := hcr.1.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right B (by omega))
    have hcoeff : 2 * (left ++ right).length - 1 =
        (2 * left.length - 1) + (2 * right.length - 1) + 1 := by
      simp only [List.length_append]
      omega

    · exact wireBitsLe_mono (wireBitsLe_encoding unit) (by dsimp [B, inputBudget]; omega)
  have hop : codeMass op ≤ B ∧ WireBitsLe op B := by

    · exact (codeMass_le_encoding op).trans (by dsimp [B, inputBudget]; omega)
    · exact wireBitsLe_mono (wireBitsLe_encoding op) (by dsimp [B, inputBudget]; omega)

theorem exists_monoidProgram_computes_of_forall_commutator {G : Type*} [Group G] [NeZero n]
    {C : Set G} (hinv : ∀ σ ∈ C, σ⁻¹ ∈ C) (hcomm : ∀ σ ∈ C, ∃ α ∈ C, ∃ β ∈ C, ⁅α, β⁆ = σ)
    (F : Formula signature n) {σ : G} (hσ : σ ∈ C) :
    ∃ P : MonoidProgram (Fin n) Bool G, P.length ≤ 4 ^ F.depthWith binaryCost ∧
      P.Computes σ (F.eval interpretation) := by
  induction F generalizing σ with
  | input i =>
    refine ⟨FreeMonoid.of (.cond i σ 1), by simp, fun x => ?_⟩
    cases h : x i <;> simp [h]
  | gate op args ih =>
    cases op with
    | const c =>
      cases c
      · exact ⟨1, by simp, fun x => by simp [interpretation]⟩
      · exact ⟨FreeMonoid.of (.const 0 σ), by simp, fun x => by simp [interpretation]⟩
    | not =>
      obtain ⟨P, hlen, hP⟩ := ih 0 (hinv σ hσ)
      refine ⟨mulLeft σ P, (length_mulLeft σ P).trans_le (max_le ?_ (hlen.trans ?_)),
        fun x => (hP.not x).trans (by simp [interpretation])⟩
      · exact Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by decide)
      · exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by simp)
    | and =>
      obtain ⟨α, hα, β, hβ, rfl⟩ := hcomm σ hσ
      obtain ⟨P, hPlen, hP⟩ := ih 0 hα
      obtain ⟨Q, hQlen, hQ⟩ := ih 1 hβ
      refine ⟨P * Q * P.inv * Q.inv, ?_, fun x => (hP.and hQ x).trans rfl⟩
      set D : ℕ := max (depthWith (σ := signature) binaryCost (args 0))
        (depthWith (σ := signature) binaryCost (args 1))
      have hd : (gate (σ := signature) Op.and args).depthWith binaryCost = D + 1 := by
        simp [D, Fin.univ_succ]
      have h₀ : P.length ≤ 4 ^ D :=
        hPlen.trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (le_max_left _ _))
      have h₁ : Q.length ≤ 4 ^ D :=
        hQlen.trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (le_max_right _ _))
      calc (P * Q * P.inv * Q.inv).length = 2 * (P.length + Q.length) := by
            simp only [FreeMonoid.length_mul, length_inv]
            omega
        _ ≤ 2 * (4 ^ D + 4 ^ D) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Nat.add_le_add h₀ h₁)
        _ = 4 ^ (D + 1) := by ring
        _ = 4 ^ (gate (σ := signature) Op.and args).depthWith binaryCost := by rw [hd]
    | or =>
      obtain ⟨α, hα, β, hβ, hαβ⟩ := hcomm σ⁻¹ (hinv σ hσ)
      obtain ⟨P, hPlen, hP⟩ := ih 0 (hinv α hα)
      obtain ⟨Q, hQlen, hQ⟩ := ih 1 (hinv β hβ)
      let R := mulLeft α P * mulLeft β Q * (mulLeft α P).inv * (mulLeft β Q).inv
      have hR : R.Computes σ⁻¹ fun x => !(args 0).eval interpretation x &&
          !(args 1).eval interpretation x := by
        rw [← hαβ]
        exact hP.not.and hQ.not
      set D : ℕ := max (depthWith (σ := signature) binaryCost (args 0))
        (depthWith (σ := signature) binaryCost (args 1))
      have hd : (gate (σ := signature) Op.or args).depthWith binaryCost = D + 1 := by
        simp [D, Fin.univ_succ]
      have hD : 1 ≤ 4 ^ D := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by decide)
      have h₀ : (mulLeft α P).length ≤ 4 ^ D := (length_mulLeft α P).trans_le (max_le hD
        (hPlen.trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (le_max_left _ _))))
      have h₁ : (mulLeft β Q).length ≤ 4 ^ D := (length_mulLeft β Q).trans_le (max_le hD
        (hQlen.trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (le_max_right _ _))))
      have hRlen : R.length ≤ 4 ^ (gate (σ := signature) Op.or args).depthWith binaryCost :=
        calc R.length = 2 * ((mulLeft α P).length + (mulLeft β Q).length) := by
              simp only [R, FreeMonoid.length_mul, length_inv]
              omega
          _ ≤ 2 * (4 ^ D + 4 ^ D) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Nat.add_le_add h₀ h₁)
          _ = 4 ^ (D + 1) := by ring
          _ = 4 ^ (gate (σ := signature) Op.or args).depthWith binaryCost := by rw [hd]
      refine ⟨mulLeft σ R, (length_mulLeft σ R).trans_le
        (max_le (Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by decide)) hRlen), fun x => ?_⟩
      · rw [hR.not x]
        simp [interpretation]

@[simp] theorem eval_entryFormula (P : MonoidProgram (Fin n) Bool (Function.End (Fin w)))
    (a b : Fin w) (x : BitString n) :
    (P.entryFormula a b).eval interpretation x = decide ((P.eval x) a = b) := by
  rw [eval_eq_prod, entryFormula]
  revert a b
  refine List.balancedFold_induction (op := entryFormulaMul)
    (e := fun a b => .const (decide (a = b))) (f := Instruction.entryFormula)
    (p := fun l (T : Fin w → Fin w → Formula signature n) =>
      ∀ a b, (T a b).eval interpretation x =
        decide (((l.map (·.eval x)).prod : Function.End (Fin w)) a = b))
    (fun a b => by simp; rfl) (fun I a b => by simp) (fun l₁ l₂ u v _ _ hu hv a b => ?_) P.toList
  rw [entryFormulaMul, Formula.eval_orList, List.map_append, List.prod_append, Bool.eq_iff_iff,
    List.any_eq_true, decide_eq_true_iff]
  simp only [List.mem_map, List.mem_finRange, true_and, exists_exists_eq_and, Formula.eval_and,
    hu, hv, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨c, hc, hcb⟩ => by subst hc; exact hcb, fun h => ⟨_, rfl, h⟩⟩

theorem depthWith_entryFormula_le (P : MonoidProgram (Fin n) Bool (Function.End (Fin w)))
    (a b : Fin w) :
    (P.entryFormula a b).depthWith binaryCost ≤ (Nat.clog 2 w + 1) * Nat.clog 2 P.length := by
  let d (T : Fin w → Fin w → Formula signature n) : ℕ :=
    Finset.univ.sup fun ab : Fin w × Fin w => (T ab.1 ab.2).depthWith binaryCost
  have hd (T : Fin w → Fin w → Formula signature n) (a b : Fin w) :
      (T a b).depthWith binaryCost ≤ d T :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun ab : Fin w × Fin w => (T ab.1 ab.2).depthWith binaryCost)
      (Finset.mem_univ (a, b))
  have hop (u v : Fin w → Fin w → Formula signature n) :
      d (entryFormulaMul u v) ≤ max (d u) (d v) + (Nat.clog 2 w + 1) := by
    refine Finset.sup_le fun ab _ => (Formula.depthWith_binaryCost_orList_le (d := max (d u)
      (d v) + 1) fun F hF => ?_).trans ?_
    · obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hF
      rw [Formula.depthWith_and, binaryCost_and]
      have := hd u c ab.2
      have := hd v ab.1 c
      omega
    · rw [List.length_map, List.length_finRange]
      omega
  have := List.apply_balancedFold_le d hop (l := P.toList) (D := 0)
    (e := fun a b => .const (decide (a = b))) (f := Instruction.entryFormula)
    (fun I _ => Finset.sup_le fun ab _ => (Instruction.depthWith_entryFormula I ab.1 ab.2).le)
    (fun _ => Finset.sup_le fun ab _ => by simp)
  rw [zero_add] at this
  exact (hd _ a b).trans this

at `a` and accepting at the states of `acc`, is computed by a De Morgan formula of depth at most
`(⌈log₂ w⌉ + 1) ⌈log₂ L⌉ + ⌈log₂ w⌉`, with negations only at the leaves (`Formula.IsNNF`). -/

theorem exists_formula (P : MonoidProgram (Fin n) Bool (Function.End (Fin w))) (a : Fin w)
    (acc : Finset (Fin w)) :
    ∃ F : Formula signature n, (∀ x, F.eval interpretation x = decide ((P.eval x) a ∈ acc)) ∧
      F.depthWith binaryCost ≤ (Nat.clog 2 w + 1) * Nat.clog 2 P.length + Nat.clog 2 w ∧
        F.IsNNF := by
  classical
  refine ⟨Formula.orList (acc.toList.map (P.entryFormula a)), fun x => ?_, ?_,
    .orList fun F hF => ?_⟩
  · rw [Formula.eval_orList, Bool.eq_iff_iff, List.any_eq_true, decide_eq_true_iff]
    simp
  · refine (Formula.depthWith_binaryCost_orList_le fun F hF => ?_).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left
      (Nat.clog_mono_right 2 (by simpa using acc.card_le_univ)) _)
    obtain ⟨b, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hF
    exact depthWith_entryFormula_le P a b
  · obtain ⟨b, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hF
    exact P.isNNF_entryFormula a b

and length `L` that `σ`-computes `f`, with `σ ≠ 1`, is turned into a De Morgan formula computing

leaves (`Formula.IsNNF`): `f` is true where some `a` is mapped to some `b ≠ a`. -/

theorem Computes.exists_formula {P : MonoidProgram (Fin n) Bool (Perm (Fin w))} {σ : Perm (Fin w)}
    {f : BooleanFunction n} (hP : P.Computes σ f) (hσ : σ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ F : Formula signature n, F.Computes interpretation f ∧
      F.depthWith binaryCost ≤ (Nat.clog 2 w + 1) * Nat.clog 2 P.length + Nat.clog 2 (w * w) ∧
        F.IsNNF := by
  let Q := P.map (MulAction.toEndHom (M := Perm (Fin w)) (α := Fin w))
  let pairs := (List.finRange w ×ˢ List.finRange w).filter fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2
  refine ⟨Formula.orList (pairs.map fun p => Q.entryFormula p.1 p.2), fun x => ?_, ?_,
    .orList fun F hF => ?_⟩
  · rw [Formula.eval_orList, List.any_map, Bool.eq_iff_iff, List.any_eq_true]
    simp only [Function.comp_def, eval_entryFormula, Q, eval_map, hP x, pairs, List.mem_filter,
      List.mem_product, List.mem_finRange, true_and, decide_eq_true_eq, Prod.exists, ne_eq]
    cases hf : f x
    · simp only [MulAction.toEndHom, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, map_one, iff_false]
      simp only [not_exists, not_and]
      intro a b hab h
      exact hab h
    · simp only [↓reduceIte, iff_true]
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := not_forall.1 fun h => hσ (Perm.ext h)
      exact ⟨a, σ a, fun h => ha h.symm, rfl⟩
  · refine (Formula.depthWith_binaryCost_orList_le fun F hF => ?_).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left
      (Nat.clog_mono_right 2 ?_) _)
    · obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hF
      simpa [Q] using depthWith_entryFormula_le Q p.1 p.2
    · rw [List.length_map]
      exact (List.length_filter_le _ _).trans
        (by rw [List.length_product, List.length_finRange])
  · obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hF
    exact Q.isNNF_entryFormula p.1 p.2

theorem mem_NC_one_iff_formulaDepth_le :
    L ∈ NC 1 ↔ ∃ c, ∀ n, formulaDepth (L.slice n) ≤ c * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) := by
  simp only [NC, PolylogDepth, DepthClass, pow_one, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, s, -, hC⟩
    refine ⟨c, fun n => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hCc, hCd, -⟩ := hC n
    calc formulaDepth (L.slice n) ≤ (C.toFormula 0).depthWith binaryCost :=
          formulaDepth_le (hCc.toFormula 0)
      _ ≤ (C.toFormula 0).depth := (C.toFormula 0).depthWith_le_depth binaryCost_le_one
      _ ≤ C.depth := C.depth_toFormula_le 0
      _ ≤ c * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) := hCd
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨c + 1, fun n => 2 ^ ((c + 1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 1)),
      polynomiallyBounded_two_pow_mul_log _, fun n => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨F, hF, hd⟩ := exists_computes_depth_le_formulaDepth_add_one (L.slice n)
    have hd' : F.depth ≤ (c + 1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) := by
      have := hc n
      rw [add_mul, one_mul]
      omega
    refine ⟨F.toCircuit, hF.toCircuit, F.depth_toCircuit_le.trans hd', ?_⟩
    rw [F.size_toCircuit]
    exact (F.size_lt_pow_depth Boolean.arity_le_two le_rfl).le.trans
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos hd')

theorem polyLength_subset_NC_one (M : Type*) [Monoid M] [Finite M] : PolyLength Bool M ⊆ NC 1 := by
  classical
  rintro L ⟨s, hs, hP⟩
  obtain ⟨k, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin M
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs.exists_clog_le_mul_log
  refine mem_NC_one_iff_formulaDepth_le.2 ⟨(Nat.clog 2 k + 1) * a + Nat.clog 2 k, fun n => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨P, S, hPS, hlen⟩ := hP n
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hd, -⟩ := (P.map (leftMulEnd e)).exists_formula (e 1)
    (Finset.univ.filter fun i => e.symm i ∈ S)
  have hFc : F.Computes interpretation (L.slice n) := fun x => by
    rw [hF x, Bool.eq_iff_iff, decide_eq_true_iff, hPS x]
    simp [leftMulEnd_apply]
  calc formulaDepth (L.slice n) ≤ F.depthWith binaryCost := formulaDepth_le hFc
    _ ≤ (Nat.clog 2 k + 1) * Nat.clog 2 P.length + Nat.clog 2 k := by
        simpa only [MonoidProgram.length_map] using hd
    _ ≤ (Nat.clog 2 k + 1) * (a * (Nat.log 2 n + 1)) + Nat.clog 2 k * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) :=
        Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ((Nat.clog_mono_right 2 hlen).trans (ha n)))
          (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.succ_pos _))
    _ = ((Nat.clog 2 k + 1) * a + Nat.clog 2 k) * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) := by ring

    (op : FullOp 2 F) (args : Fin ((fullSignature 2 F).Arity op) → (Fin n → Bool) → F)
    (hargs : ∀ a j, bitsOf enc (args a) j ∈ s) (j : Fin w) :

      (2 ^ (2 * w) * (4 * w + 2) + 1) := by
  have hk : (fullSignature 2 F).Arity op ≤ 2 := by
    rcases op with _ | _ <;> simp [fullSignature]
  let ψ : BooleanFunction ((fullSignature 2 F).Arity op * w) := fun y =>
    enc (fullInterpretation op fun a => enc.symm fun j' => y (finProdFinEquiv (a, j'))) j
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hsize⟩ := (selected (n := (fullSignature 2 F).Arity op * w) id ψ).exists_circuit
  have h := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) c
    (fun idx => bitsOf enc (args (finProdFinEquiv.symm idx).1) (finProdFinEquiv.symm idx).2)
    (fun idx => hargs _ _)
  refine h.mono Set.Subset.rfl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨0, ?_⟩) (hsize.trans ?_)
  · funext x
    refine (congrFun (hc _) 0).trans ?_

  · have hkw : (fullSignature 2 F).Arity op * w ≤ 2 * w := Nat.mul_le_mul_right w hk
    have hpow : 2 ^ ((fullSignature 2 F).Arity op * w) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * w) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hkw
    have : 2 * ((fullSignature 2 F).Arity op * w) + 2 ≤ 4 * w + 2 := by omega

theorem bitBlast_program (enc : F ≃ BitString w) {s : Set (BooleanFunction n)} {N g : ℕ}
    (p : Program (fullSignature 2 F) N g) (φ : Fin N → (Fin n → Bool) → F)
    (hφ : ∀ i j, bitsOf enc (φ i) j ∈ s) :
    Synthesis interpretation s
      (Set.range fun wj : Wire N g × Fin w =>
        bitsOf enc (fun x => p.trace fullInterpretation (fun i => φ i x) wj.1) wj.2)
      (g * bitBlastCost w) := by
  induction p with
  | empty =>
    rw [zero_mul]
    refine of_subset ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨wire, j⟩, rfl⟩
    cases wire with
    | input i => exact hφ i j
    | gate j' => exact j'.elim0
  | @gate g p line ih =>
    let T : Set (BooleanFunction n) := Set.range fun wj : Wire N g × Fin w =>
      bitsOf enc (fun x => p.trace fullInterpretation (fun i => φ i x) wj.1) wj.2
    have hnew : Synthesis interpretation (s ∪ T)
        (Set.range fun j => bitsOf enc (fun x => line.eval fullInterpretation (fun i => φ i x)
          (p.eval fullInterpretation fun i => φ i x)) j) (bitBlastCost w) := by
      have := family (I := interpretation) (s := s ∪ T)
        (fun j => bitsOf enc (fun x => line.eval fullInterpretation (fun i => φ i x)
          (p.eval fullInterpretation fun i => φ i x)) j)
        (fun _ => 2 ^ (2 * w) * (4 * w + 2) + 1)
        (fun j => bitBlast_gateBit enc line.op
          (fun a x => p.trace fullInterpretation (fun i => φ i x) (line.wires a))
          (fun a j' => Set.mem_union_right s (⟨(line.wires a, j'), rfl⟩ : _ ∈ T)) j)
      simpa [bitBlastCost, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using this
    refine (ih.comp hnew).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ (by rw [Nat.succ_mul])
    rintro _ ⟨⟨wire, j⟩, rfl⟩
    induction wire using Wire.lastCases with
    | last =>
      refine Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨j, ?_⟩
      funext x
      simp only [bitsOf, Program.trace_gateWire, Program.gateFunction_gate_last]
    | castSucc wire =>
      refine Set.mem_union_left _ ⟨(wire, j), ?_⟩
      funext x
      simp only [bitsOf, Program.trace_gate_castSucc]

over the full binary basis of `F` are available, then the bits of all its outputs can be made
available with `c.size * bitBlastCost w` De Morgan gates. -/

theorem complexity_le_of_eq_threshold {m j : ℕ} (F : BooleanFunction (n + p))
    (g : BooleanFunction n) (ω : Fin m → Fin p → Bool)
    (h : ∀ x, g x = threshold m j fun i => F (Fin.append x (ω i))) :
    complexity interpretation (single g) ≤
      m * (complexity interpretation (single F) + 2) + (2 + m * (2 * (m + 2))) := by
  let f : Fin m → BooleanFunction n := fun i x => F (substitute (appendInputs (ω i)) x)
  have hg : single g = single (threshold m j) ∘ fun x i => f i x :=
    funext fun x => funext fun _ => by simp [f, h x, single]
  rw [hg]
  refine (complexity_comp_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ((complexity_pi_le f).trans ?_)
    (complexity_threshold_le m j))
  calc ∑ i, complexity interpretation (single (f i))
      ≤ ∑ _i : Fin m, (complexity interpretation (single F) + 2) :=
        sum_le_sum fun i _ => complexity_substitute_le _ _
    _ = m * (complexity interpretation (single F) + 2) := by
        rw [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]

least two thirds of the random strings `r` have `F (x ++ r) = g x`, then some function agreeing
with `g` on `S` has circuits of size `O(n (C(F) + n))`. -/

theorem exists_complexity_le_of_boundedError (S : Set (Fin n → Bool))
    (F : BooleanFunction (n + p)) (g : BooleanFunction n)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ S, 2 * 2 ^ p ≤
      3 * (univ.filter fun r : Fin p → Bool => F (Fin.append x r) = g x).card) :
    ∃ g' : BooleanFunction n, (∀ x ∈ S, g' x = g x) ∧
      complexity interpretation (single g') ≤
        (12 * n + 12) * (complexity interpretation (single F) + 2) +
          (2 + (12 * n + 12) * (2 * (12 * n + 12 + 2))) := by
  classical
  set R := 6 * n + 6 with hR
  obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := Cslib.exists_forall_lt_card_filter_mem (X := S) (n := n)
    ((Fintype.card_subtype_le _).trans (by simp))
    (fun x => univ.filter fun r => F (Fin.append x.1 r) = g x.1)
    fun x => by simpa [Fintype.card_fun] using h x.1 x.2
  refine ⟨fun x => threshold (2 * R) (R + 1) fun i => F (Fin.append x (ω i)), fun x hx => ?_,
    (complexity_le_of_eq_threshold F _ ω fun _ => rfl).trans_eq
      (by rw [show 2 * R = 12 * n + 12 by omega])⟩
  have hc := hω ⟨x, hx⟩
  simp only at hc
  change threshold _ _ (fun i => F (Fin.append x (ω i))) = g x
  rw [threshold_apply, BitString.weight, Bool.eq_iff_iff, decide_eq_true_iff]
  cases hgx : g x
  · have e : (univ.filter fun i => F (Fin.append x (ω i)) = true) =
        univ \ univ.filter fun i => ω i ∈ univ.filter fun r => F (Fin.append x r) = g x := by
      ext i
      simp [hgx]
    rw [e, card_univ_sdiff, Fintype.card_fin]
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, iff_false, not_le]
    omega
  · have e : (univ.filter fun i => F (Fin.append x (ω i)) = true) =
        univ.filter fun i => ω i ∈ univ.filter fun r => F (Fin.append x r) = g x := by
      ext i
      simp [hgx]
    rw [e]
    simpa using hc

/-- **Adleman's theorem**, for one input length. If, for every `x`, at least two thirds of the
random strings `r` have `F (x ++ r) = g x`, then `g` has circuits of size
`O(n (C(F) + n))`. -/

theorem exists_complexity_le_of_oneSidedError (S : Set (Fin n → Bool))
    (F : BooleanFunction (n + p)) (g : BooleanFunction n)
    (h₁ : ∀ x ∈ S, g x = true →
      2 ^ p ≤ 2 * (univ.filter fun r : Fin p → Bool => F (Fin.append x r) = true).card)
    (h₂ : ∀ x ∈ S, g x = false → ∀ r, F (Fin.append x r) = false) :
    ∃ g' : BooleanFunction n, (∀ x ∈ S, g' x = g x) ∧
      complexity interpretation (single g') ≤
        (n + 1) * (complexity interpretation (single F) + 2) +
          (2 + (n + 1) * (2 * (n + 1 + 2))) := by
  classical
  let good : S → Finset (Fin p → Bool) := fun x =>
    if g x.1 = true then univ.filter fun r => F (Fin.append x.1 r) = true else univ
  obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := Cslib.exists_forall_exists_apply_mem (X := S) (n := n)
    ((Fintype.card_subtype_le _).trans (by simp)) good fun x => by
      rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin]
      by_cases hx : g x.1 = true
      · simpa [good, hx] using h₁ x.1 x.2 hx
      · rw [show good x = univ from ite_eq_right hx, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun,
          Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin]
        omega
  refine ⟨fun x => threshold (n + 1) 1 fun i => F (Fin.append x (ω i)), fun x hx => ?_,
    complexity_le_of_eq_threshold F _ ω fun _ => rfl⟩
  change threshold _ _ (fun i => F (Fin.append x (ω i))) = g x
  rw [threshold_apply, BitString.weight, Bool.eq_iff_iff, decide_eq_true_iff,
    Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero, Ne,
    card_eq_zero, filter_eq_empty_iff]
  push Not
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, -, hi⟩
    by_contra hgx
    rw [h₂ x hx (by simpa using hgx) (ω i)] at hi
    exact Bool.noConfusion hi
  · intro hgx
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hω ⟨x, hx⟩
    simp only [good, hgx, ite_true, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hi
    exact ⟨i, mem_univ _, hi⟩

/-- **Adleman's theorem for one-sided error**, for one input length. If, for every `x` with
`g x = true`, at least half of the random strings `r` have `F (x ++ r) = true`, and for every `x`
with `g x = false` none has, then `g` has circuits of size `O(n (C(F) + n))`. -/

theorem PPoly.exists_of_boundedError {p : ℕ → ℕ} (F : ∀ n, BooleanFunction (n + p n))
    (hF : PolynomiallyBounded fun n => complexity interpretation (single (F n)))
    (S : ∀ n, Set (Fin n → Bool)) (g : ∀ n, BooleanFunction n)
    (h : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ S n, 2 * 2 ^ p n ≤
      3 * (univ.filter fun r : Fin (p n) → Bool => F n (Fin.append x r) = g n x).card) :
    ∃ L ∈ PPoly, ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ S n, L.slice n x = g n x := by
  choose g' hg' hc using fun n => exists_complexity_le_of_boundedError (S n) (F n) (g n) (h n)
  refine ⟨Language.ofSlices g', ?_, fun n x hx => by rw [Language.slice_ofSlices, hg' n x hx]⟩
  set q := fun n => complexity interpretation (single (F n)) with hq
  have : PolynomiallyBounded q := hF
  refine PolynomiallyBounded.mono_of_le
    (g := fun n => (12 * n + 12) * (q n + 2) + (2 + (12 * n + 12) * (2 * (12 * n + 12 + 2))))
    (by fun_prop) fun n => ?_
  simpa only [Language.slice_ofSlices] using hc n

/-- **Adleman's theorem.** If `F n` is a family of functions of `n + p n` variables with circuits
of polynomial size, and for every input `x` of every length `n` at least two thirds of the random
strings `r` have `F n (x ++ r) = A.slice n x`, then `A ∈ P/poly`. -/

theorem PPoly.exists_of_oneSidedError {p : ℕ → ℕ} (F : ∀ n, BooleanFunction (n + p n))
    (hF : PolynomiallyBounded fun n => complexity interpretation (single (F n)))
    (S : ∀ n, Set (Fin n → Bool)) (g : ∀ n, BooleanFunction n)
    (h₁ : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ S n, g n x = true →
      2 ^ p n ≤ 2 * (univ.filter fun r : Fin (p n) → Bool => F n (Fin.append x r) = true).card)
    (h₂ : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ S n, g n x = false → ∀ r, F n (Fin.append x r) = false) :
    ∃ L ∈ PPoly, ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ S n, L.slice n x = g n x := by
  choose g' hg' hc using fun n =>
    exists_complexity_le_of_oneSidedError (S n) (F n) (g n) (h₁ n) (h₂ n)
  refine ⟨Language.ofSlices g', ?_, fun n x hx => by rw [Language.slice_ofSlices, hg' n x hx]⟩
  set q := fun n => complexity interpretation (single (F n)) with hq
  have : PolynomiallyBounded q := hF
  refine PolynomiallyBounded.mono_of_le
    (g := fun n => (n + 1) * (q n + 2) + (2 + (n + 1) * (2 * (n + 1 + 2))))
    (by fun_prop) fun n => ?_
  simpa only [Language.slice_ofSlices] using hc n

theorem eval_values_eq_true_iff {input count keyWidth width : ℕ}
    (key : Fin count → Fin keyWidth → Fin input) (tag : Fin count → Fin input)
    (payload : Fin count → Fin width → Fin input) (x : BitString input)
    (sorted : Monotone (fun record =>
      toLex (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Bool) (x ∘ key record) (x (tag record)))))
    (bit : Fin width) (destination : Fin count) (htag : x (tag destination) = true) :
    (values key tag payload).eval interpretation x (finProdFinEquiv (bit, destination)) = true ↔
      ∃ source, x ∘ key source = x ∘ key destination ∧
        x (tag source) = false ∧ x (payload source bit) = true := by
  rw [eval_values]
  have sortedNat : MonotoneOn (fun i =>
      toLex (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Bool) (inputKey key x i) (inputBlock (x ∘ tag) i)))
      (Set.Iio count) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    change a < count at ha
    change b < count at hb
    have hs := sorted (a := ⟨a, ha⟩) (b := ⟨b, hb⟩) hab
    dsimp only
    rw [inputKey_fin key x ⟨a, ha⟩, inputKey_fin key x ⟨b, hb⟩]
    simpa only [inputBlock, dite_eq_left ha, dite_eq_left hb, Function.comp_apply] using hs
  rw [BitString.propagate_sorted_tagged_eq_true_iff (inputKey key x) (inputBlock (x ∘ tag))
    (inputBlock (fun r => x (payload r bit))) destination.isLt
    (by simpa only [inputBlock, dite_eq_left destination.isLt, Function.comp_apply] using htag)
    sortedNat]
  rw [inputKey_fin]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨source, before, hkey, htag, hpayload⟩
    refine ⟨⟨source, before⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (inputKey_fin key x ⟨source, before⟩).symm.trans hkey
    · simpa only [inputBlock, dite_eq_left before, Function.comp_apply] using htag
    · simpa only [inputBlock, dite_eq_left before] using hpayload
  · rintro ⟨source, hkey, htag, hpayload⟩
    refine ⟨source.val, source.isLt, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (inputKey_fin key x source).trans hkey
    · simpa only [inputBlock, dite_eq_left source.isLt, Function.comp_apply] using htag
    · simpa only [inputBlock, dite_eq_left source.isLt] using hpayload

def broadcastCircuit {headerWidth keyWidth : ℕ}
    (key : Fin keyWidth → Fin headerWidth) (tag : Fin headerWidth)
    (count width : ℕ) : Circuit signature (count * (headerWidth + width))
      (count * (headerWidth + width)) :=
  (Circuit.wiring signature (outputWire count headerWidth width)).comp
    ((Circuit.id signature (count * (headerWidth + width))).append
      (broadcastCircuit.values
        (fun record bit => finProdFinEquiv (record, Fin.castAdd width (key bit)))
        (fun record => finProdFinEquiv (record, Fin.castAdd width tag))
        (fun record bit => finProdFinEquiv (record, Fin.natAdd headerWidth bit))))

theorem eval_broadcastCircuit_value_of_unique_source {count headerWidth keyWidth width : ℕ}
    (key : Fin keyWidth → Fin headerWidth) (tag : Fin headerWidth)
    (x : BitString (count * (headerWidth + width)))
    (sorted : Monotone (fun record =>
      toLex (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Bool) (header x record ∘ key) (header x record tag))))
    (source destination : Fin count) (hkey : header x source ∘ key = header x destination ∘ key)
    (hsource : header x source tag = false) (hdestination : header x destination tag = true)
    (unique : ∀ record, header x record ∘ key = header x source ∘ key →
      header x record tag = false → record = source) :
    value ((broadcastCircuit key tag count width).eval interpretation x) destination =
      value x source := by
  funext bit
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  rw [eval_broadcastCircuit_value_eq_true_iff key tag x sorted destination hdestination bit]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨record, hrecord, htag, hvalue⟩
    exact unique record (hrecord.trans hkey.symm) htag ▸ hvalue
  · intro hvalue
    exact ⟨source, hkey, hsource, hvalue⟩

  have h := val_eval_carryLookahead a b false

  simp only [Bool.toNat_false, Nat.add_zero] at h

  rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right] at hm
  have he : (carryLookaheadAdd w).eval interpretation (Fin.append a b) =
      Fin.init ((carryLookahead w).eval interpretation
        (Fin.append (Fin.append a b) (fun _ => false))) := by
    simp only [carryLookaheadAdd, Circuit.eval_comp, Circuit.eval_append, Circuit.eval_wiring]
    rfl
  rw [he]
  exact (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (BitString.equivFin w _).isLt).symm.trans hm

theorem computableInPolyTime_scan :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (scan p.1 p.2).code)
      (encPair encUnary encUnary) encCode := by
  refine .of_tidy ?_
  let stateEnc := encPair encUnary encCode
  let init (k : ℕ) : ℕ × (List (Op × List ℕ) × List ℕ) := (0, ([], List.range (k + k)))
  let next (k : ℕ) (state : ℕ × (List (Op × List ℕ) × List ℕ)) :=
    (state.1 + 1, compCode (k + k) (stepCode k (2 ^ state.1)) state.2)
  have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ℕ × (ℕ × (List (Op × List ℕ) × List ℕ)) => next p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encUnary stateEnc) stateEnc := by
    have hk := fst encUnary stateEnc
    have ht := (snd encUnary stateEnc).fst'
    have hc := (snd encUnary stateEnc).snd'
    have hd := binary_two_pow.comp ht
    have hk' := unary_to_binary.comp hk
    have ht' : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun p : ℕ × (ℕ × (List (Op × List ℕ) × List ℕ)) => p.2.1 + 1)
        (encPair encUnary stateEnc) encUnary := by fun_prop
    exact ht'.prod (computableInPolyTime_compCode
      (.of_tidy (by fun_prop)) (computableInPolyTime_stepCode (.of_tidy hk) (.of_tidy hd))
        (.of_tidy hc)).tidy
  have hi : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => init p.1)
      (encPair encUnary encUnary) stateEnc := by
    have hr := unary_to_binary.map.comp
      (range.comp (show ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1 + p.1)
        (encPair encUnary encUnary) encUnary from by fun_prop))
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, List.map_id_fun', id_eq, init] using
      (const (encMid := encUnary) 0).prod ((const (encMid := encList encGate) []).prod hr)
  have heq (k t : ℕ) : (next k)^[t] (init k) = (t, (scan k t).code) := by
    induction t with
    | zero => simp [init, scan]
    | succ t ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply' (f := next k), ih]
      simp only [next, stepCode_eq, compCode_code, scan]
  let bound (p : ℕ × ℕ) := 2 * p.2 + 1 +
    (2 * (3 * p.1 * p.2) * (23 + 8 * ((p.1 + p.1) + 3 * p.1 * p.2)) + 1 +
      (p.1 + p.1) * (2 * ((p.1 + p.1) + 3 * p.1 * p.2) + 1))
  have hb : PolyBounded (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (encPair encUnary encUnary p).length) bound :=
    polyBounded (by unfold bound; fun_prop)
  have h := iterateWith (par := Prod.fst) (count := Prod.snd) (init := fun p => init p.1)
    (step := next) (fst _ _) (snd _ _) hi hn hb (fun p i hit => by
      rw [heq]
      have hsize : (scan p.1 i).size ≤ 3 * p.1 * p.2 := by
        rw [size_scan]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hit
      have hcode := length_encCode_le (scan p.1 i)
      have hbound : (encCode (scan p.1 i).code).length ≤
          2 * (3 * p.1 * p.2) * (23 + 8 * ((p.1 + p.1) + 3 * p.1 * p.2)) + 1 +
            (p.1 + p.1) * (2 * ((p.1 + p.1) + 3 * p.1 * p.2) + 1) :=
        hcode.trans (by gcongr)
      change (encPair encUnary encCode (i, (scan p.1 i).code)).length ≤ _
      rw [length_encPair]
      simp only [encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate]
      dsimp only [bound]
      omega)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, heq] using h.snd'

def compareSwapCircuit {k r : ℕ} (key : Fin k → Fin r) :
    Circuit signature (r + r) (r + r) :=
  if r = 0 then Circuit.id signature (r + r) else
    exchange (Formula.lexLt (Fin.natAdd r ∘ key) (Fin.castAdd r ∘ key)).toCircuit
where
  /-- Retain a flag and compute its negation once. -/
  flagPair : Circuit signature 1 2 :=
    (Circuit.id signature 1).append ((Formula.input (0 : Fin 1)).not.toCircuit)
  /-- Select one of two data wires using a stored flag and its stored negation. -/
  selectBit {n : ℕ} (left right : Fin n) : Formula signature (2 + n) :=
    ((Formula.input (Fin.castAdd n (0 : Fin 2))).and (Formula.input (Fin.natAdd 2 right))).or
      ((Formula.input (Fin.castAdd n (1 : Fin 2))).and (Formula.input (Fin.natAdd 2 left)))
  /-- Swap the two blocks of record wires. -/
  swapInput (r : ℕ) : Fin (r + r) → Fin (r + r) :=
    Fin.addCases (Fin.natAdd r) (Fin.castAdd r)
  /-- Switch two payload blocks using a supplied flag and its supplied complement. -/
  switch (r : ℕ) : Circuit signature (2 + (r + r)) (r + r) :=
    Circuit.pi fun j => (selectBit j (swapInput r j)).toCircuit
  /-- Expose the shared flag and its complement before the exchanged records. -/
  record {r : ℕ} (flag : Circuit signature (r + r) 1) :
      Circuit signature (r + r) (2 + (r + r)) :=
    ((Circuit.wiring signature (Fin.castAdd (r + r))).append (switch r)).comp
      ((flagPair.comp flag).append (Circuit.id signature (r + r)))
  /-- Share a swap flag across every bit of the two records. -/
  exchange {r : ℕ} (flag : Circuit signature (r + r) 1) :
      Circuit signature (r + r) (r + r) :=
    (switch r).comp
      ((flagPair.comp flag).append (Circuit.id signature (r + r)))

theorem complexityGiven_le_of_cover (f g : BitString n → BitString m) (s : Finset (BitString n))
    (select : Fin k → Fin m) (hs : ∀ x ∉ s, f x = g x)
    (hselect : ∀ j ∉ Set.range select, ∀ x, f x j = g x j) :
    complexityGiven interpretation f g ≤
      complexity interpretation (single fun x => decide (x ∈ s)) +
        complexityOn interpretation s (fun x i => f x (select i) ^^ g x (select i)) + 5 * k := by
  obtain ⟨cp, hcp, hcp_size⟩ := exists_computes_patch select
  obtain ⟨cs, hcs, hcs_size⟩ := exists_computes_size_eq_complexity (I := interpretation)
    (f := single fun x => decide (x ∈ s))
  obtain ⟨cl, hcl, hcl_size⟩ := exists_computesOn_size_eq_complexityOn (I := interpretation)
    (S := (s : Set (BitString n))) (f := fun x i => f x (select i) ^^ g x (select i))
  let read : Circuit signature (n + m) n := Circuit.wiring signature (Fin.castAdd m)
  let old : Circuit signature (n + m) m := Circuit.wiring signature (Fin.natAdd n)
  let c := cp.comp (old.append ((cs.comp read).append (cl.comp read)))
  have hc (x : BitString n) : c.eval interpretation (Fin.append x (g x)) = f x := by
    simp only [c, old, read, Circuit.eval_comp, Circuit.eval_append, Circuit.eval_wiring,
      Fin.append_comp_castAdd, Fin.append_comp_natAdd, hcp _, hcs x]
    funext j
    by_cases h : ∃ i, select i = j
    · have hi := h.choose_spec
      simp only [patch, h, dite_true, oldWire, supportWire, labelWire, Fin.append_left,
        Fin.append_right, single_apply]
      by_cases hx : x ∈ s
      · rw [show cl.eval interpretation x = _ from hcl (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx)]
        simp only [hx, decide_true, Bool.true_and, hi]
        cases f x j <;> cases g x j <;> rfl
      · simp [hx, hs x hx]
    · simp only [patch, h, dite_false, oldWire, Fin.append_left]
      exact (hselect j (fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => h ⟨i, hi⟩) x).symm
  have hle := ecomplexityGiven_le_of_eval f g c hc
  rw [← natCast_complexityGiven] at hle
  have hsize : c.size ≤ complexity interpretation (single fun x => decide (x ∈ s)) +
      complexityOn interpretation s (fun x i => f x (select i) ^^ g x (select i)) + 5 * k := by
    simp only [c, old, read, Circuit.size_comp, Circuit.size_append, Circuit.size_wiring]

theorem two_pow_le_card_subfunctions_elementDistinctness (hm : m ≤ 2 ^ t) (i : Fin m) :
    2 ^ (t * (m - 1)) ≤ #(subfunctions (elementDistinctness m (t + t)) (blockBits (t + t) i)) := by
  -- Give block `j ≠ i` the value `(j, u j)`.
  let w (u : {j // j ≠ i} → Fin t → Bool) : Fin m → Fin t → Bool :=
    fun j => if h : j = i then fun _ => false else u ⟨j, h⟩
  let val (u : {j // j ≠ i} → Fin t → Bool) (j : Fin m) : Fin (t + t) → Bool :=
    Fin.append (tag t j) (w u j)
  have htag {u u' : {j // j ≠ i} → Fin t → Bool} {j j' : Fin m} (h : val u j = val u' j') :
      j = j' :=
    tag_injective hm (funext fun c => by simpa [val] using congrFun h (Fin.castAdd t c))
  let g (u : {j // j ≠ i} → Fin t → Bool) : BooleanFunction (m * (t + t)) :=
    fun x => elementDistinctness m (t + t) ((blockBits (t + t) i).piecewise x (tagged (w u)))
  have hg (u : {j // j ≠ i} → Fin t → Bool) (x : BitString (m * (t + t))) :
      g u x = decide (Function.Injective fun j => if j = i then block x j else val u j) := by
    have h : block ((blockBits (t + t) i).piecewise x (tagged (w u))) =
        fun j => if j = i then block x j else val u j := by
      funext j
      rw [block_piecewise, block_tagged]
    simp only [g, elementDistinctness, h]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn g (univ : Finset ({j // j ≠ i} → Fin t → Bool)) := by
    intro u _ u' _ huu
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.1 hne
    -- The value of block `j` under `u` is not the value of any other block under `u'`.
    have key (l : Fin m) (hl : l ≠ i) (h : val u j = val u' l) : False := by
      obtain rfl := htag h
      refine hj (funext fun c => ?_)
      have hc := congrFun h (Fin.natAdd t c)
      simp only [val] at hc
      rw [Fin.append_right, Fin.append_right] at hc
      simpa [w, j.2] using hc
    -- An input whose block `i` repeats block `j` of the first assignment.
    let x : BitString (m * (t + t)) := fun p => val u j (finProdFinEquiv.symm p).2
    have hx : ∀ l, block x l = val u j := fun l => funext fun b => by
      simp only [x, block, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have h₁ : g u x = false := by
      rw [hg, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      intro h
      exact j.2 (@h i j (by simp [hx, val, w, j.2])).symm
    have h₂ : g u' x = true := by
      rw [hg, decide_eq_true_iff]
      intro l₁ l₂ h
      by_cases h₁ : l₁ = i <;> by_cases h₂ : l₂ = i
      · exact h₁.trans h₂.symm
      · simp only [h₁, h₂, ↓reduceIte, hx] at h
        exact (key l₂ h₂ h).elim
      · simp only [h₁, h₂, ↓reduceIte, hx] at h
        exact (key l₁ h₁ h.symm).elim
      · simpa [h₁, h₂] using htag (u := u') (u' := u') (by simpa [h₁, h₂] using h)
    exact absurd (congrFun huu x) (by rw [h₁, h₂]; decide)
  have hcard : Fintype.card ({j // j ≠ i} → Fin t → Bool) = 2 ^ (t * (m - 1)) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin,
      Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_unique, pow_mul]
  rw [← hcard, ← card_univ]
  exact card_le_card_of_injOn g (fun u _ => mem_subfunctions.2 ⟨tagged (w u), rfl⟩) hinj

    {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {c : γ → Σ n, Circuit signature n 1} {x : γ → List Bool}

    (computableInPolyTime_evalOutput (.of_tidy hpad) (.of_tidy hparts.snd'.fst') (.of_tidy

theorem depth_dedupLine_le (line : Line signature n g) (depths : Wire n g → ℕ) :
    (dedupLine line).depth depths ≤ line.depth depths := by
  have hpos := line.depth_pos depths
  have hle : ∀ a, depths (line.wires a) ≤ line.depth depths - 1 := fun a => by
    have := line.wireDepth_lt_depth depths a
    omega
  refine ((Line.depth_le_add_one_iff _ depths (d := line.depth depths - 1)).2 ?_).trans
    (by omega)
  obtain ⟨op, w⟩ := line
  cases op with
  | not => exact hle
  | and k => exact (forall_get_dedup_ofFn_iff w fun a => depths a ≤ _).2 hle
  | or k => exact (forall_get_dedup_ofFn_iff w fun a => depths a ≤ _).2 hle

    | cast k =>

theorem Op.size_deMorganFormula_le (op : Op) : op.deMorganFormula.size ≤ max 1 op.arity := by
  cases op with
  | not => simp [deMorganFormula]
  | and k =>
    rcases k.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hk
    · simp [deMorganFormula]
    · have := Formula.size_andList_add_one
        (l := List.ofFn (Formula.input (σ := Boolean.signature) (n := k))) (by simpa using hk.ne')
      simp only [List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn, Function.comp_apply, Formula.size_input,
        Finset.sum_const_zero, List.length_ofFn, zero_add] at this
      exact (le_max_right 1 k).trans' (by rw [deMorganFormula]; omega)
  | or k =>
    rcases k.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hk
    · simp [deMorganFormula]
    · have := Formula.size_orList_add_one
        (l := List.ofFn (Formula.input (σ := Boolean.signature) (n := k))) (by simpa using hk.ne')
      simp only [List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn, Function.comp_apply, Formula.size_input,
        Finset.sum_const_zero, List.length_ofFn, zero_add] at this
      exact (le_max_right 1 k).trans' (by rw [deMorganFormula]; omega)

/-- The De Morgan formula of an operation of `k` arguments has depth at most `max 1 ⌈log₂ k⌉`:
one for a negation or a constant, and `⌈log₂ k⌉` for a balanced tree of `k ≥ 1` arguments. -/
