theorem Op.depth_deMorganFormula_le (op : Op) :
    op.deMorganFormula.depth ≤ max 1 (Nat.clog 2 op.arity) := by
  cases op with
  | not => simp [deMorganFormula]
  | and k =>
    rcases k.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hk
    · simp [deMorganFormula]
    · have := Formula.depthWith_andList_le (cost := 1)
        (l := List.ofFn (Formula.input (σ := Boolean.signature) (n := k))) (d := 0) (by simp)
        (by simpa using hk.ne')
      simp only [Formula.depthWith_one, List.length_ofFn, Pi.one_apply, one_mul,
        zero_add] at this
      exact this.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  | or k =>
    rcases k.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hk
    · simp [deMorganFormula]
    · have := Formula.depthWith_orList_le (cost := 1)
        (l := List.ofFn (Formula.input (σ := Boolean.signature) (n := k))) (d := 0) (by simp)
        (by simpa using hk.ne')
      simp only [Formula.depthWith_one, List.length_ofFn, Pi.one_apply, one_mul,
        zero_add] at this
      exact this.trans (le_max_right _ _)

/-! ### Simulation -/

/-- **Fan-in two simulates unbounded fan-in** [Arora and Barak, Section 6.7][AroraBarak09]: a
circuit of unbounded fan-in with `n` inputs, `s` gates and depth `d` has an equivalent De Morgan
circuit with at most `s (n + s)` gates and depth at most `max 1 ⌈log₂ (n + s)⌉ · d`. Its gates are
first made to read every wire once (`dedup`), and then replaced by balanced trees. -/

theorem exists_deMorgan_simulation (C : Circuit signature n m) :
    ∃ D : Circuit Boolean.signature n m, D.eval Boolean.interpretation = C.eval interpretation ∧
      D.size ≤ C.size * (n + C.size) ∧
      D.depth ≤ max 1 (Nat.clog 2 (n + C.size)) * C.depth := by
  refine ⟨(dedup C).simulate fun op => op.deMorganFormula.toCircuit, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Circuit.eval_simulate _ _ fun op => (Op.computes_deMorganFormula op).toCircuit, eval_dedup]
  · rw [Circuit.size_simulate, Program.cost_eq_sum]
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum (g := fun _ => n + C.size) fun k _ => ?_).trans_eq
      (by rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, size_dedup])
    rw [Formula.size_toCircuit]
    have hk : 1 ≤ n + C.size := by have := k.pos; simp only [size_dedup] at this; omega
    exact (Op.size_deMorganFormula_le _).trans
      (max_le hk (arity_lines_dedup_le C k))
  · refine (Circuit.depth_simulate_le _ _).trans
      ((Circuit.depthWith_le_mul_depth _ fun k => ?_).trans
        (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (depth_dedup_le C)))
    exact (Formula.depth_toCircuit_le _).trans ((Op.depth_deMorganFormula_le _).trans
      (max_le_max le_rfl (Nat.clog_mono_right 2 (arity_lines_dedup_le C k))))

theorem AC_subset_NC_succ (i : ℕ) : AC i ⊆ NC (i + 1) := by
  rintro L ⟨c, s, hs, hC⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := PolynomiallyBounded.exists_clog_le_mul_log (s := fun n => n + s n)
    (by fun_prop)
  refine ⟨c * (e + 1), fun n => s n * (n + s n), by fun_prop, fun n => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hCc, hCd, hCs⟩ := hC n
  obtain ⟨D, hDe, hDs, hDd⟩ := Unbounded.exists_deMorgan_simulation C
  refine ⟨D, fun x => (congrFun hDe x).trans (hCc x), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hlog : max 1 (Nat.clog 2 (n + C.size)) ≤ (e + 1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) := by
      have := (Nat.clog_mono_right 2 (Nat.add_le_add_left hCs n)).trans (he n)
      rw [add_one_mul]
      exact max_le (Nat.le_add_left_of_le (Nat.le_add_left 1 _)) (this.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
    calc D.depth ≤ max 1 (Nat.clog 2 (n + C.size)) * C.depth := hDd
      _ ≤ ((e + 1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 1)) * (c * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) ^ i) := Nat.mul_le_mul hlog hCd
      _ = c * (e + 1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) ^ (i + 1) := by ring
  · calc D.size ≤ C.size * (n + C.size) := hDs
      _ ≤ s n * (n + s n) := by gcongr

theorem depth_toUnbounded_le (e : Atom L n ≃ Fin N) {k : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormula Empty k)
    (xs : Fin k → Fin n) : (toUnbounded e φ xs).depth ≤ foDepth φ := by
  induction φ with
  | falsum => simp [toUnbounded, constUnbounded, foDepth]
  | equal t₁ t₂ => simp only [toUnbounded, constUnbounded, foDepth]; split_ifs <;> simp
  | rel R ts => simp [toUnbounded, foDepth]
  | imp φ ψ ihφ ihψ =>
    rw [toUnbounded, foDepth, Formula.depth_gate]
    refine (Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.sup_le (a := max (foDepth φ) (foDepth ψ) + 1)
      fun j _ => ?_) 1).trans (by omega)
    fin_cases j
    · change (Formula.gate _ _).depth ≤ _
      rw [Formula.depth_gate]
      refine (Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.sup_le (a := foDepth φ) fun j _ => ?_) 1).trans
        (by omega)
      fin_cases j
      exact ihφ xs
    · exact (ihψ xs).trans (by omega)
  | all φ ih =>
    simp only [toUnbounded, Formula.depth_gate, foDepth]
    exact Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.sup_le fun a _ => ih _) 1

theorem size_toUnbounded_le (e : Atom L n ≃ Fin N) {k : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormula Empty k)
    (xs : Fin k → Fin n) : (toUnbounded e φ xs).size ≤ foSize φ * (n + 2) ^ foSize φ := by
  induction φ with
  | falsum => simp [toUnbounded, constUnbounded, foSize]
  | equal t₁ t₂ =>
    simp only [toUnbounded, constUnbounded, foSize]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | rel R ts => simp [toUnbounded, foSize]
  | imp φ ψ ihφ ihψ =>
    have h₁ := ihφ xs
    have h₂ := ihψ xs
    simp only [toUnbounded, Formula.size_gate, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Fin.sum_univ_one, foSize]
    have hφ : (n + 2) ^ foSize φ ≤ (n + 2) ^ (foSize φ + foSize ψ + 1) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
    have hψ : (n + 2) ^ foSize ψ ≤ (n + 2) ^ (foSize φ + foSize ψ + 1) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
    have hpos : 2 ≤ (n + 2) ^ (foSize φ + foSize ψ + 1) :=
      (show 2 ≤ n + 2 by omega).trans (Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) _)
    nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_left (foSize φ) hφ, Nat.mul_le_mul_left (foSize ψ) hψ]
  | all φ ih =>
    simp only [toUnbounded, Formula.size_gate, foSize]
    have hsum : ∑ a : Fin n, (toUnbounded e φ (Fin.snoc xs a)).size ≤
        n * (foSize φ * (n + 2) ^ foSize φ) :=
      (Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ fun a _ => ih _).trans_eq (by simp)
    have hpos : 1 ≤ (n + 2) ^ foSize φ := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    have := foSize_pos φ
    calc _ ≤ n * (foSize φ * (n + 2) ^ foSize φ) + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right hsum 1
      _ ≤ (foSize φ + 1) * (n + 2) ^ (foSize φ + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        nlinarith

open Classical in
/-- A sentence defining even cardinality of `P` over the numerical relations `N` on `Fin n` gives a
formula on `n` inputs computing parity, of depth at most `foDepth φ + 2` and polynomial size: the
translation of the sentence, reading the facts `P(a)` from the input bits and the other facts from
`N`, followed by a negation. -/
private theorem exists_formula_computes_parity [Finite (Σ l, L.Relations l)] (P : L.Relations 1)
    (N : L.Structure (Fin n)) (φ : L.Sentence)
    (h : ∀ S : Finset (Fin n), Expansion P N S ⊨ φ ↔ Even #S) :
    ∃ F : Circuits.Formula Unbounded.signature n,
      F.Computes Unbounded.interpretation (parity n) ∧ F.depth ≤ foDepth φ + 2 ∧
        F.size ≤ (foSize φ + 2) * (n + 2) ^ foSize φ := by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite (Σ l, L.Relations l)
  let e : Atom L n ≃ Fin (Fintype.card (Atom L n)) := Fintype.equivFin _
  let G := toUnbounded e φ Fin.elim0
  -- the facts `P(a)` are read from the input bits, the other facts from `N`
  let sub : Fin (Fintype.card (Atom L n)) → Circuits.Formula Unbounded.signature n := fun j =>
    if (e.symm j).1 = ⟨1, P⟩ then .gate (.and _) fun i => .input ((e.symm j).2 i)
    else constUnbounded (decide (N.RelMap (e.symm j).1.2 (e.symm j).2))
  have hsubd : ∀ j, (sub j).depth ≤ 1 := fun j => by
    simp only [sub, constUnbounded]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hsubs : ∀ j, (sub j).size ≤ 1 := fun j => by
    simp only [sub, constUnbounded]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  refine ⟨.gate .not ![G.bind sub], fun y => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- the formula computes parity
    set S : Finset (Fin n) := {i | y i = true}
    have hatoms : (fun j => (sub j).eval Unbounded.interpretation y) =
        atomsOf (L := L) (M := Expansion P N S) (Equiv.refl _) ∘ e.symm := by
      funext j
      simp only [sub, Function.comp_apply, atomsOf]
      obtain ⟨⟨l, R⟩, t⟩ := e.symm j
      by_cases hR : (⟨l, R⟩ : Σ l, L.Relations l) = ⟨1, P⟩
      · rw [ite_eq_left hR]
        refine Bool.eq_iff_iff.2 ?_
        simp only [Circuits.Formula.eval_gate, Circuits.Formula.eval_input,
          Unbounded.interpretation_and, decide_eq_true_iff]
        change _ ↔ (if _ then _ else _)
        rw [ite_eq_left hR]
        refine forall_congr' fun i => ?_
        change _ ↔ t i ∈ S
        simp [S]
      · rw [ite_eq_right hR]
        refine Bool.eq_iff_iff.2 ?_
        simp only [eval_constUnbounded, decide_eq_true_iff]
        exact (Expansion.relMap_of_ne hR _).symm
    have hreal : (G.bind sub).eval Unbounded.interpretation y = true ↔ Even #S := by
      rw [Circuits.Formula.eval_bind, hatoms]
      exact (eval_toUnbounded_atomsOf e (M := Expansion P N S) (Equiv.refl _) φ).trans (h S)
    simp only [Circuits.Formula.eval_gate, Unbounded.interpretation_not, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
    change _ = decide (#S % 2 = 1)
    rw [Nat.even_iff] at hreal
    cases hv : (G.bind sub).eval Unbounded.interpretation y
    · rw [hv] at hreal
      have : #S % 2 = 1 := by
        rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one #S with h0 | h1
        · exact absurd (hreal.2 h0) (by simp)
        · exact h1
      simp [this]
    · have := hreal.1 hv
      simp [this]
  · -- depth
    have h := Circuits.Formula.depth_bind_le hsubd G
    have hG : G.depth ≤ foDepth φ := depth_toUnbounded_le e φ Fin.elim0
    simp only [Circuits.Formula.depth_gate, Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sup_singleton,

interpretation of the symbols of `L` on `Fin n`, for each `n`. No first-order sentence `φ` of `L`
satisfies, for all large `n` and all sets `S` of elements of `Fin n`, that the structure

number of elements. -/

theorem not_eventually_forall_realize_expansion_iff_even [Finite (Σ l, L.Relations l)]
    (P : L.Relations 1) (N : ∀ n, L.Structure (Fin n)) (φ : L.Sentence) :
    ¬ ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, ∀ S : Finset (Fin n), Expansion P (N n) S ⊨ φ ↔ Even #S := by
  intro h
  -- the lengths `s (16 s + 1) ^ (foDepth φ + 2)` grow without bound
  have htend : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => s * (16 * s + 1) ^ (foDepth φ + 2)) Filter.atTop
      Filter.atTop :=
    Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono (fun s => Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right s (by positivity))
      Filter.tendsto_id
  -- the size bound at those lengths is a polynomial in `s`
  have hpoly : PolynomiallyBounded fun s =>
      (foSize φ + 2) * (s * (16 * s + 1) ^ (foDepth φ + 2) + 2) ^ foSize φ := by
    fun_prop
  obtain ⟨s, hlt, hs, hS⟩ := (hpoly.eventually_lt_two_pow.and
    ((Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 2).and (htend.eventually h))).exists
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFd, hFs⟩ :=
    exists_formula_computes_parity P (N (s * (16 * s + 1) ^ (foDepth φ + 2))) φ hS
  have := Unbounded.two_pow_le_size_of_formula_computes_parity hF hs
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hFd))
  omega

/-- **Parity is not first-order definable** [FurstSaxeSipser1984], [Ajtai1983], [Immerman1999].

`P`, no first-order sentence of `L` holds, among the finite structures with at least `n₀`
elements, in exactly those in which `P` holds of an even number of elements. -/

theorem not_forall_realize_iff_even_card [Finite (Σ l, L.Relations l)] (P : L.Relations 1)
    (φ : L.Sentence) (n₀ : ℕ) :
    ¬ ∀ (M : Type) [L.Structure M] [Finite M], n₀ ≤ Nat.card M →
      (M ⊨ φ ↔ Even (Nat.card {m : M // Structure.RelMap P ![m]})) := by
  intro h
  -- the numerical relations are all empty
  let N : ∀ n, L.Structure (Fin n) := fun _ => ⟨fun f => isEmptyElim f, fun _ _ => False⟩
  refine not_eventually_forall_realize_expansion_iff_even P N φ
    (Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨n₀, fun n hn => ?_⟩)
  intro S
  have : Finite (Expansion P (N n) S) := inferInstanceAs (Finite (Fin n))
  have hcard : Nat.card {m : Expansion P (N n) S // Structure.RelMap P ![m]} = #S := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_finsetCard S]
    refine Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun m => ?_)
    rw [Expansion.relMap_self]
    rfl
  have hn' : Nat.card (Expansion P (N n) S) = n :=
    (Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Fin n)).trans (Fintype.card_fin n)
  rw [← hcard]
  exact h _ (hn'.symm ▸ hn)

theorem formulaSize_le_of_andreevBlock_nonempty {h : BooleanFunction b}
    {ρ : PartialAssignment (Fin (2 ^ b + b * m))} (hext : ρ.Extends (andreevFixTable b m h))
    (hblocks : ∀ j : Fin b, (ρ.free ∩ andreevBlock b m j).Nonempty) :
    formulaSize h ≤ formulaSize (andreev b m ∘ ρ.fill) := by
  have hpivot (j : Fin b) : ∃ t : Fin m, andreevBlockVar b m j t ∈ ρ.free := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hblocks j
    obtain ⟨hi_free, hi_block⟩ := mem_inter.1 hi
    obtain ⟨t, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hi_block
    exact ⟨t, hi_free⟩
  choose t_fn ht_fn using hpivot
  set y₀ : Fin b → BitString m :=
    fun j t => ρ.fill (fun _ => false) (andreevBlockVar b m j t)
  set r : Fin b → Bool := fun j => parity m (y₀ j)
  set σ : Fin (2 ^ b + b * m) → Formula signature b :=
    Fin.addCases (fun _ => const false) fun u =>
      let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm u
      if p.2 = t_fn p.1 then
        if r p.1 then (input p.1).not else input p.1
      else
        const false
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFL⟩ := exists_computes_leafSize_eq (andreev b m ∘ ρ.fill)
  have hσ_leaf (i : Fin (2 ^ b + b * m)) : (σ i).leafSize ≤ 1 := by
    refine Fin.addCases (fun _ => ?_) (fun u => ?_) i
    · simp [σ]
    · simp only [σ, Fin.addCases_right]
      split_ifs <;> simp
  have hbind_computes : (F.bind σ).Computes interpretation h := by
    intro z
    rw [eval_bind, hF, comp_apply, andreev_fill_of_extends hext]
    congr 1
    funext j
    have hblock_eq :
        (fun t => ρ.fill (fun i => (σ i).eval interpretation z) (andreevBlockVar b m j t)) =
          update (y₀ j) (t_fn j) (z j ^^ r j) := by
      funext t
      have hσ_val :
          (σ (andreevBlockVar b m j t)).eval interpretation z =
            if t = t_fn j then (z j ^^ r j) else false := by
        simp only [σ, andreevBlockVar, Fin.addCases_right, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        split_ifs with ht hr
        · cases hzj : z j <;> simp [hr, hzj]
        · cases hzj : z j <;> simp [hr, hzj]
        · rfl
      by_cases ht : t = t_fn j
      · subst ht
        have hnone : ρ (andreevBlockVar b m j (t_fn j)) = none :=
          PartialAssignment.mem_free.1 (ht_fn j)
        have hσ_eq : (σ (andreevBlockVar b m j (t_fn j))).eval interpretation z = (z j ^^ r j) := by
          simp [hσ_val]
        rw [PartialAssignment.fill_of_eq_none hnone, hσ_eq, update_self]
      · rw [update_of_ne ht]
        have hσ_false : (σ (andreevBlockVar b m j t)).eval interpretation z = false := by
          simp [hσ_val, ht]
        cases hρ : ρ (andreevBlockVar b m j t) with
        | none =>
          simp [y₀, PartialAssignment.fill, hρ, hσ_false]
        | some c =>
          simp [y₀, PartialAssignment.fill, hρ]
    have hy₀_false : y₀ j (t_fn j) = false :=
      PartialAssignment.fill_of_eq_none (PartialAssignment.mem_free.1 (ht_fn j)) (fun _ => false)
    rw [hblock_eq, parity_update_of_eq_false hy₀_false]
    change ((z j ^^ r j) ^^ r j) = z j
    cases z j <;> cases r j <;> rfl
  have hleaf_le : (F.bind σ).leafSize ≤ formulaSize (andreev b m ∘ ρ.fill) := by
    have := F.leafSize_bind_le hσ_leaf
    omega
  exact (formulaSize_le hbind_computes).trans hleaf_le

/-! ### Andreev's reduction and explicit formula lower bound -/

/-- **Andreev's reduction theorem**: for every `b`-bit Boolean function `h`, `1 ≤ b`, `1 ≤ r ≤ m`,
and `2 * b ≤ 2 ^ r`, the formula size of `andreev b m` satisfies
`(L(h) - 2 * b * r) ^ 2 * m ^ 3 ≤ 4 * L(andreev b m) ^ 2 * r ^ 3`
[Andreev1987], [Jukna, Theorem 6.14][Jukna2012]. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem exists_hard_function_formulaSize :
    ∃ B : ℕ, ∀ b ≥ B, ∃ h : BooleanFunction b, 2 ^ b < 3 * b * formulaSize h := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Shannon.exists_hard_function
  refine ⟨max N 1, fun b hb => ?_⟩
  have hbN : N ≤ b := (le_max_left N 1).trans hb
  have hb1 : 1 ≤ b := (le_max_right N 1).trans hb
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hN b hbN
  obtain ⟨F, hF, _, hsize⟩ := exists_computes_size_le h
  have hcirc := hh F.toCircuit hF.toCircuit
  rw [Formula.size_toCircuit] at hcirc
  have hb_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hmul_real : (2 ^ b : ℝ) < (F.size : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) := (div_lt_iff₀ hb_pos).1 hcirc
  have hmul_nat : 2 ^ b < F.size * b := by exact_mod_cast hmul_real
  have hpow : b < 2 ^ b := b.lt_two_pow_self
  have hmax : F.size ≤ 3 * formulaSize h := by
    rcases hsize with ⟨c, rfl⟩ | hle
    · rw [size_const] at hmul_nat
      omega
    · omega
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  nlinarith

/-- For `16 ≤ b`, `12 * b ^ 2 * (b + 2) ≤ 2 ^ b`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

theorem pow_two_mul_pow_three_le_formulaSize_andreev_sq :
    ∃ B : ℕ, ∀ b ≥ B, ∀ m ≥ Nat.log 2 b + 2,
      2 ^ (2 * b) * m ^ 3 ≤
        144 * b ^ 2 * (Nat.log 2 b + 2) ^ 3 * formulaSize (andreev b m) ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀⟩ := exists_hard_function_formulaSize
  refine ⟨max B₀ 16, fun b hb m hm => ?_⟩
  have hb₀ : B₀ ≤ b := (le_max_left B₀ 16).trans hb
  have hb16 : 16 ≤ b := (le_max_right B₀ 16).trans hb
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hB₀ b hb₀
  set r := Nat.log 2 b + 2
  have handreev := formulaSize_sub_sq_mul_pow_three_le_andreev_log h (by omega) hm
  have hlog : Nat.log 2 b ≤ b := Nat.log_le_self 2 b
  have hexp : 12 * b ^ 2 * r ≤ 2 ^ b := by
    calc 12 * b ^ 2 * r
        ≤ 12 * b ^ 2 * (b + 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
      _ ≤ 2 ^ b := twelve_mul_sq_mul_add_two_le_two_pow hb16
  have hhalf : 2 ^ b ≤ 6 * b * (formulaSize h - 2 * b * r) := by
    rw [Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib]
    have h1 : 6 * b * formulaSize h = 2 * (3 * b * formulaSize h) := by ring
    have h2 : 6 * b * (2 * b * r) = 12 * b ^ 2 * r := by ring
    rw [h1, h2]
    omega
  have hsq : (2 ^ b) ^ 2 ≤ (6 * b * (formulaSize h - 2 * b * r)) ^ 2 :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_left hhalf 2
  calc 2 ^ (2 * b) * m ^ 3
      = (2 ^ b) ^ 2 * m ^ 3 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm 2 b]
    _ ≤ (6 * b * (formulaSize h - 2 * b * r)) ^ 2 * m ^ 3 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hsq
    _ = 36 * b ^ 2 * ((formulaSize h - 2 * b * r) ^ 2 * m ^ 3) := by ring
    _ ≤ 36 * b ^ 2 * (4 * formulaSize (andreev b m) ^ 2 * r ^ 3) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ handreev
    _ = 144 * b ^ 2 * r ^ 3 * formulaSize (andreev b m) ^ 2 := by ring

`n = (b + 1) * 2 ^ b`): for all sufficiently large `b`,

theorem two_pow_five_mul_le_formulaSize_andreev_sq :
    ∃ B : ℕ, ∀ b ≥ B,
      2 ^ (5 * b) ≤
        144 * b ^ 2 * (Nat.log 2 b + 2) ^ 3 * formulaSize (andreev b (2 ^ b)) ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := pow_two_mul_pow_three_le_formulaSize_andreev_sq
  refine ⟨max B 16, fun b hb => ?_⟩
  have hbB : B ≤ b := (le_max_left B 16).trans hb
  have hb16 : 16 ≤ b := (le_max_right B 16).trans hb

  have hexp := twelve_mul_sq_mul_add_two_le_two_pow hb16

  have h := hB b hbB (2 ^ b) hm
  have hpow : 2 ^ (5 * b) = 2 ^ (2 * b) * (2 ^ b) ^ 3 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hpow]
  exact h

      exact (leafSize_mkAnd_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add (ih 0) (ih 1))

    (ρ : PartialAssignment (Fin n)) :
    ∑ i ∈ ρ.free,
        (formulaSize (f ∘ PartialAssignment.fill (update ρ i (some false))) +
          formulaSize (f ∘ PartialAssignment.fill (update ρ i (some true)))) +
        (if formulaSize (f ∘ ρ.fill) = 1 then 2 else 3 * formulaSize (f ∘ ρ.fill)) ≤
      2 * #ρ.free * formulaSize (f ∘ ρ.fill) := by

  have hmin : F.IsLeafMinimal := isLeafMinimal_iff_leafSize_eq_formulaSize.2 (hFg ▸ hL)
  have hdep : DependsOn g ρ.free := PartialAssignment.dependsOn_comp_fill_free f ρ
  have hS : F.leafSizeIn ρ.free = F.leafSize := leafSizeIn_eq_leafSize_of_dependsOn hdep hF hL
  have hle_i (i : Fin n) (hi : i ∈ ρ.free) (b : Bool) :
      formulaSize (f ∘ PartialAssignment.fill (update ρ i (some b))) ≤
        (F.restrictAt i b).leafSize := by
    rw [← PartialAssignment.comp_fill_update_empty_of_mem_free hi]
    exact formulaSize_le fun x => by
      rw [eval_restrictAt, hF, comp_apply, PartialAssignment.fill_update_empty]
  by_cases hL1 : formulaSize g = 1
  · simp only [hL1, ↓reduceIte, mul_one]
    have hsum1 : ∑ i ∈ ρ.free, F.leafSizeIn {i} = 1 := by
      rw [sum_leafSizeIn_singleton, hS, hL, hL1]
    have hex : ∃ i₀ ∈ ρ.free, F.leafSizeIn {i₀} ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! hall
      rw [sum_eq_zero hall] at hsum1
      exact absurd hsum1 (by decide)
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, hne0⟩ := hex
    have hi₀_eq : F.leafSizeIn {i₀} = 1 := by
      have := single_le_sum (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le (F.leafSizeIn {i})) hi₀
      omega
    have h0_false : (F.restrictAt i₀ false).leafSize = 0 := by
      have := leafSize_restrictAt_add_leafSizeIn_le F i₀ false; omega
    have h0_true : (F.restrictAt i₀ true).leafSize = 0 := by
      have := leafSize_restrictAt_add_leafSizeIn_le F i₀ true; omega
    have hterm_le (i : Fin n) (hi : i ∈ ρ.free) :
        formulaSize (f ∘ PartialAssignment.fill (update ρ i (some false))) +
          formulaSize (f ∘ PartialAssignment.fill (update ρ i (some true))) ≤
          if i = i₀ then 0 else 2 := by
      split_ifs with h
      · subst h
        have := hle_i i hi false
        have := hle_i i hi true
        omega
      · have := (hle_i i hi false).trans
          ((Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans (leafSize_restrictAt_add_leafSizeIn_le F i false))
        have := (hle_i i hi true).trans
          ((Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans (leafSize_restrictAt_add_leafSizeIn_le F i true))

theorem exists_extensions_formulaSize_sq_mul_pow_three_le (f : BooleanFunction n)
    (ρ₀ : PartialAssignment (Fin n)) {k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk : k ≤ #ρ₀.free) :
    ∃ ρ ∈ ρ₀.extensions k,
      formulaSize (f ∘ ρ.fill) ^ 2 * (#ρ₀.free) ^ 3 ≤
        formulaSize (f ∘ ρ₀.fill) ^ 2 * k ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, #ρ₀.free = k + d := ⟨#ρ₀.free - k, by omega⟩
  induction d generalizing ρ₀ with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.add_zero] at hd
    exact ⟨ρ₀, PartialAssignment.mem_extensions.2 ⟨.refl ρ₀, hd⟩, by rw [hd]⟩
  | succ d ih =>
    have hs : 2 ≤ #ρ₀.free := by omega
    obtain ⟨i, hi, b, hstep⟩ := exists_mem_free_formulaSize_sq_mul_pow_three_le f hs
    let ρ₁ : PartialAssignment (Fin n) := update ρ₀ i (some b)
    have hfree₁ : #ρ₁.free = k + d := by
      rw [PartialAssignment.free_update, card_erase_of_mem hi]
      omega
    have hk₁ : k ≤ #ρ₁.free := by omega
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hih⟩ := ih ρ₁ hk₁ hfree₁
    obtain ⟨hext₁, hfree⟩ := PartialAssignment.mem_extensions.1 hρ
    have hext₀ : ρ.Extends ρ₀ :=
      hext₁.trans ((PartialAssignment.Extends.refl ρ₀).update_some hi b)
    refine ⟨ρ, PartialAssignment.mem_extensions.2 ⟨hext₀, hfree⟩, ?_⟩
    have hpos_card : 0 < #ρ₁.free := by omega
    have hpos : 0 < (#ρ₁.free) ^ 3 := by positivity
    have h1 : #ρ₀.free - 1 = #ρ₁.free := by omega
    rw [h1] at hstep
    refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ hpos
    calc formulaSize (f ∘ ρ.fill) ^ 2 * (#ρ₀.free) ^ 3 * (#ρ₁.free) ^ 3
        = formulaSize (f ∘ ρ.fill) ^ 2 * (#ρ₁.free) ^ 3 * (#ρ₀.free) ^ 3 := by ring
      _ ≤ formulaSize (f ∘ ρ₁.fill) ^ 2 * k ^ 3 * (#ρ₀.free) ^ 3 :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hih
      _ = formulaSize (f ∘ ρ₁.fill) ^ 2 * (#ρ₀.free) ^ 3 * k ^ 3 := by ring
      _ ≤ formulaSize (f ∘ ρ₀.fill) ^ 2 * (#ρ₁.free) ^ 3 * k ^ 3 :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hstep
      _ = formulaSize (f ∘ ρ₀.fill) ^ 2 * k ^ 3 * (#ρ₁.free) ^ 3 := by ring

/-- **Schnorr's elimination step.** If, under `ρ`, the wire `o` computes the parity of all free
bits, possibly negated, and at least two bits are free, then fixing one free bit suitably makes at
least three nonredundant gates redundant. -/
private theorem exists_card_add_three_le {c : Bool}
    (ho : ∀ x, restricted p ρ o x = (c ^^ parityOn ρ.free x)) (hV : 2 ≤ #ρ.free) :
    ∃ i b, ρ i = none ∧
      #(nonRedundant p (update ρ i (some b))) + 3 ≤ #(nonRedundant p ρ) := by
  classical
  have hF : ¬IsConstOrLiteral (restricted p ρ o) :=
    (funext ho).symm ▸ not_isConstOrLiteral_parityOn hV c
  -- The first nonredundant gate that may matter reads two different bits.
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀N, hk₀E, hargs⟩ := exists_first hF
  have hk₀N' := hk₀N
  obtain ⟨hbin, hnt, hns⟩ := hk₀N'
  rw [restricted_gate] at hnt hns
  obtain ⟨s₀, i, j, hij, hs₀, ⟨a, d₁, hka⟩, ⟨b, d₂, hkb⟩⟩ :=
    exists_two_literals _ _ hbin hargs hnt hns
  rw [← restricted_gate] at hka hkb hnt
  have hi : ρ i = none := by
    by_contra h
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hs₀
    have := restricted_update_of_ne_none (p := p) h ((p.lines k₀).wires s₀) (fun _ => false) true
    rw [he, he] at this
    simp at this
  have hfix {l : Fin n} (hl : ρ l = none) {e d : Bool}
      (h : ∀ x, x l = e → restricted p ρ (.gate k₀) x = d) :
      IsConst (restricted p (update ρ l (some e)) (.gate k₀)) :=
    IsConst.of_forall_eq d fun x => by
      rw [restricted_update hl, comp_apply]
      exact h _ (PartialAssignment.fill_of_eq_some (update_self ..) x)
  have hj : ρ j = none := by
    by_contra h
    refine hnt (Or.inl (IsConst.of_forall_eq d₂ fun x => ?_))
    rw [← restricted_update_of_ne_none h _ x b]
    exact hkb _ (update_self ..)
  -- Another nonredundant gate that may matter reads bit `i`.
  obtain ⟨k₁, hk₁N, hk₁E, hk₁₀, s₁, hs₁⟩ := exists_second_reader ho hV hij hi hj (hfix hj hkb)
  -- Fixing bit `i` makes the first gate, the other reader of bit `i`, and a third gate redundant.
  have hk₀' := hfix hi hka
  have hout : ¬IsConst (restricted p (update ρ i (some a)) o) := by
    rw [funext (restricted_update_of_parity hi a ho)]
    exact not_isConst_parityOn ⟨j, by simp [hij.symm, hj]⟩ _
  have hconst_i {w : Wire n g} (h : EqUpToNeg (restricted p ρ w) (· i)) :
      IsConst (restricted p (update ρ i (some a)) w) := by
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h
    refine IsConst.of_forall_eq (a ^^ e) fun x => ?_
    simp only [restricted_update hi, comp_apply, he]
    rw [PartialAssignment.fill_of_eq_some (update_self ..)]
  obtain ⟨k₂, hk₂N, hk₂E, ⟨s₂, hs₂⟩, hk₂'⟩ := exists_reader_of_isConst hi a hk₀E hk₀' hout
  have hk₂₀ : k₂ ≠ k₀ := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hk₀N.2.2 s₂ hs₂.symm
  obtain ⟨k₃, hk₃N, hk₃', hk₃₀, hk₃₁⟩ : ∃ k, NonRedundant p ρ k ∧
      ¬NonRedundant p (update ρ i (some a)) k ∧ k ≠ k₀ ∧ k ≠ k₁ := by
    by_cases hk₂₁ : k₂ = k₁
    · subst hk₂₁
      -- The other reader of bit `i` also reads the first gate, so it becomes constant.
      have hsne : s₁ ≠ s₂ := by
        rintro rfl
        exact hk₀N.2.1 ((hs₂.symm.trans hs₁).isConstOrLiteral (isConstOrLiteral_literal i))
      have hc : IsConst (restricted p (update ρ i (some a)) (.gate k₂)) := by

        rcases hk₂N.1.eq_or_eq hsne t with rfl | rfl
        · exact hconst_i hs₁
        · exact isConst_update_of_eqUpToNeg hi a hs₂ hk₀'
      obtain ⟨k₃, hk₃N, -, ⟨s₃, hs₃⟩, hk₃'⟩ := exists_reader_of_isConst hi a hk₂E hc hout
      refine ⟨k₃, hk₃N, hk₃', ?_, ?_⟩

  refine ⟨i, a, hi, card_add_three_le (nonRedundant_update_subset hi a) (a := k₀) (b := k₁)

theorem complexity_add_projs_le {m : ℕ} (f : BooleanFunction n) (i : Fin m → Fin n) :
    complexity interpretation (fun x o => f x + x (i o)) ≤
      complexity interpretation (single f) + 4 * m := by
  -- `F` computes `f` beside the inputs, `G` adds the value of `f` to the selected inputs
  let F : BitString n → Fin (1 + n) → Bool := fun x => Fin.append (single f x) x
  have hF : complexity interpretation F ≤ complexity interpretation (single f) := by
    have h := complexity_append_le (I := interpretation) (single f) fun x : BitString n => x
    have hid : complexity interpretation (fun x : BitString n => x) = 0 := complexity_wiring id
    rwa [hid, add_zero] at h
  let G : (Fin (1 + n) → Bool) → Fin m → Bool :=
    fun y o => y (Fin.castAdd n 0) ^^ y (Fin.natAdd 1 (i o))
  have hG : complexity interpretation G ≤ 4 * m := by
    have hsyn : Synthesis interpretation (inputs (1 + n)) (Set.range fun o y => G y o)
        (∑ _ : Fin m, (0 + 0 + 4)) :=
      Synthesis.family _ _ fun o =>
        (Synthesis.of_mem (s := inputs (1 + n)) (f := fun y => y (Fin.castAdd n 0))
          ⟨Fin.castAdd n 0, rfl⟩).xor
        (Synthesis.of_mem (s := inputs (1 + n)) (f := fun y => y (Fin.natAdd 1 (i o)))
          ⟨Fin.natAdd 1 (i o), rfl⟩)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hsize⟩ := hsyn.exists_circuit_outputs
    refine (complexity_le_of_computes c hc).trans (hsize.trans ?_)
    simp only [zero_add, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_comm, le_refl]
  have heq : G ∘ F = fun x o => f x + x (i o) := by
    funext x o
    simp [F, G, Bool.add_eq_xor]
  rw [← heq]
  exact (complexity_comp_le (I := interpretation) F G).trans (Nat.add_le_add hF hG)

theorem exists_isHardCoreMeasure {f : BooleanFunction n} {s T : ℕ} {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hT : 1 ≤ 3 * ε ^ 2 * δ ^ 2 * T)
    (hf : ∀ g : BooleanFunction n,
      complexity interpretation (single g) ≤ T * s + (2 + T * (2 * (T + 2))) →
        (#{x | g x = f x} : ℝ) / 2 ^ n ≤ 1 - δ) :
    ∃ M, IsHardCoreMeasure f s δ ε M := by
  by_contra hno
  set rate := ε * δ with hrate_def
  have hrate : 0 < rate := mul_pos hε hδ
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ n := by positivity
  -- Against every dense measure of clipped weights some small predictor has advantage `ε`.
  have key (N : BitString n → ℝ) : ∃ g : BooleanFunction n,
      δ * 2 ^ n ≤ ∑ x, weight rate (N x) →
        complexity interpretation (single g) ≤ s ∧
          (1 / 2 + ε) * ∑ x, weight rate (N x) < ∑ x with g x = f x, weight rate (N x) := by
    by_cases hd : δ * 2 ^ n ≤ ∑ x, weight rate (N x)
    · by_contra! hall
      exact hno ⟨fun x => weight rate (N x),
        ⟨fun x => weight_mem_Icc rate (N x), hd, fun g hg => (hall g).2 hg⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨fun _ => false, fun h => absurd h hd⟩
  choose next hnext using key
  let dense (j : ℕ) : Prop := δ * 2 ^ n ≤ ∑ x, weight rate (margin f next j x)
  -- Within `T` rounds the measure stops being dense.
  have hex : ∃ j, j < T ∧ ¬dense j := by
    by_contra! hall
    have hT1 : 0 < T := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => by norm_num [h] at hT
    have hT' : 1 ≤ 3 * rate ^ 2 * T := by
      rw [hrate_def, mul_pow]
      linarith
    -- Each dense round gains more than `2 ε δ 2 ^ n` in correlation.
    have hround (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ range T) : 2 * rate * 2 ^ n <
        ∑ x, weight rate (margin f next j x) * vote f (next (margin f next j)) x := by
      have hd := hall j (mem_range.1 hj)
      have hgood := (hnext (margin f next j) hd).2
      rw [sum_mul_vote, hrate_def]
      nlinarith
    have hlower := sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty (nonempty_range_iff.2 hT1.ne') hround
    rw [sum_comm] at hlower
    -- The potential caps the total correlation.
    have hupper : ∑ x : BitString n, ∑ j ∈ range T,
        weight rate (margin f next j x) * vote f (next (margin f next j)) x ≤
          ∑ _x : BitString n, (1 / (2 * rate) + T * (rate / 2)) :=
      sum_le_sum fun x _ => sum_weight_mul_vote_le hrate next x T
    simp only [sum_const, card_range, card_univ, BitString.card, nsmul_eq_mul] at hlower hupper
    push_cast at hlower hupper
    have h1 : T * (2 * rate) < 1 / (2 * rate) + T * (rate / 2) :=
      lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right (by linarith [hlower.trans_le hupper]) hN.le
    have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * rate)
    rw [add_mul, one_div_mul_cancel (by positivity : (2 * rate) ≠ 0)] at h2
    nlinarith
  classical
  obtain ⟨j₁, hj₁T, hj₁⟩ := hex
  let j := Nat.find (⟨j₁, hj₁⟩ : ∃ j, ¬dense j)
  have hjT : j < T := (Nat.find_min' _ hj₁).trans_lt hj₁T
  have hjsparse : ¬dense j := Nat.find_spec (⟨j₁, hj₁⟩ : ∃ j, ¬dense j)
  have hdense (l : ℕ) (hl : l < j) : dense l := by
    by_contra h
    exact Nat.find_min _ hl h
  -- The strict majority of the first `j` predictors.
  let g : BooleanFunction n := fun x => strictMajority j fun l : Fin j => next (margin f next l) x
  have hcomplexity : complexity interpretation (single g) ≤ T * s + (2 + T * (2 * (T + 2))) := by
    have h : complexity interpretation (single g) ≤
        ∑ l : Fin j, complexity interpretation (single (next (margin f next l))) +
          complexity interpretation (single (strictMajority j)) :=
      (complexity_comp_le (fun x (l : Fin j) => next (margin f next l) x)
        (single (strictMajority j))).trans
        (Nat.add_le_add_right (complexity_pi_le fun l : Fin j => next (margin f next l)) _)
    have hsum : ∑ l : Fin j, complexity interpretation (single (next (margin f next l))) ≤
        ∑ _l : Fin j, s :=
      sum_le_sum fun l _ => (hnext (margin f next l) (hdense l l.2)).1
    simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul] at hsum
    have hmaj : complexity interpretation (single (strictMajority j)) ≤
        2 + j * (2 * (j + 2)) := complexity_threshold_le j (j / 2 + 1)
    have hjT' := hjT.le
    have : j * s + (2 + j * (2 * (j + 2))) ≤ T * s + (2 + T * (2 * (T + 2))) := by
      gcongr
    omega
  -- Where the majority errs, the margin is nonpositive.
  have herr (x : BitString n) (hx : g x ≠ f x) : margin f next j x ≤ 0 := by
    have hcount := le_card_ne_of_strictMajority_ne hx
    have hcount' : (j : ℝ) ≤ 2 * #{l : Fin j | next (margin f next l) x ≠ f x} := by
      exact_mod_cast (show j ≤ 2 * #{l : Fin j | next (margin f next l) x ≠ f x} by omega)
    rw [margin_eq_sum]
    simp only [vote]
    rw [sum_ite_eq (fun l : Fin j => next (margin f next l) x) (f x)]
    linarith
  -- So the majority errs on fewer than `δ 2 ^ n` inputs.
  have hfew : (#{x | g x ≠ f x} : ℝ) < δ * 2 ^ n := by
    calc (#{x | g x ≠ f x} : ℝ) = ∑ x with g x ≠ f x, (1 : ℝ) := by simp
      _ = ∑ x with g x ≠ f x, weight rate (margin f next j x) :=
          sum_congr rfl fun x hx => (weight_of_nonpos hrate.le (herr x (mem_filter.1 hx).2)).symm
      _ ≤ ∑ x, weight rate (margin f next j x) :=
          sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (filter_subset _ _)
            fun x _ _ => (weight_mem_Icc rate _).1
      _ < δ * 2 ^ n := not_le.1 hjsparse
  have hsplit := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := univ) fun x => g x = f x
  simp only [card_univ, BitString.card] at hsplit
  have hsplit' : (#{x | g x = f x} : ℝ) + #{x | g x ≠ f x} = 2 ^ n := by exact_mod_cast hsplit
  have hbound := hf g hcomplexity
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hN] at hbound
  linarith

/-- **Impagliazzo's hard-core lemma** [Impagliazzo1995] from hardness for a given size. Let
`0 < δ`, `0 < ε`, let `T` be a number of rounds with `1 ≤ 3 ε² δ² T`, and let
`2 + T (2 (T + 2)) ≤ S`. If every Boolean function of De Morgan circuit complexity at most `S`
agrees with `f` on at most a `1 - δ` fraction of the inputs, then `f` has a hard-core measure of
density `δ` against circuits of size `(S - (2 + T (2 (T + 2)))) / T` with advantage `ε`. -/

theorem mono (hf : IsAverageCaseHard f s) (hs' : 0 < s') (h : s' ≤ s) :
    IsAverageCaseHard f s' := fun g hg =>
  (hf g (hg.trans h)).trans (by gcongr)

private theorem schedule_bounds {M b : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hev : (2 ^ 27 * M ^ 3 + 4608 * M + 128) * b ^ 6 ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4)) :
    2 * M ≤ 2 ^ (b / 2) ∧ 128 * b ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4) ∧ 4608 * M * b ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4) ∧
      36 * M ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4) ∧ 2 ^ 27 * M ^ 3 * b ^ 6 ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4) := by
  have hb6 : b ≤ b ^ 6 := Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) b
  have hP1 : 128 ≤ 2 ^ 27 * M ^ 3 + 4608 * M + 128 := Nat.le_add_left _ _
  have hP2 : 4608 * M ≤ 2 ^ 27 * M ^ 3 + 4608 * M + 128 :=
    (Nat.le_add_left _ _).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have hP3 : 2 ^ 27 * M ^ 3 ≤ 2 ^ 27 * M ^ 3 + 4608 * M + 128 :=
    (Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have hB : 128 * b ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4) := (Nat.mul_le_mul hP1 hb6).trans hev
  have hD : 4608 * M * b ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4) := (Nat.mul_le_mul hP2 hb6).trans hev
  have hF : 2 ^ 27 * M ^ 3 * b ^ 6 ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4) := (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hP3).trans hev
  have hE : 36 * M ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4) := by
    have : 4608 * M * 1 ≤ 4608 * M * b := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hb
    omega
  have hA : 2 * M ≤ 2 ^ (b / 2) :=
    calc 2 * M ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4) := by omega
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (b / 2) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
  exact ⟨hA, hB, hD, hE, hF⟩

private theorem errors_le {M b σ : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hD' : 4608 * M * b ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4)) (hE : 36 * M ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4)) (h3σ : 3 * σ ≤ b) :
    6 * (((M * (2 ^ b - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * (1 / ((2 ^ (4 * b) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ M +
      2 ^ (2 * σ + Nat.log 2 (4 * b) + 2 + 4) /
        (((2 ^ (4 * b) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / ((2 ^ σ : ℕ) : ℝ))) +
      ((2 ^ (3 * b - b / 4) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (((2 ^ (4 * b) : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1)) ≤ 1 := by
  have h2b : 1 ≤ 2 ^ b := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have hMle : M ≤ M * 2 ^ b := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by positivity)
  set q := 2 ^ (4 * b) with hq
  set d := M * (2 ^ b - 1) with hd
  set K := 2 * σ + Nat.log 2 (4 * b) + 2 with hK
  set D := 2 ^ (3 * b - b / 4) with hD
  have hd1 : d + 1 ≤ M * 2 ^ b := by
    rw [hd, Nat.mul_sub_one]
    omega
  have hq18 : 18 * (d + 1) ≤ q := by
    have h18 : 18 * M ≤ 2 ^ (3 * b) :=
      calc 18 * M ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4) := by omega
        _ ≤ 2 ^ (3 * b) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    calc 18 * (d + 1) ≤ 18 * (M * 2 ^ b) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hd1
      _ = 18 * M * 2 ^ b := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (3 * b) * 2 ^ b := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h18
      _ = q := by rw [hq, ← pow_add]; congr 1; ring
  have hT1 : 18 * (d + 1) ≤ q ^ M := hq18.trans (Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) q)
  have hT2 : 18 * (d + 1) * 2 ^ (K + 4) * 2 ^ σ ≤ q :=
    calc 18 * (d + 1) * 2 ^ (K + 4) * 2 ^ σ
        ≤ 18 * (M * 2 ^ b) * (16 * b * 4 ^ σ * 16) * 2 ^ σ := by
          rw [pow_add _ K 4, show (2 : ℕ) ^ 4 = 16 by norm_num]
          gcongr
          exact two_pow_masks_le σ hb
      _ = 4608 * M * b * 2 ^ b * 2 ^ (3 * σ) := by
          rw [show 3 * σ = 2 * σ + σ by ring, pow_add, pow_mul, show (2 : ℕ) ^ 2 = 4 by norm_num]
          ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4) * 2 ^ b * 2 ^ b := by
          gcongr
      _ = 2 ^ (b / 4 + b + b) := by rw [pow_add, pow_add]
      _ ≤ q := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hT3 : 18 * (d + 1) * D + 1 ≤ q := by
    have h1 : 18 * (d + 1) * D ≤ 18 * M * 2 ^ (4 * b - b / 4) :=
      calc 18 * (d + 1) * D ≤ 18 * (M * 2 ^ b) * D := by gcongr
        _ = 18 * M * 2 ^ (b + (3 * b - b / 4)) := by rw [hD, pow_add]; ring
        _ = 18 * M * 2 ^ (4 * b - b / 4) := by congr 2; omega
    have h2 : 36 * M * 2 ^ (4 * b - b / 4) ≤ q :=
      calc 36 * M * 2 ^ (4 * b - b / 4) ≤ 2 ^ (b / 4) * 2 ^ (4 * b - b / 4) := by gcongr
        _ = q := by rw [hq, ← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    have h3 : 1 ≤ 18 * M * 2 ^ (4 * b - b / 4) := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (by positivity)
    linarith
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) < q := by
    have : 2 ≤ q :=
      calc 2 = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ 2 ^ (4 * b) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < 18 * ((d : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have e1 : 1 / (q : ℝ) ^ M ≤ 1 / (18 * ((d : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le hdpos
    exact_mod_cast hT1
  have e2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (K + 4) / ((q : ℝ) * (1 / ((2 ^ σ : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤
      1 / (18 * ((d : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    rw [mul_one_div, div_div_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) hdpos, one_mul]
    have : ((18 * (d + 1) * 2 ^ (K + 4) * 2 ^ σ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hT2
    push_cast at this ⊢
    linarith
  have e3 : (D : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) - 1) ≤ 1 / (18 * ((d : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) hdpos, one_mul]
    have : ((18 * (d + 1) * D + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hT3
    push_cast at this
    linarith
  have hsum : 1 / (q : ℝ) ^ M + 2 ^ (K + 4) / ((q : ℝ) * (1 / ((2 ^ σ : ℕ) : ℝ))) +
      (D : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) - 1) ≤ 3 * (1 / (18 * ((d : ℝ) + 1))) := by
    linarith
  have hne : (d : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  calc _ ≤ 6 * ((d : ℝ) + 1) * (3 * (1 / (18 * ((d : ℝ) + 1)))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by positivity)
    _ = 1 := by field_simp; ring

theorem isAverageCaseHard_encodedSlice_of {L : Language Bool} {M N σ : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hb : 1 ≤ blockLength M N)
    (hev : (2 ^ 27 * M ^ 3 + 4608 * M + 128) * blockLength M N ^ 6 ≤ 2 ^ (blockLength M N / 4))
    (hσ : 50 * σ ≤ blockLength M N + 1)
    (hhard : 2 ^ (40 * blockLength M N) ≤
      complexity interpretation (single (L.slice (M * blockLength M N)))) :
    IsAverageCaseHard (encodedSlice L M N) (2 ^ σ) := by
  classical
  set b := blockLength M N with hb_def
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hw0 : 4 * b ≠ 0 := by omega
  obtain ⟨hA, hB, hD', hE, hF⟩ := schedule_bounds hb hev
  have h3σ : 3 * σ ≤ b := by omega
  have h5σ : 5 * σ ≤ b := by omega
  have h2b : 2 ≤ 2 ^ b :=
    calc 2 = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 2 ^ b := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hb
  have hd1 : 1 ≤ M * (2 ^ b - 1) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  -- a circuit of high agreement
  intro g hg
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hslice : encodedSlice L M N = fun y => hardnessEncode (BinaryField.equivBits hw0).toEquiv
      (BinaryField.embed hw0 (by omega)) (L.slice (M * b))
      (fun i => y (Fin.castLE (encodedLength_le M N) i)) := by
    rw [encodedSlice, dite_eq_right hb0]
  rw [hslice, lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hcon
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hCagree⟩ := exists_complexity_le_of_agree_prefix (encodedLength_le M N) _ g hcon
  -- the reconstruction
  have hrec := complexity_le_pow_of_agree_hardnessEncode (BinaryField.equivBits hw0).toEquiv
    (BinaryField.embed hw0 (by omega : b ≤ 4 * b)) (L.slice (M * b)) (C := C)
    (s := 2 ^ σ + 2) (hC.trans (by omega)) (ε := 1 / ((2 ^ σ : ℕ) : ℝ)) (by positivity)
    hCagree.le (K := 2 * σ + Nat.log 2 (4 * b) + 2) (D := 2 ^ (3 * b - b / 4))
    (L := Nat.log 2 (M * b) + 1) (by omega) (masks_size (two_pow_masks_ge σ b)) hd1
    (by rw [BinaryField.card hw0]; exact card_lt_card_monomials hM hb hA)
    (by rw [BinaryField.card hw0]; exact margin_le hb hB h3σ)
    (by rw [BinaryField.card hw0]; exact errors_le hM hb hD' hE h3σ)
    (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by norm_num) (M * b)).le
  -- the bound contradicts the worst-case hardness
  rw [BinaryField.card hw0] at hrec
  exact absurd hhard (not_le.2 (hrec.trans_lt (final_lt hM hb hF h5σ)))

/-! ### Hardness at all large lengths -/

/-- **Exponential worst-case hardness gives exponential average-case hardness**
[SudanTrevisanVadhan2001], [ImpagliazzoWigderson1997]. If the slices of `L` need De Morgan circuits
of size `2 ^ (γ n)` for all large `n`, for some `γ > 0`, then the encoded slices of `L` at all large
lengths `N` are average-case hard for size `2 ^ ⌊N / c⌋`, where `c = hardnessDivisor γ`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem eventually_isAverageCaseHard_encodedSlice {L : Language Bool} {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hard : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (γ * n) ≤ complexity interpretation (single (L.slice n))) :
    ∀ᶠ N in atTop, IsAverageCaseHard (encodedSlice L (blockFactor γ) N)
      (2 ^ (N / hardnessDivisor γ)) := by
  set M := blockFactor γ with hM_def
  have hM : 1 ≤ M := Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  have hγM : 40 ≤ γ * M := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (40 / γ)
    have : (M : ℝ) = ⌈40 / γ⌉₊ + 1 := by rw [hM_def, blockFactor]; push_cast; rfl
    rw [this]
    have h' : 40 / γ ≤ (⌈40 / γ⌉₊ : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hγ] at h'
    linarith
  -- the block length tends to infinity
  have hblock : Tendsto (blockLength M) atTop atTop :=
    Nat.tendsto_div_const_atTop (by positivity)
  -- worst-case hardness at the lengths `M b`
  have hMb : Tendsto (fun b : ℕ => M * b) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop' (by omega)
  have hhard : ∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop,
      2 ^ (40 * b) ≤ complexity interpretation (single (L.slice (M * b))) := by
    filter_upwards [hMb.eventually hard] with b hb
    have h1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((40 * b : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (γ * ((M * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
      push_cast
      nlinarith
    rw [Real.rpow_natCast] at h1
    exact_mod_cast h1.trans hb
  have hev := Nat.eventually_mul_pow_le_pow_div (2 ^ 27 * M ^ 3 + 4608 * M + 128) 6 4
    one_lt_two (by positivity)
  filter_upwards [hblock.eventually (hhard.and (hev.and (eventually_ge_atTop 1)))] with N hN
  obtain ⟨hNhard, hNev, hNb⟩ := hN
  refine isAverageCaseHard_encodedSlice_of hM hNb hNev ?_ hNhard
  -- `50 ⌊N / c⌋ ≤ b + 1`
  have h1 := Nat.div_mul_le_self N (hardnessDivisor γ)
  have h2 := Nat.lt_div_mul_add (a := N) (b := 4 * (M + 1)) (by positivity)
  simp only [hardnessDivisor, ← hM_def, blockLength] at h1 h2 ⊢
  nlinarith

theorem bitSynthesis_glPredictor (enc : F ≃ BitString w) {C : BooleanFunction (m * w + w)}
    {sC : ℕ} (hC : complexity interpretation (single C) ≤ sC) {K : ℕ}
    (masks : Fin K → BitString w) (guess : BitString K) :
    BitSynthesis enc (glPredictor enc C masks guess) (glCost w K sC) := by
  classical
  intro n S φ hφ
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hsize⟩ := complexity_le_iff.1 hC
  -- the two constants
  have hconst : Synthesis interpretation S ({fun _ => true} ∪ {fun _ => false}) 2 :=
    (Synthesis.const (s := S) true).union (Synthesis.const (s := S) false)
  set S₁ := S ∪ ({fun _ => true} ∪ {fun _ => false})
  -- the bits of the point
  let xb : Fin (m * w) → BooleanFunction n := fun k v => BitString.pointBits enc (fun i => φ i v) k
  have hxb : ∀ k, xb k ∈ S₁ := fun k =>
    Set.mem_union_left _ (hφ (finProdFinEquiv.symm k).1 (finProdFinEquiv.symm k).2)
  -- one corrected vote: the predictor at a fixed query, xored with a fixed bit
  have hvote : ∀ (r : BitString w) (bit : Bool), Synthesis interpretation S₁
      {fun v => C (Fin.append (BitString.pointBits enc fun i => φ i v) r) ^^ bit} (sC + 1) := by
    intro r bit
    let g : Fin (m * w + w) → BooleanFunction n := Fin.append xb fun k _ => r k
    have hg : ∀ k, g k ∈ S₁ := by
      intro k
      refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) k
      · simp only [g, Fin.append_left]
        exact hxb i
      · simp only [g, Fin.append_right]
        cases r i
        · exact Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_union_right _ rfl)
        · exact Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_union_left _ rfl)
    have hcirc := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) c g hg
    have heval : (fun v => c.eval interpretation (fun k => g k v) 0) =
        fun v => C (Fin.append (BitString.pointBits enc fun i => φ i v) r) := by
      funext v
      rw [hc]
      simp only [single_apply]
      congr 1
      funext k
      change Fin.append xb (fun k _ => r k) k v = _
      rw [append_apply]
    have h1 : Synthesis interpretation S₁
        {fun v => C (Fin.append (BitString.pointBits enc fun i => φ i v) r)} sC :=
      hcirc.mono Set.Subset.rfl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨0, heval⟩) hsize
    cases bit
    · simpa using h1.mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl (Nat.le_succ _)
    · simpa using h1.not
  -- the strict majority for each output bit
  set T := Crypto.GoldreichLevin.nonemptySubsets K
  let V : Fin w → Finset (Fin K) → BooleanFunction n := fun j t v =>
    C (Fin.append (BitString.pointBits enc fun i => φ i v)
      (Pi.single j 1 + ∑ l ∈ t, masks l)) ^^
      ∑ l ∈ t, guess l
  have hbit : ∀ j, Synthesis interpretation S₁
      {bitsOf enc (fun v => glPredictor enc C masks guess fun i => φ i v) j}
      (#T * (sC + 1) + (2 + #T * (2 * (#T + 2)))) := by
    intro j
    have hvotes := Synthesis.biUnion (I := interpretation) (s := S₁) T (fun t => {V j t})
      (fun _ => sC + 1) fun t _ => hvote _ _
    set S₂ := S₁ ∪ ⋃ t ∈ T, {V j t}
    have hmaj := synthesis_atLeast (s := S₂) (k := #T) (j := #T / 2 + 1)
      (fun l => if h : l < #T then V j (T.equivFin.symm ⟨l, h⟩) else fun _ => false)
      (fun l hl => by
        rw [dite_eq_left hl]
        exact Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_biUnion (T.equivFin.symm ⟨l, hl⟩).2 rfl))
      (by omega)
    refine (hvotes.trans hmaj).mono Set.Subset.rfl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 ?_) ?_
    · change _ = _
      funext v
      rw [← strictMajorityOn_eq_atLeast T (V j) v]
      simp only [bitsOf, glPredictor, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Crypto.GoldreichLevin.candidate,
        V, T]
      rfl
    · simp only [sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
      exact le_rfl
  have hall := Synthesis.iUnion (I := interpretation) (s := S₁)
    (fun j => {bitsOf enc (fun v => glPredictor enc C masks guess fun i => φ i v) j})
    (fun _ => #T * (sC + 1) + (2 + #T * (2 * (#T + 2)))) hbit
  refine (hconst.trans hall).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, glCost, T,
      Crypto.GoldreichLevin.card_nonemptySubsets]
    exact le_rfl

/-- The gate budget of the line stage over a field with `q` elements, for points in `m`
variables, `M` monomials, `Y`-degrees up to `ℓ`, degree `d` and an oracle of cost `SG`: the points
of the line and the decoding with a hint are bit-blasted, and the oracle is queried at the `q`
points of the line. -/

text:
theorem BitSynthesis.lineListDecode {enc : F ≃ BitString w} {G : (Fin m → F) → F} {SG : ℕ}
    (hG : BitSynthesis enc G SG) (d D : ℕ) (z : Fin m → F) (a : F) :
    BitSynthesis enc (Code.lineListDecode G d D z a)
      (lineCost w (Fintype.card F) m #(Sudan.monomials d D) (D / d) d SG) := by
  intro n S φ hφ
  set q := Fintype.card F
  -- the points of the line and the hint position
  let ΨA : Option (F × Fin m) → (Fin m → F) → F := fun o v => match o with
    | none => firstNonzero (z - fun i => v i)
    | some (t, i) =>
      ((fun i => v i) + t • (firstNonzero (z - fun i => v i))⁻¹ • (z - fun i => v i)) i
  have hA : Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (inputs m) (Set.range ΨA)
      ((q + 5) * m + 2) :=
    Synthesis.full_linePoints (s := inputs m) (fun i v => v i) (fun i => ⟨i, rfl⟩) z
  have hA' := Synthesis.bitBlast_synthesis enc ΨA hA φ hφ
  set TA := Set.range fun oj : Option (F × Fin m) × Fin w =>
    bitsOf enc (fun x => ΨA oj.1 fun i => φ i x) oj.2

  let pt : F → Fin m → (Fin n → Bool) → F := fun t i x => ΨA (some (t, i)) fun k => φ k x
  have hB : Synthesis interpretation (S ∪ TA)
      (⋃ t : F, Set.range fun j => bitsOf enc (fun x => G fun i => pt t i x) j) (q * SG) := by
    have := Synthesis.iUnion (I := interpretation) (s := S ∪ TA)
      (fun t : F => Set.range fun j => bitsOf enc (fun x => G fun i => pt t i x) j)
      (fun _ => SG) (fun t => hG n (S ∪ TA) (pt t) fun i j =>
        Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨(some (t, i), j), rfl⟩)
    simpa [q] using this
  set TB := ⋃ t : F, Set.range fun j => bitsOf enc (fun x => G fun i => pt t i x) j
  -- decoding with the hint

    hintDecode id (fun t => v (Fin.castSucc (e t))) d D (v (Fin.last q)) a

omit [Fintype F] in
/-- **The self-correction stage.** If `C1` is bit-synthesizable with `S1` gates, then the majority
tree of depth `L` of the interpolations of `C1` along the lines through `x` in the directions
`V τ` is bit-synthesizable with `selfCorrectCost` gates. -/
theorem BitSynthesis.selfCorrect {enc : F ≃ BitString w} {C1 : (Fin m → F) → F} {S1 : ℕ}
    (hC1 : BitSynthesis enc C1 S1) {d : ℕ} (ν : Fin (d + 1) ↪ F) {L : ℕ}
    (V : Fin (3 ^ L) → Fin m → F) :
    BitSynthesis enc (fun x => majTree L fun τ => lagrangeDecode ν C1 x (V τ))
      (selfCorrectCost w m d L S1) := by
  intro n S φ hφ
  -- the points of the lines
  let ΨA : (Fin (3 ^ L) × Fin (d + 1)) × Fin m → (Fin m → F) → F := fun o v =>
    v o.2 + ν o.1.2 * V o.1.1 o.2
  have hA : Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (inputs m) (Set.range ΨA)
      (m * (3 ^ L * (d + 1))) := by
    have := Synthesis.family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := inputs m) ΨA (fun _ => 1)
      (fun o => Synthesis.full_unary (fun a => a + ν o.1.2 * V o.1.1 o.2)
        (⟨o.2, rfl⟩ : (fun v : Fin m → F => v o.2) ∈ inputs m))
    simpa [Fintype.card_prod, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using this
  have hA' := Synthesis.bitBlast_synthesis enc ΨA hA φ hφ
  set TA := Set.range fun oj : ((Fin (3 ^ L) × Fin (d + 1)) × Fin m) × Fin w =>
    bitsOf enc (fun x => ΨA oj.1 fun i => φ i x) oj.2
  -- the oracle at the points
  let pt : Fin (3 ^ L) × Fin (d + 1) → Fin m → (Fin n → Bool) → F := fun τi k x =>
    ΨA (τi, k) fun i => φ i x
  have hB : Synthesis interpretation (S ∪ TA)
      (⋃ τi : Fin (3 ^ L) × Fin (d + 1),
        Set.range fun j => bitsOf enc (fun x => C1 fun k => pt τi k x) j)
      (3 ^ L * (d + 1) * S1) := by
    have := Synthesis.iUnion (I := interpretation) (s := S ∪ TA)
      (fun τi : Fin (3 ^ L) × Fin (d + 1) =>
        Set.range fun j => bitsOf enc (fun x => C1 fun k => pt τi k x) j)
      (fun _ => S1) (fun τi => hC1 n (S ∪ TA) (pt τi) fun k j =>
        Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨((τi, k), j), rfl⟩)
    simpa [Fintype.card_prod, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using this
  set TB := ⋃ τi : Fin (3 ^ L) × Fin (d + 1),
    Set.range fun j => bitsOf enc (fun x => C1 fun k => pt τi k x) j
  -- interpolation and majorities
  let ΨC : Unit → (Fin (3 ^ L * (d + 1)) → F) → F := fun _ v =>
    majTree L fun τ => ∑ i, lagrangeWeight ν i * v (finProdFinEquiv (τ, i))
  have hC : Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (inputs (3 ^ L * (d + 1))) (Set.range ΨC)
      (3 ^ L * (2 * (d + 1) + 1) + (2 * 3 ^ L - 2)) := by
    have hsums := Synthesis.family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2))
      (s := inputs (3 ^ L * (d + 1)))
      (fun τ v => ∑ i, lagrangeWeight ν i * v (finProdFinEquiv (τ, i)))
      (fun _ => 2 * (d + 1) + 1)
      (fun τ => by
        simpa using Synthesis.full_weightedSum (s := inputs (3 ^ L * (d + 1))) (lagrangeWeight ν)
          (fun i v => v (finProdFinEquiv (τ, i))) (fun i => ⟨_, rfl⟩))
    have htree := Synthesis.full_majTree (s := inputs (3 ^ L * (d + 1)) ∪
        Set.range fun τ (v : Fin (3 ^ L * (d + 1)) → F) =>
          ∑ i, lagrangeWeight ν i * v (finProdFinEquiv (τ, i))) L
      (fun τ v => ∑ i, lagrangeWeight ν i * v (finProdFinEquiv (τ, i)))
      (fun τ => Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨τ, rfl⟩)
    refine (hsums.trans htree).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
      rfl
    · simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
      exact le_rfl
  let φC : Fin (3 ^ L * (d + 1)) → (Fin n → Bool) → F := fun k x =>
    C1 fun i => pt (finProdFinEquiv.symm k) i x
  have hφC : ∀ k j, bitsOf enc (φC k) j ∈ (S ∪ TA) ∪ TB := fun k j =>
    Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨finProdFinEquiv.symm k, j, rfl⟩)
  have hC' := Synthesis.bitBlast_synthesis enc ΨC hC φC hφC
  refine (hA'.trans (hB.comp hC')).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    refine Or.inr ⟨((), j), funext fun x => ?_⟩
    simp only [bitsOf, ΨC, φC, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, lagrangeDecode, pt, ΨA]
    rfl
  · unfold selfCorrectCost
    nlinarith

theorem exists_glPredictor_agree (enc : F ≃ BitString w) (h : BitString b ↪ F)
    (f : BooleanFunction (m * b)) (C : BooleanFunction (m * w + w)) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hagree : (1 / 2 + ε) * 2 ^ (m * w + w) ≤ #{y | C y = hardnessEncode enc h f y})
    {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (hsize : (w : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (ε / 2) ^ 2 * (2 ^ K - 1 : ℕ)) :
    ∃ (masks : Fin K → BitString w) (guess : BitString K),
      ε * 2 ^ (m * w) ≤
        2 ^ (K + 2) * #{x | glPredictor enc C masks guess x = truthTableExtension h f x} := by
  classical
  set p := truthTableExtension h f
  let pred : BitString (m * w) → BitString w → Bool := fun x r => C (Fin.append x r)
  let target : BitString (m * w) → BitString w :=
    fun x => enc (p ((BitString.pointEquiv enc).symm x))
  -- the agreement splits over the points
  have hsplit : (#{y | C y = hardnessEncode enc h f y} : ℝ) =
      ∑ x : BitString (m * w), (#{r | pred x r = target x ⬝ᵥ r} : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_sum]
    congr 1
    rw [show (#{y | C y = hardnessEncode enc h f y} : ℕ) =
        #{xr : BitString (m * w) × BitString w |
          C (Fin.append xr.1 xr.2) = hardnessEncode enc h f (Fin.append xr.1 xr.2)} from
      (card_equiv (Fin.appendEquiv (m * w) w).symm fun y => by
        simp [Fin.append_castAdd_natAdd, -hardnessEncode_append]).trans rfl]
    rw [card_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
    rw [card_filter]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
    rw [hardnessEncode_append]
  have hagr : ∀ x, Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement (pred x) (target x) =
      (#{r | pred x r = target x ⬝ᵥ r} : ℝ) / 2 ^ w := fun x =>
    Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement_eq_card_div _ _
  have hagr_le : ∀ x, Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement (pred x) (target x) ≤ 1 := fun x =>
    Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement_le_one _ _
  have hsum : (1 / 2 + ε) * 2 ^ (m * w) ≤
      ∑ x : BitString (m * w), Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement (pred x) (target x) := by
    simp only [hagr, ← sum_div]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity), ← hsplit, mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
    exact hagree
  -- many points are good
  set good := (univ : Finset (BitString (m * w))).filter fun x =>
    1 / 2 + ε / 2 ≤ Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement (pred x) (target x)
  have hgood : ε / 2 * 2 ^ (m * w) ≤ #good := by
    have hle : ∑ x : BitString (m * w), Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement (pred x) (target x) ≤
        #good + (2 ^ (m * w) - #good) * (1 / 2 + ε / 2) := by
      rw [← sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not univ
        (fun x => 1 / 2 + ε / 2 ≤ Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement (pred x) (target x))]
      have h1 : ∑ x ∈ good, Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement (pred x) (target x) ≤ #good := by
        calc _ ≤ ∑ _x ∈ good, (1 : ℝ) := sum_le_sum fun x _ => hagr_le x
          _ = #good := by rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      have hcard : (#(univ.filter fun x : BitString (m * w) =>
          ¬(1 / 2 + ε / 2 ≤ Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement (pred x) (target x))) : ℝ) =
            2 ^ (m * w) - #good := by
        have := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (BitString (m * w))))
          (fun x => 1 / 2 + ε / 2 ≤ Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement (pred x) (target x))
        rw [card_univ] at this
        have hc : (Fintype.card (BitString (m * w)) : ℝ) = 2 ^ (m * w) := by
          rw [BitString.card, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
        rw [← hc, ← this]
        push_cast
        ring
      have h2 : ∑ x ∈ univ.filter (fun x : BitString (m * w) =>
          ¬(1 / 2 + ε / 2 ≤ Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement (pred x) (target x))),
          Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement (pred x) (target x) ≤
            (2 ^ (m * w) - #good) * (1 / 2 + ε / 2) := by
        calc _ ≤ ∑ _x ∈ univ.filter (fun x : BitString (m * w) =>
              ¬(1 / 2 + ε / 2 ≤ Crypto.GoldreichLevin.agreement (pred x) (target x))),
              (1 / 2 + ε / 2) := sum_le_sum fun x hx => (not_le.1 (mem_filter.1 hx).2).le
          _ = _ := by rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hcard]
      linarith
    have hgood_le : (#good : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (m * w) := by
      have := card_le_univ good
      rw [BitString.card] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hε1 : ε ≤ 1 / 2 := le_half_of_agree hagree
    nlinarith
  -- Goldreich–Levin with fixed masks and guess
  obtain ⟨masks, guess, hgl⟩ := Crypto.GoldreichLevin.exists_card_candidate_eq pred target
    (ε / 2) (by positivity) hK hsize good fun x hx => (mem_filter.1 hx).2
  refine ⟨masks, guess, ?_⟩
  have hcount : #{x | glPredictor enc C masks guess x = p x} =
      #{x | Crypto.GoldreichLevin.candidate (pred x) masks guess = target x} := by
    refine card_nbij' (BitString.pointBits enc) (BitString.pointEquiv enc).symm
      (fun x hx => ?_) (fun x hx => ?_)
      (fun x _ => BitString.pointEquiv_symm_pointBits enc x)
      (fun x _ => BitString.pointBits_pointEquiv_symm enc x)
    · simp only [coe_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx ⊢
      simp only [target, BitString.pointEquiv_symm_pointBits, ← hx, glPredictor,
        Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      rfl
    · simp only [coe_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx ⊢
      simp only [glPredictor]
      rw [show (fun r => C (Fin.append (BitString.pointBits enc
          ((BitString.pointEquiv enc).symm x)) r)) = pred x by
        rw [BitString.pointBits_pointEquiv_symm]]
      rw [hx, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [hcount]
  have : (#good : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (K + 1) *
      #{x | Crypto.GoldreichLevin.candidate (pred x) masks guess = target x} := by
    exact_mod_cast hgl
  calc ε * 2 ^ (m * w) = 2 * (ε / 2 * 2 ^ (m * w)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * #good := by linarith
    _ ≤ 2 * (2 ^ (K + 1) *
        #{x | Crypto.GoldreichLevin.candidate (pred x) masks guess = target x}) := by linarith
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- The size of the circuit reconstructed from a predictor of size `s` for the encoding, with
`K` masks, Sudan parameter `D` with `M` monomials, majority trees of depth `L` and a field of `q`
elements: reading the grid point from the input, the self-correction stage over the line stage
over the Goldreich–Levin stage, and reading off `f` from the value of the extension. -/

text:
omit [DecidableEq F] in
/-- **The reconstruction theorem** [SudanTrevisanVadhan2001]. Let `F` be a field of `q` elements
with an encoding `enc : F ≃ BitString w`, let `h : BitString b ↪ F`, let `f` be a Boolean
function on `m * b` bits, and let `d = m * (2 ^ b - 1) ≥ 1`. Suppose a Boolean function `C` with a
De Morgan circuit of size at most `s` agrees with the encoding `hardnessEncode enc h f` on a
`1 / 2 + ε` fraction of its `2 ^ (m * w + w)` inputs. Let the parameters `K ≥ 1`, `D` and `L`
satisfy
* `w ≤ 2 * (ε / 2) ^ 2 * (2 ^ K - 1)` (Goldreich–Levin decoding),
* `q < #(Sudan.monomials d D)` (more monomials of `(1, d)`-weighted degree at most `D` than
  points on a line; this holds when `2 * d * q < (D + 1) * (D + 2)`),
* `2 ^ (K + 3) * D ≤ q * ε` (lines have more than `D` agreements on average),
* `6 * (d + 1) * (1 / q ^ m + 2 ^ (K + 4) / (q * ε) + D / (q - 1)) ≤ 1` (few errors are left for
  self-correction), and
* `m * b ≤ 2 ^ L` (majority trees of depth `L` correct all `2 ^ (m * b)` grid points).

Then `f` has a De Morgan circuit with at most
`reconstructionCost w b m D K L s q (#(Sudan.monomials d D))` gates. -/
theorem complexity_le_of_agree_hardnessEncode (enc : F ≃ BitString w) (h : BitString b ↪ F)
    (f : BooleanFunction (m * b)) {C : BooleanFunction (m * w + w)} {s : ℕ}
    (hC : complexity interpretation (single C) ≤ s) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hagree : (1 / 2 + ε) * 2 ^ (m * w + w) ≤ #{y | C y = hardnessEncode enc h f y})
    {K D L : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (hsize : (w : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (ε / 2) ^ 2 * (2 ^ K - 1 : ℕ))
    (hd : 1 ≤ m * (2 ^ b - 1))
    (hn : Fintype.card F < #(Sudan.monomials (m * (2 ^ b - 1)) D))
    (hmargin : (2 : ℝ) ^ (K + 3) * D ≤ Fintype.card F * ε)
    (herr : 6 * ((m * (2 ^ b - 1) : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) * (1 / (Fintype.card F : ℝ) ^ m +
      2 ^ (K + 4) / (Fintype.card F * ε) + D / (Fintype.card F - 1)) ≤ 1)
    (hL : m * b ≤ 2 ^ L) :
    complexity interpretation (single f) ≤
      reconstructionCost w b m D K L s (Fintype.card F)
        #(Sudan.monomials (m * (2 ^ b - 1)) D) := by
  classical
  set d := m * (2 ^ b - 1) with hd_def
  set q := Fintype.card F with hq_def
  set p := truthTableExtension h f
  have hp : p ∈ reedMuller F m d := truthTableExtension_mem_reedMuller h f
  have hqw : q = 2 ^ w := by
    rw [hq_def, Fintype.card_congr enc, BitString.card]
  have hQnat : Fintype.card (Fin m → F) = 2 ^ (m * w) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, ← hq_def, hqw, ← pow_mul, mul_comm]
  have hq2 : 2 ≤ q := Fintype.one_lt_card
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq2
  -- the Goldreich–Levin stage
  obtain ⟨masks, guess, hgl⟩ := exists_glPredictor_agree enc h f C hε hagree hK hsize
  set G := glPredictor enc C masks guess
  -- the parameters
  have hε1 : ε ≤ 1 / 2 := le_half_of_agree hagree
  obtain ⟨hD1, hDq, hdq⟩ := reconstruction_ranges hq2 hε hε1 hn hmargin herr
  set Q : ℝ := (q : ℝ) ^ m with hQ_def
  have hQ : (Fintype.card (Fin m → F) : ℝ) = Q := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hQ2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m * w) = Q := by
    rw [hQ_def, hqw]
    push_cast
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm]
  have hQ1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Q := one_le_pow₀ hq1.le
  set a := (#{x | G x = p x} : ℕ)
  have ha : ε * Q ≤ 2 ^ (K + 2) * a := by rw [← hQ2]; exact hgl
  have hapos : (0 : ℝ) < a := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < ε * Q := by positivity
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (K + 2) * a := lt_of_lt_of_le this ha
    exact pos_of_mul_pos_right h2 (by positivity)
  -- the line stage
  have hμ : (D : ℝ) < q * #{y | G y = p y} / q ^ m := by
    have h2D : 2 ^ (K + 3) * (D : ℝ) * Q ≤ 2 ^ (K + 2) * (q * a) := by nlinarith
    rw [show 2 ^ (K + 3) * (D : ℝ) * Q = 2 ^ (K + 2) * (2 * D * Q) by ring] at h2D
    have h4 : 2 * (D : ℝ) * Q ≤ q * a := le_of_mul_le_mul_left h2D (by positivity)
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have hD1' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast hD1
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_card_lineListDecode_ne_le hd hn hDq hp G hμ
  set C1 := lineListDecode G d D z (p z)
  have herrC1 : ((d : ℝ) + 1) * #{x | C1 x ≠ p x} ≤ Q / 6 := by
    have hbound := lineErrors_le (q := q) (Q := Q) (a := a) (ε := ε) (D := D)
      (δ := ((D - d : ℕ) : ℝ)) hq1 hQ1 hapos hε ha (by positivity) hmargin (by positivity)
      (by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le D d)
    have hz' : (#{x | C1 x ≠ p x} : ℝ) ≤ Q * (1 / Q + 2 ^ (K + 4) / (q * ε) + D / (q - 1)) :=
      hz.trans hbound
    calc ((d : ℝ) + 1) * #{x | C1 x ≠ p x} ≤
          ((d : ℝ) + 1) * (Q * (1 / Q + 2 ^ (K + 4) / (q * ε) + D / (q - 1))) := by gcongr
      _ = Q / 6 * (6 * ((d : ℝ) + 1) * (1 / Q + 2 ^ (K + 4) / (q * ε) + D / (q - 1))) := by
          ring
      _ ≤ Q / 6 * 1 := by gcongr
      _ = Q / 6 := mul_one _
  -- the interpolation nodes
  have hnodes : d + 1 ≤ Fintype.card {c : F // c ≠ 0} := by
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_subtype_eq]
    exact hdq
  obtain ⟨ν₀⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le (α := Fin (d + 1))
    (β := {c : F // c ≠ 0}) (by simpa using hnodes)
  let ν : Fin (d + 1) ↪ F := ν₀.trans (Function.Embedding.subtype _)
  have hν : ∀ i, ν i ≠ 0 := fun i => (ν₀ i).2
  -- the self-correction stage
  let grid : Finset (Fin m → F) :=
    univ.image fun x : BitString (m * b) => fun i => h (BitString.block x i)
  have hgrid : #grid ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ L) := by
    calc #grid ≤ #(univ : Finset (BitString (m * b))) := card_image_le
      _ = 2 ^ (m * b) := by rw [card_univ, BitString.card]
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ L) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hL

private theorem bitBlastCost_le (hq : q = 2 ^ w) (hw : 1 ≤ w) :
    bitBlastCost w ≤ 7 * w ^ 2 * q ^ 2 := by
  have h2 : 2 ^ (2 * w) = q ^ 2 := by rw [hq, ← pow_mul, mul_comm]
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q ^ 2 := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by rw [hq]; positivity)

  have h1 : w * q ^ 2 ≤ w ^ 2 * q ^ 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hw2
  have h3 : w ≤ w ^ 2 * q ^ 2 := hw2.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hq1)
  calc w * (q ^ 2 * (4 * w + 2) + 1) = 4 * (w ^ 2 * q ^ 2) + 2 * (w * q ^ 2) + w := by ring
    _ ≤ 4 * (w ^ 2 * q ^ 2) + 2 * (w ^ 2 * q ^ 2) + w ^ 2 * q ^ 2 := by gcongr

theorem reconstructionCost_le {w b m D K L s q M : ℕ} (hq : q = 2 ^ w) (hw : 1 ≤ w)
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hb : 2 ^ b ≤ q) (hD : D < q) (hM : M ≤ q ^ 2)
    (hdq : m * (2 ^ b - 1) + 1 ≤ q) :
    reconstructionCost w b m D K L s q M ≤
      2 ^ 11 * 3 ^ L * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * 4 ^ K * (s + 1) := by
  set d := m * (2 ^ b - 1)
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := by rw [hq]; exact Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have hq2 : 2 ≤ q := by
    rw [hq]
    calc 2 = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 2 ^ w := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hw
  have hbw : b ≤ w := by
    rw [hq] at hb
    exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right (by norm_num)).1 hb
  have hbb := bitBlastCost_le hq hw
  have hℓ : D / d ≤ q := (Nat.div_le_self D d).trans hD.le
  have hhint : hintDecodeCost q q M (D / d) d ≤ 175 * q ^ 6 := by
    unfold hintDecodeCost
    have h1 := interpolantCost_le hM hℓ hq1
    have h2 := henselCost_le hM (by omega : d ≤ q) hq1
    have : q ^ 4 ≤ q ^ 6 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hq1 (by norm_num)
    omega
  have hgl := glCost_le (K := K) (s := s) hw
  set P := 3 ^ L
  set E := 4 ^ K
  have hP : 1 ≤ P := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num)
  have hE : 1 ≤ E := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num)
  -- the line stage
  have hline : lineCost w q m M (D / d) d (glCost w K s) ≤
      1260 * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 8 + 7 * q * w * E * (s + 1) := by
    unfold lineCost
    set H := hintDecodeCost q q M (D / d) d
    have hinner : (q + 5) * m + 2 + (1 + H) ≤ 180 * m * q ^ 6 := by
      have hq6 : q + 8 ≤ 4 * q ^ 6 := by
        have : q ≤ q ^ 6 := by
          calc q = q ^ 1 := (pow_one q).symm
            _ ≤ q ^ 6 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hq1 (by norm_num)
        have : 8 ≤ 3 * q ^ 6 := by
          have : 2 ^ 6 ≤ q ^ 6 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hq2 6
          omega
        omega
      have a1 : (q + 5) * m + 2 + (1 + H) ≤ (q + 8) * m + H := by
        have : (q + 8) * m = (q + 5) * m + 3 * m := by ring

      have a3 : H ≤ 175 * q ^ 6 * m := hhint.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hm)
      have a4 : 4 * q ^ 6 * m + 175 * q ^ 6 * m = 179 * m * q ^ 6 := by ring
      have a5 : 179 * m * q ^ 6 ≤ 180 * m * q ^ 6 := by gcongr; norm_num
      omega

      _ = 1260 * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 8 + 7 * q * w * E * (s + 1) := by ring

    unfold selfCorrectCost
    have hpts : m * (P * (d + 1)) + (P * (2 * (d + 1) + 1) + (2 * P - 2)) ≤ 6 * (P * m * q) := by
      have b1 : m * (P * (d + 1)) ≤ P * m * q := by
        calc m * (P * (d + 1)) ≤ m * (P * q) := by gcongr

      have b2 : P * (2 * (d + 1) + 1) ≤ 3 * (P * m * q) := by

          have hB : P * q * (1260 * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 8) ≤

            calc P * q * (1260 * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 8) = 1260 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * 1 * 1 := by

          have hC : P * q * (7 * q * w * E * (s + 1)) ≤

            calc P * q * (7 * q * w * E * (s + 1)) = 7 * P * 1 * w * q ^ 2 * E * (s + 1) := by
                  ring
              _ ≤ 7 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) := by gcongr
          have hsplit : P * q * (1260 * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 8 + 7 * q * w * E * (s + 1)) =
              P * q * (1260 * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 8) + P * q * (7 * q * w * E * (s + 1)) := by ring
          rw [hsplit]
          have hZ : 42 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) +
              1260 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) +
              7 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) ≤
              2000 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) := by
            have : 42 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) +
                1260 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) +
                7 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) =
                1309 * (P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1)) := by ring
            rw [this, show 2000 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) =
              2000 * (P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1)) by ring]
            gcongr
            norm_num
          omega

  have hcube : m * w * (2 ^ b * (2 * b + 2) + 1) ≤ 5 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) := by
    have : 2 ^ b * (2 * b + 2) + 1 ≤ 5 * w * q := by nlinarith
    calc m * w * (2 ^ b * (2 * b + 2) + 1) ≤ m * w * (5 * w * q) := by gcongr
      _ = 5 * 1 * m * w ^ 2 * q * 1 * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ 5 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) := by
          have hq9 : q ≤ q ^ 9 := (pow_one q).symm.le.trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hq1 (by norm_num))
          gcongr
          all_goals omega
  have hout : 2 ^ w * (2 * w + 2) + 1 ≤ 5 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) := by
    rw [← hq]
    have : q * (2 * w + 2) + 1 ≤ 5 * w ^ 2 * q := by
      have hw2 : w ≤ w ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have h1 : w * q ≤ w ^ 2 * q := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hw2
      have h2 : q ≤ w ^ 2 * q := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity)
      have h3 : 1 ≤ w ^ 2 * q := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (by positivity)
      calc q * (2 * w + 2) + 1 = 2 * (w * q) + 2 * q + 1 := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * (w ^ 2 * q) + 2 * (w ^ 2 * q) + w ^ 2 * q := by omega
        _ = 5 * w ^ 2 * q := by ring

      _ = 5 * 1 * 1 * w ^ 2 * q * 1 * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ 5 * P * m * w ^ 2 * q ^ 9 * E * (s + 1) := by
          have hq9 : q ≤ q ^ 9 := (pow_one q).symm.le.trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hq1 (by norm_num))

          all_goals omega

  calc m * w * (2 ^ b * (2 * b + 2) + 1) +

        (2 ^ w * (2 * w + 2) + 1)

    (hd : 1 ≤ m * (2 ^ b - 1))
    (hn : Fintype.card F < #(Sudan.monomials (m * (2 ^ b - 1)) D))
    (hmargin : (2 : ℝ) ^ (K + 3) * D ≤ Fintype.card F * ε)
    (herr : 6 * ((m * (2 ^ b - 1) : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) * (1 / (Fintype.card F : ℝ) ^ m +

/-- **The switching fraction for a conjunction or disjunction**: if its arguments have decision
tree depth at most `k` under `ρ`, at most a `2 ^ (-s)` fraction of the extensions of `ρ` with `ℓ`
free bits leave it `s`-deep, when `s ≤ ℓ` and `ℓ` is at most a `1 / (16 k + 1)` fraction of the
free bits of `ρ`. For arguments that are literals, `k = 1` and the fraction is `1 / 17`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
private theorem two_pow_mul_card_filter_extensions_le {p : Program signature n g} (hs : 2 ≤ s)
    {j ℓ' : ℕ} (hsℓ' : s ≤ ℓ') (hℓ : (16 * s + 1) * ℓ' ≤ #ρ.free)
    (hgood : ∀ k, p.depths k ≤ j → Shallow s ρ fun x => p.eval interpretation x k) :
    2 ^ s * #{ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' |
        ∃ k, p.depths k ≤ j + 1 ∧ ¬ Shallow s ρ' fun x => p.eval interpretation x k} ≤
      #{k | p.depths k = j + 1} * #(ρ.extensions ℓ') := by
  set T : Finset (Fin g) := {k | p.depths k = j + 1}
  -- a bad extension makes a gate of depth exactly `j + 1` deep
  have hsub : {ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' |
      ∃ k, p.depths k ≤ j + 1 ∧ ¬ Shallow s ρ' fun x => p.eval interpretation x k} ⊆
      T.biUnion fun k => {ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' |
        ¬ Shallow s ρ' fun x => p.eval interpretation x k} := by
    intro ρ' hρ'
    obtain ⟨hext, k, hk, hdeep⟩ := mem_filter.1 hρ'
    refine mem_biUnion.2 ⟨k, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ k, ?_⟩, mem_filter.2 ⟨hext, hdeep⟩⟩
    by_contra hk'
    exact hdeep ((hgood k (by omega)).mono (PartialAssignment.mem_extensions.1 hext).1)
  calc 2 ^ s * #{ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' |
        ∃ k, p.depths k ≤ j + 1 ∧ ¬ Shallow s ρ' fun x => p.eval interpretation x k}
      ≤ 2 ^ s * ∑ k ∈ T, #{ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' |
          ¬ Shallow s ρ' fun x => p.eval interpretation x k} :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ((card_le_card hsub).trans card_biUnion_le)
    _ = ∑ k ∈ T, 2 ^ s * #{ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' |
          ¬ Shallow s ρ' fun x => p.eval interpretation x k} := mul_sum _ _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ T, #(ρ.extensions ℓ') := sum_le_sum fun k hk => by
        -- gate `k` is its operation on shallow wires
        have hgate : (fun x => p.eval interpretation x k) = fun x =>
            interpretation (p.lines k).op fun a => p.trace interpretation x ((p.lines k).wires a) :=
          funext fun x => (p.lines_eval interpretation x k).symm
        rw [hgate]
        exact two_pow_mul_card_filter_not_shallow_le
          (shallow_trace_wires hs hgood (mem_filter.1 hk).2.le) hsℓ' hℓ
    _ = #T * #(ρ.extensions ℓ') := by rw [sum_const, smul_eq_mul]

/-- **Random restrictions make small circuits of constant depth shallow.** For a program with
gates of depth at most `d`, `s ≥ 2` and `s (16 s + 1) ^ d ≤ n`, after `j ≤ d` stages at most a
`G / 2 ^ s` fraction of the restrictions leaving `n / (16 s + 1) ^ j` bits free make some gate of
depth at most `j` deep, where `G` is the number of gates of depth at most `j`. -/

text:
theorem two_pow_le_size_of_formula_computes_parity {F : Formula signature n}
    (hF : F.Computes interpretation (parity n)) (hs : 2 ≤ s)
    (hn : s * (16 * s + 1) ^ F.depth ≤ n) : 2 ^ s ≤ F.size :=
  F.size_toCircuit ▸ two_pow_le_size_of_computes_parity hF.toCircuit hs
    ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) F.depth_toCircuit_le)).trans hn)

text:
theorem shallow_trace_of_forall_ne_not {p : Program signature n g} (hs : 2 ≤ s) {j : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ k, (p.lines k).op ≠ .not → p.depthsWith andOrCost k ≤ j →
      Shallow s ρ fun x => p.eval interpretation x k)
    (w : Wire n g) (hw : p.wireDepthsWith andOrCost w ≤ j) :
    Shallow s ρ fun x => p.trace interpretation x w := by
  refine p.wire_induction (P := fun w => p.wireDepthsWith andOrCost w ≤ j →
    Shallow s ρ fun x => p.trace interpretation x w) (fun i _ => shallow_proj hs ρ i) ?_ w hw
  intro k ih hk
  by_cases hop : (p.lines k).op = .not
  · have heq : (fun x => p.trace interpretation x (.gate k)) =
        fun x => !p.trace interpretation x ((p.lines k).wires ⟨0, by simp [hop]⟩) :=
      funext fun x => (p.trace_gate interpretation x k).trans
        (interpretation_of_op_eq_not hop (p.trace interpretation x))
    rw [heq]
    exact (ih _ ((Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans
      ((p.wireDepthsWith_lines_add_le andOrCost k _).trans hk))).not
  · exact h k hop hk

/-- Every wire of AND/OR depth zero, a literal, has decision tree depth at most one under every
restriction. -/
