text:
private theorem two_pow_mul_card_filter_extensions_le_depthWith {p : Program signature n g}
    {k j ℓ' : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hks : k + 1 ≤ s) (hsℓ' : s ≤ ℓ')
    (hℓ : (16 * k + 1) * ℓ' ≤ #ρ.free)
    (hgood : ∀ k', p.depthsWith andOrCost k' ≤ j →
      Shallow (k + 1) ρ fun x => p.eval interpretation x k') :
    2 ^ s * #{ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' | ∃ k', p.depthsWith andOrCost k' ≤ j + 1 ∧
        ¬ Shallow s ρ' fun x => p.eval interpretation x k'} ≤
      #{k' | (p.lines k').op ≠ .not ∧ p.depthsWith andOrCost k' = j + 1} *
        #(ρ.extensions ℓ') := by
  set T : Finset (Fin g) := {k' | (p.lines k').op ≠ .not ∧ p.depthsWith andOrCost k' = j + 1}
  -- a bad extension makes a conjunction or disjunction of AND/OR depth exactly `j + 1` deep
  have hsub : {ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' | ∃ k', p.depthsWith andOrCost k' ≤ j + 1 ∧
      ¬ Shallow s ρ' fun x => p.eval interpretation x k'} ⊆
      T.biUnion fun k' => {ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' |
        ¬ Shallow s ρ' fun x => p.eval interpretation x k'} := by
    intro ρ' hρ'
    obtain ⟨hext, k₀, hk₀, hdeep⟩ := mem_filter.1 hρ'
    have hext' := (PartialAssignment.mem_extensions.1 hext).1
    by_contra hnot
    refine hdeep (shallow_trace_of_forall_ne_not (by omega) (j := j + 1) (fun k' hop hk' => ?_)
      (.gate k₀) hk₀)
    by_cases hk'j : p.depthsWith andOrCost k' ≤ j
    · exact ((hgood k' hk'j).of_le hks).mono hext'
    · by_contra hdeep'
      exact hnot (mem_biUnion.2 ⟨k', mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, hop, by omega⟩,
        mem_filter.2 ⟨hext, hdeep'⟩⟩)
  calc 2 ^ s * #{ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' | ∃ k', p.depthsWith andOrCost k' ≤ j + 1 ∧
        ¬ Shallow s ρ' fun x => p.eval interpretation x k'}
      ≤ 2 ^ s * ∑ k' ∈ T, #{ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' |
          ¬ Shallow s ρ' fun x => p.eval interpretation x k'} :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ((card_le_card hsub).trans card_biUnion_le)
    _ = ∑ k' ∈ T, 2 ^ s * #{ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' |
          ¬ Shallow s ρ' fun x => p.eval interpretation x k'} := mul_sum _ _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _k' ∈ T, #(ρ.extensions ℓ') := sum_le_sum fun k' hk' => by
        obtain ⟨hop, hdk⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hk').2
        -- gate `k'` is its operation on wires of AND/OR depth at most `j`
        have hgate : (fun x => p.eval interpretation x k') = fun x =>
            interpretation (p.lines k').op fun a =>
              p.trace interpretation x ((p.lines k').wires a) :=
          funext fun x => (p.lines_eval interpretation x k').symm
        rw [hgate]
        refine two_pow_mul_card_filter_not_shallow_le_of_ne_not hop (fun a => ?_) hsℓ' hℓ
        have hlt := wireDepthsWith_lines_add_one_le hop a
        cases hw : (p.lines k').wires a with
        | input i => exact shallow_proj (by omega) ρ i
        | gate k'' =>
          rw [hw, Program.wireDepthsWith_gateWire] at hlt
          exact hgood k'' (by omega)
    _ = #T * #(ρ.extensions ℓ') := by rw [sum_const, smul_eq_mul]

/-- **Random restrictions make the gates of small AND/OR depth shallow.** For `s ≥ 2` and
`s (16 s + 1) ^ e ≤ ⌊n / 17⌋`, after a first stage leaving `⌊n / 17⌋` bits free and `i ≤ e` more
stages each leaving a `1 / (16 s + 1)` fraction of the free bits, at most a `G / 2 ^ s` fraction of
the restrictions make some gate of AND/OR depth at most `i + 1` `s`-deep, where `G` is the number
of conjunctions and disjunctions of AND/OR depth at most `i + 1`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem two_pow_mul_card_filter_exists_not_shallow_le_depthWith {p : Program signature n g}
    (hs : 2 ≤ s) {e : ℕ} (hn : s * (16 * s + 1) ^ e ≤ n / 17) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ e) :
    2 ^ s * #{ρ ∈ PartialAssignment.withFree (Fin n) (n / 17 / (16 * s + 1) ^ i) |
        ∃ k, p.depthsWith andOrCost k ≤ i + 1 ∧
          ¬ Shallow s ρ fun x => p.eval interpretation x k} ≤
      #{k | (p.lines k).op ≠ .not ∧ p.depthsWith andOrCost k ≤ i + 1} *
        #(PartialAssignment.withFree (Fin n) (n / 17 / (16 * s + 1) ^ i)) := by
  have hsm : s ≤ n / 17 / (16 * s + 1) ^ i := Nat.le_div_pow_of_mul_pow_le (by omega) hi hn
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    -- the first stage switches conjunctions and disjunctions of literals
    rw [pow_zero, Nat.div_one] at hsm ⊢
    refine PartialAssignment.mul_card_filter_withFree_le (B := fun _ => False) (G := 0)
      (H := #{k | (p.lines k).op ≠ .not ∧ p.depthsWith andOrCost k = 0 + 1})
      (Nat.div_le_self n 17) le_rfl (by simp) (fun ρ hρ _ => ?_) ?_
    · refine two_pow_mul_card_filter_extensions_le_depthWith (k := 1) (j := 0) le_rfl hs hsm
        (by rw [PartialAssignment.mem_withFree.1 hρ]; omega) fun k' hk' => ?_
      exact shallow_two_trace_of_wireDepthsWith_eq_zero ρ (.gate k') (Nat.le_zero.1 hk')
    · rw [zero_add]
      refine card_le_card fun k hk => ?_
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hk ⊢
      exact ⟨hk.1, hk.2.le⟩
  | succ i ih =>
    have ih := ih (by omega) (Nat.le_div_pow_of_mul_pow_le (by omega) (by omega) hn)
    set ℓ := n / 17 / (16 * s + 1) ^ i
    set ℓ' := n / 17 / (16 * s + 1) ^ (i + 1)
    have hℓ : (16 * s + 1) * ℓ' ≤ ℓ := Nat.mul_div_pow_succ_le (n / 17) _ i
    have hℓn : ℓ ≤ n := (Nat.div_le_self _ _).trans (Nat.div_le_self _ _)
    have hℓ'ℓ : ℓ' ≤ ℓ := le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)) hℓ
    -- the conjunctions and disjunctions of AND/OR depth at most `i + 2`
    have hG : #{k | (p.lines k).op ≠ .not ∧ p.depthsWith andOrCost k ≤ i + 1} +
        #{k | (p.lines k).op ≠ .not ∧ p.depthsWith andOrCost k = i + 1 + 1} ≤
        #{k | (p.lines k).op ≠ .not ∧ p.depthsWith andOrCost k ≤ i + 1 + 1} := by
      rw [← card_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_filter.2 fun k _ h₁ h₂ => by
        have := h₁.2
        have := h₂.2
        omega)]
      refine card_le_card fun k hk => ?_
      simp only [mem_union, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hk ⊢
      rcases hk with ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
      · exact ⟨h₁, by omega⟩
      · exact ⟨h₁, h₂.le⟩
    refine PartialAssignment.mul_card_filter_withFree_le hℓ'ℓ hℓn ih (fun ρ hρ hb => ?_) hG
    -- a later stage switches conjunctions and disjunctions of shallow functions
    have hρℓ := PartialAssignment.mem_withFree.1 hρ
    refine two_pow_mul_card_filter_extensions_le_depthWith (k := s - 1) (j := i + 1) (by omega)
      (by omega) hsm ?_ fun k' hk' => ?_
    · rw [hρℓ]
      refine le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)) hℓ
    · rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
      by_contra hdeep
      exact hb ⟨k', hk', hdeep⟩

/-- Under a restriction leaving at least `s ≥ 2` bits free and making every gate of AND/OR depth at
most `j` `s`-shallow, no wire of AND/OR depth at most `j + 1` computes restricted parity, up to
negation. -/

text:
private theorem not_forall_trace_fill_eq_parity_bne {p : Program signature n g} (hs : 2 ≤ s)
    (hsρ : s ≤ #ρ.free) {j : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ k, p.depthsWith andOrCost k ≤ j → Shallow s ρ fun x => p.eval interpretation x k)
    (w : Wire n g) (hw : p.wireDepthsWith andOrCost w ≤ j + 1) (b : Bool) :
    ¬ ∀ y, p.trace interpretation (ρ.fill y) w = (parity n (ρ.fill y) != b) := by
  refine p.wire_induction (P := fun w => p.wireDepthsWith andOrCost w ≤ j + 1 → ∀ b,
    ¬ ∀ y, p.trace interpretation (ρ.fill y) w = (parity n (ρ.fill y) != b)) ?_ ?_ w hw b
  · -- an input is shallow, restricted parity is not
    intro i _ b hi
    have heq : (fun y => ρ.fill y i) = fun y => parity n (ρ.fill y) != b := funext hi
    have h₁ : Shallow s ρ fun x => parity n x != b := by
      change DecisionTree.complexity (fun y => parity n (ρ.fill y) != b) < s
      rw [← heq]
      exact shallow_proj hs ρ i
    refine not_shallow_parity hsρ ?_
    cases b
    · simpa using h₁
    · simpa using h₁.not
  · intro k ih hk b hk'
    by_cases hop : (p.lines k).op = .not
    · -- a negation computes restricted parity exactly when its argument computes its negation
      refine ih ⟨0, by simp [hop]⟩ ((Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans
        ((p.wireDepthsWith_lines_add_le andOrCost k _).trans hk)) (!b) fun y => ?_
      have hy := ((p.trace_gate interpretation (ρ.fill y) k).trans
        (interpretation_of_op_eq_not hop (p.trace interpretation (ρ.fill y)))).symm.trans (hk' y)
      revert hy
      cases p.trace interpretation (ρ.fill y) ((p.lines k).wires ⟨0, by simp [hop]⟩) <;>
        cases parity n (ρ.fill y) <;> cases b <;> simp
    · -- a conjunction or disjunction of shallow functions is a narrow formula in disjunctive
      -- normal form, up to negation
      have hargs : ∀ a, Shallow s ρ fun x => p.trace interpretation x ((p.lines k).wires a) :=
        fun a => by
          have hlt := wireDepthsWith_lines_add_one_le hop a
          cases hw' : (p.lines k).wires a with
          | input i => exact shallow_proj hs ρ i
          | gate k' =>
            rw [hw', Program.wireDepthsWith_gateWire] at hlt
            exact h k' (by change p.depthsWith andOrCost k ≤ j + 1 at hk; omega)
      obtain ⟨D, b', hD, heval⟩ := exists_dnf_of_shallow hop hargs
      refine DNF.not_forall_eval_eq_parity_fill_bne (fun t ht => (hD t ht).1.trans_le hsρ)
        (card_pos.1 (by omega)) (b != b') fun y => ?_
      have hy : interpretation (p.lines k).op
          (fun a => p.trace interpretation (ρ.fill y) ((p.lines k).wires a)) =
          (parity n (ρ.fill y) != b) :=
        (p.lines_eval interpretation (ρ.fill y) k).trans (hk' y)
      rw [heval y, hy]
      cases parity n (ρ.fill y) <;> cases b <;> cases b' <;> rfl

/-! ### Håstad's theorem -/

/-- **Håstad's theorem with the sharp exponent**, for programs: if a wire of AND/OR depth at most
`d` computes the parity of `n` bits, the program has at least `2 ^ s` conjunctions and
disjunctions, for every `s ≥ 2` with `17 s (16 s + 1) ^ (d - 2) ≤ n`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
private theorem two_pow_le_card_andOr_of_trace_eq_parity {p : Program signature n g} {w : Wire n g}
    (hw : ∀ x, p.trace interpretation x w = parity n x) (hs : 2 ≤ s) {d : ℕ}
    (hd : p.wireDepthsWith andOrCost w ≤ d) (hn : 17 * s * (16 * s + 1) ^ (d - 2) ≤ n) :
    2 ^ s ≤ #{k | (p.lines k).op ≠ .not} := by
  by_contra! hS
  set e := d - 2
  set ℓ := n / 17 / (16 * s + 1) ^ e
  have hm : s * (16 * s + 1) ^ e ≤ n / 17 :=
    (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by norm_num)).2 (by linarith)
  have hsℓ : s ≤ ℓ := Nat.le_div_pow_of_mul_pow_le (by omega) le_rfl hm
  -- fewer than all restrictions leaving `ℓ` bits free make some gate deep
  have h := two_pow_mul_card_filter_exists_not_shallow_le_depthWith (p := p) hs hm e le_rfl
  have hW : 0 < #(PartialAssignment.withFree (Fin n) ℓ) := by
    rw [PartialAssignment.card_withFree, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.choose_pos ((Nat.div_le_self _ _).trans (Nat.div_le_self _ _)))
      (by positivity)
  have hcard : #{k | (p.lines k).op ≠ .not ∧ p.depthsWith andOrCost k ≤ e + 1} ≤
      #{k | (p.lines k).op ≠ .not} :=
    card_le_card fun k hk => by
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hk ⊢
      exact hk.1
  have hlt : #{ρ ∈ PartialAssignment.withFree (Fin n) ℓ | ∃ k, p.depthsWith andOrCost k ≤ e + 1 ∧
      ¬ Shallow s ρ fun x => p.eval interpretation x k} <
      #(PartialAssignment.withFree (Fin n) ℓ) := by
    refine Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (a := 2 ^ s) (h.trans_lt ?_)
    exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (hcard.trans_lt hS) hW
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hgood⟩ := exists_mem_notMem_of_card_lt_card hlt
  have hall : ∀ k, p.depthsWith andOrCost k ≤ e + 1 →
      Shallow s ρ fun x => p.eval interpretation x k := fun k hk => by
    by_contra hdeep
    exact hgood (mem_filter.2 ⟨hρ, k, hk, hdeep⟩)
  exact not_forall_trace_fill_eq_parity_bne hs ((PartialAssignment.mem_withFree.1 hρ).symm ▸ hsℓ)
    hall w (by omega) false fun y => by rw [hw, Bool.bne_false]

/-- **Håstad's theorem with the sharp exponent**, counting conjunctions and disjunctions. A circuit
of negations and unbounded fan-in conjunctions and disjunctions of AND/OR depth at most `d`
computing the parity of `n` bits has at least `2 ^ s` conjunctions and disjunctions, for every
`s ≥ 2` with `17 s (16 s + 1) ^ (d - 2) ≤ n`. Their number is the AND/OR cost
`C.program.cost andOrCost` (`cost_andOrCost_eq_card`). -/

text:
theorem two_pow_le_card_andOr_of_computes_parity {C : Circuit signature n 1}
    (hC : C.Computes interpretation (single (parity n))) (hs : 2 ≤ s) {d : ℕ}
    (hd : C.depthWith andOrCost ≤ d) (hn : 17 * s * (16 * s + 1) ^ (d - 2) ≤ n) :
    2 ^ s ≤ #{k | (C.program.lines k).op ≠ .not} :=
  two_pow_le_card_andOr_of_trace_eq_parity (fun x => congrFun (hC x) 0) hs
    ((C.wireDepthsWith_outputs_le_depthWith andOrCost 0).trans hd) hn

/-- **Håstad's theorem with the sharp exponent.** A circuit of negations and unbounded fan-in
conjunctions and disjunctions of AND/OR depth at most `d` computing the parity of `n` bits has at

text:
theorem two_pow_le_size_of_computes_parity_of_depthWith_le {C : Circuit signature n 1}
    (hC : C.Computes interpretation (single (parity n))) (hs : 2 ≤ s) {d : ℕ}
    (hd : C.depthWith andOrCost ≤ d) (hn : 17 * s * (16 * s + 1) ^ (d - 2) ≤ n) :

text:
theorem two_pow_le_size_of_computes_parity_of_depth_le {C : Circuit signature n 1}
    (hC : C.Computes interpretation (single (parity n))) (hs : 2 ≤ s) {d : ℕ}
    (hd : C.depth ≤ d) (hn : 17 * s * (16 * s + 1) ^ (d - 2) ≤ n) : 2 ^ s ≤ C.size :=
  two_pow_le_size_of_computes_parity_of_depthWith_le hC hs
    ((C.depthWith_le_depth andOrCost_le_one).trans hd) hn

/-- **Håstad's theorem with the sharp exponent, when depth counts negations**, in round numbers:

text:
theorem two_pow_le_size_of_formula_computes_parity_of_depthWith_le {F : Formula signature n}
    (hF : F.Computes interpretation (parity n)) (hs : 2 ≤ s) {d : ℕ}
    (hd : F.depthWith andOrCost ≤ d) (hn : 17 * s * (16 * s + 1) ^ (d - 2) ≤ n) :
    2 ^ s ≤ F.size :=

/-- **Håstad's theorem with the sharp exponent, for formulas**, in round numbers: at least `2 ^ s`
operation nodes for every `s ≥ 2` with `(17 s) ^ (d - 1) ≤ n`, when `d ≥ 2`. -/

text:
theorem SIZE_ssubset {s t : ℕ → ℕ} (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : ∀ n, 1 ≤ t n)
    (hgap : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, s n + (2 * n + 3) ≤ t n)
    (hs : ∃ᶠ n in atTop, (s n : ℝ) < 2 ^ n / n) : SIZE s ⊂ SIZE t := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Shannon.lt_complexity
  -- The lengths at which a function of complexity in `(s n, t n]` is used.
  have hgood : ∃ᶠ n in atTop, N ≤ n ∧ s n + (2 * n + 3) ≤ t n ∧ (s n : ℝ) < 2 ^ n / n :=

theorem exists_fixedOutput (c : Circuit signature n n) (T K d : ℕ) (cp : Fin M → BitString n) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature n n,
      out.Computes interpretation (fixedOutput (w := w) c T K d cp) ∧
      out.size ≤ 2 + 5 * K * c.size + (18 * d ^ 2 + 30) * 2 ^ d * (Record.width n w + 1) +
        1000 * (K + 1) * (n + w + 1) ^ 2 := by
  let f := c.eval interpretation
  let constants : Set (BooleanFunction n) := {fun _ => false, fun _ => true}
  have hconst : Synthesis interpretation (inputs n) constants 2 :=
    (Synthesis.const false).union (Synthesis.const true)
  let s := inputs n ∪ constants
  have hc (b : Bool) : (fun _ : BitString n => b) ∈ s := by cases b <;> simp [s, constants]
  have hp : Synthesis interpretation s (prefixWires f K) (K * c.size) :=
    Synthesis.orbit c id (fun bit => Or.inl ⟨bit, rfl⟩) K
  let records := fun x => Record.initial (R := BitonicSort.arity d) (w := w) f T K cp x
  let sorted := fun x => Record.sorted d (records x)
  let pair := fun x => Record.detect (sorted x)
  let s1 := s ∪ prefixWires f K
  have hs := Record.synthesis_sorted s1 d records
    (Record.initial_wires_subset s1 f T K cp (fun _ h => Or.inr h) fun b => Or.inl (hc b))
  let s2 := s1 ∪ Record.recordsWires sorted
  have hd := Record.synthesis_detect s2 sorted
    (fun j _ h => Or.inr (Record.wireSet_subset_recordsWires sorted j h))
    fun b => Or.inl (Or.inl (hc b))
  let s3 := s2 ∪ Record.pairWires pair
  have hout := synthesis_reconstruct s3 c T K (fun x => (pair x).1) (fun x => (pair x).2)
    (fun _ h => Or.inr (Record.wireSet_fst_subset pair h))
    (fun _ h => Or.inr (Record.wireSet_snd_subset pair h))
    (fun _ h => Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr h))) fun b => Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (hc b)))
  have h := hconst.trans (hp.trans (hs.trans (hd.trans hout)))
  have hfinal : Synthesis interpretation (inputs n)
      (wires (fixedOutput (w := w) c T K d cp))
      (2 + 5 * K * c.size + (18 * d ^ 2 + 30) * 2 ^ d * (Record.width n w + 1) +
        1000 * (K + 1) * (n + w + 1) ^ 2) := by
    apply h.mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl
    rw [BitonicSort.arity_eq_two_pow]
    ring_nf
    exact le_rfl
  exact hfinal.exists_circuit_outputs

theorem fixed_power_on (n : ℕ) (c : Circuit signature n n) (S : Finset (BitString n))
    (T L : ℕ) (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, c.eval interpretation x ∈ S) (hL : 0 < L) (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature n n,
      out.ComputesOn interpretation ↑S (c.eval interpretation)^[T] ∧
      out.size ≤ 40000 * powerBudget n c.size S.card L := by
  classical
  let f := c.eval interpretation
  by_cases hT : T < 2 * L
  · refine ⟨c.iterate T, fun x _ => by rw [Circuit.eval_iterate], ?_⟩
    rw [Circuit.size_iterate]
    have ht : T * c.size ≤ 2 * L * c.size := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hT.le
    unfold powerBudget
    nlinarith [Nat.zero_le ((n + 1) ^ 3 * (L + S.card / L + 1))]
  obtain ⟨H, hHS, hcard, hcover⟩ := FunctionalGraph.exists_checkpoints f S hS hL
  let cp : Fin H.card → BitString n := fun j => (H.equivFin.symm j).val
  let d := Nat.clog 2 (H.card + 2 * L + 1)
  have hcapacity : H.card + (2 * L + 1) ≤ BitonicSort.arity d := by
    simpa only [BitonicSort.arity_eq_two_pow, d, Nat.add_assoc] using
      Nat.le_pow_clog Nat.one_lt_two (H.card + 2 * L + 1)
  have hN : H.card ≤ 2 ^ n := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool] using
      Finset.card_le_univ H
  have hd : d ≤ n + 2 := by
    apply Nat.clog_le_of_le_pow
    simp only [Nat.pow_succ]
    have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := n)
    omega
  have hR : 2 ^ d ≤ 2 * (H.card + 2 * L + 1) := by
    have hpos : 0 < d := Nat.clog_pos (by decide) (by omega)
    have hp := Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self Nat.one_lt_two
      (show 1 < H.card + 2 * L + 1 by omega)
    have hpow : 2 ^ d = 2 ^ (d - 1) * 2 := by rw [← Nat.pow_succ, show (d - 1).succ = d by omega]
    rw [hpow]
    change 2 ^ (d - 1) < _ at hp
    omega
  have hfit : 2 * L < 2 ^ (n + 2) := by
    simp only [Nat.pow_succ]
    omega
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hsize⟩ := exists_fixedOutput (w := n + 2) c T (2 * L) d cp
  refine ⟨out, fun x hx => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hout x]
    apply reconstruct_spec f T (2 * L) cp x _ _ hfit (by omega)
    apply Record.detect_sorted_witness f T (2 * L) d cp x hcapacity hfit
    rcases hcover x hx with ⟨i, j, hij, hj, heq⟩ | ⟨t, ht, hmem⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨i, j, hij, by omega, heq⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨t, ht.le, H.equivFin ⟨f^[t] x, hmem⟩, by simp [cp]⟩
  · have hc : H.card ≤ S.card / L := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hL).mpr hcard
    apply hsize.trans ((construction_cost n c.size H.card L d hL hd hR).trans ?_)
    unfold powerBudget
    gcongr

  · have hc : H.card ≤ (activeVertices f L).card / L := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hL).mpr hcard
    apply hsize.trans ((active_construction_cost n c.size H.card L d hL hd hR).trans ?_)

theorem controlled_circuit (g : BitString q → BitString q)
    (a : BitString q → BitString p → BitString p) (K : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ u, ∃ c : Circuit signature p p, c.Computes interpretation (a u) ∧ c.size ≤ K) :
    ∃ c : Circuit signature (q + p) (q + p),
      c.Computes interpretation (controlledBits g a) ∧
      c.size ≤ 2 + 2 ^ q * (K + 6 * q + 4 * p + 1) := by
  classical
  let e : Fin (2 ^ q) ≃ BitString q := (BitString.equivFin q).symm
  let u := fun x : BitString (q + p) => fun i => x (Fin.castAdd p i)
  let v := fun x : BitString (q + p) => fun i => x (Fin.natAdd q i)
  let flags := fun j x => decide (u x = e j)
  let records := fun j x => Fin.append (g (e j)) (a (e j) (v x))
  let constants : Set (BooleanFunction (q + p)) := {fun _ => false, fun _ => true}
  let src := inputs (q + p) ∪ constants
  have hc (b : Bool) : (fun _ : BitString (q + p) => b) ∈ src := by
    cases b <;> simp [src, constants]
  have hconst : Synthesis interpretation (inputs (q + p)) constants 2 :=
    (Synthesis.const false).union (Synthesis.const true)
  have hflag (j : Fin (2 ^ q)) :
      Synthesis interpretation src {flags j} (2 * q + 1) := by
    have h := Synthesis.word_eq_const (s := src) (fun x => word (u x))
      (fun i => by
        simpa [u, getLsbD_word] using
          (show (fun x : BitString (q + p) => x (Fin.castAdd p i)) ∈ src from Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩))
      (word (e j))
    have he (x : BitString (q + p)) : word (u x) = word (e j) ↔ u x = e j := by
      constructor
      · intro hh
        funext i
        simpa only [getLsbD_word] using congrArg (fun w : BitVec q => w.getLsbD i.val) hh
      · exact congrArg word
    simpa only [he] using h
  have hrecord (j : Fin (2 ^ q)) :
      Synthesis interpretation src (wires (records j)) K := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc', hs⟩ := ha (e j)
    have h := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := src) c (fun i x => v x i)
      (fun i => Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)
    have heval : c.eval interpretation = a (e j) := funext hc'
    rw [heval] at h
    have hav : wires (records j) ⊆ src ∪ wires (fun x => a (e j) (v x)) := by
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      induction i using Fin.addCases with
      | left i =>
        apply Or.inl
        simpa only [records, Fin.append_left] using hc (g (e j) i)
      | right i =>
        apply Or.inr
        exact ⟨i, by simp only [records, Fin.append_right]⟩
    exact (h.trans (Synthesis.of_subset hav)).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl
      (by simpa using hs)
  have hall := Synthesis.iUnion (fun j => {flags j} ∪ wires (records j))
    (fun _ => (2 * q + 1) + K) (fun j => (hflag j).union (hrecord j))
  let all := ⋃ j, {flags j} ∪ wires (records j)
  have hselect := synthesis_chooseRecord (src ∪ all)
    (fun x j => flags j x) (fun x j => records j x) (fun _ _ => false)
    (fun j => Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, Or.inl rfl⟩))
    (fun j bit => Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, Or.inr ⟨bit, rfl⟩⟩))
    (fun _ => Or.inl (hc false))
  have he (x : BitString (q + p)) :
      chooseRecord (fun j => flags j x) (fun j => records j x) (fun _ => false) (2 ^ q) =
        controlledBits g a x := by
    obtain ⟨j, _, hj, hout⟩ := chooseRecord_spec (fun j => flags j x)
      (fun j => records j x) (fun _ => false) (2 ^ q)
      ⟨e.symm (u x), (e.symm (u x)).isLt, by simp [flags]⟩
    have hj' : u x = e j := of_decide_eq_true hj
    rw [hout]
    change Fin.append (g (e j)) (a (e j) (v x)) = Fin.append (g (u x)) (a (u x) (v x))
    rw [hj']
  simp only [he] at hselect
  obtain ⟨c, hc', hs⟩ := (hconst.trans (hall.trans hselect)).exists_circuit_outputs
  refine ⟨c, hc', hs.trans ?_⟩
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring_nf
  exact le_rfl

    (a : BitString q → BitString p → BitString p) (family : Set (BitString p → BitString p))

theorem affineHash_circuit {k n : ℕ} (seed : (Fin k → BitString n) × BitString k) :
    ∃ c : Circuit signature n k,
      c.Computes interpretation (affineHash seed) ∧ c.size ≤ k * (5 * (n + 1) + 1) := by
  have hrow (row : Fin k) :
      Synthesis interpretation (inputs n) {fun x => affineHash seed x row}
        (5 * (n + 1) + 1) := by
    let term (j : Fin (n + 1)) (x : BitString n) : Bool :=
      Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Bool) (fun i => seed.1 row i * x i) (seed.2 row) j
    have hterm (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
        Synthesis interpretation (inputs n) {term j} 1 := by
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        simpa only [term, Fin.snoc_last] using Synthesis.const (seed.2 row)
      | cast i =>
        simp only [term, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
        cases seed.1 row i
        · simpa only [Bool.mul_eq_and, Bool.false_and] using Synthesis.const false
        · simpa only [Bool.mul_eq_and, Bool.true_and] using
            (Synthesis.of_mem (s := inputs n) ⟨i, rfl⟩).mono
              Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl (Nat.zero_le 1)
    have hsum := Synthesis.sum (s := inputs n) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))
      term (fun _ => 1) fun j _ => hterm j
    have heq : (fun x : BitString n => ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), term j x) =
        fun x => affineHash seed x row := by
      funext x
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp only [term, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last, affineHash, BitString.LinearHash.hash,
        dotProduct, Pi.add_apply]
    rw [heq] at hsum
    refine hsum.mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl ?_
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul]
    omega
  have hfam := Synthesis.family (I := interpretation) (s := inputs n)
    (fun row x => affineHash seed x row) (fun _ => 5 * (n + 1) + 1) hrow
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hs⟩ := hfam.exists_circuit_outputs
  refine ⟨c, hc, hs.trans ?_⟩
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, le_rfl]

theorem controlled_affine_circuit_of_scalar_bound (g : BitString q → BitString q)
    (a : BitString q → (BitString p →ᵃ[Bool] BitString p)) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ f : BooleanFunction q, ∃ c : Circuit signature q 1,
      c.Computes interpretation (single f) ∧ c.size ≤ L) :
    ∃ c : Circuit signature (q + p) (q + p),
      c.Computes interpretation (controlledBits g (fun u => a u)) ∧
      c.size ≤ affineControllerSynthesisBudget q p L := by
  let u : BitString (q + p) → BitString q := fun x i => x (Fin.castAdd p i)
  let v : BitString (q + p) → BitString p := fun x i => x (Fin.natAdd q i)
  have hscalar (f : BooleanFunction q) :
      Synthesis interpretation (inputs (q + p)) {fun x => f (u x)} L := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hs⟩ := hL f
    have h := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := inputs (q + p)) c
      (fun i x => u x i) (fun i => ⟨Fin.castAdd p i, rfl⟩)
    have he : c.eval interpretation = single f := funext hc
    simpa [he, wires, single] using h.mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl hs
  have hrow (row : Fin p) :
      Synthesis interpretation (inputs (q + p)) {fun x => a (u x) (v x) row}
        ((p + 1) * (L + 5) + 1) := by
    let term (j : Fin (p + 1)) (x : BitString (q + p)) : Bool :=
      Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Bool) (fun i => (affineMapSeed (a (u x))).1 row i * v x i)
        ((affineMapSeed (a (u x))).2 row) j
    have hterm (j : Fin (p + 1)) :
        Synthesis interpretation (inputs (q + p)) {term j} (L + 1) := by
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        simpa only [term, Fin.snoc_last] using
          (hscalar (fun z => (affineMapSeed (a z)).2 row)).mono
            Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl (Nat.le_succ L)
      | cast i =>
        have hinput : Synthesis interpretation (inputs (q + p)) {fun x => v x i} 0 :=
          Synthesis.of_mem ⟨Fin.natAdd q i, rfl⟩
        simpa only [term, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Bool.mul_eq_and, Nat.add_zero] using
          (hscalar (fun z => (affineMapSeed (a z)).1 row i)).and hinput
    have hsum := Synthesis.sum (s := inputs (q + p))
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (p + 1))) term (fun _ => L + 1) (fun j _ => hterm j)
    have he : (fun x : BitString (q + p) => ∑ j : Fin (p + 1), term j x) =
        fun x => a (u x) (v x) row := by
      funext x
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp only [term, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
      change affineHash (affineMapSeed (a (u x))) (v x) row = _
      exact congrFun (affineHash_affineMapSeed (a (u x)) (v x)) row
    rw [he] at hsum
    simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul,
      Nat.add_assoc, show 1 + 4 = 5 by rfl] using hsum
  let cost : Fin (q + p) → ℕ := Fin.append (fun _ => L) (fun _ => (p + 1) * (L + 5) + 1)
  have hout (i : Fin (q + p)) :
      Synthesis interpretation (inputs (q + p))
        {fun x => controlledBits g (fun z => a z) x i} (cost i) := by
    induction i using Fin.addCases with
    | left i =>
      simpa only [cost, controlledBits, Fin.append_left, u] using hscalar (fun z => g z i)
    | right i =>
      simpa only [cost, controlledBits, Fin.append_right, u, v] using hrow i
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hs⟩ := (Synthesis.family _ cost hout).exists_circuit_outputs
  refine ⟨c, hc, hs.trans (le_of_eq ?_)⟩
  simp only [cost, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul,
    affineControllerSynthesisBudget]
  ring

theorem affine_controller_power_of_scalar_bound (g : BitString q → BitString q)
    (a : BitString q → (BitString p →ᵃ[Bool] BitString p)) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ f : BooleanFunction q, ∃ c : Circuit signature q 1,
      c.Computes interpretation (single f) ∧ c.size ≤ L) (T : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : Circuit signature (q + p) (q + p),
      c.Computes interpretation ((controlledBits g (fun u => a u))^[T]) ∧
      c.size ≤ affineControllerSynthesisBudget q p L := by
  let family : Set (BitString p → BitString p) :=
    Set.range fun f : BitString p →ᵃ[Bool] BitString p => ⇑f
  have hclosed (u : BitString q) : controlledPayload g (fun z => a z) T u ∈ family :=
    controlledPayload_mem g (fun z => a z) family
      (show id ∈ family from ⟨AffineMap.id Bool (BitString p), rfl⟩)
      (fun _ ⟨f, hf⟩ _ ⟨h, hh⟩ => ⟨f.comp h, by simp only [← hf, ← hh]; rfl⟩)
      (fun z => ⟨a z, rfl⟩) T u
  choose b hb using hclosed
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hs⟩ := controlled_affine_circuit_of_scalar_bound (g^[T]) b L hL
  refine ⟨c, fun x => (hc x).trans ?_, hs⟩
  rw [controlledBits_iterate]
  simp only [controlledBits, hb]

private theorem synthesis_batched_power_on (c : Circuit signature n n)
    (s : Set (BooleanFunction a))
    (init : BitString a → Fin r → BitString n)
    (hi : ∀ member bit, (fun x => init x member bit) ∈ s)
    (hc : ∀ b : Bool, (fun _ : BitString a => b) ∈ s)
    (T L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) (hT : 2 * L ≤ T)
    (cp : Fin M → BitString n) (hcp : Function.Injective cp) (S : Set (BitString n))
    (hcover : ∀ x ∈ S, FunctionalGraph.Repeats (c.eval interpretation) x L ∨
      ∃ t < 2 * L, ∃ j, (c.eval interpretation)^[t] x = cp j) :
    ∃ result : Fin r → BitString a → BitString n,
      (∀ member x, init x member ∈ S →
        result member x = (c.eval interpretation)^[T] (init x member)) ∧
      Synthesis interpretation s (⋃ member, wires (result member))
      (r * (2 * L * c.size) +
        48 * (r * (2 * L + 1) + M + 1) * (Nat.clog 2 (r * (2 * L + 1) + M) + 1) ^ 2 *
          (n + (n + 1) + 1) +
        r * ((2 * L + 1) * (4 * ((n + 2) + n + 1)) + 2 * L * c.size +
          200 * (2 * L + 1) * (n + (n + 2) + 1) ^ 2 + 40000 * powerBudget n c.size 0 L +
          4 * n)) := by

  let K := 2 * L
  let orbit := fun member => Synthesis.stages (fun j => wires fun x => f^[j] (init x member)) K
  have hall : Synthesis interpretation s (⋃ member, orbit member) (r * (K * c.size)) := by
    simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul] using
      Synthesis.iUnion orbit (fun _ => K * c.size)
        fun member => Synthesis.orbit c (fun x => init x member) (hi member) K
  let s1 := s ∪ ⋃ member, orbit member
  let queries : BitString a → Fin (r * (K + 1)) → BitString n := fun x q =>
    f^[(finProdFinEquiv.symm q).2.val] (init x (finProdFinEquiv.symm q).1)
  have hquery (x : BitString a) (member : Fin r) (j : Fin (K + 1)) :
      queries x (finProdFinEquiv (member, j)) = f^[j.val] (init x member) := by
    simp only [queries, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  let stored : Fin M → BitString (n + 1) := fun j => Fin.cons true (f^[T - K] (cp j))
  have hdict := synthesis_lookupOr s1 cp stored queries fun q bit =>
    Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(finProdFinEquiv.symm q).1, Synthesis.subset_stages _
      (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (finProdFinEquiv.symm q).2.isLt) ⟨bit, rfl⟩⟩)
  let s2 := s1 ∪ ⋃ q, wires fun x => lookupOr cp stored (queries x q)
  have hresult (member : Fin r) (j : Fin (K + 1)) (bit : Fin (n + 1)) :
      (fun x => lookupOr cp stored (f^[j.val] (init x member)) bit) ∈ s2 :=
    Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨finProdFinEquiv (member, j), bit, funext fun x => by
      simp only [hquery]⟩)
  obtain ⟨fallback, hfall, hfs⟩ := exists_repeat_power c T L hL hLN hT
  let flags := fun member x (j : Fin (K + 1)) =>
    lookupOr cp stored (f^[j.val] (init x member)) 0
  let payloads := fun member x (j : Fin (K + 1)) (bit : Fin n) =>
    lookupOr cp stored (f^[j.val] (init x member)) bit.succ
  let finished := fun member x => finishHit (w := n + 2) f K (flags member x)
    (payloads member x) (fallback.eval interpretation (init x member))
  have hfinish (member : Fin r) : Synthesis interpretation s2 (wires (finished member))
      ((K + 1) * (4 * ((n + 2) + n + 1)) + K * c.size + 200 * (K + 1) * (n + (n + 2) + 1) ^ 2 +
        fallback.size + 4 * n) :=
    synthesis_finishHit c s2 K (flags member) (payloads member) _
      (fun j => hresult member j 0) (fun j bit => hresult member j bit.succ)
      (fun b => Or.inl (Or.inl (hc b)))
      (Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := s2) fallback (fun i x => init x member i)
        fun i => Or.inl (Or.inl (hi member i)))

      finished member x = f^[T] (init x member) := by

      simp only [K, Nat.pow_succ]
      omega
    apply finishHit_correct f T K _ _ _ _ hfit hT
    · intro j hj
      obtain ⟨h, hh, -⟩ := (decide_eq_true_iff.mp hj : ∃ h, cp h = _ ∧ stored h 0 = true)
      funext bit
      change lookupOr cp stored _ bit.succ = _
      rw [lookupOr_of_eq stored hcp hh]
      simp only [stored, Fin.cons_succ, hh]
    · intro hnone
      rcases hcover (init x member) hx with hr | ⟨t, ht, h, hh⟩
      · exact hfall _ hr
      · have hj := hnone ⟨t, by omega⟩
        simp only [flags, lookupOr, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hj

    (hall.trans (hdict.trans hfam)).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl ?_⟩

  have hm : (K + 1) * (4 * ((n + 2) + n + 1)) + K * c.size +
      200 * (K + 1) * (n + (n + 2) + 1) ^ 2 + fallback.size + 4 * n ≤

          200 * (2 * L + 1) * (n + (n + 2) + 1) ^ 2 + 40000 * powerBudget n c.size 0 L +
            4 * n := by
    simp only [K]
    omega
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left r hm
  simp only [K] at this ⊢

private theorem batch_construction_cost (n s M N r L : ℕ) (hN : N ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (hrN : r ≤ 2 ^ n) (hL : 0 < L) (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) (hM : M ≤ N / L) :
    2 + (r * (2 * L * s) +
        48 * (r * (2 * L + 1) + M + 1) * (Nat.clog 2 (r * (2 * L + 1) + M) + 1) ^ 2 *
          (n + (n + 1) + 1) +
        r * ((2 * L + 1) * (4 * ((n + 2) + n + 1)) + 2 * L * s +
          200 * (2 * L + 1) * (n + (n + 2) + 1) ^ 2 + 40000 * powerBudget n s 0 L + 4 * n)) ≤
      100000 * batchBudget n s N r L := by
  set U := 2 ^ n with hUdef
  set d := Nat.clog 2 (r * (2 * L + 1) + M)
  set P := (n + 1) ^ 3
  have hU : 1 ≤ U := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have hMU : M ≤ U := (hM.trans (Nat.div_le_self _ _)).trans hN
  have hd : d ≤ 2 * n + 2 := by
    apply Nat.clog_le_of_le_pow
    have he : 2 ^ (2 * n + 2) = 4 * U * U := by
      rw [hUdef, show 2 * n + 2 = n + n + 2 by omega, pow_add, pow_add]
      ring
    rw [he]
    have hp := Nat.mul_le_mul hrN hLN
    nlinarith
  have hP : 1 ≤ P := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have hn1 : n + 1 ≤ P := by
    simpa only [pow_one] using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 0 < n + 1 by omega) (by decide : 1 ≤ 3)
  have hn2 : (n + 1) ^ 2 ≤ P := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by decide)
  -- the shared dictionary
  have hwidth : (d + 1) ^ 2 * (n + (n + 1) + 1) ≤ 18 * P := by
    have h1 : (d + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 9 * (n + 1) ^ 2 := by
      have := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (show d + 1 ≤ 3 * (n + 1) by omega) 2
      nlinarith
    calc (d + 1) ^ 2 * (n + (n + 1) + 1) ≤ 9 * (n + 1) ^ 2 * (2 * (n + 1)) := by
          gcongr; omega
      _ = 18 * P := by simp only [P]; ring
  have hrecords : r * (2 * L + 1) + M + 1 ≤ 3 * (r * L) + N / L + 1 := by nlinarith
  have hdict : 48 * (r * (2 * L + 1) + M + 1) * (d + 1) ^ 2 * (n + (n + 1) + 1) ≤
      864 * P * (3 * (r * L) + N / L + 1) := by
    calc 48 * (r * (2 * L + 1) + M + 1) * (d + 1) ^ 2 * (n + (n + 1) + 1)
        = 48 * (r * (2 * L + 1) + M + 1) * ((d + 1) ^ 2 * (n + (n + 1) + 1)) := by ring
      _ ≤ 48 * (3 * (r * L) + N / L + 1) * (18 * P) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  -- one member
  have hmember : (2 * L + 1) * (4 * ((n + 2) + n + 1)) +
      200 * (2 * L + 1) * (n + (n + 2) + 1) ^ 2 + 40000 * (P * (L + 0 + 1)) + 4 * n ≤
        85440 * (L * P) := by
    have h1 : (2 * L + 1) * (4 * ((n + 2) + n + 1)) ≤ 36 * (L * P) := by
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 * L + 1 ≤ 3 * L by omega)
        (show 4 * ((n + 2) + n + 1) ≤ 12 * P by omega)
      nlinarith
    have h2 : 200 * (2 * L + 1) * (n + (n + 2) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 5400 * (L * P) := by
      have hs : (n + (n + 2) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 9 * P := by
        have := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (show n + (n + 2) + 1 ≤ 3 * (n + 1) by omega) 2
        nlinarith
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 * L + 1 ≤ 3 * L by omega) hs
      nlinarith
    have h3 : 40000 * (P * (L + 0 + 1)) ≤ 80000 * (L * P) := by nlinarith
    have h4 : 4 * n ≤ 4 * (L * P) := by nlinarith
    omega
  have hmembers := Nat.mul_le_mul_left r hmember
  simp only [powerBudget, Nat.zero_div] at hmembers ⊢
  change _ ≤ 100000 * (r * L * s + P * (r * L + N / L + 1))
  change 2 + (r * (2 * L * s) + 48 * (r * (2 * L + 1) + M + 1) * (d + 1) ^ 2 *
    (n + (n + 1) + 1) + r * ((2 * L + 1) * (4 * ((n + 2) + n + 1)) + 2 * L * s +
      200 * (2 * L + 1) * (n + (n + 2) + 1) ^ 2 + 40000 * (L * s + P * (L + 0 + 1)) +
        4 * n)) ≤ _
  nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (r * L * s), Nat.zero_le (P * (N / L)), Nat.zero_le (r * (L * P))]

lie in `S`, one shared checkpoint table costs `S.card / L` in the batched tradeoff. The set need
not be invariant: later states may leave it. The circuit is only required to be correct on the
displayed input domain. All gates are charged; the time to construct the circuit is not bounded. -/

text:
theorem batched_fixed_power_on_prefixes (c : Circuit signature n n)
    (S : Finset (BitString n)) (r T L : ℕ) (hrN : r ≤ 2 ^ n) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature (r * n) (r * n),
      out.ComputesOn interpretation
        {x | ∀ member : Fin r, ∀ i : Fin L,
          (c.eval interpretation)^[i.val] (directProductInput x member) ∈ S}
        (blockMap (c.eval interpretation)^[T] r) ∧
      out.size ≤ 100000 * batchBudget n c.size S.card r L := by
  classical
  let f := c.eval interpretation
  by_cases hT : T < 2 * L
  · refine ⟨(c.iterate T).replicate r, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x _
      rw [Circuit.eval_replicate]
      funext i
      simp only [blockMap, Circuit.eval_iterate]
    · rw [Circuit.size_replicate, Circuit.size_iterate]
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left r (Nat.mul_le_mul_right c.size hT.le)
      unfold batchBudget
      nlinarith [Nat.zero_le ((n + 1) ^ 3 * (r * L + S.card / L + 1))]
  obtain ⟨H, _, hcard, hcover⟩ := FunctionalGraph.exists_checkpoints_on f S hL
  let cp : Fin H.card → BitString n := fun j => (H.equivFin.symm j).val
  have hcp : Function.Injective cp := fun i j h => H.equivFin.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)
  have hcov (x : BitString n) (hx : ∀ i : Fin L, f^[i.val] x ∈ S) :
      FunctionalGraph.Repeats f x L ∨
      ∃ t < 2 * L, ∃ j, f^[t] x = cp j := by
    rcases hcover x hx with hrep | ⟨t, ht, hmem⟩
    · exact Or.inl hrep
    · exact Or.inr ⟨t, ht, H.equivFin ⟨_, hmem⟩, by simp [cp]⟩
  let constants : Set (BooleanFunction (r * n)) := {fun _ => false, fun _ => true}
  have hconst : Synthesis interpretation (inputs (r * n)) constants 2 :=
    (Synthesis.const false).union (Synthesis.const true)
  obtain ⟨result, hresult, hs⟩ := synthesis_batched_power_on c (inputs (r * n) ∪ constants)
    (fun x member => directProductInput x member) (fun _ _ => Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)
    (fun b => Or.inr (by cases b <;> simp [constants])) T L hL hLN (by omega) cp hcp
    {x | ∀ i : Fin L, f^[i.val] x ∈ S} hcov
  let output : BitString (r * n) → BitString (r * n) := fun x i =>
    result (finProdFinEquiv.symm i).1 x (finProdFinEquiv.symm i).2
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hsize⟩ := ((hconst.trans hs).mono Set.Subset.rfl
    (show wires output ⊆ ⋃ member, wires (result member) from by
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨(finProdFinEquiv.symm i).1, (finProdFinEquiv.symm i).2, rfl⟩)
    le_rfl).exists_circuit_outputs
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hsize.trans ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    rw [hout x]
    funext i
    exact congrFun (hresult (finProdFinEquiv.symm i).1 x (hx _)) (finProdFinEquiv.symm i).2
  · apply batch_construction_cost n c.size H.card S.card r L
      (by simpa using Finset.card_le_univ S) hrN hL hLN
    exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hL).mpr hcard

theorem boolean_orderedBudget_le (n m q : ℕ) :
    signature.orderedBudget n m q ≤
      (q + 1) * 5 ^ q * (n + q + 1) ^ (2 * q + m) := by
  let W := n + q + 1
  have hW : 1 ≤ W := by dsimp [W]; omega
  have ht (g : ℕ) (hg : g ∈ Finset.range (q + 1)) :
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.range g, signature.lineCount (n + j)) * (n + g) ^ m ≤
        5 ^ q * W ^ (2 * q + m) := by
    have hgq : g ≤ q := by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hg
    have hp : (∏ j ∈ Finset.range g, signature.lineCount (n + j)) ≤
        (5 * W ^ 2) ^ g := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∏ _j ∈ Finset.range g, 5 * W ^ 2 := by
          apply Finset.prod_le_prod
          intro j hj
          have hjq : n + j + 1 ≤ W := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj; dsimp [W]; omega
          exact (boolean_lineCount_le _).trans (by gcongr)
        _ = _ := by simp
    calc
      _ ≤ (5 * W ^ 2) ^ g * W ^ m := by gcongr; dsimp [W]; omega
      _ ≤ (5 * W ^ 2) ^ q * W ^ m := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
  unfold Signature.orderedBudget
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _g ∈ Finset.range (q + 1), 5 ^ q * W ^ (2 * q + m) := Finset.sum_le_sum ht
    _ = _ := by simp [W, Nat.mul_assoc]

theorem batched_counter_power (T r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ 2 ^ (k + k)) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature (r * (k + k)) (r * (k + k)),
      out.Computes interpretation (counterBatchPower T) ∧
        out.size ≤ 40000 * (k + 1) ^ 3 * (2 ^ k + r) := by
  classical
  let queries : BitString (r * (k + k)) → Fin r → BitString k :=
    fun x member bit => counterBlock x member (Fin.castAdd k bit)
  have hdict := synthesis_lookupOr (inputs (r * (k + k))) (residueKeys k) (residueValues k T)
    queries (fun member bit => ⟨finProdFinEquiv (member, Fin.castAdd k bit), rfl⟩)
  let s1 := inputs (r * (k + k)) ∪
    ⋃ member, wires fun x => lookupOr (residueKeys k) (residueValues k T) (queries x member)
  let a := fun (member : Fin r) (x : BitString (r * (k + k))) =>
    ModulusCounter.leftWord (counterBlock x member)
  let b := fun (member : Fin r) (x : BitString (r * (k + k))) =>
    ModulusCounter.rightWord (counterBlock x member)
  let rem := fun (member : Fin r) (x : BitString (r * (k + k))) =>
    word (lookupOr (residueKeys k) (residueValues k T) (queries x member))
  have ha (member : Fin r) : wordWires (a member) ⊆ s1 := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    left
    refine ⟨finProdFinEquiv (member, Fin.castAdd k i), ?_⟩
    funext x
    simp [a, ModulusCounter.leftWord, counterBlock]
  have hb (member : Fin r) : wordWires (b member) ⊆ s1 := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    left
    refine ⟨finProdFinEquiv (member, Fin.natAdd k i), ?_⟩
    funext x
    simp [b, ModulusCounter.rightWord, counterBlock]
  have hrem (member : Fin r) : wordWires (rem member) ⊆ s1 := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    right
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨member, i, by funext x; simp [rem]⟩
  have hadd (member : Fin r) := synthesis_addResidue s1 (a member) (b member) (rem member)
    (ha member) (hb member) (hrem member)
  have hfam := Synthesis.iUnion (fun member => wordWires fun x =>
      addResidue (a member x) (b member x) (rem member x)) (fun _ => 100 * (k + 1)) hadd
  have hspec (member : Fin r) (x : BitString (r * (k + k))) :
      addResidue (a member x) (b member x) (rem member x) =
        BitVec.ofNat k (ModulusCounter.advance (a member x).toNat (b member x).toNat T) := by
    apply ModulusCounter.addResidue_spec
    intro hpos
    let j : Fin (2 ^ k - 1) := ⟨(a member x).toNat - 1, by have := (a member x).isLt; omega⟩
    have hj1 : j.val + 1 = (a member x).toNat := Nat.sub_add_cancel hpos
    have hkey : residueKeys k j = queries x member := by
      funext bit
      change (BitVec.ofNat k (j.val + 1)).getLsbD bit.val =
        counterBlock x member (Fin.castAdd k bit)
      rw [hj1, BitVec.ofNat_toNat, BitVec.setWidth_eq]
      exact getLsbD_word (fun i => counterBlock x member (Fin.castAdd k i)) bit
    have hrw : rem member x = BitVec.ofNat k (T % (a member x).toNat) := by
      simp only [rem, lookupOr_of_eq (residueValues k T) (residueKeys_injective k) hkey]
      change word (fun bit : Fin k => (BitVec.ofNat k (T % (j.val + 1))).getLsbD bit.val) = _
      rw [word_getLsbD, hj1]
    rw [hrw, BitVec.toNat_ofNat,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ((Nat.mod_lt _ hpos).trans (a member x).isLt)]
  have h := (Synthesis.of_subset (I := interpretation) (s := inputs (r * (k + k)))
    (t := inputs (r * (k + k))) Set.Subset.rfl).union (hdict.trans hfam)
  have hout : wires (counterBatchPower (r := r) (k := k) T) ⊆
      inputs (r * (k + k)) ∪
        ⋃ member, wordWires fun x => addResidue (a member x) (b member x) (rem member x) := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨member, bit⟩, rfl⟩ := finProdFinEquiv.surjective i
    induction bit using Fin.addCases with
    | left i =>
      left
      refine ⟨finProdFinEquiv (member, Fin.castAdd k i), ?_⟩
      funext x
      simp only [counterBatchPower_apply, counterStep_iterate_left, counterBlock]
    | right i =>
      right
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨member, i, ?_⟩
      funext x
      simp only [hspec, counterBatchPower_apply, ModulusCounter.power, ModulusCounter.pack,
        Fin.append_right, a, b]
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hsize⟩ := (h.mono Set.Subset.rfl hout le_rfl).exists_circuit_outputs
  refine ⟨out, ho, hsize.trans ?_⟩
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul,
    Nat.zero_add]
  have hN : 1 ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have hM : r + (2 ^ k - 1) + 1 = 2 ^ k + r := by omega
  rw [hM]
  have hc := clog_two_pow_add_le hr
  have hw : (Nat.clog 2 (r + (2 ^ k - 1)) + 1) ^ 2 * (k + k + 1) ≤ 8 * (k + 1) ^ 3 := by
    have h2 : Nat.clog 2 (r + (2 ^ k - 1)) + 1 ≤ 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
    have hsq : (Nat.clog 2 (r + (2 ^ k - 1)) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * (k + 1)) ^ 2 :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_left h2 2
    have hlin : k + k + 1 ≤ 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul hsq hlin
    nlinarith
  have hl : 48 * (2 ^ k + r) * (Nat.clog 2 (r + (2 ^ k - 1)) + 1) ^ 2 * (k + k + 1) ≤
      384 * (k + 1) ^ 3 * (2 ^ k + r) := by
    calc 48 * (2 ^ k + r) * (Nat.clog 2 (r + (2 ^ k - 1)) + 1) ^ 2 * (k + k + 1)
        = 48 * (2 ^ k + r) * ((Nat.clog 2 (r + (2 ^ k - 1)) + 1) ^ 2 * (k + k + 1)) := by ring
      _ ≤ 48 * (2 ^ k + r) * (8 * (k + 1) ^ 3) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hw
      _ = 384 * (k + 1) ^ 3 * (2 ^ k + r) := by ring
  have hk : k + 1 ≤ (k + 1) ^ 3 := by
    simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 1 ≤ k + 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ 3 by omega)
  have hr' := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (100 * r) hk
  nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (2 ^ k * (k + 1) ^ 3), Nat.zero_le (r * (k + 1) ^ 3)]

theorem synthesis_encode (s : Set (BitString a → Bool)) (x : BitString a → BitVec n)

    Synthesis Boolean.interpretation s (wires fun z => chart.encode (x z))
      (R * (220 * (n + 3))) := by
  let wide := fun z => (x z).setWidth (chartWidth n)
  have hw := wordWires_setWidth_subset (v := chartWidth n) (s := s) (value := x) hx (hc false)
  have hrow (j : Fin R) : Synthesis Boolean.interpretation s
      ({fun z => chart.contains j (x z)} ∪ wires (fun z => chart.encodedRow j (x z)))
      (200 * (n + 3)) := by
    have hlo := Synthesis.word_ult (s := s) wide
      (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat (chartWidth n) (chart.start j))
      (fun i => hw ⟨i, rfl⟩) (fun _ => hc _)
    have hhi := Synthesis.word_ult (s := s) wide
      (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat (chartWidth n) (chart.stop j))
      (fun i => hw ⟨i, rfl⟩) (fun _ => hc _)
    have hflag := hlo.not.and hhi
    have hoff := Synthesis.word_sub (s := s) wide
      (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat (chartWidth n) (chart.start j)) (fun i => hw ⟨i, rfl⟩) (fun _ => hc _)
    let s1 := s ∪ wordWires (fun z => chart.offset j (x z))
    have hmod := synthesis_addResidue s1
      (fun _ => chart.period j) (fun _ => chart.initialPhase j) (fun z => chart.offset j (x z))
      (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact Or.inl (hc _))
      (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact Or.inl (hc _)) (fun _ h => Or.inr h)
    let phase := fun z => addResidue (chart.period j) (chart.initialPhase j)
      (chart.offset j (x z))
    have hout := labelBits_wires_subset (n := n) (s1 ∪ wordWires phase)
      (fun _ i => (canonicalCycle f (chart.first j)).getLsbD i.val) (fun _ => chart.period j) phase
      (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact Or.inl (Or.inl (hc _)))
      (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact Or.inl (Or.inl (hc _))) (fun _ h => Or.inr h)

  have h := synthesis_flaggedRecords s (fun j z => chart.contains j (x z))

theorem synthesis_decode (s : Set (BitString a → Bool))
    (rep : BitString a → BitVec n) (p : BitString a → BitVec (chartWidth n))
    (hr : wordWires rep ⊆ s) (hp : wordWires p ⊆ s)
    (hc : ∀ b : Bool, (fun _ : BitString a => b) ∈ s) :
    Synthesis Boolean.interpretation s (wires fun z => chart.decode (rep z) (p z))
      (R * (150 * (n + 3))) := by
  have hrow (j : Fin R) : Synthesis Boolean.interpretation s
      ({fun z => chart.decodeFlag j (rep z) (p z)} ∪
        wordWires (fun z => chart.decodedRow j (p z))) (140 * (n + 3)) := by
    let dist := fun z => chart.phaseDistance j (p z)
    have hd := synthesis_addResidue s (fun _ => chart.period j) p
      (fun _ => chart.negativePhase j) (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hc _) hp
      (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hc _)
    let src := s ∪ wordWires dist
    have hrep := Synthesis.word_eq_const (s := src) rep
      (fun i => Or.inl (hr ⟨i, rfl⟩)) (canonicalCycle f (chart.first j))
    have hlt := Synthesis.word_ult (s := src) dist (fun _ => chart.length j)
      (fun i => Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩) (fun _ => Or.inl (hc _))
    have hflag := hrep.and hlt
    have hn := wordWires_setWidth_subset (v := n) (s := src) (value := dist)
      (fun _ h => Or.inr h) (Or.inl (hc false))
    have hv := Synthesis.word_add (s := src) (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat n (chart.start j))
      (fun z => (dist z).setWidth n) (fun _ => Or.inl (hc _)) (fun i => hn ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    exact (hd.trans (hflag.union hv)).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl
      (by dsimp [chartWidth]; lia)
  have h := synthesis_flaggedRecords s (fun j z => chart.decodeFlag j (rep z) (p z))
    (fun j z i => (chart.decodedRow j (p z)).getLsbD i.val) (140 * (n + 3)) (hc false) hrow
  exact h.mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left R (by lia))

private theorem encodedRow_spec (hf : Function.Injective f) (j : Fin R) (x : BitVec n)
    (hx : chart.contains j x = true) : chart.encodedRow j x = wordCycleLabel f x := by
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := (chart.contains_iff j x).mp hx
  have hpath := chart.point_eq j x hlo hhi
  have hd : x.toNat - chart.start j < cycleLength f (chart.first j) :=
    (show x.toNat - chart.start j < chart.stop j - chart.start j by lia).trans_le
      (chart.length_le_period hf j)
  have hp : (addResidue (chart.period j) (chart.initialPhase j)
      (chart.offset j x)).toNat = phase f x := by
    rw [toNat_addResidue]
    · rw [initialPhase_toNat, period_toNat, chart.offset_toNat j x hlo, ← phase_iterate]
      exact congrArg (phase f) hpath
    · simpa using phase_lt f (chart.first j)
    · simpa only [period_toNat, chart.offset_toNat j x hlo] using hd
  have hc : canonicalCycle f (chart.first j) = canonicalCycle f x := by
    rw [← hpath, canonicalCycle_iterate]
    rfl
  have hl : cycleLength f (chart.first j) = cycleLength f x := by
    rw [← hpath, cycleLength_iterate]
    rfl
  have he : addResidue (chart.period j) (chart.initialPhase j)
      (chart.offset j x) = BitVec.ofNat (chartWidth n) (phase f x) := by
    apply BitVec.eq_of_toNat_eq
    rw [hp, chart_ofNat_toNat ((phase_lt f x).le.trans (cycleLength_le_words f x))]
  unfold encodedRow wordCycleLabel
  rw [he, hc]
  simp only [period, hl]

theorem advanceCycleLabel_spec (f : BitVec n → BitVec n) (x : BitVec n) (bits : Fin m → Bool) :
    advanceCycleLabel (wordCycleLabel f x) bits = wordCycleLabel f (f^[(word bits).toNat] x) := by
  let ell := BitVec.ofNat (chartWidth n) (cycleLength f x)
  let p := BitVec.ofNat (chartWidth n) (phase f x)
  have hel : ell.toNat = cycleLength f x := chart_ofNat_toNat (cycleLength_le_words f x)
  have hp : p.toNat = phase f x := chart_ofNat_toNat
    ((phase_lt f x).le.trans (cycleLength_le_words f x))
  have hpos : 0 < ell.toNat := by rw [hel]; exact cycleLength_pos f x
  have hwide : 2 * ell.toNat ≤ 2 ^ chartWidth n := by
    rw [hel]
    have := cycleLength_le_words f x
    simp only [chartWidth, Nat.pow_succ]
    lia
  have hrem := toNat_streamRemainder ell bits hpos hwide
  have hphase : addResidue ell p (streamRemainder ell bits) =
      BitVec.ofNat (chartWidth n) (phase f (f^[(word bits).toNat] x)) := by
    apply BitVec.eq_of_toNat_eq
    rw [toNat_addResidue _ _ _ (by rw [hp, hel]; exact phase_lt f x)
      (by rw [hrem]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ hpos), hrem, hp, hel]
    rw [chart_ofNat_toNat ((phase_lt f _).le.trans (cycleLength_le_words f _)),
      phase_iterate, Nat.add_mod_mod]
  simp only [advanceCycleLabel, wordCycleLabel, labelRepresentative_labelBits,
    labelLength_labelBits, labelPhase_labelBits, canonicalCycle_iterate, cycleLength_iterate]
  exact congrArg (labelBits (fun i => (canonicalCycle f x).getLsbD i.val) ell) hphase

theorem synthesis_advanceCycleLabel (s : Set (BitString a → Bool))
    (r : BitString a → BitString (n + (chartWidth n + chartWidth n)))
    (bits : BitString a → Fin m → Bool) (hr : wires r ⊆ s)
    (hb : ∀ j, (fun z => bits z j) ∈ s) (hz : (fun _ => false) ∈ s) :
    Synthesis Boolean.interpretation s (wires fun z => advanceCycleLabel (r z) (bits z))
      (200 * (n + 3) * (m + 1)) := by
  let ell := fun z => labelLength (r z)
  let p := fun z => labelPhase (r z)
  let rem := fun z => streamRemainder (ell z) (bits z)
  have he : wordWires ell ⊆ s := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simpa only [ell, labelLength, getLsbD_word] using hr ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hp : wordWires p ⊆ s := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simpa only [p, labelPhase, getLsbD_word] using hr ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hrem := synthesis_streamRemainder s ell bits (fun i => he ⟨i, rfl⟩) hb hz
  let src := s ∪ wordWires rem
  have hadd := synthesis_addResidue src ell p rem
    (fun _ h => Or.inl (he h)) (fun _ h => Or.inl (hp h)) (fun _ h => Or.inr h)
  let newPhase := fun z => addResidue (ell z) (p z) (rem z)
  have hout := labelBits_wires_subset (src ∪ wordWires newPhase)
    (fun z => labelRepresentative (r z)) ell newPhase
    (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact Or.inl (Or.inl (hr ⟨_, rfl⟩)))
    (fun _ h => Or.inl (Or.inl (he h))) (fun _ h => Or.inr h)
  exact (hrem.trans (hadd.trans (Synthesis.of_subset hout))).mono

private theorem synthesis_repeatedValue (s : Set (BooleanFunction n))
    (f : BitString n → BitString n)
    (T K : ℕ) (lo hi : BitString n → BitVec w)
    (hlo : ∀ i : Fin w, (fun x => (lo x).getLsbD i.val) ∈ s)
    (hhi : ∀ i : Fin w, (fun x => (hi x).getLsbD i.val) ∈ s)
    (hp : prefixWires f K ⊆ s) (hc : ∀ b : Bool, (fun _ : BitString n => b) ∈ s) :
    Synthesis interpretation s (wires fun x => repeatedValue f T K x (lo x) (hi x))
      (200 * (K + 1) * (n + w + 1) ^ 2) := by
  have hidx := synthesis_repeatWordIndex s T K lo hi hlo hhi hc
  have hsel := Synthesis.selectBits
    (s := s ∪ wordWires fun x => repeatWordIndex T K (lo x) (hi x))
    (fun x => repeatWordIndex T K (lo x) (hi x)) (fun j : Fin (K + 1) => fun x => f^[j.val] x)
    (fun i => Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    fun j bit => Or.inl (hp (prefix_mem f (by have := j.isLt; omega) bit))
  apply (hidx.trans hsel).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl

theorem synthesis_hitValue {a : ℕ} (s : Set (BooleanFunction a))
    (c : Circuit signature n n) (K : ℕ) (index : BitString a → BitVec w)
    (payload : BitString a → BitString n)
    (hi : ∀ i : Fin w, (fun x => (index x).getLsbD i.val) ∈ s)
    (hp : wires payload ⊆ s) (hc : ∀ b : Bool, (fun _ : BitString a => b) ∈ s) :
    Synthesis interpretation s
      (wires fun x => hitValue (c.eval interpretation) K (index x) (payload x))
      (K * c.size + 200 * (K + 1) * (n + w + 1) ^ 2) := by
  let idx := fun x => BitVec.ofNat w K - index x
  let trace := Synthesis.stages
    (fun j => wires fun x => (c.eval interpretation)^[j] (payload x)) K
  have horbit : Synthesis interpretation s trace (K * c.size) :=
    Synthesis.orbit c payload (fun i => hp ⟨i, rfl⟩) K
  have hidx := Synthesis.word_sub (s := s) (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat w K) index (fun _ => hc _) hi
  have hsel := Synthesis.selectBits (s := s ∪ (trace ∪ wordWires idx)) idx
    (fun j : Fin (K + 1) => fun x => (c.eval interpretation)^[j.val] (payload x))
    (fun i => Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩))
    fun j bit => Or.inr (Or.inl (Synthesis.subset_stages _ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ j.isLt) ⟨bit, rfl⟩))
  apply ((horbit.union hidx).trans hsel).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl
  nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (K * n ^ 2), Nat.zero_le (K * n * w), Nat.zero_le (K * w ^ 2)]

theorem depth_from_checkpoints (c : Circuit signature n n) (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) (cp : Fin M → BitString n) (hcp : Function.Injective cp)
    (hcover : ∀ x, Repeats (c.eval interpretation) x L ∨
      ∃ t < 2 * L, ∃ j, (c.eval interpretation)^[t] x = cp j) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature n (n + 2),
      (∀ x, word (out.eval interpretation x) =
        BitVec.ofNat (n + 2) (transientDepth (c.eval interpretation) x)) ∧
      out.size ≤ depthCost n c.size M L := by
  let f := c.eval interpretation
  let K := 2 * L
  let W := n + 2
  let constants : Set (BooleanFunction n) := {fun _ => false, fun _ => true}
  have hconst : Synthesis interpretation (inputs n) constants 2 :=
    (Synthesis.const false).union (Synthesis.const true)
  let s0 := inputs n ∪ constants
  have hc (b : Bool) : (fun _ : BitString n => b) ∈ s0 := by cases b <;> simp [s0, constants]
  obtain ⟨project, hp, hps⟩ := fixed_power n c (Fintype.card (BitString n)).factorial L hL hLN
  have hproject : Synthesis interpretation s0 (wires (cycleProjection f)) project.size := by
    refine (Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := s0) project (fun i x => x i)
      fun bit => Or.inl ⟨bit, rfl⟩).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ le_rfl
    rintro _ ⟨bit, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨bit, funext fun x => by
      change project.eval interpretation x bit = _
      rw [hp x]
      rfl⟩
  let s1 := s0 ∪ wires (cycleProjection f)
  have hx := Synthesis.orbit (I := interpretation) (s := s1) c id
    (fun bit => Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨bit, rfl⟩)) K
  have hz := Synthesis.orbit (I := interpretation) (s := s1) c (cycleProjection f)
    (fun bit => Or.inr ⟨bit, rfl⟩) K
  let s2 := s1 ∪ (Synthesis.stages (fun j => wires fun x => f^[j] x) K ∪
    Synthesis.stages (fun j => wires fun x => f^[j] (cycleProjection f x)) K)
  have htrace (j : Fin (K + 1)) : wires (fun x => f^[j.val] x) ⊆ s2 := fun _ h =>
    Or.inr (Or.inl (Synthesis.subset_stages _ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ j.isLt) h))
  have hprojected (j : Fin (K + 1)) : wires (fun x => f^[j.val] (cycleProjection f x)) ⊆ s2 :=
    fun _ h => Or.inr (Or.inr (Synthesis.subset_stages _ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ j.isLt) h))
  let depthBits := fun y : BitString n => fun bit : Fin W =>
    (BitVec.ofNat W (transientDepth f y)).getLsbD bit.val
  let stored : Fin M → BitString (W + 1) := fun i => Fin.cons true (depthBits (cp i))
  let queries : BitString n → Fin (K + 1) → BitString n := fun x j => f^[j.val] x
  have hdict := synthesis_lookupOr s2 cp stored queries fun j bit => htrace j ⟨bit, rfl⟩
  let result := fun x (j : Fin (K + 1)) => lookupOr cp stored (queries x j)
  let equal := fun x (j : Fin (K + 1)) => decide (f^[j.val] x = f^[j.val] (cycleProjection f x))
  have heq := Synthesis.family (I := interpretation) (s := s2) (fun j x => equal x j)
    (fun _ => 6 * n + 1) fun j =>
      synthesis_bits_eq s2 (fun x => f^[j.val] x) _ (htrace j) (hprojected j)
  let s3 := s2 ∪ ((⋃ j, wires fun x => result x j) ∪ Set.range fun j x => equal x j)
  have hresult (j : Fin (K + 1)) (bit : Fin (W + 1)) : (fun x => result x j bit) ∈ s3 :=
    Or.inr (Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, bit, rfl⟩))
  have hequal (j : Fin (K + 1)) : (fun x => equal x j) ∈ s3 := Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨j, rfl⟩)
  have hc3 (b : Bool) : (fun _ : BitString n => b) ∈ s3 := Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (hc b)))
  let flags := fun x (j : Fin (K + 1)) => result x j 0
  let corrected := fun (j : Fin (K + 1)) x =>
    word (fun bit : Fin W => result x j bit.succ) + BitVec.ofNat W j.val
  have hcorrect := Synthesis.iUnion (fun j => wordWires (corrected j)) (fun _ => 12 * W + 1)
    fun j => Synthesis.word_add (s := s3) (fun x => word fun bit : Fin W => result x j bit.succ)
      (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat W j.val)
      (fun bit => by simpa only [getLsbD_word] using hresult j bit.succ) fun _ => hc3 _
  let s4 := s3 ∪ ⋃ j, wordWires (corrected j)
  let selected := fun x => word (chooseRecord (flags x)
    (fun j (bit : Fin W) => (corrected j x).getLsbD bit.val) (fun _ => false) (K + 1))
  have hselected : Synthesis interpretation s4 (wordWires selected) ((K + 1) * (4 * W)) := by
    simpa only [selected, wordWires, getLsbD_word] using synthesis_chooseRecord s4 flags
      (fun x j bit => (corrected j x).getLsbD bit.val) (fun _ _ => false)
      (fun j => Or.inl (hresult j 0)) (fun j bit => Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, bit, rfl⟩))
      fun _ => Or.inl (hc3 false)
  have hshort := synthesis_firstIndex (w := W) s4 equal (fun j => Or.inl (hequal j))
    fun b => Or.inl (hc3 b)
  let s5 := s4 ∪ (wordWires selected ∪ wordWires fun x => firstIndex (w := W) (equal x))
  let last : Fin (K + 1) := ⟨K, Nat.lt_succ_self K⟩
  have hfinal := Synthesis.word_mux (s := s5) (fun x => firstIndex (w := W) (equal x)) selected
    (fun x => equal x last) (Or.inl (Or.inl (hequal last)))
    (fun bit => Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨bit, rfl⟩)) fun bit => Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨bit, rfl⟩)
  have h := hconst.trans (hproject.trans ((hx.union hz).trans ((hdict.union heq).trans
    (hcorrect.trans ((hselected.union hshort).trans hfinal)))))
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hs⟩ := h.exists_circuit_outputs
  refine ⟨out, fun x => ?_, hs.trans ?_⟩
  · rw [ho x, word_getLsbD]
    by_cases hK : transientDepth f x ≤ K
    · have he : equal x last = true := decide_eq_true ((iterate_eq_projection_iff f x K).mpr hK)
      simp only [he, ite_true]
      exact shortDepth_eq f K x hK
    · have he : equal x last = false :=
        decide_eq_false fun hh => hK ((iterate_eq_projection_iff f x K).mp hh)
      simp only [he, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
      have hex : ∃ j : Fin (K + 1), j.val < K + 1 ∧ flags x j = true := by
        rcases hcover x with ⟨i, j, hij, hj, hrep⟩ | ⟨t, ht, i, hi⟩
        · have := transientDepth_add_cycleLength_le_of_iterate_eq f x hij hrep
          omega
        · refine ⟨⟨t, by omega⟩, by simp only; omega, ?_⟩
          exact decide_eq_true ⟨i, hi.symm, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨j, -, hj, hchosen⟩ := chooseRecord_spec (flags x)
        (fun j (bit : Fin W) => (corrected j x).getLsbD bit.val) (fun _ => false) (K + 1) hex
      change word (chooseRecord _ _ _ _) = _
      rw [hchosen, word_getLsbD]
      obtain ⟨i, hi, -⟩ := (decide_eq_true_iff.mp hj : ∃ i, cp i = _ ∧ stored i 0 = true)
      have hrecord : (word fun bit : Fin W => result x j bit.succ) =
          BitVec.ofNat W (transientDepth f (f^[j.val] x)) := by
        rw [← word_getLsbD (BitVec.ofNat W _)]
        congr 1
        funext bit
        change lookupOr cp stored _ bit.succ = _
        rw [lookupOr_of_eq stored hcp hi]
        simp only [stored, depthBits, Fin.cons_succ, hi]
        rfl
      have hjμ : j.val ≤ transientDepth f x := by have := j.isLt; omega
      change word (fun bit : Fin W => result x j bit.succ) + BitVec.ofNat W j.val = _
      rw [hrecord, transientDepth_iterate, ← BitVec.ofNat_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hjμ]
  · simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul] at hs ⊢
    have hps' : project.size ≤ 40000 * powerBudget n c.size (2 ^ n) L := by simpa using hps
    unfold depthCost
    simp only [K, W] at hs ⊢
    nlinarith

private theorem depthCost_le (n s M L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) (hM : M ≤ 2 ^ n / L) :
    depthCost n s M L ≤ 50000 * powerBudget n s (2 ^ n) L := by
  unfold depthCost powerBudget
  set N := 2 ^ n with hNdef
  set d := Nat.clog 2 ((2 * L + 1) + M)
  set P := (n + 1) ^ 3
  have hN : 1 ≤ N := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have hMN : M ≤ N := hM.trans (Nat.div_le_self _ _)
  have hd : d ≤ n + 2 := by
    apply Nat.clog_le_of_le_pow
    have h4 : 2 ^ (n + 2) = 4 * N := by rw [hNdef, pow_add]; ring
    omega
  have hn1 : n + 1 ≤ P := by
    simpa only [pow_one] using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 0 < n + 1 by omega) (by decide : 1 ≤ 3)
  have hdict : 48 * ((2 * L + 1) + M + 1) * (d + 1) ^ 2 * (n + (n + 3) + 1) ≤
      6912 * P * (L + N / L + 1) := by
    have h1 : (d + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 9 * (n + 1) ^ 2 := by
      have := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (show d + 1 ≤ 3 * (n + 1) by omega) 2
      nlinarith
    calc 48 * ((2 * L + 1) + M + 1) * (d + 1) ^ 2 * (n + (n + 3) + 1)
        ≤ 48 * (4 * (L + N / L + 1)) * (9 * (n + 1) ^ 2) * (4 * (n + 1)) := by
          gcongr <;> omega
      _ = 6912 * P * (L + N / L + 1) := by simp only [P]; ring
  have hscan : (2 * L + 1) * (26 * n + 42) + 4 * (n + 2) + 2 ≤ 200 * (P * (L + N / L + 1)) := by
    have e1 : (2 * L + 1) * (26 * n + 42) ≤ 3 * L * (42 * P) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
    have hLP : L * P ≤ P * (L + N / L + 1) := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (L * s)]

theorem checkpoint_depth_circuit (c : Circuit signature n n) (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature n (n + 2),
      (∀ x, word (out.eval interpretation x) =
        BitVec.ofNat (n + 2) (transientDepth (c.eval interpretation) x)) ∧
      out.size ≤ 50000 * powerBudget n c.size (2 ^ n) L := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨H, hcard, hcover⟩ := exists_checkpoints_finite (c.eval interpretation) hL
  let cp : Fin H.card → BitString n := fun j => (H.equivFin.symm j).val
  have hcp : Function.Injective cp := fun _ _ h => H.equivFin.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)
  have hcov (x : BitString n) : Repeats (c.eval interpretation) x L ∨
      ∃ t < 2 * L, ∃ j, (c.eval interpretation)^[t] x = cp j := by
    rcases hcover x with hr | ⟨t, ht, hm⟩
    · exact Or.inl hr
    · exact Or.inr ⟨t, ht, H.equivFin ⟨_, hm⟩, by simp [cp]⟩
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hs⟩ := depth_from_checkpoints c L hL hLN cp hcp hcov
  exact ⟨out, ho, hs.trans (depthCost_le _ _ _ _ hL hLN (by simpa using hcard))⟩

theorem synthesis_threshold {a : ℕ} (s : Set (BooleanFunction a)) (μ : BitString a → ℕ)
    (n C : ℕ) (hμ : ∀ x, μ x < 2 ^ n) (hc : ∀ b : Bool, (fun _ : BitString a => b) ∈ s)
    (query : ∀ src : Set (BooleanFunction a), s ⊆ src →
      ∀ value : BitString a → BitVec (n + 2), wordWires value ⊆ src →
        Synthesis interpretation src {fun x => decide (μ x ≤ (value x).toNat)} C) :
    Synthesis interpretation s (wordWires fun x => BitVec.ofNat (n + 2) (μ x))
      ((n + 1) * (C + 16 * (n + 3))) := by
  have hbig (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ n) : 2 ^ j < 2 ^ (n + 2) :=
    Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
  let value := fun j x => BitVec.ofNat (n + 2) (searchBelow n (μ x) j)
  let q := fun j => wordWires (value j)

theorem depth_circuit (c : Circuit signature n n) (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature n (n + 2),
      (∀ x, word (out.eval interpretation x) =
        BitVec.ofNat (n + 2) (transientDepth (c.eval interpretation) x)) ∧
      out.size ≤ depthBudget n c.size L := by
  let f := c.eval interpretation
  obtain ⟨cyclic, hcyc, hcs⟩ := periodicPts_circuit c L hL hLN
  let constants : Set (BooleanFunction n) := {fun _ => false, fun _ => true}
  have hconst : Synthesis interpretation (inputs n) constants 2 :=
    (Synthesis.const false).union (Synthesis.const true)
  let s0 := inputs n ∪ constants
  have hc (b : Bool) : (fun _ : BitString n => b) ∈ s0 := by cases b <;> simp [s0, constants]
  let C := (n + 2) * (40000 * powerBudget n c.size (2 ^ n) L + 4 * n) + cyclic.size
  have query (src : Set (BooleanFunction n)) (hs : s0 ⊆ src)
      (value : BitString n → BitVec (n + 2)) (hv : wordWires value ⊆ src) :
      Synthesis interpretation src {fun x => decide (transientDepth f x ≤ (value x).toNat)} C := by
    have hi := synthesis_binary_powering (m := n + 2) f _
      (fun j _ => fixed_power n c (2 ^ j) L hL hLN) src id (fun x i => (value x).getLsbD i.val)
      (fun _ h => hs (Or.inl (by obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := h; exact ⟨i, rfl⟩)))
      (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hv ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    simp only [word_getLsbD, id] at hi
    let current := fun x => f^[(value x).toNat] x
    have hq := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := src ∪ wires current) cyclic
      (fun i x => current x i) fun bit => Or.inr ⟨bit, rfl⟩
    refine (hi.trans hq).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ le_rfl
    rintro _ rfl
    refine ⟨0, funext fun x => Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    change cyclic.eval interpretation (current x) 0 = true ↔ _
    rw [hcyc, iterate_mem_periodicPts_iff, decide_eq_true_iff]
  have h := hconst.trans (synthesis_threshold s0 (transientDepth f) n C
    (fun x => by simpa using transientDepth_lt_card f x) hc query)
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hs⟩ := h.exists_circuit_outputs
  refine ⟨out, fun x => by rw [hout x, word_getLsbD], hs.trans ?_⟩
  have hC : C + 16 * (n + 3) ≤ (n + 2) * (40000 * powerBudget n c.size (2 ^ n) L + 4 * n) +
      (40000 * powerBudget n c.size (2 ^ n) L + (6 * n + 1)) + 16 * (n + 3) := by
    simp only [C]
    omega
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (n + 1) hC
  unfold depthBudget
  omega

theorem fixed_power_image (c burn : Circuit signature n n) (d T L : ℕ)
    (hburn : burn.Computes interpretation (c.eval interpretation)^[d])
    (hdT : d ≤ T) (hL : 0 < L) (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature n n,
      out.Computes interpretation (c.eval interpretation)^[T] ∧
      out.size ≤ burn.size + 40000 * powerBudget n c.size
        (Finset.univ.image (c.eval interpretation)^[d]).card L := by

  have hS : ∀ y ∈ S, f y ∈ S := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨f x, Finset.mem_univ _, by
      rw [← Function.iterate_succ_apply, Function.iterate_succ_apply']⟩
  obtain ⟨tail, htail, hsize⟩ := fixed_power_on n c S (T - d) L hS hL hLN
  refine ⟨tail.comp burn, fun x => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Circuit.eval_comp, hburn x,
      htail (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)),
      ← Function.iterate_add_apply, Nat.sub_add_cancel hdT]
  · rw [Circuit.size_comp]
    exact Nat.add_le_add_left hsize burn.size

theorem synchronous_coalescence (c : Circuit signature n n) (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature (n + n) 1,
      (∀ z, out.eval interpretation z 0 = true ↔
        ∃ t, (c.eval interpretation)^[t] (fun i => z (Fin.castAdd n i)) =
          (c.eval interpretation)^[t] (fun i => z (Fin.natAdd n i))) ∧
      out.size ≤ 80000 * powerBudget n c.size (2 ^ n) L + 6 * n + 1 := by
  let f := c.eval interpretation
  obtain ⟨power, hp, hs⟩ := fixed_power n c (Fintype.card (BitString n)) L hL hLN
  let left := fun z : BitString (n + n) => fun i : Fin n => z (Fin.castAdd n i)
  let right := fun z : BitString (n + n) => fun i : Fin n => z (Fin.natAdd n i)
  have ha := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := inputs (n + n)) power
    (fun i z => left z i) fun i => ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hb := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := inputs (n + n)) power
    (fun i z => right z i) fun i => ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have heq := synthesis_bits_eq (inputs (n + n) ∪ (wires (fun z => power.eval interpretation
      (left z)) ∪ wires fun z => power.eval interpretation (right z)))
    (fun z => power.eval interpretation (left z)) (fun z => power.eval interpretation (right z))
    (fun _ h => Or.inr (Or.inl h)) fun _ h => Or.inr (Or.inr h)

    _
  rw [decide_eq_true_iff, hp, hp]

theorem exists_forest_circuit_tables (f : BitString n → BitString n) (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    Nonempty (ForestCircuitTables f L) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨H, hHcard, hcover⟩ := exists_checkpoints_finite f hL
  have hHcard' : H.card ≤ 2 ^ n / L := by simpa using hHcard
  obtain ⟨low, high, hinterval⟩ := exists_forest_intervals f
  obtain ⟨edgeTable⟩ := exists_forest_edge_table f H L hL hcover
  let M := forestMarks f H
  let marks : Fin M.card → BitString n := fun j => (M.equivFin.symm j).val
  have hmarks_inj : Function.Injective marks := by
    intro i j hij
    exact M.equivFin.symm.injective (Subtype.ext hij)
  have hmarks_mem (x : BitString n) : x ∈ forestMarks f H ↔ ∃ i, marks i = x := by
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨M.equivFin ⟨x, hx⟩, by simp [marks]⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact (M.equivFin.symm i).property
  have hMcard : M.card ≤ 2 * (2 ^ n / L) :=
    (forestMarks_card f H).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hHcard')
  exact ⟨⟨H, hcover, low, high, hinterval, M.card, marks, hmarks_inj, hmarks_mem, hMcard,
    edgeTable, edgeTable.card_le.trans hMcard⟩⟩

        fun j => Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr fun hj => hex ⟨j, hj⟩

      have hanyF : anyElig z = false :=
        decide_eq_false fun ⟨j, hj⟩ => by rw [hnone j] at hj; cases hj
      have hyTrue : yMarkFlag z = true := by
        simpa [foundA, hanyF] using hf

      have hymem : inputRight z ∈ forestMarks f tables.H := (tables.marks_mem _).mpr ⟨i, hi⟩
      have hstate : anchorState z = inputRight z := by
        funext b
        have hc := congrFun hch (Fin.castAdd (n + 1 + (n + 1)) b)

      have hlabels : anchorLabels z =

        funext b
        have hc := congrFun hch (Fin.natAdd n b)
        have hyr := (hyDict z).2 i hi
        simpa [anchorLabels, chosenPair, baseRec, hyr, hi] using hc
      exact ⟨Or.inl ⟨hymem, hstate⟩, hlabels.trans (by rw [hstate])⟩

    rw [tables.edgeTable.anchor_iff] at hb
    rcases hb with ⟨hymem, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, k, rfl, hk, hdepth, hkey⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (tables.marks_mem _).mp hymem
      have hyTrue : yMarkFlag z = true := (hyDict z).1.mpr ⟨i, hi⟩
      simp [foundA, hyTrue]
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hQcomplete k hk

theorem synthesis_shortLabel (s : Set (BooleanFunction a)) (f : BitString n → BitString n)
    (init : BitString a → BitString n) (K : ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ j : Fin (K + 1), ∀ bit, (fun x => f^[j.val] (init x) bit) ∈ s)
    (hc : ∀ b : Bool, (fun _ : BitString a => b) ∈ s) :
    Synthesis interpretation s (wires fun x => shortLabel f K (init x))
      ((K + 1) * (30 * n + 27) + 50 * (n + 4) ^ 2) := by
  let rep := fun x => shortRepresentative f K (init x)
  have hm : Synthesis interpretation s (wires rep) ((K + 1) * (10 * n + 1)) :=
    synthesis_scanMin s (fun x j => f^[j.val] (init x)) init (fun j bit => hp j bit) (hp 0)
  let src := s ∪ wires rep
  have hprefix (j : Fin (K + 1)) : wires (fun x => f^[j.val] (init x)) ⊆ src := by
    rintro _ ⟨bit, rfl⟩
    exact Or.inl (hp j bit)
  let back := fun x (j : Fin (K + 1)) => decide (0 < j.val ∧ f^[j.val] (init x) = init x)
  have hback := Synthesis.family (I := interpretation) (s := src) (fun j x => back x j)
    (fun _ => 6 * n + 1) fun j => by
      by_cases hj : 0 < j.val
      · simpa only [back, hj, true_and] using synthesis_bits_eq src (fun x => f^[j.val] (init x))
          init (hprefix j) (hprefix 0)
      · simpa only [back, hj, false_and, decide_false] using
          (Synthesis.of_mem (s := src) (I := interpretation) (Or.inl (hc false))).mono
            Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl (Nat.zero_le _)
  have hl := synthesis_firstIndex (w := n + 3) (src ∪ Set.range fun j x => back x j) back
    (fun j => Or.inr ⟨j, rfl⟩) fun b => Or.inl (Or.inl (hc b))
  let hit := fun x (j : Fin (K + 1)) => decide (f^[j.val] (init x) = rep x)
  have hhit := Synthesis.family (I := interpretation) (s := src) (fun j x => hit x j)
    (fun _ => 6 * n + 1) fun j =>
      synthesis_bits_eq src (fun x => f^[j.val] (init x)) rep (hprefix j) fun _ h => Or.inr h
  have ht := synthesis_firstIndex (w := n + 3) (src ∪ Set.range fun j x => hit x j) hit
    (fun j => Or.inr ⟨j, rfl⟩) fun b => Or.inl (Or.inl (hc b))
  let ell := fun x => shortLength (w := n + 3) f K (init x)
  let time := fun x => shortTime (w := n + 3) f K (init x)
  have hscans := hm.comp ((hback.trans hl).union (hhit.trans ht))
  let src2 := s ∪ (wires rep ∪ (wordWires ell ∪ wordWires time))
  have hphase := synthesis_subMod src2 (fun _ => (0 : BitVec (n + 3))) time ell
    (fun i => by
      rw [show (fun _ : BitString a => (0 : BitVec (n + 3)).getLsbD i.val) = fun _ => false from
        funext fun _ => BitVec.getLsbD_zero]
      exact Or.inl (hc false))
    (fun i => Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)))
    (fun i => Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩))) (Or.inl (hc false))
  have hout := Synthesis.of_subset (I := interpretation)
    (labelBits_wires_subset (src2 ∪ wordWires fun x => subMod 0 (time x) (ell x)) rep ell
      (fun x => subMod 0 (time x) (ell x)) (fun _ h => Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl h)))
      (fun _ h => Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h)))) fun _ h => Or.inr h)
  refine (hscans.trans (hphase.trans hout)).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl ?_
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
  exact Nat.le_of_eq (by ring)
