theorem cyclic_labels_from_checkpoints (c : Circuit signature n n) (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) (cp : Fin M → BitString n) (hcp : Function.Injective cp)
    (hcover : ∀ x, Repeats (c.eval interpretation) x L ∨
      ∃ t < 2 * L, ∃ j, (c.eval interpretation)^[t] x = cp j) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature n (labelWidth n),
      (∀ x ∈ Function.periodicPts (c.eval interpretation),
        out.eval interpretation x = canonicalLabel (c.eval interpretation) x) ∧
      out.size ≤ labelCost n c.size M L := by
  let f := c.eval interpretation
  let K := 2 * L
  let W := labelWidth n
  let constants : Set (BooleanFunction n) := {fun _ => false, fun _ => true}
  have hconst : Synthesis interpretation (inputs n) constants 2 :=
    (Synthesis.const false).union (Synthesis.const true)
  let s0 := inputs n ∪ constants
  have hc (b : Bool) : (fun _ : BitString n => b) ∈ s0 := by cases b <;> simp [s0, constants]
  have horbit : Synthesis interpretation s0 (prefixWires f K) (K * c.size) :=
    Synthesis.orbit c id (fun bit => Or.inl ⟨bit, rfl⟩) K
  let s1 := s0 ∪ prefixWires f K
  have hp (j : Fin (K + 1)) (bit : Fin n) : (fun x => f^[j.val] x bit) ∈ s1 :=
    Or.inr (prefix_mem f (Nat.le_of_lt_succ j.isLt) bit)
  let stored : Fin M → BitString (W + 1) := fun i => Fin.cons true (canonicalLabel f (cp i))
  let queries : BitString n → Fin (K + 1) → BitString n := fun x j => f^[j.val] x
  have hdict := synthesis_lookupOr s1 cp stored queries fun j bit => hp j bit
  let result := fun x (j : Fin (K + 1)) => lookupOr cp stored (queries x j)
  let s2 := s1 ∪ ⋃ j, wires fun x => result x j
  have hresult (j : Fin (K + 1)) (bit : Fin (W + 1)) : (fun x => result x j bit) ∈ s2 :=
    Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, bit, rfl⟩)
  let flags := fun x (j : Fin (K + 1)) => result x j 0
  let records := fun x (j : Fin (K + 1)) (bit : Fin W) => result x j bit.succ
  let corrected := fun (j : Fin (K + 1)) x => correctLabel (records x j) j.val
  have hcorrect := Synthesis.iUnion (fun j => wires (corrected j)) (fun _ => 50 * (n + 4) ^ 2)
    fun j => synthesis_correctLabel s2 (fun x => records x j)
      (by rintro _ ⟨bit, rfl⟩; exact hresult j bit.succ) (fun b => Or.inl (Or.inl (hc b))) j.val
  have hshort := synthesis_shortLabel s2 f id K (fun j bit => Or.inl (hp j bit))
    fun b => Or.inl (Or.inl (hc b))
  let s3 := s2 ∪ ((⋃ j, wires (corrected j)) ∪ wires fun x => shortLabel f K x)
  have hselect := synthesis_chooseRecord s3 flags (fun x j => corrected j x)
    (fun x => shortLabel f K x) (fun j => Or.inl (hresult j 0))
    (fun j bit => Or.inr (Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, bit, rfl⟩)))
    fun bit => Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨bit, rfl⟩)
  have h := hconst.trans (horbit.trans (hdict.trans ((hcorrect.union hshort).trans hselect)))
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hs⟩ := h.exists_circuit_outputs
  refine ⟨out, fun x hx => ?_, hs.trans ?_⟩
  · rw [hout x]
    change chooseRecord (flags x) (fun j => corrected j x) (shortLabel f K x) (K + 1) =
      canonicalLabel f x
    by_cases hh : ∃ j, flags x j = true
    · obtain ⟨j, -, hj, he⟩ := chooseRecord_spec (flags x) (fun j => corrected j x)
        (shortLabel f K x) (K + 1) (by obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hh; exact ⟨j, j.isLt, hj⟩)
      rw [he]
      obtain ⟨i, hi, -⟩ := (decide_eq_true_iff.mp hj : ∃ i, cp i = _ ∧ stored i 0 = true)
      have hrecord : records x j = canonicalLabel f (f^[j.val] x) := by
        funext bit
        change lookupOr cp stored _ bit.succ = _
        rw [lookupOr_of_eq stored hcp hi]
        simp only [stored, Fin.cons_succ, hi]
        rfl
      change correctLabel (records x j) j.val = _
      rw [hrecord]
      apply correctLabel_canonicalLabel
      have := j.isLt
      have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := n)
      simp only [K, Nat.pow_succ] at *
      omega
    · have hnone : ∀ j, flags x j = false := fun j => Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr fun hj => hh ⟨j, hj⟩
      rw [chooseRecord_of_forall_eq_false _ _ _ hnone]
      apply shortLabel_eq_canonicalLabel f K hx
      rcases hcover x with ⟨i, j, hij, hj, he⟩ | ⟨t, ht, i, hi⟩
      · have := transientDepth_add_cycleLength_le_of_iterate_eq f x hij he
        omega
      · exfalso
        have hj := hnone ⟨t, by omega⟩
        simp only [flags, result, queries, lookupOr, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hj
        exact hj ⟨i, hi.symm, rfl⟩
  · simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
    unfold labelCost
    simp only [K, W, labelWidth] at hs ⊢
    omega

  set d := Nat.clog 2 ((2 * L + 1) + M)
  set P := (n + 1) ^ 3
  have hN : 1 ≤ N := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have hMN : M ≤ N := hM.trans (Nat.div_le_self _ _)
  have hd : d ≤ n + 2 := by
    apply Nat.clog_le_of_le_pow
    have h4 : 2 ^ (n + 2) = 4 * N := by rw [hNdef, pow_add]; ring
    omega
  have hP : 1 ≤ P := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have hn1 : n + 1 ≤ P := by
    simpa only [pow_one] using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 0 < n + 1 by omega) (by decide : 1 ≤ 3)
  have hn2 : (n + 1) ^ 2 ≤ P := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by decide)
  have hdict : 48 * ((2 * L + 1) + M + 1) * (d + 1) ^ 2 * (n + (labelWidth n + 1) + 1) ≤

    have h1 : (d + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 9 * (n + 1) ^ 2 := by
      have := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (show d + 1 ≤ 3 * (n + 1) by omega) 2
      nlinarith
    have h2 : n + (labelWidth n + 1) + 1 ≤ 8 * (n + 1) := by unfold labelWidth; omega
    have h3 : (2 * L + 1) + M + 1 ≤ 4 * (L + N / L + 1) := by omega
    calc 48 * ((2 * L + 1) + M + 1) * (d + 1) ^ 2 * (n + (labelWidth n + 1) + 1)
        ≤ 48 * (4 * (L + N / L + 1)) * (9 * (n + 1) ^ 2) * (8 * (n + 1)) := by gcongr
      _ = 13824 * P * (L + N / L + 1) := by simp only [P]; ring
  have hfour : (n + 4) ^ 2 ≤ 16 * (n + 1) ^ 2 := by
    have := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (show n + 4 ≤ 4 * (n + 1) by omega) 2
    nlinarith
  have hrest : (2 * L + 1) * (50 * (n + 4) ^ 2) + ((2 * L + 1) * (30 * n + 27) +

    have h3L : 2 * L + 1 ≤ 3 * L := by omega

    have hLP : L * P ≤ P * (L + N / L + 1) := by nlinarith
    nlinarith

    have hx := congrArg (fun f => (rightWord (f

      (hmod : ∀ a, 0 < a → a < 2 ^ k → S % a = T % a) : period k ∣ T - S := by
    change (Finset.Icc 1 (2 ^ k - 1)).lcm id ∣ T - S

    exact (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hST).mp hm

  · have hd := helper S.val T.val h hmod
    have hz := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt hd (by have := T.isLt; omega)
    omega
  · have hd := helper T.val S.val h (fun a ha hU => (hmod a ha hU).symm)
    have hz := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt hd (by have := S.isLt; omega)

theorem synthesis_stepValue {n : ℕ} (src : Set (BooleanFunction n))
    (a b : BitString n → BitVec k)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin k, (fun x => (a x).getLsbD i.val) ∈ src)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin k, (fun x => (b x).getLsbD i.val) ∈ src)
    (hc : ∀ v : Bool, (fun _ : BitString n => v) ∈ src) :
    Synthesis interpretation src (wordWires fun x => stepValue (a x) (b x))
      (50 * k + 18) := by
  let inc := fun x => b x + 1
  have hadd := Synthesis.word_add (s := src) b (fun _ => (1 : BitVec k)) hb (fun _ => hc _)
  let src1 := src ∪ wordWires inc
  have hi (i : Fin k) : (fun x => (inc x).getLsbD i.val) ∈ src1 := Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  let equal := fun x => decide (inc x = a x)
  let active := fun x => (b x).ult (a x)
  have heq := synthesis_word_eq src1 inc a hi (fun i => Or.inl (ha i))
  have hlt := Synthesis.word_ult (s := src1) b a (fun i => Or.inl (hb i)) (fun i => Or.inl (ha i))
  let src2 := src1 ∪ ({equal} ∪ {active})
  let next := fun x => if equal x then (0 : BitVec k) else inc x
  have hm := Synthesis.word_mux (s := src2) (fun _ => (0 : BitVec k)) inc equal
    (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)) (fun _ => Or.inl (Or.inl (hc _))) (fun i => Or.inl (hi i))
  let src3 := src2 ∪ wordWires next
  have hm' := Synthesis.word_mux (s := src3) next b active
    (Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))) (fun i => Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    (fun i => Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (hb i))))
  have hout := hadd.trans ((heq.union hlt).trans (hm.trans hm'))
  refine hout.mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ (by omega)
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  funext x
  simp only [stepValue, active, next, equal, inc, decide_eq_true_eq]

theorem addResidue_spec (a b r : BitVec k) (T : ℕ)
    (hr : 0 < a.toNat → r.toNat = T % a.toNat) :
    addResidue a b r = BitVec.ofNat k (advance a.toNat b.toNat T) := by

    apply BitVec.eq_of_toNat_eq

theorem remainder_of_power (T : ℕ) (c : Circuit signature (k + k) (k + k))
    (hc : c.Computes interpretation (power T)) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature k k,
      out.Computes interpretation (remainder T) ∧ out.size ≤ c.size + 1 := by
  let s := inputs k ∪ {fun _ : BitString k => false}
  let init := fun x : BitString k => pack (word x) (0 : BitVec k)
  have hi (i : Fin (k + k)) : (fun x => init x i) ∈ s := by
    induction i using Fin.addCases with
    | left i => simpa only [init, pack, Fin.append_left, getLsbD_word] using
        (show (fun x : BitString k => x i) ∈ s from Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    | right i =>
      right
      funext x
      simp only [init, pack, Fin.append_right]
      simp
  have h := (Synthesis.const (s := inputs k) false).trans
    (Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := s) c (fun i x => init x i) hi)
  have hout : wires (remainder (k := k) T) ⊆
      wires (fun x => c.eval interpretation (init x)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Fin.natAdd k i, ?_⟩
    funext x
    change c.eval interpretation (init x) (Fin.natAdd k i) = remainder T x i
    rw [hc (init x)]
    dsimp only [power, init]
    rw [leftWord_pack, rightWord_pack]
    rw [show (0 : BitVec k).toNat = 0 by simp]
    simp only [pack, Fin.append_right]
    by_cases hz : (word x).toNat = 0
    · simp only [advance, remainder, hz, lt_self_iff_false, and_self, ite_false, ite_true]
    · simp only [advance, remainder, hz, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz, and_self, ite_true, ite_false,
        Nat.zero_add]
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hs⟩ := (h.mono Set.Subset.rfl hout le_rfl).exists_circuit_outputs
  exact ⟨out, ho, by nlinarith⟩

  let b := fun x : BitString (k + k) => rightWord x

  have ha : wordWires a ⊆ s := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simpa only [a, leftWord, getLsbD_word] using
      (show (fun x : BitString (k + k) => x (Fin.castAdd k i)) ∈ s from Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  have hb : wordWires b ⊆ s := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩

    simpa only [s, wires, Set.union_assoc, Nat.zero_add] using
      (Synthesis.of_subset (I := interpretation)
        (s := inputs (k + k)) (t := inputs (k + k)) Set.Subset.rfl).union (hcirc.comp hs)

    | right i =>

      funext x

theorem exists_le_three_mul_add_sqrt (a b M N : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hba : b ≤ a)
    (hMN : M ≤ N) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∃ L : ℕ, 0 < L ∧ L ≤ N ∧
      (a * L + b * (M / L + 1) : ℕ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) * (a + Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) * M * a)) := by
  have ha : 0 < (a : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le hb hba
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ (b : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hba' : (b : ℝ) ≤ a := by exact_mod_cast hba
  let q : ℝ := (b : ℝ) * M
  let z : ℝ := Real.sqrt (q * a)
  have hz0 : 0 ≤ z := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hz2 : z ^ 2 = q * a := Real.sq_sqrt (by dsimp [q]; positivity)
  by_cases hsmall : q ≤ a
  · refine ⟨1, by omega, hN, ?_⟩
    simp only [Nat.mul_one, Nat.div_one, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_one]
    change (a : ℝ) + b * (M + 1) ≤ 3 * (a + z)
    dsimp [q] at hsmall
    nlinarith
  have hqa : (a : ℝ) ≤ q := (lt_of_not_ge hsmall).le
  have hza : (a : ℝ) ≤ z := by nlinarith
  have hzpos : 0 < z := lt_of_lt_of_le ha hza
  have hM : 0 < M := by
    by_contra h
    have : M = 0 := by omega
    simp only [q, this, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero] at hqa
    linarith
  have hM1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hzM : z ≤ (a : ℝ) * M := by
    have hq : q ≤ (a : ℝ) * M := by dsimp [q]; gcongr
    have hsq : q * a ≤ ((a : ℝ) * M) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha.le (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ M by positivity)]
  let L := Nat.ceil (z / a)
  have hL : 0 < L := Nat.one_le_ceil_iff.mpr (div_pos hzpos ha)
  have hLM : L ≤ M := Nat.ceil_le.mpr ((div_le_iff₀ ha).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hzM))
  have hlo : z ≤ (a : ℝ) * L := by
    have := (div_le_iff₀ ha).mp (Nat.le_ceil (z / a))
    nlinarith
  have hhi : (a : ℝ) * L ≤ z + a := by
    have := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (div_nonneg hz0 ha.le)
    have hh := (lt_div_iff₀ ha).mp (show (L : ℝ) < (z + a) / a by
      simpa only [add_div, div_self ha.ne'] using this)
    nlinarith
  have hquot : ((M / L : ℕ) : ℝ) * L ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast Nat.div_mul_le_self M L
  have hterm : (b : ℝ) * (M / L : ℕ) ≤ z := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hquot hb0
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlo (show 0 ≤ (b : ℝ) * (M / L : ℕ) by positivity)
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 ha.le
    dsimp [q] at hz2
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨L, hL, hLM.trans hMN, ?_⟩
  push_cast
  change (a : ℝ) * L + b * ((M / L : ℕ) + 1) ≤ 3 * (a + z)
  nlinarith

  have hlow : L ≤ 2 ^ ((n + 1) / 2) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
  have hupp : 2 ^ (n - n / 2) ≤ 2 ^ ((n + 1) / 2) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)

    nlinarith

theorem bounded_modulus_remainder (m k : ℕ) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature (m + k) k,
      (∀ x, 0 < (word fun i : Fin k => x (Fin.natAdd m i)).toNat →
        (word (out.eval interpretation x)).toNat =
          (word fun i : Fin m => x (Fin.castAdd k i)).toNat %
            (word fun i : Fin k => x (Fin.natAdd m i)).toNat) ∧
      out.size ≤ 1 + m * (22 * (k + 1) + 3) := by
  let d := fun x : BitString (m + k) => word fun i : Fin k => x (Fin.natAdd m i)
  let bits := fun x : BitString (m + k) => fun i : Fin m => x (Fin.castAdd k i)
  let wide := fun x => (d x).setWidth (k + 1)
  let src := inputs (m + k) ∪ {fun _ : BitString (m + k) => false}
  have hz : (fun _ : BitString (m + k) => false) ∈ src := Or.inr rfl
  have hd : wordWires d ⊆ src := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simpa only [d, getLsbD_word] using
      (show (fun x : BitString (m + k) => x (Fin.natAdd m i)) ∈ src from Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  have hw := wordWires_setWidth_subset (v := k + 1) hd hz
  have hs := synthesis_streamRemainder src wide bits (fun i => hw ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    (fun i => Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩) hz
  let result := fun x => streamRemainder (wide x) (bits x)
  have hout := wordWires_setWidth_subset (v := k) (s := src ∪ wordWires result)
    (fun _ h => Or.inr h) (Or.inl hz)
  have hc := (Synthesis.const (s := inputs (m + k)) false).trans
    (hs.trans (Synthesis.of_subset hout))
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hsize⟩ := hc.exists_circuit_outputs
  refine ⟨out, fun x hpos => ?_, by simpa using hsize⟩
  have hdn : (wide x).toNat = (d x).toNat := by
    simp only [wide, BitVec.toNat_setWidth]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ((d x).isLt.trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) k.le_succ))
  have hb : 2 * (wide x).toNat ≤ 2 ^ (k + 1) := by
    rw [hdn, pow_succ]
    have := (d x).isLt
    omega
  have hr := toNat_streamRemainder (wide x) (bits x) (by rwa [hdn]) hb
  rw [hdn] at hr
  have he : out.eval interpretation x = fun i : Fin k => (result x).getLsbD i.val := by
    rw [ho x]
    funext i
    simp only [BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, i.isLt, decide_true, Bool.true_and]
  have hk : (word fun i : Fin k => (result x).getLsbD i.val) = (result x).setWidth k := by
    apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
    intro i hi
    rw [getLsbD_word _ ⟨i, hi⟩, BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth]
    simp [hi]
  rw [he, hk, BitVec.toNat_setWidth, hr, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ((Nat.mod_lt _ hpos).trans (d x).isLt)]

theorem toNat_addResidue (d a b : BitVec k)
    (ha : a.toNat < d.toNat) (hb : b.toNat < d.toNat) :
    (addResidue d a b).toNat = (a.toNat + b.toNat) % d.toNat := by
  have hwide (v : BitVec k) : (v.setWidth (k + 1)).toNat = v.toNat := by
    rw [BitVec.toNat_setWidth, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
      (v.isLt.trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (Nat.le_succ k)))]
  have hfit : a.toNat + b.toNat < 2 ^ (k + 1) := by
    rw [pow_succ]
    have := d.isLt
    lia
  have hsum : (a.setWidth (k + 1) + b.setWidth (k + 1)).toNat = a.toNat + b.toNat := by
    rw [BitVec.toNat_add, hwide, hwide, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hfit]
  unfold addResidue
  simp only [BitVec.ult, ha, decide_true, ite_true, hsum, hwide, decide_eq_true_eq]
  split_ifs with hs
  · rw [BitVec.toNat_setWidth, hsum, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hs,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hs.trans d.isLt)]
  · have hle : d.setWidth (k + 1) ≤ a.setWidth (k + 1) + b.setWidth (k + 1) := by
      change (d.setWidth (k + 1)).toNat ≤ _
      rw [hwide, hsum]
      lia
    have hsmall : a.toNat + b.toNat - d.toNat < d.toNat := by lia
    rw [BitVec.toNat_setWidth, BitVec.toNat_sub_of_le hle, hsum, hwide,
      Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod (show d.toNat ≤ a.toNat + b.toNat by lia),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsmall, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hsmall.trans d.isLt)]

theorem adjacent_distinct_collision (input output : Fin R → α) (key : α → β)
    (hperm : (List.ofFn output).Perm (List.ofFn input)) (hs : Monotone (key ∘ output))
    (i j : Fin R) (hne : input i ≠ input j) (heq : key (input i) = key (input j)) :
    ∃ (p : ℕ) (hp : p + 1 < R),
      output ⟨p, by omega⟩ ≠ output ⟨p + 1, hp⟩ ∧
      key (output ⟨p, by omega⟩) = key (output ⟨p + 1, hp⟩) ∧
      key (output ⟨p, by omega⟩) = key (input i) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (hperm.exists_ofFn_iff (· = input i)).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (hperm.exists_ofFn_iff (· = input j)).mpr ⟨j, rfl⟩
  have hdiff : output a ≠ output b := by rwa [ha, hb]
  have hkeys : key (output a) = key (output b) := by rwa [ha, hb]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne fun h : a = b => hdiff (h ▸ rfl) with hlt | hlt
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hd, hk, hi⟩ := adjacent_distinct_of_equal_keys output key hs a b hlt hdiff hkeys
    exact ⟨p, hp, hd, hk, hi.trans (congrArg key ha)⟩
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hd, hk, hi⟩ :=
      adjacent_distinct_of_equal_keys output key hs b a hlt hdiff.symm hkeys.symm
    exact ⟨p, hp, hd, hk, hi.trans ((congrArg key hb).trans heq.symm)⟩

theorem exists_repeat_power (c : Circuit signature n n) (T L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) (hT : 2 * L ≤ T) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature n n,

        out.eval interpretation x = (c.eval interpretation)^[T] x) ∧

      Nat.le_pow_clog Nat.one_lt_two (2 * L + 1)
  have hd : d ≤ n + 2 := by
    apply Nat.clog_le_of_le_pow
    simp only [Nat.pow_succ]
    have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := n)
    omega
  have hpow : 2 ^ d ≤ 2 * (0 + 2 * L + 1) := by
    have hp := Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self Nat.one_lt_two (show 1 < 2 * L + 1 by omega)
    have hdpos : 0 < d := Nat.clog_pos (by decide) (by omega)
    rw [show 2 ^ d = 2 ^ (d - 1) * 2 by rw [← Nat.pow_succ, show (d - 1).succ = d by omega]]
    change 2 ^ (d - 1) < 2 * L + 1 at hp
    omega
  have hfit : 2 * L < 2 ^ (n + 2) := by
    simp only [Nat.pow_succ]
    omega
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hs⟩ := exists_fixedOutput (w := n + 2) c T (2 * L) d (Fin.elim0 :
    Fin 0 → BitString n)
  refine ⟨out, fun x hx => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hout]
    apply reconstruct_spec _ T (2 * L) _ x _ _ hfit hT
    apply Record.detect_sorted_witness _ T (2 * L) d _ x hcap hfit
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hj, he⟩ := hx
    exact Or.inr ⟨i, j, hij, by omega, he⟩
  · refine hs.trans ((construction_cost n c.size 0 L d hL hd hpow).trans ?_)
    simp only [powerBudget, Nat.zero_div, le_refl]

private theorem synthesis_thresholdSum (S : Finset ℕ) (coeff : ℕ → BitVec w) (base : BitVec w)
    (s : Set (BitString n → Bool)) (a : BitString n → BitVec w)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin w, (fun x => (a x).getLsbD i.val) ∈ s)
    (hc : ∀ b : Bool, (fun _ : BitString n => b) ∈ s) :
    Synthesis Boolean.interpretation s
      (wordWires fun x => thresholdSum S coeff base (a x)) (S.card * (21 * w + 3)) := by
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.zero_mul]
    apply Synthesis.of_subset
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simpa [thresholdSum] using hc (base.getLsbD i.val)
  | @insert j S hj ih =>
    let previous := fun x => thresholdSum S coeff base (a x)
    let src := s ∪ wordWires previous
    let flag := fun x => (BitVec.ofNat w j).ult (a x)
    have ht := Synthesis.word_ult (s := src) (fun _ => BitVec.ofNat w j) a
      (fun i => Or.inl (hc _)) (fun i => Or.inl (ha i))
    let src1 := src ∪ {flag}
    let term := fun x => if flag x then coeff j else 0
    have hm := Synthesis.word_mux (s := src1) (fun _ => coeff j) (fun _ => (0 : BitVec w)) flag
      (Or.inr rfl) (fun i => Or.inl (Or.inl (hc _))) (fun i => Or.inl (Or.inl (hc _)))
    let src2 := src1 ∪ wordWires term
    have hadd := Synthesis.word_add (s := src2) previous term
      (fun i => Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩))) (fun i => Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    have he (x : BitString n) :
        previous x + term x = thresholdSum (insert j S) coeff base (a x) := by
      simp only [previous, term, flag, thresholdSum, Finset.sum_insert hj]
      abel
    have h := ih.trans (ht.trans (hm.trans hadd))
    simp only [he] at h
    exact h.mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl
      (by rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hj]; lia)

theorem thresholdSum_displacement (h : BitVec n → BitVec n) (x : BitVec n) :
    thresholdSum (displacementCuts h)
      (fun i => displacement h (BitVec.ofNat n (i + 1)) -
        displacement h (BitVec.ofNat n i)) (displacement h 0) x = displacement h x := by

      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range x.toNat, (d (i + 1) - d i) := by

      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ n),
          if (BitVec.ofNat n i).ult x then d (i + 1) - d i else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
        intro i hi hn
        have he : d (i + 1) = d i := by
          simpa only [displacementCuts, Finset.mem_filter, hi, true_and, not_not, d] using hn
        simp [he]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range x.toNat, (d (i + 1) - d i) := by
        symm
        calc
          _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range x.toNat,
              if (BitVec.ofNat n i).ult x then d (i + 1) - d i else 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i hi
            have hil := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
            simp [BitVec.ult, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hil.trans x.isLt), hil]
          _ = _ := Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono x.isLt.le) (by
            intro i hi hn
            have hil := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
            have hn' : ¬ i < x.toNat := by simpa using hn
            simp [BitVec.ult, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hil, hn'])

  simp [d]

    exact cycleLabelVisits_flag f f.injective _ _

theorem sparse_coordinate_visit_schedule (f g e : Equiv.Perm (BitVec n))
    (hcycle : ∀ x, e (g x) = e x + 1)
    (encode : Circuit Boolean.signature n n)
    (he : encode.Computes Boolean.interpretation (fun x i => (e (word x)).getLsbD i.val)) :
    ∃ out : Circuit Boolean.signature (n + n) (visitScheduleWidth n),
      (∀ z t, (f : BitVec n → BitVec n)^[t] (word (inputLeft z)) = word (inputRight z) ↔
        visitScheduleContains (out.eval Boolean.interpretation z) t) ∧
      (∀ z T, Set.ncard {t : ℕ | t ≤ T ∧
        (f : BitVec n → BitVec n)^[t] (word (inputLeft z)) = word (inputRight z)} =
          visitScheduleCount (out.eval Boolean.interpretation z) T) ∧
      out.size ≤ 2 * encode.size + 1200 * (n + 3) * ((disagreement f g).card + 1) := by
  have hcounter : e ∘ g ∘ e.symm = fun x => x + 1 := by
    funext x
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hcycle, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hr := disagreement_conjugate_card (f : BitVec n → BitVec n)
    (g : BitVec n → BitVec n) e
  rw [hcounter] at hr
  let conjugate := e.permCongrHom f
  obtain ⟨middle, hm, _, hs⟩ := sparse_counter_visit_schedule conjugate
  change middle.size ≤ 1200 * (n + 3) *
    ((disagreement (e ∘ f ∘ e.symm) (fun x => x + 1)).card + 1) at hs
  rw [hr] at hs
  let x := fun z : BitString (n + n) => encode.eval Boolean.interpretation (inputLeft z)
  let y := fun z : BitString (n + n) => encode.eval Boolean.interpretation (inputRight z)
  have hx := Synthesis.circuit (I := Boolean.interpretation) (s := inputs (n + n))
    encode (fun i z => inputLeft z i) (fun _ => ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  have hy := Synthesis.circuit (I := Boolean.interpretation) (s := inputs (n + n))
    encode (fun i z => inputRight z i) (fun _ => ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  let src := inputs (n + n) ∪ (wires x ∪ wires y)
  let args := fun z => Fin.append (x z) (y z)
  have hargs (i : Fin (n + n)) : (fun z => args z i) ∈ src := by
    induction i using Fin.addCases with
    | left i => exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨i, by simp only [args, Fin.append_left]⟩)
    | right i => exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨i, by simp only [args, Fin.append_right]⟩)
  have hquery := Synthesis.circuit (I := Boolean.interpretation) (s := src)
    middle (fun i z => args z i) hargs
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hsize⟩ := ((hx.union hy).trans hquery).exists_circuit_outputs
  have hconj : Function.Semiconj (e : BitVec n → BitVec n) f conjugate := by
    intro x
    simp only [conjugate, Equiv.permCongrHom_coe, Equiv.permCongr_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hex (z : BitString (n + n)) : word (inputLeft (args z)) = e (word (inputLeft z)) := by
    change word (fun i => Fin.append (x z) (y z) (Fin.castAdd n i)) = _
    simp only [Fin.append_left, x]
    change word (encode.eval Boolean.interpretation (inputLeft z)) = _
    rw [he (inputLeft z), word_getLsbD]
  have hey (z : BitString (n + n)) : word (inputRight (args z)) = e (word (inputRight z)) := by
    change word (fun i => Fin.append (x z) (y z) (Fin.natAdd n i)) = _
    simp only [Fin.append_right, y]
    change word (encode.eval Boolean.interpretation (inputRight z)) = _
    rw [he (inputRight z), word_getLsbD]
  have hspec (z : BitString (n + n)) (t : ℕ) :
      (f : BitVec n → BitVec n)^[t] (word (inputLeft z)) = word (inputRight z) ↔
        visitScheduleContains (out.eval Boolean.interpretation z) t := by
    rw [ho z]
    change _ ↔ visitScheduleContains (middle.eval Boolean.interpretation (args z)) t
    rw [← hm (args z) t, hex z, hey z]
    rw [← hconj.iterate_right t]
    exact e.injective.eq_iff.symm
  refine ⟨out, hspec, fun z T => ?_, by lia⟩
  rw [← visitScheduleCount_spec]
  congr 1
  ext t
  exact and_congr_right (fun _ => hspec z t)

theorem CounterIntervalChart.variable_time {f : BitVec n → BitVec n}
    (chart : CounterIntervalChart f R) (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ out : Circuit Boolean.signature (n + m) n,
      out.Computes Boolean.interpretation (fun z i =>
        (f^[(word (fun j => z (Fin.natAdd n j))).toNat]
          (word fun j => z (Fin.castAdd m j))).getLsbD i.val) ∧
      out.size ≤ 1000 * (n + 3) * (R + m) := by
  let x := fun z : BitString (n + m) => word fun i => z (Fin.castAdd m i)
  let bits := fun z : BitString (n + m) => fun j : Fin m => z (Fin.natAdd n j)
  let constants : Set (BitString (n + m) → Bool) := {fun _ => false, fun _ => true}
  let src := inputs (n + m) ∪ constants
  have hc (b : Bool) : (fun _ : BitString (n + m) => b) ∈ src := by
    cases b <;> simp [src, constants]
  have hconst : Synthesis Boolean.interpretation (inputs (n + m)) constants 2 :=
    (Synthesis.const false).union (Synthesis.const true)
  have hx : wordWires x ⊆ src := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simpa only [x, getLsbD_word] using
      (show (fun z : BitString (n + m) => z (Fin.castAdd m i)) ∈ src
      from Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  let encoded := fun z => chart.encode (x z)
  have henc := chart.synthesis_encode src x hx hc
  let s1 := src ∪ wires encoded
  have hadv := synthesis_advanceCycleLabel s1 encoded bits (fun _ h => Or.inr h)
    (fun j => Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)) (Or.inl (hc false))
  let advanced := fun z => advanceCycleLabel (encoded z) (bits z)
  let s2 := s1 ∪ wires advanced
  let rep := fun z => word (labelRepresentative (advanced z))
  let p := fun z => labelPhase (advanced z)
  have hrep : wordWires rep ⊆ s2 := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simpa only [rep, getLsbD_word, labelRepresentative] using
      (show (fun z => advanced z (Fin.castAdd (chartWidth n + chartWidth n) i)) ∈ s2
        from Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  have hp : wordWires p ⊆ s2 := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simpa only [p, labelPhase, getLsbD_word] using
      (show (fun z => advanced z (Fin.natAdd n (Fin.natAdd (chartWidth n) i))) ∈ s2
        from Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  have hdec := chart.synthesis_decode s2 rep p hrep hp (fun b => Or.inl (Or.inl (hc b)))
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hs⟩ := (hconst.trans (henc.trans (hadv.trans hdec))).exists_circuit_outputs
  refine ⟨out, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z
    rw [hout z]
    dsimp only [rep, p, advanced, encoded]
    rw [chart.encode_spec hf, advanceCycleLabel_spec]
    simp only [wordCycleLabel, labelRepresentative_labelBits, word_getLsbD, labelPhase_labelBits,
      chart.decode_spec hf]
    rfl
  · obtain ⟨j, _, _⟩ := chart.covers 0
    have hR : 1 ≤ R := by have := j.isLt; lia
    have hRk : n + 3 ≤ R * (n + 3) := by
      simpa only [Nat.one_mul] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n + 3) hR
    nlinarith only [hs, hRk, show 2 ≤ n + 3 by lia,
      Nat.zero_le (R * (n + 3)), Nat.zero_le (m * (n + 3))]

theorem first_target_state (c : Circuit signature n n) (p : Circuit signature n 1) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature n n,
      (∀ x, p.eval interpretation (out.eval interpretation x) 0 = true ↔
        ∃ t, p.eval interpretation ((c.eval interpretation)^[t] x) 0 = true) ∧
      (∀ x, (∃ t, p.eval interpretation ((c.eval interpretation)^[t] x) 0 = true) →
        ∃ t < 2 ^ n, out.eval interpretation x = (c.eval interpretation)^[t] x ∧
          p.eval interpretation ((c.eval interpretation)^[t] x) 0 = true ∧
          ∀ j < t, p.eval interpretation ((c.eval interpretation)^[j] x) 0 ≠ true) ∧
      out.size ≤ 40000 * powerBudget n (c.size + p.size + 4 * n) (2 ^ n) L := by
  let f := c.eval interpretation
  let P := fun x => p.eval interpretation x 0 = true
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgs⟩ := absorbing_circuit c p
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hs⟩ := fixed_power n g (2 ^ n) L hL hLN
  have hcard : Fintype.card (BitString n) = 2 ^ n := by simp
  have ho (x) : out.eval interpretation x = (absorb f P)^[Fintype.card (BitString n)] x := by
    rw [hout x, hcard]
    congr 1
    exact funext hg
  refine ⟨out, fun x => ?_, fun x hx => ?_, hs.trans ?_⟩
  · rw [ho x]
    exact absorb_iterate_card_eq_iff f P x
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, hp, hfirst, heq⟩ := absorb_iterate_card f P x hx
    exact ⟨t, hcard ▸ ht, (ho x).trans heq, hp, hfirst⟩
  · unfold powerBudget
    gcongr

theorem halting_computation (c : Circuit signature n n) (H : BitString n → Prop)
    (initial : Set (BitString n)) (hstop : ∀ x, H x → c.eval interpretation x = x)
    (hhalt : ∀ x ∈ initial, ∃ t, H ((c.eval interpretation)^[t] x)) (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature n n,
      (∀ x ∈ initial, H (out.eval interpretation x) ∧
        ∃ t < 2 ^ n, out.eval interpretation x = (c.eval interpretation)^[t] x ∧
          ∀ j < t, ¬H ((c.eval interpretation)^[j] x)) ∧
      out.size ≤ 40000 * powerBudget n c.size (2 ^ n) L := by
  classical
  let f := c.eval interpretation
  have ha : absorb f H = f := by
    funext x
    by_cases hx : H x
    · simp only [absorb, hx, ite_true]
      exact (hstop x hx).symm
    · simp only [absorb, hx, ite_false]
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hs⟩ := fixed_power n c (2 ^ n) L hL hLN
  refine ⟨out, fun x hx => ?_, hs⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hp, hfirst, he⟩ := absorb_iterate_card f H x (hhalt x hx)
  have hcard : Fintype.card (BitString n) = 2 ^ n := by simp
  rw [ha, hcard] at he
  have ho : out.eval interpretation x = f^[t] x := (hout x).trans he
  exact ⟨ho ▸ hp, t, hcard ▸ ht, ho, hfirst⟩

when the orbit of its input reaches a state accepted by `p`, followed by `n + 2` bits. When the
flag is set they are the first time a target is visited, which is below `2 ^ n`; otherwise
nothing is claimed about them. -/

theorem first_target_time (c : Circuit signature n n) (p : Circuit signature n 1) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature n (1 + (n + 2)),
      (∀ x, out.eval interpretation x 0 = true ↔
        ∃ t, p.eval interpretation ((c.eval interpretation)^[t] x) 0 = true) ∧
      (∀ x, out.eval interpretation x 0 = true →
        let t := (word fun i : Fin (n + 2) => out.eval interpretation x (Fin.natAdd 1 i)).toNat

          (∀ j < t, p.eval interpretation ((c.eval interpretation)^[j] x) 0 ≠ true) ∧ t < 2 ^ n) ∧
      out.size ≤ 90000 * powerBudget n (c.size + p.size + 4 * n) (2 ^ n) L + p.size := by
  let f := c.eval interpretation
  let P := fun x => p.eval interpretation x 0 = true
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgs⟩ := absorbing_circuit c p
  have he : g.eval interpretation = absorb f P := funext hg
  obtain ⟨depth, hd, hds⟩ := checkpoint_depth_circuit g L hL hLN
  obtain ⟨flag, hf, hfs⟩ := target_reachability c p L hL hLN
  have hdepth := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := inputs n) depth (fun i x => x i)
    fun i => ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hflag := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := inputs n) flag (fun i x => x i)
    fun i => ⟨i, rfl⟩

private theorem read_wireIndex {g : ℕ} (x : Fin n → V) (w : Fin G → V) (e : Fin g → V)
    (wire : Wire n g) (hlt : ∀ b : Fin g, wire = Wire.gate b → b.val < G)

theorem minimal_period_circuit (c : Circuit signature n n) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature n (n + 1),
      (∀ x, (word (out.eval interpretation x)).toNat =
        Function.minimalPeriod (c.eval interpretation) x) ∧
      out.size ≤ 110000 * powerBudget n c.size (2 ^ n) L := by
  let f := c.eval interpretation
  obtain ⟨labels, hl, hls⟩ := cycle_label_circuit c L hL hLN
  obtain ⟨cyclic, hc, hcs⟩ := periodicPts_circuit c L hL hLN
  let src : Set (BooleanFunction n) := inputs n ∪ {fun _ => false}
  have hlabels := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := src) labels (fun i x => x i)
    (fun bit => Or.inl ⟨bit, rfl⟩)
  have hcyclic := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := src) cyclic (fun i x => x i)
    (fun bit => Or.inl ⟨bit, rfl⟩)
  let s1 := src ∪ (wires (labels.eval interpretation) ∪
    wires (cyclic.eval interpretation))
  let ell : BitString n → BitVec (n + 3) := fun x => labelLength (labels.eval interpretation x)
  have he : wordWires ell ⊆ s1 := by
    rintro _ ⟨bit, rfl⟩
    simp only [ell, labelLength, getLsbD_word]
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  have hw := wordWires_setWidth_subset (v := n + 1) (s := s1) he (Or.inl (Or.inr rfl))
  have hmux := Synthesis.word_mux (s := s1) (fun x => (ell x).setWidth (n + 1))
    (fun _ => (0 : BitVec (n + 1))) (fun x => cyclic.eval interpretation x 0)
    (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨0, rfl⟩)) (fun i => hw ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    (fun i => by simpa using (show (fun _ : BitString n => false) ∈ s1 from Or.inl (Or.inr rfl)))
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hs⟩ := ((Synthesis.const (s := inputs n) false).trans
    ((hlabels.union hcyclic).trans hmux)).exists_circuit_outputs
  refine ⟨out, fun x => ?_, hs.trans ?_⟩
  · rw [ho x, word_getLsbD]
    by_cases hy : x ∈ Function.periodicPts f
    · have htrue := (hc x).mpr hy
      simp only [htrue, ite_true]
      have hperiod := cycleLength_eq_minimalPeriod_of_mem_periodicPts f hy
      have hbound : cycleLength f x < 2 ^ (n + 1) := by
        have hle := cycleLength_le_two_pow f x
        have hpow : 2 ^ (n + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ n := by rw [pow_succ']
        omega
      have hbound3 : cycleLength f x < 2 ^ (n + 3) := by
        have hle := cycleLength_le_two_pow f x
        have hpow : 2 ^ (n + 3) = 8 * 2 ^ n := by rw [pow_add]; ring
        omega
      dsimp only [ell]
      simp only [hl x, canonicalLabel, labelLength_labelBits, BitVec.toNat_setWidth,
        BitVec.toNat_ofNat]
      change cycleLength f x % 2 ^ (n + 3) % 2 ^ (n + 1) = Function.minimalPeriod f x
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hbound3, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hbound, hperiod]
    · have hfalse : cyclic.eval interpretation x 0 = false :=
        Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr (fun h => hy ((hc x).mp h))
      simp only [hfalse, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
      exact (Function.minimalPeriod_eq_zero_of_notMem_periodicPts hy).symm
  · have hb : n + 1 ≤ powerBudget n c.size (2 ^ n) L := by
      have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_left ((n + 1) ^ 3)
        (show 1 ≤ L + 2 ^ n / L + 1 by lia)
      unfold powerBudget
      nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (n ^ 2)]
    lia

theorem visit_schedule_circuit (c : Circuit signature n n) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hLN : L ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    ∃ out : Circuit signature (n + n) (visitScheduleWidth n),
      (∀ z t, (c.eval interpretation)^[t] (inputLeft z) = inputRight z ↔
        visitScheduleContains (out.eval interpretation z) t) ∧
      out.size ≤ 5000000 * powerBudget n c.size (2 ^ n) L := by
  let f := c.eval interpretation
  obtain ⟨nav, hn, hns⟩ := navigation_circuit c L hL hLN
  obtain ⟨period, hp, hps⟩ := minimal_period_circuit c L hL hLN
  have hnav := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := inputs (n + n)) nav (fun i z => z i)
    (fun bit => ⟨bit, rfl⟩)
  have hperiod := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := inputs (n + n))
    period (fun i z => inputRight z i) (fun bit => ⟨Fin.natAdd n bit, rfl⟩)
  let output := fun z => Fin.append (nav.eval interpretation z)
    (period.eval interpretation (inputRight z))
  have hs := (hnav.union hperiod).mono Set.Subset.rfl
    (show wires output ⊆ wires (nav.eval interpretation) ∪
      wires (fun z => period.eval interpretation (inputRight z)) from by
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      induction i using Fin.addCases with
      | left i => exact Or.inl ⟨i, by simp only [output, Fin.append_left]⟩
      | right i => exact Or.inr ⟨i, by simp only [output, Fin.append_right]⟩) le_rfl
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hsize⟩ := hs.exists_circuit_outputs
  refine ⟨out, fun z t => ?_, hsize.trans ?_⟩
  · rw [ho z]
    simp only [visitScheduleContains, visitScheduleFirst, visitSchedulePeriod, output,
      Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, hp, hn z]
    have hflag := navigationBits_flag f (inputLeft z) (inputRight z)
    constructor
    · intro ht
      have hr : ∃ t, f^[t] (inputLeft z) = inputRight z := ⟨t, ht⟩
      have hd := navigationBits_time f (inputLeft z) (inputRight z) hr
      exact ⟨hflag.mpr hr, (visit_schedule_of_first f _ _ _ hd.1 hd.2.1 t).mp ht⟩
    · rintro ⟨hr, ht⟩
      have hd := navigationBits_time f (inputLeft z) (inputRight z) (hflag.mp hr)
      exact (visit_schedule_of_first f _ _ _ hd.1 hd.2.1 t).mpr ht
  · have hnB := hns.trans (navigationBudget_le n c.size L)
    lia

`15000000 * optimizedBudget n c.size (2 ^ n)` whose output record characterizes all visit times and
determines the exact visit count up to any deadline `T`. -/

theorem depth_kwProtocol_le [NeZero n] (F : Formula signature n) (onAlice : Bool) :
    (F.kwProtocol onAlice).depth ≤ F.depthWith binaryCost := by
  induction F generalizing onAlice with
  | input i => simp [kwProtocol]
  | gate op args ih =>
    have hle (j : Fin (signature.Arity op)) :
        (args j).depthWith binaryCost ≤ Finset.univ.sup fun j => (args j).depthWith binaryCost :=
      Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (args j).depthWith binaryCost) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    cases op with
    | const c => simp [kwProtocol]
    | not => exact (ih 0 _).trans ((hle 0).trans (by simp))
    | and =>
      have h₀ := (ih 0 onAlice).trans (hle 0)
      have h₁ := (ih 1 onAlice).trans (hle 1)
      cases onAlice <;> simp only [kwProtocol, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true,
        Protocol.depth_alice, Protocol.depth_bob, depthWith_gate, binaryCost_and] <;>
        exact Nat.add_le_add_right (max_le h₀ h₁) 1
    | or =>
      have h₀ := (ih 0 onAlice).trans (hle 0)
      have h₁ := (ih 1 onAlice).trans (hle 1)
      cases onAlice <;> simp only [kwProtocol, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true,
        Protocol.depth_alice, Protocol.depth_bob, depthWith_gate, binaryCost_or] <;>
        exact Nat.add_le_add_right (max_le h₁ h₀) 1

def keyedSortCircuit (key : Circuit signature r k) (depth : ℕ) (ascending : Bool) :
    Circuit signature (BitonicSort.arity depth * r) (BitonicSort.arity depth * r) :=
  (Circuit.wiring signature fun i =>
    let jb := finProdFinEquiv.symm i
    finProdFinEquiv (jb.1, Fin.natAdd k jb.2)).comp
      ((bitonicSortCircuit (Fin.castAdd r) depth ascending).comp (pack key depth))
where
  /-- Prepend the computed key to each complete record. -/
  pack (key : Circuit signature r k) (depth : ℕ) :
      Circuit signature (BitonicSort.arity depth * r) (BitonicSort.arity depth * (k + r)) :=
    (key.append (Circuit.id signature r)).replicate (BitonicSort.arity depth)

private theorem card_hammingEdges_le_of_forall {i : Fin n} (hA : ∀ a ∈ A, a i = true)
    (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, b i = false) : #(hammingEdges A B) ^ 2 ≤ #A * #B := by
  have key {a b : BitString n} (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B) (h : hammingDist a b = 1) (j : Fin n)
      (hj : j ≠ i) : a j = b j := by
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hother⟩ := hammingDist_eq_one_iff.1 h
    have hli : l = i := by
      by_contra hli
      exact absurd (hother i (Ne.symm hli)) (by rw [hA a ha, hB b hb]; decide)
    exact hother j (hli ▸ hj)
  rw [sq]
  refine Nat.mul_le_mul (card_le_card_of_injOn Prod.fst (fun e he => (mem_hammingEdges.1 he).1) ?_)
    (card_le_card_of_injOn Prod.snd (fun e he => (mem_hammingEdges.1 he).2.1) ?_)
  · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ he ⟨a', b'⟩ he' (rfl : a = a')
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, h⟩ := mem_hammingEdges.1 he
    obtain ⟨-, hb', h'⟩ := mem_hammingEdges.1 he'
    refine Prod.ext rfl (funext fun j => ?_)
    change b j = b' j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj
      rw [hB b hb, hB b' hb']
    · exact (key ha hb h j hj).symm.trans (key ha hb' h' j hj)
  · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ he ⟨a', b'⟩ he' (rfl : b = b')
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, h⟩ := mem_hammingEdges.1 he
    obtain ⟨ha', -, h'⟩ := mem_hammingEdges.1 he'
    refine Prod.ext (funext fun j => ?_) rfl
    change a j = a' j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj
      rw [hA a ha, hA a' ha']
    · exact (key ha hb h j hj).trans (key ha' hb h' j hj).symm

theorem Formula.sq_card_hammingEdges_le (F : Formula signature n)
    (hA : ∀ a ∈ A, F.eval interpretation a = true) (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, F.eval interpretation b = false) :
    #(hammingEdges A B) ^ 2 ≤ F.leafSize * #A * #B := by
  induction F generalizing A B with
  | input i =>
    rw [Formula.leafSize_input, one_mul]
    exact card_hammingEdges_le_of_forall hA hB
  | gate op args ih =>
    cases op with
    | const c =>
      rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨a, ha⟩
      · simp [hammingEdges]
      rcases B.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨b, hb⟩
      · simp [hammingEdges]
      exact absurd ((hA a ha).symm.trans (hB b hb)) (by decide)
    | not =>
      have := ih 0 (A := B) (B := A) (fun b hb => by simpa [interpretation] using hB b hb)
        fun a ha => by simpa [interpretation] using hA a ha
      rw [card_hammingEdges_comm, Formula.leafSize_gate, sum_not]
      exact this.trans_eq (mul_right_comm _ _ _)
    | and =>
      have hA' : ∀ a ∈ A, (args 0).eval interpretation a = true ∧
          (args 1).eval interpretation a = true := fun a ha => by
        simpa [interpretation] using hA a ha
      have h₁ := ih 0 (A := A) (B := B.filter fun b => (args 0).eval interpretation b = false)
        (fun a ha => (hA' a ha).1) fun b hb => (mem_filter.1 hb).2
      have h₂ := ih 1 (A := A) (B := B.filter fun b => ¬(args 0).eval interpretation b = false)
        (fun a ha => (hA' a ha).2) fun b hb => by
          obtain ⟨hb, h0⟩ := mem_filter.1 hb
          simpa [interpretation, Bool.not_eq_false _ ▸ h0] using hB b hb
      rw [← card_hammingEdges_filter_add_card_hammingEdges_filter_not
        (fun b => (args 0).eval interpretation b = false),
        ← card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := B)
        (fun b => (args 0).eval interpretation b = false), Formula.leafSize_gate, sum_and]
      exact sq_add_le_mul h₁ h₂
    | or =>
      have hB' : ∀ b ∈ B, (args 0).eval interpretation b = false ∧
          (args 1).eval interpretation b = false := fun b hb => by
        simpa [interpretation] using hB b hb
      have h₁ := ih 0 (A := A.filter fun a => (args 0).eval interpretation a = true)
        (B := B) (fun a ha => (mem_filter.1 ha).2) fun b hb => (hB' b hb).1
      have h₂ := ih 1 (A := A.filter fun a => ¬(args 0).eval interpretation a = true)
        (B := B) (fun a ha => by
          obtain ⟨ha, h0⟩ := mem_filter.1 ha
          simpa [interpretation, Bool.not_eq_true _ ▸ h0] using hA a ha)
        fun b hb => (hB' b hb).2
      rw [card_hammingEdges_comm] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
      rw [← card_hammingEdges_filter_add_card_hammingEdges_filter_not
        (fun a => (args 0).eval interpretation a = true),
        ← card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := A)
        (fun a => (args 0).eval interpretation a = true), Formula.leafSize_gate, sum_or]
      exact (sq_add_le_mul (h₁.trans_eq (mul_right_comm _ _ _))
        (h₂.trans_eq (mul_right_comm _ _ _))).trans_eq (mul_right_comm _ _ _)

theorem mul_le_leafSize_of_computes_threshold {k : ℕ} {F : Formula signature n}
    (hF : F.Computes interpretation (threshold n k)) : k * (n + 1 - k) ≤ F.leafSize := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · simp
  rcases lt_or_ge n k with hkn | hkn
  · simp [show n + 1 - k = 0 by omega]
  rw [mul_comm, show n + 1 - k = n - (k - 1) by omega]
  refine F.mul_le_leafSize (A := BitString.weightLayer n k)
    (B := BitString.weightLayer n (k - 1))
    (fun a ha => (hF a).trans (by simp [threshold_apply, BitString.mem_weightLayer.1 ha]))
    (fun b hb => (hF b).trans (by
      simp only [threshold_apply, BitString.mem_weightLayer.1 hb, decide_eq_false_iff_not,
        not_le]
      omega))
    (BitString.weightLayer_nonempty hkn) (fun a ha => le_card_neighbors_weight_pred ha)
    fun b hb => ?_
  have := le_card_neighbors_weight_succ hb
  rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel hk] at this

theorem sum_fourierCoeff_sq_le_of_computes {f : BooleanFunction n} {C : Circuit signature n 1}
    (hC : C.Computes interpretation (single f)) {s : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) (hn0 : 0 < n) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : max 8 (2 * s) * n ≤ k * (n / (16 * s + 1) ^ C.depth)) :
    ∑ U with k ≤ #U, fourierCoeff (fun x => signVal (f x)) U ^ 2 ≤ 2 * C.size / 2 ^ s := by
  -- there is no weight on more than `n` coordinates
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n k with hkn | hkn
  · rw [sum_eq_zero fun U hU => absurd ((mem_filter.1 hU).2.trans (card_le_univ U))
      (by simpa using hkn)]
    positivity
  set ℓ := n / (16 * s + 1) ^ C.depth
  have hsℓ : s ≤ ℓ := by
    have h : n * (2 * s) ≤ n * ℓ :=
      calc n * (2 * s) = 2 * s * n := by ring
        _ ≤ max 8 (2 * s) * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (le_max_right _ _)
        _ ≤ k * ℓ := hk
        _ ≤ n * ℓ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hkn
    have := Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left h hn0
    omega
  have hn : s * (16 * s + 1) ^ C.depth ≤ n :=
    (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (Nat.pow_pos (by omega))).1 hsℓ
  set P := (univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard ℓ
  set N := n.choose ℓ
  set a : Finset (Fin n) → ℝ := fun U => fourierCoeff (fun x => signVal (f x)) U ^ 2
  set bad := (PartialAssignment.withFree (Fin n) ℓ).filter fun ρ => ¬ Shallow s ρ f
  have ha : ∀ U, 0 ≤ a U := fun U => by simp only [a]; positivity
  have hℓn : ℓ ≤ n := Nat.div_le_self _ _
  have hN : 0 < N := Nat.choose_pos hℓn
  -- the counted stages: few restrictions leave the output deep
  have hbad : 2 ^ s * bad.card ≤ C.size * (PartialAssignment.withFree (Fin n) ℓ).card := by
    have h := two_pow_mul_card_filter_exists_not_shallow_le (p := C.program) hs hn C.depth le_rfl
    refine (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (card_le_card fun ρ hρ => ?_)).trans
      (h.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ((card_filter_le _ _).trans (by simp))))
    obtain ⟨hρW, hdeep⟩ := mem_filter.1 hρ
    refine mem_filter.2 ⟨hρW, ?_⟩
    have hf : f = fun x => C.program.trace interpretation x (C.outputs 0) :=
      funext fun x => (congrFun (hC x) 0).symm
    rw [hf] at hdeep
    by_contra hall
    push Not at hall
    exact hdeep (shallow_output hs hall)
  -- the weight on sets meeting a random `J` in at least `s` coordinates
  have hupper : ∑ J ∈ P, ∑ U with s ≤ #(U ∩ J), a U ≤ (2 ^ ℓ * bad.card : ℝ) / 2 ^ n := by
    calc ∑ J ∈ P, ∑ U with s ≤ #(U ∩ J), a U
        ≤ ∑ J ∈ P, ((univ.filter fun z : BitString n =>
            ¬ Shallow s (PartialAssignment.outside J z) f).card : ℝ) / 2 ^ n :=
          sum_le_sum fun J _ => sum_fourierCoeff_sq_le_card f J s
      _ = (2 ^ ℓ * bad.card : ℝ) / 2 ^ n := by
          rw [← sum_div]
          congr 1
          exact_mod_cast PartialAssignment.sum_card_filter_outside (fun ρ => ¬ Shallow s ρ f) ℓ
  -- for the sets of at least `k` coordinates, at least half of the `J` meet them in `s`
  have hlower : (N : ℝ) / 2 * ∑ U with k ≤ #U, a U ≤ ∑ J ∈ P, ∑ U with s ≤ #(U ∩ J), a U := by
    have hswap : ∑ J ∈ P, ∑ U with s ≤ #(U ∩ J), a U =
        ∑ U, a U * (P.filter fun J => s ≤ #(U ∩ J)).card := by
      simp only [sum_filter]
      rw [sum_comm]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun U _ => ?_
      rw [← sum_filter, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    rw [hswap, mul_sum, sum_filter]
    refine sum_le_sum fun U _ => ?_
    split_ifs with hU
    · have hcount := two_mul_card_filter_card_inter_lt_le (s := univ) (U := U) (ℓ := ℓ)
        (m := s) (subset_univ U) (by simpa using hn0)
        (by
          have : 8 * n ≤ k * ℓ := (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (le_max_left _ _)).trans hk
          simpa using this.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hU))
        (by
          have : 2 * s * n ≤ k * ℓ := (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (le_max_right _ _)).trans hk
          simpa using this.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hU))
      have hcount' : 2 * (P.filter fun J => #(U ∩ J) < s).card ≤ N := by
        simpa [P, N] using hcount
      have hsplit := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := P) (fun J => s ≤ #(U ∩ J))
      have hPN : P.card = N := by simp [P, N]
      have hneg : (P.filter fun J => ¬ s ≤ #(U ∩ J)) = P.filter fun J => #(U ∩ J) < s := by
        congr 1
        ext J
        simp
      rw [hneg, hPN] at hsplit
      have h2 : (N : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (P.filter fun J => s ≤ #(U ∩ J)).card := by
        have : N ≤ 2 * (P.filter fun J => s ≤ #(U ∩ J)).card := by omega
        exact_mod_cast this
      nlinarith [ha U]
    · exact mul_nonneg (ha U) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  -- combine: `N / 2 · W ≤ 2 ^ ℓ #bad / 2 ^ n ≤ g N / 2 ^ s`
  have hW := hlower.trans hupper
  have hbadR : (2 ^ s : ℝ) * bad.card ≤ C.size * (N * 2 ^ (n - ℓ)) := by
    have := hbad
    rw [PartialAssignment.card_withFree, Fintype.card_fin] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  have h2n : (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * 2 ^ (n - ℓ) = 2 ^ n := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hℓn]
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hpow : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ s := by positivity
  have hpown : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ n := by positivity
  have hpowℓ : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ ℓ := by positivity
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hpow]
  have key : (N : ℝ) / 2 * (∑ U with k ≤ #U, a U) * 2 ^ s ≤ C.size * N := by
    have h1 : (N : ℝ) / 2 * (∑ U with k ≤ #U, a U) * 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ ℓ * bad.card := by
      rwa [le_div_iff₀ hpown] at hW
    have h3 : (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * bad.card * 2 ^ s ≤ 2 ^ ℓ * (C.size * (N * 2 ^ (n - ℓ))) := by
      nlinarith
    have h4 : (N : ℝ) / 2 * (∑ U with k ≤ #U, a U) * 2 ^ s * 2 ^ n ≤ C.size * N * 2 ^ n := by
      calc (N : ℝ) / 2 * (∑ U with k ≤ #U, a U) * 2 ^ s * 2 ^ n
          = (N / 2 * (∑ U with k ≤ #U, a U) * 2 ^ n) * 2 ^ s := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 ^ ℓ * bad.card * 2 ^ s := by gcongr
        _ ≤ 2 ^ ℓ * (C.size * (N * 2 ^ (n - ℓ))) := h3
        _ = C.size * N * (2 ^ ℓ * 2 ^ (n - ℓ)) := by ring
        _ = C.size * N * 2 ^ n := by rw [h2n]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h4 hpown
  nlinarith

/-- **The Linial–Mansour–Nisan theorem above an explicit degree.** Let `f` be computed by a
circuit of negations and unbounded fan-in conjunctions and disjunctions of depth at most `d`, and
let `s ≥ 2`. Then the Fourier weight of `f`, read as signs, on the sets of more than `t`
coordinates is at most `2 g / 2 ^ s`, where `g` is the number of gates, whenever
`2 max 8 (2 s) (16 s + 1) ^ d ≤ t + 1`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem sum_fourierCoeff_sq_le_of_computes_of_depth_le {f : BooleanFunction n}
    {C : Circuit signature n 1} (hC : C.Computes interpretation (single f)) {s d t : ℕ}
    (hs : 2 ≤ s) (hd : C.depth ≤ d) (ht : 2 * max 8 (2 * s) * (16 * s + 1) ^ d ≤ t + 1) :
    ∑ U with t < #U, fourierCoeff (fun x => signVal (f x)) U ^ 2 ≤ 2 * C.size / 2 ^ s := by
  set q := (16 * s + 1) ^ C.depth
  set M := max 8 (2 * s)
  have hq : 0 < q := by positivity
  have hqd : q ≤ (16 * s + 1) ^ d := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hd
  have hMq : 2 * M * q ≤ t + 1 := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hqd).trans ht
  have hM : 8 ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n q with hnq | hqn
  · -- every set has at most `n ≤ t` coordinates
    have htn : n ≤ t := by nlinarith
    rw [sum_eq_zero fun U hU => absurd ((mem_filter.1 hU).2.trans_le
      ((card_le_univ U).trans (by simpa using htn))) (lt_irrefl t)]
    positivity
  · have hr : 1 ≤ n / q := Nat.div_pos hqn hq
    have hk : M * n ≤ (t + 1) * (n / q) :=
      calc M * n ≤ M * (q * (n / q + 1)) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.lt_mul_div_succ n hq).le
        _ ≤ M * (q * (2 * (n / q))) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega))
        _ = 2 * M * q * (n / q) := by ring
        _ ≤ (t + 1) * (n / q) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hMq
    simpa only [Nat.add_one_le_iff] using
      sum_fourierCoeff_sq_le_of_computes hC hs (hq.trans_le hqn) hk

private theorem valid_prepareLayer (p : Program signature n g) (k width : ℕ)
    (hready : ∀ w : Wire n g, p.wireDepths w ≤ k → w.toNat < width) :
    ∀ node ∈ prepareLayer n p.code (wireDepthsCode n p.code) (k + 1), node.Valid width := by
  have hargs (j : ℕ) (hj : j < p.code.length)
      (hlevel : (wireDepthsCode n p.code).getD (n + j) 0 = k + 1) :
      ∀ a, ((p.lines ⟨j, hj.trans_eq p.length_code⟩).wires a).toNat < width := by
    let index : Fin g := ⟨j, hj.trans_eq p.length_code⟩
    have hdepth := wireDepthsCode_getD_toNat p (.gate index)
    change (wireDepthsCode n p.code).getD (n + j) 0 = p.depths index at hdepth
    intro a
    apply hready
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ ((p.wireDepths_lines_lt index a).trans_eq
      (hdepth.symm.trans hlevel))
  intro node hnode
  simp only [prepareLayer, List.mem_append, List.mem_map, List.mem_range] at hnode
  rcases hnode with (⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩) | ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
  · unfold carry
    split_ifs with h
    · let w : Wire n g := Wire.ofNat i (hi.trans_eq (congrArg (n + ·) p.length_code))
      have hdepth := wireDepthsCode_getD_toNat p w
      simp only [w, Wire.toNat_ofNat] at hdepth
      have := hready w (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (hdepth ▸ h))
      simpa only [Node.Valid, w, Wire.toNat_ofNat] using this
    · trivial
  · split_ifs with h
    · rw [Program.getD_code p ⟨j, hj.trans_eq p.length_code⟩ (.const false, [])]
      exact valid_prepareFirst _ (hargs j hj h)
    · trivial
  · split_ifs with h
    · rw [Program.getD_code p ⟨j, hj.trans_eq p.length_code⟩ (.const false, [])]
      exact valid_prepareSecond _ (hargs j hj h)

private theorem eval_round (p : Program signature n g) (x : Fin n → Bool)
    (k : ℕ) (inputs : List Bool)
    (hvalues : ∀ w : Wire n g, p.wireDepths w ≤ k →
      inputs.getD w.toNat false = p.trace interpretation x w) :
    ∀ w : Wire n g, p.wireDepths w ≤ k + 1 →
      (evalLayer (evalLayer inputs (prepareLayer n p.code (wireDepthsCode n p.code) (k + 1)))
        (finishLayer n p.code (wireDepthsCode n p.code) (k + 1))).getD w.toNat false =
          p.trace interpretation x w := by
  intro w hw
  cases w with
  | input i =>
    rw [Wire.toNat_input, getD_eval_finishLayer_input _ _ _ _ _ i.isLt,
      getD_eval_prepareLayer_main _ _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
    have hdepth := wireDepthsCode_getD_toNat p (.input i)
    change (wireDepthsCode n p.code).getD i 0 = 0 at hdepth
    rw [carry, hdepth, ite_eq_left (by omega), Node.eval]
    exact hvalues (.input i) (Nat.zero_le _)
  | gate j =>
    have hj : j.val < p.code.length := j.isLt.trans_eq p.length_code.symm
    have hdepth := wireDepthsCode_getD_toNat p (.gate j)
    change (wireDepthsCode n p.code).getD (n + j.val) 0 = p.depths j at hdepth
    change p.depths j ≤ k + 1 at hw
    rw [Wire.toNat_gate, getD_eval_finishLayer_gate _ _ _ _ _ hj, hdepth]
    by_cases hactive : p.depths j = k + 1
    · rw [ite_eq_left hactive, Program.getD_code p j (.const false, []), Line.code_fst]
      rw [finish_prepare_eq _ _ _ _ hj (p.lines j)
        (Program.getD_code p j (.const false, [])) (hdepth.trans hactive)]
      have hargs : (fun a => inputs.getD ((p.lines j).wires a).toNat false) =
          (fun a => p.trace interpretation x ((p.lines j).wires a)) := by
        funext a
        apply hvalues
        exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ ((p.wireDepths_lines_lt j a).trans_eq hactive)
      rw [hargs]
      exact p.lines_eval interpretation x j
    · have hlt : p.depths j < k + 1 := by omega
      rw [ite_eq_right hactive, carry, hdepth, ite_eq_left hlt, Node.eval,
        getD_eval_prepareLayer_main _ _ _ _ _ (by omega), carry, hdepth,
        ite_eq_left hlt, Node.eval]
      exact hvalues (.gate j) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt)

      (fun p : α × ℕ => decide ((depths p.1).getD (inputCount p.1 + p.2) 0 = level p.1))

    apply mapWithInput (range.comp hcount)

      (const (Node.const false))

theorem exists_rat_coefficient {γ ε : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ num den P : ℕ, num < den ∧ 0 < P ∧ γ < (num : ℝ) / den ∧
      ((P : ℝ) + 1) * den ≤ (1 / (1 - γ) + ε) * P * ((den - num : ℕ) : ℝ) := by

  have hgap : 0 < 1 - γ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨κ, hlow, hup⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (show 1 / (1 - γ) < target by rw [htarget]; linarith)
  have hκ : 0 < (κ : ℝ) := (one_div_pos.mpr hgap).trans hlow
  set ρ : ℚ := 1 - 1 / κ with hρ
  have hρv : (ρ : ℝ) = 1 - 1 / (κ : ℝ) := by simp [hρ]
  have hρlow : γ < (ρ : ℝ) := by
    rw [hρv]
    have := (div_lt_iff₀ hgap).mp hlow
    have : 1 / (κ : ℝ) < 1 - γ := (div_lt_iff₀ hκ).mpr (by nlinarith)
    linarith
  have hρup : (ρ : ℝ) < 1 := by
    rw [hρv]
    have := one_div_pos.mpr hκ
    linarith
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ := by exact_mod_cast hγ.trans hρlow.le
  have hnum : 0 ≤ ρ.num := Rat.num_nonneg.mpr hρ0
  have hfrac : (ρ : ℝ) = (ρ.num.toNat : ℝ) / ρ.den := by
    rw [Rat.cast_def]
    congr 1
    exact_mod_cast (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnum).symm
  have hden : 0 < (ρ.den : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ρ.den_pos
  have hproper : ρ.num.toNat < ρ.den := by
    rw [hfrac] at hρup
    have := (div_lt_iff₀ hden).mp hρup
    exact_mod_cast (by simpa using this : (ρ.num.toNat : ℝ) < ρ.den)
  have hident : (κ : ℝ) * ((ρ.den - ρ.num.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) = ρ.den := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hproper.le]
    have h1 := div_mul_cancel₀ (1 : ℝ) (ne_of_gt hκ)
    have h2 := (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hden)).mp hfrac
    rw [hρv] at h2
    nlinarith
  have herr : 0 < target - (κ : ℝ) := sub_pos.mpr hup
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((κ : ℝ) / (target - κ))
  have hP0 : 0 < P := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < P := (div_pos hκ herr).trans hP
    exact_mod_cast this

        rw [mul_assoc, hident]

        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlead (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

        ≤ ∑ _q : Fin (copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b)), ∑ _r : Fin b, L :=

      _ = copies * Fintype.card K ^ ℓ * b * L := by
          simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, card_eq_two_pow bits,

  have hscatter : (scatterCircuit t p w ℓ b s copies).size ≤

        (Nat.clog 2 (copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) + t * s) + 1) ^ 2 *
        (Nat.clog 2 copies + ℓ * b + w + 1) :=
    size_batchOrCircuit_le _ _ _

        (Nat.clog 2 (t * s + copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) * b) + 1) ^ 2 *

/-- **Closed-form overhead.** If `s + 1 = 2 ^ b`, the field size, and `ℓ` is positive, the
overhead is at most `1444 N D ^ 4`, where `N = 2 ^ p + t (s + 1) + copies (s + 1) ^ ℓ` bounds the
numbers of table entries, incidences and slots, and `D = p + w + ℓ b + ⌊log₂ (t + copies)⌋ + 2`
bounds the key widths and sorting depths. -/

theorem pipelineOverhead_le {t p w ℓ b s copies : ℕ} (hs : s + 1 = 2 ^ b) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) :
    pipelineOverhead t p w ℓ b s copies ≤
      1444 * (2 ^ p + t * (s + 1) + copies * (s + 1) ^ ℓ) *
        (p + w + ℓ * b + Nat.log 2 (t + copies) + 2) ^ 4 := by
  set N := 2 ^ p + t * (s + 1) + copies * (s + 1) ^ ℓ with hN
  set lam := Nat.log 2 (t + copies) with hlam
  set D := p + w + ℓ * b + lam + 2 with hD
  -- Widths of indices and logarithms.
  have hlog : t + copies < 2 ^ (lam + 1) := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self one_lt_two _
  have hcopies : Nat.clog 2 copies ≤ lam + 1 := Nat.clog_le_of_le_pow (by omega)
  have hb : b ≤ ℓ * b := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left b hℓ
  have hbits : Nat.clog 2 b ≤ ℓ * b :=
    (Nat.clog_le_of_le_pow (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le).trans hb
  have hslots : 2 ^ (ℓ * b) = (s + 1) ^ ℓ := by rw [hs, ← pow_mul, mul_comm]
  have hss : s < 2 ^ (ℓ * b) := (show s < 2 ^ b by omega).trans_le
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hb)
  have hp : 1 ≤ 2 ^ p := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have hpow (k : ℕ) : 2 ^ k ≤ 2 ^ (lam + 1 + k) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
  have hTt : t ≤ 2 ^ (lam + 1 + p) := (show t ≤ 2 ^ (lam + 1) by omega).trans
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega))
  have h1 : Nat.clog 2 (t + 2 ^ p) ≤ D := by
    refine (Nat.clog_le_of_le_pow (y := lam + 1 + p + 1) ?_).trans (by omega)
    have := hpow p
    rw [pow_succ]
    omega
  have hTC : copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) + t * s ≤ 2 ^ (lam + 1 + ℓ * b) := by
    calc copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) + t * s ≤ (t + copies) * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) := by
          have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left t hss.le
          rw [add_mul]
          omega
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (lam + 1) * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hlog.le
      _ = 2 ^ (lam + 1 + ℓ * b) := (pow_add _ _ _).symm
  have h2 : Nat.clog 2 (copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) + t * s) ≤ D :=
    (Nat.clog_le_of_le_pow hTC).trans (by omega)
  have h3 : Nat.clog 2 (t * s + copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) * b) ≤ 2 * D := by
    refine (Nat.clog_le_of_le_pow (y := lam + 1 + ℓ * b + b) ?_).trans (by omega)
    have hb2 : b ≤ 2 ^ b := Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le
    calc t * s + copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) * b
        ≤ (copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) + t * s) * 2 ^ b := by
          have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b)) hb2
          have h' : t * s ≤ t * s * 2 ^ b := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by positivity)
          rw [add_mul]
          omega
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (lam + 1 + ℓ * b) * 2 ^ b := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hTC
      _ = 2 ^ (lam + 1 + ℓ * b + b) := (pow_add _ _ _).symm
  -- Record counts.
  have n1 : t + 2 ^ p ≤ N := by
    have : t ≤ t * (s + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
    omega
  have n2 : copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) + t * s + 1 ≤ N := by
    have : t * s ≤ t * (s + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
    rw [hslots]
    omega
  have hD2 : 2 ≤ D := by omega
  have n3 : t * s + copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) * b + 1 ≤ N * D := by
    have e1 : t * s ≤ t * (s + 1) * D := by
      have : t * s ≤ t * (s + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
      exact this.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega))
    have e2 : copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) * b ≤ copies * (s + 1) ^ ℓ * D := by
      rw [hslots]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
    have e3 : 1 ≤ 2 ^ p * D := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity)
    calc t * s + copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) * b + 1
        ≤ t * (s + 1) * D + copies * (s + 1) ^ ℓ * D + 2 ^ p * D := by omega
      _ = N * D := by rw [hN]; ring
  have n4 : t * (4 * s + 1) ≤ 4 * N := by
    have : t * (4 * s + 1) ≤ 4 * (t * (s + 1)) := by
      calc t * (4 * s + 1) ≤ t * (4 * (s + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
        _ = 4 * (t * (s + 1)) := by ring
    omega
  -- The four stages.
  have t1 : 48 * (t + 2 ^ p) * (Nat.clog 2 (t + 2 ^ p) + 1) ^ 2 *
      (p + (ℓ * b + (Nat.clog 2 copies + Nat.clog 2 b)) + 1) ≤ 48 * N * (D + 1) ^ 2 * (2 * D) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 48 n1)
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) 2)) (by omega)
  have t2 : 48 * (copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) + t * s + 1) *
      (Nat.clog 2 (copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) + t * s) + 1) ^ 2 * (Nat.clog 2 copies + ℓ * b + w + 1) ≤
        48 * N * (D + 1) ^ 2 * D :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 48 n2)
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) 2)) (by omega)
  have t3 : 48 * (t * s + copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) * b + 1) *
      (Nat.clog 2 (t * s + copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) * b) + 1) ^ 2 *
      (Nat.clog 2 copies + ℓ * b + Nat.clog 2 b + 1 + 1) ≤
        48 * (N * D) * (2 * D + 1) ^ 2 * (2 * D) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 48 n3)
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) 2)) (by omega)
  have d1 : (D + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * D ^ 2 :=
    calc (D + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * D) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) 2
      _ = 4 * D ^ 2 := by ring
  have d2 : (2 * D + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 9 * D ^ 2 :=
    calc (2 * D + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (3 * D) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) 2
      _ = 9 * D ^ 2 := by ring
  have d3 : N * D ^ 3 ≤ N * D ^ 4 :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
  have d4 : N ≤ N * D ^ 4 := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by positivity)
  have s1 : 48 * N * (D + 1) ^ 2 * (2 * D) ≤ 384 * (N * D ^ 3) := by
    calc 48 * N * (D + 1) ^ 2 * (2 * D) ≤ 48 * N * (4 * D ^ 2) * (2 * D) := by gcongr
      _ = 384 * (N * D ^ 3) := by ring
  have s2 : 48 * N * (D + 1) ^ 2 * D ≤ 192 * (N * D ^ 3) := by
    calc 48 * N * (D + 1) ^ 2 * D ≤ 48 * N * (4 * D ^ 2) * D := by gcongr
      _ = 192 * (N * D ^ 3) := by ring
  have s3 : 48 * (N * D) * (2 * D + 1) ^ 2 * (2 * D) ≤ 864 * (N * D ^ 4) := by
    calc 48 * (N * D) * (2 * D + 1) ^ 2 * (2 * D) ≤ 48 * (N * D) * (9 * D ^ 2) * (2 * D) := by
          gcongr
      _ = 864 * (N * D ^ 4) := by ring
  have hgoal : 1444 * N * D ^ 4 = 1444 * (N * D ^ 4) := by ring
  rw [pipelineOverhead, hgoal]
  omega

/-- **Explicit composition bound.** Under the hypotheses of
`complexity_directProduct_le_of_isScheduler`, `t` independent copies of `f` have circuit size at
most the size of the scheduler, plus `L` for each of the `copies * |K| ^ ℓ * b` resources, plus
`1444 N D ^ 4`, where `N = 2 ^ p + t |K| + copies |K| ^ ℓ` and
`D = p + w + ℓ b + ⌊log₂ (t + copies)⌋ + 2`. No positivity is assumed: without requests the
bound is trivial, and a scheduler for at least one request forces `ℓ > 0`. Size counts every
gate, constants included; it does not bound the running time of a circuit constructor. -/

text:
theorem complexity_directProduct_le_explicit_of_isScheduler
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] {ℓ b s t p w copies L : ℕ}
    (bits : K ≃+ BitString b) (scalar : Fin s ≃ {c : K // c ≠ 0})
    (C : LineCode K ℓ) (place : BitString p ↪ Fin copies × C.info × Fin b)
    (sched : Circuit Boolean.signature (t * (ℓ * b)) (t * (s * (ℓ * b))))
    (hsched : IsScheduler bits scalar sched)
    (hL : ∀ g : BooleanFunction w, complexity Boolean.interpretation (single g) ≤ L)
    (f : BooleanFunction (p + w)) :
    complexity Boolean.interpretation (directProduct f t) ≤
      sched.size + copies * Fintype.card K ^ ℓ * b * L +
        1444 * (2 ^ p + t * Fintype.card K + copies * Fintype.card K ^ ℓ) *
          (p + w + ℓ * b + Nat.log 2 (t + copies) + 2) ^ 4 := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with rfl | ht
  · exact (complexity_le_of_computes
      (Circuit.wiring signature (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → Fin (0 * (p + w))))
      fun _ => funext fun i => i.elim0).trans (Nat.zero_le _)
  have hℓ : 0 < ℓ := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos ℓ with rfl | hℓ
    · obtain ⟨dirs, hdirs, -⟩ := hsched fun _ => 0
      exact absurd (funext fun i => i.elim0) (hdirs ⟨0, ht⟩)
    · exact hℓ
  refine (complexity_directProduct_le_of_isScheduler bits scalar C place sched hsched hL f).trans ?_
  rw [← succ_eq_card scalar]
  exact Nat.add_le_add_left (pipelineOverhead_le (succ_eq_two_pow bits scalar) hℓ) _

/-- The scheduled recovery circuit. Output `(i, j)` is the resource bit of request `i` at point
`j` of its line. -/
def recoveryCircuit (sched : Circuit signature (t * (ℓ * b)) (t * (s * (ℓ * b))))
    (members : Fin (copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b)) → Fin b → Circuit signature w 1) :
    Circuit signature (t * (p + w)) (t * s * 1) :=
  (gatherCircuit t p w ℓ b s copies).comp
    ((((bankCircuit members).comp (scatterCircuit t p w ℓ b s copies)).append
        (Circuit.id signature _)).comp
      ((scheduleStage sched p w copies).comp (lookupStage bits C place t w)))

theorem complexity_lineSums_le : complexity interpretation (lineSums t s) ≤ t * (4 * s + 1) := by
  have h : Synthesis interpretation (inputs (t * s * 1))
      (Set.range fun i y => lineSums t s y i) (∑ _i : Fin t, ((∑ _j : Fin s, (0 + 4)) + 1)) :=
    Synthesis.family _ _ fun i => Synthesis.sum univ _ (fun _ => 0) fun j _ =>
      Synthesis.of_mem ⟨finProdFinEquiv (finProdFinEquiv (i, j), 0), rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hsize⟩ := h.exists_circuit_outputs
  refine (complexity_le_of_computes c hc).trans (hsize.trans_eq ?_)
  simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

theorem lineSums_eval_recoveryCircuit (scalar : Fin s ≃ {c : K // c ≠ 0})
    {sched : Circuit signature (t * (ℓ * b)) (t * (s * (ℓ * b)))}
    (hsched : IsScheduler bits scalar sched) {f : BooleanFunction (p + w)}
    {members : Fin (copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b)) → Fin b → Circuit signature w 1}
    (hmembers : ∀ q r,
      (members q r).Computes interpretation (single (slotResource bits C place f q r)))
    (x : BitString (t * (p + w))) :
    lineSums t s ((recoveryCircuit bits C place sched members).eval interpretation x) =
      directProduct f t x := by
  funext i
  -- The requests, their targets and the scheduled lines.
  set a : Fin t → BitString p := fun i k => directProductInput x i (Fin.castAdd w k) with ha
  set z : Fin t → BitString w := fun i k => directProductInput x i (Fin.natAdd p k) with hz
  set targets : Fin t → Fin ℓ → K := fun i => ((place (a i)).2.1 : Fin ℓ → K) with htargets
  obtain ⟨dirs, hdirs, hdisj, hlines⟩ := hsched targets
  set point : Fin t → Fin s → Fin ℓ → K := fun i j => targets i + (scalar j : K) • dirs i
    with hpoint
  have hmem (i : Fin t) (j : Fin s) : point i j ∈ puncturedLine (targets i) (dirs i) :=
    mem_image_of_mem _ (mem_erase.mpr ⟨(scalar j).2, mem_univ _⟩)
  -- Stage one.
  set M := blockMap (metadata bits C place) t (x ∘ prefixWires t p w) with hM
  have hMapply (i : Fin t) (k : Fin (metaWidth ℓ b copies)) :
      M (finProdFinEquiv (i, k)) = metadata bits C place (a i) k := by
    rw [hM, blockMap_apply]
    congr 1
    funext k
    simp only [directProductInput, prefixWires, Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, ha]
  have h1 : (lookupStage bits C place t w).eval interpretation x = Fin.append M x := by
    simp only [lookupStage, Circuit.eval_append, Circuit.eval_comp, Circuit.eval_wiring,
      eval_batchLookupCircuit]
    rfl
  -- Stage two.
  set L := lineBits bits (fun j => (scalar j : K)) targets dirs with hL
  set W := Fin.append L (Fin.append M x) with hW
  have h2 : (scheduleStage sched p w copies).eval interpretation (Fin.append M x) = W := by
    simp only [scheduleStage, Circuit.eval_append, Circuit.eval_comp, Circuit.eval_wiring]
    rw [hW, ← hlines]
    congr 2
    funext y
    obtain ⟨⟨i, k⟩, rfl⟩ := finProdFinEquiv.surjective y
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Fin.append_left, hMapply, metadata,
      targetBits, blocksEquiv_symm_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, htargets]
  have hLapply (i : Fin t) (j : Fin s) (k : Fin (ℓ * b)) :
      L (finProdFinEquiv (i, finProdFinEquiv (j, k))) = pointBits bits (point i j) k := by
    simp only [hL, lineBits, blocksEquiv_symm_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hpoint]
  -- Stage three.
  have hkey (i : Fin t) (j : Fin s) :
      substitute (Sum.inl ∘ incidenceKey t p w ℓ b s copies (finProdFinEquiv (i, j))) W =
        Fin.append (indexBits (place (a i)).1) (pointBits bits (point i j)) := by
    funext k
    refine Fin.addCases (fun k => ?_) (fun k => ?_) k
    · simp only [substitute, incidenceKey, Function.comp_apply, Sum.elim_inl, hW,
        Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hMapply, metadata]
    · simp only [substitute, incidenceKey, Function.comp_apply, Sum.elim_inl, hW,
        Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hLapply]
  have hslot (q : Fin (copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b))) :
      substitute (Sum.inr ∘ slotKey q) W = slotKey q := rfl
  set S := (scatterCircuit t p w ℓ b s copies).eval interpretation W with hS
  have hscatter (i : Fin t) (j : Fin s) :
      directProductInput S (slotEquiv ((place (a i)).1, pointBits bits (point i j))) = z i := by
    apply directProductInput_eval_batchOrCircuit
    · exact ⟨finProdFinEquiv (i, j), by rw [hkey, hslot, slotKey_slotEquiv]⟩
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨⟨i', j'⟩, rfl⟩ := finProdFinEquiv.surjective y
      rw [hkey, hslot, slotKey_slotEquiv, append_eq_append_iff] at hy
      have hpt : point i' j' = point i j := pointBits_injective bits hy.2
      obtain rfl : i' = i := by
        by_contra hne
        exact disjoint_left.mp (hdisj i' i hne) (hmem i' j') (hpt ▸ hmem i j)
      funext k
      simp only [substitute, Sum.elim_inl, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hW, Fin.append_right, hz]
      rfl
  -- Stage four.
  set B := (bankCircuit members).eval interpretation S with hB
  have hbank (q : Fin (copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b))) (r : Fin b) :
      B (finProdFinEquiv (q, r)) = slotResource bits C place f q r (directProductInput S q) := by
    rw [hB, bankCircuit, Circuit.eval_parallelFamily_apply, Circuit.eval_pi]
    exact congrFun (hmembers q r _) 0
  have h3 : (((bankCircuit members).comp (scatterCircuit t p w ℓ b s copies)).append
      (Circuit.id signature _)).eval interpretation W = Fin.append B W := by
    simp only [Circuit.eval_append, Circuit.eval_comp, Circuit.eval_wiring, hB, hS]
    rfl
  -- Stage five.
  have hquery (i : Fin t) (j : Fin s) :
      substitute (Sum.inl ∘ Fin.append
        (Fin.natAdd _ ∘ incidenceKey t p w ℓ b s copies (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)))
        (fun k => Fin.natAdd (copies * 2 ^ (ℓ * b) * b) (Fin.natAdd (t * (s * (ℓ * b)))
          (Fin.castAdd (t * (p + w)) (finProdFinEquiv ((finProdFinEquiv.symm
            (finProdFinEquiv (i, j))).1, Fin.natAdd (ℓ * b) (Fin.natAdd (Nat.clog 2 copies) k)))))))
        (Fin.append B W) =
      Fin.append (Fin.append (indexBits (place (a i)).1) (pointBits bits (point i j)))
        (indexBits (place (a i)).2.2) := by
    funext k
    refine Fin.addCases (fun k => ?_) (fun k => ?_) k
    · rw [← hkey i j]
      simp only [substitute, Function.comp_apply, Sum.elim_inl, Fin.append_left,
        Fin.append_right]
    · simp only [substitute, Function.comp_apply, Sum.elim_inl, Fin.append_right, hW,
        Fin.append_left, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hMapply, metadata]
  have hgather (i : Fin t) (j : Fin s) :
      directProductInput ((gatherCircuit t p w ℓ b s copies).eval interpretation (Fin.append B W))
        (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)) =
      fun _ => resource bits C place f (place (a i)).1 (point i j) (place (a i)).2.2 (z i) := by
    apply directProductInput_eval_batchOrCircuit
    · refine ⟨finProdFinEquiv (slotEquiv ((place (a i)).1, pointBits bits (point i j)),
        (place (a i)).2.2), ?_⟩
      rw [hquery]
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, slotKey_slotEquiv]
      rfl
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨⟨q, r⟩, rfl⟩ := finProdFinEquiv.surjective y
      rw [hquery] at hy
      change Fin.append (slotKey (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (q, r))).1)
        (indexBits (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv (q, r))).2) = _ at hy
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, append_eq_append_iff, ← slotKey_slotEquiv] at hy
      obtain rfl := slotKey_injective hy.1
      obtain rfl := indexBits_injective hy.2
      funext _
      simp only [substitute, Sum.elim_inl, Fin.append_left, hbank, hscatter, slotResource,
        Equiv.symm_apply_apply, pointEquiv_coe_symm_pointBits]
  rw [lineSums, recoveryCircuit, Circuit.eval_comp, Circuit.eval_comp, Circuit.eval_comp, h1, h2,
    h3]
  have hsum := sum_resource bits scalar (C := C) (place := place) (f := f) (a i) (z i) (hdirs i)
  rw [Fin.append_castAdd_natAdd] at hsum
  rw [directProduct, ← hsum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => congrFun (hgather i j) 0

private theorem exists_finalOutput_circuit (D L s : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : Circuit signature (2 ^ D * width D L s) (2 ^ D * (s * L)),
      c.Computes interpretation finalOutput ∧
        c.size ≤ (D + 1) ^ 2 * 2 ^ D * (2 * D + 2 * width D L s + 1) := by
  have h2 := arity_eq_two_pow D
  let g : Fin (arity D * width D L s) → BooleanFunction (2 ^ D * width D L s) := fun w x =>
    x (finProdFinEquiv (Fin.cast h2 (finProdFinEquiv.symm w).1, (finProdFinEquiv.symm w).2))
  have hsyn := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) (s := inputs (2 ^ D * width D L s))
    (bitonicSortCircuit labelBit D true) g fun w => ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsub : (Set.range fun q x => finalOutput (D := D) (L := L) (s := s) x q) ⊆
      Set.range fun j x => (bitonicSortCircuit labelBit D true).eval interpretation
        (fun i => g i x) j := by
    rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
    let ip := finProdFinEquiv.symm q
    let cb := finProdFinEquiv.symm ip.2
    refine ⟨finProdFinEquiv (Fin.cast h2.symm (rank ip.1), lineBit cb.1 cb.2),
      funext fun x => ?_⟩
    have h := congrFun (congrFun (eval_bitonicSortCircuit labelBit D true (fun i => g i x))
      (Fin.cast h2.symm (rank ip.1))) (lineBit cb.1 cb.2)
    have hin : directProductInput (fun i => g i x) =
        fun j f => x (finProdFinEquiv (Fin.cast h2 j, f)) := by
      funext j f
      simp only [directProductInput, g, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [hin] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hsize⟩ := Synthesis.exists_circuit_outputs
    (hsyn.mono Set.Subset.rfl hsub le_rfl)
  refine ⟨c, hc, hsize.trans ?_⟩
  exact size_bitonicSortCircuit_le (labelBit (D := D) (L := L) (s := s)) D true

private theorem exists_phases_circuit (bits : K ≃+ BitString b) (scalar : Fin s ≃ {c : K // c ≠ 0})
    (hmenu : ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ 2 ^ D → ∃ r, k * r ≤ 2 ^ D * (2 + 3 * (ℓ * b)) + 2 * k ∧
      ∃ menu : Fin r → Fin k → Fin ℓ → K, IsUniversalMenu (2 ^ D) menu)
    (hs : s < 2 ^ b) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ D) :
    ∃ c : Circuit signature (2 ^ D * width D (ℓ * b) s) (2 ^ D * width D (ℓ * b) s),
      (∀ targets x, Good bits scalar targets (2 ^ D - arity p) x →
        Good bits scalar targets (2 ^ D) (c.eval interpretation x)) ∧
      c.size ≤ (p + 1) * (16384 * 2 ^ D * (s + 1) * (D + ℓ * b + b + 2) ^ 4) := by
  have hkD (q : ℕ) (hq : q ≤ D) : arity q ≤ 2 ^ D := by
    rw [arity_eq_two_pow]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hq
  have hk1 (q : ℕ) : 0 < arity q := by
    rw [arity_eq_two_pow]
    exact Nat.two_pow_pos q
  -- One phase with `2 ^ q` pending requests.
  have phase (q : ℕ) (hq : q ≤ D) :
      ∃ c : Circuit signature (2 ^ D * width D (ℓ * b) s) (2 ^ D * width D (ℓ * b) s),
        (∀ targets x, Good bits scalar targets (2 ^ D - arity q) x →
          Good bits scalar targets (2 ^ D - arity q + (arity q + 1) / 2)
            (c.eval interpretation x)) ∧
        c.size ≤ 16384 * 2 ^ D * (s + 1) * (D + ℓ * b + b + 2) ^ 4 := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr, menu, hU⟩ := hmenu (arity q) (hk1 q) (hkD q hq)
    have hk : 2 ^ D - arity q + arity q = 2 ^ D := Nat.sub_add_cancel (hkD q hq)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hsize⟩ := exists_next_circuit hk bits scalar menu
    refine ⟨c, fun targets x hx => ?_, hsize.trans (phaseCost_le hk hr hs)⟩
    rw [hc x]
    exact good_next bits scalar menu hU hx
  induction p with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hsize⟩ := phase 0 (Nat.zero_le D)
    refine ⟨c, fun targets x hx => ?_, by lia⟩
    have h := hc targets x hx
    have e : 2 ^ D - arity 0 + (arity 0 + 1) / 2 = 2 ^ D := by
      have := hkD 0 (Nat.zero_le D)
      simp only [arity] at this ⊢
      lia
    rwa [e] at h
  | succ p ih =>
    obtain ⟨c', hc', hsize'⟩ := ih (by lia)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hsize⟩ := phase (p + 1) hp
    refine ⟨c'.comp c, fun targets x hx => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Circuit.eval_comp]
      refine hc' targets _ ?_
      have h := hc targets x hx
      have e : 2 ^ D - arity (p + 1) + (arity (p + 1) + 1) / 2 = 2 ^ D - arity p := by
        have h1 := hkD (p + 1) hp
        have h2 : arity (p + 1) = arity p + arity p := rfl
        lia
      rwa [e] at h
    · rw [Circuit.size_comp]
      lia
