theorem exists_isScheduler (bits : K ≃+ BitString b) (scalar : Fin s ≃ {c : K // c ≠ 0})
    (hmenu : ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ 2 ^ D → ∃ r, k * r ≤ 2 ^ D * (2 + 3 * (ℓ * b)) + 2 * k ∧
      ∃ menu : Fin r → Fin k → Fin ℓ → K, IsUniversalMenu (2 ^ D) menu) :
    ∃ c : Circuit signature (2 ^ D * (ℓ * b)) (2 ^ D * (s * (ℓ * b))),
      IsScheduler bits scalar c ∧ c.size ≤ schedulerBound D ℓ b s := by
  -- The scalars are the nonzero field elements, and the field has `2 ^ b` elements.
  have hs : s < 2 ^ b := by
    have h1 : s = Fintype.card {c : K // c ≠ 0} := by
      simpa using Fintype.card_congr scalar
    have h2 : Fintype.card K = 2 ^ b := by
      rw [Fintype.card_congr bits.toEquiv]
      simp
    rw [h1, ← h2]
    exact Fintype.card_subtype_lt (x := (0 : K)) (by simp)
  -- A universal menu has nonzero directions, so the points have a coordinate.
  have hℓ : 0 < ℓ := by
    obtain ⟨r, -, menu, hU⟩ := hmenu 1 one_pos Nat.one_le_two_pow
    obtain ⟨e, -⟩ := hU.2 (fun _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
    by_contra h
    obtain rfl : ℓ = 0 := by lia
    exact hU.1 e 0 (funext fun i => i.elim0)
  obtain ⟨cP, hP, hPsize⟩ := exists_phases_circuit bits scalar hmenu hs D le_rfl
  obtain ⟨cF, hF, hFsize⟩ := exists_finalOutput_circuit D (ℓ * b) s
  let cI := substituteCircuit (initialSubstitution D (ℓ * b) s)
  refine ⟨cF.comp (cP.comp cI), fun targets => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 : Good bits scalar targets (2 ^ D - arity D)
        (cI.eval interpretation (targetBits bits targets)) := by
      rw [eval_substituteCircuit, arity_eq_two_pow, Nat.sub_self]
      exact good_initial bits scalar targets
    obtain ⟨dirs, hne, hdisj, heq⟩ := finalOutput_eq_lineBits bits scalar (hP targets _ h0)
    refine ⟨dirs, hne, hdisj, ?_⟩
    rw [Circuit.eval_comp, Circuit.eval_comp, hF]
    exact heq
  · rw [Circuit.size_comp, Circuit.size_comp, size_substituteCircuit, schedulerBound]
    exact total_le (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left b hℓ) hPsize hFsize

/-- All prefix disjunctions of `r` available functions, sharing each prefix with the next: one OR
gate per function after the first. -/
theorem Synthesis.prefixOr {r : ℕ} {s : Set (BooleanFunction n)} (F : Fin r → BooleanFunction n)
    (hF : ∀ e, F e ∈ s) :
    Synthesis interpretation s (Set.range fun e : Fin r => Boolean.prefixOr F e.val) r := by
  suffices h : ∀ J ≤ r, Synthesis interpretation s
      {f | ∃ e : Fin r, e.val < J ∧ f = Boolean.prefixOr F e.val} J by
    exact (h r le_rfl).mono Set.Subset.rfl (by rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩; exact ⟨e, e.isLt, rfl⟩) le_rfl
  intro J
  induction J with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    exact Synthesis.of_subset (by rintro _ ⟨e, he, -⟩; exact absurd he (Nat.not_lt_zero _))
  | succ J ih =>
    intro hJ
    have hprev := ih (by lia)
    have hstep : Synthesis interpretation (s ∪ {f | ∃ e : Fin r, e.val < J ∧
        f = Boolean.prefixOr F e.val}) {Boolean.prefixOr F J} 1 := by
      rcases J with _ | J
      · rw [prefixOr_zero F (by lia)]
        exact (Synthesis.of_mem (Or.inl (hF _))).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl (by lia)
      · rw [prefixOr_succ F J hJ]
        exact (Synthesis.of_mem (Or.inr ⟨⟨J, by lia⟩, by simp, rfl⟩)).or
          (Synthesis.of_mem (Or.inl (hF _)))
    refine (hprev.comp hstep).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ le_rfl
    rintro _ ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge e.val J with hlt | hge
    · exact Or.inl ⟨e, hlt, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr (by rw [show e.val = J by lia]; rfl)

theorem good_next [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] (bits : K ≃+ BitString b)
    (scalar : Fin s ≃ {c : K // c ≠ 0})
    (menu : Fin r → Fin (arity p) → Fin ℓ → K) (hmenu : IsUniversalMenu (2 ^ D) menu)
    {targets : Fin (2 ^ D) → Fin ℓ → K} {x : BitString (2 ^ D * width D (ℓ * b) s)}
    (hx : Good bits scalar targets a x) :
    Good bits scalar targets (a + (arity p + 1) / 2) (next hk bits scalar menu x) := by
  obtain ⟨π, dirs, hlabel, htarget, hline, hdisj⟩ := hx
  set T := fun m => targets (π m) with hT
  set P := fun i => T (pending hk i) with hP
  have hclean := clean_iff (hk := hk) bits scalar menu (x := x) (T := T) (dirs := dirs)
    htarget hline hmenu.1
  -- Some entry succeeds, so there is a first successful entry.
  obtain ⟨e₀, C, hC, hCclean⟩ := hmenu.2 (acceptedLines a T dirs) P
  have hsucc₀ : success hk bits scalar menu x e₀ = true := by
    rw [success, decide_eq_true_iff]
    refine hC.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (card_le_card fun i hi => ?_))
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    exact (hclean e₀ i).mpr (hCclean i hi)
  obtain ⟨e, he, hmin⟩ := exists_min_image ({e | success hk bits scalar menu x e = true} :
    Finset (Fin r)) id ⟨e₀, by simpa using hsucc₀⟩
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, id] at he hmin
  have hchosen (e' : Fin r) : chosen hk bits scalar menu x e' = true ↔ e' = e := by
    rw [chosen, decide_eq_true_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hs, hfirst⟩
      rcases lt_trichotomy e' e with h | h | h
      · exact absurd (hmin e' hs) (not_le.mpr h)
      · exact h
      · exact absurd he (by rw [hfirst e h]; decide)
    · rintro rfl
      refine ⟨he, fun e'' h'' => ?_⟩
      by_contra hn
      exact absurd (hmin e'' (by simpa using hn)) (not_le.mpr h'')
  have hflag (i : Fin (arity p)) :
      flag hk bits scalar menu x i = clean hk bits scalar menu x e i := by
    rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, flag, decide_eq_true_iff]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨e', h₁, h₂⟩ => (hchosen e').mp h₁ ▸ h₂, fun h => ⟨e, (hchosen e).mpr rfl, h⟩⟩
  have hnew (i : Fin (arity p)) (c : Fin s) (β : Fin (ℓ * b)) :
      newLine hk bits scalar menu x i c β = candidate hk bits scalar menu x e i c β := by
    rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, newLine, decide_eq_true_iff]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨e', h₁, h₂⟩ => (hchosen e').mp h₁ ▸ h₂, fun h => ⟨e, (hchosen e).mpr rfl, h⟩⟩
  -- Sorting permutes the pending records and puts the clean ones first.
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (sort_perm (fun record => toLex (record ∘ flagKey)) p false
    (enriched hk bits scalar menu x)).exists_equiv_ofFn
  have hsorted (j : Fin (arity p)) :
      sortedPending hk bits scalar menu x j = enriched hk bits scalar menu x (σ j) := hσ j
  have hflagbit (j : Fin (arity p)) : sortedPending hk bits scalar menu x j (Fin.castAdd _ 0) =
      clean hk bits scalar menu x e (σ j) := by
    rw [hsorted, enriched, Fin.append_left, hflag]
  have hfront (j : Fin (arity p)) (hj : j.val < (arity p + 1) / 2) :
      IsClean (occupiedPoints (acceptedLines a T dirs)) P (menu e) (σ j) := by
    refine (hclean e (σ j)).mp ?_
    rw [← hflagbit]
    refine (sort_flag_eq_true_iff (fun record => record ∘ flagKey) p
      (enriched hk bits scalar menu x) j).mpr ?_
    have hcount : #{i | (enriched hk bits scalar menu x i ∘ flagKey) 0 = true} =
        #{i | clean hk bits scalar menu x e i = true} := by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, flagKey, enriched, Fin.append_left, hflag]
    rw [hcount]
    have := he
    rw [success, decide_eq_true_iff] at this
    lia
  -- The new state.
  let E : Fin a ⊕ Fin (arity p) ≃ Fin (2 ^ D) := finSumFinEquiv.trans (finCongr hk)
  have hEl (m : Fin a) : E (Sum.inl m) = accepted hk m := Fin.ext rfl
  have hEr (i : Fin (arity p)) : E (Sum.inr i) = pending hk i := Fin.ext rfl
  let τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2 ^ D)) :=
    E.symm.trans ((Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl _) σ).trans E)
  have hτa (m : Fin a) : τ (accepted hk m) = accepted hk m := by
    simp only [τ, Equiv.trans_apply, ← hEl, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply,
      Sum.map_inl, Equiv.refl_apply]
  have hτp (i : Fin (arity p)) : τ (pending hk i) = pending hk (σ i) := by
    simp only [τ, Equiv.trans_apply, ← hEr, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply,
      Sum.map_inr]
  let dirs' : Fin (2 ^ D) → Fin ℓ → K :=
    fun m => Sum.elim (fun m' => dirs (accepted hk m')) (fun j => menu e (σ j)) (E.symm m)
  have hda (m : Fin a) : dirs' (accepted hk m) = dirs (accepted hk m) := by
    simp only [dirs', ← hEl, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Sum.elim_inl]
  have hdp (i : Fin (arity p)) : dirs' (pending hk i) = menu e (σ i) := by
    simp only [dirs', ← hEr, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Sum.elim_inr]
  -- Accepted positions after the phase.
  have hnew_acc (m : Fin (2 ^ D)) (hm : m.val < a + (arity p + 1) / 2) :
      (∃ m', m = accepted hk m') ∨
        ∃ j, m = pending hk j ∧ j.val < (arity p + 1) / 2 := by
    rcases accepted_or_pending (hk := hk) m with ⟨m', rfl⟩ | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨m', rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨j, rfl, by rw [val_pending] at hm; lia⟩
  have hsub (m : Fin a) : puncturedLine (T (accepted hk m)) (dirs (accepted hk m)) ⊆
      occupiedPoints (acceptedLines a T dirs) := fun w hw =>
    mem_occupiedPoints_acceptedLines.mpr ⟨accepted hk m, m.isLt, hw⟩
  refine ⟨τ.trans π, dirs', fun m => ?_, fun m => ?_, fun m hm => ?_, fun m m' hm hm' hne => ?_⟩
  · funext jj
    rcases accepted_or_pending (hk := hk) m with ⟨m', rfl⟩ | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · simp only [label, next_accepted, Equiv.trans_apply, hτa]
      exact congrFun (hlabel _) jj
    · simp only [label, next_pending, Equiv.trans_apply, hτp, hsorted, enriched, labelBit]
      rw [show Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd (ℓ * b + s * (ℓ * b)) jj) =
          Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd (ℓ * b + s * (ℓ * b)) jj) from rfl, Fin.append_right,
        Fin.append_left]
      exact congrFun (hlabel _) jj
  · funext β
    rcases accepted_or_pending (hk := hk) m with ⟨m', rfl⟩ | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · simp only [target, next_accepted, Equiv.trans_apply, hτa]
      exact congrFun (htarget _) β
    · simp only [target, next_pending, Equiv.trans_apply, hτp, hsorted, enriched, targetBit]
      rw [Fin.append_right, Fin.append_right, Fin.append_left]
      exact congrFun (htarget _) β
  · rcases hnew_acc m hm with ⟨m', rfl⟩ | ⟨j, rfl, hj⟩
    · rw [hda]
      refine ⟨(hline _ m'.isLt).1, fun c => ?_⟩
      funext β
      simp only [line, next_accepted, Equiv.trans_apply, hτa]
      exact congrFun ((hline _ m'.isLt).2 c) β
    · rw [hdp]
      refine ⟨hmenu.1 e (σ j), fun c => ?_⟩
      funext β
      simp only [line, next_pending, Equiv.trans_apply, hτp, hsorted, enriched, lineBit]
      rw [Fin.append_right, Fin.append_right, Fin.append_right, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hnew,
        candidate_eq bits scalar menu htarget]
  · simp only [Equiv.trans_apply]
    rcases hnew_acc m hm with ⟨m₁, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, rfl, hj⟩ <;>
      rcases hnew_acc m' hm' with ⟨m₂, rfl⟩ | ⟨j', rfl, hj'⟩
    · rw [hτa, hτa, hda, hda]
      exact hdisj _ _ m₁.isLt m₂.isLt hne
    · rw [hτa, hτp, hda, hdp]
      exact ((hfront j' hj').1.mono_right (hsub m₁)).symm
    · rw [hτp, hτa, hdp, hda]
      exact (hfront j hj).1.mono_right (hsub m₂)
    · rw [hτp, hτp, hdp, hdp]
      exact (hfront j hj).2 (σ j') fun h => hne (by rw [σ.injective h])

private theorem synthesis_occupied (hin : inputs _ ⊆ src)
    (hcand : (Set.range fun q : Fin r × Fin (arity p) × Fin s × Fin (ℓ * b) =>
      fun x => candidate hk bits scalar menu x q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2.1 q.2.2.2) ⊆ src) :
    Synthesis interpretation src
      (Set.range fun q : Fin r × Fin (arity p) × Fin s =>
        fun x => occupied hk bits scalar menu x q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      (48 * (r * arity p * s + a * s + 1) * (Nat.clog 2 (r * arity p * s + a * s) + 1) ^ 2 *
        (ℓ * b + 1 + 1)) := by
  classical
  let ι := (Fin a × Fin s × Fin (ℓ * b)) ⊕ (Fin r × Fin (arity p) × Fin s × Fin (ℓ * b))
  let eι := Fintype.equivFin ι
  let eS := Fintype.equivFin (Fin a × Fin s)
  let eQ := Fintype.equivFin (Fin r × Fin (arity p) × Fin s)
  let g : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → BooleanFunction (2 ^ D * width D (ℓ * b) s) := fun w =>
    Sum.elim (fun q x => x (finProdFinEquiv (accepted hk q.1, lineBit q.2.1 q.2.2)))
      (fun q x => candidate hk bits scalar menu x q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2.1 q.2.2.2) (eι.symm w)
  have hg : ∀ w, g w ∈ src := by
    intro w
    rcases h : eι.symm w with q | q
    · simp only [g, h, Sum.elim_inl]
      exact hin ⟨_, rfl⟩
    · simp only [g, h, Sum.elim_inr]
      exact hcand ⟨q, rfl⟩
  let sourceKeys : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin a × Fin s)) → Fin (ℓ * b) →
      Fin (Fintype.card ι) ⊕ Bool :=
    fun q β => .inl (eι (.inl ((eS.symm q).1, (eS.symm q).2, β)))
  let sourceValues : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin a × Fin s)) → Fin 1 →
      Fin (Fintype.card ι) ⊕ Bool := fun _ _ => .inr true
  let queryKeys : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin r × Fin (arity p) × Fin s)) → Fin (ℓ * b) →
      Fin (Fintype.card ι) ⊕ Bool :=
    fun q β => .inl (eι (.inr ((eQ.symm q).1, (eQ.symm q).2.1, (eQ.symm q).2.2, β)))
  refine (Synthesis.circuit (batchOrCircuit sourceKeys sourceValues queryKeys) g hg).mono
    Set.Subset.rfl ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨⟨e, i, c⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨finProdFinEquiv (eQ (e, i, c), 0), funext fun x => Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    beta_reduce
    have hsk (q : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin a × Fin s))) :
        substitute (sourceKeys q) (fun w => g w x) =
          line x (accepted hk (eS.symm q).1) (eS.symm q).2 := by
      funext β
      simp only [substitute, sourceKeys, g, Sum.elim_inl, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, line]
    have hqk : substitute (queryKeys (eQ (e, i, c))) (fun w => g w x) =
        candidate hk bits scalar menu x e i c := by
      funext β
      simp only [substitute, queryKeys, g, Sum.elim_inr, Sum.elim_inl, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have hsv (q : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin a × Fin s))) :
        substitute (sourceValues q) (fun w => g w x) 0 = true := rfl
    rw [eval_batchOrCircuit_iff, occupied, decide_eq_true_iff]
    simp only [hsk, hqk, hsv, and_true]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
      exact ⟨(eS.symm q).1, (eS.symm q).2, hq⟩
    · rintro ⟨m, c', hm⟩
      exact ⟨eS (m, c'), by simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hm⟩
  · refine (size_batchOrCircuit_le sourceKeys sourceValues queryKeys).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.mul_assoc]

    Synthesis interpretation src
      (Set.range fun q : Fin r × Fin (arity p) × Fin s =>
        fun x => duplicate hk bits scalar menu x q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      (r * ((duplicateFlagsCircuit (id : Fin (ℓ * b + 1) → Fin (ℓ * b + 1))
        (Nat.clog 2 (arity p * s))).size + 2)) := by
  classical
  let d := Nat.clog 2 (arity p * s)
  let pad := arity d - arity p * s
  have hpad : arity p * s + pad = arity d := by
    have : arity p * s ≤ arity d := by
      rw [arity_eq_two_pow d]
      exact Nat.le_pow_clog Nat.one_lt_two _
    lia
  let ι := Fin (arity p) × Fin s × Fin (ℓ * b)
  let eι := Fintype.equivFin ι
  let slot : Fin (arity p) × Fin s → Fin (arity d) :=
    fun ic => Fin.cast hpad (Fin.castAdd pad (finProdFinEquiv ic))
  let ρ : Fin (arity d * (ℓ * b + 1)) → Fin (Fintype.card ι) ⊕ Bool := fun q =>
    Fin.addCases (motive := fun _ => Fin (Fintype.card ι) ⊕ Bool)
      (fun j => Fin.cases (.inr false) (fun β => .inl (eι ((finProdFinEquiv.symm j).1,
        (finProdFinEquiv.symm j).2, β))) (finProdFinEquiv.symm q).2)
      (fun _ => Fin.cases (.inr true) (fun _ => .inr false) (finProdFinEquiv.symm q).2)
      (Fin.cast hpad.symm (finProdFinEquiv.symm q).1)
  let circuit := (duplicateFlagsCircuit (id : Fin (ℓ * b + 1) → Fin (ℓ * b + 1)) d).comp
    (substituteCircuit ρ)
  have hentry (e : Fin r) : Synthesis interpretation src
      (Set.range fun q : Fin (arity p) × Fin s =>
        fun x => duplicate hk bits scalar menu x e q.1 q.2)
      ((duplicateFlagsCircuit (id : Fin (ℓ * b + 1) → Fin (ℓ * b + 1)) d).size + 2) := by
    let g : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → BooleanFunction (2 ^ D * width D (ℓ * b) s) := fun w x =>
      candidate hk bits scalar menu x e (eι.symm w).1 (eι.symm w).2.1 (eι.symm w).2.2
    refine (Synthesis.circuit circuit g fun w => hcand ⟨(e, eι.symm w), rfl⟩).mono
      Set.Subset.rfl ?_ (by simp only [circuit, Circuit.size_comp, size_substituteCircuit]; lia)
    rintro _ ⟨⟨i, c⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨slot (i, c), funext fun x => Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    let y : BitString (Fintype.card ι) := fun w => g w x
    -- The records seen by the duplicate circuit.
    let row := directProductInput (substitute ρ y)
    have hreal (i' : Fin (arity p)) (c' : Fin s) :
        row (slot (i', c')) = Fin.cons false (candidate hk bits scalar menu x e i' c') := by
      funext f
      simp only [row, directProductInput, substitute, ρ, slot, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
        Fin.cast_cast, Fin.cast_eq_self, Fin.addCases_left]
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun β => ?_) f
      · simp only [Fin.cases_zero, Fin.cons_zero, Sum.elim_inr, id]
      · simp only [Fin.cases_succ, Fin.cons_succ, Sum.elim_inl, y, g, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have hpadRow (j : Fin pad) : row (Fin.cast hpad (Fin.natAdd _ j)) 0 = true := by
      simp only [row, directProductInput, substitute, ρ, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
        Fin.cast_cast, Fin.cast_eq_self, Fin.addCases_right, Fin.cases_zero, Sum.elim_inr, id]
    simp only [circuit, Circuit.eval_comp, eval_substituteCircuit]
    rw [eval_duplicateFlagsCircuit_iff, duplicate, decide_eq_true_iff]
    simp only [Function.comp_id]
    change (∃ j, j ≠ slot (i, c) ∧ row j = row (slot (i, c))) ↔ _
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, hne, heq⟩
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := (finCongr hpad).surjective j
      induction j using Fin.addCases with
      | left j =>
        obtain ⟨⟨i', c'⟩, rfl⟩ := finProdFinEquiv.surjective j
        change slot (i', c') ≠ slot (i, c) at hne
        change row (slot (i', c')) = row (slot (i, c)) at heq
        rw [hreal, hreal] at heq
        exact ⟨i', c', fun h => hne (congrArg slot h), funext fun β => congrFun heq β.succ⟩
      | right j =>
        have := congrFun heq 0
        rw [show (finCongr hpad) (Fin.natAdd _ j) = Fin.cast hpad (Fin.natAdd _ j) from rfl,
          hpadRow, hreal] at this
        exact absurd this (by simp)
    · rintro ⟨i', c', hne, heq⟩
      refine ⟨slot (i', c'), fun h => hne ?_, by rw [hreal, hreal, heq]⟩
      exact finProdFinEquiv.injective (Fin.castAdd_injective _ _ (Fin.cast_injective hpad h))
  refine (Synthesis.iUnion _ _ hentry).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ (le_of_eq ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨⟨e, i, c⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, ⟨(i, c), rfl⟩⟩
  · simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
    rfl

private theorem synthesis_success
    (hclean : (Set.range fun q : Fin r × Fin (arity p) =>
      fun x => clean hk bits scalar menu x q.1 q.2) ⊆ src) :
    Synthesis interpretation src
      (Set.range fun e : Fin r => fun x => success hk bits scalar menu x e)
      (r * (bitonicSortCircuit (id : Fin 1 → Fin 1) p false).size) := by
  have hpos : 0 < arity p := by
    rw [arity_eq_two_pow]
    exact Nat.two_pow_pos p
  let j₀ : Fin (arity p) := ⟨(arity p + 1) / 2 - 1, by lia⟩
  have hentry (e : Fin r) : Synthesis interpretation src
      (Set.range fun _ : Unit => fun x => success hk bits scalar menu x e)
      (bitonicSortCircuit (id : Fin 1 → Fin 1) p false).size := by
    let g : Fin (arity p * 1) → BooleanFunction (2 ^ D * width D (ℓ * b) s) :=
      fun q x => clean hk bits scalar menu x e (finProdFinEquiv.symm q).1
    refine (Synthesis.circuit (bitonicSortCircuit id p false) g
      fun q => hclean ⟨(e, _), rfl⟩).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ le_rfl
    rintro _ ⟨-, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨finProdFinEquiv (j₀, 0), funext fun x => ?_⟩
    have h := congrFun (congrFun
      (eval_bitonicSortCircuit (id : Fin 1 → Fin 1) p false (fun q => g q x)) j₀) 0
    have hin : directProductInput (fun q => g q x) =
        fun i _ => clean hk bits scalar menu x e i := by
      funext i f
      simp only [directProductInput, g, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [hin] at h
    have hflag := sort_flag_eq_true_iff (fun r : BitString 1 => r ∘ id) p
      (fun i _ => clean hk bits scalar menu x e i) j₀
    change (bitonicSortCircuit id p false).eval interpretation (fun q => g q x)
      (finProdFinEquiv (j₀, 0)) = success hk bits scalar menu x e
    rw [show (bitonicSortCircuit id p false).eval interpretation (fun q => g q x)
      (finProdFinEquiv (j₀, 0)) = _ from h, Bool.eq_iff_iff, success, decide_eq_true_iff]
    refine hflag.trans ?_
    simp only [Function.comp_id, j₀]
    lia
  refine (Synthesis.iUnion _ _ hentry).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ (le_of_eq ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, ⟨(), rfl⟩⟩
  · simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]

private theorem synthesis_chosen
    (hsucc : (Set.range fun e : Fin r => fun x => success hk bits scalar menu x e) ⊆ src) :
    Synthesis interpretation src
      (Set.range fun e : Fin r => fun x => chosen hk bits scalar menu x e) (3 * r) := by
  let F : Fin r → BooleanFunction (2 ^ D * width D (ℓ * b) s) :=
    fun e x => success hk bits scalar menu x e
  have hpre := Synthesis.prefixOr F fun e => hsucc ⟨e, rfl⟩
  refine (hpre.trans (Synthesis.family _ (fun _ => 2) fun e => ?_)).mono Set.Subset.rfl
    Set.Subset.rfl (le_of_eq ?_)
  · have hF : F e ∈ src ∪ Set.range fun e : Fin r => Boolean.prefixOr F e.val :=
      Or.inl (hsucc ⟨e, rfl⟩)
    rcases he : e.val with _ | j
    · have : (fun x => chosen hk bits scalar menu x e) = F e := by
        funext x
        rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, chosen, decide_eq_true_iff]
        refine ⟨And.left, fun h => ⟨h, fun e' he' => ?_⟩⟩
        have := Fin.lt_def.mp he'
        lia
      rw [this]
      exact (Synthesis.of_mem hF).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl (Nat.zero_le 2)
    · have hj : j < r := by have := e.isLt; lia
      have hP : Boolean.prefixOr F j ∈
          src ∪ Set.range fun e : Fin r => Boolean.prefixOr F e.val :=
        Or.inr ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, rfl⟩
      have : (fun x => chosen hk bits scalar menu x e) =
          fun x => F e x && !Boolean.prefixOr F j x := by
        funext x
        rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, chosen, decide_eq_true_iff, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true',
          Boolean.prefixOr, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
        simp only [not_exists, not_and, Bool.not_eq_true, F]
        refine and_congr Iff.rfl ⟨fun h e' he' => h e' (Fin.lt_def.mpr (by lia)),
          fun h e' he' => h e' (by have := Fin.lt_def.mp he'; lia)⟩
      rw [this]
      exact (Synthesis.of_mem hF).and (Synthesis.of_mem hP).not
  · simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
    lia

    ∃ c : Circuit signature (2 ^ D * width D (ℓ * b) s) (2 ^ D * width D (ℓ * b) s),
      c.Computes interpretation (next hk bits scalar menu) ∧
        c.size ≤ phaseCost D (ℓ * b) s p a r := by

    Set.subset_union_right)

    (by intro _ h; simp only [Set.mem_union]; tauto))
  have h4 := h3.comp (synthesis_clean hk bits scalar menu
    (by intro _ h; simp only [Set.mem_union]; tauto)
    (by intro _ h; simp only [Set.mem_union]; tauto))
  have h5 := h4.comp (synthesis_success hk bits scalar menu
    (by intro _ h; simp only [Set.mem_union]; tauto))
  have h6 := h5.comp (synthesis_chosen hk bits scalar menu
    (by intro _ h; simp only [Set.mem_union]; tauto))

    (by intro _ h; simp only [Set.mem_union]; tauto)
    (by intro _ h; simp only [Set.mem_union]; tauto))

    (by intro _ h; simp only [Set.mem_union]; tauto))

    (by intro _ h; simp only [Set.mem_union]; tauto)
    (by intro _ h; simp only [Set.mem_union]; tauto)
    (by intro _ h; simp only [Set.mem_union]; tauto))

theorem sortedByLabel_rank {x : BitString (2 ^ D * width D L s)} (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2 ^ D)))
    (hlabel : ∀ m, label x m = encode D (π m)) (i : Fin (2 ^ D)) :
    sortedByLabel x (Fin.cast (BitonicSort.arity_eq_two_pow D).symm (rank i)) =
      fun f => x (finProdFinEquiv (π.symm i, f)) := by
  have h2 := BitonicSort.arity_eq_two_pow D
  let input : Fin (BitonicSort.arity D) → BitString (width D L s) :=
    fun j f => x (finProdFinEquiv (Fin.cast h2 j, f))
  let key : BitString (width D L s) → Lex (Fin D → Bool) := fun record => toLex (record ∘ labelBit)
  have hkey (j : Fin (BitonicSort.arity D)) :
      key (input j) = toLex (encode D (π (Fin.cast h2 j))) :=
    congrArg toLex (hlabel (Fin.cast h2 j))
  let source := Fin.cast h2.symm (π.symm i)
  have hsource : π (Fin.cast h2 source) = i := by simp [source]
  refine List.Perm.apply_ofFn_eq_of_rank (BitonicSort.sort_perm key D true input).symm key
    (BitonicSort.monotone_sort key D input) source _ (fun j hj => ?_) ?_
  · rw [hkey, hkey, hsource] at hj
    have h' : π (Fin.cast h2 j) = i := encode_injective (toLex_inj.mp hj)
    apply Fin.cast_injective h2
    rw [show Fin.cast h2 source = π.symm i by simp [source], ← h', Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  · simp only [Fin.val_cast, rank, hkey, hsource]
    exact card_equiv ((finCongr h2).trans π) fun j => by
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Equiv.trans_apply, finCongr_apply]
      exact Iff.rfl

theorem complexity_directProduct_two_pow_le {p m L H : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ g : BooleanFunction m, complexity interpretation (directProduct g 1) ≤ L) :
    ∀ (d n : ℕ), n = d * p + m → (∀ e < d, layerOverhead p (e * p + m) ≤ H) →
      ∀ f : BooleanFunction n, complexity interpretation (directProduct f (2 ^ d)) ≤
        (2 ^ p + 1) ^ d * (L + d * 2 ^ d * H) := by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro n hn _ f
    obtain rfl : n = m := by simpa using hn
    simpa using hL f
  | succ d ih =>
    intro n hn hH f
    obtain rfl : n = p + (d * p + m) := by rw [hn]; ring
    have hlayer := complexity_directProduct_two_mul_le (t := 2 ^ d)
      (ih (d * p + m) rfl fun e he => hH e (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt he)) f
    rw [show 2 ^ (d + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ d from pow_succ' 2 d]
    refine hlayer.trans ?_
    have hHd := hH d (Nat.lt_succ_self d)
    rw [pow_succ']
    have hApos : 0 < (2 ^ p + 1) ^ d := by positivity
    generalize (2 ^ p + 1) ^ d = A at *
    generalize 2 ^ d = T at *
    have hK : 1 ≤ 2 ^ p + 1 := Nat.le_add_left 1 _
    generalize 2 ^ p + 1 = K at *
    have hKA : 1 ≤ K * A := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega))
    calc K * (A * (L + d * T * H)) + T * layerOverhead p (d * p + m)
        ≤ K * (A * (L + d * T * H)) + K * A * (T * H) := by
          refine Nat.add_le_add_left ?_ _
          calc T * layerOverhead p (d * p + m) ≤ 1 * (T * H) := by
                rw [one_mul]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hHd
            _ ≤ K * A * (T * H) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hKA
      _ = K * A * (L + (d + 1) * T * H) := by ring
      _ ≤ K * A * (L + (d + 1) * (2 * T) * H) := by gcongr; omega

/-! ### Asymptotics -/

/-- Lupanov's bound for single copies, without denominators: for every precision `Q`,
eventually `Q * m * size ≤ (Q + 1) * 2 ^ m` for every function on `m` inputs. -/

theorem mul_complexity_directProduct_le {P X n d p m : ℕ}
    (hX : 2 * P * (X + 1) ^ 3 ≤ (2 * P + 1) * X ^ 3) (hX0 : 0 < X)
    (hnm : n = d * p + m) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdp : (X + 1) * (d * p) ≤ n) (hd : (X + 1) * d ≤ 2 ^ p)
    (hL : ∀ g : BooleanFunction m,
      X * m * complexity interpretation (single g) ≤ (X + 1) * 2 ^ m)
    (hH : 4 * P * n * layerOverhead p n * 2 ^ (p * d + (d + d)) ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (f : BooleanFunction n) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ 2 ^ d) :
    P * n * complexity interpretation (directProduct f k) ≤ (P + 1) * 2 ^ n := by
  -- Single copies on `m` inputs.
  set L := (X + 1) * 2 ^ m / (X * m) with hLdef
  have hXm : 0 < X * m := Nat.mul_pos hX0 hm
  have hL' : ∀ g : BooleanFunction m, complexity interpretation (directProduct g 1) ≤ L :=
    fun g => complexity_directProduct_one_le.trans <| (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hXm).mpr <| by
      calc complexity interpretation (single g) * (X * m) =
            X * m * complexity interpretation (single g) := by ring
        _ ≤ (X + 1) * 2 ^ m := hL g
  have hLspec : X * m * L ≤ (X + 1) * 2 ^ m := by
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
  -- `d` layers.
  set H := layerOverhead p n with hHdef
  have hH' : ∀ e < d, layerOverhead p (e * p + m) ≤ H := fun e he =>
    layerOverhead_mono (by have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right p he.le; omega)
  have hT := complexity_directProduct_two_pow_le hL' d n hnm hH' f
  have hmono := complexity_directProduct_mono (I := interpretation) (f := f) hk
  set K := 2 ^ p + 1 with hKdef
  have h2n : 2 ^ n = 2 ^ (p * d) * 2 ^ m := by rw [← pow_add, hnm, mul_comm d p]
  have hKX : X * K ^ d ≤ (X + 1) * 2 ^ (p * d) := by
    have := Nat.mul_add_one_pow_le (R := X) (M := 2 ^ p) (d := d) hd
    rwa [← pow_mul] at this
  have hK1 : K ^ d ≤ 2 * 2 ^ (p * d) := by
    have := Nat.mul_add_one_pow_le (R := 1) (M := 2 ^ p) (d := d)
      (le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right d (by omega : 1 + 1 ≤ X + 1)) hd)
    rw [← pow_mul, ← hKdef] at this
    omega
  have hXn : X * n ≤ (X + 1) * m := by
    generalize hD : d * p = D at hnm hdp
    have e1 : X * n = X * D + X * m := by rw [hnm]; ring
    have e2 : (X + 1) * D = X * D + D := by ring
    have e3 : (X + 1) * m = X * m + m := by ring
    omega
  -- The leading term.
  have main : 2 * P * n * (K ^ d * L) ≤ (2 * P + 1) * 2 ^ n := by
    have h3 : X ^ 3 * (n * K ^ d * L) ≤ (X + 1) ^ 3 * 2 ^ n := by
      refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ hm
      calc X ^ 3 * (n * K ^ d * L) * m = (X * n) * (X * K ^ d) * (X * m * L) := by ring
        _ ≤ ((X + 1) * m) * ((X + 1) * 2 ^ (p * d)) * ((X + 1) * 2 ^ m) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul hXn hKX) hLspec
        _ = (X + 1) ^ 3 * 2 ^ n * m := by rw [h2n]; ring
    refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (show 0 < X ^ 3 by positivity)
    calc X ^ 3 * (2 * P * n * (K ^ d * L)) = 2 * P * (X ^ 3 * (n * K ^ d * L)) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * P * ((X + 1) ^ 3 * 2 ^ n) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h3
      _ = 2 * P * (X + 1) ^ 3 * 2 ^ n := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 * P + 1) * X ^ 3 * 2 ^ n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hX
      _ = X ^ 3 * ((2 * P + 1) * 2 ^ n) := by ring
  -- The overhead.
  have over : 2 * P * n * (K ^ d * (d * 2 ^ d * H)) ≤ 2 ^ n := by
    have hd2 : d * 2 ^ d ≤ 2 ^ d * 2 ^ d := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le
    calc 2 * P * n * (K ^ d * (d * 2 ^ d * H))
        ≤ 2 * P * n * ((2 * 2 ^ (p * d)) * (2 ^ d * 2 ^ d * H)) := by gcongr
      _ = 4 * P * n * H * 2 ^ (p * d + (d + d)) := by rw [pow_add, pow_add]; ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ n := hH
  calc P * n * complexity interpretation (directProduct f k)
      ≤ P * n * (K ^ d * (L + d * 2 ^ d * H)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (hmono.trans hT)
    _ ≤ (P + 1) * 2 ^ n := by
      have e1 : 2 * (P * n * (K ^ d * (L + d * 2 ^ d * H))) =
          2 * P * n * (K ^ d * L) + 2 * P * n * (K ^ d * (d * 2 ^ d * H)) := by ring
      have e2 : 2 * ((P + 1) * 2 ^ n) = (2 * P + 1) * 2 ^ n + 2 ^ n := by ring
      omega

/-- **Uhlig's theorem** for circuit size. If `d(n) log₂ n = o(n)`, then for every precision `P`,
eventually every function on `n` inputs has `k ≤ 2 ^ d(n)` independent copies of size `s` with
`P * n * s ≤ (P + 1) * 2 ^ n`: for `P > 0`, at most `(1 + 1 / P) 2 ^ n / n`. The case `P = 0`
holds trivially. Prefixes have `2 log₂ n + 2` bits. -/

theorem eventually_mul_complexity_directProduct_le {depth : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hdepth : IsUhligDepth depth) (P : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ (f : BooleanFunction n) (k : ℕ), k ≤ 2 ^ depth n →
      P * n * complexity interpretation (directProduct f k) ≤ (P + 1) * 2 ^ n := by
  set X := 8 * (P + 1) with hXdef
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (eventually_mul_complexity_single_le X)
  filter_upwards [hdepth (4 * (X + 1)), eventually_overhead_le P,

theorem sum_first_code_route {Z : Type*} {h : Z → ℕ → Bool} {M a : ℕ}
    (hM : ∀ z, h z M = false) (ha : a < M) (b : ℕ) (z z' : Z) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (M + 1), (first a b j && code (h (if first a b j then z else z')) j) =
      h z a := by
  rw [← sum_first_code (hM z) ha b]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by cases first a b j <;> rfl

    ∑ j ∈ range (M + 1), (second a b j && code (h (if first a b j then z else z')) j) =

      cases hf : first a b j

theorem decoded_eq (f : BooleanFunction (p + w)) (s : Fin 2) (i : Fin t)
    (x : BitString (2 * t * (p + w))) (y : BitString (2 * t * (p + w) + (2 ^ p + 1) * t))
    (hx : y ∘ Fin.castAdd _ = x)
    (hy : ∀ j : Fin (2 ^ p + 1), y (Fin.natAdd _ (finProdFinEquiv (j, i))) =
      resource f j (if first (rank x (pairCopy 0 i)) (rank x (pairCopy 1 i)) j then
        directProductInput x (pairCopy 0 i) ∘ Fin.natAdd p
      else directProductInput x (pairCopy 1 i) ∘ Fin.natAdd p)) :
    decoded s i y = f (directProductInput x (pairCopy s i)) := by
  have hrank (c : Fin (2 * t)) : rank x c < 2 ^ p := Fin.is_lt _
  simp only [decoded] at hy ⊢
  rw [← Function.comp_assoc, hx]
  simp only [pairSelect_comp_pairWires, hy, resource]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => ![first, second] s (rank x (pairCopy 0 i))
    (rank x (pairCopy 1 i)) j && code (restriction f (if first (rank x (pairCopy 0 i))
      (rank x (pairCopy 1 i)) j then directProductInput x (pairCopy 0 i) ∘ Fin.natAdd p
    else directProductInput x (pairCopy 1 i) ∘ Fin.natAdd p)) j)]
  match s with
  | 0 =>
    rw [Matrix.cons_val_zero, sum_first_code_route (restriction_two_pow f) (hrank _)]
    exact restriction_equivFin f _
  | 1 =>
    change ∑ j ∈ range _, (second _ _ j && _) = _
    rw [sum_second_code_route (restriction_two_pow f) (hrank _)]
    exact restriction_equivFin f _

/-- **One layer of Uhlig's construction.** If every function on `w` inputs has `t`
independent copies of size at most `B`, then every function on `p + w` inputs has `2 t`
independent copies of size at most `(2 ^ p + 1) * B + t * layerOverhead p w`. -/

theorem complexity_directProduct_two_mul_le {B : ℕ}
    (hB : ∀ g : BooleanFunction w, complexity interpretation (directProduct g t) ≤ B)
    (f : BooleanFunction (p + w)) :
    complexity interpretation (directProduct f (2 * t)) ≤
      (2 ^ p + 1) * B + t * layerOverhead p w := by
  -- The front passes the inputs through and routes suffixes to the resource bank.
  let front : Fin (2 * t * (p + w) + (2 ^ p + 1) * (t * w)) →
      BooleanFunction (2 * t * (p + w)) :=
    Fin.append (fun l x => x l) fun q x =>
      routedBit (finProdFinEquiv.symm q).1 (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv.symm q).2).1
        (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv.symm q).2).2 x
  obtain ⟨cFront, hcFront, hsFront⟩ := Synthesis.exists_circuit_outputs
    (Synthesis.family front (Fin.append (fun _ => 0) fun _ => 2 * selectorCost p + 4)
      (Fin.addCases (fun l => by
          simpa [front] using Synthesis.of_mem (I := interpretation)
            (s := inputs (2 * t * (p + w))) (f := fun x => x l) ⟨l, rfl⟩)
        fun q => by simpa [front] using synthesis_routedBit _ _ _))
  -- The bank evaluates `t` copies of every resource.
  choose bank hbank hsBank using fun j : Fin (2 ^ p + 1) =>
    complexity_le_iff.mp (hB (resource f j))
  -- The decoder sums each copy's resources.
  obtain ⟨cDec, hcDec, hsDec⟩ := Synthesis.exists_circuit_outputs
    (Synthesis.family (fun c => decoded (finProdFinEquiv.symm c).1 (finProdFinEquiv.symm c).2)
      (fun _ => (2 ^ p + 1) * (selectorCost p + 5) + 1) fun c => synthesis_decoded _ _)
  let layer := cDec.comp
    (((Circuit.id signature _).parallel (Circuit.parallelFamily bank)).comp cFront)
  refine complexity_le_iff.mpr ⟨layer, fun x => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hfront : cFront.eval interpretation x = Fin.append x fun q =>
        routedBit (finProdFinEquiv.symm q).1 (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv.symm q).2).1
          (finProdFinEquiv.symm (finProdFinEquiv.symm q).2).2 x := by
      rw [hcFront x]
      funext l
      refine Fin.addCases (fun l => ?_) (fun q => ?_) l <;> simp [front]
    funext c
    obtain ⟨⟨s, i⟩, rfl⟩ := finProdFinEquiv.surjective c
    simp only [layer, Circuit.eval_comp, hcDec _, hfront, Circuit.eval_parallel,
      Fin.append_comp_castAdd, Fin.append_comp_natAdd, Circuit.eval_wiring, Function.comp_id,
      Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    refine decoded_eq f s i x _ (by simp) fun j => ?_
    rw [Fin.append_right, Circuit.eval_parallelFamily_apply, hbank j]
    simp only [directProduct, resource]
    congr 2
    funext k
    simp only [directProductInput, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, routedBit]
    split <;> rfl
  · have hbankSize : ∑ j, (bank j).size ≤ (2 ^ p + 1) * B := by
      simpa using Finset.sum_le_sum fun j (_ : j ∈ univ) => hsBank j
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, sum_const, card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, zero_add] at hsFront hsDec
    simp only [layer, Circuit.size_comp, Circuit.size_parallel, Circuit.size_parallelFamily,
      Circuit.size_wiring, zero_add]
    refine (Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add hsFront hbankSize) hsDec).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    unfold layerOverhead
    ring

      (size_modMultCircuit_le q _).trans ?_).trans_eq
      (by rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, size_multCircuit])

theorem IsUseful.eventually_lt_complexity (hC : IsUseful Λ C) {s : ℕ → ℕ} (hΛ : SIZE s ⊆ Λ)
    (hs : ∀ n, 1 ≤ s n) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ f ∈ C n, s n < complexity interpretation (single f) := by
  classical
  by_contra h
  rw [not_eventually] at h
  -- a language choosing, wherever possible, a function in `C n` with at most `s n` gates
  let g : ∀ n, BooleanFunction n := fun n =>
    if h : ∃ f ∈ C n, complexity interpretation (single f) ≤ s n then h.choose else fun _ => false
  have hg : Language.ofSlices g ∈ SIZE s := fun n => by
    rw [Language.slice_ofSlices]
    by_cases h : ∃ f ∈ C n, complexity interpretation (single f) ≤ s n
    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_left h] using h.choose_spec.2
    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right h] using (Synthesis.const false).complexity_le.trans (hs n)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hgn⟩ := (h.and_eventually (hC _ (hΛ hg))).exists
  have hex : ∃ f ∈ C n, complexity interpretation (single f) ≤ s n := by
    simpa only [not_forall, not_lt, exists_prop] using hn
  rw [Language.slice_ofSlices] at hgn
  exact hgn (by simpa only [g, dite_eq_left hex] using hex.choose_spec.1)

theorem exists_complexity_truthTableTest_le (hC : truthTableLanguage C ∈ PPoly) :
    ∃ c, ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → complexity interpretation (single (truthTableTest (C n))) ≤ 2 ^ (c * n) := by
  obtain ⟨a, d, h⟩ := polynomiallyBounded_iff_le.1 hC

private theorem four_mul_card_le_of_gate {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ 2) (φ : (Fin k → Bool) → Bool)
    {F : Formula σ n} {args : Fin k → Formula σ n} {Y : Finset (Fin n)}
    (hF : ∀ x, F.eval I x = φ fun j => (args j).eval I x)
    (hl : F.leafSizeIn Y = ∑ j, (args j).leafSizeIn Y) (h0 : F.leafSizeIn Y ≠ 0)
    (ih : ∀ j, 4 * #(unaryClosure (subfunctions ((args j).eval I) Y)) ≤
      max 8 (16 ^ (args j).leafSizeIn Y)) :
    4 * #(unaryClosure (subfunctions (F.eval I) Y)) ≤ max 8 (16 ^ F.leafSizeIn Y) :=
  match k, hk, φ, args, hF, hl, ih with
  | 0, _, _, _, _, hl, _ => absurd (by simpa using hl) h0
  | 1, _, φ, args, hF, hl, ih => by
    have hsub : subfunctions (F.eval I) Y ⊆ unaryClosure (subfunctions ((args 0).eval I) Y) :=
      fun g hg => by
        obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := mem_subfunctions.1 hg
        have : (fun x => F.eval I (Y.piecewise x z)) =
            (fun b => φ fun _ => b) ∘ fun x => (args 0).eval I (Y.piecewise x z) :=
          funext fun x => (hF _).trans (congrArg φ (funext fun j => by rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero j]))
        rw [this]
        exact comp_mem_unaryClosure _ (mem_subfunctions.2 ⟨z, rfl⟩)
    rw [hl, Fin.sum_univ_one]
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 (card_le_card (unaryClosure_subset hsub))).trans (ih 0)
  | 2, _, φ, args, hF, hl, ih =>
    four_mul_card_le_of_binary (fun b c => φ ![b, c])
      (fun x => (hF x).trans (congrArg φ (funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨rfl, rfl⟩))))
      (hl.trans (Fin.sum_univ_two _)) (ih 0) (ih 1)
  | _ + 3, hk, _, _, _, _, _ => absurd hk (by omega)

of a formula with `l` leaves in `Y` number at most `2` if `l = 0` and `16 ^ l / 4` otherwise. -/

private theorem four_mul_card_unaryClosure_le (harity : ∀ op, σ.Arity op ≤ 2) (F : Formula σ n)
    (Y : Finset (Fin n)) :
    4 * #(unaryClosure (subfunctions (F.eval I) Y)) ≤ max 8 (16 ^ F.leafSizeIn Y) := by
  by_cases h0 : F.leafSizeIn Y = 0
  · have := card_unaryClosure_le_two (S := subfunctions (F.eval I) Y) fun g hg =>
      isConst_of_mem_subfunctions h0 hg
    exact (show 4 * _ ≤ 8 by omega).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  induction F with
  | input i =>
    have hi : i ∈ Y := by simpa using h0
    have : subfunctions ((Formula.input i).eval I) Y = {fun x => x i} := by
      ext g
      simp only [mem_subfunctions, Formula.eval_input, mem_singleton]
      exact ⟨fun ⟨z, hz⟩ => hz ▸ funext fun x => by simp [hi],
        fun hg => ⟨fun _ => false, hg ▸ funext fun x => by simp [hi]⟩⟩
    have h := card_unaryClosure_le (subfunctions ((Formula.input i).eval I) Y)
    rw [this, card_singleton] at h
    rw [this]
    refine le_max_of_le_right ?_
    simp only [Formula.leafSizeIn_input, hi, ↓reduceIte, pow_one]
    omega
  | gate op args ih =>
    refine four_mul_card_le_of_gate (harity op) (I op) (fun x => rfl) rfl h0 fun j => ?_
    by_cases hj : (args j).leafSizeIn Y = 0
    · have := card_unaryClosure_le_two (S := subfunctions ((args j).eval I) Y) fun g hg =>
        isConst_of_mem_subfunctions hj hg
      exact (show 4 * _ ≤ 8 by omega).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact ih j hj

theorem four_mul_card_subfunctions_le (harity : ∀ op, σ.Arity op ≤ 2) (I : Interpretation σ Bool)
    (F : Formula σ n) {Y : Finset (Fin n)} (hl : F.leafSizeIn Y ≠ 0) :
    4 * #(subfunctions (F.eval I) Y) ≤ 16 ^ F.leafSizeIn Y := by

theorem Formula.depth_nnf_le (F : Formula signature n) (b : Bool) :
    (F.nnf b).depth ≤ F.depthWith binaryCost + 1 := by
  induction F generalizing b with
  | input i => cases b <;> simp [nnf, Formula.not]
  | gate op args ih =>
    cases op with
    | const c => simp [nnf, Formula.const]
    | not => simpa [nnf] using ih 0 !b
    | and | or =>
      have h₀ := (ih 0 b).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right
        (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (args j).depthWith binaryCost) (Finset.mem_univ 0)) 1)
      have h₁ := (ih 1 b).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right
        (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (args j).depthWith binaryCost) (Finset.mem_univ 1)) 1)
      cases b <;> simp only [nnf, ← depthWith_one, depthWith_and, depthWith_or] <;>
        simp only [depthWith_one, depthWith_gate, binaryCost_and, binaryCost_or, Pi.one_apply] <;>
        exact Nat.add_le_add_right (max_le h₀ h₁) 1

private theorem complexity_bigOp_le {m : ℕ} (all : Bool) :
    complexity interpretation (single fun y : Fin m → Bool =>
      if all then decide (∀ i, y i = true) else decide (∃ i, y i = true)) ≤ m + 1 := by
  have hin : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)),
      Synthesis interpretation (inputs m) {fun y : Fin m → Bool => y i} 0 :=
    fun i _ => Synthesis.of_mem ⟨i, rfl⟩
  cases all
  · obtain ⟨g, hg, hs⟩ := Synthesis.exists_exists_mem (m := m) Finset.univ _ (by simp) hin
    have : g = fun y => decide (∃ i, y i = true) :=
      funext fun y => Bool.eq_iff_iff.2 ((hg y).trans (by simp))
    simpa [this] using hs.complexity_le
  · obtain ⟨g, hg, hs⟩ := Synthesis.exists_forall_mem (m := m) Finset.univ _ (by simp) hin
    have : g = fun y => decide (∀ i, y i = true) :=

private theorem complexity_guess_le (f : BooleanFunction (n + p)) (all : Bool) :
    complexity interpretation (single fun x =>
      if all then forallGuess f x else existsGuess f x) ≤
      2 ^ p * (complexity interpretation (single f) + 3) + 1 := by
  have h := complexity_comp_le (I := interpretation)
    (fun x (i : Fin (2 ^ p)) => f (Fin.append x (guesses p i)))
    (single fun y : Fin (2 ^ p) → Bool =>
      if all then decide (∀ i, y i = true) else decide (∃ i, y i = true))
  have heq : (single fun y : Fin (2 ^ p) → Bool =>
        if all then decide (∀ i, y i = true) else decide (∃ i, y i = true)) ∘
      (fun x (i : Fin (2 ^ p)) => f (Fin.append x (guesses p i))) =
      single fun x => if all then forallGuess f x else existsGuess f x := by
    funext x j
    cases all
    · simp only [Function.comp_apply, single, existsGuess, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
      exact decide_eq_decide.2 ((guesses p).exists_congr_left.trans
        (by simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]))
    · simp only [Function.comp_apply, single, forallGuess, ite_true]
      exact decide_eq_decide.2 ((guesses p).forall_congr_left.trans
        (by simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]))
  rw [heq] at h
  have := complexity_guesses_le f
  have := complexity_bigOp_le (m := 2 ^ p) all
  calc _ ≤ _ := h
    _ ≤ 2 ^ p * (complexity interpretation (single f) + 2) + (2 ^ p + 1) := by omega
    _ = 2 ^ p * (complexity interpretation (single f) + 3) + 1 := by
      rw [mul_add, mul_add]
      omega

theorem size_inlineOracle_le (C : Circuit oracleSignature n m) (D : ∀ q, Circuit signature q 1)
    {r s : ℕ} (hC : C.FanInAtMost r) (hD : ∀ q ≤ r, (D q).size ≤ s) :
    (inlineOracle C D).size ≤ C.size * max 1 s := by
  rw [size_inlineOracle, Program.cost_eq_sum]
  have hfan := Program.fanInAtMost_iff.1 hC
  calc ∑ k, oracleSize D (C.program.lines k).op ≤ ∑ _k : Fin C.size, max 1 s := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
        have hk := hfan k

        cases (C.program.lines k).op with
        | base op => exact fun _ => le_max_left 1 s
        | query q => exact fun hq => (hD q hq).trans (le_max_right 1 s)
    _ = C.size * max 1 s := by simp

theorem card_flipSensitive_le_numOr_add_one (w₀ : BitString n) {F : PosFormula n}
    (hro : F.IsReadOnce) : (flipSensitive w₀ F).card ≤ F.numOr + 1 := by
  induction F with
  | var i =>
    simpa [flipSensitive] using (Finset.card_filter_le ({i} : Finset (Fin n)) _)
  | and L R ihL ihR =>
    obtain ⟨hroL, hroR, _⟩ := hro
    by_cases hL₀ : L.eval w₀ = true
    · have hsub : flipSensitive w₀ (and L R) ⊆ flipSensitive w₀ R := fun v hv => by
        simp only [mem_flipSensitive_iff, eval_and, hL₀, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true] at hv ⊢
        exact ⟨hv.1, hv.2.2⟩
      exact (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans ((ihR hroR).trans (by rw [numOr_and]; omega))
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hL₀
      have hsub : flipSensitive w₀ (and L R) ⊆ flipSensitive w₀ L := fun v hv => by
        rw [mem_flipSensitive_iff] at hv ⊢
        exact ⟨hL₀, ((Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mp hv.2).1⟩
      exact (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans ((ihL hroL).trans (by rw [numOr_and]; omega))
  | or L R ihL ihR =>
    obtain ⟨hroL, hroR, _⟩ := hro
    have hsub : flipSensitive w₀ (or L R) ⊆ flipSensitive w₀ L ∪ flipSensitive w₀ R :=
      fun v hv => by
        simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_flipSensitive_iff, eval_or, Bool.or_eq_false_iff,
          Bool.or_eq_true] at hv ⊢
        exact hv.2.imp (fun hL => ⟨hv.1.1, hL⟩) (fun hR => ⟨hv.1.2, hR⟩)
    calc (flipSensitive w₀ (or L R)).card
        ≤ (flipSensitive w₀ L ∪ flipSensitive w₀ R).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      _ ≤ (flipSensitive w₀ L).card + (flipSensitive w₀ R).card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ (L.numOr + 1) + (R.numOr + 1) := Nat.add_le_add (ihL hroL) (ihR hroR)
      _ = (or L R).numOr + 1 := by rw [numOr_or]; omega

theorem eval_routeCircuit_value_eq_true_iff {h k o depth width : ℕ}
    (key : Fin k → Fin h) (tag : Fin h) (order : Circuit signature h o)
    (x : BitString (BitonicSort.arity depth * (h + width)))
    (destination : Fin (BitonicSort.arity depth))
    (htag : header ((routeCircuit key tag order depth width).eval interpretation x)
      destination tag = true) (bit : Fin width) :
    value ((routeCircuit key tag order depth width).eval interpretation x) destination bit = true ↔
      ∃ source, header x source ∘ key =
        header ((routeCircuit key tag order depth width).eval interpretation x) destination ∘ key ∧
        header x source tag = false ∧ value x source bit = true := by
  simp only [routeCircuit, Circuit.eval_comp] at htag ⊢
  let y := (routeCircuit.broadcast key tag depth width).eval interpretation x
  let z := (keyedSortCircuit
    (order.comp (Circuit.wiring signature (Fin.castAdd width))) depth true).eval interpretation y
  change header z destination tag = true at htag
  change value z destination bit = true ↔
    ∃ source, header x source ∘ key = header z destination ∘ key ∧
      header x source tag = false ∧ value x source bit = true
  have perm := keyedSortCircuit_perm
    (order.comp (Circuit.wiring signature (Fin.castAdd width))) depth true y
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp (perm.mem_iff.mp (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨destination, rfl⟩))
  have hh : header z destination = header y d :=
    congrArg (fun row : BitString (h + width) => row ∘ Fin.castAdd width) hd.symm
  have hv : value z destination = value y d :=
    congrArg (fun row : BitString (h + width) => row ∘ Fin.natAdd h) hd.symm
  rw [hh] at htag
  rw [hv, hh]
  exact routeCircuit.value_eq_true_iff key tag x d htag bit

theorem eval_routeCircuit_value_of_unique_source {h k o depth width : ℕ}
    (key : Fin k → Fin h) (tag : Fin h) (order : Circuit signature h o)
    (x : BitString (BitonicSort.arity depth * (h + width)))
    (source destination target : Fin (BitonicSort.arity depth))
    (uniqueDestination : ∀ i, order.eval interpretation (header x i) =
      order.eval interpretation (header x destination) → i = destination)
    (rank : #{i | toLex (order.eval interpretation (header x i)) <
      toLex (order.eval interpretation (header x destination))} = target.val)
    (hkey : header x source ∘ key = header x destination ∘ key)
    (hsource : header x source tag = false) (hdestination : header x destination tag = true)
    (uniqueSource : ∀ i, header x i ∘ key = header x source ∘ key →
      header x i tag = false → i = source) :
    value ((routeCircuit key tag order depth width).eval interpretation x) target =
      value x source := by

  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  rw [eval_routeCircuit_value_eq_true_iff_of_rank key tag order x destination target
    uniqueDestination rank hdestination bit]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, ht, hv⟩
    exact uniqueSource i (hi.trans hkey.symm) ht ▸ hv
  · intro hv
    exact ⟨source, hkey, hsource, hv⟩

theorem WellFormed.exists_consistent (hC : C.WellFormed) (u : ℕ → Bool) :
    ∃ val, (∀ j ∈ C.params, val j = u j) ∧ C.Consistent val := by
  obtain ⟨val₀, hu, heq⟩ := hC.solvable u
  have key : ∀ k, ∃ val, (∀ i, i ∉ C.gates → val i = val₀ i) ∧
      ∀ J ∈ C.gates, J < k → val J = (C.gate J).eval val := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact ⟨val₀, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨val, hval, hgate⟩ := ih
      by_cases hk : k ∈ C.gates
      · have heval : ∀ J ∈ C.gates, J ≤ k →
            (C.gate J).eval (Function.update val k ((C.gate k).eval val)) =
              (C.gate J).eval val := fun J hJ hJk => Gate.eval_congr fun i hi =>
          Function.update_of_ne (by
            rintro rfl
            exact absurd (hC.reads_lt J hJ i hk hi) (not_lt.2 hJk)) _ _
        refine ⟨Function.update val k ((C.gate k).eval val), fun i hi => ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne (by rintro rfl; exact hi hk)]
          exact hval i hi
        · intro J hJ hJk
          rcases (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 hJk).lt_or_eq with h | rfl
          · rw [heval J hJ h.le, Function.update_of_ne h.ne, hgate J hJ h]
          · rw [heval J hJ le_rfl, Function.update_self]
      · exact ⟨val, hval, fun J hJ hJk => hgate J hJ
          (lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 hJk) (by rintro rfl; exact hk hJ))⟩
  obtain ⟨val, hval, hgate⟩ := key (C.gates.sup id + 1)
  have hng : ∀ i ∈ C.params ∪ C.aux, i ∉ C.gates := by
    intro i hi hg
    rcases Finset.mem_union.1 hi with hi | hi
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hC.disjoint_params_gates hi hg
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hC.disjoint_aux_gates hi hg
  refine ⟨val, fun j hj => (hval j (hng j (Finset.mem_union_left _ hj))).trans (hu j hj),
    (eqnsHold_congr hC fun i hi => hval i (hng i hi)).2 heq,
    fun J hJ => hgate J hJ (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.le_sup (f := id) hJ))⟩

        (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hi)) hr

      card_terms_le := hC.card_terms_le
      out_live := fun i hi => mem_live_quad (hC.out_live i hi) (fun he => h.out_z (he ▸ hi))

    have hKD := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hK)
    have hK' := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hK)

    (C.moveAffine J e).WellFormed := by

  have hJp : J ∉ C.params := hC.notMem_params_of_mem_gates h.mem

    { disjoint_params_aux := Finset.disjoint_left.2 fun i hp ha => ?_
      disjoint_params_gates := Finset.disjoint_of_subset_right (Finset.erase_subset _ _)
        hC.disjoint_params_gates
      disjoint_aux_gates := Finset.disjoint_left.2 fun i ha hg => ?_
      reads_lt := fun K hK i hi hr => hC.reads_lt K (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hK) i
        (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hi) hr
      reads_live := fun K hK i hr => hlive ▸ hC.reads_live K (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hK) i hr
      terms_subset := fun e' he' t ht => ?_
      card_terms_le := fun e' he' => ?_
      out_live := fun i hi => hlive ▸ hC.out_live i hi
      solvable := fun u => ?_

  · change i ∈ insert J C.aux at ha
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 ha with rfl | ha
    · exact hJp hp
    · exact hC.notMem_aux_of_mem_params hp ha
  · change i ∈ insert J C.aux at ha
    change i ∈ C.gates.erase J at hg
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 ha with rfl | ha
    · exact Finset.notMem_erase i _ hg
    · exact hC.notMem_gates_of_mem_aux ha (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hg)
  · change t ∈ C.params ∪ insert J C.aux
    have hsub : ∀ t ∈ C.params ∪ C.aux, t ∈ C.params ∪ insert J C.aux := fun t ht => by
      rcases Finset.mem_union.1 ht with hp | ha

theorem deg_moveAffine_le {J e : ℕ} (h : C.MoveOK J e) {z : ℕ} (hzJ : z ≠ J) :
    (C.moveAffine J e).deg z ≤ C.deg z := by
  have hsub : (C.moveAffine J e).children z ⊆
      (C.children z).erase (.inl J) ∪ (if Sum.inl J ∈ C.children z then {.inr e} else ∅) := by
    intro w hw
    rcases w with K | e'
    · simp only [inl_mem_children] at hw
      change K ∈ C.gates.erase J ∧ _ at hw
      refine Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_erase.2
        ⟨fun he => by cases Sum.inl.inj he; exact Finset.notMem_erase _ _ hw.1, ?_⟩)
      exact (inl_mem_children _).2 ⟨Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hw.1, hw.2⟩
    · simp only [inr_mem_children] at hw
      change e' ∈ insert e C.eqns ∧ z ∈ (Function.update C.eqn e _ e').terms at hw
      by_cases hee : e' = e
      · subst hee
        rw [Function.update_self] at hw
        rcases mem_affEqn hw.2 with h' | h'
        · exact absurd h' hzJ
        · refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
          rw [ite_eq_left ((inl_mem_children _).2 ⟨h.mem, h'⟩)]
          exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hee] at hw
        exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨Sum.inr_ne_inl,
          (inr_mem_children _).2 ⟨Finset.mem_of_mem_insert_of_ne hw.1 hee, hw.2⟩⟩)
  refine (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans ((Finset.card_union_le _ _).trans ?_)
  unfold deg
  split_ifs with hJ
  · rw [Finset.card_singleton, Finset.card_erase_add_one hJ]
  · rw [Finset.card_empty, add_zero, Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hJ]

theorem WellFormed.restrict (hC : C.WellFormed) {x : ℕ} {ℓ : Lit} (hx : x ∈ C.params)
    (hℓ : ∀ y, ℓ.Reads y → y ∈ C.params ∧ y ≠ x) : (C.restrict x ℓ).WellFormed := by
  have hℓx : ℓ.arg ≠ .node x := fun he => (hℓ x he).2 rfl
  have hℓeval : ∀ val val' : ℕ → Bool, (∀ j ∈ C.params.erase x, val j = val' j) →
      ℓ.eval val = ℓ.eval val' := fun val val' hv =>
    Lit.eval_congr fun y hy => hv y (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨(hℓ y hy).2, (hℓ y hy).1⟩)
  have hlive : ∀ i, ℓ.Reads i → i ∈ C.live := fun i hi => by
    simp only [live, Finset.mem_union]; exact Or.inl (Or.inl (hℓ i hi).1)
  refine
    { disjoint_params_aux := Finset.disjoint_of_subset_left (Finset.erase_subset _ _)
        hC.disjoint_params_aux
      disjoint_params_gates := Finset.disjoint_of_subset_left (Finset.erase_subset _ _)
        hC.disjoint_params_gates
      disjoint_aux_gates := hC.disjoint_aux_gates
      reads_lt := fun J hJ i hi hr => ?_
      reads_live := fun J hJ i hr => ?_
      terms_subset := fun e he z hz => ?_
      card_terms_le := fun e he => Equation.card_subst_le.trans (hC.card_terms_le e he)
      out_live := fun i hi => ?_
      solvable := fun u => ?_
      unique := fun val val' hagree heq heq' v hv => ?_ }
  · rcases Gate.reads_of_reads_subst hr with hr | ⟨-, hr⟩
    · exact hC.reads_lt J hJ i hi hr
    · exact absurd hi (hC.notMem_gates_of_mem_params (hℓ i hr).1)
  · refine mem_live_restrict ?_ fun he => Gate.not_reads_subst hℓx (he ▸ hr)
    rcases Gate.reads_of_reads_subst hr with hr | ⟨-, hr⟩
    · exact hC.reads_live J hJ i hr
    · exact hlive i hr
  · have hzx : z ≠ x := by rintro rfl; exact Equation.notMem_subst hℓx hz
    have hmem : z ∈ C.params ∪ C.aux := by
      rcases Equation.mem_of_mem_subst hz with hz | ⟨-, hz⟩
      · exact hC.terms_subset e he hz
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (hℓ z hz).1
    simp only [Finset.mem_union] at hmem ⊢
    change z ∈ C.params.erase x ∨ z ∈ C.aux
    rw [Finset.mem_erase]
    tauto
  · refine mem_live_restrict ?_ fun he => Lit.not_reads_subst hℓx (he ▸ hi)
    rcases Lit.reads_of_reads_subst hi with hi | ⟨-, hi⟩
    · exact hC.out_live i hi
    · exact hlive i hi
  · obtain ⟨val, hu, heq⟩ := hC.solvable (Function.update u x (ℓ.eval u))
    have hvx : val x = ℓ.eval val := by
      rw [hu x hx, Function.update_self]
      exact hℓeval _ _ fun j hj => by
        rw [hu j (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hj), Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)]
    refine ⟨val, fun j hj => ?_, fun e he => (Equation.holds_subst hvx).2 (heq e he)⟩
    rw [hu j (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hj), Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)]
  · have hold : ∀ w : ℕ → Bool, (C.restrict x ℓ).EqnsHold w →
        C.EqnsHold (Function.update w x (ℓ.eval w)) := fun w hw e he =>
      (Equation.holds_subst_update hℓx w).1 (hw e he)
    have := hC.unique _ _ (fun j hj => by
        by_cases hjx : j = x
        · subst hjx
          simp only [Function.update_self]
          exact hℓeval _ _ hagree
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjx]
          exact hagree j (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hjx, hj⟩))
      (hold val heq) (hold val' heq') v hv
    have hvx : v ≠ x := by rintro rfl; exact hC.notMem_aux_of_mem_params hx hv
    simpa only [Function.update_of_ne hvx] using this

theorem WellFormed.deleteGate (hC : C.WellFormed) {J : ℕ} {ℓ : Lit} (h : C.DeleteGateOK J ℓ) :
    (C.deleteGate J ℓ).WellFormed := by
  have hℓJ := h.not_reads hC
  have heqn : ∀ e ∈ C.eqns, (C.eqn e).subst J ℓ = C.eqn e := fun e he =>
    Equation.subst_of_notMem (hC.notMem_terms_of_mem_gates h.mem he)
  have hreads_live : ∀ t, ℓ.Reads t → t ∈ C.live := fun t ht =>
    hC.reads_live J h.mem t (h.reads t ht)
  refine
    { disjoint_params_aux := hC.disjoint_params_aux
      disjoint_params_gates := Finset.disjoint_of_subset_right (Finset.erase_subset _ _)
        hC.disjoint_params_gates
      disjoint_aux_gates := Finset.disjoint_of_subset_right (Finset.erase_subset _ _)
        hC.disjoint_aux_gates
      reads_lt := fun K hK i hi hr => ?_
      reads_live := fun K hK i hr => ?_
      terms_subset := fun e he => by
        change ((C.eqn e).subst J ℓ).terms ⊆ _
        rw [heqn e he]; exact hC.terms_subset e he
      card_terms_le := fun e he => Equation.card_subst_le.trans (hC.card_terms_le e he)
      out_live := fun i hi => ?_
      solvable := fun u => by
        obtain ⟨val, hu, heq⟩ := hC.solvable u
        exact ⟨val, hu, (eqnsHold_deleteGate hC h.mem val).2 heq⟩
      unique := fun val val' hagree heq heq' =>
        hC.unique val val' hagree ((eqnsHold_deleteGate hC h.mem val).1 heq)
          ((eqnsHold_deleteGate hC h.mem val').1 heq') }
  · have hK' := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hK
    have hi' := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hi
    rcases Gate.reads_of_reads_subst hr with hr | ⟨hrJ, hr⟩
    · exact hC.reads_lt K hK' i hi' hr
    · exact (hC.reads_lt J h.mem i hi' (h.reads i hr)).trans (hC.reads_lt K hK' J h.mem hrJ)
  · refine mem_live_deleteGate ?_ fun he => Gate.not_reads_subst hℓJ (he ▸ hr)
    rcases Gate.reads_of_reads_subst hr with hr | ⟨-, hr⟩
    · exact hC.reads_live K (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hK) i hr
    · exact hreads_live i hr
  · refine mem_live_deleteGate ?_ fun he => Lit.not_reads_subst hℓJ (he ▸ hi)
    rcases Lit.reads_of_reads_subst hi with hi | ⟨-, hi⟩
    · exact hC.out_live i hi
    · exact hreads_live i hi

theorem WellFormed.deleteEqn (hC : C.WellFormed) {e v : ℕ} {ℓ : Lit} (h : C.DeleteEqnOK e v ℓ) :
    (C.deleteEqn e v ℓ).WellFormed := by
  have hℓv : ℓ.arg ≠ .node v := fun he => (h.reads v he).2 rfl
  have hℓpa : ∀ t, ℓ.Reads t → t ∈ C.params ∪ C.aux := fun t ht =>
    hC.terms_subset e h.mem (h.reads t ht).1
  have hvp : v ∉ C.params := hC.notMem_params_of_mem_aux h.aux
  refine
    { disjoint_params_aux := Finset.disjoint_of_subset_right (Finset.erase_subset _ _)
        hC.disjoint_params_aux
      disjoint_params_gates := hC.disjoint_params_gates
      disjoint_aux_gates := Finset.disjoint_of_subset_left (Finset.erase_subset _ _)
        hC.disjoint_aux_gates
      reads_lt := fun K hK i hi hr => ?_
      reads_live := fun K hK i hr => ?_
      terms_subset := fun e' he' z hz => ?_
      card_terms_le := fun e' he' => Equation.card_subst_le.trans
        (hC.card_terms_le e' (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase he'))
      out_live := fun i hi => ?_
      solvable := fun u => ?_
      unique := fun val val' hagree heq heq' a ha => ?_ }
  · rcases Gate.reads_of_reads_subst hr with hr | ⟨-, hr⟩
    · exact hC.reads_lt K hK i hi hr
    · exfalso
      rcases Finset.mem_union.1 (hℓpa i hr) with hp | ha
      · exact hC.notMem_gates_of_mem_params hp hi
      · exact hC.notMem_gates_of_mem_aux ha hi
  · refine mem_live_deleteEqn ?_ fun he => Gate.not_reads_subst hℓv (he ▸ hr)
    rcases Gate.reads_of_reads_subst hr with hr | ⟨-, hr⟩
    · exact hC.reads_live K hK i hr
    · simp only [live, Finset.mem_union]
      exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_union.1 (hℓpa i hr))
  · have hzv : z ≠ v := fun he => Equation.notMem_subst hℓv (he ▸ hz)
    have hmem : z ∈ C.params ∪ C.aux := by
      rcases Equation.mem_of_mem_subst hz with hz | ⟨-, hz⟩
      · exact hC.terms_subset e' (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase he') hz
      · exact hℓpa z hz
    change z ∈ C.params ∪ C.aux.erase v
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_erase] at hmem ⊢
    tauto
  · refine mem_live_deleteEqn ?_ fun he => Lit.not_reads_subst hℓv (he ▸ hi)
    rcases Lit.reads_of_reads_subst hi with hi | ⟨-, hi⟩
    · exact hC.out_live i hi
    · simp only [live, Finset.mem_union]
      exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_union.1 (hℓpa i hi))
  · obtain ⟨val, hu, heq⟩ := hC.solvable u
    have hv : val v = ℓ.eval val := (h.holds val).1 (heq e h.mem)
    exact ⟨val, hu, fun e' he' =>
      (Equation.holds_subst hv).2 (heq e' (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase he'))⟩
  · have hext : ∀ w : ℕ → Bool, ∀ i, i ≠ v → Function.update w v (ℓ.eval w) i = w i :=
      fun w i hi => Function.update_of_ne hi _ _
    have := hC.unique _ _ (fun j hj => by
        rw [hext val j fun he => hvp (he ▸ hj), hext val' j fun he => hvp (he ▸ hj)]
        exact hagree j hj) (h.eqnsHold heq) (h.eqnsHold heq') a (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase ha)
    rwa [hext val a (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase ha), hext val' a (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase ha)] at this

theorem exists_symmetric_altFormula (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ n k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → n ≤ k ^ (d + 1) →
      ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (op : AltOp),
        ∃ f : AltFormula n (d + 2), AltFormula.size f ≤ 2 ^ (C * k) ∧
          ∀ x, AltFormula.eval op f x = a (weight x) := by
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨2, fun n k hk hn a op => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hs, he⟩ := AltFormula.exists_depth_two (fun x => a (weight x)) op
    refine ⟨f, hs.trans ?_, he⟩
    have h : 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ (1 * k) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by simpa using hn)
    simpa using Nat.add_le_two_pow_add_add_one_mul hk h (show 1 ≤ 2 ^ (0 * k) by simp)
  | succ d ih =>
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hmod⟩ := exists_moduli (d + 2)
    refine ⟨2 * ((d + 2) * C) + 2 * (d + 2) + ((d + 2) + 2 * C + 2) + 4 * A + 8,
      fun n k hk hn a op => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨m, hcop, hgt, hle⟩ := hmod k hk
    let (i : Fin (d + 2)) : NeZero (m i) := ⟨by have := hgt i; omega⟩
    have hnprod : n < ∏ i, m i := hn.trans_lt (pow_lt_prod_moduli (by omega) m hgt)
    have hsmall (l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ (4 * k) ^ (d + 1)) (b : ℕ → Bool) :
        ∃ f : AltFormula l (d + 2), AltFormula.size f ≤ 2 ^ ((4 * A) * k) ∧
          ∀ x, AltFormula.eval .and f x = b (weight x) := by
      simpa only [show A * (4 * k) = (4 * A) * k by ring] using hA l (4 * k) (by omega) hl b .and
    obtain ⟨f, hs, he⟩ := exists_symmetric_altFormula_succ m hcop hnprod hsmall
      (fun i => pair_size_bound hk hn (hgt i).le) a op
    refine ⟨f, hs.trans ?_, he⟩
    apply construction_size_bound hk
    · calc n ≤ k ^ (d + 2) := hn
        _ ≤ (2 ^ k) ^ (d + 2) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le _
        _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
    · calc ∑ i, m i ≤ ∑ _i : Fin (d + 2), C * k := sum_le_sum fun i _ => hle i
        _ = _ := by simp [Nat.mul_assoc]
    · exact sum_sq_moduli_bound hk m hle
    · exact le_rfl

theorem exists_of_isSymmetric_nat {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : BitString n → Bool), IsSymmetric f → ∀ op : AltOp,

    (k : ι → ℕ) [∀ i, NeZero (k i)]
    (ih : ∀ m ≤ M, ∀ a : ℕ → Bool,
      ∃ f : AltFormula m (d + 2), AltFormula.size f ≤ B ∧
        ∀ x, AltFormula.eval .and f x = a (weight x))
    (hm : ∀ i, 2 * (n / k i + 1) ≤ M)
    (t : ℕ) (s : (i : ι) → ZMod (k i) → ZMod (k i)) :
    ∃ f : AltFormula n (d + 2), AltFormula.size f ≤ 2 + (∑ i, (k i) ^ 2) * (B + 2) ∧
      ∀ x, AltFormula.eval .and f x = true ↔
        ∀ i, ShiftTest (t : ZMod (k i))
          (fun a => (blockWeight residueBlock x a : ZMod (k i))) (s i) := by
  classical
  by_cases valid : ∀ i, (∑ a, s i a) = residueSum (ZMod (k i)) - t
  · let P := (i : ι) × (ZMod (k i) × ZMod (k i))
    have hp (p : P) : ∃ f : AltFormula n (d + 2), AltFormula.size f ≤ B + 2 ∧
        ∀ x, AltFormula.eval .and f x = true ↔ p.2.1 ≠ p.2.2 →
          (blockWeight residueBlock x p.2.1 : ZMod (k p.1)) + s p.1 p.2.1 ≠
          (blockWeight residueBlock x p.2.2 : ZMod (k p.1)) + s p.1 p.2.2 := by
      by_cases heq : p.2.1 = p.2.2
      · refine ⟨AltFormula.constant n d .and true,
          (AltFormula.size_constant_le ..).trans (by omega), ?_⟩
        intro x
        simp [AltFormula.eval_constant, heq]
      · obtain ⟨f, hf, he⟩ := exists_pairComparison ih (hm p.1)
          p.2.1 p.2.2 (s p.1 p.2.1) (s p.1 p.2.2)
        exact ⟨f, hf.trans (by omega), fun x => by simp [he x, heq]⟩
    choose fs hs he using hp
    refine ⟨AltFormula.merge fs, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc
        AltFormula.size (AltFormula.merge fs) ≤ 1 + ∑ p, AltFormula.size (fs p) :=
          AltFormula.size_merge_le fs
        _ ≤ 1 + ∑ _p : P, (B + 2) := Nat.add_le_add_left (sum_le_sum fun p _ => hs p) 1
        _ ≤ 2 + (∑ i, (k i) ^ 2) * (B + 2) := by
          simp only [sum_const, card_univ, smul_eq_mul]
          have hc : Fintype.card P = ∑ i, (k i) ^ 2 := by
            simp [P, Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_prod, ZMod.card, pow_two]
          rw [hc]

      rw [AltFormula.eval_merge_and]
      simp only [he, shiftTest_iff_pairwise]
      constructor
      · intro h i

      (AltFormula.size_constant_le ..).trans (by omega), ?_⟩
    intro x
    rw [AltFormula.eval_constant]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact Bool.noConfusion h
    · intro h

theorem card_residueBlock_le (n k : ℕ) (a : ZMod k) :
    Fintype.card {i : Fin n // residueBlock i = a} ≤ n / k + 1 := by
  let encode (i : {i : Fin n // residueBlock i = a}) : Fin (n / k + 1) :=
    ⟨i.1.val / k, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.div_le_div_right (Nat.le_of_lt i.1.isLt))⟩
  have hi : Function.Injective encode := by
    intro i j h
    have hd : i.1.val / k = j.1.val / k := congrArg Fin.val h
    have hm : i.1.val % k = j.1.val % k :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' _ _ _).1 (i.2.trans j.2.symm)
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Fin.ext
    calc
      i.1.val = i.1.val % k + k * (i.1.val / k) := (Nat.mod_add_div _ _).symm
      _ = j.1.val % k + k * (j.1.val / k) := by rw [hd, hm]
      _ = j.1.val := Nat.mod_add_div _ _
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective encode hi

theorem bound_le (hn : 16 ≤ n) :
    bound (addressWidth n) (dataWidth n) ≤ 27 * 2 ^ n / n := by
  have ⟨haddr, hinput⟩ := address_estimates hn
  have hsplit : 2 ^ dataWidth n * 2 ^ addressWidth n = 2 ^ n := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_comm, addressWidth_add_dataWidth]
  have hdata : 6 * 2 ^ dataWidth n * n ≤ 24 * 2 ^ n := calc
    _ ≤ 6 * 2 ^ dataWidth n * (4 * 2 ^ addressWidth n) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hinput.le
    _ = 24 * (2 ^ dataWidth n * 2 ^ addressWidth n) := by ring
    _ = 24 * 2 ^ n := by rw [hsplit]
  have haddress : 4 * 2 ^ addressWidth n * n ≤ 2 * 2 ^ n := calc
    _ = 2 * ((2 * 2 ^ addressWidth n) * n) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * (n * n) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Nat.mul_le_mul_right n haddr)
    _ ≤ 2 * 2 ^ n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (square_le_two_pow (by lia))
  have hlog : 4 ≤ Nat.log 2 n := Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by decide) hn
  have hquarter : 4 * Nat.log 2 n ≤ n :=
    (four_mul_le_two_pow hlog).trans (Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by lia))
  have hexponent : 2 ^ addressWidth n + addressWidth n + (Nat.log 2 n + 1) ≤ n := by
    dsimp only [addressWidth] at haddr ⊢
    lia
  have hlibrary : (2 ^ (2 ^ addressWidth n) * 2 ^ addressWidth n) * n ≤ 2 ^ n := calc
    _ ≤ (2 ^ (2 ^ addressWidth n) * 2 ^ addressWidth n) * 2 ^ (Nat.log 2 n + 1) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide) n).le
    _ = 2 ^ (2 ^ addressWidth n + addressWidth n + (Nat.log 2 n + 1)) := by
      rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add]
    _ ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hexponent
  apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by lia : 0 < n)).mpr
  calc
    bound (addressWidth n) (dataWidth n) * n =
        4 * 2 ^ addressWidth n * n + 6 * 2 ^ dataWidth n * n +
          (2 ^ (2 ^ addressWidth n) * 2 ^ addressWidth n) * n := by
      simp only [bound]
      ring
    _ ≤ 27 * 2 ^ n := by lia

theorem two_mul_two_pow_le_size_of_computes_parity (hp2 : p ≠ 2)
    {C : Circuit Unbounded.extSignature n 1}
    (hC : C.Computes (Unbounded.extInterpretation (modGate p)) (single (parity n))) {ℓ : ℕ}
    (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ)
    (hn : 100 * (((p - 1) * ℓ) ^ C.depth + 1) ^ 2 ≤ n + 1) : 2 * 2 ^ ℓ ≤ 5 * C.size := by
  classical
  let _ := invertibleTwo hp2
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, herr⟩ := exists_lowDegree_approx (R := ZMod p) hℓ C
  have heval : ∀ x, C.eval (Unbounded.extInterpretation (modGate p)) x 0 = parity n x := fun x =>
    congrFun (hC x) 0
  simp only [heval] at herr
  set A := univ.filter fun x => Q x = bitVal (ZMod p) (parity n x)
  set E := univ.filter fun x => Q x ≠ bitVal (ZMod p) (parity n x)
  have htotal : #A + #E = 2 ^ n := by
    rw [card_filter_add_card_filter_not, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool,
      Fintype.card_fin]
  have hA : 10 * #A ≤ 6 * 2 ^ n :=
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 10 (card_agree_parity_le hQ)).trans (ten_mul_card_filter_card_le_le n _ hn)
  -- so the errors are at least `4 / 10` of the inputs
  have hE : 4 * 2 ^ n ≤ 10 * #E := by omega
  have h : 2 * 2 ^ n * (2 * 2 ^ ℓ) ≤ 2 * 2 ^ n * (5 * C.size) := by
    calc 2 * 2 ^ n * (2 * 2 ^ ℓ) = 4 * 2 ^ n * 2 ^ ℓ := by ring
      _ ≤ 10 * #E * 2 ^ ℓ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hE
      _ = 10 * (#E * 2 ^ ℓ) := by ring
      _ ≤ 10 * (C.size * 2 ^ n) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ herr
      _ = 2 * 2 ^ n * (5 * C.size) := by ring
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left h (by positivity)

theorem exists_lowDegree_approx (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) (C : Circuit Unbounded.extSignature n 1) :
    ∃ Q ∈ lowDegree R (Fin n) (((p - 1) * ℓ) ^ C.depth),
      #(univ.filter fun x =>
        Q x ≠ bitVal R (C.eval (Unbounded.extInterpretation (modGate p)) x 0)) *
        2 ^ ℓ ≤ C.size * 2 ^ n := by
  classical
  have hp := (Fact.out : p.Prime).two_le
  have hbase : 1 ≤ (p - 1) * ℓ := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega))
  refine ⟨(C.program.trace (pairInterpretation R p hℓ) inputPair (C.outputs 0)).2,
    lowDegree_mono (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hbase (C.outputDepths_le_depth 0))
      (snd_trace_pair_mem hℓ C.program _), ?_⟩
  -- the inputs where the approximant errs are inputs where some gate approximator errs
  have hsub : (univ.filter fun x =>
      (C.program.trace (pairInterpretation R p hℓ) inputPair (C.outputs 0)).2 x ≠
        bitVal R (C.eval (Unbounded.extInterpretation (modGate p)) x 0)) ⊆
      univ.biUnion (errorSet R p hℓ C.program) := fun x hx => by
    rw [mem_filter] at hx
    by_contra hno
    simp only [mem_biUnion, mem_univ, true_and, not_exists] at hno
    exact hx.2 ((snd_trace_pair_eq hℓ C.program hno _).trans (by
      rw [fst_trace_pair]
      rfl))
  calc _ ≤ #(univ.biUnion (errorSet R p hℓ C.program)) * 2 ^ ℓ :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (card_le_card hsub)
    _ ≤ (∑ k, #(errorSet R p hℓ C.program k)) * 2 ^ ℓ :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _k : Fin C.size, 2 ^ n := by
        rw [sum_mul]
        exact sum_le_sum fun k _ => card_errorSet_mul_le hℓ C.program k
    _ = C.size * 2 ^ n := by simp

theorem complexity_slice_le_of_card_le {n k : ℕ}
    (h : #{x : BitString n | L.slice n x = true} ≤ k) :

private theorem partialBound_le {p h k l J w : ℕ} (hh : h ≤ p) (hk : k ≤ p - h)
    (hl : l ≤ p - h) (hkl : k + l ≤ 2 * p) (hkl' : p + h ≤ k + l) (hJ : 4 * k + 5 + J ≤ p - h)
    (hw : w ≤ 2 ^ p) :
    partialBound (2 * p) k l J w ≤ 2 ^ p / J + 32 * (p + 1) ^ 3 * 2 ^ (p - h) := by
  set G := 2 ^ (p - h)
  have hG : 1 ≤ G := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have hkG : 2 ^ k ≤ G := Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos hk
  have hlG : 2 ^ l ≤ G := Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos hl
  have hbank : (2 ^ k + 1) ^ 3 * (2 * 2 ^ k + 1) * 2 ^ J ≤ G :=
    calc (2 ^ k + 1) ^ 3 * (2 * 2 ^ k + 1) * 2 ^ J
        ≤ (2 ^ (k + 1)) ^ 3 * 2 ^ (k + 2) * 2 ^ J := by
          gcongr
          · exact two_pow_add_one_le k
          · rw [pow_add]; have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := k); omega
      _ = 2 ^ (4 * k + 5 + J) := by rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]; ring_nf
      _ ≤ G := Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos hJ
  have hwJ : w / J ≤ 2 ^ p / J := Nat.div_le_div_right hw
  have hcoll : w * w / 2 ^ (k + l) ≤ G :=
    (Nat.div_le_div_right (by rw [two_mul, pow_add]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul hw hw)).trans
      (two_pow_div_le hh hkl')
  have htable : partialTableBound k l J w ≤ 2 ^ p / J + (8 * p + 8) * G := by
    have h₁ : (2 ^ k + 2 ^ l) * (2 * (k + l) + 1) ≤ (2 * G) * (4 * p + 1) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
    unfold partialTableBound
    nlinarith
  have hhash : (k + l) * (4 * (2 * p) + 1) ≤ (16 * p ^ 2 + 2 * p) * G := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul hkl (le_refl (4 * (2 * p) + 1))
    nlinarith
  have hcoll' := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 * (2 * p) + 2) hcoll
  have hcube : 16 * p ^ 2 + 14 * p + 15 ≤ 32 * (p + 1) ^ 3 := by nlinarith
  have hcubeG := Nat.mul_le_mul_right G hcube
  unfold partialBound
  nlinarith

private theorem eventually_complexity_le (P : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ p in atTop, ∀ D : Finset (BitString (2 * p)), #D ≤ 2 ^ p →
      P * complexity interpretation (single fun x => decide (x ∈ D)) ≤ (P + 1) * 2 ^ p ∧
      ∀ u : BooleanFunction (2 * p),
        P * p * complexityOn interpretation D (single u) ≤ (P + 1) * 2 ^ p := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, q = 32 * (P + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hq6 : 4 * q + 6 ≤ q ^ 2 := by subst hq; nlinarith
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c, c + 4 * q + 6 = q ^ 2 := ⟨q ^ 2 - (4 * q + 6), by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp
    (Nat.eventually_mul_pow_le_pow (3456 * P * q ^ 8) 4 Nat.one_lt_two)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (q ^ 2 * (H + 2 * q + 1))] with p hp D hD
  have hq2 : 0 < q ^ 2 := by subst hq; positivity
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ : ∃ h, h = p / q ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlo : q ^ 2 * h ≤ p := hh ▸ Nat.mul_div_le p (q ^ 2)
  have hhi : p < q ^ 2 * (h + 1) := hh ▸ Nat.lt_mul_div_succ p hq2
  have hhH : H + 2 * q + 1 ≤ h :=
    hh ▸ (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hq2).mpr (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hp)
  obtain ⟨hind, hpart⟩ := two_mul_complexity_le (P := P) hq.ge hc (by omega) hlo hhi D hD
  have hhp : h ≤ p := le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left h hq2) hlo
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := by omega
  have herr : 2 * P * p * (32 * (p + 1) ^ 3 * 2 ^ (p - h)) ≤ 2 ^ p := by
    have hpq : p ≤ 2 * q ^ 2 * h := by nlinarith
    have hpq' : p + 1 ≤ 3 * q ^ 2 * h := by nlinarith
    have hpoly : 2 * P * p * (32 * (p + 1) ^ 3) ≤ 3456 * P * q ^ 8 * h ^ 4 :=
      calc 2 * P * p * (32 * (p + 1) ^ 3)
          ≤ 2 * P * (2 * q ^ 2 * h) * (32 * (3 * q ^ 2 * h) ^ 3) := by gcongr
        _ = 3456 * P * q ^ 8 * h ^ 4 := by ring
    calc 2 * P * p * (32 * (p + 1) ^ 3 * 2 ^ (p - h))
        = 2 * P * p * (32 * (p + 1) ^ 3) * 2 ^ (p - h) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ h * 2 ^ (p - h) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hpoly.trans (hH h (by omega)))
      _ = 2 ^ p := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hhp]
  refine ⟨Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ two_pos, fun u => Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ two_pos⟩
  · have : 2 * P * (32 * (p + 1) ^ 3 * 2 ^ (p - h)) ≤
        2 * P * p * (32 * (p + 1) ^ 3 * 2 ^ (p - h)) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hp1)
    calc 2 * (P * complexity interpretation (single fun x => decide (x ∈ D)))
        = 2 * P * complexity interpretation (single fun x => decide (x ∈ D)) := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 * P + 1) * 2 ^ p + 2 ^ p := hind.trans (by omega)
      _ = 2 * ((P + 1) * 2 ^ p) := by ring
  · calc 2 * (P * p * complexityOn interpretation D (single u))
        = 2 * P * p * complexityOn interpretation D (single u) := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 * P + 1) * 2 ^ p + 2 ^ p := (hpart u).trans (by omega)
      _ = 2 * ((P + 1) * 2 ^ p) := by ring

private theorem card_computableFunctions_lt {p : ℕ} (hp : 4 ≤ p) :
    #(computableFunctions (p + p) (2 ^ (p - 4))) < 2 ^ (p * 2 ^ p) := by
  set s := 2 ^ (p - 4)
  have hs : 2 ^ p = 16 * s := by
    rw [show p = 4 + (p - 4) by omega, pow_add]
    simp [s]
  have hs1 : 1 ≤ s := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have hpp : p + p ≤ 2 ^ p := by
    have : ∀ q, 1 ≤ q → 2 * q ≤ 2 ^ q := fun q hq => by
      induction q, hq using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => decide
      | succ q _ ih => rw [pow_succ]; omega
    simpa [two_mul] using this p (by omega)
  have hwires : p + p + s + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (p + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; omega
  have hlines : 5 * (p + p + s + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ (2 * p + 5) :=
    calc 5 * (p + p + s + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 8 * (2 ^ (p + 1)) ^ 2 := by gcongr; omega
      _ = 2 ^ (2 * p + 5) := by rw [← pow_mul, show (8 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 3 by rfl, ← pow_add]; ring_nf
  have hcount := (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.factorial_pos s)).trans
    (card_computableFunctions_mul_factorial_le (p + p) s)
  have hexp : p + (2 * p + 5) * s + (p + 1) < p * 2 ^ p := by
    rw [hs]
    nlinarith
  calc #(computableFunctions (p + p) s)
      ≤ (s + 1) * (5 * (p + p + s + 1) ^ 2) ^ s * (p + p + s) := hcount
    _ ≤ 2 ^ p * (2 ^ (2 * p + 5)) ^ s * 2 ^ (p + 1) := by
      gcongr
      · omega
      · rw [pow_succ]; omega
    _ = 2 ^ (p + (2 * p + 5) * s + (p + 1)) := by rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]
    _ < 2 ^ (p * 2 ^ p) := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right one_lt_two hexp
