private theorem synthesis_table {B : Type*} [Fintype B] (pattern : B → Finset (Fin (2 ^ k)))
    {w : ℕ} (hw : ∀ b, #(pattern b) ≤ w) (chosen : BitString l → Finset B) :
    Synthesis interpretation (inputs (k + l)) {table pattern chosen}
      ((2 ^ k + 2 ^ l) * (2 * (k + l) + 1) + Fintype.card B * (w + 1) +
        ∑ r, #(chosen r) + 3 * 2 ^ l + 1) := by
  let test : Fin (2 ^ k) ⊕ BitString l → BooleanFunction (k + l)
    | .inl c => fun x => decide (column x = c)
    | .inr r => fun x => decide (row x = r)
  have htest : Synthesis interpretation (inputs (k + l)) (Set.range test)
      ((2 ^ k + 2 ^ l) * (2 * (k + l) + 1)) := by
    have h (t : Fin (2 ^ k) ⊕ BitString l) :
        Synthesis interpretation (inputs (k + l)) {test t} (2 * (k + l) + 1) := by
      cases t with
      | inl c =>
        have heq : test (.inl c) =
            fun x => decide ((fun i => x (Fin.castAdd l i)) = (BitString.equivFin k).symm c) := by
          funext x
          exact Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr (by
            rw [decide_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_iff, Equiv.eq_symm_apply]; rfl)
        rw [heq]
        exact (synthesis_minterm _ _).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl (by omega)
      | inr r => exact (synthesis_minterm _ r).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl (by omega)
    simpa using Synthesis.family test _ h
  let bank (b : B) : BooleanFunction (k + l) := fun x => decide (column x ∈ pattern b)
  have hbank : Synthesis interpretation (Set.range test) (Set.range bank)
      (Fintype.card B * (w + 1)) := by
    have h (b : B) : Synthesis interpretation (Set.range test) {bank b} (w + 1) := by
      have h := Synthesis.exists_mem (pattern b) (fun c => test (.inl c)) (fun _ => 0)
        fun c _ => Synthesis.of_mem (s := Set.range test) ⟨.inl c, rfl⟩
      refine h.mono Set.Subset.rfl (by simp [bank, test]) ?_
      simpa using hw b
    simpa using Synthesis.family bank _ h
  let rowValue (r : BitString l) : BooleanFunction (k + l) :=
    fun x => test (.inr r) x && decide (∃ b ∈ chosen r, bank b x = true)
  have hrow (r : BitString l) : Synthesis interpretation (Set.range test ∪ Set.range bank)
      {rowValue r} (#(chosen r) + 2) := by
    have h := Synthesis.exists_mem (chosen r) bank (fun _ => 0)
      fun b _ => Synthesis.of_mem (s := Set.range test ∪ Set.range bank) (Or.inr ⟨b, rfl⟩)
    simpa [rowValue] using
      (Synthesis.of_mem (s := Set.range test ∪ Set.range bank) (Or.inl ⟨.inr r, rfl⟩)).and h

private theorem exists_eqOn_complexity_le_partialTableBound {k l : ℕ}
    (D : Finset (BitString (k + l))) (u : BooleanFunction (k + l)) {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∃ φ : BooleanFunction (k + l), Set.EqOn φ u D ∧
      complexity interpretation (single φ) ≤ partialTableBound k l J #D := by
  obtain ⟨bank, hbank_card, hbank⟩ := exists_extension_bank (2 ^ k) J
  let pattern (β : Fin (2 ^ k + 1) × Fin (2 ^ k + 1) × bank) : Finset (Fin (2 ^ k)) :=
    {c | β.1 ≤ c.castSucc ∧ c.castSucc < β.2.1 ∧ β.2.2.1 c = true}
  have hext (r : BitString l) (b : ℕ) :
      ∃ e ∈ bank, ∀ c ∈ rankBlock (rowSupport D r) J b, e c = u (entry r c) :=
    hbank _ (card_rankBlock_le _ _ _) _
  choose ext hext_mem hext_eq using hext
  let chosen (r : BitString l) : Finset (Fin (2 ^ k + 1) × Fin (2 ^ k + 1) × bank) :=
    (range (#(rowSupport D r) / J + 1)).image fun b =>
      (cut (rowSupport D r) (b * J), cut (rowSupport D r) ((b + 1) * J), ⟨ext r b, hext_mem r b⟩)
  refine ⟨table pattern chosen, fun x hx => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : column x ∈ Set.range ((rowSupport D (row x)).orderEmbOfFin rfl) := by
      rw [range_orderEmbOfFin]
      exact mem_rowSupport.mpr hx
    have hblock (b : ℕ) : (cut (rowSupport D (row x)) (b * J) ≤ (column x).castSucc ∧
        (column x).castSucc < cut (rowSupport D (row x)) ((b + 1) * J)) ↔
          b * J ≤ ρ ∧ ρ < (b + 1) * J := by
      rw [← hρ, cut_le_iff, ← not_le, cut_le_iff, not_le]
    have hvalue (b : ℕ) (hb : b * J ≤ ρ ∧ ρ < (b + 1) * J) :
        ext (row x) b (column x) = u x := by
      have hmem : column x ∈ rankBlock (rowSupport D (row x)) J b := by
        rw [← hρ]
        exact mem_map_of_mem _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hb⟩)
      rw [hext_eq _ _ _ hmem, entry_row_column]
    apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
    simp only [table, chosen, decide_eq_true_eq, exists_mem_image, pattern, mem_filter,
      mem_univ, true_and, mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, -, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
      rwa [← hvalue b ((hblock b).mp ⟨h₁, h₂⟩)]
    · intro hu
      have hb : ρ.val / J * J ≤ ρ ∧ ρ < (ρ.val / J + 1) * J :=
        ⟨Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _, by rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul]; exact Nat.lt_div_mul_add hJ⟩
      refine ⟨ρ.val / J, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.div_le_div_right ρ.isLt.le),
        (hblock _).mpr hb |>.1, (hblock _).mpr hb |>.2, ?_⟩
      rwa [hvalue _ hb]
  · refine (synthesis_table pattern (w := 2 ^ k)
      (fun β => (card_le_univ _).trans (by simp)) chosen).complexity_le.trans ?_
    have hsum : ∑ r, #(chosen r) ≤ #D / J + 2 ^ l := by
      calc ∑ r, #(chosen r) ≤ ∑ r, (#(rowSupport D r) / J + 1) :=
            sum_le_sum fun r _ => card_image_le.trans (card_range _).le
        _ ≤ #D / J + 2 ^ l := by
            rw [sum_add_distrib, ← sum_card_rowSupport D]
            simpa using sum_div_le_div_sum univ (fun r => #(rowSupport D r)) J
    have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin (2 ^ k + 1) × Fin (2 ^ k + 1) × bank) * (2 ^ k + 1) ≤
        (2 ^ k + 1) ^ 3 * (2 * 2 ^ k + 1) * 2 ^ J := by
      simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_coe]
      calc (2 ^ k + 1) * ((2 ^ k + 1) * #bank) * (2 ^ k + 1) = (2 ^ k + 1) ^ 3 * #bank := by ring
        _ ≤ (2 ^ k + 1) ^ 3 * ((2 * 2 ^ k + 1) * 2 ^ J) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hbank_card
        _ = (2 ^ k + 1) ^ 3 * (2 * 2 ^ k + 1) * 2 ^ J := by ring
    unfold partialTableBound
    omega

private theorem complexity_indicator_le_card_mul {n : ℕ} (R : Finset (BitString n)) :
    complexity interpretation (single fun x => decide (x ∈ R)) ≤ #R * (2 * n + 2) + 1 := by
  have h := Synthesis.exists_mem R (fun a x => decide ((fun i => x (id i)) = a))
    (fun _ => 2 * n + 1) fun a _ => synthesis_minterm id a
  have heq : (fun x => decide (∃ a ∈ R, decide ((fun i => x (id i)) = a) = true)) =
      fun x => decide (x ∈ R) := by
    funext x
    simp
  rw [heq] at h

/-- **One filter.** Hash to `k + l` bits and look the hash up in the image of `B`, by a sparse
table. This keeps all of `B` and, for a suitable hash, at most a `|B| / 2 ^ (k + l)` fraction
of `A`. -/

private theorem exists_filter {n : ℕ} (A B : Finset (BitString n)) (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (k l : ℕ) {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    ∃ φ : BooleanFunction n, (∀ x ∈ B, φ x = true) ∧
      #{x ∈ A | φ x = true} * 2 ^ (k + l) ≤ #A * #B ∧
      complexity interpretation (single φ) ≤
        (k + l) * (4 * n + 1) + sparseTableBound k l K #B := by
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := exists_card_filter_linearMap_mul_le (A ×ˢ B)
    (fun z hz h => disjoint_left.mp hAB (mem_product.mp hz).1 (h ▸ (mem_product.mp hz).2))
    (k + l)
  let φ : BooleanFunction n := fun x => decide (linearMap H x ∈ B.image (linearMap H))
  refine ⟨φ, fun x hx => decide_eq_true (mem_image_of_mem _ hx), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hsub : ({x ∈ A | φ x = true} : Finset (BitString n)) ⊆
        ({z ∈ A ×ˢ B | linearMap H z.1 = linearMap H z.2} :
          Finset (BitString n × BitString n)).image Prod.fst := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨hxA, hφ⟩ := mem_filter.mp hx
      obtain ⟨y, hyB, hy⟩ := mem_image.mp (of_decide_eq_true hφ)
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨(x, y), mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_product.mpr ⟨hxA, hyB⟩, hy.symm⟩, rfl⟩
    calc #{x ∈ A | φ x = true} * 2 ^ (k + l)
        ≤ #{z ∈ A ×ˢ B | linearMap H z.1 = linearMap H z.2} * 2 ^ (k + l) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ((card_le_card hsub).trans card_image_le)
      _ ≤ #A * #B := hH.trans (card_product A B).le
  · have hcomp : single φ =
        (single fun y => decide (y ∈ B.image (linearMap H))) ∘ linearMap H := rfl
    rw [hcomp]
    refine (complexity_comp_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add (complexity_linearMap_le H) ?_)
    exact (complexity_indicator_le_sparseTableBound _ hK).trans
      (sparseTableBound_mono card_image_le)

/-- **Repeated filters.** If `|B| ≤ 2 ^ p` and the hashes have `k + l = p + a` bits, then `t`
filters keep all of `B` and at most a `2 ^ -(a t)` fraction of `A`. -/

text:
private theorem exists_filters {n p a k l K : ℕ} (B : Finset (BitString n)) (hB : #B ≤ 2 ^ p)
    (hkl : k + l = p + a) (hK : 0 < K) (t : ℕ) :
    ∀ A : Finset (BitString n), Disjoint A B → ∃ φ : BooleanFunction n,
      (∀ x ∈ B, φ x = true) ∧ #{x ∈ A | φ x = true} * 2 ^ (a * t) ≤ #A ∧
      complexity interpretation (single φ) ≤
        t * ((k + l) * (4 * n + 1) + sparseTableBound k l K (2 ^ p) + 1) + 1 := by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    intro A _
    refine ⟨fun _ => true, by simp, by simp, ?_⟩
    simpa using (Synthesis.const (s := inputs n) true).complexity_le
  | succ t ih =>
    intro A hAB
    obtain ⟨φ, hφB, hφA, hφ⟩ := exists_filter A B hAB k l hK
    let rest := A.filter fun x => φ x = true
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψB, hψA, hψ⟩ := ih rest (disjoint_of_subset_left (filter_subset _ _) hAB)
    refine ⟨fun x => φ x && ψ x, fun x hx => by simp [hφB x hx, hψB x hx], ?_, ?_⟩
    · have heq : ({x ∈ A | (φ x && ψ x) = true} : Finset (BitString n)) =
          {x ∈ rest | ψ x = true} := by
        ext x
        simp [rest, and_assoc]
      have hrest : #rest * 2 ^ a ≤ #A := by
        have h : #rest * 2 ^ a * 2 ^ p ≤ #A * 2 ^ p :=
          calc #rest * 2 ^ a * 2 ^ p = #rest * 2 ^ (k + l) := by rw [hkl, pow_add]; ring
            _ ≤ #A * #B := hφA
            _ ≤ #A * 2 ^ p := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hB
        exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right h (Nat.two_pow_pos p)
      rw [heq, Nat.mul_succ, pow_add]
      calc #{x ∈ rest | ψ x = true} * (2 ^ (a * t) * 2 ^ a)
          = #{x ∈ rest | ψ x = true} * 2 ^ (a * t) * 2 ^ a := by ring
        _ ≤ #rest * 2 ^ a := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hψA
        _ ≤ #A := hrest
    · refine (complexity_and_le φ ψ).trans ?_
      have := hφ.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (sparseTableBound_mono (K := K) (l := l) hB) _)
      rw [Nat.succ_mul]
      omega

/-- The gate budget of the construction for the indicator of a set of at most `2 ^ p` of the
`2 ^ n` inputs: `t` filters, each hashing to `k + l = p + a` bits and looking the hash up in a
sparse table with chunks of `K` columns, and explicit minterms for the at most
`2 ^ n / 2 ^ (a t)` inputs that wrongly pass every filter. -/

text:
theorem complexity_indicator_le_indicatorBound {n p a k l K : ℕ} (B : Finset (BitString n))
    (hB : #B ≤ 2 ^ p) (hkl : k + l = p + a) (hK : 0 < K) (t : ℕ) :
    complexity interpretation (single fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≤
      indicatorBound n k l K p a t := by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφB, hφA, hφ⟩ := exists_filters B hB hkl hK t Bᶜ disjoint_compl_left
  let R := Bᶜ.filter fun x => φ x = true
  have hR : #R ≤ 2 ^ n / 2 ^ (a * t) :=
    (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (Nat.two_pow_pos _)).mpr
      (hφA.trans ((card_le_univ _).trans (by simp)))
  have heq : (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) = fun x => φ x && !decide (x ∈ R) := by
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ B
    · simp [R, hx, hφB x hx]
    · cases h : φ x <;> simp [R, hx, h]
  rw [heq]
  have hR' := (complexity_not_le _).trans
    (Nat.add_le_add_right (complexity_indicator_le_card_mul R) 1)
  refine (complexity_and_le _ _).trans
    (le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.add_le_add hφ hR') 1) ?_)
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 * n + 2) hR
  unfold indicatorBound
  omega

/-- The gate budget of the construction for a function on a set of `w` of the `2 ^ n` inputs:
a hash to `k + l` bits, a partial table with chunks of `J` entries for the values on the
image, and explicit minterms correcting the at most `w ^ 2 / 2 ^ (k + l)` inputs whose hashes

theorem complexityOn_le_partialBound {n : ℕ} (k l : ℕ) {J : ℕ} (D : Finset (BitString n))
    (u : BooleanFunction n) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    complexityOn interpretation D (single u) ≤ partialBound n k l J #D := by
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := exists_card_filter_linearMap_mul_le D.offDiag
    (fun z hz => (mem_offDiag.mp hz).2.2) (k + l)
  let T := D.image (linearMap H)
  have hpre (y : BitString (k + l)) (hy : y ∈ T) : ∃ x ∈ D, linearMap H x = y := mem_image.mp hy
  choose rep hrep_mem hrep using hpre
  let label (y : BitString (k + l)) : Bool := if hy : y ∈ T then u (rep y hy) else false
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφc⟩ := exists_eqOn_complexity_le_partialTableBound T label hJ
  let E := D.filter fun x => φ (linearMap H x) ≠ u x
  have hE : #E * 2 ^ (k + l) ≤ #D * #D := by
    have hsub : E ⊆ ({z ∈ D.offDiag | linearMap H z.1 = linearMap H z.2} :
        Finset (BitString n × BitString n)).image Prod.fst := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨hxD, hne⟩ := mem_filter.mp hx
      have hy : linearMap H x ∈ T := mem_image_of_mem _ hxD
      refine mem_image.mpr ⟨(x, rep _ hy), mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_offDiag.mpr ⟨hxD,
        hrep_mem _ hy, fun h => hne ?_⟩, (hrep _ hy).symm⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [hφ hy]
      simp only [label, hy, dite_true]
      exact congrArg u h.symm
    calc #E * 2 ^ (k + l)
        ≤ #{z ∈ D.offDiag | linearMap H z.1 = linearMap H z.2} * 2 ^ (k + l) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ((card_le_card hsub).trans card_image_le)
      _ ≤ #D.offDiag := hH
      _ ≤ #D * #D := by rw [offDiag_card]; exact Nat.sub_le _ _
  have hEc := (complexity_indicator_le_card_mul E).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 * n + 2) ((Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (Nat.two_pow_pos _)).mpr hE)) 1)
  have hcongr : Set.EqOn (single u) (single fun x => φ (linearMap H x) ^^ decide (x ∈ E))
      (D : Set (BitString n)) := by
    intro x hx
    funext j
    have hx : x ∈ D := hx
    by_cases h : φ (linearMap H x) = u x
    · simp [E, hx, h]
    · simp only [single_apply, E, mem_filter, hx, true_and]
      cases hu : u x <;> cases hv : φ (linearMap H x) <;> simp_all
  rw [complexityOn_congr hcongr]
  refine complexityOn_le_complexity.trans ((complexity_xor_le _ _).trans ?_)
  have hcomp : single (fun x => φ (linearMap H x)) = single φ ∘ linearMap H := rfl
  rw [hcomp]
  have hHφ := (complexity_comp_le (I := interpretation) (linearMap H) (single φ)).trans
    (Nat.add_le_add (complexity_linearMap_le H)
      (hφc.trans (partialTableBound_mono card_image_le)))
  unfold partialBound
  omega

theorem exists_split (hσ : ∀ op, σ.Arity op ≤ 2) {L : ℕ} (hL : 2 ≤ L) (H : Formula σ n)
    (hH : 2 * L < 3 * H.leafSize) :
    ∃ (G : Formula σ n) (C : Formula σ (n + 1)), C.substLast G = H ∧
      L < 3 * G.leafSize ∧ 3 * G.leafSize ≤ 2 * L ∧
      ∀ K, (C.substLast K).leafSize + G.leafSize = H.leafSize + K.leafSize := by
  induction H with
  | input i =>
    simp only [leafSize_input] at hH
    omega
  | gate op args ih =>
    rw [leafSize_gate] at hH
    have hne : (univ : Finset (Fin (σ.Arity op))).Nonempty := by
      by_contra h
      rw [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 h, sum_empty] at hH
      omega
    -- the argument with the most leaves has at least half of them
    obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := exists_max_image univ (fun j => (args j).leafSize) hne
    have hhalf : ∑ j, (args j).leafSize ≤ 2 * (args a).leafSize :=
      (sum_le_card_nsmul univ _ _ fun j _ => ha j (mem_univ j)).trans (by
        rw [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hσ op))
    -- stop at it, or keep walking
    obtain ⟨G, C, hC, h₁, h₂, hls⟩ : ∃ (G : Formula σ n) (C : Formula σ (n + 1)),
        C.substLast G = args a ∧ L < 3 * G.leafSize ∧ 3 * G.leafSize ≤ 2 * L ∧
        ∀ K, (C.substLast K).leafSize + G.leafSize = (args a).leafSize + K.leafSize := by
      by_cases hA : 2 * L < 3 * (args a).leafSize
      · exact ih a hA
      · exact ⟨args a, input (Fin.last n), input_last_substLast _, by omega, by omega,
          fun K => by rw [input_last_substLast, add_comm]⟩
    refine ⟨G, gate op (Function.update (fun j => (args j).lift) a C), ?_, h₁, h₂, fun K => ?_⟩
    · rw [gate_substLast]
      congr 1
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = a
      · subst hj
        simpa using hC
      · simp [Function.update_of_ne hj]
    · have hsum : (fun j => ((Function.update (fun j => (args j).lift) a C j).substLast
            K).leafSize) =
          Function.update (fun j => (args j).leafSize) a (C.substLast K).leafSize := by
        funext j
        by_cases hj : j = a
        · subst hj
          simp
        · simp [Function.update_of_ne hj]
      rw [gate_substLast, leafSize_gate, leafSize_gate, hsum, sum_update_of_mem (mem_univ a),
        sum_eq_add_sum_sdiff_singleton_of_mem (mem_univ a) fun j => (args j).leafSize]
      have := hls K
      omega

    ∃ G : Formula signature n, (∀ x, G.eval interpretation x = F.eval interpretation x) ∧
      G.depthWith binaryCost = 0 := by

        fun x => eval_eq_of_leafSize_eq_zero h₀ interpretation (fun _ => false) x, by simp⟩
    -- one argument has the leaf, and the others compute constants
    rw [leafSize_gate] at h₁

    rw [sum_eq_add_sum_sdiff_singleton_of_mem (mem_univ b)] at h₁

      fun x => ?_, Nat.le_zero.1 ((depthWith_postcomp_le _ _).trans hd.le)⟩
    rw [eval_postcomp, hG, eval_gate]

    by_cases hj : j = b

def thresholdDeMorganCircuit (k j : ℕ) : Circuit signature k 1 :=
  if h : j ≤ k then
    let w := Nat.clog 2 (k + 1)
    have hj : j < 2 ^ w :=
      (Nat.lt_succ_of_le h).trans_le (Nat.le_pow_clog one_lt_two (k + 1))
    (leCircuit w).comp
      ((wordConstCircuit k ((BitString.equivFin w).symm ⟨j, hj⟩)).append (weightCircuit k))
  else
    Circuit.oneGate (Op.const false) Fin.elim0

theorem kwProtocol_solves (p : Program signature n g) (i₀ : Fin n) (d : ℕ) (w : Wire n g)
    (s : Bool) (hw : p.wireDepthsWith andOrCost w ≤ d) (x y : BitString n)
    (hx : p.trace interpretation x w = s) (hy : p.trace interpretation y w = !s) :
    x ((kwProtocol p i₀ d w s).run x y) ≠ y ((kwProtocol p i₀ d w s).run x y) := by
  match w with
  | .input i =>
    rw [kwProtocol.eq_def]
    dsimp only [RoundProtocol.run]
    simp only [Program.trace_input] at hx hy
    rw [hx, hy]
    cases s <;> decide
  | .gate k =>
    have hval (z : BitString n) : p.trace interpretation z (.gate k) =
        interpretation (p.lines k).op fun a => p.trace interpretation z ((p.lines k).wires a) :=
      (p.lines_eval interpretation z k).symm
    have hdk : p.depthsWith andOrCost k ≤ d := hw
    have hle (a : Fin (signature.Arity (p.lines k).op)) :
        p.wireDepthsWith andOrCost ((p.lines k).wires a) + andOrCost (p.lines k).op ≤
          p.depthsWith andOrCost k :=
      p.wireDepthsWith_lines_add_le _ k a
    have hcost := p.cost_le_depthsWith andOrCost k
    rw [kwProtocol.eq_def]
    dsimp only
    split
    · rename_i hop
      have hx' := (hval x).symm.trans hx
      have hy' := (hval y).symm.trans hy
      rw [interpretation_of_op_eq_not hop] at hx' hy'
      have hfirst := firstArg_of_op_eq_not i₀ hop
      have hd : p.wireDepthsWith andOrCost (firstArg p i₀ k) ≤ d := by
        rw [hfirst]
        exact (Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans ((hle _).trans hdk)
      refine kwProtocol_solves p i₀ d _ (!s) hd x y ?_ ?_
      · rw [hfirst, ← hx', Bool.not_not]
      · rw [hfirst, ← hy', Bool.not_not]
    · rename_i m hop
      have hc : andOrCost (p.lines k).op = 1 := by rw [hop]; rfl
      split
      · omega
      rename_i d
      -- the player whose input makes the conjunction false names a false argument
      have hfalse : ∀ {z z' : BitString n}, p.trace interpretation z (.gate k) = false →
          p.trace interpretation z' (.gate k) = true →
          ∃ a, argWith p k false z = (p.lines k).wires a ∧
            p.trace interpretation z ((p.lines k).wires a) = false ∧
            p.trace interpretation z' ((p.lines k).wires a) = true := by
        intro z z' hz hz'
        rw [hval, ← Bool.not_eq_true, interpretation_of_op_eq_and hop] at hz
        push Not at hz
        obtain ⟨a, ha, hza⟩ := argWith_spec (b := false) (by simpa using hz)
        rw [hval, interpretation_of_op_eq_and hop] at hz'
        exact ⟨a, ha, hza, hz' a⟩
      rw [RoundProtocol.run_speak]
      cases s
      · obtain ⟨a, ha, hxa, hya⟩ := hfalse hx (by simpa using hy)
        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ha]
        exact kwProtocol_solves p i₀ d _ false (by have := hle a; omega) x y hxa hya
      · obtain ⟨a, ha, hya, hxa⟩ := hfalse (by simpa using hy) hx
        simp only [↓reduceIte, ha]
        exact kwProtocol_solves p i₀ d _ true (by have := hle a; omega) x y hxa
          (by simpa using hya)
    · rename_i m hop
      have hc : andOrCost (p.lines k).op = 1 := by rw [hop]; rfl
      split
      · omega
      rename_i d
      -- the player whose input makes the disjunction true names a true argument
      have htrue : ∀ {z z' : BitString n}, p.trace interpretation z (.gate k) = true →
          p.trace interpretation z' (.gate k) = false →
          ∃ a, argWith p k true z = (p.lines k).wires a ∧
            p.trace interpretation z ((p.lines k).wires a) = true ∧
            p.trace interpretation z' ((p.lines k).wires a) = false := by
        intro z z' hz hz'
        rw [hval, interpretation_of_op_eq_or hop] at hz
        obtain ⟨a, ha, hza⟩ := argWith_spec (b := true) hz
        rw [hval, ← Bool.not_eq_true, interpretation_of_op_eq_or hop] at hz'
        push Not at hz'
        exact ⟨a, ha, hza, by simpa using hz' a⟩
      rw [RoundProtocol.run_speak]
      cases s
      · obtain ⟨a, ha, hya, hxa⟩ := htrue (by simpa using hy) hx
        simp only [Bool.not_false, ↓reduceIte, ha]
        exact kwProtocol_solves p i₀ d _ false (by have := hle a; omega) x y hxa
          (by simpa using hya)
      · obtain ⟨a, ha, hxa, hya⟩ := htrue hx (by simpa using hy)
        simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ha]
        exact kwProtocol_solves p i₀ d _ true (by have := hle a; omega) x y hxa
          (by simpa using hya)
termination_by (d, p.wireDepths w)
decreasing_by
  all_goals simp_wf
  · exact Prod.Lex.right _ (wireDepths_firstArg_lt p i₀ k)
  all_goals exact Prod.Lex.left _ _ (by omega)

    (hC : C.Computes interpretation (single f)) (i₀ : Fin n) {d : ℕ}
    (hd : C.depthWith andOrCost ≤ d) :
    ∃ P : KWRoundProtocol (Fin n) (Wire n C.size) d, P.SolvesKW f := by
  have hval (x : BitString n) : C.program.trace interpretation x (C.outputs 0) = f x :=
    congrFun (hC x) 0

  exact kwProtocol_solves C.program i₀ d _ false
    ((C.wireDepthsWith_outputs_le_depthWith _ 0).trans hd) x y
    ((hval x).trans hx) ((hval y).trans hy)

private theorem exists_add_pow_le_two_rpow {r ε : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hε : 0 < ε) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → (n : ℝ) + n ^ k ≤ 2 ^ (ε * (n : ℝ) ^ r) := by
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hlog2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
  have hc : 0 < ε * Real.log 2 / ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  -- `log n = o(n ^ r)`
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.eventually
    ((isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop hr).def hc))
  refine ⟨max N 2, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := le_of_max_le_right hn
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by positivity
  have hbound := hN n (le_of_max_le_left hn)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hnpos.le _)] at hbound
  have hlog : ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log n ≤ Real.log 2 * (ε * (n : ℝ) ^ r) := by
    have h := (le_abs_self _).trans hbound
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hD] at h
    linarith
  -- `n + n ^ k ≤ 2 n ^ (k + 1) ≤ n ^ (k + 2)`
  have hnat : n + n ^ k ≤ n ^ (k + 2) := by
    have h1 : n ≤ n ^ (k + 1) := by
      simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : 0 < n) (show 1 ≤ k + 1 by omega)
    have h2 : n ^ k ≤ n ^ (k + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (Nat.le_succ k)
    calc n + n ^ k ≤ 2 * n ^ (k + 1) := by omega
      _ ≤ n * n ^ (k + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hn2
      _ = n ^ (k + 2) := by ring
  calc (n : ℝ) + n ^ k ≤ ((n ^ (k + 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnat
    _ = Real.exp (((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log n) := by
        rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log hnpos]
        norm_cast
    _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log 2 * (ε * (n : ℝ) ^ r)) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hlog
    _ = 2 ^ (ε * (n : ℝ) ^ r) := (Real.rpow_def_of_pos two_pos _).symm

private theorem balancedFold_keyedMinFn {α : Type*} (f : α → BitString (k + p))
    (e : BitString (k + p)) {l : List α} (hl : l ≠ []) :
    (∃ a ∈ l, l.balancedFold keyedMinFn e f = f a) ∧
      ∀ a ∈ l, BitString.equivFin k (recordKey (l.balancedFold keyedMinFn e f)) ≤
        BitString.equivFin k (recordKey (f a)) := by
  refine List.balancedFold_induction (p := fun l v => l ≠ [] → (∃ a ∈ l, v = f a) ∧
      ∀ a ∈ l, BitString.equivFin k (recordKey v) ≤ BitString.equivFin k (recordKey (f a)))
    (fun h => absurd rfl h) (fun a _ => ⟨⟨a, by simp⟩, fun b hb => by simp_all⟩)

  obtain ⟨⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hu⟩ := hu h₁
  obtain ⟨⟨b, hb, rfl⟩, hv⟩ := hv h₂
  refine ⟨?_, fun c hc => ?_⟩
  · rcases keyedMinFn_eq_or_eq (f a) (f b) with h | h
    · exact ⟨a, List.mem_append_left _ ha, h⟩
    · exact ⟨b, List.mem_append_right _ hb, h⟩
  · rcases List.mem_append.1 hc with hc | hc

private theorem masked_activation_step (p : Program activationSignature n g)
    (T : Fin g → ℕ)
    (hT : ∀ j ∈ activationInputGates p, ChangesAtMost (p.lines j).op.activate (T j))
    (gate : Fin g) :
    (BlockKind.oneDim (if gate ∈ activationInputGates p then T gate else 0)).Step
      (fun x j => if j.val < gate.val then p.eval activationInterpretation x j else false)
      (fun x j => if j.val < gate.val + 1 then
        p.eval activationInterpretation x j else false) := by
  classical
  by_cases hgate : gate ∈ activationInputGates p
  · simp only [hgate, ite_true, BlockKind.Step]

      exact ((hT gate hgate).comp_monotone (monotone_id.add_const _)).comp
        (Function.update z gate)
    · exact masked_activation_succ p gate
  · simp only [hgate, ite_false, BlockKind.Step]
    refine ⟨fun _ => 0,
      fun z _ => Function.update z gate ((p.lines gate).op.activate
        (∑ j, activationGateWeight p gate j * (z j).toNat)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z

private theorem not_reachable {K : ℕ}
    (hf : ∀ b : Bool, Frontier.RectangleFree {x | f x = b} K) (D : BlockDecomposition f H)
    (U : Finset (Fin n)) {NP NQ : ℕ} (h : Reachable D U D.length NP NQ) (hP : K ≤ NP)
    (hQ : 2 * K ≤ NQ) : False := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, Q, η, hNP, hNQ, hη⟩ := h
  let o : (↥(↑U : Set (Fin n))ᶜ → Bool) → Bool := fun q => D.output (η q)
  have hf' : ∀ p ∈ P, ∀ q ∈ Q, f (glue U p q) = o q := by
    intro p hp q hq
    rw [← D.output_history, hη p hp q hq]
  have hsplit := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := Q) (fun q => o q = true)
  have hfalse : (Q.filter fun q => ¬ o q = true) = Q.filter fun q => o q = false := by
    ext q
    simp
  rw [hfalse] at hsplit
  have hlarge : ∃ b : Bool, K ≤ (Q.filter fun q => o q = b).card := by
    by_contra hno
    push Not at hno
    have h1 := hno true
    have h2 := hno false
    omega
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hlarge
  have hrect : Frontier.rectangle (↑U) (↑P)
      (↑(Q.filter fun q => o q = b)) ⊆ {x | f x = b} := by
    intro x hx
    have h := hf' _ hx.1 _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx.2).1
    have hx' : glue U ((↑U : Set (Fin n)).domRestrict x)
        ((↑U : Set (Fin n))ᶜ.domRestrict x) = x :=
      (Equiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd (· ∈ U) fun _ => Bool).symm_apply_apply x
    rw [hx'] at h
    exact h.trans (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx.2).2
  rcases (hf b).ncard_lt_or _ _ _ hrect with h | h <;>
    simp only [Set.ncard_coe_finset] at h <;> omega

private theorem masked_eval_step (p : Program signature n g) (gate : Fin g) :
    (BlockKind.oneDim (if gate ∈ inputGates p then 1 else 0)).Step
      (fun x j => if j.val < gate.val then p.eval interpretation x j else false)
      (fun x j => if j.val < gate.val + 1 then p.eval interpretation x j else false) := by
  classical
  by_cases hgate : gate ∈ inputGates p
  · simp only [hgate, ite_true, BlockKind.Step]
    refine ⟨inputWeight p gate,
      fun z t => Function.update z gate (decide ((p.lines gate).op.threshold ≤
        t + ∑ j, gateWeight p gate j * (z j).toNat)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z
      exact ((ChangesAtMost.decide_le _).comp (Function.update z gate)).comp_monotone
        (monotone_id.add_const _)
    · exact masked_eval_succ p gate
  · simp only [hgate, ite_false, BlockKind.Step]
    refine ⟨fun _ => 0,
      fun z _ => Function.update z gate (decide ((p.lines gate).op.threshold ≤
        ∑ j, gateWeight p gate j * (z j).toNat)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z
      exact ChangesAtMost.const _
    · intro x
      simpa only [inputWeight_eq_zero_of_not_mem p hgate, zero_mul, sum_const_zero,
        zero_add] using masked_eval_succ p gate x

theorem evalFrom_eq_eval (p : Program signature n g) {fixed : Finset (Fin g)} {η : Fin g → Bool}
    {z : Fin g → ℝ} {x : Fin n → Bool} (gate : Fin g)
    (hfix : ∀ prior ≤ gate, prior ∈ fixed → η prior = p.eval interpretation x prior)
    (hz : ∀ prior ≤ gate, prior ∉ fixed → z prior = ∑ i, inputWeight p prior i * (x i).toNat) :
    evalFrom p fixed η z gate = p.eval interpretation x gate := by
  induction gate using Fin.strong_induction_on with
  | h gate ih =>
    by_cases hgate : gate ∈ fixed
    · rw [evalFrom_eq, ite_eq_left hgate]
      exact hfix gate le_rfl hgate
    · rw [evalFrom_eq, ite_eq_right hgate, eval_gate_eq, hz gate le_rfl hgate]
      have hsum : (∑ prior : Fin g, if prior < gate then
            gateWeight p gate prior * (evalFrom p fixed η z prior).toNat else 0) =
          ∑ prior : Fin g, gateWeight p gate prior * (p.eval interpretation x prior).toNat := by
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro prior _
        by_cases hprior : prior < gate
        · rw [ite_eq_left hprior, ih prior hprior
            (fun k hk => hfix k (hk.trans hprior.le))
            (fun k hk => hz k (hk.trans hprior.le))]
        · rw [ite_eq_right hprior, gateWeight_eq_zero_of_le p gate prior (le_of_not_gt hprior),
            zero_mul]
      rw [hsum]

noncomputable def DirectionRuns.toBlockDecomposition (p : Program signature n g)
    (readout : (Fin g → Bool) → Bool) {B : ℕ} (R : DirectionRuns p B) :
    BlockDecomposition (fun x => readout (p.eval interpretation x)) (Fin g → Bool) where
  length := B
  kind i := .oneDim (2 ^ R.size i - 1)
  history i x := fun gate => if R.run gate < i then p.eval interpretation x gate else false
  output := readout
  history_zero x y := by
    funext gate
    simp
  step i _ := by
    classical
    let fixed : Finset (Fin g) := Finset.univ.filter fun gate => R.run gate < i
    refine ⟨R.dir i, fun η t gate => if R.run gate < i + 1 then
      evalFrom p fixed η (fun k => R.slope i k * t) gate else false, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro η
      have hp := (piecesAtMost_evalFrom p fixed η (R.slope i)).comp
        (fun v gate => if R.run gate < i + 1 then v gate else false)
      have hcount : (Finset.univ.filter fun gate => gate ∉ fixed ∧ R.slope i gate ≠ 0).card ≤
          R.size i := by
        unfold DirectionRuns.size
        apply Finset.card_le_card
        intro gate hgate
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hgate ⊢
        have hc : R.run gate = i ∧ gate ∈ inputGates p := by
          by_contra hc
          exact hgate.2 (ite_eq_right hc)
        exact ⟨hc.2, hc.1⟩
      exact (hp.mono (Nat.pow_le_pow_right Nat.two_pos hcount)).changesAtMost
    · intro x
      funext gate
      by_cases hgate : R.run gate < i + 1
      · simp only [hgate, ite_true]
        symm
        apply evalFrom_eq_eval
        · intro prior _ hpf
          simp only [fixed, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hpf
          simp [hpf]
        · intro prior hle hpf
          simp only [fixed, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_lt] at hpf
          have hrun : R.run prior = i := by
            have := R.monotone hle
            omega
          exact (R.weightedSum_eq hrun x).symm
      · simp [hgate]
  output_history x := by
    congr 1
    funext gate
    simp [R.run_lt gate]

    ext i

private theorem touchBelow_succ (prog : Program signature n g) (S D : Finset (Fin n))
    {m : ℕ} (j₀ : Fin g) (hj₀ : j₀.val = m) :
    touchBelow prog S D (m + 1) =
      touchBelow prog S D m + (if ¬ inputSupport prog j₀ ∩ S ⊆ D then 1 else 0) := by
  classical
  unfold touchBelow
  by_cases h : ¬ inputSupport prog j₀ ∩ S ⊆ D
  · rw [ite_eq_left h]
    have hins : (univ.filter fun j : Fin g => j.val < m + 1 ∧ ¬ inputSupport prog j ∩ S ⊆ D) =
        insert j₀ (univ.filter fun j : Fin g => j.val < m ∧ ¬ inputSupport prog j ∩ S ⊆ D) := by
      ext j
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_insert]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hjm, hjS⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hjm with hlt | heq
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hlt, hjS⟩
        · exact Or.inl (Fin.ext (heq.trans hj₀.symm))
      · rintro (rfl | ⟨hlt, hjS⟩)
        · exact ⟨by omega, h⟩
        · exact ⟨by omega, hjS⟩
    have hnotmem : j₀ ∉ univ.filter
        fun j : Fin g => j.val < m ∧ ¬ inputSupport prog j ∩ S ⊆ D := by
      simp [hj₀]
    rw [hins, card_insert_of_notMem hnotmem]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h, add_zero]
    congr 1
    ext j
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hjm, hjS⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hjm with hlt | heq
      · exact ⟨hlt, hjS⟩
      · have : j = j₀ := Fin.ext (heq.trans hj₀.symm)
        subst this
        exact (h hjS).elim
    · rintro ⟨hlt, hjS⟩
      exact ⟨by omega, hjS⟩

theorem exists_rectangle_of_split (p : Program signature n g)
    (readout : (Fin g → Bool) → Bool) {f : Cslib.BooleanFunction n}
    (hreadout : ∀ x, readout (p.eval interpretation x) = f x)
    (U A B : Finset (Fin n)) (hA : A ⊆ U) (hB : B ⊆ Uᶜ)
    (hsplit : ∀ j, inputSupport p j ⊆ U ∨ inputSupport p j ⊆ Uᶜ) :
    ∃ (P : Finset (U → Bool)) (Q : Finset (↥Uᶜ → Bool)) (b : Bool),
      (∀ x ∈ P, ∀ y ∈ Q, f (glue U x y) = b) ∧
      2 ^ (U.card - A.card) ≤
        P.card * 2 ^ (univ.filter fun j =>
          inputSupport p j ⊆ U ∧ ¬ inputSupport p j ⊆ A).card ∧
      2 ^ (Uᶜ.card - B.card) ≤
        Q.card * 2 ^ (univ.filter fun j =>
          inputSupport p j ⊆ Uᶜ ∧ ¬ inputSupport p j ⊆ B).card := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, Q, v, hv, hP, hQ⟩ := exists_rectangle_of_cut_with_fixed p U A B hA hB
  have hfilterU : (univ.filter fun j => ¬ inputSupport p j ∩ U ⊆ A) =
      univ.filter fun j => inputSupport p j ⊆ U ∧ ¬ inputSupport p j ⊆ A := by
    ext j
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    rcases hsplit j with hjU | hjUc
    · rw [inter_eq_left.mpr hjU]
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨hjU, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩
    · have hemp : inputSupport p j ∩ U = ∅ :=
        disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp (disjoint_compl_left.mono_left hjUc)
      rw [hemp]
      simp only [empty_subset, not_true_eq_false, false_iff, not_and]
      intro hjU'
      have hsub : inputSupport p j ⊆ ∅ := by
         rw [← hemp]
         exact subset_inter Subset.rfl hjU'
      exact not_not.mpr (hsub.trans (empty_subset A))
  have hfilterUc : (univ.filter fun j => ¬ inputSupport p j ∩ Uᶜ ⊆ B) =
      univ.filter fun j => inputSupport p j ⊆ Uᶜ ∧ ¬ inputSupport p j ⊆ B := by
    ext j
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    rcases hsplit j with hjU | hjUc
    · have hemp : inputSupport p j ∩ Uᶜ = ∅ :=
        disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp (disjoint_compl_right.mono_left hjU)
      rw [hemp]
      simp only [empty_subset, not_true_eq_false, false_iff, not_and]
      intro hjUc'
      have hsub : inputSupport p j ⊆ ∅ := by
        rw [← hemp]
        exact subset_inter Subset.rfl hjUc'
      exact not_not.mpr (hsub.trans (empty_subset B))
    · rw [inter_eq_left.mpr hjUc]
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨hjUc, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩
  refine ⟨P, Q, readout v, fun x hx y hy => by rw [← hreadout, hv x hx y hy], ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [← hfilterU]
  · rwa [← hfilterUc]

theorem priority_le_pow {W : ℝ} (hW0 : 0 ≤ W)
    (hW : ∀ j i : Fin g, i < j → |P.gateWeight j i| ≤ W) (i : Fin g) :
    P.priority i ≤ (W + 1) ^ (g - 1 - i.val) := by
  suffices ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin g, g - 1 - i.val = m → P.priority i ≤ (W + 1) ^ m from this _ i rfl
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h m ih =>
    intro i him
    rw [P.priority_eq, ← one_add_mul_sum_geom W m]
    have hsum : (∑ j : Fin g, if i < j then P.priority j * |P.gateWeight j i| else 0) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ univ.filter (fun j : Fin g => i < j), W * (W + 1) ^ (g - 1 - j.val) := by
      rw [← sum_filter]
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      have hij : i < j := (mem_filter.mp hj).2
      have hjp : P.priority j ≤ (W + 1) ^ (g - 1 - j.val) :=
        ih (g - 1 - j.val) (by have := j.isLt; omega) j rfl
      calc P.priority j * |P.gateWeight j i|
          ≤ (W + 1) ^ (g - 1 - j.val) * W :=
            mul_le_mul hjp (hW j i hij) (abs_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
        _ = W * (W + 1) ^ (g - 1 - j.val) := mul_comm _ _
    let f : Fin g → ℕ := fun j => g - 1 - j.val
    have hmaps : ∀ j ∈ univ.filter (fun j : Fin g => i < j), f j ∈ range m := by
      intro j hj
      have hij : i < j := (mem_filter.mp hj).2
      simp only [f, mem_range]
      have := j.isLt
      omega
    have hinj_on : Set.InjOn f (univ.filter fun j : Fin g => i < j) := by
      intro j₁ _ j₂ _ heq
      have h₁ := j₁.isLt
      have h₂ := j₂.isLt
      simp only [f] at heq
      exact Fin.ext (by omega)
    have hinj : (∑ j ∈ univ.filter (fun j : Fin g => i < j), W * (W + 1) ^ f j) ≤
        W * ∑ k ∈ range m, (W + 1) ^ k := by
      calc (∑ j ∈ univ.filter (fun j : Fin g => i < j), W * (W + 1) ^ f j)
          = ∑ k ∈ (univ.filter (fun j : Fin g => i < j)).image f, W * (W + 1) ^ k :=
            (sum_image (f := fun k => W * (W + 1) ^ k) hinj_on).symm
        _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ range m, W * (W + 1) ^ k := by
            apply sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (image_subset_iff.mpr hmaps)
            intro k _ _
            exact mul_nonneg hW0 (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
        _ = W * ∑ k ∈ range m, (W + 1) ^ k := (mul_sum _ _ _).symm
    exact add_le_add_right (hsum.trans hinj) 1

private theorem word_carries (ha : ∀ i : Fin w, (fun x => (a x).getLsbD i.val) ∈ s)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin w, (fun x => (b x).getLsbD i.val) ∈ s) (c : Bool) :
    Synthesis interpretation s
      (stages (fun t => {fun x => BitVec.carry t (a x) (b x) c}) w) (4 * w + 1) := by
  let q := fun t => ({fun x => BitVec.carry t (a x) (b x) c} : Set (BooleanFunction n))
  have h0 : Synthesis interpretation s (q 0) 1 := by simpa [q] using Synthesis.const c
  have hs := steps (I := interpretation) (s := s ∪ q 0) q 4 w Set.subset_union_right
    fun t ht => ?_
  · simpa [Nat.add_comm, Nat.mul_comm] using h0.trans hs
  · have hat := of_mem (I := interpretation) (s := s ∪ q 0 ∪ stages q t)
      (Or.inl (Or.inl (ha ⟨t, ht⟩)))
    have hbt := of_mem (I := interpretation) (s := s ∪ q 0 ∪ stages q t)
      (Or.inl (Or.inl (hb ⟨t, ht⟩)))
    have hct := of_mem (I := interpretation) (s := s ∪ q 0 ∪ stages q t)
      (Or.inr (subset_stages q le_rfl rfl))
    have h := (hat.and hbt).or ((hat.or hbt).and hct)
    convert h using 2
    funext x
    rw [BitVec.carry_succ]
    cases (a x).getLsbD t <;> cases (b x).getLsbD t <;>
      cases BitVec.carry t (a x) (b x) c <;> rfl

theorem word_addCarry (ha : ∀ i : Fin w, (fun x => (a x).getLsbD i.val) ∈ s)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin w, (fun x => (b x).getLsbD i.val) ∈ s) (c : Bool) :
    Synthesis interpretation s
      (wordWires fun x => a x + b x + BitVec.setWidth w (BitVec.ofBool c)) (12 * w + 1) := by
  let C := stages (fun t => {fun x => BitVec.carry t (a x) (b x) c}) w
  have hsum := family (I := interpretation) (s := s ∪ C)
    (fun i : Fin w => fun x =>
      (a x).getLsbD i.val ^^ ((b x).getLsbD i.val ^^ BitVec.carry i.val (a x) (b x) c))
    (fun _ => 8) fun i =>
      (of_mem (Or.inl (ha i))).xor ((of_mem (Or.inl (hb i))).xor
        (of_mem (Or.inr (subset_stages _ i.isLt.le rfl))))
  have h := (word_carries a b ha hb c).trans hsum
  have heq : (fun i : Fin w => fun x =>
      (a x + b x + BitVec.setWidth w (BitVec.ofBool c)).getLsbD i.val) =
      fun i : Fin w => fun x =>
        (a x).getLsbD i.val ^^ ((b x).getLsbD i.val ^^ BitVec.carry i.val (a x) (b x) c) :=
    funext fun i => funext fun x => BitVec.getLsbD_add_add_bool i.isLt (a x) (b x) c
  rw [wordWires, heq]
  exact h.mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl
    (by simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]; omega)

theorem card_eq_sum_le {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : X → Bool) {M : X → ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ x, M x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) {ε : ℝ} :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (G : (Fin k → X) → Bool),
      (∀ (i : Fin k) (t : Fin k → X) (b : Bool),
        ∑ y with (G (update t i y) ^^ b) = f y, M y ≤ (1 / 2 + ε) * ∑ y, M y) →
      (#{t | G t = ∑ i, f (t i)} : ℝ) ≤
        (1 / 2 + ε) * Fintype.card X ^ k + (1 / 2 - ε) * (Fintype.card X - ∑ y, M y) ^ k
  | 0, G, _ => by
    have h : (#{t : Fin 0 → X | G t = ∑ i, f (t i)} : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast (card_filter_le _ _).trans (by simp)
    linarith
  | k + 1, G, hG => by
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty X with hX | ⟨⟨z⟩⟩
    · simp
    -- Split off the first input.
    set A : X → (Fin k → X) → ℝ := fun y t =>
      if G (Fin.cons y t) = f y + ∑ i, f (t i) then 1 else 0 with hA
    have hsplit : (#{t | G t = ∑ i, f (t i)} : ℝ) = ∑ y, ∑ t, A y t := by
      rw [natCast_card_filter, ← Fintype.sum_prod_type',
        ← (Fin.consEquiv fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => X).sum_comp]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
      simp [A, Fin.consEquiv, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    -- The part weighted by `M`: a prediction of `f` with the other inputs fixed.
    have hhard (t : Fin k → X) : ∑ y, M y * A y t ≤ (1 / 2 + ε) * ∑ y, M y := by
      refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ (hG 0 (Fin.cons z t) (∑ i, f (t i)))
      rw [sum_filter]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun y _ => ?_
      rw [Fin.update_cons_zero, hA, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
      exact if_congr (eq_add_iff_xor_eq _ _ _) rfl rfl
    -- The part weighted by `1 - M`: the remaining inputs, by induction.
    set B := (1 / 2 + ε) * (Fintype.card X : ℝ) ^ k +
      (1 / 2 - ε) * (Fintype.card X - ∑ y, M y) ^ k
    have hrest (y : X) : (1 - M y) * ∑ t, A y t ≤ (1 - M y) * B := by
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (sub_nonneg.2 (hM y).2)
      have h := card_eq_sum_le f hM k (fun t => G (Fin.cons y t) ^^ f y) fun i t b => by
        simpa only [Fin.cons_update, Bool.xor_assoc] using hG i.succ (Fin.cons y t) (f y ^^ b)
      refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ h
      rw [natCast_card_filter]
      exact sum_congr rfl fun t _ => if_congr (eq_add_iff_xor_eq' _ _ _) rfl rfl
    calc (#{t | G t = ∑ i, f (t i)} : ℝ)
        = ∑ y, (M y * ∑ t, A y t + (1 - M y) * ∑ t, A y t) := by
          rw [hsplit]
          exact sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring
      _ = ∑ t, ∑ y, M y * A y t + ∑ y, (1 - M y) * ∑ t, A y t := by
          rw [sum_add_distrib]
          simp only [mul_sum]
          rw [sum_comm]
      _ ≤ ∑ _t : Fin k → X, (1 / 2 + ε) * ∑ y, M y + ∑ y, (1 - M y) * B :=
          add_le_add (sum_le_sum fun t _ => hhard t) (sum_le_sum fun y _ => hrest y)
      _ = (1 / 2 + ε) * Fintype.card X ^ (k + 1) +
            (1 / 2 - ε) * (Fintype.card X - ∑ y, M y) ^ (k + 1) := by
          rw [← sum_mul, ← sum_mul, sum_sub_distrib]
          simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
            mul_one, B]
          push_cast
          ring

`f` against circuits of size `s + 3` with advantage `ε ≤ 1 / 2`, then every Boolean function of
De Morgan circuit complexity at most `s` agrees with the `k`-fold XOR `f^{⊕k}` on at most a
`1 / 2 + ε + (1 / 2 - ε) (1 - δ) ^ k` fraction of its inputs. -/

theorem IsHardCoreMeasure.card_eq_xorPower_div_le {f : BooleanFunction n} {s : ℕ} {δ ε : ℝ}
    {M : BitString n → ℝ} (hM : IsHardCoreMeasure f (s + 3) δ ε M) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 2) (k : ℕ)
    {g : BooleanFunction (k * n)} (hg : complexity interpretation (single g) ≤ s) :
    (#{x | g x = xorPower f k x} : ℝ) / 2 ^ (k * n) ≤ 1 / 2 + ε + (1 / 2 - ε) * (1 - δ) ^ k := by
  let G : (Fin k → BitString n) → Bool := fun t => g (BitString.blocksEquiv.symm t)
  have hcard : #{x | g x = xorPower f k x} = #{t | G t = ∑ i, f (t i)} :=
    card_equiv BitString.blocksEquiv fun x => by
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, G, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, xorPower_apply]
      rfl
  -- Every single-block restriction, complemented or not, costs at most three more gates.
  have hG (i : Fin k) (t : Fin k → BitString n) (b : Bool) :
      ∑ y with (G (update t i y) ^^ b) = f y, M y ≤ (1 / 2 + ε) * ∑ y, M y := by
    refine hM.sum_agree_le _ ?_
    let ρ : Fin (k * n) → Fin n ⊕ Bool := fun p =>
      if (finProdFinEquiv.symm p).1 = i then .inl (finProdFinEquiv.symm p).2
      else .inr (t (finProdFinEquiv.symm p).1 (finProdFinEquiv.symm p).2)
    have hρ (y : BitString n) : BitString.blocksEquiv.symm (update t i y) = substitute ρ y := by
      funext p
      simp only [BitString.blocksEquiv_symm_apply, substitute, ρ]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [h, update_self]
        rfl
      · rw [update_of_ne h]
        rfl
    have hrestrict : complexity interpretation (single fun y => G (update t i y)) ≤ s + 2 := by
      simp only [G, hρ]
      exact (complexity_substitute_le ρ g).trans (by omega)
    cases b
    · simpa only [Bool.xor_false] using hrestrict.trans (Nat.le_succ _)
    · simpa only [Bool.xor_true] using
        (complexity_not_le _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right hrestrict 1)
  have hbound := card_eq_sum_le f hM.mem_Icc k G hG
  rw [← hcard, BitString.card] at hbound
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ n := by positivity
  have hμ := hM.sum_le
  have hδμ := hM.mul_two_pow_le_sum
  have hpow : ((2 : ℝ) ^ n - ∑ y, M y) ^ k ≤ ((1 - δ) * 2 ^ n) ^ k :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (sub_nonneg.2 hμ) (by linarith) k
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) ^ (k * n) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ k by rw [mul_comm, pow_mul],
    div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  push_cast at hbound
  calc (#{x | g x = xorPower f k x} : ℝ)
      ≤ (1 / 2 + ε) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ k + (1 / 2 - ε) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ n - ∑ y, M y) ^ k := hbound
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 + ε) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ k + (1 / 2 - ε) * ((1 - δ) * 2 ^ n) ^ k := by
        linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 - ε)]
    _ = (1 / 2 + ε + (1 / 2 - ε) * (1 - δ) ^ k) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ k := by
        rw [mul_pow]
        ring

/-- **Yao's XOR lemma** [Yao1982], derived from Impagliazzo's hard-core lemma [Impagliazzo1995],
with explicit parameters. Let `0 < δ`, `0 < ε ≤ 1 / 2`, and let `T` be a number of rounds with
`1 ≤ 3 ε² δ² T`. If every Boolean function of De Morgan circuit complexity at most

then every Boolean function of complexity at most `s` agrees with the `k`-fold XOR `f^{⊕k}` on at

    (hstate : p.eval I (Fin.append input state) ∘ feed ≤ state) :

    apply hI _
    intro a
    change Wire.elim input _ (feedbackWire feed ((p.lines i).wires a)) ≤
      p.trace I (Fin.append input state) ((p.lines i).wires a)
    rw [elim_feedbackWire]
    cases (p.lines i).wires a with

      | right j => simpa only [trace, Wire.elim_input, Fin.append_right] using hstate j

theorem exists_mem_stops (hK : 1 < K) (hS : K ≤ P.accepted.ncard) {x : ι → U}
    (hx : x ∈ P.accepted) : ∃ v, x ∈ P.stops K v := by
  classical
  have hroot : K ≤ (P.values P.root).ncard := hS.trans
    (ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn (P.scope P.root).domRestrict (fun _ hy => hy)
      (fun _ _ _ _ h => funext fun i =>
        domRestrict_eq_domRestrict_iff.mp h (P.scope_root ▸ mem_univ i)))
  -- Take an occurring node of least rank among those accepting at least `K` assignments.
  have hex : ∃ k, ∃ v, P.rank v = k ∧ P.Occurs x v ∧ K ≤ (P.values v).ncard :=
    ⟨_, P.root, rfl, .root hx, hroot⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hxv, hlarge⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hsmall {u : N} (hu : P.rank u < P.rank v) (hxu : P.Occurs x u) :
      (P.values u).ncard < K := by
    by_contra! h
    exact Nat.find_min hex (hv ▸ hu) ⟨u, rfl, hxu, h⟩
  refine ⟨v, hxv, hlarge, ?_⟩
  cases hg : P.gate v with
  | leaf =>
    have := ncard_le_one_iff_subsingleton.mpr (P.values_subsingleton v hg)
    omega
  | union c =>
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hxu⟩ := (P.values_union v c hg x).mp hxv.accepts
    exact ⟨u, hu, hxu, hsmall (P.rank_union v c hg u hu) (.union hxv hg hu hxu)⟩
  | product l r =>
    exact ⟨hsmall (P.rank_product v l r hg).1 (.left hxv hg),
      hsmall (P.rank_product v l r hg).2 (.right hxv hg)⟩

theorem Program.card_wireSupport_le_pow {r : ℕ} :
    ∀ {g : ℕ} {p : Program σ n g}, p.FanInAtMost r →
      ∀ w : Wire n g, (p.wireSupport w).card ≤ max 1 r ^ p.wireDepths w
  | _, .empty, _, .input i => by simp
  | _, .empty, _, .gate j => j.elim0
  | _, @Program.gate _ _ g p line, ⟨hp, hline⟩, w => by
    induction w using Wire.lastCases with
    | last =>
      rw [Program.wireSupport_gate_last]
      change _ ≤ max 1 r ^ (p.gate line).depths (Fin.last g)
      rw [Program.depths_gate_last]
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, line.depth p.wireDepths = d + 1 :=
        ⟨_, (Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos (line.depth_pos _)).symm⟩
      have hargs := (line.depth_le_add_one_iff p.wireDepths).1 hd.le
      calc (line.inputSupport p.wireSupport).card
          ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (σ.Arity line.op))).card * max 1 r ^ d :=
            Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul _ _ _ fun i _ =>
              (card_wireSupport_le_pow hp _).trans
                (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_pos (le_max_left 1 r)) (hargs i))
        _ ≤ max 1 r * max 1 r ^ d := by
            rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
            exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hline.trans (le_max_right _ _))
        _ = max 1 r ^ line.depth p.wireDepths := by rw [hd, pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]
    | castSucc w =>
      rw [Program.wireSupport_gate_castSucc, Program.wireDepths_gate_castSucc]
      exact card_wireSupport_le_pow hp w

    (hS : RectangleBias S K b) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hu : K ≤ Nat.card U ^ (Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc).readᶜ.ncard) :

theorem agreement_le_of_layout {S : Set (Fin n → U)} {K : ℕ} {b : ℝ}
    (hS : RectangleBias S K b) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hfan : c.FanInAtMost 2)
    (hu : Nat.card U ^ (Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc).readᶜ.ncard < K)
    (π : Layout (Compiler.Vertex c)) {w : ℕ} (hw : (Compiler.graph c).width π ≤ w) :
    agreement S {x | c.eval I x 0 ∈ Acc} ≤ 1 / 2 + b +
      (K ^ 3 * (Nat.card (Compiler.Vertex c) + 1) * Nat.card U ^ (w + 4) : ℕ) /
        (Nat.card U : ℝ) ^ n := by
  set V := Nat.card (Compiler.Vertex c)
  set q := Nat.card U
  have bound (A : Set U) := (Compiler.network c I fun _ => A).abs_signedCount_accepted_le π
    (fun _ _ _ => Compiler.satisfies_unique) hb hS (w := w) (d := 3) (m := 1) hw
    (Compiler.maxDegreeLE le_rfl hfan) (Compiler.ncard_readAt_le I _)
  have h₁ := bound Acc
  have h₂ := bound Accᶜ
  rw [accepted_network_eq_eval] at h₁ h₂
  change _ ≤ _ + (((K - 1) ^ 2 * (V * q ^ (w + 3 + 1) +
    q ^ (Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc).readᶜ.ncard) : ℕ) : ℝ) at h₂
  have h := agreement_le h₁ h₂
  -- The residual is at most `K ^ 3 (V + 1) q ^ (w + 4)`.
  have hres : (K - 1) ^ 2 * (V * q ^ (w + 3 + 1) +
      q ^ (Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc).readᶜ.ncard) ≤ K ^ 3 * (V + 1) * q ^ (w + 4) := by
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ q ^ (w + 4) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ Nat.card_pos
    calc _ ≤ K ^ 2 * (V * K * q ^ (w + 4) + K * q ^ (w + 4)) := by
          gcongr
          · omega
          · exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
          · exact hu.le.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hq1)
      _ = K ^ 3 * (V + 1) * q ^ (w + 4) := by ring
  have hresR : (((K - 1) ^ 2 * (V * q ^ (w + 3 + 1) +
      q ^ (Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc).readᶜ.ncard) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      ((K ^ 3 * (V + 1) * q ^ (w + 4) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hres
  have hq : 0 < q := Nat.card_pos
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
  rw [card_input_eq] at h
  refine h.trans ?_
  have hhalf : ∀ R : ℝ, (R + R) / (2 * (q : ℝ) ^ n) = R / (q : ℝ) ^ n := fun R => by

  rw [hhalf]

    (hC : ∀ (V E : Type) [Finite V] [Finite E] (G : Multigraph V E),
      G.toSimpleGraph.Connected → G.Loopless → G.MaxDegreeLE 3 →
        ∃ π : Layout V, (G.width π : ℝ) ≤ (A + η) * G.cycleRank + η * Nat.card V + C)
    (hfan : c.FanInAtMost 2) {K : ℕ}
    (hu : Nat.card U ^ (Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc).readᶜ.ncard < K) :
    ∃ π : Layout (Compiler.Vertex c),
      ((Compiler.graph c).width π : ℝ) ≤
        (A + η) * (c.innerSize - n + Real.logb (Nat.card U) K + 1) +
          η * Nat.card (Compiler.Vertex c) + C := by
  have hrank : ((Compiler.graph c).cycleRank : ℝ) ≤
      c.innerSize - n + Real.logb (Nat.card U) K + 1 := by
    calc ((Compiler.graph c).cycleRank : ℝ)
        ≤ ((2 : ℕ) - 1) * c.innerSize - n + Real.logb (Nat.card U) K + 1 :=
          cycleRank_le (r := 2) hfan hu
      _ = c.innerSize - n + Real.logb (Nat.card U) K + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := hC _ _ (Compiler.graph c) (Compiler.connected c) Compiler.loopless

  exact ⟨π, hπ.trans (by gcongr)⟩

theorem Unambiguous.peers_eq_rectangle (hP : P.Unambiguous) {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ P.length)

  rintro z ⟨⟨a, ha, haz⟩, ⟨b, hb, hbz⟩⟩
  have hγ := (P.isAcceptingPath_path ha.1).splice (P.isAcceptingPath_path hb.1)
    (ha.2.trans hb.2.symm) (domRestrict_eq_domRestrict_iff.mp haz).symm
    (domRestrict_eq_domRestrict_iff.mp hbz).symm
  have hz : z ∈ P.accepted := ⟨_, hγ⟩
  refine ⟨hz, ?_⟩
  change P.path z t = P.path x t
  rw [hP z _ _ (P.isAcceptingPath_path hz) hγ t ht, ite_eq_left le_rfl]
  exact ha.2

        · rintro ⟨⟨g, a⟩, hg⟩ hw ⟨⟨g', a'⟩, hg'⟩ hw' haa'
          obtain rfl : g = g' := Wire.gate.inj (hw.trans hw'.symm)

    have h := (Vertex.junction.inj h₁).trans (Vertex.junction.inj h₂).symm

/-- **The degrees are bounded.** When the gates have fan-in at most `r ≥ 2`, every vertex has
degree at most `r + 1`: a gate vertex has its argument edges and one outgoing edge, a junction
has three edges, and input vertices and output vertices have one. For fan-in two the graph is

theorem maxDegreeLE {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hfan : c.FanInAtMost r) :
    (graph c).MaxDegreeLE (r + 1) := by
  intro v
  cases v with
  | signal w =>
    -- The first edge of the signal, and the edges delivering the slots of its gate.
    calc ((graph c).incidenceSet (.signal w)).ncard
        ≤ (insert (head w)
            ((fun a => deliverEdge (.inl a)) '' {a : Slot c | Wire.gate a.1.1 = w.1})).ncard := by
          refine ncard_le_ncard (fun e he => ?_) (toFinite _)
          rcases he with he | he
          · exact Or.inl (eq_head_of_src_eq_signal he)
          · obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := exists_slot_of_tgt_eq_signal he
            exact Or.inr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      _ ≤ {a : Slot c | Wire.gate a.1.1 = w.1}.ncard + 1 :=
          (ncard_insert_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (ncard_image_le (toFinite _)) 1)
      _ ≤ r + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right (ncard_slot_le hfan w.1) 1
  | junction j =>
    -- Its feed and deliver edges, and the feed edge of the next junction.
    calc ((graph c).incidenceSet (.junction j)).ncard
        ≤ (insert (Edge.feed j) (insert (Edge.deliver j)
            {e | ∃ j', feeder j' = .junction j ∧ e = Edge.feed j'})).ncard := by
          refine ncard_le_ncard (fun e he => ?_) (toFinite _)
          rcases he with he | he
          · rcases e with j' | j'
            · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨j', he, rfl⟩)
            · cases he
              exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
          · rcases e with j' | j'
            · cases he
              exact Or.inl rfl
            · change owner (junctionEquiv c j') = _ at he
              generalize junctionEquiv c j' = t at he
              rcases t with a | o <;> cases he
      _ ≤ {e | ∃ j', feeder j' = .junction j ∧ e = Edge.feed j'}.ncard + 1 + 1 :=
          (ncard_insert_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (ncard_insert_le _ _) 1)
      _ ≤ r + 1 := by
          have : {e | ∃ j', feeder j' = .junction j ∧ e = Edge.feed j'}.ncard ≤ 1 :=
            (ncard_le_one (toFinite _)).mpr fun _ ⟨j₁, h₁, he₁⟩ _ ⟨j₂, h₂, he₂⟩ =>
              he₁.trans ((eq_of_feeder_eq_junction h₁ h₂) ▸ he₂.symm)
          omega
  | output o =>
    -- Only the edge delivering the output.
    calc ((graph c).incidenceSet (.output o)).ncard
        ≤ ({outEdge c o} : Set (Edge c)).ncard := by
          refine ncard_le_ncard (fun e he => ?_) (toFinite _)
          rcases he with he | he
          · rcases e with ⟨_, ⟨_ | _, _⟩⟩ | j <;> cases he
          · exact eq_outEdge_of_tgt_eq_output he
      _ ≤ r + 1 := by simp

    rintro ⟨v, hv, hiv⟩
    obtain ⟨hi, rfl⟩ := site_eq_some hiv

    (hcut : ∀ e ∈ (graph c).edgeCut P,
      c.program.trace I x e.signal.1 = c.program.trace I y e.signal.1)
    (hzx : EqOn z x ((network c I fun _ => univ).readIn P))
    (hzy : EqOn z y ((network c I fun _ => univ).readIn P)ᶜ) (o : Fin m) :
    (Vertex.output o ∈ P → c.eval I z o = c.eval I x o) ∧
      (Vertex.output o ∉ P → c.eval I z o = c.eval I y o) := by
  have hx : (network c I fun _ => univ).Satisfies x fun e => c.program.trace I x e.signal.1 :=
    satisfies_trace fun _ => mem_univ _
  have hy : (network c I fun _ => univ).Satisfies y fun e => c.program.trace I y e.signal.1 :=
    satisfies_trace fun _ => mem_univ _
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, hγx, hγy⟩ := hx.splice hy hcut hzx hzy
  -- Every value at the output `o` is read off the edge delivering it.
  have hval : ∀ v, c.program.trace I v (outEdge c o).signal.1 = c.eval I v o := fun v => by
    rw [signal_deliverEdge]
    rfl
  have htgt : (network c I fun _ => univ).tgt (outEdge c o) = .output o := tgt_deliverEdge _
  rw [← hval z, ← eq_trace hγ, ← hval x, ← hval y]
  refine ⟨fun ho => hγx (Or.inr (htgt ▸ ho)), fun ho => ?_⟩
  by_cases ht : outEdge c o ∈ (network c I fun _ => univ).touching P
  · -- The edge reaches into `P` from outside, so it lies on the cut.
    have hsrc : src (outEdge c o) ∈ P := ht.resolve_right fun h => ho (htgt ▸ h)
    refine (hγx ht).trans (hcut _ ?_)
    exact fun h => ho (htgt ▸ h.mp hsrc)
  · exact hγy ht

theorem sq_correlation_quadForm_mul_le_of_unread (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (ZMod 2))
    {D : Set (Fin n)} (hD : D ⊆ (Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc).readᶜ) :
    correlation {x | BitString.quadForm Q x} {x | c.eval I x 0 ∈ Acc} ^ 2 *
      2 ^ (Q + Qᵀ).cutRank D ≤ 2 := by
  classical
  set T := {x : Fin n → Bool | c.eval I x 0 ∈ Acc}
  have hdep : DependsOn (· ∈ T) Dᶜ := by
    have h := (Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc).dependsOn_read
    rw [accepted_network_eq_eval] at h
    exact h.mono (subset_compl_comm.mp hD)
  have hdep' : DependsOn (· ∈ Tᶜ) Dᶜ := fun x y hxy => congrArg Not (hdep hxy)
  refine (sq_correlation_quadForm_mul_le Q T (fun x => decide (x ∈ T)) D
    (fun x y h => by simpa using h) fun x => ?_).trans ?_
  · by_cases hx : x ∈ T
    · refine ⟨univ, Dᶜ.domRestrict '' T, ?_⟩
      rw [← eq_rectangle_of_dependsOn hdep]
      exact Set.ext fun y => by by_cases hy : y ∈ T <;> simp [hx, hy]
    · refine ⟨univ, Dᶜ.domRestrict '' Tᶜ, ?_⟩
      rw [← eq_rectangle_of_dependsOn hdep']
      exact Set.ext fun y => by by_cases hy : y ∈ T <;> simp [hx, hy]
  · have := ncard_le_card (range fun x => decide (x ∈ T))
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_bool] at this
    exact_mod_cast this

theorem sq_correlation_quadForm_mul_le_of_layout (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (ZMod 2))
    (π : Layout (Compiler.Vertex c)) {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ Nat.card (Compiler.Vertex c)) :
    correlation {x | BitString.quadForm Q x} {x | c.eval I x 0 ∈ Acc} ^ 2 *
        2 ^ (Q + Qᵀ).cutRank ((Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc).readIn (π.initial t)) ≤
      2 * 2 ^ ((Compiler.graph c).frontier π t).ncard := by
  classical
  set T := {x : Fin n → Bool | c.eval I x 0 ∈ Acc}
  set N₁ := Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc
  set N₀ := Compiler.network c I fun _ => Accᶜ
  set P₁ := N₁.branchingProgram π
  set P₀ := N₀.branchingProgram π
  set X := N₁.readIn (π.initial t)
  have hT₁ : P₁.accepted = T := by rw [Network.accepted_branchingProgram, accepted_network_eq_eval]
  have hT₀ : P₀.accepted = Tᶜ := by
    rw [Network.accepted_branchingProgram, accepted_network_eq_eval]
    rfl
  have hX₁ : P₁.revealed t = X := by
    change N₁.revealedBy π t = X
    simp only [Network.revealedBy, ht, ite_true, X]
  have hX₀ : P₀.revealed t = X := by
    change N₀.revealedBy π t = X
    simp only [Network.revealedBy, ht, ite_true, X]
    rfl
  have htP₁ : t ≤ P₁.length := Nat.le_succ_of_le ht
  have htP₀ : t ≤ P₀.length := Nat.le_succ_of_le ht
  -- The message of an input: its output, and the state of its accepting path at layer `t`.
  let msg : (Fin n → Bool) → Bool × (Compiler.Edge c → Option Bool) := fun x =>
    if x ∈ T then (true, P₁.path x t) else (false, P₀.path x t)
  have hclass₁ {x : Fin n → Bool} (hx : x ∈ T) : {y | msg y = msg x} = P₁.sweep.peers t x := by
    ext y
    rw [mem_ofPred_eq, ReadOnceNBP.mem_peers_sweep, hT₁]
    by_cases hy : y ∈ T <;> simp [msg, hx, hy]
  have hclass₀ {x : Fin n → Bool} (hx : x ∉ T) : {y | msg y = msg x} = P₀.sweep.peers t x := by
    ext y
    rw [mem_ofPred_eq, ReadOnceNBP.mem_peers_sweep, hT₀]
    by_cases hy : y ∈ T <;> simp [msg, hx, hy]
  have H := sq_correlation_quadForm_mul_le Q T msg X
    (fun x y h => by
      by_cases hx : x ∈ T <;> by_cases hy : y ∈ T <;> simp_all [msg]) fun x => ?_
  · refine H.trans ?_
    -- The messages are the states of the two programs at layer `t`.
    have hrange : range msg ⊆ Prod.mk true '' ((fun x => P₁.path x t) '' N₁.accepted) ∪
        Prod.mk false '' ((fun x => P₀.path x t) '' N₀.accepted) := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
      by_cases hx : x ∈ T
      · refine Or.inl ⟨_, ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩, by simp [msg, hx]⟩
        rwa [accepted_network_eq_eval]
      · refine Or.inr ⟨_, ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩, by simp [msg, hx]⟩
        rw [accepted_network_eq_eval]
        exact hx
    have h₁ : ((fun x => P₁.path x t) '' N₁.accepted).ncard ≤
        2 ^ ((Compiler.graph c).frontier π t).ncard := by
      have := N₁.ncard_image_path_le π ht
      rwa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_bool] at this
    have h₀ : ((fun x => P₀.path x t) '' N₀.accepted).ncard ≤
        2 ^ ((Compiler.graph c).frontier π t).ncard := by
      have := N₀.ncard_image_path_le π ht
      rwa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_bool] at this
    have hcount : (range msg).ncard ≤ 2 * 2 ^ ((Compiler.graph c).frontier π t).ncard :=
      calc (range msg).ncard
          ≤ (Prod.mk true '' ((fun x => P₁.path x t) '' N₁.accepted)).ncard +
              (Prod.mk false '' ((fun x => P₀.path x t) '' N₀.accepted)).ncard :=
            (ncard_le_ncard hrange (toFinite _)).trans (ncard_union_le _ _)
        _ ≤ ((fun x => P₁.path x t) '' N₁.accepted).ncard +
              ((fun x => P₀.path x t) '' N₀.accepted).ncard :=
            Nat.add_le_add (ncard_image_le (toFinite _)) (ncard_image_le (toFinite _))
        _ ≤ 2 * 2 ^ ((Compiler.graph c).frontier π t).ncard := by omega
    exact_mod_cast hcount
  · by_cases hx : x ∈ T
    · rw [hclass₁ hx, (Compiler.unambiguous_branchingProgram π).peers_eq_rectangle htP₁ x]
      exact exists_rectangle_eq hX₁ _ _
    · rw [hclass₀ hx, (Compiler.unambiguous_branchingProgram π).peers_eq_rectangle htP₀ x]
      exact exists_rectangle_eq hX₀ _ _

private theorem le_rpow_of_mul_two_pow_le {y : ℝ} {ρ m : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hy : y * 2 ^ ρ ≤ 2 * 2 ^ m)
    (hr : r ≤ ρ) : y ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 + m - r) := by
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ ρ := by positivity
  have h₁ : y ≤ 2 * 2 ^ m / 2 ^ ρ := (le_div_iff₀ hpos).mpr hy
  have h₂ : (2 * 2 ^ m / 2 ^ ρ : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 + m - ρ : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_sub (by norm_num), Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), Real.rpow_one,
      Real.rpow_natCast, Real.rpow_natCast]
  rw [h₂] at h₁
  exact h₁.trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith))

`⌊n/2⌋ - e` in `Q + Qᵀ`, a circuit that leaves at least `k ≤ ⌊n/2⌋` inputs unread has

theorem sq_correlation_quadForm_le_of_layout (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (ZMod 2)) {e : ℝ}
    (hQ : ∀ U : Set (Fin n), U.ncard = n / 2 → ((n / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (Q + Qᵀ).cutRank U + e)
    (π : Layout (Compiler.Vertex c)) {w : ℕ} (hw : (Compiler.graph c).width π ≤ w)
    (hread : n / 2 ≤ (Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc).read.ncard) :
    correlation {x | BitString.quadForm Q x} {x | c.eval I x 0 ∈ Acc} ^ 2 ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 + w + e - (n / 2 : ℕ)) := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hX⟩ := (Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc).exists_ncard_readIn_initial_eq π
    (Compiler.ncard_readAt_le I _) hread
  have H := sq_correlation_quadForm_mul_le_of_layout I Acc c Q π ht
  have H' : correlation {x | BitString.quadForm Q x} {x | c.eval I x 0 ∈ Acc} ^ 2 *
      2 ^ (Q + Qᵀ).cutRank ((Compiler.network c I fun _ => Acc).readIn (π.initial t)) ≤
        2 * 2 ^ w :=
    H.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num)
      (((Compiler.graph c).ncard_frontier_le_width π t).trans hw)) (by norm_num))
  have := le_rpow_of_mul_two_pow_le H' (r := (n / 2 : ℕ) - e) (by linarith [hQ _ hX])
  convert this using 2
  ring

theorem isLittleO_log_affine {α β : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hβ : 1 ≤ β) :
    (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (α * n + β)) =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ) := by
  have hlog : (fun n : ℕ => Real.log n) =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ) :=
    Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.comp_tendsto tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  refine IsLittleO.of_bound fun δ hδ => ?_
  filter_upwards [hlog.bound (show 0 < δ / 2 by positivity), eventually_ge_atTop 1,
    eventually_ge_atTop ⌈2 * Real.log (α + β) / δ⌉₊] with n hn hn1 hnC
  have hn1' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn1
  have hnC' : 2 * Real.log (α + β) / δ ≤ n := (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (by exact_mod_cast hnC)
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n)] at hn ⊢
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith))]
  -- `log (α n + β) ≤ log ((α + β) n) = log (α + β) + log n`.
  have hle : Real.log (α * n + β) ≤ Real.log (α + β) + Real.log n := by
    rw [← Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    exact Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by nlinarith)
  have hlogn : Real.log n ≤ δ / 2 * n := (le_abs_self _).trans hn
  have hC : Real.log (α + β) ≤ δ / 2 * n := by
    have := (div_le_iff₀ hδ).mp hnC'
    linarith
  linarith

`1 / log 2 ≤ 4 + 1 / log 2`. -/

theorem eventually_lt_of_demand {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ η₀ > 0, ∀ η, 0 < η → η ≤ η₀ → ∀ (C : ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℝ), e =o[atTop] (fun n => (n : ℝ)) →
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ s v w : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ v → v ≤ κ * (n + s + 1) →
        (n : ℝ) ≤ w + e n + κ * Real.log (v + 1) →
        w ≤ (A + η) * (s - n + e n) + η * v + C →
        (1 + 1 / A - ε) * n < s := by
  -- Spend the slack so that `η B ≤ A ε / 2`, where `B` collects the coefficients of `η n`.
  set B := 1 / A + κ * (2 + 1 / A) with hB_def
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by positivity
  refine ⟨A * ε / (2 * (B + 1)), by positivity, fun η hη hηle C e he => ?_⟩
  have hηB : η * B ≤ A * ε / 2 := by
    have : A * ε / (2 * (B + 1)) * B ≤ A * ε / 2 := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) two_pos]
      nlinarith [mul_pos hA hε]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hηle hB).trans this
  -- Each lower-order term is eventually at most `δ n`, with `δ = A ε / 10`.
  set δ := A * ε / 10 with hδ_def
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by positivity
  have hlog := isLittleO_log_affine (α := κ * (2 + 1 / A)) (β := κ + 1) (by positivity)
    (by linarith)
  filter_upwards [he.bound (show 0 < δ / (A + η + 1) by positivity),
    hlog.bound (show 0 < δ / (κ + 1) by positivity), eventually_ge_atTop 1,
    eventually_ge_atTop ⌈(|C| + η * κ) / δ⌉₊] with n hen hlogn hn1 hnC
  intro s v w hs hv hvκ hdemand hsupply
  by_contra! hsn
  have hN : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn1
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n)] at hen hlogn
  -- The size of the circuit is at most `(1 + 1/A) n`, so the graph has `O(n)` vertices.
  have hεn : 0 ≤ ε * n := by positivity
  have hsA : s ≤ (1 + 1 / A) * n := by nlinarith
  have hv' : v ≤ κ * (2 + 1 / A) * n + κ := by
    have : κ * (n + s + 1) ≤ κ * ((2 + 1 / A) * n + 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by nlinarith) hκ
    linarith
  -- The logarithmic term of the demand.
  have hL : κ * Real.log (v + 1) ≤ δ * n := by
    have hlog1 : Real.log (v + 1) ≤ Real.log (κ * (2 + 1 / A) * n + (κ + 1)) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (v + 1) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
    have h1 := (hlog1.trans (le_abs_self _)).trans hlogn
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by linarith : 0 ≤ κ + 1)
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (by linarith : κ + 1 ≠ 0)] at h2
    have h3 : κ * Real.log (v + 1) ≤ (κ + 1) * Real.log (v + 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hlog0
    linarith
  -- The error term of the problem.
  have hE : (A + η + 1) * |e n| ≤ δ * n := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hen (by linarith : 0 ≤ A + η + 1)
    rwa [← mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (by linarith : A + η + 1 ≠ 0)] at this
  -- The constants.
  have hC : |C| + η * κ ≤ δ * n := by
    have h := (Nat.le_ceil ((|C| + η * κ) / δ)).trans (show (⌈(|C| + η * κ) / δ⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ n by
      exact_mod_cast hnC)
    have := (div_le_iff₀ hδ).mp h
    linarith
  -- Combine demand and supply.
  have hsupply' : (A + η) * (s - n) ≤ n + η / A * n - A * ε * n := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show s - n ≤ (1 / A - ε) * n by linarith)
      (by linarith : 0 ≤ A + η)
    have h2 : (A + η) * ((1 / A - ε) * n) = n + η / A * n - A * ε * n - η * (ε * n) := by
      field_simp; ring
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hη.le hεn]
  have hηv : η * v ≤ η * κ * (2 + 1 / A) * n + η * κ := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv' hη.le
    linarith [show η * (κ * (2 + 1 / A) * n + κ) = η * κ * (2 + 1 / A) * n + η * κ by ring]
  have he1 : (A + η) * e n + e n ≤ (A + η + 1) * |e n| := by
    have := mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ A + η + 1) (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_abs_self (e n)))
    linarith [show (A + η + 1) * (|e n| - e n) = (A + η + 1) * |e n| - ((A + η) * e n + e n)
      by ring]
  have hexpand : (A + η) * (s - n + e n) = (A + η) * (s - n) + (A + η) * e n := by ring
  have hBn : η * B * n = η / A * n + η * κ * (2 + 1 / A) * n := by rw [hB_def]; ring

theorem eventually_add_lt_of_le {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ (C : ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℝ), e =o[atTop] (fun n => (n : ℝ)) →
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ s v w : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ v → v ≤ κ * (n + s + 1) →
        s ≤ (1 + 1 / A - ε) * n → w ≤ (A + η) * (s - n + e n) + η * v + C →
        w + e n + κ * Real.log (v + 1) < (1 - A * ε / 2) * n := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, H⟩ := eventually_lt_of_demand hA hκ (half_pos hε)
  refine ⟨η, hη, fun C e he => ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [H η hη le_rfl C e he] with n hn
  intro s v w hs hv hvκ hsn hw
  by_contra! hge
  have hAη : 0 < A + η := by linarith
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  -- Spend the margin on the gate budget.
  set δ := A * ε / 2 * n / (A + η) with hδ
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ := by positivity
  have hδε : δ ≤ ε / 2 * n := by
    rw [hδ, div_le_iff₀ hAη]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hε.le hn0) hη.le]
  have hsupply : w + A * ε / 2 * n ≤ (A + η) * (s + δ - n + e n) + η * v + C := by
    have : (A + η) * δ = A * ε / 2 * n := by rw [hδ]; field_simp
    nlinarith
  have hvκ' : v ≤ κ * (n + (s + δ) + 1) := hvκ.trans (by gcongr; linarith)
  have := hn (s + δ) v (w + A * ε / 2 * n) (by positivity) hv hvκ' (by linarith) hsupply
  linarith

theorem LayoutBound.mono {d : ℕ} {A A' : ℝ} (h : LayoutBound d A) (hAA' : A ≤ A') :
    LayoutBound d A' := by
  intro η hη
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h η hη
  refine ⟨C, fun V E _ _ G hconn hloop hdeg => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := hC V E G hconn hloop hdeg
  refine ⟨π, hπ.trans ?_⟩
  have : (A + η) * G.cycleRank ≤ (A' + η) * G.cycleRank := by gcongr
  linarith

/-- **Logarithmic error terms.** To prove the layout hypothesis it suffices to find, for every
`η > 0`, layouts of width at most `(A + η) β₁ + D log₂ |V| + C`, for a constant `C`: the term
`D log₂ |V|` is at most `η |V|` plus a constant. -/

theorem LayoutBound.of_natLog {d D : ℕ} {A : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ η > 0, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (V E : Type) [Finite V] [Finite E] (G : Multigraph V E),
      G.toSimpleGraph.Connected → G.Loopless → G.MaxDegreeLE d →
        ∃ π : Layout V, (G.width π : ℝ) ≤ (A + η) * G.cycleRank + D * Nat.log 2 (Nat.card V) + C) :
    LayoutBound d A := by
  intro η hη
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h η hη
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_natLog_le_mul_add (ε := η / (D + 1)) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨C + D * K, fun V E _ _ G hconn hloop hdeg => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := hC V E G hconn hloop hdeg
  refine ⟨π, hπ.trans ?_⟩
  have hD : (D : ℝ) * (η / (D + 1)) ≤ η := by
    rw [mul_div_assoc', div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Nat.card V := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hlog := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hK (Nat.card V)) (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) D)
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD hN]

theorem layoutBound_degree {d : ℕ} (hd : 3 ≤ d) :
    LayoutBound d (Gaussian.degreeCoefficient d) := by
  refine LayoutBound.of_natLog (D := d) fun η hη => ?_
  have hD : (3 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * d - 3 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := Gaussian.exists_width_le_vertexCoefficient (by omega : 2 ≤ d)
    (show 0 < η / 3 by positivity)
  refine ⟨d * (N₀ + 1), fun V E _ _ G hG _ hdeg => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Multigraph.Compression.exists_saturated hdeg
  have hA := (Gaussian.degreeCoefficient_pos hd).le
  have hβ : 0 ≤ (Gaussian.degreeCoefficient d + η) * G.cycleRank := by positivity
  -- A layout of the core.
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : Layout Q.blocks, (Q.quotient.width σ : ℝ) ≤
      (Gaussian.degreeCoefficient d + η) * G.cycleRank + d * (N₀ + 1) := by
    by_cases hbig : 1 < Nat.card Q.blocks ∧ N₀ < Nat.card Q.blocks
    · -- A large core is laid out by Gaussian vertex scores. It has at most
      -- `3d / (2d - 3) β₁ ≤ 3 β₁` edges, and at most as many blocks.
      obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hN₀ Q.blocks Q.external Q.quotient Q.quotient_loopless
        Q.quotient_maxDegreeLE hbig.2
      refine ⟨σ, hσ.trans ?_⟩
      have hE : (Nat.card Q.external : ℝ) ≤ 3 * d / (2 * d - 3) * G.cycleRank := by
        have h := Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ).mpr (hQ.mul_card_external_le hG hbig.1)
        push_cast [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 3 ≤ 2 * d)] at h
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hden]
        linarith
      have hE3 : (Nat.card Q.external : ℝ) ≤ 3 * G.cycleRank := by
        refine hE.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hden]
        linarith
      have hV : (Nat.card Q.blocks : ℝ) ≤ 3 * G.cycleRank :=
        (Nat.cast_le.mpr (hQ.card_blocks_le_card_external hG hbig.1)).trans hE3
      have hmain := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (Gaussian.vertexCoefficient_pos hd).le
      have hslack := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV (show 0 ≤ η / 3 by positivity)
      have hN : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d * (N₀ + 1) := by positivity
      unfold Gaussian.degreeCoefficient
      nlinarith
    · -- A small core has few edges.
      refine ⟨Classical.arbitrary _, ?_⟩
      have hw := Q.quotient.width_le_card (Classical.arbitrary _)
      have he := Q.quotient.card_le_mul_card Q.quotient_maxDegreeLE
      have hv : Nat.card Q.blocks ≤ N₀ + 1 := by omega
      have : Q.quotient.width (Classical.arbitrary _) ≤ d * (N₀ + 1) :=
        hw.trans (he.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left d hv))
      have : (Q.quotient.width (Classical.arbitrary _) : ℝ) ≤ d * (N₀ + 1) := by
        exact_mod_cast this
      linarith
  -- Expand the layout of the core.
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := Q.exists_width_le σ
  refine ⟨τ, ?_⟩
  have : (G.width τ : ℝ) ≤ Q.quotient.width σ + d * Nat.log 2 (Nat.card V) := by
    exact_mod_cast hτ
  linarith

vertex-score layouts: `A_3 = 3 arccos (2√2/3) / π ≤ 1/3`. -/

theorem LayoutBound.exists_layout_componentwise {d : ℕ} {A : ℝ} (h : LayoutBound d A) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (V E : Type) [Finite V] [Finite E] (G : Multigraph V E),
      G.Loopless → G.MaxDegreeLE d →
        ∃ π : Layout V, ∀ t (ht : t < Nat.card V), ∀ s, t ≤ s → s ≤ t + 1 →
          G.frontier π s ⊆ G.touching (G.component (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)) ∧
          ((G.frontier π s).ncard : ℝ) ≤
            (A + η) * G.cycleRankOn (G.component (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)) + η * Nat.card V + C := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h η hη
  refine ⟨C, fun V E _ _ G hG hd => ?_⟩
  set Γ := G.toSimpleGraph
  -- Lay out each component by the layout hypothesis.
  have hlay (K : Γ.ConnectedComponent) : ∃ ρ : Layout K.supp, ∀ s,
      (((G.induce K.supp).frontier ρ s).ncard : ℝ) ≤
        (A + η) * G.cycleRankOn K.supp + η * Nat.card V + C := by
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := K.nonempty_supp
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hC _ _ (G.induce (G.component v)) (G.connected_induce_component v)
      (hG.induce _) (hd.induce _)
    refine ⟨ρ, fun s =>
      ((Nat.cast_le.2 ((G.induce _).ncard_frontier_le_width ρ s)).trans hρ).trans ?_⟩
    rw [G.cycleRank_induce (G.edgeCut_component v)]
    have : (Nat.card (G.component v) : ℝ) ≤ Nat.card V := by
      exact_mod_cast Finite.card_subtype_le _
    change _ ≤ (A + η) * G.cycleRankOn (G.component v) + η * Nat.card V + C
    gcongr
  choose ρ hρ using hlay
  -- Order the vertices by their component, then by their place in its layout.
  set num := Finite.equivFin Γ.ConnectedComponent
  set key : V → ℕ ×ₗ ℕ := fun v =>
    toLex ((num (Γ.connectedComponentMk v) : ℕ),
      (ρ (Γ.connectedComponentMk v) ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ℕ)) with hkey
  have hpos (v : V) (K : Γ.ConnectedComponent) (hv : v ∈ K.supp) :
      (ρ (Γ.connectedComponentMk v) ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ℕ) = ρ K ⟨v, hv⟩ := by
    obtain rfl : Γ.connectedComponentMk v = K := hv
    rfl
  have hinj : key.Injective := by
    intro v w hvw
    simp only [hkey, toLex_inj, Prod.mk.injEq] at hvw
    have hK := num.injective (Fin.ext hvw.1)
    rw [hpos w _ hK.symm] at hvw
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((ρ _).injective (Fin.ext hvw.2))
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := Layout.exists_lt_iff hinj
  refine ⟨π, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  -- The vertex processed at step `t`, its component `K`, and its place `p` in the layout of `K`.
  set v := π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩
  set K := Γ.connectedComponentMk v
  set p : ℕ := (ρ K ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ℕ)
  have hp : p < Nat.card K.supp := (ρ K ⟨v, rfl⟩).isLt
  have hK : G.edgeCut K.supp = ∅ := G.edgeCut_setOf_connectedComponentMk (· = K)
  -- The components before `K`.
  set B : Set V := {u | num (Γ.connectedComponentMk u) < num K}
  have hB : G.edgeCut B = ∅ := G.edgeCut_setOf_connectedComponentMk (num · < num K)
  have hBK (S : Set K.supp) : Disjoint B (Subtype.val '' S) := by
    refine disjoint_left.2 fun u hu ⟨u', _, hu'⟩ => ?_
    have hu : num (Γ.connectedComponentMk u) < num K := hu
    rw [← hu', u'.2] at hu
    exact lt_irrefl _ hu
  -- The first `t` vertices are the components before `K` and the first `p` vertices of `K`.
  have hinit : π.initial t = B ∪ Subtype.val '' (ρ K).initial p := by
    ext u
    rw [Layout.initial_eq_of_lt_iff hπ ht, mem_ofPred_eq, hkey, Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex]
    simp only [Fin.val_fin_lt, Fin.val_inj, B, mem_union, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_image,
      Layout.mem_initial]
    refine or_congr_right ⟨fun ⟨hu, hlt⟩ => ?_, fun ⟨u', hu', hu'u⟩ => ?_⟩
    · obtain hu := num.injective hu
      exact ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, by rwa [← hpos u K hu], rfl⟩
    · subst hu'u
      refine ⟨congrArg num u'.2, ?_⟩
      rwa [hpos _ K u'.2]
  have hinit' : π.initial (t + 1) = B ∪ Subtype.val '' (ρ K).initial (p + 1) := by
    rw [π.initial_succ ht, hinit, (ρ K).initial_succ hp, image_insert_eq, union_insert]
    congr 1
    change v = ((ρ K).symm (ρ K ⟨v, rfl⟩) : V)
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  -- Both frontiers are frontiers of the layout of `K`.
  have hfront (q : ℕ) : G.edgeCut (B ∪ Subtype.val '' (ρ K).initial q) =
      Subtype.val '' (G.induce K.supp).frontier (ρ K) q := by
    rw [G.edgeCut_union_of_edgeCut_eq_empty hB (hBK _), G.edgeCut_image_val hK]
    rfl
  intro s hts hst
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, G.frontier π s = Subtype.val '' (G.induce K.supp).frontier (ρ K) q := by
    rcases (show s = t ∨ s = t + 1 by omega) with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨p, by rw [Multigraph.frontier, hinit, hfront]⟩
    · exact ⟨p + 1, by rw [Multigraph.frontier, hinit', hfront]⟩
  rw [hq, ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective]
  exact ⟨fun _ ⟨e, _, he⟩ => he ▸ Or.inl e.2.1, hρ K q⟩
