private def singletons [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Finite E] (hG : G.MaxDegreeLE d) :
    Compression G d where
  blocks := Finset.univ.image fun v => [v]
  exists_mem v := ⟨[v], Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ v),
    List.mem_singleton_self v⟩
  eq_of_mem := by simp
  nodup := by simp
  ne_nil := by simp
  ncard_edgeCut_le := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, forall_exists_index,
      forall_apply_eq_imp_iff, List.mem_singleton]
    intro v
    refine (ncard_le_ncard fun e he => ?_).trans (hG v)
    simp only [mem_edgeCut, mem_ofPred_eq] at he
    rw [mem_incidenceSet]
    tauto
  ncard_edgeCut_take_le := by simp

    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ List.singleton_injective, Finset.card_univ,
      Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

private theorem exists_merge [Finite E] {B B' : List V} (hB : B ∈ c.blocks) (hB' : B' ∈ c.blocks)
    (hne : B ≠ B') (hjoin : (G.edgeCut {v | v ∈ B} ∩ G.edgeCut {v | v ∈ B'}).Nonempty)
    (hcut : (G.edgeCut ({v | v ∈ B} ∪ {v | v ∈ B'})).ncard ≤ d) :
    ∃ c' : Compression G d, c'.blocks.card < c.blocks.card := by
  classical
  wlog hlen : B'.length ≤ B.length generalizing B B'
  · rw [inter_comm] at hjoin
    rw [union_comm] at hcut
    exact this hB' hB hne.symm hjoin hcut (by omega)
  have hd (v : V) (hv : v ∈ B) : v ∉ B' := fun hv' => hne (c.eq_of_mem B hB B' hB' v hv hv')
  have hrest (C : List V) (hC : C ∈ c.blocks) (hCB : C ≠ B) (hCB' : C ≠ B') (v : V)
      (hv : v ∈ C) : v ∉ B ∧ v ∉ B' :=
    ⟨fun h => hCB (c.eq_of_mem C hC B hB v hv h),
      fun h => hCB' (c.eq_of_mem C hC B' hB' v hv h)⟩
  have hmem {C : List V} : C ∈ insert (B ++ B') ((c.blocks.erase B).erase B') ↔
      C = B ++ B' ∨ (C ≠ B' ∧ C ≠ B ∧ C ∈ c.blocks) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_erase]
  -- Every old block lies inside a new one.
  have hsup (C : List V) (hC : C ∈ c.blocks) :
      ∃ D ∈ insert (B ++ B') ((c.blocks.erase B).erase B'), ∀ v ∈ C, v ∈ D := by
    by_cases h : C = B ∨ C = B'
    · refine ⟨B ++ B', Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, ?_⟩
      rcases h with rfl | rfl <;> intro v hv <;> simp [hv]
    · rw [not_or] at h
      exact ⟨C, hmem.2 (Or.inr ⟨h.2, h.1, hC⟩), fun v hv => hv⟩
  have hcard : (insert (B ++ B') ((c.blocks.erase B).erase B')).card + 1 = c.blocks.card := by
    have hnot : B ++ B' ∉ (c.blocks.erase B).erase B' := by
      intro h
      simp only [Finset.mem_erase] at h
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil B (c.ne_nil B hB)
      exact h.2.1 (c.eq_of_mem _ h.2.2 B hB v (List.mem_append_left _ hv) hv)
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hnot, Finset.card_erase_of_mem
      (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hne.symm, hB'⟩), Finset.card_erase_of_mem hB]
    have := Finset.one_lt_card.2 ⟨B, hB, B', hB', hne⟩
    omega
  have happ (L L' : List V) : {v | v ∈ L ++ L'} = {v | v ∈ L} ∪ {v | v ∈ L'} :=
    Set.ext fun _ => List.mem_append
  refine ⟨{ blocks := insert (B ++ B') ((c.blocks.erase B).erase B')
            exists_mem := ?_, eq_of_mem := ?_, nodup := ?_, ne_nil := ?_
            ncard_edgeCut_le := ?_, ncard_edgeCut_take_le := ?_, card_le := ?_ },
    Nat.lt_of_succ_le hcard.le⟩
  · intro v
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hv⟩ := c.exists_mem v
    obtain ⟨D, hD, hCD⟩ := hsup C hC
    exact ⟨D, hD, hCD v hv⟩
  · simp only [hmem]
    rintro C (rfl | ⟨hC₁, hC₂, hC⟩) C' (rfl | ⟨hC₁', hC₂', hC'⟩) v hv hv'
    · rfl
    · rw [List.mem_append] at hv
      have := hrest C' hC' hC₂' hC₁' v hv'
      tauto
    · rw [List.mem_append] at hv'
      have := hrest C hC hC₂ hC₁ v hv
      tauto
    · exact c.eq_of_mem C hC C' hC' v hv hv'
  · simp only [hmem]
    rintro C (rfl | ⟨-, -, hC⟩)
    · exact List.nodup_append.2 ⟨c.nodup B hB, c.nodup B' hB',
        fun a ha b hb hab => hd a ha (hab ▸ hb)⟩
    · exact c.nodup C hC
  · simp only [hmem]
    rintro C (rfl | ⟨-, -, hC⟩)
    · exact List.append_ne_nil_of_left_ne_nil (c.ne_nil B hB) _
    · exact c.ne_nil C hC
  · simp only [hmem]
    rintro C (rfl | ⟨-, -, hC⟩)
    · rwa [happ]
    · exact c.ncard_edgeCut_le C hC
  · simp only [hmem]
    rintro C (rfl | ⟨-, -, hC⟩) k hk
    · rw [List.length_append] at hk ⊢
      rw [List.take_append]
      rcases lt_or_ge k B.length with hk' | hk'
      · -- A proper prefix of the first part.
        rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hk'.le, List.take_zero, List.append_nil]
        exact (c.ncard_edgeCut_take_le B hB k hk').trans
          (Nat.mul_le_mul_left d (Nat.log_mono_right (by omega)))
      · -- The first part followed by a proper prefix of the second, at most half as long.
        rw [List.take_of_length_le hk']
        have hb : B'.length ≠ 0 := by omega
        have h₁ := G.ncard_edgeCut_union_le {v | v ∈ B} {v | v ∈ B'.take (k - B.length)}
        have h₃ := c.ncard_edgeCut_le B hB
        have h₄ := c.ncard_edgeCut_take_le B' hB' (k - B.length) (by omega)
        have h₅ : Nat.log 2 B'.length + 1 ≤ Nat.log 2 (B.length + B'.length) := by
          rw [← Nat.log_mul_base one_lt_two hb]
          exact Nat.log_mono_right (by omega)
        have h₆ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left d h₅
        simp only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one] at h₆
        rw [happ]
        omega
    · exact c.ncard_edgeCut_take_le C hC k hk
  · -- The old inside edges and the edges joining `B` to `B'` are now inside.
    have hsub : {e | ∃ D ∈ c.blocks, G.src e ∈ D ∧ G.tgt e ∈ D} ∪
        (G.edgeCut {v | v ∈ B} ∩ G.edgeCut {v | v ∈ B'}) ⊆ {e | ∃ D ∈ insert (B ++ B')

theorem exists_spanningTree [Finite V] (hG : G.toSimpleGraph.Connected) :
    ∃ F : Set E, (G.edgeRestrict F).toSimpleGraph.Connected ∧ Nat.card F + 1 = Nat.card V := by
  obtain ⟨T, hTG, hT⟩ := hG.exists_isTree_le

  have hends (s : T.edgeSet) : ∃ e, G.ends e = s.1 := by
    have hs := SimpleGraph.edgeSet_mono hTG s.2
    rw [toSimpleGraph_eq, _root_.Cslib.Multigraph.edgeSet_toSimpleGraph] at hs
    exact hs.1
  choose g hg using hends
  have hginj : g.Injective := fun s s' h => Subtype.ext ((hg s).symm.trans (h ▸ hg s'))
  refine ⟨range g, hT.connected.mono fun u v huv => ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact toSimpleGraph_adj.mpr ⟨huv.ne, ⟨g ⟨s(u, v), huv⟩, mem_range_self _⟩, hg _⟩
  · rw [Nat.card_range_of_injective hginj]
    exact (SimpleGraph.isTree_iff_connected_and_card.mp hT).2

theorem exists_width_le_of_card_add_one_eq [Finite V] [Finite E] {d : ℕ}
    (hG : G.toSimpleGraph.Connected) (hcard : Nat.card E + 1 = Nat.card V)
    (hd : G.MaxDegreeLE d) : ∃ π : Layout V, G.width π ≤ d * Nat.log 2 (Nat.card V) := by

  have hcount := c.card_add_card_external_le
  -- A saturated compression of a tree has only one block, so no edge is external.
  have hext : Nat.card c.external = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have two : 1 < Nat.card c.blocks := by omega
    -- The cuts of the blocks add up to `2 |E_B| < 2 |B|`: some block has at most one edge
    -- leaving it.
    obtain ⟨B, -, hB⟩ : ∃ B ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset c.blocks),
        (G.edgeCut {v | v ∈ B.1}).ncard < 2 := by
      refine Finset.exists_lt_of_sum_lt ?_
      rw [c.sum_ncard_edgeCut, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul,
        ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

    -- It merges with the block at the other end of an edge leaving it.
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := c.edgeCut_nonempty hG two B

    have hsum := G.ncard_edgeCut_union_add (c.disjoint_of_ne hB'B.symm)
    have hjoin : (G.edgeCut {v | v ∈ B.1} ∩ G.edgeCut {v | v ∈ B'.1}).Nonempty := ⟨e, he, he'⟩
    have := hjoin.ncard_pos
    have := c.ncard_edgeCut_le _ B'.2
    have := hc _ B.2 _ B'.2 (fun h => hB'B (Subtype.ext h).symm) hjoin
    omega
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := c.exists_width_le (Classical.arbitrary _)
  refine ⟨π, hπ.trans ?_⟩
  have := c.quotient.width_le_card (Classical.arbitrary _)
  omega

        ((if G.edist u z = R then 1 else 0) + (if G.edist v z = R then 1 else 0)) := by

  have hIv : (0 : ℝ) ≤ if G.edist v z = R then 1 else 0 := by split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hRHS : 0 ≤ (q ^ 2) ^ R / 2 *

    split_ifs <;> positivity

  simp only [kernelRow_apply]
  by_cases hv : G.edist v z ≤ R
  · -- Both entries are nonzero: the distances are equal or differ by one.
    have hu := huvz.trans hv

    refine le_trans ?_ hRHS
    rw [edist_eq_dist_of_le hu, edist_eq_dist_of_le hv] at huvz h
    have h1 : G.dist u z ≤ G.dist v z := by exact_mod_cast huvz
    have h2 : G.dist v z ≤ G.dist u z + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h
    rcases (by omega : G.dist v z = G.dist u z ∨ G.dist v z = G.dist u z + 1) with h | h
    · rw [h]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hκ (sq_nonneg (q ^ G.dist u z))]
    · rw [h, pow_succ q (G.dist u z)]
      linarith [two_mul_div_mul_sq_add_sq q (q ^ G.dist u z)]
  rw [ite_eq_right hv]

  · -- Only the entry of `u` is nonzero, so `z` lies on the sphere of radius `R` around `u`.
    have hd := edist_eq_dist_of_le hu

    have hR : G.dist u z = R := by
      have hlt : R < G.dist u z + 1 := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_not_ge hv).trans_le h
      have hle : G.dist u z ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast hu

      · rw [mem_edgeCut_iff_otherEnd hi, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_ofPred_eq, hκ e hi] at he
        tauto
      · rw [mem_edgeCut_iff_otherEnd hi, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_ofPred_eq, hκ e hi]
        tauto
    · simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_ofPred_eq, A]
      refine ⟨fun ⟨he, hi⟩ => ⟨hi, ?_⟩, fun ⟨hi, he⟩ => ⟨?_, hi⟩⟩
      · rw [mem_edgeCut_iff_otherEnd hi, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_ofPred_eq, hκ e hi] at he
        tauto
      · rw [mem_edgeCut_iff_otherEnd hi, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_ofPred_eq, hκ e hi]
        tauto
  rw [hcut key' hfix, hcut key fun _ _ => rfl]
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := hmed
  -- The median sides with the larger of `A` and `B`.
  have hBA (hv' : key' v < t) : B.ncard ≤ A.ncard :=
    (ncard_le_ncard (s := B) (t := {e ∈ G.incidenceSet v | key' v < key (G.otherEnd v e)})
      fun e he => ⟨he.1, hv'.trans_le (not_lt.mp he.2)⟩).trans
      (h₁.trans (ncard_le_ncard fun e he => ⟨he.1, he.2.trans_lt hv'⟩))
  have hAB (hv' : ¬key' v < t) : A.ncard ≤ B.ncard :=
    (ncard_le_ncard (s := A) (t := {e ∈ G.incidenceSet v | key (G.otherEnd v e) < key' v})
      fun e he => ⟨he.1, he.2.trans_le (not_lt.mp hv')⟩).trans
      (h₂.trans (ncard_le_ncard fun e he => ⟨he.1, not_lt.mpr ((not_lt.mp hv').trans he.2)⟩))
  split_ifs with h h'
  exacts [le_rfl, hBA h, hAB h, le_rfl]

/-- **Median updates improve every threshold cut.** Moving the keys of the vertices of an
independent set `I` to medians of the keys of their neighbours does not increase the cut at any
threshold. -/

private theorem ncard_le_add_add (F : Set E) (score : E → α) (t t' : α) :
    F.ncard ≤ {e ∈ F | score e < t}.ncard + {e ∈ F | t ≤ score e ∧ score e < t'}.ncard +
      {e ∈ F | t' ≤ score e}.ncard := by
  refine (ncard_le_ncard (t := {e ∈ F | score e < t} ∪
      {e ∈ F | t ≤ score e ∧ score e < t'} ∪ {e ∈ F | t' ≤ score e}) fun e he => ?_).trans
    ((ncard_union_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (ncard_union_le _ _) _))
  by_cases h₁ : score e < t
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨he, h₁⟩)
  by_cases h₂ : score e < t'
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨he, not_lt.mp h₁, h₂⟩)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨he, not_lt.mp h₂⟩

/-- **Charging low edges.** If the medians outside `P` are at least `m`, the edges leaving `P`
that score below a threshold `t ≤ m` are no more than the vertices outside `P` that straddle
`t`. -/

text:
private theorem ncard_edgeCut_score_lt_le [Finite V] (h3 : ∀ v, (G.incidenceSet v).ncard = 3)
    (hmed : ∀ v, G.IsMedian score v (med v)) (hPc : ∀ v ∉ P, m ≤ med v) {t : α}
    (ht : t ≤ m) :
    {e ∈ G.edgeCut P | score e < t}.ncard ≤ {v | v ∉ P ∧ G.EdgeStraddles score t v}.ncard := by
  classical
  refine ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn (fun e => if G.src e ∈ P then G.tgt e else G.src e) ?_ ?_
  · rintro e ⟨he, hlt⟩
    obtain ⟨hv, hev⟩ := exists_notMem_of_mem_edgeCut he
    obtain ⟨e', he', hle⟩ := (hmed _).exists_le_score
    exact ⟨hv, e, hev, hlt, e', he', ht.trans ((hPc _ hv).trans hle)⟩
  · rintro e ⟨he, hlt⟩ e' ⟨he', hlt'⟩ heq
    obtain ⟨hv, hev⟩ := exists_notMem_of_mem_edgeCut he
    obtain ⟨-, hev'⟩ := exists_notMem_of_mem_edgeCut he'
    simp only at heq
    rw [← heq] at hev'
    exact (hmed _).eq_of_score_lt (h3 _) hev hev' (hlt.trans_le (ht.trans (hPc _ hv)))
      (hlt'.trans_le (ht.trans (hPc _ hv)))

/-- **Charging high edges.** If the medians inside `P` are at most `m`, the edges leaving `P`
that score at least a threshold `t > m` are no more than the vertices inside `P` with an edge
scoring at least `t`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem ncard_endpoints_le (F : Set E) :
    {w | ∃ e ∈ F, G.src e = w ∨ G.tgt e = w}.ncard ≤ 2 * F.ncard := by
  refine (ncard_le_ncard (t := G.src '' F ∪ G.tgt '' F) ?_).trans
    ((ncard_union_le _ _).trans ?_)
  · rintro w ⟨e, he, rfl | rfl⟩
    exacts [Or.inl ⟨e, he, rfl⟩, Or.inr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩]
  · have := ncard_image_le (f := G.src) (s := F)
    have := ncard_image_le (f := G.tgt) (s := F)
    omega

/-- **The cut of a prefix.** Let the vertices of `P` have medians at most `m`, and the others
medians at least `m`. If three times the edges scoring in each tail, and the vertices straddling
each grid threshold plus three times the edges scoring in the following window, are at most
`B`, then at most `B` edges leave `P`. -/

text:
theorem ncard_edgeCut_le_of_isMedian [Finite V] (h3 : ∀ v, (G.incidenceSet v).ncard = 3)
    {score : E → ℝ} {med : V → ℝ} (hmed : ∀ v, G.IsMedian score v (med v)) {P : Set V}
    {m : ℝ} (hP : ∀ u ∈ P, med u ≤ m) (hPc : ∀ v ∉ P, m ≤ med v) {a δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {M : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (low : 3 * ({e | score e < a}.ncard : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (high : 3 * ({e | a + M * δ ≤ score e}.ncard : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (mid : ∀ i < M, ({v | G.EdgeStraddles score (a + i * δ) v}.ncard : ℝ) +
      3 * ({e | a + i * δ ≤ score e ∧ score e < a + (i + 1) * δ}.ncard : ℝ) ≤ B) :
    ((G.edgeCut P).ncard : ℝ) ≤ B := by
  -- The edges leaving `P` scoring in a set lie among all the edges scoring in it.
  have hsub (p : ℝ → Prop) : {e ∈ G.edgeCut P | p (score e)}.ncard ≤ {e | p (score e)}.ncard :=
    ncard_le_ncard fun e he => he.2
  -- The empty window between a threshold and itself.
  have hempty (t : ℝ) : {e ∈ G.edgeCut P | t ≤ score e ∧ score e < t}.ncard = 0 := by
    rw [ncard_eq_zero]
    ext e
    simp only [mem_sep_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    exact fun h => h.2.1.not_gt h.2.2
  rcases lt_or_ge m a with hlow | hge
  · -- Below the grid: the vertices of `P` charged by high edges are endpoints of low edges.
    have hU : {u | u ∈ P ∧ ∃ e ∈ G.incidenceSet u, a ≤ score e} ⊆
        {w | ∃ e ∈ {e | score e < a}, G.src e = w ∨ G.tgt e = w} := by
      rintro u ⟨hu, -⟩
      obtain ⟨e, he, hle⟩ := (hmed u).exists_score_le
      exact ⟨e, (hle.trans (hP u hu)).trans_lt hlow, he⟩
    have := ncard_le_add_add (G.edgeCut P) score a a
    have := G.ncard_edgeCut_le_score_le h3 hmed hP hlow
    have := ncard_le_ncard hU
    have := G.ncard_endpoints_le {e | score e < a}
    have := hsub (· < a)
    have := hempty a
    have hnat : (G.edgeCut P).ncard ≤ 3 * {e | score e < a}.ncard := by omega
    exact (by exact_mod_cast hnat : ((G.edgeCut P).ncard : ℝ) ≤ _).trans low
  set top := a + M * δ
  rcases le_or_gt top m with htop | hlt
  · -- Above the grid: the vertices outside `P` charged by low edges are endpoints of high edges.
    have hV : {v | v ∉ P ∧ G.EdgeStraddles score top v} ⊆
        {w | ∃ e ∈ {e | top ≤ score e}, G.src e = w ∨ G.tgt e = w} := by
      rintro v ⟨hv, -⟩
      obtain ⟨e, he, hle⟩ := (hmed v).exists_le_score
      exact ⟨e, htop.trans ((hPc v hv).trans hle), he⟩
    have := ncard_le_add_add (G.edgeCut P) score top top
    have := G.ncard_edgeCut_score_lt_le h3 hmed hPc htop
    have := ncard_le_ncard hV
    have := G.ncard_endpoints_le {e | top ≤ score e}
    have := hsub (top ≤ ·)
    have := hempty top
    have hnat : (G.edgeCut P).ncard ≤ 3 * {e | top ≤ score e}.ncard := by omega
    exact (by exact_mod_cast hnat : ((G.edgeCut P).ncard : ℝ) ≤ _).trans high
  -- Inside the grid: `t = a + i δ ≤ m < a + (i + 1) δ = t'`.
  obtain ⟨i, hiM, ht, ht'⟩ := exists_grid_index hδ hge hlt
  set t := a + i * δ
  set t' := a + (i + 1) * δ
  set W := {e | t ≤ score e ∧ score e < t'}
  set S := {v | G.EdgeStraddles score t v}
  -- The vertices of `P` charged by high edges straddle `t` or are endpoints of window edges.
  have hU : {u | u ∈ P ∧ ∃ e ∈ G.incidenceSet u, t' ≤ score e} ⊆
      {u | u ∈ P ∧ G.EdgeStraddles score t u} ∪
        {w | ∃ e ∈ W, G.src e = w ∨ G.tgt e = w} := by
    rintro u ⟨hu, e, he, hle⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfle⟩ := (hmed u).exists_score_le
    by_cases hft : score f < t
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hu, f, hf, hft, e, he, by linarith⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨f, ⟨not_lt.mp hft, by linarith [hP u hu]⟩, hf⟩
  -- The straddling vertices inside and outside `P` are all the straddling vertices.
  have hS : {v | v ∉ P ∧ G.EdgeStraddles score t v}.ncard +
      {u | u ∈ P ∧ G.EdgeStraddles score t u}.ncard ≤ S.ncard := by
    rw [← ncard_union_eq (s := {v | v ∉ P ∧ G.EdgeStraddles score t v})
      (t := {v | v ∈ P ∧ G.EdgeStraddles score t v})
      (disjoint_left.mpr fun v hv hv' => hv.1 hv'.1)]
    exact ncard_le_ncard fun v hv => hv.elim (·.2) (·.2)
  have := ncard_le_add_add (G.edgeCut P) score t t'
  have := G.ncard_edgeCut_score_lt_le h3 hmed hPc ht
  have := G.ncard_edgeCut_le_score_le h3 hmed hP ht'
  have := (ncard_le_ncard hU).trans (ncard_union_le _ _)
  have := G.ncard_endpoints_le W
  have : _ ≤ W.ncard := hsub (fun x => t ≤ x ∧ x < t')
  have hnat : (G.edgeCut P).ncard ≤ S.ncard + 3 * W.ncard := by omega
  calc ((G.edgeCut P).ncard : ℝ) ≤ S.ncard + 3 * W.ncard := by exact_mod_cast hnat
    _ ≤ B := mid i hiM

theorem exists_multi_vertex_sample [Finite V] [Finite E] (hloop : G.Loopless) {d : ℕ}
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hdeg : G.MaxDegreeLE d) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (R : ℕ) {ρ : ℝ}
    (hρ : ρ ≤ 2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) - d * ((d - 1) * q ^ 2) ^ R) {T ε : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hε : 0 < ε) {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (large : (M * (d + 1) + 2) * (vertexOverlap d R : ℝ) / ε ^ 2 < Nat.card V) :
    ∃ σ : Layout V, (G.width σ : ℝ) ≤ arccos ρ / π * Nat.card E +
      Nat.card V * (d / T ^ 2 + d * (2 * T / M) / √(2 * π) + (d + 1) * ε) := by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite V
  have := Fintype.ofFinite E
  set P := Measure.pi fun _ : V => gaussianReal 0 1
  set h : ℝ := ((Nat.card V : ℕ) : ℝ) with hh
  set m : ℝ := ((Nat.card E : ℕ) : ℝ) with hm
  set D : ℝ := ((vertexOverlap d R : ℕ) : ℝ)
  set δ : ℝ := 2 * T / M with hδ
  set c : ℝ := ε * h with hc
  set p : ℝ := arccos ρ / π with hp
  have hMpos : (0 : ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hhpos : 0 < h := lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) large
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by positivity
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by positivity
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := div_nonneg (arccos_nonneg _) pi_pos.le
  have hmh : m ≤ d * h := by
    rw [hm, hh]
    exact_mod_cast G.card_le_mul_card hdeg
  have hcardV : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) = h := by rw [hh, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have hcardE : (Fintype.card E : ℝ) = m := by rw [hm, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have unit (v : V) : ‖unitKernelRow G.toSimpleGraph q R v‖ = 1 := norm_unitKernelRow q R v
  -- Each count deviates from its mean by `c` with probability `O(1 / h)`.
  have crossDev (t : ℝ) : P.real (deviation (crossingEvent G q R t) c) ≤ m * D / c ^ 2 := by
    have := measureReal_deviation_le (fun e => measurableSet_crossingEvent q R t e)
      (fun e => closedBall G.toSimpleGraph (G.src e) (R + 1))
      (fun e => dependsOn_crossingEvent q R t e)
      (fun e => card_not_disjoint_closedBall_src_le hdeg R e) hcpos
    rwa [hcardE] at this
  have vertexDev {f : ℝ → Prop} (hf : MeasurableSet {x | f x}) :
      P.real (deviation (vertexEvent G q R f) c) ≤ h * D / c ^ 2 := by
    have := measureReal_deviation_le (fun v => measurableSet_vertexEvent q R hf v)
      (fun v => closedBall G.toSimpleGraph v (R + 1)) (fun v => dependsOn_vertexEvent q R f v)
      (fun v => card_not_disjoint_closedBall_le hdeg (by omega) R v) hcpos
    rwa [hcardV] at this
  have hsmall : M * (m * D / c ^ 2 + h * D / c ^ 2) + h * D / c ^ 2 +
      h * D / c ^ 2 < 1 := by
    have hm' : m * D / c ^ 2 ≤ d * h * D / c ^ 2 := by gcongr
    have hcalc : (M * (d * h * D / c ^ 2 + h * D / c ^ 2) + h * D / c ^ 2 + h * D / c ^ 2) =
        (M * (d + 1) + 2) * D / ε ^ 2 / h := by
      rw [hc]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hlast : (M * (d + 1) + 2) * D / ε ^ 2 / h < 1 := (div_lt_one hhpos).mpr large
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm' (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) M)]
  obtain ⟨ω, hmid, hlow, hhigh⟩ := exists_sample_of_grid_bounds
    (fun i _ => crossDev (-T + i * δ))
    (fun i _ => vertexDev (f := fun x => -T + i * δ ≤ x ∧ x < -T + i * δ + δ)
      ((measurableSet_le measurable_const measurable_id).inter
        (measurableSet_lt measurable_id measurable_const)))
    (vertexDev (f := (· < -T)) (measurableSet_lt measurable_id measurable_const))
    (vertexDev (f := (T ≤ ·)) (measurableSet_le measurable_const measurable_id)) hsmall
  set score := vertexScore G q R ω
  set B := p * m + h * (d / T ^ 2 + d * δ / √(2 * π) + (d + 1) * ε)
  have vertexMean {f : ℝ → Prop} {b : ℝ} (hb : ∀ v, P.real (vertexEvent G q R f v) ≤ b) :
      ∑ v, P.real (vertexEvent G q R f v) ≤ h * b :=
    (Finset.sum_le_sum fun v _ => hb v).trans_eq
      (by rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, hcardV])
  -- A tail count is below its mean plus `c`.
  have tail (f : ℝ → Prop) (hf : ∀ x, f x → T ≤ |x|)
      (hdev : ω ∉ deviation (vertexEvent G q R f) c) :
      d * ({v | ω ∈ vertexEvent G q R f v}.ncard : ℝ) ≤ B := by
    have hcount := ncard_lt_of_notMem_deviation hdev
    have hmean : ∑ v, P.real (vertexEvent G q R f v) ≤ h * (1 / T ^ 2) :=
      vertexMean fun v => (measureReal_mono (μ := P) fun ω' hω' => hf _ hω').trans
        (measureReal_le_abs_le (unit v) hT)
    have hbound : ({v | ω ∈ vertexEvent G q R f v}.ncard : ℝ) ≤ h / T ^ 2 + c := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_one_div]
      linarith
    have hmult := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) d)
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ p * m + h * (d * δ / √(2 * π) + ε) := by positivity
    have hidentity : B = d * (h / T ^ 2 + c) + (p * m + h * (d * δ / √(2 * π) + ε)) := by
      simp only [B, hc]
      ring
    rw [hidentity]
    linarith
  -- The edges leaving a threshold set are those crossed at the threshold.
  have crossCount (t : ℝ) : (G.edgeCut {v | score v < t}).ncard =
      {e | ω ∈ crossingEvent G q R t e}.ncard := by
    congr 1
    ext e
    simp only [Multigraph.mem_edgeCut, crossingEvent, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_uIoc, ← not_lt]
    tauto
  have htop : -T + M * δ = T := by
    rw [hδ]
    field_simp
    ring
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := G.exists_width_le_of_vertexScore hdeg score hδpos M (a := -T) (B := B)
    (tail (· < -T) (fun x hx => by rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith) hlow)
    (by
      rw [htop]
      exact tail (T ≤ ·) (fun x hx => hx.trans (le_abs_self x)) hhigh)
    (by
      intro i hi
      have hthr : -T + ((i : ℝ) + 1) * δ = -T + i * δ + δ := by ring
      rw [hthr]
      have hC := ncard_lt_of_notMem_deviation (hmid i hi).1
      have hW := ncard_lt_of_notMem_deviation (hmid i hi).2
      have hCm : ∑ e, P.real (crossingEvent G q R (-T + i * δ) e) ≤ m * p :=
        (Finset.sum_le_sum fun e _ => measureReal_crossingEvent_le hloop hd hdeg hq R hρ
          (-T + i * δ) e).trans_eq
            (by rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, hcardE])
      have hWm := vertexMean (f := fun x => -T + i * δ ≤ x ∧ x < -T + i * δ + δ)
        (b := δ / √(2 * π)) fun v => measureReal_window_le (unit v) (-T + i * δ) hδpos.le
      have h1 : ((G.edgeCut {v | score v < -T + i * δ}).ncard : ℝ) ≤ m * p + c := by
        rw [crossCount]
        linarith
      have h2 : ({v | -T + i * δ ≤ score v ∧ score v < -T + i * δ + δ}.ncard : ℝ) ≤
          h * (δ / √(2 * π)) + c := by
        have : ({v | -T + i * δ ≤ score v ∧ score v < -T + i * δ + δ}.ncard : ℝ) <
            ∑ v, P.real (vertexEvent G q R (fun x => -T + i * δ ≤ x ∧ x < -T + i * δ + δ) v) +
              c := hW
        linarith
      have hmult := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) d)
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ h * (d / T ^ 2) := by positivity
      have hidentity : B = (m * p + c) + d * (h * (δ / √(2 * π)) + c) + h * (d / T ^ 2) := by
        simp only [B, hc]
        ring
      rw [hidentity]
      linarith)
  exact ⟨σ, hσ⟩

/-- **Gaussian vertex layouts of multigraphs.** For every `ξ > 0`, every large enough loopless
multigraph of maximum degree `d ≥ 2` has a layout of width at most
`vertexCoefficient d · |E| + ξ |V|`, parallel edges counted with multiplicity. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem exists_width_le_vertexCoefficient {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ (V E : Type*) [Finite V] [Finite E] (G : Multigraph V E), G.Loopless →
      G.MaxDegreeLE d → N₀ < Nat.card V →
        ∃ σ : Layout V, (G.width σ : ℝ) ≤ vertexCoefficient d * Nat.card E + ξ * Nat.card V := by
  set D : ℝ := (d : ℝ)
  have hD : 2 ≤ D := by
    simp only [D]
    exact_mod_cast hd
  set g := vertexCorrelation d
  have hg : 0 < g := vertexCorrelation_pos hd
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hcont⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp
    (continuous_arccos.continuousAt (x := g)) (π * ξ / (4 * D)) (by positivity)
  set ρ := g - min η g / 2
  have hmin : 0 < min η g := lt_min hη hg
  have hρg : ρ < g := by
    simp only [ρ]
    linarith
  have hcoef : arccos ρ / π ≤ vertexCoefficient d + ξ / (4 * D) := by
    have hdist : dist ρ g < η := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq, show ρ - g = -(min η g / 2) by simp only [ρ]; ring, abs_neg,
        abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      linarith [min_le_left η g]
    have H := (le_abs_self _).trans (hcont hdist).le
    rw [div_le_iff₀ pi_pos]
    have heq : (arccos g / π + ξ / (4 * D)) * π = arccos g + π * ξ / (4 * D) := by
      field_simp
    rw [vertexCoefficient, show vertexCorrelation d = g from rfl, heq]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨q, R, hq, hcorr⟩ := exists_decay_radius_degree hd hρg
  set T := 1 + 4 * D / ξ
  set ε := ξ / (4 * (D + 1))
  set M : ℕ := ⌈8 * D * T / ξ⌉₊ + 1
  have hT : 0 < T := by positivity
  have hε : 0 < ε := by positivity
  have hM : 0 < M := Nat.succ_pos _
  have hMR : 8 * D * T / ξ ≤ (M : ℝ) := by
    simp only [M]
    push_cast
    linarith [Nat.le_ceil (8 * D * T / ξ)]
  have htail : D / T ^ 2 ≤ ξ / 4 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hT)]
    have hx : 0 ≤ 4 * D / ξ := by positivity
    have hsq : 4 * D / ξ ≤ T ^ 2 := by
      simp only [T]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (4 * D / ξ)]
    have H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hξ.le
    rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hξ.ne'] at H

theorem ncard_edgeCut_le_grid [Finite V] [Finite E] {d : ℕ} (hd : G.MaxDegreeLE d)
    (score : V → ℝ) {P : Set V} {m a δ : ℝ} (hP : ∀ v ∈ P, score v ≤ m)
    (hPc : ∀ v ∉ P, m ≤ score v) (hδ : 0 < δ) (M : ℕ) {B : ℝ}
    (low : d * ({v | score v < a}.ncard : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (high : d * ({v | a + M * δ ≤ score v}.ncard : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (mid : ∀ i < M, ((G.edgeCut {v | score v < a + i * δ}).ncard : ℝ) +
      d * ({v | a + i * δ ≤ score v ∧ score v < a + (i + 1) * δ}.ncard : ℝ) ≤ B) :
    ((G.edgeCut P).ncard : ℝ) ≤ B := by
  have count (S : Set V) (hsub : G.edgeCut P ⊆ G.touching S) :
      ((G.edgeCut P).ncard : ℝ) ≤ d * S.ncard := by
    exact_mod_cast (ncard_le_ncard hsub).trans (G.ncard_touching_le hd S)
  by_cases hlo : m < a
  · -- Below the grid: the end in `P` scores below `a`.
    refine (count {v | score v < a} fun e he => ?_).trans low
    obtain ⟨u, w, hends, hu, -⟩ := G.exists_ends_of_mem_edgeCut he
    exact G.mem_touching_of_ends hends ((hP u hu).trans_lt hlo)
  by_cases hhi : a + M * δ ≤ m
  · -- Above the grid: the end outside `P` scores at least `a + M δ`.
    refine (count {v | a + M * δ ≤ score v} fun e he => ?_).trans high
    obtain ⟨u, w, hends, -, hw⟩ := G.exists_ends_of_mem_edgeCut he
    exact G.mem_touching_of_ends (u := w) (w := u) (hends.elim Or.inr Or.inl)
      (hhi.trans (hPc w hw))
  -- Inside the grid: `a + i δ ≤ m < a + (i + 1) δ`.
  obtain ⟨i, hi, ht, ht'⟩ := exists_grid_index hδ (M := M) (not_lt.mp hlo) (not_le.mp hhi)
  set W := {v | a + i * δ ≤ score v ∧ score v < a + (i + 1) * δ}
  have hsub : G.edgeCut P ⊆ G.edgeCut {v | score v < a + i * δ} ∪ G.touching W := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨u, w, hends, hu, hw⟩ := G.exists_ends_of_mem_edgeCut he
    by_cases hut : score u < a + i * δ
    · exact Or.inl (G.mem_edgeCut_of_ends hends hut (not_lt.mpr (ht.trans (hPc w hw))))
    · exact Or.inr (G.mem_touching_of_ends hends ⟨not_lt.mp hut, (hP u hu).trans_lt ht'⟩)
  have hnat := (ncard_le_ncard hsub).trans ((ncard_union_le _ _).trans
    (Nat.add_le_add_left (G.ncard_touching_le hd W) _))
  have hreal : ((G.edgeCut P).ncard : ℝ) ≤
      (G.edgeCut {v | score v < a + i * δ}).ncard + d * W.ncard := by exact_mod_cast hnat
  exact hreal.trans (mid i hi)

listing the vertices by score gives a layout of width at most `B`. -/

theorem eventually_lt_mul_card_of_ledger {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (hlayout : LayoutBound (r + 1) A) (hfree : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, RectangleFree (S n) (K n))
    (hK : (fun n => Real.log (K n)) =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ))
    (hdense : (fun n => n * Real.log (Nat.card U) - Real.log (S n).ncard) =o[atTop]
      fun n => (n : ℝ))
    {β : ℕ → ℝ} (hβ : β =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ)) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ (σ : Signature.{v}) (I : Interpretation σ U) (Acc : Set U)
      (c : Circuit σ n 1) (special : Fin c.size → Prop) [DecidablePred special] (M : Type w)
      [CommMonoid M] [Finite M],
        (∀ g, ¬special g → σ.Arity (c.program.lines g).op ≤ r) →
        Ledger special c.program I M → Real.log (Nat.card M) ≤ β n → c.Decides I Acc (S n) →
          (1 + 1 / A - ε) * n <
            (r - 1) * (c.program.innerGates.filter fun g => ¬special g).card := by
  set q := Nat.card U
  have hq : (1 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast Finite.one_lt_card
  have h2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
  have hL2 : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log q :=
    Real.log_le_log two_pos (by exact_mod_cast Finite.one_lt_card)
  -- The ledger costs three products in `M`, at most `3 β(n) / log 2` symbols.
  have hβ' : (fun n => 3 * (β n / Real.log 2)) =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ) :=
    (hβ.const_mul_left (3 / Real.log 2)).congr_left fun n => by ring
  obtain ⟨η, hη, H⟩ := eventually_lt_of_frontier hA (r + 2) hK hdense hβ' hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hlayout.exists_layout_componentwise hη
  filter_upwards [H C, hfree, eventually_card_mul_sq_le_ncard hfree hK hdense,
    eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hfreen hbign hn1
  intro σ I Acc c special _ M _ _ hfan L hM hS
  -- The set decided by the circuit is the set accepted by its program at its output.
  set o := c.outputs 0
  have hSeq : S n = {x | c.program.trace I x o ∈ Acc} := by
    ext x
    exact hS x
  rw [hSeq] at hfreen hbign
  have hK1 := hfreen.pos
  have hKS : K n ≤ {x | c.program.trace I x o ∈ Acc}.ncard :=
    (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ Nat.card_pos).trans
      ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_self_pow two_ne_zero _)).trans hbign)
  -- Lay out the live network one component after another.
  set lc := liveCircuit c.program special
  set V := Nat.card (Compiler.Vertex lc)
  set N := liveNetwork c.program special U
  have hfan' : lc.FanInAtMost r := (Program.fanInAtMost_eraseGates_iff (special := special)).2 hfan
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := hC _ _ (Compiler.graph lc) Compiler.loopless (Compiler.maxDegreeLE hr hfan')
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hcount⟩ := L.exists_ncard_le π hfreen hKS (card_vertex_liveCircuit_pos hn1)
    fun t ht => union_subset (hπ t ht t le_rfl (by omega)).1 (hπ t ht (t + 1) (by omega) le_rfl).1
  -- The quantities of the comparison: the component `W` of the vertex processed at step `t`, the
  -- width `a` of the step and the inputs `nW` read in `W`.
  set W := N.component (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)
  set se := (c.program.innerGates.filter fun g => ¬special g).card
  have hse : lc.innerSize = se := innerSize_liveCircuit
  set a := (N.frontier π t ∪ N.frontier π (t + 1)).ncard + (N.readAt (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)).ncard
  set nW := (N.readIn W).ncard
  set s : ℝ := (((r - 1) * se : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have hs : s = (r - 1) * se := by
    simp only [s]
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_one]
  -- The width of the step is at most its first frontier and the edges of the vertex processed.
  have ha : (a : ℝ) ≤ (N.frontier π t).ncard + (r + 2) := by
    have hU : (N.frontier π t ∪ N.frontier π (t + 1)).ncard ≤ (N.frontier π t).ncard + (r + 1) :=
      (ncard_le_ncard (union_subset subset_union_left (N.frontier_succ_subset π ht))
        (toFinite _)).trans ((ncard_union_le _ _).trans
          (Nat.add_le_add_left (Compiler.maxDegreeLE hr hfan' _) _))
    have hR : (N.readAt (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)).ncard ≤ 1 :=
      Compiler.ncard_readAt_le (I.withConstants (L.readout 1)) (fun _ => univ) _
    have : a ≤ (N.frontier π t).ncard + (r + 2) := by simp only [a]; omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  -- The cycle rank of the component and the inputs it reads.
  have hρ : (N.cycleRankOn W : ℝ) + nW ≤ s + 1 := by
    have h := Compiler.cycleRankOn_add_ncard_readIn_le (I.withConstants (L.readout 1))
      (fun _ => univ) hfan' (N.edgeCut_component (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩))
      (N.ncard_component_le_ncard_touching_add_one (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩))
    rw [hse] at h
    simp only [s]
    exact_mod_cast h
  -- The size of the graph: at most `2 r s' + 3 (n + s')` vertices for `s'` ordinary inner gates.
  have hV : (V : ℝ) ≤ 7 * s + 3 * n + 3 := by
    have h := Compiler.card_vertex_le hfan'
    have hlive := card_live_le (p := c.program) (special := special)
    rw [hse] at h hlive
    have : V ≤ 7 * ((r - 1) * se) + 3 * n := by
      have h7 : 2 * r + 3 ≤ 7 * (r - 1) := by omega
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right se h7
      simp only [V]
      nlinarith
    have : (V : ℝ) ≤ 7 * s + 3 * n := by simp only [s]; exact_mod_cast this
    linarith
  -- Take logarithms in the counting bound.
  have hMpos : 0 < Nat.card M := Nat.card_pos
  have hcount' : ({x | c.program.trace I x o ∈ Acc}.ncard : ℝ) ≤
      (K n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (V + 1) * (Nat.card M : ℝ) ^ 3 * (q : ℝ) ^ (min a nW) := by
    have : (K n - 1) ^ 2 ≤ K n ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.sub_le _ _) 2
    have h := hcount.trans (by gcongr : (K n - 1) ^ 2 * (V + 1) * Nat.card M ^ 3 * q ^ min a nW ≤
      K n ^ 2 * (V + 1) * Nat.card M ^ 3 * q ^ min a nW)
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hSpos : (0 : ℝ) < {x | c.program.trace I x o ∈ Acc}.ncard := by
    have : 0 < {x | c.program.trace I x o ∈ Acc}.ncard := lt_of_lt_of_le hK1 hKS
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hlogS : Real.logb q {x | c.program.trace I x o ∈ Acc}.ncard ≤
      2 * Real.logb q (K n) + Real.logb q (V + 1) + 3 * Real.logb q (Nat.card M) + min a nW := by
    have hK0 : (0 : ℝ) < K n := by exact_mod_cast hK1
    have hM0 : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.card M := by exact_mod_cast hMpos
    calc _ ≤ Real.logb q ((K n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (V + 1) * (Nat.card M : ℝ) ^ 3 * (q : ℝ) ^ (min a nW)) :=
          Real.logb_le_logb_of_le hq hSpos hcount'
      _ = _ := by
          rw [Real.logb_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.logb_mul (by positivity)
            (by positivity), Real.logb_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.logb_pow,
            Real.logb_pow, Real.logb_pow, Real.logb_self_eq_one hq]
          push_cast
          ring
  rw [← hSeq] at hlogS
  -- The logarithms of the threshold and of the ledger.
  have hlogM : 3 * Real.logb q (Nat.card M) ≤ 3 * (β n / Real.log 2) := by
    have h0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Nat.card M) :=
      Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hMpos.ne')
    have h1 : Real.logb q (Nat.card M) ≤ β n / Real.log 2 :=
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left h0 h2 hL2).trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hM h2.le)
    linarith
  have hlogK : 0 ≤ Real.logb q (K n) := Real.logb_nonneg hq (by exact_mod_cast hK1)
  have hmin1 : ((min a nW : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ a := by exact_mod_cast min_le_left a nW
  have hmin2 : ((min a nW : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ nW := by exact_mod_cast min_le_right a nW
  rw [← hs]
  refine hn s V (N.cycleRankOn W) (N.frontier π t).ncard (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    hV ?_ ?_ (hπ t ht t le_rfl (by omega)).2
  · -- The component reads almost all inputs, so its cycle rank is small.
    linarith
  · -- Some frontier is wide.
    linarith

theorem ncard_transition_le_readIn [Finite U] [Finite M] {t : ℕ}
    (ht : t < Nat.card (Compiler.Vertex (liveCircuit p special)))
    {W : Set (Compiler.Vertex (liveCircuit p special))}
    (hW : (liveNetwork p special U).edgeCut W = ∅) (hv : π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩ ∈ W)
    (hC : (liveNetwork p special U).frontier π t ∪ (liveNetwork p special U).frontier π (t + 1) ⊆
      (liveNetwork p special U).touching W) :
    ((L.sweep o Acc π).transition t '' {x | p.trace I x o ∈ Acc}).ncard ≤
      Nat.card M ^ 3 * Nat.card U ^ ((liveNetwork p special U).readIn W).ncard := by
  set Q := (liveNetwork p special U).readIn W
  have h := (L.sweep o Acc π).ncard_transition_le_of_factorsThrough (t := t) (D := Q → U)
    (fun x => (L.extra π t x, L.extra π (t + 1) x)) (fun x => Q.domRestrict x)
    fun x _ y _ h₀ hg => by
      rw [domRestrict_eq_domRestrict_iff] at hg
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h₀
      have hm : L.total (p.trace I x) = L.total (p.trace I y) := by
        have := h₀.1
        simp only [extra, ht.le, ↓reduceIte, Prod.mk.injEq] at this
        exact this.1
      -- The values on the edges at `W` depend only on the guess and the inputs read in `W`.
      have hval : EqOn (fun e => p.trace I x e.signal.1) (fun e => p.trace I y e.signal.1)
          ((liveNetwork p special U).touching W) := fun e he => by
        change p.trace I x e.signal.1 = p.trace I y e.signal.1
        rw [← L.run_total_trace x, ← L.run_total_trace y, ← hm]
        exact L.run_eq_of_eqOn_readIn _ hW hg he
      simp only [Sweep.transition, sweep, Network.frontierSweep, Prod.mk.injEq,
        Network.frontierValues_eq_iff, domRestrict_eq_domRestrict_iff]
      refine ⟨⟨h₀.1, hval.mono (subset_union_left.trans hC)⟩,
        ⟨h₀.2, hval.mono (subset_union_right.trans hC)⟩, fun i hi => hg ?_⟩
      exact ⟨_, hv, (liveNetwork p special U).revealedBy_succ_diff_subset π ht hi⟩
  refine h.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul (L.ncard_extra_le π t) ?_)
  rw [Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_coe_set_eq]

/-- **Counting along a layout of the components.** Suppose that, at each step of a layout, the
frontiers lie among the edges of the component of the vertex processed. Then some step `t`

theorem exists_ncard_le [Finite U] [Nonempty U] [Finite M] {K : ℕ}

        (liveNetwork p special U).touching
          ((liveNetwork p special U).component (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩))) :
    ∃ t, ∃ ht : t < Nat.card (Compiler.Vertex (liveCircuit p special)),
      {x | p.trace I x o ∈ Acc}.ncard ≤
        (K - 1) ^ 2 * (Nat.card (Compiler.Vertex (liveCircuit p special)) + 1) *
          Nat.card M ^ 3 * Nat.card U ^ min (((liveNetwork p special U).frontier π t ∪
            (liveNetwork p special U).frontier π (t + 1)).ncard +

  set N := Nat.card (Compiler.Vertex (liveCircuit p special))
  set G := liveNetwork p special U
  have hq : 1 ≤ Nat.card U := Nat.card_pos

    intro t' ht'mem

    simp only [f, ht, ↓reduceDIte]

theorem eventually_lt_mul_innerSize_of_isTotallyRegular (hr : 2 ≤ r) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (hlayout : LayoutBound (r + 1) A) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ N in atTop, ∀ (F : Type u) [Field F] (σ : Signature.{v}) (I : Interpretation σ F)
      (M : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) F) (c : Circuit σ N N), M.IsTotallyRegular →
        c.FanInAtMost r → c.Computes I (fun x => M *ᵥ x) → c.LinearCapacity I →
          (1 + 1 / A - ε) * N < (r - 1) * c.innerSize := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, H⟩ := eventually_lt_of_demand hA (κ := 4) (by norm_num) hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hlayout η hη
  have he : (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℝ)) =o[atTop] fun N => (N : ℝ) :=
    isLittleO_const_left.mpr (Or.inr (tendsto_norm_atTop_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop))
  filter_upwards [H η hη le_rfl C _ he, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN hN1
  intro F _ σ I M c hM hfan hc hcap
  obtain ⟨V, E, _, _, G, hconn, hloop, hdeg, hV, hrank, hwidth⟩ :=
    exists_graph_of_isTotallyRegular hN1 hr hfan hM hc hcap
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := hC V E G hconn hloop hdeg
  -- The quantities of the comparison.
  set s : ℝ := (r - 1) * c.innerSize
  have hcast : (((r - 1) * c.innerSize : ℕ) : ℝ) = s := by
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_one]
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := hcast ▸ Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hVs : (Nat.card V : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (N + s + 1) := by
    -- `2 r s + 3 N ≤ 4 (r - 1) s + 4 N`, since `2 r ≤ 4 (r - 1)`.
    have : 2 * r * c.innerSize + 3 * N ≤ 4 * ((r - 1) * c.innerSize) + 4 * N := by
      have : 2 * r ≤ 4 * (r - 1) := by omega
      nlinarith
    have h4 : (Nat.card V : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ((r - 1) * c.innerSize : ℕ) + 4 * N := by
      exact_mod_cast hV.trans this
    rw [hcast] at h4
    linarith
  refine hN s (Nat.card V) (G.width π) hs (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hVs ?_ ?_
  · -- The demand: every layout has width at least `N`.

    have h2 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Nat.card V + 1) :=

      have : (G.cycleRank : ℝ) + N ≤ ((r - 1) * c.innerSize : ℕ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hrank
      linarith
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrank' (by linarith : 0 ≤ A + η)
    linarith

    (hK : (fun n => Real.log (K n)) =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ))

  have hL : 0 < Real.log q := Real.log_pos hq

    eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hfreen hn1

  have hK1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ K n := by exact_mod_cast hfreen.pos
  have hlogK : 0 ≤ Real.log (K n) := Real.log_nonneg hK1
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n)] at hn
  have hb := (le_abs_self _).trans hn

  have hSlog : Real.log q + 2 * Real.log (K n) < Real.log (S n).ncard := by nlinarith
  have hSpos : (0 : ℝ) < (S n).ncard := by
    by_contra! h0
    have : ((S n).ncard : ℝ) = 0 := le_antisymm h0 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    rw [this, Real.log_zero] at hSlog
    nlinarith [Real.log_nonneg (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ q by linarith)]

theorem eventually_lt_of_frontier {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (d : ℝ)
    (hK : (fun n => Real.log (K n)) =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ))
    (hdense : (fun n => n * Real.log (Nat.card U) - Real.log (S n).ncard) =o[atTop]
      fun n => (n : ℝ))
    {β : ℕ → ℝ} (hβ : β =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ)) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ s v ρ w : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ v →
      v ≤ 7 * s + 3 * n + 3 →
      ρ ≤ s - Real.logb (Nat.card U) (S n).ncard + 2 * Real.logb (Nat.card U) (K n) +
        Real.logb (Nat.card U) (v + 1) + β n + 1 →
      Real.logb (Nat.card U) (S n).ncard ≤
        w + d + 3 * Real.logb (Nat.card U) (K n) + Real.logb (Nat.card U) (v + 1) + β n →
      w ≤ (A + η) * ρ + η * v + C →
      (1 + 1 / A - ε) * n < s := by
  set q := Nat.card U
  have hq : (1 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast Finite.one_lt_card
  have h2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
  have hL2 : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log q :=
    Real.log_le_log two_pos (by exact_mod_cast Finite.one_lt_card)
  -- The constant bounding the size of the graph and the logarithm of its size.
  set κ : ℝ := 7 + (A + 2) / Real.log 2
  have hκ : 0 ≤ κ := by positivity
  -- The error of the problem: the density defect, the threshold, the slack, and constants.
  set e : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (n - Real.logb q (S n).ncard) + 4 * Real.logb q (K n) + β n +
    (|d| + 3)
  have he : e =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : (fun n : ℕ => 4 * Real.logb q (K n)) =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ) :=
      (hK.const_mul_left (4 / Real.log q)).congr_left fun n => by
        simp only [Real.logb]
        ring
    have h3 : (fun _ : ℕ => |d| + 3) =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ) :=
      isLittleO_const_left.mpr
        (Or.inr (tendsto_norm_atTop_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop))
    exact (((isLittleO_sub_logb_ncard hdense).add h1).add hβ).add h3
  obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀, H⟩ := eventually_lt_of_demand hA hκ hε
  set η := min η₀ 1
  have hη : 0 < η := lt_min hη₀ one_pos
  have hη1 : η ≤ 1 := min_le_right _ _
  refine ⟨η, hη, fun C => ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [H η hη (min_le_left _ _) C e he] with n hn
  intro s v ρ w hs hv hvs hρ hw hsupply
  have hlogK : 0 ≤ Real.logb q (K n) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (K n) with h | h
    · simp [h]
    · exact Real.logb_nonneg hq (by exact_mod_cast h)
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (v + 1) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hlogV0 : 0 ≤ Real.logb q (v + 1) := Real.logb_nonneg hq (by linarith)
  -- The logarithm of the size of the graph, in base `q`, is at most `log (v + 1) / log 2`.
  have hlogV : (A + η + 1) * Real.logb q (v + 1) ≤ κ * Real.log (v + 1) := by
    have h1 : Real.logb q (v + 1) ≤ Real.log (v + 1) / Real.log 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hlog0 h2 hL2
    calc (A + η + 1) * Real.logb q (v + 1) ≤ (A + 2) * (Real.log (v + 1) / Real.log 2) :=
          mul_le_mul (by linarith) h1 hlogV0 (by linarith)
      _ ≤ κ * Real.log (v + 1) := by
          rw [mul_div_assoc', div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc]
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hlog0

          linarith

    have hκ7 : 7 ≤ κ := by simp only [κ]; linarith [show 0 ≤ (A + 2) / Real.log 2 by positivity]
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    nlinarith

  refine hn s v (w - (A + η) * Real.logb q (v + 1)) hs hv hvκ ?_ ?_

theorem Satisfies.splice {N : Network U ι V E} {L : Set V} {x y z : ι → U} {α β : E → U}
    (hx : N.Satisfies x α) (hy : N.Satisfies y β) (hcut : EqOn α β (N.edgeCut L))
    (hzx : EqOn z x (N.readIn L)) (hzy : EqOn z y (N.readIn L)ᶜ) :
    ∃ γ, N.Satisfies z γ ∧ EqOn γ α (N.touching L) ∧ EqOn γ β (N.touching L)ᶜ := by
  classical
  refine ⟨(N.touching L).piecewise α β, fun v => ?_, piecewise_eqOn _ _ _,
    piecewise_eqOn_compl _ _ _⟩
  by_cases hv : v ∈ L
  · -- Near `L`, the spliced assignment is `α` and the input reads like `x`.
    refine N.constraint_congr v x z α _ (fun i hi => (hzx ⟨v, hv, hi⟩).symm) (fun e he => ?_)
      (hx v)
    have : e ∈ N.touching L := by rcases he with h | h <;> [left; right] <;> rw [h] <;> exact hv
    exact (piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ this).symm
  · -- Away from `L`, it is `β` and the input reads like `y`; the two agree on the cut.
    have hinputs : ∀ i, N.site i = some v → y i = z i := by
      intro i hi
      refine (hzy fun hiL => ?_).symm
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hiu⟩ := hiL
      exact hv (Option.some_injective _ (hiu.symm.trans hi) ▸ hu)
    have hedges : ∀ e, N.src e = v ∨ N.tgt e = v → β e = (N.touching L).piecewise α β e := by
      intro e he
      by_cases ht : e ∈ N.touching L
      · rw [piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ ht]
        refine (hcut ?_).symm
        rcases he with h | h <;> rcases ht with h' | h' <;>
          simp_all [Multigraph.mem_edgeCut]
      · exact (piecewise_eq_of_notMem _ _ _ ht).symm
    exact N.constraint_congr v y z β _ hinputs hedges (hy v)

    exact ⟨v, lt_of_lt_of_le hv hst, hi⟩
  · exact subset_univ _
  · exact absurd (hst.trans ht) hs
  · exact le_rfl

vertex. -/

text:
theorem ncard_edges_le [Finite ι] [Finite U] [Finite E] {t : ℕ} (ht : t < Nat.card V) :
    ((N.branchingProgram π).edges t).ncard ≤
      Nat.card U ^ ((N.frontier π t ∪ N.frontier π (t + 1)).ncard +
        (N.readAt (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)).ncard) := by
  classical
  set C := N.frontier π t ∪ N.frontier π (t + 1)
  let g : (C → U) × ((N.branchingProgram π).newly t → U) →
      (E → Option U) × ((N.branchingProgram π).newly t → U) × (E → Option U) := fun ca =>
    (fun e => if h : e ∈ N.frontier π t then some (ca.1 ⟨e, Or.inl h⟩) else none, ca.2,
      fun e => if h : e ∈ N.frontier π (t + 1) then some (ca.1 ⟨e, Or.inr h⟩) else none)
  have hsub : (N.branchingProgram π).edges t ⊆ range g := by
    rintro ⟨m, a, m'⟩ he
    obtain ⟨α, x, rfl, rfl, rfl, -⟩ := (N.branchingProgram_edge_iff π).mp he
    refine ⟨(C.domRestrict α, _), Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext rfl ?_)⟩ <;> funext e <;>
      simp only [g, frontierValues] <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  calc ((N.branchingProgram π).edges t).ncard
      ≤ (range g).ncard := ncard_le_ncard hsub (toFinite _)
    _ ≤ Nat.card ((C → U) × ((N.branchingProgram π).newly t → U)) := by
        rw [← image_univ]
        exact (ncard_image_le (toFinite _)).trans (ncard_univ _).le
    _ = Nat.card U ^ (C.ncard + (N.readAt (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)).ncard) := by
        rw [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_coe_set_eq,
          Nat.card_coe_set_eq, N.newly_branchingProgram π ht, pow_add]

/-- At the last step both frontiers are empty, so an edge of the program is determined by the
unread inputs. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem ncard_edges_last_le [Finite ι] [Finite U] :
    ((N.branchingProgram π).edges (Nat.card V)).ncard ≤ Nat.card U ^ N.readᶜ.ncard := by
  have hempty (s : ℕ) (hs : Nat.card V ≤ s) (α : E → U) :
      N.frontierValues π s α = fun _ => none := by
    funext e
    refine N.frontierValues_of_notMem π ?_
    rw [Multigraph.frontier_of_card_le _ _ hs]
    exact notMem_empty _
  have hsub : (N.branchingProgram π).edges (Nat.card V) ⊆
      range fun a : (N.branchingProgram π).newly (Nat.card V) → U =>
        ((fun _ => none : E → Option U), a, (fun _ => none : E → Option U)) := by
    rintro ⟨m, a, m'⟩ he
    obtain ⟨α, x, rfl, rfl, rfl, -⟩ := (N.branchingProgram_edge_iff π).mp he
    exact ⟨(N.revealedBy π (Nat.card V + 1) \ N.revealedBy π (Nat.card V)).domRestrict x,
      by rw [hempty _ le_rfl, hempty _ (Nat.le_succ _)]⟩
  calc ((N.branchingProgram π).edges (Nat.card V)).ncard
      ≤ (range fun a : (N.branchingProgram π).newly (Nat.card V) → U =>
          ((fun _ => none : E → Option U), a, (fun _ => none : E → Option U))).ncard :=
        ncard_le_ncard hsub (toFinite _)
    _ ≤ Nat.card ((N.branchingProgram π).newly (Nat.card V) → U) := by
        rw [← image_univ]
        exact (ncard_image_le (toFinite _)).trans (ncard_univ _).le
    _ = Nat.card U ^ N.readᶜ.ncard := by
        rw [Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_coe_set_eq, N.newly_branchingProgram_card π]

/-- **The states of the branching program of a layout.** At a layer `t ≤ |V|`, the chosen
accepting paths of the accepted inputs pass through at most `|U| ^ |frontier t|` states: each is
the list of the values of a satisfying assignment on the frontier. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem ncard_image_path_le [Finite U] [Finite E] (π : Layout V) {t : ℕ}
    (ht : t ≤ Nat.card V) :
    ((fun x => (N.branchingProgram π).path x t) '' N.accepted).ncard ≤
      Nat.card U ^ (N.frontier π t).ncard := by
  classical
  set F := N.frontier π t
  let φ : (F → U) → E → Option U := fun a e => if h : e ∈ F then some (a ⟨e, h⟩) else none
  have hsub : (fun x => (N.branchingProgram π).path x t) '' N.accepted ⊆ range φ := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [← N.accepted_branchingProgram π] at hx
    obtain ⟨α, -, hα⟩ :=
      N.exists_satisfies_of_isAcceptingPath π ((N.branchingProgram π).isAcceptingPath_path hx)
    refine ⟨F.domRestrict α, funext fun e => ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [hα t (by omega)]
    simp only [φ, frontierValues, Set.domRestrict_apply]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  calc _ ≤ (range φ).ncard := ncard_le_ncard hsub (toFinite _)
    _ ≤ Nat.card (F → U) := by
        rw [← image_univ]
        exact (ncard_image_le (toFinite _)).trans (ncard_univ _).le
    _ = Nat.card U ^ F.ncard := by rw [Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_coe_set_eq]

/-- **The size of the program.** If a layout has width at most `w`, and every vertex has degree
at most `d` and reads at most `m` inputs, then the branching program has at most
`|V| · |U| ^ (w + d + m) + |U| ^ #(unread inputs)` edges. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem size_branchingProgram_le [Finite ι] [Finite U] [Nonempty U] [Finite E]
    {w d m : ℕ} (hw : N.width π ≤ w) (hd : N.MaxDegreeLE d)
    (hm : ∀ v, (N.readAt v).ncard ≤ m) :
    (N.branchingProgram π).size ≤
      Nat.card V * Nat.card U ^ (w + d + m) + Nat.card U ^ N.readᶜ.ncard := by
  have hq : 1 ≤ Nat.card U := Nat.card_pos
  rw [ReadOnceNBP.size, show (N.branchingProgram π).length = Nat.card V + 1 from rfl,
    Finset.sum_range_succ]
  refine add_le_add ?_ (N.ncard_edges_last_le π)
  calc ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (Nat.card V), ((N.branchingProgram π).edges t).ncard
      ≤ ∑ _t ∈ Finset.range (Nat.card V), Nat.card U ^ (w + d + m) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun t ht => ?_
        have ht : t < Nat.card V := Finset.mem_range.mp ht
        refine (N.ncard_edges_le π ht).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hq ?_)
        -- Both frontiers lie in the first one and the edges at the vertex processed.
        have hC : (N.frontier π t ∪ N.frontier π (t + 1)).ncard ≤ w + d :=
          calc (N.frontier π t ∪ N.frontier π (t + 1)).ncard
              ≤ (N.frontier π t ∪ N.incidenceSet (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)).ncard :=
                ncard_le_ncard (union_subset subset_union_left (N.frontier_succ_subset π ht))
                  (toFinite _)
            _ ≤ (N.frontier π t).ncard + (N.incidenceSet (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)).ncard :=
                ncard_union_le _ _
            _ ≤ w + d := add_le_add ((N.ncard_frontier_le_width π t).trans hw) (hd _)
        have := hm (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)
        omega
    _ = Nat.card V * Nat.card U ^ (w + d + m) := by simp

/-- **The frontier counting lemma for networks.** Let the accepted inputs of a network be
`K`-rectangle-free. If a layout has width at most `w`, and every vertex has degree at most `d`
and reads at most `m` inputs, then

`|accepted| ≤ (K - 1) ^ 2 · (|V| · |U| ^ (w + d + m) + |U| ^ #(unread inputs))`.

This is the rectangle bound for the branching program of the layout. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem ncard_accepted_le [Finite ι] [Finite U] [Nonempty U] [Finite E] {K : ℕ}
    (hfree : RectangleFree N.accepted K) {w d m : ℕ} (hw : N.width π ≤ w)
    (hd : N.MaxDegreeLE d) (hm : ∀ v, (N.readAt v).ncard ≤ m) :
    N.accepted.ncard ≤
      (K - 1) ^ 2 * (Nat.card V * Nat.card U ^ (w + d + m) + Nat.card U ^ N.readᶜ.ncard) := by
  have h := (N.branchingProgram π).ncard_accepted_le (Nat.succ_pos _) (K := K)
    (by rwa [accepted_branchingProgram])
  rw [accepted_branchingProgram] at h
  exact h.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (N.size_branchingProgram_le π hw hd hm))

/-- **Peeling for networks.** Let `S` have bias at most `b ≥ 0` on rectangles with both sides
of size at least `K`, and let every input have at most one satisfying assignment. If a layout
has width at most `w`, and every vertex has degree at most `d` and reads at most `m` inputs, then
the accepted inputs in `S` and those outside `S` differ in number by at most

`2 b |accepted| + (K - 1) ^ 2 · (|V| · |U| ^ (w + d + m) + |U| ^ #(unread inputs))`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem abs_signedCount_accepted_le [Finite ι] [Finite U] [Nonempty U] [Finite E]
    (hunique : ∀ x α β, N.Satisfies x α → N.Satisfies x β → α = β)
    {S : Set (ι → U)} {K : ℕ} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hS : RectangleBias S K b)
    {w d m : ℕ} (hw : N.width π ≤ w) (hd : N.MaxDegreeLE d)
    (hm : ∀ v, (N.readAt v).ncard ≤ m) :
    |signedCount S N.accepted| ≤ 2 * b * N.accepted.ncard +
      ((K - 1) ^ 2 * (Nat.card V * Nat.card U ^ (w + d + m) + Nat.card U ^ N.readᶜ.ncard) : ℕ) := by
  have h := (N.branchingProgram π).abs_signedCount_accepted_le
    (N.unambiguous_branchingProgram π hunique) (Nat.succ_pos _) hb hS
  rw [accepted_branchingProgram] at h
  refine h.trans (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
  exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (N.size_branchingProgram_le π hw hd hm)

theorem exists_thick_or_ncard_lt [Finite ι] [Finite U] [Nonempty U] {T : Set (ι → U)}
    {R : Set ι} (hR : DependsOn (· ∈ T) R) {K : ℕ} (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hle : K ≤ Nat.card U ^ Rᶜ.ncard) :
    (∃ (X : Set ι) (A : Set (X → U)) (B : Set (↥Xᶜ → U)),
      T = rectangle X A B ∧ K ≤ A.ncard ∧ K ≤ B.ncard) ∨ T.ncard < Nat.card U * K ^ 2 := by
  have hq : 0 < Nat.card U := Nat.card_pos
  have hex : ∃ d, K ≤ Nat.card U ^ d := ⟨_, hle⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hdK, hdmin⟩ : ∃ d, K ≤ Nat.card U ^ d ∧ ∀ d' < d, Nat.card U ^ d' < K :=
    ⟨Nat.find hex, Nat.find_spec hex, fun d' hd' => not_le.mp (Nat.find_min hex hd')⟩
  have hdR : d ≤ Rᶜ.ncard := by
    by_contra! h
    exact absurd hle (not_le.mpr (hdmin _ h))
  obtain ⟨D, hDR, rfl⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq hdR
  set B : Set (↥Dᶜ → U) := Dᶜ.domRestrict '' T
  have hT : T = rectangle D univ B :=
    eq_rectangle_of_dependsOn (hR.mono (subset_compl_comm.mp hDR))
  have hA : (univ : Set (D → U)).ncard = Nat.card U ^ D.ncard := by
    rw [ncard_univ, Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
  by_cases hB : K ≤ B.ncard
  · exact Or.inl ⟨D, univ, B, hT, hA ▸ hdK, hB⟩
  refine Or.inr ?_
  have hcard : T.ncard ≤ Nat.card U ^ D.ncard * (K - 1) := by
    calc T.ncard
        ≤ ((univ : Set (D → U)) ×ˢ B).ncard :=
          ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn _ (fun x hx => ⟨mem_univ _, x, hx, rfl⟩)
            (domRestrict_prodMk_injective D).injOn
      _ = Nat.card U ^ D.ncard * B.ncard := by rw [ncard_prod, hA]
      _ ≤ Nat.card U ^ D.ncard * (K - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
  -- Minimality of `|D|` gives `|U| ^ |D| ≤ |U| (K - 1)` once `D` is nonempty.
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos D.ncard with hd | hd
  · rw [hd, pow_zero, one_mul] at hcard
    calc T.ncard ≤ K - 1 := hcard
      _ < K := by omega
      _ ≤ Nat.card U * K ^ 2 :=
          (Nat.le_self_pow two_ne_zero K).trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hq)
  · have hlt : Nat.card U ^ (D.ncard - 1) < K := hdmin _ (by omega)
    have hpow : Nat.card U ^ D.ncard = Nat.card U * Nat.card U ^ (D.ncard - 1) := by
      rw [← pow_succ']
      congr 1
      omega
    calc T.ncard ≤ Nat.card U ^ D.ncard * (K - 1) := hcard
      _ ≤ Nat.card U * (K - 1) * (K - 1) := by
          rw [hpow]
          gcongr
          omega
      _ < Nat.card U * K ^ 2 := by
          rw [mul_assoc, sq]
          exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Nat.mul_lt_mul'' (by omega) (by omega)) hq

/-! ### Rectangle-free sets -/

/-- A set of inputs `S` is `K`-*rectangle-free* when every rectangle contained in `S`, for
every cut of the coordinates, has a side with fewer than `K` elements.

Sides are counted with `Set.encard`, so that an infinite side is never small. Over finitely many
coordinates and a finite alphabet the sides may be counted with `Set.ncard` instead
(`rectangleFree_iff`). -/

theorem subset (h : RectangleFree S K) (hTS : T ⊆ S) : RectangleFree T K :=
  fun X A B hAB => h X A B (hAB.trans hTS)

/-- Raising the threshold keeps a set rectangle-free. -/

theorem mono (h : RectangleBias S K b) (hK : K ≤ K') : RectangleBias S K' b :=
  fun X A B hA hB => h X A B (hK.trans hA) (hK.trans hB)

theorem nonneg [Nonempty U] (hS : RectangleBias S K b) (hK : K ≤ Nat.card U ^ (Nat.card ι / 2)) :
    0 ≤ b := by
  obtain ⟨X, -, hX⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq (s := (univ : Set ι)) (n := Nat.card ι / 2)
    (by rw [ncard_univ]; exact Nat.div_le_self _ _)
  have hXc : Nat.card ι / 2 ≤ Xᶜ.ncard := by
    have := ncard_add_ncard_compl X
    omega
  have hA : K ≤ (univ : Set (X → U)).ncard := by
    rwa [ncard_univ, Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_coe_set_eq, hX]
  have hB : K ≤ (univ : Set (↥Xᶜ → U)).ncard := by
    rw [ncard_univ, Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    exact hK.trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right Nat.card_pos hXc)
  have hR : (0 : ℝ) < (rectangle X (univ : Set (X → U)) univ).ncard := by
    rw [show rectangle X (univ : Set (X → U)) univ = univ by ext; simp [rectangle], ncard_univ]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.card_pos
  exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left ((abs_nonneg _).trans (hS X univ univ hA hB)) hR

/-- **Bias on a set that ignores many coordinates.** If `T` depends only on the coordinates in
`R` and the others carry at least `K ≥ 1` assignments, then either `T` is a rectangle with both
sides of size at least `K`, on which `S` has bias at most `b`, or `T` is small. Either way the
signed count of `S` on `T` is at most `2 b |T| + |U| K ^ 2`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem abs_signedCount_le_of_dependsOn [Nonempty U] (hS : RectangleBias S K b) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    {T : Set (ι → U)} {R : Set ι} (hR : DependsOn (· ∈ T) R) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hle : K ≤ Nat.card U ^ Rᶜ.ncard) :
    |signedCount S T| ≤ 2 * b * T.ncard + (Nat.card U * K ^ 2 : ℕ) := by
  rcases exists_thick_or_ncard_lt hR hK hle with ⟨X, A, B, rfl, hA, hB⟩ | h
  · exact (hS.abs_signedCount_rectangle_le hA hB).trans
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  · have : (T.ncard : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.card U * K ^ 2 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast h.le
    linarith [abs_signedCount_le S T, mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * b)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) T.ncard)]

theorem ncard_accepted_le_pow [Nonempty U] (hfree : RectangleFree N.accepted K)
    (hbig : Nat.card U * K ^ 2 ≤ N.accepted.ncard) (π : Layout V) {w d m : ℕ}
    (hw : N.width π ≤ w) (hd : N.MaxDegreeLE d) (hm : ∀ v, (N.readAt v).ncard ≤ m) :
    N.accepted.ncard ≤ K ^ 3 * (Nat.card V + 1) * Nat.card U ^ (w + d + m) := by
  set q := Nat.card U
  set v := Nat.card V
  have hq : 0 < q := Nat.card_pos
  have hK := hfree.pos
  have hcount := N.ncard_accepted_le π hfree hw hd hm
  have hunread := hfree.pow_ncard_compl_lt N.dependsOn_read hbig
  calc N.accepted.ncard ≤ (K - 1) ^ 2 * (v * q ^ (w + d + m) + q ^ N.readᶜ.ncard) := hcount
    _ ≤ K ^ 2 * (v * K * q ^ (w + d + m) + K * q ^ (w + d + m)) := by
        gcongr
        · omega
        · exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hK
        · exact hunread.le.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (pow_pos hq _))
    _ = K ^ 3 * (v + 1) * q ^ (w + d + m) := by ring

/-- **Frontier demand.** If the accepted set of a network is `K`-rectangle-free with at least
`q K ^ 2` elements, where `q = |U| ≥ 2`, then a layout of width at most `w`, in a network of
degree at most `d` reading at most `m` inputs per vertex, satisfies

`log_q |accepted| ≤ w + d + m + 3 log_q K + log_q (|V| + 1)`.

No uniqueness of satisfying assignments is needed. -/

theorem ncard_transition_le_of_factorsThrough [Finite ι] [Finite U] {t : ℕ} {R D : Type*}
    [Finite D] (h : (ι → U) → R) (g : (ι → U) → D)
    (hg : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, h x = h y → g x = g y → P.transition t x = P.transition t y) :
    (P.transition t '' S).ncard ≤ (h '' S).ncard * Nat.card D := by
  calc (P.transition t '' S).ncard
      ≤ ((fun x => (h x, g x)) '' S).ncard :=
        ncard_image_le_ncard_image_of_factorsThrough (toFinite _) fun x hx y hy hxy =>
          hg x hx y hy (Prod.ext_iff.mp hxy).1 (Prod.ext_iff.mp hxy).2
    _ ≤ ((h '' S) ×ˢ (univ : Set D)).ncard :=
        ncard_le_ncard (image_subset_iff.mpr fun x hx => ⟨mem_image_of_mem h hx, mem_univ _⟩)
          ((toFinite S).image h |>.prod finite_univ)
    _ = (h '' S).ncard * Nat.card D := by rw [ncard_prod, ncard_univ]

theorem pastSide_lt_or_futureSide_lt {K : ℕ} (hS : RectangleFree S K) (t : ℕ) (x : ι → U) :
    (P.pastSide t x).ncard < K ∨ (P.futureSide t x).ncard < K := by
  refine hS.ncard_lt_or _ _ _ fun z ⟨⟨y, ⟨hy, hyx⟩, hzy⟩, ⟨y', ⟨hy', hy'x⟩, hzy'⟩⟩ => ?_
  exact P.splice t y hy y' hy' (hyx.trans hy'x.symm) z
    (domRestrict_eq_domRestrict_iff.mp hzy).symm (domRestrict_eq_domRestrict_iff.mp hzy').symm

/-- An input of `S` is among its own peers, so its past side is nonempty. -/

theorem ncard_le_mul_transitionCount [Finite ι] [Finite U] {KL KR : ℕ} (hKL : 1 < KL)
    (hK : KL ≤ S.ncard) (hsides : ∀ t ≤ P.length, ∀ x ∈ S,
      (P.pastSide t x).ncard < KL ∨ (P.futureSide t x).ncard < KR) :
    S.ncard ≤ (KL - 1) * (KR - 1) * P.transitionCount := by
  -- The charge time is well defined, positive, and at most the length of the sweep.
  have hlength : ∀ x ∈ S, P.length ∈ {t | KL ≤ (P.pastSide t x).ncard} := fun x hx => by
    simpa [P.ncard_pastSide_length hx] using hK
  have hcharged : ∀ x ∈ S, KL ≤ (P.pastSide (P.chargeTime KL x) x).ncard := fun x hx =>
    Nat.sInf_mem ⟨_, hlength x hx⟩
  have hbefore : ∀ x, ∀ t < P.chargeTime KL x, (P.pastSide t x).ncard < KL := fun x t ht =>
    not_le.mp (Nat.notMem_of_lt_sInf (s := {t | KL ≤ (P.pastSide t x).ncard}) ht)
  have hle_length : ∀ x ∈ S, P.chargeTime KL x ≤ P.length := fun x hx =>
    Nat.sInf_le (hlength x hx)
  have hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < P.chargeTime KL x := fun x hx => by
    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h0 => ?_
    have := h0 ▸ hcharged x hx
    have := P.ncard_pastSide_zero_le x
    omega
  -- Each input is charged to the step `t` whose completion charges it: `chargeTime = t + 1`.
  set step : (ι → U) → ℕ := fun x => P.chargeTime KL x - 1
  -- An input charged at step `t` is determined by its transition, its part revealed by time
  -- `t`, and its part unrevealed at time `t + 1`; each of the last two takes few values.
  have hfiber : ∀ t τ, {y ∈ {y ∈ S | step y = t} | P.transition t y = τ}.ncard ≤
      (KL - 1) * (KR - 1) := by
    intro t τ
    rcases eq_empty_or_nonempty {y ∈ {y ∈ S | step y = t} | P.transition t y = τ} with h | h
    · rw [h, ncard_empty]
      exact Nat.zero_le _

    have hxcharge : P.chargeTime KL x = t + 1 := by have := hpos x hxS; omega
    have hpast : (P.pastSide t x).ncard ≤ KL - 1 := by
      have := hbefore x t (by omega); omega
    have hfuture : (P.futureSide (t + 1) x).ncard ≤ KR - 1 := by
      have := hxcharge ▸ hcharged x hxS
      rcases hsides (t + 1) (hxcharge ▸ hle_length x hxS) x hxS with h | h <;> omega
    calc {y ∈ {y ∈ S | step y = t} | P.transition t y = τ}.ncard
        ≤ (P.pastSide t x ×ˢ P.futureSide (t + 1) x).ncard := by
          refine ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn
            (fun y => ((P.revealed t).domRestrict y, (P.revealed (t + 1))ᶜ.domRestrict y))
            ?_ ?_ (toFinite _)
          · rintro y ⟨⟨hyS, -⟩, hyτ⟩
            have hyx : P.transition t y = P.transition t x := hyτ.trans hxτ.symm
            simp only [transition, Prod.mk.injEq] at hyx
            exact ⟨⟨y, ⟨hyS, hyx.1⟩, rfl⟩, ⟨y, ⟨hyS, hyx.2.1⟩, rfl⟩⟩
          · rintro y ⟨-, hyτ⟩ y' ⟨-, hy'τ⟩ hyy'
            simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, domRestrict_eq_domRestrict_iff] at hyy'
            have hnew : EqOn y y' (P.newly t) := by
              have h := hyτ.trans hy'τ.symm
              simp only [transition, Prod.mk.injEq, domRestrict_eq_domRestrict_iff] at h
              exact h.2.2
            funext i
            by_cases h₁ : i ∈ P.revealed t
            · exact hyy'.1 h₁
            by_cases h₂ : i ∈ P.revealed (t + 1)
            · exact hnew ⟨h₂, h₁⟩
            · exact hyy'.2 h₂
      _ = (P.pastSide t x).ncard * (P.futureSide (t + 1) x).ncard := ncard_prod
      _ ≤ (KL - 1) * (KR - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul hpast hfuture
  -- Sum over the steps.
  calc S.ncard
      = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range P.length, {y ∈ S | step y = t}.ncard :=
        ncard_eq_sum_ncard_fiberwise (toFinite S) fun x hx => by
          have := hle_length x hx
          have := hpos x hx
          simp only [Finset.coe_range, mem_Iio, step]
          omega
    _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range P.length, (KL - 1) * (KR - 1) * (P.transition t '' S).ncard := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun t _ => ?_
        refine (ncard_le_mul_ncard_image (toFinite _) (P.transition t) _
          fun τ _ => hfiber t τ).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (ncard_le_ncard ?_))
        exact image_mono fun y hy => hy.1
    _ = (KL - 1) * (KR - 1) * P.transitionCount := (Finset.mul_sum ..).symm

theorem exists_rectangleFree_two_pow_le_ncard :
    ∃ S : Set (ι → Bool), RectangleFree S (Fintype.card ι + 2) ∧
      2 ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) ≤ S.ncard := by
  classical
  set n := Fintype.card ι
  set K := n + 2
  set N := Fintype.card (ι → Bool)
  have hN : N = 2 ^ n := by simp [N, n]
  -- The rectangle spanned by `K` inputs, and the sets containing it with `K ^ 2` points.
  let R (w : Set ι × (Fin K → ι → Bool)) : Set (ι → Bool) :=
    rectangle w.1 (range fun i => w.1.domRestrict (w.2 i))
      (range fun j => w.1ᶜ.domRestrict (w.2 j))
  let E (w : Set ι × (Fin K → ι → Bool)) : Finset ((ι → Bool) → Bool) :=
    {f : (ι → Bool) → Bool | (R w).ncard = K * K ∧ ∀ x ∈ R w, f x = true}
  have hE (w : Set ι × (Fin K → ι → Bool)) : #(E w) * 2 ^ (K * K) ≤ 2 ^ N := by
    by_cases hw : (R w).ncard = K * K
    · have hEw : E w = ({f : (ι → Bool) → Bool |
          ∀ x ∉ (R w).toFinsetᶜ, f x = (fun _ => true) x} : Finset _) := by
        ext f
        simp [E, hw]
      have hle : K * K ≤ N := hw ▸ (ncard_le_card _).trans_eq Nat.card_eq_fintype_card
      rw [hEw, BitString.card_filter_forall_notMem_eq, card_compl, ← ncard_eq_toFinset_card', hw,
        ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hle]
    · have hEw : E w = ∅ := by
        ext f
        simp [E, hw]
      simp [hEw]
  -- Every set that is not `K`-rectangle-free contains a spanned rectangle with `K ^ 2` points.
  set bad : Finset ((ι → Bool) → Bool) :=
    {f : (ι → Bool) → Bool | ¬ RectangleFree {x | f x = true} K}
  have hbad : bad ⊆ univ.biUnion E := by
    intro f hf
    simp only [bad, RectangleFree, mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_forall, not_or,
      not_lt] at hf
    obtain ⟨X, A, B, hAB, hA, hB⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hcard⟩ := exists_rectangle_range_subset hA hB
    exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨(X, z), Finset.mem_univ _,
      mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hcard, fun x hx => hAB (hz hx)⟩⟩
  have hcount : #bad * 2 ^ (n + 4) ≤ 2 ^ N := by
    have hW : Fintype.card (Set ι × (Fin K → ι → Bool)) = 2 ^ n * 2 ^ (n * K) := by
      simp [n, Fintype.card_set, ← pow_mul]
    have hsum : #bad * 2 ^ (K * K) ≤ 2 ^ n * 2 ^ (n * K) * 2 ^ N := by
      calc #bad * 2 ^ (K * K) ≤ (∑ w, #(E w)) * 2 ^ (K * K) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ((Finset.card_le_card hbad).trans card_biUnion_le)
        _ = ∑ w, #(E w) * 2 ^ (K * K) := sum_mul _ _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _w : Set ι × (Fin K → ι → Bool), 2 ^ N := sum_le_sum fun w _ => hE w
        _ = 2 ^ n * 2 ^ (n * K) * 2 ^ N := by rw [sum_const, card_univ, hW, smul_eq_mul]
    have hKK : K * K = n + n * K + (n + 4) := by simp only [K]; ring
    rw [hKK, pow_add, pow_add] at hsum
    have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ n * 2 ^ (n * K) := by positivity
    nlinarith
  -- Some large set is rectangle-free.
  have hlarge := two_pow_le_two_mul_card_filter (ι := ι)
  have hlt : #bad < #{f : (ι → Bool) → Bool | 2 ^ (n - 1) ≤ #{x | f x = true}} := by
    have h16 : 16 ≤ 2 ^ (n + 4) := by
      rw [pow_add]
      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity)
    have hone : 1 ≤ 2 ^ N := Nat.one_le_two_pow
    generalize 2 ^ N = P at hcount hlarge hone
    generalize 2 ^ (n + 4) = Q at hcount h16
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfbad⟩ := exists_mem_notMem_of_card_lt_card hlt
  refine ⟨{x | f x = true}, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [bad] using hfbad
  · have : ({x | f x = true} : Set (ι → Bool)) = ↑({x | f x = true} : Finset (ι → Bool)) := by
      ext
      simp
    rw [this, ncard_coe_finset]
    exact (mem_filter.mp hf).2

theorem exists_rectangleBias {K : ℕ} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hK : (Fintype.card ι + 1 : ℝ) ≤ b ^ 2 * K) : ∃ S : Set (ι → Bool), RectangleBias S K b := by
  classical
  -- Every set has bias at most `1/2`.
  rcases le_or_gt (1 / 2) b with hb2 | hb2
  · exact ⟨∅, fun X A B hA hB => (rectangleBias_one_half ∅ K X A B hA hB).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _))⟩
  set n := Fintype.card ι
  set N := Fintype.card (ι → Bool)
  have hN : N = 2 ^ n := by simp [N, n]
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have hK0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ K := Nat.cast_nonneg K
  have hKpos : (0 : ℝ) < K := by
    rcases hK0.lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [← h, mul_zero] at hK
      linarith
  have hK4 : 4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) < K := by
    have hb2' : b ^ 2 < 1 / 4 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hb2' hKpos]
  have hK1 : 1 ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hKpos
  -- The rectangle spanned by `k₁ + k₂` inputs, and the sets of large bias on it.
  let R (k₁ k₂ : ℕ) (w : Set ι × (Fin k₁ → ι → Bool) × (Fin k₂ → ι → Bool)) : Set (ι → Bool) :=
    rectangle w.1 (range fun i => w.1.domRestrict (w.2.1 i))
      (range fun j => w.1ᶜ.domRestrict (w.2.2 j))
  let E (k₁ k₂ : ℕ) (w : Set ι × (Fin k₁ → ι → Bool) × (Fin k₂ → ι → Bool)) :
      Finset ((ι → Bool) → Bool) :=
    {f : (ι → Bool) → Bool | (R k₁ k₂ w).ncard = k₁ * k₂ ∧
      b * (R k₁ k₂ w).ncard < |((R k₁ k₂ w ∩ {x | f x = true}).ncard : ℝ) - (R k₁ k₂ w).ncard / 2|}
  have hE (k₁ k₂ : ℕ) (w : Set ι × (Fin k₁ → ι → Bool) × (Fin k₂ → ι → Bool)) :
      (#(E k₁ k₂ w) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * 2 ^ N * exp (-(2 * b ^ 2 * (k₁ * k₂ : ℕ))) := by
    by_cases hw : (R k₁ k₂ w).ncard = k₁ * k₂
    · rw [← hw]
      refine le_trans ?_ (card_filter_lt_abs_le (R k₁ k₂ w) hb.le)
      exact Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.card_le_card (monotone_filter_right _ fun f _ hf => hf.2))
    · have hEw : E k₁ k₂ w = ∅ := by
        ext f
        simp [E, hw]
      rw [hEw, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
      positivity
  -- Every set of large bias on some rectangle has large bias on a spanned rectangle.
  set bad : Finset ((ι → Bool) → Bool) :=
    {f : (ι → Bool) → Bool | ¬ RectangleBias {x | f x = true} K b}
  have hbad : bad ⊆ (Finset.Icc K N).biUnion fun k₁ => (Finset.Icc K N).biUnion fun k₂ =>
      Finset.univ.biUnion (E k₁ k₂) := by
    intro f hf
    simp only [bad, RectangleBias, mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_forall,
      not_le] at hf
    obtain ⟨X, A, B, hA, hB, hbias⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := exists_eq_rectangle_range (toFinite A) (toFinite B)
    have hR : (rectangle X A B).ncard = A.ncard * B.ncard := ncard_rectangle X A B
    have hRN : (rectangle X A B).ncard ≤ N := (ncard_le_card _).trans_eq Nat.card_eq_fintype_card
    have hAN : A.ncard ≤ N := (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)).trans (hR ▸ hRN)
    have hBN : B.ncard ≤ N := (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)).trans (hR ▸ hRN)
    refine mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨A.ncard, mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hA, hAN⟩, mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨B.ncard,
      mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hB, hBN⟩, mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨(X, x, y), Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩⟩⟩
    simp only [E, R, mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rw [hxy]
    exact ⟨hR, hbias⟩
  -- The union bound for rectangles with sides of sizes `k₁` and `k₂`.
  have hterm (k₁ k₂ : ℕ) (hk₁ : K ≤ k₁) (hk₂ : K ≤ k₂) :
      ∑ w : Set ι × (Fin k₁ → ι → Bool) × (Fin k₂ → ι → Bool), (#(E k₁ k₂ w) : ℝ) ≤
        2 ^ (n + 1) * 2 ^ N * exp (-(2 * K)) := by
    have hk₁' : (K : ℝ) ≤ k₁ := by exact_mod_cast hk₁
    have hk₂' : (K : ℝ) ≤ k₂ := by exact_mod_cast hk₂
    have hcard : (Fintype.card (Set ι × (Fin k₁ → ι → Bool) × (Fin k₂ → ι → Bool)) : ℝ) =
        2 ^ n * 2 ^ (n * k₁ + n * k₂) := by
      simp [n, Fintype.card_set, ← pow_mul, pow_add]
    have hexp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (n * k₁ + n * k₂) * exp (-(2 * b ^ 2 * (k₁ * k₂ : ℕ))) ≤
        exp (-(2 * K)) := by
      refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (two_pow_le_exp _) (exp_pos _).le).trans ?_
      rw [← exp_add, exp_le_exp]
      push_cast
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk₁' (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ b ^ 2 * k₂),
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk₂' (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ b ^ 2 * k₁),
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k₁),
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k₂)]
    calc ∑ w : Set ι × (Fin k₁ → ι → Bool) × (Fin k₂ → ι → Bool), (#(E k₁ k₂ w) : ℝ)
        ≤ ∑ _w : Set ι × (Fin k₁ → ι → Bool) × (Fin k₂ → ι → Bool),
            2 * 2 ^ N * exp (-(2 * b ^ 2 * (k₁ * k₂ : ℕ))) := sum_le_sum fun w _ => hE k₁ k₂ w
      _ = 2 ^ (n + 1) * 2 ^ N *
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ (n * k₁ + n * k₂) * exp (-(2 * b ^ 2 * (k₁ * k₂ : ℕ)))) := by
          rw [sum_const, card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, hcard]
          ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) * 2 ^ N * exp (-(2 * K)) := by gcongr
  -- Summed over all sizes, fewer than all sets have large bias.
  have hcount : (#bad : ℝ) < 2 ^ N := by
    have hIcc : #(Finset.Icc K N) ≤ N := by
      rw [Nat.card_Icc]
      omega
    calc (#bad : ℝ)
        ≤ ∑ k₁ ∈ Finset.Icc K N, ∑ k₂ ∈ Finset.Icc K N,
            ∑ w : Set ι × (Fin k₁ → ι → Bool) × (Fin k₂ → ι → Bool), (#(E k₁ k₂ w) : ℝ) := by
          refine le_trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr ((Finset.card_le_card hbad).trans (card_biUnion_le.trans
            (sum_le_sum fun k₁ _ => card_biUnion_le.trans
              (sum_le_sum fun k₂ _ => card_biUnion_le))))) ?_
          push_cast
          rfl
      _ ≤ ∑ _k₁ ∈ Finset.Icc K N, ∑ _k₂ ∈ Finset.Icc K N, 2 ^ (n + 1) * 2 ^ N * exp (-(2 * K)) :=
          sum_le_sum fun k₁ hk₁ => sum_le_sum fun k₂ hk₂ =>
            hterm k₁ k₂ (mem_Icc.mp hk₁).1 (mem_Icc.mp hk₂).1
      _ ≤ N * N * (2 ^ (n + 1) * 2 ^ N * exp (-(2 * K))) := by
          simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc]
          have : (#(Finset.Icc K N) : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hIcc
          gcongr
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 1) * exp (-(2 * K)) * 2 ^ N := by
          rw [hN]
          push_cast
          ring
      _ < 2 ^ N := by
          refine mul_lt_of_lt_one_left (by positivity) ?_
          refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (two_pow_le_exp _) (exp_pos _).le).trans_lt ?_
          rw [← exp_add, exp_lt_one_iff]
          push_cast
          linarith
  by_contra! h
  have huniv : bad = Finset.univ := eq_univ_of_forall fun f => by simp [bad, h]
  rw [huniv, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool] at hcount
  push_cast at hcount
  exact lt_irrefl _ hcount

theorem full_chain (c : U) (op : ℕ → U → U → U) (g : ℕ → (Fin n → U) → U) (len : ℕ)
    (hg : ∀ i < len, g i ∈ s) :
    Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s
      (Set.range fun i : Fin (len + 1) => chainValue c op g i) (len + 1) := by
  induction len with

    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero i]

    have hstep := full_binary_mem (s := s ∪ Set.range fun i : Fin (len + 1) =>
      chainValue c op g i) (op len) (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨Fin.last len, rfl⟩)
      (Set.mem_union_left _ (hg len (Nat.lt_succ_self len)))

      le_rfl
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩

/-- **Fusion lower bound for De Morgan circuits.** Every circuit over the De Morgan basis
computing `f`, with negations anywhere, has at least as many binary AND or OR gates as the cover
complexity of `f` from its literals, for any admissible class of semifilters. -/
theorem pairCoverComplexity_le_binaryCost {f : BooleanFunction n}
    (c : Circuit Boolean.signature n 1) (hc : c.Computes Boolean.interpretation (single f))
    (admissible : Semifilter ↥({x | f x = true}ᶜ) → Prop := fun _ => True) :
    pairCoverComplexity {x | f x = true} (fun i => {x | AltFormula.literals x i = true})
      admissible ≤ (c.program.cost Boolean.binaryCost : ℕ) := by
  let d := (Monotone.dualRail c).comp (Monotone.literalsRailCircuit n)
  have hd : d.ComputesFrom Monotone.interpretation (fun x (_ : Fin 1) => f x)
      AltFormula.literals := fun x => by
    funext o
    rw [Circuit.eval_comp, Monotone.eval_literalsRailCircuit, Monotone.eval_dualRail, hc x,
      single_apply]
  refine (pairCoverComplexity_le_ecomplexityFrom_bool AltFormula.literals
    (fun x (_ : Fin 1) => f x) 0 admissible).trans
    ((ecomplexityFrom_le_of_computesFrom d hd).trans ?_)
  simp only [d, Circuit.cost_program_comp, Monotone.cost_literalsRailCircuit, zero_add,

/-- **Cover complexity and De Morgan circuit size are polynomially related, up to the input
length.** The cover complexity `t = ρ(f)` of `f` from its literals over unrestricted semifilters
is finite, at most the circuit complexity `C(f)` over the De Morgan basis, and
`C(f) ≤ 4 (t + 1)² (2 n + t + 1) + n`. -/
theorem pairCoverComplexity_complexity_bounds (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, pairCoverComplexity {x | f x = true}
        (fun i => {x | AltFormula.literals x i = true}) = t ∧
      t ≤ complexity Boolean.interpretation (single f) ∧
      complexity Boolean.interpretation (single f) ≤ 4 * (t + 1) ^ 2 * (2 * n + t + 1) + n := by
  have hlow := pairCoverComplexity_le_complexity f
  have htop : pairCoverComplexity {x | f x = true}
      (fun i => {x | AltFormula.literals x i = true}) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (ENat.natCast_ne_top _) hlow
  have : Nonempty (PairCover {x | f x = true} (fun i => {x | AltFormula.literals x i = true})) :=
    ENat.iInf_natCast_ne_top.mp htop
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ENat.exists_eq_iInf (fun c : PairCover {x | f x = true}
    (fun i => {x | AltFormula.literals x i = true}) => (c.pairs.length : ℕ∞))
  refine ⟨p.pairs.length, hp.symm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact_mod_cast hp.trans_le hlow
  · obtain ⟨d, hd, hdsize⟩ := p.exists_computes_size_le
    exact (complexity_le_of_computes d hd).trans hdsize
