def canonicalFilter (e : CanonicalEdge graph) : Semifilter ↥(graphᶜ) where
  toFun s := outsideRow graph e.val.1 ⊆ s ∨ outsideColumn graph e.val.2 ⊆ s
  monotone' _ _ h := Or.imp (fun hs => hs.trans h) (fun hs => hs.trans h)
  map_top' := propext ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => Or.inl (Set.subset_univ _)⟩

theorem canonicalFilter_inequality (u v : V) (h : u ≠ v)
    (s : Set ↥((inequality V)ᶜ)) :
    canonicalFilter (inequality V) (inequalityEdge u v h) s ↔
      diagonal u ∈ s ∨ diagonal v ∈ s := by
  have row : outsideRow (inequality V) u = {diagonal u} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have heq : x.val.1 = x.val.2 := Classical.not_not.mp x.property
      apply Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Prod.ext hx (heq.symm.trans hx)
    · rintro rfl
      rfl
  have col : outsideColumn (inequality V) v = {diagonal v} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have heq : x.val.1 = x.val.2 := Classical.not_not.mp x.property
      apply Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Prod.ext (heq.trans hx) hx
    · rintro rfl
      rfl

        (canonicalClass (inequality (Fin n → Bool))) = n ∧

    ecomplexityFrom (Monotone.setInterpretation ((Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → Bool)))

        (fun _ : Unit => sources) = n := by

      (canonicalClass (inequality (Fin n → Bool))) :=

  have upper : ecomplexityFrom (Monotone.setInterpretation ((Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → Bool)))

/-- A fixed probability distribution on matching-literal witnesses cannot give a reciprocal
pair-capacity certificate larger than `8n+8`. In particular its maximum covered probability is
positive. This does not bound the minimum number of pairs covering the witnesses. -/
theorem fixedDistribution_counting_bound {W : Type*} [Fintype W]
    (F : W → Semifilter ↥(targetᶜ)) (v : W → target)
    (hv : ∀ w i, F w {x | x.val i = (v w).val i})
    (μ : W → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ w, 0 ≤ μ w) (hprob : ∑ w, μ w = 1)
    {d : ℝ} (hd : ∀ p : Set ↥(targetᶜ) × Set ↥(targetᶜ),
      ∑ w, μ w * (if ¬ (F w).PreservesPair p then 1 else 0) ≤ d) :
    0 < d ∧ 1 / d ≤ 8 * n + 8 := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_pair_weight_ge F v hv μ hμ
  rw [hprob] at hp
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < 8 * n + 8 := by positivity
  have hle := hp.trans (hd p)
  have hdpos : 0 < d := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hle
  refine ⟨hdpos, (div_le_iff₀ hdpos).mpr ?_⟩
  have hh := (div_le_iff₀ hden).mp hle
  nlinarith

    (hc : ∀ m ∈ M, c m ∈ s) {τ a lam : (Fin N → F) → F} (hτ : τ ∈ s) (ha : a ∈ s)
    (hlam : lam ∈ s) (d : ℕ) :
    ∀ k ≤ d, Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s
      (Set.range fun i : Fin (k + 1) => fun x =>
        henselSeq (Sudan.bivariateOf M fun m => c m x) (τ x) (a x) (lam x) i)
      (k * henselStepCost (Fintype.card F) #M d) := by
  intro k hk
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [zero_mul]
    refine of_subset ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero i]
    exact ha
  | succ k ih =>
    set T := Set.range fun i : Fin (k + 1) => fun x =>
      henselSeq (Sudan.bivariateOf M fun m => c m x) (τ x) (a x) (lam x) i
    let h : ℕ → (Fin N → F) → F := fun i x =>
      henselSeq (Sudan.bivariateOf M fun m => c m x) (τ x) (a x) (lam x) i
    have hh : ∀ i ≤ k, h i ∈ s ∪ T := fun i hi =>
      Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi⟩, rfl⟩
    -- the values of the current iterate at all points
    let A : F → (Fin N → F) → F := fun t x => ∑ i ∈ range (k + 1), h i x * t ^ i
    have h₁ : Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s ∪ T) (Set.range A)
        (Fintype.card F * (2 * k + 3)) := by
      have := family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s ∪ T) A (fun _ => 2 * k + 3)
        (fun t => by
          have hmul := biUnion (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s ∪ T) (range (k + 1))
            (fun i => {fun x => h i x * t ^ i}) (fun _ => 1)
            (fun i hi => full_unary (fun v => v * t ^ i) (hh i (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1
              (mem_range.1 hi))))
          have hsum := full_sum (s := (s ∪ T) ∪ ⋃ i ∈ range (k + 1), {fun x => h i x * t ^ i})
            (range (k + 1)) (fun i x => h i x * t ^ i)

          refine (hmul.trans hsum).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl ?_
          simp only [sum_const, card_range, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
          omega)
      simpa [card_univ] using this

    have h₂ : Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s₁ (Set.range V)
        (Fintype.card F * (3 * #M + 1)) := by
      have := family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s₁) V (fun _ => 3 * #M + 1)
        (fun t => by
          have hg := biUnion (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s₁) M
            (fun m => {fun x => (t + τ x) ^ m.1 * A t x ^ m.2}) (fun _ => 1)
            (fun m _ => full_binary_mem (fun u v => (t + u) ^ m.1 * v ^ m.2)
              (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_left _ hτ))
              (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨t, rfl⟩))
          have hdot := full_dot (s := s₁ ∪ ⋃ m ∈ M, {fun x => (t + τ x) ^ m.1 * A t x ^ m.2}) M
            c (fun m x => (t + τ x) ^ m.1 * A t x ^ m.2)
            (fun m hm => Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_left _
              (Set.mem_union_left _ (hc m hm))))

          simp only [sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

theorem full_henselValue (M : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (c : ℕ × ℕ → (Fin N → F) → F)
    (hc : ∀ m ∈ M, c m ∈ s) {τ a : (Fin N → F) → F} (hτ : τ ∈ s) (ha : a ∈ s) (d : ℕ) :
    Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s
      {fun x => henselValue (Sudan.bivariateOf M fun m => c m x) (τ x) (a x) d}
      (henselCost (Fintype.card F) #M d) := by
  -- the derivative `λ`
  let lam : (Fin N → F) → F := fun x => ∑ m ∈ M, c m x * (m.2 * τ x ^ m.1 * a x ^ (m.2 - 1))
  have h₁ : Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s {lam} (3 * #M + 1) := by
    have hg := biUnion (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s) M
      (fun m => {fun x => (m.2 : F) * τ x ^ m.1 * a x ^ (m.2 - 1)}) (fun _ => 1)
      (fun m _ => full_binary_mem (fun u v => (m.2 : F) * u ^ m.1 * v ^ (m.2 - 1)) hτ ha)
    have hdot := full_dot (s := s ∪ ⋃ m ∈ M, {fun x => (m.2 : F) * τ x ^ m.1 * a x ^ (m.2 - 1)})
      M c (fun m x => (m.2 : F) * τ x ^ m.1 * a x ^ (m.2 - 1))
      (fun m hm => Set.mem_union_left _ (hc m hm))
      (fun m hm => Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_biUnion hm rfl))
    refine (hg.trans hdot).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl ?_
    simp only [sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    omega
  set s₁ := s ∪ {lam}
  have h₂ := full_henselSeq (s := s₁) M c (fun m hm => Set.mem_union_left _ (hc m hm))
    (Set.mem_union_left _ hτ) (Set.mem_union_left _ ha) (Set.mem_union_right _ rfl) d d le_rfl
  set T := Set.range fun i : Fin (d + 1) => fun x =>
    henselSeq (Sudan.bivariateOf M fun m => c m x) (τ x) (a x) (lam x) i
  -- the value at `-τ`
  let h : ℕ → (Fin N → F) → F := fun i x =>
    henselSeq (Sudan.bivariateOf M fun m => c m x) (τ x) (a x) (lam x) i
  have h₃ : Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s₁ ∪ T)
      {fun x => ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), h i x * (-τ x) ^ i} (2 * d + 3) := by
    have hmul := biUnion (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s₁ ∪ T) (range (d + 1))
      (fun i => {fun x => h i x * (-τ x) ^ i}) (fun _ => 1)
      (fun i hi => full_binary_mem (fun u v => u * (-v) ^ i)
        (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨⟨i, mem_range.1 hi⟩, rfl⟩)
        (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_left _ hτ)))
    have hsum := full_sum (s := (s₁ ∪ T) ∪ ⋃ i ∈ range (d + 1), {fun x => h i x * (-τ x) ^ i})
      (range (d + 1)) (fun i x => h i x * (-τ x) ^ i)
      (fun i hi => Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_biUnion hi rfl))
    refine (hmul.trans hsum).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl ?_
    simp only [sum_const, card_range, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    omega
  refine (h₁.trans (h₂.trans h₃)).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ ?_
  · refine Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (funext fun x => ?_)
    simp only [henselValue, eval_henselTrunc, evalEval_derivative_bivariateOf, h, lam]
  · unfold henselCost
    omega

/-- **The least-`Y`-degree interpolant by a circuit.** Given the received word as available
functions, its interpolant coefficients on `monomials d D` cost at most
`interpolantCost n M (D / d)` gates of the full binary basis, for `n` points and `M` monomials. -/
theorem full_interpolantCoeffs (α : ι → F) (w : ι → (Fin N → F) → F) (hw : ∀ i, w i ∈ s)
    (d D : ℕ) :
    Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s
      (Set.range fun m : Sudan.monomials d D => fun x =>
        Sudan.interpolantCoeffs α (fun i => w i x) d D m)
      (interpolantCost (Fintype.card ι) #(Sudan.monomials d D) (D / d)) := by
  set M := Sudan.monomials d D
  set ℓ := D / d
  -- the entries of the interpolation matrix
  let E : ι × M → (Fin N → F) → F := fun tm x =>
    α tm.1 ^ (tm.2 : ℕ × ℕ).1 * w tm.1 x ^ (tm.2 : ℕ × ℕ).2
  have h₁ : Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s (Set.range E)
      (Fintype.card ι * #M) := by
    have := family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s) E (fun _ => 1)
      (fun tm => full_unary (fun v => α tm.1 ^ (tm.2 : ℕ × ℕ).1 * v ^ (tm.2 : ℕ × ℕ).2)
        (hw tm.1))
    simpa [card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_coe] using this
  set s₁ := s ∪ Set.range E
  -- the kernel vectors
  let u : (j : Fin (ℓ + 1)) → Fin #(Sudan.monomialsUpTo d D j) → (Fin N → F) → F :=
    fun j m x => Sudan.kernelVecUpTo α (fun i => w i x) d D j m
  have hsubM : ∀ j : ℕ, Sudan.monomialsUpTo d D j ⊆ M := fun _ => filter_subset _ _
  have h₂ : Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s₁
      (⋃ j : Fin (ℓ + 1), Set.range (u j)) ((ℓ + 1) * kernelVecCost (Fintype.card ι) #M) := by
    have := iUnion (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s₁)
      (fun j : Fin (ℓ + 1) => Set.range (u j)) (fun _ => kernelVecCost (Fintype.card ι) #M)
      (fun j => by
        refine (full_kernelVec (s := s₁)
          (fun t m x => Sudan.interpMatrix α (fun i => w i x) (Sudan.monomialsUpTo d D j) t m)
          (fun t m => Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨((Fintype.equivFin ι).symm t,
            ⟨_, hsubM j ((Sudan.monomialsUpTo d D j).equivFin.symm m).2⟩), rfl⟩)).mono
          Set.Subset.rfl (fun f hf => ?_) ?_
        · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hf
          exact ⟨m, rfl⟩
        · unfold kernelVecCost
          have : #(Sudan.monomialsUpTo d D j) ≤ #M := card_le_card (hsubM j)
          have : (#(Sudan.monomialsUpTo d D j) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (#M + 1) ^ 2 :=
            Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) 2
          nlinarith)
    simpa [card_univ] using this
  set s₂ := s₁ ∪ ⋃ j : Fin (ℓ + 1), Set.range (u j)
  have hu : ∀ j m, u j m ∈ s₂ := fun j m =>
    Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩)
  -- their nonzero indicators
  let z : Fin (ℓ + 1) → (Fin N → F) → F := fun j x =>
    if (fun m => u j m x) = 0 then 0 else 1
  have h₃ : Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s₂ (Set.range z) ((ℓ + 1) * (#M + 1)) := by
    have := family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s₂) z (fun _ => #M + 1)
      (fun j => (full_nonzero (u j) (hu j)).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl
        (by have := card_le_card (hsubM j); omega))
    simpa [card_univ] using this
  set s₃ := s₂ ∪ Set.range z
  -- the first nonzero kernel vector
  let f : Fin (ℓ + 1) → (Fin N → F) → F := fun j x => firstFlags (fun j => z j x) j
  have h₄ := full_firstFlags (s := s₃) z fun j => Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  set s₄ := s₃ ∪ Set.range f
  -- the coefficients
  let J : ℕ × ℕ → Finset (Fin (ℓ + 1)) := fun m => univ.filter fun j : Fin (ℓ + 1) =>
    m ∈ Sudan.monomialsUpTo d D j
  let coef : M → (Fin N → F) → F := fun m x =>
    ∑ j ∈ J m, f j x * Sudan.coeffsOf (Sudan.monomialsUpTo d D j) (fun m' => u j m' x) m
  have h₅ : Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s₄ (Set.range coef)
      (#M * (2 * (ℓ + 1) + 1)) := by
    have := family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s₄) coef
      (fun _ => 2 * (ℓ + 1) + 1)
      (fun m => by
        refine (full_dot (s := s₄) (J m) f (fun j x => Sudan.coeffsOf
          (Sudan.monomialsUpTo d D j) (fun m' => u j m' x) m)
          (fun j _ => Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨j, rfl⟩) (fun j hj => ?_)).mono
          Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl ?_
        · have hm : (m : ℕ × ℕ) ∈ Sudan.monomialsUpTo d D j := (mem_filter.1 hj).2
          have : (fun x => Sudan.coeffsOf (Sudan.monomialsUpTo d D j) (fun m' => u j m' x) m) =
              u j ((Sudan.monomialsUpTo d D j).equivFin ⟨m, hm⟩) := by
            funext x
            simp only [Sudan.coeffsOf, dite_eq_left hm]
          rw [this]
          exact Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_left _ (hu j _))
        · have : #(J m) ≤ ℓ + 1 := (card_le_univ _).trans (by simp)
          omega)
    simpa [card_univ, Fintype.card_coe] using this
  refine (h₁.trans (h₂.trans (h₃.trans (h₄.trans h₅)))).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨m, funext fun x => ?_⟩
    simp only [coef, J, f, z, u, Sudan.interpolantCoeffs, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, sum_filter]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    split_ifs with hj
    · rfl
    · simp only [Sudan.coeffsOf, dite_eq_right hj, mul_zero]
  · unfold interpolantCost
    omega

theorem full_hintDecode (α : ι → F) (w : ι → (Fin N → F) → F) (hw : ∀ i, w i ∈ s)
    {τ a : (Fin N → F) → F} (hτ : τ ∈ s) (ha : a ∈ s) (d D : ℕ) :

      {fun x => hintDecode α (fun i => w i x) d D (τ x) (a x)}

    Sudan.interpolantCoeffs α (fun i => w i x) d D m

    (fun m x => Sudan.interpolantCoeffs α (fun i => w i x) d D m)

    (Set.mem_union_left _ ha) d

theorem full_firstFlags (b : Fin n → (Fin N → F) → F) (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ s) :
    Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s
      (Set.range fun i x => firstFlags (fun j => b j x) i) (2 * n + 1) := by
  let g : ℕ → (Fin N → F) → F := fun i => if h : i < n then b ⟨i, h⟩ else fun _ => 0
  let op : ℕ → F → F → F := fun _ z bi => if bi = 0 then z else 0
  have hchain := full_chain (s := s) (1 : F) op g n fun i hi => by
    simp only [g, dite_eq_left hi]
    exact hb _
  have hval (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) (x : Fin N → F) :
      chainValue 1 op g i x = prefixZero (fun j => b j x) i := by
    induction i with
    | zero => simp [chainValue, prefixZero]
    | succ i ih =>
      have hi' : i < n := hi
      change op i (chainValue 1 op g i x) (g i x) = _
      rw [ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi), prefixZero_succ _ hi]
      simp only [op, g, dite_eq_left hi']
  have hsel := family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2))
    (s := s ∪ Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) => chainValue 1 op g i)
    (fun i : Fin n => fun x => (fun z bi => if bi = 0 then 0 else z) (chainValue 1 op g i x)
      (b i x)) (fun _ => 1)
    (fun i => full_binary_mem (f := fun x => chainValue 1 op g i x) (g := b i)
      (fun z bi => if bi = 0 then 0 else z) (Set.mem_union_right s
      (⟨i.castSucc, rfl⟩ : _ ∈ Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) => chainValue 1 op g i))
      (Set.mem_union_left _ (hb i)))
  refine (hchain.trans hsel).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_
    (by simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]; omega)
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨i, funext fun x => ?_⟩
  simp only [firstFlags_eq_prefixZero, hval i i.2.le]

private theorem full_kernelBasisUpTo (A : Fin r → Fin n → (Fin N → F) → F)
    (hA : ∀ k l, A k l ∈ s) (k : ℕ) :

  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have h := family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s)
      (fun il : Fin n × Fin n => fun _ : Fin N → F => (Pi.single il.1 1 : Fin n → F) il.2)
      (fun _ => 1) (fun il => full_const _)
    refine h.mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨il, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨il, rfl⟩
    · simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul,
        mul_one, zero_mul, add_zero]

  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hk : k < r
    · have hstep := full_kernelStep

        (A ⟨k, hk⟩) (fun i l x => kernelBasisUpTo (fun k l => A k l x) k i l)
        (fun l => Set.mem_union_left _ (hA _ l))
        (fun i l => Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨(i, l), rfl⟩)
      refine (ih.trans hstep).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ (le_of_eq (by ring))
      rintro _ ⟨il, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨il, funext fun x => ?_⟩
      simp only [kernelBasisUpTo, dite_eq_left hk]
    · refine ih.mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ (by nlinarith)

theorem full_kernelVec (A : Fin r → Fin n → (Fin N → F) → F) (hA : ∀ k l, A k l ∈ s) :
    Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s
      (Set.range fun l x => kernelVec (fun k l => A k l x) l) (kernelVecCost r n) := by
  let K : Fin n → Fin n → (Fin N → F) → F := fun i l x => kernelBasis (fun k l => A k l x) i l
  have h₁ := full_kernelBasisUpTo A hA r
  set s₁ := s ∪ Set.range fun il : Fin n × Fin n =>
    fun x => kernelBasisUpTo (fun k l => A k l x) r il.1 il.2
  have hK : ∀ i l, K i l ∈ s₁ := fun i l => Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨(i, l), rfl⟩
  -- the nonzero indicators of the members
  let c : Fin n → (Fin N → F) → F := fun i x => if (fun l => K i l x) = 0 then 0 else 1
  have h₂ := family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s₁) c (fun _ => n + 1)
    (fun i => full_nonzero (K i) (hK i))
  set s₂ := s₁ ∪ Set.range c
  -- their first nonzero entry
  let sel : Fin n → (Fin N → F) → F := fun i x => firstFlags (fun j => c j x) i
  have h₃ := full_firstFlags (s := s₂) c fun i => Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  set s₃ := s₂ ∪ Set.range sel
  -- the selected member
  have h₄ := family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s₃)
    (fun l x => ∑ i, sel i x * K i l x) (fun _ => 2 * n + 1)
    (fun l => by
      simpa [card_univ] using full_dot (s := s₃) univ sel (fun i => K i l)
        (fun i _ => Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨i, rfl⟩)
        (fun i _ => Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_left _ (hK i l))))
  have htotal := h₁.trans (h₂.trans (h₃.trans h₄))
  refine htotal.mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨l, funext fun x => ?_⟩
    have hc : (fun j => c j x) = fun i => if kernelBasis (fun k l => A k l x) i = 0 then 0 else 1 :=
      rfl
    simp only [sel, K, kernelVec, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hc]
  · simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, kernelVecCost]

theorem Program.trace_linearize (p : Program σ n s) (x : Fin n → F) (w : Wire n s) :

    {M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) F}
    (hc : c.Computes (polynomialInterpretation P F) fun x => M *ᵥ x)
    (x : Fin n → F) (i : Fin m) :
    c.program.trace (polynomialInterpretation P F[ε]) (fun j => inr (x j)) (c.outputs i) =
      inr ((M *ᵥ x) i) := by
  -- The polynomial computed at the output.

      (c.outputs i) = ∑ j, C (M i j) * X j := by
    refine MvPolynomial.funext fun y => ?_
    have h := c.program.map_trace_polynomialInterpretation P (aeval y) X (c.outputs i)
    simp only [aeval_X] at h
    rw [← aeval_eq_eval, h]
    exact (congrFun (hc y) i).trans (by simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct])
  -- Its value at `ε x`.
  have h := c.program.map_trace_polynomialInterpretation P
    (aeval fun j => (inr (x j) : F[ε])) X (c.outputs i)
  simp only [aeval_X] at h
  rw [← h, hQ]
  ext <;> simp [algebraMap_eq_inl, fst_sum, snd_sum, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]

    ∃ C : Circuit signature (edgeCount n) 1, C.Computes interpretation (single (clique n k)) := by
  classical
  have hand (f g : BooleanFunction (edgeCount n)) :
      Synthesis interpretation {f, g} {fun x => f x && g x} 1 := by
    simpa [interpretation] using Synthesis.gate (I := interpretation) (s := {f, g}) Op.and
      (fun i => if (i : ℕ) = 0 then f else g) fun i => by split <;> simp
  have hor (f g : BooleanFunction (edgeCount n)) :
      Synthesis interpretation {f, g} {fun x => f x || g x} 1 := by
    simpa [interpretation] using Synthesis.gate (I := interpretation) (s := {f, g}) Op.or
      (fun i => if (i : ℕ) = 0 then f else g) fun i => by split <;> simp
  have hconst (b : Bool) : Synthesis interpretation (inputs (edgeCount n)) {fun _ => b} 1 := by
    simpa [interpretation] using Synthesis.nullary (I := interpretation)
      (s := inputs (edgeCount n)) (.const b) rfl
  have h := Synthesis.finset_fold (· || ·) 1 hor ((univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k)
    (f := fun t x => (univ.filter fun e : Edge n => e.1.toFinset ⊆ t).fold (· && ·) true
      fun e => x (edgeEquiv n e)) (hconst false) fun t _ =>
      Synthesis.finset_fold (· && ·) 1 hand _ (hconst true) fun e _ =>
        Synthesis.of_mem ⟨edgeEquiv n e, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC, -⟩ := h.exists_circuit
  refine ⟨C, fun x => (hC x).trans (funext fun _ => ?_)⟩
  change (univ.powersetCard k).fold (· || ·) false (fun t =>
    (univ.filter fun e : Edge n => e.1.toFinset ⊆ t).fold (· && ·) true
      fun e => x (edgeEquiv n e)) = clique n k x
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, fold_or_eq_true, clique, decide_eq_true_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, h⟩
    exact ⟨t, (mem_powersetCard.1 ht).2, fun e he =>
      (fold_and_eq_true _ _).1 h e (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, he⟩)⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, h⟩

private theorem positive_budget_of_pow {n k p w s q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q)
    (hwk : w + 1 ≤ k) (hn : q * k ≤ n)

    Positive.errorCap n k p w * s < n.choose k := by
  have hkn : k ≤ n := (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left k (by omega : 0 < q)).trans hn
  have hremaining : 0 < (n - (w + 1)).choose (k - (w + 1)) :=
    Nat.choose_pos (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hkn _)

    refine hcore.trans_lt ?_
    rw [pow_succ]
    simpa using Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hq (pow_pos (by omega : 0 < q) w)
  calc Positive.errorCap n k p w * s =
      (sunflowerBound p w ^ 2 * s) * (n - (w + 1)).choose (k - (w + 1)) := by
        rw [Positive.errorCap]; ring
    _ < q ^ (w + 1) * (n - (w + 1)).choose (k - (w + 1)) :=
      Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hstrict hremaining

theorem exists_computes_of_monotone (hf : Monotone f) :
    ∃ F : Formula signature n, F.Computes interpretation f := by
  classical
  have hconj (s : Finset (Fin n)) : ∃ F : Formula signature n,
      F.Computes interpretation fun x => decide (∀ i ∈ s, x i = true) := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact ⟨const true, fun x => by simp⟩
    | insert i s _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨and (.input i) F, fun x => by simp [hF x]⟩
  have hdisj (T : Finset (BitString n)) : ∃ F : Formula signature n,
      F.Computes interpretation fun x => decide (∃ z ∈ T, ∀ i, z i = true → x i = true) := by
    induction T using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact ⟨const false, fun x => by simp⟩
    | insert z T _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := hconj {i | z i = true}
      exact ⟨or G F, fun x => by simp [hF x, hG x]⟩
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := hdisj {z | f z = true}
  refine ⟨F, fun x => (hF x).trans ?_⟩
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, decide_eq_true_iff]
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ => ?_, fun hx => ⟨x, hx, fun _ h => h⟩⟩
  exact Bool.eq_true_of_true_le (hz ▸ hf fun i => Bool.le_iff_imp.2 (hzx i))

theorem exceedsAt_run_monotoneKWProtocol (F : Formula Monotone.signature n)
    {x y : BitString n}
    (hx : F.eval interpretation x = true) (hy : F.eval interpretation y = false) :
    ExceedsAt x y (F.monotoneKWProtocol.run x y) := by
  induction F with
  | input i => exact ⟨hx, hy⟩
  | gate op args ih =>
    cases op with
    | const b =>
      simp only [Formula.eval_gate, interpretation_const] at hx hy
      exact absurd (hx.symm.trans hy) (by decide)
    | and =>
      simp only [Formula.eval_gate, interpretation_and, Bool.and_eq_true,
        Bool.and_eq_false_iff] at hx hy
      cases h : (args 0).eval interpretation y
      · simpa [monotoneKWProtocol, h] using ih 0 hx.1 h
      · simpa [monotoneKWProtocol, h] using ih 1 hx.2 (hy.resolve_left (by simp [h]))
    | or =>
      simp only [Formula.eval_gate, interpretation_or, Bool.or_eq_true,
        Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at hx hy
      cases h : (args 0).eval interpretation x
      · simpa [monotoneKWProtocol, h] using ih 1 (hx.resolve_left (by simp [h])) hy.2
      · simpa [monotoneKWProtocol, h] using ih 0 h hy.1

theorem rank_le (ev : P →ₐ[K] K) (inclusion : P →+* E)
    (hinj : Function.Injective inclusion) (A : Matrix ι ι P) :
    (ev.toRingHom.mapMatrix A).rank ≤ (inclusion.mapMatrix A).rank := by
  classical
  let S := ev.toRingHom.mapMatrix A
  obtain ⟨V, U, e, hV, hU, hform⟩ := Matrix.exists_rank_normal_form S
  let c := algebraMap K P
  let T := c.mapMatrix V * A * c.mapMatrix U
  let j : Fin S.rank → ι := fun i => e.symm (Sum.inl i)
  have hT : ev.toRingHom.mapMatrix T = V * S * U := by
    dsimp [T]
    rw [map_mul, map_mul]
    congr 2
    · ext i j; exact ev.commutes (V i j)
    · ext i j; exact ev.commutes (U i j)
  have hminor : ev.toRingHom.mapMatrix (T.submatrix j j) = 1 := by
    change (ev.toRingHom.mapMatrix T).submatrix j j = 1
    rw [hT, hform]
    ext i k
    simp [j, Matrix.submatrix, Matrix.one_apply]
  have hdet : (T.submatrix j j).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have h := ev.toRingHom.map_det (T.submatrix j j)
    rw [hz, map_zero, hminor, det_one] at h
    exact zero_ne_one h
  have hdetE : (inclusion.mapMatrix (T.submatrix j j)).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← inclusion.map_det]
    exact fun h => hdet (hinj (h.trans (map_zero inclusion).symm))
  have hrk := Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hdetE
  have hsub : (inclusion.mapMatrix (T.submatrix j j)).rank ≤
      (inclusion.mapMatrix T).rank :=
    Matrix.rank_submatrix_le (inclusion.mapMatrix T) j j
  have hmul : (inclusion.mapMatrix T).rank ≤ (inclusion.mapMatrix A).rank := by
    dsimp [T]
    rw [map_mul, map_mul]
    exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _)
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hrk
  exact hrk ▸ hsub.trans hmul

theorem formula_invertible_witness {n d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : Formula n)
    (W : Fin n → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℚ) (a : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℚ)
    (ha : f.Eval (algebraMap ℚ _) W a) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (X : Fin n → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) (HahnSeries QuantumLift.Exponents ℂ))

      f.Eval (algebraMap ℚ _) X v ∧ IsUnit v := by
  let : NeZero d := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hd⟩
  let e := Matrix.reindexRingEquiv ℂ (ZMod.finEquiv d).toEquiv
  let j : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℚ →+* Matrix (ZMod d) (ZMod d) ℂ :=
    e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap ℚ ℂ).mapMatrix
  have hj : Function.Injective j := e.injective.comp (Matrix.map_injective (algebraMap ℚ
    ℂ).injective)
  have ha' : f.Eval (algebraMap ℚ _) (fun i => j (W i)) (j a) := by
    have hh := ha.map j
    rwa [RingHom.ext_rat (j.comp (algebraMap ℚ _)) (algebraMap ℚ _)] at hh

    intro hz

  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbu⟩ := QuantumLift.formula_invertible_value χ hχ f
    (fun i => j (W i)) (j a) ha' ha0'

    d).toEquiv.symm

    hbu.map r⟩

theorem det_ne_zero (χ : AddChar (ZMod M) K) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (φ : K →+* E) (points : Fin w → K) (hp : Function.Injective points)
    (A : Fin w → Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) K)
    (B e : ℕ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hqB : q ≤ B)
    (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hMN : M = N + 2 * w ^ 3 * B) (hM : B * (2 * w ^ 3 * B) < M) (he : 0 < e)
    (X : Fin w → Matrix (Fin e) (Fin e) (F E))
    (hX : Function.Injective (Rectangular.blockEval
      (fun i => ((HahnSeries.C : E →+* F E).comp φ).mapMatrix (A i)) X)) :
    (polynomial (N := N) χ A points).det ≠ 0 := by
  let ψ : K →+* F E := (HahnSeries.C : E →+* F E).comp φ
  let τ : F E := HahnSeries.single 1 1
  let A' := fun i => ψ.mapMatrix (A i)
  let W := fun α β => (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom ψ τ).mapMatrix (polyBlocks (M := M) (N := N) A
    points α β)

    (fun i => φ (points i)) (φ.injective.comp hp) A' X hX

    rw [show QuantumLift.blockOriginal W = _ from raw_specialize φ A points, Matrix.rank_reindex]

theorem Eval.unique {c : ℚ →+* R} {X : Fin n → R} {h : Formula n} {a b : R}
    (ha : h.Eval c X a) (hb : h.Eval c X b) : a = b := by
  induction h using inductionOn generalizing a b with
  | var i => exact (eval_var_iff.mp ha).trans (eval_var_iff.mp hb).symm
  | const q => exact (eval_const_iff.mp ha).trans (eval_const_iff.mp hb).symm
  | add f g ihf ihg =>
    obtain ⟨a₁, a₂, ha₁, ha₂, rfl⟩ := eval_add_iff.mp ha
    obtain ⟨b₁, b₂, hb₁, hb₂, rfl⟩ := eval_add_iff.mp hb
    rw [ihf ha₁ hb₁, ihg ha₂ hb₂]
  | mul f g ihf ihg =>
    obtain ⟨a₁, a₂, ha₁, ha₂, rfl⟩ := eval_mul_iff.mp ha
    obtain ⟨b₁, b₂, hb₁, hb₂, rfl⟩ := eval_mul_iff.mp hb
    rw [ihf ha₁ hb₁, ihg ha₂ hb₂]
  | inv f ih =>
    obtain ⟨a', ha', -, hva⟩ := eval_inv_iff.mp ha
    obtain ⟨b', hb', hbw, -⟩ := eval_inv_iff.mp hb
    obtain rfl := ih ha' hb'
    calc
      a = a * (a' * b) := by rw [hbw, mul_one]
      _ = b := by rw [← mul_assoc, hva, one_mul]

theorem Eval.lift (f : R →+* S) (hf : ∀ x, IsUnit (f x) → IsUnit x)
    {c : ℚ →+* R} {X : Fin n → R} {h : Formula n} {a : S}
    (ha : h.Eval (f.comp c) (fun i => f (X i)) a) :
    ∃ b : R, h.Eval c X b ∧ f b = a := by
  induction h using inductionOn generalizing a with
  | var i => exact ⟨X i, .var i, (eval_var_iff.mp ha).symm⟩
  | const q => exact ⟨c q, .const q, (eval_const_iff.mp ha).symm⟩
  | add g k ihg ihk =>
    obtain ⟨a₁, a₂, ha₁, ha₂, rfl⟩ := eval_add_iff.mp ha
    obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁, rfl⟩ := ihg ha₁
    obtain ⟨b₂, hb₂, rfl⟩ := ihk ha₂
    exact ⟨b₁ + b₂, .add hb₁ hb₂, map_add f b₁ b₂⟩
  | mul g k ihg ihk =>
    obtain ⟨a₁, a₂, ha₁, ha₂, rfl⟩ := eval_mul_iff.mp ha
    obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁, rfl⟩ := ihg ha₁
    obtain ⟨b₂, hb₂, rfl⟩ := ihk ha₂
    exact ⟨b₁ * b₂, .mul hb₁ hb₂, map_mul f b₁ b₂⟩
  | inv g ih =>
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hba, hab⟩ := eval_inv_iff.mp ha
    obtain ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩ := ih hb
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hf b' ⟨⟨f b', a, hba, hab⟩, rfl⟩
    have heval : (Formula.inv g).Eval c X (↑u⁻¹ : R) :=
      .inv hb' (by rw [← hu]; exact u.mul_inv) (by rw [← hu]; exact u.inv_mul)
    exact ⟨_, heval, (heval.map f).unique ha⟩

theorem Eval.unit_of_division_lift {D : Type*} [DivisionRing D] [Nontrivial R]
    (f : D →+* R) {c : ℚ →+* D} {X : Fin n → D} {h : Formula n} {a : R}
    (ha : h.Eval (f.comp c) (fun i => f (X i)) a) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) : IsUnit a := by
  have hf : ∀ x, IsUnit (f x) → IsUnit x := by
    intro x hx
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro hzero
    exact hx.ne_zero (by rw [hzero, map_zero])
  obtain ⟨b, hb, heq⟩ := ha.lift f hf
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply ha0
    rw [← heq, h, map_zero]
  exact heq ▸ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb0).map f

private lemma transfer {n N e : ℕ} (x : Fin 3 → ℕ) (f : Formula n)
    (z : (Matrix (ZMod (CyclotomicRing.dimension e)) (ZMod (CyclotomicRing.dimension e))
      (CyclotomicRing.R e))ˣ)
    (hz : (z : Matrix _ _ _) = specializedLift n N e x 0)
    (v : Matrix (ZMod (CyclotomicRing.dimension e)) (ZMod (CyclotomicRing.dimension e))
      (CyclotomicRing.R e))
    (hf : f.Eval (algebraMap ℚ _)
      (fun i => (↑z⁻¹ : Matrix _ _ _) * specializedLift n N e x i.succ) v)
    (hu : IsUnit v) :
    ∃ a, Evaluates f (tupleAt n N e x) a ∧ IsUnit a := by
  have hzinv : regular e (↑z⁻¹ : Matrix _ _ _) = (rationalLift n N e x 0)⁻¹ := by
    symm
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
    change regular e (↑z⁻¹ : Matrix _ _ _) * regular e (specializedLift n N e x 0) = 1
    simp only [← map_mul, ← hz, Units.inv_mul, map_one]
  refine ⟨regular e v, ?_, hu.map (regular e)⟩
  have hh := hf.map (regular e)
  rw [RingHom.ext_rat ((regular e).comp (algebraMap ℚ _)) (algebraMap ℚ _)] at hh
  change f.Eval (algebraMap ℚ _) (tupleAt n N e x) (regular e v)
  change f.Eval (algebraMap ℚ _)
    (fun i => (regular e (specializedLift n N e x 0))⁻¹ * regular e
      (specializedLift n N e x i.succ)) (regular e v)
  simpa only [map_mul, hzinv, rationalLift] using hh

private lemma entry_bound (e : ℕ) (T : Matrix (ZMod (dimension e)) (ZMod (dimension e)) ℤ)
    (p r : ℤ) (A H : ℕ) (hT : ∀ i j, |T i j| ≤ A) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (hp : |p| ≤ H) (hr : |r| ≤ H) (u v : ZMod (dimension e)) (i j : Fin (degree e)) :
    |entry e T p r u v i j| ≤ (dimension e : ℤ) ^ 3 * A * (H : ℤ) ^ (2 * dimension e) := by
  have hH' : (1 : ℤ) ≤ H := by exact_mod_cast hH
  have hterm (a b k : ZMod (dimension e)) :
      |(if u = v + b then
          T k (k - b) * signedEntry e (-a * k + a * u) i j * p ^ a.val * r ^ b.val
        else 0)| ≤ (A : ℤ) * (H : ℤ) ^ (2 * dimension e) := by
    split_ifs
    · simp only [abs_mul, abs_pow]
      calc _ ≤ ((A : ℤ) * 1 * (H : ℤ) ^ dimension e) * (H : ℤ) ^ dimension e := by
               apply mul_le_mul _ _ (by positivity) (by positivity)
               · apply mul_le_mul _ _ (by positivity) (by positivity)
                 · exact mul_le_mul (hT _ _) (signedEntry_abs ..) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
                 · exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg p) hp a.val).trans
                     (pow_le_pow_right₀ hH' (Nat.le_of_lt a.val_lt))
               · exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg r) hr b.val).trans
                   (pow_le_pow_right₀ hH' (Nat.le_of_lt b.val_lt))

        ≤ ∑ a : ZMod (dimension e), |∑ b : ZMod (dimension e), _| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _

         apply Finset.sum_le_sum

theorem exists_integralFrame {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (U : Submodule (F K) (ι → F K)) : Nonempty (IntegralFrame U) := by
  classical
  suffices ∀ k, ∀ U : Submodule (F K) (ι → F K),
      Module.finrank (F K) U = k → Nonempty (IntegralFrame U) from
    this _ U rfl
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h k ih =>
    intro U hdim
    by_cases hU : U = ⊥
    · subst U
      exact ⟨{ length := 0
               vector := Fin.elim0
               coordinate := Fin.elim0
               span_eq := by simp
               vector_integral := fun j => Fin.elim0 j
               coordinate_integral := fun j => Fin.elim0 j
               pairing := fun i => Fin.elim0 i
               reduced_independent := linearIndependent_empty_type }⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hvU, hv⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hU
    obtain ⟨c, u, hu, hxint, hxc⟩ := normalize_vector v hv
    let x : ι → F K := u • v
    have hxU : x ∈ U := U.smul_mem u hvU
    have hxI : IntegralVector x := hxint
    have hxc' : x c = 1 := hxc
    let π : (ι → F K) →ₗ[F K] F K := LinearMap.proj c
    let W := U ⊓ LinearMap.ker π
    have hWU : W < U := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne inf_le_left ?_
      intro he
      have hxW : x ∈ W := he.symm ▸ hxU
      have hh : x c = 0 := hxW.2
      exact one_ne_zero (hxc'.symm.trans hh)
    have hdimW : Module.finrank (F K) W < k := by
      rw [← hdim]
      exact Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hWU
    obtain ⟨b⟩ := ih _ hdimW W rfl
    have hbW : ∀ j, b.vector j ∈ W := by
      intro j
      exact b.span_eq.le (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    have hbc : ∀ j, b.vector j c = 0 := fun j => (hbW j).2
    let φ : Fin b.length → ((ι → F K) →ₗ[F K] F K) := fun j =>
      b.coordinate j - b.coordinate j x • π
    refine ⟨{ length := b.length + 1
              vector := Fin.cons x b.vector
              coordinate := Fin.cons π φ
              span_eq := ?_
              vector_integral := ?_
              coordinate_integral := ?_
              pairing := ?_
              reduced_independent := ?_ }⟩
    · apply le_antisymm
      · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
        rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
        exact Fin.cases hxU (fun i => (hbW i).1) j
      · intro y hy
        have hr : y - y c • x ∈ W := by
          refine ⟨U.sub_mem hy (U.smul_mem _ hxU), ?_⟩
          change y c - y c * x c = 0
          simp [hxc']
        have hsub : W ≤ Submodule.span (F K) (Set.range (Fin.cons x b.vector)) := by
          apply le_trans b.span_eq.ge
          apply Submodule.span_mono
          rw [Fin.range_cons]
          exact Set.subset_insert x _
        have hxspan : x ∈ Submodule.span (F K) (Set.range (Fin.cons x b.vector)) :=
          Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, by simp⟩
        have hh := (Submodule.span (F K) (Set.range (Fin.cons x b.vector))).add_mem
          (hsub hr) ((Submodule.span (F K) (Set.range (Fin.cons x b.vector))).smul_mem (y c) hxspan)
        simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hh
    · intro j
      exact Fin.cases hxI b.vector_integral j
    · intro j
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
      · exact fun y hy => hy c
      · intro y hy
        change Integral (b.coordinate i y - b.coordinate i x * y c)
        exact (b.coordinate_integral i y hy).sub
          ((b.coordinate_integral i x hxI).mul (hy c))
    · intro i j
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun a => ?_) i <;>
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun z => ?_) j
      · simp [π, hxc']
      · simp [π, hbc, Ne.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero _)]
      · simp [φ, π, hxc']
      · simp [φ, π, hbc, b.pairing]
    · have he : (fun j : Fin (b.length + 1) => reduce ((Fin.cons x b.vector : Fin (b.length + 1)
      → (ι → F K)) j)) =
          Fin.cons (reduce x) (fun j => reduce (b.vector j)) := by
        funext j
        exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) j
      rw [he, linearIndependent_finCons]
      refine ⟨b.reduced_independent, ?_⟩
      have hsp : Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun j => reduce (b.vector j))) ≤
          LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.proj c : (ι → K) →ₗ[K] K) := by
        apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
        rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
        change reduction (b.vector j c) = 0
        rw [hbc, reduction_zero]
      intro hx
      have hh : reduction (x c) = 0 := hsp hx
      rw [hxc', reduction_one] at hh
      exact one_ne_zero hh

lemma exists_independent_subfamily {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    {h : ℕ} (v : Fin h → V) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (a : Fin k → Fin h), Function.Injective a ∧
      Submodule.span K (Set.range (v ∘ a)) = Submodule.span K (Set.range v) ∧
      LinearIndependent K (v ∘ a) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨κ, a, ha, hs, hi⟩ := exists_linearIndependent' K v
  let : Fintype κ := Fintype.ofInjective a ha
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin κ).symm
  refine ⟨Fintype.card κ, a ∘ e, ha.comp e.injective, ?_, hi.comp e e.injective⟩
  have he : Set.range (v ∘ a ∘ e) = Set.range (v ∘ a) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩; exact ⟨e j, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := e.surjective j
      exact ⟨r, rfl⟩
  change Submodule.span K (Set.range (v ∘ a ∘ e)) = _
  rw [he, hs]

    (w : ι → ℕ) (A : ℕ) (U : Submodule (F K) (ι → F K))
    (W : Submodule (F K) (ι → F K)) (hW : U.map (weightMap w) ≤ W) :

  have hs : reducedSubspace (U'.map (weightMap w)) ≤ lowSupported w A := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr

    apply reduction_weighted_supported w A U' ?_ y hyU hyI
    intro x hx hxI hh
    apply hdetect x hx hxI
    funext i

    reducedSubspace_mono ((Submodule.map_mono hU).trans hW)
  have hh := Submodule.finrank_mono (le_inf hw hs)

      intro x
      have he := liftMap_comp E.toLinearMap E.symm.toLinearMap
      have hh : E.toLinearMap.comp E.symm.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id := by ext x; simp

theorem rank_ge (w B M N q e : ℕ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hMN : M = N + 2 * w ^ 3 * B) (hq : q ≤ B) (he : 0 < e)
    (points : Fin w → K) (hp : Function.Injective points)
    (A : Fin w → Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) (F K))
    (X : Fin w → Matrix (Fin e) (Fin e) (F K))
    (hX : Function.Injective (blockEval A X)) :
    q * N ≤ (raw A (fun i => embed.mapMatrix (padded M N (points i)))).rank := by
  let R := fun i => embed.mapMatrix (padded M N (points i))
  let L := (raw A R).mulVecLin.comp (extend q M N)
  have hi : Function.Injective L := by
    apply (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot).mp
    rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro v hv
    let f : Fin q → Fin M → F K := fun α j => extend q M N v (α, j)
    have hf : ∀ α j, N ≤ j.val → f α j = 0 := extend_low q M N v
    have hker : ∀ α, ∑ i, ∑ γ, A i α γ • testMap M (points i) (f γ) = 0 := by
      intro α
      funext j
      have hh := congrFun hv (α, j)
      change (raw A R).mulVec (extend q M N v) (α, j) = 0 at hh
      rw [raw_apply] at hh
      simpa only [R, f, padded_mulVec_low M N _ _ (hf _),
        Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply] using hh
    have hzero := rectangular_kernel_zero w B M N q e hw hN hMN hq he points hp A X hX f hf hker
    have hext : extend q M N v = 0 := by
      funext ⟨α, j⟩
      exact congrFun (congrFun hzero α) j
    apply extend_injective q M N (by omega)
    simpa only [map_zero] using hext
  let E := LinearMap.toMatrix' (extend (K := K) q M N)
  have hE : E.mulVecLin = extend q M N := Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix' _
  have hr : (raw A R * E).rank = q * N := by
    rw [Matrix.rank, Matrix.mulVecLin_mul, hE]
    rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hi]
    simp
  exact hr ▸ Matrix.rank_mul_le_left (raw A R) E

theorem rectangular_kernel_zero (w B M N q e : ℕ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hMN : M = N + 2 * w ^ 3 * B) (hq : q ≤ B) (he : 0 < e)
    (points : Fin w → K) (hp : Function.Injective points)
    (A : Fin w → Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) (F K))
    (X : Fin w → Matrix (Fin e) (Fin e) (F K))
    (hX : Function.Injective (blockEval A X))
    (f : Fin q → Fin M → F K)
    (hf : ∀ α j, N ≤ j.val → f α j = 0)
    (hker : ∀ α, ∑ i, ∑ γ, A i α γ • testMap M (points i) (f γ) = 0) : f = 0 := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ α, f α ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! hh
    exact hn (funext hh)
  let U := componentSpace (F := F K) f
  let k := finrank (F K) U
  let b := Module.finBasis (F K) U
  let T := fun i => testMap M (points i)
  let W := (imageCombination T (fun j => (b j : Fin M → F K))).range
  have hk : 1 ≤ k := by
    apply finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
    refine ⟨component (F := F K) f α, ?_⟩
    intro hz
    exact hα (congrArg Subtype.val hz)
  have hkq : k ≤ q := by
    simpa using finrank_le_of_span_eq_top (span_component_top (F := F K) f)
  have hU : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : Fin M, N ≤ j.val → x j = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx => obtain ⟨α, rfl⟩ := hx; exact hf α
    | zero => intro j _; rfl
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => intro j hj; simp [hx j hj, hy j hj]
    | smul c x _ hx => intro j hj; simp [hx j hj]
  have hW : ∀ i, U.map (T i) ≤ W := fun i => component_image_le_range T f b i
  have hex := small_expansion w B M N hw hN hMN points hp U W hU hW hk (hkq.trans hq)
  exact kernel_impossible hw he A T X hX f b hker hex

  have hxor : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime

      (encPair encIntBin encIntBin) encBool :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bool_xor.comp

  have hsign : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ℤ × ℤ =>

        else if p.2 = 0 then false

      (encPair encIntBin encIntBin) encBool :=
    ha0.ite_decide (.const false) (hb0.ite_decide (.const false) hxor)

      (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => if p.2 = 0 then 0 else p.1.natAbs / Nat.gcd p.1.natAbs p.2.natAbs)

    hb0.ite_decide (.const 0) (by fun_prop)

      (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => if p.2 = 0 then 1 else p.2.natAbs / Nat.gcd p.1.natAbs p.2.natAbs)
      (encPair encIntBin encIntBin) encNat :=

private theorem intBits_le_liftBits {n M H : ℕ} {z : ℤ}
    (hz : z.natAbs ≤ M ^ 3 * (2 * (n + 1)) ^ (2 * M) * H ^ (3 * M)) :
    intBits z ≤ liftBits n M H := by
  have hM : M ^ 3 ≤ 2 ^ (3 * M) := by
    rw [Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le 3
  have hw : (2 * (n + 1)) ^ (2 * M) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * (n + 1) * (2 * M)) := by
    rw [pow_mul 2]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le _
  have hH : H ^ (3 * M) ≤ 2 ^ (H * (3 * M)) := by
    rw [pow_mul 2]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le _
  have hprod : M ^ 3 * (2 * (n + 1)) ^ (2 * M) * H ^ (3 * M) ≤
      2 ^ (4 * M + 4 * M * (n + 1) + 3 * M * H) :=
    calc _ ≤ 2 ^ (3 * M) * 2 ^ (2 * (n + 1) * (2 * M)) * 2 ^ (H * (3 * M)) := by gcongr
      _ = 2 ^ (3 * M + 4 * M * (n + 1) + 3 * M * H) := by
          rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add]
          congr 1
          ring
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hlt : z.natAbs < 2 ^ (4 * M + 4 * M * (n + 1) + 3 * M * H + 1) :=
    (hz.trans hprod).trans_lt (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.lt_succ_self _))

private lemma map_taylor_projection_kernel (M : ℕ) (a : K) (A : ℕ)
    (V : Submodule K (Fin M → K)) :
    (V ⊓ ((lowProjection Fin.val A).comp (taylorCoordinates M a).toLinearMap).ker).map
      (polynomialMap M) = vanishingFiltration (polynomialSpace V) a (A + 1) := by
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxV, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨x, hxV, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro j hj
    by_cases hjM : j < M
    · have he := congrFun hx (⟨⟨j, hjM⟩, by change j ≤ A; omega⟩ : {i : Fin M // i.val ≤ A})
      exact he
    · apply coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
      have hdeg := Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp (polynomialMap_mem M x)
      rw [degree_taylor]
      exact hdeg.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_not_gt hjM))

    refine ⟨x, ⟨hxV, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    change (lowProjection Fin.val A) (taylorCoordinates M a x) = 0

theorem order_reversal_sum (M : ℕ) (a : K)
    (U W : Submodule (F K) (Fin M → F K)) (hW : U.map (testMap M a) ≤ W)
    {k l : ℕ} (b : Basis (Fin k) K (polynomialSpace (reducedSubspace U)))
    (c : Basis (Fin l) K (polynomialSpace (reducedSubspace W)))
    (hb : Function.Injective (fun j => (b j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity a))
    (hc : Function.Injective (fun j => (c j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity a)) :
    k * (M - 1) ≤ (∑ j, (b j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity a) +
      (∑ j, (c j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity a) := by
  classical
  have hbd : ∀ j, (b j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity a ≤ M - 1 := by
    intro j
    have hle : (b j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity a ≤ (b j : K[X]).natDegree := by
      rw [rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree, ← taylor_apply]
      exact (natTrailingDegree_le_natDegree _).trans (le_of_eq (natDegree_taylor _ _))
    apply hle.trans
    have hh := polynomialSpace_bound (reducedSubspace U) _ (b j).property
      (fun hz => b.ne_zero j (Subtype.ext hz))
    omega
  have hcd : ∀ j, (c j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity a ≤ M - 1 := by
    intro j
    have hle : (c j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity a ≤ (c j : K[X]).natDegree := by
      rw [rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree, ← taylor_apply]
      exact (natTrailingDegree_le_natDegree _).trans (le_of_eq (natDegree_taylor _ _))
    apply hle.trans
    have hh := polynomialSpace_bound (reducedSubspace W) _ (c j).property
      (fun hz => c.ne_zero j (Subtype.ext hz))
    omega
  have hh := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.range (M - 1))
    (fun A _ => order_reversal_counts M a A U W hW b c hb hc)
  rw [sum_threshold_counts, sum_reversed_counts _ _ hcd] at hh
  have he : (∑ j, (M - 1 - (b j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity a)) +
      (∑ j, (b j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity a) = k * (M - 1) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [Nat.sub_add_cancel (hbd _), Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
  omega

private lemma expansion_numeric (w B M N k l : ℕ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hMN : M = N + 2 * w ^ 3 * B) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkB : k ≤ B)
    (hh : w * (k * (M - 1)) ≤ k * (N - 1) + w * (∑ j : Fin k, j.val) +
      (l * (M - 1) + w * (∑ j : Fin l, j.val))) :
    (w - 1) * k < l := by
  by_contra! hl
  have hk2 := sum_fin_val_le_square k
  have hl2 := sum_fin_val_le_square l
  have hh' : w * (k * (M - 1)) ≤ k * (N - 1) + w * (k * k) +
      (l * (M - 1) + w * (l * l)) := by
    exact hh.trans (by gcongr)
  have hgap : M - 1 = N - 1 + 2 * w ^ 3 * B := by omega
  have hw' : w - 1 + 1 = w := by omega
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (M - 1) hl
  have hlSq : l * l ≤ ((w - 1) * k) * ((w - 1) * k) := Nat.mul_self_le_mul_self hl
  have hwSq : (w - 1) * (w - 1) + 1 ≤ w * w := by nlinarith
  have hsq : k * k + l * l ≤ w * w * (k * k) := by
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (k * k) hwSq
    nlinarith
  have hkSq : k * k ≤ B * k := Nat.mul_le_mul_right k hkB
  have hfinal : w * (k * k + l * l) ≤ w ^ 3 * B * k := by
    calc
      _ ≤ w * (w * w * (k * k)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left w hsq
      _ ≤ w * (w * w * (B * k)) := by gcongr
      _ = w ^ 3 * B * k := by ring
  have hB : 0 < B := by omega
  have hpos : 0 < w ^ 3 * B * k := by positivity
  have hbase : k * (M - 1) ≤ k * (N - 1) + w * (k * k + l * l) := by
    have he : w * (k * (M - 1)) = k * (M - 1) + (w - 1) * k * (M - 1) := by
      calc
        _ = (1 + (w - 1)) * (k * (M - 1)) := by congr 1; omega
        _ = _ := by ring
    have hb : w * (k * (M - 1)) ≤ k * (N - 1) + w * (k * k + l * l) + (w - 1) * k * (M - 1) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ k * (N - 1) + w * (k * k) + ((w - 1) * k * (M - 1) + w * (l * l)) :=
          hh'.trans (by gcongr)
        _ = _ := by ring
    rw [he] at hb
    exact Nat.le_of_add_le_add_right hb
  have hneed : k * (2 * w ^ 3 * B) ≤ w * (k * k + l * l) := by
    rw [hgap] at hbase
    nlinarith only [hbase]
  nlinarith

private lemma reduced_degree_bound {M N : ℕ} (U : Submodule (F K) (Fin M → F K))
    (hU : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : Fin M, N ≤ j.val → x j = 0) :
    ∀ f ∈ polynomialSpace (reducedSubspace U), f ≠ 0 → f.natDegree < N := by

    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨b⟩ := exists_integralFrame U
    have hyy : y ∈ reducedSet U := by
      rw [reducedSet_eq_span b]
      rwa [reducedSubspace_eq_span b] at hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hI, rfl⟩ := hyy
    intro j hj
    simp only [reduce, hU x hx j hj, reduction_zero]
  rintro f ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ hn
  apply (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hn).mpr
  rw [degree_lt_iff_coeff_zero]
  intro j hj

  · exact (polynomialMap_coeff M x ⟨j, hjM⟩).trans (hr x hx ⟨j, hjM⟩ hj)

theorem small_expansion [CharZero K] (w B M N : ℕ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hMN : M = N + 2 * w ^ 3 * B) (points : Fin w → K) (hp : Function.Injective points)
    (U W : Submodule (F K) (Fin M → F K))
    (hU : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : Fin M, N ≤ j.val → x j = 0)
    (hW : ∀ i, U.map (testMap M (points i)) ≤ W)
    (hk : 1 ≤ finrank (F K) U) (hkB : finrank (F K) U ≤ B) :
    (w - 1) * finrank (F K) U < finrank (F K) W := by
  classical
  let k := finrank (F K) U
  let l := finrank (F K) W
  let V := polynomialSpace (reducedSubspace U)
  let Z := polynomialSpace (reducedSubspace W)
  let : Module.Finite K V := Module.Finite.map (reducedSubspace U) (polynomialMap M)
  let : Module.Finite K Z := Module.Finite.map (reducedSubspace W) (polynomialMap M)
  have hVdim : finrank K V = k := by
    rw [finrank_polynomialSpace, finrank_reducedSubspace]
  have hZdim : finrank K Z = l := by
    rw [finrank_polynomialSpace, finrank_reducedSubspace]
  let b : Basis (Fin k) K V := (Module.finBasis K V).reindex (finCongr hVdim)
  let c : Basis (Fin l) K Z := (Module.finBasis K Z).reindex (finCongr hZdim)
  have hV := reduced_degree_bound U hU
  have hZ := polynomialSpace_bound (reducedSubspace W)
  choose be hbe using (fun i : Fin w => exists_echelon_basis_at N V b hV (points i))
  choose ce hce using (fun i : Fin w => exists_echelon_basis_at M Z c hZ (points i))
  have horder := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun i _ => order_reversal_sum M (points i) U W (hW i) (be i) (ce i) (hbe i) (hce i))
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib] at horder
  have hWrU := wronskian_order_bound N b points hp be hV hbe
  have hWrW := wronskian_order_bound M c points hp ce hZ hce
  exact expansion_numeric w B M N k l hw hN hMN hk hkB
    (horder.trans (Nat.add_le_add hWrU hWrW))

lemma wronskian_order_of_distinct_orders {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    {h : ℕ} (f : Fin h → K[X]) (hf : ∀ j, f j ≠ 0)
    (hd : Function.Injective (fun j => (f j).natTrailingDegree)) :
    wronskianFamily f ≠ 0 ∧
      (wronskianFamily f).natTrailingDegree + (∑ i : Fin h, i.val) =
        ∑ j, (f j).natTrailingDegree := by
  let A : Matrix (Fin h) (Fin h) K[X] :=
    Matrix.of fun i j => X ^ i.val * derivative^[i.val] (f j)
  obtain ⟨B, hdet, hB⟩ := det_factor_column_orders A
    (fun j => (f j).natTrailingDegree) (fun i j => scaled_derivative_order (f j) i.val)
  have hfall : Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin h =>
      ((f j).natTrailingDegree.descFactorial i.val : K)) ≠ 0 := by
    let p : Fin h → K[X] := fun j => descPochhammer K j.val
    have hp := Matrix.det_eval_matrixOfPolynomials_eq_det_vandermonde
      (fun j : Fin h => ((f j).natTrailingDegree : K)) p
      (fun j => by simp [p]) (fun j => monic_descPochhammer K j.val)
    have he : (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin h =>
        ((f j).natTrailingDegree.descFactorial i.val : K)) =
        (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin h => (p j).eval ((f i).natTrailingDegree : K)).transpose := by
      ext i j
      simp [p, descPochhammer_eval_eq_descFactorial]
    rw [he, Matrix.det_transpose, ← hp, Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff]
    exact (Nat.cast_injective (R := K)).comp hd
  have hBc : B.det.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := by
    have he : B.map (evalRingHom (0 : K)) =
        Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin h => (f j).trailingCoeff *
          ((f j).natTrailingDegree.descFactorial i.val : K)) := by
      ext i j
      change eval (0 : K) (B i j) = _
      rw [← coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, hB i j]
      change (X ^ i.val * derivative^[i.val] (f j)).coeff (f j).natTrailingDegree = _
      rw [coeff_scaled_derivative_at]
      exact mul_comm _ _
    rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]
    change (evalRingHom (0 : K)) B.det ≠ 0
    rw [RingHom.map_det]
    change (B.map (evalRingHom (0 : K))).det ≠ 0
    rw [he]
    have hscale := Matrix.det_mul_row (fun j => (f j).trailingCoeff)
      (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin h => ((f j).natTrailingDegree.descFactorial i.val : K))
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply] at hscale
    rw [hscale]
    exact mul_ne_zero (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun j _ =>
      trailingCoeff_nonzero_iff_nonzero.mpr (hf j)) hfall
  have hB0 : B.det ≠ 0 := by intro hz; simp [hz] at hBc
  have hA0 : A.det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hdet]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ X_ne_zero) hB0
  have hscale : A.det = X ^ (∑ i : Fin h, i.val) * wronskianFamily f := by
    have he := Matrix.det_mul_column (fun i : Fin h => (X : K[X]) ^ i.val)
      (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin h => derivative^[i.val] (f j))
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply] at he
    change _ = _ * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin h => derivative^[i.val] (f j))
    rw [← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
    exact he
  have hw : wronskianFamily f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hscale, hz, mul_zero] at hA0
    exact hA0 rfl
  refine ⟨hw, ?_⟩
  have ho : A.det.natTrailingDegree = ∑ j, (f j).natTrailingDegree := by
    rw [hdet, mul_comm, natTrailingDegree_mul_X_pow hB0,
      natTrailingDegree_eq_zero.mpr (Or.inr hBc), zero_add]
  rw [hscale, mul_comm, natTrailingDegree_mul_X_pow hw] at ho
  exact ho

lemma exists_order_echelon_family {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (d : ℕ) (V : Submodule K K[X])
    (hV : ∀ f ∈ V, f ≠ 0 → f.natDegree < d) :
    ∃ (h : ℕ) (f : Fin h → K[X]), LinearIndependent K f ∧
      Submodule.span K (Set.range f) = V ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i => (f i).natTrailingDegree) := by
  classical
  let e := reflectLinearEquiv K (d - 1)
  let W := V.map e.toLinearMap
  have hW : ∀ g ∈ W, g ≠ 0 → g.natDegree < d := by
    rintro g ⟨f, hfV, rfl⟩ hfn
    have hf : f ≠ 0 := by intro hz; simp [hz] at hfn
    have hd := hV f hfV hf
    have he := natDegree_reflect_le (N := d - 1) (p := f)
    change (reflect (d - 1) f).natDegree < d
    omega
  obtain ⟨h, g, hgLI, hgspan, hgdeg⟩ := exists_degree_echelon_family d W hW
  have hgW : ∀ i, g i ∈ W := by
    intro i
    rw [← hgspan]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨h, fun i => e.symm (g i), hgLI.map' e.symm.toLinearMap (by simp), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hs : Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun i => e.symm (g i))) =
        (Submodule.span K (Set.range g)).map e.symm.toLinearMap := by
      rw [Submodule.map_span]
      congr 1
      exact Set.range_comp _ _
    rw [hs, hgspan, ← Submodule.map_comp]
    change (V.map (e.symm.toLinearMap.comp e.toLinearMap)) = V
    simp
  · intro i j hij
    change (reflect (d - 1) (g i)).natTrailingDegree =

theorem wronskian_order_bound {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (d : ℕ) {V : Submodule K K[X]} {h w : ℕ}
    (b : Basis (Fin h) K V) (a : Fin w → K) (ha : Function.Injective a)
    (e : Fin w → Basis (Fin h) K V)
    (hV : ∀ f ∈ V, f ≠ 0 → f.natDegree < d)
    (he : ∀ i, Function.Injective (fun j => (e i j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity (a i))) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, (e i j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity (a i) ≤
      h * (d - 1) + w * (∑ j : Fin h, j.val) := by
  classical
  have localOrder : ∀ i, ∑ j, (e i j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity (a i) =
      (wronskianFamily (fun j => (b j : K[X]))).rootMultiplicity (a i) +
        (∑ j : Fin h, j.val) := by
    intro i
    rw [← wronskian_order_at (a i) _ (fun j hz => (e i).ne_zero j (Subtype.ext hz)) (he i),
      wronskian_basis_rootMultiplicity d b (e i) (a i) hV]
  simp_rw [localOrder]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
    nsmul_eq_mul]
  apply Nat.add_le_add_right

  have hsum : (∑ i, W.rootMultiplicity (a i)) =
      ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.image a, W.rootMultiplicity x := by
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    exact fun i _ j _ hij => ha hij
  rw [hsum]
  apply (sum_rootMultiplicity_le_natDegree W _).trans
  apply natDegree_wronskian_le
  intro j
  have hh := hV (b j) (b j).property (fun hz => b.ne_zero j (Subtype.ext hz))

lemma low_coefficients_force_zero {K : Type*} [Field K] {h : ℕ}
    (f : Fin h → K[X]) (hf : ∀ j, f j ≠ 0)
    (hd : Function.Injective (fun j => (f j).natTrailingDegree))
    (c : Fin h → K) (r : ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ m < r, (∑ j, c j • f j).coeff m = 0) :
    ∀ j, (f j).natTrailingDegree < r → c j = 0 := by
  classical
  have hi : ∀ m, ∀ j, (f j).natTrailingDegree = m → m < r → c j = 0 := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      intro j hj hmr
      have hs : (∑ k, c k • f k).coeff m = c j * (f j).coeff m := by
        simp only [finsetSum_coeff, coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_single j
        · intro k _ hkj
          by_cases hk : (f k).natTrailingDegree < m
          · rw [ih _ hk k rfl (hk.trans hmr), zero_mul]
          · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_natTrailingDegree (show m < (f k).natTrailingDegree by
              have hn : (f k).natTrailingDegree ≠ m := by
                intro hh
                exact hkj (hd (hh.trans hj.symm))
              omega), mul_zero]
        · intro hh
          exact (hh (Finset.mem_univ j)).elim
      have htc : (f j).coeff m ≠ 0 := by
        rw [← hj]
        change (f j).trailingCoeff ≠ 0
        exact mt trailingCoeff_eq_zero.mp (hf j)
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp ((hs.symm.trans (hz m hmr)))).resolve_right htc
  intro j hj
  exact hi _ j rfl hj

theorem full_linePoints [Fintype F] {m : ℕ} (x : Fin m → (Fin N → F) → F) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ s)
    (z : Fin m → F) :
    Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s
      (Set.range fun o : Option (F × Fin m) => fun v => match o with
        | none => firstNonzero (z - fun i => x i v)
        | some (t, i) => ((fun i => x i v) + t • (firstNonzero (z - fun i => x i v))⁻¹ •
            (z - fun i => x i v)) i)
      ((Fintype.card F + 5) * m + 2) := by
  -- the differences
  have h₁ := family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s) (fun i v => z i - x i v)
    (fun _ => 1) (fun i => full_unary (fun a => z i - a) (hx i))
  set s₁ := s ∪ Set.range fun i v => z i - x i v
  -- the hint position
  have h₂ := full_firstNonzero (s := s₁) (fun i v => z i - x i v) fun i =>
    Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  set s₂ := s₁ ∪ {fun v => firstNonzero fun i => z i - x i v}
  -- the points
  have h₃ := family (I := fullInterpretation (k := 2)) (s := s₂)
    (fun ti : F × Fin m => fun v => x ti.2 v + ti.1 * ((firstNonzero fun i => z i - x i v)⁻¹ *
      (z ti.2 - x ti.2 v))) (fun _ => 1)
    (fun ti => full_binary_mem (fun a c => a + ti.1 * (c⁻¹ * (z ti.2 - a)))
      (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_left _ (hx ti.2))) (Set.mem_union_right _ rfl))
  refine (h₁.comp (h₂.comp h₃)).mono Set.Subset.rfl ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨o, rfl⟩
    rcases o with _ | ⟨t, i⟩
    · exact Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_union_left _ rfl)
    · refine Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨(t, i), funext fun v => ?_⟩)
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rfl
  · simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_prod, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    nlinarith

theorem full_majTree (L : ℕ) (f : Fin (3 ^ L) → (Fin N → F) → F) (hf : ∀ k, f k ∈ s) :
    Synthesis (fullInterpretation (k := 2)) s {fun x => majTree L fun k => f k x}
      (2 * 3 ^ L - 2) := by
  induction L generalizing s with
  | zero =>
    exact (of_mem (hf _)).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl (by omega)
  | succ L ih =>
    have h₀ := ih (s := s) (fun k => f (tripleEquiv L (0, k))) fun k => hf _
    have h₁ := ih (s := s) (fun k => f (tripleEquiv L (1, k))) fun k => hf _
    have h₂ := ih (s := s) (fun k => f (tripleEquiv L (2, k))) fun k => hf _
    have h₃ := full_maj3 (s := s ∪ ({fun x => majTree L fun k => f (tripleEquiv L (0, k)) x} ∪
        ({fun x => majTree L fun k => f (tripleEquiv L (1, k)) x} ∪
          {fun x => majTree L fun k => f (tripleEquiv L (2, k)) x})))
      (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_union_left _ rfl))
      (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_union_left _ rfl)))
      (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_union_right _ rfl)))
    refine ((h₀.union (h₁.union h₂)).trans h₃).mono Set.Subset.rfl
      (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 rfl) ?_
    rw [pow_succ]
    have : 1 ≤ 3 ^ L := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by decide)
    omega

theorem mul_sub_distributionalError_le (h : Corrupted ν f z α δ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (p : Protocol X Y Z) :
    α * ((ν.toOuterMeasure {q | f q.1 q.2 = z}).toReal -
        p.distributionalError ν (fun x y b => f x y = b)) ≤
      p.distributionalError ν (fun x y b => f x y = b) + 2 ^ p.depth * δ := by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite X
  have := Fintype.ofFinite Y
  -- Each leaf rectangle labelled `z` has weight at most `δ` when the inputs where `f` is `z` weigh
  -- `α` times their mass and the others minus their mass.
  set w : X → Y → ℝ := fun x y =>
    α * (if f x y = z then (ν (x, y)).toReal else 0) - (if f x y = z then 0 else (ν (x, y)).toReal)
  have hsum := p.sum_filter_run_le_mul z w (K := δ) fun i _ => by
    have := h {x | x ∈ p.leafAlice i} {y | y ∈ p.leafBob i}
    simp only [w, sum_sub_distrib, ← mul_sum]
    linarith
  have hleaves : (#{i | p.leafOutput i = z} : ℝ) * δ ≤ 2 ^ p.depth * δ := by
    gcongr
    · exact h.nonneg
    · exact_mod_cast (card_le_univ _).trans (by simpa using p.leafCount_le_two_pow_depth)
  -- The masses involved, as sums over all pairs of inputs.
  set E := p.distributionalError ν (fun x y b => f x y = b)
  have hE : E = ∑ q : X × Y, if f q.1 q.2 = p.run q.1 q.2 then 0 else (ν q).toReal := by
    simp only [E, Protocol.distributionalError, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply_toReal,
      Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun q _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all
  have hw : ∑ q : X × Y with p.run q.1 q.2 = z, w q.1 q.2 =
      α * (∑ q : X × Y, if p.run q.1 q.2 = z ∧ f q.1 q.2 = z then (ν q).toReal else 0) -
        ∑ q : X × Y, if p.run q.1 q.2 = z ∧ f q.1 q.2 ≠ z then (ν q).toReal else 0 := by
    rw [sum_filter, mul_sum, ← sum_sub_distrib]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
    simp only [w]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  -- `f` is `z` only where the protocol answers `z` or errs, and the protocol errs where it answers
  -- `z` but `f` is not `z`.
  have h₁ : (ν.toOuterMeasure {q | f q.1 q.2 = z}).toReal ≤
      (∑ q : X × Y, if p.run q.1 q.2 = z ∧ f q.1 q.2 = z then (ν q).toReal else 0) + E :=
    toReal_eq_le_add_distributionalError p
  have h₂ : (∑ q : X × Y, if p.run q.1 q.2 = z ∧ f q.1 q.2 ≠ z then (ν q).toReal else 0) ≤ E := by
    rw [hE]
    refine sum_le_sum fun q _ => ?_
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  have h₃ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_iff_le_add.mpr h₁) hα
  linarith

    discrepancy (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString n × BitString n)) (fun x y => x ⬝ᵥ y) ^ 2 *
      2 ^ n ≤ 1 := by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ := exists_abs_sum_eq_discrepancy
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString n × BitString n)) (fun x y => x ⬝ᵥ y)
  rw [← hAB]

    simp [Fintype.card_prod]

  set S := ∑ x ∈ A, ∑ y ∈ B, signVal (x ⬝ᵥ y)

    exact_mod_cast (card_le_univ A).trans_eq (by simp)
  have hB : (#B : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ n := by

  push_cast
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_mul]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_pow, ENNReal.toReal_ofNat]
  have hS' : S ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ n * 2 ^ n * 2 ^ n :=
    hS.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAB' hN.le)
  rw [inv_pow, mul_assoc, inv_mul_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]

private theorem high_univ {i : U} {s : Finset U} (hi : i ∉ s) :
    high univ i s = 2 ^ (#sᶜ - 1) := by
  unfold high
  have hi' : i ∈ sᶜ := mem_compl.mpr hi
  have h1 : #{x ∈ (univ : Finset (Finset U)) | i ∈ x ∧ x ⊆ sᶜ} = #{x ∈ sᶜ.powerset | i ∈ x} := by
    congr 1
    ext x
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_powerset]
    exact and_comm
  have h2 : {x ∈ sᶜ.powerset | i ∉ x} = (sᶜ.erase i).powerset := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_powerset, subset_erase]
  have h3 := (card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := sᶜ.powerset) fun x => i ∈ x).trans
    (card_powerset sᶜ)
  have h4 : #(sᶜ.erase i).powerset = 2 ^ (#sᶜ - 1) := by
    rw [card_powerset, card_erase_of_mem hi']
  have h5 : 2 ^ #sᶜ = 2 ^ (#sᶜ - 1) * 2 := by
    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel (card_pos.mpr ⟨i, hi'⟩)]
  rw [h2, h4, h5] at h3
  rw [h1]
  omega

theorem rank_communicationMatrix_dotProduct :
    (communicationMatrix R fun x y : ι → Bool => x ⬝ᵥ y).rank = 2 ^ Fintype.card ι - 1 := by
  set M := communicationMatrix R fun x y : ι → Bool => x ⬝ᵥ y
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · -- The row of `0` vanishes, so `M` factors through the other `2 ^ |ι| - 1` rows.
    let E : Matrix (ι → Bool) {x : ι → Bool // x ≠ 0} R :=
      Matrix.of fun x j => if x = j.1 then 1 else 0
    let N : Matrix {x : ι → Bool // x ≠ 0} (ι → Bool) R := Matrix.of fun j y => M j.1 y
    have hEN : M = E * N := by
      ext x y
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, E, N, Matrix.of_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
      by_cases hx : x = 0
      · subst hx
        rw [sum_eq_zero fun j _ => ite_eq_right fun h => j.2 h.symm]
        simp [M, zero_dotProduct]
      · rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single ⟨x, hx⟩ fun j hj => ite_eq_right fun h => hj (Subtype.ext h.symm)]
        simp
    rw [hEN]
    refine (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left E N).trans ((Matrix.rank_le_card_width E).trans_eq ?_)
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_subtype_eq, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool]
  · have h : (signMatrix R fun x y : ι → Bool => x ⬝ᵥ y).rank ≤ M.rank + 1 :=
      rank_signMatrix_le _
    rw [rank_signMatrix_dotProduct] at h
    omega

theorem depth_ofDecisionTree_le (t : DecisionTree (Fin n) O) :
    (ofDecisionTree (m := m) t).depth ≤ t.depth * (Nat.clog 2 m + 1) := by
  induction t with

theorem exists_pieces (hτ : 0 < τ) (F : Finset (Fin n)) (X : Finset (Fin n → Fin m)) :

  suffices h : ∀ k, ∀ W ⊆ X, #W = k → ∃ L : List (Piece n m),
      (∀ q ∈ L, q.P ⊆ W) ∧ L.Pairwise (fun q q' => Disjoint q.P q'.P) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ L, q.I ⊆ F) ∧ (∀ q ∈ L, ∀ x ∈ q.P, ∀ i ∈ q.I, x i = q.α i) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ L, IsDense τ (F \ q.I) q.P) ∧ (∀ q ∈ L, (#X : ℝ) ≤ 2 * #q.P * τ ^ #q.I) ∧
      (#X : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (#X - #W + (L.map fun q => (#q.P : ℝ)).sum) by
    obtain ⟨L, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7⟩ := h _ X subset_rfl rfl
    exact ⟨L, ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, by linarith⟩⟩
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ k ih =>
  intro W hWX hWk
  by_cases hsmall : 2 * (#W : ℝ) < #X ∨ W = ∅
  · refine ⟨[], by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp, ?_⟩
    rcases hsmall with hsmall | rfl
    · simp only [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil]
      linarith
    · simp only [card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil]
      linarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ #X by positivity]
  push Not at hsmall
  obtain ⟨hsmall, hWe⟩ := hsmall
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hWe
  -- choose a maximal concentrated set, or the empty set if there is none
  obtain ⟨I, α, hIF, hW, hmax, hstrict⟩ := exists_max_violates_or_empty (W := W) x₀ F τ
  set P := agreeOn W I α

    ih _ (hWk ▸ card_sdiff_agreeOn_lt ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ hW) (W \ P) (sdiff_subset.trans hWX) rfl

  · rw [card_sdiff_of_subset hPW, Nat.cast_sub (card_le_card hPW)] at h7

private theorem card_le_two_mul_card_sdiff_unionOf_allowing {X : Finset (Fin n → Fin m)}
    {Y : Finset (Fin n → Fin m → Bool)} {L : List (Piece n m)}
    (hL : IsPartition τ F X L) (hX : X.Nonempty) (βq : Piece n m → Fin n → Bool)
    (hsmall : ∀ q ∈ L, (#(allowing Y q.I q.α (βq q)) : ℝ) ≤ #Y * #q.P / (2 * #X)) :
    (#Y : ℝ) ≤ 2 * #(Y \ unionOf (L.map fun q => allowing Y q.I q.α (βq q))) := by
  have hXpos : (0 : ℝ) < #X := by exact_mod_cast card_pos.mpr hX

  set Ygood := Y \ Ybad
  have hbad : (#Ybad : ℝ) ≤ #Y / 2 := by
    refine (card_unionOf_le _).trans ?_
    rw [List.map_map]
    calc (L.map ((fun s => (#s : ℝ)) ∘ fun q => allowing Y q.I q.α (βq q))).sum
        ≤ (L.map fun q => (#Y * #q.P / (2 * #X) : ℝ)).sum :=

      _ ≤ #Y / (2 * #X) * #X := by

      _ = #Y / 2 := by field_simp
  have h1 : #Y - #Ybad ≤ #Ygood := le_card_sdiff _ _
  have h2 : (#Y : ℝ) - #Ybad ≤ #Ygood := by
    have := Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add.mp h1
    have : (#Y : ℝ) ≤ #Ygood + #Ybad := by exact_mod_cast this
    linarith

theorem pow_depth_sim (hτ4 : 4 ≤ τ) (hτm : τ ^ 2 ≤ m) (hτc : 64 * n * (5 * c + 2) ≤ τ) :
    ∀ (p : Protocol (Fin n → Fin m) (Fin n → Fin m → Bool) O) (st : SimState n m),
      st.Good τ c R p → ((m : ℝ) / τ) ^ (#st.J + (sim τ p st).depth) ≤ 4 ^ (st.t + p.depth) := by
  have hτ : 0 < τ := by linarith
  intro p
  induction p with
  | output o =>
    intro st h
    simpa [sim, Protocol.depth] using h.pow_le
  | bob send p₀ p₁ ih₀ ih₁ =>
    intro st h
    have key : ∀ b : Bool, (st.afterBob send).Good τ c R (cond b p₁ p₀) →
        ((m : ℝ) / τ) ^ (#st.J +
          (cond b (sim τ p₁ (st.afterBob send)) (sim τ p₀ (st.afterBob send))).depth) ≤
          4 ^ (st.t + (Protocol.bob send p₀ p₁).depth) := by
      intro b hb'
      have hle : ∀ d, d ≤ (Protocol.bob send p₀ p₁).depth - 1 → (4 : ℝ) ^ (st.t + 1 + d) ≤
          4 ^ (st.t + (Protocol.bob send p₀ p₁).depth) := fun d hd =>
        pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by simp only [Protocol.depth] at hd ⊢; omega)
      cases b
      · exact (ih₀ _ hb').trans (hle _ (by simp [Protocol.depth]))
      · exact (ih₁ _ hb').trans (hle _ (by simp [Protocol.depth]))
    exact key _ (h.bob hτ _ (card_le_two_mul_card_filter_bigHalf _ _))
  | alice send p₀ p₁ ih₀ ih₁ =>
    exact pow_depth_sim_alice hτ4 hτm hτc ih₀ ih₁

theorem exists_decisionTree_of_solves {R : (Fin n → Bool) → O → Prop} {τ : ℝ} (hτ4 : 4 ≤ τ)
    (hτm : τ ^ 2 ≤ m) (hτn : 320 * n ^ 2 * (Nat.log 2 m + 1) ≤ τ)
    {p : Protocol (Fin n → Fin m) (Fin n → Fin m → Bool) O}
    (hp : p.Solves (lift R) Set.univ Set.univ) :
    ∃ t : DecisionTree (Fin n) O,
      (∀ z, R z (t.eval z)) ∧ ((m : ℝ) / τ) ^ t.depth ≤ 4 ^ p.depth := by
  have hτ : 0 < τ := by linarith
  have hτm' : τ ≤ m := by nlinarith
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < m := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hM : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m / τ := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hτ, one_mul]
    exact hτm'
  by_cases hc : ((m : ℝ) / τ) ^ n ≤ 4 ^ p.depth
  · -- the trivial decision tree querying every coordinate
    have htot : ∀ z, ∃ o, R z o := fun z =>
      ⟨_, hp (fun _ => ⟨0, hm⟩) trivial (fun i _ => z i) trivial⟩
    choose f hf using htot
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hdepth⟩ := DecisionTree.exists_computes f
    refine ⟨t, fun z => by rw [ht z]; exact hf z, ?_⟩
    rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hdepth
    exact (pow_le_pow_right₀ hM hdepth).trans hc
  · push Not at hc
    -- the budget is small
    have hτc : 64 * n * (5 * p.depth + 2) ≤ τ :=
      sixtyFour_mul_depth_le_of_four_pow_lt hτ4 hτn hc
    -- the initial state satisfies the invariants
    have hinit : (SimState.init n m).Good τ p.depth R p := by
      refine ⟨univ_nonempty_iff.mpr ⟨fun _ => ⟨0, hm⟩⟩, by simp [SimState.init],
        by simp [SimState.init], by simp [SimState.init], isDense_univ hτ.le hτm' _, ?_, ?_,
        hp.mono (Set.subset_univ _) (Set.subset_univ _), by simp [SimState.init]⟩
      · simp [SimState.init, ← pow_mul, mul_comm]
      · simp [SimState.init]
    refine ⟨sim τ p (SimState.init n m), fun z => eval_sim hτ4 hτm hτc p _ hinit z (by
      simp [SimState.init]), ?_⟩
    simpa [SimState.init] using pow_depth_sim hτ4 hτm hτc p _ hinit

theorem PublicCoin.Solves.exists_privateCoin [Finite X] [Finite Y] {μ : PublicCoin X Y Z}
    {ε δ : ℝ} {c k : ℕ} (hμ : μ.Solves ε R A B) (hc : μ.depth ≤ c) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hk : Nat.card X * Nat.card Y * Real.exp (-2 * δ ^ 2 * 2 ^ k) < 1) :
    ∃ P : PrivateCoin k 0 X Y Z, P.Solves (ε + δ) R A B ∧ P.depth ≤ k + c := by
  classical
  let err : Protocol X Y Z → X × Y → Bool := fun p q => decide (¬R q.1 q.2 (p.run q.1 q.2))
  -- Some choice of `2 ^ k` protocols errs rarely on every pair of inputs.
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hgood⟩ := exists_mem_support_forall_count_lt k hμ hδ hk
  have hchoose (i : BitString k) : ∃ p ∈ μ.support, err p = s i :=
    (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp ((PMF.mem_support_pi_iff _ s).mp hs i)
  choose p hp hps using hchoose
  -- Alice sends her random bits and both run the chosen protocol.
  refine ⟨Protocol.aliceSend k (fun xr => xr.2) fun m => (p m).comap Prod.fst Prod.fst,
    fun x hx y hy => ?_, Protocol.depth_aliceSend_le fun m => ?_⟩
  · have hlt := hgood x hx y hy
    have hcount : (∑ i : BitString k, if s i (x, y) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
        ∑ i : BitString k, if ¬R x y ((p i).run x y) then 1 else 0 := by
      refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [← hps i]
      simp [err]
    rw [PrivateCoin.errorProb, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply_toReal, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [Fintype.sum_unique, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Protocol.run_aliceSend,
      Protocol.run_comap, PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, Fintype.card_prod]
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k := by positivity
    calc _ = (2 ^ k)⁻¹ * ∑ i : BitString k, if s i (x, y) then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
          rw [hcount, mul_sum]
          refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          split_ifs <;> simp
      _ ≤ ε + δ := by
          rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ hpos]
          exact hlt.le
  · have := (PublicCoin.depth_le_depth (hp m)).trans hc
    simpa using this

theorem PrivateCoin.ecomplexity_le_add [Finite X] [Finite Y] {ε δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : Nat.card X * Nat.card Y * Real.exp (-2 * δ ^ 2 * 2 ^ k) < 1) :
    PrivateCoin.ecomplexity (ε + δ) R A B ≤ PublicCoin.ecomplexity ε R A B + k := by
  cases h : PublicCoin.ecomplexity ε R A B using ENat.recTopCoe with
  | top => simp
  | coe c =>
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hc⟩ := PublicCoin.ecomplexity_le_iff.mp h.le
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hd⟩ := hμ.exists_privateCoin hc hδ hk
    refine (PrivateCoin.ecomplexity_le_depth hP).trans ?_
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : P.depth ≤ c + k)

theorem PrivateCoin.ecomplexity_le_add_clog [Finite X] [Finite Y] {n : ℕ}
    (hX : Nat.card X ≤ 2 ^ n) (hY : Nat.card Y ≤ 2 ^ n) {ε δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    PrivateCoin.ecomplexity (ε + δ) R A B ≤
      PublicCoin.ecomplexity ε R A B + Nat.clog 2 ⌈n / δ ^ 2⌉₊ := by
  refine PrivateCoin.ecomplexity_le_add hδ.le ?_
  set T : ℝ := 2 ^ Nat.clog 2 ⌈n / δ ^ 2⌉₊ with hTdef
  have hδ2 : 0 < δ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hT : (n : ℝ) ≤ δ ^ 2 * T := by
    have h₁ : (n : ℝ) / δ ^ 2 ≤ T := (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (by
      rw [hTdef]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.le_pow_clog one_lt_two _)
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hδ2] at h₁
    linarith
  have hTpos : 0 < T := by positivity
  have hcard : (Nat.card X * Nat.card Y : ℝ) ≤ 4 ^ n := by
    have : Nat.card X * Nat.card Y ≤ 4 ^ n := by
      calc Nat.card X * Nat.card Y ≤ 2 ^ n * 2 ^ n := Nat.mul_le_mul hX hY
        _ = 4 ^ n := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hexp : Real.exp (-2 * δ ^ 2 * T) ≤ Real.exp (-2 * n) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  calc (Nat.card X * Nat.card Y : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * δ ^ 2 * T)
      ≤ 4 ^ n * Real.exp (-2 * δ ^ 2 * T) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ < 1 := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
      · have : Real.exp (-2 * δ ^ 2 * T) < 1 :=
          Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [mul_pos hδ2 hTpos])
        simpa using this
      · have : 4 ^ n * Real.exp (-2 * n) < 1 := by
          rw [show (-2 * n : ℝ) = -(2 * n) by ring, Real.exp_neg,
            ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_lt_one (Real.exp_pos _)]
          exact four_pow_lt_exp_two_mul hn
        calc 4 ^ n * Real.exp (-2 * δ ^ 2 * T) ≤ 4 ^ n * Real.exp (-2 * n) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by positivity)
          _ < 1 := this

theorem ecomplexityFun_le_clog_card_succ [Fintype X] (f : X → Y → Bool) :

      ∀ j < E.length, fieldOfBits B ((zs.foldl (esymmStep tab) E).getD j []) =

    _ ≤ 2 * ((N + 1) * (N + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul hlog hlog)
    _ = 2 * (N + 1) * (N + 1) := by ring

    {α : Fin ms.length → F} (hm : Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on ms.get))
    (hE : finrank (ZMod 2) F = ∏ i, ms.get i)
    (hα : ∀ i, (minpoly (ZMod 2) (α i)).natDegree = ms.get i)
    (hR : ∀ i : Fin ms.length, ∀ e < 2 * ms.get i, α i ^ e = ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (ms.get i),
      bitEquiv.symm (((R.getD i []).getD e []).getD d false) • α i ^ d) :
    IsMulTable ((prodPowBasis hm hE hα).reindex finPiFinEquiv) (monomialTable ms R) := by

    fun i e d => bitEquiv.symm (((R.getD i []).getD e []).getD d false)
  have hc : ∀ i, ∀ e < 2 * ms.get i, α i ^ e = ∑ d, c i e d • α i ^ (d : ℕ) := fun i e he => by
    rw [hR i e he, Finset.sum_range (fun d => bitEquiv.symm (((R.getD i []).getD e []).getD d false)

  have hms := Fin.prod_univ_getElem ms
  have hv : (finPiFinEquiv M : ℕ) < ms.prod := (finPiFinEquiv M).2.trans_eq hms
  have hu : (u : ℕ) < ms.prod := u.2.trans_eq hms
  have hw : (w : ℕ) < ms.prod := w.2.trans_eq hms

      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd encBits encNat)

    rcases hx with ⟨y, -, rfl⟩

theorem nat_dist_le_mul_log_two_succ_of_abs_sub_le_mul_logb {v w d n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (h : |(v : ℝ) - (w : ℝ)| ≤ (d : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ)) :
    Nat.dist v w ≤ d * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) := by
  have hdist_real : ((Nat.dist v w : ℕ) : ℝ) = |(v : ℝ) - (w : ℝ)| := by
    rcases le_total v w with hvw | hwv
    · have h1 : Nat.dist v w = w - v := by
        unfold Nat.dist
        omega
      have hvw_real : (v : ℝ) ≤ (w : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hvw
      rw [h1, Nat.cast_sub hvw, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
      ring
    · have h1 : Nat.dist v w = v - w := by
        unfold Nat.dist
        omega
      have hwv_real : (w : ℝ) ≤ (v : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hwv
      rw [h1, Nat.cast_sub hwv, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
  have hlog := real_logb_two_le_nat_log_two_succ hn
  have hle : ((Nat.dist v w : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((d * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [hdist_real, Nat.cast_mul]
    exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (Nat.cast_nonneg d))
  exact_mod_cast hle

theorem MildlyHardOnAverageToApprox.eventually_real_abs_sub_le {d : ℕ} {f : List Bool → ℕ}
    (h : MildlyHardOnAverageToApprox (fun n => d * (Nat.log 2 n + 1)) f) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial ℕ, (∀ n, 0 < p.eval n) ∧
      ∀ H : List Bool → ProbComp ℕ, IsPPTOn encBits encNat H →
        ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
          (((BitString.uniformList n).bind fun x =>
            (ProbComp.eval (H x)).map fun v : ℕ =>
              decide (|(v : ℝ) - (f x : ℝ)| ≤ (d : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ))) true).toReal ≤
            1 - 1 / ((p.eval n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hH⟩ := h
  refine ⟨p, hp, fun H hppt => ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hH H hppt, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hn1
  refine (bind_map_decide_le_of_imp (fun x => ProbComp.eval (H x))
    (fun x v => |(v : ℝ) - (f x : ℝ)| ≤ (d : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ))
    (fun x v => Nat.dist v (f x) ≤ d * (Nat.log 2 n + 1)) ?_).trans hn
  intro x _ v hv
  exact nat_dist_le_mul_log_two_succ_of_abs_sub_le_mul_logb hn1 hv
