theorem mem_AWPP_of_polyTime_exponent {g : α → ℤ} {r : α → ℕ}
    (hg : g ∈ GapP enc) (hr : ComputableInPolyTime r enc encUnary)
    (hA : ∀ a, (0 ≤ g a ∧ g a ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ r a) ∧
      (a ∈ A → 2 * (2 : ℤ) ^ r a ≤ 3 * g a) ∧
      (a ∉ A → 3 * g a ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ r a)) : A ∈ AWPP enc := by
  have hr := hr.tidy
  obtain ⟨p, hle⟩ := hr.polyBounded.exists_polynomial
  have hs : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun a => 2 ^ (p.eval (enc a).length - r a)) enc encNat := by fun_prop
  have hsG := SharpP.natCast_mem_GapP (mem_SharpP_of_polyTime (.of_tidy hs))
  refine ⟨_, GapP.mul_mem hg hsG, p, fun a => ?_⟩
  have he : (2 : ℤ) ^ p.eval (enc a).length =
      (2 : ℤ) ^ r a * (2 : ℤ) ^ (p.eval (enc a).length - r a) := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le (hle a)]
  have hp : 0 ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ (p.eval (enc a).length - r a) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, hy, hn⟩ := hA a
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, he]
  refine ⟨⟨mul_nonneg h0 hp, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hp⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ha
    nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hy ha) hp]
  · intro ha
    nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hn ha) hp]

theorem majorityPolynomial_mem {α : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {g D : α → ℤ}
    {r : α → ℕ} (hg : g ∈ GapP enc) (hD : D ∈ GapP enc)
    (hr : ComputableInPolyTime r enc encUnary) :
    (fun a => majorityPolynomial (g a) (D a) (r a)) ∈ GapP enc := by
  let ones : α × List Bool → ℕ := fun x => x.2.countP id
  have hones : ComputableInPolyTime ones (encPair enc encBits) encUnary := by
    dsimp [ones]
    fun_prop
  have hR : ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : α × List Bool => r x.1)
      (encPair enc encBits) encUnary := hr.comp (.fst enc encBits)
  have hz : ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : α × List Bool => 2 * r x.1 - ones x)
      (encPair enc encBits) encUnary := by fun_prop
  have hg' := GapP.pow_mem_polyTime (GapP.comp_mem hg (.fst enc encBits)) hones
  have hd' := GapP.pow_mem_polyTime (GapP.comp_mem (GapP.sub_mem' hD hg) (.fst enc encBits)) hz
  have htest : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun x : α × List Bool => if r x.1 < ones x then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
      (encPair enc encBits) encNat :=
    .of_tidy (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.ite_decide (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_lt' hR.tidy
      hones.tidy) (.const 1) (.const 0))
  have hweight := GapP.mul_mem (GapP.mul_mem hg' hd')
    (SharpP.natCast_mem_GapP (mem_SharpP_of_polyTime htest))
  have hsum := GapP.sum_bits_mem hweight
    (ComputableInPolyTime.unary_mul.comp ((ComputableInPolyTime.const 2).prod hr))
  convert hsum using 1
  ext a
  unfold majorityPolynomial
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro w _
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Function.comp_apply, Pi.sub_apply, ones]
  split_ifs <;> simp

is a GapP value rather than an efficiently sampleable acceptance count. -/

theorem majorityPolynomial_bounds {g : ℤ} {m e : ℕ}
    (h0 : 0 ≤ g) (h1 : g ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ m) :
    let H := majorityPolynomial g ((2 : ℤ) ^ m) (6 * e)
    let D := (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * (6 * e) * m)
    (0 ≤ H ∧ H ≤ D) ∧
      (2 * (2 : ℤ) ^ m ≤ 3 * g → (2 : ℤ) ^ e * (D - H) ≤ D) ∧
      (3 * g ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ m → (2 : ℤ) ^ e * H ≤ D) := by
  classical
  let V : BitString m → Bool := fun x => decide (BitString.binaryValue (List.ofFn x) < g.toNat)
  have hg : g.toNat ≤ 2 ^ m := by
    rw [Int.toNat_le]
    exact_mod_cast h1
  have hv : #{x | V x = true} = g.toNat := by
    simpa only [V, decide_eq_true_eq] using BitString.card_filter_binaryValue_lt hg
  have htot : #{x | V x = true} + #{x | V x = false} = 2 ^ m := by
    simpa only [Bool.not_eq_true, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin,
      Fintype.card_bool] using card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (BitString m)))
        (fun x => V x = true)
  let M := #{x : BitString (2 * (6 * e) * m) |
    6 * e < #{i | V (BitString.block x i) = true}}
  have hM : (M : ℤ) = majorityPolynomial g ((2 : ℤ) ^ m) (6 * e) := by
    have heq : M = #{x : Fin (2 * (6 * e)) → BitString m |
        6 * e < (List.ofFn fun i => V (x i)).countP id} := by
      apply card_equiv BitString.blocksEquiv
      intro x
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, List.countP_ofFn, card_filter,
        id_eq, BitString.blocksEquiv_apply]
    rw [heq, card_majority_eq]
    have ht : (#{x | V x = true} : ℤ) + #{x | V x = false} = (2 : ℤ) ^ m := by
      exact_mod_cast htot
    rw [ht, hv, Int.toNat_of_nonneg h0]
  have hMle : M ≤ 2 ^ (2 * (6 * e) * m) := by
    exact (card_filter_le _ _).trans (by simp)
  have hcompl : M + #{x : BitString (2 * (6 * e) * m) |
      #{i | V (BitString.block x i) = true} ≤ 6 * e} = 2 ^ (2 * (6 * e) * m) := by
    simpa only [not_lt, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool] using
      card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (BitString (2 * (6 * e) * m))))
        (fun x => 6 * e < #{i | V (BitString.block x i) = true})
  dsimp only
  rw [← hM]
  refine ⟨⟨by positivity, by exact_mod_cast hMle⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hy
    have hv' : 2 * 2 ^ m ≤ 3 * #{x | V x = true} := by
      rw [hv]
      exact_mod_cast (show 2 * (2 : ℤ) ^ m ≤ 3 * (g.toNat : ℤ) by
        simpa only [Int.toNat_of_nonneg h0] using hy)
    have htail := BitString.two_pow_mul_card_filter_card_filter_block_le (e := e) rfl
      (fun x => V x = true) hv'
    have hc : (#{x : BitString (2 * (6 * e) * m) |
        #{i | V (BitString.block x i) = true} ≤ 6 * e} : ℤ) =
        (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * (6 * e) * m) - M := by
      have hc' : (M : ℤ) + (#{x : BitString (2 * (6 * e) * m) |
          #{i | V (BitString.block x i) = true} ≤ 6 * e} : ℤ) =
          (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * (6 * e) * m) := by exact_mod_cast hcompl
      lia
    have htail' : (2 : ℤ) ^ e *
        (#{x : BitString (2 * (6 * e) * m) |
          #{i | V (BitString.block x i) = true} ≤ 6 * e} : ℤ) ≤
        (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * (6 * e) * m) := by exact_mod_cast htail
    rwa [hc] at htail'
  · intro hn
    have hv' : 2 * 2 ^ m ≤ 3 * #{x | V x = false} := by
      have hn' : 3 * g.toNat ≤ 2 ^ m := by
        exact_mod_cast (show 3 * (g.toNat : ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ m by
          simpa only [Int.toNat_of_nonneg h0] using hn)
      lia
    have htail := BitString.two_pow_mul_card_filter_card_filter_block_le (e := e) rfl
      (fun x => V x = false) hv'
    have hsub : M ≤ #{x : BitString (2 * (6 * e) * m) |
        #{i | V (BitString.block x i) = false} ≤ 6 * e} := by
      apply card_le_card
      intro x hx
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hx ⊢
      have hs := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (Fin (2 * (6 * e)))))
        (fun i => V (BitString.block x i) = true)
      simp only [Bool.not_eq_true, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hs
      lia
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 ^ e) hsub).trans htail

/-- A dyadic AWPP witness with exponent `p(n)` amplifies to error `2^(-q(n))` by `12q(n)`
majority trials, with exact denominator exponent `12q(n)p(n)`. The amplified numerator is
uniformly GapP; no efficient sampler for the original numerator is assumed. -/

text:
theorem amplify {α : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {A : Set α}
    {g : α → ℤ} (hg : g ∈ GapP enc) (p q : Polynomial ℕ)
    (hA : ∀ a, (0 ≤ g a ∧ g a ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ p.eval (enc a).length) ∧
      (a ∈ A → 2 * (2 : ℤ) ^ p.eval (enc a).length ≤ 3 * g a) ∧
      (a ∉ A → 3 * g a ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ p.eval (enc a).length)) :
    let G := fun a => majorityPolynomial (g a) ((2 : ℤ) ^ p.eval (enc a).length)
      (6 * q.eval (enc a).length)
    G ∈ GapP enc ∧ ∀ a,
      let D := (2 : ℤ) ^ (12 * q * p).eval (enc a).length
      (0 ≤ G a ∧ G a ≤ D) ∧
        (a ∈ A → (2 : ℤ) ^ q.eval (enc a).length * (D - G a) ≤ D) ∧
        (a ∉ A → (2 : ℤ) ^ q.eval (enc a).length * G a ≤ D) := by
  refine ⟨majorityPolynomial_mem hg (GapP.two_pow_mem p) (.of_tidy (by fun_prop)), fun a => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hb, hy, hn⟩ := hA a
  have h := majorityPolynomial_bounds (e := q.eval (enc a).length) hb.1 hb.2
  have he : (12 * q * p).eval (enc a).length =
      2 * (6 * q.eval (enc a).length) * p.eval (enc a).length := by
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_ofNat]
    ring
  dsimp only
  rw [he]
  exact ⟨h.1, fun ha => h.2.1 (hy ha), fun ha => h.2.2 (hn ha)⟩

theorem exists_AWPP_gap_errorExponent {α : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {A : Set α}
    (hA : A ∈ AWPP enc) (r : α → ℕ)

    Probability.IsOraclePPTOn.exists_fin_run_pure_false hprogram

  have hr : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime r enc encUnary := by dsimp [r]; fun_prop
  have hT : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime T enc encUnary := by dsimp [T]; fun_prop
  let e : α → ℕ := fun a => r a + T a + 4
  have he : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime e enc encUnary := by dsimp [e]; fun_prop

  let R' : α × List Bool → ℕ := fun x => R x.1

    apply GapP.weightedReplay_mem machine
    · dsimp [input]; fun_prop
    · dsimp [T']; fun_prop
    · dsimp [R']; fun_prop
    · exact GapP.comp_mem hH (.of_tidy (by fun_prop))
  let S : α → ℤ := fun a => ∑ w : Fin (r a) → Bool, F (a, List.ofFn w)

theorem exists_AWPP_queryWeights {α : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {A : Set (List Bool)}
    (hA : A ∈ AWPP encBits) {T e : α → ℕ}
    (hT : ComputableInPolyTime T enc encUnary)
    (he : ComputableInPolyTime e enc encUnary) :
    ∃ H ∈ GapP (encPair enc encBits), ∃ R : α → ℕ,
      ComputableInPolyTime R enc encUnary ∧ ∀ a w,
        let D := (2 : ℤ) ^ R a
        (0 ≤ H (a, w) ∧ H (a, w) ≤ D) ∧
          (w.take (T a) ∈ A → (2 : ℤ) ^ e a * (D - H (a, w)) ≤ D) ∧
          (w.take (T a) ∉ A → (2 : ℤ) ^ e a * H (a, w) ≤ D) := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, p, hA⟩ := hA
  let query : α × List Bool → List Bool := fun x => x.2.take (T x.1)
  have hquery : ComputableInPolyTime query (encPair enc encBits) encBits := by
    dsimp [query]
    fun_prop
  have he' : ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : α × List Bool => e x.1)
      (encPair enc encBits) encUnary := he.comp (.fst enc encBits)
  let H₀ : α × List Bool → ℤ := fun x => AWPPAmplification.majorityPolynomial
    (g (query x)) ((2 : ℤ) ^ p.eval (query x).length) (6 * e x.1)
  have hH₀ : H₀ ∈ GapP (encPair enc encBits) := by
    apply AWPPAmplification.majorityPolynomial_mem (GapP.comp_mem hg hquery)
    · simpa only [Function.comp_def, encBits_apply] using
        GapP.comp_mem (GapP.two_pow_mem (enc := encBits) p) hquery
    · fun_prop
  let padding : α × List Bool → ℕ := fun x =>
    12 * e x.1 * (p.eval (T x.1) - p.eval (query x).length)
  have hpadding : ComputableInPolyTime padding (encPair enc encBits) encUnary := by
    dsimp [padding]
    fun_prop
  have hpow : ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => 2 ^ padding x)
      (encPair enc encBits) encNat := by fun_prop
  let H : α × List Bool → ℤ := fun x => H₀ x * (2 : ℤ) ^ padding x
  have hH : H ∈ GapP (encPair enc encBits) := by
    convert GapP.mul_mem hH₀
      (SharpP.natCast_mem_GapP (mem_SharpP_of_polyTime hpow)) using 1
    ext x
    simp [H]
  refine ⟨H, hH, fun a => 12 * e a * p.eval (T a), by fun_prop, fun a w => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hb, hy, hn⟩ := hA (query (a, w))
  simp only [encBits_apply] at hb hy hn
  obtain ⟨hb', hy', hn'⟩ := AWPPAmplification.majorityPolynomial_bounds
    (e := e a) hb.1 hb.2
  let d : ℤ := 2 ^ (2 * (6 * e a) * p.eval (query (a, w)).length)
  let P : ℤ := 2 ^ padding (a, w)
  have hP : 0 ≤ P := by dsimp [P]; positivity
  have hD : (2 : ℤ) ^ (12 * e a * p.eval (T a)) = d * P := by
    dsimp [d, P, padding]
    rw [← pow_add]
    congr 1
    have hlen : p.eval (query (a, w)).length ≤ p.eval (T a) :=
      p.eval_mono (List.length_take_le _ _)
    calc
      12 * e a * p.eval (T a) =
          12 * e a * (p.eval (query (a, w)).length +
            (p.eval (T a) - p.eval (query (a, w)).length)) := by
        rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hlen]
      _ = _ := by ring
  change (0 ≤ H₀ (a, w) * P ∧ H₀ (a, w) * P ≤ _) ∧ _
  rw [hD]
  refine ⟨⟨mul_nonneg hb'.1 hP, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb'.2 hP⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ha
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hy' (hy ha)) hP
    change (2 : ℤ) ^ e a * (d * P - H₀ (a, w) * P) ≤ d * P
    calc
      (2 : ℤ) ^ e a * (d * P - H₀ (a, w) * P) =
          ((2 : ℤ) ^ e a * (d - H₀ (a, w))) * P := by ring
      _ ≤ d * P := h
  · intro ha
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hn' (hn ha)) hP
    change (2 : ℤ) ^ e a * (H₀ (a, w) * P) ≤ d * P
    calc
      (2 : ℤ) ^ e a * (H₀ (a, w) * P) = ((2 : ℤ) ^ e a * H₀ (a, w)) * P :=
        (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ d * P := h

theorem WPP_subset_AWPP : WPP enc ⊆ AWPP enc := by
  rintro A ⟨g, hg, f, hf, hf0, hrange, hA⟩
  let k a := (f a * f a).toNat
  have hk : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime k enc encNat :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.intBin_toNat.comp (hf.tidy.intBin_mul' hf.tidy)
  let r a := (encNat (k a)).length
  have hr : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime r enc encUnary :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length encNat).comp hk
  let D a : ℤ := 2 ^ r a
  have hD : D ∈ GapP enc := by
    have := SharpP.natCast_mem_GapP
      (mem_SharpP_of_polyTime (.of_tidy (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.binary_two_pow.comp hr)))
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, D] using this
  let G := g * g
  have hG : G ∈ GapP enc := GapP.mul_mem hg hg
  have hnum := GapP.sub_mem' (GapP.add_mem (GapP.mul_mem hG hD) (GapP.mul_mem hG hD))
    (GapP.mul_mem hG hG)
  refine mem_AWPP_of_polyTime_exponent hnum
    (.of_tidy (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_add.comp (hr.prod hr))) (fun a => ?_)
  have hkcast : (k a : ℤ) = f a * f a := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (mul_self_nonneg _)
  have hkpos : 0 < k a := by
    have := mul_self_pos.mpr (hf0 a)
    lia
  have hrs : r a = (k a).size := by simp [r, encNat_apply, Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
  have hlow : (2 : ℤ) ^ r a ≤ 2 * (k a : ℤ) := by
    have hs := Nat.size_pos.mpr hkpos
    have hl := Nat.lt_size.mp (show (k a).size - 1 < (k a).size by lia)
    have he : 2 ^ (k a).size = 2 * 2 ^ ((k a).size - 1) := by
      rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel hs]
    rw [hrs]
    exact_mod_cast (show 2 ^ (k a).size ≤ 2 * k a by lia)
  have hupp : (k a : ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ r a := by
    rw [hrs]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_size_self (k a)).le
  have hDpos : 0 < D a := by dsimp [D]; positivity
  change (0 ≤ G a * D a + G a * D a - G a * G a ∧ _) ∧ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, pow_add]
  change (0 ≤ G a * D a + G a * D a - G a * G a ∧
      G a * D a + G a * D a - G a * G a ≤ D a * D a) ∧
    (a ∈ A → 2 * (D a * D a) ≤ 3 * (G a * D a + G a * D a - G a * G a)) ∧
    (a ∉ A → 3 * (G a * D a + G a * D a - G a * G a) ≤ D a * D a)
  change D a ≤ 2 * (k a : ℤ) at hlow
  change (k a : ℤ) ≤ D a at hupp
  rcases hrange a with hz | ht
  · have hn : a ∉ A := by rw [hA a, hz]; exact (hf0 a).symm
    have hG0 : G a = 0 := by simp [G, hz]
    simp [hG0, hn, mul_self_nonneg]
  · have hy : a ∈ A := (hA a).mpr ht
    have hGk : G a = (k a : ℤ) := by simp [G, ht, hkcast]
    rw [hGk]
    have hk0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k a := by positivity
    have hsq := sq_nonneg (D a - (k a : ℤ))
    have hprod := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 2 * (k a : ℤ) - D a by lia)
      (show 0 ≤ D a - (k a : ℤ) by lia)
    have hmul := mul_nonneg hk0 (show 0 ≤ D a - (k a : ℤ) by lia)
    constructor
    · constructor <;> nlinarith
    · constructor
      · intro _
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (k a : ℤ)]
      · exact fun hn => False.elim (hn hy)

theorem guessVerify_spec {L t₁ t₂ : ℕ} {V : List Bool → Bool}
    (hprep : prep.runFrom (Cfg.init prep.q₀ input) t₁ = wordsCfg input none
      (Function.update (fun _ => []) B (frame (List.replicate L true) ++ input)) [])
    (hverify : ∀ z : List Bool, z.length = L →
      (verify.runFrom (wordsCfg input (some verify.q₀)
        (Function.update (fun _ => []) B (frame z ++ input)) []) t₂).state = none ∧
      (verify.runFrom (wordsCfg input (some verify.q₀)
        (Function.update (fun _ => []) B (frame z ++ input)) []) t₂).output = [V z]) :
    ∃ T ≤ t₁ + (4 * L + 3 + t₂),
      (guessVerify B prep verify).HaltsWithin T
        ((guessVerify B prep verify).toPTM.toNTM.initCfg input) ∧
      ((guessVerify B prep verify).AcceptsWithin T
        ((guessVerify B prep verify).toPTM.toNTM.initCfg input) ↔
        Cslib.Complexity.Alternation true (List.replicate L 1) fun z => V z = true) := by
  obtain ⟨u, hut, hu⟩ := exists_haltsAt (tm := prep) (cfg := Cfg.init prep.q₀ input)
    (t := t₁) (by rw [hprep]; rfl)
  obtain ⟨hdet, hstart⟩ := GuessVerify.prepare_spec (S₁ := S₁) (verify := verify) hu
    ((hu.runFrom_eq hut).symm.trans hprep)
  have hguess (zd : List Bool) (hzd : zd = []) (pos : ℕ) (hpos : pos = 2 * zd.length) :
      GuessVerify.cfg (input := input) (State := GuessState) B (some (.tag false))
        (frame (List.replicate L true) ++ input) 0 =
      GuessVerify.cfg B (some (.tag false)) (frame (zd ++ List.replicate L true) ++ input) pos := by
    subst hzd hpos
    rfl
  have hpos (z : List Bool) : 2 * ([] ++ z).length ≤ (frame z ++ input).length := by
    simpa using two_mul_length_le_length_frame_append z input
  refine ⟨u + (2 * L + 1 + (2 * L + 2 + t₂)), by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [haltsWithin_add_iff_of_next_eq hdet, hstart, hguess [] rfl _ rfl,
      GuessVerify.haltsWithin_lift_tag]
    intro z hz
    have := GuessVerify.haltsWithin_lift_none (S₁ := S₁) (prep := prep) (hpos z)
      (hverify z hz).1
    simp only [List.nil_append, List.length_nil, zero_add] at this ⊢
    rwa [hz] at this
  · rw [acceptsWithin_add_iff_of_next_eq hdet, hstart, hguess [] rfl _ rfl,
      GuessVerify.acceptsWithin_lift_tag, Bool.not_false]
    refine Cslib.Complexity.alternation_congr_of_length fun z hz => ?_
    rw [Cslib.Complexity.sum_replicate_one] at hz
    have := GuessVerify.acceptsWithin_lift_none (S₁ := S₁) (prep := prep) (hpos z)
      (hverify z hz).1
    simp only [List.nil_append, List.length_nil, zero_add, hz] at this ⊢
    rw [this, (hverify z hz).2]
    simp

  have hL : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime L enc encUnary :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_mul.comp ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 2).prod
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval p).comp
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc)))
  set g : α → List Bool := fun a => frame (List.replicate (L a) true) ++ enc a with hg_def
  have hg : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime g enc encBits :=
    (((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsReplicate true).comp hL).prod
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.of_eq (encMid := enc) fun _ => rfl)).encoded
  have hLb : PolyBounded (fun a => (enc a).length) L := hL.polyBounded
  have hgl : PolyBounded (fun a => (enc a).length) fun a => (g a).length :=
    hg.polyBounded_length
  have hV' : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool × α => V (x.2, x.1))
      (encPair encBits enc) encBool :=
    hV.comp ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd encBits enc).prod
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst encBits enc))
  obtain ⟨tg, sg, htg, -, k₁, S₁, _, Tg, hTg⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨tv, sv, htv, -, k₂, S₂, _, Tv, hTv⟩ := hV'
  obtain ⟨cv, dv, htv⟩ := htv.exists_le
  -- the machine
  have hk₁ : k₁ + 1 ≤ k₁ + 1 + (k₂ + 2) := by omega
  have hk₂ : k₂ + 2 ≤ k₁ + 1 + (k₂ + 2) := by omega
  let B : Fin (k₁ + 1 + (k₂ + 2)) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let prep := Tg.outputToWord.extendTapes (placeAt hk₁ (Fin.last k₁) B)
  let verify := (Tv.inputFromWord true).extendTapes (placeAt hk₂ (Fin.natAdd k₂ 0) B)
  -- the time bound
  let t₂ : α → ℕ := fun a => cv * ((g a).length + 1) ^ dv + 4
  let t : α → ℕ := fun a => tg a + (g a).length + 2 + (4 * L a + 3 + t₂ a)

    rw [Cfg.init_eq_wordsCfg]
    exact hrun
  have hverify (a : α) (z : List Bool) (hz : z.length = L a) :
      (verify.runFrom (wordsCfg (enc a) (some verify.q₀)
        (Function.update (fun _ => []) B (frame z ++ enc a)) []) (t₂ a)).state = none ∧
      (verify.runFrom (wordsCfg (enc a) (some verify.q₀)
        (Function.update (fun _ => []) B (frame z ++ enc a)) []) (t₂ a)).output = [V (a, z)] := by
    have hlen : (encPair encBits enc (z, a)).length = (g a).length := by
      simp [hg_def, hz]
    obtain ⟨ws, em, hrun, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, -⟩ := transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mp
      (((hTv (z, a)).inputFromWord_extendTapes true
        (placeAt_self hk₂ (Fin.natAdd k₂ 0) B)).mono

    fun a => ?_⟩

        MultiTapeNTM.acceptCode (ntm.codeWidth c d (enc x.1)), x.2))

    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.polyBounded (by fun_prop)) fun x s => by

private theorem exists_truncated_verifier {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {f : α → β}
    (hf : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime f enc encB) (p₁ p₂ : Polynomial ℕ)
    {V : β × List Bool → Bool}
    (hV : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime V (encPair encB encBits) encBool) :
    ∃ (P₁ P₂ : Polynomial ℕ) (V' : α × List Bool → Bool),
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime V' (encPair enc encBits) encBool ∧
      (∀ a, p₁.eval (encB (f a)).length ≤ P₁.eval (enc a).length) ∧
      (∀ a, p₂.eval (encB (f a)).length ≤ P₂.eval (enc a).length) ∧
      ∀ (a : α) (u : Fin (P₁.eval (enc a).length) → Bool)
        (v : Fin (P₂.eval (enc a).length) → Bool),
        V' (a, List.ofFn u ++ List.ofFn v) =
          V (f a, (List.ofFn u).take (p₁.eval (encB (f a)).length) ++
            (List.ofFn v).take (p₂.eval (encB (f a)).length)) := by
  have hp₁ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => p₁.eval (encB (f a)).length) enc encUnary :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval p₁).comp
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length encB).comp hf)
  have hp₂ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => p₂.eval (encB (f a)).length) enc encUnary :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval p₂).comp
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length encB).comp hf)
  obtain ⟨P₁, hP₁⟩ := hp₁.polyBounded.exists_polynomial
  obtain ⟨P₂, hP₂⟩ := hp₂.polyBounded.exists_polynomial
  have hP₁u : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => P₁.eval (enc a).length) enc encUnary :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval P₁).comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc)
  refine ⟨P₁, P₂, fun x => V (f x.1, x.2.take (p₁.eval (encB (f x.1)).length) ++
      (x.2.drop (P₁.eval (enc x.1).length)).take (p₂.eval (encB (f x.1)).length)),
    hV.comp ((hf.comp (.fst enc encBits)).prod
      (.bitsAppend (.bitsTakeWithInput (.snd enc encBits) (hp₁.comp (.fst enc encBits)))
        (.bitsTakeWithInput (.bitsDropWithInput (.snd enc encBits) (hP₁u.comp (.fst enc encBits)))
          (hp₂.comp (.fst enc encBits))))),
    hP₁, hP₂, fun a u v => ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by simpa using hP₁ a), List.drop_left' List.length_ofFn]

theorem PolyTimeReducible.mem_MA {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {B : Set β}
    (h : PolyTimeReducible enc encB A B) (hB : B ∈ MA encB) : A ∈ MA enc := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hAB⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨q, p, V, hV, hVB⟩ := hB
  obtain ⟨Q, P, V', hV', hQe, hPe, hsplit⟩ := exists_truncated_verifier hf.tidy q p hV.tidy
  refine ⟨Q, P, V', .of_tidy hV', fun a => ?_⟩
  simp only [hsplit]
  constructor
  · intro ha
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (hVB (f a)).1 ((hAB a).1 ha)
    refine ⟨BitString.ofList _ (List.ofFn y), ?_⟩
    rw [BitString.take_ofFn_ofList (hQe a)]
    exact two_mul_two_pow_le_card_filter_take (hPe a)
      (fun w => V (f a, List.ofFn y ++ w) = true) hy
  · intro ha y
    have hy := (hVB (f a)).2 (fun hb => ha ((hAB a).2 hb))
      (BitString.ofList _ ((List.ofFn y).take (q.eval (encB (f a)).length)))
    rw [BitString.ofFn_ofList (by simp [hQe a])] at hy
    exact two_mul_two_pow_le_card_filter_take (hPe a)
      (fun w => V (f a, (List.ofFn y).take (q.eval (encB (f a)).length) ++ w) = false) hy

theorem IsMerlinArthurVerifier.repeatMajority {q p : Polynomial ℕ} {V : α × List Bool → Bool}
    (h : IsMerlinArthurVerifier enc q p V A) (e : Polynomial ℕ) :
    IsMerlinArthurVerifierWithErrorExponent enc e q (12 * e * p)
      (merlinArthurRepeat enc q (6 * e) p V) A := by
  intro a
  have hlen : (12 * e * p).eval (enc a).length =
      2 * (6 * e).eval (enc a).length * p.eval (enc a).length := by
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_ofNat]
    ring
  have hR : (6 * e).eval (enc a).length = 6 * e.eval (enc a).length := by simp
  rw [hlen]
  constructor
  · -- on a member, the good proof is rejected only when at most `R` runs accept
    intro ha
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (h a).1 ha
    refine ⟨y, (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (card_le_card fun x hx => ?_)).trans
      (BitString.two_pow_mul_card_filter_card_filter_block_le hR
        (fun s => V (a, List.ofFn y ++ List.ofFn s) = true) hy)⟩
    rw [mem_filter, merlinArthurRepeat_ofFn_append_ofFn, decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_lt] at hx
    exact mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, hx.2⟩
  · -- on a non-member, every proof is accepted only when at most `R` runs reject
    intro ha y
    refine (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (card_le_card fun x hx => ?_)).trans
      (BitString.two_pow_mul_card_filter_card_filter_block_le hR
        (fun s => V (a, List.ofFn y ++ List.ofFn s) = false) ((h a).2 ha y))
    rw [mem_filter, merlinArthurRepeat_ofFn_append_ofFn, decide_eq_true_iff] at hx
    have hsum := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (Fin (2 *
      (6 * e).eval (enc a).length))))
      fun i => V (a, List.ofFn y ++ List.ofFn (BitString.block x i)) = true
    simp only [Bool.not_eq_true, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hsum
    refine mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    omega

/-! ### `MA ⊆ AM` -/

/-- If every `y : BitString Q` accepts at most a `2 ^ -(Q + 2)` fraction of `r : BitString P`, then
at most a quarter of `r : BitString P` have some accepted `y`. -/

text:
private theorem four_mul_card_filter_not_forall_eq_false_le {P Q : ℕ}
    {f : BitString Q → BitString P → Bool}
    (hf : ∀ y, 2 ^ (Q + 2) * #{r : BitString P | f y r = true} ≤ 2 ^ P) :
    4 * #{r : BitString P | ¬∀ y, f y r = false} ≤ 2 ^ P := by
  have hunion : #{r : BitString P | ¬∀ y, f y r = false} ≤
      ∑ y : BitString Q, #{r : BitString P | f y r = true} := by
    refine (card_le_card fun r hr => ?_).trans card_biUnion_le
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := not_forall.1 (mem_filter.1 hr).2
    exact mem_biUnion.2 ⟨y, mem_univ _, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, by simpa using hy⟩⟩
  have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ Q := by positivity
  refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ hpos
  calc 2 ^ Q * (4 * #{r : BitString P | ¬∀ y, f y r = false})
      ≤ 2 ^ (Q + 2) * ∑ y : BitString Q, #{r : BitString P | f y r = true} := by
        rw [pow_add, mul_assoc]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hunion)
    _ = ∑ y : BitString Q, 2 ^ (Q + 2) * #{r : BitString P | f y r = true} := mul_sum _ _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _y : BitString Q, 2 ^ P := sum_le_sum fun y _ => hf y
    _ = 2 ^ Q * 2 ^ P := by rw [sum_const, card_univ, smul_eq_mul, BitString.card]

/-- **`MA ⊆ AM`** [Babai][Babai1985], [Arora and Barak, Section 8.2][AroraBarak09]. Reduce the
error of a Merlin–Arthur verifier with proofs of `q(n)` bits below `2 ^ (-q(n) - 2)` and let
Arthur send his coins first: on a member the good proof still answers three quarters of the random
strings, and on a non-member, by the union bound over the `2 ^ q(n)` proofs, at most a quarter of
the random strings have an accepted reply. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem MA_subset_AM : MA enc ⊆ AM enc := by
  rintro A ⟨q, p, V, hV, h⟩
  have h' := h.repeatMajority (q + 2)
  set W := merlinArthurRepeat enc q (6 * (q + 2)) p V with hW
  set P : Polynomial ℕ := 12 * (q + 2) * p with hP
  have hPu : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => P.eval (enc a).length) enc encUnary :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval P).comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc)
  refine ⟨P, q, fun x => W (x.1, x.2.drop (P.eval (enc x.1).length) ++
    x.2.take (P.eval (enc x.1).length)), ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
  · exact .of_tidy <| (computableInPolyTime_merlinArthurRepeat hV _ _ _).tidy.comp
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst enc encBits).prod
        (.bitsAppend (.bitsDropWithInput (.snd enc encBits) (hPu.comp (.fst enc encBits)))
          (.bitsTakeWithInput (.snd enc encBits) (hPu.comp (.fst enc encBits)))))
  have hswap (r : Fin (P.eval (enc a).length) → Bool) (y : Fin (q.eval (enc a).length) → Bool) :
      (List.ofFn r ++ List.ofFn y).drop (P.eval (enc a).length) ++
          (List.ofFn r ++ List.ofFn y).take (P.eval (enc a).length) =
        List.ofFn y ++ List.ofFn r := by
    rw [List.drop_left' List.length_ofFn, List.take_left' List.length_ofFn]
  simp only [hswap]
  have h4 : 4 ≤ 2 ^ (q + 2).eval (enc a).length := by
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_ofNat, pow_add]
    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity)
  constructor
  · -- the good proof answers all but a quarter of the random strings
    intro ha
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (h' a).1 ha
    refine BitString.two_mul_two_pow_le_of_four_mul_card_filter_not_le _ ?_
    have hsub : #{r : Fin (P.eval (enc a).length) → Bool |
          ¬∃ y' : Fin (q.eval (enc a).length) → Bool, W (a, List.ofFn y' ++ List.ofFn r) = true} ≤
        #{r : Fin (P.eval (enc a).length) → Bool | W (a, List.ofFn y ++ List.ofFn r) = false} :=
      card_le_card fun r hr => mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, by
        simpa using (not_exists.1 (mem_filter.1 hr).2) y⟩
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 hsub).trans ((Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h4).trans hy)
  · -- by the union bound, at most a quarter of the random strings have an accepted reply
    intro ha
    refine BitString.two_mul_two_pow_le_of_four_mul_card_filter_not_le _ ?_
    exact four_mul_card_filter_not_forall_eq_false_le fun y => by
      simpa [Polynomial.eval_add] using (h' a).2 ha y

theorem NP_subset_AM : NP enc ⊆ AM enc := NP_subset_MA.trans MA_subset_AM

/-- If some proof `y : BitString Q` fails on at most a `2 ^ -(Q + 2)` fraction of random strings,
then four times the total accepted pairs is at least `3 * 2 ^ P`. -/

text:
private theorem three_mul_two_pow_le_four_mul_sum {P Q : ℕ} (W : α × List Bool → Bool) (a : α)
    (y : BitString Q)
    (hy : 2 ^ (Q + 2) * #{r : BitString P | W (a, List.ofFn y ++ List.ofFn r) = false} ≤ 2 ^ P) :
    3 * 2 ^ P ≤ 4 * ∑ u : BitString Q, acceptCount (fun x => W (x.1, List.ofFn u ++ x.2)) a P := by
  have hsum : acceptCount (fun x => W (x.1, List.ofFn y ++ x.2)) a P +
      #{r : BitString P | W (a, List.ofFn y ++ List.ofFn r) = false} = 2 ^ P :=
    acceptCount_add_card_filter_eq_false
      (V := fun x => W (x.1, List.ofFn y ++ x.2)) (a := a) (n := P)
  have hle := single_le_sum (f := fun u : BitString Q =>
    acceptCount (fun x => W (x.1, List.ofFn u ++ x.2)) a P)
    (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (mem_univ y)
  have hbad : 4 * #{r : BitString P | W (a, List.ofFn y ++ List.ofFn r) = false} ≤ 2 ^ P :=
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _
      (by rw [pow_add]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity))).trans hy
  omega

/-- If each of the `2 ^ Q` proofs is accepted on at most `2 ^ (P - (Q + 2))` random strings, then
twice four times the total accepted pairs is strictly below `3 * 2 ^ P`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem MA_subset_SBP : MA enc ⊆ SBP enc := by
  rintro A ⟨q, p, V, hV, h⟩
  have h' := h.repeatMajority (q + 2)
  set W := merlinArthurRepeat enc q (6 * (q + 2)) p V with hW
  set P : Polynomial ℕ := 12 * (q + 2) * p with hP
  have hf : (fun a => acceptCount W a ((q + P).eval (enc a).length)) ∈ SharpP enc :=
    ⟨q + P, W, (computableInPolyTime_merlinArthurRepeat hV _ _ _), fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hd : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => 2 ^ P.eval (enc a).length) enc encNat :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.binary_two_pow.comp
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval P).comp (.encoding_length enc))
  refine ⟨_, SharpP.mul_mem (SharpP.natCast_mem 4) hf, fun a => 3 * 2 ^ P.eval (enc a).length,
    .of_tidy ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 3).binary_mul' hd), fun a => ?_⟩
  change (a ∈ A → 3 * 2 ^ P.eval (enc a).length ≤
      4 * acceptCount W a ((q + P).eval (enc a).length)) ∧
    (a ∉ A → 2 * (4 * acceptCount W a ((q + P).eval (enc a).length)) <
      3 * 2 ^ P.eval (enc a).length)
  rw [Polynomial.eval_add, acceptCount_add]
  constructor
  · -- the good proof alone is accepted with three quarters of the random strings
    intro ha
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (h' a).1 ha
    rw [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_ofNat] at hy
    exact three_mul_two_pow_le_four_mul_sum W a y hy
  · -- all proofs together are accepted with at most a quarter of the random strings
    intro ha
    refine two_mul_four_mul_sum_lt
      (f := fun u : Fin (q.eval (enc a).length) → Bool =>
        acceptCount (fun x => W (x.1, List.ofFn u ++ x.2)) a (P.eval (enc a).length))
      fun u => ?_
    simpa only [acceptCount, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_ofNat] using (h' a).2 ha u

private theorem computableInPolyTime_existsAMVerifier {VB : (α × List Bool) × List Bool → Bool}
    (hVB : ComputableInPolyTime VB (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encBits) encBool)
    (P p : Polynomial ℕ) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : α × List Bool => VB ((x.1,
      (x.2.drop (P.eval (enc x.1).length)).take (p.eval (enc x.1).length)),
      x.2.take (P.eval (enc x.1).length) ++
        x.2.drop (P.eval (enc x.1).length + p.eval (enc x.1).length)))
      (encPair enc encBits) encBool := by
  have hP : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x : α × List Bool => P.eval (enc x.1).length)
      (encPair enc encBits) encUnary :=
    ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval _).comp
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc)).comp (.fst _ _)
  have hp : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x : α × List Bool => p.eval (enc x.1).length)
      (encPair enc encBits) encUnary :=
    ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval _).comp
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc)).comp (.fst _ _)
  exact .of_tidy <| hVB.tidy.comp (((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).prod
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsTakeWithInput
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsDropWithInput (.snd _ _) hP) hp)).prod
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsAppend
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsTakeWithInput (.snd _ _) hP)
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsDropWithInput (.snd _ _)
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_add.comp (hP.prod hp)))))

/-- On `List.ofFn r ++ List.ofFn y`, the existential `AM` verifier extracts the first component of
`y` as the word and passes `r` followed by the second component of `y` to `VB`. -/

private theorem four_mul_card_filter_not_exists_word_le {P W Q E : ℕ}
    {f : BitString W → BitString P → BitString Q → Bool} (w : BitString W)
    (hw : 2 ^ (E + 2) * #{r : BitString P | ∀ y, f w r y = false} ≤ 2 ^ P) :
    4 * #{r : BitString P | ¬∃ y : BitString (W + Q),
      f ((Fin.appendEquiv W Q).symm y).1 r ((Fin.appendEquiv W Q).symm y).2 = true} ≤ 2 ^ P := by
  have h4 : 4 ≤ 2 ^ (E + 2) := by
    rw [pow_add]
    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity)
  refine (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 (card_le_card fun r hr => ?_)).trans
    ((Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h4).trans hw)
  rw [mem_filter] at hr ⊢
  refine ⟨mem_univ _, fun y => ?_⟩
  simpa [Fin.appendEquiv] using not_exists.1 hr.2 (Fin.append w y)

soundness. -/

private theorem four_mul_card_filter_exists_word_le {P W Q E : ℕ}
    {f : BitString W → BitString P → BitString Q → Bool} (hWE : W ≤ E)
    (hf : ∀ w, 2 ^ (E + 2) * #{r : BitString P | ∃ y, f w r y = true} ≤ 2 ^ P) :
    4 * #{r : BitString P | ¬∀ y : BitString (W + Q),
      f ((Fin.appendEquiv W Q).symm y).1 r ((Fin.appendEquiv W Q).symm y).2 = false} ≤ 2 ^ P := by
  have hunion : #{r : BitString P | ¬∀ y : BitString (W + Q),
      f ((Fin.appendEquiv W Q).symm y).1 r ((Fin.appendEquiv W Q).symm y).2 = false} ≤
      ∑ w : BitString W, #{r : BitString P | ∃ y, f w r y = true} := by
    refine (card_le_card fun r hr => ?_).trans card_biUnion_le
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := not_forall.1 (mem_filter.1 hr).2
    exact mem_biUnion.2 ⟨_, mem_univ _, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, _, by simpa using hy⟩⟩
  have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ W := by positivity
  refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ hpos
  have h4 : 2 ^ W * 4 ≤ 2 ^ (E + 2) := by
    rw [pow_add]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hWE)
  calc 2 ^ W * (4 * #{r : BitString P | ¬∀ y : BitString (W + Q),
        f ((Fin.appendEquiv W Q).symm y).1 r ((Fin.appendEquiv W Q).symm y).2 = false})
      ≤ 2 ^ (E + 2) * ∑ w : BitString W, #{r : BitString P | ∃ y, f w r y = true} := by
        rw [← mul_assoc]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul h4 hunion
    _ = ∑ w : BitString W, 2 ^ (E + 2) * #{r : BitString P | ∃ y, f w r y = true} :=
        mul_sum _ _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _w : BitString W, 2 ^ P := sum_le_sum fun w _ => hf w
    _ = 2 ^ W * 2 ^ P := by rw [sum_const, card_univ, smul_eq_mul, BitString.card]

theorem mem_AM_of_exists {B : Set (α × List Bool)} (hB : B ∈ AM (encPair enc encBits))
    (p : Polynomial ℕ) :
    {a | ∃ w : List Bool, w.length = p.eval (enc a).length ∧ (a, w) ∈ B} ∈ AM enc := by
  obtain ⟨pB, qB, VB, hVB, hB'⟩ := mem_AM_iff_forall_errorExponent.mp hB (Polynomial.X + 2)
  -- the length of the encoded pair of an instance and a word of length `p(n)`
  set L : Polynomial ℕ := 2 * Polynomial.X + 1 + p with hLdef
  have hL (a : α) (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = p.eval (enc a).length) :
      (encPair enc encBits (a, w)).length = L.eval (enc a).length := by
    simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply, hw, hLdef, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_one, Polynomial.eval_ofNat]
  refine ⟨pB.comp L, p + qB.comp L, fun x => VB ((x.1,
      (x.2.drop ((pB.comp L).eval (enc x.1).length)).take (p.eval (enc x.1).length)),
      x.2.take ((pB.comp L).eval (enc x.1).length) ++
        x.2.drop ((pB.comp L).eval (enc x.1).length + p.eval (enc x.1).length)),
      computableInPolyTime_existsAMVerifier hVB (pB.comp L) p, fun a => ?_⟩
  -- the verifier reads the word and runs the verifier of the pairs
  rw [Polynomial.eval_add]
  simp only [existsAMVerifier_ofFn_append]
  -- the error bounds of the pairs, at the length of the encoded instance
  have herr (w : BitString (p.eval (enc a).length)) := by
    have h := hB' (a, List.ofFn w)
    rw [hL a _ List.length_ofFn,
      show (Polynomial.X + 2 : Polynomial ℕ).eval (L.eval (enc a).length) =
        L.eval (enc a).length + 2 by simp] at h
    exact h
  rw [Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_comp]
  constructor
  · -- a good word leaves a quarter of the random strings without an accepted answer
    rintro ⟨w, hw, hmem⟩
    refine BitString.two_mul_two_pow_le_of_four_mul_card_filter_not_le _ ?_
    have hw' : List.ofFn (BitString.ofList _ w) = w := BitString.ofFn_ofList hw
    exact four_mul_card_filter_not_exists_word_le
      (f := fun w r y => VB ((a, List.ofFn w), List.ofFn r ++ List.ofFn y))
      (BitString.ofList _ w) ((herr (BitString.ofList _ w)).1 (by rwa [hw']))
  · -- by the union bound over the words, a quarter of the random strings have an accepted answer
    intro ha
    refine BitString.two_mul_two_pow_le_of_four_mul_card_filter_not_le _ ?_
    exact four_mul_card_filter_exists_word_le
      (f := fun w r y => VB ((a, List.ofFn w), List.ofFn r ++ List.ofFn y))
      (E := L.eval (enc a).length) (by simp [hLdef])
      fun w => (herr w).2 fun hw => ha ⟨_, List.length_ofFn, hw⟩

            (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst encGraph encGraph))))

    (computableInPolyTime_test N) (.of_tidy hK) (fun a => by positivity) (fun a ha => ?_)
    fun a ha => ?_

    · rw [card_certifiedSet_eq_card_pairs_union h, card_pairs_union,

      have hset : certifiedSet (encPair encGraph encGraph) N c (test N) (G₀, G₁) = univ := by
        refine filter_true_of_mem fun x _ => ⟨fun _ => false, ?_⟩
        simp only [test, h, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, decide_true, Bool.true_or]
      have hlen' := length_distinctVertices_mul_le G₀ G₁
      rw [hset, card_univ, BitString.card, show N.eval (encPair encGraph encGraph (G₀, G₁)).length =
        2 * (encPair encGraph encGraph (G₀, G₁)).length ^ 2 + 1 by
          simp only [hN, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow,
            Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_one, Polynomial.eval_ofNat], pow_succ]
      have hfac : G₀.distinctVertices.length.factorial ≤
          2 ^ (2 * (encPair encGraph encGraph (G₀, G₁)).length ^ 2) :=
        (Nat.factorial_le_pow _).trans
          (((Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le _).trans_eq (by rw [← pow_mul])).trans
            (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)))

private theorem card_amplifiedSet_bounds {N m T K : ℕ} (S : Finset (BitString N)) (hKpos : 0 < K)
    (hTm : T = m + 2) (hℓT : Nat.log 2 (K ^ 5) ≤ T) :
    (K ≤ #S → 4 * Fintype.card (BitString m) ≤ #(amplifiedSet S T (Nat.log 2 (K ^ 5)))) ∧
      (2 * #S ≤ K → 4 * #(amplifiedSet S T (Nat.log 2 (K ^ 5))) ≤ Fintype.card (BitString m)) := by
  set ℓ := Nat.log 2 (K ^ 5)
  have hcard := card_amplifiedSet S hℓT
  have hY : Fintype.card (BitString m) = 2 ^ m := BitString.card
  have hKℓ : 2 ^ ℓ ≤ K ^ 5 := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (pow_ne_zero 5 hKpos.ne')
  have hKℓ' : K ^ 5 < 2 ^ (ℓ + 1) := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by norm_num) _
  have hsplit : 2 ^ T = 2 ^ ℓ * 2 ^ (T - ℓ) := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hℓT]
  have h4 : 2 ^ T = 4 * 2 ^ m := by
    rw [hTm, pow_add]
    ring
  refine ⟨fun hmem => ?_, fun hnot => ?_⟩
  · rw [hY, hcard, ← h4, hsplit]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hKℓ.trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hmem 5))
  · have h32 : 32 * #S ^ 5 ≤ K ^ 5 := by
      have := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hnot 5
      rw [mul_pow] at this
      simpa using this
    have h16 : 16 * #S ^ 5 < 2 ^ ℓ := by
      have h2 : 2 ^ (ℓ + 1) = 2 ^ ℓ * 2 := pow_succ 2 ℓ
      omega
    rw [hY, hcard]
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ (T - ℓ)) h16.le
    rw [← hsplit, h4] at this
    nlinarith

theorem mem_AM_of_card_certifiedSet {N c : Polynomial ℕ} {R : α × List Bool → Bool} {K : α → ℕ}
    (hR : ComputableInPolyTime R (encPair enc encBits) encBool)
    (hK : ComputableInPolyTime K enc encNat) (hKpos : ∀ a, 0 < K a)
    (hmem : ∀ a ∈ A, K a ≤ #(certifiedSet enc N c R a))
    (hnot : ∀ a ∉ A, 2 * #(certifiedSet enc N c R a) ≤ K a) : A ∈ AM enc := by
  have hR := hR.tidy
  have hK := hK.tidy
  -- normalise the threshold `K a ^ 5` to a power of two
  set ℓ : α → ℕ := fun a => Nat.log 2 (K a ^ 5) with hℓdef
  have hℓ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime ℓ enc encUnary :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.binary_log_two.comp
      (hK.binary_pow' (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 5))
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hℓ.polyBounded.exists_polynomial
  set m : Polynomial ℕ := B + 2 with hm
  set T : Polynomial ℕ := B + 4 with hT
  refine ⟨m * (5 * N + T) + m, 5 * N + T + 5 * c, verifier enc N c m T ℓ R,
    (computableInPolyTime_verifier (.of_tidy hℓ) (.of_tidy hR)), fun a => ?_⟩
  have hP : (m * (5 * N + T) + m).eval (enc a).length = m.eval (enc a).length *
      (5 * N.eval (enc a).length + T.eval (enc a).length) + m.eval (enc a).length := by simp
  have hQ : (5 * N + T + 5 * c).eval (enc a).length = 5 * N.eval (enc a).length +
      T.eval (enc a).length + 5 * c.eval (enc a).length := by simp
  rw [hP, hQ]
  simp only [forall_verifier_eq_false_iff, exists_verifier_iff]
  set n := (enc a).length
  have hh := (BitString.LinearHash.isPairwiseIndependentHash_affineHash
    (m.eval n) (5 * N.eval n + T.eval n)).comp_seedEquiv (seedEquiv _ _)
  have hbnds := card_amplifiedSet_bounds (certifiedSet enc N c R a) (hKpos a)
    (show T.eval n = m.eval n + 2 by simp [hT, hm])
    (by simp only [hT, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_ofNat]; linarith [hB a])
  constructor
  · -- members: the amplified set has at least `4 ⬝ 2 ^ m(n)` elements
    intro ha
    refine BitString.two_mul_two_pow_le_of_four_mul_card_filter_not_le _ ?_
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin] using
      hh.four_mul_card_filter_notMem_image_le (hbnds.1 (hmem a ha)) 0
  · -- non-members: the amplified set has at most `2 ^ m(n) / 4` elements
    intro ha
    refine BitString.two_mul_two_pow_le_of_four_mul_card_filter_not_le _ ?_
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin, not_not] using
      hh.four_mul_card_filter_mem_image_le (hbnds.2 (hnot a ha)) 0

    have h := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := univ) (fun r : Fin m → Bool => test r = true)

        {x : α × List Bool | (x.1, x.2.drop ((r • m).eval (enc x.1).length)) ∈ E} E :=
      ⟨fun x => (x.1, x.2.drop ((r • m).eval (enc x.1).length)),
        .of_tidy ((fst _ _).prod (bitsDropWithInput (snd _ _) hn)), fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
    have htake : PolyTimeReducible (encPair enc encBits) (encPair enc encBits)
        {x : α × List Bool |

    mem_NP_setOf_exists_append (V := fun x => !V x)
      (.of_tidy (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bool_not.comp hV.tidy)) p₃

    h (compl_mem_coBH_iff.mpr (kadinChain_mem_BH hE k))
  have hU : (Set.univ : Set (α × List Bool)) ∈ NP (encPair enc encBits) :=
    ⟨0, fun _ => true, .const _, by simp [IsVerifier]⟩

    intro a s z hs hz _ hmem

    subst hz0
    simpa using hmem
  have hSoundDiff : kadinSoundDiff enc m E k 0 Set.univ (kadinChain enc m E k)ᶜ := by
    intro a s z hs hz _ hmem
    have hz0 : z = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.1 (by simpa using hz)
    subst hz0
    simpa using hmem
  obtain ⟨H, hH_mem, hH_sub, hH_comp⟩ :=
    exists_kadin_sigmaP_three enc p₁ p₂ m E rfl hE k 0 hU hLk_compl (Set.subset_univ _)
      hSoundD hSoundDiff

    ext a

    simp only [kadinTarget, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
      alternation_false_cons, alternation_true_cons, alternation_nil]
    refine forall_congr' fun u₁ => imp_congr_right fun _ => ?_
    refine exists_congr fun u₂ => and_congr_right fun _ => ?_

  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hA⟩ := mem_coModP_iff_exists_SharpP.mp hA
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := SharpP.exists_le_two_pow hf

      (encPair enc encBits) encNat :=
    (SharpP.computableInPolySpace hf).tidy.comp
      (.of_polyTime (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _))

      (encPair enc encBits) encNat := by
    have hread := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsToNat
    fun_prop
  have htest : ComputableTidilyInPolySpace (fun x : α × List Bool =>
      decide (f x.1 ≤ k * ofBits x.2) && decide (k * ofBits x.2 ≤ f x.1))
      (encPair enc encBits) encBool := by
    have hle := ComputableTidilyInPolySpace.of_polyTime ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.binary_le
    exact (ComputableTidilyInPolySpace.of_polyTime ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bool_and).comp
      ((hle.comp (hleft.prod (.of_polyTime hright))).prod
        (hle.comp ((ComputableTidilyInPolySpace.of_polyTime hright).prod hleft)))
  have hB : {x : α × List Bool | f x.1 = k * ofBits x.2} ∈
      PSPACE (encPair enc encBits) :=
    mem_PSPACE_of_computableInPolySpace (.of_tidy htest) fun x => by
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      exact le_antisymm_iff
  have hbound : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => p.eval (enc a).length + 1)
      enc encUnary := by fun_prop
  have h := setOf_exists_mem_PSPACE hB (.of_tidy hbound)
  convert h using 1
  ext a
  rw [hA a]
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  constructor
  · intro hdiv

    (hΨ : ComputableInPolyTime Ψ (encPair encBits encUnary) encBool) :
    {y : List Bool | Ψ (y, 2 ^ y.length) = true} ∈ E encBits := by
  have hΨ := hΨ.tidy
  obtain ⟨t, s, ht, hs, h⟩ := hΨ
  obtain ⟨c, d, hcd⟩ := (ht.add hs).exists_le
  -- the problem decided by `Ψ`, within polynomial time
  have hB : {x | Ψ x = true} ∈ DTIME (encPair encBits encUnary) fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ d :=
    setOf_mem_DTIME_of_computableInO (T := fun x => t x + s x) (S := fun x => t x + s x)
      (.of_tidy (.of_bounds h 1 (fun _ => by omega) (fun _ => by omega)
        fun x => (h.length_le x).trans (by omega))) hcd
  -- the padding `y ↦ (y, 2 ^ |y|)`
  have hgO : ComputableTidilyInO (fun y : List Bool => (y, 2 ^ y.length)) encBits
      (encPair encBits encUnary) (fun y => 3 * 4 ^ y.length) fun y => 3 * 4 ^ y.length := by
    have h₁ := (ComputableTidilyInO.of_linear
      (.of_eq (f := fun y : List Bool => y) (encMid := encBits) fun _ => rfl)).prod
      (ComputableTidilyInO.unary_two_pow.comp ComputableTidilyInO.lengthUnary)
    have hbound : ∀ y : List Bool, y.length + (y.length + (y.length + 1) * 2 ^ y.length) ≤
        3 * 4 ^ y.length := fun y => by
      have h2 : y.length + 1 ≤ 2 ^ y.length := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
      have h4 : 4 ^ y.length = 2 ^ y.length * 2 ^ y.length := by
        rw [← mul_pow]
        norm_num
      nlinarith
    refine h₁.mono_le (fun y => ?_) fun y => ?_
    · simpa only [encBits_apply, Function.comp_apply] using hbound y
    · have h2 : y.length + 1 ≤ 2 ^ y.length := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
      have := hbound y
      simp only [encBits_apply]
      nlinarith
  refine mem_E_iff.2 ⟨d + 2, preimage_mem_DTIME (C := c * 4 ^ d + 3) hB (.of_tidy hgO) fun y => ?_⟩
  -- the time bound is `2 ^ O(n)`
  set n := (encBits y).length
  have hn : n = y.length := by simp [n, encBits_apply]
  have hlen : (encPair encBits encUnary (y, 2 ^ y.length)).length + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (n + 2) := by
    simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate, hn]
    rw [pow_add]
    have : y.length + 1 ≤ 2 ^ y.length := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
    omega

    rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, ← pow_mul]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by nlinarith)
  have h2 : (2 ^ (n + 2)) ^ d ≤ 4 ^ d * 2 ^ ((d + 2) * n) := by
    calc (2 ^ (n + 2)) ^ d = 4 ^ d * 2 ^ (d * n) := by
          rw [← pow_mul, show (n + 2) * d = 2 * d + d * n by ring, pow_add, pow_mul]
          norm_num
      _ ≤ 4 ^ d * 2 ^ ((d + 2) * n) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by nlinarith))
  rw [← hn]
  calc 3 * 4 ^ n + c * ((encPair encBits encUnary (y, 2 ^ y.length)).length + 1) ^ d
      ≤ 3 * 2 ^ ((d + 2) * n) + c * (4 ^ d * 2 ^ ((d + 2) * n)) := by
        gcongr

theorem PolyTimeReducible.mem_EXP {α β : Type} {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool}
    {A : Set α} {B : Set β} (hAB : PolyTimeReducible encA encB A B) (hB : B ∈ EXP encB) :
    A ∈ EXP encA := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hred⟩ := hAB
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_EXP_iff.mp hB
  obtain ⟨t, s, ht, hs, h⟩ := hf.tidy
  obtain ⟨c, d, hcd⟩ := (ht.add hs).exists_le
  have hfO : ComputableInO f encA encB (fun a => c * ((encA a).length + 1) ^ d)
      (fun a => c * ((encA a).length + 1) ^ d) :=
    .of_tidy ((ComputableTidilyInO.of_bounds h 1 (fun _ => by omega) (fun _ => by omega)
      fun a => (h.length_le a).trans (by omega)).mono_le (fun a => hcd _) (fun a => hcd _))
  have hlen (a : α) : (encB (f a)).length ≤ c * ((encA a).length + 1) ^ d :=
    (h.length_le a).trans ((Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans (hcd a))
  have hpre : f ⁻¹' B ∈ DTIME encA
      (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ d + 2 ^ (c * (n + 1) ^ d) ^ k) := by
    refine preimage_mem_DTIME (C := 1) hk hfO fun a => ?_
    have hpow : 2 ^ (encB (f a)).length ^ k ≤ 2 ^ (c * ((encA a).length + 1) ^ d) ^ k :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (hlen a) k)
    omega
  have hA_eq : A = f ⁻¹' B := Set.ext hred
  rw [hA_eq]
  have hpoly : PolynomiallyBounded
      (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ d + (c * (n + 1) ^ d) ^ k + 1) := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hpoly
  refine mem_EXP_iff.mpr ⟨D, DTIME_mono_of_eventually_le ?_ hpre⟩
  filter_upwards [hD] with n hn
  set M := c * (n + 1) ^ d + (c * (n + 1) ^ d) ^ k
  have h1 : c * (n + 1) ^ d ≤ 2 ^ M :=
    (Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans (Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le)
  have h2 : 2 ^ (c * (n + 1) ^ d) ^ k ≤ 2 ^ M :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
  calc
    c * (n + 1) ^ d + 2 ^ (c * (n + 1) ^ d) ^ k ≤ 2 ^ M + 2 ^ M := Nat.add_le_add h1 h2
    _ = 2 ^ (M + 1) := by rw [← two_mul, pow_succ']
    _ ≤ 2 ^ n ^ D := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hn

theorem not_forall_halted_diagonal {k : ℕ} {State : Type} [Finite State]
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool State) {t : List Bool → ℕ} (ht : PolyBounded List.length t)
    (h : ∀ x, (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) (t x)).Halted ∧
      (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) (t x)).output = [diagonal x]) : False := by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite State
  let eS : State ↪ ℕ := (Fintype.equivFin State).toEmbedding.trans Fin.valEmbedding
  -- a padding beyond which the machine halts within the exponential clock
  obtain ⟨c, d, hle⟩ := ht.exists_le

    (PolynomiallyBounded.eventually_lt_two_pow (f := fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ d) (by fun_prop))

  have hlen : N ≤ x.length := by simp [x]
  have htime : t x ≤ 2 ^ x.length := (hle x).trans (hN _ hlen).le
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hout⟩ := h x
  have heq := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_eq_of_halt tm _ htime hhalt
  have hdiag := diagonal_desc eS tm _ ((congrArg Cfg.Halted heq).mpr hhalt)
    ((congrArg Cfg.output heq).trans hout)
  revert hdiag
  cases diagonal x <;> decide

private theorem bounds_aux {n A D N J L I E cD cO M K : ℕ} (hJ : 1 ≤ J)
    (hD : D ≤ cD * (A + 1)) (hN : N ≤ 3 * n) (hL : L = n + 1) (hI : I = 2 * D + 1 + (2 * N + 1 + L))
    (hM : M = cD * (A + 1) + A + 4 * n + 2) (hK : K = 100100 + 44100 * (cO + 1) ^ 2)
    (hE : E ≤ cO * (A + (n + n) + (runBound D N J + I) + 1)) :
    A + (n + n) + ((J + 1) * (stepBound D N J + runBound D N J + (L + 1) ^ 2) + (I + 1) ^ 2) +
        (E + 1) ^ 2 ≤ K * (M ^ 5 * J ^ 3) ∧
      A + (n + n) + (runBound D N J + I) + E ≤ K * (M ^ 5 * J) := by
  subst hL hI
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := by omega
  obtain ⟨hU₁, hU₂⟩ := Turing.MultiTapeTM.Universal.universal_bounds_le
    (D := D) (N := N) (J := J) (B := M - 1) (L := n + 1)
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hJ
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hM1] at hU₁ hU₂
  have hM2 : M ≤ M ^ 2 := Nat.le_self_pow two_ne_zero _
  have hMM2 : M ≤ M ^ 2 * J := hM2.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hJ)
  have hM25 : M ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 5 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hM1 (by omega)
  have hJ3 : J ≤ J ^ 3 := Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) _
  -- the space of the universal run, and the encoded result
  have hS : A + (n + n) + (runBound D N J + (2 * D + 1 + (2 * N + 1 + (n + 1)))) ≤
      209 * (M ^ 2 * J) := by
    have : A + (n + n) + (2 * D + 1 + (2 * N + 1 + (n + 1))) ≤ 9 * M := by omega
    nlinarith
  have hE' : E + 1 ≤ 210 * (cO + 1) * (M ^ 2 * J) := by
    have h₁ : E ≤ cO * (209 * (M ^ 2 * J) + 1) := hE.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega))
    have h₂ : 1 ≤ M ^ 2 * J := le_trans hM1 hMM2
    nlinarith
  have hM2J : M ^ 2 * J ≤ M ^ 5 * J := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hM25
  have hM5J : M ^ 5 * J ≤ M ^ 5 * J ^ 3 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hJ3
  constructor
  · have hO2 : (E + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 44100 * (cO + 1) ^ 2 * (M ^ 5 * J ^ 3) := by
      calc (E + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (210 * (cO + 1) * (M ^ 2 * J)) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hE' 2
        _ = 44100 * (cO + 1) ^ 2 * (M ^ 4 * J ^ 2) := by ring
        _ ≤ 44100 * (cO + 1) ^ 2 * (M ^ 5 * J ^ 3) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _
            (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hM1 (by omega))
              (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hJ (by omega)))
    have hIn2 : (2 * D + 1 + (2 * N + 1 + (n + 1)) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 49 * (M ^ 5 * J ^ 3) := by
      have h₁ : 2 * D + 1 + (2 * N + 1 + (n + 1)) + 1 ≤ 7 * M := by omega
      have h₂ : M ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 5 * J ^ 3 :=
        hM25.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pow_pos hJ))
      calc _ ≤ (7 * M) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left h₁ 2
        _ = 49 * M ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ 49 * (M ^ 5 * J ^ 3) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h₂
    have hA : A + (n + n) ≤ M ^ 5 * J ^ 3 := by
      have h₁ : A + (n + n) ≤ M := by omega
      have h₂ : M ≤ M ^ 5 * J ^ 3 :=
        (hM2.trans hM25).trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pow_pos hJ))
      omega
    have hU₁' : (J + 1) * (stepBound D N J + runBound D N J + (n + 1 + 1) ^ 2) ≤
        100000 * (M ^ 5 * J ^ 3) := hU₁.trans (le_of_eq (by ring))
    rw [hK]
    generalize M ^ 5 * J ^ 3 = X at hA hU₁' hIn2 hO2 ⊢
    linarith
  · have hY : (cO + 1) * (M ^ 2 * J) ≤ (cO + 1) ^ 2 * (M ^ 5 * J) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_self_pow two_ne_zero _) hM2J
    rw [hK]
    generalize M ^ 2 * J = Z at hS hE' hM2J hY ⊢
    generalize M ^ 5 * J = W at hM2J hY ⊢
    linarith

/-- **The diagonal is decidable in exponential time**, within time `O(2 ^ (4 * n))` and space

theorem computableInO_diagonal :
    ComputableInO diagonal encBits encBool (fun x => 2 ^ (4 * x.length))
      fun x => 2 ^ (2 * x.length) := by
  have this : ComputableTidilyInO diagonal encBits encBool (fun x => 2 ^ (4 * x.length))
      fun x => 2 ^ (2 * x.length) := by
    obtain ⟨dd, ed, hdec⟩ := exists_computableTidilyInDegree_decodeDesc

      .of_linear (.of_unframe fun _ => rfl)

    have hsym := Universal.computableTidilyInDegree_map_eBit.inO_one
    have hclock := (ComputableTidilyInDegree.two_pow_length encBits).inO_one
    have hpre := hdesc.prod (hsym.prod hclock)
    have hU := computableTidilyInO_universal.comp hpre
    have h := computableInO_verdict.tidy.comp hU

    obtain ⟨cO, hcO⟩ := hU.length_le

      (p := fun n => (cD * ((n + 1) ^ max 1 (1 * dd) + 1) + (n + 1) ^ max 1 (1 * dd) + 4 * n + 2) ^
        5)
      (by fun_prop)

    have hbounds (x : List Bool) := by
      have hL : (encNat (2 ^ x.length)).length = x.length + 1 := by
        rw [encNat_two_pow, List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_singleton]
      have hN : (encList encUnary (x.map eBit)).length ≤ 3 * x.length :=
        (length_encList_le encUnary _ (b := 1) fun s hs => by
          obtain ⟨b, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hs
          cases b

    · obtain ⟨h₁, -⟩ := hbounds x
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, encBits, Function.Embedding.refl_apply] at h₁ ⊢
      have hJ4 : 2 ^ (4 * x.length) = 2 ^ x.length * (2 ^ x.length) ^ 3 := by
        ring
      have := hC x.length
      calc _ ≤ K * (_ ^ 5 * (2 ^ x.length) ^ 3) := h₁
        _ ≤ K * (C * 2 ^ x.length * (2 ^ x.length) ^ 3) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ this)
        _ ≤ K * C * (2 ^ (4 * x.length) + 1) := by rw [hJ4]; nlinarith
    · obtain ⟨-, h₂⟩ := hbounds x
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, encBits, Function.Embedding.refl_apply] at h₂ ⊢
      have hJ2 : 2 ^ (2 * x.length) = 2 ^ x.length * 2 ^ x.length := by rw [two_mul, pow_add]

theorem not_NEXP_subset_NP : ¬ (NEXP encBits ⊆ NP encBits) := by
  intro hSub
  let J (n : ℕ) : ℕ := 2 ^ (2 ^ n)
  let L : Set (List Bool) := {x | timeDiagonal J x = true}
  obtain ⟨c₁, c₂, k, State, hfinite, ntm, hdec⟩ := timeDiagonal_two_pow_two_pow_mem_NTIME
  set c := Nat.card (Turing.Action k Bool State) * (c₁ + c₂)
  let h₁ (y : List Bool) : List Bool := y ++ List.replicate (2 ^ y.length) true
  let g₂ (x : List Bool) : List Bool := frame x ++ List.replicate (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) true
  have hB₁ : h₁ ⁻¹' ntm.padded c ∈ NP encBits :=
    hSub (preimage_append_two_pow_mem_NEXP (ntm.padded_mem_NP c))
  have hf_add : ComputableInPolyTime (fun n : ℕ => n + 4) encUnary encUnary :=
    .of_tidy (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_add.comp
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id'.prod (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 4)))
  have hB₂ : g₂ ⁻¹' (h₁ ⁻¹' ntm.padded c) ∈ NEXP encBits :=
    preimage_pad_mem_NEXP hB₁ hf_add fun n => Nat.le_add_right n 4
  have hL_eq : L = g₂ ⁻¹' (h₁ ⁻¹' ntm.padded c) := by
    ext x
    change x ∈ L ↔ h₁ (g₂ x) ∈ ntm.padded c
    have hpad_eq : h₁ (g₂ x) =
        frame x ++ (List.replicate (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) true ++
          List.replicate (2 ^ (g₂ x).length) true) := by
      simp [h₁, g₂, List.append_assoc]
    rw [hpad_eq]
    refine (hdec.frame_append_mem_padded_iff (a := x) ?_).symm
    change Nat.card (Turing.Action k Bool State) * (c₁ * 2 ^ (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) + c₂) ≤
      c * (frame x ++ (List.replicate (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) true ++
        List.replicate (2 ^ (g₂ x).length) true)).length
    have hM : 2 ^ (x.length + 4) ≤ (g₂ x).length := by
      simp only [g₂, List.length_append, length_frame, List.length_replicate]
      omega
    have hpow_le : 2 ^ (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) ≤ 2 ^ (g₂ x).length :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hM
    have hlen_ge : 2 ^ (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) + 1 ≤
        (frame x ++ (List.replicate (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) true ++
          List.replicate (2 ^ (g₂ x).length) true)).length := by
      simp only [List.length_append, length_frame, List.length_replicate]
      calc 2 ^ (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) + 1
          ≤ 2 ^ (g₂ x).length + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right hpow_le 1
        _ ≤ 2 * x.length + 1 + (2 ^ (x.length + 4) + 2 ^ (g₂ x).length) := by
            have := Nat.zero_le (2 ^ (x.length + 4))
            omega
    have hmul : c₁ * 2 ^ (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) + c₂ ≤
        (c₁ + c₂) * (frame x ++ (List.replicate (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) true ++
          List.replicate (2 ^ (g₂ x).length) true)).length := by
      calc c₁ * 2 ^ (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) + c₂
          ≤ c₁ * (2 ^ (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) + 1) + c₂ * (2 ^ (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) + 1) :=
            Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₁ (Nat.le_succ _))
              (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right c₂ (Nat.succ_pos _))
        _ = (c₁ + c₂) * (2 ^ (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) + 1) := (Nat.add_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ ≤ (c₁ + c₂) * (frame x ++ (List.replicate (2 ^ (x.length + 4)) true ++
            List.replicate (2 ^ (g₂ x).length) true)).length :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hlen_ge
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hmul
  have hL_EXP : L ∈ EXP encBits := hL_eq ▸ NP_subset_EXP (hSub hB₂)
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := mem_EXP_iff.mp hL_EXP
  refine setOf_timeDiagonal_notMem_DTIME (f := fun n => 2 ^ n ^ d) (J := J) (fun C => ?_) hd
  have hpoly : PolynomiallyBounded fun n => n ^ d + n + 1 := by fun_prop
  filter_upwards [hpoly.eventually_lt_two_pow, eventually_ge_atTop (C + 1)] with n hn hC
  have h₁ : 2 * C ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) := by
    have : n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
    rw [pow_succ']
    omega
  have h₂ : 1 ≤ 2 ^ n ^ d := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  calc C * 2 ^ n ^ d + C
      ≤ 2 * C * 2 ^ n ^ d := by nlinarith
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) * 2 ^ n ^ d := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h₁
    _ = 2 ^ (n ^ d + n + 1) := by rw [← Nat.pow_add]; ring_nf
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ n) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hn.le

/-- **`NP` is strictly contained in `NEXP`** on bitstrings: a special case of the nondeterministic
time hierarchy theorem [Arora and Barak, Theorem 3.2][AroraBarak09], proved via
`not_NEXP_subset_NP`. -/

      ComputableTidilyInO.of_linear (.of_unframe fun _ => rfl)

    have hsym := Universal.computableTidilyInDegree_map_eBit.inO_one

      hGu).of_enc_eq (encOut := encNat) (g := fun x : List Bool => 2 ^ G x.length) fun x => by
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate]
    have hU := computableTidilyInO_budgetedUniversal.comp (hdesc.prod (hsym.prod (hclock.prod hGu)))
    have h := computableInO_shortDesc.tidy.ite (computableInO_verdict.tidy.comp hU)

space `O(f)` halts within its number of configurations, `2 ^ O(f n)` times a polynomial, which is

`O(f n + log n)` bits, eventually within the budget `G n`; so on its own description, padded to a
short one beyond these points, the diagonal answers the negation of its answer. -/
theorem setOf_spaceDiagonal_notMem_DSPACE {f G : ℕ → ℕ} (hn : ∀ n, n ≤ G n)
    (hfG : ∀ c, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, c * f n + c ≤ G n) :
    {x | spaceDiagonal G x = true} ∉ DSPACE encBits f := by
  rintro ⟨c₁, c₂, t, hA⟩
  obtain ⟨g, ⟨k, State, hfinite, tm, htm⟩, hg⟩ := decidableInTimeAndSpace_iff.mp hA
  have := Fintype.ofFinite State
  let eS : State ↪ ℕ := (Fintype.equivFin State).toEmbedding.trans Fin.valEmbedding
  set D := descLen (desc eS eBit tm) with hD
  set P := 6 * (2 * D + 5) * (c₁ + c₂) + 3 * D + 4 with hP
  set e := storageBoundExp Bool k
  set base := storageBoundBase Bool State k
  have hpoly : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ((n + 2) * base) ^ 2 < 2 ^ n :=
    PolynomiallyBounded.eventually_lt_two_pow (f := fun n => ((n + 2) * base) ^ 2) (by fun_prop)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp ((((hfG (2 * e * (c₁ + c₂))).and (hfG (2 * P))).and
    hpoly).and eventually_four_mul_length_encNat_le)

  suffices ∀ pad : List Bool, N + 2 ^ (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)).length ≤ pad.length → False from
    this (List.replicate _ false) (List.length_replicate ..).ge

  have hpow := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)).length)
  have hlen : (frame (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) ++ pad).length =
      2 * (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)).length + 1 + pad.length := by
    rw [List.length_append, length_frame]
  have hshort : shortDesc (frame (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) ++ pad) = true := by
    rw [shortDesc, unframe_frame_append, hlen]
    exact decide_eq_true (by omega)
  generalize hx : frame (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) ++ pad = x at hlen hshort
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, h₃⟩, h₄⟩ := hN x.length (by omega)
  have hrun := htm x
  simp only [encBits_apply] at hrun
  set s := c₁ * f x.length + c₂ with hs
  have hsf : s ≤ (c₁ + c₂) * (f x.length + 1) := by rw [hs]; nlinarith
  -- the decider halts within the clock
  have hclock : (x.length + 2) * storageBound Bool State k s ≤ 2 ^ G x.length := by
    have he : 2 * (e * s) ≤ G x.length := by
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * e) hsf
      have e₁ : 2 * e * ((c₁ + c₂) * (f x.length + 1)) =
          2 * e * (c₁ + c₂) * f x.length + 2 * e * (c₁ + c₂) := by ring
      have e₂ : 2 * (e * s) = 2 * e * s := by ring
      omega
    have hsq : ((x.length + 2) * base * 2 ^ (e * s)) ^ 2 ≤ (2 ^ G x.length) ^ 2 := by
      calc ((x.length + 2) * base * 2 ^ (e * s)) ^ 2
          = ((x.length + 2) * base) ^ 2 * 2 ^ (2 * (e * s)) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 ^ x.length * 2 ^ G x.length :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul h₃.le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) he)
        _ ≤ 2 ^ G x.length * 2 ^ G x.length :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (hn _))
        _ = (2 ^ G x.length) ^ 2 := (sq _).symm
    refine le_trans ?_ ((Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_left two_ne_zero).mp hsq)
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (storageBound_le_base_mul_pow s)
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hout⟩ := hrun.of_card.runFrom_of_le hclock
  -- the configurations of the simulation fit within the budget
  have hbudget : cfgSpace (desc eS eBit tm) (x.map eBit) (2 ^ G x.length) ≤ G x.length := by
    have hsp : simSpace (desc eS eBit tm) (x.map eBit) (2 ^ G x.length) ≤ s := by
      rw [simSpace_desc]
      exact space_le_of_runsInSpace hrun.2.2 _
    have hk : (desc eS eBit tm).tapes ≤ D := by
      simp only [hD, descLen, eDesc_apply, length_encPair, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate]
      omega
    have hP' : 6 * (2 * D + 5) * s + 3 * D + 4 ≤ P * (f x.length + 1) := by
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (6 * (2 * D + 5)) hsf
      have e₁ : P * (f x.length + 1) = 6 * (2 * D + 5) * ((c₁ + c₂) * (f x.length + 1)) +
          (3 * D + 4) * (f x.length + 1) := by rw [hP]; ring
      have : 3 * D + 4 ≤ (3 * D + 4) * (f x.length + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
      omega
    have e₂ : 2 * P * f x.length + 2 * P = 2 * (P * (f x.length + 1)) := by ring
    simp only [cfgSpace, List.length_map, ← hD]
    have e₃ : 3 * (2 * D + 5) * 2 * simSpace (desc eS eBit tm) (x.map eBit) (2 ^ G x.length) ≤
        6 * (2 * D + 5) * s := by
      rw [show 3 * (2 * D + 5) * 2 = 6 * (2 * D + 5) by ring]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hsp
    have := hn x.length
    omega
  -- so the diagonal negates the answer of the decider
  have hd : spaceDiagonal G x = !g x := by
    subst hx
    exact spaceDiagonal_desc eS tm pad G hshort hbudget hhalt hout
  have hgx := hg x
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hd] at hgx
  revert hgx
  cases g x <;> decide

/-- **The space hierarchy theorem.** If `g` is space-constructible, `n ≤ g n`, and every

machine, so the gap is the textbook `f = o(g)`; the condition `n ≤ g n`, where the textbook asks
`log n ≤ g n`, is the space the diagonal takes to hold its input and decode its description. -/

theorem L_ssubset_PSPACE : L encBits ⊂ PSPACE encBits := by
  have hL : L encBits ⊆ DSPACE encBits fun n => n := fun A hA =>

  refine (Set.ssubset_iff_of_subset L_subset_PSPACE).mpr ⟨_, DSPACE_subset_PSPACE (by fun_prop)
    (setOf_spaceDiagonal_mem_DSPACE (spaceConstructible_succ_pow 2)
      fun n => (Nat.le_succ n).trans (Nat.le_self_pow two_ne_zero _)), fun h =>
    setOf_spaceDiagonal_notMem_DSPACE (f := fun n => n)
      (fun n => (Nat.le_succ n).trans (Nat.le_self_pow two_ne_zero _)) (fun c => ?_) (hL h)⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop c] with n hc
  nlinarith

theorem DSPACE_pow_ssubset_DSPACE_pow_succ (k : ℕ) :
    DSPACE encBits (· ^ k) ⊂ DSPACE encBits (· ^ (k + 1)) := by
  have hn (n : ℕ) : n ≤ (n + 1) ^ (k + 1) :=
    (Nat.le_succ n).trans (Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) _)
  have hsub : DSPACE encBits (· ^ k) ⊆ DSPACE encBits (· ^ (k + 1)) :=
    DSPACE_subset_of_le_mul_add 1 1 fun n => by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hpos
      · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk <;> simp_all
      · have : n ^ k ≤ n ^ (k + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hpos (Nat.le_succ k)
        omega
  refine (Set.ssubset_iff_of_subset hsub).mpr ⟨_, DSPACE_subset_of_le_mul_add (2 ^ (k + 1)) 1
    (fun n => by simpa using Nat.mul_add_one_pow_le_two_pow 1 (k + 1) n)
    (setOf_spaceDiagonal_mem_DSPACE (spaceConstructible_succ_pow (k + 1)) hn),
    setOf_spaceDiagonal_notMem_DSPACE hn fun c => ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (2 * c)] with n hc
  have h₁ : n ^ k ≤ (n + 1) ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_succ n) k
  have h₂ : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ k := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have e : (n + 1) ^ (k + 1) = (n + 1) ^ k * (n + 1) := pow_succ ..
  nlinarith

private theorem clockedBounds_aux (cA cD cO C₂ : ℕ) : ∃ K, ∀ {n A D N J L I E : ℕ},
    A ≤ cA * (n + 1) → D ≤ cD * (n + A + 1) → N ≤ 3 * n → (L + 1) ^ 2 ≤ C₂ * (J + 1) →
    I = 2 * D + 1 + (2 * N + 1 + L) →
    E ≤ cO * (n + A + (n + J) + (runBound D N J + I) + 1) →
    n + A + (n + J) + ((J + 1) * (stepBound D N J + runBound D N J + (L + 1) ^ 2) +
        (I + 1) ^ 2) + (E + 1) ^ 2 ≤ K * ((n + 1) ^ 5 * (J + 1) ^ 3) ∧
      n + A + (n + J) + (runBound D N J + I) + E ≤ K * ((n + 1) ^ 5 * (J + 1) ^ 3) := by
  set P := cD * (cA + 1) + 3 with hP
  set R := 5 * P + C₂ with hR
  set Q := cA + 4 + 200 * P ^ 2 + R with hQ
  refine ⟨cA + 3 + 100000 * P ^ 5 + C₂ + R ^ 2 + (cO * Q + 1) ^ 2 + 200 * P ^ 2 + R + cO * Q,
    fun {n A D N J L I E} hA hD hN hL hI hE => ?_⟩
  have hPn : P * (n + 1) = cD * (cA + 1) * (n + 1) + 3 * (n + 1) := by rw [hP]; ring
  have hD' : D ≤ cD * (cA + 1) * (n + 1) :=
    hD.trans ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left cD (show n + A + 1 ≤ (cA + 1) * (n + 1) by
      have : (cA + 1) * (n + 1) = cA * (n + 1) + (n + 1) := by ring
      omega)).trans (le_of_eq (by ring)))
  obtain ⟨hU₁, hU₂⟩ := Turing.MultiTapeTM.Universal.universal_bounds_le
    (D := D) (N := N) (J := J + 1)
    (B := P * (n + 1) - 1) (L := 0) (by omega) (by omega) (Nat.zero_le _) (by omega)
  have hPX1 : 1 ≤ P * (n + 1) := by omega
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hPX1] at hU₁ hU₂
  simp only [zero_add, one_pow] at hU₁
  have hstep := stepBound_mono (le_refl D) (le_refl N) (Nat.le_add_right J 1)
  have hrun := runBound_le_succ D N J
  have hD'' : D ≤ P * (n + 1) := by omega
  have hN' : N ≤ P * (n + 1) := by omega
  -- the monomials
  have hX1 : 1 ≤ n + 1 := by omega
  have hY1 : 1 ≤ J + 1 := by omega
  set W := (n + 1) ^ 5 * (J + 1) ^ 3 with hW
  set Z := (n + 1) ^ 2 * (J + 1) with hZ
  have hZ1 : 1 ≤ Z := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pow_pos hX1) hY1
  have hXY : (n + 1) * (J + 1) ≤ W := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) (n + 1))
    (Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) (J + 1))
  have hXYZ : (n + 1) * (J + 1) ≤ Z :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) (n + 1))
  have hZW : Z ≤ W := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hX1 (by omega))
    (Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) (J + 1))
  have hX2Y2 : (n + 1) ^ 2 * (J + 1) ^ 2 ≤ W := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hX1 (by omega))
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hY1 (by omega))
  have hX4Y2 : (n + 1) ^ 4 * (J + 1) ^ 2 ≤ W := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hX1 (by omega))
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hY1 (by omega))
  have hY2 : (J + 1) ^ 2 ≤ W := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.one_le_pow 5 (n + 1) hX1)
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hY1 (show 2 ≤ 3 by omega))
    rwa [one_mul] at this

  have hU' : 100000 * (P * (n + 1)) ^ 5 * (J + 1) ^ 3 = 100000 * P ^ 5 * W := by
    simp only [hW, mul_pow, Nat.mul_assoc]
  have hrunZ : runBound D N J ≤ 200 * P ^ 2 * Z := by
    have : 200 * (P * (n + 1)) ^ 2 * (J + 1) = 200 * P ^ 2 * Z := by
      simp only [hZ, mul_pow, Nat.mul_assoc]
    omega
  have hLY : L ≤ C₂ * (J + 1) := (Nat.le_succ L).trans ((Nat.le_self_pow two_ne_zero _).trans hL)
  have hI1 : I + 1 ≤ R * ((n + 1) * (J + 1)) := by
    have h₁ : 5 * P * (n + 1) ≤ 5 * P * ((n + 1) * (J + 1)) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hY1)
    have h₂ : C₂ * (J + 1) ≤ C₂ * ((n + 1) * (J + 1)) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hX1)
    have e₁ : R * ((n + 1) * (J + 1)) =
        5 * P * ((n + 1) * (J + 1)) + C₂ * ((n + 1) * (J + 1)) := by
      rw [hR]; ring
    have e₂ : 5 * P * (n + 1) = 5 * (P * (n + 1)) := by ring
    omega
  have hpre : n + A + (n + J) ≤ (cA + 3) * ((n + 1) * (J + 1)) := by
    have h₁ : (cA + 2) * (n + 1) ≤ (cA + 2) * ((n + 1) * (J + 1)) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hY1)
    have h₂ : (J + 1) ≤ (n + 1) * (J + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hX1
    have e₁ : (cA + 3) * ((n + 1) * (J + 1)) =
        (cA + 2) * ((n + 1) * (J + 1)) + (n + 1) * (J + 1) := by ring
    have e₂ : (cA + 2) * (n + 1) = cA * (n + 1) + 2 * (n + 1) := by ring
    omega
  have hsum : n + A + (n + J) + (runBound D N J + I) + 1 ≤ Q * Z := by
    have h₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (cA + 3) hXYZ
    have h₂ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left R hXYZ
    have e : Q * Z = (cA + 3) * Z + 200 * P ^ 2 * Z + R * Z + Z := by rw [hQ]; ring
    omega
  have hEZ : E ≤ cO * Q * Z :=
    hE.trans ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left cO hsum).trans (le_of_eq (by ring)))
  have hE1 : E + 1 ≤ (cO * Q + 1) * Z := by
    have e : (cO * Q + 1) * Z = cO * Q * Z + Z := by ring
    omega
  have hT₁ : (J + 1) * (stepBound D N J + runBound D N J + (L + 1) ^ 2) ≤
      100000 * P ^ 5 * W + C₂ * W := by
    have h₁ : (J + 1) * (stepBound D N J + runBound D N J) ≤
        (J + 1 + 1) * (stepBound D N (J + 1) + runBound D N (J + 1) + 1) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
    have h₂ : (J + 1) * (L + 1) ^ 2 ≤ C₂ * W := by
      calc (J + 1) * (L + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (J + 1) * (C₂ * (J + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hL
        _ = C₂ * (J + 1) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ C₂ * W := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hY2
    rw [Nat.mul_add]
    omega
  have hI2 : (I + 1) ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 * W := by
    calc (I + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (R * ((n + 1) * (J + 1))) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hI1 2
      _ = R ^ 2 * ((n + 1) ^ 2 * (J + 1) ^ 2) := by simp only [mul_pow]
      _ ≤ R ^ 2 * W := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hX2Y2
  have hE2 : (E + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (cO * Q + 1) ^ 2 * W := by
    calc (E + 1) ^ 2 ≤ ((cO * Q + 1) * Z) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hE1 2
      _ = (cO * Q + 1) ^ 2 * ((n + 1) ^ 4 * (J + 1) ^ 2) := by
        simp only [hZ, mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
      _ ≤ (cO * Q + 1) ^ 2 * W := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hX4Y2
  have hpreW : n + A + (n + J) ≤ (cA + 3) * W := hpre.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hXY)
  have hrunW : runBound D N J ≤ 200 * P ^ 2 * W := hrunZ.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hZW)
  have hIW : I ≤ R * W := (Nat.le_succ I).trans (hI1.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left R hXY))
  have hEW : E ≤ cO * Q * W := hEZ.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hZW)
  have e : (cA + 3 + 100000 * P ^ 5 + C₂ + R ^ 2 + (cO * Q + 1) ^ 2 + 200 * P ^ 2 + R + cO * Q) *
      W = (cA + 3) * W + 100000 * P ^ 5 * W + C₂ * W + R ^ 2 * W + (cO * Q + 1) ^ 2 * W +
        200 * P ^ 2 * W + R * W + cO * Q * W := by ring
  rw [e]
  constructor
  · clear * - hpreW hT₁ hI2 hE2
    omega
  · clear * - hpreW hrunW hIW hEW
    omega

/-- **The clocked diagonal is computable within the time of the universal machine**: within time
and space `O((n + 1) ^ 5 * (J n + 1) ^ 3)` on inputs of length `n`, for a time-constructible clock
`J`, charging the shortness test, decoding, the symbols, the clock, the universal run and the
test. -/
theorem computableInO_timeDiagonal {J : ℕ → ℕ} (hJ : TimeConstructible J) :
    ComputableInO (timeDiagonal J) encBits encBool
      (fun x => (x.length + 1) ^ 5 * (J x.length + 1) ^ 3)
      fun x => (x.length + 1) ^ 5 * (J x.length + 1) ^ 3 := by
  have this : ComputableTidilyInO (timeDiagonal J) encBits encBool
      (fun x => (x.length + 1) ^ 5 * (J x.length + 1) ^ 3) fun x => (x.length + 1) ^ 5 *
      (J x.length + 1) ^ 3 := by
    obtain ⟨dd, ed, hdec⟩ := exists_computableTidilyInDegree_decodeDesc
    have hu : ComputableTidilyInO unframe encBits encBits (fun x => x.length) fun x => x.length :=
      ComputableTidilyInO.of_linear (.of_unframe fun _ => rfl)
    have hdesc := hdec.inO.comp hu
    have hsym := Universal.computableTidilyInDegree_map_eBit.inO_one
    have hclock := hJ.computableInO.tidy
    have hU := computableTidilyInO_universal.comp (hdesc.prod (hsym.prod hclock))
    have h := computableInO_shortDesc.tidy.ite (computableInO_verdict.tidy.comp hU)
      (ComputableTidilyInO.const (encMid := encBool) false)
    obtain ⟨cD, hcD⟩ := hdesc.length_le
    obtain ⟨cO, hcO⟩ := hU.length_le
    obtain ⟨cA, hcA⟩ := PolynomiallyBounded.exists_le_mul_two_pow (p := fun u => (u + 1) ^ dd)
      (by fun_prop)
    obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := exists_pow_length_encNat_le 2
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := clockedBounds_aux cA cD cO C₂
    have hbounds (x : List Bool) (hs : shortDesc x = true) := by
      have hA : ((unframe x).length + 1) ^ dd ≤ cA * (x.length + 1) :=
        (hcA _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ((of_decide_eq_true hs).trans (Nat.le_succ _)))
      have hN : (encList encUnary (x.map eBit)).length ≤ 3 * x.length :=
        (length_encList_le encUnary _ (b := 1) fun s hs => by
          obtain ⟨b, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hs
          cases b
          · exact Nat.zero_le _
          · exact le_rfl).trans (by rw [List.length_map]; omega)
      have hD := hcD x
      have hE := hcO x
      dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, encBits_apply] at hD hE
      exact hK (D := descLen (decodeDesc (unframe x))) hA hD hN (hC₂ _)
        (by rw [length_encPair, length_encPair]) hE
    have hW (x : List Bool) : x.length + 1 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ 5 * (J x.length + 1) ^ 3 :=
      (Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) _).trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pow_pos (by omega)))
    have hW2 (x : List Bool) : (x.length + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ 5 * (J x.length + 1) ^ 3 :=
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)).trans
        (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pow_pos (by omega)))
    refine h.mono (K + 2) (fun x => ?_) fun x => ?_
    · have e : (K + 2) * ((x.length + 1) ^ 5 * (J x.length + 1) ^ 3 + 1) =
          K * ((x.length + 1) ^ 5 * (J x.length + 1) ^ 3) +
            2 * ((x.length + 1) ^ 5 * (J x.length + 1) ^ 3) + K + 2 := by ring
      have := hW x
      have := hW2 x
      dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, encBits_apply]
      split_ifs with hs
      · have := (hbounds x hs).1
        omega
      · omega
    · have e : (K + 2) * ((x.length + 1) ^ 5 * (J x.length + 1) ^ 3 + 1) =
          K * ((x.length + 1) ^ 5 * (J x.length + 1) ^ 3) +
            2 * ((x.length + 1) ^ 5 * (J x.length + 1) ^ 3) + K + 2 := by ring
      have := hW x
      dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, encBits_apply]
      split_ifs with hs
      · have := (hbounds x hs).2
        omega
      · omega
  simpa only [computableInO_iff_computableTidilyInO] using this

  rintro ⟨c₁, c₂, s, hA⟩
  obtain ⟨g, ⟨k, State, hfinite, tm, htm⟩, hg⟩ := decidableInTimeAndSpace_iff.mp hA

  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (hJ (max c₁ c₂))
  -- the description, padded beyond `N` and to a length where it is short
  suffices ∀ pad : List Bool, N + 2 ^ (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)).length ≤ pad.length → False from
    this (List.replicate _ false) (List.length_replicate ..).ge

  have hpow := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)).length)
  have hlen : (frame (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) ++ pad).length =
