    rw [List.length_append, length_frame]
  have hshort : Diagonal.shortDesc (frame (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) ++ pad) = true := by
    rw [Diagonal.shortDesc, unframe_frame_append, hlen]
    exact decide_eq_true (by omega)
  have htime : c₁ * f (frame (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) ++ pad).length + c₂ ≤
      J (frame (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) ++ pad).length := by
    have := hN _ (show N ≤ (frame (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) ++ pad).length by omega)
    have h₁ : c₁ * f (frame (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) ++ pad).length ≤
        max c₁ c₂ * f (frame (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) ++ pad).length :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (le_max_left _ _)
    have h₂ : c₂ ≤ max c₁ c₂ := le_max_right _ _
    omega
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hout⟩ := (htm _).runFrom_of_le htime
  have hd := clockedDiagonal_desc eS tm pad J hhalt hout

  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, timeDiagonal, hshort, ↓reduceIte, hd] at hgx
  revert hgx

theorem DTIME_ssubset_DTIME_of_clock {f g J : ℕ → ℕ} (hJ : TimeConstructible J)
    (hfJ : ∀ c, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, c * f n + c ≤ J n)
    (hg : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (n + 1) ^ 5 * (J n + 1) ^ 3 ≤ g n) :
    DTIME encBits f ⊂ DTIME encBits g := by
  have hsub : DTIME encBits f ⊆ DTIME encBits g := DTIME_mono_of_eventually_le <| by
    filter_upwards [hfJ 1, hg] with n h₁ h₂
    have : J n ≤ (n + 1) ^ 5 * (J n + 1) ^ 3 :=
      (Nat.le_succ _).trans ((Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) _).trans
        (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (Nat.pow_pos (by omega))))
    omega
  exact (Set.ssubset_iff_of_subset hsub).mpr ⟨_,
    DTIME_mono_of_eventually_le hg (setOf_timeDiagonal_mem_DTIME hJ),
    setOf_timeDiagonal_notMem_DTIME hfJ⟩

strictly contained in every `DTIME g` with `(n + 1) ^ 8 * (f n + 1) ^ 3 ≤ g n` eventually
[Arora and Barak, Theorem 3.1][AroraBarak09], [Sipser, Theorem 9.10][Sipser2013]. The gap is the
polynomial overhead of the native universal machine, not the textbook `f n * log (f n)`. -/

theorem foldlM_run {σ ε β γ : Type} (g : β → γ → StateT σ (Except ε) β) (l : List γ)
    (b : β) (s : σ) :
    (l.foldlM g b).run s =
      l.foldl (fun acc c => acc.bind fun p => (g p.1 c).run p.2) (.ok (b, s)) := by
  have hsplit (l : List γ) (x : Except ε (β × σ)) :
      l.foldl (fun acc c => acc.bind fun p => (g p.1 c).run p.2) x =
        x.bind fun p => l.foldl (fun acc c => acc.bind fun p => (g p.1 c).run p.2) (.ok p) := by
    induction l generalizing x with
    | nil => cases x <;> rfl
    | cons c l ih =>
      cases x with
      | error e => exact (ih (.error e)).trans rfl
      | ok p => rfl
  induction l generalizing b s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c l ih =>
    rw [List.foldlM_cons, StateT.run_bind, List.foldl_cons]
    change _ = l.foldl _ ((g b c).run s)
    rw [hsplit]
    change Except.bind _ _ = Except.bind _ _
    congr 1
    funext p
    exact ih p.1 p.2

def value : ℕ → List (X × X) → ℕ
  | 0, h => min cap (leaf h)
  | n + 1, h => min cap (leaf h + ∑ i ∈ range N, (range N).sup fun j =>

/-- **One step of the evaluator.** Without a value to return, a node at depth `D` returns its leaf
value, and any other node pushes a frame for its first message and reply. A value returned into a
frame updates the maximum, and moves on to the next reply; after the last reply, it adds the
maximum to the sum and moves on to the next message; after the last message, it pops the frame and
returns the sum. A value returned into the empty stack is a fixed point. -/

theorem iterate_step_node (n : ℕ) (st : List (Frame X)) (hst : st.length + n = D) :
    (step D cap first next last leaf)^[time N n] (st, none) =
      (st, some (value N cap first next leaf n (history st))) := by
  induction n generalizing st with
  | zero =>
    simp only [time, Function.iterate_one, step, show st.length = D by lia, ite_true]
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    set F := step D cap first next last leaf
    set T := time N n + 1 with hT
    set S := partialSum N cap first next leaf n (history st)
    set M := partialMax N cap first next leaf n (history st)
    -- one reply: the child returns its value, which updates the maximum and moves on
    have hreply (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < N) (hj : j < N) :
        F^[T] ((next^[i] first, next^[j] first, S i, M i j) :: st, none) =
          if j + 1 < N then ((next^[i] first, next^[j + 1] first, S i, M i (j + 1)) :: st, none)
          else if i + 1 < N then ((next^[i + 1] first, next^[0] first, S (i + 1), M (i + 1) 0) ::
            st, none)
          else (st, some (S N)) := by
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih _ (by simp only [List.length_cons]; lia)]
      have hmax : max (M i j) (value N cap first next leaf n
          ((next^[i] first, next^[j] first) :: history st)) = M i (j + 1) := by
        simp only [M, partialMax, range_add_one, sup_insert]
        exact max_comm _ _
      simp only [history_cons, F, step, hlast i hi, hlast j hj, decide_eq_true_eq]
      rw [hmax]
      by_cases hj' : j + 1 < N
      · rw [ite_eq_right (by lia : ¬ j + 1 = N), ite_eq_left hj',
          ← Function.iterate_succ_apply' next]
      · have hjN : j + 1 = N := by lia
        have hsum : min cap (S i + M i (j + 1)) = S (i + 1) := by
          simp only [S, partialSum, min_cap_add, sum_range_succ, M, partialMax, hjN, add_assoc]
        rw [ite_eq_left hjN, ite_eq_right hj', hsum]
        by_cases hi' : i + 1 < N
        · rw [ite_eq_right (by lia : ¬ i + 1 = N), ite_eq_left hi',
            ← Function.iterate_succ_apply' next]
          simp [M, partialMax]
        · rw [ite_eq_left (by lia : i + 1 = N), ite_eq_right hi', show i + 1 = N by lia]
    -- the replies to one message
    have hmessage (i : ℕ) (hi : i < N) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < N) :
        F^[j * T] ((next^[i] first, next^[0] first, S i, M i 0) :: st, none) =
          ((next^[i] first, next^[j] first, S i, M i j) :: st, none) := by
      induction j with
      | zero => rw [Nat.zero_mul]; rfl
      | succ j ihj =>
        rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, ihj (by lia),
          hreply i j hi (by lia),
          ite_eq_left hj]
    have hmessages (i : ℕ) (hi : i < N) :
        F^[N * T] ((next^[i] first, next^[0] first, S i, M i 0) :: st, none) =
          if i + 1 < N then ((next^[i + 1] first, next^[0] first, S (i + 1), M (i + 1) 0) ::
            st, none)
          else (st, some (S N)) := by
      obtain ⟨N', rfl⟩ : ∃ N', N = N' + 1 := ⟨N - 1, by lia⟩
      rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, hmessage i hi N' (by lia),
        hreply i N' hi (by lia), ite_eq_right (by lia)]
    -- all the messages
    have hall (i : ℕ) (hi : i < N) :
        F^[i * (N * T)] ((next^[0] first, next^[0] first, S 0, M 0 0) :: st, none) =
          ((next^[i] first, next^[0] first, S i, M i 0) :: st, none) := by
      induction i with
      | zero => rw [Nat.zero_mul]; rfl
      | succ i ihi =>
        rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, ihi (by lia),
          hmessages i (by lia),
          ite_eq_left hi]
    have hstart : F (st, none) = ((next^[0] first, next^[0] first, S 0, M 0 0) :: st, none) := by
      simp only [F, step, show st.length ≠ D by lia, ite_false]
      simp [S, partialSum, M, partialMax]
    have htime : time N (n + 1) = N * T + (N - 1) * (N * T) + 1 := by
      rw [hT]
      rcases Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hN.ne' with ⟨N', rfl⟩
      simp only [time, Nat.succ_sub_one, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
      ring
    rw [htime, Function.iterate_succ_apply, hstart, Function.iterate_add_apply,
      hall (N - 1) (by lia), hmessages (N - 1) (by lia), ite_eq_right (by lia)]
    rfl

/-- **Hiding.** Relabelings of isomorphic adjacency matrices are `1 / 16`-close: on distinct keys
they have exactly the same law, and keys collide with probability at most `1 / 16`. -/
theorem tsum_relabelDist_le {n n' : ℕ} {A : Fin n → Fin n → Bool} {A' : Fin n' → Fin n' → Bool}
    (σ : Fin n ≃ Fin n') (hσ : ∀ i j, A' (σ i) (σ j) = A i j) {f : List Bool → ENNReal}
    (hf : ∀ m, f m ≤ 1) :
    ∑' m, relabelDist n' A' m * f m ≤ ∑' m, relabelDist n A m * f m + 1 / 16 := by
  obtain rfl : n = n' := Fin.equiv_iff_eq.1 ⟨σ⟩
  refine (tsum_uniform_map_le (fun R => relabelFin A (keyValue ∘ R))
    (fun R => relabelFin A' (keyValue ∘ R)) (Equiv.arrowCongr σ.symm (Equiv.refl _))
    (fun R => Function.Injective R) (fun R hR => ?_) hf).trans ?_
  · rw [relabelFin_comp ((keyValue_injective _).comp hR) σ hσ]
    rfl
  · exact add_le_add le_rfl (card_filter_not_injective_div_le n)

/-- **The value is at most the number of coin values** whose programs follow the history. -/
theorem value_le_card (n : ℕ) (h : History) :
    value F L n h ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun r => outcome (F r) h ≠ .invalid).card := by
  induction n generalizing h with
  | zero =>
    refine Finset.card_le_card fun r hr => ?_
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hr ⊢
    rw [hr]
    exact nofun
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [value, accepted]
    have hstep (m : List Bool) :
        ((BitString.shortWords L).sup fun y => value F L n (h ++ [(m, y)])) ≤
        (Finset.univ.filter fun r => outcome (F r) h = .ask m).card :=
      Finset.sup_le fun y _ => (ih _).trans (Finset.card_le_card fun r hr => by
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hr ⊢
        refine outcome_eq_ask_of_after_append_singleton (y := y) ?_
        unfold outcome at hr
        rcases hah : after (F r) (h ++ [(m, y)]) with _ | p
        · simp [hah] at hr
        · rfl)
    refine (Nat.add_le_add_left (Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => hstep m) _).trans ?_
    rw [← Finset.card_biUnion (fun m _ m' _ hmm' => Finset.disjoint_filter.mpr
      fun r _ hr hr' => hmm' (Outcome.ask.inj (hr.symm.trans hr'))),
      ← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun r hr hr' => by
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hr
        simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hr'
        obtain ⟨m, _, hm⟩ := hr'
        rw [hr] at hm
        cases hm)]
    refine Finset.card_le_card fun r hr => ?_
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_biUnion] at hr ⊢
    rcases hr with hr | ⟨m, _, hr⟩ <;> rw [hr] <;> exact nofun

private theorem sum_acceptFrom_after_le (hF : IsBounded F D L) (P : Prover Unit) (n : ℕ)
    (h : History)
    (hn : D ≤ h.length + n) (s : P.State) :
    ∑ r, acceptFrom P s (after (F r) h) ≤ value F L n h := by
  induction n generalizing h s with
  | zero =>
    simp only [value, accepted]
    rw [Finset.card_filter, Nat.cast_sum]
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum fun r _ => ?_)
    rw [acceptFrom_after_eq P s (F r) h (fun m hm => hF.message r h m hm)]
    have hnil : ∀ m, outcome (F r) h ≠ .ask m := fun m hm => by
      have := hF.rounds r h m hm
      lia
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun m _ => ?_, add_zero]
    · split_ifs <;> simp
    · refine ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero.mpr fun ys => ?_
      rw [after_append]
      unfold outcome at hnil
      rcases hah : after (F r) h with _ | ⟨b⟩ | ⟨q, next⟩
      · simp
      · simp
      · exact (hnil q.2 (by rw [hah])).elim
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => acceptFrom_after_eq P s (F r) h
      (fun m hm => hF.message r h m hm), Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [value, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sum]
    refine add_le_add ?_ ?_
    · rw [accepted, Finset.card_filter, Nat.cast_sum]
      exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => by split_ifs <;> simp).le
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => ?_
    rw [← Summable.tsum_finsetSum fun r _ => ENNReal.summable]
    calc ∑' ys : List Bool × P.State, ∑ r, (P.respond ((), m)).run s ys *
          acceptFrom P ys.2 (after (F r) (h ++ [(m, ys.1)]))
        ≤ ∑' ys : List Bool × P.State, (P.respond ((), m)).run s ys *
          ((BitString.shortWords L).sup fun y => value F L n (h ++ [(m, y)]) : ℕ) := by
          refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun ys => ?_
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
          refine mul_le_mul_right ?_ _
          refine (ih (h ++ [(m, ys.1)]) (by
            simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add]
            lia) ys.2).trans ?_
          rw [value_take hF]
          exact Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.le_sup (f := fun y => value F L n (h ++ [(m, y)]))
            (BitString.mem_shortWords.mpr (List.length_take_le _ _)))
      _ = _ := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.tsum_coe, one_mul]

theorem IP_subset_PSPACE (enc : α ↪ List Bool) : IP enc ⊆ PSPACE enc := by
  rintro A ⟨V, hV, hA⟩
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty α with hα | hα
  · exact P_subset_PSPACE ⟨fun _ => false, ComputableInPolyTime.const false,
      fun a => isEmptyElim a⟩
  let _ : Inhabited α := Classical.inhabited_of_nonempty hα
  obtain ⟨_, k, Control, _, M, c, d, hreal⟩ := hV
  set fuel : α → ℕ := fun a => c * ((enc a).length + 1) ^ d
  have hfuel : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime fuel enc encUnary := by
    have hlen : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => (enc a).length) enc encUnary := by fun_prop
    exact ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval (Polynomial.C c * (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ d)).comp
      hlen).of_enc_eq fun a => by simp [fuel]
  have hdec : ComputableTidilyInPolySpace
      (fun a => decide (2 ^ fuel a < 2 * evaluate enc M fuel a)) enc encBool := by
    have hcap : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => 2 ^ fuel a) enc encNat :=
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.binary_two_pow.comp hfuel
    have hpost : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => decide (p.1 < 2 * p.2))
        (encPair encNat encNat) encBool :=
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.binary_lt' (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _)
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.binary_mul' (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 2)
          (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd _ _))
    exact (ComputableTidilyInPolySpace.of_polyTime hpost).comp
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolySpace.of_polyTime hcap).prod
        (computableInPolySpace_evaluate M (.of_tidy hfuel)).tidy)
  refine mem_PSPACE_of_computableInPolySpace (.of_tidy hdec) fun a => ?_
  rw [mem_iff_two_pow_lt_value (fun a S oracle s => hreal a S oracle s) hA a, evaluate_eq,
    decide_eq_true_iff]

theorem acceptProb_sequentialRepeat_le {round : WordOracleComp Operation Bool} {ε : ENNReal}
    (h : ∀ P : Prover Operation, acceptProb round P ≤ ε) (k : ℕ) (P : Prover Operation) :
    acceptProb (sequentialRepeat k round) P ≤ ε ^ k := by
  induction k generalizing P with
  | zero => exact (PMF.coe_le_one _ _).trans (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [sequentialRepeat, acceptProb_bind_ite, pow_succ]
    calc ∑' s, P.run round P.init (true, s) *
          acceptProb (sequentialRepeat k round) { P with init := s }
        ≤ ∑' s, P.run round P.init (true, s) * ε ^ k :=
          ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun s => mul_le_mul' le_rfl (ih _)
      _ = (∑' s, P.run round P.init (true, s)) * ε ^ k := ENNReal.tsum_mul_right
      _ ≤ ε * ε ^ k := by
          gcongr
          exact (acceptProb_eq_tsum round P).symm.trans_le (h P)
      _ = ε ^ k * ε := mul_comm _ _

    exact zero_le

    exact zero_le
  | not e ih =>

  | bin o e₁ e₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>

        rw [ArithQBF.roundDegree, Nat.cast_add, add_mul]

    · rw [ProbOracleComp.acceptProbWith_pure]
      exact zero_le
  | op o v e ih =>

theorem acceptProb_arithmetize_le [IsDomain F] {ε : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hsampler : ∀ z, ProbComp.eval sampler z ≤ ε) {xs : List V} {φ : QBF V} (hφ : φ.Closed)
    (hxs : ∀ v ∈ φ.vars, v ∈ xs) (hfalse : φ.eval (fun _ => false) = false) {S : Type}
    (respond : Query V F → StateT S PMF (List F)) (s : S) :
    acceptProbWith respond (verify sampler (φ.arithmetize xs) 0 1) s ≤
      ((2 * xs.length + 1) * φ.size ^ 2 : ℕ) * ε := by
  have h := QBF.eval_arithmetize_zero (R := F) xs hφ (fun _ => false)
  simp only [hfalse, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h
  refine (acceptProb_verify_le sampler hsampler respond _ (by rw [h]; exact zero_ne_one) s).trans ?_
  gcongr
  exact QBF.roundDegree_arithmetize_le hxs

  have hfalse : φ.eval (fun _ => false) = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.2 fun h => hφ' ⟨hφ, h⟩
  have h := QBF.eval_arithmetize_zero (R := F) φ.vars hφ (fun _ => false)

    (hsampler : ∀ z, ProbComp.eval sampler z ≤ ε) {S : Type}
    (respond : QueryAt F → StateT S PMF (List F)) (o : ArithQBF.Operator) (v : ℕ) (e : ArithQBF ℕ)

      ((ArithQBF.op o v e).ops * D : ℕ) * ε := by

  · rw [ProbOracleComp.acceptProbWith_sample_bind]
    set g := e.restrict r v

    have hp (z : F) : evalCoeffList z (x.1.take (D + 1)) = p.eval z := (eval_ofCoeffList z _).symm

      exact_mod_cast (Multiset.toFinset_card_le _).trans ((card_roots' _).trans hdeg)
    refine (Probability.PMF.tsum_mul_le_card_mul_add _ hsampler (p - g).roots.toFinset

theorem run_verifyAt_of_agreesAt (f : QueryAt F → List F) (xs : List ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ e' rest' r', (∀ w ∈ e'.vars, w ∈ xs) → AgreesAt D (f (e', rest', r')) e' r')
    (e : ArithQBF ℕ) (he : ∀ w ∈ e.vars, w ∈ xs) (hD : e.maxRoundDegree ≤ D)
    (rest : List (ArithQBF.Kind × ℕ)) (r : ℕ → F) (s : Unit) :
    runWith (fun q s => PMF.pure (f q, s)) (verifyAt sampler D e rest r (e.eval r)) s =
      PMF.pure (true, s) := by
  induction e generalizing rest r with
  | var v => simp only [verifyAt, ArithQBF.eval_var, decide_true, ProbOracleComp.runWith_pure]
  | top => simp only [verifyAt, ArithQBF.eval_top, decide_true, ProbOracleComp.runWith_pure]
  | bot => simp only [verifyAt, ArithQBF.eval_bot, decide_true, ProbOracleComp.runWith_pure]
  | not e ih => rw [verifyAt, ArithQBF.eval_not, sub_sub_cancel, ih he hD]
  | bin o e₁ e₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    rw [ArithQBF.maxRoundDegree, max_le_iff] at hD
    have he₁ : ∀ w ∈ e₁.vars, w ∈ xs := fun w hw => he w (List.mem_append_left _ hw)
    have he₂ : ∀ w ∈ e₂.vars, w ∈ xs := fun w hw => he w (List.mem_append_right _ hw)
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := hf (.bin o e₁ e₂) rest r he
    rw [verifyAt, ProbOracleComp.runWith_bind, ProbOracleComp.runWith_query]
    simp only [PMF.pure_bind, h₁, h₂, ArithQBF.eval_bin, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [ProbOracleComp.runWith_bind, ih₁ he₁ hD.1, PMF.pure_bind]
    exact ih₂ he₂ hD.2 _ r
  | op o v e ih =>
    rw [ArithQBF.maxRoundDegree, max_le_iff] at hD
    have he' : ∀ w ∈ e.vars, w ∈ xs := fun w hw => he w (List.mem_cons_of_mem v hw)
    have hlist : (f (.op o v e, rest, r)).take (D + 1) = coeffsBelow (e.restrict r v) (D + 1) :=
      hf (.op o v e) rest r he
    rw [verifyAt, ProbOracleComp.runWith_bind, ProbOracleComp.runWith_query]
    have hval (z : F) : evalCoeffList z (coeffsBelow (e.restrict r v) (D + 1)) =
        e.eval (Function.update r v z) := by
      rw [← eval_ofCoeffList, ofCoeffList_coeffsBelow (Nat.lt_succ_of_le
        ((e.natDegree_restrict_le r v).trans hD.1)), ArithQBF.eval_restrict]
    simp only [PMF.pure_bind, hlist, hval, ArithQBF.eval_op, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [ProbOracleComp.runWith_bind, ProbOracleComp.runWith_sample, PMF.bind_map]
    simp only [Function.comp_def, ih he' hD.2]
    exact PMF.bind_const _ _

private theorem exists_eventually_le_two_pow_pow {P Q R : ℕ → ℕ} (hP : PolynomiallyBounded P)
    (hQ : PolynomiallyBounded Q) (hR : PolynomiallyBounded R) :
    ∃ K, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, P n + 2 ^ Q n * R n ≤ 2 ^ n ^ K := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : PolynomiallyBounded fun n => Q n + n + 1 := by fun_prop
  refine ⟨K, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hP.eventually_lt_two_pow, hR.eventually_lt_two_pow, hK] with n h₁ h₂ h₃
  have h₄ : 1 ≤ 2 ^ Q n := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  calc P n + 2 ^ Q n * R n ≤ 2 ^ n * 2 ^ Q n + 2 ^ Q n * 2 ^ n :=
        Nat.add_le_add (h₁.le.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ h₄))
          (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h₂.le)
    _ = 2 ^ (Q n + n + 1) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ n ^ K := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) h₃

/-- **`PSPACE ⊆ EXP`** [Arora and Barak, Theorem 4.2][AroraBarak09],
[Sipser, Section 8.2][Sipser2013]: a problem in `PSPACE` is decided by a nondeterministic machine
within polynomial space (`Cslib.Complexity.PSPACE_subset_NPSPACE`), and Savitch's decider for it
runs within time exponential in a polynomial: its codes have polynomial width `w`, and it runs
`2 ^ ((w + 2) * (w + 1))` rounds of polynomial cost
(`Cslib.Reachability.computableTidilyInO_savitch`). -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem PSPACE_subset_EXP : PSPACE enc ⊆ EXP enc := by
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨k, State, hfinite, ntm, s, hs, hAn⟩ := PSPACE_subset_NPSPACE hA
  obtain ⟨c, d, hcd⟩ := hs.exists_le
  -- the inputs and the edge test of Savitch's decider are polynomial-time
  have hwidth := MultiTapeNTM.computableTidilyInPolyTime_codeWidth (ntm := ntm) (enc := enc) c d
  have hcodes : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun a => 2 * ntm.codeWidth c d (enc a) + 2) enc encUnary :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_add.comp ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_mul.comp
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 2).prod hwidth)).prod (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 2))
  have hedge : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun q : Unit × List Bool × List Bool => (fun _ => ntm.codeEdge) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      (encPair (encFinEnum Unit) (encPair encBits encBits)) encBool :=
    ntm.computableTidilyInPolyTime_codeEdge ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).comp (.snd _ _))
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd _ _).comp (.snd _ _))
  have hin : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun a => ((), 2 * ntm.codeWidth c d (enc a) + 2, 2 * ntm.codeWidth c d (enc a) + 2,
        MultiTapeNTM.viewCode (ntm.codeWidth c d (enc a)) (ntm.initView (enc a)),
        MultiTapeNTM.acceptCode (ntm.codeWidth c d (enc a)))) enc
      (Cslib.Reachability.encArgs (encFinEnum Unit)) :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const ()).prod (hcodes.prod (hcodes.prod
      ((MultiTapeNTM.computableTidilyInPolyTime_viewCode_initView hwidth (.encode enc)).prod
        (MultiTapeNTM.computableTidilyInPolyTime_acceptCode hwidth))))
  obtain ⟨te, se, hte, -, he⟩ := hedge
  obtain ⟨ti, si, hti, -, hi⟩ := hin
  have hedgeO : ComputableTidilyInO _ _ encBool te se :=
    ⟨1, he.mono (fun _ => by omega) fun _ => by omega, fun _ => by simp⟩
  have hinO : ComputableTidilyInO _ enc (Cslib.Reachability.encArgs (encFinEnum Unit)) ti
      fun a => ti a + si a :=
    ⟨1, hi.mono (fun _ => by omega) fun _ => by dsimp only; omega, fun a => by
      have := hi.length_le a
      dsimp only
      omega⟩
  have h := Cslib.Reachability.computableTidilyInO_savitch (edge := fun _ => ntm.codeEdge)
    (par := fun _ => ()) hedgeO hinO
    (fun _ => MultiTapeNTM.length_viewCode (Nat.le_add_right _ _)) fun _ => List.length_replicate ..
  -- polynomial bounds on the width, the inputs and the edge test
  obtain ⟨cW, dW, hW⟩ := hwidth.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  obtain ⟨cT, dT, hT⟩ := hti.exists_le
  obtain ⟨cE, dE, hE⟩ := hte.exists_le
  set L := (encFinEnum Unit ()).length
  have hedgeMax (w : ℕ) : Cslib.Reachability.edgeMax te () w ≤ cE * (2 * L + 3 * w + 3) ^ dE :=
    listMax_le fun u hu => listMax_le fun v hv => by
      refine (hE _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cE (Nat.pow_le_pow_left ?_ dE))
      simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply, Cslib.BitString.mem_enumList.mp hu,
        Cslib.BitString.mem_enumList.mp hv]
      omega
  set B : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => 2 * (cW * (n + 1) ^ dW) + 2
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_eventually_le_two_pow_pow (P := fun n => cT * (n + 1) ^ dT)
    (Q := fun n => (B n + 2) * (B n + 1))
    (R := fun n => ((B n + 1) * (B n + B n + 1) + L + 1) ^ 2 + cE * (2 * L + 3 * B n + 3) ^ dE)
    (by fun_prop) (by simp only [B]; fun_prop) (by simp only [B]; fun_prop)
  have hmem := setOf_mem_DTIME_of_computableInO (.of_tidy h)
    (t := fun n => cT * (n + 1) ^ dT + 2 ^ ((B n + 2) * (B n + 1)) *
      (((B n + 1) * (B n + B n + 1) + L + 1) ^ 2 + cE * (2 * L + 3 * B n + 3) ^ dE))
    fun a => by
      have hw : 2 * ntm.codeWidth c d (enc a) + 2 ≤ B (enc a).length := by
        have := hW a
        simp only [encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate] at this
        simp only [B]
        omega
      gcongr
      · exact hT a
      · exact (hedgeMax _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cE (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) dE))
  have hA' : A = {a | ntm.savitchDecide c d (enc a) = true} := Set.ext fun a =>
    (hAn.recognizesInSpace a).2.trans
      (MultiTapeNTM.savitchDecide_eq_true_iff (hAn.recognizesInSpace a).1 (hcd a)).symm
  rw [hA']
  exact mem_EXP_iff.mpr ⟨K, DTIME_mono_of_eventually_le hK hmem⟩

/-- The pairs `(a, u)` from which alternating quantifiers over blocks of certificates of the

private theorem alternationSet_mem_PSPACE (ps : List (Polynomial ℕ)) :
    ∀ (q : Bool) (V : α × List Bool → Bool),
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime V (encPair enc encBits) encBool →
        alternationSet enc q ps V ∈ PSPACE (encPair enc encBits) := by
  induction ps with
  | nil =>
    intro q V hV
    exact P_subset_PSPACE ⟨V, .of_tidy hV, fun x => by simp [alternationSet]⟩
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hex (V : α × List Bool → Bool)
        (hV : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime V (encPair enc encBits) encBool) :
        alternationSet enc true (p :: ps) V ∈ PSPACE (encPair enc encBits) := by
      -- the remaining quantifiers, after the first block of certificates
      have hB : {y : (α × List Bool) × List Bool | (y.1.1, y.1.2 ++ y.2) ∈
          alternationSet enc false ps V} ∈ PSPACE (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encBits) :=
        PolyTimeReducible.mem_PSPACE ⟨fun y => (y.1.1, y.1.2 ++ y.2),
          .of_tidy (((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).comp (.fst _ _)).prod
            (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsAppend
              ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd _ _).comp (.fst _ _)) (.snd _ _))),
          fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩ (ih false V hV)
      have hℓ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x : α × List Bool => p.eval (enc x.1).length)
          (encPair enc encBits) encUnary :=
        ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval p).comp
          (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc)).comp (.fst _ _)
      convert setOf_exists_mem_PSPACE hB (.of_tidy hℓ) using 1
      ext x
      simp only [alternationSet, List.map_cons, alternation_true_cons, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
        List.append_assoc]
    intro q V hV
    cases q
    · -- a universal block is the complement of an existential block
      convert compl_mem_PSPACE (hex (fun x => !V x) (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bool_not.comp hV))
        using 1
      ext x
      simp only [alternationSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_compl_iff, not_alternation,
        Bool.not_true]
      exact alternation_congr fun w => by simp
    · exact hex V hV

private theorem eventually_clock_le (i : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, ∀ j < n, clock i (word j).length ≤ n := by
  have hpoly : PolynomiallyBounded fun l => (2 * l + 2) ^ i := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (PolynomiallyBounded.eventually_lt_two_pow hpoly)
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (2 ^ L)] with n hn j hj
  have hlog : (word j).length ≤ Nat.log 2 n :=

theorem exists_H_le_of_mem_P (h : SATH ∈ P encBits) : ∃ C, ∀ n, H n ≤ C := by
  obtain ⟨f, hfpoly, hf⟩ := mem_P.mp h
  obtain ⟨t, s, ht, -, k, State, hfinite, tm, htm⟩ := hfpoly.tidy
  have := Fintype.ofFinite State
  let eS : State ↪ ℕ := (Fintype.equivFin State).toEmbedding.trans Fin.valEmbedding
  have hrun (x : List Bool) : (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) (t x)).Halted ∧
      (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) (t x)).output = [f x] :=
    ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace.runFrom_initCfg (htm x)
  obtain ⟨c, e, hle⟩ := ht.exists_le
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hdesc⟩ := exists_index_ge (desc eS eBit tm) (c + e)
  -- the clock of the index exceeds the time bound
  have hclock (x : List Bool) : t x ≤ clock i x.length := by
    calc t x ≤ c * (x.length + 1) ^ e := hle x
      _ ≤ 2 ^ i * (x.length + 1) ^ i :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul ((Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := i)).le.trans' (by omega))
            (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
      _ = clock i x.length := by rw [clock, ← mul_pow]; ring_nf
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (eventually_clock_le i)
  refine ⟨max i N, fun n => ?_⟩
  rcases lt_or_ge n N with hn | hn
  · exact (H_le_self n).trans (by omega)
  · refine (H_le_of_agrees fun j hj => ⟨f (word j), ?_, hf (word j) |>.symm⟩).trans
      (le_max_left _ _)
    rw [runIndexed, hdesc, min_eq_left (hN n hn j hj)]
    exact universal_desc_of_halted eS tm hrun (hclock _)

private theorem length_shrink_lt {R : CNF ℕ → List Bool} {c d M N : ℕ}
    (hRlen : ∀ φ, (R φ).length ≤ c * ((encCNF φ).length + 1) ^ d) (hM : ∀ m ≥ M, d + 1 ≤ H m)
    (hN₁ : (encCNF falseCNF).length < N) (hN₂ : M ≤ N) (hN₃ : c * 2 ^ d < N) {φ : CNF ℕ}
    (hφ : N ≤ (encCNF φ).length) : (encCNF (shrink R N φ)).length < (encCNF φ).length := by
  rw [shrink, ite_eq_right (by omega)]
  cases hc : padCheck H (R φ) with
  | none => exact hN₁.trans_le hφ
  | some ψ =>
    rw [Option.getD_some]
    have hlen := congrArg List.length (padCheck_eq_some_iff.mp hc)
    rw [length_pad] at hlen
    have hRφ := hRlen φ
    generalize (encCNF φ).length = n at *
    generalize (encCNF ψ).length = m at *
    by_contra hge
    replace hge := not_lt.mp hge
    have hn : 1 ≤ n := by omega
    have hHm := hM m (by omega)
    -- the padding is at least `n ^ (d + 1)`
    have hpad : n ^ (d + 1) ≤ m ^ H m :=
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hge _).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hHm)
    -- the output bound is less than `n ^ (d + 1)`
    have hbound : c * (n + 1) ^ d < n ^ (d + 1) :=
      calc c * (n + 1) ^ d ≤ c * (2 ^ d * n ^ d) := by
            rw [← mul_pow]
            exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _)
        _ = c * 2 ^ d * n ^ d := by ring
        _ < N * n ^ d := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN₃ (Nat.pow_pos hn)
        _ ≤ n * n ^ d := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hφ
        _ = n ^ (d + 1) := by ring
    omega

theorem SAT_mem_P_of_reducible_of_tendsto (hR : PolyTimeReducible encCNF encBits SAT SATH)
    (hH : Filter.Tendsto H Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) : SAT ∈ P encCNF := by
  obtain ⟨R, hRpoly, hR⟩ := hR
  have hRtidy := hRpoly.tidy
  obtain ⟨c, d, hRlen⟩ := hRtidy.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  simp only [encBits_apply] at hRlen
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (Filter.tendsto_atTop.mp hH (d + 1))
  set N := max ((encCNF falseCNF).length + 1) (max M (c * 2 ^ d + 1)) with hN
  have hlt (φ : CNF ℕ) (hφ : N ≤ (encCNF φ).length) :=
    length_shrink_lt hRlen hM (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hφ
  -- the polynomial-time certificate of a round
  have hshrink : ComputableInPolyTime (shrink R N) encCNF encCNF := by
    have hH' : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : CNF ℕ × ℕ => H p.2) (encPair encCNF encUnary)
        encUnary := by fun_prop
    have helse : ComputableInPolyTime (fun φ => (padCheck H (R φ)).getD falseCNF)
        encCNF encCNF := by
      fun_prop
    have := helse.tidy
    unfold shrink
    exact .of_tidy (by fun_prop)
  -- the rounds preserve satisfiability and shorten the formula to below `N`
  obtain ⟨hreduce, hinv⟩ := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.iterate_spec
    (count := fun φ => (encCNF φ).length) (init := fun φ => φ) (step := shrink R N)
    (by fun_prop) ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id' hshrink.tidy
    (fun φ k ψ => (ψ ∈ SAT ↔ φ ∈ SAT) ∧ (encCNF ψ).length ≤ max ((encCNF φ).length - k) (N - 1))
    (fun φ => ⟨Iff.rfl, by omega⟩)
    (fun φ k ψ _ ⟨hsat, hlen⟩ => by
      refine ⟨(shrink_mem_SAT_iff hR N ψ).trans hsat, ?_⟩
      by_cases hψ : (encCNF ψ).length < N
      · rw [shrink, ite_eq_left hψ]
        omega
      · have := hlt ψ (not_lt.mp hψ)
        omega)
    (size := fun φ => (encCNF φ).length + N) (.add .self (.const N))
    (fun φ k ψ _ ⟨_, hlen⟩ => by omega)
  refine ⟨fun φ => (smallSAT N).any fun w => decide (encCNF (selfReduce R N φ) = w), ?_,
    fun φ => ?_⟩
  · have hdec : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun φ => (smallSAT N).any fun w => decide (encCNF φ = w)) encCNF encBool :=
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.anyConst _ fun w _ =>
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.decide_eq encBits).comp
          ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encode encCNF).prod (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const w))
    exact .of_tidy (hdec.comp hreduce)
  · obtain ⟨hsat, hlen⟩ := hinv φ
    have hmem := mem_smallSAT (N := N) (φ := selfReduce R N φ) (by rw [selfReduce]; omega)
    rw [selfReduce] at hmem
    simp only [List.any_eq_true, selfReduce]
    constructor
    · intro hφ
      exact ⟨_, hmem.mpr (hsat.mpr hφ), decide_eq_true rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, hw, he⟩
      rw [← of_decide_eq_true he] at hw
      exact hsat.mp (hmem.mp hw)

private theorem reaches_markers {c i F : ℕ} (hP : P.CodeAt c (tableCode v c i F))
    (hi : i < a.2.length) (hLB : a.1 ^ arityAt v i ≤ B) :
    ∀ e j (regs : List ℕ), a.1 ^ arityAt v i - j = e → j ≤ a.1 ^ arityAt v i →
      j ≤ a.2[i].length → regs.getD 0 0 = a.1 → regs.getD 1 0 = tableStart a i →
      regs.getD 2 0 = j → 3 ≤ regs.length → (∀ r ∈ regs, r ≤ B) →
      ∃ regs', P.Reaches (encStructure a) (P.Running B) (c + 1, regs)
        (if a.1 ^ arityAt v i ≤ a.2[i].length then c + 3 else F, regs') ∧
        regs'.length = regs.length ∧ regs'.getD 0 0 = a.1 ∧ regs'.getD 1 0 = tableStart a i ∧
        (a.1 ^ arityAt v i ≤ a.2[i].length → regs'.getD 2 0 = a.1 ^ arityAt v i) ∧
        ∀ r ∈ regs', r ≤ B := by
  simp only [tableCode, codeAt_cons] at hP
  obtain ⟨-, h₁, h₂, -, h₄, -, -⟩ := hP
  rw [show c + 1 + 1 = c + 2 by omega] at h₂
  rw [show c + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = c + 4 by omega] at h₄
  intro e
  induction e with
  | zero =>
    intro j regs he hjL hjt h0 h1 h2 hlen hB
    have hj : j = a.1 ^ arityAt v i := by omega
    refine ⟨regs, ?_, rfl, h0, h1, fun _ => h2.trans hj, hB⟩
    refine Reaches.lt h₁ hB ?_
    simp only [eval_reg, eval_lenExpr h0, h2, hj, lt_irrefl, ↓reduceIte,
      show a.1 ^ arityAt v i ≤ a.2[i].length by omega]
    exact Reaches.refl _
  | succ e ih =>
    intro j regs he hjL hjt h0 h1 h2 hlen hB
    have hjL' : j < a.1 ^ arityAt v i := by omega
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hjt with hjt' | hjt'
    · obtain ⟨regs', hreach, hlen', h0', h1', h2', hB'⟩ :=
        ih (j + 1) (regs.set 2 (j + 1)) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
          (by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), h0]) (by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), h1])
          (List.getD_set_self (by omega)) (by simpa using hlen)
          (List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB (by omega))
      refine ⟨regs', ?_, by simpa using hlen', h0', h1', h2', hB'⟩
      refine Reaches.lt h₁ hB ?_
      simp only [eval_reg, eval_lenExpr h0, h2, hjL', ↓reduceIte]
      refine Reaches.read h₂ hB ?_
      simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_const, eval_reg, h1, h2,
        getElem?_encStructure_tableStart_two_mul hi hjt', readLabel]
      refine Reaches.assign h₄ hB ?_
      simp only [eval_add, eval_reg, eval_const, h2]
      exact hreach
    · refine ⟨regs, ?_, rfl, h0, h1, fun h => absurd h (by omega), hB⟩
      refine Reaches.lt h₁ hB ?_
      simp only [eval_reg, eval_lenExpr h0, h2, hjL', ↓reduceIte]
      refine Reaches.read h₂ hB ?_
      simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_const, eval_reg, h1, h2, hjt',
        getElem?_encStructure_tableStart_two_mul_length hi, readLabel,
        show ¬ (a.1 ^ arityAt v i ≤ a.2[i].length) by omega, ↓reduceIte]
      exact Reaches.refl _

/-- **Checking a table**: from the code of the table at position `i ≤ |tables|`, with the
cardinality in register `0` and the position of the table in register `1`, the program moves
register `1` past the table and goes to `c + 6` if the table exists and has `n ^ k` bits, and goes
to `F` otherwise. -/

text:
private theorem reaches_tableCode {c i F : ℕ} (hP : P.CodeAt c (tableCode v c i F))
    (hi : i ≤ a.2.length) (hLB : a.1 ^ arityAt v i ≤ B) (hwB : (encStructure a).length ≤ B)
    (regs : List ℕ) (h0 : regs.getD 0 0 = a.1) (h1 : regs.getD 1 0 = tableStart a i)
    (hlen : 3 ≤ regs.length) (hB : ∀ r ∈ regs, r ≤ B) :
    ∃ regs', P.Reaches (encStructure a) (P.Running B) (c, regs)
      (if TableOk v a i then c + 6 else F, regs') ∧ regs'.length = regs.length ∧
      regs'.getD 0 0 = a.1 ∧ (TableOk v a i → regs'.getD 1 0 = tableStart a (i + 1)) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ regs', r ≤ B := by
  have hP' := hP
  simp only [tableCode, codeAt_cons] at hP'
  obtain ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, -, h₅, -⟩ := hP'
  rw [show c + 1 + 1 = c + 2 by omega] at h₂
  rw [show c + 1 + 1 + 1 = c + 3 by omega] at h₃
  rw [show c + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = c + 5 by omega] at h₅
  have hB₀ : ∀ r ∈ regs.set 2 0, r ≤ B := List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB (Nat.zero_le _)
  have h0' : (regs.set 2 0).getD 0 0 = a.1 := by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), h0]
  have h1' : (regs.set 2 0).getD 1 0 = tableStart a i := by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), h1]
  have h2' : (regs.set 2 0).getD 2 0 = 0 := List.getD_set_self (by omega)
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hi with hi | hi
  · -- the table exists
    obtain ⟨regs₁, hreach₁, hlen₁, h0₁, h1₁, h2₁, hB₁⟩ :=
      reaches_markers hP hi hLB (a.1 ^ arityAt v i - 0) 0 (regs.set 2 0) rfl (Nat.zero_le _)
        (Nat.zero_le _) h0' h1' h2' (by simpa using hlen) hB₀
    by_cases hLt : a.1 ^ arityAt v i ≤ a.2[i].length
    · have hreach₁' : P.Reaches (encStructure a) (P.Running B) (c + 1, regs.set 2 0)
          (c + 3, regs₁) := by simpa [hLt] using hreach₁
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hLt with hlt | heq
      · -- too many bits
        have hok : ¬ TableOk v a i := fun ⟨_, h⟩ => by omega
        refine ⟨regs₁, ?_, by simpa using hlen₁, h0₁, fun h => absurd h hok, hB₁⟩
        simp only [hok, ↓reduceIte]
        refine Reaches.assign h₀ hB (hreach₁'.trans ?_)
        refine Reaches.read h₃ hB₁ ?_
        simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_const, eval_reg, eval_lenExpr h0₁, h1₁,
          getElem?_encStructure_tableStart_two_mul hi hlt, readLabel]
        exact Reaches.refl _
      · -- exactly `n ^ k` bits
        have hok : TableOk v a i := ⟨hi, heq.symm⟩
        have hnext : tableStart a i + 2 * a.1 ^ arityAt v i + 1 = tableStart a (i + 1) := by
          rw [tableStart_succ hi, heq]
        refine ⟨regs₁.set 1 (tableStart a i + 2 * a.1 ^ arityAt v i + 1), ?_,
          by simp [hlen₁], by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), h0₁], fun _ => ?_,
          List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB₁ ?_⟩
        · simp only [hok, ↓reduceIte]
          refine Reaches.assign h₀ hB (hreach₁'.trans ?_)
          refine Reaches.read h₃ hB₁ ?_
          simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_const, eval_reg, eval_lenExpr h0₁, h1₁, heq,
            getElem?_encStructure_tableStart_two_mul_length hi, readLabel]
          refine Reaches.assign h₅ hB₁ ?_
          simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_const, eval_reg, eval_lenExpr h0₁, h1₁, heq]
          exact Reaches.refl _
        · rw [List.getD_set_self (by simp only [List.length_set] at hlen₁; omega), hnext]
        · rw [hnext]
          exact (tableStart_le_length a _).trans hwB
    · -- too few bits
      have hok : ¬ TableOk v a i := fun ⟨_, h⟩ => by omega
      refine ⟨regs₁, ?_, by simpa using hlen₁, h0₁, fun h => absurd h hok, hB₁⟩
      simp only [hok, ↓reduceIte]
      exact Reaches.assign h₀ hB (by simpa [hLt] using hreach₁)
  · -- no table
    have hok : ¬ TableOk v a i := fun ⟨h, _⟩ => by omega
    have hend (q : ℕ) : (encStructure a)[tableStart a i + q]? = none := by
      rw [hi]
      exact getElem?_encStructure_tableStart_length_add a q
    refine ⟨regs.set 2 0, ?_, by simp, h0', fun h => absurd h hok, hB₀⟩
    simp only [hok, ↓reduceIte]
    refine Reaches.assign h₀ hB ?_
    refine Reaches.lt h₁ hB₀ ?_
    simp only [eval_const, eval_reg, eval_lenExpr h0', h2']
    by_cases hL0 : 0 < a.1 ^ arityAt v i
    · simp only [hL0, ↓reduceIte]
      refine Reaches.read h₂ hB₀ ?_
      simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_const, eval_reg, h1', h2', hend, readLabel]
      exact Reaches.refl _
    · simp only [hL0, ↓reduceIte]
      refine Reaches.read h₃ hB₀ ?_
      simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_const, eval_reg, eval_lenExpr h0', h1',
        show a.1 ^ arityAt v i = 0 by omega, hend, readLabel]
      exact Reaches.refl _

private theorem reaches_tables {b F : ℕ}
    (hP : P.CodeAt (b + 3) ((List.range v.count).flatMap fun i => tableCode v (b + 3 + 6 * i) i F))
    (hLB : ∀ i, a.1 ^ arityAt v i ≤ B) (hwB : (encStructure a).length ≤ B) :
    ∀ e m (regs : List ℕ), v.count - m = e → m ≤ v.count → (∀ i < m, TableOk v a i) →
      regs.getD 0 0 = a.1 → regs.getD 1 0 = tableStart a m → 3 ≤ regs.length →
      (∀ r ∈ regs, r ≤ B) →
      ∃ regs', P.Reaches (encStructure a) (P.Running B) (b + 3 + 6 * m, regs)
        (if ∀ i < v.count, TableOk v a i then b + 3 + 6 * v.count else F, regs') ∧
        regs'.length = regs.length ∧ regs'.getD 0 0 = a.1 ∧
        ((∀ i < v.count, TableOk v a i) → regs'.getD 1 0 = tableStart a v.count) ∧
        ∀ r ∈ regs', r ≤ B := by
  intro e
  induction e with
  | zero =>
    intro m regs he hm hok h0 h1 hlen hB
    have hm' : m = v.count := by omega
    subst hm'
    refine ⟨regs, ?_, rfl, h0, fun _ => h1, hB⟩
    rw [ite_eq_left hok]
    exact Reaches.refl _
  | succ e ih =>
    intro m regs he hm hok h0 h1 hlen hB
    have hmc : m < v.count := by omega
    have hma : m ≤ a.2.length := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with h | h
      · omega
      · obtain ⟨h', -⟩ := hok (m - 1) (by omega)
        omega
    obtain ⟨regs₁, hreach₁, hlen₁, h0₁, h1₁, hB₁⟩ :=
      reaches_tableCode (CodeAt.flatMap_range (f := fun i => tableCode v (b + 3 + 6 * i) i F)
        (fun i => length_tableCode v _ i F) hP m hmc) hma (hLB m) hwB regs h0 h1 hlen hB
    by_cases hokm : TableOk v a m
    · obtain ⟨regs₂, hreach₂, hlen₂, h0₂, h1₂, hB₂⟩ :=
        ih (m + 1) regs₁ (by omega) (by omega)
          (fun i hi => by
            rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hi) with h | h
            · exact hok i h
            · exact h ▸ hokm)
          h0₁ (h1₁ hokm) (hlen₁ ▸ hlen) hB₁
      refine ⟨regs₂, ?_, hlen₂.trans hlen₁, h0₂, h1₂, hB₂⟩
      refine (show P.Reaches _ _ _ (b + 3 + 6 * m + 6, regs₁) by simpa [hokm] using hreach₁).trans
        ?_
      rw [show b + 3 + 6 * m + 6 = b + 3 + 6 * (m + 1) by ring]
      exact hreach₂
    · have hall : ¬ ∀ i < v.count, TableOk v a i := fun h => hokm (h m hmc)
      refine ⟨regs₁, ?_, hlen₁, h0₁, fun h => absurd h hall, hB₁⟩
      simpa [hokm, hall] using hreach₁

/-- **The shape check accepts exactly the well-formed inputs**: from the code of the shape check,
with register `0` holding `0`, the program goes to `T` with the cardinality in register `0` if the
input is well formed, and to `F` otherwise. The registers stay below `B` if `B` bounds the length
of the input and the sizes `n ^ k` of the tables. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem reaches_shapeCode {b T F : ℕ} (hP : P.CodeAt b (shapeCode v b T F))
    (hLB : ∀ i, a.1 ^ arityAt v i ≤ B) (hwB : (encStructure a).length ≤ B) (regs : List ℕ)
    (h0 : regs.getD 0 0 = 0) (hlen : 3 ≤ regs.length) (hB : ∀ r ∈ regs, r ≤ B) :
    ∃ regs', P.Reaches (encStructure a) (P.Running B) (b, regs)
      (if v.WellFormed a then T else F, regs') ∧ regs'.length = regs.length ∧
      (v.WellFormed a → regs'.getD 0 0 = a.1) ∧ ∀ r ∈ regs', r ≤ B := by
  rw [shapeCode, codeAt_append, codeAt_append, List.length_append, length_tables] at hP
  obtain ⟨⟨h₃, htab⟩, hend⟩ := hP
  simp only [codeAt_cons, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at h₃ htab hend
  obtain ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂, -⟩ := h₃
  rw [show b + 1 + 1 = b + 2 by omega] at h₂
  rw [show b + (0 + 1 + 1 + 1) = b + 3 by omega] at htab
  rw [show b + (0 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 6 * v.count) = b + 3 + 6 * v.count by omega] at hend
  replace hend := hend.1
  have hnB : a.1 ≤ B := (card_le_length_encStructure a).trans hwB
  -- the cardinality
  obtain ⟨regs₁, hreach₁, hlen₁, h0₁, hB₁⟩ :=
    reaches_count h₀ h₁ hnB (a.1 - regs.getD 0 0) regs rfl (by omega) (by omega) hB
  have hstart : 2 * a.1 + 1 = tableStart a 0 := by simp [tableStart]
  have hB₁' : ∀ r ∈ regs₁.set 1 (2 * a.1 + 1), r ≤ B :=
    List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB₁ ((two_mul_card_add_one_le_length a).trans hwB)
  -- the tables
  obtain ⟨regs₂, hreach₂, hlen₂, h0₂, h1₂, hB₂⟩ :=
    reaches_tables htab hLB hwB (v.count - 0) 0 (regs₁.set 1 (2 * a.1 + 1)) rfl
      (Nat.zero_le _) (fun _ h => absurd h (by omega))
      (by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), h0₁])
      (by rw [List.getD_set_self (by omega), hstart]) (by simp only [List.length_set]; omega) hB₁'
  have hreach : P.Reaches (encStructure a) (P.Running B) (b, regs)
      (if ∀ i < v.count, TableOk v a i then b + 3 + 6 * v.count else F, regs₂) := by
    refine hreach₁.trans (Reaches.assign h₂ hB₁ ?_)
    simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_const, eval_reg, h0₁]
    simpa using hreach₂
  by_cases hall : ∀ i < v.count, TableOk v a i
  · -- the end of the input
    have hca : v.count ≤ a.2.length := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos v.count with h | h
      · omega
      · obtain ⟨h', -⟩ := hall (v.count - 1) (by omega)
        omega
    rw [ite_eq_left hall] at hreach
    replace h1₂ := h1₂ hall
    refine ⟨regs₂, hreach.trans (Reaches.read hend hB₂ ?_), by simp [hlen₂, hlen₁],
      fun _ => h0₂, hB₂⟩
    simp only [eval_reg, h1₂]
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hca with hlt | heq
    · have hwf : ¬ v.WellFormed a := fun h => by
        rw [wellFormed_iff_tableOk] at h
        omega
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp (getElem?_encStructure_tableStart_isSome hlt)
      rw [hx, ite_eq_right hwf]
      cases x <;> exact Reaches.refl _
    · have hwf : v.WellFormed a := wellFormed_iff_tableOk.mpr ⟨hall, heq.symm⟩
      have := getElem?_encStructure_tableStart_length_add a 0
      rw [Nat.add_zero, ← heq] at this
      rw [this, ite_eq_left hwf]
      exact Reaches.refl _
  · have hwf : ¬ v.WellFormed a := fun h => hall (wellFormed_iff_tableOk.mp h).1
    refine ⟨regs₂, ?_, by simp [hlen₂, hlen₁], fun h => absurd h hwf, hB₂⟩
    rw [ite_eq_right hall] at hreach
    rwa [ite_eq_right hwf]

theorem pow_arityAt_le (a : EncodedStructure) (i : ℕ) :
    a.1 ^ arityAt v i ≤ ((encStructure a).length + 1) ^ (regExponent v) := by
  have h₁ : a.1 ≤ (encStructure a).length + 1 :=
    (card_le_length_encStructure a).trans (Nat.le_succ _)
  have h₂ : arityAt v i ≤ (regExponent v) := by
    unfold arityAt regExponent
    split_ifs with h
    · exact (Finset.le_sup (f := v.arity) (Finset.mem_univ ⟨i, h⟩)).trans (Nat.le_succ _)
    · exact Nat.zero_le _
  exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h₁ _).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos _) h₂)

theorem queryLanguage_mem_L (φ : L.Sentence) :
    v.queryLanguage {M | M ⊨ φ} ∈ Complexity.L encStructure := by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun a => decide (a ∈ v.queryLanguage {M | M ⊨ φ}), ?_, fun a => by simp⟩
  refine (v.modelChecker φ).computableInLogSpace_of_reaches (regExponent v) fun a => ?_
  have hE := length_shapeCode v 0 (4 + 6 * v.count) (4 + 6 * v.count + codeLength φ + 1)
  have hC := length_formulaCode v (fun e : Empty => e.elim) 3 φ (4 + 6 * v.count)
    (4 + 6 * v.count + codeLength φ) (4 + 6 * v.count + codeLength φ + 1)
  have hcode : (v.modelChecker φ).CodeAt 0 (v.modelChecker φ).code :=
    codeAt_of_code_eq (pre := []) (post := []) (by simp)
  change (v.modelChecker φ).CodeAt 0 (_ ++ _ ++ _) at hcode
  rw [codeAt_append, codeAt_append] at hcode
  obtain ⟨⟨hshape, hcomp⟩, hhalt⟩ := hcode
  simp only [List.length_append, hE, hC, Nat.zero_add] at hcomp hhalt
  simp only [codeAt_cons] at hhalt
  obtain ⟨hacc, hrej, -⟩ := hhalt
  have hwB := length_le_pow_regExponent v a
  have hnB := (card_le_length_encStructure a).trans hwB
  obtain ⟨regs₁, hreach₁, hlen₁, h0₁, hB₁⟩ :=
    reaches_shapeCode hshape (pow_arityAt_le v a) hwB (List.replicate (3 + boundDepth φ) 0)
      (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)
  by_cases hwf : v.WellFormed a
  · rw [ite_eq_left hwf] at hreach₁
    obtain ⟨res, regs₂, hres, hreach₂, -, -, hB₂⟩ :=
      reaches_formulaCode hwf hnB (fun e : Empty => e.elim) 3 (by norm_num) (fun e => e.elim)
        default φ _ _ _ regs₁ default hcomp (by rw [hlen₁]; simp) (h0₁ hwf) hB₁ (fun e => e.elim)
        (fun i => i.elim0)
    refine ⟨(if res then 4 + 6 * v.count + codeLength φ else 4 + 6 * v.count + codeLength φ + 1,
      regs₂), hreach₁.trans hreach₂, ?_, hB₂⟩
    have hmem : a ∈ v.queryLanguage {M | M ⊨ φ} ↔ res = true := by
      rw [mem_queryLanguage, hres]
      exact and_iff_right hwf
    cases res
    · rw [ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, hrej]
      simp [hmem]
    · rw [ite_eq_left rfl, hacc]
      simp [hmem]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hwf] at hreach₁
    refine ⟨(4 + 6 * v.count + codeLength φ + 1, regs₁), hreach₁, ?_, hB₁⟩
    rw [hrej]
    simp [mem_queryLanguage, hwf]

private theorem reaches_formulaCodeWith_imp (hbase : 0 < base) (hfv : ∀ x, fv x < base)
    {k : ℕ} (φ ψ : L.BoundedFormula α k) (b T F : ℕ) (regs : List ℕ) (xs : Fin k → Fin n)
    (hP : P.CodeAt b (formulaCodeWith C base (.imp φ ψ) b T F))
    (hd : base + boundDepth (.imp φ ψ) ≤ regs.length)
    (h0 : regs.getD 0 0 = n) (hB : ∀ r ∈ regs, r ≤ B) (hv : ∀ x, regs.getD (fv x) 0 = val x)
    (hxs : ∀ i : Fin k, regs.getD (base + i) 0 = xs i)
    (ihφ : ∀ b T F (regs : List ℕ) (xs : Fin k → Fin n),

private theorem eval_termExpr {n : ℕ} [Fact (2 ≤ n)] [L.Structure (Fin n)]
    {α : Type*} {fv : α → ℕ} {base k : ℕ} {regs : List ℕ}
    {val : α → Fin n} {xs : Fin k → Fin n} (h0 : regs.getD 0 0 = n)

    (hxs : ∀ i : Fin k, regs.getD (base + i) 0 = xs i)
    (t : (language L).Term (α ⊕ Fin k)) :
    (termExpr fv base t).eval regs = (t.realize (Sum.elim val xs) : Fin n) := by
  cases t with
  | var x => cases x <;> first | exact hv _ | exact hxs _
  | func f ts =>
    cases f with
    | inl f => exact isEmptyElim f
    | inr f =>
      cases f with
      | zero => rfl
      | one => rfl

  let A := E + 1 + codeLength φ
  let F := A + 1

  have hC := ModelChecker.length_formulaCode v (fun e : Empty => e.elim) 3 φ (E + 1) A F
  have hcode : (modelChecker v φ).CodeAt 0 (modelChecker v φ).code :=
    codeAt_of_code_eq (pre := []) (post := []) (by simp)
  change (modelChecker v φ).CodeAt 0 (shapeCode v 0 E F ++
    [.lt (reg 0) (const 2) F (E + 1)] ++
    ModelChecker.formulaCode v (fun e : Empty => e.elim) 3 φ (E + 1) A F ++
    [.accept, .reject]) at hcode
  rw [codeAt_append, codeAt_append, codeAt_append] at hcode
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨hshape, hguard⟩, hcomp⟩, hhalt⟩ := hcode
  simp only [List.length_append, hE, hC, List.length_singleton, Nat.zero_add]
    at hguard hcomp hhalt
  obtain ⟨hacc, hrest⟩ := codeAt_cons.mp hhalt
  have hrej := (codeAt_cons.mp hrest).1
  replace hguard := (codeAt_cons.mp hguard).1
  have hwB := length_le_pow_regExponent v a
  have hnB := (card_le_length_encStructure a).trans hwB
  obtain ⟨regs₁, hreach₁, hlen₁, h0₁, hB₁⟩ :=
    reaches_shapeCode hshape (pow_arityAt_le v a) hwB (List.replicate (3 + boundDepth φ) 0)
      (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)
  by_cases hwf : v.WellFormed a
  · rw [ite_eq_left hwf] at hreach₁
    have hreachGuard : (modelChecker v φ).Reaches (encStructure a)
        ((modelChecker v φ).Running (((encStructure a).length + 1) ^ regExponent v))
        (E, regs₁) (if a.1 < 2 then F else E + 1, regs₁) := by
      refine Reaches.lt hguard hB₁ ?_
      simp only [eval_reg, eval_const, h0₁ hwf]

    by_cases hn : 2 ≤ a.1

      rw [ite_eq_right (Nat.not_lt.mpr hn)] at hreachGuard
      obtain ⟨res, regs₂, hres, hreach₂, -, -, hB₂⟩ :=
        ModelChecker.reaches_formulaCode hwf hnB (fun e : Empty => e.elim) 3 (by decide)
          (fun e => e.elim) default φ _ _ _ regs₁ default hcomp (by rw [hlen₁]; simp)

      · rw [ite_eq_left rfl, hacc]

    simp [queryLanguage, hwf]

theorem reaches_coordinatesCode {d m b n u : ℕ} (hP : P.CodeAt b (coordinatesCode d m b))
    (hu : u < n ^ d) (hnB : n ≤ B) (regs : List ℕ) (h0 : regs.getD 0 0 = n)
    (h4 : regs.getD 4 0 = u) (hlen : tupleReg d m d ≤ regs.length) (hB : ∀ r ∈ regs, r ≤ B) :
    ∃ regs', P.Reaches w (P.Running B) (b, regs) (b + d, regs') ∧
      regs'.length = regs.length ∧ (∀ i < d, regs'.getD (tupleReg d m i) 0 = u / n ^ i % n) ∧
      (∀ r, (∀ i < d, r ≠ tupleReg d m i) → regs'.getD r 0 = regs.getD r 0) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ regs', r ≤ B := by
  have key : ∀ k ≤ d, ∃ regs', P.Reaches w (P.Running B) (b, regs) (b + k, regs') ∧
      regs'.length = regs.length ∧ (∀ i < k, regs'.getD (tupleReg d m i) 0 = u / n ^ i % n) ∧
      (∀ r, (∀ i < k, r ≠ tupleReg d m i) → regs'.getD r 0 = regs.getD r 0) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ regs', r ≤ B := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact fun _ => ⟨regs, Reaches.refl _, rfl, fun _ h => absurd h (by omega),
        fun _ _ => rfl, hB⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      obtain ⟨regs₁, hreach, hlen₁, hset, hkeep, hB₁⟩ := ih (by omega)
      have hc : P.instr (b + k) =
          .assign (tupleReg d m k) (mod (div (reg 4) (pow (reg 0) k)) (reg 0)) (b + k + 1) := by
        rw [hP k (by rw [length_coordinatesCode]; omega)]
        simp [coordinatesCode]
      have h0₁ : regs₁.getD 0 0 = n := by rw [hkeep 0 (fun i _ => by unfold tupleReg; omega), h0]
      have h4₁ : regs₁.getD 4 0 = u := by rw [hkeep 4 (fun i _ => by unfold tupleReg; omega), h4]
      have hn : 0 < n := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | h
        · rw [zero_pow (by omega)] at hu
          omega
        · exact h
      refine ⟨regs₁.set (tupleReg d m k) (u / n ^ k % n), hreach.trans (Reaches.assign hc hB₁ ?_),
        by rw [List.length_set, hlen₁], fun i hi => ?_, fun r hr => ?_,
        List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB₁ ((Nat.mod_lt _ hn).le.trans hnB)⟩
      · simp only [eval_mod, eval_div, eval_pow, eval_reg, h4₁, h0₁]
        exact Reaches.refl _
      · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hi) with hi | rfl
        · rw [List.getD_set_ne (by unfold tupleReg; omega), hset i hi]
        · exact List.getD_set_self (by rw [hlen₁]; simp only [tupleReg] at hlen ⊢; omega)
      · rw [List.getD_set_ne (Ne.symm (hr k (by omega))), hkeep r fun i hi => hr i (by omega)]
  exact key d le_rfl

    (hlen : base v' d + boundDepth I.domain ≤ regs.length) (hB : ∀ r ∈ regs, r ≤ B) :
    ∃ regs', P.ReachesOut w (P.Active B) (b, regs)
      (b + d + codeLength I.domain + 8, regs')
      (MultiTapeTM.frame (List.replicate (modelCard I e n) true)) ∧
      regs'.length = regs.length ∧ regs'.getD 0 0 = n ∧
      regs'.getD 3 0 = modelCard I e n ∧ ∀ r ∈ regs', r ≤ B := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨h₀, hfor, hcoords, hdom, hy₀, hy₁, hy₂, hx⟩ := codeAt_scanCode hP
  have hbase := le_base v' (d := d)

    r.getD 3 0 = I.domainRank e n k ∧ r.length = regs.length ∧ ∀ x ∈ r, x ≤ B
  let o : ℕ → List Bool := fun k => if I.InDomain e n k then [true, true] else []

    reachesOut_forCode (B := B) (w := w) hfor Inv o hNB
    (fun k r ⟨h4, h0', _, hl, hB'⟩ => ⟨h4, by simp only [eval_pow, eval_reg, h0'],
      by rw [hl]; omega, hB'⟩)

    (regs.set 3 0) hB₀
    ⟨List.getD_set_self (by simp only [List.length_set]; omega),
      by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), List.getD_set_ne (by omega), h0],
      by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), List.getD_set_self (by omega), domainRank_zero],
      by simp only [List.length_set], List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB₀ (Nat.zero_le _)⟩

private theorem reaches_unrankCode_dom (hC : Correct n C w) {m A r u : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ maxArity v')
    (hcoords : P.CodeAt (A + 3) (coordinatesCode d m (A + 3)))
    (hdom : P.CodeAt (A + 3 + d) (domCode C v' e I m (A + 3 + d)
      (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain) (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 2)))
    (hnB : n ≤ B) (regs : List ℕ) (h0 : regs.getD 0 0 = n)
    (hlen : base v' d + boundDepth I.domain ≤ regs.length)
    (huN : u < n ^ d) (rs : List ℕ) (h4 : rs.getD 4 0 = u)
    (h5 : rs.getD 5 0 = I.domainRank e n u) (h7 : rs.getD 7 0 = r) (hl : rs.length = regs.length)
    (hkeep : ∀ x < base v' d, x ≠ 4 → x ≠ 5 → x ≠ 7 → (∀ i < d, x ≠ tupleReg d m i) →
      rs.getD x 0 = regs.getD x 0)
    (hB' : ∀ x ∈ rs, x ≤ B) :
    ∃ (res : Bool) (regs₂ : List ℕ), (res = true ↔ I.InDomain e n u) ∧
      P.Reaches w (P.Running B) (A + 3, rs)
        (if res then A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain
          else A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 2, regs₂) ∧
      regs₂.length = regs.length ∧ regs₂.getD 4 0 = u ∧
      regs₂.getD 5 0 = I.domainRank e n u ∧ regs₂.getD 7 0 = r ∧
      (∀ i : ι, regs₂.getD (tupleReg d m (e i)) 0 = ((tupleEquiv e).symm ⟨u, huN⟩ i : ℕ)) ∧
      (∀ x < base v' d, x ≠ 4 → x ≠ 5 → x ≠ 7 → (∀ i < d, x ≠ tupleReg d m i) →
        regs₂.getD x 0 = regs.getD x 0) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ regs₂, x ≤ B := by
  classical
  have hbase := le_base v' (d := d)
  have htupleRegm := tupleReg_le_base v' (d := d) hm
  have h0s : rs.getD 0 0 = n := by
    rw [hkeep 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
      (fun i _ => by unfold tupleReg; omega), h0]
  obtain ⟨regs₁, hreach₁, hlen₁, hset₁, hkeep₁, hB₁⟩ :=
    reaches_coordinatesCode (w := w) hcoords huN hnB rs h0s h4 (by omega) hB'
  obtain ⟨res, regs₂, hres, hreach₂, hlen₂, hkeep₂, hB₂⟩ :=
    reaches_formulaCodeWith hnB (fun i => tupleReg d m (e i)) (base v' d) (by omega)
      (fun i => tupleReg_lt_base v' hm (e i).2) ((tupleEquiv e).symm ⟨u, huN⟩) _
      (hC _ _ _) I.domain (A + 3 + d) (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain)
      (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 2) regs₁ default hdom (by rw [hlen₁, hl]; exact hlen)
      (by rw [hkeep₁ 0 (fun i _ => by unfold tupleReg; omega), h0s]) hB₁
      (fun i => by rw [hset₁ _ (e i).2, tupleEquiv_symm_apply_val]) (fun i => i.elim0)
  have hk₂ (x : ℕ) (hx : x < base v' d) (hxm : ∀ i < d, x ≠ tupleReg d m i) :
      regs₂.getD x 0 = rs.getD x 0 := by rw [hkeep₂ x (by omega), hkeep₁ x hxm]
  refine ⟨res, regs₂, by rw [hres, inDomain_iff huN]; rfl, hreach₁.trans hreach₂,

    by rw [hk₂ 4 (by omega) (fun _ _ => by unfold tupleReg; omega), h4],

    by rw [hk₂ 7 (by omega) (fun _ _ => by unfold tupleReg; omega), h7],

private theorem reaches_unrankCode_step (hC : Correct n C w) {m A r u₀ u : ℕ}
    (hm : m ≤ maxArity v')
    (hcoords : P.CodeAt (A + 3) (coordinatesCode d m (A + 3)))
    (hdom : P.CodeAt (A + 3 + d) (domCode C v' e I m (A + 3 + d)
      (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain) (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 2)))
    (hc₀ : P.instr (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain) = .lt (reg 5) (reg 7)
      (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 1) (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 3))
    (hc₁ : P.instr (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 1) = .assign 5 (add (reg 5) (const 1))
      (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 2))
    (hc₂ : P.instr (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 2) = .assign 4 (add (reg 4) (const 1))
      (A + 3))
    (hnB : n ≤ B) (hNB : n ^ d ≤ B) (hrB : r ≤ B) (regs : List ℕ) (h0 : regs.getD 0 0 = n)
    (hlen : base v' d + boundDepth I.domain ≤ regs.length)
    (hu₀ : I.InDomain e n u₀) (hru₀ : I.domainRank e n u₀ = r) (hu : u < u₀)
    (rs : List ℕ) (h4 : rs.getD 4 0 = u) (h5 : rs.getD 5 0 = I.domainRank e n u)
    (h7 : rs.getD 7 0 = r) (hl : rs.length = regs.length)
    (hkeep : ∀ x < base v' d, x ≠ 4 → x ≠ 5 → x ≠ 7 → (∀ i < d, x ≠ tupleReg d m i) →
      rs.getD x 0 = regs.getD x 0)
    (hB' : ∀ x ∈ rs, x ≤ B) :
    ∃ rs', P.Reaches w (P.Running B) (A + 3, rs) (A + 3, rs') ∧
      rs'.getD 4 0 = u + 1 ∧ rs'.getD 5 0 = I.domainRank e n (u + 1) ∧
      rs'.getD 7 0 = r ∧ rs'.length = regs.length ∧
      (∀ x < base v' d, x ≠ 4 → x ≠ 5 → x ≠ 7 → (∀ i < d, x ≠ tupleReg d m i) →
        rs'.getD x 0 = regs.getD x 0) ∧ ∀ x ∈ rs', x ≤ B := by
  classical
  have hbase := le_base v' (d := d)
  have hu₀N : u₀ < n ^ d := hu₀.1
  obtain ⟨res, regs₂, hres', hreach₁₂, hlen₂', h4₂, h5₂, h7₂, -, hkeep₂, hB₂⟩ :=
    reaches_unrankCode_dom hC hm hcoords hdom hnB regs h0 hlen (by omega) rs h4 h5 h7 hl hkeep hB'
  cases res with
  | false =>
    have hnot : ¬ I.InDomain e n u := fun h => Bool.false_ne_true (hres'.mpr h)
    refine ⟨regs₂.set 4 (u + 1), hreach₁₂.trans (Reaches.assign hc₂ hB₂ ?_),
      List.getD_set_self (by omega),
      by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), h5₂, domainRank_succ, ite_eq_right hnot]; rfl,
      by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), h7₂], by rw [List.length_set, hlen₂'],
      fun x hx h4' h5' h7' hxm => by
        rw [List.getD_set_ne (Ne.symm h4'), hkeep₂ x hx h4' h5' h7' hxm],
      List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB₂ (by omega)⟩
    simpa only [eval_add, eval_reg, eval_const, h4₂] using Reaches.refl _
  | true =>
    have hin : I.InDomain e n u := hres'.mp rfl
    have hlt : I.domainRank e n u < r := hru₀ ▸ domainRank_lt_of_inDomain hin hu
    have hB₃ : ∀ x ∈ regs₂.set 5 (I.domainRank e n u + 1), x ≤ B :=
      List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB₂ (by omega)
    refine ⟨(regs₂.set 5 (I.domainRank e n u + 1)).set 4 (u + 1),
      hreach₁₂.trans (Reaches.lt hc₀ hB₂ ?_),
      List.getD_set_self (by simp only [List.length_set]; omega),
      by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), List.getD_set_self (by omega), domainRank_succ,
        ite_eq_left hin],
      by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), List.getD_set_ne (by omega), h7₂],
      by simp only [List.length_set, hlen₂'],
      fun x hx h4' h5' h7' hxm => by
        rw [List.getD_set_ne (Ne.symm h4'), List.getD_set_ne (Ne.symm h5'),
          hkeep₂ x hx h4' h5' h7' hxm],
      List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB₃ (by omega)⟩
    simp only [eval_reg, h5₂, h7₂, hlt, ↓reduceIte]
    refine Reaches.assign hc₁ hB₂ ?_
    simp only [eval_add, eval_reg, eval_const, h5₂]
    refine Reaches.assign hc₂ hB₃ ?_
    simpa only [eval_add, eval_reg, eval_const, List.getD_set_ne (show 5 ≠ 4 by omega),
      h4₂] using Reaches.refl _

private theorem reaches_unrankCode_loop (hC : Correct n C w) {m A r u₀ : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ maxArity v')
    (hcoords : P.CodeAt (A + 3) (coordinatesCode d m (A + 3)))
    (hdom : P.CodeAt (A + 3 + d) (domCode C v' e I m (A + 3 + d)
      (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain) (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 2)))
    (hc₀ : P.instr (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain) = .lt (reg 5) (reg 7)
      (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 1) (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 3))
    (hc₁ : P.instr (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 1) = .assign 5 (add (reg 5) (const 1))
      (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 2))
    (hc₂ : P.instr (A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 2) = .assign 4 (add (reg 4) (const 1))
      (A + 3))
    (hnB : n ≤ B) (hNB : n ^ d ≤ B) (hrB : r ≤ B) (regs : List ℕ) (h0 : regs.getD 0 0 = n)
    (hlen : base v' d + boundDepth I.domain ≤ regs.length)
    (hB₅ : ∀ x ∈ ((regs.set 7 r).set 4 0).set 5 0, x ≤ B)
    (hu₀ : I.InDomain e n u₀) (hru₀ : I.domainRank e n u₀ = r) :
    ∀ u ≤ u₀, ∃ rs, P.Reaches w (P.Running B)
      (A + 3, ((regs.set 7 r).set 4 0).set 5 0) (A + 3, rs) ∧
      rs.getD 4 0 = u ∧ rs.getD 5 0 = I.domainRank e n u ∧ rs.getD 7 0 = r ∧
      rs.length = regs.length ∧
      (∀ x < base v' d, x ≠ 4 → x ≠ 5 → x ≠ 7 → (∀ i < d, x ≠ tupleReg d m i) →
        rs.getD x 0 = regs.getD x 0) ∧ ∀ x ∈ rs, x ≤ B := by
  have hbase := le_base v' (d := d)
  intro u
  induction u with
  | zero =>
    exact fun _ => ⟨_, Reaches.refl _,
      by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega),
        List.getD_set_self (by simp only [List.length_set]; omega)],
      by rw [List.getD_set_self (by simp only [List.length_set]; omega), domainRank_zero],
      by rw [List.getD_set_ne (by omega), List.getD_set_ne (by omega),
        List.getD_set_self (by omega)],
      by simp only [List.length_set],
      fun x _ h4' h5' h7' _ => by
        rw [List.getD_set_ne (Ne.symm h5'), List.getD_set_ne (Ne.symm h4'),
          List.getD_set_ne (Ne.symm h7')], hB₅⟩
  | succ u ih =>
    intro hu
    obtain ⟨rs, hreach, h4, h5, h7, hl, hkeep, hB'⟩ := ih (by omega)
    obtain ⟨rs', hstep, h4', h5', h7', hl', hkeep', hB''⟩ :=
      reaches_unrankCode_step hC hm hcoords hdom hc₀ hc₁ hc₂ hnB hNB hrB regs h0 hlen
        hu₀ hru₀ (by omega) rs h4 h5 h7 hl hkeep hB'
    exact ⟨rs', hreach.trans hstep, h4', h5', h7', hl', hkeep', hB''⟩

cardinality of a well-formed input in register `0`, the number `n' > 0` of elements of the
interpreted structure in register `3` and `t` in register `6`, the program writes into block `m`
the coordinates of the element of rank `t / n' ^ m % n'`, and changes no register below the base
other than `4`, `5`, `7` and those of block `m`. -/

private theorem reaches_unrankCode (hC : Correct n C w) {m A t : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ maxArity v')
    (hP : P.CodeAt A (unrankCode C v' e I m A)) (hnB : n ≤ B) (hNB : n ^ d ≤ B)
    (regs : List ℕ) (h0 : regs.getD 0 0 = n)
    (h3 : regs.getD 3 0 = modelCard I e n) (h6 : regs.getD 6 0 = t)
    (hpos : 0 < modelCard I e n)
    (hlen : base v' d + boundDepth I.domain ≤ regs.length) (hB : ∀ r ∈ regs, r ≤ B) :
    ∃ regs', P.Reaches w (P.Running B) (A, regs)
      (A + d + codeLength I.domain + 6, regs') ∧ regs'.length = regs.length ∧
      (∀ i : ι, regs'.getD (tupleReg d m (e i)) 0 =
        (((rankEquiv I e n).symm
          ⟨t / modelCard I e n ^ m % modelCard I e n, Nat.mod_lt _ hpos⟩).1 i : ℕ)) ∧
      (∀ x < base v' d, x ≠ 4 → x ≠ 5 → x ≠ 7 → (∀ i < d, x ≠ tupleReg d m i) →
        regs'.getD x 0 = regs.getD x 0) ∧ ∀ r ∈ regs', r ≤ B := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hi₀, hi₁, hi₂, hcoords, hdom, hc₀, hc₁, hc₂⟩ := codeAt_unrankCode hP
  set n' := modelCard I e n
  set r := t / n' ^ m % n'
  have hrn : r < n' := Nat.mod_lt _ hpos
  have hn'N : n' ≤ n ^ d := modelCard_le_pow (I := I) (e := e) (n := n)
  have hbase := le_base v' (d := d)
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, hru₀⟩ := exists_inDomain_of_lt (I := I) (e := e) (n := n) hrn
  have hB₇ : ∀ x ∈ regs.set 7 r, x ≤ B := List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB (by omega)
  have hB₄ : ∀ x ∈ (regs.set 7 r).set 4 0, x ≤ B :=
    List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB₇ (Nat.zero_le _)
  have hB₅ : ∀ x ∈ ((regs.set 7 r).set 4 0).set 5 0, x ≤ B :=
    List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB₄ (Nat.zero_le _)
  obtain ⟨rs, hreach, h4, h5, h7, hl, hkeep, hB'⟩ :=
    reaches_unrankCode_loop hC hm hcoords hdom hc₀ hc₁ hc₂ hnB hNB (by omega) regs h0 hlen
      hB₅ hu₀ hru₀ u₀ le_rfl
  obtain ⟨res, regs', hres, hdomRun, hlen', -, h5', h7', hset', hkeep', hB''⟩ :=
    reaches_unrankCode_dom hC hm hcoords hdom hnB regs h0 hlen hu₀.1 rs h4 h5 h7 hl hkeep hB'
  have hresT : res = true := hres.mpr hu₀
  subst hresT
  refine ⟨regs', Reaches.assign hi₀ hB ?_, hlen', fun i => by
    rw [hset' i, rankEquiv_symm_val (r := ⟨r, hrn⟩) hu₀ hru₀], hkeep', hB''⟩
  simp only [eval_mod, eval_div, eval_pow, eval_reg, h6, h3]
  refine Reaches.assign hi₁ hB₇ ?_
  simp only [eval_const]
  refine Reaches.assign hi₂ hB₄ ?_
  simp only [eval_const, ↓reduceIte] at hdomRun ⊢
  rw [show A + d + codeLength I.domain + 6 = A + 3 + d + codeLength I.domain + 3 by omega]
  refine hreach.trans (hdomRun.trans (Reaches.lt hc₀ hB'' ?_))
  simp only [eval_reg, h5', h7', hru₀, lt_irrefl, ↓reduceIte]
  exact Reaches.refl _

private theorem reaches_unranks (hC : Correct n C w) (j : Fin v'.count) {b t : ℕ}
    (hunr : P.CodeAt (b + 3) ((List.range (v'.symbol j).1).flatMap fun m =>
      unrankCode C v' e I m (b + 3 + (d + codeLength I.domain + 6) * m)))
    (hnB : n ≤ B) (hNB : n ^ d ≤ B) (regs : List ℕ)
    (hlenD : base v' d + boundDepth I.domain ≤ regs.length)
    (ht : t < modelCard I e n ^ (v'.symbol j).1) (rs : List ℕ) (h6 : rs.getD 6 0 = t)
    (h0' : rs.getD 0 0 = n) (h3' : rs.getD 3 0 = modelCard I e n) (hl : rs.length = regs.length)
    (hB' : ∀ x ∈ rs, x ≤ B) :
    ∀ m (hmk : m ≤ (v'.symbol j).1), ∃ rs', P.Reaches w (P.Running B)
      (b + 3, rs) (b + 3 + (d + codeLength I.domain + 6) * m, rs') ∧ rs'.length = regs.length ∧
      rs'.getD 0 0 = n ∧ rs'.getD 3 0 = modelCard I e n ∧ rs'.getD 6 0 = t ∧ (∀ x ∈ rs', x ≤ B) ∧
      ∀ m' (hm' : m' < m) (i : ι), rs'.getD (tupleReg d m' (e i)) 0 =
        (((rankEquiv I e n).symm
          (finFunctionFinEquiv.symm ⟨t, ht⟩ ⟨m', lt_of_lt_of_le hm' hmk⟩)).1 i : ℕ) := by
  have hkm := arity_le_maxArity (v' := v') j
  have hbase := le_base v' (d := d)
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    exact fun _ => ⟨rs, Reaches.refl _, hl, h0', h3', h6, hB', fun _ h => absurd h (by omega)⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    intro hm
    obtain ⟨rs₁, hreach₁, hl₁, h0₁, h3₁, h6₁, hB₁, htupleReg₁⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have hpos : 0 < modelCard I e n := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (modelCard I e n) with h | h
      · rw [h, zero_pow (by omega)] at ht; omega
      · exact h
    have hcode := CodeAt.flatMap_range
      (f := fun m => unrankCode C v' e I m (b + 3 + (d + codeLength I.domain + 6) * m))

    (regs : List ℕ) (h0 : regs.getD 0 0 = n)
    (h3 : regs.getD 3 0 = modelCard I e n)
    (hlenD : base v' d + boundDepth I.domain ≤ regs.length)
    (hlenR : base v' d + boundDepth (I.rel (v'.symbol j).2) ≤ regs.length)
    (hB : ∀ r ∈ regs, r ≤ B) :
    ∃ regs', P.ReachesOut w (P.Active B) (b, regs)
      (b + tableLength v' d I j, regs')
      (MultiTapeTM.frame (
        Vocabulary.relTable (I.Model (Fin n)) (rankEquiv I e n) (v'.symbol j))) ∧
      regs'.length = regs.length ∧ regs'.getD 0 0 = n ∧
      regs'.getD 3 0 = modelCard I e n ∧ ∀ r ∈ regs', r ≤ B := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hfor, hunr, hrel, hy₀, hy₁, hn₀, hn₁, hx⟩ := codeAt_relTableCode j hP
  have hbase := le_base v' (d := d)

    decide (RelMap (v'.symbol j).2 ((rankEquiv I e n).symm ∘ finFunctionFinEquiv.symm ⟨t, h⟩))
    else false
  let Inv : ℕ → List ℕ → Prop := fun t rs => rs.getD 6 0 = t ∧ rs.getD 0 0 = n ∧
    rs.getD 3 0 = modelCard I e n ∧ rs.length = regs.length ∧ ∀ x ∈ rs, x ≤ B
  obtain ⟨regsN, hloop, -, h0N, h3N, hlN, hBN⟩ := reachesOut_forCode (B := B) (w := w) hfor Inv

      by rw [hl]; omega, hB'⟩)
    (reachesOut_relTableCode_step hC j hunr hrel hy₀ hy₁ hn₀ hn₁ hnB hNB hTB regs hlenD hlenR)

      (∀ r ∈ regs, r ≤ B) →

        (b + (js.map (tableLength v' d I)).sum, regs')

semantics of a compiler `C`, on encoded finite relational structures uses logarithmic work space.

theorem computableInLogSpace_encodedMapWith :
    MultiTapeTM.ComputableInLogSpace (I.encodedMapWith C v' e) encStructure encStructure := by
  classical
  let P := program v C v' d e I
  refine P.computableInLogSpace_of_reachesOut (exponent v v' d) fun a => ?_
  let B := ((encStructure a).length + 1) ^ exponent v v' d
  have hpow (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ exponent v v' d) : a.1 ^ k ≤ B :=
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_left ((card_le_length_encStructure a).trans (Nat.le_succ _)) k).trans
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos _) hk)
  have hE : regExponent v ≤ exponent v v' d := by unfold exponent; omega
  have hwB : (encStructure a).length ≤ B :=
    (length_le_pow_regExponent v a).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos _) hE)
  have hnB : a.1 ≤ B := (card_le_length_encStructure a).trans hwB
  have hdE : d ≤ exponent v v' d := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left d (show 1 ≤ maxArity v' + 1 by omega)
    simp only [Nat.mul_one] at this; unfold exponent; omega
  obtain ⟨hshape, hguard', -, -, -, hreject⟩ := codeAt_program I C v' e
  have hlenD : base v' d + boundDepth I.domain ≤ P.registers :=
    Nat.add_le_add_left (le_max_left _ _) _
  have hbase := le_base v' (d := d)
  obtain ⟨rs, hshapeRun, hlen, h0, hB⟩ := reaches_shapeCode (B := B) (a := a) hshape
    (fun i => (pow_arityAt_le v a i).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos _) hE))
    hwB (List.replicate P.registers 0) (by simp) (by simp only [List.length_replicate]; omega)
    (by simp)

/-- **Completeness of `checkCert`**: if a family `D : Fin p → DetProver` of deterministic provers
makes `M` accept `x` on more than half of the `t = c * (x.length + 1) ^ d` coin strings, then
the canonical certificate built from `D` passes `checkCert`, and its encoded length is at most
`32 * (p + x.length + t + 1) ^ 2 * 2 ^ t`. -/
theorem exists_checkCert_of_detProver {c d : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (D : Fin p → DetProver)
    (hlt : 2 ^ (c * (x.length + 1) ^ d) <
      2 * ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (c * (x.length + 1) ^ d) → Bool)).filter fun f =>
        accepts M x (List.ofFn f)
          (canonicalTrace M (c * (x.length + 1) ^ d) D
            (MultiTapeMachine.FiniteConfig.init M.initial x) (fun i => (D i).init)
            (List.ofFn f))).card) :
    let t := c * (x.length + 1) ^ d
    ∃ cert : Cert,
      checkCert M c d x cert = true ∧
      (encCert cert).length ≤ 32 * (p + x.length + t + 1) ^ 2 * 2 ^ t := by
  set t := c * (x.length + 1) ^ d
  let traceOf (r : List Bool) : TaggedHistory :=
    canonicalTrace M t D (MultiTapeMachine.FiniteConfig.init M.initial x) (fun i => (D i).init) r
  let goodFinset : Finset (Fin t → Bool) :=
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin t → Bool)).filter fun f =>
      accepts M x (List.ofFn f) (traceOf (List.ofFn f))
  let goodFns : List (Fin t → Bool) := goodFinset.toList
  let cert : Cert := goodFns.map fun f => (List.ofFn f, traceOf (List.ofFn f))
  have hgood_length : goodFns.length = goodFinset.card := Finset.length_toList _
  have hcert_length : cert.length = goodFns.length := List.length_map _
  have hnodup_good : goodFns.Nodup := Finset.nodup_toList _
  have hnodup_fst : (cert.map Prod.fst).Nodup := by
    rw [show cert.map Prod.fst = goodFns.map List.ofFn by simp [cert, List.map_map]]
    refine hnodup_good.map_on ?_
    intro f₁ _ f₂ _ heq
    funext j
    have := congrArg (fun l : List Bool => l.getD j false) heq
    simpa using this
  refine ⟨cert, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [checkCert, Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, decide_eq_true_eq,
      List.mem_range]
    refine ⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro e he
      simp only [cert, goodFns, goodFinset, List.mem_map, Finset.mem_toList,
        Finset.mem_filter] at he
      obtain ⟨f, ⟨_, hacc⟩, rfl⟩ := he
      exact ⟨List.length_ofFn, hacc⟩
    · intro e₁ he₁
      have hcount : (cert.map Prod.fst).countP (fun r => e₁.1 == r) = 1 := by
        have hcomm : (fun r : List Bool => e₁.1 == r) = (fun r => r == e₁.1) := by
          funext r
          rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, beq_iff_eq, beq_iff_eq, eq_comm]
        rw [hcomm, ← List.count_eq_countP]
        exact List.count_eq_one_of_mem hnodup_fst (List.mem_map_of_mem he₁)
      rw [List.countP_map] at hcount
      exact hcount
    · intro e₁ he₁ e₂ he₂ i hi
      simp only [cert, List.mem_map] at he₁ he₂
      obtain ⟨f₁, _, rfl⟩ := he₁
      obtain ⟨f₂, _, rfl⟩ := he₂
      let iFin : Fin p := ⟨i, hi⟩
      have hv₁ := validFrom_canonicalTrace M t D
        (MultiTapeMachine.FiniteConfig.init M.initial x) (fun j => (D j).init) (List.ofFn f₁) iFin
      have hv₂ := validFrom_canonicalTrace M t D
        (MultiTapeMachine.FiniteConfig.init M.initial x) (fun j => (D j).init) (List.ofFn f₂) iFin
      exact DetProver.ValidFrom.consistentHist hv₁ hv₂
    · rw [hcert_length, hgood_length]
      exact hlt
  · -- Bound `(encCert cert).length`
    let B := p + x.length + t + 1
    have hentry : ∀ e ∈ cert, (encCertEntry e).length ≤ 9 * B ^ 2 := by
      intro e he
      simp only [cert, List.mem_map] at he
      obtain ⟨f, _, rfl⟩ := he
      have hlen_r : (List.ofFn f).length = t := List.length_ofFn
      have hbounds := bounds_canonicalTrace M D
        (MultiTapeMachine.FiniteConfig.spaceBound_init M.initial x t)
        (fun i => (D i).init) (List.ofFn f)
      rw [hlen_r, Nat.zero_add] at hbounds
      have htag : ∀ te ∈ traceOf (List.ofFn f), (encTaggedEntry te).length ≤ 3 * B := by
        intro te hte
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hbounds.2 te hte
        simp only [encTaggedEntry, length_encPair, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate,
          encBits_apply]
        simp only [B]
        lia
      have hth_len : (encTaggedHistory (traceOf (List.ofFn f))).length ≤ B * (2 * (3 * B) + 1) := by
        refine (length_encList_le encTaggedEntry _ htag).trans ?_
        have hlen_th : (traceOf (List.ofFn f)).length ≤ B := hbounds.1.trans (by simp [B]; lia)
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 * (3 * B) + 1) hlen_th
      simp only [encCertEntry, length_encPair, encBits_apply, hlen_r]
      have hB1 : 1 ≤ B := by simp [B]
      have htB : t + 1 ≤ B := by simp [B]
      have hsq : 2 * t + 1 + B * (2 * (3 * B) + 1) ≤ 9 * B ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      exact (Nat.add_le_add_left hth_len (2 * t + 1)).trans hsq
    have hcert_le : cert.length ≤ 2 ^ t := by
      rw [hcert_length, hgood_length]
      exact (Finset.card_le_univ _).trans (by simp)
    have htotal := length_encList_le encCertEntry cert hentry
    have hB1 : 1 ≤ B := by simp [B]
    have hmul : 2 * (9 * B ^ 2) + 1 ≤ 32 * B ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    calc (encCert cert).length
        ≤ cert.length * (2 * (9 * B ^ 2) + 1) := htotal
      _ ≤ 2 ^ t * (32 * B ^ 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul hcert_le hmul
      _ = 32 * B ^ 2 * 2 ^ t := by ring
