theorem MIP_subset_NEXP : MIP enc ⊆ NEXP enc := by
  rintro A ⟨p, verifier, hV, hproto⟩
  obtain ⟨_, k, Control, hfinControl, M, c, d, hreal⟩ := hV
  let f (n : ℕ) : ℕ := 32 * (p + n + c * (n + 1) ^ d + 1) ^ 2 + c * (n + 1) ^ d
  have hf : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime f encUnary encUnary := by
    have hpoly : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun n : ℕ => c * (n + 1) ^ d) encUnary encUnary :=
      (unary_eval (Polynomial.C c * (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ d)).of_enc_eq fun n => by simp
    have hB : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun n : ℕ => p + n + c * (n + 1) ^ d + 1)
        encUnary encUnary := by
      have hp_n := unary_add.comp ((const p).prod id')
      have hp_n_t := unary_add.comp (hp_n.prod hpoly)
      exact unary_add.comp (hp_n_t.prod (const 1))
    have hsq : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun n : ℕ => 32 * (p + n + c * (n + 1) ^ d + 1) ^ 2) encUnary encUnary :=
      unary_mul.comp ((const 32).prod ((unary_pow 2).comp hB))
    exact unary_add.comp (hsq.prod hpoly)
  have hn : ∀ n, n ≤ f n := fun n => by
    have hB : n ≤ p + n + c * (n + 1) ^ d + 1 := by lia
    have hsq : p + n + c * (n + 1) ^ d + 1 ≤ (p + n + c * (n + 1) ^ d + 1) ^ 2 :=
      Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) _
    simp only [f]
    lia
  let g (a : α) : List Bool := frame (enc a) ++ List.replicate (2 ^ f (enc a).length) true
  have hNP : MIP.paddedMIP M c d ∈ NP encBits := MIP.paddedMIP_mem_NP M c d
  have hpre : A = g ⁻¹' MIP.paddedMIP M c d := by
    ext a
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, MIP.paddedMIP, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, MIP.checkPaddedCert,
      Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    have hunf : unframe (g a) = enc a := by simp [g, unframe_frame_append]
    rw [hunf]
    set x := enc a
    set t := c * (x.length + 1) ^ d
    have hpos : 2 ^ t ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hcast : ((2 ^ t : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) = 2 ^ t := by push_cast; rfl
    constructor
    · intro ha
      obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hproto.complete a ha
      have haccP := acceptProb_eq_sum M (hreal a) (Prover.independent P)
      have hopt := MIP.exists_deterministic_prover_family
        (fun r : Fin t → Bool => coinProgram M t x (List.ofFn r))
        (fun r => by
          simpa only [coinFamily] using MIP.isBoundedComp_coinFamily M t x r)
        (fun _ => 1) P
      simp only [one_mul] at hopt
      obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hopt
      let traceOf (r : List Bool) : MIP.TaggedHistory :=
        MIP.canonicalTrace M t D (MultiTapeMachine.FiniteConfig.init M.initial x)
          (fun i => (D i).init) r
      let goodCard : ℕ :=
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin t → Bool)).filter fun r =>
          MIP.accepts M x (List.ofFn r) (traceOf (List.ofFn r))).card
      have hsumD :
          (∑ r : Fin t → Bool,
            acceptFrom (Prover.independent fun i => (D i).toProver)
              (Prover.independent fun i => (D i).toProver).init
              (some (coinProgram M t x (List.ofFn r)))) =
            (goodCard : ℝ≥0∞) := by
        have hterm (r : Fin t → Bool) :
            acceptFrom (Prover.independent fun i => (D i).toProver)
              (Prover.independent fun i => (D i).toProver).init
              (some (coinProgram M t x (List.ofFn r))) =
              if MIP.accepts M x (List.ofFn r) (traceOf (List.ofFn r)) then 1 else 0 :=
          MIP.acceptFrom_eq_ite_accepts_canonicalTrace M List.length_ofFn D
        simp only [hterm, goodCard, Finset.sum_boole]
      have hineq : (2 / 3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (goodCard : ℝ≥0∞) / (2 ^ t : ℕ) := by
        calc (2 / 3 : ℝ≥0∞)
            ≤ acceptProb (verifier a) (Prover.independent P) := hP
          _ = (2 ^ t : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∑ r : Fin t → Bool,
                acceptFrom (Prover.independent P) (Prover.independent P).init
                  (some (coinProgram M t x (List.ofFn r))) := haccP
          _ ≤ (2 ^ t : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∑ r : Fin t → Bool,
                acceptFrom (Prover.independent fun i => (D i).toProver)
                  (Prover.independent fun i => (D i).toProver).init
                  (some (coinProgram M t x (List.ofFn r))) :=
                mul_le_mul_right hD _
          _ = (goodCard : ℝ≥0∞) / (2 ^ t : ℕ) := by
                rw [hsumD, ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul, hcast]
      rw [show (2 / 3 : ℝ≥0∞) = ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) / ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) by norm_num,
        natCast_div_le_natCast_div_iff (by norm_num) hpos] at hineq
      have hpow_pos := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := t)
      have hlt_card : 2 ^ t < 2 * goodCard := by lia
      obtain ⟨cert, hcheck, hlen⟩ := MIP.exists_checkCert_of_detProver M x D hlt_card
      refine ⟨cert, ?_, hcheck⟩
      set m := 32 * (p + x.length + t + 1) ^ 2
      have hm_pow : m ≤ 2 ^ m := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := m)).le
      have hcert_pow : (MIP.encCert cert).length ≤ 2 ^ f x.length := by
        calc (MIP.encCert cert).length
            ≤ m * 2 ^ t := hlen
          _ ≤ 2 ^ m * 2 ^ t := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ t) hm_pow
          _ = 2 ^ (m + t) := (Nat.pow_add 2 m t).symm
          _ = 2 ^ f x.length := rfl
      have hg_len : 2 ^ f x.length ≤ (g a).length := by
        simp [g, x]
      exact hcert_pow.trans hg_len
    · rintro ⟨cert, -, hcheck⟩
      obtain ⟨D, hsum_le, hlt⟩ := MIP.exists_detProver_of_checkCert M hcheck
      by_contra ha
      have hsound := hproto.sound a ha (fun i => (D i).toProver)
      have haccD := acceptProb_eq_sum M (hreal a)
        (Prover.independent fun i => (D i).toProver)
      have hineq : (cert.length : ℝ≥0∞) / (2 ^ t : ℕ) ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
        calc (cert.length : ℝ≥0∞) / (2 ^ t : ℕ)
            = (2 ^ t : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (cert.length : ℝ≥0∞) := by
                rw [ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul, hcast]
          _ ≤ (2 ^ t : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∑ r : Fin t → Bool,
                acceptFrom (Prover.independent fun i => (D i).toProver)
                  (Prover.independent fun i => (D i).toProver).init
                  (some (coinProgram M t x (List.ofFn r))) :=
                mul_le_mul_right hsum_le _
          _ = acceptProb (verifier a) (Prover.independent fun i => (D i).toProver) :=
                haccD.symm
          _ ≤ 1 / 3 := hsound
      rw [show (1 / 3 : ℝ≥0∞) = ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) / ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) by norm_num,
        natCast_div_le_natCast_div_iff hpos (by norm_num)] at hineq
      lia
  rw [hpre]
  exact preimage_pad_mem_NEXP hNP (.of_tidy hf) hn

private theorem presampleTree_step (Q : Prover Unit) (L : ℕ) (queries : List (List Bool)) (d : ℕ)
    (s : Q.State) {m : List Bool} (hm : m ∈ queries) :
    (presampleTree Q L queries (d + 1) s).map (fun t => t.step m) =
      ((Q.respond ((), m)).run s).bind fun ys =>
        (presampleTree Q L queries d ys.2).map fun child => (ys.1.take L, ⟨d, child⟩) := by
  let f : List Bool → PMF (List Bool × TreeStrategy d) := fun m' =>
    ((Q.respond ((), m')).run s).bind fun ys =>
      (presampleTree Q L queries d ys.2).map fun child => (ys.1.take L, child)
  have h1 : presampleTree Q L queries (d + 1) s =
      queries.mapM fun m' => (f m').map fun p => (m', p) := by
    simp only [presampleTree, f, Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.map_bind,
      PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def]
  have h2 := congrArg (PMF.map fun o : Option (List Bool × TreeStrategy d) =>
      match o with
      | some (y, child) => (y, (⟨d, child⟩ : Sigma TreeStrategy))
      | none => ([], ⟨0, PUnit.unit⟩))
    (mapM_lookup_eq f queries hm)
  simp only [PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def] at h2
  refine (congrArg (PMF.map (fun t : TreeStrategy (d + 1) => t.step m)) h1).trans ?_
  simpa only [TreeStrategy.step, f, PMF.map_bind, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def] using h2

private theorem run_eq_bind_piPresample [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {p : WordQueryComp ι α} {L k : ℕ}
    (hp : IsBoundedComp L k p) (P : ι → Prover Unit) (d : ι → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, k ≤ d i)
    (s : ∀ i, (P i).State) :
    ((OracleComp.interpret (Prover.independent P).respond p).run s).map Prod.fst =
      (piPresample P L (BitString.shortWords L).toList d s).bind fun f =>
        ((OracleComp.interpret (Prover.independent (fun _ : ι => treeProver)).respond p).run f).map
          Prod.fst := by
  induction hp generalizing d s with
  | pure k a =>
    change ((OracleComp.interpret (Prover.independent P).respond (pure a)).run s).map Prod.fst =
      (piPresample P L (BitString.shortWords L).toList d s).bind fun f =>
        ((OracleComp.interpret (Prover.independent (fun _ : ι => treeProver)).respond
          (pure a)).run f).map Prod.fst
    simp only [OracleComp.interpret_pure, StateT.run_pure, Probability.PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure,
      PMF.pure_map, PMF.bind_const]
  | @liftBind k q next hq htake _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨i₀, m⟩ := q
    have hm : m ∈ (BitString.shortWords L).toList :=
      Finset.mem_toList.mpr (BitString.mem_shortWords.mpr hq)
    have hdi₀ : d i₀ = (d i₀ - 1) + 1 := by
      have := hd i₀
      lia
    have hd' : ∀ i, k ≤ Function.update d i₀ (d i₀ - 1) i := by
      intro i
      by_cases h : i = i₀
      · subst h
        have := hd i
        simp only [Function.update_self]
        lia
      · simp only [Function.update_of_ne h]
        exact (Nat.le_succ k).trans (hd i)
    change ((OracleComp.interpret (Prover.independent P).respond
        (OracleComp.query (i₀, m) >>= next)).run s).map Prod.fst =
      (piPresample P L (BitString.shortWords L).toList d s).bind fun f =>
        ((OracleComp.interpret (Prover.independent (fun _ : ι => treeProver)).respond
          (OracleComp.query (i₀, m) >>= next)).run f).map Prod.fst
    simp only [OracleComp.interpret_bind, OracleComp.interpret_query, StateT.run_bind,
      Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.map_bind]
    have hrhs (f : ι → Sigma TreeStrategy) :
        (((Prover.independent (fun _ : ι => treeProver)).respond (i₀, m)).run f).bind
          (fun x => ((OracleComp.interpret (Prover.independent (fun _ : ι => treeProver)).respond
            (next x.1)).run x.2).map Prod.fst) =
        let res := (f i₀).2.step m
        ((OracleComp.interpret (Prover.independent (fun _ : ι => treeProver)).respond
          (next res.1)).run (Function.update f i₀ res.2)).map Prod.fst := by
      simp only [treeProver, DetProver.toProver, TreeStrategy.toDetProver, StateT.run_mk,
        PMF.pure_map, PMF.pure_bind]
    simp only [hrhs]
    have hstep := congrArg (PMF.bind · fun (p : List Bool × (ι → Sigma TreeStrategy)) =>
        ((OracleComp.interpret (Prover.independent (fun _ : ι => treeProver)).respond
          (next p.1)).run p.2).map Prod.fst)
      (piPresample_step P L (BitString.shortWords L).toList d s i₀ (d i₀ - 1) hdi₀ hm)
    simp only [PMF.bind_map, PMF.bind_bind, Function.comp_def] at hstep
    rw [hstep]
    simp only [StateT.run_mk, PMF.bind_map, Function.comp_def]
    congr 1
    funext ys
    rw [ih ys.1 (Function.update d i₀ (d i₀ - 1)) hd' (Function.update s i₀ ys.2)]
    congr 1
    funext f'
    rw [← htake ys.1]
    rfl

theorem validFrom_candidateProver (H : List (List (List Bool × List Bool)))
    (cand : List (List (List Bool × List Bool)))
    (hcons : ∀ h₁ ∈ cand, ∀ h₂ ∈ cand, consistentHist h₁ h₂ = true)
    {h : List (List Bool × List Bool)} (hh : h ∈ cand) :
    (candidateProver H).ValidFrom cand h := by
  induction h generalizing cand with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons e rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨q, r⟩ := e
    let filterFn (h' : List (List Bool × List Bool)) :
        Option (List Bool × List (List Bool × List Bool)) :=
      match h' with
      | (q', r') :: rest' => if q' == q then some (r', rest') else none
      | [] => none
    have hmem_match : (r, rest) ∈ cand.filterMap filterFn := by
      rw [List.mem_filterMap]
      exact ⟨(q, r) :: rest, hh, by simp [filterFn]⟩
    cases hm : cand.filterMap filterFn with
    | nil =>
      rw [hm] at hmem_match
      cases hmem_match
    | cons first more =>
      obtain ⟨r₀, rest₀⟩ := first
      have hfirst_mem : (r₀, rest₀) ∈ cand.filterMap filterFn := by
        rw [hm]
        exact List.mem_cons_self
      rw [List.mem_filterMap] at hfirst_mem
      obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀, hfilter₀⟩ := hfirst_mem
      cases h₀ with
      | nil => simp [filterFn] at hfilter₀
      | cons e₀ tail₀ =>
        obtain ⟨q₀, r₀'⟩ := e₀
        simp only [filterFn, beq_iff_eq] at hfilter₀
        split_ifs at hfilter₀ with hq₀
        subst q₀
        simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hfilter₀
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hfilter₀
        have hc := hcons ((q, r₀') :: tail₀) hh₀ ((q, r) :: rest) hh
        simp only [consistentHist, beq_self_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Bool.and_eq_true,
          beq_iff_eq] at hc
        have hstep : (candidateProver H).respond q cand =
            (r₀', (cand.filterMap filterFn).map Prod.snd) := by
          simp only [candidateProver, stepCandidates, filterFn, hm]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hstep, hc.1]
        · rw [hstep]
          refine ih ((cand.filterMap filterFn).map Prod.snd) ?_
            (List.mem_map_of_mem hmem_match)
          intro t₁ ht₁ t₂ ht₂
          rw [List.mem_map] at ht₁ ht₂
          obtain ⟨⟨r₁, s₁⟩, hs₁, rfl⟩ := ht₁
          obtain ⟨⟨r₂, s₂⟩, hs₂, rfl⟩ := ht₂
          rw [List.mem_filterMap] at hs₁ hs₂
          obtain ⟨h₁, hh₁, hf₁⟩ := hs₁
          obtain ⟨h₂, hh₂, hf₂⟩ := hs₂
          cases h₁ with
          | nil => simp [filterFn] at hf₁
          | cons e₁ tail₁ =>
            obtain ⟨q₁, r₁'⟩ := e₁
            cases h₂ with
            | nil => simp [filterFn] at hf₂
            | cons e₂ tail₂ =>
              obtain ⟨q₂, r₂'⟩ := e₂
              simp only [filterFn, beq_iff_eq] at hf₁ hf₂
              split_ifs at hf₁ with hq₁
              split_ifs at hf₂ with hq₂
              subst q₁ q₂
              simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hf₁ hf₂
              obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hf₁
              obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hf₂
              have hc12 := hcons ((q, r₁') :: tail₁) hh₁ ((q, r₂') :: tail₂) hh₂
              simp only [consistentHist, beq_self_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Bool.and_eq_true] at hc12

theorem IsVerifier.exists_decidesInTime
    (hV : ComputableInPolyTime V (encPair enc encBits) encBool) (hA : IsVerifier enc p V A) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (State : Type) (_ : Finite State) (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) (c d : ℕ),
      machine.toNTM.DecidesInTime enc A (fun a => c * ((enc a).length + 1) ^ d) ∧
      ∀ input (cfg : Cfg k Bool State input), ∃ cfg', machine.toNTM.Step cfg cfg' := by
  have hV := hV.tidy
  -- guess a certificate of the required length, then verify it
  let program (a : α) : ProbComp Bool :=
    (fun w => V (a, w)) <$> BitString.sampleList (p.eval (enc a).length)
  have hcount : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => p.eval (enc a).length) enc encUnary :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval p).comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc)
  have hprogram : IsPPTOn enc encBool program :=
    (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy hcount).sampleList.map_with (.of_tidy hV)
  obtain ⟨k, State, hfinite, machine, c, d, heval, hhalt⟩ := hprogram.exists_halting_machine
  refine ⟨k, State, hfinite, machine, c, d, fun a => ?_, fun _ => machine.exists_step_toNTM⟩
  have htime : machine.toNTM.RunsInTime (enc a) (c * ((enc a).length + 1) ^ d) :=
    machine.runsInTime_toNTM (hhalt (enc a))
  refine ⟨htime, ?_⟩
  rw [hA a, MultiTapeNTM.accepts_iff_exists_time_eq htime,
    machine.exists_computationPath_toNTM_iff (P := fun cfg => cfg.output = [true])]
  -- both sides say that `[true]` is a supported output
  have hsupport := congrArg (fun μ => [true] ∈ μ.support) (heval a)
  simp only [MultiTapePTM.runClosed_eq_map, ProbComp.eval_map, PMF.mem_support_map_iff,
    program, BitString.eval_sampleList, BitString.mem_support_uniformList_iff, encBool_apply,
    List.cons.injEq, and_true] at hsupport
  rw [← hsupport]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hV⟩
    exact ⟨true, ⟨w, hw, hV⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, ⟨w, hw, hV⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w, hw, hV⟩

private theorem stage {D : ℕ → WordQueryComp Operation Bool} {bound : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hbound : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, bound n < 2 ^ n)
    (hqueries : ∀ n (A : Set (List Bool)),
      (OracleComp.queriesWith (languageOracle A) (D n)).length ≤ bound n)
    (S : Set (List Bool)) (m : ℕ) (hS : ∀ w ∈ S, w.length ≤ m) :
    ∃ (m' : ℕ) (S' : Set (List Bool)), m < m' ∧ S ⊆ S' ∧ (∀ w ∈ S', w.length ≤ m') ∧
      (∀ w ∈ S', w.length ≤ m → w ∈ S) ∧
      ∃ n, ∀ B : Set (List Bool), (∀ w, w.length ≤ m' → (w ∈ B ↔ w ∈ S')) →
        ¬(OracleComp.interpret (m := Id) (languageOracle B) (D n) = true ↔
          ∃ w ∈ B, w.length = n) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hbound
  set n := max N (m + 1) with hn
  have hmn : m < n := by omega
  set Q := (OracleComp.queriesWith (languageOracle S) (D n)).map Prod.snd with hQ
  have hQlen : Q.length < 2 ^ n := by
    rw [hQ, List.length_map]
    exact (hqueries n S).trans_lt (hN n (le_max_left _ _))
  set m' := n + (Q.map List.length).sum with hm'
  have hQm' : ∀ w ∈ Q, w.length ≤ m' := fun w hw =>
    (List.le_sum_of_mem (List.mem_map_of_mem hw)).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨w, hwn, hwQ⟩ := BitString.exists_length_eq_notMem Q n hQlen
  -- add an unrequested word of length `n` exactly when `D n` answers negatively against `S`
  set S' : Set (List Bool) :=
    if OracleComp.interpret (m := Id) (languageOracle S) (D n) = true then S else insert w S
  have hSS' : S ⊆ S' := by
    simp only [S']; split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact Set.subset_insert _ _
  have hS'm' : ∀ v ∈ S', v.length ≤ m' := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [S'] at hv; split_ifs at hv
    · exact (hS v hv).trans (by omega)
    · rcases hv with rfl | hv
      · omega
      · exact (hS v hv).trans (by omega)
  have hS'old : ∀ v ∈ S', v.length ≤ m → v ∈ S := by
    intro v hv hvm
    simp only [S'] at hv; split_ifs at hv
    · exact hv
    · rcases hv with rfl | hv
      · omega
      · exact hv
  refine ⟨m', S', by omega, hSS', hS'm', hS'old, n, fun B hB => ?_⟩
  -- `B` answers every request of the stage as `S` does
  have hagree : ∀ q ∈ OracleComp.queriesWith (languageOracle S) (D n), q.2 ∈ B ↔ q.2 ∈ S := by
    intro q hq
    have hqQ : q.2 ∈ Q := List.mem_map_of_mem hq
    rw [hB _ (hQm' _ hqQ)]
    simp only [S']; split_ifs
    · exact Iff.rfl
    · exact ⟨fun h => h.resolve_left fun h' => hwQ (h' ▸ hqQ), Or.inr⟩
  rw [(interpret_languageOracle_congr (D n) hagree).1]
  -- whether `B` has a word of length `n` is decided by `S'`
  have hlen : (∃ v ∈ B, v.length = n) ↔ ∃ v ∈ S', v.length = n := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, hvn⟩
      exact ⟨v, (hB v (by omega)).mp hv, hvn⟩
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, hvn⟩
      exact ⟨v, (hB v (by omega)).mpr hv, hvn⟩
  rw [hlen]
  by_cases hacc : OracleComp.interpret (m := Id) (languageOracle S) (D n) = true
  · -- a positive answer: no word of length `n` is added, and `S` has none
    have hnone : ¬∃ v ∈ S', v.length = n := by
      rintro ⟨v, hv, hvn⟩
      simp only [S', hacc, ite_true] at hv
      exact absurd (hS v hv) (by omega)
    exact fun h => hnone (h.mp hacc)
  · -- a negative answer: the unrequested word of length `n` is added
    have hsome : ∃ v ∈ S', v.length = n := ⟨w, by simp [S', hacc], hwn⟩
    exact fun h => hacc (h.mpr hsome)

/-- **An oracle defeating every query-bounded family.** Given countably many families of
deterministic word-query programs, where `D i n` makes at most `bound i n` requests against every
oracle language and `bound i n < 2 ^ n` for all large `n`, some oracle language `B` defeats each
family: for every `i` there is an `n` at which `D i n`, run against `B`, does not answer whether
`B` has a word of length `n`. -/

theorem exists_oracle_diagonal {ι : Type} [Countable ι]
    (D : ι → ℕ → WordQueryComp Operation Bool) (bound : ι → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, bound i n < 2 ^ n)
    (hqueries : ∀ i n (A : Set (List Bool)),
      (OracleComp.queriesWith (languageOracle A) (D i n)).length ≤ bound i n) :
    ∃ B : Set (List Bool), ∀ i, ∃ n,
      ¬(OracleComp.interpret (m := Id) (languageOracle B) (D i n) = true ↔
        ∃ w ∈ B, w.length = n) := by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hι | hι
  · exact ⟨∅, fun i => isEmptyElim i⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_surjective_nat ι
  -- a stage is an approximation with a bound on the lengths of its words
  let Data := {p : Set (List Bool) × ℕ // ∀ w ∈ p.1, w.length ≤ p.2}
  have hstep (k : ℕ) (p : Data) := stage (hbound (e k)) (hqueries (e k)) p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2
  let next (k : ℕ) (p : Data) : Data :=
    ⟨((hstep k p).choose_spec.choose, (hstep k p).choose),
      (hstep k p).choose_spec.choose_spec.2.2.1⟩
  let seq : ℕ → Data := fun k => Nat.rec ⟨(∅, 0), by simp⟩ next k
  have hseq (k : ℕ) : seq (k + 1) = next k (seq k) := rfl
  -- each stage only adds words longer than the previous bound
  have hmono (k : ℕ) : (seq k).1.2 < (seq (k + 1)).1.2 ∧ (seq k).1.1 ⊆ (seq (k + 1)).1.1 ∧
      ∀ w ∈ (seq (k + 1)).1.1, w.length ≤ (seq k).1.2 → w ∈ (seq k).1.1 := by
    rw [hseq]
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, -, h₄, -⟩ := (hstep k (seq k)).choose_spec.choose_spec
    exact ⟨h₁, h₂, h₄⟩
  have hbound_mono : StrictMono fun k => (seq k).1.2 :=
    strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun k => (hmono k).1
  have hsub_mono : Monotone fun k => (seq k).1.1 := monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun k => (hmono k).2.1
  -- later stages agree with stage `k` up to its bound
  have hstable (k j : ℕ) (hkj : k ≤ j) (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length ≤ (seq k).1.2) :
      w ∈ (seq j).1.1 ↔ w ∈ (seq k).1.1 := by
    induction j, hkj using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact Iff.rfl
    | succ j hkj ih =>
      exact ⟨fun h => ih.mp ((hmono j).2.2 w h (hw.trans (hbound_mono.monotone hkj))),
        fun h => (hmono j).2.1 (ih.mpr h)⟩
  refine ⟨⋃ k, (seq k).1.1, fun i => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := he i
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, n, hn⟩ := (hstep k (seq k)).choose_spec.choose_spec
  refine ⟨n, hn _ fun w hw => ?_⟩
  change w.length ≤ (seq (k + 1)).1.2 at hw
  change w ∈ ⋃ j, (seq j).1.1 ↔ w ∈ (seq (k + 1)).1.1
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k + 1, h⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
  rcases le_total j (k + 1) with hjk | hkj
  · exact hsub_mono hjk hj
  · exact (hstable (k + 1) j hkj w hw).mp hj

private theorem replayStepFactor_mem_SharpP [Finite Control] [Finite Operation]
    (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool Control Operation) {input : α → List Bool}
    {fYes fNo : List Bool → ℕ}
    (hinput : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime input enc encBits)
    (hYes : fYes ∈ SharpP encBits) (hNo : fNo ∈ SharpP encBits) :
    replayStepFactor machine input fYes fNo ∈ SharpP (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encUnary) := by
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite Operation
  let cfg : (α × List Bool) × ℕ → FiniteConfig k Bool Control Operation :=
    fun x => machine.replayPrefix (input x.1.1) x.1.2 x.2

      (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encUnary) encFiniteConfig :=
    machine.replayPrefix_pt.comp (g := fun x : (α × List Bool) × ℕ =>
      ((input x.1.1, x.1.2), x.2)) (by fun_prop)
  have hquery : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun x => (machine.pendingQuery (cfg x)).isSome)
      (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encUnary) encBool :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.of_finite Option.isSome).comp

      (fun x => machine.pendingRequest (cfg x))

      (fun x : (α × List Bool) × ℕ => x.1.2.getD x.2 false)
      (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encUnary) encBool := by fun_prop

    (SharpP.ite_mem (.of_tidy hbit) (SharpP.comp_mem hYes (.of_tidy hreq))

/-- **Polynomial-time predicates of encoded `FP^(NP ∩ coNP)` outputs lie in `NP`.** If
`A ∈ NP ∩ coNP`, `f : α → β` is computable in polynomial time relative to `A`, and
`P : α × List Bool → Bool` is computable in polynomial time, then
`{a | P (a, output (f a)) = true} ∈ NP enc`. -/
theorem ComputableInPolyTimeWithOracle.encoded_mem_NP {f : α → β} {P : α × List Bool → Bool}
    (hA_np : A ∈ NP encBits) (hA_conp : A ∈ coNP encBits)
    (hf : ComputableInPolyTimeWithOracle A f enc output)
    (hP : ComputableInPolyTime P (encPair enc encBits) encBool) :
    {a | P (a, output (f a)) = true} ∈ NP enc := by
  obtain ⟨fYes, hYes_mem, hYes⟩ := mem_NP_iff_exists_SharpP.mp hA_np
  obtain ⟨fNo, hNo_mem, hNo⟩ := mem_NP_iff_exists_SharpP.mp hA_conp
  obtain ⟨program, hcert, hprogram⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨k, m, machine, c, d, hrun⟩ := hcert.exists_fin_run_pure_false
  let g : List Bool → Bool := fun q => decide (q ∈ A)
  have hYes' (q : List Bool) : g q = true ↔ 0 < fYes q := by
    simp only [g, decide_eq_true_eq, hYes q]
  have hNo' (q : List Bool) : g q = false ↔ 0 < fNo q := by
    simp only [g, decide_eq_false_iff_not, ← Set.mem_compl_iff, hNo q]
  let T : α → ℕ := fun a => c * ((enc a).length + 1) ^ d
  have hT : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime T enc encUnary :=
    ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval (Polynomial.C c * (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ d)).comp
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc)).of_enc_eq fun a => by simp [T]
  have hinput : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a : α => enc a) enc encBits :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id'

theorem ComputableInPolyTimeWithOracle.encoded_mem_UP {f : α → β} {P : α × List Bool → Bool}
    (hA_up : A ∈ UP encBits) (hA_coup : A ∈ coUP encBits)
    (hf : ComputableInPolyTimeWithOracle A f enc output)
    (hP : ComputableInPolyTime P (encPair enc encBits) encBool) :
    {a | P (a, output (f a)) = true} ∈ UP enc := by

  obtain ⟨fNo, hNo_mem, hNo_le, hNo_iff⟩ := hA_coup
  obtain ⟨program, hcert, hprogram⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨k, m, machine, c, d, hrun⟩ := hcert.exists_fin_run_pure_false
  let g : List Bool → Bool := fun q => decide (q ∈ A)
  have hYes' (q : List Bool) : g q = true ↔ 0 < fYes q := by
    have hle := hYes_le q
    rw [show (0 < fYes q) ↔ fYes q = 1 by omega]
    simp only [g, decide_eq_true_eq, hYes_iff q]
  have hNo' (q : List Bool) : g q = false ↔ 0 < fNo q := by
    have hle := hNo_le q
    rw [show (0 < fNo q) ↔ fNo q = 1 by omega]
    simp only [g, decide_eq_false_iff_not, ← Set.mem_compl_iff, hNo_iff q]
  let T : α → ℕ := fun a => c * ((enc a).length + 1) ^ d
  have hT : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime T enc encUnary :=
    ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval (Polynomial.C c * (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ d)).comp
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc)).of_enc_eq fun a => by simp [T]
  have hinput : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a : α => enc a) enc encBits :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id'
  refine ⟨replayAcceptCount machine (fun a => enc a) T fYes fNo P,
    replayAcceptCount_mem_SharpP machine hinput hT hYes_mem hNo_mem hP.tidy,
    fun a => ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
  · rw [replayAcceptCount_eq_ite_of_le_one machine (fun a => enc a) T hYes_le hNo_le hYes' hNo' P a]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · rw [replayAcceptCount_eq_ite_of_le_one machine (fun a => enc a) T hYes_le hNo_le hYes' hNo' P a,
      machine.replayOutput_oracleReplies g (T a) (enc a)]

      (machine.run (pure false) (fun op word => OracleComp.query (op, word)) (T a) (enc a))) =

open Classical in
/-- **Oracle monotonicity.** If `A` reduces to `B` in polynomial time, then polynomial time
relative to `A` is polynomial time relative to `B`: every request `w` is replaced by the request
`g w`, keeping one bit of the reply. -/
theorem ComputableInPolyTimeWithOracle.of_polyTimeReducible {A B : Set (List Bool)} {f : α → β}
    (hAB : PolyTimeReducible encBits encBits A B)
    (hf : ComputableInPolyTimeWithOracle A f input output) :
    ComputableInPolyTimeWithOracle B f input output := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgAB⟩ := hAB
  obtain ⟨program, hcert, hprogram⟩ := hf
  -- a request to `A` becomes a request to `B`, of which one reply bit is kept
  let G : Unit × List Bool → WordQueryComp Unit (List Bool) := fun q =>
    List.take 1 <$> OracleComp.query ((), g q.2)
  refine ⟨fun a => OracleComp.interpret G (program a), ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
  · -- substitute the handler answering requests to `A` through `B`
    have hhandler : IsOraclePPTOn
        (encPair input (encPair (encPair (encFinEnum Unit) encBits) (encFinEnum Unit)))
        (encPair encBits (encFinEnum Unit))
        (fun pair : α × (Unit × List Bool) × Unit =>
          (fun r => (r, ())) <$> (List.take 1 <$> ProbOracleComp.query
            (spec := fun _ : Unit × List Bool => List Bool) ((), g pair.2.1.2))) :=
      (IsOraclePPTOn.query_take () (request := fun pair : α × (Unit × List Bool) × Unit =>
        g pair.2.1.2) (limit := fun _ => 1) (hg.tidy.comp (by fun_prop)) (by fun_prop)).map
        (by fun_prop)
    have hsub := hcert.run_interpret_preprocess_open (State := Unit)
      (handler := fun _ q _ => (fun r => (r, ())) <$> (List.take 1 <$> ProbOracleComp.query
        (spec := fun _ : Unit × List Bool => List Bool) ((), g q.2)))
      (prepare := id) (initial := fun _ => ()) (resources := fun _ _ => 1)
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id' hhandler (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const ())
      (fun _ _ => True) (fun _ => trivial) (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 1)
      (fun a request state _ result hresult => by
        obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_map_iff.mp hresult
        obtain ⟨r', -, rfl⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_map_iff.mp hr
        exact ⟨trivial, List.length_take_le _ _, Nat.le_add_right _ _⟩)
    refine (hsub.map (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst output (encFinEnum Unit))).congr
      fun a State oracle s => ?_
    congr 2
    rw [OracleComp.interpret_interpret, OracleComp.interpret_interpret]
    have hH : (fun q : Unit × List Bool => OracleComp.interpret (ProbOracleComp.handler
        (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbOracleComp.sample (ProbComp.unifFin n)))
        (fun (q : Unit × List Bool) (_ : Unit) => (fun r => (r, ())) <$> (List.take 1 <$>
          ProbOracleComp.query (spec := fun _ : Unit × List Bool => List Bool) ((), g q.2))))
        (ProbOracleComp.query q)) = fun q : Unit × List Bool => StateT.lift (List.take 1 <$>
          ProbOracleComp.query (spec := fun _ : Unit × List Bool => List Bool) ((), g q.2)) := by
      funext q
      rw [ProbOracleComp.interpret_query]
      funext u
      simp [StateT.lift]
    rw [hH, OracleComp.run_interpret_lift, Functor.map_map]
    simp only [G, OracleComp.interpret_map, OracleComp.interpret_query, id_map', id]
  · rw [OracleComp.interpret_interpret, ← hprogram a]
    congr 1
    funext q
    simp only [G, OracleComp.interpret_map, OracleComp.interpret_query, languageOracle_apply]
    rw [show decide (g q.2 ∈ B) = decide (q.2 ∈ A) from decide_eq_decide.mpr (hgAB q.2).symm]
    rfl

theorem isOraclePPTOn_search {input : α ↪ List Bool} {u : α → List Bool} {N : α → ℕ}
    (hu : ComputableInPolyTime u input encBits)
    (hN : ComputableInPolyTime N input encUnary) :
    IsOraclePPTOn input encNat
      (fun a => OracleComp.interpret ProbOracleComp.query (search (u a) (N a))) := by
  have hu := hu.tidy
  have hN := hN.tidy
  simp only [search, OracleComp.interpret_map, OracleComp.interpret_iterate]
  have hinit : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => ((0 : ℕ), N a)) input
      (encPair encNat encUnary) :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 0).prod hN
  have hstep₀ : IsOraclePPTOn (encPair encBits (encPair encNat encUnary))
      (encPair encNat encUnary) (fun pair : List Bool × (ℕ × ℕ) =>
        OracleComp.interpret ProbOracleComp.query (searchQuery pair.1 pair.2)) := by
    simp only [interpret_searchQuery]
    refine IsOraclePPTOn.ite (by fun_prop)
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd encBits (encPair encNat encUnary)).isOraclePPTOn ?_
    exact IsOraclePPTOn.map_with (IsOraclePPTOn.query_take () (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop))
      (by fun_prop)
  have hstep : IsOraclePPTOn (encPair input (encPair encNat encUnary)) (encPair encNat encUnary)
      (fun pair : α × (ℕ × ℕ) =>
        OracleComp.interpret ProbOracleComp.query (searchQuery (u pair.1) pair.2)) :=
    hstep₀.preprocess (prepare := fun pair : α × (ℕ × ℕ) => (u pair.1, pair.2))
      ((hu.comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst input (encPair encNat encUnary))).prod
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd input (encPair encNat encUnary)))
  have hpreserve (a : α) (i : ℕ) (s : ℕ × ℕ) (hi : i < N a)
      (hinv : s.2 = N a - i ∧ s.1 + 2 ^ s.2 ≤ 2 ^ N a) (next : ℕ × ℕ)
      (hnext : next ∈ OracleComp.support
        (OracleComp.interpret ProbOracleComp.query (searchQuery (u a) s))) :
      next.2 = N a - (i + 1) ∧ next.1 + 2 ^ next.2 ≤ 2 ^ N a := by
    obtain ⟨hs, hlo⟩ := hinv
    have hs0 : s.2 ≠ 0 := by omega
    rw [interpret_searchQuery] at hnext
    simp only [hs0, ↓reduceIte, Functor.map_map] at hnext
    obtain ⟨reply, -, rfl⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_map_iff.mp hnext
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, s.2 = j + 1 := ⟨s.2 - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hj, pow_succ] at hlo
    refine ⟨by simp only; omega, ?_⟩
    simp only [hj, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  have hbound (a : α) (i : ℕ) (s : ℕ × ℕ) (_ : i ≤ N a)
      (hinv : s.2 = N a - i ∧ s.1 + 2 ^ s.2 ≤ 2 ^ N a) :
      (encPair encNat encUnary s).length ≤ 3 * N a + 1 := by
    obtain ⟨hs, hlo⟩ := hinv
    have hsize : s.1.size ≤ N a := Nat.size_le.2 (by
      have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := s.2)
      omega)
    rw [← Nat.size_eq_bits_len] at hsize
    simp only [length_encPair, encNat_apply, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate]
    omega
  exact (IsOraclePPTOn.iterateWith_spec
    (step := fun a s => OracleComp.interpret ProbOracleComp.query (searchQuery (u a) s))
    hN hinit hstep (fun a i s => s.2 = N a - i ∧ s.1 + 2 ^ s.2 ≤ 2 ^ N a)
    (fun a => ⟨by simp, by simp⟩) hpreserve
    (((PolyBounded.const 3).mul hN.polyBounded).add (.const 1)) hbound).1.map
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst encNat encUnary)

/-! ### Answering bit requests -/

/-- The handler answering a request for bit `i` of `f b`, sent as the code
`encPair encβ encNat (b, i)`, by binary search for `f b < 2 ^ N` with `N = r (n) + 1` rounds,
where `n` is the length of the request: the code of `b` is read from the request without decoding

open BinarySearch in
/-- **`P^#P ⊆ P^PP`**: every request of a `P^#P` program for a bit of a `#P` value `f b` is
answered by binary search with queries `k ≤ f b` to the `PP` problem `{(b, k) | k ≤ f b}`. -/
theorem PWithSharpPOracle_subset_PWithPPOracle : PWithSharpPOracle enc ⊆ PWithPPOracle enc := by
  classical
  rintro L ⟨β, encβ, f, hf, program, hcert, hL⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := SharpP.exists_le_two_pow hf
  refine ⟨β × ℕ, encPair encβ encNat, {x | x.2 ≤ f x.1}, setOf_le_mem_PP hf,
    fun a => OracleComp.interpret (bitQuery r) (program a), ?_, fun A hA a => ?_⟩
  · -- substitute the binary search for every bit request
    have hindex : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun pair : List Bool × ℕ => min (ofBits (dropFrame pair.1)) (r.eval pair.1.length + 1))
        (encPair encBits encNat) encUnary := by
      refine ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.binary_to_unary_bounded
        (bound := fun pair : List Bool × ℕ => r.eval pair.1.length + 1) ?_ (by fun_prop)
        fun _ => Nat.min_le_right _ _
      have h : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun pair : List Bool × ℕ =>
          if ofBits (dropFrame pair.1) ≤ r.eval pair.1.length + 1 then ofBits (dropFrame pair.1)
          else r.eval pair.1.length + 1) (encPair encBits encNat) encNat := by
        fun_prop
      exact h.of_enc_eq fun pair => by rw [Nat.min_def]
    have hlast : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun pair : List Bool × ℕ =>
        [pair.2.testBit (min (ofBits (dropFrame pair.1)) (r.eval pair.1.length + 1))])
        (encPair encBits encNat) encBits :=
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.binary_testBit (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd encBits encNat)
        hindex).of_enc_eq fun pair => (encBool_apply _).symm
    have hG : IsOraclePPTOn encBits encBits (fun w : List Bool =>
        OracleComp.interpret ProbOracleComp.query (bitQuery r ((), w))) := by
      simp only [bitQuery, OracleComp.interpret_map]
      exact (isOraclePPTOn_search (u := unframe) (N := fun w => r.eval w.length + 1)
        (.of_tidy (by fun_prop)) (.of_tidy (by fun_prop))).map_with hlast
    have hhandler : IsOraclePPTOn
        (encPair enc (encPair (encPair (encFinEnum Unit) encBits) (encFinEnum Unit)))
        (encPair encBits (encFinEnum Unit))
        (fun pair : α × (Unit × List Bool) × Unit => (fun reply => (reply, ())) <$>
          OracleComp.interpret ProbOracleComp.query (bitQuery r pair.2.1)) :=
      (hG.preprocess (prepare := fun pair : α × (Unit × List Bool) × Unit => pair.2.1.2)
        (by fun_prop)).map (by fun_prop)
    have hsub := hcert.run_interpret_preprocess_open (State := Unit)
      (handler := fun _ q _ => (fun reply => (reply, ())) <$>
        OracleComp.interpret ProbOracleComp.query (bitQuery r q))
      (prepare := id) (initial := fun _ => ()) (resources := fun _ _ => 1)
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id' hhandler (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const ())
      (fun _ _ => True) (fun _ => trivial) (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 1)
      (fun a request state _ result hresult => by
        obtain ⟨reply, hreply, rfl⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_map_iff.mp hresult
        rw [bitQuery, OracleComp.interpret_map] at hreply
        obtain ⟨lo, -, rfl⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_map_iff.mp hreply
        exact ⟨trivial, by simp, Nat.le_add_right _ _⟩)
    refine (hsub.map (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst encBool (encFinEnum Unit))).congr
      fun a State oracle s => ?_
    congr 2
    rw [OracleComp.interpret_interpret, OracleComp.interpret_interpret]
    have hH : (fun q : Unit × List Bool => OracleComp.interpret (ProbOracleComp.handler
        (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbOracleComp.sample (ProbComp.unifFin n)))
        (fun (q : Unit × List Bool) (_ : Unit) => (fun reply => (reply, ())) <$>
          OracleComp.interpret ProbOracleComp.query (bitQuery r q)))
        (ProbOracleComp.query q)) = fun q : Unit × List Bool =>
          StateT.lift (OracleComp.interpret ProbOracleComp.query (bitQuery r q)) := by
      funext q
      rw [ProbOracleComp.interpret_query]
      funext u
      simp [StateT.lift]
    rw [hH, OracleComp.run_interpret_lift, Functor.map_map]
    simp only [id_map', id]
  · -- the bits answered by the handler
    let A' : Set (List Bool) :=
      {w | OracleComp.interpret (m := Id) (languageOracle A) (bitQuery r ((), w)) = [true]}
    have hA' : AnswersBits encβ f A' := fun b i => by
      simp only [A', Set.mem_ofPred_eq, interpret_id_bitQuery hr (fun x => hA x) b i]
      exact ⟨fun h => (List.cons.inj h).1, fun h => by rw [h]⟩
    have hhandler : (fun q => OracleComp.interpret (m := Id) (languageOracle A) (bitQuery r q)) =
        languageOracle A' := by
      funext q
      have hsingle : ∀ w, ∃ bit, OracleComp.interpret (m := Id) (languageOracle A)
          (bitQuery r ((), w)) = [bit] := fun w => by
        unfold bitQuery
        rw [OracleComp.interpret_map]
        exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

      · have hq' : [bit] ≠ [true] := fun h => hq (hbit.trans h)
        rw [decide_eq_false hq]

    rw [hL A' hA' a, OracleComp.interpret_interpret, hhandler]

private theorem wellFormed_pt : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime wellFormed
    (encList encToken) encBool := by
  have hstep : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : (Bool × ℕ) × (QBF.Kind × ℕ) => wfStep p.1 p.2)
      (encPair (encPair encBool encUnary) encToken) (encPair encBool encUnary) := by
    have hok : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime tokenOk encToken encBool := by
      refine ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.finite_cases (tag := fun t : QBF.Kind × ℕ => t.1)
        (tagEncoding := encKind) (branch := fun k t => match k with
          | .var | .ex | .all => true
          | _ => decide (t.2 = 0)) (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst encKind encNat) ?_
      intro k
      cases k <;> first | exact ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const _ | fun_prop
    have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : (Bool × ℕ) × (QBF.Kind × ℕ) => p.1.2)
        (encPair (encPair encBool encUnary) encToken) encUnary := by fun_prop
    have hpos : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : (Bool × ℕ) × (QBF.Kind × ℕ) =>
        decide (p.1.2 ≠ 0)) (encPair (encPair encBool encUnary) encToken) encBool :=
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_lt' (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 0) hn).of_enc_eq
        fun p => by simp [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    have harity : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : (Bool × ℕ) × (QBF.Kind × ℕ) =>
        arity p.2.1) (encPair (encPair encBool encUnary) encToken) encUnary :=
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.of_finite arity).comp
        ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst encKind encNat).comp
          (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd (encPair encBool encUnary) encToken))
    have hb : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : (Bool × ℕ) × (QBF.Kind × ℕ) => p.1.1)
        (encPair (encPair encBool encUnary) encToken) encBool := by fun_prop
    have hokp : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : (Bool × ℕ) × (QBF.Kind × ℕ) => tokenOk p.2)
        (encPair (encPair encBool encUnary) encToken) encBool :=
      hok.comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd (encPair encBool encUnary) encToken)
    exact ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.of_finite (fun q : Bool × Bool × Bool =>
      q.1 && q.2.1 && q.2.2)).comp (hb.prod (hpos.prod hokp))).prod
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_add.comp ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_sub.comp
        (hn.prod (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 1))).prod harity))
  have hfold := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.foldl_of_bounded_growth
    (encB := encPair encBool encUnary)
    (encIn := encList encToken) (encL := encList encToken)
    (list := fun ts : List (QBF.Kind × ℕ) => ts) (init := fun _ => (true, 1))
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id' (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const _) hstep (growth := 2)
    (fun state t => by
      simp only [wfStep, length_encPair, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton, encUnary_apply,
        List.length_replicate]
      have : arity t.1 ≤ 2 := by cases t.1 <;> simp [arity]
      omega)
  exact (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.decide_eq' hfold (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const _)).of_enc_eq
    fun _ => rfl

private theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_splitAlternatingBlocks {γ : Type}
    {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} (ps : List (Polynomial ℕ × Polynomial ℕ)) {N : γ → ℕ}
    (hN : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime N encIn encUnary) {W : γ → List Bool}
    (hW : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime W encIn encBits) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun x => splitAlternatingBlocks (ps.map fun pq => (pq.1.eval (N x), pq.2.eval (N x)))
        (W x)) encIn (encPair encBits encBits) := by
  induction ps generalizing W with
  | nil => exact .const ([], [])
  | cons pq ps ih =>
    have hp := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval pq.1).comp hN
    have hq := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval pq.2).comp hN
    have ht := ih (hW.bitsDropWithInput (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_add.comp
      (hp.prod hq)))
    exact ((hW.bitsTakeWithInput hp).bitsAppend ht.fst').prod
      (((hW.bitsDropWithInput hp).bitsTakeWithInput hq).bitsAppend ht.snd')

private theorem exists_inter_verifier {q : Bool} {k : ℕ} {A B : Set α}
    (hA : ∃ ps V, ps.length = k ∧
      ComputableInPolyTime V (encPair enc encBits) encBool ∧
      IsAlternatingVerifier enc q ps V A)
    (hB : ∃ ps V, ps.length = k ∧
      ComputableInPolyTime V (encPair enc encBits) encBool ∧
      IsAlternatingVerifier enc q ps V B) :
    ∃ ps V, ps.length = k ∧
      ComputableInPolyTime V (encPair enc encBits) encBool ∧
      IsAlternatingVerifier enc q ps V (A ∩ B) := by
  obtain ⟨ps, V, hp, hV, hA⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨qs, W, hq, hW, hB⟩ := hB
  have hlen : ps.length = qs.length := hp.trans hq.symm
  have hA' : IsAlternatingVerifier enc q ((ps.zip qs).map Prod.fst) V A := by
    simpa only [List.map_fst_zip hlen.le] using hA
  have hB' : IsAlternatingVerifier enc q ((ps.zip qs).map Prod.snd) W B := by
    simpa only [List.map_snd_zip hlen.ge] using hB
  refine ⟨_, _, ?_, ?_, hA'.inter hB'⟩
  · simp [hp, hq]
  · have hn : ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : α × List Bool => (enc x.1).length)
        (encPair enc encBits) encUnary := by fun_prop
    have hs := (computableInPolyTime_splitAlternatingBlocks (ps.zip qs) hn
      (.snd enc encBits)).tidy
    exact .of_tidy <|
      (hV.tidy.comp ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst enc encBits).prod hs.fst')).bool_and'
        (hW.tidy.comp ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst enc encBits).prod hs.snd'))

theorem SigmaP_succ_subset_SigmaP {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (h : PiP k (encPair enc encBits) ⊆ SigmaP k (encPair enc encBits)) :
    SigmaP (k + 1) enc ⊆ SigmaP k enc := by
  intro A hA
  -- the pairs of an instance and a first certificate from which the last `k` quantifiers accept
  obtain ⟨p, B, hB, hA⟩ := exists_mem_PiP_of_mem_SigmaP_succ hA
  obtain ⟨rs, V', hrs, hV', hB'⟩ := h hB
  obtain ⟨r, rs, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_length_eq_add_one
    (show rs.length = (k - 1) + 1 by omega)
  -- the length of the encoded pair of an instance and a first certificate
  let L : Polynomial ℕ := 2 * Polynomial.X + 1 + p
  have hL (a : α) (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = p.eval (enc a).length) :
      (encPair enc encBits (a, w)).length = L.eval (enc a).length := by
    simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply, hw, L, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_one, Polynomial.eval_ofNat]
  refine ⟨(p + r.comp L) :: rs.map (·.comp L),
    fun x => V' ((x.1, x.2.take (p.eval (enc x.1).length)), x.2.drop (p.eval (enc x.1).length)),
    by simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_map]; omega, ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
  · have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x : α × List Bool => p.eval (enc x.1).length)
        (encPair enc encBits) encUnary :=
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval p).comp
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc)).comp (.fst _ _)
    exact .of_tidy <| hV'.tidy.comp (((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).prod
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsTakeWithInput (.snd _ _) hn)).prod
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsDropWithInput (.snd _ _) hn))
  · rw [hA a]
    simp only [List.map_cons, alternation_true_cons, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_comp,
      List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
    rw [exists_length_add_iff]
    refine exists_congr fun w => and_congr_right fun hw => ?_
    have hmem := hB' (a, w)
    simp only [List.map_cons, alternation_true_cons, hL a w hw] at hmem
    rw [hmem]
    refine exists_congr fun v => and_congr_right fun hv => alternation_congr fun u => ?_

/-- **`Πₖ ⊆ Σₖ` collapses the polynomial hierarchy to `Σₖ`**, for `k ≥ 1`
[Arora and Barak, Theorem 5.4][AroraBarak09]: if `Πₖ ⊆ Σₖ` for problems with any encoding of their
instances, then `PH = Σₖ`. -/

theorem PH_eq_SigmaP_of_PiP_subset_SigmaP {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (h : ∀ {β : Type} (encB : β ↪ List Bool), PiP k encB ⊆ SigmaP k encB) :
    PH enc = SigmaP k enc := by
  -- every level from `k` on is within `Σₖ`, for every encoding
  have hlevel (j : ℕ) :
      ∀ {β : Type} (encB : β ↪ List Bool), SigmaP (k + j) encB ⊆ SigmaP k encB := by
    induction j with
    | zero => intro β encB; exact le_rfl
    | succ j ih =>
      intro β encB
      refine (SigmaP_succ_subset_SigmaP (k := k + j) (by omega) fun A hA => ?_).trans
        (ih encB)
      -- `Πₖ₊ⱼ` is the complement of `Σₖ₊ⱼ ⊆ Σₖ`, within `Πₖ ⊆ Σₖ ⊆ Σₖ₊ⱼ`
      have hc : Aᶜ ∈ SigmaP k _ := ih _ (compl_mem_SigmaP_of_mem_PiP hA)
      have := h _ (by simpa using compl_mem_PiP_of_mem_SigmaP hc)
      exact SigmaP_mono (Nat.le_add_right k j) this
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm (Set.iUnion_subset fun j => ?_) (SigmaP_subset_PH k)
  rcases le_total j k with hj | hj
  · exact SigmaP_mono hj
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hj
    exact hlevel i enc

/-- **Images of problems in `NP`.** The encodings of the members of a problem in `NP` form a
problem in `NP` on words, when the encoding has a decoder: the verifier decodes the word, checks
that it encodes what was decoded, and runs the verifier of the problem. -/
theorem mem_NP_image {β : Type} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} (D : Decoder encB) {B : Set β}
    (hB : B ∈ NP encB) : encB '' B ∈ NP encBits := by
  obtain ⟨p, V, hV, hBV⟩ := mem_NP.mp hB
  obtain ⟨d, e, hD⟩ := D.computable
  have hdecoder : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime D.decode encBits encB := by
    obtain ⟨c, d, k, Q, hfin, tm, htm⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hD.computableInPolyTime
    exact ⟨_, _, .of_forall_le c d (fun _ => le_rfl),
      .of_forall_le c d (fun _ => le_rfl), k, Q, hfin, tm, htm⟩
  have hdec : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool × List Bool => D.decode x.1)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encB := hdecoder.comp (fst _ _)
  refine mem_NP.mpr
    ⟨p, fun x => decide (encB (D.decode x.1) = x.1) && V (D.decode x.1, x.2),
      .of_tidy (bool_and' (decide_eq' ((encode encB).comp hdec) (fst _ _))
        (hV.tidy.comp (hdec.prod (snd _ _)))),
      fun w => ?_⟩
  simp only [encBits_apply, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hVc⟩ := (hBV b).1 hb
    exact ⟨c, hc, by rw [D.decode_enc], by rw [D.decode_enc]; exact hVc⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, hw, hVc⟩
    exact ⟨D.decode w, (hBV _).2 ⟨c, by rw [hw]; exact hc, hVc⟩, hw⟩

private theorem verifier_append {k : ℕ} (x : List Bool) {w₁ w₂ : List Bool}
    (h₁ : w₁.length = tableBound k x.length)
    (h₂ : w₂.length = tableBound k x.length + certBound k x.length) (w₃ : List Bool) :
    verifier k (x, w₁ ++ (w₂ ++ w₃)) =
      ((!MCSP.tableVerifier ((table k x.length w₁, threshold k x.length),
          w₂.drop (tableBound k x.length) ++ w₃) &&
        (!decide (BitString.binaryValue (table k x.length w₂) <
            BitString.binaryValue (table k x.length w₁)) ||
          MCSP.tableVerifier ((table k x.length w₂, threshold k x.length), w₃))) &&
        MCSP.tableValue (table k x.length w₁) (x.take (arity k x.length))) := by
  have hM := two_pow_arity_le k x.length
  have hw₁ : table k x.length (w₁ ++ (w₂ ++ w₃)) = table k x.length w₁ :=
    List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [h₁]; exact hM)
  have hw₂ : table k x.length ((w₁ ++ (w₂ ++ w₃)).drop (tableBound k x.length)) =
      table k x.length w₂ := by
    rw [← h₁, List.drop_left]
    exact List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [h₂]; exact hM.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
  have hc : (w₁ ++ (w₂ ++ w₃)).drop (2 * tableBound k x.length) =
      w₂.drop (tableBound k x.length) ++ w₃ := by
    rw [Nat.two_mul, ← List.drop_drop, ← h₁, List.drop_left, h₁,
      List.drop_append_of_le_length (by rw [h₂]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _)]
  have hc' : (w₁ ++ (w₂ ++ w₃)).drop (2 * tableBound k x.length + certBound k x.length) = w₃ := by
    rw [← List.append_assoc]
    exact List.drop_left' (by rw [List.length_append, h₁, h₂]; ring)
  simp only [verifier, hw₁, hw₂, hc, hc']

/-- The verifier for Kannan's language is polynomial-time. -/
private theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_verifier (k : ℕ) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (verifier k) (encPair encBits encBits) encBool := by
  have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => p.1.length)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encUnary :=
    length_bits.comp (fst _ _)
  have hm : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => arity k p.1.length)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encUnary := by
    unfold arity
    fun_prop
  have htb : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => tableBound k p.1.length)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encUnary := by
    unfold tableBound
    fun_prop
  have hcb : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => certBound k p.1.length)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encUnary := by
    unfold certBound certLength
    fun_prop
  have hs : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => threshold k p.1.length)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encNat := by
    refine unary_to_binary.comp ?_
    fun_prop
  have hM : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => 2 ^ arity k p.1.length)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encUnary :=
    binary_to_unary_bounded (binary_two_pow.comp hm) htb fun p => two_pow_arity_le k _
  have hT : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => table k p.1.length p.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits :=
    bitsTakeWithInput (snd _ _) hM
  have hT' : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool =>
      table k p.1.length (p.2.drop (tableBound k p.1.length))) (encPair encBits encBits) encBits :=
    bitsTakeWithInput (bitsDropWithInput (snd _ _) htb) hM
  have hc : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool =>
      p.2.drop (2 * tableBound k p.1.length)) (encPair encBits encBits) encBits :=
    bitsDropWithInput (snd _ _) (by fun_prop)
  have hc' : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool =>
      p.2.drop (2 * tableBound k p.1.length + certBound k p.1.length))
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits :=
    bitsDropWithInput (snd _ _) (by fun_prop)
  have hval : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool =>
      MCSP.tableValue (table k p.1.length p.2) (p.1.take (arity k p.1.length)))
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBool :=
    MCSP.computableInPolyTime_tableValue.tidy.comp
      (hT.prod (bitsTakeWithInput (fst _ _) hm))
  unfold verifier
  have hnotVerifier := bool_not.comp (MCSP.computableInPolyTime_tableVerifier.tidy.comp
    ((hT.prod hs).prod hc))
  have hlt := bool_not.comp (binary_lt'
    (bitsBinaryValue.comp hT')
    (bitsBinaryValue.comp hT))
  have hverifier' := MCSP.computableInPolyTime_tableVerifier.tidy.comp ((hT'.prod hs).prod hc')
  have hor := bool_or.comp (hlt.prod hverifier')
  have h := bool_and' (bool_and' hnotVerifier hor) hval
  exact h

private theorem computableInPolyTime_verifier {f : α × List Bool → CNF ℕ}
    (hf : ComputableInPolyTime f (encPair enc encBits) encCNF) (S W P : Polynomial ℕ) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (verifier enc f S W P) (encPair enc encBits) encBool := by

      (encPair enc encBits) encUnary :=

theorem PiP_two_subset_SigmaP_two_of_SAT (hSAT : SAT ∈ PPolyOn encCNF)
    (enc : α ↪ List Bool) : PiP 2 enc ⊆ SigmaP 2 enc := by
  rintro A ⟨ps, V, hlen, hV, hA⟩
  obtain ⟨p, q, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_two.1 hlen
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfB⟩ := CookLevin.SAT_npHard _ _ (mem_NP_setOf_exists_append hV q)
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hSAT⟩ := hSAT
  obtain ⟨c', d', hf'⟩ := hf.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  -- a bound on the length of the formulas `f (a, u)`
  let F : Polynomial ℕ := Polynomial.C c' * (2 * Polynomial.X + 2 + p) ^ d'
  -- a bound on the length of the queries
  let N : Polynomial ℕ := F + (F + 1) * (8 * F + 11)
  obtain ⟨S, W, P, α_adv, hlen_α, -, h_eval⟩ := PPoly.exists_evalAdvice hL N
  have hF (a : α) (u : List Bool) (hu : u.length = p.eval (enc a).length) :
      (encCNF (f (a, u))).length ≤ F.eval (enc a).length := by
    refine (hf' (a, u)).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply, hu, F, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
      Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_ofNat]
    ring
  have hN (n : ℕ) : N.eval n = SAT.queryBound (F.eval n) := by
    simp [N, SAT.queryBound, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul]
  refine ⟨[P, p], KarpLipton.verifier enc f S W P, rfl,
    KarpLipton.computableInPolyTime_verifier hf S W P, fun a => ?_⟩
  set n := (enc a).length
  -- membership in `A` through `SAT`
  have hA' : a ∈ A ↔ ∀ u : List Bool, u.length = p.eval n → f (a, u) ∈ SAT := by
    rw [hA a]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, alternation_false_cons, alternation_true_cons,
      alternation_nil, List.append_nil]
    exact forall₂_congr fun u _ => hfB (a, u)
  rw [hA']
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, alternation_true_cons, alternation_false_cons,
    alternation_nil, List.append_nil]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨α_adv n, hlen_α n, fun u hu => ?_⟩
    rw [KarpLipton.verifier_append a (hlen_α n)]
    refine SAT.verifier_search (fun ψ hψ => ?_) (h u hu)
    have hlen : (encCNF ψ).length ≤ N.eval n := by
      rw [hN]
      exact hψ.trans (SAT.queryBound_mono (hF a u hu))
    exact (h_eval n (encCNF ψ) hlen).trans (hSAT ψ).symm
  · rintro ⟨w₁, hw₁, h⟩ u hu
    have := h u hu
    rw [KarpLipton.verifier_append a hw₁] at this
    exact ⟨_, this⟩

theorem PolyTimeReducible.mem_PPolyOn {β : Type} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {A : Set α}
    {B : Set β} (hAB : PolyTimeReducible enc encB A B)
    (hB : B ∈ PPolyOn encB) :
    A ∈ PPolyOn enc := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hiff⟩ := hAB
  obtain ⟨L_B, hL_B, hLB⟩ := hB
  obtain ⟨c', d', hf'⟩ := hf.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  let N : Polynomial ℕ := Polynomial.C c' * (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ d'
  obtain ⟨S, W, _, α_adv, -, hα, h_eval⟩ := PPoly.exists_evalAdvice hL_B N
  have hN (a : α) : (encB (f a)).length ≤ N.eval (enc a).length := by
    refine (hf' a).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    simp [N]
  let g : List Bool × α → Bool := fun x =>
    evalAdvice (S.eval (enc x.2).length) (W.eval (enc x.2).length) x.1 (encB (f x.2))
  have hg : ComputableInPolyTime g (encPair encBits enc) encBool :=
    computableInPolyTime_evalAdvice_eval S W ((encoding_length enc).comp (snd _ _)) (fst _ _)
      ((of_tidy (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encode encB)).comp (hf.comp (snd _ _)))
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hgM⟩ := PPoly.exists_of_polyTime hg
  let L : Language Bool := {x : List Bool | frame (α_adv x.length) ++ x ∈ M}
  refine ⟨L, PPoly.of_advice hM α_adv hα (fun _ => Iff.rfl), fun a => ?_⟩
  change a ∈ A ↔ frame (α_adv (enc a).length) ++ enc a ∈ M
  have hgM' := hgM (α_adv (enc a).length, a)
  rw [encPair_apply, encBits_apply] at hgM'
  rw [hiff a, hLB (f a), ← hgM']
  exact (h_eval (enc a).length (encB (f a)) (hN a)).symm

theorem mem_PPoly_of_exists_frame_append
    (hNP : NP encBits ⊆ PPolyOn encBits)
    {M : Language Bool} (hM : M ∈ PPoly) (p : Polynomial ℕ) :
    ({x : List Bool | ∃ w : List Bool, w.length = p.eval x.length ∧ frame x ++ w ∈ M} :
      Language Bool) ∈ PPoly := by
  let N : Polynomial ℕ := 2 * Polynomial.X + 1 + p
  obtain ⟨S, W, _, α_adv, -, hα, h_eval⟩ := PPoly.exists_evalAdvice hM N
  have hN (n : ℕ) : N.eval n = 2 * n + 1 + p.eval n := by
    simp [N, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul]
  let V : List Bool × List Bool → Bool := fun z =>
    evalAdvice (S.eval (dropFrame z.1).length) (W.eval (dropFrame z.1).length) (unframe z.1)
      (frame (dropFrame z.1) ++ z.2.take (p.eval (dropFrame z.1).length))
  have hV : ComputableInPolyTime V (encPair encBits encBits) encBool := by
    have hx : ComputableInPolyTime (fun z : List Bool × List Bool => dropFrame z.1)
        (encPair encBits encBits) encBits :=
      (of_tidy ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.dropFrame).comp (fst _ _)
    have hu : ComputableInPolyTime (fun z : List Bool × List Bool => unframe z.1)
        (encPair encBits encBits) encBits :=
      (of_tidy ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unframe).comp (fst _ _)
    have hn : ComputableInPolyTime (fun z : List Bool × List Bool => (dropFrame z.1).length)
        (encPair encBits encBits) encUnary := length_bits.comp hx
    have hw : ComputableInPolyTime
        (fun z : List Bool × List Bool => z.2.take (p.eval (dropFrame z.1).length))
        (encPair encBits encBits) encBits :=
      bitsTakeWithInput (snd _ _) ((unary_eval p).comp hn)
    exact computableInPolyTime_evalAdvice_eval S W hn hu
      (bitsAppend ((bitsFrame encBits).comp hx) hw)
  let D : Language Bool := {z : List Bool | ∃ w : List Bool, w.length = p.eval z.length ∧
    V (z, w) = true}
  have hD : D ∈ PPoly := mem_PPolyOn_encBits_iff.1 (hNP ⟨p, V, hV, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩)
  refine PPoly.of_advice hD α_adv hα fun x => ?_
  change (∃ w : List Bool, w.length = p.eval x.length ∧ frame x ++ w ∈ M) ↔
    (∃ w : List Bool, w.length = p.eval (frame (α_adv x.length) ++ x).length ∧
      V (frame (α_adv x.length) ++ x, w) = true)
  have hle : p.eval x.length ≤ p.eval (frame (α_adv x.length) ++ x).length :=
    p.eval_mono (by simp)
  have hV_frame (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = p.eval x.length) :
      evalAdvice (S.eval x.length) (W.eval x.length) (α_adv x.length) (frame x ++ w) = true ↔
        frame x ++ w ∈ M :=
    h_eval x.length (frame x ++ w) (by simp [hN, hw])
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hwM⟩
    refine ⟨w ++ List.replicate (p.eval (frame (α_adv x.length) ++ x).length - w.length) false,
      by rw [List.length_append, List.length_replicate, hw, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hle], ?_⟩
    dsimp only [V]
    rw [unframe_frame_append, dropFrame_frame_append, ← hw, List.take_left]
    exact (hV_frame w hw).2 hwM
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hwV⟩
    dsimp only [V] at hwV
    rw [unframe_frame_append, dropFrame_frame_append] at hwV
    have htake : (w.take (p.eval x.length)).length = p.eval x.length := by
      rw [List.length_take, hw, Nat.min_eq_left hle]
    exact ⟨w.take (p.eval x.length), htake, (hV_frame _ htake).1 hwV⟩

theorem PPolyOn.exists_of_computableInPolyTime_length
    (hNP : NP encBits ⊆ PPolyOn encBits) {N : α → ℕ}
    (hN : ComputableInPolyTime N enc encUnary) {P : α → List Bool → Prop}
    (hP : {p : α × List Bool | P p.1 p.2} ∈ PPolyOn (encPair enc encBits)) :
    {a : α | ∃ u : List Bool, u.length = N a ∧ P a u} ∈ PPolyOn enc := by
  let B : Set (α × List Bool) := {p | P p.1 (p.2.take (N p.1))}
  have hred : PolyTimeReducible (encPair enc encBits) (encPair enc encBits)
      B {p : α × List Bool | P p.1 p.2} := by
    refine ⟨fun p => (p.1, p.2.take (N p.1)), ?_, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
    exact .of_tidy ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst enc encBits).prod
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsTakeWithInput
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd enc encBits)
        (hN.tidy.comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst enc encBits))))
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hBM⟩ := hred.mem_PPolyOn hP
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hN.tidy.polyBounded.exists_polynomial
  refine ⟨{x : List Bool | ∃ w : List Bool, w.length = p.eval x.length ∧ frame x ++ w ∈ M},
    mem_PPoly_of_exists_frame_append hNP hM p, fun a => ?_⟩
  have hle : N a ≤ p.eval (enc a).length := hp a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, hPu⟩
    refine ⟨u ++ List.replicate (p.eval (enc a).length - N a) false,
      by rw [List.length_append, List.length_replicate, hu, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hle], ?_⟩
    have htake : (u ++ List.replicate (p.eval (enc a).length - N a) false).take (N a) = u := by
      rw [← hu, List.take_left]
    have hmem : (a, u ++ List.replicate (p.eval (enc a).length - N a) false) ∈ B := by
      change P a ((u ++ List.replicate (p.eval (enc a).length - N a) false).take (N a))
      rwa [htake]
    simpa [encPair_apply, encBits_apply] using (hBM _).1 hmem
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hwM⟩
    have hmem : (a, w) ∈ B :=
      (hBM (a, w)).2 (by simpa [encPair_apply, encBits_apply] using hwM)
    refine ⟨w.take (N a), ?_, hmem⟩
    rw [List.length_take, hw, Nat.min_eq_left hle]

theorem alternation_truncateBlocks {ps : List (Polynomial ℕ)} {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) {q : Bool}
    {P : List Bool → Prop} :
    Alternation q (ps.map fun p => p.eval m) (fun w => P (truncateBlocks ps n m w)) ↔
      Alternation q (ps.map fun p => p.eval n) P := by
  induction ps generalizing q P with
  | nil => simp [truncateBlocks]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hle := p.eval_mono h
    -- a long block, appended to anything, cuts to its first `p.eval n` bits
    have hcut (w v : List Bool) (hw : w.length = p.eval m) :
        truncateBlocks (p :: ps) n m (w ++ v) = w.take (p.eval n) ++ truncateBlocks ps n m v := by
      simp only [truncateBlocks, List.take_append_of_le_length (hw ▸ hle),
        List.drop_left' hw]
    have key (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = p.eval m) {q : Bool} :
        Alternation q (ps.map fun p => p.eval m)
          (fun v => P (truncateBlocks (p :: ps) n m (w ++ v))) ↔
        Alternation q (ps.map fun p => p.eval n) fun v => P (w.take (p.eval n) ++ v) :=

      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate, hw]

theorem exists_seed_not_majorityAccepts {m : ℕ} {P : (Fin m → Bool) → Bool}
    (hP : 2 * 2 ^ m ≤ 3 * (univ.filter fun s : Fin m → Bool => P s = false).card)
    (tests : Fin (shifts m) → Seed m) :
    ∃ r : Seed m, ∀ i, ¬ majorityAccepts P (r + tests i) := by
  set G₀ : Finset (Fin m → Bool) := univ.filter fun s => P s = false with hG₀
  set S : Finset (Seed m) := univ.filter fun ω => majorityAccepts P ω with hSdef
  have hsub : S ⊆
      univ.filter fun ω : Seed m => (univ.filter fun j => ω j ∈ G₀).card ≤ halfRuns m := by
    intro ω hω
    have hω' : halfRuns m < (univ.filter fun j : Fin (runs m) => P (ω j) = true).card :=
      (mem_filter.1 hω).2
    refine mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ ω, ?_⟩
    have hpart := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
      (s := (univ : Finset (Fin (runs m)))) (fun j => ω j ∈ G₀)
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hpart
    have hruns : runs m = 2 * halfRuns m := rfl
    have hnot : (univ.filter fun j : Fin (runs m) => ω j ∉ G₀) =
        univ.filter fun j : Fin (runs m) => P (ω j) = true := by
      ext j
      simp [hG₀]
    rw [hnot] at hpart
    omega
  have hS : 9 ^ halfRuns m * #S ≤ 8 ^ halfRuns m * Fintype.card (Seed m) :=
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (card_le_card hsub)).trans (nine_pow_mul_card_filter_le hP)
  have hlt : shifts m * #S < Fintype.card (Seed m) := by
    refine Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (a := 9 ^ halfRuns m) ?_
    calc 9 ^ halfRuns m * (shifts m * #S) = shifts m * (9 ^ halfRuns m * #S) := by ring
      _ ≤ shifts m * (8 ^ halfRuns m * Fintype.card (Seed m)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hS
      _ = shifts m * 8 ^ halfRuns m * Fintype.card (Seed m) := by ring
      _ < 9 ^ halfRuns m * Fintype.card (Seed m) :=
        Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (shifts_mul_eight_pow_halfRuns_lt m) Fintype.card_pos
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Cslib.exists_forall_add_notMem_of_mul_card_lt S hlt tests
  exact ⟨r, fun i hi => hr i (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, hi⟩)⟩

theorem PolyTimeReducible.mem_PP {β : Type} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {A : Set α} {B : Set β}
    (h : PolyTimeReducible enc encB A B) (hB : B ∈ PP encB) : A ∈ PP enc := by
  rw [Complexity.mem_PP] at hB ⊢
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hAB⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨q, W, hW, hWB⟩ := hB
  have hf := hf.tidy
  have hW := hW.tidy

    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval q).comp
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length encB).comp hf)
  obtain ⟨p, hle⟩ := hlen.polyBounded.exists_polynomial
  refine ⟨p,
    andVerifier (fun a => q.eval (encB (f a)).length) (fun x => W (f x.1, x.2)) fun _ => true,
    .of_tidy (computableTidilyInPolyTime_andVerifier hlen
      (hW.comp ((hf.comp (.fst enc encBits)).prod (.snd enc encBits))) (.const true)),
    fun a => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (hle a)
  rw [hAB a, hWB (f a), hj, acceptCount_andVerifier_true, pow_add, ← mul_assoc]
  exact (Nat.mul_lt_mul_right (by positivity)).symm

theorem mem_PP_iff_exists_SharpP {A : Set α} :
    A ∈ PP enc ↔ ∃ f ∈ SharpP enc, ∃ q : Polynomial ℕ,
      ∀ a, a ∈ A ↔ 2 ^ q.eval (enc a).length < 2 * f a := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, V, hV, h⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨p, V, hV, fun _ => rfl⟩, p, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, ⟨p, V, hV, hf⟩, q, h⟩
    replace hV := hV.tidy
    -- on `false`, accept unless the first `k + 1` bits are `false`; on `true`, accept a
    -- certificate of `V` followed by a free bit and bits `false`
    refine ⟨p + q + 1 + 1, selectVerifier
        (fun x => !andVerifier (fun a => p.eval (enc a).length + 1) allFalseVerifier
          (fun _ => true) x)
        (andVerifier (fun a => p.eval (enc a).length) V
          (selectVerifier allFalseVerifier allFalseVerifier)), by fun_prop, fun a => ?_⟩
    have hev : (p + q + 1 + 1).eval (enc a).length =
        p.eval (enc a).length + q.eval (enc a).length + 1 + 1 := by simp
    have e₀ := acceptCount_andVerifier_true (fun a => p.eval (enc a).length + 1) allFalseVerifier
      a (q.eval (enc a).length)
    have e₁ := acceptCount_andVerifier (fun a => p.eval (enc a).length) V
      (selectVerifier allFalseVerifier allFalseVerifier) a (q.eval (enc a).length + 1)
    rw [acceptCount_allFalseVerifier, one_mul] at e₀
    rw [acceptCount_selectVerifier, acceptCount_allFalseVerifier, ← hf a] at e₁
    rw [h a, hev, acceptCount_selectVerifier, acceptCount_not,
      show p.eval (enc a).length + q.eval (enc a).length + 1 =
        p.eval (enc a).length + 1 + q.eval (enc a).length by omega, e₀,
      show p.eval (enc a).length + 1 + q.eval (enc a).length =
        p.eval (enc a).length + (q.eval (enc a).length + 1) by omega, e₁]
    have hj : 2 ^ q.eval (enc a).length ≤
        2 ^ (p.eval (enc a).length + (q.eval (enc a).length + 1)) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    rw [pow_succ _ (p.eval (enc a).length + (q.eval (enc a).length + 1))]
    omega

theorem compl_mem_PP (hA : A ∈ PP enc) : Aᶜ ∈ PP enc := by
  rw [mem_PP] at hA ⊢
  obtain ⟨p, V, hV, hA⟩ := hA
  let V' (x : α × List Bool) : Bool :=
    if x.2.headD false then !V (x.1, x.2.tail.tail)
    else !(x.2.tail.headD false) || !(x.2.tail.tail.any fun b => b)
  have hV' : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime V' (encPair enc encBits) encBool := by
    have hw : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x : α × List Bool => x.2.tail.tail)
        (encPair enc encBits) encBits :=
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsTail.comp
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsTail.comp (.snd _ _))
    exact ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.cond
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.headD (encA := encBool) false).comp (.snd _ _))
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bool_not.comp
        (hV.comp (.of_tidy ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).prod hw))).tidy)
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bool_or.comp
        ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bool_not.comp
          ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.headD (encA := encBool) false).comp
            (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsTail.comp (.snd _ _)))).prod
          (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bool_not.comp
            (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsAnyWithInput (test := fun _ b => b) hw
              (.snd _ _)))))
  refine ⟨p + 2, V', (.of_tidy hV'), fun a => ?_⟩
  -- exactly one word of length `m` is all zeros
  have hzero (m : ℕ) : (Finset.univ.filter fun w : Fin m → Bool =>
      ((List.ofFn w).any fun b => b) = false).card = 1 := by
    refine Finset.card_eq_one.mpr ⟨fun _ => false, Finset.ext fun w => ?_⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, List.any_eq_false, List.mem_ofFn,
      forall_exists_index, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff, Finset.mem_singleton, Bool.not_eq_true]
    exact ⟨fun h => funext h, fun h i => by rw [h]⟩
  have hcount (m : ℕ) : acceptCount V' a (m + 1 + 1) = 2 ^ m + 1 +
      2 * (Finset.univ.filter fun w : Fin m → Bool => V (a, List.ofFn w) = false).card := by
    rw [acceptCount, card_filter_ofFn_succ (m + 1) fun l => V' (a, l) = true,
      card_filter_ofFn_succ m fun l => V' (a, false :: l) = true,
      card_filter_ofFn_succ m fun l => V' (a, true :: l) = true]
    simp only [V', List.headD_cons, List.tail_cons, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Bool.not_false,
      Bool.true_or, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_or, Finset.filter_true, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin, Bool.not_eq_true', hzero]
    ring
  have heval : (p + 2).eval (enc a).length = p.eval (enc a).length + 1 + 1 := by simp
  have hsum := acceptCount_add_card_filter_eq_false (V := V) (a := a) (n := p.eval (enc a).length)
  rw [heval, hcount, Set.mem_compl_iff, hA a, pow_succ, pow_succ]
  omega

        fun _ => rfl⟩, fun a => ?_⟩

    dsimp only [f₁, f₂]

    let W₁ := andVerifier (fun a => p.eval (enc a).length) V₁ allFalseVerifier

      computableInPolyTime_allFalseVerifier.computableInPolyTimeWithOracle A

      computableInPolyTimeWithOracle_andVerifier (.of_tidy (by fun_prop)) h₁ hfalse
    have hW₂ : ComputableInPolyTimeWithOracle A W₂ (encPair enc encBits) encBool :=
      computableInPolyTimeWithOracle_andVerifier (.of_tidy (by fun_prop)) h₂ hfalse
    refine ⟨p + q + 1, selectVerifier W₁ (fun x => !W₂ x),

private theorem newmanAmp_mem_GapP {M r : α → ℕ} {h : α × ℕ → ℤ}
    (hh : h ∈ GapP (encPair enc encUnary))
    (hM : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime M enc encUnary)
    (hr : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime r enc encUnary) :
    (fun x : α × ℕ => newmanAmp (M x.1) (r x.1 + 1) (h x)) ∈ GapP (encPair enc encUnary) := by
  have htwo : (fun _ : (α × ℕ) × ℕ => (2 : ℤ)) ∈
      GapP (encPair (encPair enc encUnary) encUnary) :=
    GapP.add_mem GapP.one_mem GapP.one_mem
  have hpow2 : (fun p : (α × ℕ) × ℕ => (2 : ℤ) ^ p.2) ∈
      GapP (encPair (encPair enc encUnary) encUnary) :=
    GapP.pow_mem_polyTime htwo (.of_tidy (.snd (encPair enc encUnary) encUnary))
  have hbody : (fun p : (α × ℕ) × ℕ => (2 : ℤ) ^ p.2 + h p.1) ∈
      GapP (encPair (encPair enc encUnary) encUnary) :=
    GapP.add_mem hpow2 (GapP.comp_mem hh (.of_tidy (.fst (encPair enc encUnary) encUnary)))
  have hprod : (fun x : α × ℕ => newmanPoly (M x.1) (h x)) ∈ GapP (encPair enc encUnary) :=
    GapP.prod_range_mem hbody (.of_tidy (by fun_prop))
  exact GapP.pow_mem_polyTime hprod (.of_tidy (by fun_prop))

private theorem ppTruthTableGap_mem {M r : α → ℕ} {g : α × ℕ → ℤ} {d : α × List Bool → Bool}
    (hg : g ∈ GapP (encPair enc encUnary))
    (hM : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime M enc encUnary)
    (hr : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime r enc encUnary)
    (hd : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime d (encPair enc encBits) encBool) :
    ppTruthTableGap M r g d ∈ GapP enc := by
  let q : (α × List Bool) × ℕ → α × ℕ := fun x => (x.1.1, x.2)
  have hq : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime q
      (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encUnary) (encPair enc encUnary) := by dsimp [q]; fun_prop
  have hpos := newmanAmp_mem_GapP hg hM hr
  have hneg := newmanAmp_mem_GapP (GapP.neg_mem hg) hM hr
  have hs : (fun x : (α × List Bool) × ℕ =>
      if x.1.2.getD x.2 false then
        newmanAmp (M x.1.1) (r x.1.1 + 1) (g (x.1.1, x.2))
      else
        newmanAmp (M x.1.1) (r x.1.1 + 1) (-g (x.1.1, x.2))) ∈
      GapP (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encUnary) :=
    GapP.ite_mem (.of_tidy (by fun_prop)) (GapP.comp_mem hpos (.of_tidy hq))
      (GapP.comp_mem hneg (.of_tidy hq))
  have hp := GapP.prod_range_mem hs (.of_tidy (hr.comp (.fst enc encBits)))
  have hw : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun x => if d x then (1 : ℤ) else -1) (encPair enc encBits) encIntBin := by fun_prop
  exact GapP.sum_bits_mem (GapP.mul_mem (mem_GapP_of_polyTime (.of_tidy hw)) hp) (.of_tidy hr)

private theorem sum_erase_ppWordWeight_lt {A : Set (α × ℕ)} {M r : α → ℕ} {g : α × ℕ → ℤ}
    {a : α}
    (hpos : ∀ i < r a, (a, i) ∈ A → 1 ≤ g (a, i))
    (hneg : ∀ i < r a, (a, i) ∉ A → 1 ≤ -g (a, i))
    (hbnd : ∀ i < r a, |g (a, i)| ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ M a) :
    letI := Classical.decPred (· ∈ A)
    let v : Fin (r a) → Bool := fun i => decide ((a, i.1) ∈ A)
    ∑ w ∈ univ.erase v, ppWordWeight M r g a w < ppWordWeight M r g a v := by
  classical
  intro v
  let factor (w : Fin (r a) → Bool) (i : Fin (r a)) : ℤ :=
    if w i then newmanAmp (M a) (r a + 1) (g (a, i.1))
    else newmanAmp (M a) (r a + 1) (-g (a, i.1))
  have hfactor_nonneg (w : Fin (r a) → Bool) (i : Fin (r a)) : 0 ≤ factor w i := by
    dsimp [factor]
    split_ifs <;> exact newmanAmp_nonneg _ _ _
  have hfactor_v_pos (i : Fin (r a)) : 1 ≤ factor v i := by
    dsimp [factor, v]
    by_cases hi : (a, i.1) ∈ A
    · simp only [decide_eq_true hi, ↓reduceIte]
      exact one_le_newmanAmp (hpos i.1 i.2 hi)
    · simp only [decide_eq_false hi, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      exact one_le_newmanAmp (hneg i.1 i.2 hi)
  have hfactor_mismatch (w : Fin (r a) → Bool) (i : Fin (r a)) (hne : w i ≠ v i) :
      (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * (r a + 1)) * factor w i ≤ factor v i := by
    have habs := abs_le.mp (hbnd i.1 i.2)
    dsimp [factor, v] at hne ⊢
    by_cases hi : (a, i.1) ∈ A
    · have hw : w i = false := by simpa [hi] using hne
      simp only [hw, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, decide_eq_true hi]
      exact two_pow_mul_newmanAmp_neg_le (hpos i.1 i.2 hi) habs.2
    · have hw : w i = true := by simpa [hi] using hne
      simp only [hw, ↓reduceIte, decide_eq_false hi, Bool.false_eq_true]
      simpa only [neg_neg] using two_pow_mul_newmanAmp_neg_le (hneg i.1 i.2 hi) (by omega)
  have hfactor_le (w : Fin (r a) → Bool) (i : Fin (r a)) : factor w i ≤ factor v i := by
    by_cases h : w i = v i
    · dsimp [factor]; rw [h]
    · have hpow : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * (r a + 1)) := one_le_pow₀ (by omega)
      exact (le_mul_of_one_le_left (hfactor_nonneg w i) hpow).trans (hfactor_mismatch w i h)
  have hPv_pos : 1 ≤ ppWordWeight M r g a v := by
    rw [ppWordWeight_eq_prod_univ]
    exact one_le_prod₀ fun i _ => hfactor_v_pos i
  have hdom (w : Fin (r a) → Bool) (hw : w ∈ univ.erase v) :
      2 * (2 : ℤ) ^ r a * ppWordWeight M r g a w ≤ ppWordWeight M r g a v := by
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ : ∃ i₀, w i₀ ≠ v i₀ := Function.ne_iff.mp (mem_erase.mp hw).1
    have hpow_le : 2 * (2 : ℤ) ^ r a ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * (r a + 1)) := by
      rw [show (2 : ℤ) * (2 : ℤ) ^ r a = (2 : ℤ) ^ (r a + 1) by ring]
      exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by omega) (by omega)
    have hprod_dom : (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * (r a + 1)) * ppWordWeight M r g a w ≤
        ppWordWeight M r g a v := by
      rw [ppWordWeight_eq_prod_univ, ppWordWeight_eq_prod_univ]
      change (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * (r a + 1)) * ∏ i : Fin (r a), factor w i ≤
        ∏ i : Fin (r a), factor v i
      rw [← mul_prod_erase univ (factor w) (mem_univ i₀),
        ← mul_prod_erase univ (factor v) (mem_univ i₀), ← mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul (hfactor_mismatch w i₀ hi₀)
        (prod_le_prod₀ (fun i _ => hfactor_nonneg w i) (fun i _ => hfactor_le w i))
        (prod_nonneg fun i _ => hfactor_nonneg w i)
        (by have := hfactor_v_pos i₀; omega)
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow_le (ppWordWeight_nonneg M r g a w)).trans hprod_dom
  have hsum_le : 2 * (2 : ℤ) ^ r a * ∑ w ∈ univ.erase v, ppWordWeight M r g a w ≤
      (2 : ℤ) ^ r a * ppWordWeight M r g a v := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    refine (sum_le_sum hdom).trans ?_
    rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hcard : ((univ.erase v).card : ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ r a := by
      have hc : (univ.erase v).card ≤ 2 ^ r a := by simp
      exact_mod_cast hc
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (by omega)
  have h2pow_pos : (0 : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ r a := by positivity
  nlinarith

  have hg : g ∈ GapP (encPair enc encUnary) :=
    GapP.sub_mem' (GapP.add_mem hg₀ hg₀) GapP.one_mem
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := GapP.exists_abs_le_two_pow hg
  let M : α → ℕ := fun a => p.eval (2 * (enc a).length + 1 + r a)
  have hM : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime M enc encUnary := by dsimp [M]; fun_prop
  refine mem_PP_iff_exists_GapP.mpr ⟨ppTruthTableGap M r g d, ppTruthTableGap_mem hg hM hr hd,
    fun a => ?_⟩

  have hv_ofFn : List.ofFn v = truthTableAnswers A r a := rfl
  have hdom : ∑ w ∈ univ.erase v, ppWordWeight M r g a w < ppWordWeight M r g a v := by
    refine sum_erase_ppWordWeight_lt (A := A)
      (fun i _ hi => ?_) (fun i _ hi => ?_) (fun i hi => ?_)
    · have := (hAg₀ (a, i)).mp hi
      dsimp [g]; omega
    · have : ¬ 0 < g₀ (a, i) := fun h => hi ((hAg₀ (a, i)).mpr h)
      dsimp [g]; omega
    · refine (hp (a, i)).trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by omega) (Polynomial.eval_mono _ ?_))
      simp only [length_encPair, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate]

    A ∩ B ∈ PP enc := by
