theorem NTIME_subset_iUnion_DTIME_of_NP_subset_P (hNP : NP encBits ⊆ P encBits) {t T : ℕ → ℕ}
    {S : List Bool → ℕ}
    (hpad : Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInO (fun x : List Bool => t x.length) encBits encUnary
      (fun x => T x.length) S) :
    NTIME enc t ⊆ ⋃ d, DTIME enc fun n => (n + T n + 1) ^ d := by
  have hpad := hpad.tidy
  rintro A ⟨c₁, c₂, k, State, hfinite, ntm, hA⟩
  set c := Nat.card (Turing.Action k Bool State) * (c₁ + c₂)
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := mem_P_iff_exists_mem_DTIME.mp (hNP (ntm.padded_mem_NP c))
  -- the reduction: frame the instance and append `t n` ones
  let g (a : α) : List Bool := frame (enc a) ++ List.replicate (t (enc a).length) true
  have hg : ComputableTidilyInO g enc encBits (fun a => (enc a).length + T (enc a).length)
      fun a => (enc a).length + S (enc a) :=
    (ComputableTidilyInO.of_linear (.of_frame (f := id) (encOut := encFramed enc)
      fun _ => rfl)).append (hpad.comp_enc enc) fun _ => rfl
  obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := hpad.length_le_time
  have hlen (a : α) : (g a).length = 2 * (enc a).length + 1 + t (enc a).length := by
    simp [g]
  have ht (a : α) : t (enc a).length ≤ c' * (T (enc a).length + 1) := by
    simpa only [encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate] using hc' (enc a)
  have hpre : A = g ⁻¹' ntm.padded c := by
    ext a
    refine (hA.frame_append_mem_padded_iff ?_).symm
    rw [List.length_append, List.length_replicate, length_frame]
    have : c₁ * t (enc a).length + c₂ ≤ (c₁ + c₂) * (2 * (enc a).length + 1 + t (enc a).length) :=
      by nlinarith
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ this
  refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨d + 1, hpre ▸ preimage_mem_DTIME (C := (c' + 2) ^ d + 1) hd
    (.of_tidy hg)
    fun a => ?_⟩
  rw [encBits_apply, hlen]
  set n := (enc a).length
  set X := n + T n + 1
  have hX : 1 ≤ X := by omega
  have hL : 2 * n + 1 + t n ≤ (c' + 2) * X := by
    have := ht a
    simp only [X]
    nlinarith
  have h₁ : (2 * n + 1 + t n) ^ d ≤ (c' + 2) ^ d * X ^ (d + 1) := by
    calc (2 * n + 1 + t n) ^ d ≤ ((c' + 2) * X) ^ d := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hL d
      _ = (c' + 2) ^ d * X ^ d := Nat.mul_pow _ _ _
      _ ≤ (c' + 2) ^ d * X ^ (d + 1) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hX (Nat.le_succ d))
  have h₂ : n + T n ≤ X ^ (d + 1) := (Nat.le_succ _).trans (Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) X)
  calc n + T n + (2 * n + 1 + t n) ^ d ≤ X ^ (d + 1) + (c' + 2) ^ d * X ^ (d + 1) :=
        Nat.add_le_add h₂ h₁
    _ = ((c' + 2) ^ d + 1) * X ^ (d + 1) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := Nat.le_add_right _ _

  have h₃ : f n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ f n := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  have h₄ : 2 ^ f n ≤ 2 ^ (2 * f n) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have h₅ : (f n + 1) * 2 ^ f n ≤ 2 ^ (2 * f n) := by
    rw [two_mul, pow_add]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h₃
  have hle : n + (n + (n + 1) ^ d + (f n + 1) * 2 ^ f n) + 1 ≤ (C₀ + 3) * 2 ^ (2 * f n) := by
    have := hC₀ n
    have : C₀ * 2 ^ n ≤ C₀ * 2 ^ (2 * f n) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (h₁.trans h₄)
    nlinarith
  calc (n + (n + (n + 1) ^ d + (f n + 1) * 2 ^ f n) + 1) ^ D
      ≤ ((C₀ + 3) * 2 ^ (2 * f n)) ^ D := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hle D
    _ = (C₀ + 3) ^ D * 2 ^ (2 * D * f n) := by rw [Nat.mul_pow, ← Nat.pow_mul]; ring_nf
    _ ≤ _ := Nat.le_add_right _ _

theorem NE_subset_E_of_NP_subset_P (hNP : NP encBits ⊆ P encBits) : NE enc ⊆ E enc := by
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_NE_iff.mp hA
  have hk' : A ∈ NTIME enc fun n => 2 ^ ((k + 1) * n) :=
    NTIME_mono (fun n => Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num)
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_right n (Nat.le_succ k))) hk
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (NTIME_two_pow_subset_iUnion_DTIME_of_NP_subset_P hNP
    (f := fun n => (k + 1) * n) (.of_tidy (by fun_prop))
      (fun n => Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n (Nat.succ_pos k))
    hk')
  exact mem_E_iff.mpr ⟨d * (k + 1), by simpa only [Nat.mul_assoc] using hd⟩

text:
theorem NEXP_subset_EXP_of_NP_subset_P (hNP : NP encBits ⊆ P encBits) : NEXP enc ⊆ EXP enc := by
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_NEXP_iff.mp hA
  have hk' : A ∈ NTIME enc fun n => 2 ^ n ^ (k + 1) :=
    NTIME_mono_of_eventually_le (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨1, fun n hn =>
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hn (Nat.le_succ k))⟩) hk
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (NTIME_two_pow_subset_iUnion_DTIME_of_NP_subset_P hNP
    (.of_tidy (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_pow (k + 1)))
      (fun n => Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) n) hk')
  refine mem_EXP_iff.mpr ⟨k + 2, DTIME_mono_of_eventually_le (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr
    ⟨d, fun n hn => Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) ?_⟩) hd⟩
  rw [pow_succ' n (k + 1)]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hn

theorem preimage_mem_NTIME_of_mem_NP {B : Set (List Bool)} {g : α → List Bool} {T₀ : ℕ → ℕ}
    {S : α → ℕ} (hB : B ∈ NP encBits)
    (hg : Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInO g enc encBits (fun a => T₀ (enc a).length) S) :
    ∃ d, g ⁻¹' B ∈ NTIME enc fun n => (T₀ n + 1) ^ d := by
  have hg := hg.tidy
  obtain ⟨c₀, ⟨k₀, State₀, hfinite₀, tm, htm⟩, -⟩ := hg
  set t₁ : α → ℕ := fun a => c₀ * (T₀ (enc a).length + 1)
  have htm_run (a : α) :
      tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg (enc a)) (t₁ a) = wordsCfg (enc a) none (fun _ => []) (g a) := by
    obtain ⟨p, hh, hl, ht, -⟩ := computesTidily_iff.mp (htm a)
    have hhead : p.head = tm.initCfg (enc a) := hh.trans (Cfg.init_eq_wordsCfg tm.q₀ (enc a)).symm
    have hrun : tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg (enc a)) p.time =
        wordsCfg (enc a) none (fun _ => []) (g a) :=
      hhead ▸ (MultiTapeTM.runPath_apply_eq_runFrom p (.last _)).symm.trans hl
    have hhalt : (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg (enc a)) p.time).state = none := by rw [hrun]; rfl
    exact (tm.runFrom_eq_of_halt (tm.initCfg (enc a)) ht hhalt).trans hrun
  have hg_len (a : α) : (g a).length ≤ t₁ a := (htm a).length_output_le
  let M_pad : MultiTapePTM k₀ Bool State₀ := MultiTapePTM.ofDeterministic tm
  have hfirst (a : α) :
      ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval
        (M_pad.runClosedConfigFrom (t₁ a) (M_pad.initialConfig (enc a)))).support,
        final.tapes.state = none := by
    intro final hfinal
    rw [MultiTapePTM.eval_runClosedConfigFrom_ofDeterministic, PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hfinal
    subst hfinal
    change (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg (enc a)) (t₁ a)).state = none
    rw [htm_run a]
    rfl
  have hout₁ (a : α) :
      ProbComp.eval (M_pad.runClosed (t₁ a) (enc a)) = PMF.pure (g a) := by
    rw [MultiTapePTM.eval_runClosed_ofDeterministic, htm_run a]
    rfl
  -- Unpack `B ∈ NP encBits` into a halting fair-coin machine `M_NP`
  obtain ⟨p, V, hV, hVer⟩ := hB
  let program (x : List Bool) : ProbComp Bool :=
    (fun w => V (x, w)) <$> BitString.sampleList (p.eval x.length)
  have hcount : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => p.eval x.length)
      encBits encUnary :=
    (unary_eval p).comp (encoding_length encBits)
  have hprogram : IsPPTOn encBits encBool program :=
    (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy hcount).sampleList.map_with hV
  obtain ⟨k₁, State₁, hfinite₁, M_NP, c₁, d₁, heval₂, hhalt₂⟩ := hprogram.exists_halting_machine
  set t₂ : α → ℕ := fun a => c₁ * (t₁ a + 1) ^ d₁
  have ht₂_le (a : α) : c₁ * ((g a).length + 1) ^ d₁ ≤ t₂ a :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₁ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right (hg_len a) 1) d₁)
  have hsecond (a : α) :
      ∀ word ∈ (ProbComp.eval (M_pad.runClosed (t₁ a) (enc a))).support,
        ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval
          (M_NP.runClosedConfigFrom (t₂ a) (M_NP.initialConfig word))).support,
          final.tapes.state = none := by
    intro word hword final hfinal
    rw [hout₁ a, PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hword
    subst hword
    rw [M_NP.eval_runClosedConfigFrom_eq_of_halted _ (ht₂_le a) (hhalt₂ (g a))] at hfinal
    exact hhalt₂ (g a) final hfinal
  let M_comp := M_NP.comp M_pad false
  set totalTime : α → ℕ := fun a => t₁ a + (t₁ a + 4 + t₂ a)
  have hdecides : M_comp.toNTM.DecidesInTime enc (g ⁻¹' B) totalTime := by
    intro a
    have htime : M_comp.toNTM.RunsInTime (enc a) (totalTime a) :=
      M_comp.runsInTime_toNTM (M_pad.comp_halted M_NP false (enc a) (t₁ a) (t₂ a)
        (hfirst a) (hsecond a))
    refine ⟨htime, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, hVer (g a), MultiTapeNTM.accepts_iff_exists_time_eq htime,
      M_comp.exists_computationPath_toNTM_iff (P := fun cfg => cfg.output = [true])]
    have hcomp_eval :
        ProbComp.eval (M_comp.runClosed (totalTime a) (enc a)) =
          ProbComp.eval (M_NP.runClosed (c₁ * ((g a).length + 1) ^ d₁) (g a)) := by
      rw [M_pad.eval_comp M_NP false (enc a) (t₁ a) (t₂ a) (hfirst a) (hsecond a),
        hout₁ a, Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.pure_bind,
        M_NP.eval_runClosed_eq_of_halted (g a) (ht₂_le a) (hhalt₂ (g a))]
    have hsupport := congrArg (fun μ => [true] ∈ μ.support)
      ((heval₂ (g a)).trans hcomp_eval.symm)
    simp only [MultiTapePTM.runClosed_eq_map, ProbComp.eval_map, PMF.mem_support_map_iff,
      program, BitString.eval_sampleList, BitString.mem_support_uniformList_iff, encBool_apply,
      List.cons.injEq, and_true] at hsupport
    rw [← hsupport]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨w, hw, hV⟩ => ⟨true, ⟨w, hw, hV⟩, rfl⟩,
      fun ⟨_, ⟨w, hw, hV⟩, rfl⟩ => ⟨w, hw, hV⟩⟩
  refine ⟨d₁ + 1, (2 * c₀ + 4 + c₁ * (c₀ + 1) ^ d₁), 0, k₁ + k₀ + 2, _, inferInstance,
    M_comp.toNTM, hdecides.mono fun a => ?_⟩
  set X := T₀ (enc a).length + 1
  have hX : 1 ≤ X := Nat.succ_pos _
  have ht₁_bound : t₁ a + 1 ≤ (c₀ + 1) * X := by simp only [t₁, X]; nlinarith
  have ht₂_bound : t₂ a ≤ c₁ * (c₀ + 1) ^ d₁ * X ^ (d₁ + 1) := by
    calc t₂ a = c₁ * (t₁ a + 1) ^ d₁ := rfl
      _ ≤ c₁ * ((c₀ + 1) * X) ^ d₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₁ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left ht₁_bound d₁)
      _ = c₁ * (c₀ + 1) ^ d₁ * X ^ d₁ := by rw [Nat.mul_pow, Nat.mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ c₁ * (c₀ + 1) ^ d₁ * X ^ (d₁ + 1) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hX (Nat.le_succ d₁))
  have hX_pow : X ≤ X ^ (d₁ + 1) := Nat.le_self_pow (by lia) X
  calc totalTime a
      = 2 * c₀ * X + 4 + t₂ a := by simp only [totalTime, t₁, X]; ring
    _ ≤ 2 * c₀ * X ^ (d₁ + 1) + 4 * X ^ (d₁ + 1) + c₁ * (c₀ + 1) ^ d₁ * X ^ (d₁ + 1) := by
        have : 4 ≤ 4 * X ^ (d₁ + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right 4 (Nat.pow_pos hX)
        nlinarith
    _ = (2 * c₀ + 4 + c₁ * (c₀ + 1) ^ d₁) * X ^ (d₁ + 1) + 0 := by ring

/-- Pulling back `B ∈ NP encBits` along the exponential-padding map
`a ↦ frame (enc a) ++ List.replicate (2 ^ f (enc a).length) true`, where `f` is polynomial-time in
unary with `n ≤ f n`, gives a problem in `NEXP enc`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem preimage_pad_mem_NEXP {B : Set (List Bool)} (hB : B ∈ NP encBits) {f : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hf : Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime f encUnary encUnary) (hn : ∀ n, n ≤ f n) :
    (fun a : α => frame (enc a) ++ List.replicate (2 ^ f (enc a).length) true) ⁻¹' B ∈
      NEXP enc := by
  have hf := hf.tidy
  obtain ⟨d₀, e₀, hd₀⟩ := hf.exists_degree
  have hpad := ComputableTidilyInO.unary_two_pow.comp (hd₀.inO.comp ComputableTidilyInO.lengthUnary)
  have hpad' : ComputableTidilyInO (fun x : List Bool => 2 ^ f x.length) encBits encUnary
      (fun x => x.length + (x.length + 1) ^ d₀ + (f x.length + 1) * 2 ^ f x.length)
      (fun x => x.length + (x.length + 1) ^ d₀ + 2 ^ f x.length) :=
    hpad.mono_le (fun x => by simp [encUnary_apply]) fun x => by simp [encUnary_apply]
  let g (a : α) : List Bool := frame (enc a) ++ List.replicate (2 ^ f (enc a).length) true
  let T₀ (n : ℕ) : ℕ := n + (n + (n + 1) ^ d₀ + (f n + 1) * 2 ^ f n)
  have hg : ComputableTidilyInO g enc encBits (fun a => T₀ (enc a).length)
      (fun a => (enc a).length + ((enc a).length + ((enc a).length + 1) ^ d₀ +
        2 ^ f (enc a).length)) :=
    (ComputableTidilyInO.of_linear (.of_frame (f := id) (encOut := encFramed enc)
      fun _ => rfl)).append (hpad'.comp_enc enc) fun _ => rfl
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := preimage_mem_NTIME_of_mem_NP hB (.of_tidy hg)
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := (PolynomiallyBounded.of_forall_le 1 d₀ fun n => by
    simp only [one_mul]; exact le_rfl).exists_le_mul_two_pow (p := fun n => (n + 1) ^ d₀)
  obtain ⟨c_f, d_f, hf_le⟩ := hf.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  simp only [encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate] at hf_le
  have hNTIME : g ⁻¹' B ∈ NTIME enc fun n => 2 ^ (2 * D * f n) := by
    obtain ⟨c₁, c₂, k, State, hfinite, ntm, hdec⟩ := hD
    refine ⟨c₁ * (C₀ + 3) ^ D, c₂, k, State, hfinite, ntm, hdec.mono fun a => ?_⟩
    set n := (enc a).length
    have h₁ : 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ f n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (hn n)
    have h₂ : 2 * n + 1 ≤ 2 * 2 ^ n := by have := @Nat.lt_two_pow_self n; lia
    have h₃ : f n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ f n := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
    have h₄ : 2 ^ f n ≤ 2 ^ (2 * f n) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by lia)
    have h₅ : (f n + 1) * 2 ^ f n ≤ 2 ^ (2 * f n) := by
      rw [two_mul, pow_add]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h₃
    have hle : T₀ n + 1 ≤ (C₀ + 3) * 2 ^ (2 * f n) := by
      have := hC₀ n
      have : C₀ * 2 ^ n ≤ C₀ * 2 ^ (2 * f n) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (h₁.trans h₄)
      simp only [T₀]
      nlinarith
    have hpow : (T₀ n + 1) ^ D ≤ (C₀ + 3) ^ D * 2 ^ (2 * D * f n) := by
      calc (T₀ n + 1) ^ D
          ≤ ((C₀ + 3) * 2 ^ (2 * f n)) ^ D := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hle D
        _ = (C₀ + 3) ^ D * 2 ^ (2 * D * f n) := by rw [Nat.mul_pow, ← Nat.pow_mul]; ring_nf
    calc c₁ * (T₀ n + 1) ^ D + c₂
        ≤ c₁ * ((C₀ + 3) ^ D * 2 ^ (2 * D * f n)) + c₂ :=
          Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₁ hpow) c₂
      _ = c₁ * (C₀ + 3) ^ D * 2 ^ (2 * D * f n) + c₂ := by ring
  refine mem_NEXP_iff.mpr ⟨d_f + 1, NTIME_mono_of_eventually_le (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr
    ⟨2 * D * c_f * 2 ^ d_f + 2, fun n hn' => Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) ?_⟩) hNTIME⟩
  have hn1 : n + 1 ≤ 2 * n := by lia
  have hpow_n1 : (n + 1) ^ d_f ≤ 2 ^ d_f * n ^ d_f := by
    calc (n + 1) ^ d_f ≤ (2 * n) ^ d_f := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hn1 d_f
      _ = 2 ^ d_f * n ^ d_f := Nat.mul_pow 2 n d_f
  have hfn : f n ≤ c_f * (2 ^ d_f * n ^ d_f) :=
    (hf_le n).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c_f hpow_n1)
  calc 2 * D * f n
      ≤ 2 * D * (c_f * (2 ^ d_f * n ^ d_f)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * D) hfn
    _ = (2 * D * c_f * 2 ^ d_f) * n ^ d_f := by ring
    _ ≤ n * n ^ d_f := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n ^ d_f) (by lia)
    _ = n ^ (d_f + 1) := (pow_succ' n d_f).symm

problem in `NEXP encBits`. -/

theorem preimage_append_two_pow_mem_NEXP {B : Set (List Bool)} (hB : B ∈ NP encBits) :
    (fun x : List Bool => x ++ List.replicate (2 ^ x.length) true) ⁻¹' B ∈ NEXP encBits := by
  have hpad := ComputableTidilyInO.unary_two_pow.comp ComputableTidilyInO.lengthUnary
  let g (x : List Bool) : List Bool := x ++ List.replicate (2 ^ x.length) true
  let T₀ (n : ℕ) : ℕ := n + (n + (n + 1) * 2 ^ n)
  have hg : ComputableTidilyInO g encBits encBits (fun x => T₀ x.length)
      (fun x => x.length + (x.length + 2 ^ x.length)) :=
    (ComputableTidilyInO.of_linear (.of_eq (f := id) (encIn := encBits) (encMid := encBits)
      fun _ => rfl)).append hpad fun _ => rfl
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := preimage_mem_NTIME_of_mem_NP hB (.of_tidy hg)
  have hNTIME : g ⁻¹' B ∈ NTIME encBits fun n => 2 ^ (2 * D * n) := by
    obtain ⟨c₁, c₂, k, State, hfinite, ntm, hdec⟩ := hD
    refine ⟨c₁ * 4 ^ D, c₂, k, State, hfinite, ntm, hdec.mono fun x => ?_⟩
    set n := x.length
    have h₁ : 2 * n + 1 ≤ 2 * 2 ^ n := by have := @Nat.lt_two_pow_self n; omega
    have h₂ : n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
    have h₃ : 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    have h₄ : (n + 1) * 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n) := by
      rw [two_mul, pow_add]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h₂
    have hle : T₀ n + 1 ≤ 4 * 2 ^ (2 * n) := by
      simp only [T₀]
      nlinarith
    have hpow : (T₀ n + 1) ^ D ≤ 4 ^ D * 2 ^ (2 * D * n) := by
      calc (T₀ n + 1) ^ D
          ≤ (4 * 2 ^ (2 * n)) ^ D := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hle D
        _ = 4 ^ D * 2 ^ (2 * D * n) := by rw [Nat.mul_pow, ← Nat.pow_mul]; ring_nf
    calc c₁ * (T₀ n + 1) ^ D + c₂
        ≤ c₁ * (4 ^ D * 2 ^ (2 * D * n)) + c₂ :=
          Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₁ hpow) c₂
      _ = c₁ * 4 ^ D * 2 ^ (2 * D * n) + c₂ := by ring
  exact NE_subset_NEXP (mem_NE_iff.mpr ⟨2 * D, hNTIME⟩)

/-- Pulling back `B ∈ P (encPair encBits encBits)` along
`(a, y) ↦ (frame (enc a) ++ List.replicate (2 ^ f (enc a).length) true, y)`, where `f` is

theorem preimage_pad_prod_id_mem_EXP {B : Set (List Bool × List Bool)}
    (hB : B ∈ P (encPair encBits encBits)) {f : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hf : Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime f encUnary encUnary) :
    (fun p : α × List Bool =>
      (frame (enc p.1) ++ List.replicate (2 ^ f (enc p.1).length) true, p.2)) ⁻¹' B ∈
      EXP (encPair enc encBits) := by
  have hf := hf.tidy
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := mem_P_iff_exists_mem_DTIME.mp hB
  obtain ⟨d₀, e₀, hd₀⟩ := hf.exists_degree
  have hpad := ComputableTidilyInO.unary_two_pow.comp (hd₀.inO.comp ComputableTidilyInO.lengthUnary)
  have hpad' : ComputableTidilyInO (fun x : List Bool => 2 ^ f x.length) encBits encUnary
      (fun x => x.length + (x.length + 1) ^ d₀ + (f x.length + 1) * 2 ^ f x.length)
      (fun x => x.length + (x.length + 1) ^ d₀ + 2 ^ f x.length) :=
    hpad.mono_le (fun x => by simp [encUnary_apply]) fun x => by simp [encUnary_apply]
  let g₁ (a : α) : List Bool := frame (enc a) ++ List.replicate (2 ^ f (enc a).length) true
  have hg₁ : ComputableTidilyInO g₁ enc encBits
      (fun a => (enc a).length + ((enc a).length + ((enc a).length + 1) ^ d₀ +
        (f (enc a).length + 1) * 2 ^ f (enc a).length))
      (fun a => (enc a).length + ((enc a).length + ((enc a).length + 1) ^ d₀ +
        2 ^ f (enc a).length)) :=
    (ComputableTidilyInO.of_linear (.of_frame (f := id) (encOut := encFramed enc)
      fun _ => rfl)).append (hpad'.comp_enc enc) fun _ => rfl
  have hg := (hg₁.comp (ComputableTidilyInO.fst enc encBits)).prod
    (ComputableTidilyInO.snd enc encBits)
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := (PolynomiallyBounded.of_forall_le 1 d₀ fun m => by
    simp only [one_mul]; exact le_rfl).exists_le_mul_two_pow (p := fun m => (m + 1) ^ d₀)
  obtain ⟨c_f, d_f, hf_le⟩ := hf.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  simp only [encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate] at hf_le
  let F (N : ℕ) : ℕ := N + c_f * (N + 1) ^ (d_f + 1)
  have hDTIME : (fun p : α × List Bool => (g₁ p.1, p.2)) ⁻¹' B ∈
      DTIME (encPair enc encBits) fun N => 2 ^ (2 * (d + 1) * F N) := by
    refine preimage_mem_DTIME (C := C₀ + 6 + 5 ^ d) hd (.of_tidy hg) fun p => ?_
    set n := (enc p.1).length
    set N := (encPair enc encBits p).length
    have hN_eq : 2 * n + 1 + p.2.length = N := by
      simp [N, n]
    have hnN : n ≤ N := by omega
    have hyN : p.2.length ≤ N := by omega
    have hfn_F : f n ≤ F N := by
      have h₁ : (n + 1) ^ d_f ≤ (N + 1) ^ (d_f + 1) :=
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) d_f).trans
          (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (Nat.le_succ d_f))
      have h₂ := (hf_le n).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c_f h₁)
      simp only [F]

/-- **Seeded-function characterization of `RPReducible`** [Ilango, Section 2, p. 34:11][Ilango2020]:
`X` is `RPReducible` to `Y` if and only if there are a polynomial `p` and a function
`f : α × List Bool → β`, computable in polynomial time with respect to `encPair encA encBits` and
`encB`, such that for every `a ∈ X.yes` and every random string `r` of length `p(|a|)` we have
`f(a, r) ∈ Y.yes`, and for every `a ∈ X.no` at least two thirds of the random strings `r` of length
`p(|a|)` satisfy `f(a, r) ∈ Y.no`. -/
theorem rpReducible_iff_exists_seeded :
    RPReducible encA encB X Y ↔
      ∃ (p : Polynomial ℕ) (f : α × List Bool → β),
        ComputableInPolyTime f (encPair encA encBits) encB ∧
        (∀ a ∈ X.yes, ∀ r : Fin (p.eval (encA a).length) → Bool, f (a, List.ofFn r) ∈ Y.yes) ∧
        ∀ a ∈ X.no, 2 * 2 ^ p.eval (encA a).length ≤
          3 * (Finset.univ.filter fun r : Fin (p.eval (encA a).length) → Bool =>
            f (a, List.ofFn r) ∈ Y.no).card := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨R, hR, hyes, hno⟩
    obtain ⟨c, d, evalR, hevalR, hsupp, hlaw⟩ := hR.exists_total_seeded_evaluator
    refine ⟨Polynomial.C c * (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ d, fun x => evalR x.1 x.2, .of_tidy hevalR,
      fun a ha r => hyes a ha _ (hsupp a (List.ofFn r)), fun a ha => ?_⟩
    have hp : (Polynomial.C c * (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ d).eval (encA a).length =
        c * ((encA a).length + 1) ^ d := by simp
    rw [hp]
    have hprob := hno a ha
    rw [hlaw a _ le_rfl, BitString.toOuterMeasure_map_uniformList_toReal,
      le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hprob
    have h3 : (2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ (c * ((encA a).length + 1) ^ d) ≤
        3 * ((Finset.univ.filter fun r : Fin (c * ((encA a).length + 1) ^ d) → Bool =>
          evalR a (List.ofFn r) ∈ Y.no).card : ℝ) := by
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast h3
  · rintro ⟨p, f, hf, hyes, hno⟩
    let R (a : α) : ProbComp β :=
      (fun w => f (a, w)) <$> BitString.sampleList (p.eval (encA a).length)
    have hR : IsPPTOn encA encB R :=
      IsPPTOn.of_seeded
        ((ComputableInPolyTime.unary_eval p).comp (ComputableInPolyTime.encoding_length encA)) hf
    refine ⟨R, hR, fun a ha b hb => ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
    · simp only [R, ProbComp.eval_map, BitString.eval_sampleList,
        PMF.mem_support_map_iff, BitString.mem_support_uniformList_iff] at hb
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hb
      have hr := hyes a ha fun i => w[i.val]'(by omega)
      rwa [show (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (p.eval (encA a).length) => w[i.val]'(by omega)) = w from
        List.ext_getElem (by simp [hw]) fun i _ _ => by simp] at hr
    · simp only [R, ProbComp.eval_map, BitString.eval_sampleList]
      rw [BitString.toOuterMeasure_map_uniformList_toReal, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have h3 : (2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ p.eval (encA a).length ≤
          3 * ((Finset.univ.filter fun r : Fin (p.eval (encA a).length) → Bool =>
            f (a, List.ofFn r) ∈ Y.no).card : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hno a ha
      linarith

    (hXY : RPReducibleWithError encA encB s₁ X Y)
    (hYZ : RPReducibleWithError encB encC (fun _ => s₂) Y Z)
    (hs₂ : 0 ≤ s₂) :

  obtain ⟨R₁, hR₁, hyes₁, hno₁⟩ := hXY

  refine ⟨fun a => R₁ a >>= R₂, hR₁.bind hR₂, fun a ha c hc => ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  · simp only [ProbComp.eval_bind, PMF.mem_support_bind_iff] at hc
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hc⟩ := hc

    exact PMF.toOuterMeasure_bind_ge_mul (ProbComp.eval (R₁ a)) (fun b => ProbComp.eval (R₂ b))
      Y.no Z.no hs₂ (hno₁ a ha) fun b _ hb => hno₂ b hb

`s₁ a + s₂ - 1`. Note that when `s₁ a + s₂ ≤ 1`, the resulting threshold `s₁ a + s₂ - 1 ≤ 0` holds

  -- a solver for `Yᶜ` accepting every no-instance of `Y` with probability at least `3 / 4`
  obtain ⟨p, V, hV, hYV⟩ := mem_PromiseRP_iff_forall_solvesWithOneSidedErrorExponent.1 hY 2

    (fun w => V (b, w)) <$> BitString.sampleList (p.eval (encB b).length)

theorem union_mem_RP {A B : Set α} (hA : A ∈ RP enc) (hB : B ∈ RP enc) : A ∪ B ∈ RP enc := by
  obtain ⟨p₁, V₁, hV₁, h₁⟩ := mem_RP.mp hA
  obtain ⟨p₂, V₂, hV₂, h₂⟩ := mem_RP.mp hB
  refine ⟨p₁ + p₂, orVerifier (fun a => p₁.eval (enc a).length) V₁ V₂, by fun_prop,
    fun a => ⟨fun ha => ?_, fun (ha : a ∉ A ∪ B) r => ?_⟩⟩
  · change 2 ^ (p₁ + p₂).eval (enc a).length ≤
      2 * acceptCount _ a ((p₁ + p₂).eval (enc a).length)
    rw [Polynomial.eval_add]
    generalize hk₁ : p₁.eval (enc a).length = k₁
    generalize hk₂ : p₂.eval (enc a).length = k₂
    have hc := acceptCount_orVerifier (fun a => p₁.eval (enc a).length) V₁ V₂ a k₂
    simp only [hk₁] at hc ⊢
    have n₁ := acceptCount_add_acceptCount_not V₁ a k₁
    have n₂ := acceptCount_add_acceptCount_not V₂ a k₂
    -- the rejected strings make up at most half of all strings
    have hprod : 2 * (acceptCount (fun x => !V₁ x) a k₁ * acceptCount (fun x => !V₂ x) a k₂) ≤
        2 ^ (k₁ + k₂) := by
      rw [pow_add]
      rcases ha with ha | ha

        rw [← mul_assoc]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
      · have h : 2 ^ k₂ ≤ 2 * acceptCount V₂ a k₂ := hk₂ ▸ (h₂ a).1 ha
        rw [Nat.mul_left_comm]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
    omega
  · simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or] at ha
    simp only [orVerifier, Bool.or_eq_false_iff]
    refine ⟨Bool.not_eq_true _ ▸ fun hc => ha.1 ((h₁.isVerifier a).2 ⟨_, ?_, hc⟩),
      Bool.not_eq_true _ ▸ fun hc => ha.2 ((h₂.isVerifier a).2 ⟨_, ?_, hc⟩)⟩ <;>

theorem inter_mem_RP {A B : Set α} (hA : A ∈ RP enc) (hB : B ∈ RP enc) : A ∩ B ∈ RP enc := by
  obtain ⟨p₁, V₁, hV₁, h₁⟩ := mem_RP_iff_forall_decidesWithOneSidedErrorExponent.1 hA 2
  obtain ⟨p₂, V₂, hV₂, h₂⟩ := mem_RP_iff_forall_decidesWithOneSidedErrorExponent.1 hB 2
  refine ⟨p₁ + p₂, andVerifier (fun a => p₁.eval (enc a).length) V₁ V₂, by fun_prop,
    fun a => ⟨fun ha => ?_, fun ha r => ?_⟩⟩
  · have e₁ := (h₁ a).1 ha.1
    have e₂ := (h₂ a).1 ha.2
    have hs₁ := acceptCount_add_card_filter_eq_false (V := V₁) (a := a)
      (n := p₁.eval (enc a).length)
    have hs₂ := acceptCount_add_card_filter_eq_false (V := V₂) (a := a)
      (n := p₂.eval (enc a).length)
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_ofNat] at e₁ e₂
    -- each decider accepts at least three quarters of its random strings
    have f₁ : 3 * 2 ^ p₁.eval (enc a).length ≤ 4 * acceptCount V₁ a (p₁.eval (enc a).length) := by
      omega
    have f₂ : 3 * 2 ^ p₂.eval (enc a).length ≤ 4 * acceptCount V₂ a (p₂.eval (enc a).length) := by
      omega
    change 2 ^ (p₁ + p₂).eval (enc a).length ≤
      2 * acceptCount _ a ((p₁ + p₂).eval (enc a).length)
    rw [Polynomial.eval_add, acceptCount_andVerifier, pow_add]
    nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul f₁ f₂]
  · have hA' := DecidesWithOneSidedError.isVerifier (h₁.solvesWithOneSidedError fun _ => by simp) a
    have hB' := DecidesWithOneSidedError.isVerifier (h₂.solvesWithOneSidedError fun _ => by simp) a
    simp only [andVerifier, Bool.and_eq_false_iff]
    by_contra hc
    simp only [not_or, Bool.not_eq_false] at hc
    exact ha ⟨hA'.2 ⟨_, by simp [Polynomial.eval_add], hc.1⟩,
      hB'.2 ⟨_, by simp [Polynomial.eval_add], hc.2⟩⟩

theorem signedSum_eq (k : ℕ) (s : State)
    (hk : s.1 = true → s.2.2.1 = false → (above acc len s).card ≤ k) :
    signedSum acc len k s = if s.2.2.1 = false ∧ (above acc len s).Nonempty then 0 else sign s := by
  induction k generalizing s with
  | zero =>
    unfold signedSum
    rw [sum_ofFn_congr (fun l => sign ((listRows 0 (len + 1) l).foldl (step acc) s))
      (Nat.zero_mul (len + 1))]
    simp only [listRows, List.range_zero, List.map_nil, List.foldl_nil, Finset.univ_unique,
      Finset.sum_singleton]
    split_ifs with h
    · obtain ⟨hended, hne⟩ := h
      cases hok : s.1
      · simp [sign, hok]
      · exact absurd (card_eq_zero.1 (Nat.le_zero.1 (hk hok hended))) hne.ne_empty
    · rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [signedSum_succ]
    obtain ⟨ok, par, ended, started, prev⟩ := s
    cases ok
    · -- a malformed state stays malformed
      have hfail (slot : List Bool) : (step acc (false, par, ended, started, prev) slot).1 =
          false := by
        unfold step
        split <;> simp
      simp only [sign, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_self]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => ?_
      rw [ih _ (fun h => absurd h (by rw [hfail]; decide)),
        ih _ (fun h => absurd h (by rw [hfail]; decide))]
      simp [sign, hfail]
    -- an empty first slot
    have hsum₀ : ∑ c : Fin len → Bool, signedSum acc len k
        (step acc (true, par, ended, started, prev) (false :: List.ofFn c)) =
          if par then -1 else 1 := by
      have hc (c : Fin len → Bool) : signedSum acc len k
          (step acc (true, par, ended, started, prev) (false :: List.ofFn c)) =
            if (!(List.ofFn c).any (fun b => b)) = true then (if par then -1 else 1) else 0 := by
        have hstep : step acc (true, par, ended, started, prev) (false :: List.ofFn c) =
            (!(List.ofFn c).any (fun b => b), par, true, started, prev) := by
          simp [step]
        rw [hstep, ih _ (fun _ h => by simp at h)]
        simp [sign]
      simp only [hc]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, Finset.sum_const, card_filter_not_any,
        one_smul]
    cases ended
    · -- before any empty slot
      have hcard := hk rfl rfl
      set A := above acc len (true, par, false, started, prev) with hA
      have hc (c : Fin len → Bool) : signedSum acc len k
          (step acc (true, par, false, started, prev) (true :: List.ofFn c)) =
            if c ∈ A ∧ ∀ x ∈ A, binaryValue (List.ofFn x) ≤ binaryValue (List.ofFn c) then
              (if par then 1 else -1) else 0 := by
        rw [step_true_cons]
        by_cases hmem : c ∈ A
        · have hsub : above acc len (true, !par, false, true, List.ofFn c) ⊆ A.erase c := by
            intro x hx
            simp only [hA, above, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Bool.true_eq_false,
              false_or] at hmem hx
            refine mem_erase.2 ⟨fun h => lt_irrefl _ (h ▸ hx.2), ?_⟩
            simp only [hA, above, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
            refine ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
            rcases hmem.2 with h | h
            · exact Or.inl h
            · exact Or.inr (h.trans hx.2)
          have hle : (above acc len (true, !par, false, true, List.ofFn c)).card ≤ k := by
            have := card_le_card hsub
            rw [card_erase_of_mem hmem] at this
            omega
          rw [(cond_eq_true_iff (par := par)).2 hmem, ih (true, !par, false, true, List.ofFn c)
            (fun _ _ => hle)]
          have hiff := above_eq_empty_iff hmem true (!par) false
          by_cases hmax : ∀ x ∈ A, binaryValue (List.ofFn x) ≤ binaryValue (List.ofFn c)
          · have hempty : ¬ (above acc len (true, !par, false, true, List.ofFn c)).Nonempty :=
              Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.2 (hiff.2 hmax)
            rw [ite_eq_right_of_eq_false _ _ (eq_false fun h => hempty h.2),
              ite_eq_left_of_eq_true _ _ (eq_true ⟨hmem, hmax⟩)]
            cases par <;> rfl
          · have hne : (above acc len (true, !par, false, true, List.ofFn c)).Nonempty :=
              Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 fun h => hmax (hiff.1 h)
            rw [ite_eq_left_of_eq_true _ _ (eq_true ⟨rfl, hne⟩),
              ite_eq_right_of_eq_false _ _ (eq_false fun h => hmax h.2)]
        · have hcond : (acc (List.ofFn c) &&
              (!started || decide (binaryValue prev < binaryValue (List.ofFn c)))) = false :=
            Bool.eq_false_iff.2 fun h => hmem ((cond_eq_true_iff (par := par)).1 h)
          rw [hcond, ih _ (fun h => by simp at h)]
          simp [hmem, sign]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hsum₀]
      simp only [hc]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, Finset.sum_const,
        show (univ.filter fun c => c ∈ A ∧ ∀ x ∈ A,
          binaryValue (List.ofFn x) ≤ binaryValue (List.ofFn c)) =
            A.filter fun c => ∀ x ∈ A, binaryValue (List.ofFn x) ≤ binaryValue (List.ofFn c) by
          ext c
          simp]
      by_cases hne : A.Nonempty
      · rw [card_filter_isGreatest hne]
        simp only [hne, and_self, ite_true, one_smul]
        cases par <;> rfl
      · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hne]
        simp [sign]
    · -- after an empty slot only the words of `false`s are well formed
      have hfail (c : Fin len → Bool) : signedSum acc len k
          (step acc (true, par, true, started, prev) (true :: List.ofFn c)) = 0 := by
        have hstep : (step acc (true, par, true, started, prev) (true :: List.ofFn c)).1 =
            false := by
          simp [step]
        rw [ih _ (fun h => by rw [hstep] at h; exact absurd h (by simp))]
        simp [sign, hstep]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hsum₀]
      simp [hfail, sign]

theorem exists_signed_verifier_machine (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (p : Polynomial ℕ)
    (verifier : α × List Bool → Bool)
    (hverify : ComputableInPolyTime verifier (encPair enc encBits) encBool) (sign : Bool) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (State : Type) (_ : Finite State) (machine : MultiTapeCTM k Bool State)
      (clock : Polynomial ℕ), machine.Nonblocking ∧ ∀ a,
        machine.HaltsWithin (clock.eval (enc a).length) (Cfg.init machine.initial (enc a)) ∧
        machine.acceptCount (clock.eval (enc a).length) (Cfg.init machine.initial (enc a)) =
          (if sign then 2 ^ p.eval (enc a).length else
            2 ^ p.eval (enc a).length - Complexity.acceptCount verifier a (p.eval (enc a).length)) ∧
        machine.rejectCount (clock.eval (enc a).length) (Cfg.init machine.initial (enc a)) =
          (if sign then
            2 ^ p.eval (enc a).length - Complexity.acceptCount verifier a (p.eval (enc a).length)
            else 2 ^ p.eval (enc a).length) := by
  have hverify := hverify.tidy
  obtain ⟨k, State, hfinite, source, sourceClock, hnon, hm⟩ :=
    exists_verifier_machine enc p verifier hverify
  let machine := (verdictMachine sign).comp source true
  let clock := sourceClock + (sourceClock + 4 + 1)
  refine ⟨_, _, inferInstance, machine, clock, hnon.comp (VerdictMachine.nonblocking sign) true,
    fun a => ?_⟩
  have hhalt : source.HaltsWithin (sourceClock.eval (enc a).length)
      (Cfg.init source.initial (enc a)) := (hm a).1
  have hp : ((source.runList (sourceClock.eval (enc a).length)
      (Cfg.init source.initial (enc a))).map Cfg.output).Perm
      ((BitString.enumList (p.eval (enc a).length)).map
        (fun word => encBool (verifier (a, word)))) := (hm a).2
  have hbool : ∀ result ∈ source.runList (sourceClock.eval (enc a).length)
      (Cfg.init source.initial (enc a)), ∃ bit, result.output = encBool bit := by
    intro result hresult
    have hout := hp.mem_iff.mp (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨result, hresult, rfl⟩)
    obtain ⟨word, _, hword⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hout
    exact ⟨verifier (a, word), hword.symm⟩
  have hlength : (source.runList (sourceClock.eval (enc a).length)
      (Cfg.init source.initial (enc a))).length = 2 ^ p.eval (enc a).length := by
    simpa using hp.length_eq
  have hreject : source.rejectCount (sourceClock.eval (enc a).length)
      (Cfg.init source.initial (enc a)) =
      2 ^ p.eval (enc a).length - Complexity.acceptCount verifier a (p.eval (enc a).length) := by
    rw [rejectCount, hhalt.branchCount_eq_countP (fun out => !(out == [true]))]
    have hc := hp.countP_eq (fun out => !(out == [true]))
    simp only [List.countP_map, Function.comp_def] at hc
    rw [hc]
    have he := BitString.countP_enumList (p.eval (enc a).length)
      (fun word => !(encBool (verifier (a, word)) == [true]))
    have hn := Complexity.acceptCount_add_card_filter_eq_false
      (V := verifier) (a := a) (n := p.eval (enc a).length)
    rw [he]
    simpa [encBool_apply] using (show
      (Finset.univ.filter fun word : BitString (p.eval (enc a).length) =>
        verifier (a, List.ofFn word) = false).card =
      2 ^ p.eval (enc a).length - Complexity.acceptCount verifier a (p.eval (enc a).length) by lia)
  have hclock : clock.eval (enc a).length =
      sourceClock.eval (enc a).length + (sourceClock.eval (enc a).length + 4 + 1) := by
    simp [clock]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hclock]
    exact HaltsWithin.comp source (verdictMachine sign) hnon (VerdictMachine.nonblocking sign)
      true (enc a) _ 1 hhalt (fun result _ => VerdictMachine.haltsWithin sign result.output)
  · have hc := VerdictMachine.branchCount_comp source hnon (enc a) _ hhalt hbool sign true
    rw [hlength, hreject] at hc
    simpa [machine, hclock, acceptCount, initialConfig] using hc
  · have hc := VerdictMachine.branchCount_comp source hnon (enc a) _ hhalt hbool sign false
    rw [hlength, hreject] at hc
    cases sign <;> simpa [machine, hclock, rejectCount, initialConfig] using hc

private theorem replayStepFactor_mem_SharpP [Finite Control] [Finite Operation]
    (machine : MultiTapePTM tapes Bool Control Operation) {input : α → List Bool}
    {fYes fNo : List Bool → ℕ}
    (hinput : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime input enc encBits)
    (hYes : fYes ∈ SharpP encBits) (hNo : fNo ∈ SharpP encBits) :
    replayStepFactor machine input fYes fNo ∈ SharpP (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encUnary) := by
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite Operation
  let cfg : (α × List Bool) × ℕ → FiniteConfig tapes Bool Control Operation :=
    fun x => machine.replayPrefix (input x.1.1) x.1.2 x.2
  have hcfg : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime cfg
      (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encUnary) encFiniteConfig :=
    machine.replayPrefix_pt.comp (g := fun x : (α × List Bool) × ℕ =>
      ((input x.1.1, x.1.2), x.2)) (by fun_prop)
  have hquery : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun x => (machine.pendingQuery (cfg x)).isSome)
      (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encUnary) encBool :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.of_finite Option.isSome).comp
      (machine.pendingQuery_pt.comp hcfg)
  have hreq : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun x => machine.pendingRequest (cfg x))
      (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encUnary) encBits :=
    machine.pendingRequest_pt.comp hcfg
  have hbit : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun x : (α × List Bool) × ℕ => x.1.2.getD x.2 false)
      (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encUnary) encBool := by fun_prop
  exact SharpP.ite_mem (.of_tidy hquery)
    (SharpP.ite_mem (.of_tidy hbit) (SharpP.comp_mem hYes (.of_tidy hreq))
      (SharpP.comp_mem hNo (.of_tidy hreq)))

/-- **`#P` precomposition with encoded `FP^(UP ∩ coUP)` outputs.** If `A ∈ UP ∩ coUP`,
`f : α → β` is computable in polynomial time relative to `A`, and `F : α × List Bool → ℕ` belongs to

theorem SharpP.encoded_comp_mem_of_computableInPolyTimeWithOracle
    {f : α → β} {F : α × List Bool → ℕ}
    (hA_up : A ∈ UP encBits) (hA_coup : A ∈ coUP encBits)
    (hf : ComputableInPolyTimeWithOracle A f enc output)
    (hF : F ∈ SharpP (encPair enc encBits)) :
    (fun a => F (a, output (f a))) ∈ SharpP enc := by
  obtain ⟨fYes, hYes_mem, hYes_le, hYes_iff⟩ := hA_up
  obtain ⟨fNo, hNo_mem, hNo_le, hNo_iff⟩ := hA_coup
  obtain ⟨program, hcert, hprogram⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨tapes, m, machine, c, d, hrun⟩ := hcert.exists_fin_run_pure_false
  let g : List Bool → Bool := fun q => decide (q ∈ A)
  have hYes' (q : List Bool) : g q = true ↔ 0 < fYes q := by
    have hle := hYes_le q
    rw [show (0 < fYes q) ↔ fYes q = 1 by omega]
    simp only [g, decide_eq_true_eq, hYes_iff q]
  have hNo' (q : List Bool) : g q = false ↔ 0 < fNo q := by
    have hle := hNo_le q
    rw [show (0 < fNo q) ↔ fNo q = 1 by omega]
    simp only [g, decide_eq_false_iff_not, ← Set.mem_compl_iff, hNo_iff q]
  let T : α → ℕ := fun a => c * ((enc a).length + 1) ^ d
  have hT : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime T enc encUnary :=
    ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_eval (Polynomial.C c * (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ d)).comp
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc)).of_enc_eq fun a => by simp [T]
  have hinput : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a : α => enc a) enc encBits :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id'
  have hmem := replayWeightedSum_mem_SharpP machine hinput hT hYes_mem hNo_mem hF
  convert hmem using 1
  funext a
  rw [replayWeightedSum_eq_of_le_one machine (fun a => enc a) T hYes_le hNo_le hYes' hNo' F a,
    machine.replayOutput_oracleReplies g (T a) (enc a)]
  have hrun_a := hrun a (languageOracle A)
  rw [hprogram a] at hrun_a
  change F (a, output (f a)) = _
  rw [← hrun_a]
  rfl

private theorem verdictCount_mem_SharpP [Finite State]
    (machine : MultiTapeCTM k Bool State) (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (clock : Polynomial ℕ)

    (fun a => machine.branchCount (fun out => (out == [true]) == verdict)
      (clock.eval (enc a).length) (Cfg.init machine.initial (enc a))) ∈ Complexity.SharpP enc := by
  obtain ⟨bound, hbound⟩ := machine.exists_branchBound

      (show width < 2 ^ width from Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le)
  refine ⟨clock * Polynomial.C width,
    fun p => Checker.checkBinary machine width verdict (enc p.1, p.2), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact .of_tidy <|
      (Checker.computableTidilyInPolyTime_checkBinary machine width verdict).comp
        (((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst enc encBits).encoded).prod
          (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd enc encBits))
  · intro a
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
    exact (Checker.acceptCount_checkBinary machine hwidth (enc a) (hcodes (enc a))
      (clock.eval (enc a).length) verdict).symm

  have hW : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime W

    (polyTime_indexedProductVerifier (.of_tidy hr) (.of_tidy hk) (.of_tidy hW))
    (.of_tidy (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_mul.comp (hr.prod hk))) using 1

  rw [acceptCount_indexedProductVerifier]

    have hinstance : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime

        (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encUnary) enc := by fun_prop
    exact hinstance.prod (machine.pendingRequest_pt.comp hcfg)

theorem alternation_foldl_step (G : Graph) :
    ∀ (r : ℕ) (first : Bool) (vis : List ℕ) (v : ℕ),
      (G.1.toFinset \ vis.toFinset).card < r →
      (Alternation true (List.replicate (2 * G.2.length * r) 1) (fun z =>
          ((blocks G.2.length r z).foldl (step G G.2.length) (none, first, vis, v)).1.getD false =
            true) ↔
        (first = true ↔ G.GeographyWins vis v))
  | 0, _, _, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | r + 1, first, vis, v, hr => by
    set B := G.2.length
    -- the outcome after the first block
    have hP (z : List Bool) :
        ((blocks B (r + 1) z).foldl (step G B) (none, first, vis, v)).1.getD false = true ↔
          ((blocks B r (z.drop (2 * B))).foldl (step G B)
            (next G first vis v (moverBits B first z))).1.getD false = true := by
      rw [blocks_succ, List.foldl_cons, step, ite_eq_right (by simp), moverBits_take]
    -- the outcome of the rest of the game after a legal or an illegal move
    have hlegal (bits : List Bool) (hl : legal G vis v (choice bits) = true) :
        Alternation true (List.replicate (2 * B * r) 1) (fun rest =>
            ((blocks B r rest).foldl (step G B) (next G first vis v bits)).1.getD false = true) ↔
          ((!first) = true ↔ G.GeographyWins ((arc G (choice bits)).2 :: vis)
            (arc G (choice bits)).2) := by
      obtain ⟨hi, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := legal_eq_true_iff.1 hl
      have hw : (arc G (choice bits)).2 ∈ G.1 := by rwa [arc_eq hi]
      have hwvis : (arc G (choice bits)).2 ∉ vis := by rwa [arc_eq hi]
      rw [next, ite_eq_left hl]
      exact alternation_foldl_step G r _ _ _ (by have := Graph.card_sdiff_cons_lt hw hwvis; omega)
    have hillegal (bits : List Bool) (hl : ¬legal G vis v (choice bits) = true) :
        Alternation true (List.replicate (2 * B * r) 1) (fun rest =>
            ((blocks B r rest).foldl (step G B) (next G first vis v bits)).1.getD false = true) ↔
          (!first) = true := by
      rw [next, ite_eq_right hl]
      simp only [foldl_step_some, Option.getD_some]
      exact alternation_const
    rw [show 2 * B * (r + 1) = 2 * B + 2 * B * r by ring, List.replicate_add,
      alternation_congr hP]
    cases first
    · rw [alternation_moverBits_false (F := fun bits rest => ((blocks B r rest).foldl (step G B)
        (next G false vis v bits)).1.getD false = true)]
      have hy (y : List Bool) : Alternation true (List.replicate (2 * B * r) 1) (fun rest =>
          ((blocks B r rest).foldl (step G B) (next G false vis v y)).1.getD false = true) ↔
            (legal G vis v (choice y) = true →
              G.GeographyWins ((arc G (choice y)).2 :: vis) (arc G (choice y)).2) := by
        by_cases hl : legal G vis v (choice y) = true
        · rw [hlegal y hl]
          simp [hl]
        · rw [hillegal y hl]
          simp [hl]
      simp only [hy]
      rw [forall_legal_iff (R := fun w => G.GeographyWins (w :: vis) w),
        ← Graph.not_geographyWins_iff]
      simp
    · rw [alternation_moverBits_true (F := fun bits rest => ((blocks B r rest).foldl (step G B)
        (next G true vis v bits)).1.getD false = true)]
      have hx (x : List Bool) : Alternation true (List.replicate (2 * B * r) 1) (fun rest =>
          ((blocks B r rest).foldl (step G B) (next G true vis v x)).1.getD false = true) ↔
            (legal G vis v (choice x) = true ∧
              ¬G.GeographyWins ((arc G (choice x)).2 :: vis) (arc G (choice x)).2) := by
        by_cases hl : legal G vis v (choice x) = true
        · rw [hlegal x hl]
          simp [hl]
        · rw [hillegal x hl]
          simp [hl]
      simp only [hx]
      rw [exists_legal_iff (R := fun w => ¬G.GeographyWins (w :: vis) w),
        ← Graph.geographyWins_iff]
      simp

def step (s : State) : State :=
  match s.value with
  | none =>
    match s.input with
    | [] => ⟨[], s.stack, some false, s.ok⟩
    | (k, v) :: input =>
      match k with
      | .var => ⟨input, s.stack, some (assignment s.stack v), s.ok && (lookup s.stack v).isSome⟩
      | .top => ⟨input, s.stack, some true, s.ok⟩
      | .bot => ⟨input, s.stack, some false, s.ok⟩
      | .not | .and | .or | .ex | .all => ⟨input, ⟨(k, v), none, input⟩ :: s.stack, none, s.ok⟩
  | some b =>
    match s.stack with
    | [] => s
    | f :: stack =>
      match f.token.1, f.first with
      | .not, _ => ⟨s.input, stack, some !b, s.ok⟩
      | .and, none | .or, none => ⟨s.input, { f with first := some b } :: stack, none, s.ok⟩
      | .ex, none | .all, none => ⟨f.rest, { f with first := some b } :: stack, none, s.ok⟩
      | .and, some a | .all, some a => ⟨s.input, stack, some (a && b), s.ok⟩
      | .or, some a | .ex, some a => ⟨s.input, stack, some (a || b), s.ok⟩
      | .var, _ | .top, _ | .bot, _ => ⟨s.input, stack, some b, s.ok⟩

private theorem lookup_cons_quant {f : Frame} {k : QBF.Kind} {x : ℕ} (hk : k = .ex ∨ k = .all)
    (hf : f.token = (k, x)) (stack : List Frame) (v : ℕ) :
    lookup (f :: stack) v = if v = x then some f.first.isSome else lookup stack v := by
  have hb : f.binds v = true ↔ v = x := by
    have hq : (k == .ex || k == .all) = true := by rcases hk with rfl | rfl <;> rfl
    simp only [Frame.binds, hf, hq, Bool.true_and, beq_iff_eq]
    exact eq_comm
  by_cases hv : v = x
  · rw [lookup, List.find?_cons_of_pos (hb.mpr hv)]
    simp [hv]
  · rw [lookup, List.find?_cons_of_neg (fun h => hv (hb.mp h))]
    simp [hv, lookup]

private theorem Good.step {φ : QBF ℕ} {s : State} (h : Good φ s) : Good φ (step s) := by
  obtain ⟨input, stack, value, ok⟩ := s
  obtain ⟨hin, hframes, hnest⟩ := h
  dsimp only at hin hframes hnest
  rcases value with _ | b
  · rcases input with _ | ⟨⟨k, v⟩, input⟩
    · exact ⟨hin, hframes, hnest⟩
    · have htail : input <:+ φ.tokens := (List.suffix_cons _ _).trans hin
      have hnest' : Nested φ.tokens.length input.length stack :=
        hnest.mono (by simp)
      cases k
      case var | top | bot => exact ⟨htail, hframes, hnest'⟩
      all_goals
        refine ⟨htail, fun f hf => ?_, ⟨le_refl _, by simpa using hnest⟩⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hf with rfl | hf
        · exact hin
        · exact hframes f hf
  · rcases stack with _ | ⟨f, stack⟩
    · exact ⟨hin, hframes, hnest⟩
    · have hf := hframes f (by simp)
      have hrest : f.rest <:+ φ.tokens := (List.suffix_cons _ _).trans hf
      have hbelow : ∀ g ∈ stack, g.token :: g.rest <:+ φ.tokens := fun g hg =>
        hframes g (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hg)
      obtain ⟨hle, hnest₂⟩ := hnest
      have hpop : Nested φ.tokens.length input.length stack := hnest₂.mono (by omega)
      have hkeep : ∀ g ∈ { f with first := some b } :: stack, g.token :: g.rest <:+ φ.tokens := by
        intro g hg
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hg with rfl | hg
        · exact hf
        · exact hbelow g hg
      obtain ⟨⟨k, x⟩, first, rest⟩ := f
      cases k <;> cases first <;>
        first
        | exact ⟨hin, hbelow, hpop⟩
        | exact ⟨hin, hkeep, ⟨hle, hnest₂⟩⟩
        | exact ⟨hrest, hkeep, ⟨le_refl _, hnest₂⟩⟩

private def retStep (k : QBF.Kind) (second : Bool) (s : State) : State :=
  match k, second with
  | .not, _ => ⟨s.input, s.stack.tail, some !s.ret, s.ok⟩
  | .and, false | .or, false =>
    ⟨s.input, { s.top with first := some s.ret } :: s.stack.tail, none, s.ok⟩
  | .ex, false | .all, false =>
    ⟨s.top.rest, { s.top with first := some s.ret } :: s.stack.tail, none, s.ok⟩
  | .and, true | .all, true => ⟨s.input, s.stack.tail, some (s.top.first.getD false && s.ret), s.ok⟩
  | .or, true | .ex, true => ⟨s.input, s.stack.tail, some (s.top.first.getD false || s.ret), s.ok⟩
  | .var, _ | .top, _ | .bot, _ => ⟨s.input, s.stack.tail, some s.ret, s.ok⟩

theorem eval_baseFormula (tab : CNF (CookLevin.Var k State)) (w : ℕ) (σ : ℕ → Bool) :
    (baseFormula tab w).eval σ = true ↔ ∃ τ : CookLevin.Var k State → Bool,
      CookLevin.certWord τ (2 * w) = block σ w 0 0 ++ block σ w 1 0 ∧ tab.eval τ = true := by
  classical
  rw [baseFormula, QBF.eval_exs_eq_true_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ', hσ', h⟩
    simp only [QBF.eval_and, Bool.and_eq_true, certLinks, QBF.eval_conj, List.all_map,
      List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, Function.comp_apply, QBF.eval_iff, QBF.eval_var, beq_iff_eq,
      QBF.eval_ofCNF, CNF.eval_relabel] at h
    obtain ⟨hlink, htab⟩ := h
    refine ⟨σ' ∘ tabVar, ?_, htab⟩
    rw [← map_certVar]
    simp only [CookLevin.certWord, Function.comp_apply]
    exact List.map_inj_left.mpr fun j hj => (hlink j (List.mem_range.mp hj)).trans
      (hσ' _ (certVar_notMem_baseVars tab w j))
  · rintro ⟨τ, hcert, htab⟩
    let σ' : ℕ → Bool := fun x =>
      if h : x ∈ baseVars tab w ∧ ∃ v, tabVar v = x then τ h.2.choose else σ x
    have hσ' (v : CookLevin.Var k State) (hv : tabVar v ∈ baseVars tab w) :
        σ' (tabVar v) = τ v := by
      have h : tabVar v ∈ baseVars tab w ∧ ∃ v', tabVar v' = tabVar v := ⟨hv, v, rfl⟩
      simp only [σ', h]
      exact congrArg τ (tabVar_injective h.2.choose_spec)
    refine ⟨σ', fun x hx => by simp [σ', hx], ?_⟩
    simp only [QBF.eval_and, Bool.and_eq_true, certLinks, QBF.eval_conj, List.all_map,
      List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, Function.comp_apply, QBF.eval_iff, QBF.eval_var, beq_iff_eq,
      QBF.eval_ofCNF, CNF.eval_relabel]
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hmem : tabVar (CookLevin.Var.cert (k := k) (State := State) j) ∈ baseVars tab w :=
        List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨j, List.mem_range.mpr hj, rfl⟩)
      rw [hσ' _ hmem, show σ' (certVar w j) = σ (certVar w j) by
        simp [σ', certVar_notMem_baseVars tab w j]]
      have := congrArg (fun l => l[j]?) (hcert.trans (map_certVar σ w).symm)
      simpa [CookLevin.certWord, List.getElem?_range, hj] using this
    · rw [← htab]
      exact CNF.eval_congr fun v hv => hσ' v (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_map_of_mem hv))

theorem mem_FNP_iff_exists_bounded : R ∈ FNP enc ↔
    ∃ (p : Polynomial ℕ) (V : α × List Bool → Bool),
      ComputableInPolyTime V (encPair enc encBits) encBool ∧
        ∀ a w, R a w ↔ w.length ≤ p.eval (enc a).length ∧ V (a, w) = true := by
  have this : R ∈ FNP enc ↔ ∃ (p : Polynomial ℕ) (V : α × List Bool → Bool),
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime V (encPair enc encBits) encBool ∧ ∀ a w, R a w ↔ w.length ≤ p.eval
      (enc a).length ∧ V (a, w) = true := by
    rw [mem_FNP]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, V, hV, hR⟩
      exact ⟨p, V, hV.tidy, fun a w => ⟨fun h => ⟨hp a w h, (hR a w).1 h⟩, fun h => (hR a w).2 h.2⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, V, hV, hR⟩
      refine ⟨⟨p, fun a w h => ((hR a w).1 h).1⟩,
        fun x => decide (x.2.length ≤ p.eval (enc x.1).length) && V x, ?_, fun a w => ?_⟩
      · exact .of_tidy (bool_and' (unary_le' (length_bits.comp (snd enc encBits))
          ((unary_eval p).comp ((encoding_length enc).comp (fst enc encBits)))) hV)
      · simp only [hR a w, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  simpa only [computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] using this

theorem searchSum_mem_FNP (hR : R ∈ FNP enc) (hS : S ∈ FNP enc) : searchSum R S ∈ FNP enc := by
  obtain ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, V, hV, hRV⟩ := mem_FNP.mp hR
  obtain ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, W, hW, hSW⟩ := mem_FNP.mp hS
  have hV := hV.tidy
  have hW := hW.tidy
  refine mem_FNP.mpr ⟨⟨p + q + 1, fun a w h => ?_⟩,
    fun x => !x.2.isEmpty && if x.2.headD false then V (x.1, x.2.tail) else W (x.1, x.2.tail),
    ?_, fun a w => ?_⟩
  · simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_one]
    match w, h with
    | true :: u, h =>
      have := hp a u h
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      omega
    | false :: u, h =>
      have := hq a u h
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      omega
  · have htail : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x : α × List Bool => (x.1, x.2.tail))
        (encPair enc encBits) (encPair enc encBits) :=
      (fst enc encBits).prod (bitsTail.comp (snd enc encBits))
    refine .of_tidy (bool_and' (bool_not.comp ?_) (cond ?_ (hV.comp htail) (hW.comp htail)))
    · fun_prop
    · fun_prop
  · match w with
    | [] => simp
    | true :: u => simp [hRV]
    | false :: u => simp [hSW]

theorem searchDomain_mem_P_of_searchSum_mem_FPSearch (hRS : searchSum R S ∈ FPSearch enc)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (searchDomain R) (searchDomain S)) : searchDomain R ∈ P enc := by
  obtain ⟨-, f, hf, hsolve⟩ := mem_FPSearch.mp hRS
  refine mem_P.mpr ⟨fun a => ((f a).getD []).headD false, ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
  · have hget := optionGetDWithInput hf.tidy
      (const [] : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun _ : α => ([] : List Bool)) enc encBits)
    fun_prop
  · change a ∈ searchDomain R ↔ ((f a).getD []).headD false = true
    cases ha : f a with
    | none =>
      have := hsolve.notMem ha
      rw [searchDomain_searchSum] at this
      exact ⟨fun h => (this (.inl h)).elim, fun h => by simp at h⟩
    | some w =>
      have hw := hsolve.rel ha
      rcases w with _ | ⟨_ | _, u⟩
      · exact hw.elim
      · exact ⟨fun h => (Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj h ⟨u, hw⟩).elim, fun h => by simp at h⟩
      · exact ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => ⟨u, hw⟩⟩

theorem SearchReducible.trans (hRT : SearchReducible encA encB R T)

theorem SearchReducible.mem_FPSearch (h : SearchReducible encA encB R T) (hR : R ∈ FNP encA)
    (hT : T ∈ FPSearch encB) : R ∈ FPSearch encA := by
  obtain ⟨f, g, hf, hg, hdom, hsol⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨-, s, hs, hsolve⟩ := Complexity.mem_FPSearch.mp hT
  refine Complexity.mem_FPSearch.mpr ⟨hR, fun a => (s (f a)).elim none fun w => some (g (a, w)),
    .of_tidy (optionElimWithInput (hs.tidy.comp hf.tidy) (const none)
      ((optionSome encBits).comp hg.tidy)),
    fun a => ⟨fun w ha => ?_, fun ha hR => ?_⟩⟩
  · cases hsa : s (f a) with
    | none => simp [hsa] at ha
    | some v =>
      simp only [hsa, Option.elim_some, Option.some.injEq] at ha
      exact ha ▸ hsol a v (hsolve.rel hsa)
  · cases hsa : s (f a) with
    | none => exact hsolve.notMem hsa (hdom a hR)
    | some v => simp [hsa] at ha

theorem prefixSearch_mem_FNP (hR : R ∈ FNP enc) : prefixSearch R ∈ FNP (encPair enc encBits) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, V, hV, hRV⟩ := mem_FNP.mp hR
  refine mem_FNP.mpr
    ⟨⟨p, fun x v h => ?_⟩, fun y => V (y.1.1, y.1.2 ++ y.2), ?_, fun x v => hRV _ _⟩
  · have h₁ := hp _ _ h
    have h₂ := Polynomial.eval_mono p (length_le_encPair_left enc encBits x)
    simp only [List.length_append] at h₁
    omega
  · exact .of_tidy (hV.tidy.comp ((fst (encPair enc encBits) encBits).fst'.prod
      (bitsAppend (fst (encPair enc encBits) encBits).snd' (snd (encPair enc encBits) encBits))))

/-- One step of the search through prefixes, with `V` deciding solutions and `D` deciding the
prefix problem: keep a solution, and otherwise extend the word by `false` if `D` accepts the
extension, and by `true` if not. -/

private theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_prefixSearchRun {V D : α × List Bool → Bool} {n : α → ℕ}
    (hV : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime V (encPair enc encBits) encBool)
    (hD : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime D (encPair enc encBits) encBool)
    (hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime n enc encUnary) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (prefixSearchRun V D n) enc encBits := by
  have hstep : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun y : (α × List Bool) × Bool => prefixSearchStep V D y.1.1 y.1.2)
      (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encBool) encBits := by
    have hu : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun y : (α × List Bool) × Bool => y.1.2)
        (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encBool) encBits := (fst _ _).snd'
    have ha : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun y : (α × List Bool) × Bool => y.1.1)
        (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encBool) enc := (fst _ _).fst'
    have happ (b : Bool) : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun y : (α × List Bool) × Bool => y.1.2 ++ [b])
        (encPair (encPair enc encBits) encBool) encBits := bitsAppend hu (const [b])
    unfold prefixSearchStep
    exact cond (hV.comp (ha.prod hu)) hu
      (cond (hD.comp (ha.prod (happ false))) (happ false) (happ true))
  unfold prefixSearchRun
  refine foldlWithInput_of_bounded_growth (const []) ⟨(bitsReplicate false).comp hn, hstep,
    inferInstance, inferInstance⟩ (growth := fun _ => 1) ⟨.const 1, fun a u _ _ => ?_⟩
  simp only [encBits, Function.Embedding.refl_apply, prefixSearchStep]
  split_ifs <;> simp

/-- **Search reduces to decision**: if the `NP` problems on pairs of instances and words are in
`P`, every `FNP` relation is in `FPSearch`. The solver decides the prefix problem, searches through
prefixes, and checks the result. -/

theorem FNP_subset_FPSearch_of_NP_subset_P
    (h : NP (encPair enc encBits) ⊆ P (encPair enc encBits)) : FNP enc ⊆ FPSearch enc := by
  intro R hR
  obtain ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, V, hV, hRV⟩ := mem_FNP.mp hR
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hDR⟩ := mem_P.mp
    (h (searchDomain_mem_NP (prefixSearch_mem_FNP (mem_FNP.mpr ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, V, hV, hRV⟩))))
  let n : α → ℕ := fun a => p.eval (enc a).length
  have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime n enc encUnary := (unary_eval p).comp (encoding_length enc)
  have hrun := computableTidilyInPolyTime_prefixSearchRun hV.tidy hD.tidy hn
  refine mem_FPSearch.mpr
    ⟨mem_FNP.mpr ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, V, hV, hRV⟩, fun a => if V (a, prefixSearchRun V D n a) then
    some (prefixSearchRun V D n a) else none, ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
  · exact .of_tidy
      (cond (hV.tidy.comp (id'.prod hrun)) ((optionSome encBits).comp hrun) (const none))
  · have hcorrect := rel_prefixSearchRun hRV (fun a u => (hDR (a, u)).symm) hp (a := a)
    constructor
    · intro w hw
      beta_reduce at hw
      split_ifs at hw with hVa
      exact Option.some_injective _ hw ▸ (hRV _ _).2 hVa
    · intro hw ha
      beta_reduce at hw
      split_ifs at hw with hVa

/-- A polynomial-time pigeonhole family defines an `FNP` relation. -/
theorem pigeonRel_mem_FNP {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {n : α → ℕ} {F : α × List Bool → List Bool}
    (hn : ComputableInPolyTime n enc encUnary)
    (hF : ComputableInPolyTime F (encPair enc encBits) encBits) :
    pigeonRel n F ∈ FNP enc := by
  have hn := hn.tidy
  have hF := hF.tidy
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hn.polyBounded.exists_polynomial
  refine mem_FNP.mpr ⟨⟨2 * p, fun a w h => by
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_ofNat]
      have := hp a; have := h.1; omega⟩,
    fun x => decide (x.2.length = 2 * n x.1) &&
      (decide (F (x.1, x.2.take (n x.1)) = zeroVertex (n x.1)) ||
        (decide (x.2.take (n x.1) ≠ x.2.drop (n x.1)) &&
          decide (F (x.1, x.2.take (n x.1)) = F (x.1, x.2.drop (n x.1))))),
    ?_, fun a w => ?_⟩
  · have h2 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x : α × List Bool => 2 * n x.1)
        (encPair enc encBits) encUnary :=
      unary_mul.comp ((const 2).prod (hn.comp (fst enc encBits)))
    refine .of_tidy (bool_and' (decide_eq' (length_bits.comp (snd enc encBits)) h2) ?_)
    fun_prop
  · simp [pigeonRel]

private theorem exists_endomorphismCodes {n : α → ℕ} {F : α × List Bool → List Bool}
    (hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime n enc encUnary)

  obtain ⟨code, hcode, hsem⟩ := exists_uniformCircuitCodes (.of_tidy hn) (.of_tidy hn)
    (.of_tidy hF) hlen

theorem pigeonRel_searchReducible_Pigeon {n : α → ℕ} {F : α × List Bool → List Bool}
    (hn : ComputableInPolyTime n enc encUnary)
    (hF : ComputableInPolyTime F (encPair enc encBits) encBits)
    (hlen : ∀ a u, u.length = n a → (F (a, u)).length = n a) :
    SearchReducible enc encPigeon (pigeonRel n F) Pigeon := by
  have hn := hn.tidy
  have hF := hF.tidy
  obtain ⟨code, hcode, hsem⟩ := exists_endomorphismCodes hn hF hlen
  apply SearchReducible.of_isTotalSearch isTotalSearch_Pigeon (.of_tidy (hn.prod hcode))
    (.of_tidy (snd enc encBits))
  intro a w hw
  change pigeonRel (fun a => n a) (fun p => evalCircuitCode (n p.1) (code p.1) p.2) a w at hw
  obtain ⟨hw, h⟩ := hw
  change w.length = 2 * n a at hw
  have hu : (w.take (n a)).length = n a := by
    simp only [List.length_take]
    omega
  have hv : (w.drop (n a)).length = n a := by
    simp only [List.length_drop]
    omega
  exact ⟨hw, by simpa only [hsem a _ hu, hsem a _ hv] using h⟩

theorem endOfLineRel_searchReducible_EndOfLine {n : α → ℕ}
    {P S : α × List Bool → List Bool}
    (hn : ComputableInPolyTime n enc encUnary)
    (hP : ComputableInPolyTime P (encPair enc encBits) encBits)
    (hS : ComputableInPolyTime S (encPair enc encBits) encBits)
    (hP_len : ∀ a u, u.length = n a → (P (a, u)).length = n a)
    (hS_len : ∀ a u, u.length = n a → (S (a, u)).length = n a) :
    SearchReducible enc encEndOfLine (endOfLineRel n P S) EndOfLine := by
  have hn := hn.tidy
  have hP := hP.tidy
  have hS := hS.tidy
  obtain ⟨cP, hcP, hPs⟩ := exists_endomorphismCodes hn hP hP_len
  obtain ⟨cS, hcS, hSs⟩ := exists_endomorphismCodes hn hS hS_len
  apply SearchReducible.of_isTotalSearch isTotalSearch_EndOfLine
    (.of_tidy (hn.prod (hcP.prod hcS))) (.of_tidy (snd enc encBits))
  intro a u hw
  let P' (p : α × List Bool) := evalCircuitCode (n p.1) (cP p.1) p.2
  let S' (p : α × List Bool) := evalCircuitCode (n p.1) (cS p.1) p.2
  change endOfLineRel n P' S' a u at hw
  have hu := hw.1
  have hin : hasIn n P' S' a u = hasIn n P S a u := by
    simp only [hasIn, P', S', hPs a u hu, hSs a _ (hP_len a u hu)]
  have hout : hasOut n P' S' a u = hasOut n P S a u := by
    simp only [hasOut, P', S', hSs a u hu, hPs a _ (hS_len a u hu)]
  exact ⟨hu, by simpa only [hin, hout] using hw.2⟩

theorem leafRel_searchReducible_Leaf {n : α → ℕ} {N₁ N₂ : α × List Bool → List Bool}
    (hn : ComputableInPolyTime n enc encUnary)
    (hN₁ : ComputableInPolyTime N₁ (encPair enc encBits) encBits)
    (hN₂ : ComputableInPolyTime N₂ (encPair enc encBits) encBits)
    (hN₁_len : ∀ a u, u.length = n a → (N₁ (a, u)).length = n a)
    (hN₂_len : ∀ a u, u.length = n a → (N₂ (a, u)).length = n a) :
    SearchReducible enc encLeaf (leafRel n N₁ N₂) Leaf := by
  have hn := hn.tidy
  have hN₁ := hN₁.tidy
  have hN₂ := hN₂.tidy
  obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, h₁⟩ := exists_endomorphismCodes hn hN₁ hN₁_len
  obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂, h₂⟩ := exists_endomorphismCodes hn hN₂ hN₂_len
  apply SearchReducible.of_isTotalSearch isTotalSearch_Leaf
    (.of_tidy (hn.prod (hc₁.prod hc₂))) (.of_tidy (snd enc encBits))
  intro a u hw
  let N₁' (p : α × List Bool) := evalCircuitCode (n p.1) (c₁ p.1) p.2
  let N₂' (p : α × List Bool) := evalCircuitCode (n p.1) (c₂ p.1) p.2
  change leafRel n N₁' N₂' a u at hw
  have hu := hw.1
  have hedge (v : List Bool) (hv : v.length = n a) :
      undirectedEdge N₁' N₂' a u v = undirectedEdge N₁ N₂ a u v := by
    simp only [undirectedEdge, N₁', N₂', h₁ a u hu, h₂ a u hu, h₁ a v hv, h₂ a v hv]
  have hodd : hasOddDegree N₁' N₂' a u = hasOddDegree N₁ N₂ a u := by
    unfold hasOddDegree
    rw [show N₁' (a, u) = N₁ (a, u) from h₁ a u hu,
      show N₂' (a, u) = N₂ (a, u) from h₂ a u hu,
      hedge _ (hN₁_len a u hu), hedge _ (hN₂_len a u hu)]
  exact ⟨hu, by simpa only [hodd] using hw.2⟩

private theorem exists_costCodes {n : α → ℕ} {C : α × List Bool → ℕ}
    (hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime n enc encUnary)
    (hC : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime C (encPair enc encBits) encNat) :
    ∃ code : α → CircuitCode, ComputableTidilyInPolyTime code enc encCode ∧
      ∀ a u, u.length = n a → binaryValue (evalCircuitOutputs (code a) u) = C (a, u) := by
  obtain ⟨c, d, hbound⟩ := hC.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  let m (a : α) := c * (2 * (enc a).length + n a + 2) ^ d
  have hm : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime m enc encUnary := by
    unfold m
    polytime
  have hword : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : α × List Bool => binaryWord (m p.1) (C p)) (encPair enc encBits) encBits := by
    have hbits := (ComputableInPolyTime.of_eq (f := Nat.bits)
      (encIn := encNat) (encOut := encBits) fun _ => rfl).comp (.of_tidy hC)
    have hwidth := (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy hm).comp
      (ComputableInPolyTime.fst enc encBits)
    have hpadding := ComputableInPolyTime.unary_sub.comp
      (hwidth.prod (ComputableInPolyTime.length_bits.comp hbits))
    have hplain := ComputableInPolyTime.bitsAppend
      ((ComputableInPolyTime.bitsReplicate false).comp hpadding)
      (ComputableInPolyTime.bitsReverse.comp hbits)
    simpa only [binaryWord, Function.comp_def] using hplain.tidy
  have hword_len (a : α) (u : List Bool) (hu : u.length = n a) :
      (binaryWord (m a) (C (a, u))).length = m a := by
    have hb := hbound (a, u)
    simp only [encNat_apply, length_encPair, encBits_apply, hu] at hb
    have hbits : (C (a, u)).bits.length ≤ m a := by
      rw [show 2 * (enc a).length + 1 + n a + 1 =
        2 * (enc a).length + n a + 2 by omega] at hb
      exact hb
    simp only [binaryWord, List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_reverse]
    omega
  obtain ⟨code, hcode, hsem⟩ := exists_uniformCircuitCodes (.of_tidy hn) (.of_tidy hm)
    (.of_tidy hword) hword_len
  refine ⟨code, hcode.tidy, fun a u hu => ?_⟩
  rw [hsem a u hu, binaryValue_binaryWord]

theorem localOptRel_searchReducible_LocalOpt {n : α → ℕ}
    {N : α × List Bool → List Bool} {C : α × List Bool → ℕ}
    (hn : ComputableInPolyTime n enc encUnary)
    (hN : ComputableInPolyTime N (encPair enc encBits) encBits)

    (hlen : ∀ a u, u.length = n a → (N (a, u)).length = n a) :

      binaryValue (evalCircuitOutputs (cC a) (evalCircuitCode (n a) (cN a) u)) at hw
  refine ⟨hw.1, ?_⟩

private theorem sum_undirectedEdge_eq {n : α → ℕ} {N₁ N₂ : α × List Bool → List Bool} {a : α}
    (hN₁ : ∀ u, u.length = n a → (N₁ (a, u)).length = n a)
    (hN₂ : ∀ u, u.length = n a → (N₂ (a, u)).length = n a) (u : Vertex (n a)) :
    (∑ v : Vertex (n a), (undirectedEdge N₁ N₂ a u.1 v.1).toNat) =
      (undirectedEdge N₁ N₂ a u.1 (N₁ (a, u.1))).toNat +
        (undirectedEdge N₁ N₂ a u.1 (N₂ (a, u.1)) && decide (N₂ (a, u.1) ≠ N₁ (a, u.1))).toNat := by
  let v₁ : Vertex (n a) := ⟨N₁ (a, u.1), hN₁ u.1 u.2⟩
  let v₂ : Vertex (n a) := ⟨N₂ (a, u.1), hN₂ u.1 u.2⟩
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ v₁)]
  by_cases h12 : v₂ = v₁
  · have h12_val : N₂ (a, u.1) = N₁ (a, u.1) := congrArg Subtype.val h12
    have hzero : ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.erase v₁, (undirectedEdge N₁ N₂ a u.1 v.1).toNat = 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun v hv => ?_
      have hne : v.1 ≠ N₁ (a, u.1) := fun h => (Finset.mem_erase.1 hv).1 (Subtype.ext h)
      cases he : undirectedEdge N₁ N₂ a u.1 v.1
      · rfl
      · rcases eq_or_eq_of_undirectedEdge he with h | h
        · exact (hne h).elim
        · exact (hne (h.trans h12_val)).elim
    simp [hzero, h12_val, v₁]
  · have hv₂_mem : v₂ ∈ Finset.univ.erase v₁ :=
      Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨h12, Finset.mem_univ v₂⟩
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hv₂_mem]
    have hzero : ∑ v ∈ (Finset.univ.erase v₁).erase v₂,
        (undirectedEdge N₁ N₂ a u.1 v.1).toNat = 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun v hv => ?_
      have hne₂ : v.1 ≠ N₂ (a, u.1) := fun h => (Finset.mem_erase.1 hv).1 (Subtype.ext h)
      have hne₁ : v.1 ≠ N₁ (a, u.1) :=
        fun h => (Finset.mem_erase.1 (Finset.mem_erase.1 hv).2).1 (Subtype.ext h)
      cases he : undirectedEdge N₁ N₂ a u.1 v.1
      · rfl
      · rcases eq_or_eq_of_undirectedEdge he with h | h
        · exact (hne₁ h).elim
        · exact (hne₂ h).elim
    have h12_val : N₂ (a, u.1) ≠ N₁ (a, u.1) := fun h => h12 (Subtype.ext h)
    simp [hzero, h12_val, v₁, v₂]

private theorem even_sum_undirectedEdge (n : α → ℕ) (N₁ N₂ : α × List Bool → List Bool) (a : α) :
    (∑ u : Vertex (n a), ∑ v : Vertex (n a), (undirectedEdge N₁ N₂ a u.1 v.1).toNat) % 2 = 0 := by
  let g (u v : Vertex (n a)) : ℕ :=
    if binaryValue u.1 < binaryValue v.1 then (undirectedEdge N₁ N₂ a u.1 v.1).toNat else 0
  have hpt (u v : Vertex (n a)) :
      (undirectedEdge N₁ N₂ a u.1 v.1).toNat = g u v + g v u := by
    by_cases huv : u = v
    · subst huv
      simp [g]
    · have hbv : binaryValue u.1 ≠ binaryValue v.1 := fun h =>
        huv (Subtype.ext (binaryValue_injective_of_length_eq (u.2.trans v.2.symm) h))
      have hcomm := undirectedEdge_comm N₁ N₂ a u.1 v.1
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hbv with hlt | hgt
      · have hnot : ¬binaryValue v.1 < binaryValue u.1 := Nat.not_lt.2 hlt.le
        simp [g, hlt, hnot]
      · have hnot : ¬binaryValue u.1 < binaryValue v.1 := Nat.not_lt.2 hgt.le
        simp [g, hgt, hnot, hcomm]
  have hsum : (∑ u : Vertex (n a), ∑ v : Vertex (n a), (undirectedEdge N₁ N₂ a u.1 v.1).toNat) =
      2 * ∑ u : Vertex (n a), ∑ v : Vertex (n a), g u v := by
    simp_rw [hpt, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun u v => g v u), Nat.two_mul]
  rw [hsum, Nat.mul_mod_right]

    obtain ⟨k, State, hfinite, machine, c, d, heval, hhalt⟩ := hprogram.exists_halting_machine
    refine ⟨d, c * 2 ^ d, c, k, State, hfinite, machine,
      MultiTapePTM.DecidesWithBoundedErrorInTime.mono (t := fun a => c * ((enc a).length + 1) ^ d)

/-- **A problem in `BP·⊕P` is one bit of a `#P` value**: for a problem decided with bounded error,
using random strings of length `R = p (enc a).length`, by the parity of a verifier's number of
witnesses, some function in `#P` has bit `R + 1` set exactly at the members of the problem. -/
theorem exists_SharpP_testBit_of_mem_BPOp_ParityP {L : Set α}
    (hL : L ∈ BPOp enc (ParityP (encPair enc encBits))) :
    ∃ f ∈ SharpP enc, ∃ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∀ a, a ∈ L ↔ (f a).testBit (p.eval (enc a).length) := by
  obtain ⟨ρ, L', hL'P, hdec⟩ := hL
  obtain ⟨ζ, V, hV, hL'⟩ := mem_ParityP.1 hL'P
  -- the witnesses of a pair of an instance and a random string have length `Zp`
  set Zp : Polynomial ℕ := ζ.comp (2 * Polynomial.X + 1 + ρ) with hZp
  set pF : Polynomial ℕ := (ρ + 1) + ((ρ + 1) + (ρ + (ρ + 1) * Zp)) + 1 + 1 with hpF
  have hV' := hV.tidy
  refine ⟨fun a => acceptCount (fun x => sharpTest (fun r z => V ((x.1, r), z))
      (ρ.eval (enc x.1).length) (Zp.eval (enc x.1).length) x.2) a (pF.eval (enc a).length),
    ⟨pF, _, .of_tidy (by fun_prop), fun _ => rfl⟩, ρ + 1, fun a => ?_⟩
  have hpFn : pF.eval (enc a).length = (ρ.eval (enc a).length + 1) +
      ((ρ.eval (enc a).length + 1) + (ρ.eval (enc a).length +
        (ρ.eval (enc a).length + 1) * Zp.eval (enc a).length)) + 1 + 1 := by
    simp only [hpF, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_one]
  have hZlen (r : List Bool) (hr : r.length = ρ.eval (enc a).length) :
      ζ.eval (encPair enc encBits (a, r)).length = Zp.eval (enc a).length := by
    rw [length_encPair, hZp, Polynomial.eval_comp]
    simp [hr]
  obtain ⟨hyes, hno⟩ := hdec a
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, decide_eq_false_iff_not, hL',
    hZlen _ List.length_ofFn] at hyes hno
  simp only
  rw [acceptCount_congr (W := fun x => sharpTest (fun r z => V ((a, r), z)) (ρ.eval (enc a).length)
    (Zp.eval (enc a).length) x.2) (fun w => rfl), hpFn, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_one]
  generalize ρ.eval (enc a).length = R at hyes hno ⊢
  generalize Zp.eval (enc a).length = Z at hyes hno ⊢
  unfold acceptCount
  rw [testBit_card_filter_sharpTest, decide_eq_true_iff]
  -- bounded error decides the majority
  have hsplit := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (Fin R → Bool)))
    (fun r => Odd (acceptCount V (a, List.ofFn r) Z))
  simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin] at hsplit
  have hpos : 1 ≤ 2 ^ R := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  change a ∈ L ↔ 2 ^ R < 2 * (univ.filter fun r : Fin R → Bool =>
    Odd (acceptCount V (a, List.ofFn r) Z)).card
  exact ⟨fun ha => by have := hyes ha; omega,
    fun hlt => by by_contra ha; have := hno ha; omega⟩

private theorem sum_unaryTest (K : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∑ kb : Fin K → Bool, (if unaryTest K (List.ofFn kb) then F ((List.ofFn kb).count true) else 0) =
      ∑ i ∈ range K, F (i + 1) := by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  set u : ℕ → Fin K → Bool := fun k i => decide ((i : ℕ) < k) with hu
  have hcount (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ K) : (List.ofFn (u k)).count true = k := by
    rw [hu, BitString.ofFn_decide_lt hk]
    simp [List.count_replicate]
  have himage : (univ.filter fun kb : Fin K → Bool => unaryTest K (List.ofFn kb) = true) =
      (range K).image fun i => u (i + 1) := by
    ext kb
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image, mem_range, unaryTest, Bool.and_eq_true,
      decide_eq_true_eq, beq_iff_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hpos, hkb⟩
      have hle : (List.ofFn kb).count true ≤ K := (List.count_le_length).trans (by simp)
      refine ⟨(List.ofFn kb).count true - 1, by omega, ?_⟩
      apply List.ofFn_injective
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hpos, hu, BitString.ofFn_decide_lt hle, ← hkb]
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      rw [hcount _ (by omega)]
      exact ⟨by omega, by rw [hu, BitString.ofFn_decide_lt (by omega)]⟩
  rw [himage, Finset.sum_image]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
    rw [hcount _ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (mem_range.1 hi))]
  · intro i hi j hj h
    simp only [coe_range, Set.mem_Iio] at hi hj
    have := congrArg (fun kb => (List.ofFn kb).count true) h
    simp only at this
    rw [hcount _ (by omega), hcount _ (by omega)] at this
    omega

theorem card_filter_countingTest (accept : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (K R Z : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter fun w : Fin (K + (K + (R + K * Z))) → Bool =>
      countingTest accept K R Z (List.ofFn w) = true).card =
      ∑ i ∈ range K, parityCoeff K i * ∑ r : Fin R → Bool,
        ((univ.filter fun z : Fin Z → Bool =>
          accept (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn z) = true).card).choose (i + 1) := by
  classical
  -- the raw count after a selector of `k`
  set C : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => (univ.filter fun w : Fin (K + (R + K * Z)) → Bool =>
    coeffTest K k ((List.ofFn w).take K) = true ∧
      subsetTest (accept (((List.ofFn w).drop K).take R)) K Z k ((List.ofFn w).drop (K + R)) =
        true).card with hC
  have h1 := BitString.card_filter_ofFn_add K (K + (R + K * Z))
    (fun u v => countingTest accept K R Z (u ++ v) = true)
  simp only [List.take_append_drop] at h1
  rw [h1]
  have h2 (kb : Fin K → Bool) : (univ.filter fun w : Fin (K + (R + K * Z)) → Bool =>
      countingTest accept K R Z (List.ofFn kb ++ List.ofFn w) = true).card =
      if unaryTest K (List.ofFn kb) then C ((List.ofFn kb).count true) else 0 := by
    have hlen : (List.ofFn kb).length = K := List.length_ofFn
    have hw (w : List Bool) : countingTest accept K R Z (List.ofFn kb ++ w) =
        (unaryTest K (List.ofFn kb) && (coeffTest K ((List.ofFn kb).count true) (w.take K) &&
          subsetTest (accept ((w.drop K).take R)) K Z ((List.ofFn kb).count true)
            (w.drop (K + R)))) := by
      simp only [countingTest, List.take_left' hlen, Bool.and_assoc]
      rw [show K + K + R = K + (K + R) by omega, ← List.drop_drop, List.drop_left' hlen,
        ← List.drop_drop, List.drop_left' hlen]
    simp only [hw]
    by_cases hu : unaryTest K (List.ofFn kb) = true
    · simp only [hu, ↓reduceIte, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, hC]
    · simp [hu]
  simp only [h2]
  rw [sum_unaryTest]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  have hiK : i < K := by simpa using hi
  exact (card_filter_coeff_and_subsetTest accept (by omega) (by omega)).trans
    (by rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel])

theorem IsRandomParityRep.exists {ℓ m ρ ζ e : Polynomial ℕ} {W : α × List Bool → Bool}
    {P : α → List Bool → Prop} (h : IsRandomParityRep enc (ℓ + m) (e + m + 1) ρ ζ W P) :
    IsRandomParityRep enc ℓ e (ρ + 4 * (e + 1) * (m + 3) * ((m + 2) * (m + 1)))
      (4 * (e + 1) * (m + 3) * (m + ζ + 1) + 1) (existsVerifier enc ℓ m ρ ζ e W)
      (fun a u => ∃ w, w.length = m.eval (enc a).length ∧ P a (u ++ w)) := by
  classical
  intro a u hu
  set n := (enc a).length with hn
  set M := m.eval n with hM
  set R := ρ.eval n with hR
  set Z := ζ.eval n with hZ
  set E := e.eval n with hE
  set T := 4 * (E + 1) * (M + 3) with hT
  set B := (M + 2) * (M + 1) with hB
  have hρ : (ρ + 4 * (e + 1) * (m + 3) * ((m + 2) * (m + 1))).eval n = R + T * B := by
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_ofNat,
      Polynomial.eval_one, hT, hB, hM, hE, hR]
  have hζ : (4 * (e + 1) * (m + 3) * (m + ζ + 1) + 1).eval n = T * (M + Z + 1) + 1 := by
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_ofNat,
      Polynomial.eval_one, hT, hM, hE, hZ]
  rw [hρ, hζ]
  -- the set of strings `w` satisfying the inner predicate
  set S := univ.filter fun x : Fin M → Bool => P a (u ++ List.ofFn x) with hS
  have hQ : (∃ w : List Bool, w.length = M ∧ P a (u ++ w)) ↔ S.Nonempty :=
    ⟨fun ⟨w, hw, hP⟩ => ⟨BitString.ofList M w, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, by
      rwa [BitString.ofFn_ofList hw]⟩⟩,
     fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => ⟨List.ofFn x, List.length_ofFn, (mem_filter.1 hx).2⟩⟩
  have hbad := two_pow_mul_card_filter_not_odd_iff_le (B := B) (E := E) (e' := E + M + 1)
    (fun r x => acceptCount (fun y => W (y.1, u ++ List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn r ++ y.2)) a Z) S
    (fun x => by
      simpa only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_one, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, hS]
        using h a (u ++ List.ofFn x) (by simp [hu, hn, hM]))
    le_rfl le_rfl
  rw [pow_add]
  refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ hbad
  congr 1
  -- random strings of length `R + T B` are pairs of an inner random string and `T` seeds
  let eqv : (Fin R → Bool) × (Fin T → BitString B) ≃ (Fin (R + T * B) → Bool) :=
    (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl _) BitString.blocksEquiv.symm).trans (Fin.appendEquiv R (T * B))
  refine Finset.card_equiv eqv.symm fun r' => ?_
  obtain ⟨⟨r, s⟩, rfl⟩ := eqv.surjective r'
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have : eqv (r, s) = Fin.append r (BitString.blocksEquiv.symm s) := rfl
  rw [this, acceptCount_existsVerifier ℓ m ρ ζ e W a u hu rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl r,
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply, hQ]

/-! ### Alternating quantifiers -/

/-- **Alternating quantifiers are represented with every error.** For a polynomial-time verifier
`V` and certificate lengths `ps`, the alternating quantifiers over `ps` applied to `V (a, u ++ ·)`
have a polynomial-time random parity representation at every prefix length `ℓ` with every error
`2 ^ (-e)`. -/

theorem exists_isRandomParityRep_alternation {V : α × List Bool → Bool}
    (hV : ComputableInPolyTime V (encPair enc encBits) encBool) (ps : List (Polynomial ℕ)) :
    ∀ (q : Bool) (ℓ e : Polynomial ℕ), ∃ (ρ ζ : Polynomial ℕ) (W : α × List Bool → Bool),
      ComputableInPolyTime W (encPair enc encBits) encBool ∧
      IsRandomParityRep enc ℓ e ρ ζ W fun a u =>
        Alternation q (ps.map fun p => p.eval (enc a).length) fun w => V (a, u ++ w) = true := by
  have hV := hV.tidy
  have this : ∀ (q : Bool) (ℓ e : Polynomial ℕ), ∃ (ρ ζ : Polynomial ℕ) (W : α × List Bool → Bool),
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime W (encPair enc encBits) encBool ∧ IsRandomParityRep enc ℓ e ρ ζ W
      fun a u => Alternation q (ps.map fun p => p.eval (enc a).length) fun w => V (a, u ++ w) =
      true := by
    induction ps with
    | nil =>
      intro q ℓ e
      refine ⟨0, 0, _, by fun_prop, (isRandomParityRep_base ℓ e V).congr fun a u _ => ?_⟩
      simp
    | cons p ps ih =>
      intro q ℓ e
      cases q
      · -- `∀ w, P (u ++ w)` is `¬∃ w, ¬P (u ++ w)`
        obtain ⟨ρ, ζ, W, hW, h⟩ := ih true (ℓ + p) (e + p + 1)
        refine ⟨_, _, _, computableTidilyInPolyTime_notVerifier _ _
          (computableTidilyInPolyTime_existsVerifier ℓ p ρ (ζ + 1) e
            (computableTidilyInPolyTime_notVerifier _ _ hW)), (h.not.exists.not).congr
            fun a u _ => ?_⟩
        simp only [List.map_cons, alternation_false_cons, List.append_assoc, not_exists, not_and,
          not_not]
      · obtain ⟨ρ, ζ, W, hW, h⟩ := ih false (ℓ + p) (e + p + 1)
        refine ⟨_, _, _, computableTidilyInPolyTime_existsVerifier ℓ p ρ ζ e hW, h.exists.congr
          fun a u _ => ?_⟩
        simp only [List.map_cons, alternation_true_cons, List.append_assoc]
  simpa only [computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] using this
