theorem hasKernel_of_mem_FPT [Nonempty α] (hA : A ∈ FPT enc κ) : HasKernel enc κ A := by
  by_cases hy : ∃ y, y ∈ A
  swap
  · simp only [not_exists] at hy
    exact hasKernel_of_forall (Classical.arbitrary α) fun a =>
      ⟨fun h => absurd h (hy a), fun h => absurd h (hy _)⟩
  by_cases hn : ∃ n, n ∉ A
  swap
  · simp only [not_exists, not_not] at hn
    exact hasKernel_of_forall (Classical.arbitrary α) fun a => ⟨fun _ => hn _, fun _ => hn a⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hyA⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨n, hnA⟩ := hn
  obtain ⟨f, e, c, t, s, ht, k, State, hfin, tm, htm⟩ := hA
  have ht' : ∀ a, t a ≤ c * (f (κ a) * ((enc a).length + 1) ^ e) + c := fun a => by
    have := ht a
    dsimp only at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  have : Fintype State := Fintype.ofFinite State
  let eS : State ↪ ℕ := (Fintype.equivFin State).toEmbedding.trans Fin.valEmbedding
  -- the clock, in unary
  let N : α → ℕ := fun a => (c + 1) * ((enc a).length + 1) ^ (e + 1)
  -- the clocked run of the decider
  let r : α → List ℕ × Bool := fun a => universal (desc eS eBit tm, (enc a).map eBit, N a)
  let K : α → α := fun a => if Diagonal.verdict (r a) then (if (r a).2 then n else a) else y
  -- polynomial time
  have hN : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime N enc encUnary := by
    have hL := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc
    have hS : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => (enc a).length + 1) enc encUnary :=
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_add.comp (hL.prod (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 1))
    have hP := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_pow (e + 1)).comp hS
    exact ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_mul.comp
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const (c + 1)).prod hP)
  have hin : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => (desc eS eBit tm, (enc a).map eBit, N a)) enc
      (encPair eDesc (encPair (encList encUnary) encUnary)) :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const _).prod
      ((Universal.computableTidilyInDegree_map_eBit.computableTidilyInPolyTime.comp
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encode enc)).prod hN)
  have hr : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime r enc eOut := computableTidilyInPolyTime_universal.comp hin
  have hverdict : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime Diagonal.verdict eOut encBool :=
    Diagonal.computableInO_verdict.tidy.computableTidilyInPolyTime
      (.of_forall_le 1 2 fun _ => by simp) (.of_forall_le 1 1 fun _ => by simp)
  have hK : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime K enc enc :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.ite' (hverdict.comp hr)
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.ite'
        ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd (encList encUnary) encBool).comp hr)
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const n) ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id')
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const y)
  -- the behaviour of the clocked run
  have hrun : ∀ a, (K a = y ∧ a ∈ A) ∨ (K a = n ∧ a ∉ A) ∨
      (K a = a ∧ (enc a).length < f (κ a)) := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨hcomp, hrt, -⟩ := htm a
    obtain ⟨h, hht, hh⟩ := exists_haltsAt_of_runsInTime hrt
    have hr_eq : r a = ((tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg (enc a)) (N a)).output.map eBit,
        (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg (enc a)) (N a)).state.isNone) :=
      universal_desc eS eBit tm (enc a) (N a)
    by_cases hhN : h ≤ N a
    · have hrN := hh.runFrom_eq hhN
      have hhalt : (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg (enc a)) (N a)).state = none := by
        rw [hrN]
        exact hh.halted
      have hout : (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg (enc a)) (N a)).output = [indicator A a] := by
        rw [hrN]
        exact output_haltsAt hcomp hh
      rw [hout, hhalt] at hr_eq
      by_cases haA : a ∈ A
      · left
        have hi : indicator A a = true := by simp [indicator, haA]
        refine ⟨?_, haA⟩
        simp only [K, hr_eq, hi, Diagonal.verdict]
        simp
      · right; left
        have hi : indicator A a = false := by simp [indicator, haA]
        refine ⟨?_, haA⟩
        simp only [K, hr_eq, hi, Diagonal.verdict]
        simp [eBit]
    · right; right
      have hnot : (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg (enc a)) (N a)).state.isNone = false := by
        rw [Option.isNone_eq_false_iff, Option.isSome_iff_ne_none]

theorem hasPolyKernel_of_mem_P [Nonempty α] (hA : A ∈ P enc) : HasPolyKernel enc κ A := by
  have hconst : ∀ a₀ : α, (∀ a, a ∈ A ↔ a₀ ∈ A) → HasPolyKernel enc κ A := fun a₀ h =>
    ⟨fun _ => a₀, fun _ => (enc a₀).length + κ a₀, polynomiallyBounded_const _,
      ⟨.const a₀, fun a => (h a).symm, fun _ => Nat.le_add_right _ _,
        fun _ => Nat.le_add_left _ _⟩⟩
  by_cases hy : ∃ y, y ∈ A
  swap
  · simp only [not_exists] at hy
    exact hconst (Classical.arbitrary α) fun a =>
      ⟨fun h => absurd h (hy a), fun h => absurd h (hy _)⟩
  by_cases hn : ∃ n, n ∉ A
  swap
  · simp only [not_exists, not_not] at hn
    exact hconst (Classical.arbitrary α) fun a => ⟨fun _ => hn _, fun _ => hn a⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hyA⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨n, hnA⟩ := hn
  obtain ⟨dec, hdec, hdecA⟩ := hA
  refine ⟨fun a => if dec a then y else n,
    fun _ => (enc y).length + (enc n).length + κ y + κ n, polynomiallyBounded_const _,
    ⟨by fun_prop, fun a => ?_, fun a => ?_, fun a => ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [hdecA a]
    cases dec a
    · exact iff_of_false hnA Bool.false_ne_true
    · exact iff_of_true hyA rfl
  all_goals split_ifs <;> omega

theorem length_active_le {S : Finset ℕ}
    (hS : ∀ u ∈ x.1.1, ∀ v ∈ x.1.1, x.1.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v → u ∈ S ∨ v ∈ S)

  have hT : T.card ≤ x.2 := (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans hcard
  have hdeg : ∀ u ∈ T, (neighbors x.1 u).card ≤ x.2 := fun u hu => by
    have h := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2
    simp only [isHigh, decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_lt, cap_eq] at h
    rw [card_neighbors]
    omega
  have hsub : (active x).toFinset ⊆ T ∪ T.biUnion (neighbors x.1) := fun v hv => by
    obtain ⟨hvlow, u, hulow, hadj⟩ := (mem_active x).1 (List.mem_toFinset.1 hv)
    obtain ⟨hv, hvhigh⟩ := (mem_low x).1 hvlow
    obtain ⟨hu, huhigh⟩ := (mem_low x).1 hulow
    rcases hS v hv u hu hadj with hvS | huS
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hvS, hvhigh⟩)
    · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_biUnion.2
        ⟨u, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨huS, huhigh⟩, mem_neighbors.2 ⟨hv, hadj.symm⟩⟩)
  rw [← List.toFinset_card_of_nodup (nodup_active x)]

    _ ≤ T.card + ∑ u ∈ T, (neighbors x.1 u).card :=
        (Finset.card_union_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left Finset.card_biUnion_le _)
    _ ≤ T.card + T.card * x.2 := Nat.add_le_add_left (Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ hdeg) _

private theorem size_arith {k K : ℕ} (hK : K ≤ k * (k + 2)) :
    2 * (2 * (K * (2 * K + 1)) + 1 + K * K * (2 * (2 * K + 1 + K) + 1)) + 1 + k ≤
      40 * (k + 1) ^ 6 := by
  have ha : K ≤ (k + 1) ^ 2 := hK.trans (by nlinarith)
  have h1 : 1 ≤ (k + 1) ^ 2 := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (Nat.succ_pos k)
  have h2 : K * K ≤ (k + 1) ^ 2 * (k + 1) ^ 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul ha ha
  have h3 : K * K * K ≤ (k + 1) ^ 2 * (k + 1) ^ 2 * (k + 1) ^ 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul h2 ha
  have h4 : (k + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (k + 1) ^ 2 * (k + 1) ^ 2 := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ h1
  have h5 : (k + 1) ^ 2 * (k + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (k + 1) ^ 2 * (k + 1) ^ 2 * (k + 1) ^ 2 :=
    Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ h1
  have h6 : (k + 1) ^ 6 = (k + 1) ^ 2 * (k + 1) ^ 2 * (k + 1) ^ 2 := by ring
  have h7 : 2 * (2 * (K * (2 * K + 1)) + 1 + K * K * (2 * (2 * K + 1 + K) + 1)) + 1 + k =
      12 * (K * K * K) + 14 * (K * K) + 4 * K + 3 + k := by ring
  have h8 : k + 1 ≤ (k + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  rw [h7, h6]
  omega

private theorem evalCode_flatMap (φ : CNF ℕ) (x : List Bool) (hx : x.length = φ.vars.length)
    (steps : List (Literal ℕ × Bool)) (hsteps : ∀ t ∈ steps, t.2 = false → t.1.1 ∈ φ.vars)
    (k : ℕ) (V : List Bool) (s : Bool × Bool) (hV : V.length = φ.vars.length + 3 * k + 3)
    (hx' : x <+: V) (h₁ : V.getD (φ.vars.length + 3 * k + 1) false = s.1)
    (h₂ : V.getD (φ.vars.length + 3 * k + 2) false = s.2) :
    (evalCode interpretation false V ((steps.zipIdx k).flatMap fun s =>
      circuitBlock (φ.vars.length + 3 * s.2) (φ.vars.idxOf s.1.1.1) s.1.1.2 s.1.2)).getD
      (φ.vars.length + 3 * (k + steps.length) + 2) false =
      (steps.foldl (circuitState (assignment φ x)) s).2 := by
  induction steps generalizing k V s with
  | nil =>
    rw [List.zipIdx_nil, List.flatMap_nil, evalCode_nil]
    simpa using h₂
  | cons t steps ih =>
    obtain ⟨⟨v, b⟩, e⟩ := t
    have hsteps' := fun t ht => hsteps t (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ht)
    have hv : e = false → φ.vars.idxOf v < φ.vars.length := fun he =>
      List.idxOf_lt_length_iff.2 (hsteps _ (List.mem_cons_self ..) he)
    rw [List.zipIdx_cons, List.flatMap_cons, evalCode_append, List.foldl_cons, List.length_cons,
      evalCode_circuitBlock V (φ.vars.length + 3 * k) (φ.vars.idxOf v) b e hV
        fun he => by have := hv he; omega,
      show k + (steps.length + 1) = k + 1 + steps.length by ring]
    have hread : e = false → V.getD (φ.vars.idxOf v) false = assignment φ x v := fun he => by
      have h := hv he
      rw [assignment, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by omega), List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by omega),
        hx'.getElem]
    refine ih hsteps' (k + 1) _ _ ?_ (hx'.trans (List.prefix_append _ _)) ?_ ?_
    · cases e <;> simp [hV] <;> omega
    · rw [show φ.vars.length + 3 * (k + 1) + 1 = V.length + 1 by omega,
        List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, h₁]
      cases e
      · have h := hread rfl
        rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at h
        simp [circuitState, h]
      · simp [circuitState]
    · rw [show φ.vars.length + 3 * (k + 1) + 2 = V.length + 2 by omega,
        List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, h₁, h₂]

      ComputableInPolyTime (fun a => (circuits a).code) enc encCode ∧
      ∀ a (x : Fin (n a) → Bool) (j : Fin (m a)),

  have hm := hm.tidy

      (fun a => (circuits a).code) enc encCode ∧ ∀ a (x : Fin (n a) → Bool) (j : Fin (m a)),
      (circuits a).eval interpretation x j = (F (a, List.ofFn x)).getD j.val false := by
    obtain ⟨bits, hbits, hsize, hsem⟩ := exists_uniformOutputBits hn hm hF
    let circuits (a : α) : Circuit signature (n a) (m a) :=
      Circuit.pi (fun j : Fin (m a) => bits a j.val)

      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id' (encIn := enc))

theorem sharpSAT_padMajority (φ : CNF ℕ) (Q : ℕ) :
    SharpSAT (padMajority φ Q) = SharpSAT φ + (2 ^ (Q + φ.vars.toFinset.card) - 2 ^ Q) := by
  let P : Bool × (Fin Q → Bool) × ((shiftOdd φ).vars.toFinset → Bool) → Prop := fun x =>
    if x.1 = false then
      (shiftOdd φ).eval ((shiftOdd φ).extendAssignment x.2.2) = true ∧ x.2.1 = fun _ => false
    else
      x.2.2 ≠ fun _ => false
  have hcount := CNF.modelCount_eq_card_filter (φ := padMajority φ Q)
    (fun σ => (σ 0, fun j : Fin Q => σ (j.1 + j.1 + 2),
      fun v : (shiftOdd φ).vars.toFinset => σ v.1)) P
    (fun σ τ _ _ => ?_) (fun ⟨b, δ, τ⟩ => ?_)
  · rw [SharpSAT, hcount]
    let S_false : Finset (Bool × (Fin Q → Bool) × ((shiftOdd φ).vars.toFinset → Bool)) :=
      {false} ×ˢ (({fun _ : Fin Q => false} : Finset (Fin Q → Bool)) ×ˢ
        (Finset.univ.filter fun τ : (shiftOdd φ).vars.toFinset → Bool =>
          (shiftOdd φ).eval ((shiftOdd φ).extendAssignment τ) = true))
    let S_true : Finset (Bool × (Fin Q → Bool) × ((shiftOdd φ).vars.toFinset → Bool)) :=
      {true} ×ˢ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin Q → Bool)) ×ˢ
        (Finset.univ.erase (fun _ : (shiftOdd φ).vars.toFinset => false)))
    have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter P = S_false ∪ S_true := by
      ext ⟨b, δ, τ⟩
      cases b <;> simp only [P, S_false, S_true, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
        and_true, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_singleton, Finset.mem_erase,
        Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.true_eq_false, ↓reduceIte, false_and, or_false, false_or, ne_eq]
      exact ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h2, h1⟩, fun ⟨h2, h1⟩ => ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
    have hdisj : Disjoint S_false S_true := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      rintro ⟨b, δ, τ⟩ h₁ h₂
      have hb₁ : b = false := Finset.mem_singleton.1 (Finset.mem_product.1 h₁).1
      have hb₂ : b = true := Finset.mem_singleton.1 (Finset.mem_product.1 h₂).1
      exact Bool.false_ne_true (hb₁.symm.trans hb₂)
    have hS_false : S_false.card = SharpSAT φ := by
      simp only [S_false, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_singleton, one_mul]
      rw [← CNF.modelCount, shiftOdd, CNF.modelCount_relabel injective_shiftOdd_fn, ← SharpSAT]
    have hS_true : S_true.card = 2 ^ (Q + φ.vars.toFinset.card) - 2 ^ Q := by
      simp only [S_true, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_singleton, one_mul, Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin,
        Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ _), Fintype.card_coe,
        card_vars_shiftOdd, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.mul_one, ← Nat.pow_add]
    rw [hfilter, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, hS_false, hS_true]
  · simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, funext_iff, Fin.forall_iff, Subtype.forall, List.mem_toFinset]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h0, heven, hodd⟩ v hv
      rcases mem_vars_padMajority.1 hv with rfl | ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ | hv'
      · exact h0
      · exact heven j hj
      · exact hodd v hv'
    · intro h
      refine ⟨h 0 (mem_vars_padMajority.2 (Or.inl rfl)),
        fun j hj => h _ (mem_vars_padMajority.2 (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩))),
        fun v hv => h v (mem_vars_padMajority.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr hv)))⟩
  · simp only [P, Prod.mk.injEq, funext_iff, Fin.forall_iff, Subtype.forall, List.mem_toFinset]
    constructor
    · intro hP
      let σ : ℕ → Bool := fun n =>
        if n = 0 then b
        else if n % 2 = 0 then (if h : n / 2 - 1 < Q then δ ⟨n / 2 - 1, h⟩ else false)
        else (shiftOdd φ).extendAssignment τ n
      have hσ0 : σ 0 = b := rfl
      have hσeven (j : ℕ) (hj : j < Q) : σ (j + j + 2) = δ ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
        change (if j + j + 2 = 0 then b
          else if (j + j + 2) % 2 = 0 then
            if h : (j + j + 2) / 2 - 1 < Q then δ ⟨(j + j + 2) / 2 - 1, h⟩ else false
          else (shiftOdd φ).extendAssignment τ (j + j + 2)) = δ ⟨j, hj⟩
        have h1 : (j + j + 2 = 0) = False := eq_false (by omega)
        have h2 : ((j + j + 2) % 2 = 0) = True := eq_true (by omega)
        have h3 : (j + j + 2) / 2 - 1 = j := by omega
        simp only [h1, h2, h3, hj, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte]
      have hσodd (v : ℕ) (hv : v ∈ (shiftOdd φ).vars) :
          σ v = τ ⟨v, List.mem_toFinset.2 hv⟩ := by
        have hmod := odd_of_mem_vars_shiftOdd hv
        change (if v = 0 then b
          else if v % 2 = 0 then
            if h : v / 2 - 1 < Q then δ ⟨v / 2 - 1, h⟩ else false
          else (shiftOdd φ).extendAssignment τ v) = τ ⟨v, List.mem_toFinset.2 hv⟩
        have h1 : (v = 0) = False := eq_false (by omega)
        have h2 : (v % 2 = 0) = False := eq_false (by omega)
        simp only [h1, h2, ↓reduceIte, CNF.extendAssignment_of_mem _ hv]
      refine ⟨σ, ?_, hσ0, hσeven, hσodd⟩
      rw [eval_padMajority_eq_true_iff, hσ0]
      cases b
      · simp only [↓reduceIte] at hP ⊢
        refine ⟨?_, fun j hj => by rw [hσeven j hj, hP.2 j hj]⟩
        rw [← hP.1]
        exact CNF.eval_congr fun v hv => by rw [hσodd v hv, CNF.extendAssignment_of_mem _ hv]
      · simp only [Bool.true_eq_false, ↓reduceIte, ne_eq, funext_iff, not_forall,
          Bool.not_eq_false] at hP ⊢
        obtain ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, hτv⟩ := hP
        have hv' := List.mem_toFinset.1 hv
        exact ⟨v, hv', by rw [hσodd v hv', hτv]⟩
    · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, rfl, heven, hodd⟩
      rw [eval_padMajority_eq_true_iff] at hσ
      cases h0 : σ 0
      · simp only [h0, ↓reduceIte] at hσ ⊢
        refine ⟨?_, fun j hj => (heven j hj).symm.trans (hσ.2 j hj)⟩
        rw [← hσ.1]
        exact CNF.eval_congr fun v hv => by rw [CNF.extendAssignment_of_mem _ hv, ← hodd v hv]
      · simp only [h0, Bool.true_eq_false, ↓reduceIte, ne_eq, funext_iff, not_forall,
          Bool.not_eq_false] at hσ ⊢
        obtain ⟨v, hv, hσv⟩ := hσ
        exact ⟨⟨v, List.mem_toFinset.2 hv⟩, (hodd v hv).symm.trans hσv⟩

theorem exists_subtype_pairwise_iff {G : Graph} {P : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} {m : ℕ} :
    (∃ S : Finset {v // v ∈ G.1},
        (S : Set {v // v ∈ G.1}).Pairwise (fun u v => P u v) ∧ S.card = m) ↔
      ∃ S : Finset ℕ, (∀ v ∈ S, v ∈ G.1) ∧ (S : Set ℕ).Pairwise P ∧ S.card = m := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨S.map (.subtype _),
      fun v hv => by obtain ⟨u, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.1 hv; exact u.2,
      ?_, Finset.card_map _⟩
    intro u hu v hv huv
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_map] at hu hv
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hv
    exact hS hu hv (Subtype.coe_ne_coe.1 huv)
  · rintro ⟨S, hSV, hS, rfl⟩
    have hmap : (S.subtype (· ∈ G.1)).map (.subtype _) = S :=
      (Finset.subtype_map _).trans (Finset.filter_eq_self.mpr hSV)
    refine ⟨S.subtype (· ∈ G.1), ?_, by rw [← Finset.card_map (.subtype _), hmap]⟩
    intro u hu v hv huv
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_subtype] at hu hv
    exact hS hu hv (Subtype.ext_iff.not.1 huv)

theorem enumeratesBool_eq_true_iff {V p : List ℕ} :
    enumeratesBool V p = true ↔ p.Nodup ∧ ∀ v, v ∈ p ↔ v ∈ V := by
  have hnodup : (∀ e ∈ p.zipIdx, p.idxOf e.1 = e.2) ↔ p.Nodup := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [List.nodup_iff_injective_get]
      rintro ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ hij
      simp only [List.get_eq_getElem] at hij
      have hi' : p.idxOf p[i] = i := h (p[i], i) (List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.2 (by simp))
      have hj' : p.idxOf p[j] = j := h (p[j], j) (List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.2 (by simp))
      rw [hij] at hi'

    · intro hnd e he
      obtain ⟨hlt, heq⟩ := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 (List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.1 he)
      rw [← heq, hnd.idxOf_getElem]
  simp only [enumeratesBool, Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, List.any_eq_true,
    decide_eq_true_eq, hnodup]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hV, hp⟩, hnd⟩
    refine ⟨hnd, fun v => ⟨fun hv => ?_, fun hv => ?_⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hp v hv

    · obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hV v hv

theorem mem_DirHamCycle_cons_iff {G : Graph} {s t : ℕ} (hs : s ∈ G.1)
    (hin : ∀ u, (u, s) ∉ G.2) : (G.1, (t, s) :: G.2) ∈ DirHamCycle ↔ (G, s, t) ∈ DirHamPath := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hnd, hcov, -, hch⟩
    obtain ⟨rest, hq, hnd', hmem'⟩ := exists_rotated_cons ((hcov s).2 hs)
    rw [hq, Cycle.chain_coe_cons] at hch
    have hnd₀ : (s :: rest).Nodup := hnd' ▸ hnd
    have hchain := (List.isChain_append.1 (show (s :: rest ++ [s]).IsChain _ from hch))
    refine ⟨s :: rest, hnd₀, fun v => (hmem' v).trans (hcov v), rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · -- The closing arc enters `s`, so it is the added arc.
      have hlast := hchain.2.2 _ (List.getLast?_eq_some_getLast (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)) s rfl
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hlast with h | h
      · rw [List.getLast?_eq_some_getLast (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)]
        simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        rw [h.1]
      · exact (hin _ h).elim
    · -- No other arc enters `s`, so the path uses only arcs of `G`.
      refine hchain.1.imp_of_mem_tail_imp fun a b _ hb hab => ?_
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hab with h | h
      · simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        rw [h.2, List.tail_cons] at hb
        exact ((List.nodup_cons.1 hnd₀).1 hb).elim
      · exact h
  · rintro ⟨p, hnd, hcov, hhead, hlast, hch⟩
    obtain ⟨rest, rfl⟩ : ∃ rest, p = s :: rest := by
      cases p with
      | nil => simp at hhead
      | cons a rest =>
        simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hhead
        exact ⟨rest, by rw [hhead]⟩
    refine ⟨s :: rest, hnd, hcov, List.cons_ne_nil _ _, ?_⟩
    rw [Cycle.chain_coe_cons, ← List.cons_append]
    refine List.isChain_append.2 ⟨hch.imp fun a b h => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h,
      List.IsChain.singleton _, fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
    rw [hlast, Option.mem_def, Option.some.injEq] at hx
    simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.mem_def, Option.some.injEq] at hy
    rw [← hx, ← hy]
    exact List.mem_cons_self

def splitVertex (G : Graph) (v r : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.pair (G.1.idxOf v) r

/-- The vertex-splitting graph of a directed graph `G`: every declared vertex `v` becomes a path
`in(v) - mid(v) - out(v)`, and every arc `(u, v)` becomes an edge `out(u) - in(v)`. -/

text:
private theorem exists_eq_gadgets {G : Graph} (n : ℕ) : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (v : ℕ), l.length ≤ n →
    l.IsChain G.split.toSimpleGraph.Adj → l.Nodup → (∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ G.split.1) →
    l.head? = some (G.splitVertex v 0) → (∀ u, l.getLast? ≠ some (G.splitVertex u 1)) →
    (∀ u ∈ G.1, G.splitVertex u 0 ∈ l → G.splitVertex u 1 ∈ l) →
    ∃ p, (∀ u ∈ p, u ∈ G.1) ∧ l = gadgets G p := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro l v hlen _ _ _ hhead
    rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff.1 (Nat.le_zero.1 hlen)] at hhead
    simp at hhead
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l v hlen hch hnd hdecl hhead hlast hmid
    obtain ⟨l₁, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.1 hhead
    have hv : v ∈ G.1 := (splitVertex_mem_split_fst_iff.1 (hdecl _ (List.mem_cons_self ..))).1
    have hnd₀ : G.splitVertex v 0 ∉ l₁ := (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd).1
    have hnd₁ : l₁.Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd).2
    have hch₁ : l₁.IsChain G.split.toSimpleGraph.Adj := hch.tail
    -- `mid(v)` lies in `l₁`, at some position `j`.
    have hm : G.splitVertex v 1 ∈ l₁ := by
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 (hmid v hv (List.mem_cons_self ..)) with h | h
      · simp [splitVertex_eq_splitVertex_iff] at h
      · exact h
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hjm⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hm
    -- `mid(v)` is not the last vertex, and its successor is `out(v)`.
    have hj₁ : j + 1 < l₁.length := by
      by_contra h
      apply hlast v
      rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?, List.length_cons, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
        (by omega : l₁.length = j + 1), List.getElem?_cons_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, hjm]
    have hsucc : l₁[j + 1] = G.splitVertex v 2 := by
      rcases eq_of_adj_mid (hjm ▸ hch₁.getElem j hj₁) with h | h
      · exact absurd (h ▸ List.getElem_mem hj₁) hnd₀
      · exact h
    -- The predecessor of `mid(v)` is `in(v)`, so `mid(v)` is the second vertex.
    have hj₀ : j = 0 := by
      rcases j with _ | i
      · rfl
      · rcases eq_of_adj_mid (hjm ▸ (hch₁.getElem i hj).symm) with h | h
        · exact absurd (h ▸ List.getElem_mem _) hnd₀
        · have := hnd₁.getElem_inj_iff.1 (h.trans hsucc.symm)
          omega
    subst hj₀
    obtain ⟨l₂, rfl⟩ : ∃ l₂, l₁ = G.splitVertex v 1 :: G.splitVertex v 2 :: l₂ := by
      rcases l₁ with _ | ⟨b, _ | ⟨c, l₂⟩⟩
      · simp at hj
      · simp at hj₁
      · exact ⟨l₂, by rw [← hjm, ← hsucc]; rfl⟩
    rcases l₂ with _ | ⟨x, l₃⟩
    · exact ⟨[v], by simpa using hv, rfl⟩
    -- The vertex after `out(v)` is the entry of an out-neighbour `w` of `v`.
    rcases eq_of_adj_out hv (List.isChain_cons_cons.1 hch₁.tail).1 with rfl | ⟨w, -, rfl⟩
    · simp at hnd₁
    have hmid' : ∀ u ∈ G.1, G.splitVertex u 0 ∈ G.splitVertex w 0 :: l₃ →
        G.splitVertex u 1 ∈ G.splitVertex w 0 :: l₃ := by
      intro u hu hu0
      rcases List.mem_append.1 (show G.splitVertex u 1 ∈
          [G.splitVertex v 0, G.splitVertex v 1, G.splitVertex v 2] ++ (G.splitVertex w 0 :: l₃)
          from hmid u hu (List.mem_append_right
            [G.splitVertex v 0, G.splitVertex v 1, G.splitVertex v 2] hu0)) with h | h
      · obtain ⟨r, -, h⟩ := mem_triple.1 h
        rw [splitVertex_eq_splitVertex_iff.2 ⟨(splitVertex_eq_splitVertex_iff.1 h).1, rfl⟩] at hu0
        exact absurd (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu0)) hnd₀
      · exact h
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hl⟩ := ih (G.splitVertex w 0 :: l₃) w
      (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen ⊢; omega) hch₁.tail.tail hnd₁.of_cons.of_cons
      (fun y hy => hdecl y (by simp [hy])) rfl
      (fun u => by simpa only [List.getLast?_cons_cons] using hlast u) hmid'
    exact ⟨v :: p, List.forall_mem_cons.2 ⟨hv, hp⟩, by rw [gadgets_cons, ← hl]⟩

theorem split_mem_HamCycle_iff (G : Graph) : G.split ∈ HamCycle ↔ G ∈ DirHamCycle := by
  rw [mem_HamCycle_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hnd, hcov, hlen, hch⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_length_pos (by omega : 0 < q.length)
    obtain ⟨u, hu, -⟩ := mem_split_fst_iff.1 ((hcov x).1 hx)
    obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := List.append_of_mem
      ((hcov _).2 (splitVertex_mem_split_fst_iff.2 ⟨hu, (by omega : 0 < 3)⟩))
    -- Rotations and reversals preserve the hypotheses.
    have key : ∀ L : List ℕ, L ~r (A ++ G.splitVertex u 0 :: B) ∨
        L ~r (A ++ G.splitVertex u 0 :: B).reverse →
        L.Nodup ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ L ↔ x ∈ G.split.1) ∧ 3 ≤ L.length ∧
          (L : Cycle ℕ).Chain G.split.toSimpleGraph.Adj := by
      rintro L (h | h)
      · exact ⟨h.nodup_iff.2 hnd, fun x => h.mem_iff.trans (hcov x), h.perm.length_eq ▸ hlen,
          (Cycle.coe_eq_coe.2 h) ▸ hch⟩
      · refine ⟨h.nodup_iff.2 (List.nodup_reverse.2 hnd),
          fun x => h.mem_iff.trans (List.mem_reverse.trans (hcov x)), ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [h.perm.length_eq, List.length_reverse]
          exact hlen
        · rw [Cycle.coe_eq_coe.2 h, chain_reverse_coe (fun _ _ h => h.symm)]
          exact hch
    -- Rotate to start at `in(u)`, and reverse if the cycle then ends at `mid(u)`.
    obtain ⟨L₁, hL, hlast⟩ : ∃ L₁ : List ℕ,
        ((G.splitVertex u 0 :: L₁) ~r (A ++ G.splitVertex u 0 :: B) ∨
          (G.splitVertex u 0 :: L₁) ~r (A ++ G.splitVertex u 0 :: B).reverse) ∧
        ((G.splitVertex u 0 :: L₁).getLast? ≠ some (G.splitVertex u 1) ∨
          ∃ L₂, L₁ = G.splitVertex u 1 :: L₂) := by
      have hrot : (G.splitVertex u 0 :: (B ++ A)) ~r (A ++ G.splitVertex u 0 :: B) :=
        (List.isRotated_append (l := A) (l' := G.splitVertex u 0 :: B)).symm
      by_cases h : (G.splitVertex u 0 :: (B ++ A)).getLast? = some (G.splitVertex u 1)
      · obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.1 h
        obtain ⟨M', rfl⟩ : ∃ M', M = G.splitVertex u 0 :: M' := by
          rcases M with _ | ⟨a, M'⟩
          · simp [splitVertex_eq_splitVertex_iff] at hM
          · simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at hM
            exact ⟨M', by rw [hM.1]⟩
        refine ⟨G.splitVertex u 1 :: M'.reverse, Or.inr ?_, Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩⟩
        have := hrot.reverse
        rw [hM] at this
        refine List.IsRotated.trans ?_ this
        simp only [List.cons_append, List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_nil,
          List.nil_append]
        exact List.isRotated_append (l := [G.splitVertex u 0])
          (l' := G.splitVertex u 1 :: M'.reverse)
      · exact ⟨B ++ A, Or.inl hrot, Or.inl h⟩
    obtain ⟨hndL, hcovL, hlenL, hchC⟩ := key _ hL
    have hchL := hchC
    rw [Cycle.chain_coe_cons, ← List.cons_append, List.isChain_append] at hchL
    obtain ⟨hchL, -, hclose⟩ := hchL
    -- The cycle does not end at a middle vertex.
    have hlast' : ∀ w, (G.splitVertex u 0 :: L₁).getLast? ≠ some (G.splitVertex w 1) := by
      intro w hw
      rcases eq_of_adj_mid (hclose _ hw _ rfl) with h | h
      · rw [splitVertex_eq_splitVertex_iff.2 ⟨(splitVertex_eq_splitVertex_iff.1 h).1.symm, rfl⟩]
          at hw
        rcases hlast with hlast | ⟨L₂, rfl⟩
        · exact hlast hw
        · obtain ⟨b, L₃, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (by rintro rfl; simp at hlenL :
            L₂ ≠ [])
          rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons, List.getLast?_cons_cons] at hw
          exact (List.nodup_cons.1 (List.nodup_cons.1 hndL).2).1 (List.mem_of_getLast? hw)
      · simp [splitVertex_eq_splitVertex_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hL⟩ := exists_eq_gadgets _ _ u le_rfl hchL hndL (fun x hx => (hcovL x).1 hx)
      rfl hlast' (fun w hw _ => (hcovL _).2 (splitVertex_mem_split_fst_iff.2 ⟨hw, by omega⟩))
    rw [hL] at hndL hcovL hchC
    refine ⟨p, (nodup_gadgets_iff hp).1 hndL, forall_mem_iff_of_mem_gadgets_iff hp hcovL, ?_,
      (chain_gadgets_iff hp).1 hchC⟩
    rintro rfl
    simp [gadgets_nil] at hL
  · rintro ⟨p, hnd, hcov, hne, hch⟩
    have hp : ∀ v ∈ p, v ∈ G.1 := fun v hv => (hcov v).1 hv
    refine ⟨gadgets G p, (nodup_gadgets_iff hp).2 hnd, mem_gadgets_iff_of_forall_mem_iff hcov, ?_,
      (chain_gadgets_iff hp).2 hch⟩
    rw [length_gadgets]
    have := List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hne
    omega

theorem toIndependentSet_mem_iff (φ : CNF ℕ) : toIndependentSet φ ∈ IndependentSet ↔ φ ∈ SAT := by
  rw [mem_IndependentSet_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S, hSV, hS⟩
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_card_add_countUnsat_le hSV hS.isIndepSet
    have hcard : S.card = φ.length := hS.card_eq
    exact ⟨σ, CNF.countUnsat_eq_zero_iff.1 (by omega)⟩
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ⟩
    have hcl : ∀ i : Fin φ.length, ∃ j : Fin φ[i].length, σ φ[i][j].1 = φ[i][j].2 := by
      intro i
      obtain ⟨l, hl, hσl⟩ := (Clause.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).1
        ((CNF.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).1 hσ φ[i] (List.getElem_mem i.2))
      obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hl
      exact ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, hσl⟩
    choose J hJ using hcl
    let o : Fin φ.length → Occurrence ℕ := fun i => (i, J i, φ[i][J i])
    have ho : ∀ i, o i ∈ occurrences φ := fun i => mem_occurrences.2 ⟨i.2, (J i).2, rfl⟩
    have hoinj : Function.Injective fun i => (o i).vertex := by
      intro i i' h
      simp only [o, Occurrence.vertex, Nat.pair_eq_pair] at h
      exact Fin.ext h.1
    refine ⟨Finset.univ.image fun i => (o i).vertex, fun v hv => ?_, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hv
      simp only [toIndependentSet, List.mem_map]
      exact ⟨o i, ho i, rfl⟩
    · intro u hu w hw huw hadj
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hu
      obtain ⟨i', -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hw
      have hii' : i ≠ i' := fun h => huw (by rw [h])
      rcases (adj_toIndependentSet_iff (ho i) (ho i')).1 hadj with ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨hx, hb⟩
      · exact hii' (Fin.ext h)
      · have h₁ := hJ i
        have h₂ := hJ i'
        simp only [o] at hx hb
        rw [hx] at h₁
        exact hb (h₁.symm.trans h₂)
    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hoinj, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      rfl

private theorem mem_of_satisfiable (h : φ.Satisfiable) :
    toSparseIndependentSet φ ∈ IndependentSet := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := h
  have hcl : ∀ i : Fin φ.length, ∃ j : Fin φ[i].length, σ φ[i][j].1 = φ[i][j].2 := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hσl⟩ := (Clause.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).1
      ((CNF.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).1 hσ φ[i] (List.getElem_mem i.2))
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hl
    exact ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, hσl⟩
  choose J hJ using hcl
  set L : Finset ℕ := (φ.distinctVars.map fun x => literalVertex φ (x, σ x)).toFinset
  set O : Finset ℕ := Finset.univ.image fun i : Fin φ.length => occurrenceVertex i (J i)
  have hL : ∀ {v}, v ∈ L ↔ ∃ x ∈ φ.vars, v = literalVertex φ (x, σ x) := by
    intro v
    simp only [L, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map, CNF.mem_distinctVars]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨x, hx, he⟩ => ⟨x, hx, he.symm⟩, fun ⟨x, hx, he⟩ => ⟨x, hx, he.symm⟩⟩
  have hO : ∀ {v}, v ∈ O ↔ ∃ i : Fin φ.length, v = occurrenceVertex i (J i) := by
    intro v
    simp only [O, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨i, he⟩ => ⟨i, he.symm⟩, fun ⟨i, he⟩ => ⟨i, he.symm⟩⟩
  rw [mem_IndependentSet_iff]
  refine ⟨L ∪ O, fun v hv => ?_, ⟨fun u hu v hv huv hadj => ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · change v ∈ vertices φ
    rcases Finset.mem_union.1 hv with hv | hv
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hL.1 hv
      exact mem_vertices.2 (Or.inl ⟨x, hx, σ x, rfl⟩)
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hO.1 hv
      exact mem_vertices.2 (Or.inr ⟨i, i.2, J i, (J i).2, rfl⟩)
  · -- no edge joins two vertices of the set
    have key : ∀ u ∈ L ∪ O, ∀ v ∈ L ∪ O, u ≠ v → (u, v) ∉ edges φ := by
      intro u hu v hv huv he
      simp only [edges, List.mem_append] at he
      rcases he with (he | he) | he
      · obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := mem_literalEdges.1 he
        simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at he
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := he
        rcases Finset.mem_union.1 hu with hu | hu
        · rcases Finset.mem_union.1 hv with hv | hv
          · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyu⟩ := hL.1 hu
            obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := hL.1 hv
            rw [literalVertex_inj hx] at hyu hzv
            obtain ⟨rfl, h₁⟩ := hyu
            obtain ⟨rfl, h₂⟩ := hzv
            exact Bool.noConfusion (h₁.trans h₂.symm)
          · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hO.1 hv
            exact literalVertex_ne_occurrenceVertex _ _ _ hi
        · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hO.1 hu
          exact literalVertex_ne_occurrenceVertex _ _ _ hi
      · obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, j', hj', he⟩ := mem_cliqueEdges.1 he
        simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at he
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := he
        have hocc : ∀ {k}, occurrenceVertex i k ∈ L ∪ O → k = J ⟨i, hi⟩ := fun hk => by
          rcases Finset.mem_union.1 hk with hk | hk
          · obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := hL.1 hk
            exact (literalVertex_ne_occurrenceVertex _ _ _ hx.symm).elim
          · obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ := hO.1 hk
            obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := occurrenceVertex_inj.1 hi'
            rfl
        exact huv (by rw [hocc hu, hocc hv])
      · obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, he⟩ := mem_conflictEdges.1 he
        simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at he
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := he
        have hx := mem_vars hi hj
        have hj₀ : j = J ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
          rcases Finset.mem_union.1 hu with hu | hu
          · obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := hL.1 hu
            exact (literalVertex_ne_occurrenceVertex _ _ _ hx.symm).elim
          · obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ := hO.1 hu
            obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := occurrenceVertex_inj.1 hi'

          subst hj₀
          exact hJ ⟨i, hi⟩

          obtain ⟨rfl, hb⟩ := hy
          rw [hσj] at hb
          exact (Bool.not_ne_self _) hb
        · obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ := hO.1 hv
          exact literalVertex_ne_occurrenceVertex _ _ _ hi'
    rcases mem_edges_of_adj hadj with he | he
    · exact key u hu v hv huv he
    · exact key v hv u hu (Ne.symm huv) he
  · -- the set has `n + m` vertices
    have hdisj : Disjoint L O := Finset.disjoint_left.2 fun v hvL hvO => by
      obtain ⟨x, -, rfl⟩ := hL.1 hvL
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hO.1 hvO
      exact literalVertex_ne_occurrenceVertex _ _ _ hi

    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ fun i i' h => Fin.ext (occurrenceVertex_inj.1 h).1,

theorem toPartition_mem_iff (x : List ℕ × ℕ) : toPartition x ∈ Partition ↔ x ∈ SubsetSum := by
  obtain ⟨l, t⟩ := x
  rw [mem_Partition_iff_sublist, mem_SubsetSum_iff_sublist]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hsum⟩
    obtain ⟨r₁, r₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩ := List.sublist_append_iff.1 hs
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h₁.exists_perm_append
    have hl := hr.sum_eq
    simp only [toPartition, List.sum_append, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil] at hsum hl
    have hmem := List.mem_sublists.2 h₂
    simp only [List.sublists, List.foldr_cons, List.foldr_nil, List.flatMap_cons,
      List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.mem_cons,
      List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hmem
    rcases hmem with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      simp only [List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil] at hsum
    · lia
    · exact ⟨r₁, h₁, by lia⟩
    · -- The numbers of `l` beside `2 * t + 1` leave numbers of `l` summing to `t`.
      obtain ⟨r', hr', hsub⟩ : r <+~ l :=
        (List.sublist_append_right r₁ r).subperm.trans hr.symm.subperm
      exact ⟨r', hsub, by rw [hr'.sum_eq]; lia⟩
    · lia
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨s ++ [l.sum + 1], hs.append (by simp), ?_⟩
    simp only [toPartition, List.sum_append, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]

  intro r hr

  rcases hpc with (hpc | ⟨p, _, hpc⟩) | ⟨o, _, hpc⟩

    (hw : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length ≤ 3) (hv : ∀ v, φ.vars.count v ≤ 3) : (routes φ).Nodup := by
  apply List.nodup_flatMap.mpr
  refine ⟨fun _ hpc => placedClause_routes_nodup hw hv hpc, ?_⟩
  have hn := clausePositions_nodup hw hv
  rw [List.Nodup, List.pairwise_map] at hn
  apply hn.imp_of_mem
  intro pc pd hpc hpd hpos r hr hs
  have hhead (pc : PlacedClause) (hpc : pc ∈ placedClauses φ) (hr : r ∈ pc.2.2) :
      r.head? = some pc.2.1 := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hr
    have hi' : i < pc.1.length := by rwa [← placedClause_route_count φ pc hpc]
    have hzip : (pc.1[i], pc.2.2[i]) ∈ pc.1.zip pc.2.2 := by
      have hk : i < (pc.1.zip pc.2.2).length := by simp only [List.length_zip]; omega
      simpa only [List.getElem_zip] using (List.getElem_mem hk)
    exact (placedClause_endpoints φ hpc hzip).1
  exact hpos (Option.some.inj ((hhead pc hpc hr).symm.trans (hhead pd hpd hs)))

private theorem pairedLinks_variable_value {V : Type*} (σ : V → Bool)
    (cells : List (PairedWire.Cell V)) (value : Bool)
    (h : ∀ c ∈ cells, ∀ lane, σ (c lane).1 = value ∧ σ (c lane).2 = value)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ (PairedWire.links cells).vars) : σ v = value := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, b, hl⟩ := CNF.mem_vars.mp hv
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hc⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hc
  have hm := List.of_mem_zip hp
  have hfirst := h p.1 hm.1
  have hnext := h p.2 (List.mem_of_mem_tail hm.2)
  simp only [PairedWire.gapClauses, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hc
  rcases hc with rfl | rfl
  · rcases Clause.fst_mem_of_mem_imp hl with hv | hv
    · exact (congrArg σ (List.mem_singleton.mp hv)).trans (hfirst 0).2
    · exact (congrArg σ hv).trans (hnext 0).1
  · rcases Clause.fst_mem_of_mem_imp hl with hv | hv
    · exact (congrArg σ (List.mem_singleton.mp hv)).trans (hnext 1).1
    · exact (congrArg σ hv).trans (hfirst 1).2

    (hw : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length ≤ 3) (hv : ∀ v, φ.vars.count v ≤ 3)

  obtain ⟨c, hc, b, hl⟩ := CNF.mem_vars.mp hvar
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hc
  simp only [placedClauses, List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap] at hpc
  rcases hpc with ((hpc | ⟨p, hp, hpc⟩) | ⟨p, hp, hpc⟩) | ⟨o, ho, hpc⟩
  · obtain ⟨ci, hci, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpc
    obtain ⟨lr, hlr, heq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hl
    obtain ⟨lj, hlj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hlr
    have ho : (ci.2, lj.2, lj.1) ∈ Cslib.Logic.PL.occurrences φ :=
      List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨ci, hci, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨lj, hlj, rfl⟩⟩
    have heq' : (lastLiteral (crossingSites φ)
        (occurrencePath φ (ci.2, lj.2, lj.1)) lj.1.2).1.1 = v := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    rw [← heq']
    exact (lastLiteral_value hw hv hσ ho).trans
      ((he _ (variable_mem_of_mem_occurrences ho)).trans (lastLiteral_value hw hv hτ ho).symm)
  · obtain ⟨ci, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpc
    obtain ⟨lit, _, heq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hl
    have heq' : (p, Sum.inl lit.1) = v := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    rw [← heq']
    exact ordinary_assignments_agree hw hv hσ hτ he hp lit.1
  · obtain ⟨ci, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpc
    obtain ⟨lit, _, heq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hl
    have heq' : (p, Sum.inr lit.1) = v := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    rw [← heq']

  · have hm : v ∈ CNF.vars ((links (crossingSites φ) (occurrencePath φ o)).map Prod.fst) :=

theorem raw_variable_cell_membership (φ : CNF ℕ) {v : Variable}
    (hv : v ∈ (rawFormula φ).vars) :
    v.1 ∈ crossingSites φ ∨ ∃ r ∈ paths φ, v.1 ∈ r.dropLast := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, b, hv⟩ := CNF.mem_vars.mp hv
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hc
  simp only [placedClauses, List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap] at hpc
  rcases hpc with ((hpc | ⟨p, hp, hpc⟩) | ⟨p, hp, hpc⟩) | ⟨o, ho, hpc⟩
  · obtain ⟨ci, hci, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpc
    obtain ⟨lr, hlr, heq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    obtain ⟨lj, hlj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hlr
    have ho : (ci.2, lj.2, lj.1) ∈ Cslib.Logic.PL.occurrences φ :=
      List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨ci, hci, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨lj, hlj, rfl⟩⟩
    have heq' := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    dsimp only [lastLiteral] at heq'
    subst v
    exact Or.inr ⟨_, occurrencePath_mem_paths ho,
      penultimate_mem_dropLast (PlanarCompile.occurrencePath_length_ge_two ho)⟩
  · obtain ⟨ci, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpc
    obtain ⟨l, _, heq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    have heq' := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    change (p, Sum.inl l.1) = v at heq'
    subst v
    exact Or.inr (List.mem_flatMap.mp ((mem_ordinaryCells φ p).1 hp).1)
  · obtain ⟨ci, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hpc
    obtain ⟨l, _, heq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    have heq' := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    change (p, Sum.inr l.1) = v at heq'
    subst v
    exact Or.inl hp
  · obtain ⟨e, he, hpc⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hpc
    have hpair := List.of_mem_zip he
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hpc
    rcases hpc with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases link_literal_cases _ _ _ _ hv with heq | heq <;> dsimp only at heq <;> subst v
    all_goals
      apply Or.inr
      refine ⟨_, occurrencePath_mem_paths ho, ?_⟩
      first | exact hpair.1 | exact List.mem_of_mem_tail hpair.2

theorem variable_clause_positions_disjoint (φ : CNF ℕ) :
    List.Disjoint ((rawFormula φ).distinctVars.map variablePosition)
      ((placedClauses φ).map fun pc => pc.2.1) := by
  intro p hp hq
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hp
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc, heq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hq
  have hv' := CNF.mem_distinctVars.mp hv
  rcases placedClause_nonempty_or_original hpc with hne | horiginal
  · have hlen : 0 < pc.1.length := List.length_pos_iff.mpr hne
    have hrlen : 0 < pc.2.2.length := by rw [placedClause_route_count φ pc hpc]; exact hlen
    have hz : 0 < (pc.1.zip pc.2.2).length := by simp only [List.length_zip]; omega
    have hzmem := List.getElem_mem hz
    rw [List.getElem_zip] at hzmem
    have hr : pc.2.2[0] ∈ routes φ := List.mem_flatMap.mpr
      ⟨pc, hpc, List.getElem_mem hrlen⟩
    have hends := placedClause_endpoints φ hpc hzmem
    have hpoint : realPoint (variablePosition v) ∈ support pc.2.2[0] := by
      apply Or.inl
      refine ⟨variablePosition v, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [← heq]
      obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp hends.1
      rw [htail]
      exact List.mem_cons_self
    have hlast := route_variable_contact φ hr hv' hpoint
    apply simple_head_ne_last (routes_regular φ _ hr).2.1 (routes_length_ge_two φ _ hr)
      (hends.1.trans (congrArg some heq)) hlast
  · obtain ⟨ci, hci, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp horiginal
    change center (Layout.center (φ.distinctVars.length + ci.2)) = variablePosition v at heq
    have hi : ci.2 < φ.length := by simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using (List.mem_zipIdx hci).2.1
    have hpos := variablePosition_mem_openCell v
    have hcenter := center_mem_openCell (r := 120) (by decide)
      (Layout.center (φ.distinctVars.length + ci.2))
    change realPoint (center (Layout.center (φ.distinctVars.length + ci.2))) ∈
      openCell 120 (Layout.center (φ.distinctVars.length + ci.2)) at hcenter
    rw [heq] at hcenter
    have hcell := cell_eq_of_mem_open_closed (by decide) hpos
      ⟨hcenter.1.le, hcenter.2.1.le, hcenter.2.2.1.le, hcenter.2.2.2.le⟩
    exact raw_variable_not_clause_cell hv' hi hcell

    (hw : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length ≤ 3) (hv : ∀ v, φ.vars.count v ≤ 3)

    (hport.symm.trans (h.trans hport'))

    rcases hs with ⟨hprefix', hs⟩ | ⟨hfinal', hs⟩

  · exact False.elim (lastStep_not_prefix ho (hfinal' ▸ hprefix))

theorem routes_contacts {φ : CNF ℕ}
    (hw : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length ≤ 3) (hv : ∀ v, φ.vars.count v ≤ 3)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < (SAT.incidenceGraph (formula φ)).2.length)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < (SAT.incidenceGraph (formula φ)).2.length) (hij : i ≠ j)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ support ((routes φ).getD i []))
    (hq : p ∈ support ((routes φ).getD j [])) :
    ∃ v ∈ (SAT.incidenceGraph (formula φ)).1,
      (v = (SAT.incidenceGraph (formula φ)).2[i].1 ∨
        v = (SAT.incidenceGraph (formula φ)).2[i].2) ∧
      (v = (SAT.incidenceGraph (formula φ)).2[j].1 ∨
        v = (SAT.incidenceGraph (formula φ)).2[j].2) ∧
      p = realPoint (Graph.drawingPosition (SAT.incidenceGraph (formula φ))
        (positions φ, routes φ) v) := by
  have hir : i < (routes φ).length := by rwa [routes_length]
  have hjr : j < (routes φ).length := by rwa [routes_length]
  have hne : (routes φ).getD i [] ≠ (routes φ).getD j [] := by
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hir, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hjr]
    exact fun h => hij ((routes_nodup hw hv).eq_of_getElem_eq hir hjr h)
  obtain ⟨a, hpa, ha, hb⟩ := route_contacts hw hv
    (indexed_route_mem hi) (indexed_route_mem hj) hne hp hq
  obtain ⟨v, hv', hvi, hav⟩ := indexed_endpoint_declared hi ha
  obtain ⟨w, hw', hwj, haw⟩ := indexed_endpoint_declared hj hb
  have heq : v = w := drawingPosition_injective hw hv hv' hw' (hav.symm.trans haw)
  exact ⟨v, hv', hvi, heq ▸ hwj, hpa.trans (congrArg realPoint hav)⟩

theorem liftAssignment_signal (sites : List Point) (σ : PlanarCompile.Variable → Bool)
    (hcross : ∀ p ∈ sites, Crossover.splitFormula.eval (fun v => σ (p, some v)) = true)

    liftAssignment σ (signal sites p q lane) = σ (PlanarCompile.signal sites p q) := by
  by_cases hp : p ∈ sites

      (Crossover.splitTerminal (side p q))
    simp only [signal, port, hp, ↓reduceIte, liftAssignment,
      PairedCrossover.terminal_values_canonicalExtension, PlanarCompile.signal]
    change (if (side p q).val < 2 then σ (p, some .aLeft) else σ (p, some .bTop)) =
      σ (p, some (Crossover.splitTerminal (side p q)))

    fin_cases s

          Crossover.canonicalExtension, Crossover.assignment, Function.comp_def,
          Crossover.SplitVariable.origin] using heq.symm

theorem exists_compatible_assignment {φ : CNF ℕ}
    (hw : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length ≤ 3) (hv : ∀ v, φ.vars.count v ≤ 3) (τ : ℕ → Bool) :
    ∃ σ : Variable → Bool,
      (∀ o ∈ Cslib.Logic.PL.occurrences φ,
        ∀ c ∈ wire (crossingSites φ) (occurrencePath φ o),
          σ c.1 = τ o.2.2.1 ∧ σ c.2 = τ o.2.2.1) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ crossingSites φ, Crossover.splitFormula.eval (fun v => σ (p, some v)) = true) := by
  classical
  let ordinary (p : Point) := chosenValue τ (fun o =>
    o ∈ Cslib.Logic.PL.occurrences φ ∧ p ∈ (occurrencePath φ o).dropLast)
  let axis (p d : Point) := chosenValue τ (fun o =>
    o ∈ Cslib.Logic.PL.occurrences φ ∧ p ∈ occurrencePath φ o ∧
      StraightThrough (occurrencePath φ o) p d)
  have hord {o : Occurrence ℕ} (ho : o ∈ Cslib.Logic.PL.occurrences φ) {p : Point}
      (hp : p ∉ crossingSites φ) (hpo : p ∈ (occurrencePath φ o).dropLast) :
      ordinary p = τ o.2.2.1 := by
    apply chosenValue_eq τ _ ⟨ho, hpo⟩
    intro t ht
    exact ordinary_cell_source_eq hw hv ht.1 ho hp ht.2 hpo
  have haxis {o : Occurrence ℕ} (ho : o ∈ Cslib.Logic.PL.occurrences φ) {p d : Point}
      (hp : p ∈ crossingSites φ) (hpo : p ∈ occurrencePath φ o)
      (hd : d = (1, 0) ∨ d = (0, 1)) (hs : StraightThrough (occurrencePath φ o) p d) :
      axis p d = τ o.2.2.1 := by
    apply chosenValue_eq τ _ ⟨ho, hpo, hs⟩
    intro t ht
    rw [crossing_axis_occurrence_eq hw hv ht.1 ho hp ht.2.1 hpo hd ht.2.2 hs]
  let cross (p : Point) : Crossover.SplitVariable → Bool :=
    Classical.choose (Crossover.exists_split_holds (axis p (1, 0)) (axis p (0, 1)))
  have hcross (p : Point) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (Crossover.exists_split_holds (axis p (1, 0)) (axis p (0, 1)))
  let σ : Variable → Bool := fun v => match v.2 with
    | none => ordinary v.1
    | some a => cross v.1 a
  refine ⟨σ, ?_, fun p _ => (hcross p).1⟩
  intro o ho c hc
  unfold wire at hc
  obtain ⟨⟨p, k⟩, hpk, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hc
  have hget := List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mp hpk
  obtain ⟨hk, heq⟩ := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hget
  have hk' : k < (occurrencePath φ o).length := by
    simp only [List.length_dropLast] at hk
    omega
  have heq' : (occurrencePath φ o)[k] = p := by
    rw [← List.getElem_dropLast hk]
    exact heq
  have hpo : p ∈ occurrencePath φ o := heq' ▸ List.getElem_mem hk'
  change (List.dropLast (occurrencePath φ o))[k] = p at heq
  have hpod : p ∈ (occurrencePath φ o).dropLast := by
    rw [← heq]
    exact List.getElem_mem hk
  by_cases hp : p ∈ crossingSites φ
  · have hl : side p (p - (1, 0)) = 0 := by
      rcases p with ⟨x, y⟩
      simp only [side, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub]
      split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
    have hr : side p (p + (1, 0)) = 1 := by
      rcases p with ⟨x, y⟩
      simp only [side, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add]
      split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
    have ht : side p (p - (0, 1)) = 2 := by
      rcases p with ⟨x, y⟩
      simp only [side, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub]
      split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
    have hb : side p (p + (0, 1)) = 3 := by
      rcases p with ⟨x, y⟩
      simp only [side, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add]
      split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
    rcases occurrencePath_crossing_straight hw hv ho hp hpo with hs | hs
    · have hav := haxis ho hp hpo (Or.inl rfl) hs
      have hports := (hcross p).2
      obtain ⟨_, _, hnb⟩ := hs.getD_neighbors (occurrencePath_nodup ho) hk' heq'
      rcases hnb with ⟨hprev, hnext⟩ | ⟨hprev, hnext⟩
      all_goals
        simp only [hprev, hnext, signal, hp, ite_true, hl, hr, Crossover.splitTerminal]
        exact ⟨by simpa only [σ, cross, hports.1, hports.2.1] using hav,
          by simpa only [σ, cross, hports.1, hports.2.1] using hav⟩
    · have hav := haxis ho hp hpo (Or.inr rfl) hs
      have hports := (hcross p).2.2.2
      obtain ⟨_, _, hnb⟩ := hs.getD_neighbors (occurrencePath_nodup ho) hk' heq'
      rcases hnb with ⟨hprev, hnext⟩ | ⟨hprev, hnext⟩
      all_goals
        simp only [hprev, hnext, signal, hp, ite_true, ht, hb, Crossover.splitTerminal]
        exact ⟨by simpa only [σ, cross, hports.1, hports.2] using hav,
          by simpa only [σ, cross, hports.1, hports.2] using hav⟩
  · simpa only [signal, hp, ite_false, σ] using
      And.intro (hord ho hp hpod) (hord ho hp hpod)

private theorem neighbor_of_straight {r : Route} {p q d : Point}
    (ht : StraightThrough r p d) (hn : r.Nodup)
    (h : (p, q) ∈ r.consecutivePairs ∨ (q, p) ∈ r.consecutivePairs) :
    q = p - d ∨ q = p + d := by
  rcases h with h | h
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hp, hq⟩ := consecutivePair_index h
    have hh := ht.getD_neighbors hn (by omega) hp
    have hd : r.getD (k + 1) p = q := by rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hk]; exact hq
    rcases hh.2.2 with ⟨_, hnext⟩ | ⟨_, hnext⟩
    · exact Or.inr (hd.symm.trans hnext)
    · exact Or.inl (hd.symm.trans hnext)
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hq, hp⟩ := consecutivePair_index h
    have hh := ht.getD_neighbors hn hk hp
    have hd : r.getD (k + 1 - 1) p = q := by
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by omega)]
      exact hq
    rcases hh.2.2 with ⟨hprev, _⟩ | ⟨hprev, _⟩
    · exact Or.inl (hd.symm.trans hprev)
    · exact Or.inr (hd.symm.trans hprev)

private theorem occurrencePath_clause_center_iff {φ : CNF ℕ} {o : Occurrence ℕ}
    (ho : o ∈ Cslib.Logic.PL.occurrences φ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < φ.length) :

  have he : (SAT.incidenceGraph φ).2[(Cslib.Logic.PL.occurrences φ).idxOf o] =

  rw [he] at hb h

    φ.distinctVars.length + i = (List.range _).idxOf (φ.distinctVars.idxOf o.2.2.1) ∨

theorem occurrencePath_length_ge_two {φ : CNF ℕ} {o : Occurrence ℕ}
    (ho : o ∈ Cslib.Logic.PL.occurrences φ) : 2 ≤ (occurrencePath φ o).length := by
  have hne := occurrencePath_ne_nil ho

  have hi : φ.distinctVars.idxOf o.2.2.1 < φ.distinctVars.length := by
    apply List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem
    apply CNF.mem_distinctVars.mpr
    rw [← Cslib.Logic.PL.map_occurrences]
    exact List.mem_map_of_mem ho
  have hcenters : Layout.center (φ.distinctVars.idxOf o.2.2.1) ≠
      Layout.center (φ.distinctVars.length + o.1) := by
    intro heq
    have hx := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    simp only [Layout.center] at hx
    omega
  cases hr : occurrencePath φ o with
  | nil => exact False.elim (hne hr)
  | cons p r =>
    cases r with

    simp only [side, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega

theorem counts_iff_satisfiable (hφ : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length ≤ 3) :
    (∃ A ⊆ range φ.distinctVars.length ×ˢ (univ : Finset Bool),
      ∃ B ⊆ range φ.length ×ˢ (univ : Finset Bool),
        (∀ i < φ.distinctVars.length, #{a ∈ A | a.1 = i} = 1) ∧
          ∀ j < φ.length, #{a ∈ A | covers φ a.1 a.2 j} + #{c ∈ B | c.1 = j} = 3) ↔
      φ.Satisfiable := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨A, hA, B, -, hvar, hclause⟩
    -- Each variable position holds the number of exactly one of its literals.
    have hnot : ∀ i, (i, false) ∈ A → (i, true) ∉ A := by
      intro i hf ht
      have hi : i < φ.distinctVars.length := mem_range.1 (mem_product.1 (hA ht)).1
      have h₂ : 2 ≤ #{a ∈ A | a.1 = i} := by
        calc 2 = #({(i, true), (i, false)} : Finset (ℕ × Bool)) := by simp
          _ ≤ _ := card_le_card fun a ha => by
            simp only [mem_insert, mem_singleton] at ha
            rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> simpa
      have := hvar i hi
      lia
    refine ⟨fun v => decide ((φ.distinctVars.idxOf v, true) ∈ A),
      (CNF.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).2 fun c hc => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hc
    -- Some literal number of the clause is chosen, since slack numbers fill at most two.
    have hpos : 0 < #{a ∈ A | covers φ a.1 a.2 j} := by
      have := hclause j hj
      have := card_filter_fst_le B j
      lia
    obtain ⟨⟨i, b⟩, ha⟩ := card_pos.1 hpos
    obtain ⟨haA, hcov⟩ := mem_filter.1 ha
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hi, hb⟩ := covers_eq_true_iff.1 hcov
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hj] at hl
    refine (Clause.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).2 ⟨l, hl, ?_⟩
    simp only at hi hb
    rw [hi, hb]
    cases b
    · exact decide_eq_false (hnot i haA)
    · exact decide_eq_true haA
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ⟩
    -- Choose the true literal of each variable, then fill each clause position with slack.
    set b : ℕ → Bool := fun i => σ (φ.distinctVars.getD i 0) with hb
    set A : Finset (ℕ × Bool) := (range φ.distinctVars.length).image fun i => (i, b i) with hA
    have hmemA : ∀ a, a ∈ A ↔ a.1 < φ.distinctVars.length ∧ a.2 = b a.1 := by
      rintro ⟨i, c⟩
      simp only [hA, mem_image, mem_range, Prod.mk.injEq]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨hi, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨hi, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨i, hi, rfl, rfl⟩
    set cnt : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => #{a ∈ A | covers φ a.1 a.2 j} with hcnt
    set B : Finset (ℕ × Bool) := (range φ.length ×ˢ univ).filter
      (fun c => cnt c.1 + (!c.2).toNat ≤ 2) with hB
    refine ⟨A, fun a ha => ?_, B, filter_subset _ _, fun i hi => ?_, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    · exact mem_product.2 ⟨mem_range.2 ((hmemA a).1 ha).1, mem_univ _⟩
    · refine card_eq_one.2 ⟨(i, b i), ?_⟩
      ext ⟨i', c⟩
      simp only [mem_filter, hmemA, mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨-, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨⟨hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · have hle : cnt j ≤ 3 := (card_filter_covers_le A j).trans
        (by rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hj]; exact hφ _ (List.getElem_mem hj))
      have hpos : 1 ≤ cnt j := by
        obtain ⟨l, hl, hσl⟩ := (Clause.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).1
          ((CNF.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).1 hσ _ (List.getElem_mem hj))
        have hl' : l ∈ φ.getD j [] := by rwa [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hj]
        have hidx : φ.distinctVars.idxOf l.1 < φ.distinctVars.length :=
          List.idxOf_lt_length_iff.2 (mem_distinctVars_of_mem hl')
        refine card_pos.2 ⟨(φ.distinctVars.idxOf l.1, l.2), mem_filter.2 ⟨(hmemA _).2
          ⟨hidx, ?_⟩, covers_eq_true_iff.2 ⟨l, hl', rfl, rfl⟩⟩⟩
        simp only [hb, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx,
          List.getElem_idxOf hidx, Option.getD_some, hσl]
      have hBj : ({c ∈ B | c.1 = j} : Finset (ℕ × Bool)) =
          ({c ∈ (univ : Finset Bool) | cnt j + (!c).toNat ≤ 2}).image (Prod.mk j) := by
        ext ⟨j', c⟩
        simp only [hB, mem_filter, mem_product, mem_range, mem_univ, and_true, mem_image,
          true_and, Prod.mk.injEq]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨-, h⟩, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨c, h, rfl, rfl⟩
        · rintro ⟨c, h, rfl, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨⟨hj, h⟩, rfl⟩
      change cnt j + _ = 3
      rw [hBj, card_image_of_injective _ (Prod.mk_right_injective j),
        card_filter _ (univ : Finset Bool), Fintype.sum_bool]
      simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, Bool.toNat_false, Bool.toNat_true]

          TSP.dist (V.map fun u => V.map fun v => if G.adjBool u v then 1 else 2)

          split_ifs at h with hadj
          · exact hadj
          · omega

          obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 ha
          rw [dist_map (hget j) (hget (j + 1))]
          split_ifs <;> omega
      refine ⟨p.map fun i => V.getD i 0, ?_, fun v => ?_, by rw [List.length_map, hplen]; exact hn,
        ?_⟩
      · refine (hp.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range).map_on fun i hi j hj hij => ?_
        rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (hplt i hi), List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (hplt j hj)] at hij

      · rw [← hmemV, List.mem_map]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
          rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (hplt i hi)]

          have hlt := List.idxOf_lt_length_iff.2 hv
          refine ⟨V.idxOf v, hp.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hlt), ?_⟩
          rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hlt, List.getElem_idxOf]

          simp only [List.length_append, List.length_take, hplen]
          omega

        intro k hk
        rw [List.length_map, hplen] at hk
        rw [← List.map_take, ← List.map_append, getD_map_of_lt (by omega),
          getD_map_of_lt (by omega)]
        exact (Graph.adjBool_eq_true_iff _ _ _).1 (hone k hk)
    · rintro ⟨q, hq, hcov, h3, hch⟩
      have hqlen := hlenV q hq hcov
      have hqV : ∀ v ∈ q, v ∈ V := fun v hv => (hmemV v).2 ((hcov v).1 hv)
      refine ⟨q.map V.idxOf, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hnd : (q.map V.idxOf).Nodup :=
          hq.map_on fun u hu v _ h => (List.idxOf_inj (hqV u hu)).1 h
        have hsub : q.map V.idxOf ⊆ List.range V.length := fun i hi => by
          obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hi

        refine (List.sum_le_length_nsmul _ 1 fun a ha => ?_).trans (by simp [hqlen])
        obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 ha

          simp only [List.length_append, List.length_take]

private theorem sumElim {α β γ : Type} {left : α ↪ List Bool} {right : β ↪ List Bool}
    {encC : γ ↪ List Bool} {f : α → γ} {g : β → γ}
    (hf : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime f left encC)
    (hg : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime g right encC) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (Sum.elim f g) (encSum left right) encC := by
  let encS := encSum left right
  have hc : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime Sum.isRight encS encBool :=
    ((headD (encA := encBool) false).comp (encode encS)).of_enc_eq fun x => by cases x <;> rfl
  let encR := (Function.Embedding.subtype (Sum.isRight · = true)).trans encS
  let unRight : {x : α ⊕ β // x.isRight = true} → β
    | ⟨.inr b, _⟩ => b
    | ⟨.inl _, h⟩ => by cases h
  have hunRight : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime unRight encR right :=
    (bitsTail.comp (encode encR)).of_enc_eq fun x => by
      rcases x with ⟨a | b, h⟩
      · cases h
      · rfl
  let encL := (Function.Embedding.subtype (Sum.isRight · = false)).trans encS
  let unLeft : {x : α ⊕ β // x.isRight = false} → α
    | ⟨.inl a, _⟩ => a
    | ⟨.inr _, h⟩ => by cases h
  have hunLeft : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime unLeft encL left :=
    (bitsTail.comp (encode encL)).of_enc_eq fun x => by
      rcases x with ⟨a | b, h⟩
      · rfl
      · cases h
  have hR : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (Sum.elim f g ∘ Subtype.val) encR encC := by
    convert hg.comp hunRight using 1
    funext x
    rcases x with ⟨a | b, hx⟩
    · cases hx
    · rfl
  have hL : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (Sum.elim f g ∘ Subtype.val) encL encC := by
    convert hf.comp hunLeft using 1
    funext x
    rcases x with ⟨a | b, hx⟩
    · rfl
    · cases hx
  simpa only [ite_self] using hc.ite hR hL

private theorem reaches_width_two {q : ℕ} {m₁ m₂ : Literal ℕ} {rest : Clause ℕ}
    (hrest : LitsAt (encCNF φ) q (m₂ :: rest)) {st : St} (hB : st.Bounded (bnd φ))
    (x : ℕ) (hx : x ≤ bnd φ) :
    ∃ st' : St, st'.Bounded (bnd φ) ∧
      decider.Reaches (encCNF φ) (decider.Oblivious (bnd φ))
        (15, ({ st with q₁ := q } : St).regs x)
        (if (m₁ :: m₂ :: rest).length = 0 ∨ 3 ≤ (m₁ :: m₂ :: rest).length then 102 else 103,
          st'.regs x) := by
  have hro : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → (reg i).readsChoice = false := fun i hi => by
    simp [Expr.readsChoice, hi]
  obtain ⟨hm₂, hrest₂⟩ := hrest.cons
  have hend₂ := le_bnd_of_infixAt hm₂ (literalBits_ne_nil _ _)
  have hB₁ : ({ st with q₁ := q } : St).Bounded (bnd φ) := by bounded_tac
  have hB₂ : ({ st with q₁ := q + (literalBits m₂.1 m₂.2).length } : St).Bounded (bnd φ) := by
    bounded_tac

      (15, ({ st with q₁ := q } : St).regs x)
      (19, ({ st with q₁ := q + (literalBits m₂.1 m₂.2).length } : St).regs x) := by
    refine Reaches.oread (show decider.instr 15 = _ from rfl) (hro 8 (by omega))
      (St.forall_mem_regs hB₁ hx) ?_
    simp only [eval_reg, St.getD_regs_8, hm₂.literal_start, readLabel]
    simpa using reaches_skipLitCode codeAt_skipLit₁₆ (by omega) (by simp) hm₂
      (St.getD_regs_8 _ _) (St.forall_mem_regs hB₁ hx) hend₂
  refine ⟨_, hB₂, hread₂.trans (Reaches.oread (show decider.instr 19 = _ from rfl)
    (hro 8 (by omega)) (St.forall_mem_regs hB₂ hx) ?_)⟩
  rcases rest with _ | ⟨m₃, rest⟩
  · simp only [eval_reg, St.getD_regs_8, hrest₂.getElem?_nil, readLabel, List.length_cons,
      List.length_nil]
    exact Reaches.refl _
  · simp only [eval_reg, St.getD_regs_8, hrest₂.cons.1.literal_start, readLabel, List.length_cons,

theorem reaches_width {p : ℕ} {c : Clause ℕ} (hc : LitsAt (encCNF φ) p c) {st : St}
    (hp : st.p = p) (hB : st.Bounded (bnd φ)) (x : ℕ) (hx : x ≤ bnd φ) :
    ∃ st' : St, st'.Bounded (bnd φ) ∧
      decider.Reaches (encCNF φ) (decider.Oblivious (bnd φ)) (10, st.regs x)
        (if c.length = 0 ∨ 3 ≤ c.length then 102 else 103, st'.regs x) := by
  have hro : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → (reg i).readsChoice = false := fun i hi => by
    simp [Expr.readsChoice, hi]
  have hpB : p ≤ bnd φ := hp ▸ hB.1
  have hB₁ : ∀ q, q ≤ bnd φ → ({ st with q₁ := q } : St).Bounded (bnd φ) := fun q hq => by
    bounded_tac
  -- label 10, then the first read at label 11
  have h₁₀ : decider.Reaches (encCNF φ) (decider.Oblivious (bnd φ)) (10, st.regs x)
      (11, ({ st with q₁ := p } : St).regs x) := by
    refine Reaches.oassign (show decider.instr 10 = _ from rfl) (by omega) (hro 1 (by omega))
      (st.forall_mem_regs hB hx) ?_
    simp only [eval_reg, St.getD_regs_1, St.set_regs_8, hp]
    exact Reaches.refl _
  rcases c with _ | ⟨m₁, _ | ⟨m₂, rest⟩⟩
  · refine ⟨{ st with q₁ := p }, hB₁ p hpB, h₁₀.trans ?_⟩
    refine Reaches.oread (show decider.instr 11 = _ from rfl) (hro 8 (by omega))
      (St.forall_mem_regs (hB₁ p hpB) hx) ?_
    simp only [eval_reg, St.getD_regs_8, hc.getElem?_nil, readLabel, List.length_nil,
      true_or, ↓reduceIte]
    exact Reaches.refl _
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨hm₁, hrest⟩ := hc.cons
    have hend₁ := le_bnd_of_infixAt hm₁ (literalBits_ne_nil _ _)
    have hread₁ : decider.Reaches (encCNF φ) (decider.Oblivious (bnd φ)) (10, st.regs x)
        (15, ({ st with q₁ := p + (literalBits m₁.1 m₁.2).length } : St).regs x) := by
      refine h₁₀.trans (Reaches.oread (show decider.instr 11 = _ from rfl) (hro 8 (by omega))
        (St.forall_mem_regs (hB₁ p hpB) hx) ?_)
      simp only [eval_reg, St.getD_regs_8, hm₁.literal_start, readLabel]
      simpa using reaches_skipLitCode codeAt_skipLit₁₂ (by omega) (by simp) hm₁
        (St.getD_regs_8 _ _) (St.forall_mem_regs (hB₁ p hpB) hx) hend₁
  · refine ⟨_, hB₁ _ (by omega), hread₁.trans ?_⟩
    refine Reaches.oread (show decider.instr 15 = _ from rfl) (hro 8 (by omega))
      (St.forall_mem_regs (hB₁ _ (by omega)) hx) ?_
    simp only [eval_reg, St.getD_regs_8, hrest.getElem?_nil, readLabel, List.length_singleton]
    exact Reaches.refl _
  · obtain ⟨st', hB', h₂⟩ := reaches_width_two (m₁ := m₁) hrest hB x hx
    exact ⟨st', hB', hread₁.trans h₂⟩

    (ho₂ : InfixAt (encCNF φ) st.o₂ (literalBits m.1 m.2)) (hB : st.Bounded (bnd φ)) :
    ∃ st' : St, st'.Bounded (bnd φ) ∧
      decider.Reaches (encCNF φ) (decider.Oblivious (bnd φ)) (79, st.regs 0)
        (if m = Std.Sat.Literal.negate (v, decide (st.sgn = 1)) then 35 else 103, st'.regs 0) ∧
      (m = Std.Sat.Literal.negate (v, decide (st.sgn = 1)) → st'.o₀ = st.o₀ ∧
        st'.phase = st.phase ∧ st'.steps = st.steps ∧ st'.len = st.len ∧ st'.cur = st.o₁ ∧
        st'.sgn = ℓ'.2.toNat) := by
  have hend₂ := le_bnd_of_infixAt ho₂ (literalBits_ne_nil _ _)
  have hendc := le_bnd_of_infixAt hcur (literalBits_ne_nil _ _)
  have hlen₂ : st.o₂ + 8 * m.1.bits.length ≤ bnd φ := by
    simp only [length_literalBits] at hend₂
    omega
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hcmp⟩ := reaches_cmpVarCode codeAt_cmpVar₇₉ (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by simp) (by simp) ho₂ hcur
    (St.getD_regs_12 st 0) (St.getD_regs_3 st 0) (st.forall_mem_regs hB (Nat.zero_le _))
    hend₂ hendc
  simp only [St.set_regs_13, St.set_regs_14] at hcmp
  set st₁ : St := { st with t₁ := x, t₂ := y }
  have hB₁ : st₁.Bounded (bnd φ) := by simp only [st₁]; bounded_tac
  by_cases hmv : m.1 = v
  swap
  · have hne : m ≠ Std.Sat.Literal.negate (v, decide (st.sgn = 1)) := fun h => hmv (by rw [h]; rfl)
    exact ⟨st₁, hB₁, by simpa [hmv, hne] using hcmp, fun h => absurd h hne⟩
  rw [ite_eq_left hmv] at hcmp
  have hsign := reaches_signCode codeAt_sign₈₉ (B := bnd φ) (by omega) (by omega) (by simp) ho₂
    (St.getD_regs_12 st₁ 0) (st₁.forall_mem_regs hB₁ (Nat.zero_le _)) hend₂
  simp only [St.set_regs_15] at hsign
  set st₂ : St := { st₁ with t := st.o₂ + 8 * m.1.bits.length }
  have hB₂ : st₂.Bounded (bnd φ) := by simp only [st₂, st₁]; bounded_tac

    rcases m with ⟨_, mb⟩

    simp [Std.Sat.Literal.negate]
  have hpol := hcmp.trans (hsign.trans (reaches_check_polarity (st := st₂) hsgn hB₂ m.2))
  by_cases hpass : m = Std.Sat.Literal.negate (v, decide (st.sgn = 1))

    obtain ⟨hBmv, hmv'⟩ := reaches_check_move (st := st₂) ho₁ hB₂
    rw [ite_eq_left (hneg.mp hpass)] at hpol
    refine ⟨checkMoveSt st₂ ℓ', hBmv, ?_, fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    rw [ite_eq_left hpass]

    rw [ite_eq_right (mt hneg.mpr hpass)] at hpol
    exact ⟨st₂, hB₂, by simpa [hpass] using hpol, fun h => absurd h hpass⟩

private theorem pair_choice {ℓ' m m₁ m₂ : Literal ℕ} (hm : m ∈ [m₁, m₂]) (hℓ' : ℓ' ∈ [m₁, m₂])
    (hall : ∀ y ∈ [m₁, m₂], y = m ∨ y = ℓ') :
    (ℓ' = m₁ ∧ m = m₂) ∨ (ℓ' = m₂ ∧ m = m₁) := by

  by_cases h1 : ℓ' = m₁
  · refine .inl ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    rcases hall m₂ (by simp) with h | h
    · exact h.symm
    · exact hm.elim (fun h' => h'.trans (h1.symm.trans h.symm)) id
  · refine .inr ⟨hℓ'.resolve_left h1, ?_⟩
    rcases hall m₁ (by simp) with h | h
    · exact h.symm
    · exact absurd h.symm h1

text:
private theorem branches_arc_pair {st st₂ st₃ : St} {b : Bool} {ℓ' m m₁ m₂ : Literal ℕ}
    (hB₃ : st₃.Bounded (bnd φ)) (hsame : Same st₂ st₃)
    (hm : m ∈ [m₁, m₂]) (hℓ' : ℓ' ∈ [m₁, m₂]) (hall : ∀ y ∈ [m₁, m₂], y = m ∨ y = ℓ')
    (hq₁ : InfixAt (encCNF φ) st₃.q₁ (literalBits m₁.1 m₁.2))
    (hq₂ : InfixAt (encCNF φ) st₃.q₂ (literalBits m₂.1 m₂.2))
    (hto60 : Branches (P := decider) (w := encCNF φ) (50, st.regs b.toNat)
      (60, st₂.regs (false : Bool).toNat))
    (h : decider.Reaches (encCNF φ) (decider.Oblivious (bnd φ)) (60, st₂.regs 0)
      (74, st₃.regs 0)) :
    ∃ st₄ : St, st₄.Bounded (bnd φ) ∧ Same st₂ st₄ ∧
      InfixAt (encCNF φ) st₄.o₁ (literalBits ℓ'.1 ℓ'.2) ∧
      InfixAt (encCNF φ) st₄.o₂ (literalBits m.1 m.2) ∧
      Branches (P := decider) (w := encCNF φ) (50, st.regs b.toNat)
        (79, st₄.regs (false : Bool).toNat) := by
  obtain ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅⟩ := hsame
  have hB₃' (first : Bool) : (pairSt st₃ first).Bounded (bnd φ) := by
    cases first <;> simp only [pairSt, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true] <;> bounded_tac
  rcases pair_choice hm hℓ' hall with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · refine ⟨pairSt st₃ true, hB₃' true, ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅⟩, by simpa [pairSt] using hq₁,
      by simpa [pairSt] using hq₂, hto60.trans ?_⟩
    exact (branches_of_reaches' h (by omega) false false).trans
      ((branches_choice (show decider.instr 74 = _ from rfl) st₃ false false).trans
        (branches_of_reaches' (reaches_pair hB₃ true) (by simp) false false))
  · refine ⟨pairSt st₃ false, hB₃' false, ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅⟩, by simpa [pairSt] using hq₂,
      by simpa [pairSt] using hq₁, hto60.trans ?_⟩
    exact (branches_of_reaches' h (by omega) false true).trans
      ((branches_choice (show decider.instr 74 = _ from rfl) st₃ true false).trans
        (branches_of_reaches' (reaches_pair hB₃ false) (by simp) false false))

/-- **A branch along an arc** of the implication graph, from label `50` back to the head of the
walk, for a formula whose clauses have one or two literals. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem branches_arc {st : St} {v : ℕ} {b₁ : Bool}
    (hcur : InfixAt (encCNF φ) st.cur (literalBits v b₁)) (hsgn : st.sgn ≤ 1)
    (hB : st.Bounded (bnd φ)) (hlen : st.len = (encCNF φ).length) (hs : st.steps < st.len)
    (hw : ∀ c ∈ φ, 1 ≤ c.length ∧ c.length ≤ 2) {ℓ' : Literal ℕ}
    (harc : φ.Implies (v, decide (st.sgn = 1)) ℓ') (b : Bool) :
    ∃ (st' : St) (b' : Bool), Branches (P := decider) (w := encCNF φ) (50, st.regs b.toNat)
      (35, st'.regs b'.toNat) ∧ st'.o₀ = st.o₀ ∧ st'.phase = st.phase ∧
      st'.steps = st.steps + 1 ∧ st'.len = st.len ∧ Occ φ st'.cur ℓ'.1 ℓ'.2 ∧
      st'.sgn = ℓ'.2.toNat ∧ st'.Bounded (bnd φ) := by
  obtain ⟨c, hcφ, hneg, hℓ', hall⟩ := harc
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hcφ
  have hB₁ := stepSt_bounded hB hlen hs
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqB, hscan⟩ := branches_scan (φ := φ) (l₀ := 53) (skip := 55) (inspect := 60)
    rfl rfl codeAt_skipClause₅₅ (by omega) (by omega) φ (clausesAt_encCNF φ) rfl hB₁ i hi false
    false
  set st₂ : St := { stepSt st with p := q }
  have hB₂ : st₂.Bounded (bnd φ) := by simp only [st₂, stepSt]; bounded_tac
  have hto60 := (branches_of_reaches' (reaches_steps hB hlen hs) (by omega) b false).trans hscan
  obtain ⟨st₃, hB₃, hsame, hcase⟩ := reaches_inspect hq rfl hB₂
  -- the positions of `ℓ'` and of the negation of the current literal, at label `79`
  obtain ⟨st₄, hB₄, ⟨h₄₀, h₄₁, h₄₂, h₄₃, h₄₄, h₄₅⟩, ho₁, ho₂, hto79⟩ :
      ∃ st₄ : St, st₄.Bounded (bnd φ) ∧ Same st₂ st₄ ∧
        InfixAt (encCNF φ) st₄.o₁ (literalBits ℓ'.1 ℓ'.2) ∧
        InfixAt (encCNF φ) st₄.o₂ (literalBits (Std.Sat.Literal.negate (v, decide (st.sgn = 1))).1
          (Std.Sat.Literal.negate (v, decide (st.sgn = 1))).2) ∧
        Branches (P := decider) (w := encCNF φ) (50, st.regs b.toNat)
          (79, st₄.regs (false : Bool).toNat) := by
    rcases hcase with ⟨hbad, -⟩ | ⟨m₁, hc, ho₁, ho₂, h⟩ | ⟨m₁, m₂, hc, hq₁, hq₂, h⟩
    · have := hw _ hcφ
      rcases hbad with h | h
      · simp [h] at this
      · omega
    · rw [hc] at hneg hℓ'
      simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hneg hℓ'
      exact ⟨st₃, hB₃, hsame, hℓ' ▸ ho₁, hneg ▸ ho₂,
        hto60.trans (branches_of_reaches' h (by omega) false false)⟩
    · rw [hc] at hneg hℓ' hall
      exact branches_arc_pair hB₃ hsame hneg hℓ' hall hq₁ hq₂ hto60 h
  -- the check
  obtain ⟨st₅, hB₅, hcheck, hfields⟩ := reaches_check (h₄₁ ▸ hcur) (by rw [h₄₂]; exact hsgn)
    ho₁ ho₂ hB₄
  have hpass : Std.Sat.Literal.negate (v, decide (st.sgn = 1)) =
      Std.Sat.Literal.negate (v, decide (st₄.sgn = 1)) := by simp [h₄₂, st₂, stepSt]
  rw [ite_eq_left hpass] at hcheck
  obtain ⟨h₅₀, h₅₁, h₅₂, h₅₃, h₅₄, h₅₅⟩ := hfields hpass
  refine ⟨st₅, false, hto79.trans (branches_of_reaches' hcheck (by omega) false false),
    by simp [h₅₀, h₄₀, st₂, stepSt], by simp [h₅₁, h₄₃, st₂, stepSt],
    by simp [h₅₂, h₄₄, st₂, stepSt], by simp [h₅₃, h₄₅, st₂, stepSt],
    ⟨⟨_, hcφ, hℓ'⟩, h₅₄ ▸ ho₁⟩, h₅₅, hB₅⟩

/-- Reaching the target of the current half of the walk at label `35`: phase `0` switches to phase
`1` at label `50`, and phase `1` accepts at label `102`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
private theorem branches_walk (hw : ∀ c ∈ φ, 1 ≤ c.length ∧ c.length ≤ 2) {x : ℕ} {b₀ : Bool} :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (st : St) {v : ℕ} {b₁ : Bool},
    InfixAt (encCNF φ) st.o₀ (literalBits x b₀) → InfixAt (encCNF φ) st.cur (literalBits v b₁) →
    st.sgn ≤ 1 → st.phase ≤ 1 → st.Bounded (bnd φ) → st.len = (encCNF φ).length →
    st.steps + m ≤ st.len →
    Relation.RelatesInSteps φ.Implies (v, decide (st.sgn = 1)) (x, decide (st.phase = 1)) m →
    ∀ b : Bool, ∃ (l : ℕ) (st' : St) (b' : Bool),
      Branches (P := decider) (w := encCNF φ) (35, st.regs b.toNat) (l, st'.regs b'.toNat) ∧
      (st.phase = 0 → l = 50 ∧ st'.phase = 1 ∧ st'.steps = 0 ∧ st'.o₀ = st.o₀ ∧
        st'.len = st.len ∧ st'.Bounded (bnd φ) ∧ st'.sgn = 0 ∧
        ∃ b₂, InfixAt (encCNF φ) st'.cur (literalBits x b₂)) ∧
      (st.phase = 1 → l = 102) := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro st v b₁ hO₀ hOc hsgn hph hB hlen hsteps hpath b
    obtain ⟨rfl, hsp⟩ := Prod.mk.inj (Relation.RelatesInSteps.zero hpath)
    have hhit : st.sgn = st.phase := by
      have : st.sgn = 0 ∨ st.sgn = 1 := by omega
      have : st.phase = 0 ∨ st.phase = 1 := by omega
      by_cases h1 : st.sgn = 1 <;> by_cases h2 : st.phase = 1 <;> simp_all
    obtain ⟨X, Y, hX, hY, hhead⟩ := reaches_head hO₀ hOc hsgn hph hB
    exact branches_walk_hit hOc hB hX hY (by simpa [headOut] using hhead) hhit b
  | succ m ih =>
    intro st v b₁ hO₀ hOc hsgn hph hB hlen hsteps hpath b
    obtain ⟨ℓ₁, harc, hrest⟩ := hpath.succ'
    obtain ⟨X, Y, hX, hY, hhead⟩ := reaches_head hO₀ hOc hsgn hph hB
    by_cases hhit : v = x ∧ st.sgn = st.phase
    · -- the end of the half is reached already
      exact branches_walk_hit (hhit.1 ▸ hOc) hB hX hY (by simpa [headOut, hhit.1] using hhead)
        hhit.2 b
    · -- one step along the walk
      rw [headOut, ite_eq_right (by simpa using hhit)] at hhead
      set st₁ : St := { st with t₁ := X, t₂ := Y }
      have hB₁ : st₁.Bounded (bnd φ) := by simp only [st₁]; bounded_tac
      obtain ⟨st₂, b₂, hbr, h₀, hph₂, hst₂, hln₂, hocc, hsg₂, hB₂⟩ := branches_arc
        (st := st₁) hOc hsgn hB₁ hlen (by simp only [st₁]; omega) hw harc false
      have hsg₂' : decide (st₂.sgn = 1) = ℓ₁.2 := by rw [hsg₂, decide_toNat_eq_one]
      obtain ⟨l, st', b', hbr', h0, h1⟩ := ih st₂ (v := ℓ₁.1) (b₁ := ℓ₁.2)
        (by rw [h₀]; exact hO₀) hocc.2 (by rw [hsg₂]; exact Bool.toNat_le _)
        (by rw [hph₂]; exact hph) hB₂ (by rw [hln₂]; exact hlen)
        (by rw [hst₂, hln₂]; simp only [st₁]; omega)
        (by rw [hsg₂', hph₂]; exact hrest) b₂
      refine ⟨l, st', b', (branches_of_reaches' hhead (by omega) b false).trans
        (hbr.trans hbr'), fun hp => ?_, fun hp => h1 (by rw [hph₂]; exact hp)⟩
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇, h₈⟩ := h0 (by rw [hph₂]; exact hp)
      exact ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, by rw [h₄, h₀], by rw [h₅, hln₂], h₆, h₇, h₈⟩

/-- A formula has at most as many occurrences of literals as its encoding has bits. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
private theorem exists_relatesInSteps {ℓ ℓ' : Literal ℕ}
    (h : Relation.ReflTransGen φ.Implies ℓ ℓ') :
    ∃ m ≤ (encCNF φ).length, Relation.RelatesInSteps φ.Implies ℓ ℓ' m := by
  have hsub : {y | Relation.ReflTransGen φ.Implies ℓ y} ⊆
      insert ℓ (↑φ.flatten.toFinset : Set (Literal ℕ)) := by
    intro y hy
    rcases Relation.ReflTransGen.cases_tail hy with rfl | ⟨z, -, c, hc, -, hy, -⟩
    · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
    · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (by simpa using ⟨c, hc, hy⟩)
  have hcard : {y | Relation.ReflTransGen φ.Implies ℓ y}.encard ≤
      ((φ.flatten.length : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 :=
    calc _ ≤ (insert ℓ (↑φ.flatten.toFinset : Set (Literal ℕ))).encard :=
          Set.encard_le_encard hsub
      _ ≤ (↑φ.flatten.toFinset : Set (Literal ℕ)).encard + 1 := Set.encard_insert_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by
        rw [Set.encard_coe_eq_coe_finsetCard]
        gcongr
        exact_mod_cast List.toFinset_card_le _
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hsteps⟩ := h.relatesWithinSteps_of_encard_le hcard
  exact ⟨m, hm.trans (length_flatten_le_length_encCNF φ), hsteps⟩
