private theorem branches_modeB_init {x m₁ : ℕ}
    (hpath₁ : Relation.RelatesInSteps φ.Implies (x, true) (x, false) (m₁ + 1)) :
    ∃ o ≤ bnd φ, InfixAt (encCNF φ) o (literalBits x false) ∧
      Branches (P := decider) (w := encCNF φ) decider.init
        (35, ({ len := (encCNF φ).length, p := o, o₀ := o, cur := o, sgn := 1 } : St).regs
          (false : Bool).toNat) := by
  -- an occurrence of `x`: the first arc out of `x` comes from a clause containing `¬x`
  obtain ⟨ℓ₁, ⟨c, hcφ, hneg, -, -⟩, -⟩ := hpath₁.succ'
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hcφ
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjx⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hneg
  have hB : ({ len := (encCNF φ).length } : St).Bounded (bnd φ) := by
    simp only [St.Bounded, bnd]; omega
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqB, hscan⟩ := branches_scan (φ := φ) (l₀ := 20) (skip := 22) (inspect := 27)
    rfl rfl codeAt_skipClause₂₂ (by omega) (by omega) φ (clausesAt_encCNF φ) rfl hB i hi false
    false
  obtain ⟨o, ho, hlit⟩ := branches_lit (φ[i]) hq
    (st := { ({ len := (encCNF φ).length } : St) with p := q }) rfl (by bounded_tac) j hj false
    false
  replace ho : InfixAt (encCNF φ) o (literalBits x false) := by rw [hjx] at ho; exact ho
  have hoB := le_bnd_of_infixAt ho (literalBits_ne_nil _ _)
  refine ⟨o, by omega, ho, ?_⟩
  rw [init_decider]
  refine (branches_of_reaches' (reaches_count 0 (Nat.zero_le _)) (by omega) false true).trans ?_
  refine (branches_choice (show decider.instr 2 = _ from rfl) _ true false).trans ?_
  simp only [↓reduceIte]
  exact hscan.trans (hlit.trans
    (branches_of_reaches' (reaches_pick rfl (by bounded_tac)) (by omega) false false))

/-- **An accepting branch for a variable `x` with a path from `x` to `¬x` and one back**, for a
formula whose clauses have one or two literals. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem branches_modeB (hw : ∀ c ∈ φ, 1 ≤ c.length ∧ c.length ≤ 2) {x : ℕ}
    (h₁ : Relation.ReflTransGen φ.Implies (x, true) (x, false))
    (h₂ : Relation.ReflTransGen φ.Implies (x, false) (x, true)) :
    ∃ s, Branches (P := decider) (w := encCNF φ) decider.init s ∧
      decider.instr s.1 = .accept := by
  obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁, hpath₁⟩ := exists_relatesInSteps h₁
  obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂, hpath₂⟩ := exists_relatesInSteps h₂
  rcases m₁ with _ | m₁
  · simp at hpath₁
  rcases m₂ with _ | m₂
  · simp at hpath₂
  obtain ⟨o, hoB, ho, hto35⟩ := branches_modeB_init hpath₁
  set st₀ : St := { len := (encCNF φ).length, p := o, o₀ := o, cur := o, sgn := 1 }
  have hB₀ : st₀.Bounded (bnd φ) := by simp only [st₀]; bounded_tac
  -- the first half, from `x` to `¬x`
  obtain ⟨l, st₁, b₁, hbr₁, h0, -⟩ := branches_walk hw (m₁ + 1) st₀ (v := x) (b₁ := false) ho ho
    (by simp [st₀]) (by simp [st₀]) hB₀ rfl (by simp only [st₀]; omega)
    (by simpa [st₀] using hpath₁) false
  obtain ⟨rfl, hph₁, hst₁, ho₁, hln₁, hB₁, hsg₁, b₂, hcur₁⟩ := h0 rfl
  -- the second half, from `¬x` to `x`, starting with an arc
  obtain ⟨ℓ₂, harc, hrest⟩ := hpath₂.succ'
  obtain ⟨st₂, b₃, hbr₂, h₂₀, h₂₁, h₂₂, h₂₃, hocc, hsg₂, hB₂⟩ := branches_arc hcur₁
    (by rw [hsg₁]; omega) hB₁ hln₁ (by rw [hst₁, hln₁]; simp only [st₀]; omega) hw
    (by simpa [hsg₁] using harc) b₁
  obtain ⟨l', st₃, b₄, hbr₃, -, h1⟩ := branches_walk hw m₂ st₂ (v := ℓ₂.1) (b₁ := ℓ₂.2)
    (by rw [h₂₀, ho₁]; exact ho) hocc.2 (by rw [hsg₂]; exact Bool.toNat_le _)
    (by rw [h₂₁, hph₁]) hB₂ (by rw [h₂₃, hln₁])
    (by rw [h₂₂, hst₁, h₂₃, hln₁]; simp only [st₀]; omega)
    (by rw [hsg₂, decide_toNat_eq_one, h₂₁, hph₁]; exact hrest) b₃
  obtain rfl := h1 (by rw [h₂₁, hph₁])
  exact ⟨_, hto35.trans (hbr₁.trans (hbr₂.trans hbr₃)), rfl⟩

/-- **The decider accepts exactly the formulas outside `TwoSAT`**: some branch accepts exactly
then. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
private theorem notMem_STCON_of_eval_reachabilityFormula {I : STCONInstance} {σ : ℕ → Bool}
    (hσ : (reachabilityFormula I).eval σ = true) : I ∉ STCON := by
  -- a satisfying assignment makes every reachable vertex true
  rw [mem_STCON]
  intro hst
  have hcl : ∀ c ∈ reachabilityFormula I, ∃ l ∈ c, σ l.1 = l.2 := fun c hc =>
    (Clause.eval_eq_true_iff σ c).mp ((CNF.eval_eq_true_iff σ _).mp hσ c hc)
  have key : ∀ x, Relation.ReflTransGen I.Adj I.s x → σ x = true := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx with
    | refl =>
      obtain ⟨l, hl, hlσ⟩ := hcl _ (mem_reachabilityFormula.mpr (.inl rfl))
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hl
      subst hl
      exact hlσ
    | @tail y z _ hyz ih =>
      have harc : arc I y z = true := by
        rw [arc, dite_eq_left ⟨y.isLt, z.isLt⟩]
        exact hyz
      obtain ⟨l, hl, hlσ⟩ := hcl _ (mem_reachabilityFormula.mpr (.inr (.inr ⟨y, z, harc, rfl⟩)))
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hl
      rcases hl with rfl | rfl
      · simp only at hlσ
        exact absurd (ih.symm.trans hlσ) (by decide)
      · exact hlσ
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hlσ⟩ := hcl _ (mem_reachabilityFormula.mpr (.inr (.inl rfl)))
  rw [List.mem_singleton] at hl
  subst hl
  simp only at hlσ
  exact absurd ((key _ hst).symm.trans hlσ) (by decide)

private theorem reachesOut_literalCode_loop {b r exit : ℕ} {sign : Bool}

      refine ReachesOut.emit (hi 10 (by omega)) hB' (ReachesOut.assign (hi 12 (by omega)) hB' ?_)

      refine ReachesOut.emit (hi 11 (by omega)) hB' (ReachesOut.assign (hi 12 (by omega)) hB' ?_)

theorem reachesOut_literalCode {b r exit : ℕ} {sign : Bool}
    (hcode : P.CodeAt b (literalCode b r sign exit)) {regs : List ℕ} (h5 : 5 < regs.length)
    (hB : ∀ x ∈ regs, x ≤ B) :
    P.ReachesOut w (P.Active B) (b, regs) (exit, regs.set 5 0)
      (literalBits (regs.getD r 0) sign) := by
  have hi (i : ℕ) (h : i < 23) := hcode i (length_literalCode b r sign exit ▸ h)
  have hrB : regs.getD r 0 ≤ B := by
    rcases lt_or_ge r regs.length with hr | hr
    · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hr]
      exact hB _ (List.getElem_mem hr)
    · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ hr]
      exact Nat.zero_le _
  have hB0 : ∀ x ∈ regs.set 5 0, x ≤ B :=
    List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB (Nat.zero_le _)
  -- the register, then the end of the literal
  have htail : P.ReachesOut w (P.Active B) (b + 13, regs.set 5 0) (exit, regs.set 5 0)
      [true, true, true, false, true, true, true, sign, true, false] :=
    ReachesOut.emit (hi 13 (by omega)) hB0 <| ReachesOut.emit (hi 14 (by omega)) hB0 <|
      ReachesOut.emit (hi 15 (by omega)) hB0 <| ReachesOut.emit (hi 16 (by omega)) hB0 <|
      ReachesOut.emit (hi 17 (by omega)) hB0 <| ReachesOut.emit (hi 18 (by omega)) hB0 <|
      ReachesOut.emit (hi 19 (by omega)) hB0 <| ReachesOut.emit (hi 20 (by omega)) hB0 <|
      ReachesOut.emit (hi 21 (by omega)) hB0 <| ReachesOut.emit (hi 22 (by omega)) hB0 <|
      ReachesOut.refl _
  have hdigits := reachesOut_literalCode_loop (w := w) hcode (regs.getD r 0)
    (regs.set 5 (regs.getD r 0)) (List.getD_set_self (by omega)) (by simpa using h5)
    (List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB hrB)
  rw [List.set_set] at hdigits
  refine ReachesOut.assign (hi 0 (by omega)) hB ?_
  simp only [eval_reg]
  exact (hdigits.trans htail).of_eq rfl

    writer.ReachesOut I.encode (writer.Active B)
      (60, [I.n, I.s, I.t, u, v, 0]) (59, [I.n, I.s, I.t, u, v, 0])
      (if arc I u v then literalBits u false ++ literalBits v true ++ [false] else []) := by
  -- an entry of the matrix
  have hs := I.s.isLt
  have ht := I.t.isLt
  have hb : ∀ z ∈ [I.n, (I.s : ℕ), (I.t : ℕ), u, v, 0], z ≤ B :=
    bounded6 hB (by omega) (by omega) (hu.le.trans hB) (hv.le.trans hB) (Nat.zero_le _)
  have hlit₁ : writer.CodeAt 61 (literalCode 61 3 false 84) := codeAt_literal fun i hi => by
    interval_cases i <;> rfl
  have hlit₂ : writer.CodeAt 84 (literalCode 84 4 true 107) := codeAt_literal fun i hi => by
    interval_cases i <;> rfl
  refine ReachesOut.read (show writer.instr 60 = _ from rfl) hb ?_
  simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_reg, eval_const, List.getD_cons_zero,
    List.getD_cons_succ, I.getElem?_encode_matrix hu hv]

    rw [arc, dite_eq_left ⟨hu, hv⟩]

  · simp only [readLabel, ↓reduceIte]
    have h₁ := reachesOut_literalCode (w := I.encode) (B := B) hlit₁
      (regs := [I.n, I.s, I.t, u, v, 0]) (by simp) hb
    have h₂ := reachesOut_literalCode (w := I.encode) (B := B) hlit₂

theorem reaches_skipClauseCode {b p exit : ℕ} (hcode : P.CodeAt b (skipClauseCode b p exit))
    (hp : p ≠ 0) {regs : List ℕ} (hlen : p < regs.length) {pos : ℕ} {ls : Clause ℕ}
    (hls : LitsAt w pos ls) (hpos : regs.getD p 0 = pos) (hB : ∀ r ∈ regs, r ≤ B)
    (hend : pos + (ls.flatMap fun l => literalBits l.1 l.2).length + 1 ≤ B) :
    P.Reaches w (P.Oblivious B) (b, regs)
      (exit, regs.set p (pos + (ls.flatMap fun l => literalBits l.1 l.2).length + 1)) := by
  have hc := codeAt_append.mp hcode
  have hc' := codeAt_append.mp hc.1
  have h₀ : P.instr b = read (reg p) (b + 1) (b + 4) (b + 4) := (codeAt_cons.mp hc'.1).1
  have hskip : P.CodeAt (b + 1) (skipLitCode (b + 1) p b) := by simpa using hc'.2
  have h₄ : P.instr (b + 4) = assign p (add (reg p) (const 1)) exit := by
    simpa [skipLitCode] using (codeAt_cons.mp hc.2).1
  induction ls generalizing pos regs with
  | nil =>
    refine Reaches.oread h₀ (by simp [Expr.readsChoice, hp]) hB ?_
    simp only [eval_reg, hpos, hls.getElem?_nil, readLabel]
    refine Reaches.oassign h₄ hp (by simp [Expr.readsChoice, hp]) hB ?_
    simp only [eval_add, eval_reg, eval_const, hpos, List.flatMap_nil, List.length_nil,
      Nat.add_zero]
    exact Reaches.refl _
  | cons l ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hl, hrest⟩ := hls.cons
    have hlB : pos + (literalBits l.1 l.2).length ≤ B := by
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.length_append] at hend
      omega
    refine Reaches.oread h₀ (by simp [Expr.readsChoice, hp]) hB ?_
    simp only [eval_reg, hpos, hl.literal_start, readLabel]
    refine (reaches_skipLitCode hskip hp hlen hl hpos hB hlB).trans ?_
    have := ih (regs := regs.set p (pos + (literalBits l.1 l.2).length)) (by simpa using hlen)
      hrest (List.getD_set_self hlen) (List.forall_mem_set_of_forall_mem hB hlB)

private theorem reaches_cmpVarCode_loop :
    ∀ e k, min v₁.bits.length v₂.bits.length - k = e →
      k ≤ v₁.bits.length → k ≤ v₂.bits.length →
      (∀ k' (h₁ : k' < v₁.bits.length) (h₂ : k' < v₂.bits.length), k' < k →
        v₁.bits[k'] = v₂.bits[k']) →
      ∃ x y, x ≤ B ∧ y ≤ B ∧ P.Reaches w (P.Oblivious B) (b + 2, cmpCur regs t₁ t₂ pos₁ pos₂ k)
        (if v₁ = v₂ then eq else ne, (regs.set t₁ x).set t₂ y) := by
  intro e
  induction e with
  | zero =>
    intro k he hk₁ hk₂ hpre
    have h₁ := hend₁
    have h₂ := hend₂
    rw [length_literalBits] at h₁ h₂
    exact ⟨pos₁ + 8 * k, pos₂ + 8 * k, by omega, by omega,
      reaches_cmpVarCode_end hcode ht₁ ht₂ htt hlen₁ hlen₂ hl₁ hl₂ hB hend₁ hend₂ hk₁ hk₂
        (by omega) hpre⟩
  | succ e ih =>
    intro k he hk₁ hk₂ hpre
    have hk₁' : k < v₁.bits.length := by omega
    have hk₂' : k < v₂.bits.length := by omega
    have hdig := reaches_cmpVarCode_digit hcode ht₁ ht₂ htt hlen₁ hlen₂ hl₁ hl₂ hB hend₁ hend₂
      hk₁' hk₂'
    by_cases hd : v₁.bits[k] = v₂.bits[k]
    · -- equal digits, then the next ones
      rw [ite_eq_left hd] at hdig
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hreach⟩ := ih (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
        fun k' h₁ h₂ hk' => (lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hk')).elim (hpre k' h₁ h₂)
          fun h => h ▸ hd
      exact ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hdig.trans ((reaches_cmpVarCode_advance hcode ht₁ ht₂ htt hlen₁ hlen₂
        hB hend₁ hend₂ hk₁' hk₂').trans hreach)⟩
    · rw [ite_eq_right hd] at hdig
      have hne : v₁ ≠ v₂ := fun h => by subst h; exact hd rfl
      have h₁ := hend₁
      have h₂ := hend₂
      rw [length_literalBits] at h₁ h₂
      refine ⟨pos₁ + 8 * k, pos₂ + 8 * k, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      simpa [hne] using hdig

theorem mem_VertexCover_iff {G : Graph} {k : ℕ} :
    (G, k) ∈ VertexCover ↔ ∃ S : Finset ℕ, (∀ v ∈ S, v ∈ G.1) ∧

  · rintro ⟨S, hS, hcard⟩

      (Finset.card_map _).trans hcard⟩
  · rintro ⟨S, hSV, hS, rfl⟩

      (Graph.computableInPolyTime_distinctVertices.tidy.comp (fst _ _))

      (fun x : Graph × ℕ => Cslib.BitString.boundedBinaryValue x.1.1.toFinset.card

    bitsBoundedBinaryValueWithInput hn (bitsReverse.comp ((encode encNat).comp (snd _ _)))

      (x.1, if Cslib.BitString.boundedBinaryValue x.1.1.toFinset.card (encNat x.2).reverse = x.2
        then x.1.1.toFinset.card -

theorem leafScore_add_one_le_leafScore_path {M : ℝ} {d : ℕ} {q : ι → ℝ} {x : ι → Bool}
    (t : DecisionTree ι β) {p : List Bool} (ht : t.depth ≤ d) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hq : ∀ i, |q i| ≤ M) (htrue : ∀ i, x i = true → 1 ≤ q i)
    (hfalse : ∀ i, x i = false → q i ≤ -1) (hp : p ∈ t.paths) (hne : p ≠ t.path x) :
    leafScore (2 * M + 1) d q t p + 1 ≤ leafScore (2 * M + 1) d q t (t.path x) := by
  induction t generalizing d p with
  | leaf _ =>
    rw [paths_leaf, List.mem_singleton] at hp
    exact (hne (hp.trans rfl)).elim
  | node i left right ihl ihr =>
    have hleft : left.depth ≤ d - 1 := by
      rw [depth_node] at ht
      omega
    have hright : right.depth ≤ d - 1 := by
      rw [depth_node] at ht
      omega
    rw [paths_node, List.mem_append, List.mem_map, List.mem_map] at hp
    rcases hp with ⟨p', hp', rfl⟩ | ⟨p', hp', rfl⟩
    · cases hx : x i with
      | false =>
        have hp'ne : p' ≠ left.path x := fun h => hne (by simp [path, hx, h])
        simpa [path, hx, leafScore] using ihl hleft hp' hp'ne
      | true =>
        simpa only [path, hx, Bool.cond_true, leafScore] using
          leafScore_add_one_le_add_of_le left right p' (right.path x) hleft hright hM hq
            (htrue i hx)
    · cases hx : x i with
      | false =>
        have hcross := leafScore_add_one_le_add_of_le right left p' (left.path x) hright hleft hM
          hq (show 1 ≤ -q i by linarith [hfalse i hx])
        simp only [path, hx, Bool.cond_false, leafScore]
        linarith
      | true =>
        have hp'ne : p' ≠ right.path x := fun h => hne (by simp [path, hx, h])
        have hrec := ihr hright hp' hp'ne
        simp only [path, hx, Bool.cond_true, leafScore]
        linarith

theorem depth_canonicalTree_le (ρ : PartialAssignment ι) :
    (F.canonicalTree ρ).depth ≤ univ.sup (F.pathLength ρ) := by
  by_cases h : F.queried ρ = []
  · simp [canonicalTree_of_queried_eq_nil h]
  rw [canonicalTree_of_queried_ne_nil h]
  set V := F.queried ρ
  have hV : V.length ≤ univ.sup (F.pathLength ρ) :=
    le_sup_of_le (mem_univ fun _ => false)
      ((pathLength_of_queried_ne_nil h _).symm ▸ Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  refine (depth_graft_le V _ _ (d := univ.sup (F.pathLength ρ) - V.length) fun a => ?_).trans
    (by omega)
  refine (depth_canonicalTree_le (ρ.assign V.toFinset a)).trans ?_
  obtain ⟨y, -, hy⟩ := exists_mem_eq_sup univ univ_nonempty
    (F.pathLength (ρ.assign V.toFinset a))
  rw [hy]
  -- The input reading `a` on `V` and `y` elsewhere has a query path through `V`.
  set x : ι → Bool := fun j => if j ∈ V then a j else y j
  have hxa : ρ.assign V.toFinset x = ρ.assign V.toFinset a := by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ V <;> simp [x, hi]
  have hpath : F.pathLength ρ x = V.length + F.pathLength (ρ.assign V.toFinset a) y := by
    rw [pathLength_of_queried_ne_nil h, hxa]
    refine congrArg (V.length + ·) (pathLength_congr fun i hi => ?_)
    rw [PartialAssignment.free_assign] at hi
    simp [x, show i ∉ V from fun h' => (mem_sdiff.1 hi).2 (List.mem_toFinset.2 h')]
  have := le_sup (f := F.pathLength ρ) (mem_univ x)
  omega

theorem complexity_le_certificateComplexityFor_mul (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    complexity f ≤ certificateComplexityFor f false * certificateComplexityFor f true := by
  suffices ∀ m (f : BooleanFunction n), certificateComplexityFor f false ≤ m →
      complexity f ≤ m * certificateComplexityFor f true from this _ f le_rfl
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro f hf
    refine (complexity_eq_zero_iff.2 fun x y => ?_).trans_le (Nat.zero_le _)
    -- With `C₀(f) = 0`, every input of value `0` is certified by no variable.
    by_contra hxy
    wlog hx : f x = false generalizing x y
    · exact this y x (Ne.symm hxy) (by simpa [hx] using hxy)
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hcard⟩ := exists_isCertificate_card_eq f x
    have : S = ∅ := card_eq_zero.1 (hcard.trans (Nat.le_zero.1
      ((certificateComplexityAt_le_certificateComplexityFor hx).trans hf)))
    subst this
    exact hxy (hS y fun _ h => absurd h (notMem_empty _)).symm
  | succ m ih =>
    intro f hf
    by_cases h1 : ∃ x, f x = true
    swap
    · push Not at h1
      exact (complexity_eq_zero_iff.2 fun x y => by simp [h1 x, h1 y]).trans_le (Nat.zero_le _)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hScard⟩ := exists_isCertificate_card_eq f x
    -- Query the certificate of `x`, then continue with a tree for the restricted function.
    refine (complexity_le_card_add S (d := m * certificateComplexityFor f true) fun a =>
      (ih _ (certificateComplexityFor_restrict_lt hS a (by simp [hx]) hf)).trans
        (Nat.mul_le_mul_left m (certificateComplexityFor_restrict_le S a true))).trans ?_
    rw [hScard, Nat.succ_mul, add_comm]
    exact Nat.add_le_add_left (certificateComplexityAt_le_certificateComplexityFor hx) _

private theorem eval_toDNFAux (t : DecisionTree ι Bool) (p : Term ι) (x : ι → Bool) :
    DNF.eval x (toDNFAux t p) = (p.eval x && t.eval x) := by
  induction t generalizing p with
  | leaf b => cases b <;> simp [toDNFAux, DNF.eval]
  | node i t₀ t₁ ih₀ ih₁ =>
    simp only [toDNFAux, eval_node]
    cases h : p.lookup i with
    | some b =>
      cases b <;> simp only [ih₀, ih₁] <;> cases hp : p.eval x <;>
        first | (simp; done) | simp [eval_lookup h hp]
    | none =>
      simp only [DNF.eval_append, ih₀, ih₁, Term.eval_cons, Literal.eval]
      cases x i <;> simp

      exact ⟨h₁.trans (by simp only [depth_node]; omega), h₂⟩
    · obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := ih₀ hq

    (observe : X → I → Bool) (answer : Q → X → Bool) (output : X → β)
    (hout : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, observe x = observe y → output x = output y)
    (hquery : ∀ T : Finset X, T ⊆ S → T.Nonempty →
      (∃ x ∈ T, ∃ y ∈ T, observe x ≠ observe y) →
      ∃ (q : Q) (i : I), (∀ x ∈ T, answer q x = observe x i) ∧
        ∀ b : Bool, (T.filter fun x => observe x i = b).Nonempty) :
    ∃ t : DecisionTree Q β, (∀ x ∈ S, t.eval (fun q => answer q x) = output x) ∧
      t.depth ≤ Fintype.card I ∧ t.leafCount ≤ (S.image observe).card := by
  classical
  have build (remaining : Finset I) : ∀ T : Finset X, T ⊆ S → T.Nonempty →
      (∀ x ∈ T, ∀ y ∈ T, ∀ i ∉ remaining, observe x i = observe y i) →
      ∃ t : DecisionTree Q β, (∀ x ∈ T, t.eval (fun q => answer q x) = output x) ∧
        t.depth ≤ remaining.card ∧ t.leafCount ≤ (T.image observe).card := by
    induction remaining using Finset.strongInductionOn with
    | _ remaining ih =>
      intro T hTS hT hfixed
      obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hT
      by_cases hconstant : ∀ x ∈ T, observe x = observe x₀
      · exact ⟨.leaf (output x₀), fun x hx =>
          hout x₀ (hTS hx₀) x (hTS hx) (hconstant x hx).symm,
          Nat.zero_le _, card_pos.mpr ⟨observe x₀, mem_image.mpr ⟨x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩⟩⟩
      · obtain ⟨x, hx, hne⟩ := by simpa only [not_forall, not_imp] using hconstant
        obtain ⟨q, i, hq, hbranches⟩ := hquery T hTS ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ ⟨x, hx, x₀, hx₀, hne⟩
        have hi : i ∈ remaining := mem_remaining_of_branches hfixed hbranches
        have branch (b : Bool) :
            ∃ t : DecisionTree Q β,
              (∀ x ∈ T.filter (fun x => observe x i = b),
                t.eval (fun q => answer q x) = output x) ∧
              t.depth ≤ (remaining.erase i).card ∧
              t.leafCount ≤ ((T.filter (fun x => observe x i = b)).image observe).card :=
          ih (remaining.erase i) (erase_ssubset hi) _
            ((filter_subset _ _).trans hTS) (hbranches b) (fixed_of_mem_filter_erase hfixed)
        obtain ⟨left, hl, hld, hlc⟩ := branch false
        obtain ⟨right, hr, hrd, hrc⟩ := branch true
        refine ⟨.node q left right, ?_,
          (Nat.add_le_add_right (max_le hld hrd) 1).trans_eq (card_erase_add_one hi),
          (Nat.add_le_add hlc hrc).trans_eq (card_image_filter_false_add_true T observe i)⟩
        intro x hx
        simp only [eval_node, hq x hx]
        cases hb : observe x i
        · exact hl x (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, hb⟩)
        · exact hr x (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, hb⟩)
  simpa only [card_univ] using build univ S (Subset.refl _) hS
    (fun _ _ _ _ i hi => (hi (mem_univ i)).elim)

    ∃ (b : Bool) (A' : Finset X) (B' : Finset Y), A' ⊆ A ∧ B' ⊆ B ∧

      (if b then 1 - a else a) * A.card ≤ (A'.card : ℝ) ∧
      (if b then 1 - a else a) * B.card ≤ (B'.card : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ A', ∀ y ∈ B', q.eval x y = b := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hxlo, hxhi⟩ := A.exists_quantile hA q.left ha ha₁
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, hylo, hyhi⟩ := B.exists_quantile hB q.right ha ha₁

      Finset.filter_subset _ _, ⟨x₀, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx₀, le_rfl⟩⟩,

        (q.monotone_right (q.left x₀) (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2)

theorem exists_leaf_rectangle_biMonotone (t : DecisionTree (BiMonotoneComparison X Y) β)
    (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    ∃ (A' : Finset X) (B' : Finset Y) (p : List Bool), A' ⊆ A ∧ B' ⊆ B ∧
      A'.Nonempty ∧ B'.Nonempty ∧ A.card ≤ A'.card * t.leafCount ∧ B.card ≤ B'.card * t.leafCount ∧
      ∀ x ∈ A', ∀ y ∈ B', t.path (fun q => q.eval x y) = p := by
  classical
  induction t generalizing A B with
  | leaf b => exact ⟨A, B, [], fun _ h => h, fun _ h => h, hA, hB,
      by simp [leafCount], by simp [leafCount], fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  | node q left right ihl ihr =>
    have hl : (0 : ℝ) < left.leafCount := Nat.cast_pos.mpr left.leafCount_pos
    have hr : (0 : ℝ) < right.leafCount := Nat.cast_pos.mpr right.leafCount_pos
    have ht : (0 : ℝ) < left.leafCount + right.leafCount := add_pos hl hr
    let a : ℝ := left.leafCount / (left.leafCount + right.leafCount)
    have ha : 0 < a := div_pos hl ht
    have ha₁ : a < 1 := (div_lt_one ht).mpr (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨b, A₀, B₀, hA₀, hB₀, hA₀ne, hB₀ne, hAc, hBc, hquery⟩ :=
      q.exists_rectangle A B hA hB ha.le ha₁.le
    cases b with
    | false =>
      obtain ⟨A', B', p, hA', hB', hA'ne, hB'ne, hAl, hBl, hp⟩ := ihl A₀ B₀ hA₀ne hB₀ne
      refine ⟨A', B', false :: p, hA'.trans hA₀, hB'.trans hB₀, hA'ne, hB'ne,
        le_mul_of_div_mul_le left.leafCount_pos (Nat.add_pos_left left.leafCount_pos _) ?_ hAl,
        le_mul_of_div_mul_le left.leafCount_pos (Nat.add_pos_left left.leafCount_pos _) ?_ hBl, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, a, leafCount, Nat.cast_add] using hAc
      · simpa only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, a, leafCount, Nat.cast_add] using hBc
      · intro x hx y hy
        simp only [path, hquery x (hA' hx) y (hB' hy), Bool.cond_false, hp x hx y hy]
    | true =>
      have heq : 1 - a = right.leafCount / (left.leafCount + right.leafCount : ℝ) := by
        dsimp only [a]
        field_simp
        ring
      obtain ⟨A', B', p, hA', hB', hA'ne, hB'ne, hAr, hBr, hp⟩ := ihr A₀ B₀ hA₀ne hB₀ne
      refine ⟨A', B', true :: p, hA'.trans hA₀, hB'.trans hB₀, hA'ne, hB'ne,
        le_mul_of_div_mul_le right.leafCount_pos (Nat.add_pos_left left.leafCount_pos _) ?_ hAr,
        le_mul_of_div_mul_le right.leafCount_pos (Nat.add_pos_left left.leafCount_pos _) ?_ hBr, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [↓reduceIte, heq, leafCount, Nat.cast_add] using hAc
      · simpa only [↓reduceIte, heq, leafCount, Nat.cast_add] using hBc
      · intro x hx y hy
        simp only [path, hquery x (hA' hx) y (hB' hy), Bool.cond_true, hp x hx y hy]

theorem card_mul_le_mul_leafCount_sq_biMonotone (t : DecisionTree (BiMonotoneComparison X Y) β)
    (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty) {R : ℕ}
    (hR : ∀ (A' : Finset X), A' ⊆ A → ∀ (B' : Finset Y), B' ⊆ B → ∀ z,
      (∀ x ∈ A', ∀ y ∈ B', t.eval (fun q => q.eval x y) = z) → A'.card * B'.card ≤ R) :
    A.card * B.card ≤ R * t.leafCount ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨A', B', p, hA', hB', ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩, ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩, hAc, hBc, hp⟩ :=
    t.exists_leaf_rectangle_biMonotone A B hA hB
  have harea := hR A' hA' B' hB' (t.eval fun q => q.eval x₀ y₀) fun x hx y hy =>
    t.eval_eq_of_path_eq ((hp x hx y hy).trans (hp x₀ hx₀ y₀ hy₀).symm)
  calc A.card * B.card ≤ (A'.card * t.leafCount) * (B'.card * t.leafCount) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul hAc hBc
    _ = (A'.card * B'.card) * t.leafCount ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ R * t.leafCount ^ 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ harea

    {s : ℕ} {x : ι → Bool} (hs : s ≤ F.pathLength ρ x) (Q : Finset ι) :
    F.decodeAux none (F.encode s ρ x).1 Q (F.encode s ρ x).2 = ρ.unassign Q := by
  by_cases h : F.queried ρ = []
  · rw [encode_of_queried_eq_nil h]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_firstTerm_of_queried_ne_nil h
  have htV : ∀ v ∈ F.queried ρ, v ∈ t.map Prod.fst := fun v hv => mem_map_fst_of_mem_queried ht hv
  by_cases hsV : s ≤ (F.queried ρ).length
  · rw [encode_of_le h hsV, ht, Option.getD_some]
    dsimp only
    by_cases hs0 : s = 0
    · subst hs0
      simp only [List.take_zero, List.toFinset_nil, Term.stageCode, decodeAux]
      exact congrArg (PartialAssignment.unassign · Q) (PartialAssignment.assign_eq_self (by simp))
    have hW : (F.queried ρ).take s ≠ [] := by simp [List.take_eq_nil_iff, hs0, h]
    rw [decodeAux_none (Term.stageCode_eq_nil_iff.not.2 hW),
      firstTerm_assign_satisfying hF ht (PartialAssignment.Extends.refl ρ)
        (fun _ hv => List.mem_of_mem_take hv)
        (fun v hv _ => free_of_mem_queried hv),
      Option.getD_some, ← List.append_nil (Term.stageCode _ _ _),
      decodeAux_stageCode (fun v hv => htV v (List.mem_of_mem_take hv)) hW]
    simp only [decodeAux, PartialAssignment.assign_assign]
    exact PartialAssignment.unassign_union_assign (toFinset_take_queried_subset_free s) x
  · have hlt : (F.queried ρ).length < s := by omega
    rw [encode_of_lt h hlt, ht, Option.getD_some]
    dsimp only
    rw [decodeAux_none (List.append_ne_nil_of_left_ne_nil (Term.stageCode_eq_nil_iff.not.2 h) _),
      firstTerm_assign_satisfying hF ht ((encode_extends _ _ _).trans
          (PartialAssignment.extends_assign toFinset_queried_subset_free x))
        (fun _ hv => hv) (fun _ hv hv' => absurd hv hv'),
      Option.getD_some, decodeAux_stageCode htV h, PartialAssignment.assign_assign,
      PartialAssignment.assign_eq_self fun i hi => encode_assign_eq _ x hi,
      decodeAux_encode hF (ρ := ρ.assign (F.queried ρ).toFinset x) (by
        rw [pathLength_of_queried_ne_nil h] at hs

theorem card_filter_pathLength_le {k : ℕ} (hk : ∀ t ∈ F, t.length ≤ k)
    (hnd : ∀ t ∈ F, (t.map Prod.fst).Nodup) (ρ₀ : PartialAssignment ι) (ℓ s : ℕ) :
    #((ρ₀.extensions ℓ).filter fun ρ => ∃ x, s ≤ F.pathLength ρ x) ≤
      #(ρ₀.extensions (ℓ - s)) * (4 * k) ^ s := by
  set C := (Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin s => range k ×ˢ (univ : Finset (Bool × Bool))).image
    List.ofFn
  have hC : #C ≤ (4 * k) ^ s := card_image_le.trans (by simp [mul_comm])
  calc _ ≤ #((ρ₀.extensions (ℓ - s) ×ˢ C).image fun p => F.decode p.1 p.2) :=
        card_le_card fun ρ hρ => by
          obtain ⟨hρ, x, hx⟩ := mem_filter.1 hρ
          obtain ⟨hext, hcard⟩ := PartialAssignment.mem_extensions.1 hρ
          refine mem_image.2 ⟨F.encode s ρ x, mem_product.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩, decode_encode hnd hx⟩
          · refine PartialAssignment.mem_extensions.2 ⟨(encode_extends s ρ x).trans hext, ?_⟩
            rw [card_free_encode hnd hx, hcard]
          · exact mem_image_ofFn (length_encode hx) fun e he => fst_lt_of_mem_encode hk s ρ x he
    _ ≤ #(ρ₀.extensions (ℓ - s) ×ˢ C) := card_image_le
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [card_product]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hC

and reads each variable once, then at most `#E(ℓ - s) (4k)^s` of the extensions of `ρ₀` leaving `ℓ`
variables free leave `F` with decision tree complexity at least `s`, where `E(m)` are the
extensions of `ρ₀` leaving `m` variables free. For `ρ₀` fixing nothing, these are all restrictions

theorem eval_multilinearExtension_step (i : ℕ) (W : (Fin (C.width i) → Bool) → R)
    (z : Fin (C.width (i + 1)) → R) :
    eval z (multilinearExtension (C.step i W)) =
      ∑ b, ∑ c,
        (eval (Sum.elim z (Sum.elim (bitPoint b) (bitPoint c)))
            (multilinearExtension (C.addPred (R := R) i)) * (W b + W c) +
          eval (Sum.elim z (Sum.elim (bitPoint b) (bitPoint c)))
            (multilinearExtension (C.multPred (R := R) i)) * (W b * W c)) := by
  rw [eval_multilinearExtension_eq_sum (C.step i W)]
  simp only [eval_multilinearExtension_wiringPred, eval_indicatorPoly]
  have hinner : ∀ b c, (∑ a, if C.gate i a = .add then eval z (indicatorPoly a) *
        (if C.left i a = b then (1 : R) else 0) * (if C.right i a = c then 1 else 0) else 0) *
        (W b + W c) +
      (∑ a, if C.gate i a = .mul then eval z (indicatorPoly a) *
        (if C.left i a = b then (1 : R) else 0) * (if C.right i a = c then 1 else 0) else 0) *
        (W b * W c) =
      ∑ a, (if C.left i a = b ∧ C.right i a = c then eval z (indicatorPoly a) *
        (if C.gate i a = .add then W b + W c else W b * W c) else 0) := by
    intro b c
    rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    by_cases hb : C.left i a = b <;> by_cases hc : C.right i a = c <;>
      cases C.gate i a <;> simp [hb, hc]
  simp only [hinner]
  symm
  refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => Finset.sum_comm).trans (Finset.sum_comm.trans ?_)
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (C.left i a), Finset.sum_eq_single (C.right i a)]
  · simp only [and_self, ite_true, step]
    cases C.gate i a <;> simp [mul_comm]
  · intro c _ hc
    simp [Ne.symm hc]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => by simp [Ne.symm hb]
  · simp

theorem lineStep_rbrSound (W : (Fin (C.width i) → Bool) → F) :
    (C.lineStep i W).verifier.RbrSound (C.endLang i W) (C.layerLang i W)
      ((C.width i : ℝ≥0∞) / Fintype.card F, ()) := by
  refine ⟨fun x p => match p with
    | none => x ∈ C.endLang i W
    | some (_, none) => x ∈ C.endLang i W
    | some (q, some (t, _)) => x ∈ C.endLang i W ∨ (C.lineAccepts i x q ∧
        q.eval t = (restrictLine (x.2.1 ∘ Fin.castAdd _) (x.2.1 ∘ Fin.natAdd _) W).eval t),
    fun x hx h => hx h, fun x => ⟨fun hS _ h => hS h, fun q => ⟨?_, fun t => ?_⟩⟩⟩
  · intro hS
    change x ∉ C.endLang i W at hS
    change (ProbComp.eval (ProbComp.uniform F)).toOuterMeasure {t | x ∈ C.endLang i W ∨
      (C.lineAccepts i x q ∧ q.eval t =
        (restrictLine (x.2.1 ∘ Fin.castAdd _) (x.2.1 ∘ Fin.natAdd _) W).eval t)} ≤
          (C.width i : ℝ≥0∞) / Fintype.card F
    by_cases hacc : C.lineAccepts i x q
    · set q' := restrictLine (x.2.1 ∘ Fin.castAdd _) (x.2.1 ∘ Fin.natAdd _) W
      have hne : q - q' ≠ 0 := by
        refine sub_ne_zero.mpr fun h => hS ?_
        rw [C.mem_endLang, ← C.combine_restrictLine i W x]
        exact (h ▸ hacc.2).symm
      classical
      rw [ProbComp.eval_uniform, Probability.PMF.toOuterMeasure_uniformOfFintype, div_eq_mul_inv]
      gcongr
      have hsub : Finset.univ.filter (· ∈ {t | x ∈ C.endLang i W ∨
          (C.lineAccepts i x q ∧ q.eval t = q'.eval t)}) ⊆ (q - q').roots.toFinset := by
        intro t ht
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at ht
        rcases ht with ht | ht
        · exact absurd ht hS
        rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hne, Polynomial.IsRoot,
          Polynomial.eval_sub, ht.2, sub_self]
      exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans ((Multiset.toFinset_card_le _).trans
        ((Polynomial.card_roots' _).trans ((Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans
          (max_le hacc.1 (natDegree_restrictLine_le _ _ W)))))
    · simp [hacc, hS]
  · rintro hS ⟨y, hy, hout⟩
    rw [lineStep_outputOn] at hout
    split_ifs at hout with hacc
    obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hout
    exact hS (Or.inr ⟨hacc, hy.symm.trans (eval_restrictLine _ _ W t).symm⟩)

/-- **Schwartz–Zippel** at a uniform point: a nonzero polynomial of total degree at most `d`
vanishes with probability at most `d / |F|`. -/
theorem toOuterMeasure_eval_eq_zero_le {k d : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin k) F} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hdeg : p.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    (ProbComp.eval (ProbComp.uniform (Fin k → F))).toOuterMeasure {r | eval r p = 0} ≤
      (d : ℝ≥0∞) / Fintype.card F := by
  classical
  have hq : 0 < Fintype.card F := Fintype.card_pos
  have hsz := schwartz_zippel_totalDegree hp (Finset.univ : Finset F)
  rw [Fintype.piFinset_univ, Finset.card_univ, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    at hsz
  have hN : (Finset.univ.filter fun r : Fin k → F => eval r p = 0).card * Fintype.card F ≤
      d * Fintype.card F ^ k := by
    have : ((Finset.univ.filter fun r : Fin k → F => eval r p = 0).card * Fintype.card F : ℚ≥0) ≤
        d * Fintype.card F ^ k := hsz.trans (by gcongr)
    exact_mod_cast this
  rw [ProbComp.eval_uniform, Probability.PMF.toOuterMeasure_uniformOfFintype, Fintype.card_fun,
    Fintype.card_fin]
  set N := (Finset.univ.filter (· ∈ {r : Fin k → F | eval r p = 0})).card
  have hN' : ((N : ℝ≥0∞) * Fintype.card F) ≤ d * (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k := by
    have : N = (Finset.univ.filter fun r : Fin k → F => eval r p = 0).card := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact_mod_cast hN
  have hq0 : (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne'
  have hqt : (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _
  have hk0 : (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hq0
  have hkt : (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.pow_ne_top hqt
  push_cast
  calc (N : ℝ≥0∞) * ((Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k)⁻¹
      = N * ((Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k)⁻¹ *
          ((Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞) * (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) := by
        rw [ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hq0 hqt, mul_one]
    _ = (N * Fintype.card F) * ((Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k)⁻¹ *
          (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by ring
    _ ≤ (d * (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k) * ((Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k)⁻¹ *
          (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by gcongr
    _ = d / Fintype.card F := by
        rw [mul_assoc (d : ℝ≥0∞), ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hk0 hkt, mul_one, div_eq_mul_inv]

private theorem natDegree_aeval_le (k : Fin n) (φ : Fin n → Polynomial F)
    (hφ : ∀ j, j ≠ k → (φ j).natDegree = 0) (hk : (φ k).natDegree ≤ 1) :

    | none => partialSum P x.1 = x.2
    | some (g, none) => accepts d x.2 g ∧ g = roundPoly P x.1
    | some (g, some (z, _)) => accepts d x.2 g ∧ g.eval z = (roundPoly P x.1).eval z,

  · rintro hS m ⟨hacc, rfl⟩
    exact hS ((roundPoly_eval_zero_add_one P hi x.1).symm.trans hacc.2)
  · intro hS
    change (ProbComp.eval (ProbComp.uniform F)).toOuterMeasure
      {c | accepts d x.2 g ∧ g.eval c = (roundPoly P x.1).eval c} ≤ (d : ℝ≥0∞) / Fintype.card F
    by_cases hacc : accepts d x.2 g
    · have hne : g - roundPoly P x.1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr fun h => hS ⟨hacc, h⟩

    · simp [hacc]
  · rintro hS ⟨x', ⟨_, hx'⟩, hout⟩
    rw [round_outputOn] at hout
    split_ifs at hout with hacc
    obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hout

theorem exists_timeBounded_generator_le {G : List Bool → List Bool}
    (hG : ComputableInPolyTime G encBits encBits)
    (hstretch : ∀ z : List Bool, z.length ≤ (G z).length) :
    ∃ (pG : Polynomial ℕ) (c : ℕ),
      (∀ n, n + 1 ≤ pG.eval n) ∧
      Monotone pG.eval ∧
      ∀ {t : ℕ → ℕ}, (∀ m, pG.eval m ≤ t m) → ∀ z : List Bool,
        timeBounded t (G z) ≤ (z.length + c : ℕ) := by
  obtain ⟨tG, sG, htG, _, k, State, hfin, tm, htm⟩ := hG
  obtain ⟨c_tm, d_tm, hle⟩ := polynomiallyBounded_iff_le.mp htG
  obtain ⟨c_sim, hsim⟩ :=
    DescriptionMethod.exists_etimeBoundedComplexity_universalTM_le_ofMultiTapeTM tm
  let pG : Polynomial ℕ := Polynomial.C (c_tm + 1) * (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (d_tm + 1)
  have hpG_eval (n : ℕ) : pG.eval n = (c_tm + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d_tm + 1) := by
    simp [pG]
  have hpG_ge (n : ℕ) : n + 1 ≤ pG.eval n := by
    rw [hpG_eval, pow_succ']
    have hpow : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ d_tm := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    calc
      n + 1 = 1 * ((n + 1) * 1) := by ring
      _ ≤ (c_tm + 1) * ((n + 1) * (n + 1) ^ d_tm) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hpow)
  have hpG_mono : Monotone pG.eval := by
    intro a b hab
    dsimp only
    rw [hpG_eval, hpG_eval]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _)
  have htG_le (n : ℕ) : tG n ≤ pG.eval n := by
    rw [hpG_eval, pow_succ']
    have h1 := hle n
    have hpow : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ d_tm := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    have h2 : c_tm * (n + 1) ^ d_tm ≤ (c_tm + 1) * (n + 1) ^ d_tm :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    have h3 : (c_tm + 1) * (n + 1) ^ d_tm ≤ (c_tm + 1) * ((n + 1) * (n + 1) ^ d_tm) := by
      refine Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ?_
      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
    omega
  refine ⟨pG, c_sim, hpG_ge, hpG_mono, fun {t} ht z => ?_⟩
  have hcomp := htm z
  have hstep : tG z.length ≤ t (G z).length :=
    (htG_le z.length).trans ((hpG_mono (hstretch z)).trans (ht (G z).length))
  have htm_le : (DescriptionMethod.ofMultiTapeTM tm).etimeBoundedComplexity (tG z.length) (G z) ≤
      (z.length : ℕ∞) :=
    DescriptionMethod.etimeBoundedComplexity_ofMultiTapeTM_le hcomp.2.1 hcomp.1
  calc
    timeBounded t (G z) = timeBoundedAt (t (G z).length) (G z) := rfl
    _ ≤ timeBoundedAt (tG z.length) (G z) := timeBoundedAt_anti hstep
    _ ≤ (DescriptionMethod.ofMultiTapeTM tm).etimeBoundedComplexity (tG z.length) (G z) + c_sim :=
      hsim (tG z.length) (G z)
    _ ≤ (z.length : ℕ∞) + c_sim := add_le_add_left htm_le _
    _ = (z.length + c_sim : ℕ) := by rw [Nat.cast_add]

theorem exists_condTimeBoundedAt_le_of_computableInPolyTime
    {F : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool}
    (hF : ComputableInPolyTime F (encPair encBits encBits) encBits) :
    ∃ (pF : Polynomial ℕ) (c : ℕ),
      (∀ n, n + 1 ≤ pF.eval n) ∧
      Monotone pF.eval ∧
      ∀ {t : ℕ} (w y : List Bool),
        pF.eval (encPair encBits encBits (w, y)).length ≤ t →
          condTimeBoundedAt t (F (w, y)) y ≤ (w.length + c : ℕ) := by
  obtain ⟨tF, sF, htF, _, k, State, hfin, tm, htm⟩ := hF
  obtain ⟨c_tm, d_tm, hle⟩ := polynomiallyBounded_iff_le.mp htF
  obtain ⟨c_sim, hsim⟩ :=
    exists_etimeBoundedComplexity_condUniversalTM_le_ofMultiTapeTM tm
  let pF : Polynomial ℕ := Polynomial.C (c_tm + 1) * (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (d_tm + 1)
  have hpF_eval (n : ℕ) : pF.eval n = (c_tm + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d_tm + 1) := by
    simp [pF]
  have hpF_ge (n : ℕ) : n + 1 ≤ pF.eval n := by
    rw [hpF_eval, pow_succ']
    have hpow : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ d_tm := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    calc
      n + 1 = 1 * ((n + 1) * 1) := by ring
      _ ≤ (c_tm + 1) * ((n + 1) * (n + 1) ^ d_tm) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hpow)
  have hpF_mono : Monotone pF.eval := by
    intro a b hab
    dsimp only
    rw [hpF_eval, hpF_eval]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _)
  have htF_le (n : ℕ) : tF n ≤ pF.eval n := by
    rw [hpF_eval, pow_succ']
    have h1 := hle n
    have h2 : c_tm * (n + 1) ^ d_tm ≤ (c_tm + 1) * (n + 1) ^ d_tm :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    have h3 : (c_tm + 1) * (n + 1) ^ d_tm ≤ (c_tm + 1) * ((n + 1) * (n + 1) ^ d_tm) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega))
    omega
  refine ⟨pF, c_sim, hpF_ge, hpF_mono, fun {t} w y ht => ?_⟩
  have hcomp := htm (w, y)
  have hstep : tF (encPair encBits encBits (w, y)).length ≤ t :=
    (htF_le _).trans ht
  exact (condTimeBoundedAt_anti hstep).trans
    (hsim _ w y (F (w, y)) hcomp.2.1 hcomp.1)

theorem exists_condTimeBoundedAt_apply_le {f : List Bool → List Bool}
    (hf : ComputableInPolyTime f encBits encBits) :

      (∀ n, n + 1 ≤ q.eval n) ∧
      Monotone q.eval ∧
      (∀ {t : ℕ} (y : List Bool), q.eval (y.length + 1) ≤ t →
        condTimeBoundedAt t (f y) y ≤ c) ∧

  have hF : ComputableInPolyTime (fun wy : List Bool × List Bool => f wy.2)

    exists_condTimeBoundedAt_le_of_computableInPolyTime hF
  refine ⟨q, c, hq_ge, hq_mono, fun {t} y ht => ?_, fun y => ?_⟩
  · have hlen : (encPair encBits encBits ([], y)).length = y.length + 1 := by
      simp

  · have hlen : (encPair encBits encBits ([], y)).length = y.length + 1 := by

  rw [boundedSearch, List.any_eq_true, pair_mem_iff_exists_runFor_two_pow]

  · rintro ⟨j, _, hj⟩
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hj
    refine ⟨Ladner.word j, hj.1, ?_⟩
    rw [universalTM_runFor]
    exact universalTMRunFor_mono _ (Nat.min_le_left _ _) hj.2
  · rintro ⟨p, hplen, hp⟩
    refine ⟨Ladner.index p, List.mem_range.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hind := Ladner.index_add_two_le p
      have hpow : 2 ^ (p.length + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (k + 1) :=
        Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)

    · simp only [Ladner.word_index, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      refine ⟨hplen, ?_⟩
      have hcap : Ladner.capPow 2 (k - p.length) N = 2 ^ (k - p.length) :=
        Nat.min_eq_left ((Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)).trans hN)

theorem mem_E : MKtP ∈ E (encPair encBits encUnary) := by
  let Ψ : List Bool × ℕ → Bool := fun yN =>
    boundedSearch (unframe yN.1) (dropFrame yN.1).length yN.2
  have hΨ : ComputableInPolyTime Ψ (encPair encBits encUnary) encBool := by
    open ComputableInPolyTime in
    have hy := fst encBits encUnary
    have hN := snd encBits encUnary
    have hunf : ComputableInPolyTime (fun yN : List Bool × ℕ => unframe yN.1)
        (encPair encBits encUnary) encBits :=
      (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unframe).comp hy
    have hdrop : ComputableInPolyTime (fun yN : List Bool × ℕ => (dropFrame yN.1).length)
        (encPair encBits encUnary) encUnary :=
      (encoding_length encBits).comp
        ((ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.dropFrame).comp hy)
    exact computableInPolyTime_boundedSearch.comp (hunf.prod (hdrop.prod hN))
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := mem_E_iff.mp (setOf_mem_E_of_computableInPolyTime_pad hΨ)
  let g : List Bool × ℕ → List Bool := fun xk => encPair encBits encUnary xk
  have hgO : ComputableInO g (encPair encBits encUnary) encBits
      (fun xk => (encPair encBits encUnary xk).length)
      (fun xk => (encPair encBits encUnary xk).length) :=
    .of_tidy (ComputableTidilyInO.of_linear
      (.of_eq (f := g) (encIn := encPair encBits encUnary) (encMid := encBits) fun _ => rfl))
  have hpre : g ⁻¹' {y : List Bool | Ψ (y, 2 ^ y.length) = true} ∈
      DTIME (encPair encBits encUnary) (fun n => 2 ^ ((c + 1) * n)) := by
    refine preimage_mem_DTIME (C := 2) hc hgO fun xk => ?_
    set n := (encPair encBits encUnary xk).length
    have hlen : (encBits (g xk)).length = n := rfl
    rw [hlen]
    have h1 : n ≤ 2 ^ ((c + 1) * n) := by
      have : n ≤ (c + 1) * n := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n (by omega)
      exact this.trans (Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le)
    have h2 : 2 ^ (c * n) ≤ 2 ^ ((c + 1) * n) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by nlinarith)
    omega
  have heq : MKtP = g ⁻¹' {y : List Bool | Ψ (y, 2 ^ y.length) = true} := by
    ext ⟨x, k⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Ψ, g]
    have hunf : unframe (encPair encBits encUnary (x, k)) = x := by
      simp [encPair_apply]
    have hdrop : (dropFrame (encPair encBits encUnary (x, k))).length = k := by
      simp [encPair_apply]
    have hpow : 2 ^ (k + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (encPair encBits encUnary (x, k)).length := by
      refine Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) ?_
      simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate]
      omega
    rw [hunf, hdrop, boundedSearch_eq_true_iff_of_two_pow_le hpow]
  rw [heq]
  exact mem_E_iff.mpr ⟨c + 1, hpre⟩

$$\mathrm{Kt}(x) = \inf_{s \in \mathbb{N}} \bigl(K^s(x) + \lceil \log_2 s \rceil\bigr).$$

theorem exists_complexity_universal_lt_of_computable {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Computable f)
    (hunb : ∀ k, ∃ x, k ≤ f x) : ∃ x, universal.complexity x < f x := by
  by_contra! hle
  let F : List Bool →. ℕ := fun q => Nat.rfind fun x => decide (2 * q.length ≤ f x)
  have hdec : Computable₂ fun (q : List Bool) (x : ℕ) => decide (2 * q.length ≤ f x) :=
    (Primrec.nat_le.decide.to_comp).comp
      (Primrec.nat_double.to_comp.comp (Computable.list_length.comp Computable.fst))
      (hf.comp Computable.snd)
  have hF : Partrec F := Partrec.rfind hdec.partrec₂
  have hdom (q : List Bool) : (F q).Dom := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hunb (2 * q.length)
    obtain ⟨n, hn, -⟩ := Nat.rfind_min' (p := fun x => decide (2 * q.length ≤ f x)) (m := x)
      (decide_eq_true hx)
    exact Part.dom_iff_mem.mpr ⟨n, hn⟩
  let g (q : List Bool) : ℕ := (F q).get (hdom q)
  have hg : Computable g := hF.of_eq fun q => (Part.some_get (hdom q)).symm
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_complexity_universal_le_length_add hg
  let q : List Bool := List.replicate (c + 1) true
  have hq : q.length = c + 1 := List.length_replicate
  have hspec : 2 * q.length ≤ f (g q) := by
    simpa using Nat.rfind_spec (Part.get_mem (hdom q))
  have := hle (g q)
  have := hc q
  omega

theorem frequently_complexity_universal_lt_of_computable {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Computable f)
    (hunb : ∀ k, ∃ x, k ≤ f x) : ∃ᶠ x in atTop, universal.complexity x < f x := by
  refine frequently_atTop.2 fun N => ?_
  let g (x : ℕ) : ℕ := if x < N then 0 else f x
  have hc : Computable fun x : ℕ => decide (x < N) :=
    Primrec.nat_lt.decide.to_comp.comp Computable.id (Computable.const N)
  have hg : Computable g :=
    (Computable.cond hc (Computable.const 0) hf).of_eq fun x => by
      by_cases h : x < N <;> simp [g, h]
  have hgunb (k : ℕ) : ∃ x, k ≤ g x := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hunb (k + 1 + ∑ y ∈ Finset.range N, f y)
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    by_cases h : x < N
    · have := Finset.single_le_sum (fun y _ => Nat.zero_le (f y)) (Finset.mem_range.2 h)
      omega
    · simp only [g, h, ↓reduceIte]
      omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_complexity_universal_lt_of_computable hg hgunb
  by_cases h : x < N
  · simp [g, h] at hx
  · simp only [g, h, ↓reduceIte] at hx
    exact ⟨x, by omega, hx⟩

theorem exists_card_le_sixteen_mul (hm : 0 < m) (hα : Fintype.card α ≤ 2 ^ m)
    {G : Finset (α → Bool)} (hG : G.Nonempty) {f : α → Bool}
    (hmaj : ∀ g : Fin m → α → Bool, (∀ i, g i ∈ G) →
      (fun x => strictMajority m fun i => g i x) ≠ f) :
    ∃ x, #G ≤ 16 * #{g ∈ G | g x ≠ f x} := by
  by_contra! hx
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ := hG
  obtain ⟨x₀, -⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp (hmaj (fun _ => g₀) fun _ => hg₀)
  set r := #G
  set h := m - m / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := card_pos.mpr ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩
  have hh : 0 < h := by omega
  set T := Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin m => G
  -- Every tuple is refuted by at least half of its entries at some input.
  have hcover : T ⊆ univ.biUnion fun x => {t ∈ T | h ≤ #{i | t i ∈ {g ∈ G | g x ≠ f x}}} := by
    intro t ht
    have htG := Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp ht
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp (hmaj t htG)
    refine mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨x, mem_univ x, mem_filter.mpr ⟨ht, ?_⟩⟩
    convert le_card_ne_of_strictMajority_ne hx using 2
    ext i
    simp [htG i]
  have hcount : r ^ m * 16 ^ h ≤
      ∑ x : α, 2 ^ m * (16 ^ h * #{g ∈ G | g x ≠ f x} ^ h) * r ^ (m - h) := by
    calc r ^ m * 16 ^ h = #T * 16 ^ h := by simp [T, r]
      _ ≤ (∑ x : α, #{t ∈ T | h ≤ #{i | t i ∈ {g ∈ G | g x ≠ f x}}}) * 16 ^ h :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ((card_le_card hcover).trans card_biUnion_le)
      _ ≤ (∑ x : α, 2 ^ m * #{g ∈ G | g x ≠ f x} ^ h * r ^ (m - h)) * 16 ^ h :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (sum_le_sum fun x _ =>
            card_filter_le_card_mem_le (by omega) _ _)
      _ = ∑ x : α, 2 ^ m * (16 ^ h * #{g ∈ G | g x ≠ f x} ^ h) * r ^ (m - h) := by
          rw [sum_mul]; exact sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by ring
  -- But at each input fewer than a sixteenth of `G` is refuted.
  have hlt : ∑ x : α, 2 ^ m * (16 ^ h * #{g ∈ G | g x ≠ f x} ^ h) * r ^ (m - h) <
      ∑ _x : α, 2 ^ m * r ^ h * r ^ (m - h) := by
    refine sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty ⟨x₀, mem_univ _⟩ fun x _ => ?_
    have := Nat.pow_lt_pow_left (hx x) hh.ne'
    rw [mul_pow] at this
    gcongr
  have hfour : Fintype.card α * 2 ^ m ≤ 16 ^ h := by
    calc Fintype.card α * 2 ^ m ≤ 2 ^ m * 2 ^ m := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hα
      _ = 4 ^ m := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
      _ ≤ 4 ^ (2 * h) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ = 16 ^ h := by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num
  have : ∑ _x : α, 2 ^ m * r ^ h * r ^ (m - h) ≤ r ^ m * 16 ^ h := by
    rw [sum_const, card_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (by omega),
      ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (r ^ m)]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hfour
  omega

/-- Greedily choosing inputs by the good-string lemma, `k` inputs leave at most a `(15 / 16) ^ k`
share of `F` agreeing with `f` on all of them. -/

private theorem exists_card_filter_le (hm : 0 < m) (hα : Fintype.card α ≤ 2 ^ m)
    (F : Finset (α → Bool)) {f : α → Bool}
    (hmaj : ∀ g : Fin m → α → Bool, (∀ i, g i ∈ F) →
      (fun x => strictMajority m fun i => g i x) ≠ f) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ S : Finset α, #S ≤ k ∧ 16 ^ k * #{g ∈ F | ∀ x ∈ S, g x = f x} ≤ 15 ^ k * #F := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact ⟨∅, by simp, by simp⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hcard⟩ := ih
    set G := {g ∈ F | ∀ x ∈ S, g x = f x}
    rcases G.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hG | hG
    · refine ⟨S, by omega, ?_⟩
      rw [show {g ∈ F | ∀ x ∈ S, g x = f x} = G from rfl, hG, card_empty, mul_zero]
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_card_le_sixteen_mul hm hα hG fun g hg =>
      hmaj g fun i => (mem_filter.mp (hg i)).1
    have hsplit := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := G) (fun g => g x = f x)
    have hstep : 16 * #{g ∈ G | g x = f x} ≤ 15 * #G := by
      simp only [← ne_eq] at hsplit
      omega
    have key : 16 ^ (k + 1) * #{g ∈ G | g x = f x} ≤ 15 ^ (k + 1) * #F :=
      calc 16 ^ (k + 1) * #{g ∈ G | g x = f x} = 16 ^ k * (16 * #{g ∈ G | g x = f x}) := by ring
        _ ≤ 16 ^ k * (15 * #G) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hstep
        _ = 15 * (16 ^ k * #G) := by ring
        _ ≤ 15 * (15 ^ k * #F) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hcard
        _ = 15 ^ (k + 1) * #F := by ring
    classical
    refine ⟨insert x S, (card_insert_le x S).trans (by omega), ?_⟩
    convert key using 3
    ext g
    simp [G, and_assoc, and_comm (a := g x = f x)]

there are at most `2 ^ m` inputs, with `m > 0`, and no `m` members of `F`, repetitions allowed,

theorem isAntiChecker_computableFunctions_iff {f : BooleanFunction n} {S : Set (BitString n)} :
    IsAntiChecker (computableFunctions n s) f S ↔ s < complexityOn interpretation S (single f) := by
  rw [← not_le, complexityOn_le_iff]
  simp only [Circuit.computesOn_single_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro hS ⟨c, hc, hsize⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hne⟩ := hS (fun y => c.eval interpretation y 0)
      (Boolean.mem_computableFunctions.mpr
        ⟨c, Circuit.computes_single_iff.mpr fun _ => rfl, hsize⟩)
    exact hne (hc x hx)
  · intro h g hg
    obtain ⟨c, hcg, hsize⟩ := Boolean.mem_computableFunctions.mp hg
    by_contra! hgS
    exact h ⟨c, fun x hx => (Circuit.computes_single_iff.mp hcg x).trans (hgS x hx), hsize⟩

/-- **Leaf-size-preserving substitution into a language slice.** If every formula in
`fs : List (Formula signature N)` has leaf size at most `1`, then membership of `evalWord fs T` in
any language `L : Set (List Bool)` is computed by a De Morgan formula on `N` variables of leaf size
at most `formulaSize (Language.slice L fs.length)`. -/
theorem exists_formula_of_evalWord {N : ℕ} (fs : List (Formula signature N))
    (hfs : ∀ F ∈ fs, F.leafSize ≤ 1) (L : Set (List Bool)) :
    ∃ F : Formula signature N,
      (∀ T : BitString N, F.eval interpretation T = decide (evalWord fs T ∈ L)) ∧
      F.leafSize ≤ formulaSize (Language.slice L fs.length) := by
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hGleaf⟩ := exists_computes_leafSize_eq (Language.slice L fs.length)
  let sub : Fin fs.length → Formula signature N := fun i => fs[i.1]'i.2
  refine ⟨G.bind sub, fun T => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Formula.eval_bind, hG]
    have heq : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin fs.length => (sub i).eval interpretation T) =
        evalWord fs T := by
      calc (List.ofFn fun i : Fin fs.length => (sub i).eval interpretation T)
          = (List.ofFn sub).map (fun F => F.eval interpretation T) :=
            (List.map_ofFn (f := sub) (g := fun F => F.eval interpretation T)).symm
        _ = fs.map (fun F => F.eval interpretation T) := by
            rw [show List.ofFn sub = fs from List.ofFn_getElem]
        _ = evalWord fs T := rfl
    change decide ((List.ofFn fun i : Fin fs.length => (sub i).eval interpretation T) ∈ L) = _
    rw [heq]
  · exact (G.leafSize_bind_le fun i => hfs (sub i) (List.getElem_mem i.2)).trans hGleaf.le

theorem exists_seed_tuple_of_one_sided_error {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    {N k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (no : Finset (BitString N))
    (Good : BitString N → Ω → Prop) [∀ T ω, Decidable (Good T ω)]
    (hgood : ∀ T ∈ no, Fintype.card Ω ≤ k * (Finset.univ.filter (Good T)).card) :
    ∃ ωs : Fin (k * (N + 1)) → Ω, ∀ T ∈ no, ∃ j : Fin (k * (N + 1)), Good T (ωs j) := by
  classical
  have hcover : ∃ ωs : Fin (k * (N + 1)) → Ω, ∀ T : no, ∃ j, Good T.1 (ωs j) := by
    apply exists_cover_of_scaled_card_lt (fun ω (T : no) => Good T.1 ω) (k - 1) k (k * (N + 1))
    · intro ⟨T, hT⟩
      rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_subtype]
      dsimp only
      have hg := hgood T hT
      have hle : (Finset.univ.filter (Good T)).card ≤ Fintype.card Ω :=
        Finset.card_le_univ _
      have hk1 : k * Fintype.card Ω = (k - 1) * Fintype.card Ω + Fintype.card Ω := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hk, add_mul, one_mul]
      have hsub : k * (Fintype.card Ω - (Finset.univ.filter (Good T)).card) +
          k * (Finset.univ.filter (Good T)).card = k * Fintype.card Ω := by
        rw [← mul_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hle]
      change k * (Fintype.card Ω - (Finset.univ.filter (Good T)).card) ≤ (k - 1) * Fintype.card Ω
      omega
    · have hno_card : Fintype.card no ≤ 2 ^ N := by
        rw [Fintype.card_coe]
        exact (Finset.card_le_univ no).trans (by simp [BitString])
      exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hno_card).trans_lt (two_pow_mul_pred_pow_lt hk)
  obtain ⟨ωs, hωs⟩ := hcover
  exact ⟨ωs, fun T hT => hωs ⟨T, hT⟩⟩

theorem card_computableFunctions_le_two_pow (n s : ℕ) :
    (computableFunctions n s).card ≤ 2 ^ computableFunctionsLogBound n s := by
  set L := Nat.clog 2 (n + s + 1)
  have hns : n + s + 1 ≤ 2 ^ L := Nat.le_pow_clog (by decide) (n + s + 1)
  have hs1 : s + 1 ≤ 2 ^ L := (by omega : s + 1 ≤ n + s + 1).trans hns
  have hns0 : n + s ≤ 2 ^ L := (by omega : n + s ≤ n + s + 1).trans hns
  have hbase : 5 * (n + s + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ (2 * L + 3) := by

/-- **Oliveira–Santhanam Lemma 26 (exponential-tail form)**
[OliveiraSanthanam2018, Section 3.3, Lemma 26, p. 21]: if `(computableFunctions n s).card ≤ 2 ^ M`
(in particular for `M = computableFunctionsLogBound n s`) and `M + r ≤ S.card`, then at most

`SuccinctMCSP.Instance.ofFunction ((MCSP.truthTable n).symm T) S s ∈ SuccinctMCSP`
(so for `r = n`, at most a `2 ^ (-n)`-fraction of all `2 ^ (2 ^ n)` truth tables are consistent
with a circuit of size at most `s` on `S`). -/
theorem card_filter_ofFunction_mem_succinctMCSP_le_two_pow
    {n s M r : ℕ} {S : Finset (BitString n)}
    (hcard : (computableFunctions n s).card ≤ 2 ^ M) (hS : M + r ≤ S.card) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun T : BitString (2 ^ n) =>
      SuccinctMCSP.Instance.ofFunction
        ((MCSP.truthTable n).symm T) S s ∈ SuccinctMCSP).card ≤
    2 ^ (2 ^ n - r) := by
  have hScard : S.card ≤ 2 ^ n :=
    (Finset.card_le_univ S).trans (by simp [BitString])
  have hexp : M + (2 ^ n - S.card) ≤ 2 ^ n - r := by omega
  calc (Finset.univ.filter fun T : BitString (2 ^ n) =>
        SuccinctMCSP.Instance.ofFunction
          ((MCSP.truthTable n).symm T) S s ∈ SuccinctMCSP).card
      ≤ (computableFunctions n s).card * 2 ^ (2 ^ n - S.card) :=
        card_filter_ofFunction_mem_succinctMCSP_le n S s
    _ ≤ 2 ^ M * 2 ^ (2 ^ n - S.card) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hcard
    _ = 2 ^ (M + (2 ^ n - S.card)) := (pow_add 2 M (2 ^ n - S.card)).symm
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ n - r) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hexp

theorem NEXP_subset_EXP_of_MCSP_npHard_of_EXP_subset_PPoly
    (hHard : NPHard MCSP.encInstance MCSP) (hEXP : EXP encBits ⊆ PPolyOn encBits)
    {α : Type} (enc : α ↪ List Bool) :
    NEXP enc ⊆ EXP enc := by
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_NEXP_iff.mp hA
  obtain ⟨c₁, c₂, k_tapes, State, hfinite, ntm, hdec⟩ := hk
  set c := Nat.card (Turing.Action k_tapes Bool State) * (c₁ + c₂)
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hR_iff⟩ := hHard encBits (ntm.padded c) (ntm.padded_mem_NP c)
  let f (n : ℕ) : ℕ := n ^ (k + 1) + 1
  have hf : ComputableInPolyTime f encUnary encUnary := by
    unfold f
    fun_prop
  have hnf (n : ℕ) : n ≤ f n :=
    (Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) n).trans (Nat.le_succ _)
  let z (x : List Bool) : List Bool := frame x ++ List.replicate (2 ^ f x.length) true
  have hR_pair : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun w : List Bool => (List.ofFn (R w).table, (R w).threshold))
      encBits (encPair encBits encNat) :=
    .of_tidy (hR.tidy.of_enc_eq (encD := encPair encBits encNat) fun _ => rfl)
  have hR_table : ComputableInPolyTime (fun w : List Bool => List.ofFn (R w).table)
      encBits encBits :=
    (ComputableInPolyTime.fst encBits encNat).comp hR_pair
  have hR_thresh : ComputableInPolyTime (fun w : List Bool => (R w).threshold)
      encBits encNat :=
    (ComputableInPolyTime.snd encBits encNat).comp hR_pair
  let B_bit : Set (List Bool × List Bool) :=
    {q : List Bool × List Bool | tableValue (List.ofFn (R q.1).table) q.2 = true}
  have hB_bit : B_bit ∈ P (encPair encBits encBits) :=
    ⟨fun q => tableValue (List.ofFn (R q.1).table) q.2,
      computableInPolyTime_tableValue.comp
        ((hR_table.comp (ComputableInPolyTime.fst encBits encBits)).prod
          (ComputableInPolyTime.snd encBits encBits)),
      fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
  let L_pad : Set (List Bool × List Bool) :=
    (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => (z p.1, p.2)) ⁻¹' B_bit
  have hL_pad_EXP : L_pad ∈ EXP (encPair encBits encBits) :=
    preimage_pad_prod_id_mem_EXP (enc := encBits) hB_bit hf
  obtain ⟨M, hM_PPoly, hM⟩ := EXP_encPair_subset_PPolyOn_of_EXP_subset_PPoly hEXP hL_pad_EXP
  obtain ⟨c_R, d_R, hR_len⟩ := hR.tidy.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  simp only [encBits_apply] at hR_len
  obtain ⟨c_M, d_M, hM_size⟩ := polynomiallyBounded_iff_le.mp hM_PPoly
  let m_bound (n : ℕ) : ℕ := c_R + (f n + 2) * d_R
  let s_bound (n : ℕ) : ℕ := c_M * (2 * n + 1 + m_bound n + 1) ^ d_M + 2
  let g (n : ℕ) : ℕ := certLength (m_bound n) (s_bound n) + n
  have harity (x : List Bool) : (R (z x)).arity ≤ m_bound x.length := by
    set n := x.length
    have h2_arity : 2 ^ (R (z x)).arity ≤ (MCSP.encInstance (R (z x))).length := by
      rw [MCSP.encInstance_apply, length_encPair, encBits_apply, List.length_ofFn]
      omega
    have hn_le : n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ f n :=
      (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := n)).trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (hnf n))
    have hzx_len : (z x).length + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (f n + 2) := by
      simp only [z, List.length_append, length_frame, List.length_replicate, pow_add]
      change 2 * n + 1 + 2 ^ f n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ f n * 4
      omega
    have hpow_le : 2 ^ (R (z x)).arity ≤ 2 ^ m_bound n := by
      calc 2 ^ (R (z x)).arity
          ≤ (MCSP.encInstance (R (z x))).length := h2_arity
        _ ≤ c_R * ((z x).length + 1) ^ d_R := hR_len (z x)
        _ ≤ 2 ^ c_R * (2 ^ (f n + 2)) ^ d_R :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hzx_len d_R)
        _ = 2 ^ m_bound n := by simp only [m_bound, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
    exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right (by norm_num : 1 < 2)).mp hpow_le
  have hcomp_le (x : List Bool) :
      complexity interpretation (single (R (z x)).function) ≤ s_bound x.length := by
    let a_frame : Fin (frame x).length → Bool := fun j => (frame x)[j]
    have ha_frame : List.ofFn a_frame = frame x := List.ofFn_getElem
    have hslice : (R (z x)).function =
        fun y => M.slice ((frame x).length + (R (z x)).arity)
          (substitute (prependInputs a_frame) y) := by
      funext y
      have hMx := hM (x, List.ofFn y)
      rw [encPair_apply, encBits_apply] at hMx
      rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, ← tableValue_ofFn, Language.slice_eq_true_iff,
        substitute_prependInputs, List.ofFn_fin_append, ha_frame]
      exact hMx
    have hc : complexity interpretation (single (R (z x)).function) ≤
        complexity interpretation (single (M.slice (2 * x.length + 1 + (R (z x)).arity))) + 2 := by
      have hc₀ := complexity_substitute_le (prependInputs a_frame)
        (M.slice ((frame x).length + (R (z x)).arity))
      rwa [← hslice, length_frame] at hc₀
    have hm_le := harity x
    calc complexity interpretation (single (R (z x)).function)
        ≤ complexity interpretation
            (single (M.slice (2 * x.length + 1 + (R (z x)).arity))) + 2 := hc
      _ ≤ c_M * (2 * x.length + 1 + (R (z x)).arity + 1) ^ d_M + 2 :=
          Nat.add_le_add_right (hM_size _) 2
      _ ≤ c_M * (2 * x.length + 1 + m_bound x.length + 1) ^ d_M + 2 :=
          Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c_M
            (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) d_M)) 2
  -- Compose the unary bounds explicitly: one `fun_prop` over the unfolded nest is too slow.
  have hid : ComputableInPolyTime (fun n : ℕ => n) encUnary encUnary := .id'
  have hc (a : ℕ) : ComputableInPolyTime (fun _ : ℕ => a) encUnary encUnary := .const a
  have hadd {u v : ℕ → ℕ} (hu : ComputableInPolyTime u encUnary encUnary)
      (hv : ComputableInPolyTime v encUnary encUnary) :
      ComputableInPolyTime (fun n => u n + v n) encUnary encUnary :=
    ComputableInPolyTime.unary_add.comp (hu.prod hv)
  have hmul {u v : ℕ → ℕ} (hu : ComputableInPolyTime u encUnary encUnary)
      (hv : ComputableInPolyTime v encUnary encUnary) :
      ComputableInPolyTime (fun n => u n * v n) encUnary encUnary :=
    ComputableInPolyTime.unary_mul.comp (hu.prod hv)
  have hm_bound : ComputableInPolyTime m_bound encUnary encUnary :=
    hadd (hc c_R) (hmul (hadd hf (hc 2)) (hc d_R))
  have hs_bound : ComputableInPolyTime s_bound encUnary encUnary :=
    hadd (hmul (hc c_M) ((ComputableInPolyTime.unary_pow d_M).comp
      (hadd (hadd (hadd (hmul (hc 2) hid) (hc 1)) hm_bound) (hc 1)))) (hc 2)
  have hg : ComputableInPolyTime g encUnary encUnary := by
    have hns := hadd hm_bound hs_bound
    exact hadd (hadd (hadd hs_bound hns) (hmul hs_bound (hadd (hc 3) (hmul (hc 2) hns)))) hid
  let B_search : Set (List Bool × ℕ) :=
    {p : List Bool × ℕ |
      boundedMCSPSearch (List.ofFn (R p.1).table)
        (min (s_bound (unframe p.1).length) (R p.1).threshold) p.2 = true}
  have hB_search : B_search ∈ P (encPair encBits encUnary) := by
    let encIn := encPair encBits encUnary
    have hunframe_len : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × ℕ => (unframe p.1).length)
        encIn encUnary :=
      (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy length_bits).comp
        ((ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy
          (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.of_linear (.of_unframe fun _ => rfl))).comp
          (ComputableInPolyTime.fst encBits encUnary))
    have hcap : ComputableInPolyTime
        (fun p : List Bool × ℕ => s_bound (unframe p.1).length) encIn encUnary :=
      hs_bound.comp hunframe_len
    have hS : ComputableInPolyTime
        (fun p : List Bool × ℕ => min (s_bound (unframe p.1).length) (R p.1).threshold)
        encIn encUnary :=
      ComputableInPolyTime.binary_min_unary' hcap
        (hR_thresh.comp (ComputableInPolyTime.fst encBits encUnary))
    exact ⟨_, computableInPolyTime_boundedMCSPSearch
      (hR_table.comp (ComputableInPolyTime.fst encBits encUnary))
      hS (ComputableInPolyTime.snd encBits encUnary), fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
  have hEXP_pre :
      (fun a : α => (z (enc a), 2 ^ g (enc a).length)) ⁻¹' B_search ∈ EXP enc :=
    preimage_pad_prod_two_pow_mem_EXP hB_search hf hnf hg
  have hA_eq : A = (fun a : α => (z (enc a), 2 ^ g (enc a).length)) ⁻¹' B_search := by
    ext a
    set x := enc a
    set n := x.length
    have hunframe_zx : (unframe (z x)).length = n := by
      simp [z, n]
    have hcert_le :
        certLength (R (z x)).arity (min (s_bound n) (R (z x)).threshold) ≤
          Nat.log 2 (2 ^ g n) := by
      rw [Nat.log_pow Nat.one_lt_two]
      exact (certLength_mono (harity x) (Nat.min_le_left _ _)).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ n)
    have hsearch_iff :
        (z x, 2 ^ g n) ∈ B_search ↔ R (z x) ∈ MCSP := by
      change boundedMCSPSearch (List.ofFn (R (z x)).table)
        (min (s_bound (unframe (z x)).length) (R (z x)).threshold) (2 ^ g n) = true ↔
        R (z x) ∈ MCSP
      rw [hunframe_zx, boundedMCSPSearch_ofFn_eq_true_iff (R (z x)) hcert_le,
        le_min_iff, MCSP.mem_iff]
      exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hcomp_le x, h⟩⟩
    have hpad_iff : a ∈ A ↔ z x ∈ ntm.padded c := by
      refine (hdec.frame_append_mem_padded_iff ?_).symm
      change Nat.card (Turing.Action k_tapes Bool State) * (c₁ * 2 ^ n ^ k + c₂) ≤
        c * (frame x ++ List.replicate (2 ^ f n) true).length
      simp only [List.length_append, length_frame, List.length_replicate]
      have hpow_le : 2 ^ n ^ k ≤ 2 ^ f n := by
        refine Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) ?_

        · rcases k with _ | k <;> simp [f, h0]
        · exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hpos (Nat.le_succ k)).trans (Nat.le_succ _)

        have : 1 ≤ 2 * n + 1 + 2 ^ f n :=
          (Nat.le_add_left 1 (2 * n)).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
        nlinarith

      (fun a => (x a).getD (p a).length false) encIn encBool :=

  have hew₀ := (computableInPolyTime_evalCertificate hn hs hw₀ hx).tidy

    (snd encUnary encUnary).comp ((fst _ _).comp (fst encHeader encBits))
  have hcert_a : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun a : MergeInput => certLength a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2) encMerge encUnary := by
    refine .of_tidy ?_
    unfold certLength
    fun_prop
  have hok : {a : MergeInput | mergeOk₀ a = true ∧ mergeOk₁ a = true} ∈ PPolyOn encMerge := by
    have hok₀ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime mergeOk₀ encMerge encBool :=
      bitsGetDWithInput (snd encHeader encBits) (const 0) false
    have hsw : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun a : MergeInput => stateWidth a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2) encMerge encUnary := by
      unfold stateWidth certLength
      fun_prop
    have hok₁ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime mergeOk₁ encMerge encBool :=
      bitsGetDWithInput (snd encHeader encBits) hsw false
    simpa [Bool.and_eq_true] using
      PPolyOn_of_computableInPolyTime (.of_tidy (bool_and' hok₀ hok₁))
  have hj_q : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun q : MergeInput × List Bool => q.1.1.2.2) encQ encUnary :=
    (snd encBits encUnary).comp ((snd _ _).comp
      ((fst encHeader encBits).comp (fst encMerge encBits)))
  have hbit_q : {q : MergeInput × List Bool |
      (q.1.1.2.2 == 0 || q.2.getD (q.1.1.2.2 - 1) false) = true} ∈ PPolyOn encQ := by
    have hj0 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime

        (fun q : MergeInput × List Bool => q.2.getD (q.1.1.2.2 - 1) false) encQ encBool :=

private theorem isMergedCert_iff_isSubcubeCert {n s : ℕ} {f : BooleanFunction n}
    {p w₀ w₁ w : List Bool} (hp : p.length < n)
    (hw₀ : IsSubcubeCert n s f (p ++ [false]) w₀)
    (hw₁ : IsSubcubeCert n s f (p ++ [true]) w₁) :
    IsMergedCert n s p w₀ w₁ w ↔ IsSubcubeCert n s f p w := by
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr_right fun _ => ⟨fun h x hx => ?_, fun h x hx => ?_⟩
  · have hpt := h (List.ofFn x) List.length_ofFn
    simp only [agreesOnPoint, hx, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_or, beq_iff_eq] at hpt
    have hlen : p.length < (List.ofFn x).length := by simpa using hp
    cases hb : (List.ofFn x).getD p.length false
    · simp only [hb, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hpt
      exact hpt.trans (hw₀.2.2 x ((isPrefixOf_append_singleton hlen).2 ⟨hx, hb⟩))
    · simp only [hb, ↓reduceIte] at hpt
      exact hpt.trans (hw₁.2.2 x ((isPrefixOf_append_singleton hlen).2 ⟨hx, hb⟩))
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : ∃ y : BitString n, List.ofFn y = x :=
      ⟨BitString.ofList n x, BitString.ofFn_ofList hx⟩
    have hlen : p.length < (List.ofFn y).length := by simpa using hp
    simp only [agreesOnPoint, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true', beq_iff_eq]
    cases hin : p.isPrefixOf (List.ofFn y)
    · left; rfl
    · right
      rw [h y hin]
      cases hb : (List.ofFn y).getD p.length false
      · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
        exact (hw₀.2.2 y ((isPrefixOf_append_singleton hlen).2 ⟨hin, hb⟩)).symm
      · simp only [↓reduceIte]
        exact (hw₁.2.2 y ((isPrefixOf_append_singleton hlen).2 ⟨hin, hb⟩)).symm

    (hL : ∀ a : MergeInput, a ∈ CircuitMinMergeLanguage ↔ encMerge a ∈ L)

    ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : List Bool), p.length + k = n →
      complexity interpretation
        (fun T : BitString (2 ^ n) => subcubeState n s ((truthTable n).symm T) p) ≤
        2 ^ k * stateWidth n s + (2 ^ k - 1) * (stateWidth n s * (M + 2))
  | 0, p, hp => by

    simpa using complexity_subcubeState_leaf_le hp'

    have hp1 : (p ++ [true]).length + k = n := by simp; omega

    have ih1 := complexity_subcubeState_tree_le hL hM k (p ++ [true]) hp1

    exact (hc₀ m).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₀ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) c₀))
  have htree : complexity interpretation
      (fun T : BitString (2 ^ n) => subcubeState n (s n) ((truthTable n).symm T) []) ≤
      2 ^ n * (stateWidth n (s n) * (M + 3)) := by
    refine (complexity_subcubeState_tree_le hL hM n [] (by simp)).trans ?_
    have hle : 2 ^ n - 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.sub_le _ _
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (stateWidth n (s n) * (M + 2)) hle
    nlinarith
  have hslice : single ((GapMCSP.yesSet s).slice (2 ^ n)) =
      (single fun v : BitString (stateWidth n (s n)) => v ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩) ∘
        fun T => subcubeState n (s n) ((truthTable n).symm T) [] := by
    funext T i
    rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0]
    exact (subcubeState_nil_zero_eq_slice_yesSet s n T).symm
  have hcomp : complexity interpretation (single ((GapMCSP.yesSet s).slice (2 ^ n))) ≤
      2 ^ n * (stateWidth n (s n) * (M + 3)) := by
    rw [hslice]
    have h0 := complexity_comp_le (I := interpretation)
      (fun T : BitString (2 ^ n) => subcubeState n (s n) ((truthTable n).symm T) [])
      (single fun v : BitString (stateWidth n (s n)) => v ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩)
    rw [complexity_single_proj, Nat.add_zero] at h0
    exact h0.trans htree
  have hsw : stateWidth n (s n) ≤ 6 * N ^ 2 := by
    unfold stateWidth certLength N
    nlinarith
  have h48 : 48 * N ^ 2 + 1 ≤ 49 * N ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hM_le : M + 3 ≤ (c₀ * 49 ^ c₀ + 3) * (N ^ 2) ^ c₀ := by
    have h1 : M ≤ c₀ * 49 ^ c₀ * (N ^ 2) ^ c₀ := by
      calc M ≤ c₀ * (49 * N ^ 2) ^ c₀ :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₀ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h48 c₀)
        _ = c₀ * 49 ^ c₀ * (N ^ 2) ^ c₀ := by rw [Nat.mul_pow, Nat.mul_assoc]
    have hpow_pos : 1 ≤ (N ^ 2) ^ c₀ := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by nlinarith)
    nlinarith
  have hprod : stateWidth n (s n) * (M + 3) ≤ C₁ * N ^ D₁ := by
    calc stateWidth n (s n) * (M + 3)
        ≤ (6 * N ^ 2) * ((c₀ * 49 ^ c₀ + 3) * (N ^ 2) ^ c₀) := Nat.mul_le_mul hsw hM_le
      _ = 6 * (c₀ * 49 ^ c₀ + 3) * (N ^ 2 * (N ^ 2) ^ c₀) := by ring
      _ ≤ C₁ * N ^ D₁ := by
        rw [← Nat.pow_mul, ← pow_add, show 2 + 2 * c₀ = D₁ by unfold D₁; omega]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by unfold C₁; omega)
  have hCD : C₁ * N ^ D₁ ≤ c * N ^ c :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul (le_max_left C₁ D₁) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hN_pos (le_max_right C₁ D₁))
  calc complexity interpretation (single ((GapMCSP.yesSet s).slice (2 ^ n)))
      ≤ 2 ^ n * (stateWidth n (s n) * (M + 3)) := hcomp
    _ ≤ 2 ^ n * (c * N ^ c) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 ^ n) (hprod.trans hCD)
    _ = 2 ^ n * c * (n + s n + 1) ^ c := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc]

/-- **McKay–Murray–Williams circuit upper bound for `MCSP[n ^ k]` under `NP ⊆ P/poly`**
[McKayMurrayWilliams2019, Lemma 3.1 and Section 5 (proof of Theorem 1.4, `C = P/poly` case)]: if
`NP ⊆ P/poly`, then for every degree `k`, there is `c > 0` such that the `2 ^ n`-bit slice of
`GapMCSP.yesSet (fun m => m ^ k)` has circuit complexity at most `2 ^ n * c * (n + 1) ^ c`. -/

theorem exists_complexity_yesSet_pow_le_of_NP_subset_PPoly
    (hNP : NP encBits ⊆ PPolyOn encBits) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ c > 0, ∀ n : ℕ,
      complexity interpretation (single ((GapMCSP.yesSet fun m => m ^ k).slice (2 ^ n))) ≤
        2 ^ n * c * (n + 1) ^ c := by
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀_pos, hc₀⟩ := exists_complexity_yesSet_le_of_NP_subset_PPoly hNP
  let C₁ : ℕ := c₀ * 2 ^ c₀
  let D₁ : ℕ := (k + 1) * c₀
  let c : ℕ := max C₁ (max D₁ 1)
  refine ⟨c, by positivity, fun n => ?_⟩
  have hbase : n + n ^ k + 1 ≤ 2 * (n + 1) ^ (k + 1) := by
    have h1 : n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (k + 1) :=
      Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) (n + 1)
    have h2 : n ^ k ≤ (n + 1) ^ (k + 1) :=
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_succ n) k).trans
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (Nat.le_succ k))
    omega
  have hpow : (n + n ^ k + 1) ^ c₀ ≤ 2 ^ c₀ * (n + 1) ^ D₁ := by
    calc (n + n ^ k + 1) ^ c₀
        ≤ (2 * (n + 1) ^ (k + 1)) ^ c₀ := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hbase c₀
      _ = 2 ^ c₀ * (n + 1) ^ D₁ := by rw [Nat.mul_pow, ← Nat.pow_mul]
  have hC : C₁ ≤ c := le_max_left _ _
  have hD : D₁ ≤ c := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  calc complexity interpretation (single ((GapMCSP.yesSet fun m => m ^ k).slice (2 ^ n)))
      ≤ 2 ^ n * c₀ * (n + n ^ k + 1) ^ c₀ := hc₀ (fun m => m ^ k) n
    _ ≤ 2 ^ n * c₀ * (2 ^ c₀ * (n + 1) ^ D₁) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hpow
    _ = 2 ^ n * (C₁ * (n + 1) ^ D₁) := by unfold C₁; ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ n * (c * (n + 1) ^ c) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul hC (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hD))
    _ = 2 ^ n * c * (n + 1) ^ c := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc]

/-- **Hardness magnification for `MCSP[s]` against `NP ⊆ P/poly`**
[McKayMurrayWilliams2019, Theorem 1.4, third bullet]: if for every `c > 0` there exist a schedule
`s` and input arity `n` such that the `2 ^ n`-bit slice of `GapMCSP.yesSet s` requires more than
`2 ^ n * c * (n + s n + 1) ^ c` gates, then `NP ⊄ P/poly`.

Relative to the paper's statement, this specializes `search-MCSP^A[s]` to decision
`GapMCSP.yesSet s` (`MCSP[s]`), sets `A = ∅`, uses fan-in-2 De Morgan circuits counting all gates,
and assumes a size-only lower bound rather than a combined size-and-depth lower bound. -/

theorem computableInPolyTime_checkCertificateOn {γ α : Type}
    {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {encTest : α ↪ List Bool}
    {tests : γ → List α} {input : α → List Bool}
    {m S : γ → ℕ} {w : γ → List Bool} {accept : γ → α → Bool → Bool}
    (hm : ComputableInPolyTime m encIn encUnary)
    (hS : ComputableInPolyTime S encIn encUnary)
    (hw : ComputableInPolyTime w encIn encBits)
    (htests : ComputableInPolyTime tests encIn (encList encTest))
    (hinput : ComputableInPolyTime input encTest encBits)
    (haccept : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : (γ × α) × Bool => accept p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
      (encPair (encPair encIn encTest) encBool) encBool) :
    ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun a => checkCertificateOn (tests a) input (accept a) (m a) (S a) (w a))
      encIn encBool := by
  refine .of_tidy ?_
  have hvalid := (computableInPolyTime_validCertificate hm hS hw).tidy
  have htests_t := htests.tidy
  have hout : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : γ × α => evalCertificate (m p.1) (S p.1) (w p.1) (input p.2))
      (encPair encIn encTest) encBool :=
    (computableInPolyTime_evalCertificate (hm.comp (.of_tidy (fst encIn encTest)))
      (hS.comp (.of_tidy (fst encIn encTest))) (hw.comp (.of_tidy (fst encIn encTest)))
      (hinput.comp (.of_tidy (snd encIn encTest)))).tidy
  have htest : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : γ × α => accept p.1 p.2 (evalCertificate (m p.1) (S p.1) (w p.1) (input p.2)))
      (encPair encIn encTest) encBool :=
    haccept.tidy.comp ((id' (encIn := encPair encIn encTest)).prod hout)
  unfold checkCertificateOn
  exact bool_and' hvalid (allWithInput htests_t htest)

theorem computableInPolyTime_checkCertificate_table {α : Type} {encT : List α ↪ List Bool}
    {accept : List α → List Bool → Bool → Bool}
    (hlen : ComputableInPolyTime (fun T : List α => T.length) encT encUnary)
    (hlen_le : ∀ T : List α, T.length ≤ (encT T).length)
    (haccept : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : (List α × List Bool) × Bool => accept p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
      (encPair (encPair encT encBits) encBool) encBool) :
    ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun r : (List α × ℕ) × List Bool =>
        checkCertificate (accept r.1.1) (Nat.log 2 r.1.1.length)
          (sampleBudget (Nat.log 2 r.1.1.length) r.1.1.length r.1.2) r.2)
      (encPair (encPair encT encNat) encBits) encBool := by
  let encIn := encPair (encPair encT encNat) encBits
  have hT : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun r : (List α × ℕ) × List Bool => r.1.1)
      encIn encT := (fst encT encNat).comp (fst _ _)
  have hlen_r : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun r : (List α × ℕ) × List Bool => r.1.1.length)
      encIn encUnary := hlen.tidy.comp hT
  have hm : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun r : (List α × ℕ) × List Bool =>
      Nat.log 2 r.1.1.length) encIn encUnary := unary_log_two.comp hlen_r
  have hs : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun r : (List α × ℕ) × List Bool => r.1.2)
      encIn encNat := (snd encT encNat).comp (fst _ _)
  have hS : ComputableInPolyTime (fun r : (List α × ℕ) × List Bool =>
      sampleBudget (Nat.log 2 r.1.1.length) r.1.1.length r.1.2) encIn encUnary :=
    computableInPolyTime_sampleBudget (.of_tidy hm) (.of_tidy hlen_r) (.of_tidy hs)
  have hw : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun r : (List α × ℕ) × List Bool => r.2)
      encIn encBits := snd _ _
  have hsize : PolynomiallyBounded (fun L => L * L) := by fun_prop
  have hbudget (r : (List α × ℕ) × List Bool) :
      2 ^ Nat.log 2 r.1.1.length * (2 * Nat.log 2 r.1.1.length + 1) ≤
        (encIn r).length * (encIn r).length := by
    set T := r.1.1.length
    have hT_enc : 2 * T + 1 ≤ (encIn r).length := by
      have h1 := hlen_le r.1.1
      simp only [encIn, length_encPair]
      omega
    have hpow : 2 ^ Nat.log 2 T ≤ T + 1 := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos T with h | h
      · simp [h]
      · exact (Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 h.ne').trans (Nat.le_succ T)
    have hlog : 2 * Nat.log 2 T + 1 ≤ 2 * T + 1 := by
      have := Nat.log_le_self 2 T
      omega
    calc 2 ^ Nat.log 2 T * (2 * Nat.log 2 T + 1) ≤ (T + 1) * (2 * T + 1) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul hpow hlog
      _ ≤ (encIn r).length * (encIn r).length :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) hT_enc
  have hproj : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (((List α × ℕ) × List Bool) × List Bool) × Bool =>
        ((p.1.1.1.1, p.1.2), p.2))
      (encPair (encPair encIn encBits) encBool)
      (encPair (encPair encT encBits) encBool) :=
    (((fst _ _).fst'.fst'.fst').prod (fst _ _).snd').prod (snd _ _)
  have haccept_full : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : (((List α × ℕ) × List Bool) × List Bool) × Bool => accept p.1.1.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
      (encPair (encPair encIn encBits) encBool) encBool :=
    .of_tidy (haccept.tidy.comp hproj)
  exact computableInPolyTime_checkCertificate (.of_tidy hm) hS (.of_tidy hw)
    hsize hbudget haccept_full

    (hC3 : ∀ x y : BitString (2 * n),

    4 * n ≤ F.numOr + 1 ∧ F.numAnd ≤ 2 * n := by
  have hsupp : F.leafSupport = Finset.univ := by
    have hcard : F.leafSupport.card = 6 * n :=
      ((F.isReadOnce_iff_card_leafSupport_eq_leafSize).mp hro).trans hleaf
    exact Finset.eq_univ_of_card F.leafSupport (by simpa using hcard)
  let w₀ : BitString (6 * n) := packXYZ zeros2n zeros2n ones2n
  have hw₀ : F.eval w₀ = false := by
    simpa [w₀] using hC3 zeros2n zeros2n
  have hsub : xSet n ∪ ySet n ⊆ PosFormula.flipSensitive w₀ F := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [PosFormula.flipSensitive, hsupp, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, hw₀,
      Bool.not_false, Bool.true_and, true_and]
