private theorem structure_of_zCount_eq_numAnd {F S : PosFormula (6 * n)} (hro : F.IsReadOnce)
    (hC1 : ∀ y z : BitString (2 * n),
      F.eval (packXYZ zeros2n y z) = decide (∃ j, y j = true ∧ z j = true))
    (hC3 : ∀ x y : BitString (2 * n),
      F.eval (packXYZ x y ones2n) = decide (∃ j, x j = true ∨ y j = true))
    (hsub : PosFormula.IsSubformula S F) (hnotZ : NotZLeaf S) (hz : zCount S = S.numAnd) :
    Disjoint (topOrVars S) (zSet n) ∧
    (∀ i, Disjoint (zPartnerVars i S) (zSet n)) ∧
    (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (zPartnerVars i S) (zPartnerVars j S)) ∧
    (∀ w : BitString (6 * n),
      S.eval w =
        decide ((∃ v ∈ topOrVars S, w v = true) ∨
          (∃ i : Fin (2 * n), w (zVar i) = true ∧ ∃ v ∈ zPartnerVars i S, w v = true))) := by
  induction S with
  | var v =>
    refine ⟨?_, fun _ => Finset.disjoint_empty_left _, fun _ _ _ => Finset.disjoint_empty_left _,
      fun w => ?_⟩
    · rw [topOrVars, Finset.disjoint_singleton_left, mem_zSet]
      rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact hnotZ i rfl
    · simp [topOrVars, zPartnerVars]
  | or L R ihL ihR =>
    have hroS := hsub.isReadOnce hro
    have hnotZL : NotZLeaf L := fun i hL =>
      not_isSubformula_or_var_zVar_left hro hC1 hC3 i R (hL ▸ hsub)
    have hnotZR : NotZLeaf R := fun i hR =>
      not_isSubformula_or_var_zVar_right hro hC1 hC3 i L (hR ▸ hsub)
    have hL_le := zCount_le_numAnd_of_notZLeaf hro hC1 hC3 hsub.of_or_left hnotZL
    have hR_le := zCount_le_numAnd_of_notZLeaf hro hC1 hC3 hsub.of_or_right hnotZR
    rw [zCount_or_of_isReadOnce hroS, PosFormula.numAnd_or] at hz
    obtain ⟨hdL_top, hdL_part, hdL_ij, hevalL⟩ :=
      ihL hsub.of_or_left hnotZL (by omega)
    obtain ⟨hdR_top, hdR_part, hdR_ij, hevalR⟩ :=
      ihR hsub.of_or_right hnotZR (by omega)
    refine ⟨Finset.disjoint_union_left.mpr ⟨hdL_top, hdR_top⟩,
      fun i => Finset.disjoint_union_left.mpr ⟨hdL_part i, hdR_part i⟩,
      fun i j hij => ?_, fun w => ?_⟩
    · have hLR : Disjoint (zPartnerVars i L) (zPartnerVars j R) :=
        hroS.2.2.mono (zPartnerVars_subset_leafSupport i L) (zPartnerVars_subset_leafSupport j R)
      have hRL : Disjoint (zPartnerVars i R) (zPartnerVars j L) :=
        hroS.2.2.symm.mono (zPartnerVars_subset_leafSupport i R)
          (zPartnerVars_subset_leafSupport j L)
      exact Finset.disjoint_union_left.mpr
        ⟨Finset.disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨hdL_ij i j hij, hLR⟩,
          Finset.disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨hRL, hdR_ij i j hij⟩⟩
    · rw [PosFormula.eval_or, hevalL w, hevalR w, ← Bool.decide_or, decide_eq_decide]
      simp only [topOrVars, zPartnerVars, Finset.mem_union]
      constructor
      · rintro ((⟨v, hv, hw⟩ | ⟨i, hi, v, hv, hw⟩) | (⟨v, hv, hw⟩ | ⟨i, hi, v, hv, hw⟩))
        · exact Or.inl ⟨v, Or.inl hv, hw⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨i, hi, v, Or.inl hv, hw⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨v, Or.inr hv, hw⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨i, hi, v, Or.inr hv, hw⟩
      · rintro (⟨v, hv | hv, hw⟩ | ⟨i, hi, v, hv | hv, hw⟩)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨v, hv, hw⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨v, hv, hw⟩)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i, hi, v, hv, hw⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨i, hi, v, hv, hw⟩)
  | and L R _ _ =>
    have hroS := hsub.isReadOnce hro
    rw [zCount_and_of_isReadOnce hroS, PosFormula.numAnd_and] at hz
    have h_has_z : (∃ i, L = .var (zVar i)) ∨ (∃ i, R = .var (zVar i)) := by
      by_contra! h
      have hL_le := zCount_le_numAnd_of_notZLeaf hro hC1 hC3 hsub.of_and_left h.1
      have hR_le := zCount_le_numAnd_of_notZLeaf hro hC1 hC3 hsub.of_and_right h.2
      omega
    rcases h_has_z with ⟨i₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨i₀, rfl⟩
    · have hR_disj : Disjoint R.leafSupport (zSet n) := by
        rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
        intro v hvR hvz
        obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := mem_zSet.mp hvz
        exact not_mem_leafSupport_zVar_of_isSubformula_and_left hro hC1 hsub hvR
      have hR_z0 : zCount R = 0 :=
        Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr (Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hR_disj)
      rw [zCount_var_zVar, hR_z0, PosFormula.numAnd_var] at hz
      have hR_and0 : R.numAnd = 0 := by omega
      have hpart_eq (i : Fin (2 * n)) :
          zPartnerVars i (.and (.var (zVar i₀)) R) = if i = i₀ then R.leafSupport else ∅ := by
        dsimp [zPartnerVars]
        by_cases hi : i = i₀
        · subst hi; simp
        · have hneL : (PosFormula.var (zVar i₀) : PosFormula (6 * n)) ≠ .var (zVar i) := by
            simp [Ne.symm hi]
          have hneR : R ≠ .var (zVar i) := by
            intro hR_eq
            have hmem : zVar i ∈ R.leafSupport := by simp [hR_eq]
            exact not_mem_leafSupport_zVar_of_isSubformula_and_left hro hC1 hsub hmem
          simp [hi, hneL, hneR]
      refine ⟨Finset.disjoint_empty_left _, fun i => ?_, fun i j hij => ?_, fun w => ?_⟩
      · rw [hpart_eq]
        split_ifs
        · exact hR_disj
        · exact Finset.disjoint_empty_left _
      · rw [hpart_eq i, hpart_eq j]
        split_ifs with hi hj
        · exact absurd (hi.trans hj.symm) hij
        · exact Finset.disjoint_empty_right _
        · exact Finset.disjoint_empty_left _
        · exact Finset.disjoint_empty_left _
      · rw [PosFormula.eval_and, PosFormula.eval_var,
          PosFormula.eval_eq_decide_exists_of_numAnd_eq_zero hR_and0 w]
        simp only [topOrVars, Finset.notMem_empty, false_and, exists_false, false_or, hpart_eq]
        rw [← Bool.decide_coe (w (zVar i₀)), ← Bool.decide_and, decide_eq_decide]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hwz, v, hv, hwv⟩
          exact ⟨i₀, hwz, v, by simp [hv], hwv⟩
        · rintro ⟨i, hwz, v, hv, hwv⟩
          by_cases hi : i = i₀
          · subst hi
            exact ⟨hwz, v, by simpa using hv, hwv⟩
          · simp [hi] at hv
    · have hL_disj : Disjoint L.leafSupport (zSet n) := by
        rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
        intro v hvL hvz
        obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := mem_zSet.mp hvz
        exact not_mem_leafSupport_zVar_of_isSubformula_and_right hro hC1 hsub hvL
      have hL_z0 : zCount L = 0 :=
        Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr (Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hL_disj)
      rw [zCount_var_zVar, hL_z0, PosFormula.numAnd_var] at hz
      have hL_and0 : L.numAnd = 0 := by omega
      have hpart_eq (i : Fin (2 * n)) :
          zPartnerVars i (.and L (.var (zVar i₀))) = if i = i₀ then L.leafSupport else ∅ := by
        dsimp [zPartnerVars]
        have hneL : L ≠ .var (zVar i) := by
          intro hL_eq
          have hmem : zVar i ∈ L.leafSupport := by simp [hL_eq]
          exact not_mem_leafSupport_zVar_of_isSubformula_and_right hro hC1 hsub hmem
        by_cases hi : i = i₀
        · subst hi; simp [hneL]
        · have hneR : (PosFormula.var (zVar i₀) : PosFormula (6 * n)) ≠ .var (zVar i) := by
            simp [Ne.symm hi]
          simp [hi, hneL, hneR]
      refine ⟨Finset.disjoint_empty_left _, fun i => ?_, fun i j hij => ?_, fun w => ?_⟩
      · rw [hpart_eq]
        split_ifs
        · exact hL_disj
        · exact Finset.disjoint_empty_left _
      · rw [hpart_eq i, hpart_eq j]
        split_ifs with hi hj
        · exact absurd (hi.trans hj.symm) hij
        · exact Finset.disjoint_empty_right _
        · exact Finset.disjoint_empty_left _
        · exact Finset.disjoint_empty_left _
      · rw [PosFormula.eval_and, PosFormula.eval_var,
          PosFormula.eval_eq_decide_exists_of_numAnd_eq_zero hL_and0 w, Bool.and_comm]
        simp only [topOrVars, Finset.notMem_empty, false_and, exists_false, false_or, hpart_eq]
        rw [← Bool.decide_coe (w (zVar i₀)), ← Bool.decide_and, decide_eq_decide]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hwz, v, hv, hwv⟩
          exact ⟨i₀, hwz, v, by simp [hv], hwv⟩
        · rintro ⟨i, hwz, v, hv, hwv⟩
          by_cases hi : i = i₀
          · subst hi
            exact ⟨hwz, v, by simpa using hv, hwv⟩
          · simp [hi] at hv

    {F : PosFormula (6 * n)} (hro : F.IsReadOnce) (hleaf : F.leafSize = 6 * n)
    (hC1 : ∀ y z : BitString (2 * n),
      F.eval (packXYZ zeros2n y z) = decide (∃ i, y i = true ∧ z i = true))
    (hC2 : ∀ y z : BitString (2 * n),
      F.eval (packXYZ ones2n y z) = decide (∃ i, z i = true))
    (hC3 : ∀ x y : BitString (2 * n),
      F.eval (packXYZ x y ones2n) = decide (∃ i, x i = true ∨ y i = true))
    (hC4 : ∀ x y : BitString (2 * n),
      F.eval (packXYZ x y zeros2n) = false) :
    ∃ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2 * n)), ∀ x y z : BitString (2 * n),
      F.eval (packXYZ x y z) =
        decide (∃ i : Fin (2 * n), (x (π i) || y i) && z i) := by
  have hsupp : F.leafSupport = Finset.univ := by
    have hcard : F.leafSupport.card = 6 * n :=
      ((F.isReadOnce_iff_card_leafSupport_eq_leafSize).mp hro).trans hleaf
    exact Finset.eq_univ_of_card F.leafSupport (by simpa using hcard)
  have hnotZF : NotZLeaf F := by
    intro i hF
    have : F.leafSize = 1 := by rw [hF, PosFormula.leafSize_var]
    omega
  have hzF : zCount F = 2 * n := by
    simp [zCount, hsupp]

  have hz_le := zCount_le_numAnd_of_notZLeaf hro hC1 hC3 (.refl F) hnotZF
  have hz_eq : zCount F = F.numAnd := by omega
  obtain ⟨hd_top, hd_part, hd_ij, heval⟩ :=
    structure_of_zCount_eq_numAnd hro hC1 hC3 (.refl F) hnotZF hz_eq
  -- Claim 17: `topOrVars F = ∅` from Clause (4).
  have htop_empty : topOrVars F = ∅ := by
    rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    intro v hv
    have hv_notZ : v ∉ zSet n := Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd_top hv
    have hwv : packXYZ ones2n ones2n zeros2n v = true := by
      rcases eq_xVar_or_yVar_or_zVar v with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩
      · simp
      · simp

      rw [heval, decide_eq_true_iff]
      exact Or.inl ⟨v, hv, hwv⟩
    exact Bool.false_ne_true ((hC4 ones2n ones2n).symm.trans h1)
  have heval' (x y z : BitString (2 * n)) :
      F.eval (packXYZ x y z) =
        decide (∃ i : Fin (2 * n), z i = true ∧
          ∃ v ∈ zPartnerVars i F, packXYZ x y z v = true) := by
    simpa [htop_empty] using heval (packXYZ x y z)
  have heval_unit (x y : BitString (2 * n)) (i : Fin (2 * n)) :
      F.eval (packXYZ x y (Function.update zeros2n i true)) =

          packXYZ x y (Function.update zeros2n i true) v = true) := by

      have hji : j = i := by
        by_contra hne
        simp [Function.update_of_ne hne] at hj
      subst hji
      exact ⟨v, hv, hwv⟩
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, hwv⟩

  have hy_mem (i : Fin (2 * n)) : yVar i ∈ zPartnerVars i F := by
    have h := hC1 (Function.update zeros2n i true) (Function.update zeros2n i true)

        Function.update (zeros2n (n := n)) i true j = true ∧
        Function.update (zeros2n (n := n)) i true j = true := ⟨i, by simp, by simp⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hwv⟩ := h.mpr htrue
    have hv_notZ : v ∉ zSet n := Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd_part i) hv
    rcases eq_xVar_or_yVar_or_zVar v with ⟨k, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, rfl⟩
    · simp at hwv
    · have hki : k = i := by
        by_contra hne
        simp [Function.update_of_ne hne] at hwv
      subst hki
      exact hv
    · exact absurd (zVar_mem_zSet k) hv_notZ
  have hy_iff (i k : Fin (2 * n)) : yVar k ∈ zPartnerVars i F ↔ k = i := by
    constructor
    · intro hk
      by_contra hne
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd_ij k i hne) (hy_mem k) hk
    · rintro rfl
      exact hy_mem k
  -- Clause (2) provides an `x`-variable in each `zPartnerVars i F`.
  have hx_exists (i : Fin (2 * n)) : ∃ k : Fin (2 * n), xVar k ∈ zPartnerVars i F := by
    have h := hC2 zeros2n (Function.update zeros2n i true)
    rw [heval_unit, decide_eq_decide] at h
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hwv⟩ := h.mpr ⟨i, by simp⟩
    have hv_notZ : v ∉ zSet n := Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd_part i) hv
    rcases eq_xVar_or_yVar_or_zVar v with ⟨k, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨k, hv⟩
    · simp at hwv
    · exact absurd (zVar_mem_zSet k) hv_notZ
  let f (i : Fin (2 * n)) : Fin (2 * n) := (hx_exists i).choose
  have hf_mem (i : Fin (2 * n)) : xVar (f i) ∈ zPartnerVars i F :=
    (hx_exists i).choose_spec
  have hf_inj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i j hij
    by_contra hne
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd_ij i j hne) (hf_mem i) (hij ▸ hf_mem j)
  let π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2 * n)) :=
    Equiv.ofBijective f (Finite.injective_iff_bijective.mp hf_inj)
  have hπ_mem (i : Fin (2 * n)) : xVar (π i) ∈ zPartnerVars i F := hf_mem i
  have hx_iff (i k : Fin (2 * n)) : xVar k ∈ zPartnerVars i F ↔ k = π i := by
    constructor
    · intro hk
      have hsymm : xVar k ∈ zPartnerVars (π.symm k) F := by
        simpa [π] using hπ_mem (π.symm k)
      have hi_eq : i = π.symm k := by
        by_contra hne
        exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd_ij i (π.symm k) hne) hk hsymm
      rw [hi_eq, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    · rintro rfl
      exact hπ_mem i
  refine ⟨π, fun x y z => ?_⟩
  rw [heval', decide_eq_decide]
  refine exists_congr fun i => ?_
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hz, v, hv, hwv⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hz⟩
    have hv_notZ : v ∉ zSet n := Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd_part i) hv
    rcases eq_xVar_or_yVar_or_zVar v with ⟨k, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, rfl⟩

    · rw [(hy_iff i k).mp hv] at hwv
      exact Or.inr (by simpa using hwv)
    · exact absurd (zVar_mem_zSet k) hv_notZ
  · rintro ⟨hx | hy, hz⟩
    · exact ⟨hz, xVar (π i), hπ_mem i, by simpa using hx⟩
    · exact ⟨hz, yVar i, hy_mem i, by simpa using hy⟩

theorem mem_BipartitePermutationIndependentSet_of_ilangoInstance_mem_binaryGate
    {G : BipartitePermutationGraph} (hG : 2 ≤ G.1)
    (hmem : ilangoInstance G ∈ PartialMCSP.BinaryGate) :
    G ∈ BipartitePermutationIndependentSet := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc_cost, hc_agrees⟩ := hmem
  change (c : Circuit signature (6 * G.1) 1).program.cost binaryCost ≤ 6 * G.1 - 1 at hc_cost
  change (ilangoInstance G).AgreesWith
    (fun y => (c : Circuit signature (6 * G.1) 1).eval interpretation y 0) at hc_agrees
  have hpos6 : 0 < 6 * G.1 := by omega
  have hcost' : c.program.cost binaryCost + 1 ≤ 6 * G.1 := by omega
  have hpos (i : Fin (6 * G.1)) : ∃ y₀ y₁ : BitString (6 * G.1),
      (∀ k, k ≠ i → y₀ k = y₁ k) ∧ y₀ i = false ∧ y₁ i = true ∧
      c.eval interpretation y₀ 0 = false ∧ c.eval interpretation y₁ 0 = true := by
    obtain ⟨w, h0, h1⟩ := ilangoInstance_posEssential (by omega) hc_agrees i
    exact ⟨Function.update w i false, Function.update w i true,
      fun k hk => by simp [Function.update_of_ne hk], by simp, by simp, h0, h1⟩
  obtain ⟨F, hro, hleaf, _, _, hF_eval⟩ :=
    c.exists_posFormula_of_cost_binaryCost_le hpos6 hcost' hpos
  have hF_agrees : ∀ w : BitString (6 * G.1), ∀ b : Bool,
      ilangoGamma G w = some b → F.eval w = b := by
    intro w b hwb
    rw [hF_eval]
    apply hc_agrees w b
    rwa [ilangoInstance_partialFunction]
  have hC1 (y z : BitString (2 * G.1)) :
      F.eval (packXYZ zeros2n y z) = decide (∃ i, y i = true ∧ z i = true) :=
    hF_agrees _ _ (ilangoGamma_zeros2n_x G y z)
  have hC2 (y z : BitString (2 * G.1)) :
      F.eval (packXYZ ones2n y z) = decide (∃ i, z i = true) :=
    hF_agrees _ _ (ilangoGamma_ones2n_x G y z)
  have hC3 (x y : BitString (2 * G.1)) :
      F.eval (packXYZ x y ones2n) = decide (∃ i, x i = true ∨ y i = true) :=
    hF_agrees _ _ (ilangoGamma_ones2n_z G x y)
  have hC4 (x y : BitString (2 * G.1)) :
      F.eval (packXYZ x y zeros2n) = false :=
    hF_agrees _ _ (ilangoGamma_zeros2n_z G x y)
  obtain ⟨π, hF_π⟩ :=
    PosFormula.exists_perm_of_agreesWith_ilango hro hleaf hC1 hC2 hC3 hC4
  rw [BipartitePermutationIndependentSet.mem_iff_exists_satisfiesUndirected]
  have hblock : BipartitePermutationGraph.IsBlockPreserving π := by
    intro i
    have h1 := hF_agrees _ _
      (ilangoGamma_leftHalfOnes G (Function.update zeros2n (π i) true))
    rw [hF_π, decide_eq_decide] at h1
    simp only [zeros2n, leftHalfOnes, Bool.or_false, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h1
    have hLHS : (∃ j : Fin (2 * G.1),
        Function.update (zeros2n (n := G.1)) (π i) true (π j) = true ∧ j.1 < G.1) ↔ i.1 < G.1 := by
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨j, hj, hj_lt⟩
        have hji : j = i := by
          by_contra hne
          have hπne : π j ≠ π i := π.injective.ne hne
          simp [Function.update_of_ne hπne] at hj
        exact hji ▸ hj_lt
      · intro hi_lt
        exact ⟨i, by simp, hi_lt⟩
    have hRHS : (∃ j : Fin (2 * G.1),
        j.1 < G.1 ∧ Function.update (zeros2n (n := G.1)) (π i) true j = true) ↔
        (π i).1 < G.1 := by
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨j, hj_lt, hj⟩
        have hji : j = π i := by
          by_contra hne
          simp [Function.update_of_ne hne] at hj
        exact hji ▸ hj_lt
      · intro hπ_lt
        exact ⟨π i, hπ_lt, by simp⟩
    exact (hLHS.symm.trans h1).trans hRHS
  refine ⟨π, hblock, fun e he hu₁ hu₂ hv₁ hv₂ => ?_⟩
  let j : Fin G.1 := ⟨e.1.1, hu₁⟩
  let k : Fin G.1 := ⟨e.1.2, hu₂⟩
  let j' : Fin G.1 := ⟨e.2.1, hv₁⟩
  let k' : Fin G.1 := ⟨e.2.2, hv₂⟩
  have h7 := hF_agrees _ _ (ilangoGamma_edge hG j j' k k' he)
  rw [hF_π, decide_eq_true_iff, eval_antiUnitPair_unitPair_of_isBlockPreserving hblock] at h7
  exact h7

    {encOut : (List (Option Bool) × ℕ) ↪ List Bool}
    {encInst : Instance ↪ List Bool}
    (hRaw : ComputableInPolyTime ilangoRawFromFuel
      (encPair encBipartitePermutationGraph encUnary) encOut)
    (henc : ∀ I : Instance, encInst I = encOut (List.ofFn I.table, I.threshold)) :
    ∃ C D : ℕ, ComputableInO ilangoReduction
      encBipartitePermutationGraph encInst
      (fun G => 2 ^ (C * G.1) * ((encBipartitePermutationGraph G).length + 1) ^ D)
      (fun G => 2 ^ (C * G.1) * ((encBipartitePermutationGraph G).length + 1) ^ D) := by
  obtain ⟨d₁, _, hd₁⟩ := computableInPolyTime_sixMulFst.tidy.exists_degree
  obtain ⟨d₂, _, hd₂⟩ := hRaw.tidy.exists_degree
  have hId : ComputableTidilyInO (fun G : BipartitePermutationGraph => G)
      encBipartitePermutationGraph encBipartitePermutationGraph
      (fun G => (encBipartitePermutationGraph G).length)
      (fun G => (encBipartitePermutationGraph G).length) :=
    ComputableTidilyInO.of_linear
      (.of_eq (encIn := encBipartitePermutationGraph) (encMid := encBipartitePermutationGraph)
        fun _ => rfl)
  have hFuel : ComputableTidilyInO (fun G : BipartitePermutationGraph => 2 ^ (6 * G.1))
      encBipartitePermutationGraph encUnary
      (fun G => ((encBipartitePermutationGraph G).length + 1) ^ d₁ + 2 ^ (2 * (6 * G.1)))
      (fun G => ((encBipartitePermutationGraph G).length + 1) ^ d₁ + 2 ^ (2 * (6 * G.1))) :=
    computableTidilyInO_twoPow.comp hd₁.inO
  have hPair := hId.prod hFuel
  have hComp := hd₂.inO.comp hPair
  set C : ℕ := 12 + 6 * d₂
  set D : ℕ := d₁ + d₂ + 1
  have hbound (G : BipartitePermutationGraph) :
      (encBipartitePermutationGraph G).length +
        (((encBipartitePermutationGraph G).length + 1) ^ d₁ + 2 ^ (2 * (6 * G.1))) +
        ((encPair encBipartitePermutationGraph encUnary (G, 2 ^ (6 * G.1))).length + 1) ^ d₂ ≤
        (3 ^ d₂ + 3) * (2 ^ (C * G.1) * ((encBipartitePermutationGraph G).length + 1) ^ D + 1) := by
    set L := (encBipartitePermutationGraph G).length
    set M := 2 ^ (6 * G.1)
    have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := Nat.one_le_two_pow
    have hL1 : 1 ≤ L + 1 := Nat.succ_pos L
    have hX1 : 1 ≤ 2 ^ (C * G.1) := Nat.one_le_two_pow
    have hP1 : 1 ≤ (L + 1) ^ D := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hL1
    have hL_le : L ≤ (L + 1) ^ D :=

    have hd₁_le : (L + 1) ^ d₁ ≤ (L + 1) ^ D :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right hL1 (by omega)
    have hd₂_le : (L + 1) ^ d₂ ≤ (L + 1) ^ D :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right hL1 (by omega)
    have h12_le : 2 ^ (2 * (6 * G.1)) ≤ 2 ^ (C * G.1) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos (by simp only [C]; nlinarith)
    have hpair_len : (encPair encBipartitePermutationGraph encUnary (G, M)).length + 1 ≤
        3 * M * (L + 1) := by
      simp only [length_encPair, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate, L]
      nlinarith
    have hpow_pair : ((encPair encBipartitePermutationGraph encUnary (G, M)).length + 1) ^ d₂ ≤
        3 ^ d₂ * (2 ^ (C * G.1) * (L + 1) ^ D) := by
      have hMd₂ : M ^ d₂ ≤ 2 ^ (C * G.1) := by
        rw [show M ^ d₂ = 2 ^ (6 * G.1 * d₂) by simp [M, ← pow_mul]]
        exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos (by simp only [C]; nlinarith)
      calc ((encPair encBipartitePermutationGraph encUnary (G, M)).length + 1) ^ d₂
          ≤ (3 * M * (L + 1)) ^ d₂ := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hpair_len d₂
        _ = 3 ^ d₂ * (M ^ d₂ * (L + 1) ^ d₂) := by simp only [mul_pow, mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ 3 ^ d₂ * (2 ^ (C * G.1) * (L + 1) ^ D) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul hMd₂ hd₂_le)
    have ht1 : L ≤ 2 ^ (C * G.1) * (L + 1) ^ D :=
      hL_le.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hX1)
    have ht2 : (L + 1) ^ d₁ ≤ 2 ^ (C * G.1) * (L + 1) ^ D :=
      hd₁_le.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hX1)
    have ht3 : 2 ^ (2 * (6 * G.1)) ≤ 2 ^ (C * G.1) * (L + 1) ^ D :=

    generalize 3 ^ d₂ = K₃ at hpow_pair ⊢
    nlinarith

    le_min hx hcomp_bound

  have hagree : x.AgreesWith fun y => c.eval interpretation y 0 :=
    (Instance.computesOn_definedInputs_iff.mp hc)

    (accept := fun y out => (tableEntry (List.ofFn x.table) y).getD out == out)
    hsize fun y => by

private theorem mul_bound_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 64 ≤ n) :
    n * Lupanov.bound (2 * Nat.log2 n + 3) (n - (2 * Nat.log2 n + 3))
      (n - (3 * Nat.log2 n + 4)) ≤ 12 * 2 ^ n := by
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hl : 6 ≤ Nat.log2 n := (Nat.le_log2 hn0).mpr (le_trans (by norm_num) hn)
  have hhigh : n < 2 ^ (Nat.log2 n + 1) := Nat.lt_log2_self
  have hlow := (add_le_two_pow hl).trans (Nat.log2_self_le hn0)
  generalize Nat.log2 n = l at hl hhigh hlow
  set k := 2 * l + 3
  set d := n - k
  set s := n - (3 * l + 4)
  have hkd : k + d = n := by omega
  have hs : 4 ≤ s := by omega
  have hns : n ≤ 2 * s := by omega
  -- The powers of two involved, with `P = 2 ^ (2 l + 2) > n ^ 2`.
  have hA : 2 ^ k = 2 * 2 ^ (2 * l + 2) := by
    rw [show k = 1 + (2 * l + 2) by omega, pow_add, pow_one]
  have hP : n * n < 2 ^ (2 * l + 2) := by
    calc n * n < 2 ^ (l + 1) * 2 ^ (l + 1) := Nat.mul_lt_mul'' hhigh hhigh
      _ = 2 ^ (2 * l + 2) := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  have hAB : 2 * (2 ^ (2 * l + 2) * 2 ^ d) = 2 ^ n := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← hA, ← pow_add, hkd]
  have hAC : 2 * (2 ^ (l + 1) * (2 ^ (2 * l + 2) * 2 ^ s)) = 2 ^ n := by
    rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add, ← pow_succ']; congr 1; omega
  have hCP : 4 * (2 ^ s * 2 ^ (2 * l + 2)) ≤ 2 ^ n := by
    calc 4 * (2 ^ s * 2 ^ (2 * l + 2)) = 2 ^ (s + (2 * l + 4)) := by
          rw [show 2 * l + 4 = 2 * l + 2 + 2 by omega, pow_add, pow_add]; ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos (by omega)
  have hPP : 8 * (2 ^ (2 * l + 2) * 2 ^ (2 * l + 2)) ≤ 2 ^ n := by
    calc 8 * (2 ^ (2 * l + 2) * 2 ^ (2 * l + 2)) = 2 ^ (4 * l + 7) := by
          rw [← pow_add, show (8 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 3 by norm_num, ← pow_add]
          congr 1
          omega
      _ ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos (by omega)
  have hn2 : n ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le
  have hq : 2 ^ k / s * s ≤ 2 * 2 ^ (2 * l + 2) := hA ▸ Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
  have hbound : n * Lupanov.bound k d s =
      4 * (n * n * 2 ^ (2 * l + 2)) + 2 * (n * 2 ^ (2 * l + 2)) + 2 * (n * n * 2 ^ d) + n * 2 ^ d +
        n * (2 ^ k / s * (2 ^ s * (2 * s + 4))) + n * (2 ^ k / s * 2 ^ d) +
        n * (2 ^ s * (2 * s + 4)) + n * 2 ^ d + n := by
    rw [Lupanov.bound, hkd, hA]; ring
  rw [hbound]
  -- Each term is at most a small multiple of `2 ^ n`.
  generalize 2 ^ k / s = q at hq
  generalize 2 ^ (2 * l + 2) = P at hq hP hAB hAC hCP hPP
  generalize 2 ^ (l + 1) = H at hhigh hAC
  generalize 2 ^ n = N at hAB hAC hCP hPP hn2 ⊢
  generalize 2 ^ d = B at hAB ⊢
  generalize 2 ^ s = C at hAC hCP ⊢
  have h1 : 1 ≤ n := by omega
  have hnn : n ≤ n * n := Nat.le_mul_self n
  have ha : n * n * P ≤ P * P := Nat.mul_le_mul_right P hP.le
  have ha' : n * P ≤ P * P := (Nat.mul_le_mul_right P hnn).trans ha
  have hb : n * n * B ≤ P * B := Nat.mul_le_mul_right B hP.le
  have hb' : n * B ≤ P * B := (Nat.mul_le_mul_right B hnn).trans hb
  have hc : n * (q * (C * (2 * s + 4))) ≤ 3 * (H * (P * C)) * 2 := by
    calc n * (q * (C * (2 * s + 4))) ≤ n * (q * (C * (3 * s))) := by gcongr; omega
      _ = 3 * (n * C * (q * s)) := by ring
      _ ≤ 3 * (H * C * (2 * P)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul_right C hhigh.le) hq)
      _ = 3 * (H * (P * C)) * 2 := by ring
  have hd : n * (q * B) ≤ 2 * (2 * (P * B)) := by
    calc n * (q * B) ≤ 2 * s * (q * B) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hns
      _ = 2 * (q * s * B) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * (2 * P * B) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Nat.mul_le_mul_right B hq)
      _ = 2 * (2 * (P * B)) := by ring
  have he : n * (C * (2 * s + 4)) ≤ 3 * (C * P) := by
    calc n * (C * (2 * s + 4)) ≤ n * (C * (3 * n)) := by gcongr; omega
      _ = 3 * (n * n * C) := by ring
      _ ≤ 3 * (P * C) := by gcongr
      _ = 3 * (C * P) := by ring
  omega

/-- For `n ≥ 16`, at most `2 ^ (2 ^ n / 4)` Boolean functions on `n` inputs have a circuit with
at most `2 ^ n / (5 n)` gates. -/

private theorem card_computableFunctions_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 16 ≤ n) :
    (computableFunctions n (2 ^ n / (5 * n))).card ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ n / 4) := by
  set s := 2 ^ n / (5 * n)
  set c := (computableFunctions n s).card
  have h64 := mul_sq_le_two_pow hn
  have hsn : 5 * n * s ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.mul_div_le _ _
  have hs : n + 1 ≤ s := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hs64 : 64 * s ≤ 2 ^ n := le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right s (by omega : 64 ≤ 5 * n)) hsn
  -- Shannon's count, simplified with `n + 1 ≤ s` and `s ^ s ≤ 3 ^ s s!`.
  have hcount : c * s.factorial ≤ 4 * s ^ 2 * (20 * s ^ 2) ^ s := by
    refine (card_computableFunctions_mul_factorial_le n s).trans ?_
    calc (s + 1) * (5 * (n + s + 1) ^ 2) ^ s * (n + s)
        ≤ (2 * s) * (5 * (2 * s) ^ 2) ^ s * (2 * s) := by gcongr <;> omega
      _ = 4 * s ^ 2 * (20 * s ^ 2) ^ s := by ring
  have hc : c * s ^ s ≤ 4 * s ^ 2 * (60 * s) ^ s * s ^ s := by
    calc c * s ^ s ≤ c * (3 ^ s * s.factorial) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_self_le_three_pow_mul_factorial s)
      _ = 3 ^ s * (c * s.factorial) := by ring
      _ ≤ 3 ^ s * (4 * s ^ 2 * (20 * s ^ 2) ^ s) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hcount
      _ = 4 * s ^ 2 * (60 * s) ^ s * s ^ s := by
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, show (60 : ℕ) ^ s = 3 ^ s * 20 ^ s by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num]; ring
  have hc' : c ≤ 4 * s ^ 2 * (60 * s) ^ s :=
    Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right hc (pow_pos (by omega) s)
  have hexp : n * (s + 2) ≤ 2 ^ n / 4 := by
    apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by norm_num)).mpr
    nlinarith
  calc c ≤ 4 * s ^ 2 * (60 * s) ^ s := hc'
    _ ≤ (2 ^ n) ^ 2 * (2 ^ n) ^ s := by
        gcongr
        · nlinarith
        · omega
    _ = 2 ^ (n * (s + 2)) := by rw [← pow_add, ← pow_mul]; ring_nf
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ n / 4) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos hexp

theorem mem_of_twelve_mul_le (hn : 64 ≤ n) (T : BitString (2 ^ n)) (hs : 12 * 2 ^ n / n ≤ s) :

  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega

  exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).mpr (by rw [mul_comm]; exact mul_bound_le hn)

      samples.card * (2 * n + 3) + 1 := by
  classical
  let S : Finset (BitString n) := (samples.filter fun p => p.2 = true).image Prod.fst
  have heq : sampleFunction samples = fun y => decide (y ∈ S) && true := by
    funext y

  have hcard : S.card ≤ samples.card :=

theorem toStepMachine_resourceCertificate (hhalt : ComputableInO m.halt encS encBool T S)
    (haddr : ComputableInO m.addr encS (encOption encNat) T S)
    (hstep : ComputableInO (fun p : σ × Bool => m.step p.1 p.2) (encPair encS encBool)
      (encPair encS encBits) (fun p => T p.1) fun p => S p.1) :
    (m.toStepMachine).ResourceCertificate (encPair encS encNat)
      (stateT encS T S) (stateS encS S) where
  computable_halt := by
    refine ((hhalt.comp (fst encS encNat)).mono_le (fun q => ?_) fun q => ?_)
    · simp only [stateT]
      have : (encPair encS encNat q).length + T q.1 ≤
          (T q.1 + S q.1 + 2 * (encPair encS encNat q).length + 4) ^ 2 :=
        (by omega : _ ≤ T q.1 + S q.1 + 2 * (encPair encS encNat q).length + 4).trans
          (Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) _)
      exact this.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega))
    · simp only [stateS]; omega
  computable_step := by
    have hst : spaceB encS S ≼ timeB encS T S := .of_le spaceB_le_timeB
    have hin : (fun p => (encStepIn encS p).length) ≼ spaceB encS S := .of_le inLen_le_spaceB
    obtain ⟨hq, hpos, ha⟩ := budget_proj (encS := encS) (T := T) (S := S)
    -- the address and its components
    have hT : (fun p : (σ × ℕ) × Option Bool => T p.1.1) ≼ timeB encS T S := .of_le fun p => by
      simp only [timeB]
      have : T p.1.1 ≤ (T p.1.1 + S p.1.1 + inLen encS p + 1) ^ 2 :=
        (by omega : _ ≤ T p.1.1 + S p.1.1 + inLen encS p + 1).trans
          (Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) _)
      exact this.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega))
    have hS : (fun p : (σ × ℕ) × Option Bool => S p.1.1) ≼ spaceB encS S := .of_le fun p => by
      simp [spaceB]
    have hA := budget_comp haddr hq hT hS
    have hisNone : ComputableInO (fun o : Option ℕ => o.isNone)
        (encOption encNat) encBool (fun o => (encOption encNat o).length)
        (fun o => (encOption encNat o).length) := by
      refine ((ComputableInDegree.of_finite (encIn := encBool) (encMid := encBool)
        Bool.not).inO_one.comp_linear (ComputableInDegree.isSome encNat).inO_one).of_enc_eq
          (g := fun o : Option ℕ => o.isNone) fun o => ?_
      cases o <;> rfl
    have hisN := budget_comp_linear hisNone hA hst
    have hgetD := budget_comp_linear (ComputableInDegree.getD (enc₁ := encNat) 0).inO_one
      hA hst
    have hA₁ := budget_comp natSucc hgetD (sq_bigOLe hgetD.length_le)
      (.add hgetD.length_le (.const 1 _))
    have hpair := budget_prod hpos hA₁
    have he := budget_comp (ComputableInO.eq encNat) hpair
      ((BigOLe.of_le fun p => by simp only [length_encPair]; nlinarith).trans
        (sq_bigOLe hpair.length_le)) hpair.length_le
    have hl := budget_comp natLt hpair (lt_bigOLe hpair.length_le)
      (.add hpair.length_le (.const 1 _))
    -- the bit read and the step of the read machine
    have hb := budget_finite (encD := encBool)
      (fun q : Bool × Bool × Option Bool => if q.1 then false else if q.2.1
        then q.2.2.getD false else false) (budget_prod hisN (budget_prod he ha)) hst
    have hr := budget_comp hstep (budget_prod hq hb) hT hS
    have hz := budget_comp_linear natIsZero hpos hst
    have hc := budget_finite (encD := encBool) (fun q : Bool × Bool × Bool × Option Bool × Bool =>
      q.1 || q.2.1 || (q.2.2.1 && q.2.2.2.1.isNone && !q.2.2.2.2))
      (budget_prod hisN (budget_prod he (budget_prod hl (budget_prod ha hz)))) hst
    -- the three results
    have hres₁ := budget_prod (encB := encPair encS encNat) (budget_prod (fst' hr) hpos)
      (budget_prod (encB := encMove) (budget_const (0 : SignType) hin hst) (snd' hr))
    have hres₂ := budget_prod (encB := encPair encS encNat) (budget_prod hq
      (budget_comp natSucc hpos (sq_bigOLe hpos.length_le)
        (.add hpos.length_le (.const 1 _))))
      (budget_prod (encB := encMove) (budget_const (1 : SignType) hin hst)
        (budget_const (encB := encBits) ([] : List Bool) hin hst))
    have hres₃ := budget_prod (encB := encPair encS encNat) (budget_prod hq
      (budget_comp natPred hpos (sq_bigOLe hpos.length_le)
        (.add hpos.length_le (.const 1 _))))
      (budget_prod (encB := encMove) (budget_const (-1 : SignType) hin hst)
        (budget_const (encB := encBits) ([] : List Bool) hin hst))
    have hall := budget_ite hc hres₁ (budget_ite hl hres₂ hres₃)
    refine ((hall.of_enc_eq fun p => by rw [← stepBy_eq]; rfl).mono 4 (fun p => ?_)
      fun p => ?_)
    · have := inLen_le (encS := encS) p
      simp only [timeB, stateT]
      have h : T p.1.1 + S p.1.1 + inLen encS p + 1 ≤
          T p.1.1 + S p.1.1 + 2 * (encPair encS encNat p.1).length + 4 := by omega
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (p.1.2 + 1) (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h 2)
      omega
    · have := inLen_le (encS := encS) p
      simp only [spaceB, stateS]
      omega

    (hc : ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace c encIn encC)
    (hf : ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace (f ∘ Subtype.val)
      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = true)).trans encIn) encMid)
    (hg : ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace (g ∘ Subtype.val)
      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = false)).trans encIn) encMid) :
    ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace (fun x => if c x then f x else g x) encIn encMid := by
  obtain ⟨c₀, h₀⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨c₁, h₁⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨c₂, h₂⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨k, h⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.ite h₀
    (tf := fun x => c₁ * ((encIn x).length + 1)) (sf := fun x => c₁ * ((encIn x).length + 1))
    (tg := fun x => c₂ * ((encIn x).length + 1)) (sg := fun x => c₂ * ((encIn x).length + 1))
    h₁ h₂
  refine ⟨c₀ + c₁ + c₂ + k, h.mono (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_)⟩ <;> split_ifs <;> nlinarith

public theorem ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.restrict {α β : Type*} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
    {encOut : β ↪ List Bool} {f : α → β} {t s : α → ℕ}
    (h : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut t s) (p : α → Prop) :
    ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (f ∘ Subtype.val) ((Function.Embedding.subtype p).trans encIn)

public theorem ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.ite {γ β : Type*} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {encC : Bool ↪ List Bool} {encOut : β ↪ List Bool} {c : γ → Bool} {f g : γ → β}
    {tc sc tf sf tg sg : γ → ℕ}
    (hc : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace c encIn encC tc sc)
    (hf : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (f ∘ Subtype.val)
      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = true)).trans encIn) encOut (tf ∘ Subtype.val)
      (sf ∘ Subtype.val))
    (hg : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (g ∘ Subtype.val)
      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = false)).trans encIn) encOut (tg ∘ Subtype.val)
      (sg ∘ Subtype.val)) :
    ∃ k, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (fun x => if c x then f x else g x) encIn encOut
      (fun x => tc x + (if c x then tf x else tg x) + k)
      (fun x => sc x + (if c x then sf x else sg x) + k) := by
  -- the test word of the condition, in time bounded by the longer encoding of a truth value
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l, ∀ b, (encC b).length ≤ l :=
    ⟨(encC true).length + (encC false).length, fun b => by cases b <;> omega⟩
  have htest := (eqWordT (encC true)).computableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (f := id) (encIn := encC)
    (encOut := encTest) fun b => by
      rw [eqWordT_run_q₀]; cases b <;> simp [encTest_true, encTest_false]
  -- vendored: crei's `comp` is `comp_linear` here, as cslib #1111 restates `comp`
  obtain ⟨ct, hct⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear htest hc
  have hb (x : γ) : 4 * (encC (c x)).length + 8 + ct * ((encC (c x)).length + 1) ≤
      (ct + 4) * (l + 2) := by
    have := hl (c x)
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left ct this
    simp only [Nat.mul_add_one, Nat.add_mul]; omega
  obtain ⟨k₀, S₀, _, tmc, htmc⟩ := hct.mono (t' := fun x => tc x + (ct + 4) * (l + 2))
    (s' := fun x => sc x + (ct + 4) * (l + 2)) (fun x => by have := hb x; omega)
    (fun x => by have := hb x; omega)
  obtain ⟨k₁, S₁, _, tm₁, htm₁⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨k₂, S₂, _, tm₂, htm₂⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨(ct + 4) * (l + 2) + 15 + 5 * max k₀ (max k₁ k₂), _, _, inferInstance,
    iteTM tmc tm₁ tm₂, fun x => ?_⟩
  have h := (htmc x).ite (tm₁ := tm₁) (tm₂ := tm₂) (y := encOut (if c x then f x else g x))
    (t₁ := tf x) (s₁ := sf x) (t₂ := tg x) (s₂ := sg x)
    (fun hw => by
      have hcx : c x = true := by cases hcx : c x <;> simp_all [encTest_true, encTest_false]
      simpa [hcx] using htm₁ ⟨x, hcx⟩)
    (fun hw => by
      have hcx : c x = false := by cases hcx : c x <;> simp_all [encTest_true, encTest_false]
      simpa [hcx] using htm₂ ⟨x, hcx⟩)
  refine TransformsTapes.mono h ?_ ?_ <;> cases hcx : c x <;>
    simp [hcx, encTest_true, encTest_false] <;> omega

public theorem ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpaceOfLength.iterateWhile {α : Type*} {f : α → α}
    {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {t s l ρ : ℕ → ℕ} {r : α → ℕ} (ht : Monotone t) (hs : Monotone s)
    (hf : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpaceOfLength f enc enc t s)
    (hr : ∀ a, IsLeast {n | enc (f^[n + 1] a) = []} (r a))
    (hρ : ∀ a, r a ≤ ρ (enc a).length)
    (hl : ∀ a, ∀ n ≤ r a, (enc (f^[n] a)).length ≤ l (enc a).length) :
    ∃ c, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpaceOfLength (fun a => f^[r a] a) enc enc
      (fun n => (ρ n + 1) * (t (l n) + c * (l n + 1))) (fun n => c * (s (l n) + l n + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.iterateWhile hf hr
  refine ⟨c, h.mono (fun a => ?_) (fun a => ?_)⟩ <;> dsimp only <;> gcongr
  all_goals first
    | exact hρ a
    | refine Finset.sup_le fun n hn => ?_
      have := hl a n (Finset.mem_Iic.mp hn)
      first | exact this | exact ht this | exact hs this

public theorem computesTidily_multiPassTM {pass : MultiTapeTM K Bool SP} (hVC : V ≠ C)
    (x : List Bool) (passes : ℕ) (vs cs es : ℕ → List Bool) (ef : List Bool)
    {tI sI tP sP tF sF : ℕ}
    (hI : TransformsTapes I (fun inp ws => inp = x ∧ ws = fun _ => [])
      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs 0) ∧ em = []) tI sI)
    (hpass : ∀ i ≤ passes, TransformsTapes pass
      (fun inp ws => inp = x ∧ ws = passTapes V C (vs i) (cs i))
      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = passTapes V C (vs (i + 1)) (cs (i + 1)) ∧ em = es i) tP sP)
    (hfirst : cs 0 = []) (hcs : ∀ i < passes, cs (i + 1) ≠ []) (hlast : cs (passes + 1) = [])
    (hF : TransformsTapes Fm
      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs (passes + 1)))
      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = ef) tF sF) :
    (multiPassTM I pass Fm V C).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x
      (((List.range (passes + 1)).map es).flatten ++ ef)
      (tI + ((passes + 1) * (tP + 1) + (tF + 3 * ((vs (passes + 1)).length + 1))))
      (sI + ((2 * K * sP + K) + (sF + ((vs (passes + 1)).length + 1 + K)))) := by
  let P (n : ℕ) (inp : List Bool) (ws : Fin K → List Bool) (em : List Bool) : Prop :=
    inp = x ∧ ws = passTapes V C (vs n) (cs n) ∧ em = ((List.range n).map es).flatten
  have hround : ∀ n < passes, ∀ acc, TransformsTapes pass (fun inp ws => P n inp ws acc)
      (fun inp _ ws' e => P (n + 1) inp ws' (acc ++ e) ∧ ws' C ≠ []) tP sP := by
    -- vendored: `TransformsTapes` is stated with run paths since cslib #1117
    refine fun n hn acc => transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mpr ?_
    rintro inp ws out ⟨hin, hws, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ws', e, hrun, ⟨h, rfl⟩, hsp⟩ :=
      transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mp (hpass n hn.le) inp ws out ⟨hin, hws⟩
    refine ⟨ws', _, hrun, ⟨⟨hin, h, by simp [List.range_succ]⟩, ?_⟩, hsp⟩
    simpa [h, passTapes] using hcs n hn
  let R (inp : List Bool) (ws : Fin K → List Bool) (em : List Bool) : Prop :=
    inp = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs (passes + 1)) ∧
      em = ((List.range (passes + 1)).map es).flatten
  have hstop : ∀ acc, TransformsTapes pass (fun inp ws => P passes inp ws acc)
      (fun inp _ ws' e => R inp ws' (acc ++ e) ∧ ws' C = []) tP sP := by
    -- vendored: `TransformsTapes` is stated with run paths since cslib #1117
    refine fun acc => transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mpr ?_
    rintro inp ws out ⟨hin, hws, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ws', e, hrun, ⟨h, rfl⟩, hsp⟩ :=
      transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mp (hpass passes le_rfl) inp ws out ⟨hin, hws⟩
    refine ⟨ws', _, hrun, ⟨⟨hin, by rw [h, hlast, passTapes_nil hVC], by simp [List.range_succ]⟩,
      ?_⟩, hsp⟩
    simp [h, passTapes, hlast]
  have hloop := transformsTapes_repeatUntilBlank C hround hstop
  have hclear : TransformsTapes ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb V))
      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs (passes + 1)))
      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = (fun _ => []) ∧ em = [])
      (3 * ((vs (passes + 1)).length + 1)) ((vs (passes + 1)).length + 1 + K) :=
    (transformsTapes_clearWork_tapeEmb V (vs (passes + 1))).imp (fun _ _ h => by simp [h])
      (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws]; simp, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
  have hfin := (hF.imp (fun _ _ h => h) (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨h.trans hws, he⟩) le_rfl
    le_rfl).seq_eq hclear
  have hmain := transformsTapes_seq hloop hfin fun _ _ _ _ _ h => h.2.1
  refine (transformsTapes_seq hI hmain fun _ _ _ _ ⟨hin, _⟩ ⟨h, _⟩ =>
    ⟨hin, by rw [h, hfirst, passTapes_nil hVC], rfl⟩).imp (fun _ _ h => h) ?_ le_rfl le_rfl
  rintro _ _ _ _ _ ⟨_, _, _, ⟨-, rfl⟩, ⟨_, _, _, ⟨-, -, rfl⟩, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  simp

public theorem exists_embedding_eq₂ (h : m ≤ K) {i o : Fin m} (hio : i ≠ o) {a b : Fin K}
    (hab : a ≠ b) : ∃ e : Fin m ↪ Fin K, e i = a ∧ e o = b := by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_embedding_eq h i a

  have hoa : e o ≠ a := fun h => hio (e.injective (h.trans he.symm)).symm

/-- `frozenRound` takes the word `w` on tape `V` and every other tape blank to `next` on tape `V`
and every other tape blank, emitting `emit`, if `E` emits `emit` from `w` and `Nm` writes `next`
to tape `N`. -/
public theorem transformsTapes_frozenRound (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F)
    {w emit next : List Bool} {tE sE tN sN : ℕ}
    (hE : TransformsTapes E (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V w)
      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = emit) tE sE)
    (hN : TransformsTapes Nm (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V w)
      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws N next ∧ em = []) tN sN) :
    TransformsTapes (frozenRound E Nm V N F hVN hVF hNF)
      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V w)
      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V next ∧ em = emit)
      (tE + (tN + (3 * (w.length + 1) + ((3 * next.length + 10) + 3 * (next.length + 1)))))
      (sE + (sN + ((w.length + 1 + K) + ((4 * next.length + K + 15) +
        (next.length + 1 + K))))) := by
  set W₀ := Function.update (fun _ => ([] : List Bool)) V w
  set W₁ := Function.update W₀ N next
  set W₂ := Function.update W₁ V []
  set W₃ := Function.update W₂ V next
  have hW₄ : Function.update W₃ N [] = Function.update (fun _ => []) V next := by
    funext l
    simp only [W₃, W₂, W₁, W₀, Function.update_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  have h₀ : TransformsTapes E (fun _ ws => ws = W₀) (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = W₀ ∧ em = emit)
      tE sE := hE.imp (fun _ _ h => h) (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨h.trans hws, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
  have h₁ : TransformsTapes Nm (fun _ ws => ws = W₀) (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = W₁ ∧ em = [])
      tN sN := hN.imp (fun _ _ h => h) (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws], he⟩)
      le_rfl le_rfl
  have h₂ : TransformsTapes ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb V)) (fun _ ws => ws = W₁)
      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = W₂ ∧ em = []) (3 * (w.length + 1)) (w.length + 1 + K) :=
    (transformsTapes_clearWork_tapeEmb V w).imp (fun _ _ h => by simp [h, W₁, W₀, hVN])
      (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws], he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
  have h₃ := (transformsTapes_copyWord (threeTapes V N F hVN hVF hNF) true next).imp
    (P' := fun _ ws => ws = W₂) (Q' := fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = W₃ ∧ em = [])
    (fun _ _ h => by
      subst h
      change W₂ N = next ∧ W₂ V = [] ∧ W₂ F = []
      simp [W₂, W₁, W₀, hVN.symm, hVF.symm, hNF.symm])
    (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws]; rfl, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
  have h₄ : TransformsTapes ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb N)) (fun _ ws => ws = W₃)
      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V next ∧ em = [])
      (3 * (next.length + 1)) (next.length + 1 + K) :=
    (transformsTapes_clearWork_tapeEmb N next).imp
      (fun _ _ h => by simp [h, W₃, W₂, W₁, hVN.symm])
      (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws, hW₄], he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
  refine (h₀.seq_eq (h₁.seq_eq (h₂.seq_eq (h₃.seq_eq h₄)))).imp (fun _ _ h => h)
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨h, by simp [he]⟩) le_rfl le_rfl

public theorem transformsTapesAt_streamLoop_after (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F)
    (pre : List Bool) (toks : List (List Bool)) (htoks : ∀ t ∈ toks, t ≠ [])
    (cont vs es : ℕ → List Bool) {sR : ℕ} {tE sE tN sN : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hread : ∀ j (hj : j < toks.length),
      r.read r.q₀ (toks.flatten.drop ((toks.take j).flatten).length) = (cont j, toks[j].length))
    (hE : ∀ j < toks.length, TransformsTapes E
      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs j ++ cont j))
      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = es j) (tE j) (sE j))
    (hN : ∀ j < toks.length, TransformsTapes Nm
      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs j ++ cont j))
      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws N (vs (j + 1)) ∧ em = []) (tN j) (sN j))
    (hsR : ∀ j < toks.length, (vs j ++ cont j).length + 2 + (K - 1) +
        (sE j + (sN j + (((vs j ++ cont j).length + 1 + K) + ((4 * (vs (j + 1)).length + K + 15) +
          ((vs (j + 1)).length + 1 + K))))) ≤ sR) :
    TransformsTapesAt (whileInput (streamRound r E Nm V N F hVN hVF hNF))
      (fun input p ws => input = pre ++ toks.flatten ∧ p.val = 1 + pre.length ∧
        ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs 0))
      (fun input _ _ p' ws' em => input = pre ++ toks.flatten ∧
        p'.val = 1 + (pre ++ toks.flatten).length ∧
        ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs toks.length) ∧
        em = ((List.range toks.length).map es).flatten)
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range toks.length, (streamRoundTime toks cont vs tE tN j + 1) + 1)
      (2 * K * sR + K) := by
  set x := pre ++ toks.flatten with hx
  let L (j : ℕ) : ℕ := pre.length + ((toks.take j).flatten).length
  have hpos (j : ℕ) : 1 + L j < x.length + 2 := by
    have := streamPos_lt toks j
    simp only [x, L, List.length_append]
    omega
  let P (n : ℕ) (input : List Bool) (p : Fin (input.length + 2)) (ws : Fin K → List Bool)
      (em : List Bool) : Prop :=
    input = x ∧ p.val = 1 + L n ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs n) ∧
      em = ((List.range n).map es).flatten
  have hround : ∀ n < toks.length, ∀ acc, TransformsTapesAt (streamRound r E Nm V N F hVN hVF hNF)
      (fun input p ws => P n input p ws acc)
      (fun input _ _ p' ws' e => P (n + 1) input p' ws' (acc ++ e))
      (streamRoundTime toks cont vs tE tN n) sR := by
    intro n hn acc
    let p₀ : Fin (x.length + 2) := ⟨1 + L n, hpos n⟩
    have hrd : r.read r.q₀ (x.drop (p₀.val - 1)) = (cont n, toks[n].length) := by
      have hdrop : x.drop (p₀.val - 1) = toks.flatten.drop ((toks.take n).flatten).length := by
        simp only [p₀, L, hx, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
        rw [← List.drop_drop, List.drop_left]
      rw [hdrop]
      exact hread n hn
    have h := transformsTapesAt_streamRound (r := r) hVN hVF hNF x p₀ (by simp [p₀]) (vs n)
      (hE := by rw [hrd]; exact hE n hn) (hN := by rw [hrd]; exact hN n hn)

public theorem computesTidily_streamTM_after (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F)

      (fun _ _ _ p' ws' e => p'.val = 1 + pre.length ∧
        ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V v₀ ∧ e = []) tI sI)
    (hloop : TransformsTapesAt (whileInput (streamRound r E Nm V N F hVN hVF hNF))
      (fun input p ws => input = x ∧ p.val = 1 + pre.length ∧
        ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V v₀)
      (fun input _ _ p' ws' e => input = x ∧ p'.val = 1 + x.length ∧
        ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V v₁ ∧ e = em) tLoop sLoop)
    (hF : TransformsTapes Fm (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V v₁)
      (fun _ ws ws' e => ws' = ws ∧ e = ef) tF sF) :
    (streamTM r I E Nm Fm V N F hVN hVF hNF).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x (em ++ ef)

      (sI + (sLoop + ((sF + (v₁.length + 1 + K)) + K))) := by
  have hI' := hI.imp
    (Q' := fun input _ _ p' ws' e => input = x ∧ p'.val = 1 + pre.length ∧
      ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V v₀ ∧ e = [])
    (fun _ _ _ h => h) (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨hin, _, _⟩ h => ⟨hin, h⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
  have hF' := hF.imp
    (Q' := fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V v₁ ∧ e = ef)
    (fun _ _ h => h)
    (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨h.trans hws, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
  have hclear : TransformsTapes ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb V))
      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V v₁)
      (fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = (fun _ => []) ∧ e = [])
      (3 * (v₁.length + 1)) (v₁.length + 1 + K) :=
    (transformsTapes_clearWork_tapeEmb V v₁).imp (fun _ _ h => by simp [h])
      (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws]; simp, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl

        exact ⟨hin, rfl, hws, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl

  refine (hall.transformsTapes (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ h => Fin.ext h.2.1)).imp
    (fun _ _ ⟨hin, hws⟩ => ⟨hin, rfl, hws⟩)

public theorem computableTidilyInDegree_add :

  let encS := encPair encBool (encPair encBits encBits)

      (encPair encS encBool) encS 1 1 := by
    have hs := fst encS encBool
    have hr := hs.snd'.fst'
    have habc := (snd encS encBool).prod (((headD (enc₁ := encBool) false).comp hr).prod hs.fst')
    have hcarry := (of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool (encPair encBool encBool))
      (encMid := encBool) fun t : Bool × Bool × Bool => carry t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).comp habc
    have hdigit := (of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool (encPair encBool encBool))
      (encMid := encBool) fun t : Bool × Bool × Bool => t.1 ^^ (t.2.1 ^^ t.2.2)).comp habc
    exact (hcarry.prod ((tail (enc₁ := encBool)).comp hr |>.prod
      (hs.snd'.snd'.append hdigit (encOut := encBits) fun _ => rfl))).mono
  have hsize : DegreeBounded (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (encPair encNat encNat p).length)
      (fun p => 2 * (encPair encNat encNat p).length + 4) 1 :=
    (DegreeBounded.self.smul 2).add_const 4
  -- the first fold, over the digits of the first summand
  have hfold := foldl' (encL := encBits) (encB := encS)
    (list := fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1.bits) (init := fun p => (false, p.2.bits, []))
    (of_eq (encIn := encNat) (encMid := encBits) (f := Nat.bits) (fun _ => rfl) |>.comp
      (fst encNat encNat))
    ((const false).prod ((of_eq (encIn := encNat) (encMid := encBits) (f := Nat.bits)
      (fun _ => rfl) |>.comp (snd encNat encNat)).prod (const [])))
    hstep hsize ?_
  rotate_left
  · intro p i hi
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := length_foldl_addStep (p.1.bits.take i) (false, p.2.bits, [])
    simp only [encS, length_encPair, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton, encBits_apply,
      encNat_apply, List.length_take, List.length_nil] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    omega

  have hfin : ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun s : Bool × List Bool × List Bool =>
      succFinish (s.2.1.foldl succStep (s.1, s.2.2))) encS encBits 2 1 := by
    have hs := of_eq (encIn := encS) (encMid := encS) (f := id) fun _ => rfl

      (of_linear linear_succStep) (B := fun s => (encS s).length + 3)
      (DegreeBounded.self.add_const 3) fun s i hi => ?_)).mono
    simp only [length_foldl_succStep, encS, length_encPair, encBool_apply, id_eq,
      List.length_singleton, encBits_apply, List.length_take]
    omega
  refine ((hfin.comp hfold).of_enc_eq fun p => ?_).mono
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, encBits_apply, encNat_apply]
  rw [succFinish_foldl, ← foldl_addStep, List.nil_append, addBits_bits]
  rfl

    {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {encC : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {value : α → Option β} {fallback : α → γ} {body : α → β → γ}
    {Tv Sv Tnone Snone : α → ℕ} {Tbody Sbody : α × β → ℕ}
    (hvalue : ComputableTidilyInO value encA (encOption encB) Tv Sv)
    (hfallback : ComputableTidilyInO fallback encA encC Tnone Snone)
    (hbody : ComputableTidilyInO (fun p : α × β => body p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encA encB) encC Tbody Sbody) :
    ComputableTidilyInO (fun a => (value a).elim (fallback a) (body a)) encA encC
      (fun a => 2 * Tv a + (encA a).length +
        (value a).elim (Tnone a) (fun b => Tbody (a, b)))
      (fun a => 2 * Sv a + (encA a).length +
        (value a).elim (Snone a) (fun b => Sbody (a, b))) := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty β with h | h
  · have hv : ∀ a, value a = none := by
      intro a
      cases value a with
      | none => rfl

    simpa only [hv, Option.elim_none] using hfallback.mono_le
      (T' := fun a => 2 * Tv a + (encA a).length + Tnone a)
      (S' := fun a => 2 * Sv a + (encA a).length + Snone a)
      (fun _ => by omega) (fun _ => by omega)

    have hget := (ComputableTidilyInDegree.optionGetD encB b).inO_one.comp_linear hvalue
    have htag := (ComputableTidilyInDegree.isSome (enc := encB)).inO_one.comp_linear hvalue
    have hid : ComputableTidilyInO (fun a : α => a) encA encA
        (fun a => (encA a).length) (fun a => (encA a).length) :=
      (ComputableTidilyInDegree.id').inO_one
    have h := htag.ite (hbody.comp (hid.prod hget)) hfallback
    have h' := h.mono_le
      (T' := fun a => 2 * Tv a + (encA a).length +
        (value a).elim (Tnone a) (fun b => Tbody (a, b)))
      (S' := fun a => 2 * Sv a + (encA a).length +
        (value a).elim (Snone a) (fun b => Sbody (a, b)))

        cases hv : value a <;>

        cases hv : value a <;>

    (hstate : ∀ x, ∀ k ≤ n x, (encB (step^[k] (init x))).length ≤ B x) :

    · refine ⟨?_, fun m hm => ?_⟩
      · simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', iterate_countStep step t b le_rfl, Nat.sub_self]
        rfl

        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some, not_le] at hm hlt

    (enc := encOption (encPair encNat encB))).inO_one.comp_linear (hn.prod hinit)

  obtain ⟨c₁, h⟩ := hit.comp_linear h₀

    iterate_countStep step _ _ hk

    (hc : ComputableTidilyInDegree c encIn encC dc ec)
    (hf : ComputableTidilyInDegree (f ∘ Subtype.val)
      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = true)).trans encIn) encMid d₁ e₁)

      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = false)).trans encIn) encMid d₂ e₂) :

      (max dc (max d₁ d₂)) (max e₁ e₂) := by

  obtain ⟨⟨tf, sf, ⟨ctf, htf⟩, ⟨csf, hsf⟩, h₁⟩, ⟨clf, hlf⟩⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨⟨tg, sg, ⟨ctg, htg⟩, ⟨csg, hsg⟩, h₂⟩, ⟨clg, hlg⟩⟩ := hg

    (h₂.mono (fun x => by simp [ext, x.2]) (fun x => by simp [ext, x.2]))

    {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {encL : List α ↪ List Bool}
    [ListEncoding encA encL] [hS : SizedListEncoding encA encL]
    {list : γ → List α} {init : γ → β} {step : β → α → β} {dL eL dI eI dS eS b : ℕ}
    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInDegree list encIn encL dL eL)
    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInDegree init encIn encB dI eI)
    (hstep : ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : β × α => step p.1 p.2) (encPair encB encA) encB
      dS eS)

    (hstates : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ (list x).length,
      (encB (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x))).length ≤ B x) :
    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun x => (list x).foldl step (init x)) encIn encB
      (max (max dL dI) (eL + max 1 dS * max b eL)) b := by
  obtain ⟨⟨t₁, s₁, ht₁, hs₁, h₁⟩, hl⟩ := hlist
  obtain ⟨⟨t₂, s₂, ht₂, hs₂, h₂⟩, -⟩ := hinit
  obtain ⟨⟨tS, sS, ⟨ct, htS⟩, ⟨cs, hsS⟩, hS'⟩, -⟩ := hstep
  set a := max b eL
  set D := max 1 dS * a
  -- the arguments of a round and the states with the rest of the list
  have haMax : DegreeBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length)
      (fun x => 2 * B x + 1 + (encL (list x)).length) a :=
    ((hB.smul 2).add_const 1).add_max hl
  have hlMax : DegreeBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length)
      (fun x => 2 * (encL (list x)).length + 1 + B x) a :=
    ((hl.mono_deg (le_max_right _ _)).smul 2 |>.add_const 1).add (hB.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _))
  have hround {c : ℕ} : DegreeBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length)
      (fun x => c * (2 * B x + 1 + (encL (list x)).length + 1) ^ dS) D :=
    (DegreeBounded.comp (size' := id) (v := fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ dS) ⟨c, fun _ => le_rfl⟩
      haMax).mono_deg (by rw [Nat.mul_comm]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (le_max_right _ _))
  have hargs : ∀ x i (hi : i < (list x).length),
      (encPair encB encA (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x), (list x)[i])).length ≤
        2 * B x + 1 + (encL (list x)).length := fun x i hi => by
    have h₁ := hstates x i hi.le
    have h₂ := hS.length_elem_le (list x) _ (List.getElem_mem hi)
    simp only [length_encPair]
    omega
  have hrest : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ (list x).length,
      (encPair encL encB ((list x).drop i, ((list x).take i).foldl step (init x))).length ≤
        2 * (encL (list x)).length + 1 + B x := fun x i hi => by
    have h₁ := hstates x i hi
    have h₂ := hS.length_drop_le (list x) i
    simp only [length_encPair]
    omega
  have haD : a ≤ D := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_pos (le_max_left _ _))
  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.foldl (encA := encA) (encL := encL)
    (encBA := encPair encB encA) (encS := encPair encL encB)
    (encO := encOption (encPair encL encB))

      (fun _ => Nat.le_add_right _ _) (fun _ => Nat.le_add_right _ _))
    (h₂.mono (fun _ => Nat.le_add_left _ _) (fun _ => Nat.le_add_left _ _)) hS'
    (tMax := fun x => ct * (2 * B x + 1 + (encL (list x)).length + 1) ^ dS)
    (sMax := fun x => cs * (2 * B x + 1 + (encL (list x)).length + 1) ^ dS)
    (lMax := fun x => 2 * (encL (list x)).length + 1 + B x)

      (Nat.add_le_add_right (hargs x i hi) 1) dS)))
    (fun x i hi => (hsS _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs (Nat.pow_le_pow_left
      (Nat.add_le_add_right (hargs x i hi) 1) dS))) hrest
  · have hd₀ : max dL dI ≤ max (max dL dI) (eL + D) := le_max_left _ _
    have hd₁ : eL + D ≤ max (max dL dI) (eL + D) := le_max_right _ _

      1)).mono_deg hd₁)).smul c, ((((hs.mono_deg hd₀).add (hround.mono_deg (by omega))).add

      (encOption enc) (max (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 dt * max 1 eP)) 1 := by

  have hel := snd (encPair encP (encOption enc)) enc
  have hisSome := (of_finite (encIn := encBool) (encMid := encBool) (fun b : Bool => !b)).comp

      (f := fun o : Option α => o.isNone) fun o => by cases o <;> simp)).comp hq.snd')

public theorem mapWith {β : Type} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {f : π × α → β} {par : γ → π}
    {list : γ → List α} {df ef : ℕ} (hf : ComputableTidilyInDegree f (encPair encP enc) encB df ef)
    (hpar : ComputableTidilyInDegree par encIn encP dP 1)
    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInDegree list encIn (encList enc) dL 1) :
    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun x => (list x).map fun a => f (par x, a)) encIn
      (encList encB) (max (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 (max df ef) * (ef + 1))) (ef + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨c, hcd⟩ := hf.2
  -- a bound on the encoded images of the elements
  set S : γ → ℕ := fun x => 2 * (encP (par x)).length + 1 + (encList enc (list x)).length
  have hS : DegreeBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) S 1 :=
    ((hpar.2.smul 2).add_const 1).add hlist.2
  have himg (x : γ) (a : α) (ha : a ∈ list x) : (encB (f (par x, a))).length ≤ c * (S x + 1) ^ ef :=
    (hcd _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by
      have := length_le_encList_of_mem enc ha
      simp only [length_encPair, S]
      omega) ef))
  have hq := fst (encPair encP (encList encB)) enc
  have hel := snd (encPair encP (encList encB)) enc
  have hfold := foldlWith (encL := encList enc) (encB := encList encB) hpar hlist
    (const []) (step := mapStep f) ((snoc encB).comp (hq.snd'.prod (hf.comp (hq.fst'.prod hel))))
    (B := fun x => (encList enc (list x)).length * (2 * (c * (S x + 1) ^ ef) + 1))
    (hlist.2.mul (((DegreeBounded.comp (size' := id) (v := fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ ef)
      ⟨c, fun _ => le_rfl⟩ hS).smul 2).add_const 1))
    (fun x i hi => by
      rw [foldl_mapStep, List.nil_append]
      refine (length_encList_le encB _ (b := c * (S x + 1) ^ ef) fun b hb => ?_).trans ?_
      · obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hb
        exact himg x a (List.mem_of_mem_take ha)
      · refine Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ?_
        have := length_le_length_encList enc (list x)
        simp only [List.length_map, List.length_take]
        omega)
  simp only [max_self, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_one] at hfold
  convert hfold.mono (d' := max (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 (max df ef) * (ef + 1))) (e' := ef + 1)
    (max_le (by have := le_max_right (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 (max df ef) * (ef + 1)); omega)
      (le_max_of_le_right (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)) 1)))
    (by omega) using 1
  funext x
  rw [foldl_mapStep, List.nil_append]

theorem haltsAt_le_card [Fintype Symbol] [Fintype State] {s u : ℕ}
    (hs : tm.RunsInSpace input s) (hu : tm.HaltsAt (tm.initCfg input) u) :
    u ≤ (input.length + 2) * storageBound Symbol State k s := by
  classical
  let core := fun t => (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).core
  -- a core repeated before halting would repeat at the halting step
  have hne : ∀ i j, i < j → j < u → core i ≠ core j := by
    intro i j hij hj hcore
    have hshift := core_runFrom_eq_of_core_eq (tm := tm) hcore (u - j)
    rw [← runFrom_add, ← runFrom_add, show j + (u - j) = u by omega] at hshift
    have hstate := congrArg (fun c => c.2.state) hshift
    exact hu.not_halted (show i + (u - j) < u by omega) (hstate.trans hu.halted)
  have hinj : Set.InjOn core (Finset.range u : Set ℕ) := by
    intro i hi j hj hcore
    simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio] at hi hj
    rcases lt_trichotomy i j with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exact absurd hcore (hne i j hlt hj)
    · exact heq
    · exact absurd hcore.symm (hne j i hgt hi)
  have hsub : (((Finset.range u).image core : Finset _) : Set _).encard ≤
      (Set.range core).encard := Set.encard_le_encard fun _ hx => by
    obtain ⟨t, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_coe.mp hx |> Finset.mem_image.mp
    exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
  rw [Set.encard_coe_eq_coe_finsetCard, Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj,
    Finset.card_range] at hsub
  exact_mod_cast hsub.trans (tm.encard_cores_le (RunsInSpace.space_le hs))

private theorem card_le_of_log (State : Type*) [Fintype State] (k c : ℕ) :
    ∃ A d, ∀ n, (n + 2) * storageBound Bool State k (c * (Nat.log2 n + 1)) ≤ A * (n + 1) ^ d := by
  refine ⟨2 * storageBoundBase Bool State k * 2 ^ (storageBoundExp Bool k * c),
    storageBoundExp Bool k * c + 1, fun n => ?_⟩
  set e := storageBoundExp Bool k * c
  have hpow : 2 ^ (storageBoundExp Bool k * (c * (Nat.log2 n + 1))) ≤ 2 ^ e * (n + 1) ^ e :=
    calc 2 ^ (storageBoundExp Bool k * (c * (Nat.log2 n + 1))) = (2 ^ (Nat.log2 n + 1)) ^ e := by
          rw [← pow_mul]
          congr 1
          simp only [e]
          ring
      _ ≤ (2 * (n + 1)) ^ e := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.two_pow_log2_succ_le n) e
      _ = 2 ^ e * (n + 1) ^ e := mul_pow ..
  calc (n + 2) * storageBound Bool State k (c * (Nat.log2 n + 1))
      ≤ (2 * (n + 1)) * (storageBoundBase Bool State k * (2 ^ e * (n + 1) ^ e)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) ((storageBound_le_base_mul_pow _).trans
          (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hpow))
    _ = _ := by ring

private theorem stack_bound (c n : ℕ) :
    3 ^ (4 * (c * (Nat.log2 n + 1)) + 1) ≤ radix (radixExponent State c) n := by
  have hlog : 2 ^ (Nat.log2 n + 1) ≤ (n + 2) ^ 2 :=
    (Nat.two_pow_log2_succ_le n).trans (by nlinarith)
  calc
    3 ^ (4 * (c * (Nat.log2 n + 1)) + 1)
      ≤ 4 ^ (4 * (c * (Nat.log2 n + 1)) + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _
    _ = 2 ^ (8 * (c * (Nat.log2 n + 1)) + 2) := by
      rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 2 by decide, ← pow_mul]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ ((8 * c + 2) * (Nat.log2 n + 1)) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by nlinarith)
    _ = (2 ^ (Nat.log2 n + 1)) ^ (8 * c + 2) := by rw [← pow_mul]; congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ ((n + 2) ^ 2) ^ (8 * c + 2) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hlog _
    _ ≤ radix (radixExponent State c) n := by
      rw [← pow_mul]
      exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by simp only [radixExponent]; omega)

  have hD : 2 ≤ radixExponent State c := by simp only [radixExponent]; omega
  have hbase : w.length + 2 ≤ radix (radixExponent State c) w.length := by
    calc
      w.length + 2 = (w.length + 2) ^ 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ (w.length + 2) ^ radixExponent State c := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
  have hthree : 3 < radix (radixExponent State c) w.length := by
    have hp := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (show 2 ≤ w.length + 2 by omega) 2
    have he := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 1 ≤ w.length + 2 by omega) hD

    (hin : (fun a => (enc a).length) ≼ S) (act : Action k Bool State) (i : Register k) :

    | neg => simpa only [nextRegisters, hm, inputMove] using budget_natPred (hr .inputPos)
    | zero => simpa only [nextRegisters, hm, inputMove] using hr .inputPos

        simp only [nextRegisters, hm, inputMove, decide_eq_true_eq]
        congr 1

      cases (act.workTapes i).1 with

private theorem halted_replay_unchecked {J₀ : ℕ}
    (hJ₀ : Closed ntm (roundRadix State input.length J₀) input) :
    ∀ m j, J₀ - j = m → ∀ (c : Cslib.InductiveCounting.State) (choices : List Bool),
      RuntimeInvariant ntm input
        ⟨input.length, roundRadix State input.length j, false, some c⟩ →
      Cslib.InductiveCounting.rank (vertexBound (k := k) (roundRadix State input.length j))
          (guessWidth k (roundRadix State input.length j)) c + 1 +
          roundBudget k State J₀ input.length +
          m * (roundBudget k State J₀ input.length + 1) ≤ choices.length →
      (queryMachine ntm).halted ((queryMachine ntm).replay input choices
        ⟨input.length, roundRadix State input.length j, false, some c⟩) = true := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => ?_
  | succ m ihm => ?_
  all_goals
    intro j hm c
    induction hr : Cslib.InductiveCounting.rank (vertexBound (k := k)
      (roundRadix State input.length j)) (guessWidth k (roundRadix State input.length j)) c
      using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing c with
    | _ r ih =>
    intro choices hinv hlen
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨j', hj', hjs⟩, hi, hb, -⟩ := hinv
    have hjj : j = j' := by
      by_contra hne
      rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
      · have := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
          (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega : 1 < 4) h)
          (by have := card_lt_startRadix (State := State) input.length; omega :
            0 < startRadix State input.length)
        simp only [roundRadix] at hj'
        omega
      · have := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
          (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega : 1 < 4) h)
          (by have := card_lt_startRadix (State := State) input.length; omega :
            0 < startRadix State input.length)
        simp only [roundRadix] at hj'
        omega
    subst hjj
    have hjJ := round_le hJ₀ hjs
    rcases choices with _ | ⟨b, rest⟩
    · simp at hlen
    by_cases hh : (queryMachine ntm).halted
        ⟨input.length, roundRadix State input.length j, false, some c⟩ = true
    · rw [NondeterministicQueryMachine.replay_of_halted _ _ hh]
      exact hh
    have hinv : RuntimeInvariant ntm input
        ⟨input.length, roundRadix State input.length j, false, some c⟩ :=
      ⟨rfl, ⟨j, rfl, hjs⟩, hi, hb, by simp⟩
    obtain ⟨hnr, -⟩ := not_halted_counting (Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hh)
    have hinv' := runtimeInvariant_step hinv b
    rw [NondeterministicQueryMachine.replay_cons]
    simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
    by_cases ho : overflowed c = true
    · rw [step_overflowed ntm input ho, ← roundRadix_succ]
      rw [step_overflowed ntm input ho, ← roundRadix_succ] at hinv'
      have hncl := not_closed_of_overflowed (card_lt_roundRadix _ _)
        (by simpa only [graphBad, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] using hi) ho
      have hjJ' : j < J₀ := by
        by_contra h
        exact hncl (hJ₀.mono (card_lt_roundRadix _ _) (roundRadix_mono _ (by omega)))
      first
      | omega
      | exact ihm (j + 1) (by omega) _ rest hinv' (by
          have := rank_install_le (ntm := ntm) (State := State) (n := input.length)
            (show j + 1 ≤ J₀ by omega)
          nlinarith)
    by_cases ha : c.phase = .accept
    · rw [step_switch ntm input ha]
      refine halted_replay_checked rest ?_
      have := rank_install_le (ntm := ntm) (State := State) (n := input.length) hjJ
      nlinarith
    · rw [step_counting ntm input (by simp [ho]) (by simp [ha])]
      rw [step_counting ntm input (by simp [ho]) (by simp [ha])] at hinv'
      have hc : Cslib.InductiveCounting.halted c = false := by
        simp [Cslib.InductiveCounting.halted, ha, hnr]
      have hlt := Cslib.InductiveCounting.rank_advance_lt (N := vertexBound (k := k)
        (roundRadix State input.length j)) (width := guessWidth k (roundRadix State input.length j))
        (source := startID ntm (roundRadix State input.length j))
        (Cslib.InductiveCounting.answer (graphEdge ntm (roundRadix State input.length j) input)
          (graphBad ntm input (roundRadix State input.length j) false) c) b hc
      have hlt' : Cslib.InductiveCounting.rank (vertexBound (k := k)
          (roundRadix State input.length j)) (guessWidth k (roundRadix State input.length j))
          (ctlStep ntm input (roundRadix State input.length j) false c b) < r := hr ▸ hlt
      exact ih _ hlt' _ rfl rest hinv' (by omega)

theorem length_runtime_le {J₀ : ℕ} (hJ₀ : Closed ntm (roundRadix State input.length J₀) input)

    length_encNat_le_log2 hl

  · obtain ⟨hl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    change (encPair encNat (encPair encNat (encPair encBool (encOption encState)))
      (l, 0, false, none)).length ≤ _
    simp only [length_encPair, encOption_none, List.length_nil, encBool_apply,
      List.length_singleton]
    have := hlen l hl
    simp only [storageBound]
    have : (encNat 0).length = 0 := rfl
    nlinarith
  · obtain ⟨rfl, ⟨j, rfl, hjs⟩, -, hb, -⟩ := h
    have hjJ := round_le hJ₀ hjs
    have hB : roundRadix State input.length j ≤ 2 ^ E :=
      (roundRadix_le_two_pow input.length j).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
    have hBpos : 0 < roundRadix State input.length j := by
      have := card_lt_roundRadix (State := State) input.length j
      omega

    have hN : N ≤ 2 ^ (E * Fintype.card (Register k)) := by
      change roundRadix State input.length j ^ Fintype.card (Register k) ≤ _
      rw [pow_mul]

    have hNpos : 1 ≤ N := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero _ (by omega))
    have hreg : Cslib.InductiveCounting.registerBound N (guessWidth k
        (roundRadix State input.length j)) ≤ 2 ^ (E * Fintype.card (Register k) + 3) := by
      have hsize := Nat.size_le.mpr (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := N))
      have hpow := two_pow_size_le N
      unfold Cslib.InductiveCounting.registerBound guessWidth
      have hs : N.size ≤ N := Nat.size_le.mpr Nat.lt_two_pow_self
      rw [pow_add]
      change N + 2 ^ N.size + N.size + 2 ≤ _

      (input.length, roundRadix State input.length j, chk, some c)).length ≤ _
    simp only [length_encPair, encOption_some, List.length_cons, encBool_apply,
      List.length_nil]

    simp only [storageBound]
    simp only [E] at hstate hradix

theorem accepts_iff (a : α) : R.machine.Accepts (enc a) ↔ M.Accepts (enc a) := by
  obtain ⟨tI, hI⟩ := R.initial_spec a
  obtain ⟨ws, e, ⟨hws, he⟩, q₀, hqhead, hqlast, _, _⟩ :=
    hI _ _ [] ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hhead', hlast', _, _⟩ := q₀.exists_running (by rw [hqlast]; rfl)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hhalt, hout⟩
    have hmap : p.head = q.head.mapState Native.initState := by
      rw [p.head_eq, hhead', hqhead, mapState_wordsCfg]
      change Cfg.init (.init R.I.q₀ : Native.State R.SI R.SP R.SF) (enc a) = _
      simp [Native.initState, wordsCfg]
    have hlong : q.length < p.length + 1 := by
      by_contra hshort
      have h := Native.follows_init R.I R.P R.F R.C p.toRunPath q hmap p.length
        (Nat.lt_succ_self _) (by omega)
      change p.last = (q ⟨p.length, by omega⟩).mapState Native.initState at h
      have hh := h ▸ hhalt
      change some _ = none at hh
      cases hh
    have hcfg : p.toRunPath ⟨q.length, hlong⟩ =
        wordsCfg (enc a) (some .choose) (R.boundary M.init false) [] := by
      have h := Native.follows_init R.I R.P R.F R.C p.toRunPath q hmap q.length hlong
        (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
      change p.toRunPath ⟨q.length, hlong⟩ = q.last.mapState Native.initState at h
      simpa [hlast', hqlast, Native.initState, hws, he] using h
    obtain ⟨s, ⟨choices, hchoices⟩, hhalt', hout'⟩ :=
      R.choose_output a (p.toRunPath.drop ⟨q.length, hlong⟩) M.init
        (M.reachable_init _) false [] (by simpa using hcfg) (by simpa using hhalt)
    refine ⟨choices, hchoices ▸ hhalt', ?_⟩
    have hbit : [M.accept s] = [true] := by simpa [hout] using hout'.symm
    rw [hchoices]
    exact List.head_eq_of_cons_eq hbit
  · rintro ⟨choices, hhalt, haccept⟩
    let p := q.map (Native.initHom R.I R.P R.F R.C)
    have hphead : p.head = R.machine.initCfg (enc a) := by
      change (q.map (Native.initHom R.I R.P R.F R.C)).head =
        Cfg.init (.init R.I.q₀ : Native.State R.SI R.SP R.SF) (enc a)
      rw [RelSeries.head_map]
      simp [hhead', hqhead, Native.initState, wordsCfg, Cfg.mapState]
    have hplast : p.last =
        wordsCfg (enc a) (some .choose) (R.boundary M.init false) [] := by
      simp [p, hlast', hqlast, Native.initState, hws, he]
    obtain ⟨p', hp'head, hp'halt, hp'out⟩ :=
      R.choose_realizes a choices M.init (M.reachable_init _) hhalt false []
    change M.accept (M.replay (enc a) choices M.init) = true at haccept
    let p'' := p.smash p' (hplast.trans hp'head.symm)
    exact ⟨⟨p'', by simpa [p''] using hphead⟩,

theorem exists_decidesInSpace {α σ : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {encS : σ ↪ List Bool}
    (M : NondeterministicQueryMachine σ)
    (hquery : ComputableTidilyInSpace M.query encS encNat fun s => (encS s).length)
    (hnext : ComputableTidilyInSpace M.next
      (encPair encS (encPair (encOption encBool) encBool)) encS
      fun p => (encPair encS (encPair (encOption encBool) encBool) p).length)
    (hhalted : ComputableTidilyInSpace M.halted encS encBool fun s => (encS s).length)
    (haccept : ComputableTidilyInSpace M.accept encS encBool fun s => (encS s).length)
    (time : α → ℕ) (hhalt : ∀ a, M.HaltsWithin (enc a) (time a))
    {A : Set α} (hcorrect : ∀ a, a ∈ A ↔ M.Accepts (enc a))
    (S : α → ℕ) (hlog : ∀ a, Nat.log2 (enc a).length + 1 ≤ S a)
    (hsize : ∃ c, ∀ a choices, (encS (M.run (enc a) choices)).length ≤ c * S a) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (State : Type) (_ : Finite State) (ntm : MultiTapeNTM k Bool State) (c : ℕ),
      ntm.DecidesInSpace enc A (fun a => c * S a) := by
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := M.exists_routines hquery hnext hhalted haccept S hlog hsize
  let : Finite R.SI := R.finiteI
  let : ∀ b, Finite (R.SP b) := R.finiteP
  let : Finite R.SF := R.finiteF
  refine ⟨R.k, Native.State R.SI R.SP R.SF, inferInstance, R.machine,
    R.k * (2 * R.c + 1), ⟨fun a => ?_, fun a => R.exists_runsInTime a (hhalt a)⟩⟩
  refine ⟨(R.runsInSpace a).mono ?_, (hcorrect a).trans (R.accepts_iff a).symm⟩
  have hS : 1 ≤ S a := (Nat.le_add_left _ _).trans (hlog a)
  calc
    R.k * (2 * (R.c * S a) + 1) ≤ R.k * ((2 * R.c + 1) * S a) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by nlinarith only [hS])
    _ = R.k * (2 * R.c + 1) * S a := by ring

  have hpn' (b : Bool) := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear hfr (hPN₁ b)

theorem passNext_inSpace
    (hquery : ComputableTidilyInSpace M'.query encS' encNat fun s => (encS' s).length) :
    ComputableTidilyInSpace (passNext M') (encPair (encPass encS') encBool) (encPass encS')
      fun p => (encPair (encPass encS') encBool p).length := by
  have hq1 : ComputableTidilyInSpace (fun p : PassState σ' × Bool => p.1)
      (encPair (encPass encS') encBool) (encPass encS')
      fun p => (encPair (encPass encS') encBool p).length := fst _ _
  have hs : ComputableTidilyInSpace (fun p : PassState σ' × Bool => p.1.1)
      (encPair (encPass encS') encBool) encS'
      fun p => (encPair (encPass encS') encBool p).length :=
    budget_comp_lin (fst _ _) (.refl _) hq1
  have hrest : ComputableTidilyInSpace (fun p : PassState σ' × Bool => p.1.2)
      (encPair (encPass encS') encBool) (encPair encNat (encOption encBool))
      fun p => (encPair (encPass encS') encBool p).length :=
    budget_comp_lin (snd _ _) (.refl _) hq1
  have hpos : ComputableTidilyInSpace (fun p : PassState σ' × Bool => p.1.2.1)
      (encPair (encPass encS') encBool) encNat
      fun p => (encPair (encPass encS') encBool p).length :=
    budget_comp_lin (fst _ _) (.refl _) hrest
  have hfd : ComputableTidilyInSpace (fun p : PassState σ' × Bool => p.1.2.2)
      (encPair (encPass encS') encBool) (encOption encBool)
      fun p => (encPair (encPass encS') encBool p).length :=
    budget_comp_lin (snd _ _) (.refl _) hrest
  have hb : ComputableTidilyInSpace (fun p : PassState σ' × Bool => p.2)
      (encPair (encPass encS') encBool) encBool
      fun p => (encPair (encPass encS') encBool p).length := snd _ _
  have hsucc : ComputableTidilyInSpace (fun p : PassState σ' × Bool => p.1.2.1 + 1)
      (encPair (encPass encS') encBool) encNat
      fun p => (encPair (encPass encS') encBool p).length :=
    budget_comp_lin natSucc linear_succ hpos
  have hlenS : (fun p : PassState σ' × Bool => (encS' p.1.1).length) ≼
      fun p => (encPair (encPass encS') encBool p).length :=
    .of_le fun p => by simp only [length_encPair]; omega
  have hqs : ComputableTidilyInSpace (fun p : PassState σ' × Bool => M'.query p.1.1)
      (encPair (encPass encS') encBool) encNat
      fun p => (encPair (encPass encS') encBool p).length :=
    budget_comp hquery hs hlenS
  have heq : ComputableTidilyInSpace
      (fun p : PassState σ' × Bool => decide (p.1.2.1 = M'.query p.1.1))
      (encPair (encPass encS') encBool) encBool
      fun p => (encPair (encPass encS') encBool p).length :=
    budget_comp natEq (budget_prod hpos hqs)
      (((hpos.prod hqs).length_le).trans (.add (.refl _) (.refl _)))
  have hsome : ComputableTidilyInSpace (fun p : PassState σ' × Bool => some p.2)
      (encPair (encPass encS') encBool) (encOption encBool)
      fun p => (encPair (encPass encS') encBool p).length :=
    budget_comp_lin (of_inO (.of_linear (Internal.NormalForm.linear OptionEncoding.some)))
      (.refl _) hb
  exact budget_prod hs (budget_prod hsucc (budget_ite heq hsome hfd))
