theorem computableInSpace {α β : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {encOut : β ↪ List Bool}
    {σ : Type} {encS : σ ↪ List Bool} (M : QueryMachine σ)
    (hquery : ComputableTidilyInSpace M.query encS encNat fun s => (encS s).length)
    (hnext : ComputableTidilyInSpace M.next (encPair encS (encOption encBool)) encS
      fun p => (encPair encS (encOption encBool) p).length)
    (hemit : ComputableTidilyInSpace M.emit (encPair encS (encOption encBool)) encBits
      fun p => (encPair encS (encOption encBool) p).length)
    (hhalted : ComputableTidilyInSpace M.halted encS encBool fun s => (encS s).length)
    (hfinish : ComputableTidilyInSpace M.finish encS encBits fun s => (encS s).length)
    {f : α → β} (time : α → ℕ)
    (hhalt : ∀ a, M.halted (M.run (enc a) (time a)) = true)
    (hpre : ∀ a, ∀ t < time a, M.halted (M.run (enc a) t) = false)
    (hf : ∀ a, encOut (f a) = M.output (enc a) (time a))
    (S : α → ℕ) (hlog : ∀ a, Nat.log2 (enc a).length + 1 ≤ S a)
    (hsize : ∃ c, ∀ a, ∀ t ≤ time a, (encS (M.run (enc a) t)).length ≤ c * S a) :
    ∃ t c, ComputableInTimeAndSpace f enc encOut t fun a => c * S a := by
  obtain ⟨cS, hS⟩ := hsize
  have hS1 (a : α) : 1 ≤ S a := (Nat.le_add_left _ _).trans (hlog a)
  have hS' (a : α) (t : ℕ) :
      (encS (M.run (enc a) t)).length ≤ cS * S a := by
    rcases le_or_gt t (time a) with h | h
    · exact hS a t h
    · rw [M.run_eq_of_le _ (hhalt a) h.le]
      exact hS a _ le_rfl
  -- the parts of the simulation
  obtain ⟨cI, hI⟩ := computableInTimeAndSpace_of_const (encIn := enc) (encOut := encPass encS)
    ((M.init, 0, none) : PassState σ)
  obtain ⟨cE, hE⟩ := computableInTimeAndSpace_of_const
    (encIn := encPair (encPass encS) encBool) (encOut := encBits) ([] : List Bool)
  obtain ⟨TN, cN, hN, -⟩ := passNext_inSpace (M' := M) hquery
  obtain ⟨TPE, cPE, hPE, -⟩ := passEmit_inSpace (M' := M) hemit hhalted
  obtain ⟨TPN, cPN, hPN, -⟩ := passEnd_inSpace (M' := M) hnext hhalted
  obtain ⟨TC, cC, hC, -⟩ := passCont_inSpace (M' := M) hhalted
  obtain ⟨TF, cF, hF, -⟩ := passFinish_inSpace (M' := M) hfinish
  -- the states of the passes
  have hP (a : α) (i : ℕ) := (passState_eq M) (enc a) i
  have hQ (a : α) (i : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ (enc a).length) :
      streamState (passState ((M.init, 0, none) : PassState σ) (passNext M) (passEnd M) (enc a) i)
        (passNext M) (enc a) j =
        (M.run (enc a) i, j, ((enc a).take j)[M.query (M.run (enc a) i)]?) := by
    rw [hP, (streamState_passNext M) _ _ hj]
  -- the encoded states of the passes are logarithmic
  set K := 2 * cS + 6 with hK
  have hlenQ (a : α) (i : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ (enc a).length) :
      (encPass encS (streamState (passState ((M.init, 0, none) : PassState σ) (passNext M)
        (passEnd M) (enc a) i) (passNext M) (enc a) j)).length ≤
        K * S a := by
    rw [hQ a i hj]
    refine (length_encPass_le encS _).trans ?_
    have h₁ := hS' a i
    have h₂ := (length_encNat_le_log2 hj).trans (hlog a)
    have := hS1 a
    simp only at h₂ ⊢
    rw [hK]
    nlinarith
  have hlenP (a : α) (i : ℕ) :
      (encPass encS (passState ((M.init, 0, none) : PassState σ) (passNext M) (passEnd M)
        (enc a) i)).length ≤ K * S a := by
    rw [hP]
    refine (length_encPass_le encS _).trans ?_
    have h₁ := hS' a i
    have := hS1 a
    simp only [encNat_apply, Nat.zero_bits, List.length_nil]
    rw [hK]
    nlinarith
  -- the passes
  have hpass (a : α) : ∀ i ≤ time a - 1,
      (passCont M) (passState ((M.init, 0, none) : PassState σ) (passNext M) (passEnd M) (enc a)
        (i + 1)) = decide (i < time a - 1) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hP, passCont]
    have := M.halted_run_iff (enc a) (hhalt a) (hpre a) (i + 1)
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (time a) with h0 | hpos
    · rw [h0] at this hi ⊢
      have hi0 : i = 0 := by omega
      subst hi0
      simp [this.mpr (by omega)]
    · by_cases hlt : i < time a - 1
      · have : M.halted (M.run (enc a) (i + 1)) = false := hpre a _ (by omega)
        simp [this, hlt]
      · simp [this.mpr (by omega), hlt]
  -- the output
  have hout (a : α) : encOut (f a) =
      ((List.range (time a - 1 + 1)).map fun i =>
        streamEmit (passNext M) (fun p => encBits ((fun _ => ([] : List Bool)) p))
          (passState ((M.init, 0, none) : PassState σ) (passNext M) (passEnd M) (enc a) i)
          (enc a) ++
        encBits ((passEmit M) (streamState (passState ((M.init, 0, none) : PassState σ)
          (passNext M) (passEnd M) (enc a) i) (passNext M) (enc a) (enc a).length))).flatten ++
      encBits ((passFinish M) (passState ((M.init, 0, none) : PassState σ) (passNext M) (passEnd M)
        (enc a) (time a - 1 + 1))) := by
    rw [hf, M.output_eq_of_not_halted _ (hpre a)]
    simp only [encBits_apply, streamEmit_const_nil, List.nil_append, hP,
      (streamState_passNext_length M), passEmit, passFinish]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (time a) with h0 | hpos
    · rw [h0]
      have h1 := M.run_eq_of_le (enc a) (h0 ▸ hhalt a) (show 0 ≤ 1 by omega)
      have h2 : M.halted M.init = true := by simpa [h0] using hhalt a
      simp [h1, h2]
    · rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hpos]
      congr 2
      refine List.map_congr_left fun i hi => ?_
      rw [hpre a i (List.mem_range.mp hi)]
      rfl
  -- the bounds of the simulation
  set tN : PassState σ × Bool → ℕ := fun p => cN * (TN p + 1)
  set tPE : PassState σ → ℕ := fun q => cPE * (TPE q + 1)
  set tPN : PassState σ → ℕ := fun q => cPN * (TPN q + 1)

/-- **Acceptance within logarithmic space is decided by breadth-first search in polynomial time.**

`c * (Nat.log2 n + 1)`, then some polynomial number of rounds suffices for
`Turing.MultiTapeNTM.searchAccepts_iff`, and breadth-first search for that many rounds is
polynomial-time in the encoded instance. -/
theorem exists_computableTidilyInPolyTime_searchAccepts {α : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {c : ℕ}
    (hs : ∀ a, ntm.RunsInSpace (enc a) (c * (Nat.log2 (enc a).length + 1))) :
    ∃ rounds : α → ℕ, (∀ a, 2 ^ (2 * coreLengthBound k State (enc a).length
        (c * (Nat.log2 (enc a).length + 1)) + 1) ≤ rounds a) ∧
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => ntm.searchAccepts (rounds a) (enc a)) enc encBool := by
  set D := 2 * (8 + 2 * Nat.card (Option State) + 200 * k) * (c + 1)
  set rounds : α → ℕ := fun a => 2 * 2 ^ D * ((enc a).length + 1) ^ D
  refine ⟨rounds, fun a => rounds_le k State c _, ?_⟩
  -- the number of rounds in unary
  have hcount : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime rounds enc encUnary :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_mul.comp ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const _).prod
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_pow D).comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_add.comp
        ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length enc).prod
          (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 1)))))
  have hinit : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => [ntm.initView (enc a)]) enc
      (encList encFiniteCfg) :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.cons' (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.finiteCfg_init
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.of_eq (encIn := enc) (encMid := encBits) (f := fun a => enc a)
        fun _ => rfl) ntm.q₀)
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const [])
  -- the found views are polynomially many, each of linear length
  set bound : α → ℕ := fun a => rounds a *
    (2 * viewLengthBound k State (enc a).length (c * (Nat.log2 (enc a).length + 1)) + 1)
  have hbound : PolyBounded (fun a => (enc a).length) bound := by
    refine (PolyBounded.of_forall_le (2 * 2 ^ D) D fun a => le_rfl).mul ?_
    refine .of_forall_le (2 * (10 + 2 * Nat.card (Option State) + 200 * k) * (c + 2) + 1) 1
      fun a => ?_
    have hlog := Nat.mul_le_mul_left ((10 + 2 * Nat.card (Option State) + 200 * k) * c)
      (Nat.log2_le_self (enc a).length)
    simp only [viewLengthBound, pow_one]
    generalize 10 + 2 * Nat.card (Option State) + 200 * k = B at *
    nlinarith
  have hstates : ∀ a, ∀ i ≤ rounds a, (encList encFiniteCfg
      ((Cslib.Reachability.expand ntm.viewSucc)^[i] [ntm.initView (enc a)])).length ≤ bound a := by
    intro a i _
    have hreach (finite) (hf : finite ∈ Cslib.Reachability.search ntm.viewSucc i
        (ntm.initView (enc a))) :
        Relation.ReflTransGen ntm.ViewStep (ntm.initView (enc a)) finite :=
      reflTransGen_viewSucc_iff.mp (Cslib.Reachability.reflTransGen_of_mem_search hf)
    have hlen := (length_le_of_nodup_reachable (hs a) (Cslib.Reachability.nodup_search i _)

    refine (length_encList_le encFiniteCfg _ fun finite hf =>
      length_encFiniteCfg_le (hs a) (hreach finite hf)).trans ?_
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hlen
  have hsearch := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.iterate hcount hinit
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.expand computableTidilyInPolyTime_viewSucc) hbound hstates
  have htest : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun finite : FiniteCfg k Bool State =>
        decide (finite.state = none) && decide (finite.output = [true])) encFiniteCfg encBool :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bool_and.comp
      (((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.of_finite fun state : Option State =>
          decide (state = none)).comp ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.finiteCfg_state).prod
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.decide_eq' ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.finiteCfg_output
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const [true])))

theorem RunsInTime.exists_time_eq {t : ℕ} (ht : ntm.RunsInTime input t)
    (p : ntm.ComputationPath input) (hp : p.last.Halted) :
    ∃ q : ntm.ComputationPath input, q.time = t ∧ q.last = p.last := by
  rcases le_or_gt t p.time with hle | hlt

    have hlt : t < p.length + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_of_le hle
    let q : ntm.ComputationPath input :=
      ⟨p.toRunPath.take ⟨t, hlt⟩, by rw [RelSeries.head_take]; exact p.head_eq⟩
    have hq : q.last.Halted := ht q (by simp [q, ComputationPath.time, RunPath.time])
    refine ⟨q, by simp [q, ComputationPath.time, RunPath.time], ?_⟩
    have hlast : q.last = p.toRunPath ⟨t, hlt⟩ := RelSeries.last_take _ _
    exact hlast.trans (RunPath.last_eq_of_halted p.toRunPath _ (hlast ▸ hq)).symm
  · obtain ⟨q, hhead, hlen, hlast⟩ := RunPath.exists_extend_of_halted p.toRunPath hp hlt.le
    exact ⟨⟨q, hhead.trans p.head_eq⟩, hlen, hlast⟩

theorem RunPath.exists_extend (htotal : ∀ c : Cfg k Symbol State input, ∃ c', ntm.Step c c')
    (p : ntm.RunPath input) {n : ℕ} (hn : p.length ≤ n) :
    ∃ (q : ntm.RunPath input) (hq : q.length = n),

  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn

  | zero => exact ⟨p, rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨q, hlen, hprefix⟩ := ih (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := htotal q.last
    refine ⟨q.snoc c hc, by rw [RelSeries.snoc_length, hlen, Nat.add_assoc], fun i hi => ?_⟩
    rw [← hprefix i hi]
    have hi' : i < q.length + 1 := by omega

theorem RunsInTime.runsInSpace {t : ℕ} (h : ntm.RunsInTime input t) :
    ntm.RunsInSpace input (k * (t + 1)) := by
  intro p
  rcases le_or_gt p.time t with hle | hlt
  · exact (RunPath.space_le_mul_time_add_one p.toRunPath).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left k (Nat.add_le_add_right hle 1))
  -- the first `t` steps have halted, and the path stays there
  have ht : t < p.length + 1 := by unfold ComputationPath.time RunPath.time at hlt; omega
  let q : ntm.ComputationPath input :=
    ⟨p.toRunPath.take ⟨t, ht⟩, by rw [RelSeries.head_take]; exact p.head_eq⟩
  have hq : q.time = t := rfl
  have hhalt : (p.toRunPath ⟨t, ht⟩).Halted := by
    have hlast : q.last = p.toRunPath ⟨t, ht⟩ := RelSeries.last_take _ _
    exact hlast ▸ h q hq.ge
  have hsub : ∀ c ∈ p.toRunPath, c ∈ q.toRunPath := by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    rcases le_or_gt j.val t with hj | hj
    · exact ⟨⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj⟩, rfl⟩
    · refine ⟨Fin.last _, ?_⟩
      have hj' := RunPath.last_eq_of_halted (p.toRunPath.take j) ⟨t, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj⟩ hhalt
      rw [RelSeries.last_take] at hj'
      change p.toRunPath ⟨t, ht⟩ = p.toRunPath j
      exact hj'.symm
  exact (RunPath.space_le_of_subset hsub).trans
    ((RunPath.space_le_mul_time_add_one q.toRunPath).trans_eq (by rw [← hq]; rfl))

public theorem ite {encC : Bool ↪ List Bool} {c : α → Bool} {f g : α → β}
    (hc : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime c encIn encC)
    (hf : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (f ∘ Subtype.val)
      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = true)).trans encIn) encMid)
    (hg : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (g ∘ Subtype.val)
      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = false)).trans encIn) encMid) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x => if c x then f x else g x) encIn encMid := by
  obtain ⟨tc, sc, htc, hsc, h₀⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨tf, sf, htf, hsf, h₁⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨tg, sg, htg, hsg, h₂⟩ := hg
  -- the bounds of the branches, extended to all inputs
  let ext (u : {x // c x = true} → ℕ) (v : {x // c x = false} → ℕ) (x : α) : ℕ :=
    if h : c x = true then u ⟨x, h⟩ else v ⟨x, by simpa using h⟩
  obtain ⟨k, h⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.ite h₀ (tf := ext tf tg) (sf := ext sf sg)
    (tg := ext tf tg) (sg := ext sf sg)
    (h₁.mono (fun x => by simp [ext, x.2]) (fun x => by simp [ext, x.2]))
    (h₂.mono (fun x => by simp [ext, x.2]) (fun x => by simp [ext, x.2]))
  have hext {u v}
      (hu : PolyBounded (fun x : {x // c x = true} => (encIn x).length) u)
      (hv : PolyBounded (fun x : {x // c x = false} => (encIn x).length) v) :
      PolyBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) (ext u v) := by
    obtain ⟨_, hbu, hu⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨_, hbv, hv⟩ := hv
    refine ⟨_, hbu.add hbv, fun x => ?_⟩
    by_cases hx : c x = true
    · simpa [ext, hx] using Nat.le_add_right_of_le (hu ⟨x, hx⟩)
    · simpa [ext, hx] using Nat.le_add_left_of_le (hv ⟨x, by simpa using hx⟩)
  refine ⟨_, _, (htc.add (hext htf htg)).add (.const k), (hsc.add (hext hsf hsg)).add (.const k),
    h.mono (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_)⟩ <;>
  · by_cases hx : c x = true <;> simp [ext, hx]

public theorem ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.foldl {γ α β : Type u} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {encL : List α ↪ List Bool}
    {encBA : β × α ↪ List Bool} {encS : List α × β ↪ List Bool}
    {encO : Option (List α × β) ↪ List Bool}
    [ListEncoding encA encL] [PairEncoding encB encA encBA] [PairEncoding encL encB encS]
    [OptionEncoding encS encO] {list : γ → List α} {init : γ → β} {step : β → α → β}
    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime list encIn encL)
    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime init encIn encB)
    (hstep : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : β × α => step p.1 p.2) encBA encB)
    {lMax aMax : γ → ℕ} (hlMax' : PolyBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) lMax)
    (haMax' : PolyBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) aMax)
    (hlen : PolyBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) fun x => (list x).length)
    (haMax : ∀ x i (hi : i < (list x).length),
      (encBA (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x), (list x)[i])).length ≤ aMax x)
    (hlMax : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ (list x).length,
      (encS ((list x).drop i, ((list x).take i).foldl step (init x))).length ≤ lMax x) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x => (list x).foldl step (init x)) encIn encB := by
  obtain ⟨t₁, s₁, ht₁, hs₁, h₁⟩ := hlist
  obtain ⟨t₂, s₂, ht₂, hs₂, h₂⟩ := hinit
  obtain ⟨tS, sS, htS, hsS, hS⟩ := hstep
  obtain ⟨ct, dt, htS⟩ := htS.exists_le
  obtain ⟨cs, ds, hsS⟩ := hsS.exists_le
  have hmax {c d : ℕ} : PolyBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) fun x => c * (aMax x + 1) ^ d :=
    PolyBounded.comp (size' := id) (v := fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ d)
      (.of_forall_le c d (fun _ => le_rfl)) haMax'
  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.foldl (encA := encA) (encL := encL)
    (encBA := encBA) (encS := encS) (encO := encO)
    (h₁.mono (t' := fun x => t₁ x + t₂ x) (s' := fun x => s₁ x + s₂ x)
      (fun _ => Nat.le_add_right _ _) (fun _ => Nat.le_add_right _ _))
    (h₂.mono (fun _ => Nat.le_add_left _ _) (fun _ => Nat.le_add_left _ _)) hS
    (tMax := fun x => ct * (aMax x + 1) ^ dt) (sMax := fun x => cs * (aMax x + 1) ^ ds)
    (fun x i hi => (htS _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left ct (Nat.pow_le_pow_left
      (Nat.add_le_add_right (haMax x i hi) 1) dt)))
    (fun x i hi => (hsS _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs (Nat.pow_le_pow_left
      (Nat.add_le_add_right (haMax x i hi) 1) ds)))
    hlMax
  exact ⟨_, _, (PolyBounded.const c).mul ((ht₁.add ht₂).add
      ((hlen.add (.const 1)).mul ((hmax.add hlMax').add (.const 1)))),
    (PolyBounded.const c).mul ((((hs₁.add hs₂).add hmax).add hlMax').add (.const 1)), h⟩

theorem moveInputPos {word : α → List Bool} {position : ∀ a, Fin ((word a).length + 2)}
    (hword : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime word input encBits)
    (hposition : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => (position a).val) input encUnary)
    (move : SignType) : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun a => (Turing.moveInputPos (position a) move).val) input encUnary := by
  cases move with
  | neg =>
    apply (unary_sub.comp (hposition.prod (const 1))).of_enc_eq
    intro a
    apply congrArg encUnary
    have h := val_moveInputPos_eq (position a) .neg
    have hp := (position a).isLt
    simp only [SignType.cast, Function.comp_def] at h ⊢
    lia
  | zero => simpa using hposition
  | pos =>
    apply (unary_min.comp ((unary_add.comp (hposition.prod (const 1))).prod
      (unary_add.comp ((length_bits.comp hword).prod (const 1))))).of_enc_eq
    intro a
    apply congrArg encUnary
    have h := val_moveInputPos_eq (position a) .pos
    simp only [SignType.cast, Function.comp_def] at h ⊢
    lia

    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime list encIn encL)
    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime init encIn encB)
    (hstep : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : β × α => step p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encB encA) encB)
    (invariant : γ → List α → β → Prop)
    (hbase : ∀ x, invariant x [] (init x))
    (hpreserve : ∀ x consumed state value, consumed ++ [value] <+: list x →
      invariant x consumed state → invariant x (consumed ++ [value]) (step state value))
    {size : γ → ℕ} (hsize : PolyBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) size)
    (hbound : ∀ x consumed state, consumed <+: list x → invariant x consumed state →
      (encB state).length ≤ size x) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x => (list x).foldl step (init x)) encIn encB ∧
      ∀ x, invariant x (list x) ((list x).foldl step (init x)) :=
  foldlWith_spec (step := fun (_ : Bool) => step) (const false) hlist hinit

    invariant hbase hpreserve hsize hbound

theorem foldlWith_of_bounded_growth {par : γ → π} {list : γ → List α} {init : γ → β}
    {step : π → β → α → β}
    (hpar : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime par encIn encP)
    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime list encIn encL)
    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime init encIn encB)
    (hstep : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : (π × β) × α => step p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
      (encPair (encPair encP encB) encA) encB)
    {growth : γ → ℕ} (hpoly : PolyBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) growth)
    (hgrowth : ∀ x state value, value ∈ list x →
      (encB (step (par x) state value)).length ≤ (encB state).length + growth x) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x => (list x).foldl (step (par x)) (init x)) encIn encB := by
  refine (foldlWith_spec hpar hlist hinit hstep
    (fun x consumed state => (encB state).length ≤
      (encB (init x)).length + consumed.length * growth x)
    (by simp) ?_
    (hinit.polyBounded_length.add (hlist.polyBounded_length.mul hpoly)) ?_).1
  · intro x consumed state value hprefix hs
    have := hgrowth x state value (hprefix.subset (by simp))
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    lia
  · intro x consumed state hprefix hs
    have hlen := hprefix.length_le.trans
      (SizedListEncoding.length_le (encA := encA) (encL := encL) (list x))
    exact hs.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (growth x) hlen) _)

theorem size_natAbs_sum_le {l : List ℤ} {b : ℕ} (h : ∀ z ∈ l, z.natAbs.size ≤ b) :
    l.sum.natAbs.size ≤ b + l.length.size := by
  have habs (l : List ℤ) : l.sum.natAbs ≤ (l.map Int.natAbs).sum := by
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons z l ih =>
      simp only [List.sum_cons, List.map_cons]
      exact (Int.natAbs_add_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left ih _)
  have hsum := Nat.size_sum_le (l := l.map Int.natAbs) (b := b) (by simpa using h)
  rw [List.length_map] at hsum
  exact (Nat.size_le_size (habs l)).trans hsum

theorem intBin_add : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => p.1 + p.2)
    (encPair encIntBin encIntBin) encIntBin := by
  have hsa := intBin_isNeg.comp (fst encIntBin encIntBin)
  have hsb := intBin_isNeg.comp (snd encIntBin encIntBin)
  have hma := intBin_natAbs.comp (fst encIntBin encIntBin)
  have hmb := intBin_natAbs.comp (snd encIntBin encIntBin)
  have h := (bool_beq.comp (hsa.prod hsb)).ite'

    ((binary_le.comp (hmb.prod hma)).ite'
      (intBin_signMagnitude.comp (hsa.prod (binary_sub.comp (hma.prod hmb))))
      (intBin_signMagnitude.comp (hsb.prod (binary_sub.comp (hmb.prod hma)))))
  refine h.of_enc_eq fun ⟨a, b⟩ => congrArg encIntBin ?_
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  by_cases ha : a < 0 <;> by_cases hb : b < 0 <;>
    simp only [ha, hb, decide_true, decide_false, beq_self_eq_true, Bool.true_beq,

    {par : α → π} {count : α → ℕ} {init : α → β} {step : π → β → β}
    (hpar : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime par encIn encPar)

      (encState state).length + growth x) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun x => (step (par x))^[count x] (init x)) encIn encState := by
  refine (iterateWith_spec hpar hcount hinit hstep
    (fun x i state => (encState state).length ≤ (encState (init x)).length + i * growth x)

theorem zip {α β : Type} (encA : α ↪ List Bool) (encB : β ↪ List Bool) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List α × List β => p.1.zip p.2)
      (encPair (encList encA) (encList encB)) (encList (encPair encA encB)) := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty α with h | h
  · have heq : (fun p : List α × List β => p.1.zip p.2) = fun _ => [] := by
      funext p
      cases p.1 with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons a _ => exact isEmptyElim a
    rw [heq]
    exact const []
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty β with h' | h'
  · have heq : (fun p : List α × List β => p.1.zip p.2) = fun _ => [] := by
      funext p
      cases p.2 with
      | nil => simp
      | cons b _ => exact isEmptyElim b
    rw [heq]
    exact const []
  obtain ⟨a⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := h'
  have heq (p : List α × List β) : p.1.zip p.2 =
      (List.range (min p.1.length p.2.length)).map
        (fun i => (p.1.getD i a, p.2.getD i b)) := by
    apply List.ext_getElem (by simp)
    intro i hi hi'
    have hleft : i < p.1.length := (Nat.lt_min.mp (by simpa using hi)).1
    have hright : i < p.2.length := (Nat.lt_min.mp (by simpa using hi)).2
    simp only [List.getElem_zip, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range,
      List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hleft, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hright]
  simp_rw [heq, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  fun_prop

    cases bit
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact le_max_right _ _
  have hforward := foldl' (encA := encBool) (encL := encBits) (encB := encList enc)
    (step := fun acc bit => acc ++ [bit]) id' (const [])

      ((fst (encList enc) encBool).prod
        ((of_finite (id : Bool → Bool) (encA := encBool) (encB := enc)).comp
          (snd (encList enc) encBool))))
    (B := fun word : List Bool => word.length * C)

      intro word i hi
      simp only [foldl_snoc, List.nil_append]
      exact (length_encList_le enc _ (fun bit _ => hsymbol bit)).trans

        (snd encBits enc)))

      intro word i hi
      simp only [foldl_snoc, List.nil_append, encBits_apply, List.length_take]

theorem unary_divMod : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (p.1 / p.2, p.1 % p.2))
    (encPair encUnary encUnary) (encPair encUnary encUnary) := by
  let step (divisor : ℕ) (state : ℕ × ℕ) :=
    if state.2 + 1 == divisor then (state.1 + 1, 0) else (state.1, state.2 + 1)
  have hstep : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × (ℕ × ℕ) => step p.1 p.2)

    unfold step
    fun_prop
  obtain ⟨hefficient, hspec⟩ := iterateWith_spec (par := Prod.snd) (count := Prod.fst)
    (init := fun _ => (0, 0)) (encIn := encPair encUnary encUnary)
    (snd encUnary encUnary) (fst encUnary encUnary) (const (0, 0)) hstep
    (fun p i state => i = p.2 * state.1 + state.2 ∧ state.1 ≤ i ∧
      (p.2 = 0 → state.1 = 0) ∧ (0 < p.2 → state.2 < p.2))
    (fun _ => by simp) (fun p i state _ h => by
      dsimp only [step]
      split <;> rename_i htest
      · have heq : state.2 + 1 = p.2 := by simpa using htest
        exact ⟨by nlinarith [h.1], by lia, by lia, by lia⟩
      · have hne : state.2 + 1 ≠ p.2 := by simpa using htest
        exact ⟨by nlinarith [h.1], by lia, h.2.2.1, fun hpos => by
          have := h.2.2.2 hpos
          lia⟩)
    (size := fun p => 3 * p.1 + 1) (polyBounded (by fun_prop)) (fun _ i state hi h => by
      simp only [length_encPair, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate]
      nlinarith [h.1, h.2.1])
  have hresult (p : ℕ × ℕ) : (step p.2)^[p.1] (0, 0) = (p.1 / p.2, p.1 % p.2) := by
    have h := hspec p
    have hquot : ((step p.2)^[p.1] (0, 0)).1 = p.1 / p.2 := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p.2 with hzero | hpos

      · symm

theorem polytime_rotateFamily [Finite D] (H : RotationMap (Fin b) D)
    (e : Fin b ≃ (Fin 2 → D × D)) (hb : 1 < b)
    (edge : ((Fin b × (D × D)) ⊕ (Fin b × (D × D))) ↪ List Bool) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (rotateFamily H e (by lia))
      (encPair encUnary (encPair encUnary edge)) (encPair encUnary edge) := by

  have hvertex := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd encUnary (encPair encUnary edge)).fst'
  have hlabel := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd encUnary (encPair encUnary edge)).snd'
  have hbound := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_le.comp
    ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const 2).prod hsize)
  have hbranches (choice : (Fin b × (D × D)) ⊕ (Fin b × (D × D))) :
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × (ℕ × _ ) =>
        rotateFamily H e (by lia) (p.1, p.2.1, choice))
        (encPair encUnary (encPair encUnary edge)) (encPair encUnary edge) := by
    cases choice with
    | inl choice =>
      have hcall := (polytime_contract (by lia) label slot).comp
        (((polytime_build H e hb label).comp hsize).prod
          (hsize.prod (hvertex.prod (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const choice))))
      have hinl : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (Sum.inl : (Fin b × (D × D)) → _)
          slot edge := .of_finite _

        (hvertex.prod (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const (encMid := edge) (Sum.inr choice)))

theorem polytime_nextRow (H : RotationMap (Fin b) D) (e : Fin b ≃ (Fin 2 → D × D))

theorem lookup_iterate_numbered {B : Type*} (H : RotationMap B D)
    (e : B ≃ (Fin 2 → D × D)) (numbering : B ≃ Fin b) (hb : 0 < b)
    (level : ℕ) (vertex : ZigzagTowerVertex B level) (label : D × D) :
    ((next (H.reindex numbering) (numbering.symm.trans e) hb)^[level]
      (initial (H.reindex numbering))).lookup
        (ZigzagTowerVertex.equivFin numbering level vertex).val label =
      ((ZigzagTowerVertex.equivFin numbering level
          ((zigzagTower H e level).rot (vertex, label)).1).val,
        ((zigzagTower H e level).rot (vertex, label)).2) := by
  induction level generalizing label with
  | zero =>
    change B at vertex
    rw [Function.iterate_zero_apply]
    change (initial (H.reindex numbering)).lookup (numbering vertex).val label = _
    rw [lookup_initial]
    simp only [rot_reindex, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rfl
  | succ level ih =>
    rcases vertex with ⟨vertex, cloud⟩
    rcases label with ⟨first, second⟩
    have hstep (u : ZigzagTowerVertex B level) (c : B) :
        (ZigzagTowerVertex.equivFin numbering (level + 1) (u, c)).val =
          (ZigzagTowerVertex.equivFin numbering level u).val * b + (numbering c).val := by
      change (numbering c).val + b * (ZigzagTowerVertex.equivFin numbering level u).val = _
      ring
    have hindex : (ZigzagTowerVertex.equivFin numbering (level + 1) (vertex, cloud)).val <
        ((next (H.reindex numbering) (numbering.symm.trans e) hb)^[level]
          (initial (H.reindex numbering))).length * b := by
      rw [length_iterate, ← pow_succ]
      exact (ZigzagTowerVertex.equivFin numbering (level + 1) (vertex, cloud)).isLt
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', lookup_next _ _ _ _ hindex, hstep]
    have hmod :
        ((ZigzagTowerVertex.equivFin numbering level vertex).val * b + (numbering cloud).val) % b =
          (numbering cloud).val := by
      simp [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (numbering cloud).isLt]

          (ZigzagTowerVertex.equivFin numbering level vertex).val := by
      rw [Nat.mul_comm (ZigzagTowerVertex.equivFin numbering level vertex).val,
        Nat.mul_add_div hb, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (numbering cloud).isLt, Nat.add_zero]

/-- **Savitch's algorithm in the space of its stack.** Let the edge test `edge p` be tidily
computable within time `O(Te)` and space `O(Se)`, and let the parameter, the width `w` and depth
`d` in unary, and endpoints of width `w` be computable from `x` within time `O(Tin)` and space
`O(Sin)`. Then Savitch's algorithm is tidily computable within time
`O(Tin + 2 ^ ((w + 2) * (d + 1)) * (S₀ ^ 2 + Te))` and space `O(Sin + S₀ + Se)`, with
`S₀ = (d + 1) * (d + w + 1) + |p|` and `Te`, `Se` at the worst endpoints of width `w`
(`Cslib.Reachability.edgeMax`). The space charges the stack of at most `d` frames, each with a
level and three words, the register, the parameter, the width, and the counter of the rounds; the
time charges every round, which copies the state [Sipser, Theorem 8.5][Sipser2013]
[Arora and Barak, Section 4.2][AroraBarak09]. -/
theorem computableTidilyInO_savitch {γ : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {edge : π → List Bool → List Bool → Bool} {Te Se : π × List Bool × List Bool → ℕ}
    (hedge : ComputableTidilyInO (fun q : π × List Bool × List Bool => edge q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      (encPair encP (encPair encBits encBits)) encBool Te Se)
    {par : γ → π} {width depth : γ → ℕ} {src dst : γ → List Bool} {Tin Sin : γ → ℕ}
    (hin : ComputableTidilyInO (fun x => (par x, width x, depth x, src x, dst x)) encIn
      (encArgs encP) Tin Sin)
    (hsrc : ∀ x, (src x).length = width x) (hdst : ∀ x, (dst x).length = width x) :
    ComputableTidilyInO (fun x => savitch (edge (par x)) (width x) (depth x) (src x) (dst x))
      encIn encBool
      (fun x => Tin x + 2 ^ ((width x + 2) * (depth x + 1)) *
        (((depth x + 1) * (depth x + width x + 1) + (encP (par x)).length + 1) ^ 2 +
          edgeMax Te (par x) (width x)))
      fun x => Sin x + (depth x + 1) * (depth x + width x + 1) + (encP (par x)).length +
        edgeMax Se (par x) (width x) := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty γ with hγ | ⟨⟨x₀⟩⟩
  · exact ((ComputableTidilyInO.const (encMid := encBool) false).mono 0 (fun x => isEmptyElim x)
      fun x => isEmptyElim x).of_enc_eq fun x => isEmptyElim x
  have : Inhabited π := ⟨par x₀⟩
  have hn := steps_inO.comp (widthDepth_deg.inO_one.comp_linear hin)
  have hinit := init_deg.inO_one.comp_linear hin
  -- every state of the run is a state of a run from a call at level `depth x`
  have hinv (x : γ) (k : ℕ) : Invariant (width x) (depth x)
      ((step (edge (par x)) (width x))^[k] ⟨[], .call (depth x) (src x) (dst x)⟩) :=
    invariant_iterate (w := width x) (d := depth x)
      (s := ⟨[], .call (depth x) (src x) (dst x)⟩) _ ⟨trivial, fun i u v h => by
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := Reg.call.inj h
        exact ⟨by simp, hsrc x, hdst x⟩⟩ k
  have hiter := ComputableTidilyInO.iterate hn hinit (computableTidilyInO_roundStep hedge)
    (R := fun x => (stateBound (encP (par x)).length (width x) (depth x) + 1) ^ 2 +
      edgeMax Te (par x) (width x))
    (Q := fun x => stateBound (encP (par x)).length (width x) (depth x) +
      edgeMax Se (par x) (width x))
    (B := fun x => stateBound (encP (par x)).length (width x) (depth x))
    (fun x k _ => by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, roundStep_iterate]
      exact Nat.add_le_add (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right
        (length_encRound_le (hinv x k)) 1) 2) (edgeCost_le Te _ (hinv x k)))
    (fun x k _ => by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, roundStep_iterate]
      exact Nat.add_le_add (length_encRound_le (hinv x k)) (edgeCost_le Se _ (hinv x k)))
    (fun x k _ => by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, roundStep_iterate]
      exact length_encRound_le (hinv x k))
  refine ((answer_deg.inO_one.comp_linear hiter).mono 900 (fun x => ?_) fun x => ?_).of_enc_eq
    fun x => ?_
  all_goals simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  · rw [steps_add_one, length_encNat_steps]
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := savitch_bounds (encP (par x)).length (width x) (depth x)
    generalize stateBound (encP (par x)).length (width x) (depth x) = B at h₁ ⊢
    generalize (depth x + 1) * (depth x + width x + 1) + (encP (par x)).length = S at h₁ h₂ h₃ ⊢
    generalize (width x + 2) * (depth x + 1) = K at h₂ ⊢
    generalize edgeMax Te (par x) (width x) = E
    have hM : 1 ≤ 2 ^ K := Nat.one_le_two_pow
    generalize 2 ^ K = M at hM ⊢
    have hB := Nat.pow_le_pow_left h₁ 2
    have hK := Nat.pow_le_pow_left h₂ 2
    have hdK := Nat.mul_le_mul h₃ (show K ≤ 2 * (S + 1) by omega)
    rw [Nat.mul_pow] at hB hK
    have hround : (B + 1) ^ 2 + E + B + (K + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 760 * (S + 1) ^ 2 + E := by nlinarith
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left M hround
    have : (S + 1) ^ 2 ≤ M * (S + 1) ^ 2 := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hM
    nlinarith
  · rw [length_encNat_steps]
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, -⟩ := savitch_bounds (encP (par x)).length (width x) (depth x)
    simp only [stateBound] at h₁ ⊢
    nlinarith
  · rw [roundStep_iterate, savitch, answer_eq]

      (encArgs encP))

    ∃ t s, PolyBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) s ∧

        s := by

    ⟨1, hi.mono (fun _ => by omega) fun _ => by dsimp only; omega, fun x => by
      have := hi.length_le x

  obtain ⟨c, h, -⟩ := computableTidilyInO_savitch hedgeO hinO hsrc hdst
  refine ⟨_, _, ?_, h⟩

theorem savitchDecide_eq_true_iff {c d s : ℕ} {input : List Bool} (hs : ntm.RunsInSpace input s)
    (hsc : s ≤ c * (input.length + 1) ^ d) :

    length_viewCode (hwidth _ .refl)

    ∃ c, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (fun p : σ × List Bool => p.2.foldl step p.1)
      (encPair enc encBits) enc
      (fun p => c * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.2.length, R p i) + B p + 1))
      (fun p => c * (Q p + B p + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨ce, he⟩ := computableInTimeAndSpace_of_const
    (encIn := encPair enc encBool) (encOut := encBits) []
  let reader : InputReader Bool Unit := ⟨(), fun _ b => (none, some b)⟩
  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.streamFold_pair_sum
    (g := fun p : σ × List Bool => p.2.foldl step p.1)
    (encIn := encPair enc encBits) (encOut := enc)

    (fun a rest => by simp [reader, InputReader.read])

      nlinarith)

    (fun p i hi => (hstate p i hi).trans (Nat.le_succ _))
    (fun _ _ _ => by simp)

    calc
      p.2.length = ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range p.2.length, 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => by

      streamState, List.take_length]

      (2 * ce + 4) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.2.length, R p i) + (B p + 1) + 1 ≤ _

    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left c

theorem ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.iterate_unary_stream_sum {σ : Type} {enc : σ ↪ List Bool}
    {f : σ → σ} {emit finish : σ → List Bool} {tN sN tE sE tF sF : σ → ℕ}
    (hnext : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace f enc enc tN sN)
    (hemit : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace emit enc encBits tE sE)
    (hfinish : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace finish enc encBits tF sF)
    {R : σ × ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {Q B : σ × ℕ → ℕ}
    (hcost : ∀ x i, i < x.2 → tN (f^[i] x.1) + tE (f^[i] x.1) + (enc (f^[i] x.1)).length +
      (enc (f^[i + 1] x.1)).length + 1 ≤ R x i)
    (hspace : ∀ x i, i < x.2 → sN (f^[i] x.1) + sE (f^[i] x.1) ≤ Q x)
    (hstate : ∀ x i, i ≤ x.2 → (enc (f^[i] x.1)).length ≤ B x) :
    ∃ c, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace
      (fun x : σ × ℕ => ((List.range x.2).map fun i => emit (f^[i] x.1)).flatten ++
        finish (f^[x.2] x.1))
      (encPair enc encUnary) encBits
      (fun x => c * (tF (f^[x.2] x.1) + (∑ i ∈ Finset.range x.2, R x i) + B x + 1))
      (fun x => c * (sF (f^[x.2] x.1) + Q x + B x + 1)) := by
  -- each round reads its state from the stream state paired with the token bit
  obtain ⟨cfst, hfst⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear
    (PairEncoding.fst (enc₁ := enc) (enc₂ := encBool) (enc := encPair enc encBool))
  obtain ⟨cN, hN⟩ := hnext.comp_linear hfst
  obtain ⟨cE, hE⟩ := hemit.comp_linear hfst
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D, D = 6 * cfst + cN + cE + 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hst (x : σ × ℕ) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ x.2) :
      streamState x.1 (f ∘ Prod.fst) (List.replicate x.2 true) j = f^[j] x.1 :=
    streamState_replicate f x.1 true hj
  let reader : InputReader Bool Unit := ⟨(), fun _ b => (none, some b)⟩
  have hsf := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.streamFold_pair_sum
    (g := fun x : σ × ℕ => ((List.range x.2).map fun i => emit (f^[i] x.1)).flatten ++
      finish (f^[x.2] x.1))
    (encIn := encPair enc encUnary) (encOut := encBits)
    reader (fun b => [b]) (fun _ => List.cons_ne_nil _ _)
    (fun a rest => by simp [reader, InputReader.read])
    Prod.fst (fun x => List.replicate x.2 true) (fun x => by simp [encPair_apply, encUnary_apply])
    hN hE hfinish
    (fun x => by
      rw [streamEmit_eq, List.length_replicate, hst x x.2 le_rfl]
      simp only [encBits_apply]
      congr 2
      refine List.map_congr_left fun j hj => ?_
      have hj' := List.mem_range.mp hj
      simp [hj', hst x j hj'.le])
    (roundCost := fun x i => D * R x i) (sMax := fun x => D * (Q x + B x + 1))
    (lMax := fun x => B x + 1) ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ _ => by simp)
  · obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := hsf
    have hn (x : σ × ℕ) : x.2 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range x.2, R x i := by
      calc x.2 = ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range x.2, 1 := by simp
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => by
          have := hcost x i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          omega
    refine ⟨c * (D + 4), h.mono (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_)⟩ <;>
      simp only [List.length_replicate, hst x x.2 le_rfl, ← Finset.mul_sum, Nat.mul_assoc] <;>
      refine Nat.mul_le_mul_left c ?_
    · have h₀ := hstate x 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
      have := hn x
      simp only [length_encPair, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate,
        Function.iterate_zero_apply] at h₀ ⊢
      nlinarith
    · nlinarith
  · intro x i hi
    have hi' : i < x.2 := by simpa using hi
    have hc := hcost x i hi'
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (6 * cfst + cN + cE + 1)
      (show (enc (f^[i] x.1)).length + 1 ≤ R x i by omega)
    simp only [length_encPair, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton, List.getElem_replicate,
      hst x i hi'.le, hst x (i + 1) hi']
    subst hD
    nlinarith
  · intro x i hi
    have hi' : i < x.2 := by simpa using hi
    have hs := hspace x i hi'
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (6 * cfst + cN + cE)
      (Nat.succ_le_succ (hstate x i hi'.le))
    simp only [length_encPair, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton, List.getElem_replicate,
      hst x i hi'.le]
    subst hD
    nlinarith
  · intro x i hi
    rw [hst x i (by simpa using hi)]
    exact (hstate x i (by simpa using hi)).trans (Nat.le_succ _)

private lemma run_lastBitT (final : Option Bool → List Bool) (hfinal : ∀ q, (final q).length ≤ 2)
    (l : List Bool) :
    (lastBitT final hfinal).run (lastBitT final hfinal).q₀ l = final l.getLast? := by
  suffices ∀ q, (lastBitT final hfinal).run q l = final (l.getLast?.or q) from
    (this none).trans (by rw [Option.or_none])
  induction l with
  | nil => intro q; rfl
  | cons b l ih =>
    intro q
    rw [Transducer.run_cons, ih, List.getLast?_cons]
    cases l.getLast? <;> rfl

public theorem lift (tr : Translator Q E)
    (h : ComputableTidilyInO next (encPair encS encE) encS T S) :
    ComputableTidilyInO (tr.lift next) (encPair (encPair encQ encS) encBool) (encPair encQ encS)
      (fun p => (encPair (encPair encQ encS) encBool p).length +
        (tr.step p.1.1 p.2).2.elim 0 fun e => T (p.1.2, e))
      (fun p => (encPair (encPair encQ encS) encBool p).length +
        (tr.step p.1.1 p.2).2.elim 0 fun e => S (p.1.2, e)) := by
  have hl (p : (Q × σ) × Bool) : (encPair encQ encBool (p.1.1, p.2)).length ≤
      (encPair (encPair encQ encS) encBool p).length := by
    simp only [length_encPair, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton]
    omega
  have h₁ := fst (encPair encQ encS) encBool
  have hqb := (fst' h₁).prod (snd (encPair encQ encS) encBool)
  have hstate := ((ComputableTidilyInDegree.of_finite (encIn := encPair encQ encBool)
    (encMid := encQ) fun qb : Q × Bool => (tr.step qb.1 qb.2).1).inO_one).comp hqb
  have hsome := ((ComputableTidilyInDegree.of_finite (encIn := encPair encQ encBool)
    (encMid := encBool) fun qb : Q × Bool => (tr.step qb.1 qb.2).2.isSome).inO_one).comp hqb
  have hevent := ((ComputableTidilyInDegree.of_finite (encIn := encPair encQ encBool)
    (encMid := encE) fun qb : Q × Bool => (tr.step qb.1 qb.2).2.getD default).inO_one).comp hqb
  have hs := snd' h₁
  have hnext := h.comp (hs.prod hevent)
  have hall := hstate.prod (hsome.ite hnext hs)
  refine (hall.of_enc_eq (g := tr.lift next) fun p => ?_).mono 20 (fun p => ?_) fun p => ?_
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply, Translator.lift]
    cases (tr.step p.1.1 p.2).2 <;> rfl
  all_goals
    have := hl p
    cases h : (tr.step p.1.1 p.2).2 <;> simp only [Function.comp_apply, h] <;> simp <;> omega

open Translator in
/-- **Multi-pass folds behind a translator.** A multi-pass fold over the events that the
translator `tr` emits on the encoded input is tidily computable on the encoded input itself, from
parts computable within the given bounds. Each pass reads every bit, so its time is the length of
the input times the bounds on a round; the space is that of the fold on the events. The bounds
`tMax`, `sMax` and `lMax` bound the time and space of a round and of the end of a pass, and the
lengths of the states. -/
public theorem ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.multiPassFold_translate {Q E σ γ ε' φ ω : Type}
    [Finite Q] [Inhabited E] {encQ : Q ↪ List Bool} {encE : E ↪ List Bool}
    {encS : σ ↪ List Bool} {encE' : ε' ↪ List Bool} {encF : φ ↪ List Bool}
    {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {encOut : ω ↪ List Bool} (tr : Translator Q E)
    {init : γ → σ} {next : σ × E → σ} {passEmit : σ → ε'} {passEnd : σ → σ} {cont : σ → Bool}
    {finish : σ → φ} {g : γ → ω} {passes : γ → ℕ} {TI SI : γ → ℕ} {T S : σ × E → ℕ}
    {TPE SPE TPN SPN TC SC TF SF : σ → ℕ}
    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInO init encIn encS TI SI)
    (hnext : ComputableTidilyInO next (encPair encS encE) encS T S)
    (hpassEmit : ComputableTidilyInO passEmit encS encE' TPE SPE)
    (hpassEnd : ComputableTidilyInO passEnd encS encS TPN SPN)
    (hcont : ComputableTidilyInO cont encS encBool TC SC)
    (hfinish : ComputableTidilyInO finish encS encF TF SF)
    (hpasses : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x,
      cont (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) (i + 1)) = decide (i < passes x))
    (hg : ∀ x, encOut (g x) = ((List.range (passes x + 1)).map fun i =>
      encE' (passEmit (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) i)
        next (tr.events (encIn x)) (tr.events (encIn x)).length))).flatten ++
      encF (finish (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) (passes x + 1))))
    {tMax sMax lMax : γ → ℕ}
    (htMax : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x, ∀ j (hj : j < (tr.events (encIn x)).length),
      T (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) i) next
        (tr.events (encIn x)) j, (tr.events (encIn x))[j]) ≤ tMax x)
    (hsMax : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x, ∀ j (hj : j < (tr.events (encIn x)).length),
      S (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) i) next
        (tr.events (encIn x)) j, (tr.events (encIn x))[j]) ≤ sMax x)
    (htEnd : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x,
      TPE (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) i) next
          (tr.events (encIn x)) (tr.events (encIn x)).length) +
        TPN (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) i) next
          (tr.events (encIn x)) (tr.events (encIn x)).length) +
        TC (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) (i + 1)) ≤ tMax x)
    (hsEnd : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x,
      SPE (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) i) next
          (tr.events (encIn x)) (tr.events (encIn x)).length) +
        SPN (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) i) next
          (tr.events (encIn x)) (tr.events (encIn x)).length) +
        SC (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) (i + 1)) ≤ sMax x)
    (hS : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x, ∀ j ≤ (tr.events (encIn x)).length,
      (encS (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) i) next
        (tr.events (encIn x)) j)).length ≤ lMax x)
    (hSlast : ∀ x, (encS (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x))
      (passes x + 1))).length ≤ lMax x) :
    ∃ c, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace g encIn encOut
      (fun x => c * (TI x + TF (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x))
        (passes x + 1)) + (passes x + 1) * ((encIn x).length +
          ((encIn x).length + 1) * (tMax x + lMax x + 1))))
      (fun x => c * (SI x + SF (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x))
        (passes x + 1)) + sMax x + lMax x + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨cQ, hcQ⟩ : ∃ cQ, ∀ q, (encQ q).length ≤ cQ := by
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty Q with hQ | hQ
    · exact ⟨0, fun q => isEmptyElim q⟩
    · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Finite.exists_max fun q => (encQ q).length
      exact ⟨_, hq⟩
  -- the parts on the states with the translator
  have hpre : ComputableTidilyInO (fun s : σ => (tr.q₀, s)) encS (encPair encQ encS)
      (fun s => (encS s).length + (encS s).length)
      (fun s => (encS s).length + (encS s).length) :=
    ComputableTidilyInO.append (enc₂ := encS) (f₂ := id) (g := fun s => (tr.q₀, s))
      (encOut := encPair encQ encS)
      (.of_linear (.const (encMid := encFramed encQ) tr.q₀)) (.of_linear (.of_eq fun _ => rfl))
      fun s => by simp
  have hsnd := ComputableTidilyInO.snd encQ encS
  obtain ⟨cI, hI, -⟩ := hpre.comp hinit
  obtain ⟨cN, hN, -⟩ := ComputableTidilyInO.lift (encQ := encQ) tr hnext
  obtain ⟨cE, hE⟩ := ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace.const (α := (Q × σ) × Bool)
    (encIn := encPair (encPair encQ encS) encBool) (encMid := encBits) []
  obtain ⟨cPE, hPE, -⟩ := hpassEmit.comp hsnd
  obtain ⟨cPN, hPN, -⟩ := hpre.comp (hpassEnd.comp hsnd)
  obtain ⟨cC, hC, -⟩ := hcont.comp hsnd
  obtain ⟨cF, hF, -⟩ := hfinish.comp hsnd
  have hI' : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (fun x => (tr.q₀, init x)) encIn (encPair encQ encS)
      _ _ := hI
  have hPE' : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (fun p : Q × σ => passEmit p.2) (encPair encQ encS)
      encE' _ _ := hPE
  have hPN' : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (fun p : Q × σ => (tr.q₀, passEnd p.2))
      (encPair encQ encS) (encPair encQ encS) _ _ := hPN
  have hC' : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (fun p : Q × σ => cont p.2) (encPair encQ encS)
      encBool _ _ := hC
  have hF' : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (fun p : Q × σ => finish p.2) (encPair encQ encS)
      encF _ _ := hF
  -- the bounds of the fold on bits
  set K := cN + cE + cPE + cPN + cC + 1 with hK
  let B (x : γ) : ℕ := 4 * cQ + 4 * lMax x + 6
  -- the states of the passes, and the bounds on them
  have hps (x : γ) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ passes x + 1) :
      (encS (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) i)).length ≤ lMax x := by
    rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hi with hi | rfl
    · exact hS x i (by omega) 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
    · exact hSlast x
  have hlen (x : γ) (q : Q) (s : σ) (hs : (encS s).length ≤ lMax x) :
      (encPair encQ encS (q, s)).length ≤ 2 * cQ + 1 + lMax x := by
    have := hcQ q
    simp only [length_encPair]
    omega
  have hK2 (a b : ℕ) (hab : a + b ≤ K) (X : ℕ) : a * X + b * X ≤ 2 * K * X := by
    rw [← Nat.add_mul]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right X (by omega)
  have hK3 (a b c : ℕ) (habc : a + b + c ≤ K) (X : ℕ) : a * X + b * X + c * X ≤ 2 * K * X := by
    rw [← Nat.add_mul, ← Nat.add_mul]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right X (by omega)
  refine Exists.elim (ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.multiPassFold (r := bitReader)
    (tok := fun b => [b]) (encA := encBool) (fun _ => List.cons_ne_nil _ _)
    (fun a rest => by simp [bitReader, InputReader.read]) (fun x => encIn x) (fun x => by simp)
    hI' hN hE hPE' hPN' hC' hF' (passes := passes) (g := g) (encOut := encOut) ?_ ?_
    (tMax := fun x => 2 * K * (tMax x + B x + 1)) (sMax := fun x => 2 * K * (sMax x + B x + 1))
    (lMax := B) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_) fun c h => ?_
  case refine_1 =>
    intro x i hi
    rw [Translator.passState_lift]
    exact hpasses x i hi
  case refine_2 =>
    intro x
    rw [hg x]
    simp only [Translator.passState_lift, Translator.streamState_lift, List.take_length,
      encBits_apply, streamEmit_nil, List.nil_append]
    rfl
  case refine_3 =>
    intro x i hi j hj
    rw [Translator.passState_lift, Translator.streamState_lift]
    have he := tr.elim_le tr.q₀ (encIn x) hj (fun jj e => T (streamState
      (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) i) next (tr.run tr.q₀ (encIn x)).2 jj,
        e)) (fun jj hjj => htMax x i hi jj hjj)
    have hl := hlen x (tr.run tr.q₀ ((encIn x).take j)).1 _
      (hS x i hi _ (tr.length_run_take_le tr.q₀ (encIn x) j))
    beta_reduce at he ⊢
    simp only [length_encPair, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton, Translator.events] at hl he ⊢
    have hB : B x = 4 * cQ + 4 * lMax x + 6 := rfl
    refine (Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (m := tMax x + B x + 1) cN ?_)
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (m := tMax x + B x + 1) cE ?_)).trans (hK2 _ _ (by omega) _)
    · omega
    · omega
  case refine_4 =>
    intro x i hi j hj
    rw [Translator.passState_lift, Translator.streamState_lift]
    have he := tr.elim_le tr.q₀ (encIn x) hj (fun jj e => S (streamState
      (passState (init x) next passEnd (tr.events (encIn x)) i) next (tr.run tr.q₀ (encIn x)).2 jj,
        e)) (fun jj hjj => hsMax x i hi jj hjj)
    have hl := hlen x (tr.run tr.q₀ ((encIn x).take j)).1 _
      (hS x i hi _ (tr.length_run_take_le tr.q₀ (encIn x) j))
    beta_reduce at he ⊢
    simp only [length_encPair, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton, Translator.events] at hl he ⊢
    have hB : B x = 4 * cQ + 4 * lMax x + 6 := rfl
    refine (Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (m := sMax x + B x + 1) cN ?_)
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (m := sMax x + B x + 1) cE ?_)).trans (hK2 _ _ (by omega) _)
    · omega
    · omega
  case refine_5 =>
    intro x i hi
    rw [Translator.passState_lift, Translator.streamState_lift, List.take_length,
      Translator.passState_lift]
    have h₀ := hlen x (tr.run tr.q₀ (encIn x)).1 _ (hS x i hi _ le_rfl)
    have h₁ := hlen x tr.q₀ _ (hps x (i + 1) (by omega))
    have h₂ := hps x (i + 1) (by omega)

    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (fuel : ℕ) (choices : List ℕ) :

def alternative (first : MultiTapeCTM k Symbol State₀)
    (second : MultiTapeCTM k Symbol State₁) :
    MultiTapeCTM k Symbol (Option (State₀ ⊕ State₁)) where
  initial := none
  tr state symbol work answer := match state with
    | none => [jump (some (.inl first.initial)), jump (some (.inr second.initial))].map
        MultiTapeMachine.Action.emptyOracleEquiv.symm
    | some (.inl state) => (first.tr state symbol work answer).map fun action =>
        MultiTapeMachine.Action.emptyOracleEquiv.symm
          (mapAction (some ∘ Sum.inl) (MultiTapeMachine.Action.emptyOracleEquiv action))
    | some (.inr state) => (second.tr state symbol work answer).map fun action =>
        MultiTapeMachine.Action.emptyOracleEquiv.symm

theorem runList_alternative (first : MultiTapeCTM k Symbol State₀)
    (second : MultiTapeCTM k Symbol State₁) (fuel : ℕ) (input : List Symbol) :
    (alternative first second).runList (fuel + 1)
        (Cfg.init (alternative first second).initial input) =
      (first.runList fuel (Cfg.init first.initial input)).map (config (some ∘ Sum.inl)) ++
      (second.runList fuel (Cfg.init second.initial input)).map (config (some ∘ Sum.inr)) := by
  have ha : (alternative first second).actions
      (Cfg.init (alternative first second).initial input) =
      [jump (some (.inl first.initial)), jump (some (.inr second.initial))] := by
    simp [actions, Cfg.init, alternative]
  rw [runList_succ _ _ fuel none rfl, ha]
  simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil]
  have hjump (state : Option (State₀ ⊕ State₁)) : (jump (k := k) state).apply
      (Cfg.init (alternative first second).initial input) =
        Cfg.init state input := by
    simp [jump, Turing.Action.apply, Cfg.init, moveInputPos, alternative]
  rw [hjump, hjump]
  exact congrArg₂ List.append
    (runList_alternative_left first second fuel (Cfg.init first.initial input))
    (runList_alternative_right first second fuel (Cfg.init second.initial input))

theorem padCertificate_injOn (machine : MultiTapeCTM k Symbol State)
    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (fuel : ℕ) :
    Set.InjOn (padCertificate fuel) (machine.branches fuel cfg) := by
  intro left hleft right hright heq
  obtain ⟨_, finalLeft, hrunLeft, hhaltLeft⟩ :=
    (machine.mem_branches_iff cfg fuel left).mp hleft
  obtain ⟨_, finalRight, hrunRight, hhaltRight⟩ :=
    (machine.mem_branches_iff cfg fuel right).mp hright
  have hleft := machine.decodeCertificate_append_replicate hrunLeft hhaltLeft
    (fuel - left.length)
  have hright := machine.decodeCertificate_append_replicate hrunRight hhaltRight
    (fuel - right.length)
  change machine.decodeCertificate cfg (padCertificate fuel left) = _ at hleft
  change machine.decodeCertificate cfg (padCertificate fuel right) = _ at hright
  rw [heq] at hleft
  exact congrArg Prod.fst (Option.some.inj (hleft.symm.trans hright))

theorem output_eq_decodeCertificate (machine : MultiTapeCTM k Bool State)
    {finite : Storage k State} {cfg : Cfg k Bool State finite.tapes.input}
    (h : finite.tapes.Represents cfg) (indices : List ℕ) :

      (machine.decodeCertificate cfg indices).map (fun r => r.2.output) := by

    cases hs : finite.tapes.state <;>
      simp [output, finish, decodeCertificate, ← h.state, hs, h.output]
  | cons index rest ih =>
    cases hs : finite.tapes.state with
    | none =>

      by_cases hz : index = 0

        rw [ite_eq_left rfl, Option.bind_some, ih h,
          machine.decodeCertificate_of_halted hhalt]
        simp [machine.decodeCertificate_of_halted hhalt, List.replicate_succ]
      · simp [hz, machine.decodeCertificate_of_halted hhalt, List.replicate_succ]
    | some state =>
      have ha := localActions_eq_actions machine h hs
      simp only [output, indexStep, ha, decodeCertificate, ← h.state, hs, step?]
      cases hi : (machine.actions cfg)[index]? with
      | none => rfl

        simp only [bind, Option.map_some, Option.bind_some, Option.map_map, Function.comp_def]
        exact ih (finite := finite.step action Empty.elim Empty.elim) (h.step action)

    (machine : MultiTapeCTM k Bool State) :

      (encPair encFiniteConfig encUnary) (encOption encFiniteConfig) := by

  let encIn := encPair (encFiniteConfig (k := k) (State := State) (Oracle := Empty)) encUnary
  have hcfg : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : Storage k State × ℕ => p.1)
      encIn encFiniteConfig := .fst _ _
  have hindex : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : Storage k State × ℕ => p.2)
      encIn encUnary := .snd _ _
  have hstate := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.finiteCfg_state.comp
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.finiteConfig_tapes.comp hcfg)
  unfold indexStep
  refine ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.finite_cases
    (branch := fun state p => match state with
      | none => if p.2 = 0 then some p.1 else none
      | some state =>
        ((localActions machine
          (state, p.1.tapes.inputSymbol, p.1.tapes.workTapeSymbols))[p.2]?).map
          (fun action => p.1.step action Empty.elim Empty.elim)) hstate (fun state => ?_)
  cases state with
  | none =>
    exact (hindex.decide_eq' (.const 0)).ite_decide
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.optionSome _).comp hcfg) (.const none)
  | some state =>
    have hview : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : Storage k State × ℕ =>
        (state, p.1.tapes.inputSymbol, p.1.tapes.workTapeSymbols)) encIn
        (encPair (encFinite State)
          (encPair (encFinEnum (Option Bool)) (encFinEnum (Fin k → Option Bool)))) := by fun_prop
    have hactions : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : Storage k State × ℕ =>
        localActions machine (state, p.1.tapes.inputSymbol, p.1.tapes.workTapeSymbols))
        encIn (encList (encFinite (Turing.Action k Bool State))) :=
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.of_finite (localActions machine)).comp hview
    refine (hactions.getElem? (encA := encFinite (Turing.Action k Bool State)) hindex).finite_cases
      (branch := fun selected p => selected.map
        (fun action => p.1.step action Empty.elim Empty.elim)) (fun selected => ?_)
    cases selected with
    | none => exact .const none

theorem length_encFiniteConfig_le {Oracle : Type} [Fintype Oracle] : ∃ c : ℕ,
    ∀ (inputSize steps answerSize : ℕ) (cfg : FiniteConfig k Bool State Oracle),
      FiniteConfig.SpaceBound inputSize steps answerSize cfg →
      (encFiniteConfig cfg).length ≤ c * (inputSize + steps + answerSize + 1) := by
  refine ⟨19 + 4 * Nat.card (Option State) + 100 * k + 31 * Fintype.card Oracle, ?_⟩
  intro inputSize steps answerSize cfg h
  let bound := inputSize + steps + answerSize + 1
  have hpositive : 1 ≤ bound := by dsimp only [bound]; lia
  have htape (tape : BiTape Bool) (htape : tape.spaceUsed ≤ bound) :
      (encBiTape encBool tape).length ≤ 12 * bound :=
    (length_encBiTape_le encBool tape (bound := 1) (by simp)).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 12 htape)
  have hwork : (encPi (encBiTape encBool) cfg.tapes.workTapes).length ≤ 25 * k * bound := by
    calc
      _ ≤ k * (2 * (12 * bound) + 1) := by
        simpa using length_encPi_le (encBiTape encBool) cfg.tapes.workTapes
          (fun tape => htape _ ((h.work tape).trans (by dsimp only [bound]; lia)))
      _ ≤ k * (25 * bound) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k (by lia)
      _ = _ := by ac_rfl
  have hcontrol : (encFinite (Option State) cfg.tapes.state).length ≤
      Nat.card (Option State) * bound :=
    (length_encFinite_lt _).le.trans (by
      simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left (Nat.card (Option State)) hpositive)
  have hinput := h.input
  have hposition := cfg.tapes.inputPos.isLt
  have houtput := h.output
  have hcfg : (encFiniteCfg cfg.tapes).length ≤
      (9 + 2 * Nat.card (Option State) + 50 * k) * bound := by
    simp only [encFiniteCfg_apply, length_encPair, encBits_apply, encUnary_apply,
      List.length_replicate]
    dsimp only [bound] at *
    nlinarith
  have hchannel (channel : Oracle) :
      (encPair encBits (encBiTape encBool) (cfg.channels channel)).length ≤ 15 * bound := by
    have hquery := h.query channel
    have hanswer := htape _ ((h.answer channel).trans (by dsimp only [bound]; lia))
    simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply]
    dsimp only [bound] at *
    lia
  have hchannels : (encPi (encPair encBits (encBiTape encBool)) cfg.channels).length ≤
      31 * Fintype.card Oracle * bound := by
    calc
      _ ≤ Fintype.card Oracle * (2 * (15 * bound) + 1) := length_encPi_le _ _ hchannel
      _ ≤ Fintype.card Oracle * (31 * bound) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by lia)
      _ = _ := by ac_rfl
  simp only [encFiniteConfig_apply, length_encPair]
  change _ ≤ (19 + 4 * Nat.card (Option State) + 100 * k + 31 * Fintype.card Oracle) * bound
  nlinarith

    {encE' : ε' ↪ List Bool} {encF : φ ↪ List Bool} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}

    {passEnd : σ → σ} {cont : σ → Bool} {finish : σ → φ} {g : γ → ω} {passes : γ → ℕ}
    {tI sI : γ → ℕ} {tN sN tE sE : σ × α → ℕ} {tPE sPE tPN sPN tC sC tF sF : σ → ℕ}
    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace init encIn encS tI sI)
    (hnext : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace next (encPair encS encA) encS tN sN)
    (hemit : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace emit (encPair encS encA) encE tE sE)
    (hpassEmit : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace passEmit encS encE' tPE sPE)
    (hpassEnd : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace passEnd encS encS tPN sPN)
    (hcont : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace cont encS encBool tC sC)
    (hfinish : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace finish encS encF tF sF)
    (hpasses : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x,
      cont (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) (i + 1)) = decide (i < passes x))
    (hg : ∀ x, encOut (g x) = ((List.range (passes x + 1)).map fun i =>
      streamEmit next (fun p => encE (emit p)) (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i)
        (elems x) ++ encE' (passEmit (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i)
          next (elems x) (elems x).length))).flatten ++
      encF (finish (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) (passes x + 1))))
    {tMax sMax lMax : γ → ℕ}
    (htMax : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x, ∀ j (hj : j < (elems x).length),
      tN (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x) j,
          (elems x)[j]) +
        tE (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x) j,
          (elems x)[j]) ≤ tMax x)

          (elems x)[j]) +
        sE (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x) j,
          (elems x)[j]) ≤ sMax x)
    (htEnd : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x,
      tPE (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x)
          (elems x).length) +
        tPN (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x)
          (elems x).length) +
        tC (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) (i + 1)) ≤ tMax x)
    (hsEnd : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x,
      sPE (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x)
          (elems x).length) +
        sPN (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x)
          (elems x).length) +
        sC (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) (i + 1)) ≤ sMax x)
    (hS : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x, ∀ j ≤ (elems x).length,

        (passes x + 1) * ((encIn x).length + ((elems x).length + 1) * (tMax x + lMax x + 1))))

    (by simp [Fin.ext_iff]) hVN
  obtain ⟨eF, heF⟩ := exists_embedding_eq (K := M + 4) (by omega) (Fin.natAdd kF (0 : Fin 2)) V
  obtain ⟨ePE, hePE⟩ := exists_embedding_eq (K := M + 4) (by omega)

  obtain ⟨ePN, hePN, hePN'⟩ := exists_embedding_eq₂ (K := M + 4) (by omega)
    (i := Fin.natAdd (kPN + 1) (0 : Fin 2)) (o := (Fin.last kPN).castAdd 2)
    (by simp [Fin.ext_iff]) hVN
  obtain ⟨eC, heC, heC'⟩ := exists_embedding_eq₂ (K := M + 4) (by omega)
    (i := Fin.natAdd (kC + 1) (0 : Fin 2)) (o := (Fin.last kC).castAdd 2)
    (by simp [Fin.ext_iff]) hVC
  -- the machines on the common tapes
  have hI := fun a => (htmI a).outputToWord_onTape heI
  have hE := fun a => (htmE a).inputFromWord_extendTapes true heE
  have hN := fun a => (htmN a).onWords_extendTapes true heN heN'
  have hF := fun a => (htmF a).inputFromWord_extendTapes true heF
  have hPE := fun a => (htmPE a).inputFromWord_extendTapes true hePE
  have hPN := fun a => (htmPN a).onWords_extendTapes true hePN hePN'
  have hC := fun a => (htmC a).onWords_extendTapes true heC heC'

public lemma linear_succStep :
    ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace (fun p => succStep p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encAcc encBool) encAcc := by
  apply Internal.NormalForm.linear
  have hacc : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace Prod.fst (encPair encAcc encBool) encAcc :=
    PairEncoding.fst encBool
  have hcarry : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (fun p : (Bool × List Bool) × Bool => p.1.1)
      (encPair encAcc encBool) encBool :=
    (PairEncoding.fst encBits).comp hacc
  have hdigit : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (fun p : (Bool × List Bool) × Bool => p.2)
      (encPair encAcc encBool) encBool :=
    PairEncoding.snd encAcc
  have hdigits : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (fun p : (Bool × List Bool) × Bool => p.1.2)
      (encPair encAcc encBool) encBits :=
    (PairEncoding.snd encBool).comp hacc
  have hand : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (fun p : (Bool × List Bool) × Bool =>
      p.1.1 && p.2) (encPair encAcc encBool) encBool := by
    convert hdigit.ite (hcarry.restrict _) ((const false).restrict _) using 1
    funext p
    cases p.2 <;> simp
  have hnot : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (fun p : (Bool × List Bool) × Bool => !p.1.1)
      (encPair encAcc encBool) encBool := by
    convert hcarry.ite ((const false).restrict _) ((const true).restrict _) using 1
    funext p
    cases p.1.1 <;> rfl
  have hxor : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (fun p : (Bool × List Bool) × Bool =>
      p.1.1 ^^ p.2) (encPair encAcc encBool) encBool := by
    convert hdigit.ite (hnot.restrict _) (hcarry.restrict _) using 1
    funext p
    cases p.2 <;> simp
  exact hand.pair (hdigits.append hxor (encOut := encBits) fun _ => rfl)

theorem SpaceBound.step {inputSize steps answerSize : ℕ}
    {finite : FiniteConfig k Symbol State Oracle} (h : SpaceBound inputSize steps answerSize finite)
    (action : Turing.Action k Symbol State) (symbol : Oracle → Option Symbol)
    (move : Oracle → SignType) :
    SpaceBound inputSize (steps + 1) answerSize (finite.step action symbol move) := by
  refine ⟨h.input, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro tape
    exact (BiTape.spaceUsed_step_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (h.work tape) 1)
  · simpa only [FiniteConfig.step, FiniteCfg.step, List.length_append] using
      Nat.add_le_add (h.output) action.output.length_toList_le
  · intro channel
    simpa only [FiniteConfig.step, List.length_append] using
      Nat.add_le_add (h.query channel) (symbol channel).length_toList_le
  · intro channel
    have := (BiTape.spaceUsed_step_le (finite.channels channel).2 (none, move channel)).trans
      (Nat.add_le_add_right (h.answer channel) 1)
    simpa only [FiniteConfig.step, Nat.add_right_comm steps answerSize 1] using this

    {finite : FiniteConfig k Symbol State Oracle}

    (channel : Oracle) (next : State) (answer : List Symbol)

  refine ⟨h.input, fun tape => (h.work tape).trans (by lia),
    h.output.trans (by lia), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro other
    by_cases heq : other = channel
    · subst other

    · simpa [FiniteConfig.receive, heq] using (h.answer other).trans (by lia)

theorem not_separates_self_desc {f : List Bool → Bool} (hf : IsComputable f encBits encBool)
    (r₀ r₁ : Option (List Bool))
    (h₀ : ∀ ⦃k : ℕ⦄ ⦃State : Type⦄ [Fintype State] (eS : State ↪ ℕ)
      (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool State), (∀ o, tm.Computes (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) o ↔ o ∈ r₀) →
        f (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) = false)
    (h₁ : ∀ ⦃k : ℕ⦄ ⦃State : Type⦄ [Fintype State] (eS : State ↪ ℕ)
      (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool State), (∀ o, tm.Computes (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) o ↔ o ∈ r₁) →
        f (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm)) = true) :
    False := by
  obtain ⟨k, State, _, eS, tm, htm⟩ := exists_self_desc hf fun b => if b then r₀ else r₁
  cases hw : f (eDesc (desc eS eBit tm))
  · simp only [hw, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at htm
    exact Bool.false_ne_true (hw.symm.trans (h₁ eS tm htm))
  · simp only [hw, ↓reduceIte] at htm
    exact Bool.false_ne_true (hw.symm.trans (h₀ eS tm htm)).symm

theorem step_redirect (hφ : φ.Injective)
    (hD : ∀ q ws, D.table.find? (·.1 = ⟨φ q, r, ws⟩) =
      (redirect φ r pre suf adj d.table).find? (·.1 = ⟨φ q, r, ws⟩))
    (hrp : inputSymbol X rp = r) (hxs : ∀ a ∈ xs, a ≠ marker) (hpre : preT.map Tape.read = pre)
    (hsuf : sufT.map Tape.read = List.replicate suf none) {c : SCfg}
    (hc : c.inputPos ≤ xs.length + 1)
    (hadj : ∀ was,
      applyTapes (c.workTapes ++ sufT) (adj was) = applyTapes c.workTapes was ++ sufT) :
    step D X (redirectCfg φ rp base l xs preT sufT c) =
      (redirectCfg φ rp base l xs preT sufT (step d xs c).1, (step d xs c).2) := by
  obtain ⟨_ | q, p, ws⟩ := c
  · rfl
  · have hkey : (redirectCfg φ rp base l xs preT sufT ⟨some q, p, ws⟩).key X (φ q) =
        ⟨φ q, r, (vtape base l xs p).read :: (pre ++ (ws.map Tape.read ++
          List.replicate suf none))⟩ := by
      simp [redirectCfg, SCfg.key, hrp, ← hpre, ← hsuf]
    have hfind := (hD q _).trans
      (find?_redirect hφ q (vtape base l xs p).read (ws.map Tape.read) d.table)
    rw [← hkey, vsym_read_vtape hxs,
      show (⟨q, inputSymbol xs p, ws.map Tape.read⟩ : Key) = SCfg.key ⟨some q, p, ws⟩ xs q
        from rfl] at hfind
    rcases hfe : d.table.find? (·.1 = SCfg.key ⟨some q, p, ws⟩ xs q) with _ | e
    · rw [step_of_find?_eq_none rfl hfe, step_of_find?_eq_none rfl (hfind.trans (by
        rw [hfe]; rfl))]
      rfl
    · rw [step_of_find? rfl hfe, step_of_find? rfl (hfind.trans (by rw [hfe]; rfl))]
      simp only [redirectCfg, Act.apply, redirectEntry, Prod.mk.injEq, SCfg.mk.injEq, and_true,
        true_and, applyTapes]
      refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
      rw [applyTapes_append_idle (by simp [← hpre]), hadj]
      exact congrArg₂ (· :: ·) (move_vmove_vtape hxs hc _) rfl

    (hrp : inputSymbol X rp = r) (hxs : ∀ a ∈ xs, a ≠ marker) (hpre : preT.map Tape.read = pre)

    Primrec (fun s : ℕ ⊕ ℕ => intEquivNatSumNat (intEquivNatSumNat.symm s + 1)) := by
  have hinl : Primrec₂ fun (_ : ℕ ⊕ ℕ) (n : ℕ) => (Sum.inl (n + 1) : ℕ ⊕ ℕ) :=
    Primrec₂.mk (Primrec.sumInl.comp (Primrec.succ.comp Primrec.snd))
  have hinr : Primrec₂ fun (_ : ℕ ⊕ ℕ) (n : ℕ) =>

    Primrec₂.mk <| (Primrec.cond ((Primrec.eq.comp Primrec.snd (Primrec.const 0)).decide)
      (Primrec.const (Sum.inl 0))
      (Primrec.sumInr.comp (Primrec.pred.comp Primrec.snd))).of_eq fun ⟨_, n⟩ => by
        cases n <;> rfl
  refine (Primrec.sumCasesOn .id hinl hinr).of_eq fun s => ?_
  rcases s with n | (_ | n) <;> rfl

    applyTapes ts as = (List.range ts.length).map fun i =>

theorem primrec_step :
    Primrec fun p : Desc × List ℕ × SCfg => step p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 := by
  have hd : Primrec fun p : Desc × List ℕ × SCfg => p.1 := Primrec.fst
  have hx : Primrec fun p : Desc × List ℕ × SCfg => p.2.1 := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
  have hc : Primrec fun p : Desc × List ℕ × SCfg => p.2.2 := Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd
  have hnone : Primrec fun p : Desc × List ℕ × SCfg => (p.2.2, (none : Option ℕ)) :=
    Primrec.pair hc (Primrec.const none)
  have hsome : Primrec₂ fun (p : Desc × List ℕ × SCfg) (q : ℕ) =>
      match p.1.table.find? (·.1 = p.2.2.key p.2.1 q) with
      | none => ({ p.2.2 with state := none }, none)
      | some e => (e.2.apply p.2.1 p.2.2, e.2.output) := by
    -- Explicit composition inputs avoid unfolding the transition functions during inference.
    have hkey : Primrec fun pq : (Desc × List ℕ × SCfg) × ℕ =>
        pq.1.2.2.key pq.1.2.1 pq.2 :=
      primrec_scfg_key.comp
        (g := fun pq : (Desc × List ℕ × SCfg) × ℕ => (pq.1.2.2, pq.1.2.1, pq.2))
        (Primrec.pair (hc.comp Primrec.fst)
          (Primrec.pair (hx.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd))
    have hfind : Primrec fun pq : (Desc × List ℕ × SCfg) × ℕ =>
        pq.1.1.table.find? (·.1 = pq.1.2.2.key pq.1.2.1 pq.2) :=
      primrec_find_table.comp (primrec_desc_table.comp (hd.comp Primrec.fst)) hkey
    have hnotFound : Primrec fun pq : (Desc × List ℕ × SCfg) × ℕ =>
        ({ pq.1.2.2 with state := none }, (none : Option ℕ)) :=
      Primrec.pair
        (primrec_scfg_mk (Primrec.const none)
          (primrec_scfg_inputPos.comp (hc.comp Primrec.fst))
          (primrec_scfg_workTapes.comp (hc.comp Primrec.fst)))
        (Primrec.const none)
    have hfound : Primrec₂ fun (pq : (Desc × List ℕ × SCfg) × ℕ) (e : Key × Act) =>
        (e.2.apply pq.1.2.1 pq.1.2.2, e.2.output) :=
      Primrec₂.mk <| Primrec.pair
        (primrec_act_apply.comp
          (g := fun q : ((Desc × List ℕ × SCfg) × ℕ) × (Key × Act) =>
            (q.2.2, q.1.1.2.1, q.1.1.2.2))
          (Primrec.pair (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
            (Primrec.pair (hx.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst))
              (hc.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)))))
        (primrec_act_output.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
    exact Primrec₂.mk <| (Primrec.option_casesOn hfind hnotFound hfound).of_eq fun ⟨p, q⟩ => by
      cases p.1.table.find? (·.1 = p.2.2.key p.2.1 q) <;> rfl
  exact (Primrec.option_casesOn (primrec_scfg_state.comp hc) hnone hsome).of_eq
    fun ⟨d, x, c⟩ => by
      unfold step
      cases c.state <;> rfl

theorem primrec_runFor : Primrec₂ tm.runFor := by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite State
  let eS : State ↪ ℕ := (Fintype.equivFin State).toEmbedding.trans Fin.valEmbedding
  let d := desc eS eBit tm
  have heBit : Primrec eBit := Primrec.dom_finite _
  have hmapIn : Primrec fun x : List Bool => x.map eBit :=
    Primrec.list_map .id (heBit.comp Primrec.snd).to₂
  have hsim : Primrec fun p : List Bool × ℕ => simulate d (p.1.map eBit) p.2 :=
    primrec_simulate.comp (g := fun p : List Bool × ℕ => (d, p.1.map eBit, p.2))
      (Primrec.pair (Primrec.const d)

    (Primrec.not.comp ((Primrec.eq.comp .id (Primrec.const 0)).decide)).of_eq fun n => by
      cases n <;> rfl
  have hmapOut : Primrec fun l : List ℕ => l.map (· != 0) :=
    Primrec.list_map .id (hneZero.comp Primrec.snd).to₂
  exact Primrec₂.mk <| (Primrec.cond (Primrec.snd.comp hsim)
    (Primrec.option_some.comp (hmapOut.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hsim)))
    (Primrec.const none)).of_eq fun ⟨x, t⟩ => by
      rw [tm.runFor_eq_simulate eS x t]

/-- **Kleene's recursion theorem, in its two-way case.** For every computable verdict `f` on words
and descriptions `d false`, `d true`, some word `e` describes a machine behaving on inputs of bits
as `d (f e)` does: a machine can make its whole behavior depend on a computable verdict about its
own description. The full recursion theorem allows any computable transformation of descriptions
in place of the choice between `d false` and `d true`. The proof is Kleene's construction: a
machine reads a word `y` before its input, computes the verdict on the description of the machine
described by `y` with `y` built in, and dispatches on it; `e` is that description for `y` the
description of the machine itself. -/

theorem exists_behavior_eq {f : List Bool → Bool} (hf : IsComputable f encBits encBool)
    (d : Bool → Desc) : ∃ e : List Bool, ∀ (x : List Bool) (o : List ℕ),
      (decodeDesc e).Computes (x.map eBit) o ↔ (d (f e)).Computes (x.map eBit) o := by
  set s : List Bool → List Bool := fun y => eDesc (hardwire (decodeDesc y) (frame y))
  have hs : IsComputable s encBits encBits := computableTidilyInPolyTime_selfHardwire.isComputable
  have hcons : IsComputable (fun p : Bool × List Bool => p.1 :: p.2) (encPair encBool encBits)
      encBits :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsCons (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _)
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd _ _)).isComputable
  have hg : IsComputable (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => f (s p.1) :: p.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits :=
    hcons.comp ((hf.comp (hs.comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst encBits encBits).isComputable)
      ).prod (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd encBits encBits).isComputable)
  obtain ⟨_, _, k, State, hfin, tm, htm⟩ := hg.exists_computableTidilyInTimeAndSpace
  have := Fintype.ofFinite State
  set eS : State ↪ ℕ := (Fintype.equivFin State).toEmbedding.trans Fin.valEmbedding
  set T := dispatch eS tm d
  have hsT : s (eDesc T) = eDesc (hardwire T (frame (eDesc T))) := by
    simp only [s, decodeDesc_eDesc]
  refine ⟨s (eDesc T), fun x o => ?_⟩
  have h := Desc.computes_dispatch (w := frame (eDesc T) ++ x) (b := f (s (eDesc T))) (v := x) eS
    tm d (htm (eDesc T, x)) o
  rw [hsT, decodeDesc_eDesc, Desc.computes_hardwire]
  rwa [hsT] at h

lemma sum_le {c₀ c₁ k k' A M X Y : ℕ} (hX : X ≤ k * (M + 1)) (hY : Y ≤ c₀ * (A + 1)) :
    c₀ * (A + 1) + X + c₁ * (Y + 1) ≤ (c₀ + c₁ * (c₀ + 1) + k + k') * (A + M + 1) := by
  have h₁ : c₁ * (Y + 1) ≤ c₁ * (c₀ + 1) * (A + M + 1) :=
    calc c₁ * (Y + 1) ≤ c₁ * (c₀ * (A + 1) + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
      _ ≤ c₁ * ((c₀ + 1) * (A + M + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by nlinarith)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have h₂ : X ≤ k * (A + M + 1) := hX.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega))
  have h₃ : c₀ * (A + 1) ≤ c₀ * (A + M + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
  have : (c₀ + c₁ * (c₀ + 1) + k + k') * (A + M + 1) = c₀ * (A + M + 1) +
      c₁ * (c₀ + 1) * (A + M + 1) + k * (A + M + 1) + k' * (A + M + 1) := by ring
  omega

theorem conditional {α β : Type*} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool} {encOut : β ↪ List Bool}
    {encC : Bool ↪ List Bool} {c : α → Bool} {f g : α → β}
    {tc sc tf sf tg sg : α → ℕ} {kc kf kg : ℕ} {Qc Qf Qg : Type}
    [Finite Qc] [Finite Qf] [Finite Qg]
    {tmc : MultiTapeTM kc Bool Qc} {tmf : MultiTapeTM kf Bool Qf}
    {tmg : MultiTapeTM kg Bool Qg}
    (hc : ∀ a, tmc.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (encIn a) (encC (c a)) (tc a) (sc a))
    (hf : ∀ a : {a // c a = true}, tmf.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace
      (encIn a) (encOut (f a)) (tf a) (sf a))
    (hg : ∀ a : {a // c a = false}, tmg.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace
      (encIn a) (encOut (g a)) (tg a) (sg a)) :
    ∃ C, ∃ (k : ℕ) (Q : Type) (_ : Finite Q) (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q), ∀ a,
      tm.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (encIn a) (encOut (if c a then f a else g a))
        (tc a + (if c a then tf a else tg a) + C)
        (sc a + (if c a then sf a else sg a) + C) := by
  let τ := eqWordT (encC true)
  have htest (a : α) : (τ.toTM.seq (rewindInput Bool)).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace
      (encC (c a)) (encTest (c a)) (4 * (encC (c a)).length + 8) 0 := by
    convert τ.computesTidily (encC (c a)) using 1
    simp only [τ, eqWordT_run_q₀, encC.injective.eq_iff]
    cases c a <;> simp [encTest_true, encTest_false]
  let l := (encC true).length + (encC false).length
  have hl (a : α) : (encC (c a)).length ≤ l := by cases c a <;> dsimp [l] <;> omega
  let K := 8 * l + 6 * max kc 0 + 40
  have hct (a : α) := ((hc a).comp (htest a) true).mono
    (t' := tc a + K) (s' := sc a + K)
    (by have hb := hl a; dsimp [l] at hb; dsimp [K, l]; omega)
    (by have hb := hl a; dsimp [l] at hb; dsimp [K, l]; omega)
  refine ⟨K + 5 * max (max kc 0 + 2) (max kf kg) + 20,
    _, _, inferInstance, iteTM ((τ.toTM.seq (rewindInput Bool)).comp tmc true) tmf tmg,
    fun a => ?_⟩
  have h := (hct a).ite (tm₁ := tmf) (tm₂ := tmg)
    (y := encOut (if c a then f a else g a))
    (t₁ := tf a) (s₁ := sf a) (t₂ := tg a) (s₂ := sg a)
    (fun hw => by
      have ha : c a = true := by cases ha : c a <;> simp_all [encTest_true, encTest_false]
      simpa [ha] using hf ⟨a, ha⟩)
    (fun hw => by
      have ha : c a = false := by cases ha : c a <;> simp_all [encTest_true, encTest_false]
      simpa [ha] using hg ⟨a, ha⟩)
  refine h.mono ?_ ?_ <;> cases ha : c a <;> simp_all [encTest_true, encTest_false] <;> omega

  obtain ⟨t₂, s₂, ht₂, hs₂, k₂, Q₂, _, tm₂, h₂⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.degree hg
  obtain ⟨c, k, Q, hfin, tm, h⟩ := hP.pair
    (t := fun a => t₁ a + t₂ a) (s := fun a => s₁ a + s₂ a)
    ⟨k₁, Q₁, inferInstance, tm₁, fun a =>
      ((h₁ a).mono (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)).computesInTimeAndSpace⟩
