theorem ite {encC : Bool ↪ List Bool} {c : α → Bool} {f g : α → β} {dc ec : ℕ}
    (hc : ComputableInDegree c encIn encC dc ec)
    (hf : ComputableInDegree (f ∘ Subtype.val)
      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = true)).trans encIn) encMid d₁ e₁)
    (hg : ComputableInDegree (g ∘ Subtype.val)
      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = false)).trans encIn) encMid d₂ e₂) :
    ComputableInDegree (fun x => if c x then f x else g x) encIn encMid
      (max dc (max d₁ d₂)) (max e₁ e₂) := by
  obtain ⟨tc, sc, htc, hsc, kc, Qc, _, tmc, hmc⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.degree hc
  obtain ⟨tf, sf, ⟨ctf, htf⟩, ⟨csf, hsf⟩, kf, Qf, _, tmf, hmf⟩ :=
    Internal.NormalForm.degree hf
  obtain ⟨tg, sg, ⟨ctg, htg⟩, ⟨csg, hsg⟩, kg, Qg, _, tmg, hmg⟩ :=
    Internal.NormalForm.degree hg
  obtain ⟨clf, hlf⟩ := hf.2
  obtain ⟨clg, hlg⟩ := hg.2
  -- the bounds of the branches, extended to all inputs
  let ext (u : {x // c x = true} → ℕ) (v : {x // c x = false} → ℕ) (x : α) : ℕ :=
    if h : c x = true then u ⟨x, h⟩ else v ⟨x, by simpa using h⟩
  obtain ⟨k, km, Qm, hmfin, tm, htm⟩ := Internal.conditional hmc
    (tf := ext tf tg) (sf := ext sf sg) (tg := ext tf tg) (sg := ext sf sg)
    (fun x => (hmf x).mono (by simp [ext, x.2]) (by simp [ext, x.2]))
    (fun x => (hmg x).mono (by simp [ext, x.2]) (by simp [ext, x.2]))
  have hext {u v} {cu du cv dv : ℕ}
      (hu : ∀ x : {x // c x = true}, u x ≤ cu * ((encIn x).length + 1) ^ du)
      (hv : ∀ x : {x // c x = false}, v x ≤ cv * ((encIn x).length + 1) ^ dv) :
      DegreeBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) (ext u v) (max du dv) :=
    ((DegreeBounded.mono_deg ⟨cu, fun _ => le_rfl⟩ (le_max_left du dv)).add
      (DegreeBounded.mono_deg ⟨cv, fun _ => le_rfl⟩ (le_max_right du dv))).mono fun x => by
      by_cases hx : c x = true
      · simpa [ext, hx] using Nat.le_add_right_of_le (hu ⟨x, hx⟩)
      · simpa [ext, hx] using Nat.le_add_left_of_le (hv ⟨x, by simpa using hx⟩)
  have hd : max d₁ d₂ ≤ max dc (max d₁ d₂) := le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨⟨_, _, ((htc.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).add ((hext htf htg).mono_deg hd)).add_const k,
    ((hsc.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).add ((hext hsf hsg).mono_deg hd)).add_const k,
    km, Qm, hmfin, tm, fun x => ((htm x).mono ?_ ?_).computesInTimeAndSpace⟩,
    (hext hlf hlg).mono fun x => ?_⟩ <;>
  · by_cases hx : c x = true <;> simp [ext, hx]

      0, _, inferInstance, Internal.WordPredicates.nonemptyT.toTM, fun n => ?_⟩,
      ⟨1, fun n => by simp⟩⟩
    have heq : encBool (decide (n ≠ 0)) = Internal.WordPredicates.nonemptyT.run
        Internal.WordPredicates.nonemptyT.q₀ (encUnary n) := by
      cases n with
      | zero => rfl

        change [true] = [true] ++ Internal.WordPredicates.nonemptyT.run true
          (List.replicate n true)
        rw [Internal.WordPredicates.nonemptyT_run_true, List.append_nil]
    simpa only [heq] using

  have hnot := (of_finite (encIn := encBool) (encMid := encBool) Bool.not).comp hn

private theorem roundMachine [hLE : ListEncoding encA encL] [hBA : PairEncoding encB encA encBA]
    [hSE : PairEncoding encL encB encS] [hOE : OptionEncoding encS encO]
    {ts ss : β × α → ℕ} {ks : ℕ} {Qs : Type} [Finite Qs]
    {tms : MultiTapeTM ks Bool Qs}
    (hstep : ∀ p : β × α, tms.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (encBA p)
      (encB (step p.1 p.2)) (ts p) (ss p)) :
    ∃ c, ∃ (k : ℕ) (Q : Type) (_ : Finite Q) (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q), ∀ o,
      tm.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (encO o) (encO (foldStep step a₀ b₀ o))
        (c * ((encO o).length + roundCost step a₀ b₀ encS ts o + 1))
        (c * ((encO o).length + roundCost step a₀ b₀ encS ss o + 1)) := by
  have hlist := hSE.fst.comp (hOE.getD ([], b₀))
  have htail := hLE.tail.comp hlist
  have harg : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (arg a₀ b₀) encO encBA :=
    (hSE.snd.comp (hOE.getD ([], b₀))).pair ((hLE.headD a₀).comp hlist)
  obtain ⟨ca, ka, Qa, _, tma, ha⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear harg
  let A := 6 * ca + 6 * max ka ks + 30
  have happ : ComputableInTimeAndSpace
      (fun o => step (arg a₀ b₀ o).1 (arg a₀ b₀ o).2) encO encB
      (fun o => A * ((encO o).length + ts (arg a₀ b₀ o) + 1))
      (fun o => A * ((encO o).length + ss (arg a₀ b₀ o) + 1)) := by
    refine ⟨_, _, inferInstance, tms.comp tma true, fun o =>
      (((ha o).comp (hstep _) true).mono ?_ ?_).computesInTimeAndSpace⟩
    all_goals have hl := (ha o).length_output_le; dsimp [A]; ring_nf at hl ⊢; omega
  obtain ⟨ct, kt, Qt, _, tmt, ht⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear htail
  obtain ⟨cn, hn⟩ := hSE.pair_mono
    (show ComputableInTimeAndSpace _ encO encL _ _ from
      ⟨kt, Qt, inferInstance, tmt, fun o => (ht o).computesInTimeAndSpace⟩) happ
  let N := cn * (ct + A + 2)
  have hnext : ComputableInBigO (next step a₀ b₀) encO encS
      (fun o => (encO o).length + ts (arg a₀ b₀ o))
      (fun o => (encO o).length + ss (arg a₀ b₀ o) + (encS (next step a₀ b₀ o)).length) := by
    refine ⟨N, hn.mono (fun o => ?_) (fun o => ?_)⟩
    all_goals dsimp [N, next]; ring_nf; omega
  obtain ⟨cN, kN, QN, _, tmN, hN⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.bigO hnext
  obtain ⟨co, ko, Qo, _, tmo, ho⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear hOE.some
  let C := cN + (co + 5) + 6 * max kN ko + 30
  have hsome : ∀ o, (tmo.comp tmN true).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace
      (encO o) (encO (some (next step a₀ b₀ o)))
      (C * ((encO o).length + ts (arg a₀ b₀ o) + (encS (next step a₀ b₀ o)).length + 1))
      (C * ((encO o).length + ss (arg a₀ b₀ o) + (encS (next step a₀ b₀ o)).length + 1)) := by
    intro o
    apply ((hN o).comp (ho _) true).mono
    all_goals dsimp [C]; ring_nf; omega
  obtain ⟨ce, ke, Qe, _, tme, he⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear (hLE.isEmpty.comp hlist)
  obtain ⟨cz, kz, Qz, _, tmz, hz⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear
    (ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace.const (encIn := encO) (encMid := encO)
      (none : Option (List α × β)))
  obtain ⟨ci, k, Q, hfinite, tm, htm⟩ := Internal.conditional
    (encIn := encO) (encOut := encO) (encC := encBool)
    (tmc := tme) (tmf := tmz) (tmg := tmo.comp tmN true)
    (tc := fun o => ce * ((encO o).length + 1))
    (sc := fun o => ce * ((encO o).length + 1))
    (tf := fun o => cz * ((encO o).length + 1))
    (sf := fun o => cz * ((encO o).length + 1))
    (tg := fun o => C * ((encO o).length + ts (arg a₀ b₀ o) +
      (encS (next step a₀ b₀ o)).length + 1))
    (sg := fun o => C * ((encO o).length + ss (arg a₀ b₀ o) +
      (encS (next step a₀ b₀ o)).length + 1))
    (c := fun o : Option (List α × β) => (o.getD ([], b₀)).1.isEmpty)
    (f := fun _ => (none : Option (List α × β)))
    (g := fun o => some (next step a₀ b₀ o)) he
    (fun o : {o : Option (List α × β) // (o.getD ([], b₀)).1.isEmpty = true} => hz o)
    (fun o : {o : Option (List α × β) // (o.getD ([], b₀)).1.isEmpty = false} => hsome o)
  refine ⟨ce + cz + C + ci + 1, k, Q, hfinite, tm, fun o => (htm o).mono ?_ ?_⟩
  all_goals
    dsimp only [foldStep, roundCost]
    split_ifs <;> ring_nf <;> omega

public theorem foldl {γ α β : Type u} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {encL : List α ↪ List Bool}
    {encBA : β × α ↪ List Bool} {encS : List α × β ↪ List Bool}
    {encO : Option (List α × β) ↪ List Bool}
    [hLE : ListEncoding encA encL] [hBA : PairEncoding encB encA encBA]
    [hSE : PairEncoding encL encB encS] [hOE : OptionEncoding encS encO]
    {list : γ → List α} {init : γ → β} {step : β → α → β}
    {t s : γ → ℕ} {tStep sStep : β × α → ℕ} {tMax sMax lMax : γ → ℕ}
    {kl ki ks : ℕ} {Ql Qi Qs : Type} [Finite Ql] [Finite Qi] [Finite Qs]
    {tml : MultiTapeTM kl Bool Ql} {tmi : MultiTapeTM ki Bool Qi}
    {tms : MultiTapeTM ks Bool Qs}
    (hlist : ∀ x, tml.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (encIn x) (encL (list x)) (t x) (s x))
    (hinit : ∀ x, tmi.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (encIn x) (encB (init x)) (t x) (s x))
    (hstep : ∀ p : β × α, tms.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (encBA p)
      (encB (step p.1 p.2)) (tStep p) (sStep p))
    (htMax : ∀ x i (hi : i < (list x).length),
      tStep (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x), (list x)[i]) ≤ tMax x)
    (hsMax : ∀ x i (hi : i < (list x).length),
      sStep (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x), (list x)[i]) ≤ sMax x)
    (hlMax : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ (list x).length,
      (encS ((list x).drop i, ((list x).take i).foldl step (init x))).length ≤ lMax x) :
    ∃ c, ∃ (k : ℕ) (Q : Type) (_ : Finite Q) (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q), ∀ x,
      tm.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (encIn x) (encB ((list x).foldl step (init x)))
        (c * (t x + ((list x).length + 1) * (tMax x + lMax x + 1)))
        (c * (s x + sMax x + lMax x + 1)) := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty γ with hγ | ⟨⟨x₀⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨0, 0, _, inferInstance, tidyCopy Bool, isEmptyElim⟩
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty α with hα | ⟨⟨a₀⟩⟩
  · refine ⟨1, ki, Qi, inferInstance, tmi, fun x => ?_⟩
    simpa only [Subsingleton.elim (list x) [], List.foldl_nil, one_mul] using
      (hinit x).mono (by omega) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨cF, kF, QF, _, tmF, hF⟩ := roundMachine (encA := encA) (encL := encL) (encS := encS)
    (encO := encO) step a₀ (init x₀) hstep
  set g := foldStep step a₀ (init x₀)
  let tAlong (o : Option (List α × β)) := (Finset.Iic (rounds o)).sup
    fun n => roundCost step a₀ (init x₀) encS tStep (g^[n] o)
  let sAlong (o : Option (List α × β)) := (Finset.Iic (rounds o)).sup
    fun n => roundCost step a₀ (init x₀) encS sStep (g^[n] o)
  let lAlong (o : Option (List α × β)) := (Finset.Iic (rounds o)).sup
    fun n => (encO (g^[n] o)).length
  have htAlong (o) : tAlong o = _ := rfl
  have hsAlong (o) : sAlong o = _ := rfl
  have hlAlong (o) : lAlong o = _ := rfl
  let ci := 2 * (kF + 3) * (6 * kF + 54) + (4 * kF + 42)
  have hloop (o) : (tmF.iterateWhile true).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace
      (encO o) (encO (g^[rounds o] o))
      ((cF + ci) * ((rounds o + 1) * (tAlong o + lAlong o + 1)))
      ((ci * (cF + 1) + 1) * (sAlong o + lAlong o + 1)) := by
    have hr := isLeast_rounds step a₀ (init x₀) hOE o
    have hround (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ rounds o) :
        tmF.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (encO (g^[n] o)) (encO (g^[n + 1] o))
          (cF * (tAlong o + lAlong o + 1)) (cF * (sAlong o + lAlong o + 1)) := by
      have ht := Finset.le_sup (f := fun n =>
        roundCost step a₀ (init x₀) encS tStep (g^[n] o)) (Finset.mem_Iic.mpr hn)
      have hs := Finset.le_sup (f := fun n =>
        roundCost step a₀ (init x₀) encS sStep (g^[n] o)) (Finset.mem_Iic.mpr hn)
      have hl := Finset.le_sup (f := fun n => (encO (g^[n] o)).length)
        (Finset.mem_Iic.mpr hn)
      change _ ≤ tAlong o at ht
      change _ ≤ sAlong o at hs
      change _ ≤ lAlong o at hl
      simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply'] using (hF (g^[n] o)).mono
        (t' := cF * (tAlong o + lAlong o + 1))
        (s' := cF * (sAlong o + lAlong o + 1))
        (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cF (by omega)) (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cF (by omega))
    have h := computesTidily_iterateWhile
      (w := fun n => encO (g^[n] o))
      (t := cF * (tAlong o + lAlong o + 1))
      (s := cF * (sAlong o + lAlong o + 1)) (l := lAlong o) hround
      (fun n hn => Finset.le_sup (f := fun n => (encO (g^[n] o)).length)
        (Finset.mem_Iic.mpr hn))
      (fun n hn he => Nat.not_le_of_lt hn (hr.2 (by simpa using he)))
      (by simpa using hr.1) true
    simpa only [Function.iterate_zero_apply] using h.mono
      (by dsimp [ci]; ring_nf; omega) (by dsimp [ci]; ring_nf; omega)
  obtain ⟨cp, hp⟩ := hSE.pair
    (show ComputableInTimeAndSpace list encIn encL t s from
      ⟨kl, Ql, inferInstance, tml, fun x => (hlist x).computesInTimeAndSpace⟩)
    (show ComputableInTimeAndSpace init encIn encB t s from
      ⟨ki, Qi, inferInstance, tmi, fun x => (hinit x).computesInTimeAndSpace⟩)
  have hpair : ComputableInBigO (fun x => (list x, init x)) encIn encS t
      (fun x => s x + lMax x) := by
    refine ⟨cp, hp.mono (fun _ => le_rfl) (fun x => ?_)⟩
    have hl := hlMax x 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left cp (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.add_le_add_left hl (s x)) 1)
  obtain ⟨cP, kP, QP, _, tmP, hP⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.bigO hpair
  obtain ⟨cs, kS, QS, _, tmS, hS⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear hOE.some
  let cStart := cP + cs + 6 * max kP kS + 30
  have hstart (x) : (tmS.comp tmP true).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace
      (encIn x) (encO (some (list x, init x)))
      (cStart * (t x + lMax x + 1)) (cStart * (s x + lMax x + 1)) := by
    have hl : (encS (list x, init x)).length ≤ lMax x := by
      simpa using hlMax x 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
    apply ((hP x).comp (hS _) true).mono
    all_goals
      have hlc := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs hl
      dsimp [cStart]
      ring_nf at hlc ⊢
      omega
  have hcs (p : List α × β) : (encO (some p)).length ≤ cs * ((encS p).length + 1) :=
    (hS p).length_output_le
  have hrounds (x : γ) : rounds (some (list x, init x)) = (list x).length := rfl
  have hstate (x : γ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ (list x).length) : g^[i] (some (list x, init x)) =
      some ((list x).drop i, ((list x).take i).foldl step (init x)) :=
    iterate_foldStep step a₀ (init x₀) _ _ hi
  have hstep_le (x : γ) {u : β × α → ℕ} {U : ℕ}
      (hu : ∀ i (hi : i < (list x).length),
        u (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x), (list x)[i]) ≤ U)
      {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ (list x).length) :
      roundCost step a₀ (init x₀) encS u (g^[i] (some (list x, init x))) ≤ U + lMax x := by
    rw [roundCost, hstate x hi, Option.getD_some]

    · have hi' : i < (list x).length := by
        by_contra hc
        simp [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega : (list x).length ≤ i)] at h
      have hdrop := List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hi'
      refine Nat.add_le_add ?_ ?_
      · simp only [arg, Option.getD_some, hdrop, List.headD_cons]
        exact hu i hi'
      · have := hlMax x (i + 1) hi'
        simp only [next, arg, Option.getD_some, hdrop, List.tail_cons, List.headD_cons]
        rwa [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hi', List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons,
          List.foldl_nil] at this
  have htx (x : γ) : tAlong (some (list x, init x)) ≤ tMax x + lMax x := by
    rw [htAlong]
    exact Finset.sup_le fun i hi => hstep_le x (htMax x) (by rwa [Finset.mem_Iic, hrounds] at hi)
  have hsx (x : γ) : sAlong (some (list x, init x)) ≤ sMax x + lMax x := by
    rw [hsAlong]
    exact Finset.sup_le fun i hi => hstep_le x (hsMax x) (by rwa [Finset.mem_Iic, hrounds] at hi)
  have hlen (x : γ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ (list x).length) :
      (encO (g^[i] (some (list x, init x)))).length ≤ cs * (lMax x + 1) := by
    rw [hstate x hi]
    exact (hcs _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs (Nat.add_le_add_right (hlMax x i hi) 1))
  have hlx (x : γ) : lAlong (some (list x, init x)) ≤ cs * (lMax x + 1) := by
    rw [hlAlong]
    exact Finset.sup_le fun i hi => hlen x (by rwa [Finset.mem_Iic, hrounds] at hi)
  obtain ⟨cf, kf, Qf, _, tmf, hf⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear
    (hSE.snd.comp (hOE.getD ([], init x₀)))
  let A := (cF + ci) * (cs + 2)
  let D := (ci * (cF + 1) + 1) * (cs + 2)
  have hrun (x) : (tmF.iterateWhile true).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace
      (encO (some (list x, init x))) (encO (some ([], (list x).foldl step (init x))))
      (A * (((list x).length + 1) * (tMax x + lMax x + 1)))
      (D * (sMax x + lMax x + 1)) := by
    have hfinal : g^[rounds (some (list x, init x))] (some (list x, init x)) =
        some ([], (list x).foldl step (init x)) := by
      rw [hrounds, iterate_foldStep step a₀ (init x₀) _ _ le_rfl]; simp
    rw [← hfinal]
    apply (hloop _).mono
    · dsimp only [A]; rw [hrounds]
      calc
        _ ≤ (cF + ci) * (((list x).length + 1) *
            ((cs + 2) * (tMax x + lMax x + 1))) := by
          apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left _
          apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left _

        _ = _ := by ring
    · dsimp only [D]
      calc
        _ ≤ (ci * (cF + 1) + 1) * ((cs + 2) * (sMax x + lMax x + 1)) := by
          apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left _
          have hs := hsx x; have hl := hlx x

        _ = _ := by ring

  let K₂ := 6 * max (max (max kP kS + 2) (kF + 1 + 2) + 2) kf + 20
  let C := cStart + A + D + (cf + 10) * cs + K₁ + K₂ + cf + 30
  refine ⟨C, _, _, inferInstance,
    tmf.comp ((tmF.iterateWhile true).comp (tmS.comp tmP true) true) true, fun x => ?_⟩
  have h := ((hstart x).comp (hrun x) true).comp
    (hf (some ([], (list x).foldl step (init x)))) true
  apply h.mono
  · have hi : (encO (some (list x, init x))).length ≤ cs * (lMax x + 1) := by
      apply (hcs _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs _)
      have hh := hlMax x 0 (Nat.zero_le _); simpa using Nat.add_le_add_right hh 1
    have he : (encO (some ([], (list x).foldl step (init x)))).length ≤
        cs * (lMax x + 1) := by
      apply (hcs _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs _)
      have hh := hlMax x (list x).length le_rfl
      simpa using Nat.add_le_add_right hh 1
    have hm : lMax x + 1 ≤ ((list x).length + 1) * (tMax x + lMax x + 1) := by

public theorem ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp {tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k₁ Symbol S₁}
    {tm₂ : MultiTapeTM k₂ Symbol S₂} {x w y : List Symbol} {t₁ s₁ t₂ s₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : tm₁.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x w t₁ s₁)
    (h₂ : tm₂.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace w y t₂ s₂) (mark : Symbol) :
    (tm₂.comp tm₁ mark).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y (t₁ + t₂ + 4 * w.length + 9)
      (s₁ + s₂ + 5 * w.length + (6 * max k₁ k₂ + 20)) := by
  set K := max k₁ k₂
  -- the work tape holding the intermediate word `w`
  set A : Fin (K + 2) := Fin.natAdd K 0
  have hA : Fin.append (fun _ : Fin K => ([] : List Symbol)) ![w, []] =
      Function.update (fun _ => []) A w := by
    funext l
    cases l using Fin.addCases with
    | left j => simp [A, Function.update_of_ne (Fin.castAdd_ne_natAdd j 0)]
    | right i => match i with | 0 | 1 => simp [A]
  -- phase 1: `tm₁` writes `w` to `A`
  have hQ₁ (ws' : Fin (K + 1 + 1) → List Symbol)
      (hv : (fun j => ws' (Fin.castSuccEmb j)) = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w)
      (hx : ∀ l ∉ Set.range Fin.castSuccEmb, ws' l = []) :
      ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) A w := by
    funext l
    induction l using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      rw [hx _ fun ⟨j, hj⟩ => Fin.castSucc_ne_last j hj]
      simp [A, Fin.ext_iff]
    | cast j =>
      rw [show ws' j.castSucc = _ from congrFun hv j]
      simp [A, Function.update_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
  have hp₁ := ((h₁.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_left k₁ k₂))).outputToWord.extendTapes
    Fin.castSuccEmb).imp (P' := fun inp ws => inp = x ∧ ws = fun _ => [])
    (Q' := fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) A w ∧ e = [])
    (fun _ _ ⟨hin, hws⟩ => ⟨hin, by simp [hws]⟩)
    (fun _ _ ws' _ ⟨_, hws⟩ ⟨⟨hv, he⟩, hx⟩ => ⟨hQ₁ ws' hv fun l hl => (hx l hl).trans
      (congrFun hws l), he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
  -- phase 2: `tm₂` reads `w` from `A` and emits `y`
  have hp₂ := (transformsTapes_inputFromWord mark
      (computesTidily_iff.mp (h₂.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_right k₁ k₂))))).imp
    (P' := fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) A w)
    (Q' := fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) A w ∧ e = y)
    (fun _ _ hws => hws.trans hA.symm) (fun _ _ _ _ _ ⟨hws', he⟩ => ⟨hws'.trans hA, he⟩)
    le_rfl le_rfl
  -- phase 3: clear `A`
  have hclear : Function.update (Function.update (fun _ => []) A w) A [] = fun _ => [] := by
    rw [Function.update_idem]
    exact Function.update_eq_self A _
  have hp₃ := (transformsTapes_clearWork_tapeEmb (Symbol := Symbol) A w).imp
    (P' := fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) A w)
    (Q' := fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = (fun _ => []) ∧ e = [])
    (fun _ _ hws => by rw [hws, Function.update_self])
    (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨hws', he⟩ => ⟨by rw [hws', hws, hclear], he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
  refine (transformsTapes_seq hp₁ (transformsTapes_seq hp₂ hp₃ fun _ _ _ _ _ hQ => hQ.1)
    fun _ _ _ _ _ hQ => hQ.1).imp (fun _ _ h => h) ?_ (by omega) (by omega)
  rintro _ _ _ _ _ ⟨_, _, _, ⟨-, rfl⟩, ⟨_, _, _, ⟨-, rfl⟩, ⟨hws, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨hws, by simp⟩

theorem computesInTimeAndSpace (h : tm.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input output t s) :
    tm.ComputesInTimeAndSpace input output t s := by
  obtain ⟨p, hh, hl, ht, hs⟩ := computesTidily_iff.mp h
  have hhead : p.head = tm.initCfg input := hh.trans (Cfg.init_eq_wordsCfg tm.q₀ input).symm

open Ite in
/-- If `tmc` computes `w` from `x` tidily, `tm₁` computes `y` from `x` tidily when `w` is non-empty
and `tm₂` does when `w` is empty, then `iteTM tmc tm₁ tm₂` computes `y` from `x` tidily, within the
bounds of `tmc` plus those of the machine that runs. -/
public theorem ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace.ite {tmc : MultiTapeTM k₀ Symbol S₀}
    {tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k₁ Symbol S₁} {tm₂ : MultiTapeTM k₂ Symbol S₂} {x w y : List Symbol}
    {tc sc t₁ s₁ t₂ s₂ : ℕ} (hc : tmc.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x w tc sc)
    (h₁ : w ≠ [] → tm₁.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y t₁ s₁)
    (h₂ : w = [] → tm₂.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y t₂ s₂) :
    (iteTM tmc tm₁ tm₂).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y
      (tc + (if w = [] then t₂ else t₁) + 4 * w.length + 6)
      (sc + (if w = [] then s₂ else s₁) + 3 * w.length + 5 * max k₀ (max k₁ k₂) + 10) := by
  set K := max k₀ (max k₁ k₂)
  -- phase 1: the test word on the last tape
  have hp₁ := (hc.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_left k₀ (max k₁ k₂)))).outputToWord
  -- phase 2: the branch, with the machine that does not run specified vacuously
  have hM₁ : TransformsTapes ((tm₁.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb ((le_max_left k₁ k₂).trans
        (le_max_right k₀ _)))).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)
      (fun inp ws => (inp = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w) ∧
        ws (Fin.last K) ≠ [])
      (fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w ∧ e = y)
      (if w = [] then 0 else t₁) (if w = [] then 0 else s₁ + (K - k₁) + (K + 1 - K)) := by
    split_ifs with hw
    · rintro _ _ _ ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, hne⟩
      simp [hw] at hne
    · exact (transformsTapes_padded _ (h₁ hw)).imp (fun _ _ h => h.1) (fun _ _ _ _ _ h => h)
        le_rfl le_rfl
  have hM₂ : TransformsTapes ((tm₂.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb ((le_max_right k₁ k₂).trans
        (le_max_right k₀ _)))).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)
      (fun inp ws => (inp = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w) ∧
        ws (Fin.last K) = [])
      (fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w ∧ e = y)
      (if w = [] then t₂ else 0) (if w = [] then s₂ + (K - k₂) + (K + 1 - K) else 0) := by
    split_ifs with hw
    · exact (transformsTapes_padded _ (h₂ hw)).imp (fun _ _ h => h.1) (fun _ _ _ _ _ h => h)
        le_rfl le_rfl
    · rintro _ _ _ ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, he⟩
      simp [hw] at he
  have hp₂ := transformsTapes_branch (Fin.last K) hM₁ hM₂

  have hp₃ := transformsTapes_clearWork_only (Symbol := Symbol) (Fin.last K) w

    exact ⟨hws, by simp⟩

  · split_ifs <;> omega

public theorem computesTidily_iterateWhile {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State}
    {w : ℕ → List Symbol} {r t s l : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ n ≤ r, tm.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (w n) (w (n + 1)) t s)
    (hl : ∀ n ≤ r, (w n).length ≤ l) (hne : ∀ n < r, w (n + 1) ≠ []) (hnil : w (r + 1) = [])
    (mark : Symbol) :
    (tm.iterateWhile mark).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (w 0) (w r)
      ((r + 1) * (t + 10 * l + 24) + 8 * l + 17)
      (2 * (k + 3) * (s + 10 * l + 6 * k + 44) + 5 * l + 4 * k + 26) := by
  have hl' (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ r) : (w (n + 1)).length ≤ l := by
    rcases hn.lt_or_eq with hn | rfl
    exacts [hl _ hn, by simp [hnil]]
  -- the word on the current tape at the start of round `n`
  let prev : ℕ → List Symbol := fun | 0 => [] | n + 1 => w n
  have hprev (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ r) : (prev n).length ≤ l := by
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [prev]
    | succ n => exact hl n (by omega)
  -- each round, within uniform bounds

    have := hprev n hn; have := hl n hn; have := hl' n hn
    exact (transformsTapes_iterateWhileRound mark (vp := prev n) (h n hn)).mono
      (t' := t + 10 * l + 23) (s' := s + 10 * l + 6 * k + 44) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hloop := (transformsTapes_repeatUntilBlank (nextTape k) (tm := iterateWhileRound tm mark)
    (P := fun n _ ws emitted => ws = words (prev n) (w n) ∧ emitted = [])
    (R := fun _ ws emitted => ws = words (w r) [] ∧ emitted = [])
    (fun n hn _ => (hround n hn.le).imp (fun _ _ hP => hP.1)
      (fun _ _ _ _ ⟨_, hem⟩ ⟨hws', he⟩ => ⟨⟨hws', by simp [hem, he]⟩,

      (fun _ _ _ _ ⟨_, hem⟩ ⟨hws', he⟩ => ⟨⟨by rw [hws', hnil], by simp [hem, he]⟩,
        by rw [hws', words_next, hnil]⟩) le_rfl le_rfl)).imp

  have hb : ∀ i, (b i : ℤ) = R i := fun i => Int.toNat_of_nonneg (h0 i).2

/-- If a machine without work tapes has a run path from its start to a halted configuration, then
following it with `Turing.MultiTapeTM.rewindInput` computes the output of that configuration
tidily: the rewind returns the input head from its position `p` in `p - 1 + 2` further steps. -/
public theorem computesTidily_seq_rewindInput_of_runPath {q : tm.RunPath input}
    (hh : q.head = wordsCfg input (some tm.q₀) (fun _ => []) []) (hl : q.last.Halted) :
    (tm.seq (rewindInput Symbol)).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input q.last.output
      (q.time + (q.last.inputPos.val - 1 + 2)) 0 := by
  let r := MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.ofDeterministic (rewindInput Symbol)
    (q.last.withState (some (rewindInput Symbol).q₀)) (q.last.inputPos.val - 1 + 2)
  have hr : r.last = wordsCfg input none (fun _ => []) q.last.output :=
    (runFrom_rewindInput q.last.inputPos q.last.workTapes q.last.workTapePos q.last.output).trans
      (Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl rfl rfl)
  obtain ⟨p, hph, hpl, hpt, -⟩ := exists_runPath_seq hl rfl (by rw [hr]; rfl)
  exact computesTidily_iff.mpr ⟨p, by rw [hph, hh]; rfl, by simp [hpl, hr, rightCfg], hpt,
    by simp [MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.space]⟩

/-- A machine without work tapes that computes `output` in time `t`, followed by
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.rewindInput`, computes `output` tidily in time `2 * t + 2`: in `t` steps the
input head moves at most `t` cells, so the rewind takes at most `t + 2` steps. -/

text:
public theorem ComputesInTimeAndSpace.computesTidily_seq_rewindInput {output : List Symbol}
    {t s : ℕ} (h : ComputesInTimeAndSpace tm input output t s) :
    (tm.seq (rewindInput Symbol)).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input output (2 * t + 2) 0 := by
  obtain ⟨⟨u, hu_halt, hu_out⟩, htime, -⟩ := h
  -- the computation path of `t` steps ends halted
  let q := MultiTapeNTM.ComputationPath.ofDeterministic tm input t
  have hl : q.last.Halted := htime q le_rfl
  -- the machine has halted after both `t` and `u` steps, so the outputs agree
  have hout : q.last.output = output := by
    change (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).output = output
    rcases le_total u t with hut | htu
    · rw [runFrom_eq_of_halt _ _ hut hu_halt, hu_out]
    · rw [← runFrom_eq_of_halt _ _ htu hl, hu_out]
  have hpos : q.last.inputPos.val ≤ 1 + t := by
    change ((tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).inputPos : ℕ) ≤ 1 + t
    simpa [Cfg.init] using inputPos_runFrom_le tm (tm.initCfg input) t
  have h := computesTidily_seq_rewindInput_of_runPath (q := q.toRunPath)
    (q.head_eq.trans (Cfg.init_eq_wordsCfg _ _)) hl
  rw [hout] at h
  exact h.mono (by change t + _ ≤ _; omega) le_rfl

theorem binary_add : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1 + p.2)
    (encPair encNat encNat) encNat := by
  let encS := encPair encBool (encPair encBits encBits)
  have hstep : ComputableInDegree (fun p : (Bool × List Bool × List Bool) × Bool =>
      addStep p.1 p.2) (encPair encS encBool) encS 1 1 := by
    have hs := ComputableInDegree.fst encS encBool
    have hrest := (ComputableInDegree.snd encBool (encPair encBits encBits)).comp hs
    have hr := (ComputableInDegree.fst encBits encBits).comp hrest
    have hflag := (ComputableInDegree.fst encBool (encPair encBits encBits)).comp hs
    have hout := (ComputableInDegree.snd encBits encBits).comp hrest
    have habc := (ComputableInDegree.snd encS encBool).prod
      (Internal.DecoderWords.bool_degree.comp hr |>.prod hflag)
    have hcarry := (ComputableInDegree.of_finite
      (encIn := encPair encBool (encPair encBool encBool))
      (encMid := encBool) fun t : Bool × Bool × Bool => carry t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).comp habc
    have hdigit := (ComputableInDegree.of_finite
      (encIn := encPair encBool (encPair encBool encBool))
      (encMid := encBool) fun t : Bool × Bool × Bool => t.1 ^^ (t.2.1 ^^ t.2.2)).comp habc
    exact (hcarry.prod ((Internal.DecoderWords.tail_degree.comp hr).prod
      (hout.append hdigit (encOut := encBits) fun _ => rfl))).mono
  have hbits : ComputableInPolyTime Nat.bits encNat encBits := of_eq fun _ => rfl
  have hfold := foldl' (encA := encBool) (encL := encBits) (encB := encS)
    (list := fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1.bits) (init := fun p => (false, p.2.bits, []))
    (hbits.comp (fst encNat encNat))
    ((const false).prod ((hbits.comp (snd encNat encNat)).prod (const [])))
    hstep.computableInPolyTime
    (B := fun p => 2 * (encPair encNat encNat p).length + 4)
    (PolyBounded.of_forall_le 4 1 fun _ => by simp only [pow_one]; omega) (by
      intro p i _
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := length_foldl_addStep (p.1.bits.take i) (false, p.2.bits, [])
      simp only [encS, length_encPair, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton, encBits_apply,
        encNat_apply, List.length_take, List.length_nil] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
      omega)
  let encAcc := encPair encBool encBits
  have hsuccStep : ComputableInDegree (fun p : (Bool × List Bool) × Bool =>
      succStep p.1 p.2) (encPair encAcc encBool) encAcc 1 1 := by
    have hs := ComputableInDegree.fst encAcc encBool
    have hb := ComputableInDegree.snd encAcc encBool
    have hflag := (ComputableInDegree.fst encBool encBits).comp hs
    have hout := (ComputableInDegree.snd encBool encBits).comp hs
    have hc := (ComputableInDegree.of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool encBool) (encMid := encBool)
      fun q : Bool × Bool => q.1 && q.2).comp (hflag.prod hb)
    have hd := (ComputableInDegree.of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool encBool) (encMid := encBool)
      fun q : Bool × Bool => q.1 ^^ q.2).comp (hflag.prod hb)
    exact (hc.prod (hout.append hd (encOut := encBits) fun _ => rfl)).mono

    have hword := ComputableInDegree.snd encBool encBits

        encAcc encBits 1 1 :=
      hword.append (ComputableInDegree.const (encMid := encBool) true)
        (encOut := encBits) (fun _ => rfl)

  have hs : ComputableInPolyTime id encS encS := id'
  have hfin := foldl' (encA := encBool) (encL := encBits) (encB := encAcc)
    hs.snd'.fst' (hs.fst'.prod hs.snd'.snd') hsuccStep.computableInPolyTime
    (B := fun s => (encS s).length + 3)
    (PolyBounded.of_forall_le 3 1 fun _ => by simp only [pow_one]; omega) (by
      intro s i _
      simp only [length_foldl_succStep, encS, encAcc, length_encPair, encBool_apply, id_eq,
        List.length_singleton, encBits_apply, List.length_take]

private theorem binaryMulPair :

  let encS := encPair encNat encNat

  have hleft := (fst encNat encNat).comp hs
  have hright := (snd encNat encNat).comp hs

  have hfold := foldl' (encA := encBool) (encL := encBits) (encB := encS)
    (list := fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1.bits) (init := fun p => (0, p.2))
    (hbits.comp (fst encNat encNat)) ((const 0).prod (snd encNat encNat)) hstep
    (B := fun p => 3 * (encPair encNat encNat p).length + 1)
    (PolyBounded.of_forall_le 4 1 fun _ => by simp only [pow_one]; omega) (by
      intro p i _
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := NatMul.foldl_mulStep_le (p.1.bits.take i) 0 p.2
      have hi' : (p.1.bits.take i).length ≤ p.1.size := by simp [← Nat.size_eq_bits_len]

      simp only [encS, length_encPair, encNat_apply, Nat.size_eq_bits_len] at hacc hsh hi' ⊢

theorem mapWithInput {α β γ : Type} {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool}
    {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {f : γ → α → β} {list : γ → List α}
    (hlist : ComputableInPolyTime list encIn (encList encA))
    (hf : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : γ × α => f p.1 p.2) (encPair encIn encA) encB) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => (list x).map (f x)) encIn (encList encB) := by
  obtain ⟨c, d, hsize⟩ := hf.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  obtain ⟨cl, dl, hlistSize⟩ := hlist.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  let L := fun n : ℕ => n + cl * (n + 1) ^ dl
  let bound := fun n : ℕ => L n * (2 * (c * (3 * L n + 3) ^ d) + 1)
  have hb : PolynomiallyBounded bound := by dsimp [bound, L]; fun_prop
  have houter := fst (encPair encIn (encList encB)) encA
  have hvalue := snd (encPair encIn (encList encB)) encA
  have hstep : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun q : (γ × List β) × α => q.1.2 ++ [f q.1.1 q.2])
      (encPair (encPair encIn (encList encB)) encA) (encList encB) :=
    (snoc encB).comp (houter.snd'.prod (hf.comp (houter.fst'.prod hvalue)))
  have hfold := foldlWith (encA := encA) (encL := encList encA) (encP := encIn)
    (encB := encList encB) (par := id) (list := list) (init := fun _ => [])
    (step := fun x mapped value => mapped ++ [f x value]) id' hlist (const []) hstep
    (PolyBounded.of_polynomiallyBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) hb) (by
      intro x i _
      simp only [foldlMap, List.nil_append, id_eq]
      have hlistBound : (encList encA (list x)).length ≤ L (encIn x).length :=
        (hlistSize x).trans (by dsimp [L]; omega)
      have heach : ∀ b ∈ ((list x).take i).map (f x),
          (encB b).length ≤ c * (3 * L (encIn x).length + 3) ^ d := by
        intro b hb
        obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hb
        have hain := (List.take_sublist i (list x)).subset ha
        have haBound := (SizedListEncoding.length_elem_le
          (encA := encA) (encL := encList encA) (list x) a hain).trans hlistBound
        apply (hsize (x, a)).trans
        apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
        apply Nat.pow_le_pow_left
        simp only [length_encPair]
        have hx : (encIn x).length ≤ L (encIn x).length := by dsimp [L]; omega
        omega
      apply (length_encList_le encB _ heach).trans
      dsimp [bound]
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
      simp only [List.length_map, List.length_take]
      exact (Nat.min_le_right i (list x).length).trans
        ((SizedListEncoding.length_le (encA := encA) (encL := encList encA) (list x)).trans
          hlistBound))
  simpa only [foldlMap, List.nil_append, id_eq] using hfold

private theorem ofTransducer {Q : Type} [Finite Q] (τ : Transducer Bool Q)
    {α β : Type*} {input : α ↪ List Bool} {output : β ↪ List Bool} {f : α → β}
    (hf : ∀ a, output (f a) = τ.run τ.q₀ (input a)) :
    ComputableInPolyTime f input output := by
  refine ⟨fun n => 2 * n + 3, fun _ => 0, by fun_prop, by fun_prop,
    0, _, inferInstance, τ.toTM, fun a => ?_⟩
  rw [hf a]
  exact τ.computesInTimeAndSpace_toTM (input a)

private theorem appendEncoded {γ α β δ : Type*} {input : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {output : δ ↪ List Bool}
    {left : γ → α} {right : γ → β} {result : γ → δ}
    (hleft : ComputableInPolyTime left input encA)
    (hright : ComputableInPolyTime right input encB)
    (hout : ∀ x, output (result x) = encA (left x) ++ encB (right x)) :
    ComputableInPolyTime result input output := by
  obtain ⟨c₁, d₁, k₁, S₁, _, tm₁, h₁⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hleft
  obtain ⟨c₂, d₂, k₂, S₂, _, tm₂, h₂⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hright
  let bound := fun n => c₁ * (n + 1) ^ d₁ + c₂ * (n + 1) ^ d₂ + 2 * max k₁ k₂
  have hb : PolynomiallyBounded bound := by dsimp [bound]; fun_prop
  refine ⟨bound, bound, hb, hb, max k₁ k₂, S₁ ⊕ S₂, inferInstance,
    appendTM tm₁ tm₂, fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [hout x]
  exact (((h₁ x).append (h₂ x)).mono (Nat.le_add_right _ _) le_rfl).computesInTimeAndSpace

@[fun_prop]
theorem snoc {α : Type} (enc : α ↪ List Bool) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : List α × α => p.1 ++ [p.2])
      (encPair (encList enc) enc) (encList enc) := by
  apply ofTransducer snocTransducer
  intro p
  change encList enc (p.1 ++ [p.2]) =
    snocTransducer.run none (Turing.MultiTapeTM.frame (encList enc p.1) ++ enc p.2)
  rw [snocRun]
  change ((p.1 ++ [p.2]).flatMap (Turing.MultiTapeTM.frame ∘ enc)) =
    p.1.flatMap (Turing.MultiTapeTM.frame ∘ enc) ++ Turing.MultiTapeTM.frame (enc p.2)
  simp only [List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil,
    Function.comp_apply, List.append_nil]

theorem range : ComputableInPolyTime List.range encUnary (encList encUnary) := by
  have hlist : ComputableInPolyTime (fun n : ℕ => List.replicate n true) encUnary encBits :=
    of_eq fun _ => rfl
  have hbound : PolyBounded (fun n => (encUnary n).length)
      (fun n => 2 * n + 1 + rangeOutputBound n) := by
    apply PolyBounded.of_forall_le 8 2
    intro n
    simp only [encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate]
    dsimp [rangeOutputBound]
    nlinarith
  have hfold := foldl' (encA := encBool) (encL := encBits) (encB := rangeEncoding)
    (list := fun n : ℕ => List.replicate n true) (init := fun _ => (0, [])) (step := rangeStep)
    hlist (const (0, [])) rangeStepCertificate hbound (by
      intro n i _
      rw [List.take_replicate, rangeFold, rangeStateSize]
      have hk := Nat.min_le_right i n
      have hsq := Nat.mul_le_mul hk hk
      dsimp [rangeOutputBound]
      nlinarith)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, rangeFold] using (snd encUnary (encList encUnary)).comp hfold

@[fun_prop]
theorem allWithInput {α γ : Type} {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {test : γ → α → Bool} {list : γ → List α}
    (hlist : ComputableInPolyTime list encIn (encList encA))
    (htest : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : γ × α => test p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encIn encA) encBool) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => (list x).all (test x)) encIn encBool := by
  have houter := fst (encPair encIn encBool) encA
  have hvalue := snd (encPair encIn encBool) encA
  have hstep : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun q : (γ × Bool) × α => q.1.2 && test q.1.1 q.2)
      (encPair (encPair encIn encBool) encA) encBool :=
    bool_and.comp (houter.snd'.prod (htest.comp (houter.fst'.prod hvalue)))
  have hfold := foldlWith (encA := encA) (encL := encList encA) (encP := encIn)
    (encB := encBool) (par := id) (list := list) (init := fun _ => true)
    (step := fun par state value => state && test par value)
    id' hlist (const true) hstep (PolyBounded.const 1) (by simp)
  simpa only [foldlAll, Bool.true_and, id_eq] using hfold

@[fun_prop]
theorem allConst {γ : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {ι : Type*} (l : List ι)
    {test : γ → ι → Bool}
    (htest : ∀ i ∈ l, ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => test x i) encIn encBool) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => l.all (test x)) encIn encBool := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact const true
  | cons a l ih =>
    exact bool_and.comp ((htest a (List.mem_cons_self ..)).prod
      (ih fun b hb => htest b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)))

@[fun_prop]
theorem map {α β : Type} {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {f : α → β}
    (hf : ComputableInPolyTime f encA encB) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (List.map f) (encList encA) (encList encB) := by
  obtain ⟨c, d, hfsize⟩ := hf.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  let bound := fun n : ℕ => n * (2 * (c * (n + 1) ^ d) + 1)
  have hb : PolynomiallyBounded bound := by dsimp [bound]; fun_prop
  have hstep : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : List β × α => p.1 ++ [f p.2])
      (encPair (encList encB) encA) (encList encB) :=
    (snoc encB).comp ((fst (encList encB) encA).prod (hf.comp (snd (encList encB) encA)))
  have hfold := foldl' (encA := encA) (encL := encList encA) (encB := encList encB)
    (list := id) (init := fun _ => []) (step := fun mapped value => mapped ++ [f value])
    id' (const []) hstep
    (PolyBounded.of_polynomiallyBounded (fun list : List α => (encList encA list).length) hb)
    (by
      intro list i _
      simp only [foldlMap, List.nil_append, id_eq]
      let n := (encList encA list).length
      have heach : ∀ b ∈ (list.take i).map f, (encB b).length ≤ c * (n + 1) ^ d := by
        intro b hb
        obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hb
        have hain := (List.take_sublist i list).subset ha
        have haBound := SizedListEncoding.length_elem_le
          (encA := encA) (encL := encList encA) list a hain
        exact (hfsize a).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c
          (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right haBound 1) d))
      apply (length_encList_le encB _ heach).trans
      dsimp [bound]
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
      simp only [List.length_map, List.length_take]
      exact (Nat.min_le_right i list.length).trans
        (SizedListEncoding.length_le (encA := encA) (encL := encList encA) list))
  simpa only [foldlMap, List.nil_append, id_eq] using hfold

theorem cons' {γ α : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {encA : α ↪ List Bool}
    {head : γ → α} {tail : γ → List α}

@[fun_prop]
theorem listAppend' {γ α : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {encA : α ↪ List Bool}
    {left right : γ → List α}
    (hleft : ComputableInPolyTime left encIn (encList encA))
    (hright : ComputableInPolyTime right encIn (encList encA)) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => left x ++ right x) encIn (encList encA) := by

    (left x).flatMap (Turing.MultiTapeTM.frame ∘ encA) ++
      (right x).flatMap (Turing.MultiTapeTM.frame ∘ encA)

theorem listReverseWithInput {γ α : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {encA : α ↪ List Bool}
    {list : γ → List α} (hlist : ComputableInPolyTime list encIn (encList encA)) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun a => (list a).reverse) encIn (encList encA) := by
  have hreverse : ComputableInPolyTime List.reverse (encList encA) (encList encA) := by
    have hfold := foldl' (encA := encA) (encL := encList encA)
      (step := fun reversed value => value :: reversed) (init := fun _ => []) id' (const [])

theorem foldl' {γ α β : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {encA : α ↪ List Bool}
    {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {encL : List α ↪ List Bool}
    [ListEncoding encA encL] [hS : SizedListEncoding encA encL]
    {list : γ → List α} {init : γ → β} {step : β → α → β}
    (hlist : ComputableInPolyTime list encIn encL)
    (hinit : ComputableInPolyTime init encIn encB)
    (hstep : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : β × α => step p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encB encA) encB)
    {B : γ → ℕ}
    (hB : PolyBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) B)
    (hstates : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ (list x).length,
      (encB (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x))).length ≤ B x) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => (list x).foldl step (init x)) encIn encB := by
  obtain ⟨cL, dL, hL⟩ := hlist.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  obtain ⟨cB, dB, hB⟩ := hB.exists_le
  let A := fun n : ℕ => cL * (n + 1) ^ dL
  let D := fun n : ℕ => cB * (n + 1) ^ dB
  let P := fun n => 3 * A n + 3 * D n + 3
  have hP : PolynomiallyBounded P := by dsimp [P, A, D]; fun_prop
  apply ComputableInPolyTime.foldl (encA := encA) (encB := encB) (encL := encL)
    (list := list) (init := init) (step := step) (encBA := encPair encB encA)
    (encS := encPair encL encB) (encO := encOption (encPair encL encB))
    hlist hinit hstep hP
  · intro x
    exact (hS.length_le _).trans ((hL x).trans (by dsimp [P, A, D]; omega))
  · intro x i hi
    have hs := (hstates x i hi.le).trans (hB x)
    have ha := (hS.length_elem_le (list x) _ (List.getElem_mem hi)).trans (hL x)
    simp only [length_encPair]
    dsimp [P, A, D]
    omega
  · intro x i hi
    have hs := (hstates x i hi).trans (hB x)
    have hl := (hS.length_drop_le (list x) i).trans (hL x)
    simp only [length_encPair]
    dsimp [P, A, D]
    omega

text:
theorem foldlWith {γ α β π : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {encA : α ↪ List Bool}
    {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {encL : List α ↪ List Bool} {encP : π ↪ List Bool}
    [ListEncoding encA encL] [SizedListEncoding encA encL]
    {par : γ → π} {list : γ → List α} {init : γ → β} {step : π → β → α → β}
    (hpar : ComputableInPolyTime par encIn encP)
    (hlist : ComputableInPolyTime list encIn encL)
    (hinit : ComputableInPolyTime init encIn encB)
    (hstep : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : (π × β) × α => step p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
      (encPair (encPair encP encB) encA) encB)
    {B : γ → ℕ}
    (hB : PolyBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) B)
    (hstates : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ (list x).length,
      (encB (((list x).take i).foldl (step (par x)) (init x))).length ≤ B x) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => (list x).foldl (step (par x)) (init x)) encIn encB := by
  have houter : ComputableInPolyTime (fun q : (π × β) × α => q.1)
      (encPair (encPair encP encB) encA) (encPair encP encB) :=
    ComputableInPolyTime.fst (encPair encP encB) encA
  have hfirst : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : π × β => p.1) (encPair encP encB) encP :=
    ComputableInPolyTime.fst encP encB
  have hstart : ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => (par x, init x)) encIn (encPair encP encB) :=
    ComputableInPolyTime.pair (enc₁ := encP) (enc₂ := encB) hpar hinit
  have hjoint : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun q : (π × β) × α => (q.1.1, step q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2))
      (encPair (encPair encP encB) encA) (encPair encP encB) :=
    ComputableInPolyTime.pair (enc₁ := encP) (enc₂ := encB)
      (ComputableInPolyTime.comp hfirst houter) hstep
  obtain ⟨cP, dP, hP⟩ := hpar.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  obtain ⟨cB, dB, hB⟩ := hB.exists_le
  let C := fun x => 2 * (encP (par x)).length + 1 + B x
  let P := fun n : ℕ => 2 * (cP * (n + 1) ^ dP) + 1 + cB * (n + 1) ^ dB
  have hp : PolynomiallyBounded P := by dsimp [P]; fun_prop
  obtain ⟨c, d, hcd⟩ := polynomiallyBounded_iff_le.mp hp
  have hC : ∀ x, C x ≤ c * ((encIn x).length + 1) ^ d := by
    intro x
    apply le_trans (b := P (encIn x).length) _ (hcd _)
    dsimp [C, P]
    have := hP x
    have := hB x
    omega
  have hfold := foldl' (encA := encA) (encB := encPair encP encB)
    (list := list) (init := fun x => (par x, init x))
    (step := fun state value => (state.1, step state.1 state.2 value))

theorem finite_cases {α β Tag : Type} [Finite Tag]
    {input : α ↪ List Bool} {output : β ↪ List Bool} {tagEncoding : Tag ↪ List Bool}
    {tag : α → Tag} {branch : Tag → α → β}
    (htag : ComputableInPolyTime tag input tagEncoding)
    (hbranch : ∀ choice, ComputableInPolyTime (branch choice) input output) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun a => branch (tag a) a) input output := by
  classical
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite Tag
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty Tag with
  | inl hempty =>
    let : IsEmpty α := ⟨fun a => isEmptyElim (tag a)⟩
    exact of_finite _
  | inr hnonempty =>
    let fallback := Classical.choice hnonempty
    have hselect (tags : List Tag) : ComputableInPolyTime (fun a =>
        tags.foldr (fun choice rest => if tag a = choice then branch choice a else rest)
          (branch fallback a)) input output := by
      induction tags with
      | nil => exact hbranch fallback
      | cons choice tags ih =>
        have htest := (of_finite (encIn := tagEncoding) (encOut := encBool)
          fun t : Tag => decide (t = choice)).comp htag
        simpa only [List.foldr_cons, Function.comp_def, Bool.decide_iff] using
          (htest.ite (hbranch choice) ih)
    simpa only [List.foldr_ite_eq_of_mem, Finset.mem_toList, Finset.mem_univ] using

theorem pi_apply [Fintype Index] (enc : Value ↪ List Bool) (i : Index) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun values : Index → Value => values i) (encPi enc) enc := by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty Value with

      ((fixedDrop (enc := enc) (Fintype.equivFin Index i).val).comp hlist)
    simpa [Function.comp_def, List.headD_eq_getD, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] using hlookup

theorem comp {f : β → γ} {g : α → β} (hf : ComputableInPolyTime f encMid encOut)
    (hg : ComputableInPolyTime g encIn encMid) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (f ∘ g) encIn encOut := by
  obtain ⟨c₁, d₁, k₁, S₁, _, tm₁, h₁⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hg
  obtain ⟨c₂, d₂, k₂, S₂, _, tm₂, h₂⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hf
  refine of_computesTidily (tm := tm₂.comp tm₁ true)
    (T := fun n => 6 * (c₁ * (n + 1) ^ d₁) + c₂ * (c₁ * (n + 1) ^ d₁ + 1) ^ d₂ +
      (6 * max k₁ k₂ + 20)) (by fun_prop) (fun a => (h₁ a).comp (h₂ (g a)) true)
    (fun a => ?_) (fun a => ?_) <;>
  · have hl := (h₁ a).length_output_le
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₂ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right hl 1) d₂)
    omega

theorem pair {α β₁ β₂ : Type u} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool} {enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool}
    {enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool} {enc : β₁ × β₂ ↪ List Bool} [PairEncoding enc₁ enc₂ enc]
    {f : α → β₁} {g : α → β₂} (hf : ComputableInPolyTime f encIn enc₁)
    (hg : ComputableInPolyTime g encIn enc₂) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => (f x, g x)) encIn enc := by
  obtain ⟨c₁, d₁, k₁, S₁, _, tm₁, h₁⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hf
  obtain ⟨c₂, d₂, k₂, S₂, _, tm₂, h₂⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hg
  obtain ⟨c, k, S, _, tm, h⟩ := PairEncoding.pair_mono (enc := enc)
    (t₁ := fun a => c₁ * ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d₁)
    (s₁ := fun a => c₁ * ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d₁)
    (t₂ := fun a => c₂ * ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d₂)
    (s₂ := fun a => c₂ * ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d₂)
    ⟨k₁, S₁, inferInstance, tm₁, fun a => (h₁ a).computesInTimeAndSpace⟩
    ⟨k₂, S₂, inferInstance, tm₂, fun a => (h₂ a).computesInTimeAndSpace⟩
  -- the encoded pair, kept in the space bound, is no longer than the time bound
  refine of_computesPlain (T := fun n =>
      c * (c₁ * (n + 1) ^ d₁ + c₂ * (n + 1) ^ d₂ + 1) +
      c * (c₁ * (n + 1) ^ d₁ + c₂ * (n + 1) ^ d₂ +
        c * (c₁ * (n + 1) ^ d₁ + c₂ * (n + 1) ^ d₂ + 1) + 1))
    (by fun_prop) h (fun a => ?_) (fun a => ?_)
  · exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  · have hl := (h a).length_output_le
    beta_reduce at hl
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (by omega)).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

theorem ite {encC : Bool ↪ List Bool} {c : α → Bool} {f g : α → β}
    (hc : ComputableInPolyTime c encIn encC) (hf : ComputableInPolyTime f encIn encMid)
    (hg : ComputableInPolyTime g encIn encMid) :

  obtain ⟨c₀, d₀, k₀, S₀, _, tm₀, h₀⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hc
  obtain ⟨c₁, d₁, k₁, S₁, _, tm₁, h₁⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hf
  obtain ⟨c₂, d₂, k₂, S₂, _, tm₂, h₂⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hg
  obtain ⟨k, K, S, _, tm, h⟩ := Internal.conditional (encOut := encMid)
    (f := f) (g := g)
    (tc := fun a => c₀ * ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d₀)
    (sc := fun a => c₀ * ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d₀)
    (tf := fun a => c₁ * ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d₁)
    (sf := fun a => c₁ * ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d₁)
    (tg := fun a => c₂ * ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d₂)
    (sg := fun a => c₂ * ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d₂)
    h₀ (fun x => h₁ x.1) (fun x => h₂ x.1)
  refine of_computesTidily (T := fun n =>
      c₀ * (n + 1) ^ d₀ + (c₁ * (n + 1) ^ d₁ + c₂ * (n + 1) ^ d₂) + k)

value and the step, a polynomially bounded `L` must bound the length of the list, the encoded
arguments of every step and the encoded intermediate states. -/

theorem foldl {γ α β : Type u} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {encL : List α ↪ List Bool}
    {encBA : β × α ↪ List Bool} {encS : List α × β ↪ List Bool}
    {encO : Option (List α × β) ↪ List Bool}
    [ListEncoding encA encL] [PairEncoding encB encA encBA] [PairEncoding encL encB encS]
    [OptionEncoding encS encO] {list : γ → List α} {init : γ → β} {step : β → α → β}
    (hlist : ComputableInPolyTime list encIn encL) (hinit : ComputableInPolyTime init encIn encB)
    (hstep : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : β × α => step p.1 p.2) encBA encB)
    {L : ℕ → ℕ} (hL : PolynomiallyBounded L)
    (hlen : ∀ x, (list x).length ≤ L (encIn x).length)
    (harg : ∀ x i (hi : i < (list x).length),
      (encBA (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x), (list x)[i])).length ≤ L (encIn x).length)
    (hstate : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ (list x).length,
      (encS ((list x).drop i, ((list x).take i).foldl step (init x))).length ≤
        L (encIn x).length) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => (list x).foldl step (init x)) encIn encB := by
  obtain ⟨c₁, d₁, k₁, S₁, _, tm₁, h₁⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hlist
  obtain ⟨c₂, d₂, k₂, S₂, _, tm₂, h₂⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hinit
  obtain ⟨c₃, d₃, k₃, S₃, _, tm₃, h₃⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.polyTime hstep
  -- the step on the arguments that occur, within the bound at the largest argument
  have hmax (x : γ) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < (list x).length) :
      c₃ * ((encBA (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x), (list x)[i])).length + 1) ^ d₃ ≤
        c₃ * (L (encIn x).length + 1) ^ d₃ :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₃ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right (harg x i hi) 1) d₃)
  obtain ⟨c, k, S, _, tm, h⟩ := Internal.FoldCompiler.foldl (encA := encA)
    (encL := encL) (encBA := encBA) (encS := encS) (encO := encO) (step := step)
    (t := fun x => c₁ * ((encIn x).length + 1) ^ d₁ + c₂ * ((encIn x).length + 1) ^ d₂)
    (s := fun x => c₁ * ((encIn x).length + 1) ^ d₁ + c₂ * ((encIn x).length + 1) ^ d₂)
    (tStep := fun p => c₃ * ((encBA p).length + 1) ^ d₃)
    (sStep := fun p => c₃ * ((encBA p).length + 1) ^ d₃)
    (tMax := fun x => c₃ * (L (encIn x).length + 1) ^ d₃)
    (sMax := fun x => c₃ * (L (encIn x).length + 1) ^ d₃)
    (lMax := fun x => L (encIn x).length)
    (fun x => (h₁ x).mono (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
    (fun x => (h₂ x).mono (Nat.le_add_left _ _) (Nat.le_add_left _ _))
    h₃ hmax hmax hstate
  refine of_computesTidily (T := fun n =>
      c * (c₁ * (n + 1) ^ d₁ + c₂ * (n + 1) ^ d₂ +
        (L n + 1) * (c₃ * (L n + 1) ^ d₃ + L n + 1)) +
      c * (c₁ * (n + 1) ^ d₁ + c₂ * (n + 1) ^ d₂ + c₃ * (L n + 1) ^ d₃ + L n + 1))
    (by fun_prop) h (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_)
  · have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (c₃ * (L (encIn x).length + 1) ^ d₃ + L (encIn x).length + 1)
      (Nat.add_le_add_right (hlen x) 1)
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (by omega)).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  · exact Nat.le_add_left _ _

    (hP₁ : P₁ ≤ 2 * L + 4) (hP₂ : P₂ ≤ 2 * L + 4) (hS : S ≤ R * (100 * (D * (Tm + L + 1)))) :
    cI * (TI + w + 1) + P₁ + 2 + (D * (Tm + 2 * L + 5) + 7) + (S + 1 + (3 * (P₂ + 1) + (w + 2)))
      ≤ 1000 * D * D * (TI + (R + 1) * (Tm + L + 1) + w) := by
  set Y := TI + (R + 1) * (Tm + L + 1) + w
  have hX : Tm + L + 1 ≤ Y := by
    have : Tm + L + 1 ≤ (R + 1) * (Tm + L + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
    omega
  have hRX : R * (Tm + L + 1) ≤ Y := by

lemma step_space_le (cI D SI Sm L K P P₂ sR : ℕ) (hcI : cI ≤ D) (hD : 100 ≤ D) (hK : K ≤ D)
    (hP : P ≤ 2 * L + 4) (hP₂ : P₂ ≤ 2 * L + 4) (hsR : sR ≤ 200 * (D * (Sm + L + 1))) :
    cI * (SI + 0 + 1) + 2 * P + 2 * K + 3 + (D * (Sm + 2 * L + 5) + 4 * L + 30 + 4 * K) +
      (2 * K * sR + K + (P₂ + 1 + K + K)) ≤ 1000 * D * D * (SI + Sm + L + 1) := by
  set Y := SI + Sm + L + 1
  have h₁ : cI * (SI + 0 + 1) ≤ D * Y := Nat.mul_le_mul hcI (by omega)
  have h₂ : D * (Sm + 2 * L + 5) ≤ D * (5 * Y) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
  have h₃ : 2 * K * sR ≤ 2 * D * (200 * (D * Y)) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hK) (hsR.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega))))
  have hY : 1 ≤ Y := by omega
  have h₅ : Y ≤ D * Y := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
  have h₄ : D * Y ≤ D * D * Y := by
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
  have e : 2 * D * (200 * (D * Y)) = 400 * (D * D * Y) := by ring
  have e' : D * (5 * Y) = 5 * (D * Y) := by ring
  have e'' : 1000 * D * D * Y = 1000 * (D * D * Y) := by ring
  have h₆ : D ≤ D * Y := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hY
  rw [e] at h₃
  rw [e'] at h₂
  rw [e'']
  omega

/-- **Compile step machines with plain resource-certified components.** Let the step machine
`⟨init x, halt, step⟩` halt on the input `encIn x` after `rounds x` steps with the output
`encOut (g x)`. If `init`, `halt` and `step` have plain resource certificates, then `g` has a tidy
implementation, in time
`O(TI x + (rounds x + 1) * (tMax x + lMax x + 1) + n)` and space `O(SI x + sMax x + lMax x + 1)`,
where `tMax`, `sMax` bound the time and space of `halt` and `step` along the run and `lMax` the
size of the states. The input head is never rewound between steps. -/

private theorem Internal.compileStepMachine {σ γ ω : Type} {encS : σ ↪ List Bool}
    {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {encOut : ω ↪ List Bool} (init : γ → σ) (halt : σ → Bool)
    (step : σ → Option Bool → σ × SignType × List Bool) (g : γ → ω) (rounds : γ → ℕ)
    {TI SI : γ → ℕ} {TH SH : σ → ℕ} {TS SS : σ × Option Bool → ℕ}
    (hinit : ComputableInO init encIn encS TI SI)
    (hhalt : ComputableInO halt encS encBool TH SH)
    (hstep : ComputableInO (fun p : σ × Option Bool => step p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encS (encOption encBool)) (encPair encS (encPair encMove encBits)) TS SS)
    (hrounds : ∀ x, (StepMachine.mk (init x) halt step).HaltsAt (encIn x) (rounds x))
    (hg : ∀ x, encOut (g x) =
      ((StepMachine.mk (init x) halt step).run (encIn x) (rounds x)).out)
    {tMax sMax lMax : γ → ℕ}
    (htMax : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ rounds x,
      TS (((StepMachine.mk (init x) halt step).run (encIn x) i).state, inputSymbolAt (encIn x)
        ((StepMachine.mk (init x) halt step).run (encIn x) i).pos) +
      TH ((StepMachine.mk (init x) halt step).run (encIn x) i).state ≤ tMax x)
    (hsMax : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ rounds x,
      SS (((StepMachine.mk (init x) halt step).run (encIn x) i).state, inputSymbolAt (encIn x)
        ((StepMachine.mk (init x) halt step).run (encIn x) i).pos) +
      SH ((StepMachine.mk (init x) halt step).run (encIn x) i).state ≤ sMax x)
    (hlMax : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ rounds x,
      (encS ((StepMachine.mk (init x) halt step).run (encIn x) i).state).length ≤ lMax x) :

      (fun x => c * (TI x + (rounds x + 1) * (tMax x + lMax x + 1) + (encIn x).length))

  have fN := peek_none.comp_linear (hS.fst'.prod hS.snd'.fst')

      (encIn := encBool) (encMid := encBool) fun b : Bool => !b)).comp_linear
      (hhalt.comp (peek_snd (enc := encAug encS)).fst'))

  obtain ⟨cN, ⟨kN, SN, _, tmN, htmN⟩, -⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.inO fN
  obtain ⟨cM, ⟨kM, SM, _, tmM, htmM⟩, -⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.inO fM
  obtain ⟨cC, ⟨kC, SC, _, tmC, htmC⟩, -⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.inO fC
  obtain ⟨cI, ⟨kI, SI', _, tmI, htmI⟩, -⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.inO fI
  -- the tapes: those of the machines, then the state `V`, the next state `N`, a flag `F` for
  -- copying, the flag `C` for another round and the move `Mv`
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M, M = kI + kE + kN + kM + kC + 8 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  let V : Fin (M + 5) := ⟨M, by omega⟩
  let N : Fin (M + 5) := ⟨M + 1, by omega⟩
  let F : Fin (M + 5) := ⟨M + 2, by omega⟩
  let C : Fin (M + 5) := ⟨M + 3, by omega⟩
  let Mv : Fin (M + 5) := ⟨M + 4, by omega⟩
  have hVN : V ≠ N := by simp [V, N, Fin.ext_iff]
  have hVF : V ≠ F := by simp [V, F, Fin.ext_iff]
  have hNF : N ≠ F := by simp [N, F, Fin.ext_iff]
  have hVC : V ≠ C := by simp [V, C, Fin.ext_iff]
  have hVM : V ≠ Mv := by simp [V, Mv, Fin.ext_iff]

    (by simp [Fin.ext_iff]) hVN

    (by simp [Fin.ext_iff]) hVM
  obtain ⟨eC, heC, heC'⟩ := exists_embedding_eq₂ (K := M + 5) (by omega)

  have hE := transformsTapes_inputFromWord_fun htmE heE
  have hN := transformsTapes_onWords htmN heN heN'
  have hMm := transformsTapes_onWords htmM heM heM'

  set w := encIn x

    (tN := fun _ => D * (2 * Tm + 8 * L + 20) + 2 * L + 10)
    (sN := fun _ => D * (2 * Sm + 8 * L + 20) + 12 * L + 40 + 4 * (M + 5))

    (sM := fun _ => D * (2 * L + 5) + 4 * L + 30 + 4 * (M + 5))

    (hg : ∀ x, encOut (g x) = ((m.withInit (init x)).run (encIn x) (rounds x)).out)
    {tMax sMax : γ → ℕ}
    (hmax : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ rounds x, T ((m.withInit (init x)).run (encIn x) i).state ≤ tMax x ∧
      S ((m.withInit (init x)).run (encIn x) i).state ≤ sMax x) :
    ComputableInBigO g encIn encOut
      (fun x => TI x + (rounds x + 1) * (tMax x + sMax x + SI x + 1) + (encIn x).length)
      fun x => SI x + sMax x := by
  obtain ⟨cS, hcS⟩ := hm.computable_step.length_le
  obtain ⟨cI, hcI⟩ := hinit.length_le
  -- the states along the run are within the space of the steps before them
  have hlen : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ rounds x, (encS ((m.withInit (init x)).run (encIn x) i).state).length ≤
      cS * (sMax x + 1) + cI * (SI x + 1) := by

    cases i with
    | zero => exact (hcI x).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
    | succ i =>
      have hh : (m.withInit (init x)).halt ((m.withInit (init x)).run (encIn x) i).state =
          false := by simpa using (hrounds x).2 i (by omega)
      rw [(m.withInit (init x)).run_succ_of_not_halt hh]
      have h₁ := hcS (((m.withInit (init x)).run (encIn x) i).state,
        inputSymbolAt (encIn x) ((m.withInit (init x)).run (encIn x) i).pos)
      have h₂ := length_le_encPair_left encS (encPair encMove encBits)
        (m.step ((m.withInit (init x)).run (encIn x) i).state
          (inputSymbolAt (encIn x) ((m.withInit (init x)).run (encIn x) i).pos))
      have h₃ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cS (Nat.add_le_add_right (hmax x i (by omega)).2 1)
      dsimp only [withInit, stepAt] at h₁ h₂ h₃ ⊢
      omega
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := MultiTapeTM.Internal.compileStepMachine (encS := encS)
    init m.halt m.step g rounds hinit hm.computable_halt hm.computable_step hrounds hg
    (tMax := fun x => 2 * tMax x) (sMax := fun x => 2 * sMax x)
    (fun x i hi => (Nat.add_le_add (hmax x i hi).1 (hmax x i hi).1).trans_eq (two_mul _).symm)
    (fun x i hi => (Nat.add_le_add (hmax x i hi).2 (hmax x i hi).2).trans_eq (two_mul _).symm)
    hlen
  obtain ⟨k, State, hfinite, tm, htm⟩ := hc
  refine .of_bounds ⟨k, State, hfinite, tm, fun x => (htm x).computesInTimeAndSpace⟩ ?_
    (.const_mul c (.of_le_linear (cS + cI + 3) (cS + cI + 1) fun x => by nlinarith))
  have hR := BigOLe.mul_left (fun x => rounds x + 1)
    (v := fun x => 2 * tMax x + (cS * (sMax x + 1) + cI * (SI x + 1)) + 1)
    (w := fun x => tMax x + sMax x + SI x + 1)
    (.of_le_linear (cS + cI + 2) 0 fun x => by nlinarith) fun _ => by omega
  have hR' := hR.trans_le (w := fun x => TI x + (rounds x + 1) * (tMax x + sMax x + SI x + 1) +
    (encIn x).length) fun x => by omega
  have hTI : TI ≼ fun x => TI x + (rounds x + 1) * (tMax x + sMax x + SI x + 1) +
      (encIn x).length := .of_le fun x => by omega
  have hn : (fun x => (encIn x).length) ≼ fun x => TI x + (rounds x + 1) *
      (tMax x + sMax x + SI x + 1) + (encIn x).length := .of_le fun x => by omega

theorem exists_coins_runPath (p : ntm.RunPath input) :
    ∃ coins : List Bool, coins.length ≤ Nat.card (Turing.Action k Bool State) * p.length ∧
      ntm.choiceTable.stepCoins coins (simCfg p.head) = simCfg p.last := by

    rcases hs : p.last.state with _ | state

      exact ⟨coins, hlen.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_succ _)), hc' ▸ hcoins⟩
    · obtain ⟨more, hmore, hstep⟩ := exists_coins_step hs hc
      refine ⟨coins ++ more, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.length_append, Nat.mul_succ]

theorem interpret_runConfigFrom_seq_list (oracle : (q : Query) → List (spec q))
    (cfg : Config k Symbol State₀ Oracle input) (firstTime secondTime : ℕ)
    (hfirst : ∀ result ∈ OracleComp.interpret oracle
      (first.runConfigFrom choose query firstTime cfg), result.tapes.state = none)
    (hsecond : ∀ result ∈ OracleComp.interpret oracle
      (first.runConfigFrom choose query firstTime cfg),
      ∀ final ∈ OracleComp.interpret oracle
        (second.runConfigFrom choose query secondTime (start second result)),
        final.tapes.state = none) :
    OracleComp.interpret oracle ((first.seq second).runConfigFrom choose query
      (firstTime + secondTime) (left second cfg)) =
      (OracleComp.interpret oracle (first.runConfigFrom choose query firstTime cfg)).flatMap
        (fun result => (OracleComp.interpret oracle
          (second.runConfigFrom choose query secondTime (start second result))).map right) := by
  induction firstTime generalizing cfg with
  | zero =>
    have hhalt := hfirst cfg (by simp)
    simp only [Nat.zero_add, runConfigFrom_zero, OracleComp.interpret_pure,
      List.pure_def, List.flatMap_singleton]
    rw [left_halted second cfg hhalt, Sequential.runConfigFrom_right first second choose hchoose,
      OracleComp.interpret_map]
    rfl
  | succ firstTime ih =>
    by_cases hhalt : cfg.tapes.state = none
    · have hsecond' := hsecond cfg (by simp [hhalt])
      simp only [runConfigFrom_halted first choose query _ cfg hhalt, OracleComp.interpret_pure,
        List.pure_def, List.flatMap_singleton]
      rw [left_halted second cfg hhalt, Sequential.runConfigFrom_right first second choose hchoose,
        OracleComp.interpret_map, Nat.add_comm (firstTime + 1) secondTime,
        interpret_runConfigFrom_add_of_halted_list second choose query oracle _
          secondTime (firstTime + 1) hsecond']
      rfl
    · have hsplit : firstTime + 1 = 1 + firstTime := by lia
      have hstep : firstTime + 1 + secondTime = 1 + (firstTime + secondTime) := by lia
      rw [hstep, runConfigFrom_add,
        Sequential.runConfigFrom_one first second choose hchoose query cfg hhalt,
        OracleComp.interpret_bind, OracleComp.interpret_map]
      change List.flatMap _ (List.map _ _) = _
      rw [List.flatMap_map, hsplit, runConfigFrom_add, OracleComp.interpret_bind]
      change List.flatMap _ _ = List.flatMap _ (List.flatMap _ _)
      rw [List.flatMap_assoc]
      apply List.flatMap_congr
      intro next hnext
      apply ih
      · intro final hfinal
        apply hfirst final
        rw [hsplit, runConfigFrom_add, OracleComp.interpret_bind]
        exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨next, hnext, hfinal⟩
      · intro final hfinal
        apply hsecond final
        rw [hsplit, runConfigFrom_add, OracleComp.interpret_bind]
        exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨next, hnext, hfinal⟩

theorem run_interpret_runConfigFrom_seq {OracleState : Type}
    (oracle : (q : Query) → StateT OracleState PMF (spec q))
    (cfg : Config k Symbol State₀ Oracle input) (firstTime secondTime : ℕ) (s : OracleState)
    (hfirst : ∀ result ∈
      ((OracleComp.interpret oracle
        (first.runConfigFrom choose query firstTime cfg)).run s).support,
      result.1.tapes.state = none)
    (hsecond : ∀ result ∈
      ((OracleComp.interpret oracle
        (first.runConfigFrom choose query firstTime cfg)).run s).support,
      ∀ final ∈ ((OracleComp.interpret oracle
        (second.runConfigFrom choose query secondTime
          (start second result.1))).run result.2).support,
        final.1.tapes.state = none) :
    (OracleComp.interpret oracle ((first.seq second).runConfigFrom choose query
      (firstTime + secondTime) (left second cfg))).run s =
      ((OracleComp.interpret oracle (first.runConfigFrom choose query firstTime cfg)).run s).bind
        (fun result => ((OracleComp.interpret oracle
          (second.runConfigFrom choose query secondTime (start second result.1))).run result.2).map
          (fun (final, s') => (right final, s'))) := by
  induction firstTime generalizing cfg s with
  | zero =>
    have hhalt := hfirst (cfg, s) (by simp)
    simp only [Nat.zero_add, runConfigFrom_zero, OracleComp.interpret_pure, StateT.run_pure,
      Probability.PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.pure_bind]
    rw [left_halted second cfg hhalt, Sequential.runConfigFrom_right first second choose hchoose,
      OracleComp.interpret_map, StateT.run_map, PMF.monad_map_eq_map]
  | succ firstTime ih =>
    by_cases hhalt : cfg.tapes.state = none
    · have hsecond' := hsecond (cfg, s) (by simp [hhalt])
      simp only [runConfigFrom_halted first choose query _ cfg hhalt, OracleComp.interpret_pure,
        StateT.run_pure, Probability.PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.pure_bind]
      rw [left_halted second cfg hhalt, Sequential.runConfigFrom_right first second choose hchoose,
        OracleComp.interpret_map, StateT.run_map, PMF.monad_map_eq_map,
        Nat.add_comm (firstTime + 1) secondTime,
        run_interpret_runConfigFrom_add_of_halted second choose query oracle _
          secondTime (firstTime + 1) s hsecond']
    · have hsplit : firstTime + 1 = 1 + firstTime := by lia
      have hstep : firstTime + 1 + secondTime = 1 + (firstTime + secondTime) := by lia
      rw [hstep, runConfigFrom_add,
        Sequential.runConfigFrom_one first second choose hchoose query cfg hhalt,
        OracleComp.interpret_bind, StateT.run_bind, Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind,
        OracleComp.interpret_map, StateT.run_map, PMF.monad_map_eq_map, PMF.bind_map]
      rw [hsplit, runConfigFrom_add, OracleComp.interpret_bind, StateT.run_bind,
        Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.bind_bind]
      apply Probability.PMF.bind_congr_on_support
      rintro ⟨next, s'⟩ hnext
      dsimp only [Function.comp_def]
      apply ih
      · intro final hfinal
        apply hfirst final
        rw [hsplit, runConfigFrom_add, OracleComp.interpret_bind, StateT.run_bind,
          Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind]
        exact (PMF.mem_support_bind_iff _ _ _).mpr ⟨(next, s'), hnext, hfinal⟩
      · intro final hfinal
        apply hsecond final
        rw [hsplit, runConfigFrom_add, OracleComp.interpret_bind, StateT.run_bind,
          Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind]
        exact (PMF.mem_support_bind_iff _ _ _).mpr ⟨(next, s'), hnext, hfinal⟩

theorem exists_viewStep_of_runPath (p : ntm.RunPath input) (hp : p.head = ntm.initCfg input) :
    ∃ finite, Relation.ReflTransGen ntm.ViewStep (ntm.initView input) finite ∧
      ViewRep finite p.last := by

theorem length_encFiniteCfg_le {s : ℕ} (hs : ntm.RunsInSpace input s)
    {finite : FiniteCfg k Bool State}
    (h : Relation.ReflTransGen ntm.ViewStep (ntm.initView input) finite) :
    (MultiTapeTM.encFiniteCfg finite).length ≤ viewLengthBound k State input.length s := by
  rw [viewLengthBound]
  obtain ⟨p, hrep⟩ := exists_computationPath_of_viewStep h
  have hspace : RunPath.space p.toRunPath ≤ s := hs p
  -- every work tape is stored in few cells
  have htape (tape : Fin k) : (finite.workTapes tape).spaceUsed ≤ 4 * s + 1 := by
    have hle : RunPath.spaceUsedByTape p.toRunPath tape ≤ s :=
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => RunPath.spaceUsedByTape p.toRunPath i)
        (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ tape)).trans hspace
    obtain ⟨hhead, hcells⟩ := RunPath.natAbs_lt_spaceUsedByTape p.toRunPath
      (fun i z => by rw [p.head_eq]; rfl) (fun i => by rw [p.head_eq]; rfl) tape
    exact (hrep.workTapes tape).spaceUsed_le (hhead.trans_le hle)
      fun z hz => (hcells z hz).trans_le hle
  have hwork : (MultiTapeTM.encPi (MultiTapeTM.encBiTape MultiTapeTM.encBool)
      finite.workTapes).length ≤ k * (2 * (12 * (4 * s + 1)) + 1) := by

private theorem runFrom_sweep (n : ℕ) (x : ℤ) (W S : ℤ → Option Symbol)
    (hS : ∀ j < n, S (x + j) ≠ none) (hn : S (x + n) = none) :
    (clearShadowed m₀ m₁).runFrom (cfg (some .sweep) ip W S x out) (n + 1) =
      cfg (some .home) ip
        (fun y => if x ≤ y ∧ y < x + n then (if S y = some m₀ then some m₁ else none) else W y)
        (fun y => if x ≤ y ∧ y < x + n then none else S y) (x + n - 1) out := by
  induction n generalizing x W S with
  | zero =>
    rw [runFrom_one, step_cfg (w₀ := none) (w₁ := none) (d := -1) (q' := some .home)
      (by simp [clearShadowed, by simpa using hn])]
    congr 1
    · funext y
      rw [Option.elim_none, ite_eq_right (by omega)]
    · funext y
      rw [Option.elim_none, ite_eq_right (by omega)]
    · simp only [SignType.coe_neg_one, Nat.cast_zero]
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1 (by simpa using hS 0 (by omega))
    rw [runFrom, Function.iterate_succ_apply, ← runFrom,
      step_cfg (w₀ := some (if m = m₀ then some m₁ else none)) (w₁ := some none) (d := 1)
        (q' := some .sweep) (by simp [clearShadowed, hm]), Option.elim_some, Option.elim_some,
      ih (x + ((1 : SignType) : ℤ)) _ _ (fun j hj => by
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (by simp only [SignType.coe_one]; omega)]
        convert hS (j + 1) (by omega) using 2
        simp only [SignType.coe_one]
        omega) (by
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (by simp only [SignType.coe_one]; omega)]
        convert hn using 2
        simp only [SignType.coe_one]
        omega)]
    simp only [SignType.coe_one]
    congr 1
    · funext y
      by_cases hy : y = x
      · subst hy
        simp [hm]
      · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hy]
        split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
    · funext y
      by_cases hy : y = x
      · subst hy
        simp
      · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hy]
        split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
    · omega

precondition of the second, the composed machine performs the two one after the other. -/
theorem transformsTapesAt_seq {tm₀ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State₀}
    {tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State₁}
    {P₀ P₁ : (input : List Symbol) → Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → Prop}
    {Q₀ Q₁ : (input : List Symbol) → Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) →
      Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → List Symbol → Prop} {t₀ s₀ t₁ s₁ : ℕ}
    (h₀ : TransformsTapesAt tm₀ P₀ Q₀ t₀ s₀) (h₁ : TransformsTapesAt tm₁ P₁ Q₁ t₁ s₁)
    (hmid : ∀ input p ws p' ws' e, P₀ input p ws → Q₀ input p ws p' ws' e → P₁ input p' ws') :
    TransformsTapesAt (tm₀.seq tm₁) P₀
      (fun input p ws p'' ws'' e => ∃ p' ws' e₀ e₁, Q₀ input p ws p' ws' e₀ ∧
        Q₁ input p' ws' p'' ws'' e₁ ∧ e = e₀ ++ e₁)
      (t₀ + t₁) (s₀ + s₁) := by
  intro input p ws out hP₀
  obtain ⟨p', ws', e₀, hrun₀, hQ₀, hspace₀⟩ := h₀ input p ws out hP₀
  obtain ⟨p'', ws'', e₁, hrun₁, hQ₁, hspace₁⟩ :=
    h₁ input p' ws' (out ++ e₀) (hmid input p ws p' ws' e₀ hP₀ hQ₀)
  have hstart : wordsCfgAt input p (some (tm₀.seq tm₁).q₀) ws out =
      leftCfg tm₁ (wordsCfgAt input p (some tm₀.q₀) ws out) := rfl
  refine ⟨p'', ws'', e₀ ++ e₁, ?_, ⟨p', ws', e₀, e₁, hQ₀, hQ₁, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hstart, runFrom_seq hrun₀ rfl (by simpa using hrun₁) rfl]
    rfl
  · rw [hstart]
    refine (space_seq_le hrun₀ rfl (by rw [withState_wordsCfgAt, hrun₁]; rfl)).trans ?_
    simpa using Nat.add_le_add hspace₀ hspace₁

public theorem TransformsTapes.extendTapes {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State}
    {P : (input : List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → Prop}
    {Q : (input : List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) →
      List Symbol → Prop} {t s : ℕ}
    (h : TransformsTapes tm P Q t s) (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') :
    TransformsTapes (tm.extendTapes e) (fun input ws => P input fun j => ws (e j))
      (fun input ws ws' emitted => Q input (fun j => ws (e j)) (fun j => ws' (e j)) emitted ∧
        ∀ l ∉ Set.range e, ws' l = ws l)
      t (s + (k' - k)) := by
  intro input ws out hP
  obtain ⟨v, emitted, hQ, p, hhead, hlast, htime, hspace⟩ := h input (fun j => ws (e j)) out hP
  -- `v` on the selected tapes, `ws` on the others
  let ws' : Fin k' → List Symbol := fun l => (partialInv e l).elim (ws l) v
  have hv : ∀ j, ws' (e j) = v j := by simp [ws']
  have hx : ∀ l ∉ Set.range e, ws' l = ws l := fun l hl => by simp [ws', partialInv_eq_none e hl]
  -- the path of the extended machine is the path of `tm`, placed on the selected tapes
  refine ⟨ws', emitted, ⟨by simpa only [hv] using hQ, hx⟩,
    p.map (embedHom tm e (fun l => tapeOfList (ws l)) (fun _ => 0)), ?_, ?_, htime,
    (space_map_embedHom_le ..).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right hspace _)⟩
  · simp only [RelSeries.head_map, hhead, embedHom_apply, extendTapes_q₀]
    exact embed_wordsCfg e (fun _ => rfl) fun _ _ => rfl
  · simp only [RelSeries.last_map, hlast, embedHom_apply]
    exact embed_wordsCfg e hv hx
