theorem run_frame (x : List Bool)
    (oracle : Operation × List Bool → StateT OracleState PMF (List Bool))
    (rem : List Bool) :
    ∀ (pre suf : List Bool) (h : x = pre ++ frame rem ++ suf)
      (out : List Bool) (ch : Operation → Channel Bool) (s : OracleState),
      (OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle n)) oracle)
        ((queryTakeCore op).runOracleConfigFrom (2 * rem.length + 2)
          (config x (some .marker) pre.length (by subst h; simp) out ch))).run s =
        (oracle (op, (ch op).queryBuffer ++ rem) s).map
          (fun (answer, s') =>
            (config x (some .copyReply) (pre.length + (frame rem).length)
              (by subst h; simp) out (Function.update ch op ⟨[], answer, 0⟩), s')) := by
  induction rem with
  | nil =>
    intro pre suf h out ch s
    have hlt : pre.length < x.length := by subst h; simp
    have hget : x[pre.length]'hlt = false := by
      cases h
      simp
    have hsym : (config x (some .marker) pre.length hlt.le out ch).tapes.inputSymbol =
        some false := by
      rw [inputSymbolInner pre.length (by simp [config]; lia) hlt]
      exact congrArg some hget
    have hstep₁ :
        (config x (some .marker) pre.length hlt.le out ch).step
          { inputTape := 1, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := none, state := some .submit }
          (fun _ => none) (fun _ => 0) =
        config x (some .submit) (pre.length + 1) (by subst h; simp) out ch := by
      refine Config.ext ?_ (funext fun _ => by simp [Config.step, config])
      refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl ?_ (by simp [Config.step, config, Turing.Action.apply])
      apply Fin.ext
      change (moveInputPos _ .pos).val = pre.length + 1 + 1
      rw [moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp only [config]; lia)]
      rfl
    change (OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle n)) oracle)
        ((queryTakeCore op).runOracleConfigFrom (0 + 1 + 1)
          (config x (some .marker) pre.length hlt.le out ch))).run s = _
    rw [run_interpret_runOracleConfigFrom_succ_step (queryTakeCore op) oracle (0 + 1)
      (config x (some .marker) pre.length hlt.le out ch) s rfl
      (fun _ => by rw [hsym]; rfl),
      hstep₁,
      run_interpret_runOracleConfigFrom_succ_query (queryTakeCore op) oracle 0
        (config x (some .submit) (pre.length + 1) (by subst h; simp) out ch) s rfl
        (fun _ => rfl)]
    dsimp only [runOracleConfigFrom, runConfigFrom, MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom]
    simp only [OracleComp.interpret_pure, StateT.run_pure, Probability.PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure,
      List.append_nil]
    rfl
  | cons b rem ih =>
    intro pre suf h out ch s
    have hlt₁ : pre.length < x.length := by subst h; simp
    have hget₁ : x[pre.length]'hlt₁ = true := by
      cases h
      simp
    have hsym₁ : (config x (some .marker) pre.length hlt₁.le out ch).tapes.inputSymbol =
        some true := by
      rw [inputSymbolInner pre.length (by simp [config]; lia) hlt₁]
      exact congrArg some hget₁
    have hlt₂ : pre.length + 1 < x.length := by subst h; simp
    have hget₂ : x[pre.length + 1]'hlt₂ = b := by
      cases h
      simp [List.getElem_append_right]
    have hsym₂ : (config x (some .bit) (pre.length + 1) hlt₂.le out ch).tapes.inputSymbol =
        some b := by
      rw [inputSymbolInner (pre.length + 1) (by simp [config]; lia) hlt₂]
      exact congrArg some hget₂
    let ch' := Function.update ch op
      { ch op with queryBuffer := (ch op).queryBuffer ++ [b] }
    have hstep₁ :
        (config x (some .marker) pre.length hlt₁.le out ch).step
          { inputTape := 1, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := none, state := some .bit }
          (fun _ => none) (fun _ => 0) =
        config x (some .bit) (pre.length + 1) hlt₂.le out ch := by
      refine Config.ext ?_ (funext fun _ => by simp [Config.step, config])
      refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl ?_ (by simp [Config.step, config, Turing.Action.apply])
      apply Fin.ext
      change (moveInputPos _ .pos).val = pre.length + 1 + 1
      rw [moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp only [config]; lia)]
      rfl
    have hstep₂ :
        (config x (some .bit) (pre.length + 1) hlt₂.le out ch).step
          { inputTape := 1, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := none, state := some .marker }
          (Function.update (fun _ => none) op (some b)) (fun _ => 0) =
        config x (some .marker) (pre ++ [true, b]).length
          (by subst h; simp) out ch' := by
      refine Config.ext ?_ ?_
      · refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl ?_ (by simp [Config.step, config, Turing.Action.apply])
        apply Fin.ext
        change (moveInputPos _ .pos).val = (pre ++ [true, b]).length + 1
        rw [moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp only [config]; lia)]
        simp [config]
      · funext other
        by_cases heq : other = op
        · subst other
          simp [Config.step, config, ch']
        · simp [Config.step, config, ch', heq]
    have h2 : 2 * (b :: rem).length + 2 = (2 * rem.length + 2) + 1 + 1 := by simp; lia
    have hsplit : pre ++ frame (b :: rem) ++ suf = (pre ++ [true, b]) ++ frame rem ++ suf := by
      simp [frame_cons, List.append_assoc]
    rw [h2,
      run_interpret_runOracleConfigFrom_succ_step (queryTakeCore op) oracle
        ((2 * rem.length + 2) + 1)
        (config x (some .marker) pre.length hlt₁.le out ch) s rfl
        (fun _ => by rw [hsym₁]; rfl),
      hstep₁,
      run_interpret_runOracleConfigFrom_succ_step (queryTakeCore op) oracle
        (2 * rem.length + 2)
        (config x (some .bit) (pre.length + 1) hlt₂.le out ch) s rfl
        (fun _ => by rw [hsym₂]; rfl),
      hstep₂,
      ih (pre ++ [true, b]) suf (h.trans hsplit) out ch' s]
    congr 1
    · funext p
      refine Prod.ext (Config.ext ?_ ?_) rfl
      · refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl ?_ rfl
        apply Fin.ext
        simp only [config, List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add,
          Nat.reduceAdd, length_frame, frame_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff]
        lia
      · funext other
        by_cases heq : other = op
        · subst other
          simp [config, ch']
        · simp [config, ch', heq]
    · simp [ch', List.append_assoc]

theorem computesTidily_queryTakePTM (op : Operation) (q : List Bool) (limit : ℕ) :
    (queryTakePTM op).ComputesTidily (encPair encBits encUnary (q, limit))
      (4 * q.length + 2 * limit + 6)
      (List.take limit <$> ProbOracleComp.query (op, q)) := by
  let x := encPair encBits encUnary (q, limit)
  have hx : x = frame q ++ List.replicate limit true := by
    simp [x, encPair_apply, encBits_apply, encUnary_apply]
  have hxlen : x.length = 2 * q.length + 1 + limit := by simp [hx]
  let t₁ := 2 * q.length + 2
  let t₂ := limit + 1
  let tCore := t₁ + t₂
  let tRew := 2 * q.length + limit + 3
  intro out₀ OracleState oracle s cfg htapes hbuf
  let cfg₀ : Config 0 Bool QueryTakeState Operation x :=
    QueryTakeCore.config x (some .marker) 0 (Nat.zero_le _) out₀ cfg.channels
  have hcfg : cfg = Sequential.left (ofDeterministic (rewindInput Bool)) cfg₀ := by
    refine Config.ext ?_ rfl
    rw [htapes]
    exact Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl rfl rfl
  -- Combine `run_frame` and `run_copyReply` for `queryTakeCore op`
  have hcore :
      (OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle n)) oracle)
        ((queryTakeCore op).runOracleConfigFrom tCore cfg₀)).run s =
      (oracle (op, q) s).map
        (fun (answer, s') =>
          (QueryTakeCore.config x none x.length le_rfl (out₀ ++ answer.take limit)
            (Function.update cfg.channels op ⟨[], answer, (limit : ℤ)⟩), s')) := by
    dsimp only [tCore, runOracleConfigFrom, runConfigFrom]
    rw [MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom_add, OracleComp.interpret_bind, StateT.run_bind,
      Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind]
    have hframe := QueryTakeCore.run_frame op x oracle q [] (List.replicate limit true)
      (by simp [hx]) out₀ cfg.channels s
    dsimp only [runOracleConfigFrom, runConfigFrom] at hframe
    simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add, hbuf op, List.nil_append] at hframe
    rw [hframe, PMF.bind_map]
    refine (PMF.bind_congr_on_support _ _ _ ?_).trans rfl
    rintro ⟨answer, s₁⟩ _
    dsimp only [Function.comp_def, t₂]
    have hcopy := QueryTakeCore.run_copyReply op x oracle limit (frame q) hx 0 answer out₀
      (Function.update cfg.channels op ⟨[], answer, 0⟩) (by simp) s₁
    dsimp only [runOracleConfigFrom, runConfigFrom] at hcopy
    simpa only [List.drop_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, Function.update_idem] using hcopy
  have hhalt₁ : ∀ result ∈ ((OracleComp.interpret
      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle n)) oracle)
      ((queryTakeCore op).runOracleConfigFrom tCore cfg₀)).run s).support,
      result.1.tapes.state = none := by
    intro result hresult
    rw [hcore] at hresult
    obtain ⟨⟨answer, s₁⟩, _, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hresult
    rfl
  have hrew (answer : List Bool) :
      (rewindInput Bool).runFrom
        (Sequential.start (ofDeterministic (rewindInput Bool) :
          MultiTapePTM 0 Bool RewindState Operation)
          (QueryTakeCore.config x none x.length le_rfl (out₀ ++ answer.take limit)
            (Function.update cfg.channels op ⟨[], answer, (limit : ℤ)⟩))).tapes tRew =
        wordsCfg x none (fun _ => []) (out₀ ++ answer.take limit) := by
    have htime : tRew = (⟨x.length + 1, by lia⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)).val - 1 + 2 := by
      dsimp only [tRew]
      lia
    rw [htime]
    exact (runFrom_rewindInput ⟨x.length + 1, by lia⟩ Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0
      (out₀ ++ answer.take limit)).trans (Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl rfl rfl)
  have hhalt₂ : ∀ result ∈ ((OracleComp.interpret
      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle n)) oracle)
      ((queryTakeCore op).runOracleConfigFrom tCore cfg₀)).run s).support,
      ∀ final ∈ ((OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle n)) oracle)
        ((ofDeterministic (rewindInput Bool)).runOracleConfigFrom tRew
          (Sequential.start (ofDeterministic (rewindInput Bool)) result.1))).run result.2).support,
        final.1.tapes.state = none := by
    rintro result hresult ⟨finalCfg, finalState⟩ hfinal
    rw [hcore] at hresult
    obtain ⟨⟨answer, s₁⟩, _, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hresult
    rw [run_interpret_runOracleConfigFrom_ofDeterministic, hrew answer,
      PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hfinal
    rcases Prod.mk.inj hfinal with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rfl
  have htotal : 4 * q.length + 2 * limit + 6 = tCore + tRew := by
    dsimp only [tCore, t₁, t₂, tRew]
    lia
  dsimp only [queryTakePTM]
  rw [htotal, hcfg,
    run_interpret_runOracleConfigFrom_seq (queryTakeCore op) (ofDeterministic (rewindInput Bool))
      oracle cfg₀ tCore tRew s hhalt₁ hhalt₂,
    hcore]
  constructor
  · simp only [PMF.bind_map, PMF.map_bind, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def,
      run_interpret_runOracleConfigFrom_ofDeterministic, hrew, PMF.pure_map,
      OracleComp.interpret_map, ProbOracleComp.interpret_query, StateT.run_map,
      PMF.monad_map_eq_map, Sequential.right, Cfg.mapState, wordsCfg_state, Option.map_none,
      id_eq]
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨finalCfg, finalState⟩ hfinal other
    rw [PMF.bind_map] at hfinal
    obtain ⟨⟨answer, s₁⟩, _, hfinal⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_bind_iff _ _ _).mp hfinal
    dsimp only [Function.comp_def] at hfinal
    rw [run_interpret_runOracleConfigFrom_ofDeterministic, hrew answer, PMF.pure_map,
      PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hfinal
    rcases Prod.mk.inj hfinal with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    by_cases heq : other = op
    · subst other
      simp [Sequential.right, Sequential.start, QueryTakeCore.config]
    · simp [Sequential.right, Sequential.start, QueryTakeCore.config, heq, hbuf other]

theorem computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace_runClosedCoins [Finite State]
    (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) :
    ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace
      (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => machine.runClosedCoins p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits := by
  obtain ⟨r, PrepareState, _, prepare, c, hp⟩ :=
    PairEncoding.exists_prepare encBits encBits (encPair encBits encBits)
  let size (p : List Bool × List Bool) := (encPair encBits encBits p).length + 1
  let time (p : List Bool × List Bool) := c * size p + (2 + (p.1.length + 1))
  let n := k + r + 3
  let b := (n + 1) * (c + 5)
  have hraw : ComputableInTimeAndSpace
      (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => machine.runClosedCoins p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits (fun p => b * size p) (fun p => b * size p) := by
    refine ⟨n, PrepareState ⊕ MarkWorkState ⊕ Option State, inferInstance,
      Replay.compile machine prepare, fun p => ?_⟩
    have hr := Replay.runFrom_compile machine prepare p.1 p.2 (encPair encBits encBits p)
      (c * size p) (c * size p) (hp p)
    have hh : ((Replay.compile machine prepare).runFrom
        ((Replay.compile machine prepare).initCfg (encPair encBits encBits p))
        (time p)).Halted := by
      rw [show time p = c * size p + (2 + (p.1.length + 1)) from rfl, hr]
      rfl
    have hlen := length_le_encPair_left encBits encBits p
    have ht₀ : time p + 1 ≤ (c + 5) * size p := by
      dsimp only [time, size]
      simp only [encBits_apply] at hlen
      nlinarith
    have ht : time p ≤ b * size p :=
      (Nat.le_succ _).trans (ht₀.trans
        (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left (c + 5) (Nat.succ_pos n))))
    have hs : n * (time p + 1) ≤ b * size p := by
      calc
        _ ≤ n * ((c + 5) * size p) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n ht₀
        _ ≤ (n + 1) * ((c + 5) * size p) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ n)
        _ = _ := (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    refine ⟨⟨time p, hh, ?_⟩, (runsInTime_of_halted hh).mono ht,
      runsInSpace_of_halted hh ?_⟩
    · change ((Replay.compile machine prepare).runFrom _
        (c * size p + (2 + (p.1.length + 1)))).output = _
      rw [hr]
      rfl
    · exact (MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.ofDeterministic (Replay.compile machine prepare)
        ((Replay.compile machine prepare).initCfg (encPair encBits encBits p))
        (time p)).space_le_mul_time_add_one.trans hs
  obtain ⟨d, htidy⟩ := hraw.exists_computableTidilyInTimeAndSpace
  refine ⟨(d + 5) * (b + 1), htidy.mono (fun p => ?_) (fun p => ?_)⟩ <;>
    dsimp only [size] <;>
    nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (d * b * (encPair encBits encBits p).length)]

noncomputable def itePTM (tmc : MultiTapePTM k₀ Bool State₀ Operation)
    (tm₁ : MultiTapePTM k₁ Bool State₁ Operation)

    (h₂ : w = [] → tm₂.ComputesTidily x t₂ prog₂) :

  set K := max k₀ (max k₁ k₂)

    ofDeterministic ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb (Fin.last K)))
  have hl : ∀ (OracleState : Type)
      (oracle : Operation × List Bool → StateT OracleState PMF (List Bool))
      (s : OracleState) (w' : List Bool) (s' : OracleState),

    intro _ _ _ w' s' hw'
    simp only [OracleComp.interpret_pure, StateT.run_pure,
      Probability.PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hw'
    rcases Prod.mk.inj hw' with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact le_rfl
  have hp₁ : (tmc.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_left k₀ (max k₁ k₂)))).outputToWord.RunsWords
      x (fun _ => []) [] (tc + (w.length + 2)) (pure ())
      (fun _ => Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w) (fun _ => []) := by
    have h₀ := (hc.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_left k₀ (max k₁ k₂)))).outputToWord_of_le
      hl []
    have hcongr : (tmc.extendTapes
        (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_left k₀ (max k₁ k₂)))).outputToWord.RunsWords
        x (fun _ => []) [] (tc + (w.length + 2)) ((fun _ => w) <$> pure ())
        (fun w' => Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w') (fun _ => []) := by
      simpa only [map_pure] using h₀
    intro OracleState oracle s cfg htapes hbuf
    obtain ⟨hlaw, hclean⟩ := hcongr OracleState oracle s cfg htapes hbuf
    refine ⟨?_, hclean⟩
    simpa only [OracleComp.interpret_pure, OracleComp.interpret_map, StateT.run_pure,
      StateT.run_map, Probability.PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.monad_map_eq_map, PMF.pure_map]
      using hlaw

      ((tm₁.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb ((le_max_left k₁ k₂).trans
        (le_max_right k₀ _)))).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)
      ((tm₂.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb ((le_max_right k₁ k₂).trans
        (le_max_right k₀ _)))).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)).RunsWords
      x (Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w) []
      ((if w = [] then t₂ else t₁) + 1)
      (if w = [] then prog₂ else prog₁)
      (fun _ => Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w) id := by
    by_cases hw : w = []

    · simp only [hw, ↓reduceIte]

theorem HaltsAt.lt_three_pow (enc : σ ↪ List Bool) {s t : ℕ}
    (hs : ∀ i, (enc (m.run input i).state).length ≤ s) (ht : m.HaltsAt input t) :
    t < (input.length + 2) * 3 ^ s := by
  -- a state of at most `s` bits is determined by its bits at the positions below `s`
  let bits (q : σ) (k : Fin s) : Option Bool := (enc q)[k.val]?
  have hbits {q q' : σ} (hq : (enc q).length ≤ s) (hq' : (enc q').length ≤ s)
      (h : bits q = bits q') : q = q' := by
    refine enc.injective (List.ext_getElem? fun k => ?_)
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k s with hk | hk
    · exact congrFun h ⟨k, hk⟩
    · simp [List.getElem?_eq_none (hq.trans hk), List.getElem?_eq_none (hq'.trans hk)]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun i => ((m.run input i).pos, bits (m.run input i).state))
      (Set.Iic t) := fun i hi j hj h => ht.injOn_core m hi hj (Prod.ext
    (hbits (hs i) (hs j) (congrArg Prod.snd h)) (congrArg Prod.fst h))
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _ (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
    (Set.InjOn.mono (by simp) hinj : Set.InjOn _ (Finset.Iic t : Set ℕ))
  simp only [Nat.card_Iic, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin,
    Fintype.card_pi, Fintype.card_option, Fintype.card_bool, Finset.prod_const,
    Finset.card_univ, show (2 + 1 : ℕ) = 3 from rfl] at hcard
  omega

      ⟨{ s with phase := .run }, 1, out⟩ := by

      simp [MultiTapeTM.inputSymbolAt, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (show r < x.length by omega)]

lemma run_f_iterate {uf : ℕ} (hf : f.HaltsAt x uf) (sg : σg) (hsg : g.halt sg = false) (pg : ℕ)
    (out : List Out) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ uf) :
    (g.comp f).stepCfg^[r]
        (⟨⟨(sg, pg), .run, f.init, .start pg⟩, 1, out⟩ : Cfg (CompState σf σg) Out x) =
      ⟨⟨(sg, pg), .run, (f.run x r).state, (f.run x r).out.foldl .push (.start pg)⟩,
        (f.run x r).pos, out⟩ := by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih =>
    have hfh : f.halt (f.run x r).state = false := by simpa using hf.2 r (by omega)
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih (by omega), f.run_succ_of_not_halt hfh]

theorem simulates_comp {uf : ℕ} (hf : f.HaltsAt x uf) :
    (g.comp f).Simulates x (g.stepCfg (input := (f.run x uf).out)) (fun c => g.halt c.state)
      Cfg.out (fun c C => C = roundCfg f x c) (compPeriod f x uf) where
  step c _ hC hc := by
    rw [hC, compPeriod, Nat.add_comm (uf + 1), Function.iterate_add_apply, round_g f g x hf c hc]
    exact rewindStart_iterate f g x ⟨_, .run, f.init, _⟩ _ _

theorem along_run_comp {uf ug : ℕ} (hf : f.HaltsAt x uf) (hg : g.HaltsAt (f.run x uf).out ug)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ ug * compPeriod f x uf) :
    ((g.comp f).run x i).state.Along f g x uf ug := by
  set y := (f.run x uf).out with hy
  obtain ⟨q, j, hj, hqu, hround, hrun⟩ := (simulates_comp f g x hf).exists_round
    (run_zero_comp f g x) (u := ug) (fun i hi => Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr (hg.2 i hi))
    (by simp [compPeriod]) hi
  simp only [Nat.zero_add] at hround hrun
  rw [hrun, show (g.comp f).run x (q * compPeriod f x uf) = roundCfg f x (g.run y q) from hround]
  have hpos (q : ℕ) : (g.run y q).pos.val ≤ y.length + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (g.run y q).pos.isLt
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj₀
  · exact ⟨⟨q, by omega, rfl⟩, ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, rfl⟩, hpos q, Nat.zero_le _⟩
  have hq : q < ug := hqu.resolve_right (by omega)
  have hgq : g.halt (g.run y q).state = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr (hg.2 q hq)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge uf j with hjf | hjf
  · obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + (uf + 1) := ⟨j - (uf + 1), by omega⟩
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, round_g f g x hf _ hgq]
    obtain ⟨ph, hph⟩ := rewindStart_iterate_le f g x
      ⟨((g.stepCfg (g.run y q)).state, (g.stepCfg (g.run y q)).pos.val), .run, f.init,
        .start (g.stepCfg (g.run y q)).pos.val⟩ (g.stepCfg (g.run y q)).out (f.run x uf).pos
      (j := j') (by simp only [compPeriod] at hj; omega)
    rw [hph, ← run_succ]
    exact ⟨⟨q + 1, hq, rfl⟩, ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, rfl⟩, hpos (q + 1), Nat.zero_le _⟩
  · rw [roundCfg, run_f_iterate f g x hf _ hgq _ _ hjf]
    have hlen := (f.out_run_prefix (input := x) hjf).length_le
    refine ⟨⟨q, hq.le, rfl⟩, ⟨j, hjf, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Countdown.k_foldl, Countdown.start, ← hy]
      have := hpos q
      omega
    · simp only [Countdown.len_foldl, Countdown.start, ← hy] at hlen ⊢
      omega

/-- **Composition within small space.** If `f` and `g` are computable within the time bounds
`tf`, `tg` and the space bounds `sf`, `sg`, then `g ∘ f` is computable within space linear in
`sf a + sg (f a)` plus the logarithms of the lengths of the input and of the intermediate value,
without ever writing down the intermediate value. Its time is polynomial in the time bounds, the
length of the input and the space bound. -/
public theorem ComputableInTimeAndSpace.comp_space {α β γ : Type} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
    {encMid : β ↪ List Bool} {encOut : γ ↪ List Bool} {f : α → β} {g : β → γ}
    {tf sf : α → ℕ} {tg sg : β → ℕ} (hf : ComputableInTimeAndSpace f encIn encMid tf sf)
    (hg : ComputableInTimeAndSpace g encMid encOut tg sg) :
    ∃ c, ComputableInTimeAndSpace (g ∘ f) encIn encOut
      (fun a => c * ((tg (f a) + 1) * (tf a + 1) * ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ 2 *
        (sf a + sg (f a) + (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length +
          (encNat ((encMid (f a)).length + 1)).length + 1) ^ 3))
      (fun a => c * (sf a + sg (f a) + (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length +
          (encNat ((encMid (f a)).length + 1)).length + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨kf, Sf, _, tmf, htmf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨kg, Sg, _, tmg, htmg⟩ := hg
  let := Fintype.ofFinite Sf
  let := Fintype.ofFinite Sg
  obtain ⟨ef, hef⟩ := Countable.exists_injective_nat Sf
  obtain ⟨eg, heg⟩ := Countable.exists_injective_nat Sg

  set dg := desc ⟨eg, heg⟩ eBit tmg

  choose ug hug_le hug using fun a => exists_haltsAt_of_runsInTime (htmg (f a)).2.1
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := computableTidily_compose (encIn := encIn) (encOut := encOut) (g ∘ f) dg df
    (fun a => (encMid (f a)).map eBit) uf ug
    (fun a => run_desc_halted _ tmf (encIn a) (huf a))
    (fun a => (congrArg Prod.fst (simulate_eq df _ (uf a))).symm.trans
      (simulate_desc_output _ tmf (encIn a) (htmf a).1 (huf a)))
    (fun a n hn => by
      obtain ⟨b, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hn
      cases b <;> decide)
    (fun a => run_desc_halted _ tmg (encMid (f a)) (hug a))
    (fun a => haltsAt_pos (hug a))

      rw [simulate_desc_output _ tmg (encMid (f a)) (htmg (f a)).1 (hug a), List.map_map]

public theorem ComputableInTimeAndSpace.comp_logSpace {α β γ : Type} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
    {encMid : β ↪ List Bool} {encOut : γ ↪ List Bool} {f : α → β} {g : β → γ}

    (hg : ComputableInTimeAndSpace g encMid encOut tg
      fun b => kg * (encNat ((encMid b).length + 1)).length)
    (hlen : ∀ a, (encMid (f a)).length + 1 ≤ ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d) :
    ∃ c, ComputableInTimeAndSpace (g ∘ f) encIn encOut
      (fun a => c * ((tg (f a) + 1) * (tf a + 1) * ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ 2 *
        (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length ^ 3))
      (fun a => c * (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length) := by
  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := hf.comp_space hg
  set M := kf + (kg + 1) * (d + 1) + 3
  have hM (a : α) : kf * (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length +
      kg * (encNat ((encMid (f a)).length + 1)).length + (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length +
        (encNat ((encMid (f a)).length + 1)).length + 1 ≤
          M * (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length := by
    have hℓ : 1 ≤ (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length :=
      ComputableTidilyInO.length_encNat_mono (m := 1) (by omega)
    have hy : (encNat ((encMid (f a)).length + 1)).length ≤
        (d + 1) * (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length :=
      (ComputableTidilyInO.length_encNat_mono (hlen a)).trans
        ((length_encNat_pow_le _ d).trans (by nlinarith))
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left kg hy
    have e : M * (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length =
        kf * (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length +
          kg * ((d + 1) * (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length) +
          (d + 1) * (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length +
          3 * (encNat ((encIn a).length + 1)).length := by
      simp only [M]
      ring
    omega
  exact ⟨c * M ^ 3, h.mono (fun a => log_time_le c M _ _ _ _ (hM a))
    fun a => log_space_le c M _ _ (hM a)⟩

theorem extractWord_eq_some_iff {b : BiTape Symbol} {l : List Symbol} :
    b.extractWord = some l ↔ b = BiTape.mk₁ l := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold extractWord at h
    split_ifs at h with hleft
    have hleft_eq : b.left = StackTape.nil := by
      apply StackTape.ext
      exact List.isEmpty_iff.mp hleft
    have hcons_list : (StackTape.cons b.head b.right).toList = (StackTape.mapSome l).toList := by
      rw [unmapSome_eq_some_iff.mp h, StackTape.mapSome]
    have hcons : StackTape.cons b.head b.right = StackTape.mapSome l :=
      StackTape.ext hcons_list
    have h1 : b.head = (StackTape.mapSome l).head := by
      have := congrArg StackTape.head hcons
      rwa [StackTape.head_cons] at this
    have h2 : b.right = (StackTape.mapSome l).tail := by
      have := congrArg StackTape.tail hcons
      rwa [StackTape.tail_cons] at this
    have hhead : b.head = (BiTape.mk₁ l).head :=
      h1.trans (by cases l <;> rfl)
    have hright : b.right = (BiTape.mk₁ l).right :=
      h2.trans (by cases l <;> rfl)
    have hleft_mk₁ : b.left = (BiTape.mk₁ l).left :=
      hleft_eq.trans (by cases l <;> rfl)
    rcases b with ⟨bh, bl, br⟩
    dsimp only at hhead hleft_mk₁ hright
    rw [hhead, hleft_mk₁, hright]
  · rintro rfl
    exact extractWord_mk₁ l

theorem primrec_step (tm : SingleTapeTM Symbol) :
    Primrec tm.step := by
  have htr : Primrec₂ tm.tr := Primrec₂.mk (Primrec.dom_finite _)
  have hstate : Primrec fun c : tm.Cfg => c.state :=
    Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.of_equiv (e := tm.cfgEquiv))
  have htape : Primrec fun c : tm.Cfg => c.BiTape :=
    Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.of_equiv (e := tm.cfgEquiv))
  have hact_sym : Primrec fun a : Stmt Symbol => a.symbol :=
    Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.of_equiv (e := stmtEquiv Symbol))
  have hact_dir : Primrec fun a : Stmt Symbol => a.movement :=
    Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.of_equiv (e := stmtEquiv Symbol))
  have hsome : Primrec₂ fun (c : tm.Cfg) (q : tm.State) =>
      let res := tm.tr q c.BiTape.head
      (⟨res.2, (c.BiTape.write res.1.symbol).optionMove res.1.movement⟩ : tm.Cfg) := by
    have hres : Primrec fun p : tm.Cfg × tm.State => tm.tr p.2 p.1.BiTape.head :=
      htr.comp Primrec.snd (BiTape.primrec_head.comp (htape.comp Primrec.fst))
    have hnew_tape : Primrec fun p : tm.Cfg × tm.State =>
        (p.1.BiTape.write (tm.tr p.2 p.1.BiTape.head).1.symbol).optionMove
          (tm.tr p.2 p.1.BiTape.head).1.movement :=
      BiTape.primrec_optionMove.comp
        (BiTape.primrec_write.comp (htape.comp Primrec.fst)
          (hact_sym.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hres)))
        (hact_dir.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hres))
    exact Primrec₂.mk <| (Primrec.of_equiv_symm (e := tm.cfgEquiv)).comp
      (Primrec.pair (Primrec.snd.comp hres) hnew_tape)
  exact (Primrec.option_casesOn hstate (Primrec.const none)
    (Primrec.option_some.comp (hsome.comp Primrec.fst Primrec.snd)).to₂).of_eq fun ⟨q, t⟩ => by
      cases q <;> rfl

private theorem iterate_eq_of_bounded_encoding {α : Type} (f : α → α) (enc : α ↪ List Bool)
    (initial final : α) (width : ℕ) (hfinal : f final = final)
    (hterm : ∃ n, f^[n] initial = final)
    (hsize : ∀ n, (enc (f^[n] initial)).length ≤ width) :
    f^[2 ^ (width + 1)] initial = final := by
  classical
  let first := Nat.find hterm
  have hfirst : f^[first] initial = final := Nat.find_spec hterm
  have hmin : ∀ n < first, f^[n] initial ≠ final := fun n hn => Nat.find_min hterm hn
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun n => enc (f^[n] initial)) (Finset.range (first + 1)) := by
    intro i hi j hj heq
    have hi' : i ≤ first := by
      simpa only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hi
    have hj' : j ≤ first := by
      simpa only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hj
    have hcfg : f^[i] initial = f^[j] initial := enc.injective heq
    suffices hle : ∀ i j, i < j → j ≤ first → f^[i] initial = f^[j] initial → False by
      rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | h | h

    (next : Statement k State) (scratch : Option Bool) (busy : Bool) :

  cases direction <;> cases atLeft

theorem stepAux_stack_bound (q : Stmt Γ Λ σ) (v : σ) (store : ∀ k, List (Γ k))
    (bound : ℕ) (h : ∀ k, (store k).length ≤ bound) :
    ∀ k, ((stepAux q v store).stk k).length ≤ bound + pushBound q := by
  induction q generalizing v store bound with
  | push j f q ih =>
    have hupdate (k : K) : (Function.update store j (f v :: store j) k).length ≤ bound + 1 := by
      by_cases hk : k = j
      · subst k; simpa using Nat.add_le_add_right (h j) 1
      · simpa only [Function.update_of_ne hk] using (h k).trans (Nat.le_add_right bound 1)
    simpa only [stepAux, pushBound, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm 1] using
      ih v _ (bound + 1) hupdate
  | peek j f q ih => exact ih _ _ bound h
  | pop j f q ih =>
    apply ih _ _ bound
    intro k
    by_cases hk : k = j
    · subst k
      simp only [Function.update_self, List.length_tail]
      exact (Nat.sub_le _ _).trans (h j)
    · simpa only [Function.update_of_ne hk] using h k
  | load f q ih => exact ih _ _ bound h
  | branch f q₁ q₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro k
    cases hf : f v
    · simpa only [stepAux, hf, Bool.cond_false, pushBound] using
        (ih₂ v store bound h k).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_max_right _ _) bound)
    · simpa only [stepAux, hf, Bool.cond_true, pushBound] using
        (ih₁ v store bound h k).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_max_left _ _) bound)
  | goto f => exact h
  | halt => exact h

theorem graphLinearCorr_sq_le (g : Graph (β → γ)) {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (k : ℕ) {B : ℕ → (γ → Bool) → Bool} (hB : ∀ w, IsOdd (B w))
    (A : ℕ → (β → Bool) → Bool) :
    graphLinearCorr g δ B A ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - 2 * δ) ^ (2 * k) + (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 - (g.toGraph projectionEval).unsatVal) := by
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ 1 - 2 * δ := by linarith
  have hunsat1 : (g.toGraph projectionEval).unsatVal ≤ 1 :=
    (g.toGraph projectionEval).unsatVal_le_one
  rcases g.edges.eq_nil_or_concat with hnil | ⟨l, d, hconcat⟩
  · have hempty : IsEmpty (Fin g.edges.length) := by simp [hnil]
    rw [show graphLinearCorr g δ B A = 0 by simp [graphLinearCorr], sq, mul_zero]
    positivity
  · have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < g.edges.length := by
      rw [hconcat, List.length_concat]
      positivity
    refine (sq_expect_le_expect_sq univ _).trans ?_
    rw [Fintype.expect_eq_sum_div_card, Fintype.card_fin, div_le_iff₀ hm_pos]
    calc (∑ i : Fin g.edges.length,
          linearCorr (g.edges.get i).constraint δ
            (B (g.edges.get i).dst) (A (g.edges.get i).src) ^ 2)
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin g.edges.length,
            ((1 - 2 * δ) ^ (2 * k) +
              (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ x : β,
                spectralWeight k (A (g.edges.get i).src) x *
                  spectralWeight k (B (g.edges.get i).dst) ((g.edges.get i).constraint x)) :=
        sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
          linearCorr_sq_le (g.edges.get i).constraint hδ0 hδ1 k
            (hB (g.edges.get i).dst) (A (g.edges.get i).src)
      _ = g.edges.length * (1 - 2 * δ) ^ (2 * k) +
            (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin g.edges.length, ∑ x : β,
              spectralWeight k (A (g.edges.get i).src) x *
                spectralWeight k (B (g.edges.get i).dst) ((g.edges.get i).constraint x) := by
        rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_sum]
      _ ≤ g.edges.length * (1 - 2 * δ) ^ (2 * k) +
            (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * (g.edges.length * (1 - (g.toGraph projectionEval).unsatVal)) := by
        gcongr
        exact sum_spectralWeight_le_unsatVal g k B A
      _ = ((1 - 2 * δ) ^ (2 * k) + (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 - (g.toGraph projectionEval).unsatVal)) *
            g.edges.length := by ring

theorem gapLabelCover_dichotomy_lt_one {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ0 : 0 < δ)
    (hδ1 : δ < 1 / 2) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∀ {β γ : Type} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β]
      [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq γ] [Nonempty γ] {g : Graph (β → γ)}, g.edges ≠ [] →
      (g ∈ (GapLabelCover β γ 1 η).yes →
        ∃ (B : ℕ → (γ → Bool) → Bool) (A : ℕ → (β → Bool) → Bool),
          (∀ w, IsOdd (B w)) ∧
            graphLinearProb g δ B A = 1 - δ) ∧
      (g ∈ (GapLabelCover β γ 1 η).no →
        ∀ (B : ℕ → (γ → Bool) → Bool) (A : ℕ → (β → Bool) → Bool),
          (∀ w, IsOdd (B w)) →
            graphLinearProb g δ B A ≤ 1 / 2 + 4 * ε) := by
  obtain ⟨k, θ, hθ, hparam⟩ := exists_params hε hδ0 hδ1
  let η := min θ (1 / 2)
  have hη : 0 < η := lt_min hθ (by norm_num)
  have hη1 : η < 1 := (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hparam' : (1 - 2 * δ) ^ (2 * k) + (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * η ≤ (8 * ε) ^ 2 :=
    (add_le_add le_rfl
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_left θ (1 / 2)) (sq_nonneg (k : ℝ)))).trans hparam
  refine ⟨η, hη, hη1, fun {β γ} _ _ _ _ _ _ {g} hg => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro hyes
    simp only [GapLabelCover, PromiseProblem.mem_yes_gapMax] at hyes
    have hunsat0 : (g.toGraph projectionEval).unsatVal = 0 :=
      le_antisymm (by linarith) (g.toGraph projectionEval).unsatVal_nonneg
    have hsat : (g.toGraph projectionEval).Satisfiable :=
      (g.toGraph projectionEval).unsatVal_eq_zero_iff.1 hunsat0
    obtain ⟨ℓ, r, hℓr⟩ := (satisfiable_toGraph_projectionEval_iff g).1 hsat
    obtain ⟨hfold, hlin⟩ := graphLinearProb_longCode_of_satisfies hg δ hℓr
    exact ⟨fun w => longCode (r w), fun u => longCode (ℓ u), hfold, hlin⟩
  · intro hno B A hB
    simp only [GapLabelCover, PromiseProblem.mem_no_gapMax] at hno
    have hcorr := graphLinearCorr_le_of_unsatVal g hδ0.le hδ1.le k hε.le hno.1 hparam' hB A
    have hlin := graphLinearProb_eq_add_graphLinearCorr hg δ B A
    linarith

theorem card_toFinset_vertices_toIndependentSet {φ : CNF ℕ} (h3 : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length = 3) :
    (toIndependentSet φ).1.1.toFinset.card = 3 * φ.length := by
  have hset : (toIndependentSet φ).1.1.toFinset =
      (Finset.range φ.length ×ˢ Finset.range 3).image fun p => Nat.pair p.1 p.2 := by
    ext v
    rw [List.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_image]
    simp only [toIndependentSet, List.mem_map]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨i, j, l⟩, ho, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨hi, hj, -⟩ := mem_occurrences.1 ho
      exact ⟨(i, j), Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨Finset.mem_range.2 hi,
        Finset.mem_range.2 ((h3 _ (List.getElem_mem hi)) ▸ hj)⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨i, j⟩, hij, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨hi, hj⟩ := Finset.mem_product.1 hij
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi hj
      have hj' : j < φ[i].length := (h3 _ (List.getElem_mem hi)).symm ▸ hj
      exact ⟨(i, j, φ[i][j]), mem_occurrences.2 ⟨hi, hj', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hset, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ fun p q h => Prod.ext (Nat.pair_eq_pair.1 h).1
    (Nat.pair_eq_pair.1 h).2, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_range, Finset.card_range,
    Nat.mul_comm]

/-- **MAX-E3SAT reduces to minimum vertex cover**: Karp's graph of a formula with `m` clauses of
three, not necessarily distinct, literals has `3 m` vertices, so the target `m` of an independent
set becomes the target `2 m` of a vertex cover (`IndependentSet.toVertexCover`), and soundness `s`
for MAX-E3SAT becomes the ratio `1 + (1 - s) / 2` for vertex covers. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

theorem polyTimeReducible_GapExactThreeSAT_GapVertexCover (hs : s < 1) :
    PromiseProblem.PolyTimeReducible encCNF (encPair encGraph encNat) (GapExactThreeSAT s)
      (GapVertexCover (1 + (1 - s) / 2)) := by
  have hred (φ : CNF ℕ) (h3 : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length = 3) :
      IndependentSet.toVertexCover (SAT.toIndependentSet φ) =
        ((SAT.toIndependentSet φ).1, 2 * φ.length) := by
    rw [IndependentSet.toVertexCover, SAT.card_toFinset_vertices_toIndependentSet h3,
      SAT.toIndependentSet_snd, ite_eq_left (show φ.length ≤ 3 * φ.length by omega)]
    congr 1
    omega
  have hτ (φ : CNF ℕ) (h3 : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length = 3) :
      ((SAT.toIndependentSet φ).1.vertexCoverNum : ℝ) =
        3 * φ.length - (SAT.toIndependentSet φ).1.indepNum := by
    have hle := Graph.indepNum_le_card (SAT.toIndependentSet φ).1
    rw [SAT.card_toFinset_vertices_toIndependentSet h3] at hle
    rw [Graph.vertexCoverNum_eq_card_sub_indepNum, SAT.card_toFinset_vertices_toIndependentSet h3,
      Nat.cast_sub hle]
    push_cast
    ring
  refine ⟨fun φ => IndependentSet.toVertexCover (SAT.toIndependentSet φ),
    .of_tidy (IndependentSet.computableInPolyTime_toVertexCover.tidy.comp
      SAT.computableInPolyTime_toIndependentSet.tidy), fun φ hφ => ?_, fun φ hφ => ?_⟩
  · rw [yes_GapExactThreeSAT] at hφ
    obtain ⟨h3, hsat⟩ := hφ
    have hα : (φ.length : ℝ) ≤ (SAT.toIndependentSet φ).1.indepNum := by
      exact_mod_cast Graph.le_indepNum_iff.2 ((SAT.toIndependentSet_mem_iff φ).2 hsat)
    simp only [GapVertexCover, PromiseProblem.mem_yes_gapMin, hred φ h3, hτ φ h3]
    push_cast
    linarith
  · obtain ⟨h3, hval⟩ := (mem_no_GapExactThreeSAT hs).1 hφ
    have hm : (0 : ℝ) < φ.length := by
      exact_mod_cast CNF.length_pos_of_unsatVal_pos (by linarith)
    have hα := SAT.indepNum_toIndependentSet_le φ
    simp only [GapVertexCover, PromiseProblem.mem_no_gapMin, hred φ h3, hτ φ h3]
    push_cast
    constructor <;> nlinarith

theorem div_le_unsatVal_toThreeSAT_toCNF (hpairs : ∀ p, p ∈ pairs) (g : Graph (α → α → Bool)) :
    (g.toGraph id).unsatVal / (pairs.length * max 1 (2 * k - 2) : ℕ) ≤
      (toThreeSAT (toCNF e pairs g)).unsatVal := by
  rw [CNF.le_unsatVal_iff]
  intro τ
  set φ := toCNF e pairs g
  set σ := readLabel e (τ ∘ splitVarToNat ∘ Sum.inl)
  set m := max 1 (2 * k - 2)
  have hcount : #((g.toGraph id).unsatEdges σ) ≤ (toThreeSAT φ).countUnsat τ :=
    (card_unsatEdges_le_countUnsat e pairs hpairs g _).trans <| by
      rw [toThreeSAT, CNF.countUnsat_relabel]
      exact CNF.countUnsat_comp_inl_le_countUnsat_to3CNF φ (τ ∘ splitVarToNat)
  have hval : (g.toGraph id).unsatVal ≤ #((g.toGraph id).unsatEdges σ) / g.edges.length := by
    simpa [ConstraintGraph.unsatFrac] using (g.toGraph id).unsatVal_le σ
  have hlen := length_toThreeSAT_toCNF e pairs g
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (toThreeSAT φ).length with hL | hL
  · have hC : (toThreeSAT φ).countUnsat τ = 0 :=
      Nat.le_zero.1 (hL ▸ CNF.countUnsat_le_length _ _)
    have hU : #((g.toGraph id).unsatEdges σ) = 0 := Nat.le_zero.1 (hC ▸ hcount)
    have hnonpos : (g.toGraph id).unsatVal ≤ 0 := by simpa [hU] using hval
    rw [hL, Nat.cast_zero, div_zero]
    exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hnonpos (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  · have hm : 0 < m := lt_max_of_lt_left Nat.one_pos
    have hφ : 0 < φ.length := by
      rw [hlen] at hL
      exact Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_right hL
    have hφle : φ.length ≤ g.edges.length * pairs.length := length_toCNF_le e pairs g
    have hn : 0 < g.edges.length := Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_right (hφ.trans_le hφle)
    have hp : 0 < pairs.length := Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left (hφ.trans_le hφle)
    have hLle : ((toThreeSAT φ).length : ℝ) ≤ g.edges.length * (pairs.length * m : ℕ) := by
      rw [hlen, ← Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_le, ← Nat.mul_assoc]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right m hφle
    calc (g.toGraph id).unsatVal / (pairs.length * m : ℕ)
        ≤ #((g.toGraph id).unsatEdges σ) / g.edges.length / (pairs.length * m : ℕ) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hval (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = #((g.toGraph id).unsatEdges σ) / (g.edges.length * (pairs.length * m : ℕ)) := by
          rw [div_div]
      _ ≤ (toThreeSAT φ).countUnsat τ / (g.edges.length * (pairs.length * m : ℕ)) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcount) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (toThreeSAT φ).countUnsat τ / (toThreeSAT φ).length :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast hL) hLle

theorem GapThreeSAT_npHard : PromiseProblem.NPHard encCNF (GapThreeSAT (1 - 1 / (3 * 2 ^ 77))) := by
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Bool × (Fin 6 → Bool)) = 128 := by
    simp [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_bool]
  have hs : 1 - (1 - (1 - 1 / 2 ^ 61 : ℝ)) /
      (Fintype.card (Bool × (Fin 6 → Bool)) ^ 2 * max 1 (2 * (6 + 1) - 2) : ℕ) =
      1 - 1 / (3 * 2 ^ 77) := by
    rw [hcard]
    norm_num
  have hred := polyTimeReducible_GapTwoCSP_GapThreeSAT (Fin.consEquiv fun _ : Fin 7 => Bool)
    (by norm_num : (1 - 1 / 2 ^ 61 : ℝ) < 1)
  rw [hs] at hred

theorem forall_hadamardCode_tensor_equationCoeff_iff {C : α → α → Prop}
    {x : Fin 2 × α → Bool} :
    (∀ e, hadamardCode (tensor x x) (equationCoeff C e) = equationRhs e) ↔
      ∃ σ : Fin 2 → α, C (σ 0) (σ 1) ∧ x = oneHot σ := by
  rw [forall_hadamardCode_tensor_equationCoeff_iff_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hpair, hsum⟩
    -- Every end has a set variable.
    have hex (b : Fin 2) : ∃ a, x (b, a) = true := by
      by_contra! h
      have h0 : ∑ a, x (b, a) = 0 :=
        sum_eq_zero fun a _ ↦ by simpa [Bool.zero_eq_false] using h a
      rw [hsum b] at h0
      exact absurd h0 (by decide)
    choose σ hσ using hex
    -- Two variables of the same end, or of the two ends violating `C`, are never both set.
    have hboth {p p' : Fin 2 × α} (hp : x p = true) (hp' : x p' = true) : Compatible C p p' := by
      by_contra hpp'
      have h := hpair p p' hpp'
      rw [hp, hp', Bool.and_self] at h
      exact absurd h (by decide)
    refine ⟨σ, ?_, funext fun ⟨b, a⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨τ, hτ, h0, h1⟩ := hboth (hσ 0) (hσ 1)
      have hτσ : τ = σ := funext <| Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨h0, h1⟩
      rwa [hτσ] at hτ
    · rw [oneHot_apply]
      by_cases ha : σ b = a
      · rw [← ha, hσ b]
        exact (decide_eq_true rfl).symm
      · rw [decide_eq_false ha]
        by_contra hx
        obtain ⟨τ, -, hτ, hτ'⟩ := hboth (Bool.not_eq_false _ ▸ hx) (hσ b)
        exact ha (hτ'.symm.trans hτ)
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun p p' hpp' ↦ ?_, fun b ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [oneHot_apply, oneHot_apply]
      by_contra h
      simp only [Bool.not_eq_false, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      exact hpp' ⟨σ, hσ, h.1, h.2⟩
    · simp_rw [oneHot_apply]
      rw [sum_eq_single (σ b) (fun a _ ha ↦ decide_eq_false (Ne.symm ha)) (by simp)]
      exact decide_eq_true rfl

Hadamard encoding of `x`, then on average over the ends `b`, the table `T b` is within relative
distance `1 - p + 2ε` of `r ↦ hadamardCode x (endEmbed b r)`, where `p` is the acceptance

private theorem expect_hammingDist_div_le_one_sub_acceptProb_inputTest
    {T : Fin 2 → (α → Bool) → Bool}
    {f : (Fin 2 × α → Bool) → Bool} {x : Fin 2 × α → Bool} {ε : ℝ}
    (hf : (hammingDist f (hadamardCode x) : ℝ) / 2 ^ Fintype.card (Fin 2 × α) ≤ ε) :
    𝔼 b, (hammingDist (T b) (fun r ↦ hadamardCode x (endEmbed b r)) : ℝ) / 2 ^ Fintype.card α ≤
      1 - (inputTest α).acceptProb (Sum.elim (fun p ↦ T p.1 p.2) f) + 2 * ε := by
  -- Self-correction reads the encoding of `x` correctly with probability at least `1 - 2ε`.
  have hsc (b : Fin 2) (r : α → Bool) : 𝔼 y, (1 - if selfCorrect f (endEmbed b r) y =
      hadamardCode x (endEmbed b r) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 2 * ε := by
    have h := one_sub_two_mul_le_expect_selfCorrect_hadamardCode hf (endEmbed b r)
    rw [expect_sub_distrib, Fintype.expect_const]
    linarith
  calc 𝔼 b, (hammingDist (T b) (fun r ↦ hadamardCode x (endEmbed b r)) : ℝ) / 2 ^ Fintype.card α
      = 𝔼 b, 𝔼 r, 𝔼 _y : Fin 2 × α → Bool,
          if T b r ≠ hadamardCode x (endEmbed b r) then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
        have h (g g' : (α → Bool) → Bool) : (hammingDist g g' : ℝ) / 2 ^ Fintype.card α =
            𝔼 r, if g r ≠ g' r then 1 else 0 := by
          rw [← hammingDist_div_eq_expect, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Nat.cast_pow,
            Nat.cast_ofNat]
        simp only [h, Fintype.expect_const]
    _ ≤ 𝔼 b, 𝔼 r, 𝔼 y, ((1 - if T b r = selfCorrect f (endEmbed b r) y then (1 : ℝ) else 0) +
          (1 - if selfCorrect f (endEmbed b r) y = hadamardCode x (endEmbed b r) then (1 : ℝ)
            else 0)) := by
        gcongr with b _ r _ y _
        exact one_sub_boole_le fun h h' ↦ h.trans h'
    _ = 1 - (inputTest α).acceptProb (Sum.elim (fun p ↦ T p.1 p.2) f) + 𝔼 b, 𝔼 r, 𝔼 y,
          (1 - if selfCorrect f (endEmbed b r) y = hadamardCode x (endEmbed b r) then (1 : ℝ)
            else 0) := by
        rw [acceptProb_inputTest]
        simp only [expect_add_distrib]
        congr 1
        simp only [expect_sub_distrib, Fintype.expect_const]
    _ ≤ 1 - (inputTest α).acceptProb (Sum.elim (fun p ↦ T p.1 p.2) f) + 𝔼 _b : Fin 2,
          𝔼 _r : α → Bool, 2 * ε := by
        gcongr with b _ r _
        exact hsc b r
    _ = 1 - (inputTest α).acceptProb (Sum.elim (fun p ↦ T p.1 p.2) f) + 2 * ε := by
        simp only [Fintype.expect_const]

private theorem acceptProb_le (π : Pos α → Bool) :
    (hadamardTester C).acceptProb π ≤ blrAcceptance (linTable π) ∧
      (hadamardTester C).acceptProb π ≤ blrAcceptance (quadTable π) ∧
      (hadamardTester C).acceptProb π ≤ tensorTestAcceptance (linTable π) (quadTable π) ∧
      (hadamardTester C).acceptProb π ≤
        equationTestAcceptance (quadTable π) (equationCoeff C) equationRhs ∧
      (hadamardTester C).acceptProb π ≤
        (inputTest α).acceptProb (Sum.elim (fun p ↦ inputTable π p.1 p.2) (linTable π)) := by
  open LocalTest in
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (acceptProb_and_le_left _ π).trans_eq ?_
    rw [acceptProb_map]
    exact acceptProb_blrTest _
  · refine (acceptProb_and_le_right _ π).trans <| (acceptProb_and_le_left _ π).trans_eq ?_
    rw [acceptProb_map]
    exact acceptProb_blrTest _
  · refine (acceptProb_and_le_right _ π).trans <| (acceptProb_and_le_right _ π).trans <|
      (acceptProb_and_le_left _ π).trans_eq ?_
    rw [acceptProb_map, Sum.comp_elim]
    exact acceptProb_tensorTest _ _
  · refine (acceptProb_and_le_right _ π).trans <| (acceptProb_and_le_right _ π).trans <|
      (acceptProb_and_le_right _ π).trans <| (acceptProb_and_le_left _ π).trans_eq ?_
    rw [acceptProb_map]
    exact acceptProb_equationTest _ _ _
  · refine (acceptProb_and_le_right _ π).trans <| (acceptProb_and_le_right _ π).trans <|
      (acceptProb_and_le_right _ π).trans <| (acceptProb_and_le_right _ π).trans_eq ?_

    (hH : ∀ v, (H v).spectralExpansion ≤ μ) (A : E × Bool → α) (σ : V → α)
    (hσ : ∀ v b, #{x : G.Cloud v | A x.1 = b} ≤ #{x : G.Cloud v | A x.1 = σ v}) :
    (1 - μ) * Fintype.card D * #{p | A p ≠ σ (G.endpoint p)} ≤
      #{q ∈ (G.degreeReduce H).toConstraintGraph.unsatEdges A | q.2.isRight} := by
  classical
  set T : Finset V := univ.image G.endpoint
  /- The darts of the multigraph on the cloud of `v` joining differently labelled half-edges, and
  their embedding into the cloud-links. -/
  set Dis : ∀ v, Finset (G.Cloud v × D) := fun v ↦ {r | A r.1.1 ≠ A ((H v).neighbor r.1 r.2).1}
  set f : ∀ v, G.Cloud v × D → (E × Bool) × (Unit ⊕ D) := fun _ r ↦ (r.1.1, .inr r.2)
  have hf (v : V) : Function.Injective (f v) := fun r r' h ↦ by
    simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq, Sum.inr.injEq] at h
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext h.1) h.2
  /- In each cloud, the disagreeing darts are many. -/
  have hcloud (v : V) : (1 - μ) * Fintype.card D * #{x : G.Cloud v | A x.1 ≠ σ v} ≤ #(Dis v) := by
    refine le_trans ?_ ((H v).mul_card_filter_ne_le_card_filter_ne_neighbor (fun x ↦ A x.1) (hσ v))
    gcongr
    linarith [hH v]
  /- The disagreeing darts of different clouds give different violated cloud-links. -/
  have hdisj : (T : Set V).PairwiseDisjoint fun v ↦ (Dis v).image (f v) := by
    intro v _ w _ hvw
    refine disjoint_left.2 fun q hq hq' ↦ hvw ?_
    simp only [mem_image] at hq hq'
    obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := hq
    obtain ⟨r', -, h⟩ := hq'
    exact r.1.2.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun q ↦ G.endpoint q.1) h).symm.trans r'.1.2)
  have hsub : T.biUnion (fun v ↦ (Dis v).image (f v)) ⊆
      {q ∈ (G.degreeReduce H).toConstraintGraph.unsatEdges A | q.2.isRight} := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [mem_biUnion, mem_image] at hq
    obtain ⟨v, -, r, hr, rfl⟩ := hq
    rw [mem_filter, mem_unsatEdges, satisfies_degreeReduce_inr, neighbor_cloudGraph H r.1]
    exact ⟨by simpa [Dis] using hr, rfl⟩
  calc (1 - μ) * Fintype.card D * #{p | A p ≠ σ (G.endpoint p)}
      = ∑ v ∈ T, (1 - μ) * Fintype.card D * #{x : G.Cloud v | A x.1 ≠ σ v} := by
        rw [G.card_filter_ne_endpoint_eq_sum A σ, mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ T, (#((Dis v).image (f v)) : ℝ) := by
        refine sum_le_sum fun v _ ↦ ?_
        rw [card_image_of_injective _ (hf v)]
        exact hcloud v
    _ = #(T.biUnion fun v ↦ (Dis v).image (f v)) := by
        rw [card_biUnion hdisj]
        push_cast
        rfl
    _ ≤ _ := by exact_mod_cast card_le_card hsub

      (G.degreeReduce H).toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac A := by

  choose σ hσ using exists_forall_card_filter_le_card_filter (G := G) A

  have hedge := card_unsatEdges_le_card_filter_isLeft_add H A σ
  have hsplit : #{q ∈ U | q.2.isLeft} + #{q ∈ U | q.2.isRight} = #U := by
    rw [← card_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_filter.2 fun q _ h h' ↦ by
      rcases q with ⟨_, _ | _⟩ <;> simp_all), ← filter_or]

    rw [← card_mul_unsatFrac]

      nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) #{q ∈ U | q.2.isLeft}]

  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]

  · nlinarith [mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hm G.unsatVal_nonneg,

      Fintype.card (gapGraph φ).V ≤ C * φ.length ^ c ∧

  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ : ∃ c₀ : ℕ, ∀ {V : Type u} [DecidableEq V] (φ : CNF V),

    ⟨_, fun φ ↦ card_edges_cnfGraph φ⟩
  obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁⟩ : ∃ c₁ : ℕ, ∀ {V : Type u} [DecidableEq V] (φ : CNF V),

    ⟨_, fun φ ↦ card_vertices_cnfGraph φ⟩

    ∀ m : ℕ, 12 * C ^ 2 * m * L ≤ (1 - v) ^ 2 * (n - m) → p m ≤ ((1 + v) / 2) ^ m

    have hb0 : 0 < (1 + v) / 2 := by linarith

    have Hm : 12 * C ^ 2 * m * L ≤ (1 - v) ^ 2 * (n - m) := by

theorem le_pow_floor_of_step (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hp0 : p 0 = 1) (hnn : ∀ m, 0 ≤ p m) (hmono : ∀ m, p (m + 1) ≤ p m)
    (hstep : ∀ m < n, p (m + 1) ≤
      p m * (v + C * Real.sqrt ((m * L + Real.log (1 / p m)) / (n - m)))) :
    p n ≤ ((1 + v) / 2) ^ ⌊(1 - v) ^ 2 * n / (13 * C ^ 2 * L)⌋₊ := by
  set M := ⌊(1 - v) ^ 2 * n / (13 * C ^ 2 * L)⌋₊
  have hK : 0 < 13 * C ^ 2 * L := by positivity
  have hx : 0 ≤ (1 - v) ^ 2 * n / (13 * C ^ 2 * L) := by positivity
  have hM : (M : ℝ) ≤ (1 - v) ^ 2 * n / (13 * C ^ 2 * L) := Nat.floor_le hx
  have hM' : 13 * C ^ 2 * L * M ≤ (1 - v) ^ 2 * n := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hK] at hM
    linarith
  have hsq1 : (1 - v) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hCL : 1 ≤ C ^ 2 * L := by nlinarith
  have hM0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ M := Nat.cast_nonneg M
  have hcond : 12 * C ^ 2 * M * L ≤ (1 - v) ^ 2 * (n - M) := by nlinarith
  have hMn : M ≤ n := by
    have : (M : ℝ) ≤ n := by nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  -- `p` is nonincreasing, so `p_n ≤ p_M`.
  have hanti : ∀ k, p (M + k) ≤ p M := fun k => by
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih => exact (hmono _).trans ih
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hMn
  rw [hk]
  exact (hanti k).trans (le_pow_of_step hv hv1 hL hp0 hnn hmono hstep M hcond)

[Holenstein2009]: under the recursion of `le_pow_of_step` with `C ≥ 1`,
`p_n ≤ 2 (1 - (1 - v)³ / (26 C²))^{n / L}`. The factor `2` accounts for rounding the number of
steps down; Holenstein's `6000` corresponds to `26 C²` with `C = 15` (`26 · 225 = 5850`). -/

theorem le_two_mul_rpow_of_step (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hp0 : p 0 = 1) (hnn : ∀ m, 0 ≤ p m) (hmono : ∀ m, p (m + 1) ≤ p m)
    (hstep : ∀ m < n, p (m + 1) ≤
      p m * (v + C * Real.sqrt ((m * L + Real.log (1 / p m)) / (n - m)))) :
    p n ≤ 2 * (1 - (1 - v) ^ 3 / (26 * C ^ 2)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / L) := by
  set b := (1 + v) / 2
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by positivity
  have hb1 : b ≤ 1 := by simp only [b]; linarith
  have hbhalf : 1 / 2 ≤ b := by simp only [b]; linarith
  set a := (1 - v) ^ 2 / (13 * C ^ 2)
  set x := (1 - v) ^ 2 * n / (13 * C ^ 2 * L)
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by positivity
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := (div_le_one (by positivity)).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hx : x = a * (n / L) := by
    simp only [x, a]
    field_simp
  have hfloor := le_pow_floor_of_step hv hv1 hC hL hp0 hnn hmono hstep
  -- Round the number of steps down at the cost of a factor `2`.
  have hround : b ^ ⌊x⌋₊ ≤ 2 * b ^ x := by
    have hle : x - 1 ≤ (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) := by linarith [Nat.lt_floor_add_one x]
    have h1 : b ^ ⌊x⌋₊ = b ^ ((⌊x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_natCast b _).symm
    have h2 : b ^ ((⌊x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ b ^ (x - 1) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hb0 hb1 hle
    have h3 : b ^ (x - 1) = b ^ x / b := Real.rpow_sub_one hb0.ne' x
    rw [h1]
    refine h2.trans (h3.le.trans ?_)
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hb0]
    have := Real.rpow_nonneg hb0.le x
    nlinarith
  -- Bernoulli's inequality for the exponent `a ∈ [0, 1]`.
  have hbern : b ^ a ≤ 1 - (1 - v) ^ 3 / (26 * C ^ 2) := by
    have h := rpow_one_add_le_one_add_mul_self (s := -((1 - v) / 2)) (by linarith) ha0 ha1
    have hb : 1 + -((1 - v) / 2) = b := by simp only [b]; ring
    rw [hb] at h
    refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    simp only [a]
    field_simp
    ring
  calc p n ≤ b ^ ⌊x⌋₊ := hfloor
    _ ≤ 2 * b ^ x := hround
    _ = 2 * (b ^ a) ^ ((n : ℝ) / L) := by rw [hx, Real.rpow_mul hb0.le]
    _ ≤ 2 * (1 - (1 - v) ^ 3 / (26 * C ^ 2)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / L) := by
        gcongr

private theorem inv_card_le_expect_report_eq_decode [Nonempty D] (A : V → WalkLabels D T → α)

      if R.report T A (killTime_le x.2) (v, Fin.take _ (killTime_le x.2) x.1) =
        R.decode T q A v then 1 else 0 := by
  set f := fun x : (Fin T → D) × (Fin T → Fin q) ↦
    R.report T A (killTime_le x.2) (v, Fin.take _ (killTime_le x.2) x.1)
  have hα : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card α := Nat.cast_pos.2 Fintype.card_pos
  have hX : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ((Fin T → D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) :=
    Nat.cast_pos.2 Fintype.card_pos
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Fintype.exists_le_card_fiber_of_nsmul_le_card (M := ℝ) f
    (b := Fintype.card ((Fin T → D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) / Fintype.card α)
    (by rw [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hα.ne'])
  have hmax : #{x | f x = a} ≤ #{x | f x = R.decode T q A v} :=
    (univ.exists_max_image (fun a ↦ #{x | f x = a}) univ_nonempty).choose_spec.2 a (mem_univ a)
  rw [Fintype.expect_eq_sum_div_card, sum_boole, inv_eq_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hα hX, one_mul]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hα] at ha

at most `H` from `v` whose far end reports the decoded label of `v`, weighted by the probability
`(1 - 1 / q) ^ ℓ / q` that a killed walk is killed at step `ℓ`, have total weight at least
`1 / |α| - (1 - 1 / q) ^ (H + 1)`, for a killed walk survives its first `H + 1` steps with
probability `(1 - 1 / q) ^ (H + 1)` only. -/
theorem inv_card_sub_le_sum_truthProb [Nonempty D] (A : V → WalkLabels D T → α) (v : V) {H : ℕ}
    (hH : H < T) :
    (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ - (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (H + 1) ≤
      ∑ ℓ ∈ range (H + 1), (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ ℓ / q * R.truthProb T A (R.decode T q A) v ℓ := by
  set f := fun x : (Fin T → D) × (Fin T → Fin q) ↦
    R.report T A (killTime_le x.2) (v, Fin.take _ (killTime_le x.2) x.1)
  -- a killed walk is killed by step `H` or survives its first `H + 1` steps
  have hpt (x : (Fin T → D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) :
      (if f x = R.decode T q A v then 1 else 0 : ℝ) ≤
        ∑ ℓ ∈ range (H + 1), (if killTime x.2 = ℓ ∧ f x = R.decode T q A v then 1 else 0 : ℝ) +
          if H + 1 ≤ killTime x.2 then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hk : killTime x.2 ≤ H
    · have h := single_le_sum (f := fun ℓ ↦
        (if killTime x.2 = ℓ ∧ f x = R.decode T q A v then 1 else 0 : ℝ))
        (fun ℓ _ ↦ by positivity) (mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk))
      simp only [true_and] at h
      rw [ite_eq_right (show ¬ H + 1 ≤ killTime x.2 by omega), add_zero]
      exact h
    · rw [ite_eq_left (show H + 1 ≤ killTime x.2 by omega)]
      have : 0 ≤ ∑ ℓ ∈ range (H + 1),
          (if killTime x.2 = ℓ ∧ f x = R.decode T q A v then 1 else 0 : ℝ) :=
        sum_nonneg fun ℓ _ ↦ by positivity
      split_ifs <;> linarith
  have hsurv : 𝔼 x : (Fin T → D) × (Fin T → Fin q),
      (if H + 1 ≤ killTime x.2 then 1 else 0 : ℝ) = (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (H + 1) := by
    rw [Fintype.expect_prod_type]
    simp only [expect_le_killTime (q := q) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hH), Fintype.expect_const]
  have h := R.inv_card_le_expect_report_eq_decode T q A v
  calc (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ - (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (H + 1)
      ≤ 𝔼 x, (∑ ℓ ∈ range (H + 1),
          (if killTime x.2 = ℓ ∧ f x = R.decode T q A v then 1 else 0 : ℝ) +

  have hm₀ : 0 ≤ m := le_min hu hδ

    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_right _ _) (sq_nonneg T)

private theorem hit_iff_splitHit (A : V → WalkLabels D T → α) (σ : V → α)
    (p : V × (Fin T → D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) (hℓ : killTime p.2.2 < T) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < killTime p.2.2) :
    R.Hit T q A σ p i ↔ R.SplitHit T A σ (hi.le.trans hℓ.le) ((Nat.sub_le _ _).trans hℓ.le)
      (R.graph.splitWalk ⟨i, hi⟩ (p.1, Fin.take _ hℓ.le p.2.1)) := by
  let y := R.graph.splitWalk ⟨i, hi⟩ (p.1, Fin.take _ hℓ.le p.2.1)
  have e₁ : y.1 = R.graph.walkDart (p.1, p.2.1) ⟨i, hi.trans hℓ⟩ :=
    R.graph.walkDart_take (p.1, p.2.1) hℓ.le ⟨i, hi⟩
  -- the reverse of the steps before step `i` leads back to the start of `p`
  have e₂ : R.report T A (hi.le.trans hℓ.le) (y.1.1, y.2.1) =
      A p.1 (.take i (hi.le.trans hℓ.le) p.2.1) := by
    rw [show (y.1.1, y.2.1) =
        (R.graph.pow i).rot (p.1, Fin.take i hi.le (Fin.take _ hℓ.le p.2.1)) from
      Prod.ext (R.graph.fst_rot_pow_take (p.1, Fin.take _ hℓ.le p.2.1) hi.le).symm rfl,
      report_rot_pow]
    rfl
  -- the steps after step `i` lead on to the end of `p`, and their reverse is read there
  have e₃ : R.report T A ((Nat.sub_le _ _).trans hℓ.le) ((R.graph.rot y.1).1, y.2.2) =
      A ((R.graph.killedPow T q).rot p).1 (.take (killTime p.2.2 - (i + 1))
        ((Nat.sub_le _ _).trans (killTime_le _)) ((R.graph.killedPow T q).rot p).2.1) := by
    rw [show ((R.graph.rot y.1).1, y.2.2) =
        R.graph.walkDrop (p.1, Fin.take _ hℓ.le p.2.1) (i + 1) from
      Prod.ext (R.graph.fst_rot_walkDart _ ⟨i, hi⟩) rfl,
      report, R.graph.rot_pow_walkDrop, R.graph.rot_pow_killTime T q p]
    rfl
  have e₄ : σ (R.graph.rot y.1).1 =
      R.truthful T σ ((R.graph.killedPow T q).rot p).1 (.take (killTime p.2.2 - (i + 1))
        ((Nat.sub_le _ _).trans (killTime_le _)) ((R.graph.killedPow T q).rot p).2.1) := by
    change σ (R.graph.rot (R.graph.walkDart (p.1, Fin.take _ hℓ.le p.2.1) ⟨i, hi⟩)).1 = _
    rw [R.truthful_take_rot_killedPow T q σ p (Nat.sub_le _ _),
      Nat.sub_sub_self (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi), R.graph.fst_rot_walkDart _ ⟨i, hi⟩]
    exact congrArg σ (R.graph.walkAt_take (p.1, p.2.1) hℓ.le (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi))
  rw [SplitHit, e₂, e₃, e₄, e₁, walkDart_fst, ← R.truthful_take T σ p.1 (hi.le.trans hℓ.le)]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨_, h⟩ ↦ h, fun h ↦ ⟨hi, h⟩⟩

open Classical in
/-- **The crossing count** [Dinur, Section 5.1][Dinur2005]: a uniformly random killed walk is
killed at its step `ℓ < T` and hit at its step `i < ℓ` with probability `(1 - 1 / q) ^ ℓ / q` times
the average over the darts `d` violated by `σ` of the product of the proportion of the walks of
length `i` from the start of `d` and the proportion of the walks of length `ℓ - (i + 1)` from the
end of `d` whose far ends report `σ` truthfully. Split at step `i`, the killed walk crosses a
uniformly random dart, and its pieces before and after are independent uniformly random walks. -/
theorem expect_killTime_eq_and_hit [Fintype V] [Fintype D] [Nonempty D]
    (A : V → WalkLabels D T → α) (σ : V → α) {ℓ i : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ < T) (hi : i < ℓ) :
    𝔼 p : V × (Fin T → D) × (Fin T → Fin q),
        (if killTime p.2.2 = ℓ ∧ R.Hit T q A σ p i then 1 else 0 : ℝ) =
      (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ ℓ / q * 𝔼 d : V × D,
        (if d ∈ R.toConstraintGraph.unsatEdges σ then 1 else 0) * R.truthProb T A σ d.1 i *
          R.truthProb T A σ (R.graph.rot d).1 (ℓ - (i + 1)) := by
  have hiT : i ≤ T := hi.le.trans hℓ.le
  have hjT : ℓ - (i + 1) ≤ T := (Nat.sub_le _ _).trans hℓ.le
  -- the right-hand side, as an average over the walks of length `ℓ` split at step `i`
  have hrhs : 𝔼 d : V × D, (if d ∈ R.toConstraintGraph.unsatEdges σ then 1 else 0) *
        R.truthProb T A σ d.1 i * R.truthProb T A σ (R.graph.rot d).1 (ℓ - (i + 1)) =
      𝔼 w : V × (Fin ℓ → D),
        if R.SplitHit T A σ hiT hjT (R.graph.splitWalk ⟨i, hi⟩ w) then 1 else 0 := by
    rw [R.graph.expect_splitWalk ⟨i, hi⟩ fun y ↦ if R.SplitHit T A σ hiT hjT y then 1 else 0]
    refine expect_congr rfl fun d _ ↦ ?_
    have h (r : Fin i → D) (s : Fin (ℓ - (i + 1)) → D) :
        (if R.SplitHit T A σ hiT hjT (d, r, s) then 1 else 0 : ℝ) =
          (if d ∈ R.toConstraintGraph.unsatEdges σ then 1 else 0) *
            (if R.report T A hiT (d.1, r) = σ d.1 then 1 else 0) *
              (if R.report T A hjT ((R.graph.rot d).1, s) = σ (R.graph.rot d).1 then 1 else 0) := by
      simp only [SplitHit, ConstraintGraph.mem_unsatEdges]
      by_cases h₁ : R.toConstraintGraph.Satisfies σ d <;>
        by_cases h₂ : R.report T A hiT (d.1, r) = σ d.1 <;>
        by_cases h₃ : R.report T A hjT ((R.graph.rot d).1, s) = σ (R.graph.rot d).1 <;>
        simp only [h₁, h₂, h₃, not_true_eq_false, not_false_eq_true, true_and, false_and,
          and_false, ↓reduceIte, mul_one, mul_zero]
    simp only [h, truthProb, dite_eq_left hiT, dite_eq_left hjT, ← mul_expect, ← expect_mul,
      mul_assoc]
  rw [hrhs, ← expect_prod_ite_killTime_eq hℓ]
  refine expect_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  by_cases h : killTime p.2.2 = ℓ
  · subst h
    simp only [true_and, ite_true, R.hit_iff_splitHit T q A σ p hℓ hi]
  · simp [h]

open Classical in
/-- **The first moment** [Dinur, Lemma 5.1][Dinur2005]: for `2 H + 1 < T`, a uniformly random
killed walk is hit by a labelling `A` of the powered constraint graph, relative to its plurality
decoding, at least `(q - 1) (1 / |α| - (1 - 1 / q) ^ (H + 1)) ^ 2` times the proportion of the darts
violated by the decoding many times on average.

The killed walks hit at a step `i ≤ H` and killed at step `i + j + 1` for `j ≤ H` are counted by
the crossing count `expect_killTime_eq_and_hit`, and the probability `(1 - 1 / q) ^ (i + j + 1) / q`
of the kill time is `q - 1` times the product of those of the kill times `i` and `j`. So the count
factors, at every violated dart, into a product of two weighted proportions of truthful walks, one
from each end of the dart, each of which is bounded below by plurality
(`inv_card_sub_le_sum_truthProb`). -/
theorem le_expect_numHits [Fintype V] [Fintype D] [Nonempty D] [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (A : V → WalkLabels D T → α) {H : ℕ} (hH : 2 * H + 1 < T)
    (hα : (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (H + 1) ≤ (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹) :
    ((q : ℝ) - 1) * ((Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ - (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (H + 1)) ^ 2 *
        R.toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac (R.decode T q A) ≤
      𝔼 p, (R.numHits T q A (R.decode T q A) p : ℝ) := by
  set σ := R.decode T q A
  set β := (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ - (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (H + 1)
  set P : ℕ → ℝ := fun ℓ ↦ (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ ℓ / q
  set b : V × D → ℝ := fun d ↦ if d ∈ R.toConstraintGraph.unsatEdges σ then 1 else 0
  set S : V → ℝ := fun u ↦ ∑ ℓ ∈ range (H + 1), P ℓ * R.truthProb T A σ u ℓ
  have hq₁ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q - 1 := sub_nonneg.2 (Nat.one_le_cast.2 NeZero.one_le)
  have hβ : 0 ≤ β := sub_nonneg.2 hα
  have hb (d : V × D) : 0 ≤ b d := by positivity
  have hS (u : V) : β ≤ S u := R.inv_card_sub_le_sum_truthProb T q A u (by omega)
  calc ((q : ℝ) - 1) * β ^ 2 * R.toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac σ
      = 𝔼 d, (q - 1) * (b d * (β * β)) := by
        rw [← ConstraintGraph.expect_mem_unsatEdges, mul_expect]
        exact expect_congr rfl fun d _ ↦ by simp only [b]; ring
    _ ≤ 𝔼 d, (q - 1) * (b d * (S d.1 * S (R.graph.rot d).1)) :=
        expect_le_expect fun d _ ↦ mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul (hS _) (hS _) hβ (hβ.trans (hS _))) (hb d)) hq₁
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range (H + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (H + 1), P (i + j + 1) *
          𝔼 d, b d * R.truthProb T A σ d.1 i * R.truthProb T A σ (R.graph.rot d).1 j := by
        simp only [S, P, sub_one_mul_sum_mul_sum_eq q H, expect_sum_comm, mul_expect]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range (H + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (H + 1),
          𝔼 p, (if killTime p.2.2 = i + j + 1 ∧ R.Hit T q A σ p i then 1 else 0 : ℝ) := by
        refine sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ ?_
        rw [mem_range] at hi hj
        rw [R.expect_killTime_eq_and_hit T q A σ (by omega) (by omega),
          show i + j + 1 - (i + 1) = j by omega]
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ range (H + 1), 𝔼 p, (if R.Hit T q A σ p i then 1 else 0 : ℝ) := by
        refine sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ ?_
        rw [← expect_sum_comm]
        exact expect_le_expect fun p _ ↦ R.sum_ite_killTime_eq_and_hit_le T q A σ H i p
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ range T, 𝔼 p, (if R.Hit T q A σ p i then 1 else 0 : ℝ) :=
        sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (range_subset_range.2 (by omega))
          fun i _ _ ↦ expect_nonneg fun p _ ↦ by positivity
    _ = 𝔼 p, (R.numHits T q A σ p : ℝ) := by
        simp only [numHits_eq_sum, expect_sum_comm]

open Classical in
/-- The square of the number of hits of a walk `p` is at most its number of hits plus the number
of ordered pairs of distinct steps that cross darts violated by `σ`. -/
private theorem numHits_sq_le_add_sum (A : V → WalkLabels D T → α) (σ : V → α)
    (p : V × (Fin T → D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) :
    (R.numHits T q A σ p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ R.numHits T q A σ p + ∑ i : Fin T, ∑ j : Fin T,
      if i = j then 0 else
        (if R.graph.walkDart (p.1, p.2.1) i ∈ R.toConstraintGraph.unsatEdges σ then 1 else 0) *
          if R.graph.walkDart (p.1, p.2.1) j ∈ R.toConstraintGraph.unsatEdges σ then 1 else 0 := by
  set h : Fin T → ℝ := fun i ↦ if R.Hit T q A σ p i then 1 else 0
  set c : Fin T → ℝ := fun i ↦
    if R.graph.walkDart (p.1, p.2.1) i ∈ R.toConstraintGraph.unsatEdges σ then 1 else 0
  have hN : (R.numHits T q A σ p : ℝ) = ∑ i, h i := by
    rw [numHits_eq_sum, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  -- a hit at step `i` crosses a violated dart
  have hhc (i : Fin T) : h i ≤ c i := by
    simp only [h, c]
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact absurd ((ConstraintGraph.mem_unsatEdges).2 h₁.2.1) h₂
    · exact zero_le_one
    · exact le_rfl
  have hh₀ (i : Fin T) : 0 ≤ h i := by
    simp only [h]
    positivity
  rw [hN, sq, sum_mul_sum, ← sum_add_distrib]
  refine sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ ?_
  calc ∑ j, h i * h j
      ≤ ∑ j, ((if i = j then h j else 0) + if i = j then 0 else c i * c j) := by
        refine sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ ?_
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst hij
          simp only [↓reduceIte, add_zero, h]
          split_ifs <;> norm_num
        · simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte, zero_add]
          exact mul_le_mul (hhc i) (hhc j) (hh₀ j) ((hh₀ i).trans (hhc i))
    _ = h i + ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else c i * c j := by
        rw [sum_add_distrib, Fintype.sum_ite_eq]

open Classical in
/-- **The second moment** [Dinur, Lemma 5.2][Dinur2005]: on an expander, the number of hits of a
uniformly random killed walk has second moment at most its first moment plus
`T ^ 2 ε ^ 2 + 2 T ε / (1 - λ)`, where `ε` is the proportion of the darts violated by `σ` and
`λ < 1` the spectral expansion. A hit is a step crossing a violated dart, and two steps `i < j` of
a random walk both cross violated darts with probability at most `ε ^ 2 + λ ^ (j - (i + 1)) ε`
(`expect_mem_unsatEdges_mul_le`); the errors sum to a geometric series at every step. -/
theorem expect_numHits_sq_le (A : V → WalkLabels D T → α) (σ : V → α)
    (hlam : R.graph.spectralExpansion < 1) :
    𝔼 p, (R.numHits T q A σ p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      𝔼 p, (R.numHits T q A σ p : ℝ) + T ^ 2 * R.toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac σ ^ 2 +
        2 * T * R.toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac σ / (1 - R.graph.spectralExpansion) := by
  set ε := R.toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac σ
  set lam := R.graph.spectralExpansion
  set c : Fin T → V × (Fin T → D) × (Fin T → Fin q) → ℝ := fun i p ↦
    if R.graph.walkDart (p.1, p.2.1) i ∈ R.toConstraintGraph.unsatEdges σ then 1 else 0
  set g : Fin T → Fin T → ℝ := fun i j ↦ if i < j then lam ^ (j - (i + 1) : ℕ) else 0
  have hε : 0 ≤ ε := R.toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac_nonneg σ
  have hlam₀ : 0 ≤ lam := R.graph.spectralExpansion_nonneg
  -- the errors sum to a geometric series at every step
  have hgsum : ∑ i, ∑ j, g i j ≤ T * (1 / (1 - lam)) := by
    calc ∑ i, ∑ j, g i j ≤ ∑ _i : Fin T, 1 / (1 - lam) := by
          refine sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ ?_
          simpa [g] using (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
            (fun j ↦ if (i : ℕ) < j then lam ^ (j - (i + 1)) else 0) T).le.trans
            (sum_ite_lt_pow_le hlam₀ hlam T i)
      _ = T * (1 / (1 - lam)) := by simp
  calc 𝔼 p, (R.numHits T q A σ p : ℝ) ^ 2
      ≤ 𝔼 p, ((R.numHits T q A σ p : ℝ) + ∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else c i p * c j p) :=
        expect_le_expect fun p _ ↦ numHits_sq_le_add_sum R T q A σ p
    _ = 𝔼 p, (R.numHits T q A σ p : ℝ) +
          ∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else 𝔼 p, c i p * c j p := by
        rw [expect_add_distrib, expect_sum_comm]
        simp only [expect_sum_comm]
        congr 1
        refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
        split_ifs <;> simp
    _ ≤ 𝔼 p, (R.numHits T q A σ p : ℝ) +
          ∑ i : Fin T, ∑ j : Fin T, (ε ^ 2 + ε * g i j + ε * g j i) := by
        gcongr with i _ j _
        exact ite_expect_walkDart_mem_unsatEdges_mul_le R T q σ i j
    _ ≤ 𝔼 p, (R.numHits T q A σ p : ℝ) + T ^ 2 * ε ^ 2 + 2 * T * ε / (1 - lam) := by
        have hsum : ∑ i : Fin T, ∑ j : Fin T, (ε ^ 2 + ε * g i j + ε * g j i) =
            T ^ 2 * ε ^ 2 + ε * ∑ i, ∑ j, g i j + ε * ∑ i, ∑ j, g i j := by
          simp only [sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
            nsmul_eq_mul]
          rw [sum_comm (f := fun i j ↦ g j i)]
          ring
        rw [hsum, show 2 * (T : ℝ) * ε / (1 - lam) = 2 * (ε * (T * (1 / (1 - lam)))) by ring]
        linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgsum hε]

theorem le_unsatFrac_power [Nonempty D] (A : V → WalkLabels D T → α) {H : ℕ} (hH : 2 * H + 1 < T)
    (hα : (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (H + 1) ≤ (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹) {c : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c)
    (hc : c ≤ ((q : ℝ) - 1) * ((Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ - (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (H + 1)) ^ 2)
    (hlam : R.graph.spectralExpansion < 1) :
    c ^ 2 * R.toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac (R.decode T q A) /
        (c + T ^ 2 * R.toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac (R.decode T q A) +
          2 * T / (1 - R.graph.spectralExpansion)) ≤
      (R.power T q).toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac A := by
  set ε := R.toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac (R.decode T q A)
  set lam := R.graph.spectralExpansion
  set N := fun p ↦ (R.numHits T q A (R.decode T q A) p : ℝ)
  set x := (R.power T q).toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac A
  have hε : 0 ≤ ε := R.toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac_nonneg _
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := (R.power T q).toConstraintGraph.unsatFrac_nonneg _
  have hlam' : 0 < 1 - lam := sub_pos.2 hlam
  -- the first moment
  have h₁ : c * ε ≤ 𝔼 p, N p :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc hε).trans (R.le_expect_numHits T q A hH hα)
  -- the second moment
  have h₂ := R.expect_numHits_sq_le T q A (R.decode T q A) hlam
  -- the second moment method
  have h₃ : (𝔼 p, N p) ^ 2 ≤ x * (𝔼 p, N p + (T ^ 2 * ε ^ 2 + 2 * T * ε / (1 - lam))) := by
    refine (Fintype.sq_expect_le_dens_mul_expect_sq N).trans (mul_le_mul ?_
      (h₂.trans_eq (add_assoc _ _ _)) (expect_nonneg fun p _ ↦ sq_nonneg _) hx)
    rw [← Fintype.expect_boole]
    exact le_of_eq_of_le (expect_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ite_not _ _ _)
      (R.expect_numHits_ne_zero_le T q A (R.decode T q A))
  have h₄ := sq_le_mul_add_of_le (mul_nonneg hc₀ hε) h₁ (by positivity) hx h₃
  rcases hε.eq_or_lt with h₀ | h₀
  · rw [← h₀]
    simpa using hx
  have hT : (0 : ℝ) < T := Nat.cast_pos.2 (by omega)
  have h₅ : ε * (c ^ 2 * ε) ≤ ε * (x * (c + T ^ 2 * ε + 2 * T / (1 - lam))) :=
    calc ε * (c ^ 2 * ε) = (c * ε) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ x * (c * ε + (T ^ 2 * ε ^ 2 + 2 * T * ε / (1 - lam))) := h₄
      _ = ε * (x * (c + T ^ 2 * ε + 2 * T / (1 - lam))) := by ring
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h₅ h₀

theorem le_unsatVal_power_of_le (H : ℕ) (hH : 2 * H + 1 < T)
    (hα : (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (H + 1) ≤ (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹) {c : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c)
    (hc : c ≤ ((q : ℝ) - 1) * ((Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ - (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (H + 1)) ^ 2) {μ : ℝ}
    (hμ : R.graph.spectralExpansion ≤ μ) (hμ₁ : μ < 1) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    c ^ 2 / (c + T ^ 2 * δ + 2 * T / (1 - μ)) * min R.toConstraintGraph.unsatVal δ ≤
      (R.power T q).toConstraintGraph.unsatVal := by
  have hlam : R.graph.spectralExpansion < 1 := hμ.trans_lt hμ₁

    div_nonneg (by positivity) (sub_pos.2 hlam).le
  have hBB : 2 * (T : ℝ) / (1 - R.graph.spectralExpansion) ≤ 2 * T / (1 - μ) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (sub_pos.2 hμ₁) (by linarith)
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty D with hD | hD
  · -- without labels, `R` has no darts and its value is zero
    have h₀ : R.toConstraintGraph.unsatVal = 0 := by
      refine le_antisymm ?_ R.toConstraintGraph.unsatVal_nonneg
      refine (R.toConstraintGraph.unsatVal_le fun _ ↦ Classical.arbitrary α).trans_eq ?_
      simp [ConstraintGraph.unsatFrac]

    exact (R.power T q).toConstraintGraph.unsatVal_nonneg
  refine ((R.power T q).toConstraintGraph.le_unsatVal_iff).2 fun A ↦ ?_

/-- The standard killed-walk cutoff supplies first-moment coefficient `(q - 1) / (4 |α|²)`.
The soundness threshold remains a parameter, independently of the walk length. -/

theorem le_unsatVal_power_min (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hT : T = 4 * Fintype.card α * (q - 1)) {μ : ℝ}
    (hμ : R.graph.spectralExpansion ≤ μ) (hμ₁ : μ < 1) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    let c : ℝ := (q - 1) / (4 * Fintype.card α ^ 2)
    c ^ 2 / (c + T ^ 2 * δ + 2 * T / (1 - μ)) * min R.toConstraintGraph.unsatVal δ ≤
      (R.power T q).toConstraintGraph.unsatVal := by
  set K := Fintype.card α
  have hK : 1 ≤ K := Fintype.card_pos
  have hK' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hq' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q - 1 := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
    linarith
  -- the killed walks surviving their first `2 |α| (q - 1)` steps are few
  have hm : 1 ≤ K * (q - 1) := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega))
  have hH : 2 * (2 * K * (q - 1) - 1) + 1 < T := by
    rw [hT, show 4 * K * (q - 1) = 4 * (K * (q - 1)) by ring,
      show 2 * K * (q - 1) = 2 * (K * (q - 1)) by ring]
    omega
  have hsurv : (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (2 * K * (q - 1) - 1 + 1) ≤ (2 * K : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by rw [show 2 * K * (q - 1) = 2 * (K * (q - 1)) by ring]; omega)]
    exact one_sub_inv_pow_le hq hK
  have h2K : (2 * K : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (K : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by linarith)
  set c : ℝ := (q - 1) / (4 * K ^ 2)
  have hc₀ : 0 ≤ c := by positivity
  have hc : c ≤ ((q : ℝ) - 1) * ((K : ℝ)⁻¹ - (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (2 * K * (q - 1) - 1 + 1)) ^ 2 := by
    have h : (2 * K : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (K : ℝ)⁻¹ - (1 - (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (2 * K * (q - 1) - 1 + 1) := by
      have : (K : ℝ)⁻¹ = 2 * (2 * K : ℝ)⁻¹ := by field_simp
      linarith
    calc c = (q - 1) * ((2 * K : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by simp only [c]; field_simp; ring
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr
  exact R.le_unsatVal_power_of_le T q _ hH (hsurv.trans h2K) hc₀ hc hμ hμ₁ hδ

linear in `q`, up to threshold `1 / T²`. The more precise `le_unsatVal_power_min` permits larger
thresholds without repeating the probabilistic argument. -/

theorem IsPPTOn.exists_total_seeded_evaluator (h : IsPPTOn input output program) :
    ∃ (c d : ℕ) (evaluate : α → List Bool → β),
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : α × List Bool => evaluate p.1 p.2)
        (encPair input encBits) output ∧
      (∀ a coins, evaluate a coins ∈ (ProbComp.eval (program a)).support) ∧
      ∀ a length, c * ((input a).length + 1) ^ d ≤ length →
        ProbComp.eval (program a) = (BitString.uniformList length).map (evaluate a) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, d, raw, hraw, hlaw⟩ := h.exists_polyTime_coin_evaluator
  let budget (a : α) := c * ((input a).length + 1) ^ d
  let tape (a : α) (coins : List Bool) := (coins ++ List.replicate (budget a) true).take (budget a)
  have hlength (a : α) (coins : List Bool) : (tape a coins).length = budget a := by
    simp [tape]
  have hvalid (a : α) (coins : List Bool) : ∃ result,
      result ∈ (ProbComp.eval (program a)).support ∧
        output result = raw (tape a coins) (input a) := by
    have hs : raw (tape a coins) (input a) ∈
        ((BitString.uniformList (budget a)).map (fun seed => raw seed (input a))).support :=
      (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mpr
        ⟨tape a coins, BitString.mem_support_uniformList_iff.mpr (hlength a coins), rfl⟩
    rw [← hlaw a] at hs
    exact (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hs
  let evaluate (a : α) (coins : List Bool) := (hvalid a coins).choose
  have hencode (a : α) (coins : List Bool) :
      output (evaluate a coins) = raw (tape a coins) (input a) := (hvalid a coins).choose_spec.2
  refine ⟨c, d, evaluate, ?_, fun a coins => (hvalid a coins).choose_spec.1, ?_⟩
  · have hinput : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime input input encBits := .of_eq fun _ => rfl
    have hbudget : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime budget input encUnary := by
      dsimp only [budget]
      fun_prop
    have hpad : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => List.replicate (budget a) true)
        input encBits := hbudget.of_enc_eq (fun _ => rfl)
    have ht : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun p : α × List Bool => (tape p.1 p.2, input p.1))
        (encPair input encBits) (encPair encBits encBits) := by
      have hfirst := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst input encBits
      have hsecond := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd input encBits
      exact (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsTakeWithInput
        (hsecond.bitsAppend (hpad.comp hfirst)) (hbudget.comp hfirst)).prod (hinput.comp hfirst)
    exact (hraw.comp ht).of_enc_eq (fun p => hencode p.1 p.2)
  · intro a length hbudget
    apply PMF.map_injective output.injective
    rw [hlaw, PMF.map_comp, ← BitString.uniformList_take hbudget, PMF.map_comp]
    apply PMF.bind_congr_on_support
    intro coins hcoins
    change PMF.pure (raw (coins.take (budget a)) (input a)) =
      PMF.pure (output (evaluate a coins))
    congr 1
    have hcoinsLength := BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hcoins
    simp only [hencode, tape, List.take_append_of_le_length
      (show budget a ≤ coins.length by simpa only [budget, hcoinsLength] using hbudget)]
