theorem memoize_cache_size_le {α Key Value : Type} [BEq Key]
    (keyEncoding : Key ↪ List Bool) (valueEncoding : Value ↪ List Bool)
    (distribution : Key → PMF Value) (program : ProbOracleComp (fun _ : Key => Value) α)
    (calls maxKey maxValue : ℕ)
    (hcalls : program.IsQueryBounded calls)
    (hkeys : program.QueriesSatisfy fun key => (keyEncoding key).length ≤ maxKey)
    (hvalues : ∀ key, (keyEncoding key).length ≤ maxKey →
      ∀ value ∈ (distribution key).support, (valueEncoding value).length ≤ maxValue)
    (cache cache' : List (Key × Value))
    (hcache : ∀ entry ∈ cache,
      (keyEncoding entry.1).length ≤ maxKey ∧ (valueEncoding entry.2).length ≤ maxValue)
    (result : α)
    (h : (result, cache') ∈ ((OracleComp.interpret
      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle n))
        (memoize distribution)) program).run cache).support) :
    (encList (encPair keyEncoding valueEncoding) cache').length ≤
      (cache.length + calls) * (4 * maxKey + 2 * maxValue + 3) := by
  obtain ⟨hcount, hentries⟩ := RandomOracle.memoize_cache_bounds_prob distribution program
    (fun key => (keyEncoding key).length) calls maxKey hcalls hkeys cache cache' result h
  have hentry : ∀ entry ∈ cache', (encPair keyEncoding valueEncoding entry).length ≤
      2 * maxKey + maxValue + 1 := by
    intro entry hentry
    have hbounds : (keyEncoding entry.1).length ≤ maxKey ∧
        (valueEncoding entry.2).length ≤ maxValue := by
      rcases hentries entry hentry with h | ⟨hkey, hvalue⟩
      · exact hcache entry h
      · exact ⟨hkey, hvalues entry.1 hkey entry.2 hvalue⟩
    simp only [length_encPair]
    lia
  have hlength := (length_encList_le _ _ hentry).trans
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 * (2 * maxKey + maxValue + 1) + 1) hcount)
  convert hlength using 1
  ring

    (invariant : α → ℕ → σ → Prop) (hbase : ∀ a, invariant a 0 (initial a))

      ∀ next ∈ OracleComp.support (step a state), invariant a (i + 1) next)
    {size : α → ℕ} (hsize : PolyBounded (fun a => (input a).length) size)

      rintro a i ⟨captured, state⟩ hi ⟨rfl, hstate⟩ next hnext

theorem IsTidyOraclePPTOn.finiteStep [Fintype Operation] [Finite Control]
    (machine : _root_.Turing.MultiTapePTM k Bool Control Operation) :
    IsTidyOraclePPTOn (encPair encUnary encFiniteConfig) encFiniteConfig
      (fun pair : ℕ × FiniteConfig k Bool Control Operation =>
        machine.finiteStep
          (fun choices => choices <$> ProbOracleComp.sample (ProbComp.uniform Bool))
          (fun op word => List.take pair.1 <$> ProbOracleComp.query (op, word)) pair.2) := by
  let branch (control : Option Control) (pair : ℕ × FiniteConfig k Bool Control Operation) :
      WordOracleComp Operation (FiniteConfig k Bool Control Operation) :=
    match control with
    | none => pure pair.2
    | some control => do
      let bit ← ProbOracleComp.sample (ProbComp.uniform Bool)
      match machine.tr control pair.2.tapes.inputSymbol pair.2.tapes.workTapeSymbols
          pair.2.answerSymbols bit with
      | .step action symbol move => pure (pair.2.step action symbol move)
      | .query channel next => do
        let answer ← ProbOracleComp.query (spec := fun _ : Operation × List Bool => List Bool)
          (channel, (pair.2.channels channel).1)

      branch pair.2.tapes.state pair = machine.finiteStep
        (fun choices => choices <$> ProbOracleComp.sample (ProbComp.uniform Bool))
        (fun op word => List.take pair.1 <$> ProbOracleComp.query (op, word)) pair.2 := by
    rcases pair with ⟨limit, cfg⟩
    cases hstate : cfg.tapes.state with
    | none => simp only [branch, MultiTapeMachine.finiteStep, hstate]
    | some control =>
      simp only [branch, MultiTapeMachine.finiteStep, hstate, bind_map_left]
      congr 1
      funext bit
      cases machine.tr control cfg.tapes.inputSymbol cfg.tapes.workTapeSymbols cfg.answerSymbols
          bit with
      | step action symbol move => rfl
      | query channel next => rfl
  refine (IsTidyOraclePPTOn.finite_cases (tagEncoding := encFinite (Option Control))
    (tag := fun pair : ℕ × FiniteConfig k Bool Control Operation => pair.2.tapes.state)
    (branch := branch) (by fun_prop) fun control => ?_).congr
      fun pair State oracle s => by rw [hprogram]
  cases control with
  | none => exact IsTidyOraclePPTOn.of_computableInPolyTime (by fun_prop)
  | some control =>
    apply (IsTidyOraclePPTOn.uniform_bool (encPair encUnary encFiniteConfig)).bind_with

    · fun_prop
    · rintro ⟨inputSymbol, workSymbols, answerSymbols, bit⟩
      cases machine.tr control inputSymbol workSymbols answerSymbols bit with

theorem IsTidyOraclePPTOn.runOracle [Finite Operation] [Finite Control]
    (machine : _root_.Turing.MultiTapePTM k Bool Control Operation) (c d : ℕ) :
    IsTidyOraclePPTOn encBits encBits
      (fun word : List Bool => machine.runOracle (c * (word.length + 1) ^ d) word) := by
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite Operation
  obtain ⟨cf, hconfigurationSize⟩ :=
    length_encFiniteConfig_le (k := k) (State := Control) (Oracle := Operation)
  let clock (word : List Bool) : ℕ := c * (word.length + 1) ^ d
  have hclock : ComputableInPolyTime clock encBits encUnary := by
    dsimp only [clock]
    fun_prop
  have hclockPoly : PolyBounded (fun word => (encBits word).length) clock := by
    simpa only [encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate] using hclock.polyBounded_length
  have hstart : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun word => FiniteConfig.init (k := k) (Oracle := Operation) machine.initial word)
      encBits encFiniteConfig := by fun_prop
  let step (word : List Bool) (cfg : FiniteConfig k Bool Control Operation) :
      WordOracleComp Operation (FiniteConfig k Bool Control Operation) :=
    machine.finiteStep (fun choices => choices <$> ProbOracleComp.sample (ProbComp.uniform Bool))
      (fun op query => List.take (clock word) <$> ProbOracleComp.query (op, query)) cfg
  have hstep : IsTidyOraclePPTOn (encPair encBits encFiniteConfig) encFiniteConfig
      (fun pair => step pair.1 pair.2) :=
    (IsTidyOraclePPTOn.finiteStep machine).preprocess
      (prepare := fun pair : List Bool × FiniteConfig k Bool Control Operation =>
        (clock pair.1, pair.2)) (by fun_prop)
  have hloop := (IsTidyOraclePPTOn.iterateWith_spec hclock hstart hstep
    (fun word i cfg => FiniteConfig.SpaceBound word.length i (clock word) cfg)
    (fun word => FiniteConfig.spaceBound_init _ _ _)
    (by
      intro word i cfg _ hcfg next hnext
      cases hstate : cfg.tapes.state with
      | none =>
        simp only [step, MultiTapeMachine.finiteStep, hstate] at hnext
        exact (OracleComp.eq_of_mem_supportWith_pure hnext) ▸
          hcfg.mono le_rfl (Nat.le_succ i) le_rfl
      | some control =>
        simp only [step, MultiTapeMachine.finiteStep, hstate] at hnext
        obtain ⟨action, _, hnext⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_bind_iff.mp hnext
        cases action with
        | step action symbol move =>
          exact (OracleComp.eq_of_mem_supportWith_pure hnext) ▸ hcfg.step action symbol move
        | query channel control =>
          obtain ⟨answer, hanswer, hnext⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_bind_iff.mp hnext
          obtain ⟨reply, _, rfl⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_map_iff.mp hanswer
          exact (OracleComp.eq_of_mem_supportWith_pure hnext) ▸
            hcfg.receive channel control _ (List.length_take_le _ _))
    (size := fun word => cf * (word.length + clock word + clock word + 1))
    ((PolyBounded.const cf).mul
      (((PolyBounded.self.add hclockPoly).add hclockPoly).add (.const 1)))
    (fun word i cfg hi hcfg => (hconfigurationSize _ _ _ cfg hcfg).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cf (by lia)))).1
  refine (hloop.map (by fun_prop : ComputableInPolyTime
    (fun cfg : FiniteConfig k Bool Control Operation => cfg.tapes.output)
    encFiniteConfig encBits)).congr fun word State oracle s => ?_
  rw [← finiteRunFrom_take_runOracle]
  rfl

      ∀ result ∈ OracleComp.support (handler a request state),

        (stateEncoding result.2).length ≤ (stateEncoding state).length + resources a request.2) :

    have hclock : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ d) encUnary encUnary := by

theorem bind {first : α → WordOracleComp Operation β} {second : β → WordOracleComp Operation γ}
    (hfirst : IsTidyOraclePPTOn input middle first)
    (hsecond : IsTidyOraclePPTOn middle output second) :
    IsTidyOraclePPTOn input output (fun a => first a >>= second) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hops, k₁, Control₁, hfinite₁, source, c₁, d₁, hsource⟩ := hfirst
  obtain ⟨_, k₂, Control₂, hfinite₂, target, c₂, d₂, htarget⟩ := hsecond
  let firstTime := fun length => c₁ * (length + 1) ^ d₁
  let secondTime := fun length => c₂ * (firstTime length + 1) ^ d₂
  let continuation : List Bool → WordOracleComp Operation (List Bool) :=
    Function.extend middle (fun b => output <$> second b) (fun _ => pure [])
  have hcontinuation (b : β) : continuation (middle b) = output <$> second b :=
    middle.injective.extend_apply _ _ b
  have hpoly : Cslib.PolynomiallyBounded
      (fun length => 5 * firstTime length + secondTime length + 9) := by
    fun_prop
  refine of_polyBounded (target.tidyComp source true)
    (.of_polynomiallyBounded (fun a => (input a).length) hpoly) fun a => ?_
  have hcomp := (hsource a).comp true (prog₂ := continuation) (t₂ := secondTime (input a).length)
    (fun word State oracle s s' hword => by
      have hlength := (hsource a).length_output_le oracle s hword
      rw [OracleComp.interpret_map, StateT.run_map, PMF.monad_map_eq_map,
        PMF.mem_support_map_iff] at hword
      obtain ⟨⟨b, s₁⟩, _, heq⟩ := hword
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj heq
      rw [hcontinuation]
      exact (htarget b).mono (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₂
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right hlength 1) d₂)))
  simpa only [bind_map_left, hcontinuation, map_bind] using hcomp

    dsimp only [start]

theorem approxDegree_threshold_one_right_le {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 * n ≤ d ^ 2 + 1) :
    approxDegree (1 / 3) (threshold n 1) ≤ d := by
  rcases lt_or_ge n 2 with hn | hn
  · -- at most one bit: the disjunction itself has degree `n ≤ d`
    refine (approxDegree_le_degree (by norm_num)).trans ?_
    rw [degree_threshold_one_right]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge d 1 with hd1 | hd1
    · interval_cases d
      omega
    · omega
  have hN : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n - 1 := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    linarith
  set N : ℝ := n - 1
  have hN0 : 0 < N := by linarith
  -- `L k = (n - k) / (n - 1)`, from `L 0 = 1 + 1 / N` down to `L n = 0`
  set L : ℝ[X] := C (n / N) - C (1 / N) * X
  have hL (t : ℝ) : L.eval t = (n - t) / N := by
    simp only [L, eval_sub, eval_C, eval_mul, eval_X]
    ring
  set τ := (Chebyshev.T ℝ d).eval (L.eval 0)
  have hτ : 3 ≤ τ := by
    have h := Chebyshev.one_add_sq_mul_le_eval_T d (μ := 1 / N) (by positivity)
    have hL0 : L.eval 0 = 1 + 1 / N := by
      rw [hL]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hd' : 2 * N ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have : (2 * n : ℝ) ≤ d ^ 2 + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hd
      linarith
    have : 2 ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 / N) := by
      rw [mul_one_div, le_div_iff₀ hN0]
      exact hd'
    simp only [τ, hL0]
    linarith
  have hτ0 : 0 < τ := by linarith
  set Q : ℝ[X] := 1 - C τ⁻¹ * (Chebyshev.T ℝ d).comp L
  have hQdeg : Q.natDegree ≤ d := by
    have hLdeg : L.natDegree ≤ 1 :=
      natDegree_sub_le_of_le ((natDegree_C _).le.trans zero_le_one)
        ((natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans natDegree_X_le)
    have hTL : ((Chebyshev.T ℝ d).comp L).natDegree ≤ d := by
      refine natDegree_comp_le.trans ?_
      rw [Chebyshev.natDegree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast]
      nlinarith
    exact (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le (by simp) ((natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans hTL))
  refine approxDegree_le_of_mem_lowDegree (p := fun x => Q.eval (weight x : ℝ))
    (lowDegree_mono hQdeg (eval_weight_mem_lowDegree Q)) fun x => ?_
  have hQ (t : ℝ) : Q.eval t = 1 - τ⁻¹ * (Chebyshev.T ℝ d).eval (L.eval t) := by
    simp only [Q, eval_sub, eval_one, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_comp]
  rw [threshold_apply, hQ]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (weight x) with h0 | hpos
  · -- the all-false input: `Q 0 = 0`
    rw [h0, Nat.cast_zero, inv_mul_cancel₀ hτ0.ne']
    simp
  · -- an input of weight `k ≥ 1`: `|Q k - 1| ≤ 1 / τ ≤ 1 / 3`
    have hk : (1 : ℝ) ≤ weight x := by exact_mod_cast hpos
    have hkn : (weight x : ℝ) ≤ n := by
      have := weight_le x
      rw [Fintype.card_fin] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hu : |L.eval (weight x : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hL, abs_le]
      constructor
      · rw [le_div_iff₀ hN0]; linarith
      · rw [div_le_iff₀ hN0]; linarith
    have hT := Chebyshev.abs_eval_T_real_le_one d hu
    have h1 : decide (1 ≤ weight x) = true := decide_eq_true hpos
    rw [h1, bitVal_true, sub_sub_cancel_left, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hτ0]
    calc τ⁻¹ * |(Chebyshev.T ℝ d).eval (L.eval (weight x : ℝ))| ≤ τ⁻¹ * 1 := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 1 / 3 := by
        rw [mul_one, inv_le_comm₀ hτ0 (by norm_num)]
        norm_num
        exact hτ

theorem sqrt_card_le_sensitivity_of_fourierCoeff_ne_zero {f : BooleanFunction n}
    {S : Finset (Fin n)} (h : fourierCoeff (fun x => signVal (f x)) S ≠ 0) :
    √(#S : ℝ) ≤ sensitivity f := by
  -- `f` twisted by the parity on `S`
  set g : BitString n → Bool := fun x => f x ^^ parityOn S x with hg
  have hf (y : BitString n) : f y = (g y ^^ parityOn S y) := by
    simp only [hg, Bool.xor_assoc, Bool.xor_self, Bool.xor_false]
  -- the coefficient is the bias of `g`, so `g` is unbalanced
  have hsum : ∑ x, signVal (g x) = (#{x | ¬g x = true} : ℝ) - #{x | g x = true} := by
    simp only [signVal, sum_ite, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_neg, mul_one]
    ring
  have hne : #{x | g x = true} ≠ #{x | ¬g x = true} := fun heq => h (by
    simp only [fourierCoeff, chi_eq_signVal_parityOn, ← signVal_xor]
    rw [expect_eq_sum_div_card, hsum, heq, sub_self, zero_div])
  have hcard := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := univ) fun x : BitString n =>
    g x = true
  rw [card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
  -- one of the fibers of `g` has more than half of the points
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : Bool, 2 ^ n < 2 * #{x | g x = c} := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
    · refine ⟨false, ?_⟩
      simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hcard hlt
      omega
    · exact ⟨true, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hS⟩ := exists_mem_sqrt_card_le_card_update_mem
    (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]) S
  refine hS.trans ?_
  -- along the directions of `S` inside the fiber, `g` is constant and `f` flips
  refine Nat.cast_le.2 (card_le_sensitivity_of_forall_isSensitiveCoord (x := x) fun i hi => ?_)
  obtain ⟨hiS, hiV⟩ := mem_filter.1 hi
  have hgx : g x = c := (mem_filter.1 hx).2
  have hgi : g (update x i (!x i)) = c := (mem_filter.1 hiV).2
  rw [IsSensitiveCoord, hf, hf x, hgi, hgx, parityOn_update_not hiS]
  cases c <;> cases parityOn S x <;> decide

theorem complexity_le_degree_mul_blockSensitivity (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    complexity f ≤ degree f * blockSensitivity f := by
  suffices ∀ m (f : BooleanFunction n), blockSensitivity f ≤ m →
      complexity f ≤ degree f * m from this _ f le_rfl
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro f hf
    have h := complexity_le_blockSensitivity_pow_three f
    simpa [Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hf] using h
  | succ m ih =>
    intro f hf
    by_cases hd : degree f = 0
    · have hbs : blockSensitivity f = 0 := by
        have := blockSensitivity_le_two_mul_degree_sq f
        simp only [hd, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, mul_zero] at this
        exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero this
      have h := complexity_le_blockSensitivity_pow_three f
      simpa [hbs, hd] using h
    obtain ⟨S, hScard, hS⟩ := exists_card_eq_degree_forall_exists_isSensitiveBlock_subset f hd
    refine (complexity_le_card_add S (d := degree f * m) fun a => ?_).trans_eq ?_
    · have hbs : blockSensitivity (fun y => f (S.piecewise a y)) ≤ m := by
        refine Finset.sup_le fun z _ => ?_
        obtain ⟨B, hBS, hB⟩ := hS (S.piecewise a z)
        have := (blockSensitivityAt_comp_piecewise_add_one_le a z hBS hB).trans
          ((blockSensitivityAt_le_blockSensitivity f _).trans hf)
        omega
      have hdeg : degree (fun y => f (S.piecewise a y)) ≤ degree f := by
        refine degree_le_iff_mem_lowDegree.2
          (comp_mem_lowDegree (φ := fun y => S.piecewise a y) ?_ (mem_lowDegree_totalDegree _))
        intro i
        by_cases hi : i ∈ S
        · simpa [hi] using const_mem_lowDegree (R := ℝ) (ι := Fin n) 1 (bitVal ℝ (a i))
        · simpa [hi] using bitVal_mem_lowDegree (R := ℝ) i
      exact (ih _ hbs).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right m hdeg)
    · rw [hScard, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm]

private theorem certificateComplexityAt_le_sensitivityFor_true (hf : Monotone f)
    {x : BitString n} (hx : f x = true) : certificateComplexityAt f x ≤ sensitivityFor f true := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hmin⟩ := exists_min_image (univ.filter fun y => y ≤ x ∧ f y = true) weight
    ⟨x, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, le_rfl, hx⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨hyx, hfy⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hy).2
  -- clearing a true bit of `y` gives a lighter input below `x`, of value `0`
  have hsens : ∀ i ∈ univ.filter fun i => y i = true, IsSensitiveCoord f y i := by
    intro i hi
    have hyi : y i = true := (mem_filter.1 hi).2
    rw [IsSensitiveCoord, hyi, Bool.not_true, hfy]
    intro h
    have hw := weight_update_false hyi
    have := hmin _ (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _,
      (update_le_iff.2 ⟨Bool.false_le _, fun _ _ => le_rfl⟩).trans hyx, h⟩)
    omega
  -- the true bits of `y` certify the value `1`
  refine (certificateComplexityAt_le (S := univ.filter fun i => y i = true) fun z hz => ?_).trans
    ((card_le_sensitivityAt hsens).trans (sensitivityAt_le_sensitivityFor hfy))
  have hyz : y ≤ z := fun k => by
    cases hk : y k with
    | false => exact Bool.false_le _
    | true => exact hk ▸ (hyx k).trans_eq (hz k (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, hk⟩)).symm
  have := hf hyz
  rw [hfy] at this
  rw [hx]
  exact le_antisymm (Bool.le_true _) this

theorem one_sub_two_mul_mul_blockSensitivity_le_of_mem_lowDegree {p : BitString n → ℝ} {D : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ lowDegree ℝ (Fin n) D) {ε : ℝ} (hpf : ∀ x, |p x - bitVal ℝ (f x)| ≤ ε) :
    (1 - 2 * ε) * blockSensitivity f ≤ 2 * D ^ 2 := by
  rcases le_or_gt (1 - 2 * ε) 0 with hε | hε
  · exact (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hε (Nat.cast_nonneg _)).trans (by positivity)
  -- an input and a family of pairwise disjoint sensitive blocks attaining `bs(f)`

  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFcard⟩ := exists_mem_eq_sup (sensitiveFamilies f x)
    ⟨∅, mem_sensitiveFamilies.2 ⟨by simp, by simp⟩⟩ card
  rw [mem_sensitiveFamilies] at hF
  rw [blockSensitivity, hx, blockSensitivityAt, hFcard]
  set m := #F
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm | hm
  · rw [hm, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]
    positivity
  set B : Fin m → Block n := fun j => (F.equivFin.symm j : Block n)
  have hBF (j : Fin m) : B j ∈ F := (F.equivFin.symm j).2
  have hBinj : Function.Injective B := fun j j' h =>
    F.equivFin.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)
  have hB : Pairwise fun j j' => Disjoint (B j) (B j') := fun j j' hjj =>
    hF.2 (hBF j) (hBF j') (hBinj.ne hjj)
  -- normalize so that `f x` reads as `0`
  set h : BitString n → ℝ := fun z => if f x then 1 - p z else p z
  have hh : h ∈ lowDegree ℝ (Fin n) D := by
    cases hfx : f x
    · simpa [h, hfx] using hp
    · convert one_sub_mem_lowDegree hp using 1
      funext z
      simp [h, hfx]
  have hhf (z : BitString n) : |h z - bitVal ℝ (f z ^^ f x)| ≤ ε := by
    have := hpf z
    cases hfx : f x
    · simpa [h, hfx] using this
    · rw [← abs_neg] at this
      convert this using 2
      simp only [h, hfx, ↓reduceIte, Bool.xor_true, bitVal_not]
      ring
  -- the restriction to the subcube spanned by the blocks
  set g : BitString m → ℝ := fun y => h (flipBlocks B x y)
  have hg : g ∈ lowDegree ℝ (Fin m) D :=
    comp_mem_lowDegree (bitVal_flipBlocks_mem_lowDegree hB x) hh
  have hgI (y : BitString m) : g y ∈ Set.Icc (-ε) (1 + ε) := by
    have h₁ := abs_le.1 (hhf (flipBlocks B x y))
    have h₂ := bitVal_mem_Icc (f (flipBlocks B x y) ^^ f x)
    exact ⟨by linarith [h₁.1, h₂.1], by linarith [h₁.2, h₂.2]⟩

    have hy' : ({j | y j = true} : Finset (Fin m)) = ∅ := card_eq_zero.1 hy
    have := (abs_le.1 (hhf (flipBlocks B x y))).2
    simp only [flipBlocks, hy', biUnion_empty, flipBlock_empty, Bool.xor_self, bitVal_false]
      at this
    change h (flipBlocks B x y) ≤ ε
    simp only [flipBlocks, hy', biUnion_empty, flipBlock_empty]
    linarith
  have hg₁ (y : BitString m) (hy : weight y = 1) : 1 - ε ≤ g y := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := card_eq_one.1 hy
    have := (abs_le.1 (hhf (flipBlocks B x y))).1
    have hsens : f (flipBlock (B j) x) ≠ f x := hF.1 _ (hBF j)
    have hxor : (f (flipBlock (B j) x) ^^ f x) = true := by
      cases h₁ : f (flipBlock (B j) x) <;> cases h₂ : f x <;> simp_all
    simp only [flipBlocks, hj, singleton_biUnion, hxor, bitVal_true] at this
    change 1 - ε ≤ h (flipBlocks B x y)
    simp only [flipBlocks, hj, singleton_biUnion]
    linarith
  -- its symmetrization
  obtain ⟨q, hqdeg, hq⟩ := exists_natDegree_le_eval_eq_layerAverage hg
  have hlayer {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ m) :
      ({x : BitString m | weight x = k} : Finset (BitString m)).Nonempty :=
    weightLayer_nonempty hk
  have hqI (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) : q.eval (k : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-ε) (1 + ε) := by
    rw [hq k (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; exact hk), layerAverage]

theorem Computes.one_sub_two_mul_mul_blockSensitivity_le_depth (h : μ.Computes ε f) :
    (1 - 2 * ε) * blockSensitivity f ≤ μ.depth := by
  classical
  -- an input and a family of pairwise disjoint sensitive blocks attaining `bs(f)`
  obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := exists_mem_eq_sup univ univ_nonempty (blockSensitivityAt f)
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFcard⟩ := exists_mem_eq_sup (sensitiveFamilies f x)
    ⟨∅, mem_sensitiveFamilies.2 ⟨by simp, by simp⟩⟩ card
  rw [mem_sensitiveFamilies] at hF
  rw [blockSensitivity, hx, blockSensitivityAt, hFcard]
  set e : DecisionTree (Fin n) Bool → BitString n → ℝ := fun t y =>
    if t.eval y = f y then 0 else 1
  have he (t : DecisionTree (Fin n) Bool) (y : BitString n) : 0 ≤ e t y := by
    simp only [e]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  -- every tree that `μ` can draw meets at most `depth μ` blocks and errs for every other block
  have key (t : DecisionTree (Fin n) Bool) (ht : t ∈ μ.weights.support) :
      (#F : ℝ) ≤ μ.depth + ∑ B ∈ F, (e t x + e t (flipBlock B x)) := by
    set Q := t.queries x
    have hhit : #(F.filter fun B => ¬Disjoint B Q) ≤ μ.depth := by
      refine (card_le_card_biUnion (f := fun B => B ∩ Q) (fun B hB B' hB' hne =>
        Disjoint.mono inter_subset_left inter_subset_left
          (hF.2 (mem_filter.1 hB).1 (mem_filter.1 hB').1 hne))
        fun B hB => not_disjoint_iff_nonempty_inter.1 (mem_filter.1 hB).2).trans ?_
      exact ((card_le_card (biUnion_subset.2 fun _ _ => inter_subset_right)).trans
        (t.card_queries_le_depth x)).trans (depth_le_depth ht)
    have hmiss : (#(F.filter fun B => Disjoint B Q) : ℝ) ≤
        ∑ B ∈ F, (e t x + e t (flipBlock B x)) := by
      rw [card_eq_sum_ones, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_one]
      refine (sum_le_sum fun B hB => one_le_err_add_err (hF.1 B (mem_filter.1 hB).1)
        (mem_filter.1 hB).2).trans ?_
      exact sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (filter_subset _ _) fun B _ _ =>
        add_nonneg (he t x) (he t _)
    have hsplit := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := F) fun B => Disjoint B Q
    have : (#F : ℝ) = #(F.filter fun B => Disjoint B Q) + #(F.filter fun B => ¬Disjoint B Q) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_add, hsplit]
    rw [this]
    have hhit' : (#(F.filter fun B => ¬Disjoint B Q) : ℝ) ≤ μ.depth := by exact_mod_cast hhit
    linarith
  -- average over the tree drawn from `μ`
  have htot : ∑ t ∈ μ.weights.support, μ.weights t = 1 := by simpa [Finsupp.sum] using μ.total
  have havg := Finset.sum_le_sum fun t ht =>
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (key t ht) (μ.weights_nonneg t)
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, htot, one_mul] at havg
  have hrhs : ∑ t ∈ μ.weights.support,
      μ.weights t * (μ.depth + ∑ B ∈ F, (e t x + e t (flipBlock B x))) =
      μ.depth + ∑ B ∈ F, (μ.errorProb f x + μ.errorProb f (flipBlock B x)) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => mul_add _ _ _, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
      htot, one_mul]
    congr 1
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun B _ => ?_
    simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, errorProb_eq_sum, Finsupp.sum, e]
  have herr : ∑ B ∈ F, (μ.errorProb f x + μ.errorProb f (flipBlock B x)) ≤ 2 * ε * #F := by
    refine (sum_le_sum fun B _ => add_le_add (h x) (h (flipBlock B x))).trans_eq ?_
    rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  linarith

theorem complexity_le_blockSensitivityFor_mul_certificateComplexityFor (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    complexity f ≤ blockSensitivityFor f false * certificateComplexityFor f true := by
  suffices ∀ m (f : BooleanFunction n), blockSensitivityFor f false ≤ m →
      complexity f ≤ m * certificateComplexityFor f true from this _ f le_rfl
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro f hf
    refine (complexity_eq_zero_iff.2 fun x y => ?_).trans_le (Nat.zero_le _)
    -- with `bs₀(f) = 0`, no block is sensitive at an input of value `0`
    by_contra hxy
    wlog hx : f x = false generalizing x y
    · exact this y x (Ne.symm hxy) (by simpa [hx] using hxy)
    have hB : IsSensitiveBlock f x ({i | y i ≠ x i} : Finset (Fin n)) := by
      rw [IsSensitiveBlock, flipBlock_filter_ne]
      exact Ne.symm hxy
    have h1 := card_le_blockSensitivityAt (F := {({i | y i ≠ x i} : Finset (Fin n))})
      ⟨fun B hB' => by rw [mem_singleton.1 hB']; exact hB, by simp⟩
    rw [card_singleton] at h1
    have := (blockSensitivityAt_le_blockSensitivityFor hx).trans hf
    omega
  | succ m ih =>
    intro f hf
    by_cases h1 : ∃ x, f x = true
    swap
    · push Not at h1
      exact (complexity_eq_zero_iff.2 fun x y => by simp [h1 x, h1 y]).trans_le (Nat.zero_le _)
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hScard⟩ := exists_isCertificate_card_eq f w
    -- query the certificate of `w`, then continue with a tree for the restricted function
    refine (complexity_le_card_add S (d := m * certificateComplexityFor f true) fun a =>
      (ih _ (blockSensitivityFor_comp_piecewise_false_le hS hw a hf)).trans
        (Nat.mul_le_mul_left m (certificateComplexityFor_restrict_le S a true))).trans ?_
    rw [hScard, Nat.succ_mul, add_comm]
    exact Nat.add_le_add_left (certificateComplexityAt_le_certificateComplexityFor hw) _

      (∀ m : ℕ,
        0 < Fintype.card I ^ m ∧
        iterateFin f m (fun _ => false) = false ∧
        (∃ x y, iterateFin f m x ≠ iterateFin f m y) ∧

  have hBr : (A : ℝ) ^ 2 < (B : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hB
  have hAp : 0 < (A : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hB1 : 1 < (B : ℝ) := by nlinarith
  have hBp : 0 < (B : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hBn : 0 < B := by exact_mod_cast hBp

  have hcard : 0 < Fintype.card I := by
    by_contra h
    have : IsEmpty I := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h)
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := nonconstant_of_blockSensitivityAt_pos f (fun _ => false) hbf
    exact hxy (congrArg f (funext fun i => isEmptyElim i))
  have hα := log_exponent_gt_two hAr hBr
  have hpow := rpow_log_exponent hAr hBp
  have hs' (m : ℕ) : (sensitivity (iterateFin f m) : ℝ) ≤ (A : ℝ) ^ m := by
    have hp : sensitivity f ^ m ≤ A ^ m := by gcongr
    exact_mod_cast (sensitivity_iterateFin_le f m).trans hp

      _ = ((A : ℝ) ^ (Real.log (B : ℝ) / Real.log (A : ℝ))) ^ m := by

  have hcond := (rowClause_eq_true_iff T label F q x i).mp hi
  have hcond' := (rowClause_eq_true_iff T label F q' x i).mp hi'

/-- If the row clause `i` is false at `x` but true after flipping `((j, c), a)`, then either `i` is
a target candidate, `j = i`, and the flip changes the final predicate on the child `(j, c)` from
`false` to `true`; or `i` is a gate candidate, `T.Adj i j`, `c = label i j`, and the flip changes
the gate predicate on the child `(j, c)` from `true` to `false`. -/
theorem rowClause_repair_cases {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [DecidableEq ((Fin k × Fin r) × I)]
    (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool)
    (i j : Fin k) (c : Fin r) (a : I)
    (hi : rowClause T label F q x i = false)
    (hf : rowClause T label F q (BitString.flipOn {((j, c), a)} x) i = true) :
    (i ∈ targetCandidates T label F q x ∧ j = i ∧
      F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x j c) = false ∧
      F (Fin.last h) (BitString.flipOn {a} (recursiveChild x j c)) = true) ∨
    (i ∈ gateCandidates T label F q x ∧ T.Adj i j ∧ c = label i j ∧
      F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j c) = true ∧
      F (gateIndex q) (BitString.flipOn {a} (recursiveChild x j c)) = false) := by
  have hchange : rowClause T label F q (BitString.flipOn {((j, c), a)} x) i ≠
      rowClause T label F q x i := by
    simp [hi, hf]
  rcases rowClause_flip_change T label F q x i j c a hchange with
    ⟨hji, ht⟩ | ⟨hij, rfl, hg⟩
  · subst j
    have hton := ((rowClause_eq_true_iff T label F q _ i).mp hf).1 c
    rw [recursiveChild_flip_same] at hton
    have htoff : F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x i c) = false := by
      cases hc : F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x i c)
      · rfl
      · exact False.elim (ht (hton.trans hc.symm))
    have htargets : targetFailures F x i = {c} := by
      ext c'
      simp only [targetFailures, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · intro hfalse
        exact congrArg Prod.snd (repaired_target_location T label F q x i i c c' a hf hfalse)
      · rintro rfl
        exact htoff
    have hgates : gateFailures T label F q x i = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro j' hj'
      have h := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj').2
      have heq := repaired_gate_location T label F q x i i j' c a hf h.1 h.2
      exact T.ne_of_adj h.1 (congrArg Prod.fst heq).symm
    have hmem : i ∈ targetCandidates T label F q x := by
      simp [targetCandidates, htargets, hgates]
    exact Or.inl ⟨hmem, rfl, htoff, hton⟩
  · have hgoff := ((rowClause_eq_true_iff T label F q _ i).mp hf).2 j hij
    rw [recursiveChild_flip_same] at hgoff
    have hgon : F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j (label i j)) = true := by
      cases hc : F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j (label i j))
      · exact False.elim (hg (hgoff.trans hc.symm))
      · rfl
    have htargets : targetFailures F x i = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro c' hc'
      have heq := repaired_target_location T label F q x i j (label i j) c' a hf
        (Finset.mem_filter.mp hc').2
      exact T.ne_of_adj hij (congrArg Prod.fst heq)
    have hgates : gateFailures T label F q x i = {j} := by
      ext j'
      simp only [gateFailures, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hij', hon⟩
        exact congrArg Prod.fst
          (repaired_gate_location T label F q x i j j' (label i j) a hf hij' hon)
      · rintro rfl
        exact ⟨hij, hgon⟩
    have hmem : i ∈ gateCandidates T label F q x := by
      simp [gateCandidates, htargets, hgates]
    exact Or.inr ⟨hmem, hij, rfl, hgon, hgoff⟩

/-- For a good labeling `A`, a nested family `F` and `0 < r`, at an input `x` where
`recursiveFamily T A.label F q` is `false`, its sensitivity at `x` is at most
`15 * sideSensitivity F false + sideSensitivity F true + 3 * jointSensitivity F true`. -/
theorem recursive_sensitivity_zero_at {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (T : Tournament k) (A : GoodLabeling T r)
    (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool) (hF : NestedFamily F) (hr : 0 < r)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool)
    (hx : recursiveFamily T A.label F q x = false) :
    sensitivityAt (recursiveFamily T A.label F q) x ≤
      15 * sideSensitivity F false + sideSensitivity F true + 3 * jointSensitivity F true := by
  let TC := targetCandidates T A.label F q x
  let GC := gateCandidates T A.label F q x
  let SC := gateSinks T A.label F q x
  let NC := GC \ SC
  let w := gateWitness T A.label F q x
  let U := TC.biUnion fun i => childChanges F (Fin.last h) x i (targetWitness F x hr i)
  let V := NC.biUnion fun i =>
    childJointChanges F (gateIndex q) (Fin.last h) x (w i) (A.label i (w i))
  let W := SC.biUnion fun i => childChanges F (gateIndex q) x (w i) (A.label i (w i))
  have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter fun p =>
      recursiveFamily T A.label F q (BitString.flipOn {p} x) ≠
        recursiveFamily T A.label F q x) ⊆
      U ∪ (V ∪ W) := by
    rintro ⟨⟨j, c⟩, a⟩ hp
    have hchange := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
    have hon : recursiveFamily T A.label F q (BitString.flipOn {((j, c), a)} x) = true := by
      cases hy : recursiveFamily T A.label F q (BitString.flipOn {((j, c), a)} x)
      · exact False.elim (hchange (hy.trans hx.symm))
      · rfl
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (recursiveFamily_eq_true_iff T A.label F q _).mp hon
    have hioff := (recursiveFamily_eq_false_iff T A.label F q x).mp hx i
    rcases rowClause_repair_cases T A.label F q x i j c a hioff hi with
      ⟨hit, hji, htoff, hton⟩ | ⟨hig, hij, rfl, hgon, hgoff⟩
    · subst j
      have hc := targetWitness_unique T A.label F q x hr i hit c htoff
      apply Finset.mem_union_left
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨i, hit, ?_⟩
      have hn : F (Fin.last h) (BitString.flipOn {a} (recursiveChild x i c)) ≠
          F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x i c) := by simp [hton, htoff]
      simpa [childChanges, hc] using hn
    · have hj := gateWitness_unique T A.label F q x i hig j hij hgon
      apply Finset.mem_union_right
      by_cases hs : i ∈ SC
      · apply Finset.mem_union_right
        apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
        refine ⟨i, hs, ?_⟩
        have hn : F (gateIndex q) (BitString.flipOn {a} (recursiveChild x j (A.label i j))) ≠
            F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j (A.label i j)) := by simp [hgon, hgoff]
        simpa [childChanges, w, hj] using hn
      · have hwg := nonsink_gateWitness_mem T A.label F hF q x i hig hs
        have hjg : j ∈ gateCandidates T A.label F q x := by simpa [hj] using hwg
        have hton :=
          (targetFailures_empty_iff F x j).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hjg).2.1 (A.label i j)
        have htoff := hF.rejects_of_le (gateIndex_lt_last q).le hgoff
        apply Finset.mem_union_left
        apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
        refine ⟨i, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hig, hs⟩, ?_⟩
        have hn :
            F (gateIndex q) (BitString.flipOn {a} (recursiveChild x j (A.label i j))) ≠
              F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j (A.label i j)) ∧
            F (Fin.last h) (BitString.flipOn {a} (recursiveChild x j (A.label i j))) ≠
              F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x j (A.label i j)) := by
          simp [hgon, hgoff, hton, htoff]
        simpa [childJointChanges, w, hj] using hn

    targetCandidates_biUnion_card_le T A F hF hr q x
  have hV : V.card ≤ 3 * jointSensitivity F true := by
    calc
      V.card ≤ NC.card * jointSensitivity F true :=
        card_biUnion_le_mul NC _ _ (fun i hi => by
          have hg := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi
          have hw := nonsink_gateWitness_mem T A.label F hF q x i hg.1 hg.2
          have hgate := (gateWitness_spec T A.label F q x i hg.1).2
          have htarget := (targetFailures_empty_iff F x _).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).2.1
            (A.label i (w i))
          rw [childJointChanges_card]
          exact jointSensitivityAt_le_jointSensitivity F true _ _ _
            (gateIndex_lt_last q) hgate htarget)
      _ ≤ GC.card * jointSensitivity F true :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Finset.card_le_card Finset.sdiff_subset)

    calc
      W.card ≤ SC.card * sideSensitivity F true :=
        card_biUnion_le_mul SC _ _ (fun i hi => by

            (gateWitness_spec T A.label F q x i (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1).2)
      _ ≤ 1 * sideSensitivity F true := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (gateSinks_card T A.label F q x)
      _ = _ := Nat.one_mul _

    sensitivityAt (recursiveFamily T A.label F q) x ≤ (U ∪ (V ∪ W)).card := by
      unfold sensitivityAt
      convert Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ U.card + (V ∪ W).card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ U.card + (V.card + W.card) := Nat.add_le_add_left (Finset.card_union_le _ _) _
    _ ≤ 15 * sideSensitivity F false + (3 * jointSensitivity F true + sideSensitivity F true) :=
      Nat.add_le_add hU (Nat.add_le_add hV hW)
    _ = _ := by omega

    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hbudget : ε * 3 ^ (d + 1) ≤ 2) :
    (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ε * L * (3 ^ n - 1) ≤ L := by
  have hp : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) ≤ 3 ^ (d + 1) :=
    pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.succ_le_succ hn)
  have hb := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp hε).trans hbudget
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb hL
  rw [pow_succ] at hm
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hε hL]

`u (n + 1) ≤ (1 + ε) * u n + 3 * v n` and `v (n + 1) ≤ ε * u n + 3 * v n`, then `u n ≤ 2 * L` and
`v n ≤ ε * L * (3 ^ n - 1)` for all `n ≤ d`. -/

    (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (d M : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hnc : ∃ x y, f x ≠ f y)
    (hs : sensitivity f ≤ 2 * (d + 2) * M ^ (d + 1))
    (hb : M ^ 2 * (2 * M ^ 2 + 1) ^ d ≤ blockSensitivityAt f (fun _ => false)) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ d / (4 * ((d : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2) ≤
      (blockSensitivityAt f (fun _ => false) : ℝ) / (sensitivity f : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
  have hMr : 0 < (M : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hM
  apply (seed_ratio_lower d hMr).trans
  apply ratio_of_bounds
  · exact_mod_cast sensitivity_pos_of_nonconstant f hnc
  · exact_mod_cast hs

  · positivity

theorem quantitative_ratio_tendsto :
    Tendsto (fun d : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) ^ d / (4 * ((d : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)) atTop atTop := by
  have hb := (tendsto_pow_const_div_const_pow_of_one_lt 2 (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)).comp
    (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 2)
  have hz : Tendsto (fun d : ℕ => 4 * ((d : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ d)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := hb.const_mul (16 : ℝ)
    convert h using 1
    · funext d
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_add]
      ring
    · simp
  have hr : Tendsto (fun d : ℕ => 4 * ((d : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ d)
      atTop (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) := by
    apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨hz, Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_⟩
    intro d
    change 0 < 4 * ((d : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ d
    positivity
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, inv_div] using tendsto_inv_nhdsGT_zero.comp hr

theorem certificateComplexityAt_threshold_le (x : BitString n) :
    certificateComplexityAt (threshold n j) x ≤ max j (n + 1 - j) := by
  have hwy := weight_le_length (n := n)
  by_cases hw : j ≤ weight x
  · obtain ⟨S, hS, hcard⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq (s := univ.filter fun i => x i = true)
      (n := j) (by rwa [← weight])
    refine (certificateComplexityAt_le (S := S) fun y hy => ?_).trans
      (hcard.le.trans (le_max_left _ _))
    have hle : #S ≤ weight y := card_le_card fun i hi => by
      have := (mem_filter.1 (hS hi)).2
      simp [hy i hi, this]
    simp only [threshold_apply, decide_eq_decide]
    omega
  · obtain ⟨S, hS, hcard⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq (s := univ.filter fun i => x i = false)
      (n := n + 1 - j) (by
        rw [card_filter_eq_false_eq_card_sub_weight, Fintype.card_fin]; have := hwy x; omega)
    refine (certificateComplexityAt_le (S := S) fun y hy => ?_).trans
      (hcard.le.trans (le_max_right _ _))
    have hle : #S ≤ #{i | y i = false} := card_le_card fun i hi => by
      have := (mem_filter.1 (hS hi)).2
      simp [hy i hi, this]
    rw [card_filter_eq_false_eq_card_sub_weight, Fintype.card_fin] at hle
    have := hwy y
    simp only [threshold_apply, decide_eq_decide]
    omega

    exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨i, hi⟩, fun _ => ⟨i, (hy i (mem_singleton_self i)).trans hi⟩⟩
  · have hx : threshold n 1 (fun _ => true) = true := by
      rw [threshold_one_right, decide_eq_true_iff]

    refine le_trans ?_ (certificateComplexityAt_le_certificateComplexityFor hx)

    rintro rfl

    rw [hx, threshold_one_right] at this

theorem distributionalComplexity_le_randomizedComplexity (ε : ℝ) (ν : StdSimplex ℝ (ι → Bool))
    (f : (ι → Bool) → β) : distributionalComplexity ε ν f ≤ randomizedComplexity ε f := by
  rcases lt_or_ge ε 0 with hε | hε
  · rw [distributionalComplexity_of_neg hε]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hd⟩ := exists_computes_depth_eq_randomizedComplexity hε f
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hνt⟩ := hμ.exists_distributionalError_le ν
  exact (distributionalComplexity_le_depth hνt).trans ((depth_le_depth ht).trans_eq hd)

/-- **The hard direction of Yao's principle**, by the minimax theorem: if for every distribution
`ν` on the inputs some decision tree of depth at most `d` errs with probability at most `ε` on
inputs drawn from `ν`, then some randomized decision tree of depth at most `d` computes `f` with
error `ε`. -/

theorem randomizedComplexity_le_iff_forall_distributionalComplexity_le :
    randomizedComplexity ε f ≤ d ↔
      ∀ ν : StdSimplex ℝ (ι → Bool), distributionalComplexity ε ν f ≤ d := by
  refine ⟨fun h ν => (distributionalComplexity_le_randomizedComplexity ε ν f).trans h,
    fun h => ?_⟩
  rcases lt_or_ge ε 0 with hε | hε
  · rw [randomizedComplexity_of_neg hε]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hd⟩ := exists_computes_of_forall_exists_distributionalError_le fun ν =>
    let ⟨t, ht, hd⟩ := exists_distributionalError_le_depth_eq_distributionalComplexity hε ν f
    ⟨t, hd.trans_le (h ν), ht⟩
  exact (randomizedComplexity_le_depth hμ).trans hd

/-- **Yao's minimax principle**: the randomized decision tree complexity is the largest
distributional complexity over the distributions on the inputs, `R_ε(f) = ⨆ ν, D^ν_ε(f)`. -/

    ∃ ν : StdSimplex ℝ (ι → Bool), distributionalComplexity ε ν f = randomizedComplexity ε f := by
  have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun ν : StdSimplex ℝ (ι → Bool) =>
      distributionalComplexity ε ν f) :=
    ⟨randomizedComplexity ε f, Set.forall_mem_range.mpr fun ν =>
      distributionalComplexity_le_randomizedComplexity ε ν f⟩
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := Nat.sSup_mem (Set.range_nonempty _) hbdd
  exact ⟨ν, hν.trans (randomizedComplexity_eq_iSup_distributionalComplexity ε f).symm⟩

theorem time_prepare_append_le {R b : ℕ} (hR : 5 ≤ R) (tail : Program) (input : List ℕ)
    (hlen : bitLength input.length ≤ b) (hinput : ∀ v ∈ input, bitLength v ≤ b) :
    time logCost (prepare R ++ tail) (prepareSteps R input) (State.init (encode 5 input)) ≤
      (24 + R) * (bitLength (R + 5) + 2) * (input.length + 1) * b := by
  have hb : 1 ≤ b := (one_le_bitLength input.length).trans hlen
  have hvalues (i : ℕ) : bitLength ((input.length :: input).getD i 0) ≤ b := by
    by_cases hi : i < (input.length :: input).length
    · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ 0 hi]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp (List.getElem_mem hi) with h | h
      · rw [h]
        exact hlen
      · exact hinput _ h
    · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ 0 (by lia)]
      exact hb
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := run_copy_loop hR tail (input.length :: input) (input.length + 1) 0
  have hsetup := time_setup_le (R := R) tail input hlen
  have hcopy := time_copy_loop_le hR tail (input.length :: input) 0 le_rfl hlen hvalues
  rw [prepareSteps, time_add, time_add, run_add, run_setup hR, hv]
  change _ + _ + time logCost (prepare R ++ tail) R
    ⟨12, copyRegs R (input.length :: input) 0 v⟩ ≤ _
  rw [time_clear tail le_rfl]
  have hbound : bitLength (R + 5) + b + 1 ≤ (bitLength (R + 5) + 2) * b := by
    nlinarith
  have hcost := add_le_add (add_le_add hsetup hcopy) (Nat.le_refl R)
  refine hcost.trans ?_
  calc
    _ ≤ (24 + R) * (input.length + 1) * (bitLength (R + 5) + b + 1) := by
      have hfirst : 12 * (bitLength (R + 5) + b + 1) ≤
          12 * (input.length + 1) * (bitLength (R + 5) + b + 1) := by
        gcongr
        lia
      have hclear : R ≤ R * ((input.length + 1) * (bitLength (R + 5) + b + 1)) := by
        exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by positivity)
      nlinarith only [hfirst, hclear]
    _ ≤ (24 + R) * (input.length + 1) * ((bitLength (R + 5) + 2) * b) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hbound
    _ = _ := by ring

  | @node d g l r ihl ihr =>

      have hlt := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp

      rw [List.append_assoc, List.getElem?_append_right (by simp; omega),
        List.getElem?_append_left (by simp at hlt ⊢; omega)]

    · rw [readBit_of_addr (A := I.n) rfl, USTCONInstance.getD_encode_n _ le_rfl]

  -- the source
  have h₂ : Reaches I { init with ctl := .hdrS, n := I.n }
      { init with ctl := .hdrT, n := I.n, s := I.s } := by
    refine (reaches_iterate (fun i ↦ { init with ctl := .hdrS, n := I.n, cnt := i }) I.s

    refine (reaches_iterate (fun i ↦ { init with ctl := .hdrT, n := I.n, s := I.s, cnt := i })
      I.t fun i hi ↦ .single (by simp) ?_) |>.trans (.single (by simp) ?_)

private theorem reaches_size (q : State) (m d l : ℕ) :
    Reaches I { q with ctl := .size, cnt := m, depth := d, len := l }
      { q with
        ctl := .start
        cnt := 0
        c := 0
        depth := d + 16 * Nat.size m
        len := l + 4168 * Nat.size m } := by
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing d l with
  | _ m ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
    · refine .single (by simp) ?_
      rw [readBit_of_addr_none rfl]
      simp [step]
    · refine (Reaches.single
        (q' := { q with ctl := .size, cnt := m / 2, depth := d + 16, len := l + 4168 })
        (by simp) ?_).trans ?_
      · rw [readBit_of_addr_none rfl]
        simp [step, hm.ne']
      · have h := ih (m / 2) (Nat.div_lt_self hm (by norm_num)) (d + 16) (l + 4168)
        have hs := Nat.size_div_two_add_one hm.ne'
        have e₁ : d + 16 * Nat.size m = d + 16 + 16 * Nat.size (m / 2) := by rw [← hs]; ring
        have e₂ : l + 4168 * Nat.size m = l + 4168 + 4168 * Nat.size (m / 2) := by
          rw [← hs]; ring
        rw [e₁, e₂]
        exact h

private theorem reaches_walk {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (q : State) (hc : q.ctl = .next) (hn : q.n = I.n)
    (hs : q.s = I.s) (ht : q.t = I.t) (x : IteratedProd (Fin I.n × Fin I.n) Label m) (w j : ℕ)
    (hev : q.ev = ⟨slotVal x.root, (x.toList).2, []⟩) (hw : q.w = w) (hj : q.j = j) :
    Reaches I q { q with
      ctl := .check
      ev := ⟨slotVal (walkFrom I x w j).root, ((walkFrom I x w j).toList).2, []⟩
      w := w / numLabels ^ j
      j := 0 } := by
  induction j generalizing q x w with
  | zero =>
    refine .single (by simp [hc]) ?_
    rw [readBit_of_addr_none (by simp [addr, hc])]
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := q
    simp_all [step, walkFrom]
  | succ j ih =>
    set lab := labelOfNat w
    set r := (reingold base baseEquiv (input I.graph) m).rot (x, lab)
    -- the next step pushes the frame of the top level
    have h₁ : Reaches I q { q with
        ctl := .eval
        ev := (⟨(x.toList).1, (x.toList).2, [(.zig₀, lab)]⟩ :
          ReingoldEvalState (Fin I.n × Fin I.n) Label).mapVertex slotVal
        w := w / numLabels
        j := j } := by
      refine .single (by simp [hc]) ?_
      rw [readBit_of_addr_none (by simp [addr, hc])]
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := q
      simp_all [step, ReingoldEvalState.mapVertex, lab]
    -- the evaluation of the rotation map
    have h₂ := reaches_eval { q with
        ctl := .eval
        ev := (⟨(x.toList).1, (x.toList).2, [(.zig₀, lab)]⟩ :
          ReingoldEvalState (Fin I.n × Fin I.n) Label).mapVertex slotVal
        w := w / numLabels
        j := j } rfl hn hs ht hm x lab rfl
    -- the label at the far end is dropped
    have h₃ : Reaches I { q with
        ctl := .eval
        ev := (⟨(r.1.toList).1, r.2 :: (r.1.toList).2, []⟩ :
          ReingoldEvalState (Fin I.n × Fin I.n) Label).mapVertex slotVal
        w := w / numLabels
        j := j }
        { q with
          ctl := .next
          ev := ⟨slotVal r.1.root, (r.1.toList).2, []⟩
          w := w / numLabels
          j := j } := by
      refine .single (by simp) ?_
      rw [readBit_of_addr_none (by simp [addr, ReingoldEvalState.atRoot,
        ReingoldEvalState.mapVertex])]
      simp [step, ReingoldEvalState.mapVertex]
    have h₄ := ih { q with
        ctl := .next
        ev := ⟨slotVal r.1.root, (r.1.toList).2, []⟩
        w := w / numLabels
        j := j } rfl hn hs ht r.1 (w / numLabels) rfl rfl rfl
    refine h₁.trans (h₂.trans (h₃.trans ?_))
    have e₁ : walkFrom I x w (j + 1) = walkFrom I r.1 (w / numLabels) j := rfl
    have e₂ : w / numLabels ^ (j + 1) = w / numLabels / numLabels ^ j := by
      rw [pow_succ', Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]
    rw [e₁, e₂]
    exact h₄

private theorem reaches_start {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (q : State) (hc : q.ctl = .start)
    (hn : q.n = I.n)
    (hs : q.s = I.s) (ht : q.t = I.t) (hd : q.depth = m) :
    Reaches I q { q with
      ctl := .check
      ev := ⟨slotVal (walkFrom I (IteratedProd.mk (I.s, I.s) 0 m) q.c q.len).root,
        ((walkFrom I (IteratedProd.mk (I.s, I.s) 0 m) q.c q.len).toList).2, []⟩
      w := q.c / numLabels ^ q.len
      j := 0 } := by
  -- the start resets the registers
  have h₁ : Reaches I q { q with
      ctl := .fill
      ev := ⟨(q.s, q.s), List.replicate 0 0, []⟩
      w := q.c
      j := q.len } := by
    refine .single (by simp [hc]) ?_
    rw [readBit_of_addr_none (by simp [addr, hc])]
    simp [step, hc]
  -- the labels are filled with zeros
  have h₂ : Reaches I { q with
      ctl := .fill
      ev := ⟨(q.s, q.s), List.replicate 0 0, []⟩
      w := q.c
      j := q.len }
      { q with
        ctl := .next
        ev := ⟨(q.s, q.s), List.replicate m 0, []⟩
        w := q.c
        j := q.len } := by
    refine (reaches_iterate (fun i ↦ { q with
      ctl := .fill
      ev := ⟨(q.s, q.s), List.replicate i 0, []⟩
      w := q.c
      j := q.len }) m fun i hi ↦ .single (by simp) ?_).trans (.single (by simp) ?_)
    · rw [readBit_of_addr_none (by simp [addr])]
      simp [step, hd, hi.ne, List.replicate_succ]
    · rw [readBit_of_addr_none (by simp [addr])]
      simp [step, hd]
  have h₃ := reaches_walk hm { q with
      ctl := .next
      ev := ⟨(q.s, q.s), List.replicate m 0, []⟩
      w := q.c
      j := q.len } rfl hn hs ht (IteratedProd.mk (I.s, I.s) 0 m) q.c q.len
    (by simp [slotVal, hs]) rfl rfl
  exact h₁.trans (h₂.trans h₃)

  have h₈ : (encNat q.len).length ≤ 4168 * a + 136240 :=
    (length_encNat_le_self _).trans (hT ▸ hb.len)

theorem Exec.runs {c : Code B r} {y : Data r} {n : ℕ} (h : Exec w c x y n)
    (hp : p.Contains pc (c.assemble pc)) : Runs w p ⟨pc, x⟩ ⟨pc + c.size, y⟩ n := by
  induction h generalizing pc with
  | op ho =>
    exact .single (step_op (s := ⟨pc, _⟩) hp.head ho)
  | @seq c₁ c₂ x y z m n _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    have h₁ := ih₁ hp.append_left
    have h₂ := ih₂ (pc := pc + c₁.size) (by simpa using hp.append_right)
    simpa [Code.size, Nat.add_assoc] using h₁.trans h₂
  | @branch_pos c pos neg x y n hc _ ih =>
    have hb := next_branch_pos (w := w) hp.head hc
    have hc' := (hp.cons_tail.append_right (q₁ := neg.assemble (pc + 1))).cons_tail
    rw [Code.length_assemble, show pc + 1 + neg.size + 1 = pc + neg.size + 2 by omega] at hc'
    have hpos := ih hc'
    have := Relation.RelatesInSteps.head _ _ _ _ hb hpos
    simpa [Code.size, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using this
  | @branch_neg c pos neg x y n hc _ ih =>
    have hb := next_branch_neg (w := w) hp.head hc
    have hneg := ih (pc := pc + 1) hp.cons_tail.append_left
    have hj : Next w p ⟨pc + 1 + neg.size, y⟩ ⟨pc + neg.size + pos.size + 2, y⟩ :=
      next_jump (by simpa using (hp.cons_tail.append_right (q₁ := neg.assemble (pc + 1))).head)
    have := (Relation.RelatesInSteps.head _ _ _ _ hb hneg).tail _ _ _ _ hj
    simpa [Code.size, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using this
  | @loop_exit c body x hc =>
    have hb := next_branch_neg (w := w) hp.head hc
    have hj : Next w p ⟨pc + 1, x⟩ ⟨pc + body.size + 3, x⟩ := next_jump hp.cons_tail.head
    simpa [Code.size, Nat.add_assoc] using (Relation.RelatesInSteps.single hb).tail _ _ _ _ hj
  | @loop_iter c body x y z m n hc _ _ ihb ihl =>
    have hb := next_branch_pos (w := w) hp.head hc
    have hbody := ihb (pc := pc + 2) (by
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hp.cons_tail.cons_tail.append_left)
    have hj : Next w p ⟨pc + 2 + body.size, y⟩ ⟨pc, y⟩ :=
      next_jump (by simpa using hp.cons_tail.cons_tail.append_right.head)
    have hrest := ihl hp
    have := ((Relation.RelatesInSteps.head _ _ _ _ hb hbody).tail _ _ _ _ hj).trans hrest
    simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using this

theorem exec {w : ℕ} (hw : 2 ≤ w) (as bs ds os : List (Fin (r + 4)))
    (hlen : bs.length = ds.length) (hos : os.length = as.length)
    (hin : ∀ i ∈ as ++ bs, IsDigit i) (hout : ∀ i ∈ ds ++ os, IsDigit i)
    (hnd : (ds ++ os).Nodup) (hdis : List.Disjoint (ds ++ os) (as ++ bs))
    (x : Data (r + 4)) (ha : Bounded (radix w) x as) (hb : Bounded (radix w) x bs) :
    ∃ y, Exec w (program as bs ds os) x y
        (7 + bs.length + rowCost as.length bs.length) ∧
      Bounded (radix w) y (ds ++ os) ∧
      value (radix w) y (ds ++ os) = value (radix w) x as * value (radix w) x bs ∧
      y.mem = x.mem ∧ ∀ i ∈ as ++ bs, y.regs i = x.regs i := by
  let I : Set (Fin (r + 4)) := {i | i = zero ∨ i ∈ as ++ bs}
  have hI : ∀ i ∈ I, i ≠ total ∧ i ≠ carry := by
    intro i hi
    rcases hi with rfl | hi
    · simp [zero, total, carry]
    · exact ⟨(digit_ne (hin i hi)).1, (digit_ne (hin i hi)).2.1⟩
  have houtI : ∀ i ∈ ds ++ os, IsDigit i ∧ i ∉ I := by
    intro i hi
    refine ⟨hout i hi, ?_⟩
    rintro (hz | hin')
    · exact (digit_ne (hout i hi)).2.2.2 hz
    · exact List.disjoint_left.mp hdis hi hin'
  let z := setupResult w x
  obtain ⟨u, heu, hu, huf⟩ := exec_clear (w := w) ds
    (fun i hi => hout i (by simp [hi])) (List.nodup_append.mp hnd).1 z
  have huz (i : Fin (r + 4)) (hi : i ∉ ds) (ht : i ≠ total) (hc : i ≠ carry) :
      u.regs i = z.regs i := huf.2 i hi ht hc
  have hui (i : Fin (r + 4)) (hi : i ∈ as ++ bs) : u.regs i = x.regs i := by
    rw [huz i (fun hm => List.disjoint_left.mp hdis (by simp [hm]) hi)
      (digit_ne (hin i hi)).1 (digit_ne (hin i hi)).2.1]
    exact setup_digit w x (hin i hi)
  have hub : u.regs base = radix w := by
    rw [huz base (fun hm => (digit_ne (hout base (by simp [hm]))).2.2.1 rfl)
      (by simp [base, total]) (by simp [base, carry])]
    simp [z, setupResult, base, zero]
  have huzero : u.regs zero = 0 := by
    rw [huz zero (fun hm => (digit_ne (hout zero (by simp [hm]))).2.2.2 rfl)
      (by simp [zero, total]) (by simp [zero, carry])]
    simp [z, setupResult]
  obtain ⟨y, hey, hyb, hyval, hyf⟩ := exec_rows hw I hI (Or.inl rfl)
    as bs ds os hlen hos (fun i hi => Or.inr (by simp [hi]))
    (fun i hi => Or.inr (by simp [hi])) houtI hnd u hub huzero
    (fun i hi => by rw [hui i (by simp [hi])]; exact ha i hi)
    (fun i hi => by rw [hui i (by simp [hi])]; exact hb i hi)
    (fun i hi => by rw [hu i hi]; have := one_lt_radix hw; omega)
  have huval : value (radix w) u ds = 0 := by
    unfold value
    have hm : ds.map u.regs = List.replicate ds.length 0 := by
      simpa only [List.map_const'] using List.map_congr_left hu
    rw [hm, Nat.ofDigits_replicate_zero]
  have hvals (es : List (Fin (r + 4))) (hes : es ⊆ as ++ bs) :
      value (radix w) u es = value (radix w) x es := by
    unfold value
    congr 1
    exact List.map_congr_left fun i hi => hui i (hes hi)
  refine ⟨y, ?_, hyb, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold program
    convert (exec_setup hw x).seq (heu.seq hey) using 1
    omega
  · rw [huval, zero_add, hvals as (by simp), hvals bs (by simp)] at hyval
    exact hyval
  · exact hyf.1.trans (huf.1.trans rfl)
  · intro i hi
    exact (frame_input hyf hI (fun j hj => (houtI j hj).2) (Or.inr hi)).trans (hui i hi)

/-- Left shift fits a `w`-bit word if and only if shifting by `min w y` fits, and when it fits

theorem checkedShiftLeft_eq (w x y : ℕ) :
    (if decide (Fits w (x <<< y)) then some (x <<< y) else none) =
      if decide (Fits w (x * 2 ^ min w y)) then some (x * 2 ^ min w y) else none := by
  rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
  rcases le_or_gt y w with h | h
  · rw [Nat.min_eq_right h]
  · rw [Nat.min_eq_left h.le]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with rfl | hx
    · simp
    · have h1 : ¬Fits w (x * 2 ^ y) := by
        rw [fits_iff, not_lt]
        exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_right Nat.two_pos h.le).trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hx)
      have h2 : ¬Fits w (x * 2 ^ w) := by
        rw [fits_iff, not_lt]
        exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hx
      simp [h1, h2]

@[fun_prop, program_certificate]
theorem checkedBinOp_polyTime (f : BinOp) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (Basis.standard.genericModel.checkedOp (.bin f))
      (encPair encUnary (encPi encNat)) (encOption encNat) := by
  have hw := fst encUnary (encPi encNat (Index := Fin 2))
  have hx := (pi_apply encNat (0 : Fin 2)).comp (snd encUnary (encPi encNat))
  have hy := (pi_apply encNat (1 : Fin 2)).comp (snd encUnary (encPi encNat))
  have hwp := hw.computableInPolyTime
  have hxp := hx.computableInPolyTime
  have hyp := hy.computableInPolyTime
  cases f
  · exact checkedAdd_polyTime
  · exact checkFits_polyTime (binary_sub' hx hy)
  · exact checkFits_polyTime (binary_mul' hx hy)
  · exact checkFits_polyTime (binary_div' hx hy)
  · exact checkFits_polyTime (binary_mod' hx hy)
  · exact checkFits_polyTime (ComputableInPolyTime.binary_and' hxp hyp).tidy
  · exact checkFits_polyTime (ComputableInPolyTime.binary_or' hxp hyp).tidy
  · exact checkFits_polyTime (ComputableInPolyTime.binary_xor' hxp hyp).tidy
  · have h := checkFits_polyTime
      (binary_mul' hx (binary_two_pow.comp (ComputableInPolyTime.binary_min_unary' hwp hyp).tidy))
    refine .of_tidy (h.tidy.of_enc_eq fun ⟨w, x⟩ => congrArg (encOption encNat) ?_)
    exact checkedShiftLeft_eq w (x 0) (x 1)
  · exact checkFits_polyTime (ComputableInPolyTime.binary_shiftRight' hxp hyp).tidy

theorem checkedExactOp_polyTime (op : StandardOp) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (Basis.exact.genericModel.checkedOp op)
      (encPair encUnary (encPi encNat)) (encOption encNat) := by
  cases op with
  | width => exact checkedWidth_polyTime
  | bin f =>
    have hx := (pi_apply encNat (0 : Fin 2)).comp (snd encUnary (encPi encNat))
    have hy := (pi_apply encNat (1 : Fin 2)).comp (snd encUnary (encPi encNat))
    cases f
    · exact checkedBinOp_polyTime .add
    · have h := (binary_le' hy hx).ite_decide (checkedBinOp_polyTime .sub).tidy (const none)
      refine .of_tidy (h.of_enc_eq fun ⟨w, x⟩ => congrArg (encOption encNat) ?_)
      by_cases hle : x 1 ≤ x 0 <;>
        simp [Model.checkedOp, Basis.genericModel, StandardOp.evalExact, StandardOp.eval, hle]
    · exact checkedBinOp_polyTime .mul
    · have h := ((decide_eq encNat).comp (hy.prod (const 0))).ite_decide
        (const none) (checkedBinOp_polyTime .div).tidy
      refine .of_tidy (h.of_enc_eq fun ⟨w, x⟩ => congrArg (encOption encNat) ?_)
      by_cases hz : x 1 = 0 <;>
        simp [Model.checkedOp, Basis.genericModel, StandardOp.evalExact, StandardOp.eval, hz]
    · have h := ((decide_eq encNat).comp (hy.prod (const 0))).ite_decide
        (const none) (checkedBinOp_polyTime .mod).tidy
      refine .of_tidy (h.of_enc_eq fun ⟨w, x⟩ => congrArg (encOption encNat) ?_)
      by_cases hz : x 1 = 0 <;>
        simp [Model.checkedOp, Basis.genericModel, StandardOp.evalExact, StandardOp.eval, hz]
    · exact checkedBinOp_polyTime .and
    · exact checkedBinOp_polyTime .or
    · exact checkedBinOp_polyTime .xor
    · exact checkedBinOp_polyTime .shiftLeft
    · exact checkedBinOp_polyTime .shiftRight

theorem Basis.Hom.checkedOp_polyTime {B B' : Basis} (φ : B.Hom B')
    (hop : ∀ op : B'.Op,
      ComputableInPolyTime (B'.genericModel.checkedOp op)
        (encPair encUnary (encPi encNat)) (encOption encNat))

  refine .of_tidy (h.of_enc_eq fun ⟨w, x⟩ => congrArg (encOption encNat) ?_)

    (hExec : ∀ a, ∃ m ≤ steps a, Executes (cfg a) p (u a) (f a) m)

private theorem branch_simulation {q : RAM.Program} {base length pc target w : ℕ}
    {c : Cond r} {x : Data r} {σ : URM.Regs}
    (hcode : BlockAt q base length pc (.branch c target)) (hσ : Represents x σ)
    (hx : x.Bounded w) :
    ∃ τ, Reaches q ⟨entry base pc, σ⟩
      ⟨entry base (if c.Holds x then target else pc + 1), τ⟩
      (8 * (RAM.bitLength (memoryBase r) + w + 1)) ∧ Represents x τ := by
  have hr (i : Fin r) : RAM.bitLength (x.regs i) ≤ w + 1 := (hx.1 i).bitLength_le
  have hd (i j : Fin r) : RAM.bitLength (x.regs i - x.regs j) ≤ w + 1 :=
    (RAM.bitLength_mono (Nat.sub_le _ _)).trans (hr i)
  cases c with
  | lt i j =>
    let σ₁ := σ.write (test r) (x.regs j - x.regs i)
    have hσ₁ : Represents x σ₁ := hσ.scratch (Or.inr rfl) _
    have hfirst : Reaches q ⟨entry base pc, σ⟩ ⟨entry base pc + 1, σ₁⟩
        (RAM.bitLength (x.regs j) + RAM.bitLength (x.regs i)) := by
      simpa [compileInstr, RAM.Instr.exec, RAM.logCost, hσ.regs, σ₁]
        using Reaches.step (s := ⟨entry base pc, σ⟩) hcode.first
    have hsecond := Reaches.step (s := ⟨entry base pc + 1, σ₁⟩) (hcode 1 (by decide))
    by_cases hij : x.regs i < x.regs j
    · have hsecond' : Reaches q ⟨entry base pc + 1, σ₁⟩ ⟨entry base target, σ₁⟩
          (RAM.bitLength (x.regs j - x.regs i)) := by
        simpa [compileInstr, RAM.Instr.exec, RAM.logCost, σ₁, Nat.sub_pos_iff_lt, hij] using hsecond
      refine ⟨_, ?_, hσ₁⟩
      simpa only [Cond.holds_lt, ite_eq_left hij] using (hfirst.trans hsecond').mono (by
        have := hr i; have := hr j; have := hd j i; lia)
    · have hsecond' : Reaches q ⟨entry base pc + 1, σ₁⟩ ⟨entry base pc + 2, σ₁⟩
          (RAM.bitLength (x.regs j - x.regs i)) := by
        simpa [compileInstr, RAM.Instr.exec, RAM.logCost, σ₁, Nat.sub_pos_iff_lt, hij,
          Nat.add_assoc] using hsecond
      refine ⟨_, ?_, hσ₁⟩
      simpa only [Cond.holds_lt, ite_eq_right hij] using
        ((hfirst.trans hsecond').trans (reaches_jump (hcode 2 (by decide)) hσ₁.one)).mono (by
          have := hr i; have := hr j; have := hd j i; lia)
  | eq i j =>
    let σ₁ := σ.write (test r) (x.regs i - x.regs j)
    have hσ₁ : Represents x σ₁ := hσ.scratch (Or.inr rfl) _
    have hfirst : Reaches q ⟨entry base pc, σ⟩ ⟨entry base pc + 1, σ₁⟩
        (RAM.bitLength (x.regs i) + RAM.bitLength (x.regs j)) := by
      simpa [compileInstr, RAM.Instr.exec, RAM.logCost, hσ.regs, σ₁]
        using Reaches.step (s := ⟨entry base pc, σ⟩) hcode.first
    have hsecond := Reaches.step (s := ⟨entry base pc + 1, σ₁⟩) (hcode 1 (by decide))
    by_cases hji : x.regs j < x.regs i
    · have hsecond' : Reaches q ⟨entry base pc + 1, σ₁⟩ ⟨entry base (pc + 1), σ₁⟩
          (RAM.bitLength (x.regs i - x.regs j)) := by
        simpa [compileInstr, RAM.Instr.exec, RAM.logCost, σ₁, Nat.sub_pos_iff_lt, hji] using hsecond
      refine ⟨_, ?_, hσ₁⟩
      simpa only [Cond.holds_eq, ite_eq_right (by lia : x.regs i ≠ x.regs j)] using
        (hfirst.trans hsecond').mono (by have := hr i; have := hr j; have := hd i j; lia)
    · have hsecond' : Reaches q ⟨entry base pc + 1, σ₁⟩ ⟨entry base pc + 2, σ₁⟩
          (RAM.bitLength (x.regs i - x.regs j)) := by
        simpa [compileInstr, RAM.Instr.exec, RAM.logCost, σ₁, Nat.sub_pos_iff_lt, hji,
          Nat.add_assoc] using hsecond
      let σ₂ := σ₁.write (test r) (x.regs j - x.regs i)
      have hσ₂ : Represents x σ₂ := hσ₁.scratch (Or.inr rfl) _
      have hthird : Reaches q ⟨entry base pc + 2, σ₁⟩ ⟨entry base pc + 3, σ₂⟩
          (RAM.bitLength (x.regs j) + RAM.bitLength (x.regs i)) := by
        simpa [compileInstr, RAM.Instr.exec, RAM.logCost, hσ₁.regs, σ₂, Nat.add_assoc]
          using Reaches.step (s := ⟨entry base pc + 2, σ₁⟩) (hcode 2 (by decide))
      have hfourth := Reaches.step (s := ⟨entry base pc + 3, σ₂⟩) (hcode 3 (by decide))
      by_cases hij : x.regs i < x.regs j
      · have hfourth' : Reaches q ⟨entry base pc + 3, σ₂⟩ ⟨entry base (pc + 1), σ₂⟩
            (RAM.bitLength (x.regs j - x.regs i)) := by
          simpa [compileInstr, RAM.Instr.exec, RAM.logCost, σ₂, Nat.sub_pos_iff_lt, hij]
            using hfourth
        refine ⟨_, ?_, hσ₂⟩
        simpa only [Cond.holds_eq, ite_eq_right (by lia : x.regs i ≠ x.regs j)] using
          (((hfirst.trans hsecond').trans hthird).trans hfourth').mono (by
            have := hr i; have := hr j; have := hd i j; have := hd j i; lia)
      · have heq : x.regs i = x.regs j := by lia
        have hfourth' : Reaches q ⟨entry base pc + 3, σ₂⟩ ⟨entry base pc + 4, σ₂⟩
            (RAM.bitLength (x.regs j - x.regs i)) := by
          simpa [compileInstr, RAM.Instr.exec, RAM.logCost, σ₂, Nat.sub_pos_iff_lt, hij,
            Nat.add_assoc] using hfourth
        refine ⟨_, ?_, hσ₂⟩
        simpa only [Cond.holds_eq, ite_eq_left heq] using
          ((((hfirst.trans hsecond').trans hthird).trans hfourth').trans
            (reaches_jump (hcode 4 (by decide)) hσ₂.one)).mono (by
              have := hr i; have := hr j; have := hd i j; have := hd j i; lia)

private theorem halt_simulation {q : RAM.Program} {base length pc w : ℕ} {i : Fin r}
    {x : Data r} {σ : URM.Regs} (hcode : BlockAt q base length pc (.halt i))
    (hσ : Represents x σ) (hx : x.Bounded w) :
    ∃ τ, Reaches q ⟨entry base pc, σ⟩ ⟨entry base length, τ⟩
      (8 * (RAM.bitLength (memoryBase r) + w + 1)) ∧ τ.output = x.regs i := by
  let τ := σ.write 0 (x.regs i)
  have hfirst : Reaches q ⟨entry base pc, σ⟩ ⟨entry base pc + 1, τ⟩
      (RAM.bitLength (x.regs i) + 1) := by
    simpa [compileInstr, RAM.Instr.exec, RAM.logCost, hσ.regs, hσ.zero, τ]
      using Reaches.step (s := ⟨entry base pc, σ⟩) hcode.first
  have hone : τ.read (one r) = 1 := by
    rw [URM.Regs.write_read_of_ne _ _ _ _ (by dsimp [one]; lia), hσ.one]
  refine ⟨τ, (hfirst.trans (reaches_jump (hcode 1 (by decide)) hone)).mono ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := (hx.1 i).bitLength_le
    lia
  · exact URM.Regs.write_read_self _ _ _

private theorem next_simulation {p : Program .standard r} {q : RAM.Program} {base w : ℕ}
    {s t : State r} {σ : URM.Regs}
    (hcode : ∀ pc i, p[pc]? = some i → BlockAt q base p.length pc i)
    (hp : p.IsAdditive) (hσ : Represents s.data σ) (hs : s.data.Bounded w)
    (h : Next w p s t) :
    ∃ τ, Reaches q ⟨entry base s.pc, σ⟩ ⟨entry base t.pc, τ⟩
      (8 * (RAM.bitLength (memoryBase r) + w + 1)) ∧ Represents t.data τ := by
  cases hi : p[s.pc]? with
  | none => simp [Next, WordRAM.step, hi] at h
  | some i =>
    have hc := hcode s.pc i hi
    have ha := hp i (List.mem_of_getElem? hi)
    cases i with
    | op o =>
      cases he : o.eval w s.data with
      | none => simp [Next, WordRAM.step, hi, he] at h
      | some y =>
        have ht : t = ⟨s.pc + 1, y⟩ := by simpa [Next, WordRAM.step, hi, he] using h.symm
        subst t
        exact op_simulation hc ha hσ hs he
    | jump target =>
      have ht : t = ⟨target, s.data⟩ := by simpa [Next, WordRAM.step, hi] using h.symm
      subst t
      exact ⟨σ, (reaches_jump hc.first hσ.one).mono (by lia), hσ⟩
    | branch c target =>
      have ht : t = ⟨if c.Holds s.data then target else s.pc + 1, s.data⟩ := by
        simpa [Next, WordRAM.step, hi] using h.symm
      subst t
      exact branch_simulation hc hσ hs
    | halt i => simp [Next, WordRAM.step, hi] at h
    | rand _ _ => simp [Next, WordRAM.step, hi] at h

private theorem runs_simulation {p : Program .standard r} {q : RAM.Program} {base w n : ℕ}
    {s t : State r} {σ : URM.Regs}
    (hcode : ∀ pc i, p[pc]? = some i → BlockAt q base p.length pc i)
    (hp : p.IsAdditive) (hσ : Represents s.data σ) (hs : s.data.Bounded w)
    (h : Runs w p s t n) :
    ∃ τ, Reaches q ⟨entry base s.pc, σ⟩ ⟨entry base t.pc, τ⟩
      (n * (8 * (RAM.bitLength (memoryBase r) + w + 1))) ∧ Represents t.data τ := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨σ, ⟨0, rfl, by simp⟩, hσ⟩
  | tail t u n hst htu ih =>
    obtain ⟨τ, hr, hτ⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨υ, hr', hυ⟩ := next_simulation hcode hp hτ (Runs.bounded hst hs) htu
    exact ⟨υ, by simpa only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] using hr.trans hr', hυ⟩

theorem executes_compile {p : Program .standard r} (hp : p.IsAdditive) (pre : RAM.Program)
    {w v n : ℕ} {s : State r} {σ : URM.Regs} (hσ : Represents s.data σ)
    (hs : s.data.Bounded w) (h : Executes w p s v n) :
    ∃ k, (RAM.run (pre ++ compile pre.length p) k ⟨entry pre.length s.pc, σ⟩).isHalted
        (pre ++ compile pre.length p) ∧
      (RAM.run (pre ++ compile pre.length p) k ⟨entry pre.length s.pc, σ⟩).regs.output = v ∧
      RAM.time RAM.logCost (pre ++ compile pre.length p) k ⟨entry pre.length s.pc, σ⟩ ≤
        n * (8 * (RAM.bitLength (memoryBase r) + w + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨t, m, hr, ht, rfl⟩ := h
  have hc := fun pc i hi => blockAt_append (p := p) (pc := pc) (i := i) pre hi
  obtain ⟨τ, hrun, hτ⟩ := runs_simulation hc hp hσ hs hr
  cases hi : p[t.pc]? with
  | none => simp [WordRAM.step, hi] at ht
  | some i =>
    cases i with
    | halt i =>
      have hv : t.data.regs i = v := by simpa [WordRAM.step, hi] using ht
      obtain ⟨υ, hhalt, hυ⟩ := halt_simulation (hc t.pc (.halt i) hi) hτ (hr.bounded hs)
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hcost⟩ := hrun.trans hhalt
      refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hk]
        simp [RAM.State.isHalted, entry]
      · rw [hk, hυ, hv]
      · simpa only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] using hcost
    | op o =>
      simp only [WordRAM.step, hi] at ht
      split at ht <;> cases ht
    | jump | branch | rand => simp [WordRAM.step, hi] at ht

theorem executes_compile_from_paddedInput {p : Program .standard r} (hp : p.IsAdditive)
    (pre : RAM.Program) {input : List ℕ} {w v n : ℕ} (hi : InputFits w input)
    (h : Executes w p (State.init input) v n) :
    let q := (pre ++ prologue r) ++ compile (pre.length + 2) p
    let s := RAM.State.mk pre.length (URM.Regs.ofInputs (paddedInput r input))
    ∃ k, (RAM.run q k s).isHalted q ∧ (RAM.run q k s).regs.output = v ∧
      RAM.time RAM.logCost q k s ≤
        8 * (RAM.bitLength (memoryBase r) + 1) * (n + 1) * (w + 1) := by
  let q := (pre ++ prologue r) ++ compile (pre.length + 2) p
  let σ := ((URM.Regs.ofInputs (paddedInput r input)).write (one r) 1).write
    (offset r) (memoryBase r)
  have h0 : q[pre.length]? = some (.const (one r) 1) := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [List.append_assoc, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_refl _)]
    simp [prologue]
  have h1 : q[pre.length + 1]? = some (.const (offset r) (memoryBase r)) := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [List.append_assoc, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _)]
    simp [prologue]
  have hfirst := Reaches.step (p := q)
    (s := ⟨pre.length, URM.Regs.ofInputs (paddedInput r input)⟩) h0
  have hsecond := Reaches.step (p := q)
    (s := ⟨pre.length + 1, (URM.Regs.ofInputs (paddedInput r input)).write (one r) 1⟩) h1
  have hstart : Reaches q ⟨pre.length, URM.Regs.ofInputs (paddedInput r input)⟩ ⟨pre.length + 2, σ⟩
      (1 + RAM.bitLength (memoryBase r)) := by
    simpa [RAM.Instr.exec, RAM.logCost, RAM.bitLength, σ, Nat.add_assoc]
      using hfirst.trans hsecond
  have hc := executes_compile hp (pre ++ prologue r) (represents_prologued input)
    (Data.Bounded.init hi) h
  simp only [List.length_append, prologue, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hc
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hv, ht⟩ := hc
  change (RAM.run q k ⟨pre.length + 2, σ⟩).isHalted q at hk
  change (RAM.run q k ⟨pre.length + 2, σ⟩).regs.output = v at hv
  change RAM.time RAM.logCost q k ⟨pre.length + 2, σ⟩ ≤
    n * (8 * (RAM.bitLength (memoryBase r) + w + 1)) at ht
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hcost⟩ := hstart
  refine ⟨m + k, by rwa [RAM.run_add, hm], by rwa [RAM.run_add, hm], ?_⟩
  rw [RAM.time_add, hm]
  have hB : RAM.bitLength (memoryBase r) + w + 1 ≤
      (RAM.bitLength (memoryBase r) + 1) * (w + 1) := by nlinarith
  calc
    _ ≤ (n + 1) * (8 * (RAM.bitLength (memoryBase r) + w + 1)) := by
      have := Nat.add_le_add hcost ht
      nlinarith
    _ ≤ (n + 1) * (8 * ((RAM.bitLength (memoryBase r) + 1) * (w + 1))) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hB)
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem regs_eq {c : Code B r} {x : Data r} {m : ProbComp (Data r × ℕ)} {i : Fin r}
    (h : ExecRand w c x m) (hi : c.Preserves i) {z : Data r × ℕ} (hz : z ∈ m.support) :
    z.1.regs i = x.regs i := by
  induction h generalizing z with
  | op ho =>
    cases OracleComp.eq_of_mem_supportWith_pure hz
    exact (Exec.op ho).regs_eq hi
  | rand _ =>
    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_bind_iff.mp hz
    cases OracleComp.eq_of_mem_supportWith_pure hk
    simp only [Data.set_regs, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hi)]
  | seq _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁, hrest⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_bind_iff.mp hz
    obtain ⟨z₂, hz₂, hfinal⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_bind_iff.mp hrest
    cases OracleComp.eq_of_mem_supportWith_pure hfinal
    have hr₁ := ih₁ hi.1 hz₁
    have hr₂ := ih₂ z₁ hz₁ hi.2 hz₂
    exact hr₂.trans hr₁
  | branch_pos _ _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_map_iff.mp hz
    have hr₀ := ih hi.1 hz₀
    exact hr₀
  | branch_neg _ _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_map_iff.mp hz
    have hr₀ := ih hi.2 hz₀
    exact hr₀
  | loop_exit _ =>
    cases OracleComp.eq_of_mem_supportWith_pure hz
    rfl
  | loop_iter _ _ _ ihb ihl =>
    obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁, hrest⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_bind_iff.mp hz
    obtain ⟨z₂, hz₂, hfinal⟩ := OracleComp.mem_supportWith_bind_iff.mp hrest
    cases OracleComp.eq_of_mem_supportWith_pure hfinal
    have hr₁ := ihb hi hz₁
    have hr₂ := ihl z₁ hz₁ hi hz₂
    exact hr₂.trans hr₁

      (Nat.le_ceil c).trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right ⌈c⌉₊ 1)

@[local fun_prop]
private theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_isCollision
    {H : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool} {valid : ℕ → List Bool → Bool}
    (hH : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => H p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits)
    (hvalid : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => valid p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encUnary encBits) encBool)
    {γ : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {n : γ → ℕ} {k m₁ m₂ : γ → List Bool}
    (hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime n encIn encUnary)
    (hk : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime k encIn encBits)
    (hm₁ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime m₁ encIn encBits)
    (hm₂ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime m₂ encIn encBits) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun a => isCollision H valid (n a) (k a) (m₁ a) (m₂ a)) encIn encBool := by
  have hv₁ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => valid (n a) (m₁ a)) encIn encBool :=
    hvalid.comp (hn.prod hm₁)
  have hv₂ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => valid (n a) (m₂ a)) encIn encBool :=
    hvalid.comp (hn.prod hm₂)
  have hH₁ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => H (k a) (m₁ a)) encIn encBits :=
    hH.comp (hk.prod hm₁)
  have hH₂ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => H (k a) (m₂ a)) encIn encBits :=
    hH.comp (hk.prod hm₂)
  have hdiff := ComputableInPolyTime.bool_not.comp
    (ComputableInPolyTime.beq (.of_tidy hm₁) (.of_tidy hm₂))
  have hhash := ComputableInPolyTime.beq (.of_tidy hH₁) (.of_tidy hH₂)
  have hplain := ComputableInPolyTime.bool_and.comp
    ((ComputableInPolyTime.bool_and.comp
      ((ComputableInPolyTime.bool_and.comp
        ((ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy hv₁).prod (.of_tidy hv₂))).prod hdiff)).prod hhash)
  simpa only [isCollision, bne, Function.comp_def] using hplain.tidy

    (extract : ℕ → List Bool → List Bool → List Bool → List Bool × List Bool)
    (hextract : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : ℕ × List Bool × List Bool × List Bool => extract p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2)
      (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits (encPair encBits encBits)))

theorem naorCommitSplit_append (generator : List Bool → List Bool) (r : List Bool)
    {flags₁ flags₂ bits₁ bits₂ : List Bool} {seeds₁ seeds₂ pads₁ pads₂ : List (List Bool)}
    (hflags : flags₁.length = bits₁.length) (hseeds : seeds₁.length = bits₁.length)
    (hpads : pads₁.length = bits₁.length) :
    naorCommitSplit generator r (flags₁ ++ flags₂) (bits₁ ++ bits₂)
        (seeds₁ ++ seeds₂) (pads₁ ++ pads₂) =
      naorCommitSplit generator r flags₁ bits₁ seeds₁ pads₁ ++
        naorCommitSplit generator r flags₂ bits₂ seeds₂ pads₂ := by
  induction bits₁ generalizing flags₁ seeds₁ pads₁ with
  | nil =>
    cases flags₁ <;> cases seeds₁ <;> cases pads₁ <;>
      try simp only [List.length_nil, List.length_cons, Nat.succ_ne_zero] at hflags hseeds hpads
    rfl
  | cons b bits₁ ih =>
    cases flags₁ with
    | nil => simp at hflags
    | cons f flags₁ =>
      cases seeds₁ with
      | nil => simp at hseeds
      | cons s seeds₁ =>
        cases pads₁ with
        | nil => simp at hpads
        | cons p pads₁ =>
          simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hflags hseeds hpads
          simp [naorCommitSplit, ih hflags hseeds hpads]

          (q.1 • F.generator d) (q.2.1 • F.generator d) = q.2.2.2)))) true ≤
      (queries.length : ℝ≥0∞) / (F.order d : ℝ≥0∞) := by

      (q.1 • F.generator d) (q.2.1 • F.generator d) = q.2.2.2)

    have hq_head : q.2.1 ≠ α * q.1 ∧ q.2.2.1 ≠ ρ := hq q List.mem_cons_self
    have hq_tail : ∀ q' ∈ qs, q'.2.1 ≠ α * q'.1 ∧ q'.2.2.1 ≠ ρ :=

      simp only [List.any_cons, PMF.map_apply, ← ENNReal.tsum_add]
      refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun τ₂ => ?_

                (q.1 • F.generator d) (q.2.1 • F.generator d))) q.2.2.2 := by

        · exfalso; exact h₁ (decide_eq_true h₂.symm).symm
        · rfl

    refine hor.trans ?_

            (δ₂ - α * τ₂) τ₂) req)

              (δ₂ - α * τ₂) τ₂) req) = false := by
      rw [Bool.and_eq_false_iff]

      · left; simp [hrej]

        simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, not_or, Bool.not_eq_true] at hrej
        rcases hrej with ⟨hne_ct, hnot_coll⟩
        by_cases hframe : (encBits4 parts == req) = true

          rcases Prod.mk.inj hrest with ⟨hw_eq, he_eq⟩

private theorem uniform_decide_eq_encode_le (d : F.Desc) (guess : List Bool) :
    ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind
      (fun γ => PMF.pure (decide (guess = F.encode d (γ • F.generator d))))) true ≤
      (F.order d : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
  rw [PMF.bind_apply, tsum_fintype]
  simp only [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, ZMod.card, PMF.pure_apply, eq_comm (a := true),
    decide_eq_true_eq]
  have hcard :
      (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun γ : ZMod (F.order d) => guess = F.encode d (γ • F.generator d))).card ≤ 1 := by
    refine Finset.card_le_one_iff.mpr fun {γ₁ γ₂} h₁ h₂ => ?_
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at h₁ h₂
    exact F.smul_generator_injective d (F.encode_injective d (h₁.symm.trans h₂))
  calc ∑ x : ZMod (F.order d),
        (F.order d : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ *
          (if guess = F.encode d (x • F.generator d) then 1 else 0)
      = ((Finset.univ.filter
          (fun γ : ZMod (F.order d) =>
            guess = F.encode d (γ • F.generator d))).card : ℝ≥0∞) *
          (F.order d : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_boole, mul_comm]
    _ ≤ 1 * (F.order d : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcard) zero_le
    _ = (F.order d : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := one_mul _
