theorem ddhIdealGame_cdhToDDHDistinguisher_true_le (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
    (adversary : ℕ → F.Desc × List Bool × List Bool → ProbComp (List Bool)) (n m : ℕ)
    (hm : ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, m ≤ F.order d) :
    (F.ddhIdealGame setup (F.cdhToDDHDistinguisher adversary) n) true ≤ (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
  simp only [ddhIdealGame, cdhToDDHDistinguisher, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure,
    PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.bind_apply]
  calc ∑' d, setup n d * ∑' α, PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)) α *
        ∑' β, PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)) β *
          ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun γ =>
            (ProbComp.eval (adversary n
              (d, F.encode d (α • F.generator d), F.encode d (β • F.generator d)))).bind
              fun guess =>
                PMF.pure (decide (guess = F.encode d (γ • F.generator d)))) true
      ≤ ∑' d, setup n d * (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
        refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun d => ?_
        by_cases hd : d ∈ (setup n).support
        · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ zero_le
          have hord : (F.order d : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ≤ (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ :=
            ENNReal.inv_le_inv.mpr (Nat.cast_le.mpr (hm d hd))
          calc ∑' α, PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)) α *
                ∑' β, PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)) β *
                  ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun γ =>
                    (ProbComp.eval (adversary n
                      (d, F.encode d (α • F.generator d),
                        F.encode d (β • F.generator d)))).bind fun guess =>
                      PMF.pure (decide (guess = F.encode d (γ • F.generator d)))) true
              ≤ ∑' α, PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)) α *
                  ∑' β, PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)) β * (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
                refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun α => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ zero_le
                refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun β => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ zero_le
                rw [PMF.bind_comm, PMF.bind_apply]
                calc ∑' guess, ProbComp.eval (adversary n
                        (d, F.encode d (α • F.generator d), F.encode d (β • F.generator d))) guess *
                      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun γ =>
                        PMF.pure (decide (guess = F.encode d (γ • F.generator d)))) true
                    ≤ ∑' guess, ProbComp.eval (adversary n
                        (d, F.encode d (α • F.generator d), F.encode d (β • F.generator d))) guess *
                      (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
                      refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun guess =>
                        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                          ((F.uniform_decide_eq_encode_le d guess).trans hord) zero_le
                  _ = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.tsum_coe, one_mul]
            _ = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
                simp only [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.tsum_coe, one_mul]
        · have hd0 : setup n d = 0 := by rwa [PMF.mem_support_iff, not_not] at hd
          simp only [hd0, zero_mul, le_rfl]
    _ = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.tsum_coe, one_mul]

theorem ddhRerandomizeLaw_ideal (d : F.Desc) {α β γ : ZMod (F.order d)} (hγ : γ ≠ α * β) :
    F.ddhRerandomizeLaw d (α • F.generator d) (β • F.generator d) (γ • F.generator d) =
      F.ddhIdealTupleLaw d := by
  simp only [ddhRerandomizeLaw, ddhIdealTupleLaw, ddhRerandomize_smul_generator,
    PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure]
  have hs₂ (r α' : ZMod (F.order d)) :
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun s₂ =>
        PMF.pure (α' • F.generator d, (β + s₂) • F.generator d,
          (α' * (β + s₂) + r * (γ - α * β)) • F.generator d)) =
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun β' =>
        PMF.pure (α' • F.generator d, β' • F.generator d,
          (α' * β' + r * (γ - α * β)) • F.generator d)) :=
    uniformOfFintype_bind_equiv (Equiv.addLeft β)
      (fun β' => PMF.pure (α' • F.generator d, β' • F.generator d,
        (α' * β' + r * (γ - α * β)) • F.generator d))
  have hs₁ (r : ZMod (F.order d)) :
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun s₁ =>
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun s₂ =>
          PMF.pure ((r * α + s₁) • F.generator d, (β + s₂) • F.generator d,
            ((r * α + s₁) * (β + s₂) + r * (γ - α * β)) • F.generator d)) =
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun α' =>
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun β' =>
          PMF.pure (α' • F.generator d, β' • F.generator d,
            (α' * β' + r * (γ - α * β)) • F.generator d)) := by
    simp_rw [hs₂]
    exact uniformOfFintype_bind_equiv (Equiv.addLeft (r * α))
      (fun α' => (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun β' =>
        PMF.pure (α' • F.generator d, β' • F.generator d,
          (α' * β' + r * (γ - α * β)) • F.generator d))
  simp_rw [hs₁]
  rw [PMF.bind_comm]
  congr 1; funext α'
  rw [PMF.bind_comm]
  congr 1; funext β'
  exact uniformOfFintype_bind_equiv
    ((Equiv.mulRight₀ (γ - α * β) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hγ)).trans (Equiv.addLeft (α' * β')))
    (fun γ' => PMF.pure (α' • F.generator d, β' • F.generator d, γ' • F.generator d))

theorem computableInPolyTime_encodeDDHRerandomize :

  let encIn := encPair F.encDesc
    (encPair (encPair encBits (encPair encBits encBits))
      (encPair encNat (encPair encNat encNat)))
  have hd : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun input : F.Desc × (List Bool × List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => input.1)
      encIn F.encDesc := by fun_prop
  have hu : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun input : F.Desc × (List Bool × List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => input.2.1.1)
      encIn encBits := by fun_prop
  have hv : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun input : F.Desc × (List Bool × List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => input.2.1.2.1)
      encIn encBits := by fun_prop
  have hw : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun input : F.Desc × (List Bool × List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => input.2.1.2.2)
      encIn encBits := by fun_prop
  have hr : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun input : F.Desc × (List Bool × List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => input.2.2.1)
      encIn encNat := by fun_prop
  have hs₁ : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun input : F.Desc × (List Bool × List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => input.2.2.2.1)
      encIn encNat := by fun_prop
  have hs₂ : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun input : F.Desc × (List Bool × List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => input.2.2.2.2)
      encIn encNat := by fun_prop
  have hg := F.computableInPolyTime_generator.comp hd
  have hru := F.computableInPolyTime_smul.comp (hd.prod (hr.prod hu))
  have hs₁g := F.computableInPolyTime_smul.comp (hd.prod (hs₁.prod hg))
  have hs₂g := F.computableInPolyTime_smul.comp (hd.prod (hs₂.prod hg))
  have hrw := F.computableInPolyTime_smul.comp (hd.prod (hr.prod hw))
  have hrs₂u := F.computableInPolyTime_smul.comp (hd.prod ((hr.binary_mul' hs₂).prod hu))
  have hs₁v := F.computableInPolyTime_smul.comp (hd.prod (hs₁.prod hv))

  have hc₂ := F.computableInPolyTime_add.comp (hd.prod (hv.prod hs₂g))

  have hc₃ := F.computableInPolyTime_add.comp (hd.prod (hc₃₂.prod hs₁s₂g))

private theorem advantage_bind_le_dist_add {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p q : PMF α)
    (f g : α → Game) {ε δ : ℝ} (hpq : dist p q ≤ ε)
    (hfg : ∀ a, (Game.advantage (f a) (g a) : ℝ) ≤ δ) :
    (Game.advantage (p.bind f) (q.bind g) : ℝ) ≤ ε + δ := by
  have htri : (Game.advantage (p.bind f) (q.bind g) : ℝ) ≤
      (Game.advantage (p.bind f) (q.bind f) : ℝ) +
      (Game.advantage (q.bind f) (q.bind g) : ℝ) := by

theorem advantage_ddhRealGame_le_ddhWorstCaseGame (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc)
    (α β α' β' γ' : ∀ d : F.Desc, ZMod (F.order d))
    (distinguisher : ℕ → F.Desc × List Bool × List Bool × List Bool → ProbComp Bool) (n : ℕ)
    (hγ' : ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, γ' d ≠ α' d * β' d) :
    let tuple₀ := fun d => (α d • F.generator d, β d • F.generator d, (α d * β d) • F.generator d)
    let tuple₁ := fun d => (α' d • F.generator d, β' d • F.generator d, γ' d • F.generator d)
    Game.advantage (F.ddhRealGame setup distinguisher n)
      (F.ddhIdealGame setup distinguisher n) ≤
      Game.advantage
        (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₀
          (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n)
        (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₁
          (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n) +
      6 / 2 ^ n := by
  intro tuple₀ tuple₁
  rw [← F.advantage_ddhRerandomizeGame_eq setup α β α' β' γ' distinguisher n hγ']
  have h1 := Game.advantage_triangle
    (F.ddhRerandomizeGame setup tuple₀ distinguisher n)
    (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₀ (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n)
    (F.ddhRerandomizeGame setup tuple₁ distinguisher n)
  have h2 := Game.advantage_triangle
    (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₀ (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n)
    (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₁ (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n)
    (F.ddhRerandomizeGame setup tuple₁ distinguisher n)
  have h0 := F.advantage_ddhRerandomizeGame_ddhWorstCaseGame_le setup tuple₀ distinguisher n
  have h3 :
      Game.advantage
        (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₁ (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n)
        (F.ddhRerandomizeGame setup tuple₁ distinguisher n) ≤ 3 / 2 ^ n := by
    rw [Game.advantage_comm]
    exact F.advantage_ddhRerandomizeGame_ddhWorstCaseGame_le setup tuple₁ distinguisher n
  calc
    Game.advantage (F.ddhRerandomizeGame setup tuple₀ distinguisher n)
        (F.ddhRerandomizeGame setup tuple₁ distinguisher n)
      ≤ Game.advantage (F.ddhRerandomizeGame setup tuple₀ distinguisher n)
          (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₀ (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n) +
        (Game.advantage
          (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₀ (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n)
          (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₁ (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n) +
        Game.advantage
          (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₁ (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n)
          (F.ddhRerandomizeGame setup tuple₁ distinguisher n)) :=
      h1.trans (add_le_add le_rfl h2)
    _ ≤ 3 / 2 ^ n +
        (Game.advantage
          (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₀ (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n)
          (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₁ (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n) +
        3 / 2 ^ n) :=
      add_le_add h0 (add_le_add le_rfl h3)
    _ = Game.advantage
          (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₀ (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n)
          (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup tuple₁ (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher) n) +
        6 / 2 ^ n := by
      ring

theorem ddh_of_worstCase {setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc}
    (α β α' β' γ' : ∀ d : F.Desc, ZMod (F.order d))
    (hγ' : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, γ' d ≠ α' d * β' d)
    (hworst : Game.Indistinguishable
      (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup
        (fun d => (α d • F.generator d, β d • F.generator d, (α d * β d) • F.generator d)))
      (F.ddhWorstCaseGame setup
        (fun d => (α' d • F.generator d, β' d • F.generator d, γ' d • F.generator d)))
      fun distinguisher =>
        IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary (encPair F.encDesc (encPair encBits (encPair encBits encBits))))
          encBool (fun input => distinguisher input.1 input.2)) :
    F.DDH setup := by
  intro distinguisher hD
  have hgeom : Negligible fun n => (6 / 2 ^ n : ℝ≥0) := by
    refine negligible_of_le
      ((negligible_geometric (ratio := 2⁻¹) (by norm_num)).polynomiallyBounded_mul
        (p := fun _ => 6) (by fun_prop))
      fun n => ?_
    exact le_of_eq (by simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow])
  refine negligible_of_eventually_le
    ((hworst (F.ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher distinguisher)
      (F.isPPTOn_ddhSelfReduceDistinguisher hD)).add hgeom)
    (hγ'.mono fun n hn =>
      F.advantage_ddhRealGame_le_ddhWorstCaseGame setup α β α' β' γ' distinguisher n hn)

theorem ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw_ideal (d : F.Desc) {α β γ : ZMod (F.order d)} (hγ : γ ≠ α * β) :
    F.ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw d (α • F.generator d) (β • F.generator d) (γ • F.generator d) =
      F.ddhFixedUIdealLaw d := by
  simp only [ddhFixedURerandomizeLaw, ddhFixedUIdealLaw, ddhFixedURerandomize_smul_generator,
    PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure]
  rw [PMF.bind_comm]
  have hσ (τ : ZMod (F.order d)) :
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun σ =>
        PMF.pure ((σ + τ * β) • F.generator d,
          (α * (σ + τ * β) + τ * (γ - α * β)) • F.generator d)) =
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun β' =>
        PMF.pure (β' • F.generator d,
          (α * β' + τ * (γ - α * β)) • F.generator d)) :=
    by
      change (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind
        ((fun β' => PMF.pure (β' • F.generator d,
          (α * β' + τ * (γ - α * β)) • F.generator d)) ∘ Equiv.addRight (τ * β)) = _
      rw [← PMF.bind_map, PMF.uniformOfFintype_map_equiv]
  simp_rw [hσ]
  rw [PMF.bind_comm]
  congr 1; funext β'
  change (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind
    ((fun γ' => PMF.pure (β' • F.generator d, γ' • F.generator d)) ∘
      (Equiv.mulRight₀ (γ - α * β) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hγ)).trans (Equiv.addLeft (α * β'))) = _
  rw [← PMF.bind_map, PMF.uniformOfFintype_map_equiv]

theorem advantage_multiDDH_le (d : F.Desc) (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (test : F.Carrier d → (ι → F.Carrier d × F.Carrier d) → PMF Bool) :
    Game.advantage
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun α =>
        (F.multiDDHRealTupleLaw d ι α).bind (test (α • F.generator d)))
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun α =>
        (F.multiDDHIdealTupleLaw d ι).bind (test (α • F.generator d))) ≤
    Game.advantage
      ((F.ddhRealTupleLaw d).bind fun t =>
        (F.multiDDHRerandomizeLaw d ι t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).bind (test t.1))
      ((F.ddhIdealTupleLaw d).bind fun t =>
        (F.multiDDHRerandomizeLaw d ι t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).bind (test t.1)) +
      (F.order d : ℝ≥0)⁻¹ := by
  have hreal :
      ((F.ddhRealTupleLaw d).bind fun t =>
        (F.multiDDHRerandomizeLaw d ι t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).bind (test t.1)) =
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun α =>
        (F.multiDDHRealTupleLaw d ι α).bind (test (α • F.generator d))) := by
    simp only [ddhRealTupleLaw, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.bind_bind,
      PMF.pure_bind, multiDDHRerandomizeLaw_real, PMF.bind_const]
  rw [← hreal]
  refine (Game.advantage_triangle _
    ((F.ddhIdealTupleLaw d).bind fun t =>
      (F.multiDDHRerandomizeLaw d ι t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).bind (test t.1)) _).trans ?_
  refine add_le_add le_rfl ?_
  simp only [ddhIdealTupleLaw, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.bind_bind,
    PMF.pure_bind]
  -- Bound the advantage inside the outer `α, β` averages using `Game.advantage_bind_le`.
  have hpoint (α β : ZMod (F.order d)) :
      (Game.advantage
        ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun γ =>
          (F.multiDDHRerandomizeLaw d ι (α • F.generator d) (β • F.generator d)
            (γ • F.generator d)).bind (test (α • F.generator d)))
        ((F.multiDDHIdealTupleLaw d ι).bind (test (α • F.generator d))) : ℝ) ≤
      (((F.order d : ℝ≥0)⁻¹ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
    refine NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr ?_
    simpa only [ZMod.card] using
      Game.advantage_bind_uniformOfFintype_of_ne_le (α * β)
        (fun γ => (F.multiDDHRerandomizeLaw d ι (α • F.generator d) (β • F.generator d)
          (γ • F.generator d)).bind (test (α • F.generator d)))
        ((F.multiDDHIdealTupleLaw d ι).bind (test (α • F.generator d)))
        (fun γ hγ => by rw [F.multiDDHRerandomizeLaw_ideal d ι hγ])
  have hβ (α : ZMod (F.order d)) :
      (Game.advantage
        ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun β =>
          (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).bind fun γ =>
            (F.multiDDHRerandomizeLaw d ι (α • F.generator d) (β • F.generator d)
              (γ • F.generator d)).bind (test (α • F.generator d)))
        ((F.multiDDHIdealTupleLaw d ι).bind (test (α • F.generator d))) : ℝ) ≤
      (((F.order d : ℝ≥0)⁻¹ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
    rw [← PMF.bind_const (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d)))
      ((F.multiDDHIdealTupleLaw d ι).bind (test (α • F.generator d)))]
    exact Game.advantage_bind_le _ _ _ (hpoint α)
  exact NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp (Game.advantage_bind_le _ _ _ hβ)

  have hd : ComputableInPolyTime

  have hu : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun input : F.Desc × List Bool × List Bool × ℕ => input.2.1) encIn encBits := by fun_prop
  have hm : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun input : F.Desc × List Bool × List Bool × ℕ => input.2.2.1) encIn encBits := by fun_prop
  have hb : ComputableInPolyTime

  have hpad := hH.comp (hd.prod hbu)

        let pad := H (input.1, F.smul (input.1, input.2.2.2, input.2.1))
        Cslib.BitString.listXor pad.length [pad, input.2.2.1])
      encIn encBits := by fun_prop

theorem isPPTOn_run_cpaEncryptionOracle (E : SymmetricCipher) {adversary : OracleDistinguisher}
    (hadversary : IsOraclePPT encBool adversary) (bit : Bool) :
    IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary encBits) (encPair encBool (encFinite Unit))
      (fun caller : ℕ × List Bool =>
        (OracleComp.interpret
          (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
            (E.cpaEncryptionOracle caller.1 caller.2 bit)) (adversary caller.1 [])).run ()) := by
  obtain ⟨c, d, hlen⟩ := E.encrypt_ppt.length_le
  let EIn := encPair (encPair encUnary encBits)
    (encPair (encPair (encFinite Unit) encBits) (encFinite Unit))
  have hm0 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit) => unframe p.2.1.2)
      EIn encBits :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unframe.comp (by dsimp only [EIn]; fun_prop)
  have hm1 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit) => dropFrame p.2.1.2)
      EIn encBits :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.dropFrame.comp (by dsimp only [EIn]; fun_prop)
  have hcond : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit) =>
        ((unframe p.2.1.2).length == p.1.1) && ((dropFrame p.2.1.2).length == p.1.1))
      EIn encBool := by
    dsimp only [EIn]; polytime
  have hmsg : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit) =>
        if bit then dropFrame p.2.1.2 else unframe p.2.1.2)
      EIn encBits := by
    cases bit <;> simpa using (by first | exact hm1 | exact hm0)
  have hencArg : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit) =>
        (p.1.1, p.1.2, if bit then dropFrame p.2.1.2 else unframe p.2.1.2))
      EIn (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)) :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by dsimp only [EIn]; fun_prop)
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by dsimp only [EIn]; fun_prop) hmsg)
  have hyes : IsPPTOn EIn (encPair encBits (encFinite Unit))
      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit) => do
        let ct ← E.encrypt p.1.1 p.1.2 (if bit then dropFrame p.2.1.2 else unframe p.2.1.2)
        return (ct, ())) :=
    (E.encrypt_ppt.preprocess hencArg.computableInPolyTime).bind_with
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by fun_prop)
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const ())).isPPTOn)
  have hno : IsPPTOn EIn (encPair encBits (encFinite Unit))
      (fun _ => pure ([], ())) :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const ([], ())).isPPTOn
  have hhandler : IsPPTOn EIn (encPair encBits (encFinite Unit))
      (fun pair : (ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit) =>
        E.cpaEncryptionOracle pair.1.1 pair.1.2 bit pair.2.1 pair.2.2) := by
    unfold cpaEncryptionOracle
    exact IsPPTOn.cond hcond hyes hno
  apply hadversary.run_interpret_preprocess
    (prepare := fun caller : ℕ × List Bool => (caller.1, ([] : List Bool)))
    (initial := fun _ => ())
    (resources := fun caller _ =>
      c * (3 * caller.1 + 2 * caller.2.length + 4) ^ d + 1)
    (by fun_prop) hhandler (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const ())
    (fun _ _ => True) (fun _ => trivial) (by polytime)
  intro caller request _ _ result hresult
  unfold cpaEncryptionOracle at hresult
  by_cases hlenEq : ((unframe request.2).length == caller.1 &&
      (dropFrame request.2).length == caller.1) = true
  · simp only [hlenEq, ↓reduceIte, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure,
      PMF.mem_support_bind_iff, PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hresult
    obtain ⟨ct, hct, rfl⟩ := hresult
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at hlenEq
    have hmbLen : (if bit then dropFrame request.2 else unframe request.2).length = caller.1 := by
      cases bit <;> simp [hlenEq]
    have hctLen := hlen (caller.1, caller.2, if bit then dropFrame request.2 else unframe request.2)
      ct hct
    simp only [length_encPair, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate, encBits_apply,
      hmbLen] at hctLen
    have hbound : ct.length ≤ c * (3 * caller.1 + 2 * caller.2.length + 4) ^ d :=
      hctLen.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by lia) d))
    exact ⟨trivial, by lia, by lia⟩
  · simp only [hlenEq, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ProbComp.eval_pure,
      PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hresult
    subst result
    exact ⟨trivial, by simp, by lia⟩

theorem not_indcpa_of_ciphertext_length_eq (E : SymmetricCipher)
    (hctLen : ∀ n, ∀ ke ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.keyGen n)).support,
      ∀ msg : List Bool, msg.length = n →
      ∀ c ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.encrypt n ke msg)).support, c.length = n) :

  have hcongr : Negligible (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℝ≥0)) :=
    hcomp.congr fun n => advantage_cpaGame_detCPAAdversary E (by lia) (hctLen (n + 1))

    {adversary : CCAAdversary} (hadversary : IsOraclePPT encBool adversary) :

        ((unframe p.2.1.2).length == p.1.1) && ((dropFrame p.2.1.2).length == p.1.1))
      EIn encBool := by
    dsimp only [EIn]; polytime
  have hlimit : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × ((Bool × List Bool) × Unit) => ctBound p.1.1)

      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × ((Bool × List Bool) × Unit) =>

      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by fun_prop) (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const ()))

      (fun _ => pure ([], ())) :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const ([], ())).isPPTOn.isOraclePPTOn (Operation := Unit)
  have hhandler : IsOraclePPTOn EIn (encPair encBits (encFinite Unit))
      (fun pair : (ℕ × List Bool) × ((Bool × List Bool) × Unit) =>

    unfold ccaToCPAHandler
    exact IsOraclePPTOn.cond hop hnoReply (IsOraclePPTOn.cond hencCond hquery hnoReply)
  have hres : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun pair : (ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool => ctBound pair.1.1 + 1)

    cases hreq : request.1
    · simp only [hreq, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hresult

    (hq : program.IsQueryBounded Q) (queried : List (List Bool)) :

      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
        (fun q s => ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectWithBadOracle n k bit q s)))
      program).run (queried, false)).toOuterMeasure {x | x.2.2 = true} ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (Q + 1),
        ((OracleComp.interpret
          (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
            (fun q s => ProbComp.eval (E.ccaToCICombinedOracle n k bit q s)))
          program).run ((j, (false, [])), queried)).bind
          (fun x => PMF.pure (!x.2.2.contains x.2.1.2.2 && (E.decrypt n k x.2.1.2.2).isSome))

      PMF.toOuterMeasure_pure_apply, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, zero_le]

        Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, Probability.PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure,
        PMF.bind_bind, PMF.pure_bind, PMF.toOuterMeasure_bind_apply, PMF.bind_apply]

                  (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
                    (fun q s => ProbComp.eval (E.ccaToCICombinedOracle n k bit q s)))
                  (cont a)).run ((j, (false, [])), queried)).bind
                  (fun x =>
                    PMF.pure (!x.2.2.contains x.2.1.2.2 && (E.decrypt n k x.2.1.2.2).isSome))

        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
        by_cases hlenEq : ((unframe request.2).length == n &&

            Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind,
            PMF.bind_bind, PMF.pure_bind, PMF.toOuterMeasure_bind_apply]

                  (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))

                        (fun q s => ProbComp.eval (E.ccaToCICombinedOracle n k bit q s)))

                simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
                rw [ennreal_tsum_finsetSum]

          Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.pure_bind]
        by_cases hmem : queried.contains request.2 = true
        · simp only [hmem, ↓reduceIte, PMF.pure_bind]
          exact (ih [] queried).trans le_self_add
        · simp only [hmem, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, PMF.pure_bind]

private theorem advantage_ccaGame_ccaRejectGame_le_sum (E : SymmetricCipher) (ctBound Q : ℕ → ℕ)
    (adversary : CCAAdversary) (bit : Bool) (n : ℕ)
    (hq : (adversary n []).IsQueryBounded (Q n))
    (hctBound : ∀ k ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.keyGen n)).support,
      ∀ msg, msg.length = n →
      ∀ ct ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.encrypt n k msg)).support, ct.length ≤ ctBound n) :
    (Game.advantage (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary bit n))
        (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary bit n)) : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (Q n + 1),
        (Game.succProbability
          (ProbComp.eval (E.ciGame (ccaToCIAtIndexAdversary ctBound j bit adversary) n)) : ℝ) := by
  have hccaEq (k : List Bool) :
      ((OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
          (fun q s => ProbComp.eval (E.ccaOracle n k bit q s)))
        (adversary n [])).run []).bind (fun out => PMF.pure out.1) =
      ((OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
          (fun q s => ProbComp.eval (E.ccaWithBadOracle n k bit q s)))
        (adversary n [])).run ([], false)).bind (fun out => PMF.pure out.1) := by
    rw [← run_ccaWithBadOracle_map_fst E n k bit (adversary n []) [] false,
      PMF.bind_map, Function.comp_def]
  have hrejEq (k : List Bool) :
      ((OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
          (fun q s => ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectOracle n k bit q s)))
        (adversary n [])).run []).bind (fun out => PMF.pure out.1) =
      ((OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
          (fun q s => ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectWithBadOracle n k bit q s)))
        (adversary n [])).run ([], false)).bind (fun out => PMF.pure out.1) := by
    rw [← run_ccaRejectWithBadOracle_map_fst E n k bit (adversary n []) [] false,
      PMF.bind_map, Function.comp_def]

  set pRej := ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary bit n) true

    ProbComp.eval (E.ciGame (ccaToCIAtIndexAdversary ctBound j bit adversary) n) true

      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (Q n + 1),
        ((OracleComp.interpret
          (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
            (fun q s => ProbComp.eval (E.ciEncryptionOracle n k q s)))
          (ccaToCIAtIndexAdversary ctBound j bit adversary n [])).run []).bind
          (fun out => PMF.pure (!out.2.contains out.1 && (E.decrypt n k out.1).isSome)) true := by
    simp only [pSum, ciGame, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure,
      ProbOracleComp.eval_run_interpret]
    conv_lhs =>
      arg 2; ext j
      rw [PMF.bind_apply]
    rw [← ennreal_tsum_finsetSum]
    refine tsum_congr fun k => ?_
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hCCA_eq : pCCA = ∑' k : List Bool, ProbComp.eval (E.keyGen n) k *
      ((OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
          (fun q s => ProbComp.eval (E.ccaWithBadOracle n k bit q s)))
        (adversary n [])).run ([], false)).bind (fun out => PMF.pure out.1) true := by
    simp only [pCCA, ccaGame, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure,
      ProbOracleComp.eval_run_interpret, hccaEq]
    exact PMF.bind_apply _ _ _
  have hRej_eq : pRej = ∑' k : List Bool, ProbComp.eval (E.keyGen n) k *
      ((OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
          (fun q s => ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectWithBadOracle n k bit q s)))
        (adversary n [])).run ([], false)).bind (fun out => PMF.pure out.1) true := by
    simp only [pRej, ccaRejectGame, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure,
      ProbOracleComp.eval_run_interpret, hrejEq]
    exact PMF.bind_apply _ _ _
  have hle1 : pCCA ≤ pRej + pSum := by
    rw [hCCA_eq, hRej_eq, hsum_eq, ← ENNReal.tsum_add]
    refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun k => ?_
    rw [← mul_add]
    by_cases hk : k ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.keyGen n)).support
    · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ zero_le
      have hiub := (identicalUntilBad_ccaRejectWithBad_ccaWithBad E n k bit).symm
      have hstep := hiub.bind_apply_le (adversary n []) ([], false) (fun out => PMF.pure out.1) true

      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_

    rw [hCCA_eq, hRej_eq, hsum_eq, ← ENNReal.tsum_add]
    refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun k => ?_
    rw [← mul_add]
    by_cases hk : k ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.keyGen n)).support
    · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ zero_le
      have hiub := identicalUntilBad_ccaRejectWithBad_ccaWithBad E n k bit
      have hstep := hiub.bind_apply_le (adversary n []) ([], false) (fun out => PMF.pure out.1) true
      refine hstep.trans (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
      refine (bad_ccaRejectWithBad_le_sum_ciCombined E n k bit hq []).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [eval_ciGame_ccaToCIAtIndexAdversary_key E ctBound j bit adversary n k hk hctBound]
    · rw [(PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr hk, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  have hpSum_ne_top : pSum ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.sum_ne_top.mpr fun j _ => PMF.apply_ne_top _ _
  have h1 := ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨PMF.apply_ne_top _ _, hpSum_ne_top⟩) hle1
  have h2 := ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨PMF.apply_ne_top _ _, hpSum_ne_top⟩) hle2
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _) hpSum_ne_top] at h1 h2
  have habs : |pCCA.toReal - pRej.toReal| ≤ pSum.toReal :=
    abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  rw [Game.coe_advantage]
  simpa only [Game.succProbability, ENNReal.coe_toNNReal_eq_toReal, pCCA, pRej, pSum,
    ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun j _ => PMF.apply_ne_top _ _)] using habs

    (adversary : CCAAdversary) (n : ℕ)

    (hctBound : ∀ k ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.keyGen n)).support,

      ∀ ct ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.encrypt n k msg)).support, ct.length ≤ ctBound n) :
    (Game.advantage (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary false n))
        (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary true n)) : ℝ) ≤
      (dyadicSize (Q n) : ℝ) *
        (Game.succProbability
          (ProbComp.eval (E.ciGame (ccaToCIAdversary ctBound Q false adversary) n)) : ℝ) +
      (Game.advantage
        (ProbComp.eval (E.cpaGame (ccaToCPAAdversary ctBound adversary) false n))
        (ProbComp.eval (E.cpaGame (ccaToCPAAdversary ctBound adversary) true n)) : ℝ) +
      (dyadicSize (Q n) : ℝ) *
        (Game.succProbability
          (ProbComp.eval (E.ciGame (ccaToCIAdversary ctBound Q true adversary) n)) : ℝ) := by
  have h1 : (Game.advantage (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary false n))
      (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary true n)) : ℝ) ≤
      (Game.advantage (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary false n))
        (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary false n)) : ℝ) +
      (Game.advantage (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary false n))
        (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary true n)) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Game.advantage_triangle
      (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary false n))
      (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary false n))
      (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary true n))
  have h2 : (Game.advantage (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary false n))
      (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary true n)) : ℝ) ≤
      (Game.advantage (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary false n))
        (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary true n)) : ℝ) +
      (Game.advantage (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary true n))
        (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary true n)) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Game.advantage_triangle
      (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary false n))
      (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary true n))
      (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary true n))
  have hcomm : Game.advantage (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary true n))
      (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary true n)) =
      Game.advantage (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaGame adversary true n))
      (ProbComp.eval (E.ccaRejectGame adversary true n)) := Game.advantage_comm _ _

theorem AuthenticatedEncryption.indcca {E : SymmetricCipher} (hAE : E.AuthenticatedEncryption) :
    E.INDCCA := by
  rcases hAE with ⟨hcpa, hci⟩
  intro adversary hadversary
  obtain ⟨ck, dk, hlenKey⟩ := E.keyGen_ppt.length_le
  obtain ⟨ce, de, hlenEnc⟩ := E.encrypt_ppt.length_le
  obtain ⟨cq, dq, hqbounds⟩ := hadversary.query_bounds
  let ctBound : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => ce * (3 * n + 2 * (ck * (n + 1) ^ dk) + 4) ^ de
  let Q : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => cq * (n + 2) ^ dq
  have hctBoundPoly : ComputableInPolyTime ctBound encUnary encUnary := by
    dsimp only [ctBound]; polytime
  have hQPoly : ComputableInPolyTime Q encUnary encUnary := by
    dsimp only [Q]; polytime
  have hctBound (n : ℕ) (k : List Bool) (hk : k ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.keyGen n)).support)
      (msg : List Bool) (hmsg : msg.length = n) (ct : List Bool)
      (hct : ct ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.encrypt n k msg)).support) : ct.length ≤ ctBound n := by
    have hkLen := hlenKey n k hk
    have hctLen := hlenEnc (n, k, msg) ct hct
    simp only [encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate, encBits_apply] at hkLen
    simp only [length_encPair, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate, encBits_apply,
      hmsg] at hctLen
    exact hctLen.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left ce (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by lia) de))
  have hq (n : ℕ) : (adversary n []).IsQueryBounded (Q n) := by
    simpa only [Q, List.length_nil, Nat.add_zero] using (hqbounds n []).1
  have hcpaNeg := hcpa (ccaToCPAAdversary ctBound adversary)
    (isOraclePPT_ccaToCPAAdversary hctBoundPoly hadversary)
  have hciNeg := hci.negligible (ccaToCIHiddenBitAdversary ctBound Q adversary)
    (isOraclePPT_ccaToCIHiddenBitAdversary hctBoundPoly hQPoly hadversary)
  have hpolyDyadic : PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => 2 * dyadicSize (Q n)) := by
    dsimp only [Q]; fun_prop
  have hsumNeg := (hciNeg.polynomiallyBounded_mul hpolyDyadic).add hcpaNeg
  refine negligible_of_le hsumNeg fun n => ?_
  rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe]
  simpa only [Pi.add_apply, NNReal.coe_add, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_natCast, NNReal.coe_ofNat,
    Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_assoc] using
    advantage_ccaGame_le_two_mul E ctBound Q adversary n (hq n) (hctBound n)

theorem isPPTOn_cca2GameOn {Msg Out : Type} {encMsg : Msg ↪ List Bool} {encOut : Out ↪ List Bool}
    {valid : ℕ → List Bool → Msg → Msg → Bool}
    {keyGen : ℕ → ProbComp (List Bool × List Bool)}
    {encrypt : ℕ → List Bool → Msg → ProbComp (List Bool)}
    {decrypt : ℕ → List Bool → List Bool → Option Out}
    {adversary : CCA2AdversaryOf Msg}
    (hvalid : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : ℕ × List Bool × Msg × Msg => valid p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2)
      (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits (encPair encMsg encMsg))) encBool)
    (hkeyGen : IsPPTOn encUnary (encPair encBits encBits) keyGen)
    (hencrypt : IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encMsg)) encBits
      (fun p => encrypt p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (hdecrypt : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : ℕ × List Bool × List Bool => decrypt p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
      (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)) (encOption encOut))
    (hA : adversary.IsPPT encMsg) (bit : Bool) :
    IsPPTOn encUnary encBool (cca2GameOn valid encOut keyGen encrypt decrypt adversary bit) := by
  let E1 := encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)
  let EChoice := encPair (encPair (encPair encMsg encMsg) encBits) (encFinite Unit)
  let E2 := encPair E1 EChoice
  let E3 := encPair E2 encBits
  have hphase1 : IsPPTOn E1 EChoice
      (fun p : ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool) =>
        (OracleComp.interpret
          (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
            (cca2Phase1Oracle encOut decrypt p.1 p.2.2))
          (adversary.choose p.1 p.2.1)).run ()) :=
    isPPTOn_run_cca2Phase1Oracle hdecrypt hA
  have hm0 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool)) × (((Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Unit) => p.2.1.1.1)
      E2 encMsg :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).comp
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).comp
        ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd _ _)))
  have hm1 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool)) × (((Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Unit) => p.2.1.1.2)
      E2 encMsg :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd _ _).comp
      ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).comp
        ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd _ _)))
  have hvalidArg : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool)) × (((Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Unit) =>
        (p.1.1, p.1.2.1, p.2.1.1.1, p.2.1.1.2))
      E2 (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits (encPair encMsg encMsg))) :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by fun_prop)
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by fun_prop)
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod hm0 hm1))
  have hvalidStep : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool)) × (((Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Unit) =>
        valid p.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.1.1.1 p.2.1.1.2)
      E2 encBool :=
    hvalid.tidy.comp hvalidArg
  have hmsg : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool)) × (((Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Unit) =>
        if bit then p.2.1.1.2 else p.2.1.1.1)
      E2 encMsg := by
    cases bit
    · exact hm0
    · exact hm1
  have hencArg : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool)) × (((Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Unit) =>
        (p.1.1, p.1.2.1, if bit then p.2.1.1.2 else p.2.1.1.1))
      E2 (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encMsg)) :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by fun_prop)
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by fun_prop) hmsg)).computableInPolyTime
  have hencStep : IsPPTOn E2 encBits
      (fun p => encrypt p.1.1 p.1.2.1 (if bit then p.2.1.1.2 else p.2.1.1.1)) :=
    hencrypt.preprocess hencArg
  have hphase2Arg : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : ((ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool)) × (((Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Unit)) × List Bool =>
        (p.1.1.1, p.1.1.2.2, p.1.2.1.2, p.2))
      E3 (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits (encPair encBits encBits))) := by fun_prop
  have hphase2 : IsPPTOn E3 (encPair encBool (encFinite Unit))
      (fun p : ((ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool)) × (((Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Unit)) × List Bool =>
        (OracleComp.interpret
          (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
            (cca2Phase2Oracle encOut decrypt p.1.1.1 p.1.1.2.2 p.2))
          (adversary.guess p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1.2 p.2)).run ()) :=
    (isPPTOn_run_cca2Phase2Oracle hdecrypt hA).preprocess hphase2Arg
  have hphase2Bool : IsPPTOn E3 encBool
      (fun p :
        ((ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool)) × (((Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Unit)) × List Bool => do
        let guessOut ← (OracleComp.interpret
          (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin m))
            (cca2Phase2Oracle encOut decrypt p.1.1.1 p.1.1.2.2 p.2))
          (adversary.guess p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1.2 p.2)).run ()
        return guessOut.1) :=
    hphase2.bind (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).isPPTOn
  have hbranch : IsPPTOn E2 encBool
      (fun p : (ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool)) × (((Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Unit) =>

            (adversary.guess p.1.1 p.2.1.2 ct)).run ()
          return guessOut.1
        else
          return false) :=
    IsPPTOn.cond hvalidStep (hencStep.bind_with hphase2Bool)
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const false).isPPTOn

noncomputable def encryptThenMAC (E : SymmetricCipher) (M : MACScheme)
    (hctLen : ∀ n ke, ke ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.keyGen n)).support →
      ∀ msg, msg.length = n →
      ∀ c ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.encrypt n ke msg)).support, c.length = M.msgLen n) :
    SymmetricCipher where
  keyGen n := do
    let ke ← E.keyGen n
    let km ← M.keyGen n
    return encPair encBits encBits (ke, km)
  encrypt n k msg := do
    let c ← E.encrypt n (unframe k) msg
    let tag ← M.sign (dropFrame k) c
    return encPair encBits encBits (c, tag)
  decrypt n k ct :=
    if (encPair encBits encBits (unframe ct, dropFrame ct) == ct) &&
        ((unframe ct).length == M.msgLen n) &&
        M.verify (dropFrame k) (unframe ct) (dropFrame ct) then
      E.decrypt n (unframe k) (unframe ct)
    else
      none
  keyGen_ppt := by
    have hpost : ComputableInPolyTime
        (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool => encPair encBits encBits (p.1.2, p.2))
        (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits) encBits :=
      ComputableInPolyTime.encoding_comp
        (((ComputableInPolyTime.snd encUnary encBits).comp
          (ComputableInPolyTime.fst (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits)).prod
            (ComputableInPolyTime.snd (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits))
    exact E.keyGen_ppt.bind_with
      ((M.keyGen_ppt.preprocess (ComputableInPolyTime.fst encUnary encBits)).bind_with
        hpost.isPPTOn)
  encrypt_ppt := by
    let I := encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)
    have hn := ComputableInPolyTime.fst encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)
    have hrest := ComputableInPolyTime.snd encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)
    have hk := (ComputableInPolyTime.fst encBits encBits).comp hrest
    have hm := (ComputableInPolyTime.snd encBits encBits).comp hrest
    have hrun := E.isPPTOn_encrypt_comp hn (ComputableInPolyTime.unframe.comp hk) hm
    have hsign := M.isPPTOn_sign_comp
      (ComputableInPolyTime.dropFrame.comp (hk.comp (ComputableInPolyTime.fst I encBits)))
      (ComputableInPolyTime.snd I encBits)
    have hpost : ComputableInPolyTime
        (fun p : ((ℕ × List Bool × List Bool) × List Bool) × List Bool =>
          encPair encBits encBits (p.1.2, p.2))
        (encPair (encPair I encBits) encBits) encBits :=
      ComputableInPolyTime.encoding_comp
        (((ComputableInPolyTime.snd I encBits).comp
          (ComputableInPolyTime.fst (encPair I encBits) encBits)).prod
            (ComputableInPolyTime.snd (encPair I encBits) encBits))
    exact hrun.bind_with (hsign.bind_with hpost.isPPTOn)
  decrypt_polyTime := by
    have hn := ComputableInPolyTime.fst encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)
    have hrest := ComputableInPolyTime.snd encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)
    have hk := (ComputableInPolyTime.fst encBits encBits).comp hrest
    have hct := (ComputableInPolyTime.snd encBits encBits).comp hrest
    have hmsgLen := M.msgLen_polyTime.comp hn
    have hmsg := ComputableInPolyTime.unframe.comp hct
    have htag := ComputableInPolyTime.dropFrame.comp hct
    have hver := M.computableInPolyTime_verify_comp
      (ComputableInPolyTime.dropFrame.comp hk) hmsg htag
    have hroundTrip := ComputableInPolyTime.beq (encB := encBits)
      (ComputableInPolyTime.bitsAppend (ComputableInPolyTime.frame.comp hmsg) htag) hct
    have hsize := ComputableInPolyTime.beq (encB := encUnary)
      (ComputableInPolyTime.length_bits.comp hmsg) hmsgLen
    have hcond := ComputableInPolyTime.bool_and.comp
      ((ComputableInPolyTime.bool_and.comp (hroundTrip.prod hsize)).prod hver)
    have hyes := E.decrypt_polyTime.comp
      (hn.prod ((ComputableInPolyTime.unframe.comp hk).prod hmsg))
    exact ComputableInPolyTime.ite hcond hyes (ComputableInPolyTime.const none)
  decrypt_encrypt := by
    intro n k hk msg hmsg ct hct
    simp only [ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure, PMF.mem_support_bind_iff,
      PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hk hct
    obtain ⟨ke, hke, km, hkm, rfl⟩ := hk
    have hunframe_k : unframe (encPair encBits encBits (ke, km)) = ke := by
      simp [encPair_apply, unframe_frame_append]
    have hdrop_k : dropFrame (encPair encBits encBits (ke, km)) = km := by
      simp [encPair_apply, dropFrame_frame_append]
    rw [hunframe_k, hdrop_k] at hct
    obtain ⟨c, hc, tag, htag, rfl⟩ := hct
    have hunframe_ct : unframe (encPair encBits encBits (c, tag)) = c := by
      simp [encPair_apply, unframe_frame_append]
    have hdrop_ct : dropFrame (encPair encBits encBits (c, tag)) = tag := by
      simp [encPair_apply, dropFrame_frame_append]
    have hcLen : c.length = M.msgLen n := hctLen n ke hke msg hmsg c hc
    have hver : M.verify km c tag = true := M.verify_sign n km hkm c hcLen tag htag
    have hdec : E.decrypt n ke c = some msg := E.decrypt_encrypt n ke hke msg hmsg c hc
    rw [hunframe_k, hdrop_k, hunframe_ct, hdrop_ct]
    simp [hcLen, hver, hdec]

noncomputable def prfCipher (family : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (hpoly : ComputableInPolyTime (fun pair => family pair.1 pair.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits)
    (hlen : ∀ key query, query.length = key.length → (family key query).length = key.length) :
    SymmetricCipher where
  keyGen n := BitString.sampleList n
  encrypt n k msg := do
    let r ← BitString.sampleList n
    return (r ++ List.zipWith xor (family k r) msg)
  decrypt n k ct :=
    if ct.length == 2 * n then
      some (List.zipWith xor (family k (ct.take n)) (ct.drop n))
    else
      none
  keyGen_ppt := by
    ppt
  encrypt_ppt := by
    have hfamTidy := hpoly.tidy
    ppt
  decrypt_polyTime := by
    have hfamTidy := hpoly.tidy
    have hcond : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun p : ℕ × List Bool × List Bool => p.2.2.length == 2 * p.1)
        (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)) encBool := by polytime
    have hyes : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun p : ℕ × List Bool × List Bool =>
          (some (List.zipWith xor (family p.2.1 (p.2.2.take p.1)) (p.2.2.drop p.1)) :
            Option (List Bool)))
        (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)) (encOption encBits) := by polytime
    have hno : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun _ : ℕ × List Bool × List Bool => (none : Option (List Bool)))
        (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)) (encOption encBits) :=
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.const none
    exact .of_tidy (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.cond hcond hyes hno)
  decrypt_encrypt := by
    intro n k hk msg hmsg ct hct
    rw [BitString.eval_sampleList] at hk
    have hkLen : k.length = n := BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hk
    simp only [ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure, BitString.eval_sampleList,
      PMF.mem_support_bind_iff, PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hct
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hct
    have hrLen : r.length = n := BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hr
    have hpadLen : (family k r).length = n := by
      rw [hlen k r (by rw [hrLen, hkLen]), hkLen]
    have hzipLen : (List.zipWith xor (family k r) msg).length = n := by
      simp [hpadLen, hmsg]
    have hctLen : (r ++ List.zipWith xor (family k r) msg).length = 2 * n := by
      rw [List.length_append, hrLen, hzipLen]; lia
    have htake : (r ++ List.zipWith xor (family k r) msg).take n = r := by
      rw [← hrLen, List.take_left]
    have hdrop : (r ++ List.zipWith xor (family k r) msg).drop n =
        List.zipWith xor (family k r) msg := by
      rw [← hrLen, List.drop_left]
    simp [hctLen, htake, hdrop,
      BitString.zipWith_xor_self_left (family k r) msg (by rw [hpadLen, hmsg])]

      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit) =>
        ((unframe p.2.1.2).length == p.1.1) && ((dropFrame p.2.1.2).length == p.1.1))
      EIn encBool := by
    dsimp only [EIn, ECaller]; polytime

      (fun q : ((ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit)) × List Bool => q.2)
      (encPair EIn encBits) encBits := by
    fun_prop

      (fun q : ((ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit)) × List Bool => q.1.1.1)
      (encPair EIn encBits) encUnary := by
    dsimp only [EIn, ECaller]; fun_prop
  have hq : IsOraclePPTOn (Operation := Unit) (encPair EIn encBits) encBits
      (fun q : ((ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit)) × List Bool =>
        List.take q.1.1.1 <$> ProbOracleComp.query ((), q.2)) :=
    IsOraclePPTOn.query_take (Operation := Unit) () hqReq hqLim

      (fun r : (((ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit)) × List Bool) × List Bool =>
        (r.1.2 ++ List.zipWith xor r.2
          (if bit then dropFrame r.1.1.2.1.2 else unframe r.1.1.2.1.2), ()))
      (encPair (encPair EIn encBits) encBits)

          (List.take q.1.1.1 <$> ProbOracleComp.query ((), q.2))) :=

      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × ((Unit × List Bool) × Unit) => do
        let r ← ProbOracleComp.sample (BitString.sampleList p.1.1)
        (fun pad => (r ++ List.zipWith xor pad

private theorem advantage_prfIdealGame_prfCipherOTPOracle_le (adversary : OracleDistinguisher)
    (bit : Bool) (n Q : ℕ) (hq : (adversary n []).IsQueryBounded Q) :
    (Game.advantage
      (ProbComp.eval (prfIdealGame (cpaToPrfDistinguisher adversary bit) n))
      (((OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
          (prfCipherOTPOracle n))
        (adversary n [])).run ()).map Prod.fst) : ℝ) ≤
      (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
  rw [eval_prfIdealGame_cpaToPrfDistinguisher,
    ← run_prfCipherForgetfulWithBadOracle_map_fst adversary bit n [] false]
  have hiub := identicalUntilBad_prfCipherFaithful_forgetful n bit
  have hadv := hiub.advantage_le (adversary n []) ([], false) (fun out => PMF.pure out.1)
  change (Game.advantage
      (((OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
          (prfCipherFaithfulWithBadOracle n bit))
        (adversary n [])).run ([], false)).map Prod.fst)
      (((OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun m => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle m))
          (prfCipherForgetfulWithBadOracle n bit))
        (adversary n [])).run ([], false)).map Prod.fst) : ℝ) ≤ _ at hadv
  rw [hiub.bad_eq] at hadv
  have hbad := bad_prfCipherForgetfulWithBadOracle_le n bit hq []
  simp only [List.length_nil, zero_add] at hbad
  have htop : (Q : ℝ≥0∞) * (Q : ℝ≥0∞) * ((1 : ℝ≥0∞) / 2 ^ n) ≠ ⊤ := by
    refine ENNReal.mul_ne_top (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top Q)
      (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top Q)) ?_
    exact ENNReal.div_ne_top ENNReal.one_ne_top (by positivity)
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono htop hbad
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_natCast, ENNReal.toReal_div,
    ENNReal.toReal_one, ENNReal.toReal_pow, ENNReal.toReal_ofNat] at hreal

theorem PseudorandomFunction.indcpa_prfCipher
    {family : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool} (hprf : PseudorandomFunction family) :
    (prfCipher family hprf.polyTime hprf.length_eq).INDCPA := by
  intro adversary hadversary
  obtain ⟨cq, dq, hqbounds⟩ := hadversary.query_bounds
  let Q : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => cq * (n + 2) ^ dq
  have hq (n : ℕ) : (adversary n []).IsQueryBounded (Q n) := by
    simpa only [Q, List.length_nil, Nat.add_zero] using (hqbounds n []).1
  have hprfFalse := hprf.secure (cpaToPrfDistinguisher adversary false)
    (isOraclePPT_cpaToPrfDistinguisher hadversary false)
  have hprfTrue := hprf.secure (cpaToPrfDistinguisher adversary true)
    (isOraclePPT_cpaToPrfDistinguisher hadversary true)
  have hpolyQ : PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => 2 * (Q n) ^ 2) := by
    dsimp only [Q]; fun_prop
  have hcollNeg :=
    (negligible_geometric (ratio := (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0)) (by norm_num)).polynomiallyBounded_mul hpolyQ
  have hsumNeg := (hprfFalse.add hprfTrue).add hcollNeg
  refine negligible_of_le hsumNeg fun n => ?_
  rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe]
  have hbound := advantage_cpaGame_prfCipher_le family hprf.polyTime hprf.length_eq
    adversary n (Q n) (hq n)
  simpa only [Pi.add_apply, NNReal.coe_add, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_natCast, NNReal.coe_ofNat,
    NNReal.coe_pow, NNReal.coe_inv, NNReal.coe_one, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_pow,
    one_div, one_mul, inv_pow, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc] using hbound

theorem isPPT_hybridToKEMHiddenBitDistinguisher {Msg : Type} {encMsg : Msg ↪ List Bool}
    {encryptSym : ℕ → List Bool → Msg → ProbComp (List Bool)}
    {adversary : AdversaryOf Msg}
    (hencryptSym : IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encMsg)) encBits
      (fun p => encryptSym p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (hadversary : AdversaryOf.IsPPT encMsg adversary) :
    IsPPT encBool (hybridToKEMHiddenBitDistinguisher encryptSym adversary) := by
  let E0 := encPair encUnary encBits
  let E1 := encPair E0 (encPair (encPair encMsg encMsg) encBits)
  let E2 := encPair E1 encBool
  let E3 := encPair E2 encBits
  let E4 := encPair E3 encBool
  have hpk : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => unframe p.2) E0 encBits :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unframe.comp (by dsimp only [E0]; fun_prop)
  have h1 : IsPPTOn E0 (encPair (encPair encMsg encMsg) encBits)
      (fun p => adversary.choose p.1 (unframe p.2)) := by
    dsimp only [E0]; exact hadversary.choose.preprocess (by fun_prop) hpk
  have hk2 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ((ℕ × List Bool) × (Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Bool =>
        unframe (dropFrame p.1.1.2)) E2 encBits :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unframe.comp
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.dropFrame.comp (by dsimp only [E2, E1, E0]; fun_prop))
  have h2 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ((ℕ × List Bool) × (Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Bool =>
        (p.1.1.1, unframe (dropFrame p.1.1.2), if p.2 then p.1.2.1.2 else p.1.2.1.1))
      E2 (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encMsg)) :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by dsimp only [E2, E1, E0]; fun_prop)
      (hk2.prod (by dsimp only [E2, E1, E0]; fun_prop))
  have hctKem3 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (((ℕ × List Bool) × (Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Bool) × List Bool =>
        dropFrame (dropFrame p.1.1.1.2)) E3 encBits :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.dropFrame.comp
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.dropFrame.comp (by dsimp only [E3, E2, E1, E0]; fun_prop))
  have hct3 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (((ℕ × List Bool) × (Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Bool) × List Bool =>
        encPair encBits encBits (dropFrame (dropFrame p.1.1.1.2), p.2))
      E3 encBits :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encode (encPair encBits encBits)).comp
      (hctKem3.prod (by dsimp only [E3]; fun_prop))
  have h3 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (((ℕ × List Bool) × (Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Bool) × List Bool =>
        (p.1.1.1.1, p.1.1.2.2, encPair encBits encBits (dropFrame (dropFrame p.1.1.1.2), p.2)))
      E3 (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)) :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by dsimp only [E3, E2, E1, E0]; fun_prop)
      (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by dsimp only [E3, E2, E1, E0]; fun_prop) hct3)
  have h4 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ((((ℕ × List Bool) × (Msg × Msg) × List Bool) × Bool) × List Bool) × Bool =>
        p.2 ^^ p.1.1.2)
      E4 encBool := by
    dsimp only [E4, E3, E2, E1, E0]; fun_prop
  unfold IsPPT hybridToKEMHiddenBitDistinguisher
  exact h1.bind_with
    ((isPPTOn_uniform_bool E1).bind_with
      ((hencryptSym.preprocess h2.computableInPolyTime).bind_with
        ((hadversary.guess.preprocess h3.computableInPolyTime).bind_with h4.isPPTOn)))

theorem isPPT_hybridToDEMAdversary {Msg : Type} {encMsg : Msg ↪ List Bool}
    {keyGen : ℕ → ProbComp (List Bool × List Bool)}
    {encaps : ℕ → List Bool → ProbComp (List Bool × List Bool)}
    {adversary : AdversaryOf Msg}
    (hkeyGen : IsPPTOn encUnary (encPair encBits encBits) keyGen)
    (hencaps : IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary encBits) (encPair encBits encBits)
      (fun p => encaps p.1 p.2))
    (hadversary : AdversaryOf.IsPPT encMsg adversary) :
    AdversaryOf.IsPPT encMsg (hybridToDEMAdversary keyGen encaps adversary) := by
  let E0 := encPair encUnary encBits
  let E1 := encPair E0 (encPair encBits encBits)
  let E2 := encPair E1 (encPair (encPair encMsg encMsg) encBits)
  let E3 := encPair E2 (encPair encBits encBits)
  have h1 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => p.1) E0 encUnary := by
    dsimp only [E0]; fun_prop
  have h2 : IsPPTOn E1 (encPair (encPair encMsg encMsg) encBits)
      (fun p => adversary.choose p.1.1 p.2.1) := by
    dsimp only [E1, E0]; exact hadversary.choose.preprocess (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have h3 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ((ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool × List Bool) × (Msg × Msg) × List Bool =>
        (p.1.1.1, p.1.2.1))
      E2 (encPair encUnary encBits) := by
    dsimp only [E2, E1, E0]; fun_prop
  have hstate4 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (((ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool × List Bool) × (Msg × Msg) × List Bool) ×
          List Bool × List Bool =>
        encPair encBits encBits (p.2.2, p.1.2.2))
      E3 encBits :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encode (encPair encBits encBits)).comp
      (by dsimp only [E3, E2, E1, E0]; fun_prop)
  have h4 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (((ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool × List Bool) × (Msg × Msg) × List Bool) ×
          List Bool × List Bool =>
        (p.1.2.1, encPair encBits encBits (p.2.2, p.1.2.2)))
      E3 (encPair (encPair encMsg encMsg) encBits) :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by dsimp only [E3, E2, E1, E0]; fun_prop) hstate4
  let EG := encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)
  have hstate5 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ℕ × List Bool × List Bool => dropFrame p.2.1) EG encBits :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.dropFrame.comp (by dsimp only [EG]; fun_prop)
  have hctKem5 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ℕ × List Bool × List Bool => unframe p.2.1) EG encBits :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unframe.comp (by dsimp only [EG]; fun_prop)
  have hct5 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ℕ × List Bool × List Bool => encPair encBits encBits (unframe p.2.1, p.2.2))
      EG encBits :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encode (encPair encBits encBits)).comp
      (hctKem5.prod (by dsimp only [EG]; fun_prop))
  have h5 : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ℕ × List Bool × List Bool =>
        (p.1, dropFrame p.2.1, encPair encBits encBits (unframe p.2.1, p.2.2)))
      EG EG :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.prod (by dsimp only [EG]; fun_prop) (hstate5.prod hct5)
  refine ⟨?_, hadversary.guess.preprocess h5.computableInPolyTime⟩
  unfold Probability.IsPPT hybridToDEMAdversary
  exact (hkeyGen.preprocess h1.computableInPolyTime).bind_with
    (h2.bind_with
      ((hencaps.preprocess h3.computableInPolyTime).bind_with h4.isPPTOn))

theorem advantage_hybridGame_le {Msg : Type}
    (keyGen : ℕ → ProbComp (List Bool × List Bool))
    (encaps : ℕ → List Bool → ProbComp (List Bool × List Bool))
    (encryptSym : ℕ → List Bool → Msg → ProbComp (List Bool))
    (adversary : AdversaryOf Msg) (n : ℕ) :
    Game.advantage
      (ProbComp.eval (game keyGen (hybridEncrypt encaps encryptSym) adversary false n))
      (ProbComp.eval (game keyGen (hybridEncrypt encaps encryptSym) adversary true n)) ≤
      Game.advantage
        (ProbComp.eval
          (kemRealGame keyGen encaps (hybridToKEMDistinguisher encryptSym adversary false) n))
        (ProbComp.eval
          (kemIdealGame keyGen encaps (hybridToKEMDistinguisher encryptSym adversary false) n)) +
      Game.advantage
        (ProbComp.eval
          (kemRealGame keyGen encaps (hybridToKEMDistinguisher encryptSym adversary true) n))
        (ProbComp.eval
          (kemIdealGame keyGen encaps (hybridToKEMDistinguisher encryptSym adversary true) n)) +
      Game.advantage
        (ProbComp.eval (demGame encryptSym (hybridToDEMAdversary keyGen encaps adversary) false n))
        (ProbComp.eval
          (demGame encryptSym (hybridToDEMAdversary keyGen encaps adversary) true n)) := by
  simp only [eval_kemRealGame_hybridToKEMDistinguisher, eval_kemIdealGame_hybridToKEMDistinguisher,
    eval_demGame_hybridToDEMAdversary]
  have h1 := Game.advantage_triangle
    (ProbComp.eval (game keyGen (hybridEncrypt encaps encryptSym) adversary false n))
    (ProbComp.eval (hybridIdealGame keyGen encaps encryptSym adversary false n))
    (ProbComp.eval (game keyGen (hybridEncrypt encaps encryptSym) adversary true n))
  have h2 := Game.advantage_triangle
    (ProbComp.eval (hybridIdealGame keyGen encaps encryptSym adversary false n))
    (ProbComp.eval (hybridIdealGame keyGen encaps encryptSym adversary true n))
    (ProbComp.eval (game keyGen (hybridEncrypt encaps encryptSym) adversary true n))
  rw [Game.advantage_comm
    (ProbComp.eval (hybridIdealGame keyGen encaps encryptSym adversary true n))
    (ProbComp.eval (game keyGen (hybridEncrypt encaps encryptSym) adversary true n))] at h2
  exact (h1.trans (add_le_add le_rfl h2)).trans_eq (by ac_rfl)

  simp only [demGame, demGameOn, ↓reduceIte, otpWordEncrypt, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure,
    BitString.eval_sampleList, PMF.pure_bind, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]

theorem isPPT_keyDistinguisher
    {encrypt : ℕ → List Bool → Bool → ProbComp (List Bool)} {adversary : Adversary}
    (hencrypt : IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBool)) encBits
      (fun input => encrypt input.1 input.2.1 input.2.2))
    (hadversary : adversary.IsPPT) : IsPPT encBool (keyDistinguisher encrypt adversary) := by
  let choiceEncoding := encPair (encPair encBool encBool) encBits
  let baseEncoding := encPair encUnary encBits
  let coinEncoding := encPair (encPair baseEncoding choiceEncoding) encBool
  have hchoose := hadversary.choose.on
  have hcoin := isPPTOn_uniform_bool (encPair baseEncoding choiceEncoding)
  have hencryptArg : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : ((ℕ × List Bool) × ((Bool × Bool) × List Bool)) × Bool =>
        (p.1.1.1, p.1.1.2, if p.2 then p.1.2.1.2 else p.1.2.1.1))
      coinEncoding (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBool)) := by
    dsimp only [coinEncoding, baseEncoding, choiceEncoding]
    fun_prop
  have hcipher := hencrypt.preprocess hencryptArg
  have hguessArg : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : (((ℕ × List Bool) × ((Bool × Bool) × List Bool)) × Bool) × List Bool =>
        (p.1.1.1.1, p.1.1.2.2, p.2)) (encPair coinEncoding encBits)
      (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)) := by
    dsimp only [coinEncoding, baseEncoding, choiceEncoding]
    fun_prop
  have hguess := hadversary.guess.preprocess hguessArg
  have hxor : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : (((((ℕ × List Bool) × ((Bool × Bool) × List Bool)) × Bool) × List Bool) × Bool) =>
        p.2 ^^ p.1.1.2) (encPair (encPair coinEncoding encBits) encBool) encBool := by
    have hx := ComputableInPolyTime.of_finite
      (encIn := encPair encBool encBool) (encOut := encBool) (fun p : Bool × Bool => p.1 ^^ p.2)
    have harg : ComputableInPolyTime
        (fun p : (((((ℕ × List Bool) × ((Bool × Bool) × List Bool)) × Bool) × List Bool) × Bool) =>
          (p.2, p.1.1.2)) (encPair (encPair coinEncoding encBits) encBool)
        (encPair encBool encBool) := by
      dsimp only [coinEncoding, baseEncoding, choiceEncoding]
      fun_prop
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hx.comp harg
  have hlast := hguess.map_with
    (f := fun p guess => guess ^^ p.1.2) hxor
  have hlast' : IsPPTOn (encPair coinEncoding encBits) encBool
      (fun p : (((ℕ × List Bool) × ((Bool × Bool) × List Bool)) × Bool) × List Bool => do
        let guess ← adversary.guess p.1.1.1.1 p.1.1.2.2 p.2
        pure (guess ^^ p.1.2)) := by
    simpa only [bind_pure_comp] using hlast
  have hbody := hcipher.bind_with
    (second := fun p ciphertext => do
      let guess ← adversary.guess p.1.1.1 p.1.2.2 ciphertext
      pure (guess ^^ p.2)) hlast'
  have hbits := hcoin.bind_with
    (second := fun p bit => do
      let ciphertext ← encrypt p.1.1 p.1.2 (if bit then p.2.1.2 else p.2.1.1)
      let guess ← adversary.guess p.1.1 p.2.2 ciphertext
      pure (guess ^^ bit)) hbody
  simpa only [IsPPT, keyDistinguisher, choiceEncoding, baseEncoding, coinEncoding,

theorem synthesis_evalBits {N : ℕ} (G : PRG.Generator (BitString k) (BitString (2 * k)))
    {s : Set (BooleanFunction N)} (seed : BitString N → BitString k)
    (query : BitString N → BitString n) (hseed : ∀ i, (fun z => seed z i) ∈ s)
    (hquery : ∀ i, (fun z => query z i) ∈ s) :
    Synthesis interpretation s (Set.range fun i z => evalBits G (seed z) (query z) i)
      (n * (complexity interpretation ⇑G + 4 * k)) := by
  induction n generalizing s seed with
  | zero =>
    rw [zero_mul]
    exact Synthesis.of_subset (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hseed)
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hsize⟩ := exists_computes_size_eq_complexity (I := interpretation) (f := ⇑G)
    -- the expansion of the current label, by a smallest circuit for the generator
    have h1 : Synthesis interpretation s (Set.range fun j z => G (seed z) j)
        (complexity interpretation ⇑G) := by
      have h := Synthesis.circuit (I := interpretation) c (fun i z => seed z i) hseed
      rw [hsize] at h
      convert h using 3 with j
      funext z
      exact (congrFun (hc (seed z)) j).symm
    -- the block selected by the first query bit, by one multiplexer per bit
    have h2 : Synthesis interpretation (s ∪ Set.range fun j z => G (seed z) j)
        (Set.range fun i z => BitString.block (G (seed z)) (finTwoEquiv.symm (query z 0)) i)
        (4 * k) := by
      have h := Synthesis.family (I := interpretation)
        (s := s ∪ Set.range fun j z => G (seed z) j)
        (fun i : Fin k => fun z => BitString.block (G (seed z)) (finTwoEquiv.symm (query z 0)) i)
        (fun _ => 4) fun i => by
          have hmux := Synthesis.mux (s := s ∪ Set.range fun j z => G (seed z) j)
            (Or.inl (hquery 0)) (Or.inr ⟨finProdFinEquiv (1, i), rfl⟩)
            (Or.inr ⟨finProdFinEquiv (0, i), rfl⟩)
          convert hmux using 2
          funext z
          cases query z 0 <;> rfl
      simpa [mul_comm] using h
    have h3 := ih
      (s := s ∪ Set.range fun i z => BitString.block (G (seed z)) (finTwoEquiv.symm (query z 0)) i)
      (fun z => BitString.block (G (seed z)) (finTwoEquiv.symm (query z 0)))
      (fun z => Fin.tail (query z))
      (fun i => Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩) (fun i => Or.inl (hquery i.succ))
    exact ((h1.trans h2).trans h3).mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.Subset.rfl (le_of_eq (by ring))

    (G : PRG.Generator (BitString k) (BitString (2 * k))) (n : ℕ) (seed : BitString k) :
    complexity interpretation (single (booleanFamily G n seed)) ≤
      n * (complexity interpretation ⇑G + 4 * k) + 2 := by

    (fun _ => seed) id (fun i => by cases seed i <;> simp) (fun i => Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  exact (hconst.trans h).mono Set.Subset.rfl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨0, rfl⟩)

private theorem complexity_slice_le (G : PRG.Generator (BitString k) (BitString (2 * k)))
    (D : BitString (2 ^ n) → Bool) (h : j + 1 + m = n)
    (c : BitString j → BitString (2 * k)) (q : BitString j) :
    complexity interpretation (single fun y => D (truthTable n fun x =>
        leaves G (j + 1) m h (reshape (update c q y)) x 0)) ≤
      2 ^ n * (m * complexity interpretation ⇑G + 1) + complexity interpretation (single D) := by
  refine (complexity_comp_le (fun y => truthTable n fun x =>
    leaves G (j + 1) m h (reshape (update c q y)) x 0) (single D)).trans
    (Nat.add_le_add_right ?_ _)
  refine (complexity_pi_le (I := interpretation) fun i y => truthTable n (fun x =>
    leaves G (j + 1) m h (reshape (update c q y)) x 0) i).trans ?_
  refine (sum_le_sum (g := fun _ => m * complexity interpretation ⇑G + 1) fun i _ => ?_).trans_eq
    (by simp)
  -- the bit of the truth table at the input `x`
  set x := (BitString.equivFin n).symm i
  set p : BitString (j + 1) := fun l => x ⟨l, by omega⟩
  by_cases hp : Fin.init p = q
  · have he : (fun y => truthTable n (fun x =>
        leaves G (j + 1) m h (reshape (update c q y)) x 0) i) =
        fun y => evalBits G (BitString.block y (finTwoEquiv.symm (p (Fin.last j))))
          (fun l : Fin m => x ⟨j + 1 + l, by omega⟩) 0 := by
      funext y
      simp only [truthTable_apply, leaves, reshape_apply]
      rw [← hp, update_self]
    rw [he]
    exact (complexity_evalBits_block_le G _ _ 0).trans (Nat.le_succ _)
  · have he : (fun y => truthTable n (fun x =>
        leaves G (j + 1) m h (reshape (update c q y)) x 0) i) =
        fun _ => evalBits G (BitString.block (c (Fin.init p)) (finTwoEquiv.symm (p (Fin.last j))))
          (fun l : Fin m => x ⟨j + 1 + l, by omega⟩) 0 := by
      funext y
      simp only [truthTable_apply, leaves, reshape_apply]
      rw [update_of_ne hp]
    rw [he]
    exact (Synthesis.const _).complexity_le.trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

theorem secure_truthTableGenerator_booleanFamily [NeZero k]
    {G : PRG.Generator (BitString k) (BitString (2 * k))} {t : ℕ} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (hG : G.Secure (IsCircuitTest (t + 2 ^ n * (n * complexity interpretation ⇑G + 1))) ε) :
    (truthTableGenerator (booleanFamily G n)).Secure (IsCircuitTest t) ((2 ^ n - 1) * ε) := by
  rintro _ ⟨D, hD, rfl⟩
  -- the hybrids at depths `j` and `n` differ by at most `(2 ^ n - 2 ^ j) ε`
  have htel (m : ℕ) : ∀ j (h : j + m = n),
      |hybridProb G D j m h - hybridProb G D n 0 (add_zero n)| ≤ (2 ^ n - 2 ^ j) * ε := by
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro j h
      subst h
      simp
    | succ m ih =>
      intro j h
      have hstep := abs_hybridProb_sub_le G D h (ε := ε) fun c q => by
        have hslice := complexity_slice_le G D (j := j) (m := m) (by omega) c q
        have hadv := hG (fun y => PMF.pure (D (truthTable n fun x =>
          leaves G (j + 1) m (by omega) (reshape (update c q y)) x 0)))
          ⟨_, hslice.trans (by rw [add_comm]; gcongr; omega), rfl⟩
        rwa [PRG.Generator.advantage, PRG.Generator.toReal_realExperiment_pure,
          PRG.Generator.toReal_idealExperiment_pure, ← Fintype.expect_boole,
          ← Fintype.expect_boole] at hadv
      calc _ ≤ |hybridProb G D j (m + 1) h - hybridProb G D (j + 1) m (by omega)| +
            |hybridProb G D (j + 1) m (by omega) - hybridProb G D n 0 (add_zero n)| :=
            abs_sub_le _ _ _
        _ ≤ 2 ^ j * ε + (2 ^ n - 2 ^ (j + 1)) * ε := add_le_add hstep (ih (j + 1) (by omega))
        _ = (2 ^ n - 2 ^ j) * ε := by ring
  have h := htel n 0 (zero_add n)
  rw [hybridProb_zero, hybridProb_self, pow_zero] at h
  rw [PRG.Generator.advantage, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_sub (one_le_pow₀ one_le_two),
    NNReal.coe_pow, NNReal.coe_ofNat, NNReal.coe_one]
  exact h

/-! ### Asymptotic security -/

/-- **The GGM family from a subexponentially secure generator is exponentially secure**
[GGM1986], [RazborovRudich1997, Section 4]. Let `G` be a family of length-doubling generators of
polynomial circuit complexity, subexponentially secure with exponent `1 / d`. With keys of length
`(n + 1) ^ (2 d + 1)`, the GGM functions on `n` inputs are pseudorandom against circuits of size
`2 ^ (c n)` with error `2 ^ (-c n)` for every `c` and all large `n`: the generator on these keys
resists circuits of size `2 ^ (n ^ 2)`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

theorem isExponentiallySecure_booleanFamily
    {G : ∀ k, PRG.Generator (BitString k) (BitString (2 * k))} {d : ℕ}
    (hsize : PolynomiallyBounded fun k => complexity interpretation ⇑(G k))
    (hG : PRG.IsSubexponentiallySecure G d) :
    IsExponentiallySecure fun n => booleanFamily (G ((n + 1) ^ (2 * d + 1))) n := by
  intro c
  -- the keys are eventually long enough for the security of the generator
  have hkey : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ m, m ^ d ≤ (n + 1) ^ (2 * d + 1) →
      (G ((n + 1) ^ (2 * d + 1))).Secure (IsCircuitTest (2 ^ m)) (2 ^ m)⁻¹ :=
    (tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n => (Nat.le_succ n).trans (Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) _))
      tendsto_id).eventually hG
  have hpoly : PolynomiallyBounded fun n =>
      n * complexity interpretation ⇑(G ((n + 1) ^ (2 * d + 1))) + 1 := by
    have := hsize.comp (g := fun n => (n + 1) ^ (2 * d + 1)) (by fun_prop)
    fun_prop
  filter_upwards [hkey, hpoly.eventually_lt_two_pow, eventually_ge_atTop (c + 3)] with n hG hn hc
  -- the generator resists circuits with `2 ^ (n ^ 2)` gates
  have hsec : (G ((n + 1) ^ (2 * d + 1))).Secure (IsCircuitTest (2 ^ (n ^ 2))) (2 ^ (n ^ 2))⁻¹ :=
    hG _ (by
      rw [← pow_mul]
      exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_succ n) _).trans
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) (Nat.le_succ _)))
  -- which exceeds the size of the reduction
  have hsize : 2 ^ (c * n) +
      2 ^ n * (n * complexity interpretation ⇑(G ((n + 1) ^ (2 * d + 1))) + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (n ^ 2) := by
    have h1 : 2 ^ (c * n) ≤ 2 ^ ((c + 3) * n - 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos (by
      rw [add_mul]; omega)
    have h2 : 2 ^ n * (n * complexity interpretation ⇑(G ((n + 1) ^ (2 * d + 1))) + 1) ≤
        2 ^ ((c + 3) * n - 1) := by
      calc _ ≤ 2 ^ n * 2 ^ n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hn.le
        _ = 2 ^ (2 * n) := by rw [← pow_add, two_mul]
        _ ≤ _ := Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos (by rw [add_mul]; omega)
    calc _ ≤ 2 * 2 ^ ((c + 3) * n - 1) := by omega
      _ = 2 ^ ((c + 3) * n) := by
          rw [← pow_succ']
          congr 1
          have : 1 ≤ (c + 3) * n := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega))
          omega
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (n ^ 2) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos (by rw [sq]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hc)
  refine (secure_truthTableGenerator_booleanFamily ((hsec.of_admissible fun A ⟨test, htest, hA⟩ =>
    ⟨test, htest.trans hsize, hA⟩))).mono ?_
  -- and the loss `2 ^ n` in the advantage is absorbed
  have hpow : (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ n * 2 ^ (c * n) ≤ 2 ^ (n ^ 2) := by
    rw [← pow_add]
    exact pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two (by rw [sq]; nlinarith)
  calc ((2 : ℝ≥0) ^ n - 1) * (2 ^ (n ^ 2))⁻¹ ≤ 2 ^ n * (2 ^ n * 2 ^ (c * n))⁻¹ := by
        gcongr
        exact tsub_le_self
    _ = (2 ^ (c * n))⁻¹ := by
        rw [mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity), one_mul]

theorem isPPTOn_hybridGame {generator : List Bool → List Bool}
    (hgenerator : ComputableInPolyTime generator encBits encBits)
    {adversary : OracleDistinguisher} (hadversary : IsOraclePPT encBool adversary) :
    IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary encUnary) encBool
      (fun pair => hybridGame generator adversary pair.1 pair.2) := by
  have hgenerator := hgenerator.tidy
  have hrun : IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary encUnary) (encPair encBool cacheEncoding)
      (fun pair : ℕ × ℕ => (OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin k))
          (fun request => frontierOracle generator pair.1 pair.2 request.2))
            (adversary pair.1 [])).run []) := by
    apply hadversary.run_interpret_preprocess
      (prepare := fun pair : ℕ × ℕ => (pair.1, []))
      (resources := fun pair query => 4 * query.length + 2 * pair.1 + 3)
      (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      (fun pair cache => ∀ entry ∈ cache, entry.2.length ≤ pair.1) (by simp) (by fun_prop)
    intro pair request cache hcache result hresult
    obtain ⟨hcache', hreply, hgrowth⟩ :=
      frontierOracle_bounds generator pair.1 pair.2 request.2 cache hcache result hresult
    exact ⟨hcache', by lia, by lia⟩
  exact hrun.map (ComputableInPolyTime.fst _ _)

theorem GGM.pseudorandomFunction_of_indistinguishable {generator : List Bool → List Bool}
    (hgenerator : ComputableInPolyTime generator encBits encBits)
    (hlength : ∀ seed, (generator seed).length = 2 * seed.length)
    (hsecure : ComputationallyIndistinguishable (generatorEnsemble generator)
      (fun n => BitString.uniformList (2 * n))) : PseudorandomFunction (GGM.eval generator) := by
  have hgenerator := hgenerator.tidy
  refine ⟨(Crypto.GGM.computableInPolyTime_eval (.of_tidy hgenerator)), fun key query _ =>
    length_eval (fun seed => by rw [hlength]) key query, ?_⟩
  intro adversary hadversary
  obtain ⟨c, d, hqueries⟩ := hadversary.query_bounds
  let count := fun n => c * (n + 2) ^ d
  have hcount : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime count encUnary encUnary := by
    unfold count
    polytime
  have hreduce := hsecure (reduction generator adversary count)
    (isPPT_reduction (.of_tidy hgenerator) hadversary (.of_tidy hcount))
  have hloss : PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => dyadicSize n * dyadicSize (count n)) := by
    have := hcount.polynomiallyBounded
    fun_prop
  apply negligible_of_le (hreduce.polynomiallyBounded_mul hloss)
  intro n
  have hquery : (adversary n []).IsQueryBounded (count n) := by
    simpa [count] using (hqueries n []).1
  have h := reduction_advantage generator adversary count n hquery
  simpa only [distinguishingGame, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_map,
    BitString.eval_sampleList,
    generatorEnsemble, Nat.cast_mul] using h.le

theorem PseudorandomGenerator.ggm {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {length : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hgenerator : PseudorandomGenerator generator length) (hdouble : ∀ n, 2 * n ≤ length n) :
    PseudorandomFunction (GGM.eval generator) := by
  have hpoly := hgenerator.polyTime.tidy
  have hsecure := hgenerator.indistinguishable.map
    (f := fun n word => word.take (2 * n)) (by polytime)
  have htruncated : ComputationallyIndistinguishable
      (generatorEnsemble (fun seed => (generator seed).take (2 * seed.length)))
      (fun n => BitString.uniformList (2 * n)) := by
    simpa only [← generatorEnsemble_postprocess generator (fun n word => word.take (2 * n)),
      BitString.uniformList_take (hdouble _)] using hsecure
  have h := GGM.pseudorandomFunction_of_indistinguishable
    (generator := fun seed => (generator seed).take (2 * seed.length)) (.of_tidy (by polytime))
    (fun seed => by simp [hgenerator.length_eq, Nat.min_eq_left (hdouble _)]) htruncated
  simpa only [GGM.eval_truncate] using h

/-- Every uniform pseudorandom generator yields a uniform adaptive pseudorandom function.
Truncate to one extra bit, amplify to two labels plus one bit, and apply GGM. -/

theorem PseudorandomGenerator.exists_pseudorandomFunction {generator : List Bool → List Bool}
    {length : ℕ → ℕ} (hgenerator : PseudorandomGenerator generator length) :
    ∃ family : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool, PseudorandomFunction family := by
  have hone := hgenerator.truncate (fun n => n + 1) (by polytime)
    (fun n => hgenerator.stretch n) (by intro n; lia)
  have htwo := hone.amplify (fun n => 2 * n + 1) (by polytime) (by intro n; lia)
  exact ⟨_, htwo.ggm (by intro n; lia)⟩
