theorem isPPTOn_runTwoRound {α Caller : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {input : Caller ↪ List Bool}
    {Vstar : ℕ → α → List Bool → WordOracleComp Unit (List Bool)}
    {prepare : Caller → ℕ × α × List Bool}
    {reply1 reply2 : Caller × List Bool → List Bool}
    {bound : Caller → ℕ}
    (hV : IsOraclePPTOn (encPair encUnary (encPair enc encBits)) encBits
      (fun p => Vstar p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (hprep : ComputableInPolyTime prepare input (encPair encUnary (encPair enc encBits)))
    (hr1 : ComputableInPolyTime reply1 (encPair input encBits) encBits)
    (hr2 : ComputableInPolyTime reply2 (encPair input encBits) encBits)
    (hbound : ComputableInPolyTime bound input encUnary)
    (hle1 : ∀ c q, (reply1 (c, q)).length ≤ bound c)
    (hle2 : ∀ c q, (reply2 (c, q)).length ≤ bound c) :
    IsPPTOn input (encPair encBits (encPair encUnary encBits))
      (fun c => runTwoRound (fun q => reply1 (c, q)) (fun q => reply2 (c, q))
        (Vstar (prepare c).1 (prepare c).2.1 (prepare c).2.2) (0, [false, false, false])) := by
  have hprep := hprep.tidy
  have hr1 := hr1.tidy
  have hr2 := hr2.tidy
  have hbound := hbound.tidy
  let stateEncoding : ℕ × List Bool ↪ List Bool := encPair encUnary encBits
  have hlen_state : ∀ s : ℕ × List Bool, s.1 ≤ 2 → s.2.length = 3 →
      (stateEncoding s).length ≤ 9 := by
    intro s hs1 hs2
    simp only [stateEncoding, length_encPair, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate,
      encBits_apply, hs2]
    omega
  refine hV.run_interpret_preprocess (stateEncoding := stateEncoding)
    (handler := fun c q s =>
      pure (twoRoundStep (fun x => reply1 (c, x)) (fun x => reply2 (c, x)) q.2 s))
    (prepare := prepare)
    (initial := fun _ => (0, [false, false, false]))
    (resources := fun c _ => bound c + 9)
    hprep
    (by dsimp only [twoRoundStep, stateEncoding]; fun_prop)
    (by dsimp only [stateEncoding]; fun_prop)
    (fun _ s => s.1 ≤ 2 ∧ s.2.length = 3)
    (fun _ => ⟨by omega, rfl⟩)
    (by fun_prop)
    (fun c request state hstate result hresult => ?_)
  simp only [ProbComp.eval_pure, PMF.support_pure, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hresult
  subst hresult
  dsimp only [twoRoundStep]
  split_ifs with h0 h1
  · dsimp only
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, hstate.2⟩, (hle1 c request.2).trans (by omega), ?_⟩
    exact (hlen_state (1, state.2) (by omega) hstate.2).trans (by omega)
  · dsimp only
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, BitString.length_listRow 3 0 request.2⟩,
      (hle2 c _).trans (by omega), ?_⟩
    exact (hlen_state (2, BitString.listRow 3 0 request.2)
      (by omega) (BitString.length_listRow 3 0 request.2)).trans (by omega)
  · dsimp only
    refine ⟨hstate, by simp, ?_⟩
    exact (hlen_state state hstate.1 hstate.2).trans (by omega)

private theorem eval_game1_eq_eval_gmwSimAttempt (generator : List Bool → List Bool) {s m : ℕ}
    {φ : CNF ℕ} {w : List Bool} (hw : ThreeSAT.verifier (φ, w) = true)
    (prog : WordOracleComp Unit (List Bool)) :
    ProbComp.eval (gmwRealUniformPads generator s m φ w prog) =
      ProbComp.eval (gmwSimAttempt generator s m φ prog) := by
  rw [gmwRealUniformPads, eval_bind_gameWithPads, gmwSimAttempt, eval_bind_gmwSimWithPads]
  let simCont (ch_guess r₀ r₁ r₂ : List Bool) : PMF (List Bool) :=
    let sbits := simBits φ ch_guess r₀ r₁ r₂; let sflags := allOpenFlags φ ch_guess sbits
    ProbComp.eval (do
      let seeds ← OracleComp.replicate (totalLen φ) (BitString.sampleList s)
      let pads ← OracleComp.replicate (totalLen φ) (BitString.sampleList m)
      let p ← runTwoRound (fun r => proverReply1 generator m r sflags sbits seeds pads)
        (fun _ => proverReply2 s φ ch_guess sbits seeds) prog (0, [false, false, false])
      return if p.2.2 == ch_guess then true :: p.1 else [])
  have hinner (ch_guess m₀ m₁ m₂ : List Bool) :
      ProbComp.eval (do
        let bits := realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂; let openFlags := allOpenFlags φ ch_guess bits
        let seeds ← OracleComp.replicate (totalLen φ) (BitString.sampleList s)
        let pads ← OracleComp.replicate (totalLen φ) (BitString.sampleList m)
        let p ← runTwoRound (fun r => proverReply1 generator m r openFlags bits seeds pads)
          (fun _ => proverReply2 s φ ch_guess bits seeds) prog (0, [false, false, false])
        return if p.2.2 == ch_guess then true :: p.1 else []) =
      simCont ch_guess
        (if ch_guess.getD 0 false then BitString.listXor φ.vars.length [w, m₀] else m₀)
        (if ch_guess.getD 1 false then BitString.listXor φ.vars.length [w, m₁] else m₁)
        (if ch_guess.getD 2 false then BitString.listXor φ.vars.length [w, m₂] else m₂) := by
    let bits := realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂; let openFlags := allOpenFlags φ ch_guess bits
    let r₀ := if ch_guess.getD 0 false then BitString.listXor φ.vars.length [w, m₀] else m₀
    let r₁ := if ch_guess.getD 1 false then BitString.listXor φ.vars.length [w, m₁] else m₁
    let r₂ := if ch_guess.getD 2 false then BitString.listXor φ.vars.length [w, m₂] else m₂
    let sbits := simBits φ ch_guess r₀ r₁ r₂
    have hbits_len : bits.length = totalLen φ := length_realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂
    have hsbits_len : sbits.length = totalLen φ := length_simBits φ ch_guess r₀ r₁ r₂
    have hmask : naorMaskBits openFlags bits = sbits := naorMaskBits_realBits ch_guess hw
    have hflags : openFlags = allOpenFlags φ ch_guess sbits :=
      allOpenFlags_realBits φ ch_guess w m₀ m₁ m₂
    have hrep2 (seeds : List (List Bool)) :
        proverReply2 s φ ch_guess bits seeds = proverReply2 s φ ch_guess sbits seeds := by
      simp only [proverReply2]
      change naorMaskBits openFlags bits ++ (naorSelectSeeds s openFlags bits seeds).flatten =
        naorMaskBits (allOpenFlags φ ch_guess sbits) sbits ++
          (naorSelectSeeds s (allOpenFlags φ ch_guess sbits) sbits seeds).flatten
      rw [hmask, naorMaskBits_simBits, hflags,
        naorSelectSeeds_congr_length s _ bits sbits seeds (hbits_len.trans hsbits_len.symm)]
    dsimp only [simCont]; simp only [ProbComp.eval_bind]; congr 1; funext seeds
    have hpad := eval_pads_runTwoRound_mask generator s m φ ch_guess openFlags bits seeds prog
    rw [hbits_len] at hpad
    have hpad_rhs :
        ProbComp.eval (do
          let pads ← OracleComp.replicate (totalLen φ) (BitString.sampleList m)
          let p ← runTwoRound
            (fun r => proverReply1 generator m r openFlags (naorMaskBits openFlags bits) seeds pads)
            (fun _ => proverReply2 s φ ch_guess bits seeds) prog (0, [false, false, false])
          return if p.2.2 == ch_guess then true :: p.1 else []) =
        ProbComp.eval (do
          let pads ← OracleComp.replicate (totalLen φ) (BitString.sampleList m)
          let p ← runTwoRound
            (fun r => proverReply1 generator m r (allOpenFlags φ ch_guess sbits) sbits seeds pads)
            (fun _ => proverReply2 s φ ch_guess sbits seeds) prog (0, [false, false, false])
          return if p.2.2 == ch_guess then true :: p.1 else []) := by
      rw [hmask, hflags, hrep2 seeds]
    simpa only [ProbComp.eval_bind] using hpad.trans hpad_rhs
  simp only [ProbComp.eval_bind, BitString.eval_sampleList, hinner]; congr 1; funext ch_guess
  simpa only [simCont, ProbComp.eval_bind] using
    uniformList_bind_ite_listXor_three φ.vars.length

theorem gmwView_advantage_le {α : Type} (generator : List Bool → List Bool)
    (length : ℕ → ℕ) (f : α → CNF ℕ)
    (Vstar : ℕ → α → List Bool → WordOracleComp Unit (List Bool))
    (adversary : ℕ → α → List Bool → List Bool → ProbComp Bool)
    (n : ℕ) (a : α) (w z : List Bool) (hw : ThreeSAT.verifier (f a, w) = true) :
    Game.advantage
        (distinguishingGame
          (((gmwProver generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f a) w).run (Vstar n a z)
            (gmwProver generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f a) w).init).map Prod.fst)
          (adversary n a z))
        (distinguishingGame
          (ProbComp.eval (gmwSimulator generator length f Vstar n a z)) (adversary n a z)) ≤
      (7 / 8 : ℝ≥0) ^ (n + 1) +
        (dyadicSize (n + 1) : ℝ≥0) * (dyadicSize (totalLen (f a)) : ℝ≥0) *
          Game.advantage
            (ProbComp.eval ((generator <$> BitString.sampleList (n + 7)) >>=
              gmwViewReduction generator length f Vstar adversary n a w z))
            (ProbComp.eval (BitString.sampleList (length (n + 7)) >>=
              gmwViewReduction generator length f Vstar adversary n a w z)) := by
  let real := ((gmwProver generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f a) w).run (Vstar n a z)
    (gmwProver generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f a) w).init).map Prod.fst
  let guess := ProbComp.eval (gmwFirstSuccess <$> OracleComp.replicate (n + 1)
    (game0 generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f a) w (Vstar n a z)))
  let sim := ProbComp.eval (gmwSimulator generator length f Vstar n a z)
  have hguess : Game.advantage (distinguishingGame real (adversary n a z))
      (distinguishingGame guess (adversary n a z)) ≤ (7 / 8 : ℝ≥0) ^ (n + 1) := by
    rw [Game.advantage_comm]
    dsimp only [guess]
    rw [eval_gmwFirstSuccess_replicate_eq_repeatAttempt
      (eval_game0_eq_bind_bernoulliAttempt generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7))
        (f a) w (Vstar n a z)) (n + 1)]
    exact advantage_repeatAttempt_le real (adversary n a z) (n + 1)
  have htest (g : ProbComp (List Bool)) :
      distinguishingGame (ProbComp.eval (gmwFirstSuccess <$> OracleComp.replicate (n + 1) g))
        (adversary n a z) =
      ProbComp.eval (OracleComp.replicate (n + 1) g >>=
        fun attempts => adversary n a z (gmwFirstSuccess attempts)) := by
    simp only [distinguishingGame, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, ProbComp.eval_map, ProbComp.eval_bind,
      PMF.bind_map,
      Function.comp_def]
  have hzero : ProbComp.eval (gmwFirstSuccess <$> OracleComp.replicate (n + 1)
      (gmwRealPRGPads generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f a) w (Vstar n a z))) = guess := by
    simp only [guess, ProbComp.eval_map,
      ProbComp.eval_replicate_congr (eval_game0Pads_eq_eval_game0 generator (n + 7)
        (length (n + 7)) (f a) w (Vstar n a z))]
  have hone : ProbComp.eval (gmwFirstSuccess <$> OracleComp.replicate (n + 1)
      (gmwRealUniformPads generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f a) w (Vstar n a z))) = sim := by
    simp only [sim, gmwSimulator, ProbComp.eval_map,
      ProbComp.eval_replicate_congr
        (eval_game1_eq_eval_gmwSimAttempt generator hw (Vstar n a z))]
  have hgap := gmwViewReduction_advantage generator length f Vstar adversary n a w z
  rw [← htest, ← htest, hzero, hone] at hgap
  exact (Game.advantage_triangle (distinguishingGame real (adversary n a z))
    (distinguishingGame guess (adversary n a z))
    (distinguishingGame sim (adversary n a z))).trans (add_le_add hguess hgap.le)

theorem gmwView_negligible_of_advice_prg {α : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool}
    {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {length : ℕ → ℕ} {f : α → CNF ℕ}
    {Vstar : ℕ → α → List Bool → WordOracleComp Unit (List Bool)}
    {adversary : ℕ → α → List Bool → List Bool → ProbComp Bool}
    (hg : ComputableInPolyTime generator encBits encBits)
    (hlen : ∀ s, (generator s).length = length s.length)
    (hf : ComputableInPolyTime f enc encCNF)
    (hV : IsOraclePPTOn (encPair encUnary (encPair enc encBits)) encBits
      (fun p => Vstar p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (hadv : IsPPTOn (encPair (encPair encUnary (encPair enc encBits)) encBits) encBool
      (fun p => adversary p.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.1.2.2 p.2))
    (hPRG : ∀ test : (ℕ × (α × (List Bool × List Bool))) × List Bool → ProbComp Bool,
      IsPPTOn
        (encPair (encPair encUnary (encPair enc (encPair encBits encBits))) encBits)
        encBool test →
      ∀ (a : ℕ → α) (w z : ℕ → List Bool),
        PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => (enc (a n)).length) →
        PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => (w n).length) →
        PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => (z n).length) →
        Negligible (fun n => Game.advantage
          (ProbComp.eval ((generator <$> BitString.sampleList (n + 7)) >>=
            fun challenge => test ((n, a n, w n, z n), challenge)))
          (ProbComp.eval (BitString.sampleList (length (n + 7)) >>=
            fun challenge => test ((n, a n, w n, z n), challenge)))))
    {a : ℕ → α} {w z : ℕ → List Bool}
    (ha : PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => (enc (a n)).length))
    (hw : PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => (w n).length))
    (hz : PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => (z n).length))
    (hw_sat : ∀ n, ThreeSAT.verifier (f (a n), w n) = true) :
    Negligible (fun n => Game.advantage
      (distinguishingGame
        (((gmwProver generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f (a n)) (w n)).run
          (Vstar n (a n) (z n))
          (gmwProver generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f (a n)) (w n)).init).map Prod.fst)
        (adversary n (a n) (z n)))
      (distinguishingGame (ProbComp.eval (gmwSimulator generator length f Vstar n (a n) (z n)))
        (adversary n (a n) (z n)))) := by
  have hg := hg.tidy
  have hf := hf.tidy
  have hclock := isPPTOn_gmwViewReduction (.of_tidy hg) hlen (.of_tidy hf) hV hadv
  have hneg := hPRG
    (fun p => gmwViewReduction generator length f Vstar adversary
      p.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.1.2.2.1 p.1.2.2.2 p.2) hclock a w z ha hw hz
  have hcount : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => totalLen (f a)) enc encUnary :=
    (computableInPolyTime_totalLen (.of_tidy hf)).tidy
  have hsize : PolyBounded id (fun n => (enc (a n)).length) :=
    ⟨_, ha, fun _ => le_rfl⟩
  have hcount_poly := (hcount.polyBounded.comp hsize).polynomiallyBounded
  have hloss : PolynomiallyBounded
      (fun n => dyadicSize (n + 1) * dyadicSize (totalLen (f (a n)))) := by fun_prop
  have herr := (negligible_geometric (by norm_num : (7 / 8 : ℝ≥0) < 1)).shift 1
  apply negligible_of_le (herr.add_fun (hneg.polynomiallyBounded_mul hloss))
  intro n
  simpa only [Nat.cast_mul] using
    gmwView_advantage_le generator length f Vstar adversary n (a n) (w n) (z n) (hw_sat n)

theorem gmwView_indistinguishable_gmwSimulator {α : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool}
    {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {length : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hG : PseudorandomGenerator generator length)
    {f : α → CNF ℕ} (hf : ComputableInPolyTime f enc encCNF)
    {Vstar : ℕ → α → List Bool → WordOracleComp Unit (List Bool)}
    (hV : IsOraclePPTOn (encPair encUnary (encPair enc encBits)) encBits
      (fun p => Vstar p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    {a : ℕ → α} {w z : ℕ → List Bool}
    (ha : ComputableInPolyTime a encUnary enc)
    (hw_comp : ComputableInPolyTime w encUnary encBits)
    (hz : ComputableInPolyTime z encUnary encBits)
    (hw_sat : ∀ n, ThreeSAT.verifier (f (a n), w n) = true) :
    ComputationallyIndistinguishable
      (fun n => ((gmwProver generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f (a n)) (w n)).run
        (Vstar n (a n) (z n))
        (gmwProver generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f (a n)) (w n)).init).map Prod.fst)
      (fun n => ProbComp.eval (gmwSimulator generator length f Vstar n (a n) (z n))) := by
  have hf := hf.tidy
  have ha := ha.tidy
  have hw_comp := hw_comp.tidy
  have hz := hz.tidy
  intro adversary hadversary
  have htest : IsPPTOn (encPair (encPair encUnary (encPair enc encBits)) encBits) encBool
      (fun p => adversary p.1.1 p.2) :=
    hadversary.preprocess (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have hclock := isPPTOn_gmwViewReduction
    (adversary := fun n _ _ view => adversary n view) hG.polyTime hG.length_eq (.of_tidy hf) hV
      htest
  let red : Distinguisher := fun n challenge =>
    gmwViewReduction generator length f Vstar (fun n _ _ view => adversary n view)
      n (a n) (w n) (z n) challenge
  have hred : IsPPT encBool red := by
    exact hclock.preprocess
      (input := encPair encUnary encBits)
      (prepare := fun p => ((p.1, a p.1, w p.1, z p.1), p.2)) (by fun_prop)
  have hneg := (hG.indistinguishable.shift 7) red hred
  have hcount : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun n => totalLen (f (a n)))
      encUnary encUnary :=
    (computableInPolyTime_totalLen (.of_tidy hf)).tidy.comp ha
  have hcount_poly := hcount.polynomiallyBounded
  have hloss : PolynomiallyBounded
      (fun n => dyadicSize (n + 1) * dyadicSize (totalLen (f (a n)))) := by fun_prop
  have herr := (negligible_geometric (by norm_num : (7 / 8 : ℝ≥0) < 1)).shift 1
  apply negligible_of_le (herr.add_fun (hneg.polynomiallyBounded_mul hloss))
  intro n
  simpa only [distinguishingGame, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_map,
    BitString.eval_sampleList, generatorEnsemble, Nat.cast_mul, red] using
    gmwView_advantage_le generator length f Vstar (fun n _ _ view => adversary n view)
      n (a n) (w n) (z n) (hw_sat n)

private theorem verifyTranscript_honest {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {s m : ℕ}
    {φ : CNF ℕ} {w m₀ m₁ m₂ r ch : List Bool} {seeds : List (List Bool)}
    (hw : ThreeSAT.verifier (φ, w) = true) (hseeds : seeds.length = totalLen φ)
    (hseed_len : ∀ seed ∈ seeds, seed.length = s)
    (hgen_len : ∀ seed ∈ seeds, (generator seed).length = m) :
    verifyTranscript generator s m φ r
      (proverReply1 generator m r (List.replicate (totalLen φ) true)
        (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂) seeds []) ch
      (proverReply2 s φ ch (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂) seeds) = true := by
  let K := totalLen φ; let bits := realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂
  have hbits_len : bits.length = K := length_realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂
  let flags := allOpenFlags φ ch bits
  have hmask_len :
      (naorMaskBits (allOpenFlags φ ch (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂))
        (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂)).length = totalLen φ := by simp
  have htake : (proverReply2 s φ ch (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂) seeds).take (totalLen φ) =
      naorMaskBits (allOpenFlags φ ch (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂)) (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂) := by
    simp [proverReply2, List.take_left' hmask_len]
  have hdrop : (proverReply2 s φ ch (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂) seeds).drop (totalLen φ) =
      (naorSelectSeeds s (allOpenFlags φ ch (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂))
        (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂) seeds).flatten := by
    simp [proverReply2, List.drop_left' hmask_len]
  have hmask_eq := naorMaskBits_realBits (m₀ := m₀) (m₁ := m₁) (m₂ := m₂) ch hw
  have hflags_eq : allOpenFlags φ ch (naorMaskBits (allOpenFlags φ ch (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂))
        (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂)) = allOpenFlags φ ch (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂) := by
    rw [hmask_eq]; exact (allOpenFlags_realBits φ ch w m₀ m₁ m₂).symm
  have h3sat : (φ.all fun c => decide (c.length ≤ 3)) = true :=
    (Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mp hw |>.1
  dsimp only [verifyTranscript]; rw [htake, hdrop, hflags_eq, h3sat]
  have hcopy :
      verifyCopyBits φ (ch.getD 0 false) (gmwCopy0 φ (naorMaskBits flags bits)) = true ∧
      verifyCopyBits φ (ch.getD 1 false) (gmwCopy1 φ (naorMaskBits flags bits)) = true ∧
      verifyCopyBits φ (ch.getD 2 false) (gmwCopy2 φ (naorMaskBits flags bits)) = true := by
    dsimp only [flags, bits]; rw [hmask_eq]
    simp [gmwCopy0_simBits, gmwCopy1_simBits, gmwCopy2_simBits, verifyCopyBits_simCopyBits]
  change (true &&
      verifyCopyBits φ (ch.getD 0 false) (gmwCopy0 φ (naorMaskBits flags bits)) &&
      verifyCopyBits φ (ch.getD 1 false) (gmwCopy1 φ (naorMaskBits flags bits)) &&
      verifyCopyBits φ (ch.getD 2 false) (gmwCopy2 φ (naorMaskBits flags bits)) &&
      verifyCommitments generator s m φ r flags
        (proverReply1 generator m r (List.replicate K true) bits seeds [])
        (naorMaskBits flags bits) (naorSelectSeeds s flags bits seeds).flatten) = true
  simp only [hcopy.1, hcopy.2.1, hcopy.2.2, Bool.true_and, verifyCommitments, List.all_eq_true,
    List.mem_range, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true', beq_iff_eq]
  intro i hi
  by_cases hfi : flags.getD i false = true
  · right
    have hbit_i : (naorMaskBits flags bits).getD i false = bits.getD i false := by
      rw [getD_naorMaskBits, hfi, Bool.true_and]
    have hi_bits : i < bits.length := hbits_len ▸ hi
    have hi_seeds : i < seeds.length := hseeds ▸ hi
    have hseed_mem : seeds.getD i [] ∈ seeds := by
      simp [List.getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi_seeds]
    have hseed_i : BitString.listRow s i (naorSelectSeeds s flags bits seeds).flatten =
        seeds.getD i [] := by
      rw [BitString.listRow_flatten (fun w hw => length_mem_naorSelectSeeds hw) (by simp [hi_bits]),
        getD_naorSelectSeeds s flags bits seeds i hi_bits, hfi]
      simp only [↓reduceIte, BitString.listRow, Nat.zero_mul, List.drop_zero,
        List.take_left' (hseed_len _ hseed_mem)]
    have hcommit_i : BitString.listRow m i
          (proverReply1 generator m r (List.replicate K true) bits seeds []) =
        naorCommit generator (BitString.listRow m 0 r) (bits.getD i false) (seeds.getD i []) := by
      have hmem := length_mem_naorCommitSplit_true
        (r := BitString.listRow m 0 r) (hseeds.trans hbits_len.symm) hgen_len
      rw [← hbits_len, proverReply1_true_eq_flatten r (hseeds.trans hbits_len.symm) hgen_len,
        BitString.listRow_flatten hmem (by simp [hi_bits]),
        getD_naorCommitSplit _ _ _ _ _ _ i hi_bits]
      have hrep : (List.replicate bits.length true).getD i false = true := by
        simp [List.getD, hi_bits]
      rw [hrep, naorCommitAt_true]
    rw [hbit_i, hseed_i, hcommit_i]
  · left; exact Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hfi

theorem acceptProb_gmwVerifier_gmwProver {α : Type} {generator : List Bool → List Bool}
    {length : ℕ → ℕ} (hlen : ∀ seed, (generator seed).length = length seed.length)
    (f : α → CNF ℕ) (n : ℕ) (a : α) {w : List Bool}
    (hw : ThreeSAT.verifier (f a, w) = true) :
    acceptProb (gmwVerifier generator length f n a)
      (gmwProver generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f a) w) = 1 := by
  let φ := f a; let s := n + 7; let m := length s; let K := totalLen φ
  rw [acceptProb, run_gmwProver_fst]
  let prog : ProbComp Bool := do
    let coins ← sampleHonestCoins s φ w
    Prod.fst <$> runTwoRound (honestReply1 generator m φ coins)
      (honestReply2 s φ coins) (gmwVerifier generator length f n a) (0, [false, false, false])
  change ProbComp.eval prog true = 1
  have hfalse : ProbComp.eval prog false = 0 := by
    rw [PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff]
    intro hmem
    simp only [prog, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_map, PMF.mem_support_bind_iff,
      PMF.mem_support_map_iff] at hmem
    obtain ⟨coins, hcoins, ⟨b, finalState⟩, hrun, hfst⟩ := hmem
    simp only at hfst; subst hfst
    simp only [sampleHonestCoins, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure,
      BitString.eval_sampleList, PMF.mem_support_bind_iff, PMF.support_pure,
      Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hcoins
    obtain ⟨m₀, _, m₁, _, m₂, _, seeds, hseeds, rfl⟩ := hcoins
    simp only [gmwVerifier, runTwoRound_bind, runTwoRound_sample, runTwoRound_map,
      runTwoRound_query, runTwoRound_pure, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_map,
      ProbComp.eval_pure, BitString.eval_sampleList, PMF.mem_support_bind_iff,
      PMF.mem_support_map_iff, PMF.support_pure, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hrun
    obtain ⟨⟨r, s₁⟩, ⟨r', _, hr1⟩, ⟨commitReply, s₂⟩, ⟨⟨q1, s₁'⟩, hq1, hmap1⟩,
      ⟨ch, s₃⟩, ⟨ch', hch, hch1⟩, ⟨openReply, s₄⟩, ⟨⟨q2, s₃'⟩, hq2, hmap2⟩, hfinal⟩ := hrun
    cases hr1; cases hq1; cases hmap1; cases hch1; cases hq2; cases hmap2
    obtain ⟨hseeds_len, hseeds_mem⟩ := length_mem_support_replicate_sampleList hseeds
    have hch_len : ch.length = 3 := BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hch
    have hch_row : BitString.listRow 3 0 ch = ch := by
      simp [BitString.listRow, List.take_left' hch_len]
    have hgen_len : ∀ seed ∈ seeds, (generator seed).length = m := fun seed hseed => by
      rw [hlen, hseeds_mem seed hseed]
    have hr1_len :
        (honestReply1 generator m φ (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂, seeds) r).length = K * m := by
      simpa [honestReply1, K, length_realBits] using length_proverReply1_true (r := r)
        (hseeds_len.trans (length_realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂).symm) hgen_len
    have hr2_len :
        (honestReply2 s φ (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂, seeds) ch).length = K * (s + 1) := by
      simpa [honestReply2, K] using length_proverReply2 s φ seeds (length_realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂)
    have htake1 := List.take_of_length_le hr1_len.le
    have htake2 := List.take_of_length_le hr2_len.le
    have hfalse_eq := congrArg Prod.fst hfinal
    dsimp only at hfalse_eq
    change false = verifyTranscript generator s m φ r
        (List.take (K * m) (honestReply1 generator m φ (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂, seeds) r)) ch
        (List.take (K * (s + 1))
          (honestReply2 s φ (realBits φ w m₀ m₁ m₂, seeds) (BitString.listRow 3 0 ch))) at hfalse_eq
    rw [hch_row, htake1, htake2] at hfalse_eq
    exact Bool.false_ne_true (hfalse_eq.trans (verifyTranscript_honest (m₀ := m₀) (m₁ := m₁)
      (m₂ := m₂) (r := r) (ch := ch) hw hseeds_len hseeds_mem hgen_len))
  have hsum := PMF.tsum_coe (ProbComp.eval prog)
  rw [tsum_bool, hfalse, zero_add] at hsum
  exact hsum

theorem mem_ThreeSAT_of_verifyTranscript_ne
    {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {s m : ℕ} {φ : CNF ℕ}
    {r commitReply openReply₁ openReply₂ : List Bool} {x₁ x₂ : BitString 3}
    (hbind : NaorBinding generator s (BitString.listRow m 0 r))
    (hne : x₁ ≠ x₂)
    (hv₁ : verifyTranscript generator s m φ r commitReply (List.ofFn x₁) openReply₁ = true)
    (hv₂ : verifyTranscript generator s m φ r commitReply (List.ofFn x₂) openReply₂ = true) :
    φ ∈ ThreeSAT := by
  have hdiff :
      (List.ofFn x₁).getD 0 false ≠ (List.ofFn x₂).getD 0 false ∨
      (List.ofFn x₁).getD 1 false ≠ (List.ofFn x₂).getD 1 false ∨
      (List.ofFn x₁).getD 2 false ≠ (List.ofFn x₂).getD 2 false := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hne
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · simpa using h.1
    · simpa using h.2.1
    · simpa using h.2.2
  rcases hdiff with h0 | h1 | h2
  · cases h10 : (List.ofFn x₁).getD 0 false <;> cases h20 : (List.ofFn x₂).getD 0 false
    · exact False.elim (h0 (h10.trans h20.symm))
    · exact mem_ThreeSAT_of_verifyTranscript_false_true hbind hv₁ hv₂ (Or.inl ⟨h10, h20⟩)
    · exact mem_ThreeSAT_of_verifyTranscript_false_true hbind hv₂ hv₁ (Or.inl ⟨h20, h10⟩)
    · exact False.elim (h0 (h10.trans h20.symm))

        BitString.eval_sampleList, BitString.uniformList, PMF.bind_map, PMF.map_bind,
        PMF.bind_map, PMF.bind_apply, tsum_fintype]

        calc (1 / 8 : ℝ≥0∞) *
              ProbOracleComp.acceptProbWith P.respond (step3 r commitReply (List.ofFn x)) state₁

    fun s masks => score predictor x (Pi.single i 1 + ∑ j ∈ s, masks j)

    exact ⟨{⟨0, hk⟩}, by simp⟩

        (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString n)).toMeasure := by
      rw [PMF.toMeasure_map _ _ (measurable_of_countable _),
        query_uniform i s (mem_nonemptySubsets s |>.mp hs)]

    intro s hs t ht hst
    have hquery : IndepFun
        (fun masks : Fin k → BitString n => Pi.single i 1 + ∑ j ∈ s, masks j)
        (fun masks : Fin k → BitString n => Pi.single i 1 + ∑ j ∈ t, masks j) μ := by
      apply PMF.indepFun_of_map_pair _ _ _ (measurable_of_countable _) (measurable_of_countable _)
      rw [query_pair_uniform i s t (mem_nonemptySubsets s |>.mp hs)
          (mem_nonemptySubsets t |>.mp ht) hst,
        query_uniform i s (mem_nonemptySubsets s |>.mp hs),
        query_uniform i t (mem_nonemptySubsets t |>.mp ht),

    (hcircular : Encryption.CircularSecure E.keyGen E.encrypt)
    (hkeyGen : IsPPTOn encUnary (encPair encBits encBits) E.keyGen)

    Encryption.INDCPA (keyGen E) (encrypt E) := by

    ProbComp.eval (do

    (R : Matrix ι κ Bool) (error : κ → ℤ) (i : ι) :
    (encryptionError R error i).natAbs ≤ ∑ j, (error j).natAbs := by
  change (∑ j, ((R i j).toNat : ℤ) * error j).natAbs ≤ _
  refine (Int.natAbs_sum_le _ _).trans (sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)

theorem encryptionError_natAbs_le {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (R : Matrix ι κ Bool) (error : κ → ℤ) {bound : ℕ}
    (herror : ∀ j, (error j).natAbs ≤ bound) (i : ι) :
    (encryptionError R error i).natAbs ≤ Fintype.card κ * bound := by
  refine (encryptionError_natAbs_le_sum R error i).trans ?_
  simpa using sum_le_sum (s := univ) (fun j _ => herror j)

    (C₁ : Matrix ι ι Bool) (μ₂ : Bool) (error₁ error₂ : ι → ℤ)
    {bound₁ bound₂ : ℕ}
    (herror₁ : ∀ i, (error₁ i).natAbs ≤ bound₁)
    (herror₂ : ∀ i, (error₂ i).natAbs ≤ bound₂) (i : ι) :
    (nandError C₁ μ₂ error₁ error₂ i).natAbs ≤ bound₁ + Fintype.card ι * bound₂ := by
  refine (Int.natAbs_sub_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add ?_
    (encryptionError_natAbs_le C₁ error₂ herror₂ i))
  cases μ₂
  · simp
  · simpa using herror₁ i

        (fun k => keyGenSerialized (n k) (m k) (w k) (η k))

  simp only [Encryption.eval_game_eq_publicKeyGame, eval_keyGenSerialized_publicWord]
  exact (Encryption.advantage_publicKeyGame_le _ (LWE.uniformEnsemble n m w security)

open Filter in
/-- The actual encryption scheme is IND-CPA secure under its exact decision-LWE assumption,
provided efficient dimensions have an eventual entropy surplus of twice the security parameter. -/
theorem indCPA_of_decisionLWE {n m w η : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hn : ComputableInPolyTime n encUnary encUnary)
    (hm : ComputableInPolyTime m encUnary encUnary)
    (hw : ComputableInPolyTime w encUnary encUnary)
    (hmargin : ∀ᶠ security in atTop, (n security + 1) * w security + 2 * security ≤ m security)
    (hLWE : DecisionLWE n m w (fun k => noiseLaw (w k) (η k))) :
    Encryption.INDCPA (fun k => keyGenSerialized (n k) (m k) (w k) (η k))
      (fun k => encryptSerialized (n k) (m k) (w k)) := by
  have hn := hn.tidy
  have hm := hm.tidy
  have hw := hw.tidy
  intro adversary hadversary
  have hsource := hLWE (lweDistinguisher n m w adversary)
    (isPPT_lweDistinguisher (.of_tidy hn) (.of_tidy hm) (.of_tidy hw) hadversary)
  have hrows : PolynomiallyBounded (fun k => (n k + 1) * w k) := by
    have := hn.polynomiallyBounded
    have := hw.polynomiallyBounded
    fun_prop
  have herror := negligible_mul_sqrt_pow_two_div_pow_two hrows hmargin
  apply negligible_of_le
    ((hsource.polynomiallyBounded_mul (p := fun _ => 2) (by fun_prop)).add herror)
  exact advantage_game_le n m w η adversary

  have hsecret := hsecret.tidy

  have hterm : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : α × ℕ => Matrix.binaryEntry (n p.1 + 1) (w p.1) (ciphertext p.1)
        (w p.1 - 1) (p.2 + 1) * Matrix.binaryEntry (n p.1) (w p.1) (secret p.1) 0 p.2)
      (encPair input encUnary) encNat := by
    apply binary_mul'
    · exact matrixBinaryEntry (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
        (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    · exact matrixBinaryEntry (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)

    (hn : ComputableInPolyTime n input encUnary)

      input encBool :=

theorem publicKeyLinkHybrid_gap (n beforeCount afterCount width capacity : ℕ)
    (hwidth : ∀ keys ∈ (ProbComp.eval (E.keyGen n)).support, keys.2.length = width)
    (hcapacity : width ≤ capacity)
    (test : (List (List Bool) × List (List (List Bool))) → ProbComp Bool) :
    (Game.succProbability (ProbComp.eval
      (E.publicKeyChainHybrid n (beforeCount + afterCount + 1) (beforeCount + 1) >>= test)) : ℝ) -
      Game.succProbability (ProbComp.eval
        (E.publicKeyChainHybrid n (beforeCount + afterCount + 1) beforeCount >>= test)) =
      (dyadicSize capacity : ℝ) *
        (Game.succProbability ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (dyadicSize capacity))).bind
          (fun j => if j.val < width then ProbComp.eval
            (E.publicKeyLinkHybrid n beforeCount afterCount j.val >>= test) else PMF.pure false)) -
        Game.succProbability ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (dyadicSize capacity))).bind
          (fun j => if j.val < width then ProbComp.eval
            (E.publicKeyLinkHybrid n beforeCount afterCount (j.val + 1) >>= test)
            else PMF.pure false))) := by
  have h := Game.succProbability_hybrid_average
    (fun j => ProbComp.eval (E.publicKeyLinkHybrid n beforeCount afterCount j >>= test))
    width (dyadicSize capacity) (hcapacity.trans (lt_dyadicSize capacity).le)
  simpa only [ProbComp.eval_bind, E.eval_publicKeyLinkHybrid_zero,
    E.eval_publicKeyLinkHybrid_length n beforeCount afterCount width hwidth] using h

    (hE : E.Correct) (hwidth : E.FixedWidth secretWidth ciphertextWidth)
    (hboot : Scheme.Bootstrappable D)
    (hsecure : Encryption.INDCPA E.keyGen E.encrypt)
    (hkeyGen : IsPPTOn encUnary (encPair encBits encBits) E.keyGen)
    (hencrypt : IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBool)) encBits
      (fun p => E.encrypt p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (hevaluate : IsPPTOn
      (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits (encPair (Boolean.encCircuit 1) (encList encBits))))
      encBits (fun p => E.evaluate p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2))
    (hD : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun n => (⟨_, D.circuit n⟩ : Σ m, Circuit Boolean.signature m 1))
      encUnary (Boolean.encCircuit 1)) (hdepth : PolynomiallyBounded depth) :
    ∃ budget : ℕ → ℕ,
      ComputableInPolyTime budget encUnary encUnary ∧
      (∀ n, depth n ≤ budget n) ∧
      (scheme D budget).Correct ∧
      (∀ n c, c.2.depth ≤ depth n → (scheme D budget).permitted n c) ∧
      (scheme D budget).FixedWidth (fun n => 3 * secretWidth n + 1)
        (fun n => ciphertextWidth n + 1) ∧
      PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => 3 * secretWidth n + 1) ∧
      PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => ciphertextWidth n + 1) ∧
      IsPPTOn encUnary (encPair encBits encBits) (scheme D budget).keyGen ∧
      IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBool)) encBits
        (fun p => (scheme D budget).encrypt p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
      ComputableInPolyTime
        (fun p : ℕ × List Bool × List Bool => (scheme D budget).decrypt p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
        (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)) encBool ∧
      IsPPTOn
        (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits (encPair (Boolean.encCircuit 1) (encList encBits))))
        encBits (fun p => (scheme D budget).evaluate p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2) ∧
      Encryption.INDCPA (scheme D budget).keyGen (scheme D budget).encrypt := by

  let budget := fun n => coefficient * (n + 1) ^ degree

    dsimp only [budget]

    isPPTOn_scheme_keyGen hkeyGen hencrypt D budget (.of_tidy hbudget),
    isPPTOn_scheme_encrypt hencrypt D budget,
    computableInPolyTime_scheme_decrypt D hD budget,
    isPPTOn_scheme_evaluate hencrypt D hD hevaluate budget (.of_tidy hbudget),

    ∃ (time space : ℕ × List Bool × List Bool → ℕ) (bound : ℕ → ℕ),
      PolynomiallyBounded bound ∧
        (∀ budget : ℕ → ℕ, ComputableInTimeAndSpace
          (fun p : ℕ × List Bool × List Bool => (scheme D budget).decrypt p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
          (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)) encBool time space) ∧
        ∀ n (sk ciphertext : List Bool),
          sk.length = 3 * secretWidth n + 1 →
          ciphertext.length = ciphertextWidth n + 1 →
          time (n, sk, ciphertext) ≤ bound n ∧ space (n, sk, ciphertext) ≤ bound n := by

    computableInPolyTime_scheme_decrypt D hD (fun _ => 0)
  obtain ⟨ct, dt, ht⟩ := polynomiallyBounded_iff_le.mp ht
  obtain ⟨cs, ds, hs⟩ := polynomiallyBounded_iff_le.mp hs
  obtain ⟨hkey, hciphertext⟩ := polynomiallyBounded_widths D hD

    fun p => space ((encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)) p).length,
    bound, by dsimp [bound]; fun_prop, fun _ => hdecrypt, ?_⟩

theorem isPPTOn_publicKeyGame (bit : Bool) :
    IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary encPublicKey) encBool
      (fun p => publicKeyGame E adversary bit p.1 p.2) := by
  let baseEncoding := encPair encUnary encPublicKey
  let choiceEncoding := encPair (encPair encBool encBool) encBits
  have hn := ComputableInPolyTime.fst encUnary encPublicKey
  have hartifact := ComputableInPolyTime.snd encUnary encPublicKey
  have hpublic := ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd encUnary encPublicKey).encoded
  have hchoose := hadversary.choose.on.preprocess (hn.prod hpublic)
  have hfirst := (ComputableInPolyTime.listGetD (encA := encBits) []).comp
    (hartifact.fst'.prod (ComputableInPolyTime.const 0))
  have hencryptArg : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × (List (List Bool) × List (List (List Bool)))) ×
        ((Bool × Bool) × List Bool) =>
        (p.1.1, p.1.2.1.getD 0 [], if bit then p.2.1.2 else p.2.1.1))
      (encPair baseEncoding choiceEncoding) (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBool)) := by
    have houter := ComputableInPolyTime.fst baseEncoding choiceEncoding
    apply ComputableInPolyTime.prod (hn.comp houter)
    apply ComputableInPolyTime.prod (hfirst.comp houter)
    cases bit <;> dsimp only [baseEncoding, choiceEncoding, encPublicKey] <;> fun_prop
  have hcipher := hencrypt.preprocess hencryptArg
  have hguessArg : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : ((ℕ × (List (List Bool) × List (List (List Bool)))) ×
        ((Bool × Bool) × List Bool)) × List Bool =>
        (p.1.1.1, p.1.2.2, false :: p.2)) (encPair (encPair baseEncoding choiceEncoding) encBits)
      (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)) := by
    dsimp only [baseEncoding, choiceEncoding, encPublicKey]
    fun_prop
  have hlast := hadversary.guess.preprocess hguessArg
  have hbody := hcipher.bind_with
    (second := fun p ciphertext => adversary.guess p.1.1 p.2.2 (false :: ciphertext)) hlast
  simpa only [publicKeyGame, baseEncoding, choiceEncoding, Function.comp_def] using
    hchoose.bind_with (second := fun p choice => do
      let ciphertext ← E.encrypt p.1 (p.2.1.getD 0 [])

theorem EUFCMA.oneTimeEUFCMA {M : MACScheme} (h : M.EUFCMA) : M.OneTimeEUFCMA := by
  obtain ⟨ck, dk, hlenk⟩ := M.keyGen_ppt.length_le
  obtain ⟨cs, ds, hlens⟩ := M.sign_ppt.length_le
  let skBound (n : ℕ) : ℕ := ck * (n + 1) ^ dk
  let bound (n msgLen : ℕ) : ℕ := cs * (2 * skBound n + msgLen + 2) ^ ds
  have hbound_poly : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => bound p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encUnary encUnary) encUnary := by
    dsimp [bound, skBound]
    polytime
  apply OneTimeEUFCMA.of_negligible
  intro adversary hadversary
  have hred := h.negligible (SignatureScheme.limitToOneQuery bound adversary)
    (SignatureScheme.isOraclePPT_limitToOneQuery (.of_tidy hbound_poly) hadversary)
  refine hred.congr fun n => ?_
  congr 1
  simp only [eufOneTimeGame, eufCmaGame, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure]
  refine PMF.bind_congr_on_support _ _ _ fun sk hsk => ?_
  have hskLen_raw := hlenk n sk hsk
  simp only [encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate, encBits_apply] at hskLen_raw
  have htagBound : ∀ msg tag, tag ∈ (ProbComp.eval (M.sign sk msg)).support →
      tag.length ≤ bound n msg.length := by
    intro msg tag htag
    have h1 := hlens (sk, msg) tag htag
    simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply] at h1
    have h2 : 2 * sk.length + 1 + msg.length + 1 ≤ 2 * skBound n + msg.length + 2 := by
      dsimp [skBound]
      lia
    exact h1.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h2 ds))
  have hrun := run_limitToOneQuery_eq_oneTimeSigningOracle M bound n sk htagBound
    (adversary n [])
  have hmap : ((OracleComp.interpret
      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin k))
        (M.signingOracle sk))
      (SignatureScheme.limitToOneQuery bound adversary n [])).run []) =
    Prod.map Prod.fst id <$> ((OracleComp.interpret
      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin k))
        (M.signingOracle sk))
      ((OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler
          (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbOracleComp.sample (ProbComp.unifFin k)))
          (SignatureScheme.oneTimeFilterHandler bound (n, [])))
        (adversary n [])).run false)).run []) := by
    unfold SignatureScheme.limitToOneQuery
    rw [OracleComp.interpret_map, StateT.run_map]
    rfl
  rw [hmap]
  exact congrArg (fun p : PMF ((List Bool × List Bool) × List (List Bool)) =>
    p.bind fun x => PMF.pure
      ((x.1.1.length == M.msgLen n) && !x.2.contains x.1.1 && M.verify sk x.1.1 x.1.2)) hrun

noncomputable def prfMAC (family : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (hpoly : ComputableInPolyTime (fun pair : List Bool × List Bool => family pair.1 pair.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits) : MACScheme where
  keyGen n := BitString.sampleList n
  sign sk msg := pure (prfOracle family sk.length sk msg)
  verify sk msg tag := (msg.length == sk.length) && (family sk msg == tag)
  keyGen_ppt := by ppt
  sign_ppt := by
    have htidy := hpoly.tidy
    have hbody : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => prfOracle family p.1.length p.1 p.2)
        (encPair encBits encBits) encBits := by
      have heq : (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => prfOracle family p.1.length p.1 p.2) =
          (fun p : List Bool × List Bool =>
            if p.2.length == p.1.length then family p.1 p.2 else []) := by
        funext p
        simp [prfOracle]
      rw [heq]
      polytime
    exact hbody.isPPTOn
  verify_polyTime := by
    have htidy := hpoly.tidy
    have hcall : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun p : List Bool × List Bool × List Bool => family p.1 p.2.1)
        (encPair encBits (encPair encBits encBits)) encBits :=
      htidy.comp ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).prod
        ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd _ _)))
    exact .of_tidy (by polytime)
  verify_sign := by
    intro n sk hsk msg hmsg tag htag
    rw [BitString.eval_sampleList] at hsk
    have hskLen : sk.length = n := BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hsk
    simp only [ProbComp.eval_pure, PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at htag
    subst htag
    simp [prfOracle, hskLen, hmsg]

            (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle k))
              (fun request (u : Unit) => (PMF.pure (prfOracle family n sk request.2)).map (·, u)))

theorem eval_prfRealGame_macToPrfDistinguisher
    {family : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool}
    (hpoly : ComputableInPolyTime (fun pair : List Bool × List Bool => family pair.1 pair.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits)
    (hlen : ∀ key query, query.length = key.length → (family key query).length = key.length)
    (adversary : Forger) (n : ℕ) :
    ProbComp.eval (prfRealGame family (macToPrfDistinguisher adversary) n) =
      ProbComp.eval ((prfMAC family hpoly).eufCmaGame adversary n) := by
  simp only [prfRealGame, MACScheme.eufCmaGame, macToPrfDistinguisher,
    OracleComp.interpret_bind, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure]
  refine PMF.bind_congr_on_support _ _ _ fun sk hsk => ?_
  have hsk' : sk ∈ (ProbComp.eval (BitString.sampleList n)).support := hsk
  rw [BitString.eval_sampleList] at hsk'
  have hskLen : sk.length = n := BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hsk'
  rw [run_macLogHandler_eq_signingOracle hpoly hlen n sk hskLen (adversary n [])]
  refine PMF.bind_congr_on_support _ _ _ fun out _ => ?_
  dsimp only [prfMAC]
  by_cases hcond : ((out.1.1.length == n) && !out.2.contains out.1.1) = true
  · simp only [hcond, ↓reduceIte, Bool.true_and]
    have hmsgLen : out.1.1.length = n := by
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at hcond

    have hfamLen : (family sk out.1.1).length = n := by
      rw [← hskLen]
      exact hlen sk out.1.1 (hmsgLen.trans hskLen.symm)
    simp only [Functor.map_map, OracleComp.interpret_map,
      ProbOracleComp.interpret_query, ProbComp.eval_map, ProbComp.eval_pure, PMF.pure_map,
      prfOracle, hmsgLen, ↓reduceIte, List.take_of_length_le hfamLen.le, hskLen, beq_self_eq_true,
      Bool.true_and]

      Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hcond
    simp only [hcondF, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Bool.false_and,
      OracleComp.interpret_pure, ProbComp.eval_pure]

private theorem uniformOfFintype_bitString_beq_true_le (n : ℕ) (target : List Bool) :
    ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString n)).map (fun v => List.ofFn v == target)) true ≤
      (1 : ℝ≥0∞) / 2 ^ n := by
  have heq : (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString n)).map (fun v => List.ofFn v == target) =
      (BitString.uniformList n).map (· == target) := by
    simp [BitString.uniformList, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def]
  rw [heq, BitString.uniformList_map_apply]
  have hcard : (Finset.univ.filter fun r : Fin n → Bool =>
      (List.ofFn r == target) = true).card ≤ 1 := by
    refine Finset.card_le_one_iff.mpr fun {a b} ha hb => ?_
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, beq_iff_eq] at ha hb
    exact List.ofFn_injective (ha.trans hb.symm)
  exact ENNReal.div_le_div_right (by exact_mod_cast hcard) (2 ^ n)

/-- In the ideal random-function game, `macToPrfDistinguisher adversary` succeeds with probability
at most `1 / 2 ^ n`: any unqueried `n`-bit forgery message misses the lazy random-oracle cache and
draws a fresh uniform `n`-bit tag, matching the forger's candidate tag with probability at most
`1 / 2 ^ n`. -/

theorem succProbability_prfIdealGame_macToPrfDistinguisher_le (adversary : Forger) (n : ℕ) :
    Game.succProbability (ProbComp.eval (prfIdealGame (macToPrfDistinguisher adversary) n)) ≤
      (1 : ℝ≥0) / 2 ^ n := by
  classical
  rw [prfIdealGame_eq_lazy]
  let combinedOracle : Unit × List Bool →
      StateT (List (List Bool) × RandomOracle.Cache (fun _ : BitString n => BitString n))
        PMF (List Bool) :=
    fun q state =>
      ((OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle k))
          (fun request => lazyRandomFunctionOracle n request.2))
        ((macLogHandler n q).run state.1)).run state.2).map
          (fun result => (result.1.1, result.1.2, result.2))
  let phase1 := ((OracleComp.interpret
    (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle k)) combinedOracle)
    (adversary n [])).run ([], fun _ => none))
  let phase2 : ((List Bool × List Bool) × List (List Bool) ×
      RandomOracle.Cache (fun _ : BitString n => BitString n)) → PMF Bool :=
    fun ⟨out, queried, cache⟩ =>
      if (out.1.length == n) && !queried.contains out.1 then
        ((OracleComp.interpret
          (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle k))
            (fun request => lazyRandomFunctionOracle n request.2))
          ((· == out.2) <$> (List.take n <$> ProbOracleComp.query ((), out.1)))).run cache).map
            Prod.fst
      else
        PMF.pure false
  have hgame : ((OracleComp.interpret
      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle k))
        (fun request => lazyRandomFunctionOracle n request.2))
      (macToPrfDistinguisher adversary n [])).run (fun _ => none)).map Prod.fst =
      phase1.bind phase2 := by
    dsimp only [macToPrfDistinguisher, phase1, phase2, combinedOracle]
    simp only [OracleComp.interpret_bind, StateT.run_bind, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.map_bind,
      ProbOracleComp.run_interpret_run_interpret, PMF.bind_map, Function.comp_def]
    refine PMF.bind_congr_on_support _ _ _ fun ⟨out, queried, cache⟩ _ => ?_
    by_cases hcond : ((out.1.length == n) && !queried.contains out.1) = true
    · simp only [hcond, ↓reduceIte]
    · have hcondF : ((out.1.length == n) && !queried.contains out.1) = false :=
        Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hcond
      simp only [hcondF, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, OracleComp.interpret_pure,
        StateT.run_pure, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.pure_map]
  have hinv : ∀ result state,
      (result, state) ∈ phase1.support →
      ∀ x : BitString n, state.2 x ≠ none → List.ofFn x ∈ state.1 := by
    intro result state hmem
    refine ProbOracleComp.run_interpret_invariant combinedOracle
      (fun s => ∀ x : BitString n, s.2 x ≠ none → List.ofFn x ∈ s.1)
      ?_ (adversary n []) ([], fun _ => none) (by simp) result state hmem
    intro ⟨⟨⟩, msg⟩ ⟨queried, cache⟩ hstate val ⟨queried', cache'⟩ hstep
    dsimp only [combinedOracle] at hstep
    rw [show (macLogHandler n ((), msg)).run queried = macLogHandler n ((), msg) queried from rfl]
      at hstep
    simp only [macLogHandler, Functor.map_map, OracleComp.interpret_map, StateT.run_map,
      ProbOracleComp.interpret_query, PMF.monad_map_eq_map, PMF.mem_support_map_iff] at hstep
    obtain ⟨⟨rawTag, nextCache'⟩, hlazy, hpair⟩ := hstep
    cases hpair
    obtain ⟨⟨rawAns, nextCache⟩, hlazy, hpair0⟩ := hlazy
    cases hpair0
    intro x hx
    rw [List.mem_cons]
    unfold lazyRandomFunctionOracle randomFunctionQuery at hlazy
    by_cases hmsg : msg.length = n
    · simp only [hmsg, ↓reduceIte, OracleComp.interpret_map, ProbOracleComp.interpret_query,
        StateT.run_map, PMF.monad_map_eq_map, PMF.mem_support_map_iff] at hlazy
      obtain ⟨⟨v, nextCache₂⟩, hans, hpair2⟩ := hlazy
      cases hpair2
      dsimp only [StateT.run] at hans
      cases hcache : cache (BitString.ofList n msg) with
      | some v0 =>
        rw [RandomOracle.answer_of_some _ _ _ _ hcache] at hans
        simp only [PMF.mem_support_pure_iff, Prod.mk.injEq] at hans
        rcases hans with ⟨_, rfl⟩
        exact Or.inr (hstate x hx)
      | none =>
        rw [RandomOracle.answer_of_none _ _ _ hcache] at hans
        simp only [PMF.mem_support_map_iff] at hans
        obtain ⟨v1, _, hupd⟩ := hans
        have hnc : nextCache₂ = Function.update cache (BitString.ofList n msg) (some v1) :=
          (Prod.mk.inj hupd).2.symm
        subst hnc
        by_cases heq : x = BitString.ofList n msg
        · subst heq
          exact Or.inl (BitString.ofFn_ofList hmsg)
        · dsimp only at hx
          rw [Function.update_of_ne heq] at hx
          exact Or.inr (hstate x hx)
    · simp only [hmsg, ↓reduceIte, OracleComp.interpret_pure, StateT.run_pure,
        PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.mem_support_pure_iff, Prod.mk.injEq] at hlazy
      rcases hlazy with ⟨_, rfl⟩
      exact Or.inr (hstate x hx)
  have hstep_bound : ∀ item ∈ phase1.support,
      phase2 item true ≤ (1 : ℝ≥0∞) / 2 ^ n := by
    rintro ⟨⟨msg, tag⟩, queried, cache⟩ hmem
    have hcache_inv := hinv (msg, tag) (queried, cache) hmem
    dsimp only [phase2]
    by_cases hcond : ((msg.length == n) && !queried.contains msg) = true
    · simp only [hcond, ↓reduceIte]
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, Bool.not_eq_true'] at hcond
      rcases hcond with ⟨hmsgLen, hnotContains⟩
      have hnotMem : msg ∉ queried := by
        intro hmem_q
        have htrue := List.contains_iff_mem.mpr hmem_q
        rw [hnotContains] at htrue
        contradiction
      have hnone : cache (BitString.ofList n msg) = none := by
        by_contra hsome
        exact hnotMem (BitString.ofFn_ofList hmsgLen ▸ hcache_inv _ hsome)
      simp only [Functor.map_map, OracleComp.interpret_map, StateT.run_map,
        ProbOracleComp.interpret_query, PMF.monad_map_eq_map, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def]
      unfold lazyRandomFunctionOracle randomFunctionQuery
      simp only [hmsgLen, ↓reduceIte, OracleComp.interpret_map, ProbOracleComp.interpret_query,
        StateT.run_map, PMF.monad_map_eq_map, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def]
      dsimp only [StateT.run]
      rw [RandomOracle.answer_of_none _ _ _ hnone]
      simp only [PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def]
      have htake : (fun x : BitString n => ((List.ofFn x).take n == tag)) =
          (fun x : BitString n => (List.ofFn x == tag)) := by
        funext x
        simp [List.take_of_length_le (List.length_ofFn (f := x)).le]
      rw [htake]
      exact uniformOfFintype_bitString_beq_true_le n tag
    · have hcondF : ((msg.length == n) && !queried.contains msg) = false :=
        Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hcond
      simp only [hcondF, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, PMF.pure_apply, reduceCtorEq,
        zero_le]
  have htotal : (phase1.bind phase2) true ≤ (1 : ℝ≥0∞) / 2 ^ n := by
    rw [PMF.bind_apply]
    refine (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun a => ?_).trans
      (PMF.tsum_mul_le_of_forall_le phase1 fun _ => le_rfl)
    by_cases ha : a ∈ phase1.support
    · exact mul_le_mul_right (hstep_bound a ha) _
    · simp [(phase1.apply_eq_zero_iff a).mpr ha]
  rw [hgame, Game.succProbability]
  have hne_top : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) / 2 ^ n ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.div_ne_top ENNReal.one_ne_top (by positivity)
  have hmono := ENNReal.toNNReal_mono hne_top htotal
  have hrhs : ((1 : ℝ≥0∞) / 2 ^ n).toNNReal = (1 : ℝ≥0) / 2 ^ n := by
    rw [ENNReal.toNNReal_div, ENNReal.toNNReal_one, ENNReal.toNNReal_pow, ENNReal.toNNReal_ofNat]
  rwa [hrhs] at hmono

private theorem unique_tag_prfMAC
    {family : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool}
    (hpoly : ComputableInPolyTime (fun pair : List Bool × List Bool => family pair.1 pair.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits) :
    ∀ n sk, sk ∈ (ProbComp.eval ((prfMAC family hpoly).keyGen n)).support →
      ∀ msg, msg.length = n → ∀ tag tag',
      (prfMAC family hpoly).verify sk msg tag = true →
      tag' ∈ (ProbComp.eval ((prfMAC family hpoly).sign sk msg)).support →
      tag' = tag := by
  intro n sk hsk msg hmsg tag tag' hver htag'
  dsimp [prfMAC] at hsk hver htag'
  rw [BitString.eval_sampleList] at hsk
  have hskLen : sk.length = n := BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hsk

  simp only [PMF.mem_support_pure_iff, prfOracle, hskLen, hmsg, ↓reduceIte] at htag'
  exact htag'.trans hver.2

theorem succProbability_eufCmaGame_prfMAC_le
    {family : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool}
    (hpoly : ComputableInPolyTime (fun pair : List Bool × List Bool => family pair.1 pair.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits)
    (hlen : ∀ key query, query.length = key.length → (family key query).length = key.length)
    (adversary : Forger) (n : ℕ) :
    Game.succProbability (ProbComp.eval ((prfMAC family hpoly).eufCmaGame adversary n)) ≤
      Game.advantage
        (ProbComp.eval (prfRealGame family (macToPrfDistinguisher adversary) n))
        (ProbComp.eval (prfIdealGame (macToPrfDistinguisher adversary) n)) +
      (1 : ℝ≥0) / 2 ^ n := by
  rw [← eval_prfRealGame_macToPrfDistinguisher hpoly hlen adversary n]
  have htri := Game.advantage_triangle
    (ProbComp.eval (prfRealGame family (macToPrfDistinguisher adversary) n))
    (ProbComp.eval (prfIdealGame (macToPrfDistinguisher adversary) n))
    (PMF.pure false)
  simp only [Game.advantage_pure_false] at htri
  exact htri.trans (add_le_add_right
    (succProbability_prfIdealGame_macToPrfDistinguisher_le adversary n) _)

@[local fun_prop]
private theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_chainTrace
    {h : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool}
    (hh : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => h p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits)
    (hlen : ∀ k x, x.length = 2 * k.length → (h k x).length = k.length)
    {γ : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {k iv : γ → List Bool} {bs : γ → List (List Bool)}
    (hk : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime k encIn encBits)
    (hiv : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime iv encIn encBits)
    (hbs : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime bs encIn (encList encBits)) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => chainTrace h (k a) (iv a) (bs a))
      encIn (encPair encBits (encList encBits)) := by
  have hstep : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (List Bool × (List Bool × List (List Bool))) × List Bool =>
        chainTraceStep h p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
      (encPair (encPair encBits (encPair encBits (encList encBits))) encBits)
      (encPair encBits (encList encBits)) := by
    have hk_p : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun p : (List Bool × (List Bool × List (List Bool))) × List Bool => p.1.1)
        (encPair (encPair encBits (encPair encBits (encList encBits))) encBits) encBits := by
      fun_prop
    have hx_p : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun p : (List Bool × (List Bool × List (List Bool))) × List Bool =>
          padOrTake p.1.1.length p.1.2.1 ++ padOrTake p.1.1.length p.2)
        (encPair (encPair encBits (encPair encBits (encList encBits))) encBits) encBits := by
      polytime
    have hhx : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun p : (List Bool × (List Bool × List (List Bool))) × List Bool =>
          h p.1.1 (padOrTake p.1.1.length p.1.2.1 ++ padOrTake p.1.1.length p.2))
        (encPair (encPair encBits (encPair encBits (encList encBits))) encBits) encBits :=
      hh.comp (hk_p.prod hx_p)
    have htail_p : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun p : (List Bool × (List Bool × List (List Bool))) × List Bool => p.1.2.2)
        (encPair (encPair encBits (encPair encBits (encList encBits))) encBits)
        (encList encBits) := by
      fun_prop
    exact hhx.prod (hx_p.cons' htail_p)
  apply ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.foldlWith_of_bounded_growth
    (encA := encBits) (encL := encList encBits)
    (encP := encBits) (encB := encPair encBits (encList encBits))
    (step := chainTraceStep h)
    hk hbs (hiv.prod (.const [])) hstep
    (growth := fun a => 6 * (k a).length + 2)
    (((PolyBounded.const 6).mul hk.polyBounded_length).add (.const 2))
  intro a state b _
  have hxlen : (padOrTake (k a).length state.1 ++ padOrTake (k a).length b).length =
      2 * (k a).length := by
    rw [List.length_append, length_padOrTake, length_padOrTake]
    omega
  have hhlen : (h (k a) (padOrTake (k a).length state.1 ++ padOrTake (k a).length b)).length =
      (k a).length :=
    hlen (k a) _ hxlen
  simp only [chainTraceStep, length_encPair, encList_cons, List.length_append, length_frame,
    encBits_apply, hhlen, hxlen]
  lia

private theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_extractChainCollision
    {h : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool}
    (hh : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => h p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits)
    (hlen : ∀ k x, x.length = 2 * k.length → (h k x).length = k.length)
    {γ : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {k iv : γ → List Bool} {bs₁ bs₂ : γ → List (List Bool)}
    (hk : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime k encIn encBits)
    (hiv : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime iv encIn encBits)
    (hbs₁ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime bs₁ encIn (encList encBits))
    (hbs₂ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime bs₂ encIn (encList encBits)) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun a => extractChainCollision h (k a) (iv a) (bs₁ a) (bs₂ a))
      encIn (encPair encBits encBits) := by
  have ht₁ := (computableTidilyInPolyTime_chainTrace hh hlen hk hiv hbs₁).snd'
  have ht₂ := (computableTidilyInPolyTime_chainTrace hh hlen hk hiv hbs₂).snd'
  have hzip : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime

theorem succProbability_indexedEufCmaGame_le
    (hH : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => H p.1 p.2)

    {bound : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ}

      ∀ σ ∈ (ProbComp.eval (S.sign x.2 msg)).support, σ.length ≤ bound n)
    (adversary : IndexedForger) :
    Game.succProbability
        (ProbComp.eval ((scheme S H depth hH hlen hcap).indexedEufCmaGame adversary n)) ≤
      2 ^ depth n * Game.succProbability
          (ProbComp.eval (S.eufOneTimeGame (oneTimeForger S H depth bound adversary) n)) +

  have hsupp : ∀ t ∈ X.support, t.1.length = n ∧ t.2.1.length = 2 ^ depth n := by
    intro t ht
    simp only [X, realExp, PMF.mem_support_bind_iff, PMF.mem_support_map_iff] at ht
    obtain ⟨k, hk, keys, hkeys, r, _, rfl⟩ := ht
    exact ⟨BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hk,
      ((ProbComp.mem_support_replicate_iff _ _ _).mp hkeys).1⟩
  have hsplit : ProbComp.eval ((scheme S H depth hH hlen hcap).indexedEufCmaGame adversary n) true ≤

      eval_collisionGame_eq hH hlen hcap adversary n]

      (add_le_add le_rfl ((PMF.map_any_range_true_le_sum X (2 ^ depth n)
        (fun i t => otsWin S H n i t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)).trans ?_))

    (hcr : CollisionResistant H)

      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits)

    (scheme S H depth hH hlen hcap).IndexedEUFCMA := by

  obtain ⟨cs, ds, hlens⟩ := S.sign_ppt.length_le

  have hboundPoly : ComputableInPolyTime bound encUnary encUnary := by
    apply ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy
    dsimp only [bound]
    polytime
  have hbound (n : ℕ) : ∀ x ∈ (ProbComp.eval (S.keyGen n)).support, ∀ msg, msg.length = n →
      ∀ σ ∈ (ProbComp.eval (S.sign x.2 msg)).support, σ.length ≤ bound n := by
    intro x hx msg hmsg σ hσ

    refine hσLen.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs (Nat.pow_le_pow_left ?_ ds))
    omega

  intro adversary hadversary
  have hB := hS.negligible (oneTimeForger S H depth bound adversary)
    (isOraclePPT_oneTimeForger hH hlen hcap hboundPoly hadversary)
  have hC := hcr.negligible (collisionFinder S H depth hH hlen hcap adversary)
    (isPPT_collisionFinder hH hlen hcap hadversary)
  have hN : PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => 2 ^ depth n) := hcap.tidy.polynomiallyBounded
  refine negligible_of_le ((hB.polynomiallyBounded_mul hN).add hC) fun n => ?_
  have h := succProbability_indexedEufCmaGame_le hH hlen hcap (hbound n) adversary
  simpa only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, Pi.add_apply] using h

theorem advantage_naorReingold_le_sum (d : F.Desc) (n : ℕ)
    (adv : OracleComp (fun _ : BitString n => F.Carrier d) Bool) :
    Game.advantage (F.naorReingoldRealGame d n adv) (F.naorReingoldIdealGame d n adv) ≤
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
        Game.advantage
          ((F.ddhRealTupleLaw d).bind (F.naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher d n k adv))
          ((F.ddhIdealTupleLaw d).bind (F.naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher d n k adv))) +
        n * (F.order d : ℝ≥0)⁻¹ := by
  rw [← F.naorReingoldHybridGame_zero d n adv, ← F.naorReingoldHybridGame_self d n adv]
  refine (Game.advantage_hybrid_le_sum (F.naorReingoldHybridGame d n · adv) n).trans ?_
  have hsum :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
        (Game.advantage
          ((F.ddhRealTupleLaw d).bind (F.naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher d n k adv))
          ((F.ddhIdealTupleLaw d).bind (F.naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher d n k adv)) +
          (F.order d : ℝ≥0)⁻¹)) =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
        Game.advantage
          ((F.ddhRealTupleLaw d).bind (F.naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher d n k adv))
          ((F.ddhIdealTupleLaw d).bind (F.naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher d n k adv))) +
        n * (F.order d : ℝ≥0)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [← hsum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk => ?_
  have hlt : k < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
  have heq : F.naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher d n k adv =
      F.naorReingoldLevelDDHDistinguisher d k hlt adv := by
    funext t
    simp [naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher, hlt]
  rw [heq]
  exact F.advantage_naorReingoldHybridGame_succ_le d k hlt adv

/-- **Common-bound Naor–Reingold PRF distributional prefix-hybrid bound**
([BonehShoup2023], Exercise 10.4; [NaorReingold2004], Theorem 4.1): if for every `k < n` the
explicit `2^k`-pair PMF distinguisher `naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher d n k adv` has DDH advantage
at most `ε`, then the Naor–Reingold PRF advantage is at most `n * (ε + (F.order d)⁻¹)`. The
efficient lazy-sampling reduction (`IsOraclePPT` / `PseudorandomFunction` bridge) remains open in
#1093. -/

theorem advantage_naorReingold_le_mul (d : F.Desc) (n : ℕ)
    (adv : OracleComp (fun _ : BitString n => F.Carrier d) Bool) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (hε : ∀ k < n,
      Game.advantage
        ((F.ddhRealTupleLaw d).bind (F.naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher d n k adv))
        ((F.ddhIdealTupleLaw d).bind (F.naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher d n k adv)) ≤ ε) :
    Game.advantage (F.naorReingoldRealGame d n adv) (F.naorReingoldIdealGame d n adv) ≤
      n * (ε + (F.order d : ℝ≥0)⁻¹) := by
  rw [← F.naorReingoldHybridGame_zero d n adv, ← F.naorReingoldHybridGame_self d n adv]
  refine Game.advantage_hybrid_le (F.naorReingoldHybridGame d n · adv) n
    (ε + (F.order d : ℝ≥0)⁻¹) fun k hk => ?_
  have heq : F.naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher d n k adv =
      F.naorReingoldLevelDDHDistinguisher d k hk adv := by
    funext t
    simp [naorReingoldHopDDHDistinguisher, hk]
  refine (F.advantage_naorReingoldHybridGame_succ_le d k hk adv).trans ?_
  rw [← heq]
  exact add_le_add (hε k hk) le_rfl

private theorem pow_one_sub_le_inv_two_mul {q m : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (1 - 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ))) ^ (4 * q * m) ≤ 1 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) := by
  have hqR : (0 : ℝ) < q := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hq
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  have hα1 : 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
    linarith
  have h := Real.one_sub_pow_le_one_div_one_add_mul (by positivity) hα1 (4 * q * m)
  have hmul : ((4 * q * m : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * (m : ℝ))) = 2 * (q : ℝ) := by
    push_cast
    field_simp

private theorem parallelCore_inversion_le {k w outLen : ℕ → ℕ} {f : List Bool → List Bool}
    (hlen : ∀ x, (f x).length = outLen x.length)
    {evalA : (ℕ × List Bool) → List Bool → List Bool}
    (n B : ℕ) (good : List Bool → Bool) {c : ENNReal}
    (hc : ∀ j < k n, ∀ x, x.length = w n → good x = false →
      (((BitString.uniformList (k n * w n + B)).map (fun seed =>
        f (slotCand k w f evalA n (f x) seed j) == f x)) true) ≤ c) :
    (((BitString.uniformList (k n * w n)).bind (fun X =>
      (BitString.uniformList B).map (fun coins =>
        parallelCore k w f n (evalA (n, parallelCore k w f n X) coins) ==
          parallelCore k w f n X))) true) ≤
      (((BitString.uniformList (w n)).map good) true) ^ (k n) + (k n : ENNReal) * c := by
  let joint : PMF (List Bool × List Bool) :=
    (BitString.uniformList (k n * w n)).bind (fun X =>
      (BitString.uniformList B).map (fun coins => (X, coins)))
  let E (p : List Bool × List Bool) : Bool :=
    parallelCore k w f n (evalA (n, parallelCore k w f n p.1) p.2) ==
      parallelCore k w f n p.1
  let E₀ (p : List Bool × List Bool) : Bool :=
    (List.range (k n)).all (fun j => good (BitString.listRow (w n) j p.1))
  let F (j : ℕ) (p : List Bool × List Bool) : Bool :=
    !good (BitString.listRow (w n) j p.1) &&
      (f (BitString.listRow (w n) j (evalA (n, parallelCore k w f n p.1) p.2)) ==
        f (BitString.listRow (w n) j p.1))
  have hjoint_map (G : List Bool × List Bool → Bool) :
      (joint.map G) true =
        ((BitString.uniformList (k n * w n)).bind (fun X =>
          (BitString.uniformList B).map (fun coins => G (X, coins)))) true := by
    simp [joint, PMF.map_bind, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def]
  have hsplit : ∀ p ∈ joint.support, E p = true →
      E₀ p = true ∨ ((List.range (k n)).any (fun j => F j p)) = true := by
    rintro ⟨X, coins⟩ _ hE
    by_cases h0 : E₀ (X, coins) = true
    · exact Or.inl h0
    · right
      have h0_false :
          ((List.range (k n)).all (fun j => good (BitString.listRow (w n) j X))) = false :=
        Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr h0
      obtain ⟨j, hj_mem, hj_bad⟩ := List.all_eq_false.mp h0_false
      rw [List.any_eq_true]
      refine ⟨j, hj_mem, ?_⟩
      have hrow_eq := parallelCore_eq_imp_row_eq hlen (beq_iff_eq.mp hE)
        (List.mem_range.mp hj_mem)
      simp [F, Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hj_bad, hrow_eq]
  have hle1 : (joint.map E) true ≤
      (joint.map E₀) true + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k n), (joint.map (F j)) true :=
    (PMF.map_true_le_add joint hsplit).trans
      (add_le_add_right (PMF.map_any_range_true_le_sum joint (k n) F) _)
  have hE0_eq : (joint.map E₀) true =
      (((BitString.uniformList (w n)).map good) true) ^ (k n) := by
    rw [hjoint_map E₀]
    have hbind : ((BitString.uniformList (k n * w n)).bind (fun X =>
        (BitString.uniformList B).map (fun coins => E₀ (X, coins)))) =
      (BitString.uniformList (k n * w n)).map (fun X =>
        (List.range (k n)).all (fun j => good (BitString.listRow (w n) j X))) := by
      simp only [E₀, PMF.map, Function.comp_def, PMF.bind_const]
    rw [hbind, BitString.uniformList_all_listRow_true]
  have hF_le : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (k n), (joint.map (F j)) true ≤ c := by
    intro j hj
    have hj_lt : j < k n := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
    rw [hjoint_map (F j), slot_event_eq_planted n B good hj_lt]
    refine PMF.bind_apply_le_on_support _ fun x hx => ?_
    have hx_len : x.length = w n := BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hx
    by_cases hgx : good x = true
    · simp [hgx]
    · have hgf : good x = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hgx
      simpa [hgf] using hc j hj_lt x hx_len hgf
  have hsum_le : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k n), (joint.map (F j)) true ≤ (k n : ENNReal) * c := by
    calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k n), (joint.map (F j)) true
      _ ≤ ∑ _ ∈ Finset.range (k n), c := Finset.sum_le_sum hF_le
      _ = (k n : ENNReal) * c := by simp
  rw [← hjoint_map E]
  exact hle1.trans (by rw [hE0_eq]; exact add_le_add_right hsum_le _)

    (n : ℕ) (good : List Bool → Bool) {c : ENNReal}
    (hc : ∀ x, x.length = w n → good x = true → ∃ j < k n,
      c ≤ ((BitString.uniformList (seedLen n)).map (fun seed =>

    (((BitString.uniformList (w n)).map good) true) ≤

        (BitString.uniformList (t n * seedLen n)).map (fun allSeeds =>
          f (runTrials k w t seedLen f evalA n (f x) allSeeds) == f x))) true) +

      V (query j, coins.take (p.eval (encPreimagePrefix (query j)).length)) ≠ D (query j)}
    have hfalse : {coins | g coins = false} ⊆ ⋃ j ∈ Finset.range n, bad j := by
      intro coins hcoins
      by_contra hgood
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_exists, not_not,
        bad] at hgood
      have hsame := preimageSearch_congr (D := D) (q := (n, f x))
        (D' := fun inst => V (inst, coins.take (p.eval (encPreimagePrefix inst).length)))

      have := apply_preimageSearch hD x
      rw [hxn] at this
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, g, hsame, this, beq_self_eq_true, Bool.true_eq_false] at hcoins

        n ≤ (encPreimagePrefix (query j)).length ∧
          p.eval (encPreimagePrefix (query j)).length ≤ searchCoinLength p (n, f x) := by
      have hj' := length_iterate_preimageSearchStep D (n, f x) j
      constructor
      · simp only [query, length_encPair, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate, encBits_apply]
        omega
      · refine Polynomial.eval_mono p ?_
        simp only [query, length_encPair, encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate, encBits_apply,
          List.length_append, hj', List.length_singleton]
        omega
    have hbad (j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) : μ.toOuterMeasure (bad j) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ (n + 1) := by
      refine (toOuterMeasure_take_wrong_le hV (query j) (hlen j hj).2).trans ?_
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_one]

      rw [← PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply_singleton, PMF.toOuterMeasure_map_apply]

            MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _

                  rw [← mul_div_assoc, ENNReal.mul_div_mul_left _ _ (by simp) (by simp)]
    have hsum : (μ.map g) true + (μ.map g) false = 1 := by
      rw [add_comm, ← tsum_bool, PMF.tsum_coe]
    calc (1 / 2 : ENNReal) = 1 - 1 / 2 := by rw [one_div, ENNReal.one_sub_inv_two]
      _ ≤ 1 - (μ.map g) false := tsub_le_tsub_left hfail 1
      _ = (μ.map g) true := by
          rw [← hsum, ENNReal.add_sub_cancel_right (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _)]
  have h12 : ((1 / 2 : NNReal) : ENNReal) = 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  rw [← ENNReal.coe_le_coe, ENNReal.coe_toNNReal (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _), h12]
  exact hhalf

theorem mass_map_regularityBucket_le {n : ℕ} {Image : Type*}
    (f : BitString n → Image) (r : Fin (n + 1)) (hS : (regularityBucket f r).Nonempty)
    (hdense : 2 ^ n ≤ (n + 1) * (regularityBucket f r).card) (y : Image) :
    (((PMF.uniformOfFinset (regularityBucket f r) hS).map f) y).toReal ≤
      (2 * (n + 1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ r.val) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
  classical
  let S := regularityBucket f r
  have hS_pos : (0 : ℝ) < S.card := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hS.card_pos
  have hmap : ((PMF.uniformOfFinset S hS).map f) y =
      ((S.filter fun x => f x = y).card : ℝ≥0∞) * (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
    rw [PMF.map_apply, tsum_fintype]
    conv_rhs =>
      rw [← nsmul_eq_mul, ← Finset.sum_const, ← Finset.filter_univ_mem (s := S),
        Finset.filter_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    simp only [PMF.uniformOfFinset_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  rw [hmap, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_natCast, ENNReal.toReal_inv,
    ENNReal.toReal_natCast, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hcard_le : ((S.filter fun x => f x = y).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r.val := by
    rcases (S.filter fun x => f x = y).eq_empty_or_nonempty with hemp | ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩
    · rw [hemp, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
      positivity
    · rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx₀
      have hsub : S.filter (fun x => f x = y) ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x = f x₀) := by
        intro x hx
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx ⊢
        exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hx.2.trans hx₀.2.symm⟩
      have hle1 : (S.filter fun x => f x = y).card ≤
          (Finset.univ.filter fun x => f x = f x₀).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      have hle2 : (Finset.univ.filter fun x => f x = f x₀).card =
          Nat.card {x : BitString n // f x = f x₀} := by
        rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype]
      have hlt := (card_fiber_of_mem_regularityBucket f r hx₀.1).2
      have hle_nat : (S.filter fun x => f x = y).card ≤ 2 * 2 ^ r.val := by
        rw [pow_succ'] at hlt
        omega
      exact_mod_cast hle_nat
  have hdense_real : (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ (n + 1 : ℝ) * (S.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdense
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hS_pos (by positivity)]
  calc
    ((S.filter fun x => f x = y).card : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n
      ≤ (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r.val) * ((n + 1 : ℝ) * (S.card : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul hcard_le hdense_real (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * (n + 1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ r.val * (S.card : ℝ) := by ring

theorem eventually_regularity_gap {g : List Bool → List Bool} (hg : OneWay g)
    {imgLen : ℕ → ℕ} (himgLen : ∀ x, (g x).length = imgLen x.length)
    (r : ∀ k, Fin (k + 1))
    (hdense : ∀ k, 2 ^ k ≤ (k + 1) *
      (regularityBucket (fun x : BitString k => ofList (imgLen k) (g (List.ofFn x))) (r k)).card)
    (D : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop, (r k).val + D * Nat.log 2 k ≤ k := by
  have hneg :=
    (hg.inversion_negligible trivialInverter isPPT_trivialInverter).eventually_le_inv_polynomial
      (p := fun k => (k + 1) ^ (D + 1)) (by fun_prop) (fun k => by positivity)
  filter_upwards [hneg, eventually_ge_atTop 2] with k hk hk2
  have hsucc := trivialInverter_succ_ge himgLen k (r k) (hdense k)
  have hk_real : (Game.succProbability (ProbComp.eval (inversionGame g trivialInverter k)) : ℝ) ≤
      1 / ((k + 1 : ℝ) ^ (D + 1)) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hk
  have hcomb : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (r k).val) / ((k + 1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ k) ≤
      1 / ((k + 1 : ℝ) ^ (D + 1)) :=
    hsucc.trans hk_real
  have hk_log : (2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.log 2 k) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by omega)
  have hlog_D : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.log 2 k)) ^ D ≤ (k + 1 : ℝ) ^ D :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) D
  have hcross : (2 : ℝ) ^ (r k).val * (k + 1 : ℝ) ^ (D + 1) ≤ (k + 1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    rwa [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity), one_mul] at hcomb
  have hpow_D : (k + 1 : ℝ) ^ (D + 1) = (k + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 1 : ℝ) ^ D := pow_succ' (k + 1 : ℝ) D
  have hpow_le : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((r k).val + D * Nat.log 2 k) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < k + 1 := by positivity
    have h1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (r k).val * (k + 1 : ℝ) ^ D ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      rw [hpow_D] at hcross
      nlinarith
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((r k).val + D * Nat.log 2 k)
        = (2 : ℝ) ^ (r k).val * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.log 2 k)) ^ D := by
          rw [pow_add, pow_mul']
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (r k).val * (k + 1 : ℝ) ^ D :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog_D (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := h1
  have hpow_nat : 2 ^ ((r k).val + D * Nat.log 2 k) ≤ 2 ^ k := by
    exact_mod_cast hpow_le
  exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right Nat.one_lt_two).mp hpow_nat

private theorem dist_seededHash_regularityBucket_fiber_le {k m2 c2 : ℕ} {Image : Type*}
    [DecidableEq Image] (f : BitString k → Image) (r : Fin (k + 1))
    (hS : (regularityBucket f r).Nonempty) (hm2 : m2 ≤ c2) :
    haveI (x₀ : BitString k) : Nonempty {x : BitString k // f x = f x₀} := ⟨⟨x₀, rfl⟩⟩
    let side := PMF.uniformOfFinset (regularityBucket f r) hS
    let source (x₀ : BitString k) :=
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype {x : BitString k // f x = f x₀}).map Subtype.val
    let seed2 := PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString (c2 * k))
    let hash2 (h2 : BitString (c2 * k)) (x : BitString k) : BitString m2 :=
      LinearHash.hash (block h2 ∘ Fin.castLE hm2) x
    dist (side.bind fun x₀ => (seededHash seed2 (source x₀) hash2).map (x₀, ·))
      (side.bind fun x₀ =>
        (seed2.bind fun h2 => (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString m2)).map (h2, ·)).map (x₀, ·)) ≤
      if m2 = 0 then 0 else Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ m2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ r.val) / 2 := by
  have (x₀ : BitString k) : Nonempty {x : BitString k // f x = f x₀} := ⟨⟨x₀, rfl⟩⟩
  intro side source seed2 hash2
  split_ifs with hm2_zero
  · subst m2
    have hsub : Subsingleton (BitString 0) := inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (Fin 0 → Bool))
    have heq : (side.bind fun x₀ => (seededHash seed2 (source x₀) hash2).map (x₀, ·)) =
        (side.bind fun x₀ =>
          (seed2.bind fun h2 => (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString 0)).map (h2, ·)).map (x₀, ·)) := by
      congr 1; funext x₀
      rw [seededHash_eq_uniform_of_subsingleton]
    rw [heq, dist_self]
  · have hhash2 : IsTwoUniversal seed2 hash2 := isTwoUniversal_block_prefix hm2
    have hcond := hhash2.leftover_hash_conditional side source
    refine hcond.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_) (by norm_num))
    simp only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
    have hpoint : ∀ x₀ : BitString k,
        (side x₀).toReal * collisionProbability (source x₀) ≤
          (side x₀).toReal * ((2 : ℝ) ^ r.val)⁻¹ := by
      intro x₀
      by_cases hx₀ : x₀ ∈ regularityBucket f r
      · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
        rw [collisionProbability_map_of_injective _ _ Subtype.val_injective,
          collisionProbability_uniform, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
        have hfib := (card_fiber_of_mem_regularityBucket f r hx₀).1
        rw [inv_eq_one_div, inv_eq_one_div]
        exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast hfib)
      · have h0 : side x₀ = 0 := by
          simp [side, PMF.uniformOfFinset_apply, hx₀]
        simp [h0]
    calc
      ∑ x₀ : BitString k, (side x₀).toReal * collisionProbability (source x₀)
        ≤ ∑ x₀ : BitString k, (side x₀).toReal * ((2 : ℝ) ^ r.val)⁻¹ :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun x₀ _ => hpoint x₀
      _ = (∑ x₀ : BitString k, (side x₀).toReal) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ r.val)⁻¹ :=
          (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
      _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ r.val)⁻¹ := by rw [PMF.sum_toReal, one_mul]

    LinearHash.hash (block h2 ∘ Fin.castLE hm2) x

  have hcore_eq : coreLHLDist f r hS hm1 hm2 =

        seed2.bind fun h2 =>

      rw [x.property]

        (fun h1 h2 => PMF.pure ((h1, hash1 h1 (f x₀)), (h2, hash2 h2 x.val)))

    simp [unifCoreDist, seed1, seed2, unif2, PMF.map_bind, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def]
