private theorem entropy_fullGen_condSeedSet_ge (g : List Bool → List Bool) (imgLen : ℕ → ℕ)
    (d γ_core γ : ℕ) (S : ∀ k, Finset (BitString k)) (hS : ∀ k, (S k).Nonempty)
    (r : ∀ k, Fin (k + 1)) {n : ℕ}
    (hfits : coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core
      (GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core) n) ≤ n)
    (hk_2d : 2 * (d * Nat.log 2
      (GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core) n)) ≤
        GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core) n)
    (hg_len : ∀ x : BitString (GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core) n),
      (g (List.ofFn x)).length =
        imgLen (GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core) n))
    (hS_eq : S (GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core) n) =
      regularityBucket
        (fun x : BitString (GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core) n) =>
          ofList (imgLen (GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core) n))
            (g (List.ofFn x)))
        (r (GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core) n)))
    (hdist :
      let k := GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core) n
      let f (x : BitString k) : BitString (imgLen k) := ofList (imgLen k) (g (List.ofFn x))
      dist (coreLHLDist f (r k) (hS_eq ▸ hS k) (l1Val_le d k (r k).val)
          (l2Val_le_h2Rows d γ_core k (r k).val))
        (unifCoreDist k (imgLen k) (l1Val d k (r k).val) (l2Val d k (r k).val)
          (h2Rows d γ_core k)) ≤ 1 / (lhlPrefixLen d k n : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    let k := GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core) n
    ((lhlPrefixLen d k n : ℝ) - 2) ≤
      PMF.entropy ((PMF.uniformOfFinset (condSeedSet imgLen d γ_core S r n)
        (condSeedSet_nonempty imgLen d γ_core S hS r n)).map fun x =>
          ofList (n + γ * Nat.log 2 n) (fullGen g imgLen d γ_core γ (List.ofFn x))) := by
  intro k
  let f (x : BitString k) : BitString (imgLen k) := ofList (imgLen k) (g (List.ofFn x))
  have hS_reg : (regularityBucket f (r k)).Nonempty := hS_eq ▸ hS k
  let m_lhl := lhlPrefixLen d k n
  let L := n + γ * Nat.log 2 n
  let padLen := n - coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core k
  let m1 := l1Val d k (r k).val
  let m2 := l2Val d k (r k).val
  let c2 := h2Rows d γ_core k
  let D_seed := (PMF.uniformOfFinset (condSeedSet imgLen d γ_core S r n)
    (condSeedSet_nonempty imgLen d γ_core S hS r n)).map List.ofFn
  let D_out := D_seed.map fun z => ofList L (fullGen g imgLen d γ_core γ z)
  let D_lhl := D_seed.map fun z => ofList m_lhl ((fullGen g imgLen d γ_core γ z).take m_lhl)
  have hent_mono : D_lhl.entropy ≤
      ((PMF.uniformOfFinset (condSeedSet imgLen d γ_core S r n)
        (condSeedSet_nonempty imgLen d γ_core S hS r n)).map fun x =>
          ofList L (fullGen g imgLen d γ_core γ (List.ofFn x))).entropy := by
    have hmap_out : ((PMF.uniformOfFinset (condSeedSet imgLen d γ_core S r n)
        (condSeedSet_nonempty imgLen d γ_core S hS r n)).map fun x =>
          ofList L (fullGen g imgLen d γ_core γ (List.ofFn x))) = D_out := by
      simp [D_out, D_seed, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def]
    have hmap_lhl : D_lhl = D_out.map (fun y : BitString L => ofList m_lhl (List.ofFn y)) := by
      simp only [D_lhl, D_out, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def]
      congr 1; funext z
      rw [ofList_take_eq_ofList, ofList_ofFn_ofList_of_le (lhlPrefixLen_le_output d γ k n)]
    rw [hmap_out, hmap_lhl]
    exact PMF.entropy_map_le D_out _

      (c : (BitString (k * imgLen k) × BitString m1) × (BitString (c2 * k) × BitString m2)) :
      PMF (BitString m_lhl) :=
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString padLen)).map fun pad =>
      ofList m_lhl (List.ofFn pad ++ List.ofFn c.1.1 ++ List.ofFn c.1.2 ++
        List.ofFn c.2.1 ++ List.ofFn c.2.2)
  have hreal_lhl : D_lhl =
      (coreLHLDist f (r k) hS_reg (l1Val_le d k (r k).val)
        (l2Val_le_h2Rows d γ_core k (r k).val)).bind packLHL := by
    have hcond_seed : D_seed =
        (PMF.uniformOfFinset (regularityBucket f (r k)) hS_reg).bind fun x =>
          (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString (k * imgLen k))).bind fun h1 =>
            (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString (c2 * k))).bind fun h2 =>
              (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString padLen)).map fun pad =>
                packSeedWords (r k).val (x, h1, h2, pad) := by

      dsimp only at h1
      have h2 : PMF.uniformOfFinset (S k) (hS k) =
          PMF.uniformOfFinset (regularityBucket f (r k)) hS_reg := by
        congr 1
      dsimp [D_seed]
      rw [h1, h2]
    dsimp only [D_lhl, coreLHLDist, packLHL]
    rw [hcond_seed]
    refine map_bind_four_eq_bind_three_map _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ fun x h1 h2 pad => ?_
    have hplen : (packSeedWords (r k).val (x, h1, h2, pad)).length = n :=
      length_packSeedWords (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (r k).isLt) hfits (x, h1, h2, pad)
    have hfits_z : coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core
        (GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core)
          (packSeedWords (r k).val (x, h1, h2, pad)).length) ≤
        (packSeedWords (r k).val (x, h1, h2, pad)).length := by
      rw [hplen]; exact hfits
    have hk_z : 2 * (d * Nat.log 2
        (GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core)
          (packSeedWords (r k).val (x, h1, h2, pad)).length)) ≤
        GeneratorReindex.parameter (coreSeedLen imgLen d γ_core)
          (packSeedWords (r k).val (x, h1, h2, pad)).length := by
      rw [hplen]; exact hk_2d
    rw [fullGen_eq_rawGen hfits_z hk_z,
      rawGen_packSeedWords g imgLen d γ_core γ n (r k).val
        (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (r k).isLt) hfits (x, h1, h2, pad)]
    set u := List.ofFn pad ++ List.ofFn h1 ++
      LinearHash.wordHash m1 (List.ofFn h1) (g (List.ofFn x)) ++ List.ofFn h2
    set v := LinearHash.wordHash (m2 + mActual d γ k n) (List.ofFn h2) (List.ofFn x)
    have hu_len : u.length = padLen + k * imgLen k + m1 + c2 * k := by
      simp [u, padLen, Nat.add_assoc]
    have hsplit : m_lhl = u.length + m2 := by
      rw [hu_len]
      exact (lhlPrefixLen_split imgLen d γ_core (r k).val hfits hk_2d).symm
    have htake : (u ++ v).take m_lhl = u ++ v.take m2 := by
      rw [hsplit, List.take_append]
      simp
    have hv_take : v.take m2 =
        List.ofFn (LinearHash.hash
          (block h2 ∘ Fin.castLE (l2Val_le_h2Rows d γ_core k (r k).val)) x) := by
      dsimp [v]
      rw [wordHash_take (Nat.le_add_right m2 _), wordHash_ofFn_prefix]
    have hg_fx : g (List.ofFn x) = List.ofFn (f x) := (ofFn_ofList (hg_len x)).symm
    have hu_d1 : LinearHash.wordHash m1 (List.ofFn h1) (g (List.ofFn x)) =
        List.ofFn (LinearHash.hash (block h1 ∘ Fin.castLE (l1Val_le d k (r k).val)) (f x)) := by
      rw [hg_fx, wordHash_ofFn_prefix]
    change ofList m_lhl ((u ++ v).take m_lhl) = _
    rw [htake, hv_take]
    dsimp [u]
    rw [hu_d1]
  have hunif_lhl : (unifCoreDist k (imgLen k) m1 m2 c2).bind packLHL =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString m_lhl) :=
    unifCoreDist_bind_packLHL k (imgLen k) m1 m2 c2 padLen m_lhl
      (lhlPrefixLen_split imgLen d γ_core (r k).val hfits hk_2d)
  have hdist_lhl : dist D_lhl (PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString m_lhl)) ≤
      1 / (m_lhl : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hreal_lhl, ← hunif_lhl]
    exact (PMF.dist_bind_le _ _ packLHL).trans hdist
  exact (entropy_ge_of_dist_uniform_le D_lhl hdist_lhl).trans hent_mono

private theorem pow_le_two_pow_two_mul_log (B : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    k ^ B ≤ 2 ^ (2 * B * Nat.log 2 k) := by

    (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self Nat.one_lt_two k).le.trans
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right Nat.zero_lt_two (by omega))
  calc
    k ^ B ≤ (2 ^ (2 * Nat.log 2 k)) ^ B := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hk_le B
    _ = 2 ^ (2 * B * Nat.log 2 k) := by rw [← pow_mul]; ring_nf

private theorem isPPTOn_heuristic {t : ℕ → ℕ}
    (ht : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime t encUnary encUnary)
    {cA dA : ℕ} {evalA : (ℕ × List Bool) → List Bool → List Bool}
    (hevalA : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool => evalA p.1 p.2)
      (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits) encBits) :
    IsPPTOn encBits encNat
      (fun y : List Bool =>
        heuristicCand t evalA y <$> BitString.sampleList (coinBudget cA dA y.length)) := by
  let E2 := encPair encBits encBits
  let E3 := encPair E2 encUnary
  have hlen_y : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun y : List Bool => y.length) encBits encUnary :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length encBits
  have hmax_y : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun y : List Bool => maxComplexity y.length) encBits encUnary :=
    computableTidily_maxComplexity.comp hlen_y
  have hbudget : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun y : List Bool => coinBudget cA dA y.length) encBits encUnary := by
    unfold coinBudget
    fun_prop
  have hsched := computableTidily_inputSchedule
  have hmax := computableTidily_maxComplexity
  have htry : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun q : (List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ =>
        decide (tryComplexity t evalA q.1.1.length q.1.1 q.1.2
          (maxComplexity q.1.1.length - q.2) = true))
      E3 encBool := by
    have hsimp_eq : (fun q : (List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ =>
        decide (tryComplexity t evalA q.1.1.length q.1.1 q.1.2
          (maxComplexity q.1.1.length - q.2) = true)) =
      (fun q : (List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ =>
        liuPassCore t q.1.1.length
          ((evalA (q.1.1.length, targetImage (maxComplexity q.1.1.length - q.2) q.1.1) q.1.2).take
            (inputSchedule q.1.1.length)) ==
          targetImage (maxComplexity q.1.1.length - q.2) q.1.1) := by
      funext q
      have hdecide (b : Bool) : decide (b = true) = b := by cases b <;> rfl
      exact hdecide _
    rw [hsimp_eq]
    have hy : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun q : (List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ => q.1.1)
        E3 encBits := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).fst'
    have hcoins : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun q : (List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ => q.1.2)
        E3 encBits := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).snd'
    have hk : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun q : (List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ => q.2)
        E3 encUnary := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd _ _
    have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun q : (List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ => q.1.1.length)
        E3 encUnary := hlen_y.comp hy
    have hi : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun q : (List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ => maxComplexity q.1.1.length - q.2)
        E3 encUnary := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_sub.comp ((hmax.comp hn).prod hk)
    have htarget := computableTidily_targetImage hi hy
    have hev : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun q : (List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ =>
          evalA (q.1.1.length, targetImage (maxComplexity q.1.1.length - q.2) q.1.1) q.1.2)
        E3 encBits := hevalA.comp ((hn.prod htarget).prod hcoins)
    have htk := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsTakeWithInput hev (hsched.comp hn)
    have hcr := computableTidily_liuPassCore ht hn htk
    exact hcr.beq htarget
  have hbest : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => bestSlack t evalA p.1.length p.1 p.2)
      E2 encUnary :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.findGreatest
      (hmax_y.comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _)) htry
  have hcand_unary : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => heuristicCand t evalA p.1 p.2)
      E2 encUnary := by
    unfold heuristicCand
    exact ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_sub.comp
      ((hmax_y.comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _)).prod hbest)
  have hcand : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => heuristicCand t evalA p.1 p.2)
      E2 encNat :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.unary_to_binary.comp hcand_unary
  exact IsPPTOn.map_with (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy hbudget).sampleList (.of_tidy hcand)

theorem weakOneWay_reindex_liuPassCore
    {t : ℕ → ℕ} (ht_comp : ComputableInPolyTime t encUnary encUnary)
    (ht : ∀ n, n + 1 ≤ t n)
    (hK : MildlyHardOnAverage (timeBoundedNat t)) :
    WeakOneWay (OneWayReindex.reindex inputSchedule (liuPassCore t)) := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp_pos, hK_hard⟩ := hK

  have hC_pos : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; positivity

    simp [q]
  have hq_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < q.eval n := by
    rw [hq_eval]
    have := hp_pos n
    positivity
  refine OneWayReindex.weakOneWay computableInPolyTime_inputSchedule le_inputSchedule
    (computableInPolyTime_liuPassCore ht_comp) hq_pos fun A hA => ?_
  obtain ⟨cA, dA, evalA, hevalA, _, hlawA⟩ := hA.on.exists_total_seeded_evaluator
  let H (y : List Bool) : ProbComp ℕ :=
    heuristicCand t evalA y <$> BitString.sampleList (coinBudget cA dA y.length)
  have hH_ppt : IsPPTOn encBits encNat H := isPPTOn_heuristic ht_comp.tidy hevalA
  filter_upwards [hK_hard H hH_ppt] with n hn_H
  let B := coinBudget cA dA n
  let distH : PMF Bool :=
    (BitString.uniformList n).bind fun y =>
      (BitString.uniformList B).map fun coins =>
        decide (heuristicCand t evalA y coins = timeBoundedNat t y)
  let distA : PMF Bool :=
    ProbComp.eval (OneWayReindex.familyInversionGame inputSchedule (liuPassCore t) A n)
  have hdistH_eq :
      ((BitString.uniformList n).bind fun y =>
        (ProbComp.eval (H y)).map fun v => decide (v = timeBoundedNat t y)) =
        distH := by
    dsimp only [distH, H]
    apply PMF.bind_congr_on_support
    intro y hy
    have hlen : y.length = n := BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hy
    simp [hlen, B, PMF.map, Function.comp_def]
  rw [hdistH_eq] at hn_H
  have hsumH := PMF.toReal_true_add_toReal_false distH
  have hsumA := PMF.toReal_true_add_toReal_false distA
  have hfailH_ge : 1 / ((p.eval n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (distH false).toReal := by linarith
  have hpow_ne_zero : (2 ^ (lenWidth n + Kolmogorov.copyOverhead) : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hpow_ne_top : (2 ^ (lenWidth n + Kolmogorov.copyOverhead) : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.pow_ne_top ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top
  have hinv_ne_top : (2 ^ (lenWidth n + Kolmogorov.copyOverhead) : ENNReal)⁻¹ ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr hpow_ne_zero
  have hfail_le := heuristic_fail_mul_le_family_fail ht hlawA n
  have hfail_real := ENNReal.toReal_mono (PMF.apply_ne_top distA false) hfail_le
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_pow,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofNat] at hfail_real
  have hpow_le :
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (lenWidth n + Kolmogorov.copyOverhead) ≤
        (C : ℝ) * ((n + (Kolmogorov.copyOverhead + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : 2 ^ (lenWidth n + Kolmogorov.copyOverhead) =
        2 ^ lenWidth n * 2 ^ Kolmogorov.copyOverhead := pow_add 2 _ _
    have h2 : 2 ^ lenWidth n ≤ 2 * (maxComplexity n + 1) := two_pow_lenWidth_le n
    have h3 : 2 ^ (lenWidth n + Kolmogorov.copyOverhead) ≤
        C * (n + (Kolmogorov.copyOverhead + 1)) := by
      have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ Kolmogorov.copyOverhead) h2
      have heq : 2 * (maxComplexity n + 1) * 2 ^ Kolmogorov.copyOverhead =

        dsimp [C, maxComplexity]
        rw [pow_succ']

  have hinv_ge :

    have hq_cast : ((q.eval n : ℕ) : ℝ) =

theorem eventually_tableArity (c : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, 0 < n ∧ 16 ≤ tableArity (c + 2) n ∧ tableArity (c + 2) n ≤ n ∧
      c * (3 * n + 2) ^ c + 2 ≤ 2 ^ tableArity (c + 2) n / (5 * tableArity (c + 2) n) := by
  have htend : Filter.Tendsto (Nat.clog 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.2 fun b => ⟨2 ^ b, fun n hn => by
      simpa only [Nat.clog_pow 2 b one_lt_two] using Nat.clog_mono_right 2 hn⟩
  have hlin : ∀ᶠ t in Filter.atTop, 2 * (c + 2) * t < 2 ^ t :=
    PolynomiallyBounded.eventually_lt_two_pow (by fun_prop)
  filter_upwards [htend.eventually_ge_atTop 16, htend.eventually hlin,
    Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (10 * (c + 2) * (c * 5 ^ c + 2) + 1)] with n h16 hlin hK
  set t := Nat.clog 2 n
  have hn2 : n ≤ 2 ^ t := Nat.le_pow_clog one_lt_two n
  have h2n : 2 ^ t ≤ 2 * n := Nat.pow_clog_le_mul one_lt_two (by omega)
  have ht : t ≤ 2 * n := Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le.trans h2n
  refine ⟨by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [tableArity]
    nlinarith
  · rw [tableArity]
    nlinarith
  · rw [tableArity]
    have h3 : (3 * n + 2) ^ c ≤ 5 ^ c * n ^ c := by
      rw [← mul_pow]
      exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) c
    have h1 : 1 ≤ n ^ c := Nat.one_le_pow c n (by omega)
    have hpow : n ^ (c + 2) ≤ 2 ^ ((c + 2) * t) := by
      rw [mul_comm, pow_mul]
      exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left hn2 _
    have hpos : 0 < 5 * ((c + 2) * t) := by
      have : 0 < t := by omega
      positivity
    refine (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hpos).2 ?_
    calc (c * (3 * n + 2) ^ c + 2) * (5 * ((c + 2) * t))
        ≤ (c * (5 ^ c * n ^ c) + 2 * n ^ c) * (5 * ((c + 2) * (2 * n))) := by gcongr; omega
      _ = (10 * (c + 2) * (c * 5 ^ c + 2)) * n * n ^ c := by ring
      _ ≤ n * n * n ^ c := by gcongr; omega
      _ = n ^ (c + 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ ((c + 2) * t) := hpow

  classical

  obtain ⟨p, V, hV, hdec⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := KabanetsCai.exists_complexity_restriction_le hprf.polyTime

  filter_upwards [eventually_tableArity c] with n ⟨hn, hm16, hmn, hsize⟩
  set m := tableArity (c + 2) n

    rw [eval_prfRealGame_mcspDistinguisher family hmn, BitString.uniformList, PMF.bind_map,

theorem computableInPolyTime_preimageSearch_of_input {γ : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {D : γ → ℕ × List Bool × List Bool → Bool} {q : γ → ℕ × List Bool}
    (hD : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : γ × (ℕ × List Bool × List Bool) => D p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encIn encPreimagePrefix) encBool)
    (hq : ComputableInPolyTime q encIn (encPair encUnary encBits)) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => preimageSearch (D x) (q x)) encIn encBits := by
  have hD := hD.tidy

  refine .of_tidy ?_
  unfold preimageSearch
  refine iterateWithInput_of_bounded_growth hq.fst' (const []) ?_ ⟨.const 1, fun x u => ?_⟩
  · have hinst : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : γ × List Bool =>
        (p.1, ((q p.1).1, (q p.1).2, p.2 ++ [false])))
        (encPair encIn encBits) (encPair encIn encPreimagePrefix) :=
      (fst _ _).prod ((hq.comp (fst _ _)).fst'.prod ((hq.comp (fst _ _)).snd'.prod
        (bitsAppend (snd _ _) (const [false]))))
    unfold preimageSearchStep
    exact bitsAppend (snd _ _) (bitsCons (bool_not.comp (hD.comp hinst)) (const []))
  · simp [preimageSearchStep]

theorem OneWay.exists_fixedOutputLength {f : List Bool → List Bool} (hf : OneWay f) :
    ∃ (g : List Bool → List Bool) (length : ℕ → ℕ), OneWay g ∧

    hf.normalize bound (.of_tidy hbound), ?_, by fun_prop⟩

private theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_reindex {m : ℕ → ℕ} {core : ℕ → List Bool → List Bool}
    (hm : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime m encUnary encUnary)
    (hcore : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => core p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (reindex m core) encBits encBits := by
  have hparam : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun x : List Bool => GeneratorReindex.parameter m x.length) encBits encUnary :=
    (GeneratorReindex.isPolyTime_parameter (.of_tidy hm)
      (ComputableInPolyTime.encoding_length encBits)).tidy
  have htake : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun x : List Bool => x.take (m (GeneratorReindex.parameter m x.length))) encBits encBits :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsTakeWithInput ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id' (hm.comp hparam)
  have hpair : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun x : List Bool =>
        (GeneratorReindex.parameter m x.length,
          core (GeneratorReindex.parameter m x.length)
            (x.take (m (GeneratorReindex.parameter m x.length)))))
      encBits (encPair encUnary encBits) :=
    hparam.prod (hcore.comp (hparam.prod htake))
  exact hpair.of_enc_eq fun _ => rfl

/-- The parameter-indexed inversion game for `core` at input length `m n`.
Scores `core n (candidate.take (m n)) == core n input` by truncating the inverter's candidate to
`m n` bits; since composing any inverter with `List.take (m n)` preserves PPT computability,
bounding success in this game is no stronger a security hypothesis than the untruncated game. -/

text:
private theorem isPPT_familyInverter {m : ℕ → ℕ} {core : ℕ → List Bool → List Bool}
    (hm : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime m encUnary encUnary)
    (hcore : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => core p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits)
    {c d : ℕ} {evaluate : (ℕ × List Bool) → List Bool → List Bool}
    (heval : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool => evaluate p.1 p.2)
      (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits) encBits) :
    IsPPT encBits (familyInverter m core c d evaluate) := by
  apply IsPPTOn.isPPT
  let E1 := encPair encUnary encBits
  let E2 := encPair E1 encBits
  let E3 := encPair E2 encUnary
  have hwrap : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => wrappedImage p.1 p.2) E1 encBits :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.of_enc_eq ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id' fun _ => rfl
  have hm_succ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => m (p.1 + 1)) E1 encUnary := by
    fun_prop
  have hbudget : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => coinBudget m c d p.1 p.2) E1 encUnary := by
    unfold coinBudget
    have hlen := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.encoding_length encBits).comp hwrap
    fun_prop
  have htry : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun q : ((ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool) × ℕ =>
        decide (tryLength m core evaluate q.1.1.1 q.1.1.2 q.1.2 q.2 = true))
      E3 encBool := by
    simp only [tryLength]
    have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun q : ((ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool) × ℕ => q.1.1.1)
        E3 encUnary := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).fst'.fst'
    have hy : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun q : ((ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool) × ℕ => q.1.1.2)
        E3 encBits := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).fst'.snd'
    have hcoins : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun q : ((ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool) × ℕ => q.1.2)
        E3 encBits := (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).snd'
    have hM : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun q : ((ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool) × ℕ => q.2)
        E3 encUnary := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd _ _
    have hw : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun q : ((ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool) × ℕ => wrappedImage q.1.1.1 q.1.1.2)
        E3 encBits := hwrap.comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _).fst'
    have hev : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun q : ((ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool) × ℕ =>
          evaluate (q.2, wrappedImage q.1.1.1 q.1.1.2) q.1.2)
        E3 encBits := heval.comp ((hM.prod hw).prod hcoins)
    have htk : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun q : ((ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool) × ℕ =>
          (evaluate (q.2, wrappedImage q.1.1.1 q.1.1.2) q.1.2).take (m q.1.1.1))
        E3 encBits := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsTakeWithInput hev (hm.comp hn)
    have hcr : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun q : ((ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool) × ℕ =>
          core q.1.1.1 ((evaluate (q.2, wrappedImage q.1.1.1 q.1.1.2) q.1.2).take (m q.1.1.1)))
        E3 encBits := hcore.comp (hn.prod htk)
    exact hcr.beq hy
  have hbest : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool =>
        bestLength m core evaluate p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2) E2 encUnary :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.findGreatest
      (hm_succ.comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _)) htry
  have hsearch : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool =>
        searchCandidate m core evaluate p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2) E2 encBits := by
    unfold searchCandidate
    have hw := hwrap.comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst E1 encBits)
    have hcoins := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd E1 encBits
    exact heval.comp ((hbest.prod hw).prod hcoins)
  exact IsPPTOn.map_with (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy hbudget).sampleList (.of_tidy hsearch)

/-- **Fundamental schedule-reindexing reduction
(`OneWayReindex.exists_familyInverter_inversion_le`).**
For any uniform strict PPT inverter `adversary` against `reindex m core`, there exists a uniform
strict PPT inverter `familyAdv` against `familyInversionGame m core` such that for every input
length `M ≥ m 0`, the inversion probability of `adversary` at length `M` is at most the inversion
probability of `familyAdv` at parameter `GeneratorReindex.parameter m M`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem exists_familyInverter_inversion_le {m : ℕ → ℕ} {core : ℕ → List Bool → List Bool}
    (hm : ComputableInPolyTime m encUnary encUnary)
    (hge : ∀ n, n + 1 ≤ m n)
    (hcore : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => core p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits)
    (adversary : Inverter) (hPPT : IsPPT encBits adversary) :
    ∃ familyAdv : Inverter, IsPPT encBits familyAdv ∧
      ∀ {M : ℕ}, m 0 ≤ M →
        Game.succProbability (ProbComp.eval (inversionGame (reindex m core) adversary M)) ≤
          Game.succProbability (ProbComp.eval (familyInversionGame m core familyAdv
            (GeneratorReindex.parameter m M))) := by
  obtain ⟨c, d, evaluate, heval, _, hlaw⟩ := hPPT.on.exists_total_seeded_evaluator
  refine ⟨familyInverter m core c d evaluate, isPPT_familyInverter hm.tidy hcore.tidy heval,
    fun {M} hM0 => ?_⟩
  let n := GeneratorReindex.parameter m M
  have hfits : m n ≤ M := GeneratorReindex.parameter_fits hM0
  have hlt : M < m (n + 1) := GeneratorReindex.lt_length_succ_parameter hge M
  apply ENNReal.toNNReal_mono (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _)
  have hlhs : ProbComp.eval (inversionGame (reindex m core) adversary M) =
      (BitString.uniformList (m n)).bind (fun x₀ =>
        (ProbComp.eval (adversary M (wrappedImage n (core n x₀)))).map fun candidate =>
          reindex m core candidate == wrappedImage n (core n x₀)) := by
    have h1 : ProbComp.eval (inversionGame (reindex m core) adversary M) =
        ((BitString.uniformList M).map (List.take (m n))).bind (fun x₀ =>
          (ProbComp.eval (adversary M (wrappedImage n (core n x₀)))).map fun candidate =>
            reindex m core candidate == wrappedImage n (core n x₀)) := by
      rw [PMF.bind_map]
      simp only [inversionGame, ProbComp.eval_bind, BitString.eval_sampleList, ProbComp.eval_pure,
        PMF.map]
      apply PMF.bind_congr_on_support
      intro input hinput
      have hlen : input.length = M := BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hinput
      simp [Function.comp_def, reindex, hlen, n]
    rwa [BitString.uniformList_take hfits] at h1
  have hrhs : ProbComp.eval (familyInversionGame m core (familyInverter m core c d evaluate) n) =
      (BitString.uniformList (m n)).bind (fun x₀ =>
        (BitString.uniformList (coinBudget m c d n (core n x₀))).map fun coins =>
          core n ((searchCandidate m core evaluate n (core n x₀) coins).take (m n)) ==
            core n x₀) := by
    simp [familyInversionGame, familyInverter, PMF.map]
  rw [hlhs, hrhs]
  apply PMF.bind_apply_mono_on_support _ true
  intro x₀ _
  set y := core n x₀
  have hlaw_M := hlaw (M, wrappedImage n y) (coinBudget m c d n y)
    (le_coinBudget m c d y hlt.le)
  rw [hlaw_M, PMF.map_comp]
  apply PMF.bind_apply_mono_on_support _ true
  intro coins _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, PMF.pure_apply]
  by_cases h : reindex m core (evaluate (M, wrappedImage n y) coins) == wrappedImage n y
  · have heq : reindex m core (evaluate (M, wrappedImage n y) coins) = wrappedImage n y :=
      beq_iff_eq.mp h
    simp only [reindex, wrappedImage_inj] at heq
    obtain ⟨hn_eq, hcore_eq⟩ := heq
    rw [hn_eq] at hcore_eq
    have hspec := searchCandidate_spec hlt.le hcore_eq
    simp [h, hspec]
  · simp [h]

/-- **Weak one-wayness under schedule reindexing
(library generalization of the padding trick in
[Liu and Pass, Proof of Theorem 4.1, §4, p. 10 of `arXiv:2009.11514v1`][LiuPass2020];

If a parameter-indexed family `core` on input lengths `m n` (with `m n ≥ n + 1`) satisfies the
weak one-way bound `≤ 1 - 1 / q(n)` in `familyInversionGame` for a positive polynomial `q`, then
`reindex m core` is a weak one-way function on all input lengths. -/

text:
theorem weakOneWay {m : ℕ → ℕ} {core : ℕ → List Bool → List Bool}
    (hm : ComputableInPolyTime m encUnary encUnary)

    (hm : ComputableInPolyTime m encUnary encUnary)
    (hge : ∀ n, n + 1 ≤ m n)
    (hcore : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => core p.1 p.2)

  intro adversary hPPT

  apply negligible_of_eventually_le hdecay

theorem SignatureScheme.OneTimeEUFCMA.exists_oneWay {S : SignatureScheme}
    (hS : S.OneTimeEUFCMA) : ∃ f, OneWay f := by
  obtain ⟨c, d, evaluate, heval, hsupp, hlaw⟩ := S.keyGen_ppt.exists_total_seeded_evaluator
  let schedule (n : ℕ) : ℕ := c * (n + 1) ^ d + n + 1
  let param (size : ℕ) : ℕ := GeneratorReindex.parameter schedule size
  let f (seed : List Bool) : List Bool :=
    encPair encUnary encBits (param seed.length, (evaluate (param seed.length) seed).1)
  have hsched : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime schedule encUnary encUnary := by
    dsimp [schedule]
    polytime
  have hparam_unary : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime param encUnary encUnary :=
    (GeneratorReindex.isPolyTime_parameter (.of_tidy hsched) (.of_tidy .id')).tidy
  have hparam : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun seed : List Bool => param seed.length)
      encBits encUnary :=
    hparam_unary.comp ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.length_bits
  have hpk : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun seed : List Bool => (evaluate (param seed.length) seed).1) encBits encBits :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst encBits encBits).comp (heval.comp (hparam.prod .id'))
  have hf : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime f encBits encBits :=
    (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.of_eq (encIn := encPair encUnary encBits) (encMid := encBits)
      fun _ => rfl).comp (hparam.prod hpk)
  refine ⟨f, OneWay.of_inversion_negligible (.of_tidy hf) ?_⟩
  intro adversary hadversary
  let forgerBody (n : ℕ) (pk : List Bool) : ProbComp (List Bool × List Bool) := do
    let size ← sampleDyadicIndex (schedule (n + 1))
    let cand ← adversary size (encPair encUnary encBits (n, pk))
    let msg := List.replicate n false
    let sig ← S.sign (evaluate n cand).2 msg
    return (msg, sig)
  let forger : Forger := fun n pk => ProbOracleComp.sample (forgerBody n pk)
  have hforgerBody : IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary encBits) (encPair encBits encBits)
      (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => forgerBody p.1 p.2) := by
    unfold forgerBody
    have hidx : IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary
        (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => sampleDyadicIndex (schedule (p.1 + 1))) :=
      isPPTOn_sampleDyadicIndex (by polytime)
    have hprep_cand : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun q : (ℕ × List Bool) × ℕ => (q.2, encPair encUnary encBits (q.1.1, q.1.2)))
        (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary) (encPair encUnary encBits) := by
      have hfst : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
          (fun q : (ℕ × List Bool) × ℕ => q.2)
          (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary) encUnary := by polytime
      have hsnd : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
          (fun q : (ℕ × List Bool) × ℕ => encPair encUnary encBits (q.1.1, q.1.2))
          (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary) encBits :=
        (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.of_eq (encIn := encPair encUnary encBits) (encMid := encBits)
          fun _ => rfl).comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _)
      exact hfst.prod hsnd
    have hcand : IsPPTOn (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary) encBits
        (fun q : (ℕ × List Bool) × ℕ =>
          adversary q.2 (encPair encUnary encBits (q.1.1, q.1.2))) :=
      hadversary.on.preprocess (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy hprep_cand)
    have hsk : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun r : ((ℕ × List Bool) × ℕ) × List Bool => (evaluate r.1.1.1 r.2).2)
        (encPair (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary) encBits) encBits := by
      have hprep : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
          (fun r : ((ℕ × List Bool) × ℕ) × List Bool => (r.1.1.1, r.2))
          (encPair (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary) encBits)
          (encPair encUnary encBits) := by polytime
      exact (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd encBits encBits).comp (heval.comp hprep)
    have hmsg : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun r : ((ℕ × List Bool) × ℕ) × List Bool => List.replicate r.1.1.1 false)
        (encPair (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary) encBits) encBits := by
      have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
          (fun r : ((ℕ × List Bool) × ℕ) × List Bool => r.1.1.1)
          (encPair (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary) encBits) encUnary := by polytime
      exact (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsReplicate false).comp hn
    have hsig : IsPPTOn (encPair (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary) encBits)
        (encPair encBits encBits)
        (fun r : ((ℕ × List Bool) × ℕ) × List Bool => do
          let sig ← S.sign (evaluate r.1.1.1 r.2).2 (List.replicate r.1.1.1 false)
          return (List.replicate r.1.1.1 false, sig)) := by
      have hsign := S.isPPTOn_sign_comp (.of_tidy hsk) (.of_tidy hmsg)
      have hpair : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
          (fun s : (((ℕ × List Bool) × ℕ) × List Bool) × List Bool =>
            (List.replicate s.1.1.1.1 false, s.2))
          (encPair (encPair (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary) encBits) encBits)
          (encPair encBits encBits) :=
        (hmsg.comp (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst _ _)).prod (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd _ _)
      exact hsign.bind_with hpair.isPPTOn
    exact hidx.bind_with (hcand.bind_with hsig)
  have hforger : IsOraclePPT (encPair encBits encBits) forger :=
    hforgerBody.isOraclePPTOn.isOraclePPT
  have hforger_neg := hS.negligible forger hforger
  have hscaled : Negligible (fun n =>
      (dyadicSize (schedule (n + 1)) : ℝ≥0) *
        Game.succProbability (ProbComp.eval (S.eufOneTimeGame forger n))) :=
    hforger_neg.polynomiallyBounded_mul
      (dyadicSize_polynomiallyBounded.comp
        (hsched.polynomiallyBounded.comp (PolynomiallyBounded.id.add (.const 1))))
  have hge : ∀ n, n + 1 ≤ schedule n := fun n => by dsimp [schedule]; lia
  have hdecay := hscaled.comp_of_polynomial_bound (GeneratorReindex.parameter_tendsto schedule)
    (hsched.polynomiallyBounded.comp (PolynomiallyBounded.id.add (.const 1)))
    (Eventually.of_forall fun size => (GeneratorReindex.lt_length_succ_parameter hge size).le)
  apply negligible_of_eventually_le hdecay
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (schedule 0)] with size hsize
  set n := param size
  have hfits : schedule n ≤ size := GeneratorReindex.parameter_fits hsize
  have hbudget : c * ((encUnary n).length + 1) ^ d ≤ size := by
    simp only [encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate]
    dsimp [schedule] at hfits
    lia
  have hlt : size < schedule (n + 1) := GeneratorReindex.lt_length_succ_parameter hge size
  have hlt_dyadic : size < dyadicSize (schedule (n + 1)) :=
    hlt.trans (lt_dyadicSize (schedule (n + 1)))
  let trial (idx : ℕ) : PMF Bool := do
    let keys ← ProbComp.eval (S.keyGen n)
    let cand ← ProbComp.eval (adversary idx (encPair encUnary encBits (n, keys.1)))
    (ProbComp.eval (S.sign (evaluate n cand).2 (List.replicate n false))).map fun sig =>
      S.verify keys.1 (List.replicate n false) sig
  have hgame_eq : ProbComp.eval (S.eufOneTimeGame forger n) =
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (dyadicSize (schedule (n + 1))))).bind
        (fun idx => trial idx.val) := by
    simp only [SignatureScheme.eufOneTimeGame, forger, forgerBody, ProbComp.eval_bind,
      ProbComp.eval_pure, ProbOracleComp.eval_run_interpret, ProbOracleComp.run_interpret_sample,
      PMF.bind_map, PMF.bind_bind, PMF.pure_bind, Function.comp_def, eval_sampleDyadicIndex,
      List.length_replicate, beq_self_eq_true, Bool.true_and]
    rw [PMF.bind_comm]
    rfl
  have hstep1 : Game.succProbability (ProbComp.eval (inversionGame f adversary size)) ≤
      Game.succProbability (trial size) := by
    apply ENNReal.toNNReal_mono (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _)
    dsimp only [trial, inversionGame]
    rw [hlaw n size hbudget, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.bind_map]
    simp only [ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure, BitString.eval_sampleList,
      Function.comp_def]
    refine PMF.bind_apply_mono_on_support _ true fun seed hseed => ?_
    have hseed_len : seed.length = size := BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hseed
    have hf_seed : f seed = encPair encUnary encBits (n, (evaluate n seed).1) := by
      simp [f, hseed_len, n]
    rw [hf_seed]
    refine PMF.bind_apply_mono_on_support _ true fun cand _ => ?_
    by_cases hwin : (f cand == encPair encUnary encBits (n, (evaluate n seed).1)) = true
    · rw [hwin]
      have hcand_eq : f cand = encPair encUnary encBits (n, (evaluate n seed).1) :=
        beq_iff_eq.mp hwin
      have hinj := (encPair encUnary encBits).injective hcand_eq
      have hparam_cand : param cand.length = n := congrArg Prod.fst hinj
      have hpk_cand : (evaluate n cand).1 = (evaluate n seed).1 := by
        have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd hinj
        dsimp at h2
        rwa [hparam_cand] at h2
      rw [PMF.map]
      refine PMF.le_bind_apply_on_support _ fun sig hsig => ?_
      have hver := S.verify_sign n (evaluate n cand) (hsupp n cand)
        (List.replicate n false) (by simp) sig hsig
      rw [hpk_cand] at hver
      simp [hver]
    · have hfalse : (f cand == encPair encUnary encBits (n, (evaluate n seed).1)) = false :=
        Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hwin
      rw [hfalse]
      simp
  have hstep2 : Game.succProbability (trial size) ≤
      (dyadicSize (schedule (n + 1)) : ℝ≥0) *
        Game.succProbability (ProbComp.eval (S.eufOneTimeGame forger n)) := by
    rw [hgame_eq]
    exact succProbability_le_dyadicSize_mul trial hlt_dyadic
  exact hstep1.trans hstep2

theorem isPPT_lamportInverter {f : List Bool → List Bool}
    (hf : ComputableInPolyTime f encBits encBits) {adversary : Forger}
    (hadversary : IsOraclePPT (encPair encBits encBits) adversary) :
    IsPPT encBits (lamportInverter f hf adversary) := by
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at hf
  have hrun_base := (lamportScheme f (.of_tidy hf)).isPPTOn_run_oneTimeSigningOracle hadversary
  have hj : IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary
      (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => sampleDyadicIndex (2 * p.1)) :=
    isPPTOn_sampleDyadicIndex (by polytime)
  have hkeys := isPPTOn_lamportSimKeys (.of_tidy hf)
  have hcall : IsPPTOn
      (encPair (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary) (encPair encBits encBits))
      encBits
      (fun r : ((ℕ × List Bool) × ℕ) × (List Bool × List Bool) => do
        let out ← (OracleComp.interpret
          (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin k))
            ((lamportScheme f (.of_tidy hf)).oneTimeSigningOracle r.2.2))
          (adversary r.1.1.1 r.2.1)).run []
        return (frames out.1.2).getD (r.1.2 / 2) []) := by
    have hprep : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun r : ((ℕ × List Bool) × ℕ) × (List Bool × List Bool) => (r.1.1.1, r.2))
        (encPair (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary) (encPair encBits encBits))
        (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits)) := by
      polytime
    have hpost : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime

theorem OneWay.oneTimeEUFCMA_lamport {f : List Bool → List Bool} (hf : OneWay f) :
    (lamportScheme f hf.polyTime).OneTimeEUFCMA := by
  let S := lamportScheme f hf.polyTime
  apply SignatureScheme.OneTimeEUFCMA.of_negligible
  intro adversary hadversary
  let inverter := lamportInverter f hf.polyTime adversary
  have hinv_ppt : IsPPT encBits inverter := isPPT_lamportInverter hf.polyTime hadversary
  have hinv_neg := hf.inversion_negligible inverter hinv_ppt
  have htwo_poly : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun n : ℕ => 2 * n) encUnary encUnary := by polytime
  have hscaled : Negligible (fun n =>
      (dyadicSize (2 * n) : ℝ≥0) *
        Game.succProbability (ProbComp.eval (inversionGame f inverter n))) :=
    hinv_neg.polynomiallyBounded_mul
      (dyadicSize_polynomiallyBounded.comp htwo_poly.polynomiallyBounded)
  apply negligible_of_eventually_le hscaled
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
  let μ : PMF (List (List Bool)) :=
    ProbComp.eval (OracleComp.replicate (2 * n) (BitString.sampleList n))
  let pkOf (w : List (List Bool)) : List Bool := encList encBits (w.map f)
  let realSkOf (w : List (List Bool)) : List Bool := encList encBits w
  let dummySkOf (w : List (List Bool)) (j : ℕ) : List Bool :=
    encList encBits (w.take j ++ [] :: w.drop (j + 1))
  let runWith (pk sk : List Bool) : PMF ((List Bool × List Bool) × List (List Bool)) :=
    ProbComp.eval ((OracleComp.interpret
      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin k))
        (S.oneTimeSigningOracle sk)) (adversary n pk)).run [])
  let win (w : List (List Bool)) (out : (List Bool × List Bool) × List (List Bool)) : Bool :=
    (out.1.1.length == n) && !out.2.contains out.1.1 &&
      lamportVerify f (pkOf w) out.1.1 out.1.2
  let invWin (w : List (List Bool)) (j : ℕ)
      (out : (List Bool × List Bool) × List (List Bool)) : Bool :=
    f ((frames out.1.2).getD (j / 2) []) == f (w.getD j [])
  let inverterAt (j : ℕ) (y : List Bool) : ProbComp (List Bool) :=
    if j < 2 * n then do
      let keys ← lamportSimKeys f n j y
      let out ← (OracleComp.interpret
        (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin k))
          (S.oneTimeSigningOracle keys.2)) (adversary n keys.1)).run []
      return (frames out.1.2).getD (j / 2) []
    else
      return []
  let trial (j : ℕ) : PMF Bool := do
    let xStar ← BitString.uniformList n
    (ProbComp.eval (inverterAt j (f xStar))).map fun cand => f cand == f xStar
  have hinv_eq : ProbComp.eval (inversionGame f inverter n) =
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)))).bind (fun j => trial j.val) := by
    simp only [inversionGame, inverter, lamportInverter, trial, inverterAt,
      ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure, BitString.eval_sampleList, eval_sampleDyadicIndex,
      PMF.bind_map, PMF.bind_bind, Function.comp_def]
    rw [PMF.bind_comm]
    rfl
  have htrial_eq : ∀ j < 2 * n,
      μ.bind (fun w => (runWith (pkOf w) (dummySkOf w j)).map (invWin w j)) = trial j := by
    intro j hj
    dsimp only [μ, trial, inverterAt]
    rw [eval_replicate_split (BitString.sampleList n) hj]
    simp only [hj, ↓reduceIte, BitString.eval_sampleList, lamportSimKeys, ProbComp.eval_bind,
      ProbComp.eval_pure, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.bind_bind, PMF.bind_map, PMF.pure_bind,
      PMF.map_bind, Function.comp_def]
    refine PMF.bind_congr_on_support _ _ _ fun xStar _ => ?_
    refine PMF.bind_congr_on_support _ _ _ fun front hfront => ?_
    have hfront_len : front.length = j :=
      ((ProbComp.mem_support_replicate_iff _ _ _).mp hfront).1
    refine PMF.bind_congr_on_support _ _ _ fun back _ => ?_
    have hpk_eq : pkOf (front ++ xStar :: back) =
        encList encBits (front.map f ++ f xStar :: back.map f) := by
      simp [pkOf]
    have hsk_eq : dummySkOf (front ++ xStar :: back) j =
        encList encBits (front ++ [] :: back) := by
      dsimp only [dummySkOf]
      rw [← hfront_len]
      simp
    have hget_eq : (front ++ xStar :: back).getD j [] = xStar := by
      rw [← hfront_len, List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ le_rfl,
        Nat.sub_self, List.getD_cons_zero]
    simp only [runWith, invWin, hpk_eq, hsk_eq, hget_eq, PMF.map, PMF.pure_bind,
      Function.comp_def]
  have hpointwise : ∀ w ∈ μ.support, ∀ out,
      runWith (pkOf w) (realSkOf w) out * (if win w out then 1 else 0) ≤
        ∑ j : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)),
          if j.val < 2 * n then
            runWith (pkOf w) (dummySkOf w j.val) out * (if invWin w j.val out then 1 else 0)
          else 0 := by
    intro w hw out
    have hw_len : w.length = 2 * n := ((ProbComp.mem_support_replicate_iff _ _ _).mp hw).1
    by_cases hwin : win w out = true
    · by_cases hsupp : out ∈ (runWith (pkOf w) (realSkOf w)).support
      · have hqlen : out.2.length ≤ 1 := by
          dsimp only [runWith] at hsupp
          rw [ProbOracleComp.eval_run_interpret] at hsupp
          exact S.length_le_one_of_mem_support_run_oneTimeSigningOracle (realSkOf w)
            (adversary n (pkOf w)) hsupp
        have hwin' := hwin
        dsimp only [win] at hwin'
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at hwin'
        obtain ⟨⟨hmsg_len, hnot_mem⟩, hver⟩ := hwin'
        obtain ⟨i, hi, hagree⟩ := exists_unqueried_index hn hmsg_len hqlen hnot_mem
        let jStar := 2 * i + (out.1.1.getD i false).toNat
        have hjStar_lt : jStar < 2 * n := by
          have := Bool.toNat_le (out.1.1.getD i false)
          omega
        have hjStar_dyadic : jStar < dyadicSize (2 * n) :=
          hjStar_lt.trans (lt_dyadicSize (2 * n))
        have hrun_eq : runWith (pkOf w) (realSkOf w) out =
            runWith (pkOf w) (dummySkOf w jStar) out := by
          dsimp only [runWith]
          rw [ProbOracleComp.eval_run_interpret, ProbOracleComp.eval_run_interpret]
          exact S.run_oneTimeSigningOracle_apply_eq_of_agree (realSkOf w) (dummySkOf w jStar)
            (fun req hreq => lamportSign_eq_of_agreeAt hjStar_lt hw_len hreq)
            (adversary n (pkOf w)) [] out.1 out.2 hagree
        have hinvWin_true : invWin w jStar out = true := by
          dsimp only [invWin, jStar]
          rw [two_mul_add_toNat_div_two]
          simp only [lamportVerify, pkOf, frames_encList_bits, Bool.and_eq_true,
            List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range] at hver
          have hcheck := hver.2 i (by omega)
          have hjStar_w : jStar < w.length := by omega
          have hjStar_map : jStar < (w.map f).length := by simp [hjStar_w]
          rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hjStar_map, List.getElem_map,
            ← List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hjStar_w] at hcheck
          exact hcheck
        simp only [hwin, ↓reduceIte, mul_one, hrun_eq]
        let jFin : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)) := ⟨jStar, hjStar_dyadic⟩
        let term (j : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n))) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
          if j.val < 2 * n then
            runWith (pkOf w) (dummySkOf w j.val) out *
              (if invWin w j.val out then 1 else 0)
          else 0
        have hterm : runWith (pkOf w) (dummySkOf w jStar) out = term jFin := by
          simp [term, jFin, hjStar_lt, hinvWin_true]
        rw [hterm]
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := term) (fun _ _ => zero_le) (Finset.mem_univ jFin)
      · have hzero : runWith (pkOf w) (realSkOf w) out = 0 :=
          (PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr hsupp
        rw [hzero, zero_mul]
        exact zero_le
    · simp [hwin]
  have hw_sum : ∀ w ∈ μ.support,
      ((runWith (pkOf w) (realSkOf w)).map (win w)) true ≤
        ∑ j : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)),
          if j.val < 2 * n then
            ((runWith (pkOf w) (dummySkOf w j.val)).map (invWin w j.val)) true
          else 0 := by
    intro w hw
    rw [map_bool_apply_true]
    calc
      ∑' out, runWith (pkOf w) (realSkOf w) out * (if win w out then 1 else 0)
        ≤ ∑' out, ∑ j : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)),
            if j.val < 2 * n then
              runWith (pkOf w) (dummySkOf w j.val) out * (if invWin w j.val out then 1 else 0)
            else 0 := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (hpointwise w hw)
      _ = ∑ j : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)),
            ∑' out, if j.val < 2 * n then
              runWith (pkOf w) (dummySkOf w j.val) out * (if invWin w j.val out then 1 else 0)
            else 0 := ennreal_tsum_finsetSum _ _
      _ = ∑ j : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)),
            if j.val < 2 * n then
              ((runWith (pkOf w) (dummySkOf w j.val)).map (invWin w j.val)) true
            else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
          split_ifs with hj
          · rw [map_bool_apply_true]
          · simp
  have hgame_real : ProbComp.eval (S.eufOneTimeGame adversary n) =
      μ.bind (fun w => (runWith (pkOf w) (realSkOf w)).map (win w)) := by
    simp only [SignatureScheme.eufOneTimeGame, S, lamportScheme, lamportKeyGen, μ, pkOf, realSkOf,
      runWith, win, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure, PMF.bind_bind, PMF.pure_bind,
      PMF.map]
    rfl
  have htotal_ennreal : (ProbComp.eval (S.eufOneTimeGame adversary n)) true ≤
      ∑ j : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)), (trial j.val) true := by
    rw [hgame_real, PMF.bind_apply]
    calc
      ∑' w, μ w * ((runWith (pkOf w) (realSkOf w)).map (win w)) true
        ≤ ∑' w, μ w * ∑ j : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)),
            if j.val < 2 * n then
              ((runWith (pkOf w) (dummySkOf w j.val)).map (invWin w j.val)) true
            else 0 := by
          refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun w => ?_
          by_cases hw : w ∈ μ.support
          · exact mul_le_mul_right (hw_sum w hw) (μ w)
          · simp [(PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff μ w).mpr hw]
      _ = ∑' w, ∑ j : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)),
            μ w * (if j.val < 2 * n then
              ((runWith (pkOf w) (dummySkOf w j.val)).map (invWin w j.val)) true
            else 0) := by
          refine tsum_congr fun w => Finset.mul_sum _ _ _
      _ = ∑ j : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)),
            ∑' w, μ w * (if j.val < 2 * n then
              ((runWith (pkOf w) (dummySkOf w j.val)).map (invWin w j.val)) true
            else 0) := ennreal_tsum_finsetSum _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)), (trial j.val) true := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
          split_ifs with hj
          · rw [← htrial_eq j.val hj, PMF.bind_apply]
          · simp
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ≥0) < dyadicSize (2 * n) := by
    exact_mod_cast dyadicSize_pos (2 * n)
  rw [hinv_eq, Game.succProbability_uniform, Fintype.card_fin,
    mul_div_cancel₀ _ hpos.ne']
  have hsum_ne_top : (∑ j : Fin (dyadicSize (2 * n)), (trial j.val) true) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_of_lt (ENNReal.sum_lt_top.mpr fun j _ => (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _).lt_top)
  have hmono := ENNReal.toNNReal_mono hsum_ne_top htotal_ennreal
  rwa [ENNReal.toNNReal_sum fun j _ => PMF.apply_ne_top _ _] at hmono

theorem succProbability_uniformList_test_le {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {ℓ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hlen : ∀ word, (generator word).length = ℓ word.length) (adversary : Inverter) (n : ℕ)
    (P : Finset (List Bool)) (hP : ∀ x : List Bool, ℓ x.length = ℓ n → x ∈ P) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (hε : (#P : ℝ≥0) ≤ ε * 2 ^ ℓ n) :
    Game.succProbability
      (distinguishingGame (BitString.uniformList (ℓ n)) (test generator adversary n)) ≤ ε := by
  classical
  set T := P.image generator
  have hle (r : Fin (ℓ n) → Bool) :
      ProbComp.eval (test generator adversary n (List.ofFn r)) true ≤
        if List.ofFn r ∈ T then 1 else 0 := by
    split_ifs with hr
    · exact PMF.coe_le_one _ _
    simp only [test, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure, PMF.bind_apply, PMF.pure_apply]
    refine le_of_eq (ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero.2 fun x => ?_)
    have hne : generator x ≠ List.ofFn r := fun hx => hr <| mem_image.2
      ⟨x, hP x (by rw [← hlen x, hx, List.length_ofFn]), hx⟩
    simp [hne]
  have hgame : distinguishingGame (BitString.uniformList (ℓ n)) (test generator adversary n) true ≤
      ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ℓ n)⁻¹ * (#T : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    rw [distinguishingGame, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, BitString.uniformList, PMF.bind_map,
      PMF.bind_apply, tsum_fintype]
    simp only [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin,
      Function.comp_apply]
    push_cast
    calc ∑ r : Fin (ℓ n) → Bool, ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ℓ n)⁻¹ *
          ProbComp.eval (test generator adversary n (List.ofFn r)) true
        ≤ ∑ r : Fin (ℓ n) → Bool, ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ℓ n)⁻¹ * (if List.ofFn r ∈ T then 1 else 0) :=
          sum_le_sum fun r _ => by gcongr; exact hle r
      _ = ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ℓ n)⁻¹ * (#{r : Fin (ℓ n) → Bool | List.ofFn r ∈ T} : ℝ≥0∞) := by
          rw [← mul_sum, sum_boole]
      _ ≤ ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ℓ n)⁻¹ * (#T : ℝ≥0∞) := by
          gcongr
          exact card_le_card_of_injOn List.ofFn (fun r hr => by simpa using hr)
            fun r _ s _ h => List.ofFn_injective h
  have hT : (#T : ℝ≥0) ≤ ε * 2 ^ ℓ n :=
    (by exact_mod_cast card_image_le : (#T : ℝ≥0) ≤ #P).trans hε
  have hfin : distinguishingGame (BitString.uniformList (ℓ n)) (test generator adversary n) true ≤
      (ε : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    refine hgame.trans ?_
    rw [ENNReal.inv_mul_le_iff (by positivity) (by simp), mul_comm]
    exact_mod_cast hT
  exact (ENNReal.toNNReal_mono ENNReal.coe_ne_top hfin).trans_eq (ENNReal.toNNReal_coe _)

theorem PseudorandomGenerator.oneWay_of_card_le {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {ℓ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hgenerator : PseudorandomGenerator generator ℓ) {ε : ℕ → ℝ≥0} (hε : Negligible ε)
    (P : ℕ → Finset (List Bool)) (hP : ∀ n (x : List Bool), ℓ x.length = ℓ n → x ∈ P n)
    (hcard : ∀ n, (#(P n) : ℝ≥0) ≤ ε n * 2 ^ ℓ n) : OneWay generator := by
  refine OneWay.of_inversion_negligible hgenerator.polyTime fun adversary hadversary => ?_
  have hind := hgenerator.indistinguishable (test generator adversary)
    (isPPT_test hgenerator.polyTime hadversary)
  refine negligible_of_le (hind.add_fun hε) fun n => ?_
  rw [inversionGame_eq_prgRealGame, eval_prgRealGame]
  exact ((NNReal.le_add_nndist _ _).trans_eq (add_comm _ _)).trans <| by
    gcongr
    exact succProbability_uniformList_test_le hgenerator.length_eq adversary n (P n) (hP n)
      (ε n) (hcard n)

/-- **Length-doubling pseudorandom generators are one-way.** If `2 n ≤ ℓ n` for all `n`, a
pseudorandom generator with output length `ℓ` is a one-way function: the seeds whose image has
length `ℓ n` have length at most `ℓ n - n`, so a uniform word of length `ℓ n` is in the image with
probability at most `2 ^ (1 - n)`. -/

theorem PseudorandomGenerator.oneWay_of_injective {generator : List Bool → List Bool}
    {ℓ : ℕ → ℕ} (hgenerator : PseudorandomGenerator generator ℓ) (hinj : Function.Injective ℓ)
    (hgap : Negligible fun n => (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) ^ (ℓ n - n)) : OneWay generator := by
  classical
  refine hgenerator.oneWay_of_card_le hgap
    (fun n => univ.image (List.ofFn : (Fin n → Bool) → _)) (fun n x hx => ?_) fun n => ?_
  · obtain rfl : x.length = n := hinj hx
    exact mem_image.2 ⟨x.get, mem_univ _, List.ofFn_get x⟩
  · have h : (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) ^ (ℓ n - n) * 2 ^ ℓ n = 2 ^ n := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, ℓ n = k + n := ⟨ℓ n - n, by have := hgenerator.stretch n; omega⟩
      rw [hk, Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_add, one_div_pow]
      field_simp
    rw [h]
    exact_mod_cast card_image_le.trans (by simp)

/-- **Every pseudorandom generator yields a one-way function.** Truncate the generator to one bit
of stretch, amplify it to stretch `n ↦ 2 n + 1`, and apply `PseudorandomGenerator.oneWay`. -/

theorem PseudorandomGenerator.exists_oneWay {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {ℓ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hgenerator : PseudorandomGenerator generator ℓ) : ∃ f : List Bool → List Bool, OneWay f := by
  have h1 := hgenerator.truncate (fun n => n + 1) (by polytime) hgenerator.stretch
    fun n => Nat.lt_succ_self n
  have h2 := h1.amplify (fun n => 2 * n + 1) (by polytime) fun n => by omega
  exact ⟨_, h2.oneWay fun n => by omega⟩

/-- **One-way functions exist if and only if pseudorandom generators exist** [HILL1999]. The
forward direction is `OneWay.exists_pseudorandomGenerator`, the converse
`PseudorandomGenerator.exists_oneWay`. -/

theorem pedersenCommitLaw_eq_uniform_of_ne_zero (d : F.Desc) {h : F.Carrier d} (hh : h ≠ 0)
    (m : ZMod (F.order d)) :
    F.pedersenCommitLaw d h m =
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ZMod (F.order d))).map (· • F.generator d) := by
  obtain ⟨α, rfl⟩ := F.smul_generator_surjective d h
  have hα : α ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hh (zero_smul _ _)
  let e : ZMod (F.order d) ≃ ZMod (F.order d) :=
    (Equiv.mulRight₀ α hα).trans (Equiv.addLeft m)
  have hcomp : F.pedersenCommit d (α • F.generator d) m =
      (fun γ : ZMod (F.order d) => γ • F.generator d) ∘ e := by
    funext r
    simp [e, pedersenCommit_smul_generator]

theorem pedersenExtractNat_cast {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] {m₀ r₀ m₁ r₁ : ℕ}
    (hr : (r₁ : ZMod q) ≠ r₀) :
    (pedersenExtractNat q m₀ r₀ m₁ r₁ : ZMod q) =
      ((r₁ : ZMod q) - r₀)⁻¹ * ((m₀ : ZMod q) - m₁) := by
  have hsub (a b : ℕ) : (((a % q + q - b % q) % q : ℕ) : ZMod q) = (a : ZMod q) - b := by
    rw [ZMod.natCast_mod, Nat.cast_sub ((Nat.mod_lt _ (Fact.out : q.Prime).pos).le.trans
      (Nat.le_add_left _ _)), Nat.cast_add, ZMod.natCast_mod, ZMod.natCast_mod, ZMod.natCast_self,
      add_zero]
  have hne : (r₁ : ZMod q) - r₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hr
  have hinv : ((r₁ : ZMod q) - r₀) ^ (q - 2) = ((r₁ : ZMod q) - r₀)⁻¹ :=
    ZMod.pow_card_sub_two_eq_inv hne
  simp only [pedersenExtractNat, Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_mod, Nat.cast_pow, hsub, hinv]

theorem pedersenExtractNat_eq_of_isBindingCollision (d : F.Desc) (α : ZMod (F.order d))
    {out : List Bool × (List Bool × List Bool) × (List Bool × List Bool)}
    (hcoll : F.pedersenScheme.isBindingCollision ⟨d, α • F.generator d⟩ out = true) :
    (pedersenExtractNat (F.order d)
      (ofBits out.2.1.1) (ofBits out.2.1.2)
      (ofBits out.2.2.1) (ofBits out.2.2.2) : ZMod (F.order d)) = α := by
  simp only [CommitmentScheme.isBindingCollision, pedersenScheme, pedersenVerify,
    Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hcoll
  rcases hcoll with ⟨⟨hne, ⟨hm₀_lt, hm₀_bits⟩, hc₀⟩, ⟨hm₁_lt, hm₁_bits⟩, hc₁⟩
  have hm_nat : ofBits out.2.1.1 ≠ ofBits out.2.2.1 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    rw [← hm₀_bits, ← hm₁_bits, h]
  have hm : (ofBits out.2.1.1 : ZMod (F.order d)) ≠ (ofBits out.2.2.1 : ZMod (F.order d)) := by
    intro h
    apply hm_nat
    have hval := congrArg ZMod.val h
    rwa [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hm₀_lt, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hm₁_lt] at hval
  have hlin : (ofBits out.2.1.1 : ZMod (F.order d)) + (ofBits out.2.1.2 : ZMod (F.order d)) * α =
      (ofBits out.2.2.1 : ZMod (F.order d)) + (ofBits out.2.2.2 : ZMod (F.order d)) * α :=
    (F.pedersenCommit_smul_generator_eq_iff d α _ _ _ _).mp
      (F.encode_injective d (hc₀.trans hc₁.symm))
  have hmul : ((ofBits out.2.2.2 : ZMod (F.order d)) - ofBits out.2.1.2) * α =
      (ofBits out.2.1.1 : ZMod (F.order d)) - ofBits out.2.2.1 := by
    linear_combination -hlin
  have hr : (ofBits out.2.2.2 : ZMod (F.order d)) ≠ ofBits out.2.1.2 := by
    intro hreq
    apply hm
    have hzero : ((ofBits out.2.2.2 : ZMod (F.order d)) - ofBits out.2.1.2) * α = 0 := by
      rw [sub_eq_zero.mpr hreq, zero_mul]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hmul.symm.trans hzero)
  rw [pedersenExtractNat_cast hr, ← hmul, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hr)]

private theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_pedersenExtractNat {α : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool}
    {d : α → F.Desc} {m₀ r₀ m₁ r₁ : α → ℕ}
    (hd : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime d input F.encDesc)
    (hm₀ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime m₀ input encNat)
    (hr₀ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime r₀ input encNat)
    (hm₁ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime m₁ input encNat)
    (hr₁ : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime r₁ input encNat) :
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun a => pedersenExtractNat (F.order (d a)) (m₀ a) (r₀ a) (m₁ a) (r₁ a))
      input encNat := by
  have hq : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => F.order (d a)) input encNat :=
    F.computableInPolyTime_order.tidy.comp hd
  have hdiff {x y : α → ℕ} (hx : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime x input encNat)
      (hy : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime y input encNat) :
      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun a => (x a % F.order (d a) + F.order (d a) - y a % F.order (d a)) % F.order (d a))
        input encNat :=
    .binary_mod' (.binary_sub' (.binary_add' (.binary_mod' hx hq) hq) (.binary_mod' hy hq)) hq
  have hpow := (ComputableInPolyTime.binary_powMod (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy (hdiff hr₁ hr₀))
    (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy (.binary_sub' hq (.const 2)))
    (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy hq) fun a => (F.prime_order (d a)).pos).tidy
  exact .binary_mod' (.binary_mul' hpow (hdiff hm₀ hm₁)) hq

    (hparams : params.Valid) (hactive : state.stopped = false) (yes : Bool) (code : List Bool)
    (hguard : if yes then density source params.rate
      (fun x => state.margin predict truth x - state.threshold) ≤
        params.delta * (1 + params.rate / 16)
      else params.delta ≤ density source params.rate
        (fun x => state.margin predict truth x - state.threshold))
    (hbelow : 3 * params.delta / 8 ≤
      (source.toOuterMeasure {x | state.margin predict truth x ≤ 0}).toReal)
    (hcorrelation : GoodPredictor source predict truth params (state.shift yes) code) :
    Invariant source predict truth params (rounds + 1)
      ((state.shift yes).add params.codeBound code) := by

  simp only [Invariant, hactive, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false] at hinvariant
  obtain ⟨hrestore, hpotential⟩ := hinvariant
  let before := fun x => state.margin predict truth x - state.threshold
  let vote := fun x => signedVote (predict (code.take params.codeBound) x) (truth x)
  have hshift (x : α) : (state.shift yes).margin predict truth x - (state.shift yes).threshold =
      before x - if yes then 1 else 0 := by
    rw [margin_shift]
    change state.margin predict truth x - ((state.threshold + if yes then 1 else 0 : ℕ) : ℝ) = _
    cases yes <;> simp [before, sub_sub]
  have hnext (x : α) :
      ((state.shift yes).add params.codeBound code).margin predict truth x -
        ((state.shift yes).add params.codeBound code).threshold =
      before x - (if yes then 1 else 0) + vote x := by
    rw [margin_add]
    change (state.shift yes).margin predict truth x + vote x - (state.shift yes).threshold = _
    linarith [hshift x]
  have hdensity : params.delta ≤ density source params.rate
      (fun x => before x - if yes then 1 else 0) := by
    cases yes
    · simpa only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, sub_zero] using hguard
    · simpa only [ite_true] using hrestore
  have hmass : 3 * params.delta / 8 ≤ (source.toOuterMeasure {x | before x ≤ 0}).toReal := by
    refine hbelow.trans (ENNReal.toReal_mono (Cslib.Probability.PMF.toOuterMeasure_ne_top _ _)
      (MeasureTheory.measure_mono ?_))
    intro x hx
    change state.margin predict truth x ≤ 0 at hx
    change state.margin predict truth x - (state.threshold : ℝ) ≤ 0
    linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) state.threshold]
  have hstep := step_progress source hparams.gamma_pos hparams.delta_pos hparams.delta_le_one
    before vote (fun _ => by simp [vote]) yes
    (by intro hy; subst yes; simpa only [ite_true, hparams.gamma_mul_delta] using hguard)
    (fun _ => hmass) (by simpa only [hparams.gamma_mul_delta] using hdensity)
    (by simpa only [GoodPredictor, hshift, hparams.gamma_mul_delta] using hcorrelation)

  have hactiveNext : ((state.shift yes).add params.codeBound code).stopped = false := hactive
  simp only [Invariant, hactiveNext, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
  constructor

  · have hnextPotential := (show averagePotential source params.rate
        (fun x => ((state.shift yes).add params.codeBound code).margin predict truth x -
          ((state.shift yes).add params.codeBound code).threshold) ≤
        averagePotential source params.rate before + (if yes then params.delta else 0) -
          params.gamma * params.delta ^ 2 / 8 from by simpa only [hnext] using hstep)

    ∃ index, Valid n sourceBits bound index observationEntropy labelEntropy gap := by
  let D := dyadicSize bound

  let second := ⌊(D : ℝ) * labelEntropy⌋₊

  have hDr : (0 : ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hfirst : (first : ℝ) ≤ D * observationEntropy := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hsecond : (second : ℝ) ≤ D * labelEntropy := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hfirst_lt : D * observationEntropy < (first : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hsecond_lt : D * labelEntropy < (second : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hfirst_le : first ≤ D * sourceBits := by
    exact_mod_cast hfirst.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (show observationEntropy ≤ (sourceBits : ℝ) by linarith) hDr.le)
  have hgap' : (4 : ℝ) ≤ gap * D := (div_le_iff₀ hDr).mp hgap
  have hsecond_le : second + 4 ≤ D := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hone hDr.le
    exact_mod_cast (show (second : ℝ) + 4 ≤ D by nlinarith)
  have hsecond_mod : second < D := by lia
  have hquot : (first * D + second) / D = first := by
    rw [Nat.mul_comm first D, Nat.mul_add_div hD, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hsecond_mod, Nat.add_zero]
  have hrem : (first * D + second) % D = second := by simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsecond_mod]
  refine ⟨first * D + second, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · unfold size
    change first * D + second < (D * sourceBits + 1) * D
    nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_right D hfirst_le]
  · simpa only [numerator, ← show D = dyadicSize bound from rfl, hrem] using hsecond_le
  · simp only [numerator, ← show D = dyadicSize bound from rfl, hrem, Nat.cast_add,
      Nat.cast_ofNat]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hDr).mpr
    nlinarith

    simp only [observationBits, ← show D = dyadicSize bound from rfl, hquot]
    simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_assoc] using
      rounded_budget (scale n sourceBits bound) first hfirst

/-- A shared repetition schedule makes conditional extraction statistically uniform. A
zero-bit output is always permitted; positive lengths reserve two slacks below conditional
entropy. Every randomized Boolean test is admissible, with no computability assumption on
entropy or its numerical bound. -/
theorem extractLabels_indistinguishable {Observation Label Seed : ℕ → Type}
    [∀ n, Finite (Observation n)] [∀ n, Finite (Label n)] [∀ n, Finite (Seed n)]
    (source : ∀ n, ProbComp (Observation n × Label n))
    (sourceBits inverseSlack outputBits : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hmass : ∀ n value, value ∈ (ProbComp.eval (source n)).support →
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(sourceBits n : ℝ)) ≤ (ProbComp.eval (source n) value).toReal)
    (seed : ∀ n, ProbComp (Seed n)) (hash : ∀ n, Seed n → List (Label n) → BitString (outputBits n))
    (hhash : ∀ n, IsTwoUniversal (ProbComp.eval (seed n))
      (fun key (values : Fin (ExtractionSchedule.count n (sourceBits n) (inverseSlack n)) →
        Label n) => hash n key (List.ofFn values)))
    (hbudget : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, outputBits n = 0 ∨
      outputBits n + 2 * (ExtractionSchedule.slack n (sourceBits n) (inverseSlack n) : ℝ) ≤
        ExtractionSchedule.count n (sourceBits n) (inverseSlack n) *
          conditionalEntropy (ProbComp.eval (source n))) :
    Game.Indistinguishable
      (fun (test : ∀ n, List (Observation n) × Seed n × BitString (outputBits n) → Game) n =>
        (ProbComp.eval (OracleComp.replicate
          (ExtractionSchedule.count n (sourceBits n) (inverseSlack n)) (source n) >>=
            extractLabels (seed n) (hash n))).bind (test n))
      (fun test n => (extractLabelsIdeal (Output := BitString (outputBits n))
        (Prod.fst <$> source n) (ExtractionSchedule.count n (sourceBits n) (inverseSlack n))
          (seed n)).bind (test n)) (fun _ => True) := by
  intro test _
  apply negligible_of_eventually_le ExtractionSchedule.error_negligible
  filter_upwards [hbudget] with n hn
  apply NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp
  rw [Game.advantage_eq_nndist, coe_nndist]
  rcases hn with hzero | hbudget
  · have : Subsingleton (BitString (outputBits n)) := by rw [hzero]; infer_instance
    rw [eval_extractLabels_of_subsingleton, dist_self]
    exact (ExtractionSchedule.error n).coe_nonneg
  · have hmass' (value) (hvalue : value ∈ (ProbComp.eval (source n)).support) :
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((sourceBits n + n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
          (ProbComp.eval (source n) value).toReal := by
      apply le_trans _ (hmass n value hvalue)
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
      exact neg_le_neg (by exact_mod_cast (by lia : sourceBits n ≤ sourceBits n + n + 2))
    have h := extractLabels_dist_bind_le (source n)
      (ExtractionSchedule.count n (sourceBits n) (inverseSlack n)) (sourceBits n + n + 2)
      hmass' (seed n) (hash n) (hhash n) le_rfl
      (Nat.cast_nonneg (ExtractionSchedule.slack n (sourceBits n) (inverseSlack n))) (test n)
    apply h.trans
    simpa only [BitString, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow,
      Nat.cast_ofNat] using ExtractionSchedule.error_le n (sourceBits n) (inverseSlack n)

theorem SamplablePair.HasGap.extract_three {pair : SamplablePair} {gap : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hpair : pair.HasGap gap) (saved : pair.SeedRealization)
    {bound inverseSlack observationBits labelBits remainingBits numerator densityBound : ℕ → ℕ}
    (efficient : ThreeSource.Efficient (fun _ => 1) bound inverseSlack densityBound
      (fun n _ => observationBits n) (fun n _ => labelBits n)
      (fun n _ => remainingBits n) (fun n _ => numerator n))
    (hfits : ∀ n observation, observation ∈ ((pair.joint n).map Prod.fst).support →
      (pair.encode n observation).length ≤ bound n)
    (hvalid : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 0 < numerator n ∧ numerator n ≤ dyadicSize (densityBound n) ∧
      (numerator n : ℝ) / dyadicSize (densityBound n) ≤
        conditionalEntropy (pair.joint n) + gap n)
    (hfirst : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, observationBits n = 0 ∨
      observationBits n + 2 * (ExtractionSchedule.slack n (saved.length n) (inverseSlack n) : ℝ) ≤
        ExtractionSchedule.count n (saved.length n) (inverseSlack n) *
          entropy ((pair.joint n).map Prod.fst))
    (hmiddle : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      labelBits n + 2 * (ExtractionSchedule.slack n (saved.length n) (inverseSlack n) : ℝ) ≤
        ExtractionSchedule.count n (saved.length n) (inverseSlack n) *
          ((numerator n : ℝ) / dyadicSize (densityBound n)))
    (hlast : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, remainingBits n = 0 ∨
      remainingBits n + 2 * (ExtractionSchedule.slack n (saved.length n) (inverseSlack n) : ℝ) ≤
        ExtractionSchedule.count n (saved.length n) (inverseSlack n) *
          (saved.length n - entropy ((pair.joint n).map Prod.fst) -
            conditionalEntropy (pair.joint n))) :
    let count := fun n => ExtractionSchedule.count n (saved.length n) (inverseSlack n)
    ComputationallyIndistinguishable
      (fun n => ProbComp.eval (ThreeSource.extract (count n) (saved.length n) (bound n)
        (observationBits n) (labelBits n) (remainingBits n) (saved.sampleWithSeed n)))
      (fun n => uniformList (ThreeSource.outputLength (count n) (saved.length n) (bound n)
        (observationBits n) (labelBits n) (remainingBits n))) := by
  dsimp only
  intro adversary hadversary
  have h := hpair.extract_indexed_three saved (fun _ => 0)
    (candidates := fun _ => 1) (observationBits := fun n _ => observationBits n)
    (labelBits := fun n _ => labelBits n) (remainingBits := fun n _ => remainingBits n)
    (numerator := fun n _ => numerator n) efficient hfits
    (Eventually.of_forall (by intro n; decide))
    hvalid hfirst hmiddle hlast (fun n _ => adversary n) (by ppt)
  simpa only [distinguishingGame, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, ProbComp.eval_bind,
    BitString.eval_sampleList] using h

theorem exists_secure_amplified_choice {pair : SamplablePair} {gap : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hpair : pair.HasGap gap) (saved : pair.SeedRealization)
    {observationBound densityBound common : ℕ → ℕ}
    (bounds : PaddingBounds saved observationBound densityBound common)
    (hgap : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 4 / (dyadicSize (densityBound n) : ℝ) ≤ gap n) :
    ∃ choose : ℕ → ℕ,
      (∀ᶠ n in atTop, choose n < size (saved.length n) (densityBound n)) ∧
      ∀ test : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool → ProbComp Bool,
        IsPPTOn (encPair (encPair encUnary encUnary) encBits)
          encBool (fun input => test input.1.1 input.1.2 input.2) →
        Negligible (fun n => Game.advantage
          (((uniformList (common n)).map (amplifiedGenerate n (saved.length n)
            (observationBound n) (densityBound n) (common n) (choose n) (saved.evaluate n))).bind
              (fun word => ProbComp.eval (test n (choose n) word)))
          ((uniformList (size (saved.length n) (densityBound n) * common n + 1)).bind
            (fun word => ProbComp.eval (test n (choose n) word)))) := by
  obtain ⟨choose, hchoose, hsecure⟩ :=
    exists_secure_padded_choice hpair saved bounds hgap
  obtain ⟨hobservationPlain, hdensityPlain, hcommonPlain, _, _⟩ := bounds
  have hobservation := hobservationPlain.tidy
  have hdensity := hdensityPlain.tidy
  have hcommon := hcommonPlain.tidy
  have hlength := saved.length_isPolyTime.tidy
  have hsize := (isPolyTime_size saved.length_isPolyTime hdensityPlain).tidy
  have hcount : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun n =>
      size (saved.length n) (densityBound n) * common n + 1 - common n) encUnary encUnary := by
    polytime
  have h := PRGStretch.indexed_indistinguishable (seedBits := common)
    (generator := fun n index => paddedGenerate n (saved.length n) (observationBound n)
      (densityBound n) (common n) index (saved.evaluate n))
    (count := fun n => size (saved.length n) (densityBound n) * common n + 1 - common n)
    (choose := choose)
    (isPolyTime_paddedGenerate saved (.of_tidy hobservation) (.of_tidy hdensity) (.of_tidy
      hcommon))
    (.of_tidy hcommon) (.of_tidy hcount) hsecure
  refine ⟨choose, hchoose, fun test htest => ?_⟩
  unfold amplifiedGenerate
  simpa only [length_add_count] using h test htest

theorem exists_secure_choice {pair : SamplablePair} {gap : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hpair : pair.HasGap gap) (saved : pair.SeedRealization)
    {observationBound densityBound : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hobservation : ComputableInPolyTime observationBound encUnary encUnary)
    (hdensity : ComputableInPolyTime densityBound encUnary encUnary)
    (hfits : ∀ n observation, observation ∈ ((pair.joint n).map Prod.fst).support →
      (pair.encode n observation).length ≤ observationBound n)
    (hgap : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 4 / (dyadicSize (densityBound n) : ℝ) ≤ gap n) :
    ∃ choose : ℕ → ℕ,
      (∀ᶠ n in atTop, choose n < size (saved.length n) (densityBound n)) ∧
      ∀ test : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool → ProbComp Bool,
        IsPPTOn (encPair (encPair encUnary encUnary) encBits)
          encBool (fun input => test input.1.1 input.1.2 input.2) →
        Negligible (fun n => Game.advantage
          (((uniformList (seedLength n (saved.length n) (observationBound n) (densityBound n)
            (choose n))).map (generate n (saved.length n) (observationBound n) (densityBound n)
              (choose n) (saved.evaluate n))).bind
                (fun word => ProbComp.eval (test n (choose n) word)))
          ((uniformList (outputLength n (saved.length n) (observationBound n) (densityBound n)
            (choose n))).bind (fun word => ProbComp.eval (test n (choose n) word)))) := by
  have hobservation := hobservation.tidy
  have hdensity := hdensity.tidy
  obtain ⟨choose, hvalid⟩ := exists_valid_choice hpair saved hgap
  refine ⟨choose, hvalid.mono (fun _ h => h.index_lt), ?_⟩
  intro test htest
  have hlength := saved.length_isPolyTime.tidy
  have h := hpair.extract_indexed_three saved choose
    (candidates := fun n => size (saved.length n) (densityBound n))
    (inverseSlack := fun n => dyadicSize (densityBound n) - 1)
    (observationBits := fun n i => observationBits n (saved.length n) (densityBound n) i)
    (labelBits := fun n i => labelBits n (saved.length n) (densityBound n) i)
    (remainingBits := fun n i => remainingBits n (saved.length n) (densityBound n) i)
    (numerator := fun n i => numerator (densityBound n) i)
    ⟨by polytime, .of_tidy hobservation, by polytime, by polytime, by polytime, by polytime,
      by polytime, .of_tidy hdensity⟩ hfits (hvalid.mono (fun _ h => h.index_lt))
    (hvalid.mono (fun n h => ⟨numerator_pos _ _, h.numerator_le, h.density_le⟩))
    (hvalid.mono (fun _ h => by simpa only [scale, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      using h.observation_budget))
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => by
      simpa only [scale, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
        (label_budget n (saved.length n) (densityBound n) (choose n)).le))
    (hvalid.mono (fun _ h => by simpa only [scale, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      using h.remaining_budget)) test htest
  unfold seedLength outputLength generate
  simp_rw [ThreeSource.eval_generate_of_realization saved _ _ _ _ _ _ (hfits _)]
  simpa only [ProbComp.eval_bind, BitString.eval_sampleList] using h

        seedLength n (sourceBits n) (observationBound n) (densityBound n) index ≤ common n := by
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at hsource
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at hobservation
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at hdensity

  have hseed : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun input => seedLength input.1 (sourceBits input.1)

theorem isPolyTime_hashSamples {α : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool}
    {count seedBits bound observationBits labelBits remainingBits : α → ℕ}
    {samples : α → List ((List Bool × Bool) × List Bool)}
    {firstKey middleKey lastKey : α → List Bool}
    (hcount : ComputableInPolyTime count input encUnary)
    (hseed : ComputableInPolyTime seedBits input encUnary)
    (hbound : ComputableInPolyTime bound input encUnary)
    (hobservation : ComputableInPolyTime observationBits input encUnary)
    (hlabel : ComputableInPolyTime labelBits input encUnary)
    (hremaining : ComputableInPolyTime remainingBits input encUnary)
    (hsamples : ComputableInPolyTime samples input
      (encList (encPair (encPair encBits encBool) encBits)))
    (hfirst : ComputableInPolyTime firstKey input encBits)
    (hmiddle : ComputableInPolyTime middleKey input encBits)
    (hlast : ComputableInPolyTime lastKey input encBits) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun a => hashSamples (count a) (seedBits a) (bound a)
      (observationBits a) (labelBits a) (remainingBits a) (samples a)
      (firstKey a) (middleKey a) (lastKey a)) input encBits := by
  let sampleEncoding := encPair (encPair encBits encBool) encBits
  have houter := ComputableInPolyTime.fst input sampleEncoding
  have hsample := ComputableInPolyTime.snd input sampleEncoding
  have hpad := ComputableInPolyTime.bitsPadWord (hbound.comp houter) hsample.fst'.fst'
  have hobservationWords := ComputableInPolyTime.mapWithInput
    (encB := encBits)
    (f := fun a (sample : (List Bool × Bool) × List Bool) => padWord (bound a) sample.1.1)
    hsamples (by simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hpad)
  have hobservations := ComputableInPolyTime.bitsFlatten hobservationWords
  have hlabelWord := ComputableInPolyTime.mapToBitsWithInput
    (f := fun (_ : α) (sample : (List Bool × Bool) × List Bool) => sample.1.2)
    hsamples hsample.fst'.snd'

/-- The ideal experiment has a strict PPT realization through its lazy cache. This does not
construct the exponentially large eager table; the entire adaptive interaction is certified. -/
theorem isPPT_prfIdealGame {adversary : OracleDistinguisher}
    (hadversary : IsOraclePPT encBool adversary) :
    IsPPT encBool (fun n _ => prfIdealGame adversary n) := by
  have hrun : IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary encBits)
      (encPair encBool (encList (encPair encBits encBits))) (fun pair : ℕ × List Bool =>
        (OracleComp.interpret
          (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin k))
            (fun request => cachedRandomFunctionOracle pair.1 request.2))
              (adversary pair.1 [])).run []) := by
    apply hadversary.run_interpret_preprocess
      (prepare := fun pair : ℕ × List Bool => (pair.1, []))
      (resources := fun pair query => 4 * query.length + 2 * pair.1 + 3)
      (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      (fun pair cache => ∀ entry ∈ cache, entry.2.length ≤ pair.1) (by simp) (by fun_prop)
    intro pair request cache hcache result hresult
    by_cases hquery : request.2.length = pair.1
    · simp only [cachedRandomFunctionOracle, hquery, ↓reduceIte] at hresult
      rw [ProbComp.eval_memoize] at hresult
      obtain ⟨hreply, hcache', hgrowth⟩ := memoize_call_size_le encBits encBits
        (fun _ => ProbComp.eval (BitString.sampleList pair.1)) request.2 cache pair.1
        hcache (fun value hvalue => by
          rw [BitString.eval_sampleList] at hvalue
          exact (BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hvalue).le) result hresult
      exact ⟨hcache', by simpa only [encBits_apply] using hreply.trans (by lia), by
        simpa only [encBits_apply, Nat.add_assoc] using hgrowth⟩
    · simp only [cachedRandomFunctionOracle, hquery, ↓reduceIte, ProbComp.eval_pure,
        PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hresult
      subst result
      exact ⟨hcache, by simp, by lia⟩
  exact ((hrun.map (ComputableInPolyTime.fst _ _)).isPPT).congr
