theorem exists_complexity_restriction_le {family : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool}
    (hfamily : ComputableInPolyTime (fun pair : List Bool × List Bool =>
      family pair.1 pair.2) (encPair encBits encBits) encBits) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ (key : List Bool) (m : ℕ), m ≤ key.length →
      complexity interpretation (single (restriction (family key) key.length m)) ≤
        c * (3 * key.length + 2) ^ c + 2 := by

  obtain ⟨L, hL, hg⟩ := PPoly.exists_of_polyTime
    (.of_tidy ((ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.headD (encA := encBool) false).comp hfamily))
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := mem_PPoly_iff_exists_mem_SIZE.1 hL
  refine ⟨c, fun key m hm => ?_⟩
  set t : List (Fin m ⊕ Bool) :=
    (frame key ++ List.replicate (key.length - m) false).map Sum.inr ++ List.ofFn Sum.inl
  have hlen : t.length = 3 * key.length + 1 := by
    simp only [t, List.length_append, List.length_map, length_frame, List.length_replicate,
      List.length_ofFn]
    omega

      fun z => L.slice t.length (substitute (fun j => t[j]) z) := by
    funext z

      rw [this]

private theorem extractNat_cast {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] {c z c' z' : ℕ}
    (hc : (c : ZMod q) ≠ c') :
    (extractNat q c z c' z' : ZMod q) = ((c : ZMod q) - c')⁻¹ * ((z : ZMod q) - z') := by

      add_zero]

private theorem specialSoundOn (setup : ℕ → PMF F.Desc) {k : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ}
    (hkq : ∀ d ∈ (setup n).support, 2 ^ k n ≤ F.order d) :
    (wordProtocol F (k n)).SpecialSoundOn (wordKeyGen F setup n) (wordRelation F)
      (wordExtract F (k n)) := by

      Probability.PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.mem_support_bind_iff, PMF.mem_support_pure_iff,

  have heq := F.encode_injective d (hz.symm.trans hz')

  obtain ⟨c, d, hlen⟩ := S.sign_ppt.length_le
  have hhandler : IsPPTOn
      (encPair (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits))
        (encPair (encPair (encFinite Unit) encBits) (encList encBits)))
      (encPair encBits (encList encBits))
      (fun pair : (ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool)) × ((Unit × List Bool) × List (List Bool)) =>
        S.signingOracle pair.1.2.2 pair.2.1 pair.2.2) := by
    unfold signingOracle
    ppt
  have hrun : IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary (encPair encBits encBits))
      (encPair (encPair encBits encBits) (encList encBits))
      (fun caller : ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool) =>
        (OracleComp.interpret
          (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin k))
            (S.signingOracle caller.2.2)) (adversary caller.1 caller.2.1)).run []) := by

      (prepare := fun caller : ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool) => (caller.1, caller.2.1))

      (resources := fun caller query =>

      (by fun_prop) hhandler (by fun_prop)
      (fun _ _ => True) (fun _ => trivial) (by fun_prop)
    intro caller request queried _ result hresult
    simp only [signingOracle, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure,
      PMF.mem_support_bind_iff, PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hresult
    obtain ⟨sig, hsig, rfl⟩ := hresult
    have hsigLen := hlen (caller.2.2, request.2) sig hsig
    simp only [encBits_apply, length_encPair] at hsigLen
    refine ⟨trivial, by lia, ?_⟩
    simp only [encList_cons, List.length_append, length_frame, encBits_apply]
    lia
  have hpost : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun pair : (ℕ × (List Bool × List Bool)) × ((List Bool × List Bool) × List (List Bool)) =>

  have hbound_poly : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => bound p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encUnary encUnary) encUnary := by

  intro adversary hadversary
  have hred := h.negligible (limitToOneQuery bound adversary)
    (isOraclePPT_limitToOneQuery (.of_tidy hbound_poly) hadversary)

      sig.length ≤ bound n msg.length := by
    intro msg sig hsig

    have h2 : 2 * keys.2.length + 1 + msg.length + 1 ≤ 2 * skBound n + msg.length + 2 := by lia
    exact h1.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h2 ds))
  have hrun := run_limitToOneQuery_eq_oneTimeSigningOracle S bound n keys.1 keys.2 hsigBound

      (ProbOracleComp.handler (fun k => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifFin k))
        (S.signingOracle keys.2))
      (limitToOneQuery bound adversary n keys.1)).run []) =
    Prod.map Prod.fst id <$> ((OracleComp.interpret

/-- Captured parameters, generator code, and the adversary compose through the public tactics. -/
@[program_certificate]
theorem isPPT_test {α : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool}
    {generator : α → List Bool → List Bool} {seedBits count : α → ℕ}
    {adversary : α → List Bool → ProbComp Bool} {challenge : α → List Bool}
    (hgenerator : ComputableInPolyTime (fun pair => generator pair.1 pair.2)
      (encPair input encBits) encBits)
    (hseedBits : ComputableInPolyTime seedBits input encUnary)
    (hcount : ComputableInPolyTime count input encUnary)
    (hadversary : IsPPTOn (encPair input encBits) encBool
      (fun pair => adversary pair.1 pair.2))
    (hchallenge : ComputableInPolyTime challenge input encBits) :
    IsPPTOn input encBool
      (fun a => test (generator a) (seedBits a) (count a) (adversary a) (challenge a)) := by
  let pairEncoding := encPair input encUnary
  let fullEncoding := encPair pairEncoding encBits
  have ha := ComputableInPolyTime.fst input encUnary
  have hi := ComputableInPolyTime.snd input encUnary
  have houter := ComputableInPolyTime.fst pairEncoding encBits
  have hsuffix := ComputableInPolyTime.snd pairEncoding encBits
  have hprepare : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : (α × ℕ) × List Bool => (p.1.1,
        iterate (generator p.1.1) (seedBits p.1.1) (count p.1.1 - (p.1.2 + 1))
          (challenge p.1.1 ++ p.2))) fullEncoding (encPair input encBits) := by
    apply ComputableInPolyTime.prod (ha.comp houter)
    apply polyTime_iterate
    · have hparam := ComputableInPolyTime.fst fullEncoding encBits
      have hword := ComputableInPolyTime.snd fullEncoding encBits
      have harg : ComputableInPolyTime
          (fun p : ((α × ℕ) × List Bool) × List Bool => (p.1.1.1, p.2))
          (encPair fullEncoding encBits) (encPair input encBits) :=
        ((ha.comp houter).comp hparam).prod hword
      exact hgenerator.comp harg
    · exact hseedBits.comp (ha.comp houter)
    · exact ComputableInPolyTime.unary_sub.comp
        ((hcount.comp (ha.comp houter)).prod
          (ComputableInPolyTime.unary_succ.comp (hi.comp houter)))
    · exact ComputableInPolyTime.bitsAppend (hchallenge.comp (ha.comp houter)) hsuffix
  have hsample := isPPTOn_sampleList.preprocess hi
  have hpost : IsPPTOn fullEncoding encBool (fun p : (α × ℕ) × List Bool =>
      adversary p.1.1 (iterate (generator p.1.1) (seedBits p.1.1)
        (count p.1.1 - (p.1.2 + 1)) (challenge p.1.1 ++ p.2))) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hadversary.preprocess hprepare
  have hyes := hsample.bind_with
    (second := fun p suffix => adversary p.1 (iterate (generator p.1) (seedBits p.1)
      (count p.1 - (p.2 + 1)) (challenge p.1 ++ suffix))) hpost
  have hcond := ComputableInPolyTime.unary_lt' hi (hcount.comp ha)
  have hfalse : IsPPTOn pairEncoding encBool (fun _ => pure false) :=
    (ComputableInPolyTime.const false).isPPTOn
  have hbranch := IsPPTOn.ite hcond.tidy hyes hfalse
  have hindex := isPPTOn_sampleBoundedIndex hcount
  simpa only [test, reduction, hop, pairEncoding, fullEncoding, Function.comp_def] using
    hindex.bind_with hbranch

@[program_certificate]
theorem isPPT_reduction {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {count : ℕ → ℕ}
    {adversary : Distinguisher} (hgenerator : ComputableInPolyTime generator encBits encBits)
    (hcount : ComputableInPolyTime count encUnary encUnary)
    (hadversary : IsPPT encBool adversary) :
    IsPPT encBool (reduction generator count adversary) := by
  have hgen : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun p : (ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool => generator p.2)
      (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits) encBits :=
    hgenerator.comp (ComputableInPolyTime.snd (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits)
  have hadv : IsPPTOn (encPair (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits) encBool
      (fun p => adversary p.1.1 p.2) := hadversary.on.preprocess
    ((ComputableInPolyTime.fst (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits).fst'.prod
      (ComputableInPolyTime.snd (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits))
  simpa only [IsPPT, test, reduction, hop, Function.comp_def] using
    (isPPT_test hgen (ComputableInPolyTime.fst encUnary encBits)
      (hcount.comp (ComputableInPolyTime.fst encUnary encBits)) hadv
      (ComputableInPolyTime.snd encUnary encBits))

theorem loss_polynomial {count : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hcount : ComputableInPolyTime count encUnary encUnary) :
    PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => 2 ^ (Nat.log 2 (count n) + 1)) := by

  exact dyadicSize_polynomiallyBounded.comp hcount.polynomiallyBounded

theorem indexed_indistinguishable {generator : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool → List Bool}
    {seedBits count choose : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hgenerator : ComputableInPolyTime
      (fun input => generator input.1.1 input.1.2 input.2)
      (encPair (encPair encUnary encUnary) encBits) encBits)
    (hseedBits : ComputableInPolyTime seedBits encUnary encUnary)
    (hcount : ComputableInPolyTime count encUnary encUnary)
    (hsecure : ∀ adversary : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool → ProbComp Bool,
      IsPPTOn (encPair (encPair encUnary encUnary) encBits)
        encBool (fun input => adversary input.1.1 input.1.2 input.2) →
      Negligible (fun n => Game.advantage
        (((uniformList (seedBits n)).map (generator n (choose n))).bind
          (fun word => ProbComp.eval (adversary n (choose n) word)))
        ((uniformList (seedBits n + 1)).bind
          (fun word => ProbComp.eval (adversary n (choose n) word))))) :
    ∀ adversary : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool → ProbComp Bool,
      IsPPTOn (encPair (encPair encUnary encUnary) encBits)
        encBool (fun input => adversary input.1.1 input.1.2 input.2) →
      Negligible (fun n => Game.advantage
        (((uniformList (seedBits n)).map
          (iterate (generator n (choose n)) (seedBits n) (count n))).bind
            (fun word => ProbComp.eval (adversary n (choose n) word)))
        ((uniformList (seedBits n + count n)).bind
          (fun word => ProbComp.eval (adversary n (choose n) word)))) := by
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at hgenerator
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at hseedBits
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at hcount
  intro adversary hadversary
  let reduction := fun n index =>
    test (generator n index) (seedBits n) (count n) (adversary n index)
  have hprepare : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ((ℕ × ℕ) × List Bool) × List Bool => (p.1.1, p.2))
      (encPair (encPair (encPair encUnary encUnary) encBits) encBits)
      (encPair (encPair encUnary encUnary) encBits) := by fun_prop
  have hreduce : IsPPTOn (encPair (encPair encUnary encUnary) encBits)
      encBool (fun input => reduction input.1.1 input.1.2 input.2) := by
    unfold reduction
    exact isPPT_test (.of_tidy (hgenerator.comp hprepare)) (.of_tidy (by polytime))
      (.of_tidy (by polytime))
      (hadversary.preprocess (.of_tidy hprepare)) (.of_tidy (by polytime))
  have h := (hsecure reduction hreduce).polynomiallyBounded_mul (loss_polynomial (.of_tidy hcount))
  exact h.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (test_advantage_eq _ _ _ _).symm))

theorem indistinguishable {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {count : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hgenerator : PseudorandomGenerator generator (fun n => n + 1))
    (hcount : ComputableInPolyTime count encUnary encUnary) :
    ComputationallyIndistinguishable (generatorEnsemble (stretch generator count))
      (fun n => uniformList (n + count n)) := by
  have hcount := hcount.tidy
  intro adversary hadversary
  have hreduce := isPPT_reduction hgenerator.polyTime (.of_tidy hcount) hadversary
  have hnegligible := hgenerator.indistinguishable _ hreduce
  have hloss := hnegligible.polynomiallyBounded_mul (loss_polynomial (.of_tidy hcount))
  convert hloss using 1
  funext n
  simpa only [eval_prgRealGame, eval_prgIdealGame] using
    advantage_eq generator count adversary n

theorem pseudorandomGenerator {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {count : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hgenerator : PseudorandomGenerator generator (fun n => n + 1))
    (hcount : ComputableInPolyTime count encUnary encUnary)
    (hpositive : ∀ n, 0 < count n) :
    PseudorandomGenerator (stretch generator count) (fun n => n + count n) := by
  have hcount := hcount.tidy
  refine PseudorandomGenerator.of_indistinguishable
    (polyTime_stretch hgenerator.polyTime (.of_tidy hcount)) ?_ ?_
    (indistinguishable hgenerator (.of_tidy hcount))
  · intro seed
    exact length_iterate hgenerator.length_eq _ _ _
  · intro n
    exact Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (hpositive n)

theorem PseudorandomGenerator.amplify {generator : List Bool → List Bool}
    (hgenerator : PseudorandomGenerator generator (fun n => n + 1))
    (target : ℕ → ℕ) (htarget : ComputableInPolyTime target encUnary encUnary)
    (hstretch : ∀ n, n < target n) :
    PseudorandomGenerator (PRGStretch.stretch generator (fun n => target n - n)) target := by
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at htarget
  have hcount : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun n => target n - n) encUnary encUnary := by polytime
  have h := PRGStretch.pseudorandomGenerator hgenerator (.of_tidy hcount) (fun n => by
    have := hstretch n
    lia)
  convert h using 1
  funext n
  have := hstretch n
  lia

theorem PseudorandomGenerator.truncate {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {length : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hgenerator : PseudorandomGenerator generator length)
    (target : ℕ → ℕ)
    (htarget : ComputableInPolyTime target encUnary encUnary)
    (hle : ∀ n, target n ≤ length n) (hstretch : ∀ n, n < target n) :
    PseudorandomGenerator (fun seed => (generator seed).take (target seed.length)) target := by
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at htarget
  have hpoly := hgenerator.polyTime.tidy
  refine PseudorandomGenerator.of_indistinguishable (.of_tidy (by polytime)) ?_ hstretch ?_
  · intro seed
    simp only [List.length_take, hgenerator.length_eq, Nat.min_eq_left (hle _)]
  · have h := hgenerator.indistinguishable.map
      (f := fun n word => word.take (target n)) (by polytime)
    simpa only [← generatorEnsemble_postprocess generator (fun n word => word.take (target n)),
      uniformList_take (hle _)] using h

theorem polyTime_iterate {α : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool}
    {generator : α → List Bool → List Bool} {seedBits count : α → ℕ} {word : α → List Bool}
    (hgenerator : ComputableInPolyTime (fun pair => generator pair.1 pair.2)
      (encPair input encBits) encBits)
    (hseedBits : ComputableInPolyTime seedBits input encUnary)
    (hcount : ComputableInPolyTime count input encUnary)
    (hword : ComputableInPolyTime word input encBits) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (fun a => iterate (generator a) (seedBits a) (count a) (word a))
      input encBits := by
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at hgenerator
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at hseedBits
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at hcount
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime] at hword
  simp only [Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInPolyTime_iff_computableTidilyInPolyTime]
  obtain ⟨c, d, hlength⟩ := hgenerator.polyBounded_length.exists_le
  have hpoly : PolyBounded (fun a => (input a).length)
      (fun a => c * (2 * (input a).length + seedBits a + 2) ^ d) :=
    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.polyBounded (by fun_prop)
  have hgrowth (a : α) (state : List Bool) :
      (generator a (state.take (seedBits a)) ++ state.drop (seedBits a)).length ≤
        state.length + c * (2 * (input a).length + seedBits a + 2) ^ d := by
    have h := hlength (a, state.take (seedBits a))
    simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply, List.length_take] at h
    have hbound : (generator a (state.take (seedBits a))).length ≤
        c * (2 * (input a).length + seedBits a + 2) ^ d :=
      h.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by lia) d))
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_drop]
    lia
  unfold iterate step
  polytime

private theorem iterate_of_forwardIterate {γ : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
    {generator : γ → List Bool → List Bool} {seed : γ → List Bool} {count : γ → ℕ}
    (hlen : ∀ x s, (generator x s).length = s.length + 1) {t s : γ → ℕ}
    (h : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (fun x => forwardIterate (generator x) (count x) (seed x))
      encIn encBits t s) :
    ∃ c, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace
      (fun x => iterate (generator x) (seed x).length (count x) (seed x)) encIn encBits
      (fun x => c * (t x + (seed x).length + count x + 1))
      (fun x => c * (s x + (seed x).length + count x + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨c, hrev⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.reverse_bits.comp h
  have heq : (List.reverse ∘ fun x => forwardIterate (generator x) (count x) (seed x)) =
      fun x => iterate (generator x) (seed x).length (count x) (seed x) :=
    funext fun x => reverse_forwardIterate_eq_iterate_of_forall (hlen x) (seed x) (count x)
  rw [heq] at hrev
  refine ⟨c + 13, hrev.mono (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_)⟩ <;>
  · simp only [encBits_apply, length_forwardIterate_of_forall (hlen x)]
    nlinarith

reversed final seed. Each round runs the generator twice, once for the next seed and once for the

theorem computableInTimeAndSpace_forwardIterate
    {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {tGen sGen : List Bool → ℕ}
    (hlen : ∀ s, (generator s).length = s.length + 1)
    (hgen : ComputableInTimeAndSpace generator encBits encBits tGen sGen)
    {Q : List Bool × ℕ → ℕ}
    (hspace : ∀ p i, i < p.2 → sGen (seedAt generator p.1 i) ≤ Q p) :
    ∃ c, ComputableInTimeAndSpace
      (fun p : List Bool × ℕ => forwardIterate generator p.2 p.1)
      (encPair encBits encUnary) encBits
      (fun p => c * (p.1.length + p.2 +
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.2, (tGen (seedAt generator p.1 i) + p.1.length + 1)) + 1))
      (fun p => c * (Q p + p.1.length + 1)) := by
  have build
      {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {tGen sGen : List Bool → ℕ}
      (hlen : ∀ s, (generator s).length = s.length + 1)
      (hgen : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace generator encBits encBits tGen sGen)
      {Q : List Bool × ℕ → ℕ}
      (hspace : ∀ p i, i < p.2 → sGen (seedAt generator p.1 i) ≤ Q p) :
      ∃ c, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace
        (fun p : List Bool × ℕ => forwardIterate generator p.2 p.1)
        (encPair encBits encUnary) encBits
        (fun p => c * (p.1.length + p.2 +
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.2, (tGen (seedAt generator p.1 i) + p.1.length + 1)) + 1))
        (fun p => c * (Q p + p.1.length + 1)) := by
    obtain ⟨c₁, hnext₀⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.dropLast_bits.comp hgen
    obtain ⟨c₂, hemit₀⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.getLast?_toList_bits.comp hgen
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K, K = c₁ + c₂ + 30 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hnext : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (seedStep generator) encBits encBits
        (fun s => tGen s + K * (s.length + 1)) (fun s => sGen s + K * (s.length + 1)) :=
      hnext₀.mono (fun s => by simp only [encBits_apply, hlen]; nlinarith)
        (fun s => by simp only [encBits_apply, hlen]; nlinarith)
    have hemit : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (emitBit generator) encBits encBits
        (fun s => tGen s + K * (s.length + 1)) (fun s => sGen s + K * (s.length + 1)) :=
      hemit₀.mono (fun s => by simp only [encBits_apply, hlen]; nlinarith)
        (fun s => by simp only [encBits_apply, hlen]; nlinarith)
    obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := hnext.iterate_unary_stream_sum hemit
      ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.reverse_bits
      (R := fun p i => (2 * K + 2) * (tGen (seedAt generator p.1 i) + p.1.length + 1))
      (Q := fun p => 2 * Q p + 2 * K * (p.1.length + 1)) (B := fun p => p.1.length)
      (fun p i _ => by
        simp only [iterate_seedStep, encBits_apply, length_seedAt_of_forall hlen]
        nlinarith)
      (fun p i hi => by
        have := hspace p i hi
        simp only [iterate_seedStep, length_seedAt_of_forall hlen]
        nlinarith)
      (fun p i _ => by
        simp only [iterate_seedStep, encBits_apply, length_seedAt_of_forall hlen]
        rfl)
    refine ⟨c * (2 * K + 6), ?_⟩
    simp only [forwardIterate_eq]
    refine h.mono (fun p => ?_) (fun p => ?_) <;>
      simp only [iterate_seedStep, length_seedAt_of_forall hlen,
        ← Finset.mul_sum, Nat.mul_assoc] <;>
      refine Nat.mul_le_mul_left c ?_
    · generalize ∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.2, (tGen (seedAt generator p.1 i) + p.1.length + 1) = S
      nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (K * p.1.length), Nat.zero_le (K * p.2)]
    · nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (K * Q p)]
  have hcharged := hgen.mono (fun _ => le_rfl)
    (fun seed => Nat.le_add_right (sGen seed) (seed.length + 1))
  obtain ⟨a, hclean, _⟩ := hcharged.computableTidilyInO (fun seed => by
    simp only [encBits_apply, hlen]
    omega)
  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := build hlen hclean
    (Q := fun p => a * (Q p + p.1.length + 2)) (fun p i hi => by
      have hs := hspace p i hi
      simp only [length_seedAt_of_forall hlen]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left a (by omega))
  refine ⟨c * (2 * a + 3), h.computableInTimeAndSpace.mono ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro p
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc]
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left c
    have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.range p.2)
      (fun i _ => show a * (tGen (seedAt generator p.1 i) + 1) + p.1.length + 1 ≤
        (a + 1) * (tGen (seedAt generator p.1 i) + p.1.length + 1) by nlinarith)

        omega
      _ ≤ (a + 1) * (p.1.length + p.2 +
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.2, (tGen (seedAt generator p.1 i) + p.1.length + 1)) + 1) := by
        nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (a * (p.1.length + p.2 + 1))]
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
  · intro p
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc]

/-- **Quantitative cumulative-time and workspace certificate for `PRGStretch.iterate`.**
The proof composes `forwardIterate` with the linear-time zero-workspace tidy reversal primitive
`ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.reverse_bits` produces the exact output of
`iterate generator p.1.length p.2 p.1`. The time bound remains
`O(n + k + ∑_{i < k} (tGen(seed_i) + n + 1))`, while the workspace bound `O(Q + n + k + 1)`
explicitly includes the `(n + k)`-bit intermediate reversal buffer. -/

text:
theorem computableInTimeAndSpace_stretch
    {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {count : ℕ → ℕ}
    {tGen sGen : List Bool → ℕ} {tCount sCount : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hlen : ∀ s, (generator s).length = s.length + 1)
    (hgen : ComputableInTimeAndSpace generator encBits encBits tGen sGen)
    (hcount : ComputableInTimeAndSpace count encUnary encUnary tCount sCount)
    {Q : List Bool → ℕ}
    (hspace : ∀ seed i, i < count seed.length → sGen (seedAt generator seed i) ≤ Q seed) :
    ∃ c, ComputableInTimeAndSpace (stretch generator count) encBits encBits
      (fun seed => c * (tCount seed.length + seed.length + count seed.length +
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (count seed.length),
          (tGen (seedAt generator seed i) + seed.length + 1)) + 1))
      (fun seed => c * (sCount seed.length + Q seed + seed.length + count seed.length + 1)) := by
  have hcountCharged := hcount.mono (fun _ => le_rfl)
    (fun n => Nat.le_add_right (sCount n) (count n))
  obtain ⟨a, hcountClean, _⟩ := hcountCharged.computableTidilyInO (fun n => by
    simp only [encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate]
    omega)
  obtain ⟨c₁, hcnt_seed⟩ := hcountClean.comp ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.length_bits
  obtain ⟨c₂, hpair⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.bigO
    (PairEncoding.pair_mono (enc := encPair encBits encUnary)
      (computableTidilyInTimeAndSpace_id (enc := encBits)).computableInTimeAndSpace
      hcnt_seed.computableInTimeAndSpace)
  obtain ⟨c₃, hiter⟩ := computableInTimeAndSpace_iterate_pair hlen hgen
    (Q := fun p => Finset.sup (Finset.range p.2) (fun i => sGen (seedAt generator p.1 i)))
    (fun p i hi => Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => sGen (seedAt generator p.1 j))

`(dCount, eCount)`, then under the one-bit length promise `(generator s).length = s.length + 1`,
`stretch generator count` is computable in time/space degree `max dCount (eCount + max dGen 1)` and
output-size degree `max 1 eCount`. -/

theorem computableInDegree_stretch
    {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {count : ℕ → ℕ}
    {dGen eGen dCount eCount : ℕ}
    (hlen : ∀ s, (generator s).length = s.length + 1)
    (hgen : ComputableInDegree generator encBits encBits dGen eGen)
    (hcount : ComputableInDegree count encUnary encUnary dCount eCount) :
    ComputableInDegree (stretch generator count) encBits encBits
      (max dCount (eCount + max dGen 1)) (max 1 eCount) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨tGen, sGen, ⟨ctG, hctG⟩, ⟨csG, hcsG⟩, hgen_ts⟩, -⟩ := hgen
  obtain ⟨⟨tCount, sCount, ⟨ctC, hctC⟩, ⟨csC, hcsC⟩, hcount_ts⟩, ⟨clC, hclC⟩⟩ := hcount
  obtain ⟨c, hstretch⟩ := computableInTimeAndSpace_stretch hlen hgen_ts hcount_ts
    (Q := fun seed => csG * (seed.length + 1) ^ dGen)
    (fun seed i _ => by
      simpa only [encBits_apply, length_seedAt_of_forall hlen] using
        hcsG (seedAt generator seed i))
  let size : List Bool → ℕ := fun seed => (encBits seed).length
  let d := max dCount (eCount + max dGen 1)
  have hdCount : dCount ≤ d := le_max_left _ _
  have heGen : eCount + max dGen 1 ≤ d := le_max_right _ _
  have hdGen : dGen ≤ d := (le_max_left dGen 1).trans ((Nat.le_add_left _ eCount).trans heGen)
  have h1 : 1 ≤ d := (le_max_right dGen 1).trans ((Nat.le_add_left _ eCount).trans heGen)
  have heCount : eCount ≤ d := (Nat.le_add_right eCount (max dGen 1)).trans heGen
  have htC : DegreeBounded size (fun seed => tCount seed.length) d :=
    DegreeBounded.mono_deg ⟨ctC, fun s => by simpa [size] using hctC s.length⟩ hdCount
  have hsC : DegreeBounded size (fun seed => sCount seed.length) d :=
    DegreeBounded.mono_deg ⟨csC, fun s => by simpa [size] using hcsC s.length⟩ hdCount
  have hlC_e : DegreeBounded size (fun seed => count seed.length) eCount :=
    ⟨clC, fun s => by simpa [size] using hclC s.length⟩
  have hlC : DegreeBounded size (fun seed => count seed.length) d :=
    hlC_e.mono_deg heCount
  have hseed : DegreeBounded size List.length d :=
    DegreeBounded.self.mono_deg h1
  have hQ : DegreeBounded size (fun seed => csG * (seed.length + 1) ^ dGen) d :=
    DegreeBounded.mono_deg ⟨csG, fun _ => le_rfl⟩ hdGen
  have hround : DegreeBounded size
      (fun seed => ctG * (seed.length + 1) ^ dGen + seed.length + 1) (max dGen 1) :=
    ((DegreeBounded.mono_deg ⟨ctG, fun _ => le_rfl⟩ (le_max_left dGen 1)).add
      (DegreeBounded.self.mono_deg (le_max_right dGen 1))).add_const 1
  have hsum : DegreeBounded size
      (fun seed => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (count seed.length),
        (tGen (seedAt generator seed i) + seed.length + 1)) d := by
    refine ((hlC_e.mul hround).mono_deg heGen).mono (fun seed => ?_)
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (count seed.length),
          (tGen (seedAt generator seed i) + seed.length + 1)
      _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range (count seed.length),
          (ctG * (seed.length + 1) ^ dGen + seed.length + 1) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        have ht := hctG (seedAt generator seed i)
        simp only [encBits_apply, length_seedAt_of_forall hlen] at ht
        omega
      _ = count seed.length * (ctG * (seed.length + 1) ^ dGen + seed.length + 1) := by
        simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, smul_eq_mul]
  have hout : DegreeBounded size (fun seed => (encBits (stretch generator count seed)).length)
      (max 1 eCount) := by
    refine ((DegreeBounded.self.mono_deg (le_max_left 1 eCount)).add
      (hlC_e.mono_deg (le_max_right 1 eCount))).mono (fun seed => ?_)
    simp [stretch, length_iterate hlen, size]
  exact ⟨⟨_, _, (((htC.add hseed).add hlC).add hsum).add_const 1 |>.smul c,
    (((hsC.add hQ).add hseed).add hlC).add_const 1 |>.smul c, hstretch⟩, hout⟩

theorem polyTime_stretch_of_length_eq {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {count : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hlen : ∀ s, (generator s).length = s.length + 1)
    (hgenerator : ComputableInPolyTime generator encBits encBits)
    (hcount : ComputableInPolyTime count encUnary encUnary) :
    ComputableInPolyTime (stretch generator count) encBits encBits := by
  have hgenerator := hgenerator.tidy
  have hcount := hcount.tidy
  obtain ⟨clG, dlG, hclG⟩ := (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy hgenerator).polyBounded_length.exists_le
  obtain ⟨tG, sG, htG, hsG, hgen_ts⟩ := hgenerator
  obtain ⟨ctG, dtG, hctG⟩ := htG.exists_le
  obtain ⟨csG, dsG, hcsG⟩ := hsG.exists_le
  obtain ⟨clC, dlC, hclC⟩ := (ComputableInPolyTime.of_tidy hcount).polyBounded_length.exists_le
  obtain ⟨tC, sC, htC, hsC, hcount_ts⟩ := hcount
  obtain ⟨ctC, dtC, hctC⟩ := htC.exists_le
  obtain ⟨csC, dsC, hcsC⟩ := hsC.exists_le
  have hgen_deg : ComputableInDegree generator encBits encBits (max dtG dsG) dlG :=
    ⟨⟨tG, sG, DegreeBounded.mono_deg ⟨ctG, hctG⟩ (le_max_left _ _),
      DegreeBounded.mono_deg ⟨csG, hcsG⟩ (le_max_right _ _),
      hgen_ts.computableInTimeAndSpace⟩, ⟨clG, hclG⟩⟩
  have hcount_deg : ComputableInDegree count encUnary encUnary (max dtC dsC) dlC :=
    ⟨⟨tC, sC, DegreeBounded.mono_deg ⟨ctC, hctC⟩ (le_max_left _ _),
      DegreeBounded.mono_deg ⟨csC, hcsC⟩ (le_max_right _ _),
      hcount_ts.computableInTimeAndSpace⟩, ⟨clC, hclC⟩⟩
  exact (computableInDegree_stretch hlen hgen_deg hcount_deg).computableInPolyTime

theorem computableInTimeAndSpace_forwardIterate_captured {α : Type}
    {encParam : α ↪ List Bool} {generator : α → List Bool → List Bool}
    {tGen sGen : α × List Bool → ℕ}
    (hlen : ∀ a s, (generator a s).length = s.length + 1)
    (hgen : ComputableInTimeAndSpace (fun p : α × List Bool => generator p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encParam encBits) encBits tGen sGen)
    {Q : (α × List Bool) × ℕ → ℕ}
    (hspace : ∀ x i, i < x.2 → sGen (x.1.1, seedAt (generator x.1.1) x.1.2 i) ≤ Q x) :
    ∃ c, ComputableInTimeAndSpace
      (fun x : (α × List Bool) × ℕ => forwardIterate (generator x.1.1) x.2 x.1.2)
      (encPair (encPair encParam encBits) encUnary) encBits
      (fun x => c * ((encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + x.2 +
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range x.2,
          (tGen (x.1.1, seedAt (generator x.1.1) x.1.2 i) +
            (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1)) + 1))
      (fun x => c * (Q x + (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1)) := by
  -- Retain the captured streaming construction as a proof-local raw witness.
  have build {α : Type}
      {encParam : α ↪ List Bool} {generator : α → List Bool → List Bool}
      {tGen sGen : α × List Bool → ℕ}
      (hlen : ∀ a s, (generator a s).length = s.length + 1)
      (hgen : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (fun p : α × List Bool => generator p.1 p.2)
        (encPair encParam encBits) encBits tGen sGen)
      {Q : (α × List Bool) × ℕ → ℕ}
      (hspace : ∀ x i, i < x.2 → sGen (x.1.1, seedAt (generator x.1.1) x.1.2 i) ≤ Q x) :
      ∃ c, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace
        (fun x : (α × List Bool) × ℕ => forwardIterate (generator x.1.1) x.2 x.1.2)
        (encPair (encPair encParam encBits) encUnary) encBits
        (fun x => c * ((encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + x.2 +
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range x.2,
            (tGen (x.1.1, seedAt (generator x.1.1) x.1.2 i) +
              (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1)) + 1))
        (fun x => c * (Q x + (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1)) := by
    let encS := encPair encParam encBits
    obtain ⟨cpar, hpar⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear
      (PairEncoding.fst (enc₁ := encParam) (enc₂ := encBits) (enc := encS))
    obtain ⟨csnd, hsnd⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear
      (PairEncoding.snd (enc₁ := encParam) (enc₂ := encBits) (enc := encS))
    obtain ⟨c₁, hdrop⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.dropLast_bits.comp hgen
    obtain ⟨cpair, hnext₀⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.bigO
      (PairEncoding.pair_mono (enc := encS)
        (ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.computableInTimeAndSpace hpar)
        hdrop.computableInTimeAndSpace)
    obtain ⟨c₂, hemit₀⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.getLast?_toList_bits.comp hgen
    obtain ⟨c₃, hfin₀⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.reverse_bits.comp hsnd
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K, K = cpair * (cpar + c₁ + 30) + c₂ + c₃ + csnd + 30 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hseed (q : α × List Bool) : q.2.length + 1 ≤ (encS q).length + 1 := by
      simp only [encS, length_encPair, encBits_apply]
      omega
    have hnext : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace
        (fun q : α × List Bool => (q.1, seedStep (generator q.1) q.2)) encS encS
        (fun q => cpair * tGen q + K * ((encS q).length + 1))
        (fun q => cpair * sGen q + K * ((encS q).length + 1)) := by
      refine ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.mono hnext₀ (fun q => ?_) (fun q => ?_) <;>
      · have hd : (encS (q.1, (generator q.1 q.2).dropLast)).length = (encS q).length := by
          simp only [encS, length_encPair, encBits_apply, List.length_dropLast, hlen,
            Nat.add_sub_cancel]

        have hKE := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ((encS q).length + 1)

        have hc := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cpair (show 8 * q.2.length + 26 + c₁ + (encS q).length ≤
          (c₁ + 30) * ((encS q).length + 1) by nlinarith)
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, encBits_apply, hlen, hd]
        nlinarith
    have hemit : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace
        (fun q : α × List Bool => emitBit (generator q.1) q.2) encS encBits
        (fun q => tGen q + K * ((encS q).length + 1))
        (fun q => sGen q + K * ((encS q).length + 1)) := by
      refine hemit₀.mono (fun q => ?_) (fun q => ?_) <;>
      · have hs := hseed q
        have hKE := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ((encS q).length + 1) (show c₂ + 30 ≤ K by omega)
        simp only [encBits_apply, hlen]
        nlinarith
    have hfin : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (fun q : α × List Bool => q.2.reverse) encS encBits
        (fun q => K * ((encS q).length + 1)) (fun q => K * ((encS q).length + 1)) := by
      refine hfin₀.mono (fun q => ?_) (fun q => ?_) <;>
      · have hs := hseed q
        have hKE := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ((encS q).length + 1) (show csnd + c₃ + 30 ≤ K by omega)
        simp only [encBits_apply]
        nlinarith

          2 * (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1 := by
      simp only [encS, length_encPair, encBits_apply, length_seedAt_of_forall (hlen x.1.1)]

      (R := fun x i => (cpair + 4 * K + 6) * (tGen (x.1.1, seedAt (generator x.1.1) x.1.2 i) +
        (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1))
      (Q := fun x => (cpair + 1) * Q x + 4 * K * ((encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1))
      (B := fun x => 2 * (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1)
      (fun x i _ => by
        simp only [iterate_seedStep_captured, hS]
        nlinarith)
      (fun x i hi => by
        have := hspace x i hi
        simp only [iterate_seedStep_captured, hS]
        nlinarith)
      (fun x i _ => by simp only [iterate_seedStep_captured, hS]; rfl)
    simp only [iterate_seedStep_captured, hS] at h
    refine ⟨c * (cpair + 6 * K + 10), ?_⟩
    simp only [forwardIterate_eq]
    refine h.mono (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_) <;>
      simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, Nat.mul_assoc] <;> refine Nat.mul_le_mul_left c ?_
    · generalize ∑ i ∈ Finset.range x.2, (tGen (x.1.1, seedAt (generator x.1.1) x.1.2 i) +
        (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1) = S
      nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (K * (encParam x.1.1).length), Nat.zero_le (K * x.1.2.length),
        Nat.zero_le (K * x.2), Nat.zero_le (cpair * x.2)]
    · nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (K * Q x), Nat.zero_le (cpair * Q x)]
  have hcharged := hgen.mono (fun _ => le_rfl)
    (fun q => Nat.le_add_right (sGen q) ((encParam q.1).length + q.2.length + 1))
  obtain ⟨a, hclean, _⟩ := hcharged.computableTidilyInO (fun q => by
    simp only [encBits_apply, hlen]
    omega)
  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := build hlen hclean
    (Q := fun x => a * (Q x + (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 2))
    (fun x i hi => by
      have hs := hspace x i hi
      simp only [length_seedAt_of_forall (hlen x.1.1)]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left a (by omega))
  refine ⟨c * (2 * a + 3), h.computableInTimeAndSpace.mono ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc]
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left c
    have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.range x.2)
      (fun i _ => show
        a * (tGen (x.1.1, seedAt (generator x.1.1) x.1.2 i) + 1) +
          (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1 ≤
        (a + 1) * (tGen (x.1.1, seedAt (generator x.1.1) x.1.2 i) +
          (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1) by nlinarith)
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at hsum
    calc
      _ ≤ (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + x.2 + (a + 1) *
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range x.2, (tGen (x.1.1, seedAt (generator x.1.1) x.1.2 i) +
            (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      _ ≤ (a + 1) * ((encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + x.2 +
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range x.2, (tGen (x.1.1, seedAt (generator x.1.1) x.1.2 i) +
            (encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + 1)) + 1) := by
        nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (a * ((encParam x.1.1).length + x.1.2.length + x.2 + 1))]
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)

    rw [Nat.mul_assoc]
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left c

theorem AuxiliaryInputZeroKnowledge.generableZeroKnowledge {α : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool}
    {prover : ℕ → α → List Bool → Prover Unit} {isWitness : α → List Bool → Bool}
    (h : AuxiliaryInputZeroKnowledge enc prover isWitness) :
    GenerableZeroKnowledge enc prover isWitness := by
  intro Vstar hV
  obtain ⟨S, hS_ppt, hS_zk⟩ := h Vstar hV
  refine ⟨S, hS_ppt, fun a w z ha hw hz hw_sat adversary hadversary => ?_⟩
  have ha_poly : PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => (enc (a n)).length) :=
    ((encoding_length enc).comp ha.tidy).polynomiallyBounded
  have hw_poly : PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => (w n).length) :=
    ((encoding_length encBits).comp hw.tidy).polynomiallyBounded
  have hz_poly : PolynomiallyBounded (fun n => (z n).length) :=
    ((encoding_length encBits).comp hz.tidy).polynomiallyBounded
  have htest : IsPPTOn (encPair (encPair encUnary (encPair enc encBits)) encBits) encBool
      (fun p => adversary p.1.1 p.2) :=
    hadversary.preprocess (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  exact hS_zk a w z ha_poly hw_poly hz_poly hw_sat (fun n _ _ view => adversary n view) htest

theorem GenerableZeroKnowledge.advantage_negligible {α : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool}
    {prover : ℕ → α → List Bool → Prover Unit} {isWitness : α → List Bool → Bool}
    (h : GenerableZeroKnowledge enc prover isWitness)
    {Vstar : ℕ → α → List Bool → WordOracleComp Unit (List Bool)}
    (hV : IsOraclePPTOn (encPair encUnary (encPair enc encBits)) encBits
      (fun p : ℕ × α × List Bool => Vstar p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :
    ∃ S : ℕ → α → List Bool → ProbComp (List Bool),
      IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary (encPair enc encBits)) encBits
        (fun p : ℕ × α × List Bool => S p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
      ∀ (a : ℕ → α) (w z : ℕ → List Bool),
        ComputableInPolyTime a encUnary enc →
        ComputableInPolyTime w encUnary encBits →
        ComputableInPolyTime z encUnary encBits →
        (∀ n, isWitness (a n) (w n) = true) →
        ∀ adversary : ℕ → α → List Bool → List Bool → ProbComp Bool,
          IsPPTOn (encPair (encPair encUnary (encPair enc encBits)) encBits) encBool
            (fun p => adversary p.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.1.2.2 p.2) →
          Negligible (fun n => Game.advantage
            (distinguishingGame
              (((prover n (a n) (w n)).run (Vstar n (a n) (z n))
                (prover n (a n) (w n)).init).map Prod.fst)
              (adversary n (a n) (z n)))
            (distinguishingGame
              (ProbComp.eval (S n (a n) (z n)))
              (adversary n (a n) (z n)))) := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS_ppt, hS_zk⟩ := h Vstar hV
  refine ⟨S, hS_ppt, fun a w z ha hw hz hw_sat adversary hadversary => ?_⟩
  have ha_tidy := ha.tidy
  have hz_tidy := hz.tidy
  have hD : IsPPT encBool (fun n view => adversary n (a n) (z n) view) :=
    hadversary.preprocess
      (input := encPair encUnary encBits)
      (prepare := fun p => ((p.1, a p.1, z p.1), p.2))
      (by fun_prop)
  exact hS_zk a w z ha hw hz hw_sat (fun n view => adversary n (a n) (z n) view) hD

/-! ### Bundled computational zero-knowledge proof systems -/

/-- A computational zero-knowledge interactive proof system for a language `A : Set α` (with
instance encoding `enc : α ↪ List Bool`), indexed by a security parameter `n : ℕ` [Goldreich,
Micali, and Wigderson][GoldreichMicaliWigderson1991].

* `verifier n a`: the honest verifier's interactive program on security parameter `n` and
  instance `a`, certified uniform strict oracle PPT in `(1^n, a)` by `isOraclePPT_verifier`.
* `prover n a w`: the honest prover strategy on security parameter `n`, instance `a`, and
  witness `w`, certified efficient by `interact`, `eval_interact`, and `isPPT_interact`.
* `isWitness a w`: the bundled polynomial-time witness predicate characterizing membership in `A`
  (`mem_iff_exists_witness`). No witness-length bound is imposed, so `isWitness` by itself need
  not be an `NP` relation (in `zero_knowledge`, `w` is polynomial-time-generable in `1^n`). When
  constructed via a Karp reduction `f : α → CNF ℕ` to `ThreeSAT`
  (`PseudorandomGenerator.zeroKnowledgeProofOfReduction`),
  `isWitness a w` is `ThreeSAT.verifier (f a, w)`, checking a `ThreeSAT` witness for `f a`.
* `complete` and `sound`: completeness `1` for valid witnesses and soundness error at most `1 / 3`
  against all computationally unbounded stateful provers `P : Prover Unit`.
* `zero_knowledge`: **uniform zero-knowledge with poly-time-generable families**
  (`GenerableZeroKnowledge enc prover isWitness`). For every uniform strict oracle PPT malicious
  verifier `Vstar` (taking security parameter `n`, instance `a`, and auxiliary input `z`), there is
  a uniform strict PPT simulator `S` (taking `(1^n, a, z)` without any witness) whose output
  ensemble is computationally indistinguishable from the real interaction output across all
  deterministic polynomial-time-generable families of instances `a : ℕ → α`, valid witnesses
  `w : ℕ → List Bool`, and auxiliary inputs `z : ℕ → List Bool`
  (`ComputableInPolyTime · encUnary _`). The stronger general auxiliary-input property over
  arbitrary polynomially bounded valid families is stated separately as
  `ZeroKnowledgeProof.AuxiliaryInputZeroKnowledge`. -/

      (fun p : ℕ × α × List Bool => Vstar p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :

noncomputable def PseudorandomGenerator.zeroKnowledgeProofOfReduction
    {α : Type} {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {A : Set α}
    {generator : List Bool → List Bool} {length : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hG : PseudorandomGenerator generator length)
    (hstretch : ∀ k, 3 * k + 1 ≤ length k)
    {f : α → CNF ℕ} (hf : ComputableInPolyTime f enc encCNF)
    (hred : ∀ a, a ∈ A ↔ f a ∈ ThreeSAT) :
    ZeroKnowledgeProof enc A where
  verifier := GMW.gmwVerifier generator length f
  prover n a w := GMW.gmwProver generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f a) w
  isWitness a w := ThreeSAT.verifier (f a, w)
  polyTime_isWitness := by
    have := hf.tidy
    fun_prop
  mem_iff_exists_witness a := by
    rw [hred a]
    refine ⟨fun ha => ?_, fun ⟨w, hw⟩ => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := (ThreeSAT.isVerifier (f a)).mp ha
      exact ⟨w, hw⟩
    · simp only [ThreeSAT.verifier, SAT.verifier, Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true,
        decide_eq_true_eq] at hw
      exact ⟨hw.1, SAT.assignment (f a) w, hw.2⟩
  isOraclePPT_verifier := GMW.isOraclePPTOn_gmwVerifier hG.polyTime hG.length_eq hf
  interact n a w prog := GMW.gmwInteract generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f a) w prog
  eval_interact n a w prog := GMW.eval_gmwInteract generator (n + 7) (length (n + 7)) (f a) w prog
  isPPT_interact _ hV := GMW.isPPTOn_gmwInteract hG.polyTime hG.length_eq hf hV
  complete n a _ hw := GMW.acceptProb_gmwVerifier_gmwProver hG.length_eq f n a hw
  sound n a ha P :=
    GMW.acceptProb_gmwVerifier_le hG.length_eq hstretch f n a (mt (hred a).mpr ha) P
  zero_knowledge Vstar hV :=
    ⟨GMW.gmwSimulator generator length f Vstar,
      GMW.isPPTOn_gmwSimulator hG.polyTime hG.length_eq hf hV,
      fun _ _ _ ha hw_comp hz hw_sat =>
        GMW.gmwView_indistinguishable_gmwSimulator hG hf hV ha hw_comp hz
          hw_sat⟩

zero-knowledge (`ZeroKnowledgeProof.AuxiliaryInputZeroKnowledge`) across all arbitrary polynomially
bounded valid instance, witness, and auxiliary-input families. -/

/-- Averaging two families of games over a common first stage preserves any uniform real-valued
advantage bound. -/
theorem advantage_bind_le {α : Type*} (d : PMF α) (game1 game2 : α → Game) {ε : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ a, (advantage (game1 a) (game2 a) : ℝ) ≤ ε) :
    (advantage (d.bind game1) (d.bind game2) : ℝ) ≤ ε := by
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := by
    obtain ⟨a, -⟩ := d.support_nonempty
    exact (NNReal.coe_nonneg _).trans (h a)
  have h1 (a : α) : game1 a true ≤ game2 a true + ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    have ha := h a
    rw [coe_advantage, coe_succProbability, coe_succProbability] at ha
    have hle : (game1 a true).toReal ≤ (game2 a true).toReal + ε :=
      sub_le_iff_le_add'.mp (abs_sub_le_iff.mp ha).1
    have hof := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hle
    rwa [ENNReal.ofReal_add ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hε0,
      ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _),
      ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _)] at hof
  have h2 (a : α) : game2 a true ≤ game1 a true + ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    have ha := h a
    rw [coe_advantage, coe_succProbability, coe_succProbability] at ha
    have hle : (game2 a true).toReal ≤ (game1 a true).toReal + ε :=
      sub_le_iff_le_add'.mp (abs_sub_le_iff.mp ha).2
    have hof := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hle
    rwa [ENNReal.ofReal_add ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hε0,
      ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _),
      ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _)] at hof
  have hsum1 : (d.bind game1) true ≤ (d.bind game2) true + ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    rw [PMF.bind_apply, PMF.bind_apply]
    calc ∑' a, d a * game1 a true
        ≤ ∑' a, d a * (game2 a true + ENNReal.ofReal ε) :=
          ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun a => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h1 a) zero_le
      _ = (∑' a, d a * game2 a true) + ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
          simp only [mul_add, ENNReal.tsum_add, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, d.tsum_coe, one_mul]
  have hsum2 : (d.bind game2) true ≤ (d.bind game1) true + ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    rw [PMF.bind_apply, PMF.bind_apply]
    calc ∑' a, d a * game2 a true
        ≤ ∑' a, d a * (game1 a true + ENNReal.ofReal ε) :=
          ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun a => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h2 a) zero_le
      _ = (∑' a, d a * game1 a true) + ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
          simp only [mul_add, ENNReal.tsum_add, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, d.tsum_coe, one_mul]
  have hadv := advantage_le_of_apply_le ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hsum1 hsum2
  rwa [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hε0] at hadv

/-- If a family of games `g : α → Game` agrees with `p : Game` on every `a ≠ a₀`, then averaging
`g` over `PMF.uniformOfFintype α` is within `(Fintype.card α)⁻¹` of `p`. -/
theorem advantage_bind_uniformOfFintype_of_ne_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (a₀ : α) (g : α → Game) (p : Game) (hne : ∀ a, a ≠ a₀ → g a = p) :
    Game.advantage ((PMF.uniformOfFintype α).bind g) p ≤ (Fintype.card α : ℝ≥0)⁻¹ := by
  classical
  have hsingle :
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype α).bind fun a => PMF.pure (decide (a = a₀))) true =
        (Fintype.card α : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
    rw [PMF.bind_apply, tsum_fintype]
    simp [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, PMF.pure_apply, eq_comm (a := true)]
  have hle₁ :
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype α).bind g) true ≤ p true + (Fintype.card α : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
    rw [← PMF.bind_const (PMF.uniformOfFintype α) p, ← hsingle, PMF.bind_apply, PMF.bind_apply,
      PMF.bind_apply, ← ENNReal.tsum_add]
    refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun a => ?_
    rw [← mul_add]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ zero_le
    by_cases ha : a = a₀
    · simp only [ha, decide_true, PMF.pure_apply, ↓reduceIte]
      exact (PMF.coe_le_one _ _).trans le_add_self
    · simp [hne a ha, ha]
  have hle₂ :
      p true ≤ ((PMF.uniformOfFintype α).bind g) true + (Fintype.card α : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
    nth_rw 1 [← PMF.bind_const (PMF.uniformOfFintype α) p]
    rw [← hsingle, PMF.bind_apply, PMF.bind_apply, PMF.bind_apply, ← ENNReal.tsum_add]
    refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun a => ?_
    rw [← mul_add]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ zero_le
    by_cases ha : a = a₀
    · simp only [ha, decide_true, PMF.pure_apply, ↓reduceIte]
      exact (PMF.coe_le_one _ _).trans le_add_self
    · simp [hne a ha, ha]
  have hinv_ne_top : (Fintype.card α : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ≠ ⊤ := by simp
  have hadv := Game.advantage_le_of_apply_le hinv_ne_top hle₁ hle₂
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast, ← NNReal.coe_natCast, ← NNReal.coe_inv] at hadv
  exact NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp hadv

    (o₁ : T → List Bool → List Bool) (o₂ : List Bool → List Bool)
    (isBad : T → List Bool → Bool) (next : T → α → Game)
    {Q : ℕ} {δ : ℝ≥0∞}
    {prog : WordOracleComp Unit α} (hq : prog.IsQueryBounded Q)
    (hagree : ∀ τ req, isBad τ req = false → o₁ τ req = o₂ req)
    (hbad : ∀ req, (∑' τ, μ τ * if isBad τ req then (1 : ℝ≥0∞) else 0) ≤ δ)

      (μ.bind fun τ => runStatelessOracle o₂ prog (next τ)) b + (Q : ℝ≥0∞) * δ) ∧

  | pure a Q =>
    simp only [runStatelessOracle_pure]
    exact ⟨le_self_add, le_self_add⟩
  | liftBind q k Q _ ih =>
    rcases q with m | req
    · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Nat.add_zero]
      have hinl (o : T → List Bool → List Bool) :
          (μ.bind fun τ =>
            runStatelessOracle (o τ) (OracleComp.query (Sum.inl m) >>= k) (next τ)) =
          (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (m + 1))).bind
            (fun x => μ.bind fun τ => runStatelessOracle (o τ) (k x) (next τ)) := by
        rw [show (fun τ =>
            runStatelessOracle (o τ) (OracleComp.query (Sum.inl m) >>= k) (next τ)) = _ from
          funext fun τ => runStatelessOracle_query_inl (o τ) m k (next τ)]
        exact PMF.bind_comm μ (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (m + 1))) _
      rw [hinl o₁, hinl (fun _ => o₂)]
      simp only [PMF.bind_apply]
      have hsum (f g : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ≥0∞) (hle : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x + (Q : ℝ≥0∞) * δ) :
          (∑' x, PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (m + 1)) x * f x) ≤
            (∑' x, PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (m + 1)) x * g x) + (Q : ℝ≥0∞) * δ := by
        calc ∑' x, PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (m + 1)) x * f x
            ≤ ∑' x, PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (m + 1)) x * (g x + (Q : ℝ≥0∞) * δ) :=
              ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hle x) zero_le
          _ = (∑' x, PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (m + 1)) x * g x) + (Q : ℝ≥0∞) * δ := by
              simp only [mul_add, ENNReal.tsum_add, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.tsum_coe, one_mul]
      exact ⟨hsum _ _ (fun x => (ih x).1), hsum _ _ (fun x => (ih x).2)⟩
    · simp only [Sum.elim_inr]
      have hinr₁ :
          (fun τ => runStatelessOracle (o₁ τ) (OracleComp.query (Sum.inr req) >>= k) (next τ)) =
            fun τ => runStatelessOracle (o₁ τ) (k (o₁ τ req.2)) (next τ) :=
        funext fun τ => runStatelessOracle_query_inr (o₁ τ) req k (next τ)
      have hinr₂ :
          (fun τ => runStatelessOracle o₂ (OracleComp.query (Sum.inr req) >>= k) (next τ)) =
            fun τ => runStatelessOracle o₂ (k (o₂ req.2)) (next τ) :=
        funext fun τ => runStatelessOracle_query_inr o₂ req k (next τ)
      rw [hinr₁, hinr₂]
      have hstep (f g : T → Game)
          (hfg : ∀ τ, isBad τ req.2 = false → f τ = g τ) :
          (μ.bind f) b ≤ (μ.bind g) b + δ := by
        simp only [PMF.bind_apply]
        calc ∑' τ, μ τ * f τ b
            ≤ ∑' τ, (μ τ * g τ b + μ τ * if isBad τ req.2 then 1 else 0) := by
              refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun τ => ?_
              by_cases hb : isBad τ req.2 = true
              · simp only [hb, ↓reduceIte, mul_one]
                exact le_add_of_le_right (mul_le_of_le_one_right zero_le (PMF.coe_le_one _ _))
              · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hb
                rw [hfg τ hb]; simp [hb]
          _ = (∑' τ, μ τ * g τ b) + ∑' τ, μ τ * if isBad τ req.2 then 1 else 0 := ENNReal.tsum_add
          _ ≤ (∑' τ, μ τ * g τ b) + δ := add_le_add le_rfl (hbad req.2)
      have hstep1 := hstep
        (fun τ => runStatelessOracle (o₁ τ) (k (o₁ τ req.2)) (next τ))
        (fun τ => runStatelessOracle (o₁ τ) (k (o₂ req.2)) (next τ))
        (fun τ hb => by rw [hagree τ req.2 hb])
      have hstep2 := hstep
        (fun τ => runStatelessOracle (o₁ τ) (k (o₂ req.2)) (next τ))
        (fun τ => runStatelessOracle (o₁ τ) (k (o₁ τ req.2)) (next τ))
        (fun τ hb => by rw [hagree τ req.2 hb])
      have hcast : ((Q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * δ = (Q : ℝ≥0∞) * δ + δ := by
        rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_mul, one_mul]
      rw [hcast]
      exact ⟨(hstep1.trans (add_le_add (ih (o₂ req.2)).1 le_rfl)).trans_eq (add_assoc _ _ _),
        ((ih (o₂ req.2)).2.trans (add_le_add hstep2 le_rfl)).trans_eq (by ac_rfl)⟩

/-- Negligible decay survives reindexing when the new parameter tends to infinity and the old
parameter is polynomially bounded in it. The reindexing function need not be computable. -/
theorem Negligible.comp_of_polynomial_bound {ε : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {index bound : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hε : Negligible ε) (hindex : Tendsto index atTop atTop)
    (hbound : PolynomiallyBounded bound) (hle : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ≤ bound (index n)) :
    Negligible (fun n => ε (index n)) := by

  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hlimit
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => zero_le)) ?_

theorem IsSubexponentiallySecure.of_rpow {G : ∀ k, Generator (BitString k) (BitString (2 * k))}
    {ε : ℝ} {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d * ε)
    (hG : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, (G k).Secure (IsCircuitTest ⌊(2 : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) ^ ε)⌋₊)
      ((2 : ℝ≥0) ^ ((k : ℝ) ^ ε))⁻¹) :

  have hmk : (m : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) ^ ε := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm0
    · simp only [CharP.cast_eq_zero]; positivity
    have hε : 0 < ε := by
      rcases le_or_gt ε 0 with h | h
      · nlinarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg d : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d)]
      · exact h
    calc (m : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_one _).symm
      _ ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) * ε) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by exact_mod_cast hm0) hd
      _ = ((m : ℝ) ^ d) ^ ε := by rw [Real.rpow_mul (by positivity), Real.rpow_natCast]
      _ ≤ (k : ℝ) ^ ε := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast hm) hε.le
  have hsize : 2 ^ m ≤ ⌊(2 : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) ^ ε)⌋₊ := by
    refine Nat.le_floor ?_
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, ← Real.rpow_natCast]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le one_le_two hmk
  have herr : ((2 : ℝ≥0) ^ ((k : ℝ) ^ ε))⁻¹ ≤ (2 ^ m)⁻¹ := by
    refine inv_anti₀ (by positivity) ?_
    rw [← NNReal.rpow_natCast]
    exact NNReal.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le one_le_two hmk
  exact (hk.of_admissible fun A ⟨test, htest, hA⟩ => ⟨test, htest.trans hsize, hA⟩).mono herr

theorem abs_expect_comp_sub_expect_le (g : α → β) (T : (ι → β) → ℝ) {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : ∀ (c : ι → β) (i : ι), |𝔼 a, T (update c i (g a)) - 𝔼 b, T (update c i b)| ≤ ε) :
    |𝔼 s : ι → α, T (fun i => g (s i)) - 𝔼 y : ι → β, T y| ≤ Fintype.card ι * ε := by
  -- the hybrid in which the coordinates in `S` are uniform
  let v : Finset ι → (ι → α) → (ι → β) → ι → β := fun S s y j => if j ∈ S then y j else g (s j)
  let H : Finset ι → ℝ := fun S => 𝔼 s, 𝔼 y, T (v S s y)
  have hstep (i : ι) (S : Finset ι) (hi : i ∉ S) : |H S - H (insert i S)| ≤ ε := by
    have hS : H S = 𝔼 s, 𝔼 y, 𝔼 a, T (update (v S s y) i (g a)) := by
      change 𝔼 s, 𝔼 y, T (v S s y) = _
      rw [← Fintype.expect_expect_update (fun s => 𝔼 y, T (v S s y)) i]
      refine expect_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
      rw [expect_comm]
      refine expect_congr rfl fun y _ => expect_congr rfl fun a _ => congrArg T ?_
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj; simp [v, hi]
      · simp [v, hj]
    have hS' : H (insert i S) = 𝔼 s, 𝔼 y, 𝔼 b, T (update (v S s y) i b) := by
      change 𝔼 s, 𝔼 y, T (v (insert i S) s y) = _
      refine expect_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
      rw [← Fintype.expect_expect_update (fun y => T (v (insert i S) s y)) i]
      refine expect_congr rfl fun y _ => expect_congr rfl fun b _ => congrArg T ?_
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj; simp [v]
      · simp [v, hj]
    rw [hS, hS', ← expect_sub_distrib]
    refine (abs_expect_le _ _).trans ?_
    refine (expect_le_expect fun s _ => ?_).trans_eq (Fintype.expect_const ε)
    rw [← expect_sub_distrib]
    refine (abs_expect_le _ _).trans ?_
    refine (expect_le_expect fun y _ => ?_).trans_eq (Fintype.expect_const ε)
    exact hT _ i
  have hind (S : Finset ι) : |H ∅ - H S| ≤ S.card * ε := by
    induction S using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert i S hi ih =>
      calc |H ∅ - H (insert i S)| ≤ |H ∅ - H S| + |H S - H (insert i S)| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
        _ ≤ S.card * ε + ε := add_le_add ih (hstep i S hi)
        _ = (insert i S).card * ε := by rw [card_insert_of_notMem hi]; push_cast; ring
  have h0 : H ∅ = 𝔼 s : ι → α, T (fun i => g (s i)) := by
    simp only [H, v, notMem_empty, ite_false, Fintype.expect_const]
  have h1 : H univ = 𝔼 y : ι → β, T y := by
    simp only [H, v, mem_univ, ite_true, Fintype.expect_const]
  simpa only [h0, h1, card_univ] using hind univ

theorem Generator.toReal_predictionExperiment_nextBitPredictor
    (G : Generator Seed (Fin m → Bool)) (adversary : Adversary (Fin m → Bool)) (i : Fin m) :
    (G.predictionExperiment i (nextBitPredictor adversary i) true).toReal =
      1 / 2 + G.hybridGap adversary i := by
  have hpad (y z : Fin m → Bool) (r : Bool) :
      (fun j : Fin m => if h : (j : ℕ) < i then Fin.take i i.isLt.le y ⟨j, h⟩
        else if j = i then r else z j) =
        fun j : Fin m => if (j : ℕ) < i then y j else Function.update z i r j := by
    funext j
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  have hsucc (y z : Fin m → Bool) :
      (fun j : Fin m => if (j : ℕ) < i then y j else Function.update z i (y i) j) =
        fun j : Fin m => if (j : ℕ) < i + 1 then y j else z j := by
    funext j
    rw [Function.update_apply]
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst hji
      simp
    · have : (j : ℕ) ≠ i := fun h => hji (Fin.ext h)
      split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
  have h := toReal_bind_guessOfDistinguisher G.outputDist (fun y => y i)
    fun y r => (uniformOfFintype (Fin m → Bool)).bind fun z =>
      adversary fun j => if h : (j : ℕ) < i then Fin.take i i.isLt.le y ⟨j, h⟩
        else if j = i then r else z j
  refine h.trans ?_
  rw [Generator.hybridGap, G.hybridExperiment_eq_bind, G.hybridExperiment_eq_bind]
  simp only [hpad, hsucc]
  have hlast : (G.outputDist.bind fun y => (uniformOfFintype Bool).bind fun r =>
      (uniformOfFintype (Fin m → Bool)).bind fun z =>
        adversary fun j => if (j : ℕ) < i then y j else Function.update z i r j) =
      G.outputDist.bind fun y => (uniformOfFintype (Fin m → Bool)).bind fun z =>
        adversary fun j => if (j : ℕ) < i then y j else z j := by
    congr 1
    funext y
    exact uniformOfFintype_bind_bind_update i fun w =>
      adversary fun j => if (j : ℕ) < i then y j else w j
  rw [hlast]
  ring

private theorem complexity_nextBitGuess_le (test : BooleanFunction m) (i : Fin m) (r : Bool)
    (u : Fin m → Bool) (bit : Fin i → BooleanFunction n) {B : ℕ} (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hbit : ∀ j, complexity interpretation (single (bit j)) ≤ B) :
    complexity interpretation (single fun x => nextBitGuess test i r u fun j => bit j x) ≤
      complexity interpretation (single test) + m * B + 1 := by
  let q : Fin m → BooleanFunction n := fun j x =>
    if h : (j : ℕ) < i then bit ⟨j, h⟩ x else if j = i then r else u j
  have hq (j : Fin m) : complexity interpretation (single (q j)) ≤ B := by
    by_cases h : (j : ℕ) < i
    · simpa only [q, dite_eq_left h] using hbit ⟨j, h⟩
    · simp only [q, dite_eq_right h]
      exact (Synthesis.const _).complexity_le.trans hB
  have htest : complexity interpretation (single fun x => test fun j => q j x) ≤
      complexity interpretation (single test) + m * B := by
    calc _ ≤ complexity interpretation (fun x j => q j x) +
          complexity interpretation (single test) := complexity_comp_le _ (single test)
      _ ≤ m * B + complexity interpretation (single test) := by
          gcongr
          refine (complexity_pi_le q).trans ?_
          calc _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin m, B := sum_le_sum fun j _ => hq j
            _ = m * B := by simp
      _ = _ := add_comm _ _
  cases r
  · have e : (fun x => nextBitGuess test i false u fun j => bit j x) =
        fun x => !test fun j => q j x := funext fun x => by
      simp only [nextBitGuess, q]
      cases test _ <;> rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (complexity_not_le _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right htest 1)
  · have e : (fun x => nextBitGuess test i true u fun j => bit j x) =
        fun x => test fun j => q j x := funext fun x => by
      simp only [nextBitGuess, q]
      cases test _ <;> rfl
    rw [e]
    exact htest.trans (Nat.le_succ _)

/-- **The Nisan–Wigderson reconstruction with circuits**
[Arora and Barak, Chapter 20][AroraBarak09]. If `0 < m` and a deterministic test accepts outputs of
the generator with probability at least `ε` more than uniform strings, then some function `g` on `n`
bits agrees with `f` on at least a `1 / 2 + ε / m` fraction of the inputs and has De Morgan circuit
complexity at most that of the test plus `m * (2 ^ a * (2 * a + 3) + 1) + 1`. -/

      1 / 2 + ε / m ≤ (#{x | g x = f x} : ℝ) / 2 ^ n := by
  obtain ⟨i, s, bit, r, u, hs, hbit, h⟩ :=
    exists_dependsOn_half_add_div_le_card_nextBitGuess_eq D f test hm hε
  refine ⟨_, complexity_nextBitGuess_le test i r u bit (Nat.le_add_left 1 _) fun j => ?_, h⟩

private theorem card_filter_le_card_inter_le {B : Finset (Fin ℓ)} (hB : #B = n) (t : ℕ) :
    #{S ∈ powersetCard n univ | t ≤ #(S ∩ B)} ≤ n.choose t * (ℓ - t).choose (n - t) := by
  calc #{S ∈ powersetCard n univ | t ≤ #(S ∩ B)}
      ≤ #((powersetCard t B).biUnion fun T => {S ∈ powersetCard n univ | T ⊆ S}) := by
        refine card_le_card fun S hS => ?_
        obtain ⟨hS, ht⟩ := mem_filter.1 hS
        obtain ⟨T, hTS, hT⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq ht
        exact mem_biUnion.2 ⟨T, mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨hTS.trans inter_subset_right, hT⟩,
          mem_filter.2 ⟨hS, hTS.trans inter_subset_left⟩⟩
    _ ≤ ∑ T ∈ powersetCard t B, #{S ∈ powersetCard n univ | T ⊆ S} := card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _T ∈ powersetCard t B, (ℓ - t).choose (n - t) :=
        sum_le_sum fun T hT => card_filter_superset_le (mem_powersetCard.1 hT).2
    _ = n.choose t * (ℓ - t).choose (n - t) := by
        rw [sum_const, card_powersetCard, hB, smul_eq_mul]

theorem choose_le_length_greedyMasks_mul (han : a < n) (hnℓ : n ≤ ℓ) :
    ℓ.choose (a + 1) ≤ (greedyMasks ℓ n a).length * n.choose (a + 1) ^ 2 := by
  set F := greedyMasks ℓ n a
  set K := (ℓ - (a + 1)).choose (n - (a + 1))
  -- every `n`-set shares `a + 1` elements with a block of `F`
  have hcover : powersetCard n (univ : Finset (Fin ℓ)) ⊆
      F.toFinset.biUnion fun v => {S ∈ powersetCard n univ | a + 1 ≤ #(S ∩ maskBlock ℓ v)} := by
    intro S hS
    set w := List.ofFn fun k : Fin ℓ => decide (k ∈ S)
    have hlen : w.length = ℓ := List.length_ofFn
    have hblock : maskBlock ℓ w = S := by
      ext k
      simp [w, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    have hcount : w.count true = n := by
      rw [count_true_eq_card_maskBlock_of_length hlen, hblock, (mem_powersetCard.1 hS).2]
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hlt⟩ := exists_mem_greedyMasks_lt_overlapCount han hlen hcount
    rw [overlapCount_eq_card_inter hlen (length_of_mem_greedyMasks hv), hblock] at hlt
    exact mem_biUnion.2 ⟨v, List.mem_toFinset.2 hv, mem_filter.2 ⟨hS, hlt⟩⟩
  have hcount : ℓ.choose n ≤ F.length * (n.choose (a + 1) * K) := by
    calc ℓ.choose n = #(powersetCard n (univ : Finset (Fin ℓ))) := by
          rw [card_powersetCard, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ F.toFinset, #{S ∈ powersetCard n univ | a + 1 ≤ #(S ∩ maskBlock ℓ v)} :=
          (card_le_card hcover).trans card_biUnion_le
      _ ≤ ∑ _v ∈ F.toFinset, n.choose (a + 1) * K := by
          refine sum_le_sum fun v hv => card_filter_le_card_inter_le ?_ (a + 1)
          have hv := List.mem_toFinset.1 hv
          rw [← count_true_eq_card_maskBlock_of_length (length_of_mem_greedyMasks hv),
            count_of_mem_greedyMasks hv]
      _ ≤ F.length * (n.choose (a + 1) * K) := by
          rw [sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
          exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (List.toFinset_card_le F)
  have hK : 0 < K := Nat.choose_pos (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hnℓ _)
  refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ hK
  calc ℓ.choose (a + 1) * K = ℓ.choose n * n.choose (a + 1) := (Nat.choose_mul han).symm
    _ ≤ F.length * (n.choose (a + 1) * K) * n.choose (a + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hcount
    _ = F.length * n.choose (a + 1) ^ 2 * K := by ring

private theorem pow_le_choose_succ_mul (b t : ℕ) : b ^ t ≤ ((b + 1) * t).choose t := by
  have h₁ : (b * t) ^ t ≤ ((b + 1) * t).descFactorial t :=
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul]; omega) t).trans
      (Nat.pow_sub_le_descFactorial _ t)
  rw [Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose, mul_pow] at h₁
  have h₂ : b ^ t * t.factorial ≤ t.factorial * ((b + 1) * t).choose t :=
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.factorial_le_pow t)).trans h₁
  rw [mul_comm] at h₂
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left h₂ (Nat.factorial_pos t)

/-- **The greedy design with seeds of linear length.** If `0 < t ≤ n ≤ (b + 1) t` and
`4 ^ n m ≤ b ^ t`, the greedy design on seeds of `(b + 1) t` bits, with blocks of `n` positions
sharing at most `t - 1` of them, has at least `m` blocks. -/

theorem le_length_greedyMasks {b t : ℕ} (ht : 0 < t) (htn : t ≤ n) (hn : n ≤ (b + 1) * t)
    (hm : 4 ^ n * m ≤ b ^ t) : m ≤ (greedyMasks ((b + 1) * t) n (t - 1)).length := by
  have h := choose_le_length_greedyMasks_mul (ℓ := (b + 1) * t) (a := t - 1) (by omega) hn
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel ht] at h
  have hc : n.choose t ^ 2 ≤ 4 ^ n := by
    rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 2 by rfl, ← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.choose_le_two_pow n t) 2
  refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left (c := 4 ^ n) ?_ (by positivity)
  calc 4 ^ n * m ≤ ((b + 1) * t).choose t := hm.trans (pow_le_choose_succ_mul b t)
    _ ≤ _ * n.choose t ^ 2 := h
    _ ≤ _ * 4 ^ n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hc
    _ = 4 ^ n * _ := mul_comm _ _

private theorem card_not_div {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] (p : X → Bool) :
    (#{x | (!p x) = true} : ℝ) / Fintype.card X =
      1 - (#{x | p x = true} : ℝ) / Fintype.card X := by
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card X := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hsum : #{x | p x = true} + #{x | (!p x) = true} = Fintype.card X := by
    rw [← card_univ, ← card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := univ) (fun x => p x = true)]
    simp
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← add_div, div_eq_one_iff_eq hpos.ne']
  exact_mod_cast (add_comm _ _).trans hsum

/-- **The Nisan–Wigderson generator fools small circuits, in counting form**
[NisanWigderson1994]. Let `f` be average-case hard for size `s` (with the non-strict bound of
`Cslib.Circuits.Boolean.IsAverageCaseHard`), let `S + 1 + m (2 ^ a (2 a + 3) + 1) + 1 ≤ s`, and
let `m < ε s`. Then for every test of De Morgan circuit complexity at most `S`, the fraction of
the `2 ^ ℓ` seeds on which the test accepts the output of the generator differs from the fraction
of the `2 ^ m` strings it accepts by less than `ε`. The slack `m < ε s` makes the agreement bound
`1 / 2 + 1 / s` strictly smaller than the `1 / 2 + ε / m` of the reconstruction. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem abs_card_div_sub_card_div_lt (D : Design ℓ n a m) {f : BooleanFunction n} {s S : ℕ}
    {ε : ℝ} (hf : IsAverageCaseHard f s) (hs : S + 1 + m * (2 ^ a * (2 * a + 3) + 1) + 1 ≤ s)
    (hm : (m : ℝ) < ε * s) (test : BooleanFunction m)
    (htest : complexity interpretation (single test) ≤ S) :
    |(#{z | test (generator D f z) = true} : ℝ) / 2 ^ ℓ - #{r | test r = true} / 2 ^ m| < ε := by
  have hcardSeed : (Fintype.card (Fin ℓ → Bool) : ℝ) = 2 ^ ℓ := by simp
  have hcardOut : (Fintype.card (Fin m → Bool) : ℝ) = 2 ^ m := by simp
  have hεs : 0 < ε * s := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.cast_nonneg m) hm
  have hs0 : (0 : ℝ) < s := by
    rcases (Nat.cast_nonneg s : (0 : ℝ) ≤ s).lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [← h, mul_zero] at hεs
      exact absurd hεs (lt_irrefl 0)
  have hε : 0 < ε := pos_of_mul_pos_left hεs hs0.le
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm0
  · -- with no output bits, the test sees the same empty string on every seed
    have hr (r : Fin 0 → Bool) : test r = test Fin.elim0 := congrArg test (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rcases hb : test Fin.elim0 with _ | _
    · rw [filter_false_of_mem fun z _ => by rw [hr, hb]; decide,
        filter_false_of_mem fun r _ => by rw [hr, hb]; decide]
      simpa using hε
    · rw [filter_true_of_mem fun z _ => by rw [hr, hb],
        filter_true_of_mem fun r _ => by rw [hr, hb]]
      simp [hpow, hε]
  -- the strict agreement bound of the reconstruction, from the slack
  have hslack : 1 / (s : ℝ) < ε / m := by
    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hs0 (by exact_mod_cast hm0)]
    linarith
  have hhard (S' : ℕ) (hS' : S' ≤ S + 1) (g : BooleanFunction n)
      (hg : complexity interpretation (single g) ≤ S' + m * (2 ^ a * (2 * a + 3) + 1) + 1) :
      (#{x | g x = f x} : ℝ) / 2 ^ n < 1 / 2 + ε / m :=
    hf.div_lt hslack (hg.trans (by omega))
  have h₁ := toReal_realExperiment_sub_toReal_idealExperiment_lt D f hm0 (hhard S (by omega))
    test htest
  have h₂ := toReal_realExperiment_sub_toReal_idealExperiment_lt D f hm0 (hhard (S + 1) le_rfl)
    (fun r => !test r) ((complexity_not_le test).trans (by omega))
  rw [Generator.toReal_realExperiment_pure, Generator.toReal_idealExperiment_pure,
    nnratCast_dens, nnratCast_dens] at h₁ h₂
  rw [card_not_div (fun z => test (generator D f z)), card_not_div test] at h₂
  rw [hcardSeed, hcardOut] at h₁ h₂
  rw [abs_sub_lt_iff]
  constructor <;> linarith

theorem card_polynomialBlock_inter_le {c d : Fin k → F} (hcd : c ≠ d) :
    #(polynomialBlock F k c ∩ polynomialBlock F k d) ≤ k - 1 := by
  have heval (c : Fin k → F) (x : F) :
      ((degreeLTEquiv F k).symm c : F[X]).eval x = ∑ i, c i * x ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    rw [eval_eq_sum_degreeLTEquiv ((degreeLTEquiv F k).symm c).2, Subtype.coe_eta,
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  set P : F[X] := ↑((degreeLTEquiv F k).symm c)
  set Q : F[X] := ↑((degreeLTEquiv F k).symm d)
  set s : Finset F := {x | P.eval x = Q.eval x}
  have hs : #(polynomialBlock F k c ∩ polynomialBlock F k d) ≤ #s := by
    refine card_le_card_of_injOn Prod.fst (fun p hp => ?_) (fun p hp p' hp' h => ?_)
    · rw [coe_inter, Set.mem_inter_iff, mem_coe, mem_coe, mem_polynomialBlock,
        mem_polynomialBlock] at hp
      rw [mem_coe, mem_filter, heval, heval, ← hp.1, ← hp.2]
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    · rw [coe_inter, Set.mem_inter_iff, mem_coe, mem_coe, mem_polynomialBlock] at hp hp'
      exact Prod.ext h (by rw [hp.1, hp'.1, h])
  refine hs.trans (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge fun hks => hcd ?_))
  refine (degreeLTEquiv F k).symm.injective (Subtype.ext ?_)
  refine eq_of_degree_sub_lt_of_eval_finset_eq s ?_ fun x hx => (mem_filter.1 hx).2
  refine (mem_degreeLT.1 (Submodule.sub_mem _ (Subtype.prop _) (Subtype.prop _))).trans_le ?_
  exact_mod_cast hks

  let sim (st : RandomPermutation.Cache G × RandomPermutation.Cache G) :
      PMF (Equiv.Perm G × Equiv.Perm G) :=
    (RandomPermutation.complete st.1).bind fun E => (RandomPermutation.complete st.2).map (E, ·)
  let inv (st : RandomPermutation.Cache G × RandomPermutation.Cache G) : Prop :=
    RandomPermutation.IsPartialBijection st.1 ∧ RandomPermutation.IsPartialBijection st.2
  let readH (q : PermQuery G ⊕ PermQuery G) (p : Equiv.Perm G × Equiv.Perm G) :
      PMF (EvenMansourSpec G q) :=
    sumHandler (fun q => PMF.pure (evalPerm p.1 q)) (fun q => PMF.pure (evalPerm p.2 q)) q
  have hpres : ∀ q st, inv st →
      ∀ a st', (a, st') ∈ (idealLazyHandler q st).support → inv st' := by
    rintro (qe | qπ) ⟨c_e, c_π⟩ ⟨he, hπ⟩ a ⟨c_e', c_π'⟩ hmem
    · simp only [idealLazyHandler, PMF.mem_support_map_iff] at hmem
      obtain ⟨⟨a₀, ce₀⟩, hmem₀, hpair⟩ := hmem
      cases hpair
      exact ⟨RandomPermutation.answer_preserve_isPartialBijection qe c_e he a₀ ce₀ hmem₀, hπ⟩
    · simp only [idealLazyHandler, PMF.mem_support_map_iff] at hmem
      obtain ⟨⟨a₀, cπ₀⟩, hmem₀, hpair⟩ := hmem
      cases hpair
      exact ⟨he, RandomPermutation.answer_preserve_isPartialBijection qπ c_π hπ a₀ cπ₀ hmem₀⟩
  have hstep : ∀ q st, inv st →
      (do let (a, st') ← idealLazyHandler q st; (a, ·) <$> sim st') =
      (do let p ← sim st; let y ← (·, p) <$> readH q p; pure y) := by
    rintro (qe | qπ) ⟨c_e, c_π⟩ ⟨he, hπ⟩
    · have h1 := congrArg
        (fun m : PMF (G × Equiv.Perm G) =>
          m.bind fun (y, E) => (RandomPermutation.complete c_π).map fun π => (y, (E, π)))
        (RandomPermutation.answer_complete qe c_e he)
      simpa only [idealLazyHandler, sim, readH, sumHandler, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind,
        PMF.monad_map_eq_map, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.bind_map, PMF.map_bind,
        PMF.bind_bind, PMF.pure_map, PMF.pure_bind, PMF.map_comp, PMF.map,
        Function.comp_def] using h1
    · have h2 := congrArg
        (fun m : PMF (G × Equiv.Perm G) =>
          (RandomPermutation.complete c_e).bind fun E =>
            m.map fun (v, π) => (v, (E, π)))
        (RandomPermutation.answer_complete qπ c_π hπ)
      simp only [idealLazyHandler, sim, readH, sumHandler, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind,
        PMF.monad_map_eq_map, PMF.bind_bind, PMF.pure_bind, PMF.map, Function.comp_def] at h2 ⊢
      rw [PMF.bind_comm]
      exact h2
  have hsim := OracleComp.run_interpret_simulation_of_invariant idealLazyHandler
    (fun q p => (·, p) <$> readH q p) sim inv hpres hstep program ([], [])
    ⟨RandomPermutation.isPartialBijection_nil, RandomPermutation.isPartialBijection_nil⟩

    PMF.map, Function.comp_def, PMF.bind_bind,

  rw [pure_evalTwoPerms]

    PMF.bind_bind, PMF.pure_bind, PMF.bind_pure] using

private theorem memoize_pairwise_and_length_le {α : Type}
    (distribution : G × G → PMF (G × G))
    {program : OracleComp (fun _ : G × G => G × G) α} {n : ℕ}
    (hn : OracleComp.IsQueryBounded program n)
    {qc : List ((G × G) × (G × G))} (hpair : qc.Pairwise (fun a b => a.1 ≠ b.1))
    {result : α} {qc' : List ((G × G) × (G × G))}
    (hmem : (result, qc') ∈
      ((OracleComp.interpret (memoize distribution) program).run qc).support) :
    qc'.Pairwise (fun a b => a.1 ≠ b.1) ∧ qc'.length ≤ qc.length + n := by
  induction hn generalizing qc with
  | pure a n =>
    change (result, qc') ∈ (PMF.pure (a, qc)).support at hmem
    rw [PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hmem
    obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hmem
    exact ⟨hpair, Nat.le_add_right _ _⟩
  | liftBind p cont n _ ih =>
    change (result, qc') ∈
      ((memoize distribution p qc).bind fun y =>
        (OracleComp.interpret (memoize distribution) (cont y.1)).run y.2).support at hmem
    rw [PMF.mem_support_bind_iff] at hmem
    obtain ⟨⟨r, qc₁⟩, hstep, hcont⟩ := hmem
    have hmem' := (RandomOracle.mem_support_memoize_iff _ _ _ (r, qc₁)).mp hstep
    dsimp only at hmem' hcont
    rcases hmem' with ⟨_, rfl⟩ | ⟨hlookup, _, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨hp', hlen'⟩ := ih r hpair hcont

        List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨ne_fst_of_lookup_eq_none hlookup, hpair⟩
      obtain ⟨hp', hlen'⟩ := ih r hpair₁ hcont
      rw [List.length_cons] at hlen'

    (hQ : OracleComp.IsQueryBounded program Q) :
    (∑' k₁, seed₁ k₁ *
      ((OracleComp.interpret (memoize (fun _ : G × G => PMF.uniformOfFintype (G × G)))

      Q.choose 2 * ε + Q.choose 2 * (Fintype.card G : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
  classical
  set idealRun :=
    (OracleComp.interpret (memoize (fun _ : G × G => PMF.uniformOfFintype (G × G)))
      program).run []
  have hsplit (k₁ : K₁) :
      idealRun.toOuterMeasure {x | hasCollision (h₁ k₁) x.2 = true} ≤
        idealRun.toOuterMeasure {x | hasUCollision (h₁ k₁) x.2 = true} +
          idealRun.toOuterMeasure {x | hasVCollision x.2 = true} := by
    calc idealRun.toOuterMeasure {x | hasCollision (h₁ k₁) x.2 = true}
        ≤ idealRun.toOuterMeasure
          ({x | hasUCollision (h₁ k₁) x.2 = true} ∪ {x | hasVCollision x.2 = true}) := by
          refine idealRun.toOuterMeasure.mono fun x hx => ?_
          simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hasCollision_eq_or, Bool.or_eq_true] at hx
          exact hx
      _ ≤ _ := MeasureTheory.measure_union_le _ _
  have hu :
      (∑' k₁, seed₁ k₁ * idealRun.toOuterMeasure {x | hasUCollision (h₁ k₁) x.2 = true}) ≤
        Q.choose 2 * ε := by
    simp only [PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
    have hcomm :
        (∑' k₁, seed₁ k₁ * ∑' x,
          ({x : Bool × List ((G × G) × (G × G)) |
            hasUCollision (h₁ k₁) x.2 = true}.indicator idealRun x)) =
        ∑' x, idealRun x * ∑' k₁,
          ({k₁ : K₁ | hasUCollision (h₁ k₁) x.2 = true}.indicator seed₁ k₁) := by
      simp only [← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
      rw [ENNReal.tsum_comm]
      refine tsum_congr fun x => tsum_congr fun k₁ => ?_
      by_cases hx : hasUCollision (h₁ k₁) x.2 = true
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Set.indicator_of_mem hx, mul_comm]
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, mul_zero, mul_zero]
    rw [hcomm]
    calc ∑' x, idealRun x * ∑' k₁,

          refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
          by_cases hmem : x ∈ idealRun.support
          · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ zero_le
            rw [← PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
            obtain ⟨hpair, hlen⟩ :=
              memoize_pairwise_and_length_le _ hQ List.Pairwise.nil hmem
            rw [List.length_nil, zero_add] at hlen

      _ = Q.choose 2 * ε := by
          rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, idealRun.tsum_coe, one_mul]

      OracleComp.interpret (feistelStrongOracle π) (feistel3CCAAttack l₀ l₁ r₀) =
        OracleComp.interpret (fun q => PMF.pure (RandomPermutation.evalPerm π q))

  have hswitch := RandomPermutation.uniformPerm_bind_apply_le_forgetful
    (RandomPermutation.isQueryBounded_liftBoolProd (isQueryBounded_feistel3CCAAttack l₀ l₁ r₀))
    PMF.pure true

  rw [← hgame] at hswitch
  have hp10 : (l₁, r₀) ≠ (l₀, r₀) := fun h => h01 (congrArg Prod.fst h).symm

          Prod.fst) true ≤
        (Fintype.card G : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ + (Fintype.card (G × G) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by

          (RandomPermutation.liftBoolProd (feistel3CCAAttack l₀ l₁ r₀))).run []).map Prod.fst) =

            (PMF.uniformOfFintype (G × G)).bind fun vw₁ =>

                (.inverse (vw₀.1, (l₁ - l₀) + vw₀.2))

        ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (G × G)).bind fun vw₁ =>
          (RandomPermutation.forgetfulAnswer
            (.inverse (vw₀.1, (l₁ - l₀) + vw₀.2))
            [((l₁, r₀), vw₁), ((l₀, r₀), vw₀)]).map
            (fun x => decide (-vw₀.1 + x.1.2 = -vw₁.1 + r₀))) true ≤
          (Fintype.card G : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ + (Fintype.card (G × G) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by

            ((RandomPermutation.forgetfulAnswer (.inverse q₃)

              (fun x => decide (-vw₀.1 + x.1.2 = -vw₁.1 + r₀))) true ≤

                  (fun x => decide (-vw₀.1 + x.1.2 = -vw₁.1 + r₀))) true

                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (PMF.coe_le_one _ true) zero_le

            simp [RandomPermutation.invLookup, Ne.symm h13, Ne.symm hvw₀_ne]

                [((l₁, r₀), vw₁), ((l₀, r₀), vw₀)]).map
                (fun x => decide (-vw₀.1 + x.1.2 = -vw₁.1 + r₀))) true =
                (Fintype.card G : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by

          rw [hnone]
