            ((RandomPermutation.forgetfulAnswer (.inverse q₃)
              [((l₁, r₀), vw₁), ((l₀, r₀), vw₀)]).map
              (fun x => decide (-vw₀.1 + x.1.2 = -vw₁.1 + r₀))) true
          ≤ ∑' vw₁, ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (G × G)) vw₁ * (Fintype.card G : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ +
              ({q₃} : Set (G × G)).indicator (PMF.uniformOfFintype (G × G)) vw₁) :=
            ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hvw₁
        _ = (Fintype.card G : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ + (Fintype.card (G × G) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
            rw [ENNReal.tsum_add, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.tsum_coe, one_mul,

              PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply]
    calc ∑' vw₀, (PMF.uniformOfFintype (G × G)) vw₀ *
          ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (G × G)).bind fun vw₁ =>
            (RandomPermutation.forgetfulAnswer
              (.inverse (vw₀.1, (l₁ - l₀) + vw₀.2))
              [((l₁, r₀), vw₁), ((l₀, r₀), vw₀)]).map
              (fun x => decide (-vw₀.1 + x.1.2 = -vw₁.1 + r₀))) true
        ≤ ∑' vw₀, (PMF.uniformOfFintype (G × G)) vw₀ *
            ((Fintype.card G : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ + (Fintype.card (G × G) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) :=

      _ = (Fintype.card G : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ + (Fintype.card (G × G) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
          rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.tsum_coe, one_mul]

theorem randomNonceSimHandler_not_nodup_le {α : Type} [Fintype N] [Nonempty N] [DecidableEq N]

    (hprog : prog.IsQueryBounded Q) (tr : List ((M × N) × Y)) :
    (((OracleComp.interpret randomNonceSimHandler prog).run tr).bind fun res =>
      PMF.pure (!decide (res.2.map (fun e => e.1.2)).Nodup)) true ≤
      if (tr.map (fun e => e.1.2)).Nodup then
        ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range Q, (tr.length + i) : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) / Fintype.card N
      else 1 := by
  induction hprog generalizing tr with
  | pure a Q =>
    by_cases hnodup : (tr.map (fun e => e.1.2)).Nodup <;>
      simp [hnodup, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure]

    by_cases hnodup : (tr.map (fun e => e.1.2)).Nodup
    · simp only [hnodup, ↓reduceIte, OracleComp.run_interpret_bind, OracleComp.run_interpret_query,
        randomNonceSimHandler, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind,
        PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.bind_bind, PMF.pure_bind]

          (((OracleComp.interpret randomNonceSimHandler (cont (x, t))).run
            (tr ++ [((m, x), t)])).bind fun res =>
              PMF.pure (!decide (res.2.map (fun e => e.1.2)).Nodup)) true ≤
          (PMF.pure (decide (x ∈ tr.map (fun e => e.1.2)))) true + B := by
        by_cases hx : x ∈ tr.map (fun e => e.1.2)
        · simp only [decide_eq_true hx, PMF.pure_apply, ↓reduceIte]
          exact (PMF.coe_le_one _ _).trans le_self_add
        · have hnodup' : ((tr ++ [((m, x), t)]).map (fun e => e.1.2)).Nodup := by
            rw [List.map_append, List.map_singleton, List.nodup_append]
            refine ⟨hnodup, List.nodup_singleton _, fun a ha b hb hab => ?_⟩
            rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb
            subst hb; subst hab
            exact hx ha

            ((OracleComp.interpret randomNonceSimHandler (cont (x, t))).run
              (tr ++ [((m, x), t)])).bind fun res =>
                PMF.pure (!decide (res.2.map (fun e => e.1.2)).Nodup)) true ≤
          (PMF.pure (decide (x ∈ tr.map (fun e => e.1.2)))) true + B := by
        rw [PMF.bind_apply]
        exact tsum_mul_le_of_forall_le (PMF.uniformOfFintype Y) (hxt x)
      have hmem_le :
          ((PMF.uniformOfFintype N).bind fun x =>
            PMF.pure (decide (x ∈ tr.map (fun e => e.1.2)))) true ≤
          (tr.length : ℝ≥0∞) / Fintype.card N := by
        let s : Set N := {x | x ∈ tr.map (fun e => e.1.2)}
        have h_eq :
            ((PMF.uniformOfFintype N).bind fun x =>
              PMF.pure (decide (x ∈ tr.map (fun e => e.1.2)))) true =
            (PMF.uniformOfFintype N).toOuterMeasure s := by
          rw [PMF.bind_apply, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
          change ∑' x, PMF.uniformOfFintype N x * (PMF.pure (decide (x ∈ s))) true =
            ∑' x, s.indicator (PMF.uniformOfFintype N) x

        gcongr
        have hsub : Finset.univ.filter (· ∈ s) ⊆ (tr.map (fun e => e.1.2)).toFinset := by
          intro x hx
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
          exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr hx.2

          (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans
            ((List.toFinset_card_le _).trans (by simp))
        exact_mod_cast hcard

      calc ∑' x, PMF.uniformOfFintype N x *
              ((PMF.uniformOfFintype Y).bind fun t =>
                ((OracleComp.interpret randomNonceSimHandler (cont (x, t))).run
                  (tr ++ [((m, x), t)])).bind fun res =>
                    PMF.pure (!decide (res.2.map (fun e => e.1.2)).Nodup)) true

        _ = ((PMF.uniformOfFintype N).bind fun x =>

private theorem identicalUntilBad (P : SigmaProtocol X Y T C Z) (key : X × Y) :
    IdenticalUntilBad (realHandler (M := M) P key) (programHandler P key)
      fun st => st.2 = true where
  agree q st _ a st' hst' := by
    cases q with
    | inr x => rfl
    | inl m =>
      simp only [realHandler, programHandler, PMF.bind_apply]
      refine tsum_congr fun ts => congrArg (_ * ·) ?_
      cases hlookup : st.1.1.lookup (m, ts.1) with
      | some c =>
        refine ((PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr fun hx => ?_).trans
          ((PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr fun hx => ?_).symm <;>
        · obtain ⟨r, -, hr⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hx
          exact hst' (by rw [← (Prod.mk.inj hr).2]; simp)
      | none =>
        rw [oracle, memoize_of_none _ _ _ hlookup]
        simp only [PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.map_bind, PMF.pure_map]
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun (PMF.bind_pure_comp _ _) _
  absorb_first q st hst x hx := by
    cases q with
    | inl m =>
      obtain ⟨ts, -, hx⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_bind_iff _ _ _).mp hx
      obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hx
      simp [hst]
    | inr x' =>
      obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hx
      exact hst
  absorb_second q st hst x hx := by
    cases q with
    | inl m =>
      obtain ⟨ts, -, hx⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_bind_iff _ _ _).mp hx
      obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hx
      simp [hst]
    | inr x' =>
      obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hx
      exact hst

private theorem fork_le_oneWayGame [Nonempty X] {P : SigmaProtocol X Y T C Z}
    {keyGen : PMF (X × Y)} {R : X → Y → Prop} [∀ x y, Decidable (R x y)]
    {extract : Y → T → C → Z → C → Z → X} (hsound : P.SpecialSoundOn keyGen R extract)
    (simulate : Y → C → PMF (T × Z)) (A : Forger Y M (T × Z) (M × T) C) (Qs Qro : ℕ) :
    (Forking.fork (keyGen.bind fun key => coins simulate A (Qs + Qro) key.2)
        (forkingAlgorithm (Classical.arbitrary C) (Qro + 1) (forkingProgram P A))).map
          Option.isSome true ≤
      oneWayGame keyGen R (reduction P simulate extract A Qs Qro) true := by
  have hfork : Forking.fork (keyGen.bind fun key => coins simulate A (Qs + Qro) key.2)
      (forkingAlgorithm (Classical.arbitrary C) (Qro + 1) (forkingProgram P A)) =
      keyGen.bind fun key => Forking.fork (coins simulate A (Qs + Qro) key.2)
        (forkingAlgorithm (Classical.arbitrary C) (Qro + 1) (forkingProgram P A)) := by
    simp only [Forking.fork, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.bind_bind]
  rw [hfork, PMF.map_bind]
  simp only [oneWayGame, reduction, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.bind_map]
  refine Probability.PMF.bind_apply_mono_on_support _ _ fun key hkey => ?_
  rw [← PMF.bind_pure_comp]
  refine Probability.PMF.bind_apply_mono_on_support _ _ fun result hresult => ?_
  rcases result with _ | ⟨j, out, out'⟩
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨s, hs, h, h', -, hne, hout, hout', hj, hj', -, query, hq, hq'⟩ :=
      mem_support_fork hresult
    simp only [coins, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.mem_support_bind_iff,
      PMF.mem_support_pure_iff] at hs
    obtain ⟨c, -, trs, -, rfl⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨-, hnamed⟩ := runWithAnswers_forkingProgram P A _ (List.ofFn h) hout.symm
    obtain ⟨-, hnamed'⟩ := runWithAnswers_forkingProgram P A _ (List.ofFn h') hout'.symm
    obtain ⟨hp, hc, hv⟩ := hnamed j hj
    obtain ⟨hp', hc', hv'⟩ := hnamed' j hj'
    rw [List.getD_ofFn] at hc hc'
    have hpoint : out.1.2.2.1 = out'.1.2.2.1 :=
      Option.some.inj (hp.symm.trans (hq.trans (hq'.symm.trans hp')))
    have hR := hsound key hkey out.1.2.2.1.2 out.1.2.2.2.1 out.1.2.2.2.2 out'.1.2.2.2.1
      out'.1.2.2.2.2 (by rw [← hc, ← hc']; exact hne) hv (by rw [hpoint]; exact hv')
    simp [hR]

/-- **The game hops** for one key and one choice of the forger's coins: the experiment wins at
most as often as the forking program, with presampled transcripts, plus `Qs · (Qs + Qro) · δ`. -/
private theorem run_bind_finishGame_le {P : SigmaProtocol X Y T C Z} {keyGen : PMF (X × Y)}
    {R : X → Y → Prop} {simulate : Y → C → PMF (T × Z)} (hzk : P.SpecialHVZK R simulate)
    {key : X × Y} (hkey : R key.1 key.2) {δ : ENNReal}
    (hcommit : ∀ t, (P.commit key.1 key.2).map Prod.fst t ≤ δ)
    (A : Forger Y M (T × Z) (M × T) C) {Qs Qro : ℕ} (hA : A.CallBounded Qs Qro)
    (c : A.Coins) :
    ((interpret (handler (fiatShamir P keyGen) key) (A.forge key.2 c)).run ([], [])).bind
        (finishGame P key.2) true ≤
      ((PMF.iid (simulateConversation simulate key.2) (Qs + Qro)).map List.ofFn).bind (fun trs =>
        ((interpret countingUniform (forkingProgram P A (key.2, c, trs))).run 0).map
          fun run => run.1.2.1) true + (Qs * (Qs + Qro) : ℕ) * δ := by
  have h0 := run_interpret_map_state (realHandler P key) (handler (fiatShamir P keyGen) key)
    Prod.fst (realHandler_map P keyGen key) (A.forge key.2 c) (([], []), false)
  have h1 := run_interpret_map_state (programHandler P key)
    (fun q st => (simulateConversation simulate key.2).bind fun v => simulatedHandler v q st)
    Prod.fst (programHandler_map hzk hkey) (A.forge key.2 c) (([], []), false)
  have h2 := (hA.isQueryBounded key.2 c).run_interpret_presample
    (simulateConversation simulate key.2) (Classical.arbitrary _) simulatedHandler ([], [])
  have hflag := toOuterMeasure_flag_le P key hcommit (hA key.2 c).1 (hA.isQueryBounded key.2 c)
  rw [show (Qs : ENNReal) * ((Qs + Qro : ℕ) * δ) = (Qs * (Qs + Qro) : ℕ) * δ by
    push_cast; ring] at hflag
  rw [← h0, PMF.bind_map]
  refine ((identicalUntilBad P key).bind_apply_le _ _ _ _).trans (add_le_add (le_of_eq ?_) hflag)
  rw [← PMF.bind_map, h1, ← h2, PMF.bind_bind]
  refine congrArg (fun p : PMF Bool => p true) (congrArg (PMF.bind _) (funext fun trs => ?_))
  rw [PMF.bind_map, map_run_forkingProgram]
  rfl

open FiatShamir in
open scoped NNReal in
/-- **Security of Fiat–Shamir signatures** ([BonehShoup2023], Theorem 19.16 with Equation 19.21,
via [BellareNeven2006], Lemma 1). Let the Sigma protocol be special sound on the generated keys
with extractor `extract`, special HVZK with simulator `simulate`, and have `δ`-unpredictable
commitments, and let the key generator produce pairs in the relation. A forger making at most `Qs`
signing calls and `Qro` hash calls wins the random-oracle EUF-CMA experiment with probability at
most `Qs · (Qs + Qro) · δ + (Qro + 1) / N + √((Qro + 1) · ε')`, where `N` is the number of
challenges and `ε'` is the probability that the reduction outputs a witness for a generated
statement. -/
theorem succProbability_eufCmaGame_le [Nonempty X] [Nonempty T] [Nonempty Z] [DecidableEq C]
    {P : SigmaProtocol X Y T C Z} {keyGen : PMF (X × Y)} {R : X → Y → Prop}
    [∀ x y, Decidable (R x y)] {extract : Y → T → C → Z → C → Z → X}
    {simulate : Y → C → PMF (T × Z)} {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (hkey : ∀ key ∈ keyGen.support, R key.1 key.2) (hsound : P.SpecialSoundOn keyGen R extract)
    (hzk : P.SpecialHVZK R simulate)
    (hcommit : ∀ key ∈ keyGen.support, ∀ t, (P.commit key.1 key.2).map Prod.fst t ≤ δ)
    (A : Forger Y M (T × Z) (M × T) C) {Qs Qro : ℕ} (hA : A.CallBounded Qs Qro) :
    (Game.succProbability (eufCmaGame (fiatShamir P keyGen) A) : ℝ) ≤
      Qs * (Qs + Qro) * δ + (Qro + 1) / Fintype.card C +
        √((Qro + 1) * Game.succProbability
          (oneWayGame keyGen R (reduction P simulate extract A Qs Qro))) := by
  classical
  set first := keyGen.bind fun key => coins simulate A (Qs + Qro) key.2 with hfirst
  have hA' : eufCmaGame (fiatShamir P keyGen) A true ≤
      first.bind (fun s => ((interpret countingUniform (forkingProgram P A s)).run 0).map
        fun run => run.1.2.1) true + (Qs * (Qs + Qro) : ℕ) * (δ : ENNReal) := by
    rw [eufCmaGame_fiatShamir, hfirst]
    simp only [coins, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure, PMF.bind_bind,
      PMF.pure_bind]
    refine bind_apply_le_add fun key hkey' => bind_apply_le_add fun c _ => ?_
    exact run_bind_finishGame_le hzk (hkey key hkey') (hcommit key hkey') A hA c
  have hQro (y : Y) (s : A.Coins) : IsCostBounded hashCost (A.forge y s) Qro := (hA y s).2
  have hB : first.bind (fun s => ((interpret countingUniform (forkingProgram P A s)).run 0).map
        fun run => run.1.2.1) true ≤
      first.bind (fun s => ((interpret countingUniform (forkingProgram P A s)).run 0).bind
        fun run => PMF.pure (validIndex (Qro + 1) run.2 run.1.1).isSome) true :=
    Probability.PMF.bind_apply_mono_on_support _ _ fun s _ => map_run_le_accept P A hQro s
  have hC := le_add_sqrt_fork first (forkingProgram P A) (Classical.arbitrary C)
    (fun s => isQueryBounded_forkingProgram P A hQro s)
  have hD := fork_le_oneWayGame (P := P) hsound simulate A Qs Qro
  simp only [PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure] at hC
  simp only [Game.succProbability, ENNReal.coe_toNNReal_eq_toReal]
  have hK : (((Qs * (Qs + Qro) : ℕ) : ENNReal) * δ).toReal = Qs * (Qs + Qro) * δ := by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_natCast, ENNReal.coe_toReal]
    push_cast
    ring
  calc (eufCmaGame (fiatShamir P keyGen) A true).toReal
      ≤ (first.bind (fun s => ((interpret countingUniform (forkingProgram P A s)).run 0).bind
          fun run => PMF.pure (validIndex (Qro + 1) run.2 run.1.1).isSome) true).toReal +
          Qs * (Qs + Qro) * δ := by
        rw [← hK, ← ENNReal.toReal_add (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _)
          (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _) ENNReal.coe_ne_top)]
        exact ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨PMF.apply_ne_top _ _,
          ENNReal.mul_ne_top (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _) ENNReal.coe_ne_top⟩)
          (hA'.trans (add_le_add hB le_rfl))
    _ ≤ ((Qro + 1 : ℕ) / Fintype.card C + √((Qro + 1 : ℕ) * ((Forking.fork first
          (forkingAlgorithm (Classical.arbitrary C) (Qro + 1) (forkingProgram P A))).map
            Option.isSome true).toReal)) + Qs * (Qs + Qro) * δ := add_le_add hC le_rfl
    _ ≤ _ := by
        push_cast
        have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (ENNReal.toReal_mono (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _) hD) (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Qro + 1))
        linarith

private theorem abs_eval_derivative_T_mul_sqrt {n k : ℕ} (hk : k < n) :
    |(derivative (Chebyshev.T ℝ n)).eval (chebyshevZero n k)| *
      √(1 - chebyshevZero n k ^ 2) = n := by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := angle_mem hk
  have hn : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : n ≠ 0)
  set θ := (2 * k + 1) * π / (2 * n) with hθ
  have hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ := (by positivity : 0 ≤ π / (2 * n)).trans h₁
  rw [chebyshevZero, ← hθ, ← sin_eq_sqrt_one_sub_cos_sq hθ0 h₂, ← abs_of_nonneg
    (sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hθ0 h₂), ← abs_mul, Chebyshev.T_derivative_eq_U, eval_mul,
    mul_assoc, Chebyshev.U_real_cos]
  have hnθ : ((((n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1) * θ = k * π + π / 2 := by
    rw [hθ]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hnθ, sin_add_pi_div_two, cos_nat_mul_pi, eval_intCast, Int.cast_natCast, abs_mul, abs_pow,
    abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, mul_one, Nat.abs_cast]

private theorem abs_eval_le_mul_of_cos_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {q : ℝ[X]} (hq : q.natDegree < n)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, √(1 - y ^ 2) * |q.eval y| ≤ M) {x : ℝ}
    (hx₁ : cos (π / (2 * n)) ≤ x) (hx₂ : x ≤ 1) : |q.eval x| ≤ n * M := by
  classical
  set s := range n
  set v := chebyshevZero n
  set c : ℝ := 2 ^ (n - 1)
  have hc : 0 < c := by positivity
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (mul_nonneg (sqrt_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)).trans (hM 0 (by simp))
  have hinj := injOn_chebyshevZero n
  -- every node lies at or below `x`
  have hvx (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ s) : v j ≤ x := by
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := angle_mem (mem_range.1 hj)
    exact (cos_le_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (by positivity) h₂ h₁).trans hx₁
  have hv (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ s) : v j ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨neg_one_le_cos _, cos_le_one _⟩
  -- the derivative of `T n` is `c` times that of the node polynomial
  have hT' (y : ℝ) : (derivative (Chebyshev.T ℝ n)).eval y =
      c * (derivative (Lagrange.nodal s v)).eval y := by
    rw [T_eq_C_mul_nodal, derivative_C_mul, eval_mul, eval_C]
  -- interpolation at the zeros of `T n`
  have hdeg : q.degree < #s := by
    rw [card_range]
    exact (degree_le_natDegree).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hq)
  have heval : q.eval x = ∑ k ∈ s, q.eval (v k) *
      ((∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (x - v j)) / ∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (v k - v j)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [Lagrange.eq_interpolate hinj hdeg]
    rw [Lagrange.interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [eval_mul, eval_C, Lagrange.basis, eval_prod, ← prod_div_distrib]
    congr 1
    refine prod_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [Lagrange.basisDivisor, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, div_eq_inv_mul]
  -- the weight of each node
  have hweight (k : ℕ) (hk : k ∈ s) :
      n * |q.eval (v k)| ≤ c * M * |∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (v k - v j)| := by
    have hd : (derivative (Lagrange.nodal s v)).eval (v k) = ∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (v k - v j) := by
      rw [Lagrange.eval_nodal_derivative_eval_node_eq hk, Lagrange.eval_nodal]
    have h := abs_eval_derivative_T_mul_sqrt (mem_range.1 hk)
    rw [hT', hd] at h
    calc (n : ℝ) * |q.eval (v k)|
        = |c * ∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (v k - v j)| * (√(1 - v k ^ 2) * |q.eval (v k)|) := by
          rw [← h]; ring
      _ ≤ |c * ∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (v k - v j)| * M := by gcongr; exact hM _ (hv k hk)
      _ = c * M * |∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (v k - v j)| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc]; ring
  have hsum : ∑ k ∈ s, ∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (x - v j) = (derivative (Lagrange.nodal s v)).eval x := by
    rw [Lagrange.derivative_nodal, eval_finsetSum]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Lagrange.eval_nodal.symm
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hcos : 0 ≤ cos (π / (2 * n)) :=
    cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [(by positivity : 0 ≤ π / (2 * n)), pi_pos],
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left pi_pos.le two_pos (by linarith)⟩
  have hx : |x| ≤ 1 := abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, hx₂⟩
  have hTx : (derivative (Chebyshev.T ℝ n)).eval x ≤ n ^ 2 := by
    have h := Chebyshev.abs_iterate_derivative_T_real_le n 1 hx
    simp only [Function.iterate_one, Chebyshev.derivative_T_eval_one] at h
    exact_mod_cast (le_abs_self _).trans h
  calc |q.eval x|
      ≤ ∑ k ∈ s, |q.eval (v k) *
          ((∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (x - v j)) / ∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (v k - v j))| := by
        rw [heval]; exact abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ s, c * M / n * ∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (x - v j) := by
        refine sum_le_sum fun k hk => ?_
        have hw : 0 ≤ ∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (x - v j) :=
          prod_nonneg fun j hj => sub_nonneg.2 (hvx j (mem_of_mem_erase hj))
        have hd : ∏ j ∈ s.erase k, (v k - v j) ≠ 0 := prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun j hj =>
          sub_ne_zero.2 fun h => (mem_erase.1 hj).1 (hinj (mem_of_mem_erase hj) hk h.symm)
        have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hweight k hk) hw
        rw [abs_mul, abs_div, abs_of_nonneg hw, mul_div_assoc', div_le_iff₀ (abs_pos.2 hd),
          div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hnR]
        linarith
    _ = M / n * (derivative (Chebyshev.T ℝ n)).eval x := by
        rw [← mul_sum, hsum, hT']; ring
    _ ≤ M / n * n ^ 2 := by gcongr
    _ = n * M := by field_simp

`√(1 - x²) |q(x)| ≤ M` on `[-1, 1]` satisfies `|q(x)| ≤ n M` on `[-1, 1]`. -/

theorem abs_eval_le_mul_of_sqrt_mul_abs_eval_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {q : ℝ[X]}
    (hq : q.natDegree < n) {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, √(1 - y ^ 2) * |q.eval y| ≤ M)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) : |q.eval x| ≤ n * M := by
  rcases le_or_gt (cos (π / (2 * n))) x with h | h
  · exact abs_eval_le_mul_of_cos_le hn hq hM h hx.2
  rcases le_or_gt x (-cos (π / (2 * n))) with h' | h'
  · -- reflect `q` to `q(-x)`
    have hq' : (q.comp (-X)).natDegree < n := by
      rwa [natDegree_comp, natDegree_neg, natDegree_X, mul_one]
    have := abs_eval_le_mul_of_cos_le hn hq' (M := M) (fun y hy => by
      simpa [eval_comp] using hM (-y) ⟨by linarith [hy.2], by linarith [hy.1]⟩)
      (x := -x) (by linarith) (by linarith [hx.1])
    simpa [eval_comp] using this
  · -- here `√(1 - x²) ≥ sin (π / 2n) ≥ 1 / n`
    have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hsin : 1 / n ≤ sin (π / (2 * n)) := by
      have h := mul_le_sin (x := π / (2 * n)) (by positivity)
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left pi_pos.le two_pos (by linarith [(by exact_mod_cast hn :
          (1 : ℝ) ≤ n)]))
      calc 1 / (n : ℝ) = 2 / π * (π / (2 * n)) := by field_simp
        _ ≤ _ := h
    have hsq : x ^ 2 < cos (π / (2 * n)) ^ 2 := sq_lt_sq' (by linarith) h
    have h1 : 1 / n ≤ √(1 - x ^ 2) := by
      rw [show (1 : ℝ) / n = √((1 / n) ^ 2) from (sqrt_sq (by positivity)).symm]
      refine sqrt_le_sqrt ?_
      have := sin_sq_add_cos_sq (π / (2 * n))
      nlinarith [hsin, (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / n)]
    calc |q.eval x| = n * (1 / n * |q.eval x|) := by field_simp
      _ ≤ n * (√(1 - x ^ 2) * |q.eval x|) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ n * M := by gcongr; exact hM x hx

private theorem natDegree_oddPart_lt {p : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : p.natDegree ≤ n)

  refine (natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun m _ => ?_).trans_lt (Nat.sub_lt hn one_pos)
  by_cases hm : p.natDegree < 2 * m + 1
  · simp [hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_lt_natDegree p _ hm]
  refine (natDegree_mul_le.trans (add_le_add (natDegree_mul_le.trans (add_le_add
    natDegree_comp_le (natDegree_C _).le)) natDegree_pow_le)).trans ?_
  have hX : (C a * X).natDegree ≤ 1 := (natDegree_C_mul_le a X).trans natDegree_X_le
  have h2 : (1 - X ^ 2 : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ 2 :=
    natDegree_sub_le_of_le (natDegree_one.le.trans (Nat.zero_le 2)) (natDegree_X_pow_le 2)
  rw [natDegree_hasseDeriv]
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (p.natDegree - (2 * m + 1)) hX
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m h2
  omega

theorem sqrt_mul_abs_eval_derivative_le {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.natDegree ≤ n) {M : ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |p.eval y| ≤ M) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    √(1 - x ^ 2) * |(derivative p).eval x| ≤ n * M := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp [derivative_of_natDegree_zero (Nat.le_zero.1 hp)]
  set b := √(1 - x ^ 2)
  have hb : b ^ 2 = 1 - x ^ 2 := sq_sqrt (by nlinarith [hx.1, hx.2])
  -- the odd part of `p` along the circle is bounded by `M`
  have hr : ∀ c ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, √(1 - c ^ 2) * |(oddPart p n x b).eval c| ≤ M := by
    intro c hc
    set s := √(1 - c ^ 2)
    have hs : s ^ 2 = 1 - c ^ 2 := sq_sqrt (by nlinarith [hc.1, hc.2])
    have hcirc (σ : ℝ) (hσ : σ ^ 2 = 1) : x * c + σ * b * s ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
      rw [Set.mem_Icc, ← abs_le, ← sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one]
      have key : (x * c + σ * b * s) ^ 2 + (x * s - σ * b * c) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        have : (x * c + σ * b * s) ^ 2 + (x * s - σ * b * c) ^ 2 =
            (x ^ 2 + σ ^ 2 * b ^ 2) * (c ^ 2 + s ^ 2) := by ring
        rw [this, hσ, hb, hs]
        ring
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x * s - σ * b * c)]
    have h := two_mul_mul_eval_oddPart hn hp x b c s hs
    have h₁ := hM _ (by simpa only [one_mul] using hcirc 1 (one_pow 2))
    have h₂ := hM (x * c - b * s) (by
      have hm := hcirc (-1) (by norm_num)
      rwa [show x * c + -1 * b * s = x * c - b * s by ring] at hm)
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := sqrt_nonneg _
    have : |2 * (s * (oddPart p n x b).eval c)| ≤ 2 * M :=
      h ▸ (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith)
    rw [abs_mul, abs_two, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs0] at this
    linarith
  have h := abs_eval_le_mul_of_sqrt_mul_abs_eval_le hn (natDegree_oddPart_lt hn hp x b) hr
    (x := 1) ⟨by norm_num, le_rfl⟩
  rwa [eval_oddPart_one hn, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sqrt_nonneg _), mul_comm] at h

theorem sub_mul_abs_eval_derivative_le {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.natDegree ≤ n) {a b M : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hM : ∀ y ∈ Icc a b, |p.eval y| ≤ M) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) :
    (b - a) * |(derivative p).eval x| ≤ 2 * n ^ 2 * M := by
  set L : ℝ[X] := C ((b - a) / 2) * X + C ((a + b) / 2)
  have hL (t : ℝ) : L.eval t = (b - a) / 2 * t + (a + b) / 2 := by simp [L]
  have hdeg : (p.comp L).natDegree ≤ n := by
    refine natDegree_comp_le.trans ?_
    have : L.natDegree ≤ 1 := natDegree_linear_le
    nlinarith
  have hbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |(p.comp L).eval t| ≤ M := fun t ht => by
    rw [eval_comp, hL]
    exact hM _ ⟨by nlinarith [ht.1], by nlinarith [ht.2]⟩
  have hba : 0 < b - a := sub_pos.2 hab
  set t := (2 * x - a - b) / (b - a)
  have ht : t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ hba]; linarith [hx.1]
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hba]; linarith [hx.2]
  have hLt : L.eval t = x := by
    rw [hL, show t = (2 * x - a - b) / (b - a) from rfl]
    field_simp
    ring
  have h := abs_eval_derivative_le_sq_mul hdeg hbound ht
  rw [derivative_comp, eval_mul, eval_comp, hLt, abs_mul] at h
  have hL' : (derivative L).eval t = (b - a) / 2 := by simp [L]
  rw [hL', abs_of_pos (by positivity)] at h
  linarith

private theorem exists_max_abs_eval_derivative {d N : ℕ} {q : ℝ[X]} (hq : q.natDegree ≤ d)
    (hN : 0 < N) {b₁ b₂ : ℝ} (hb : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → q.eval (k : ℝ) ∈ Icc b₁ b₂) :
    ∃ c, (∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) N, |(derivative q).eval y| ≤ c) ∧
      N * c ≤ d ^ 2 * (b₂ - b₁ + c) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) N, |q.eval y - (b₁ + b₂) / 2| ≤ (b₂ - b₁ + c) / 2 := by
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, hmax⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn (Set.nonempty_Icc.2 hNR.le)
    (continuous_abs.comp (derivative q).continuous).continuousOn
  set c := |(derivative q).eval y₀|
  have hc (y : ℝ) (hy : y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) N) : |(derivative q).eval y| ≤ c := hmax hy
  -- `q` is within `c / 2` of its value at the nearest integer
  have hval : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) N, |q.eval y - (b₁ + b₂) / 2| ≤ (b₂ - b₁ + c) / 2 := by
    intro y hy
    set k := ⌊y + 1 / 2⌋₊
    have hk₁ : (k : ℝ) ≤ y + 1 / 2 := Nat.floor_le (by linarith [hy.1])
    have hk₂ : y + 1 / 2 < k + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hkN : k ≤ N := by
      have : (k : ℝ) < N + 1 := by linarith [hy.2]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (by exact_mod_cast this)
    have hkI : (k : ℝ) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) N := ⟨k.cast_nonneg, by exact_mod_cast hkN⟩
    have hmvt := (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) N).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      (f := fun z => q.eval z) (fun z _ => (q.hasDerivAt z).hasDerivWithinAt) hc hkI hy
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmvt
    have hyk : |y - k| ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hqk := hb k hkN
    have h0 : 0 ≤ c := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hc y hy)
    rw [abs_le] at hmvt ⊢
    constructor <;> nlinarith [hqk.1, hqk.2, abs_nonneg (y - k)]
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_, hval⟩
  -- Markov's inequality on `[0, N]` at the maximum
  have h := sub_mul_abs_eval_derivative_le (p := q - C ((b₁ + b₂) / 2))
    ((natDegree_sub_C).le.trans hq) hNR (fun y hy => by simpa using hval y hy) hy₀
  rw [derivative_sub, derivative_C, sub_zero, sub_zero] at h
  linarith

most `d` whose values at the integers `0, …, N` lie in `[b₁, b₂]` satisfies
`(N - d²) |q'| ≤ d² (b₂ - b₁)` on `[0, N]`. -/

theorem sub_mul_abs_eval_le_of_forall_nat {d N : ℕ} {q : ℝ[X]} (hq : q.natDegree ≤ d) (hN : 0 < N)
    {B : ℝ} (hb : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → |q.eval (k : ℝ)| ≤ B) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) N) :
    (N - d ^ 2) * |q.eval x| ≤ N * B := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hNc, hval⟩ := exists_max_abs_eval_derivative hq hN (b₁ := -B) (b₂ := B)
    fun k hk => abs_le.1 (hb k hk)
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hb 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
  have hq' : |q.eval x| ≤ B + c / 2 := by
    have := hval x hx
    rw [neg_add_cancel, zero_div, sub_zero] at this
    linarith
  have h0 : 0 ≤ c := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hc x hx)
  rcases le_or_gt ((N : ℝ) - d ^ 2) 0 with h | h
  · nlinarith [abs_nonneg (q.eval x), (Nat.cast_nonneg N : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N)]
  · nlinarith

theorem sum_arccos_le_card_mul_arccos {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {x : ι → ℝ} {x₀ : ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, x i ∈ Icc 0 1) (hsum : s.card * x₀ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, x i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, arccos (x i) ≤ s.card * arccos x₀ := by
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · simp
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < s.card := by exact_mod_cast hne.card_pos
  have h := strictConcaveOn_arccos_Icc.concaveOn.le_map_sum (t := s)
    (w := fun _ => (s.card : ℝ)⁻¹) (p := x) (fun _ _ => by positivity)
    (by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hn.ne']) hx
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum] at h

    (hp' : p ≤ 2) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht' : t ≤ 1) :

  have hψ := monotoneOn_one_add_rpow_sub_one_sub_rpow_sub hp hp'
  -- `φ t = (1 + t) ^ p + (1 - t) ^ p - p (p - 1) t ^ 2` increases from `φ 0 = 2`
  have hφ : MonotoneOn (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t) ^ p + (1 - t) ^ p - p * (p - 1) * t ^ 2)
      (Icc 0 1) := by
    refine monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 1)
      (f' := fun t => p * ((1 + t) ^ (p - 1) - (1 - t) ^ (p - 1) - 2 * (p - 1) * t))

    have ht1 : t ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hA0).2 hBA
    have hBt : B = A * t := by rw [ht, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hA0.ne']

          rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by linarith), ← Real.rpow_natCast,
            ← Real.rpow_mul hA0.le, Nat.cast_ofNat, show (2 : ℝ) * (p / 2) = p by ring]
      _ ≤ A ^ p * (((1 + t) ^ p + (1 - t) ^ p) / 2) := by
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg hA0.le _)
          have hb := rpow_one_add_le_one_add_mul_self (s := (p - 1) * t ^ 2) (by linarith)
            (p := p / 2) (by positivity) (by linarith)
          have h2 := two_add_mul_sq_le_one_add_rpow_add_one_sub_rpow hp hp' ht0 ht1
          nlinarith

private theorem noiseOp_unit (ρ : ℝ) (g : (Unit → Bool) → ℝ) (b : Bool) :

  rw [noiseOp, h]
  refine (bernoulliAverage_prod _ fun (_ : Unit) (c : Bool) => g fun _ => b ^^ c).trans ?_
  rw [Fintype.prod_unique, Bool.xor_false, Bool.xor_true]

theorem lpNorm_two_noiseOp_le_of_unit {p ρ : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ 2) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)

private theorem fiber_completion_density (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (s x : ι → Bool)
    (hX : (coordinateFiber X s x).Nonempty) (R : {i // s i = true} → Bool)
    {k : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hd : uniformDeficit (coordinateFiber X s x) ≤ 64 * k)
    (hl : (𝔼 z, if coordinateMarginal (uniformDensity (coordinateFiber X s x)) R z ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (-128 * k - 2) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-64 * k)) :
    (𝔼 u, if coordinateDensity X (fun i => if h : s i = true then !R ⟨i, h⟩ else false)
      (completePattern s x u) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-194 * k) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (-k - 6) := by
  have hpoint (u : {i // s i = true} → Bool) :
      (if coordinateDensity X (fun i => if h : s i = true then !R ⟨i, h⟩ else false)
        (completePattern s x u) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-194 * k) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        if projectionAverage (uniformDensity (coordinateFiber X s x)) R u ≤
          (2 : ℝ) ^ (-128 * k - 2) then 1 else 0 := by
    split_ifs with hb hl
    · exact le_rfl
    · exfalso
      apply hl
      have he := projectionAverage_uniformDensity_fiber X s x hX R u
      rw [he]
      calc
        _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ uniformDeficit (coordinateFiber X s x) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-194 * k) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb.le (by positivity)
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (uniformDeficit (coordinateFiber X s x) - 194 * k) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num)]
          congr 1
          ring
        _ ≤ _ := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    · positivity
    · exact le_rfl
  have he := expect_le_expect (s := univ) (fun u _ => hpoint u)
  rw [expect_comp_projectionAverage (uniformDensity (coordinateFiber X s x)) R
    (fun v => if v ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-128 * k - 2) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)] at he
  exact (he.trans hl).trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith))

theorem exists_mirror_set (X Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) (hX : X.Nonempty)
    {k p q : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hdef : uniformDeficit X ≤ k) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : q = 32768 * k * p) (hq' : q ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hlim : ∀ x ∈ X, IsDensityLimit Y p k x) :
    ∃ Y' : Finset (ι → Bool), Y' ⊆ Y ∧ Y'.Nonempty ∧ uniformDeficit Y' ≤ 2 * k + 2 ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Y', IsDensityLimit X q (194 * k) y := by
  let A := Y.filter (IsDensityLimit X q (194 * k))
  have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hpq : p ≤ q := by rw [hq]; nlinarith [mul_nonneg hp.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hk)]
  have hm : 1 / 4 ≤ guidedAverage X Y p k (fun z => if z ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    simpa only [A, mem_filter] using
      guidedAverage_mirror_mass X Y hX hk hdef hp hq hq' hlim
  have hb : guidedAverage X Y p k (fun z => if z ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ k * A.card / X.card := by
    simpa using guidedAverage_bound X Y hp.le (hpq.trans hq1) (show 0 ≤ k by linarith)
      (fun z => if z ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) (by intro z; split_ifs <;> norm_num)
  have hxpos : (0 : ℝ) < X.card := by exact_mod_cast hX.card_pos
  have hxcount := (uniformDeficit_le_iff hX).mp hdef
  have hprod : (4 * (2 : ℝ) ^ k) * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - (2 * k + 2)) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - k) := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ) by norm_num,
      ← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num)]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hcard : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - (2 * k + 2)) ≤ A.card := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (show 0 < 4 * (2 : ℝ) ^ k by positivity)).mp
    rw [hprod]
    have hh := (le_div_iff₀ hxpos).mp (hm.trans hb)
    nlinarith
  have hA : A.Nonempty := by
    apply card_pos.mp
    have hpos := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)
      ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - (2 * k + 2))).trans_le hcard
    exact_mod_cast hpos
  exact ⟨A, filter_subset _ _, hA, (uniformDeficit_le_iff hA).mpr hcard,
    fun y hy => (mem_filter.mp hy).2⟩

      #((univ.powersetCard k).filter (S ⊆ ·)) := by

    exact sum_congr rfl fun x _ => (monomial_apply S x).trans (by congr)
  rw [layerAverage, expect_eq_sum_div_card, hsum, card_filter_weight_eq]
  have hnk : (n.choose k : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (Nat.choose_pos hk).ne'
  rcases lt_or_ge k #S with hks | hks
  · -- no `k`-set contains `S`

    have hns : (n.choose #S : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (Nat.choose_pos (hks.trans hk)).ne'
    rw [div_eq_div_iff hnk hns]

      rw [mul_comm, ← Nat.choose_mul hks, mul_comm])

theorem eq_of_covering {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r → ℕ) (hk : StrictAnti k) (hk0 : ∀ i, 0 < k i)
    (I J : Finset (Fin r)) (hcard : J.card = I.card)
    (ℓ : (Σ j : J, Fin (k j)) → Option (Σ i : I, Fin (k i)))
    (hcov : ∀ v, ∃ p, ℓ p = some v) (hmono : ∀ p v, ℓ p = some v → (v.1 : Fin r) ≤ p.1) :
    J = I := by
  classical
  choose sec hsec using hcov
  -- weight `1 / k i` on every slot of block `i`
  let w : Fin r → ℚ := fun i => 1 / (k i : ℚ)
  have hw_pos : ∀ i, 0 < w i := fun i => by
    have := hk0 i
    positivity
  have hsumI : ∑ v : (Σ i : I, Fin (k i)), w v.1 = I.card := sum_sigma_one_div_eq_card hk0 I
  have hsumJ : ∑ p : (Σ j : J, Fin (k j)), w p.1 = J.card := sum_sigma_one_div_eq_card hk0 J
  have hsec_inj : Function.Injective sec := fun v v' h =>
    Option.some_injective _ ((hsec v).symm.trans ((congrArg ℓ h).trans (hsec v')))
  have hle : ∀ v, w v.1 ≤ w (sec v).1 := fun v => by
    have h := hk.antitone (hmono (sec v) v (hsec v))
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by have := hk0 (sec v).1; positivity) (by exact_mod_cast h)
  have h1 : ∑ v : (Σ i : I, Fin (k i)), w v.1 ≤ ∑ v, w (sec v).1 :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun v _ => hle v
  have himage : ∑ v : (Σ i : I, Fin (k i)), w (sec v).1 =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.image sec, w p.1 :=
    (Finset.sum_image (f := fun p : (Σ j : J, Fin (k j)) => w p.1)
      fun v _ v' _ h => hsec_inj h).symm
  have h2 : ∑ v : (Σ i : I, Fin (k i)), w (sec v).1 ≤ ∑ p : (Σ j : J, Fin (k j)), w p.1 := by
    rw [himage]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      fun p _ _ => (hw_pos _).le
  have hcardQ : ((I.card : ℕ) : ℚ) = J.card := by rw [hcard]
  -- every slot of `J` is the chosen preimage of a slot of `I`
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective sec := by
    intro p
    by_contra hp
    push Not at hp
    have : ∑ v : (Σ i : I, Fin (k i)), w (sec v).1 < ∑ p : (Σ j : J, Fin (k j)), w p.1 := by
      rw [himage]
      refine Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) (Finset.mem_univ p) ?_ (hw_pos _)
        fun _ _ _ => (hw_pos _).le
      rw [Finset.mem_image]
      rintro ⟨v, -, hv⟩
      exact hp v hv
    linarith
  -- and lies in the same block
  have hblock : ∀ v, ((sec v).1 : Fin r) = v.1 := by
    intro v
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : w v.1 < w (sec v).1 := by
      have h := hk (lt_of_le_of_ne (hmono (sec v) v (hsec v)) (Ne.symm hne))
      exact one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by have := hk0 (sec v).1; positivity) (by exact_mod_cast h)
    have : ∑ v : (Σ i : I, Fin (k i)), w v.1 < ∑ v, w (sec v).1 :=
      Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun v _ => hle v) ⟨v, Finset.mem_univ _, hlt⟩
    linarith
  refine Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (fun j hj => ?_) hcard.ge
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsurj ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, ⟨0, hk0 j⟩⟩
  have := hblock v
  rw [hv] at this
  rw [show j = (v.1 : Fin r) from this]
  exact v.1.2

theorem exists_subset_card_eq_mul_sum_le {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (d : ι → ℕ)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ S.card) :
    ∃ I ⊆ S, I.card = t ∧ t * ∑ i ∈ S, d i ≤ S.card * ∑ i ∈ I, d i := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image (S.powersetCard t) (fun I => ∑ i ∈ I, d i)
    (Finset.powersetCard_nonempty.2 ht)
  obtain ⟨hIS, hIcard⟩ := Finset.mem_powersetCard.1 hI
  refine ⟨I, hIS, hIcard, ?_⟩
  -- no element outside `I` beats an element of `I`
  have hex : ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j ∈ S \ I, d j ≤ d i := by
    intro i hi j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hj
    have hjI : j ∉ I.erase i := fun h => hj.2 (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase h)
    have := hmax (insert j (I.erase i)) (Finset.mem_powersetCard.2
      ⟨Finset.insert_subset hj.1 ((Finset.erase_subset _ _).trans hIS), by
        rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hjI, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi, hIcard]
        have := Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨i, hi⟩
        omega⟩)
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hjI, ← Finset.add_sum_erase I d hi] at this
    omega
  have h1 : t * ∑ j ∈ S \ I, d j ≤ (S \ I).card * ∑ i ∈ I, d i := by
    calc t * ∑ j ∈ S \ I, d j = ∑ j ∈ S \ I, ∑ _i ∈ I, d j := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          simp [Finset.sum_const, hIcard]
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ S \ I, ∑ i ∈ I, d i :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hex i hi j hj
      _ = (S \ I).card * ∑ i ∈ I, d i := by rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_sdiff hIS, ← Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card hIS, hIcard, mul_add,
    add_mul]
  omega

private theorem exists_subset_card_eq_forall_lt_and_mul_sum_le {n r M t : ℕ} {d : Fin r → ℕ}
    (hdn : ∀ i, d i ≤ n) (hsum : r * M + n * t < ∑ i, d i) :
    ∃ I₀ : Finset (Fin r), I₀.card = t ∧ (∀ i ∈ I₀, M < d i) ∧
      t * (∑ i, d i - r * M) ≤ r * ∑ i ∈ I₀, d i := by
  classical
  -- the blocks of dimension above `M`
  let S := Finset.univ.filter fun i => M < d i
  have hS : ∑ i, d i ≤ r * M + ∑ i ∈ S, d i := by
    have hsmall : ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬ M < d i), d i ≤ r * M :=
      calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬ M < d i), d i
          ≤ ∑ _i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬ M < d i), M :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => not_lt.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2
        _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin r, M := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
        _ = r * M := by simp
    have := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ (fun i => M < d i) d
    change ∑ i ∈ S, d i + _ = _ at this
    omega
  have hSr : S.card ≤ r := by simpa using Finset.card_filter_le Finset.univ fun i => M < d i
  have hSn : ∑ i ∈ S, d i ≤ S.card * n :=
    calc ∑ i ∈ S, d i ≤ ∑ _i ∈ S, n := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hdn i
      _ = S.card * n := by simp
  have hSt : t ≤ S.card := by
    by_contra h
    have : S.card * n + n ≤ t * n := by
      rw [← Nat.succ_mul]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    rw [mul_comm n t] at hsum
    omega
  obtain ⟨I₀, hI₀S, hI₀card, hI₀sum⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq_mul_sum_le S d hSt
  exact ⟨I₀, hI₀card, fun i hi => (Finset.mem_filter.1 (hI₀S hi)).2,
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left t (by omega)).trans (hI₀sum.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hSr))⟩

`t`-element set `I₀` of blocks with `M < d i` and `n < ∑ i ∈ I₀, (d i - (r + 1 - i))`. -/

private theorem exists_subset_card_eq_sum_sub_gt {n r M t : ℕ} {d : Fin r → ℕ}
    (hdn : ∀ i, d i ≤ n) (ht : 0 < t) (hM : r + 1 ≤ M)
    (hsum : r * M + r * (r + 1) + n * t + n * r / t < ∑ i, d i) :
    ∃ I₀ : Finset (Fin r), I₀.card = t ∧ (∀ i ∈ I₀, M < d i) ∧
      n < ∑ i ∈ I₀, (d i - (r + 1 - (i : ℕ))) := by
  have h2 : n * r < t * (n * r / t + 1) := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (n * r) ht
  generalize n * r / t = q at hsum h2
  obtain ⟨I₀, hI₀card, hI₀big, h1⟩ :=
    exists_subset_card_eq_forall_lt_and_mul_sum_le (M := M) (t := t) hdn (by omega)
  refine ⟨I₀, hI₀card, hI₀big, ?_⟩
  -- `I₀` has `∑ (dᵢ - kᵢ) > n`
  set X := ∑ i ∈ I₀, d i
  have h3 : r * (r + 1) + n * t + q + 1 ≤ ∑ i, d i - r * M := by omega
  have h4 := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left t h3).trans h1
  have e1 : t * (r * (r + 1) + n * t + q + 1) =
      t * (r * (r + 1)) + t * (n * t) + t * (q + 1) := by ring
  have e2 : r * (t * (r + 1) + n) = t * (r * (r + 1)) + n * r := by ring
  rw [e1] at h4
  have h5 : r * (t * (r + 1) + n) < r * X := by
    rw [e2]
    omega
  have hX : t * (r + 1) + n < X := Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h5
  have hsplit : ∑ i ∈ I₀, (d i - (r + 1 - (i : ℕ))) + ∑ i ∈ I₀, (r + 1 - (i : ℕ)) = X := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi =>
      Nat.sub_add_cancel ((Nat.sub_le (r + 1) i).trans (hM.trans (hI₀big i hi).le))
  have hk : ∑ i ∈ I₀, (r + 1 - (i : ℕ)) ≤ t * (r + 1) :=
    calc ∑ i ∈ I₀, (r + 1 - (i : ℕ))
        ≤ ∑ _i ∈ I₀, (r + 1) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => Nat.sub_le _ _
      _ = t * (r + 1) := by simp [hI₀card]
  omega

theorem exists_traceSym_ne {n s r t : ℕ} (hn : finrank (ZMod 2) F = n)
    (hs : ∀ K : Subfield F, K ≠ ⊤ → Nat.card K ≤ 2 ^ s) {μ : F} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (ht : 0 < t)
    (A : AffineSubspace (ZMod 2) (Fin r → F))
    (hA : r * max (r + 1) s + r * (r + 1) + n * t + n * r / t <
      finrank (ZMod 2) A.direction) :
    ∃ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∈ A, traceSym μ r t x ≠ traceSym μ r t y := by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype F
  -- the pivot spaces of the direction of `A`
  let Y : Fin r → Submodule (ZMod 2) F := pivotSpace A.direction
  let d : Fin r → ℕ := fun i => finrank (ZMod 2) (Y i)
  let k : Fin r → ℕ := fun i => r + 1 - i
  obtain ⟨I₀, hI₀card, hI₀big, hI₀⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq_sum_sub_gt
    (d := d) (fun i => hn ▸ Submodule.finrank_le _) ht (le_max_left _ _)
    ((sum_finrank_pivotSpace A.direction).symm ▸ hA)
  -- families in the pivot spaces with nonzero trace of the product of Moore determinants
  have hI₀ne : I₀.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.1 (hI₀card ▸ ht)
  obtain ⟨u, huY, hu⟩ := exists_trace_mul_prod_det_mooreMatrix_ne_zero (ι := I₀) hn hs
    (fun i => Y i) (fun i => k i)
    (fun i => show 2 ≤ r + 1 - ((i : Fin r) : ℕ) by have := (i.1 : Fin r).isLt; omega)
    (fun i => lt_of_le_of_lt ((Nat.sub_le _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)) (hI₀big i i.2))
    (fun i => lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) (hI₀big i i.2)) ⟨hI₀ne.choose, hI₀ne.choose_spec⟩
    (by
      rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort I₀ fun i => d i - k i]
      exact hI₀.trans_le (Nat.le_add_left _ _)) hμ
  -- lift them to `A.direction`, vanishing below their block
  choose v hvA hvlow hvdiag using
    fun (i : I₀) (l : Fin (k i)) => mem_pivotSpace.1 (huY i l)
  -- a base point
  have hAne : (A : Set (Fin r → F)).Nonempty := by
    rw [AffineSubspace.nonempty_iff_ne_bot]
    rintro rfl
    rw [AffineSubspace.direction_bot, finrank_bot] at hA
    exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ hA
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := hAne
  -- the cube spanned by the lifted directions
  let κ := Σ i : I₀, Fin (k i)
  let x : (κ → ZMod 2) → Fin r → F := fun c => (∑ q : κ, c q • v q.1 q.2) +ᵥ γ
  have hxA : ∀ c, x c ∈ A := fun c => AffineSubspace.vadd_mem_of_mem_direction
    (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun q _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hvA _ _)) hγ
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  -- a constant function has zero cube sum
  have hzero : ∑ c : κ → ZMod 2, traceSym μ r t (x c) = 0 := by
    have hκ : 0 < Fintype.card κ :=
      Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 ⟨⟨⟨_, hI₀ne.choose_spec⟩, ⟨0, by simp only [k]; omega⟩⟩⟩
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => hcon _ (hxA c) _ hγ, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fun, ZMod.card, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_pow,
      show ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod 2) = 0 from rfl, zero_pow hκ.ne', zero_mul]
  -- comparing the two computations of the cube sum
  exact hu ((sum_cube_traceSym_eq μ hI₀card u v hvlow hvdiag γ).symm.trans hzero)

theorem exists_isAffineDisperser {n d : ℕ} (h : n * (d + 1) + 1 < 2 ^ d) :
    ∃ f : BitString n → Bool, IsAffineDisperser f d := by
  classical
  by_contra hno
  push Not at hno
  set A := univ.filter fun g : BitString d → BitString n => IsAffine g ∧ Function.Injective g
  have hsub : (univ : Finset (BitString n → Bool)) ⊆
      A.biUnion fun g => univ.filter fun f => ∀ x y, f (g x) = f (g y) := by
    intro f _
    have := hno f
    unfold IsAffineDisperser at this
    push Not at this
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hinj, hconst⟩ := this
    exact mem_biUnion.2 ⟨g, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, hg, hinj⟩, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, hconst⟩⟩
  have hcard := (card_le_card hsub).trans (card_biUnion_le_card_mul A _ (2 * 2 ^ (2 ^ n - 2 ^ d))
    fun g hg => card_const_on_range_le (mem_filter.1 hg).2.2)
  rw [card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool,
    Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
  rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hA | ⟨g, hg⟩
  · rw [hA, card_empty, zero_mul] at hcard
    exact absurd hcard (Nat.not_le.2 (Nat.two_pow_pos _))
  · have hdn : 2 ^ d ≤ 2 ^ n := by
      have := Fintype.card_le_of_injective g (mem_filter.1 hg).2.2
      simpa [Fintype.card_fun] using this
    have hA : A.card ≤ 2 ^ (n * (d + 1)) := (card_le_card fun g hg =>
      mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.1 hg).2.1⟩).trans (card_isAffine_le d n)
    have hlt : A.card * (2 * 2 ^ (2 ^ n - 2 ^ d)) < 2 ^ 2 ^ n :=
      calc A.card * (2 * 2 ^ (2 ^ n - 2 ^ d)) ≤ 2 ^ (n * (d + 1)) * (2 * 2 ^ (2 ^ n - 2 ^ d)) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hA
        _ = 2 ^ (n * (d + 1) + 1 + (2 ^ n - 2 ^ d)) := by rw [pow_add, pow_add, pow_one]; ring
        _ < 2 ^ 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    omega

    (hs : ∀ K : Subfield F, K ≠ ⊤ → Nat.card K ≤ 2 ^ s) {μ : F} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (ht : 0 < t)
    (b : Basis ι (ZMod 2) F) {pos : Fin r × ι → Fin N} (hpos : Function.Injective pos)
    (A : AffineSubspace Bool (BitString N))
    (hA : N - r * n + (r * max (r + 1) s + r * (r + 1) + n * t + n * r / t) <
      finrank Bool A.direction) :
    ∃ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∈ A, traceSymBits μ r t b pos x ≠ traceSymBits μ r t b pos y := by
  classical
  have hcard : Fintype.card ι = n := (finrank_eq_card_basis b).symm.trans hn
  have hAne : (A : Set (BitString N)).Nonempty := by
    rw [AffineSubspace.nonempty_iff_ne_bot]
    rintro rfl
    rw [AffineSubspace.direction_bot, finrank_bot] at hA
    exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ hA
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hAne
  set W := A.direction
  set E := toZMod N
  -- the direction of `A`, as an `𝔽₂`-subspace of `Fin N → ZMod 2`
  set WZ : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin N → ZMod 2) :=
    AddSubgroup.toZModSubmodule 2 (W.toAddSubgroup.map E.toAddMonoidHom)
  have hWZ : finrank (ZMod 2) WZ = finrank Bool W := by
    have h := rank_eq_of_equiv_equiv (R := Bool) (R' := ZMod 2) (M := W) (M₁ := WZ)
      bitEquiv.symm (E.addSubgroupMap W.toAddSubgroup) bitEquiv.symm.bijective fun c w => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        funext k
        change bitEquiv.symm ((c • (w : BitString N)) k) = bitEquiv.symm c * bitEquiv.symm (w.1 k)
        rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]
    exact (congrArg Cardinal.toNat h).symm
  set ψ := readLinear b pos
  set A' : AffineSubspace (ZMod 2) (Fin r → F) := AffineSubspace.mk' (ψ (E p)) (WZ.map ψ)
  have hdim : finrank Bool W - (N - r * n) ≤ finrank (ZMod 2) A'.direction := by
    rw [AffineSubspace.direction_mk']
    have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (ψ.domRestrict WZ)
    rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict] at h1
    have h2 : finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker (ψ.domRestrict WZ)) ≤
        finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker ψ) := by
      rw [LinearMap.ker_domRestrict, ← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq,
        Submodule.map_comap_subtype]
      exact Submodule.finrank_mono inf_le_right
    have h3 : finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker ψ) ≤ N - r * n := by
      have := finrank_ker_readLinear_le b hpos
      rwa [hcard] at this
    omega
  obtain ⟨x', hx', y', hy', hne⟩ := exists_traceSym_ne hn hs hμ ht A' (by omega)
  -- the points of `A'` are read from points of `A`
  have hlift : ∀ z ∈ A', ∃ x ∈ A, readField b pos x = z := by
    intro z hz
    rw [AffineSubspace.mem_mk'] at hz
    obtain ⟨w', ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, hwz⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨w +ᵥ p, AffineSubspace.vadd_mem_of_mem_direction hw hp, ?_⟩
    rw [readField_eq, vadd_eq_add, map_add, map_add]
    change ψ (E.toAddMonoidHom w) + ψ (E p) = z
    rw [hwz, vsub_eq_sub, sub_add_cancel]
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hlift x' hx'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hlift y' hy'
  exact ⟨x, hx, y, hy, fun h => hne (bitEquiv.injective h)⟩

  set L := primeBound N
  set T := N / (ℓ + 1) ^ 2

    change N / (ℓ + 1) ^ 2 = _
    rw [Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, sq]

  set r := numBlocks N
  have hr : r = N / n := rfl
  have hn0 : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fieldDegree_ne_zero N)
  have hn : n = (selectBelow T (primesIoc L (4 * L))).prod := fieldDegree_eq_prod N
  have hnT : n ≤ T := hn ▸ prod_selectBelow_le hT1 _

    have h1 := Nat.mod_add_div' N n
    have h2 := Nat.mod_lt N hn0
    rw [hr]
    omega
  have hmax : r * max (r + 1) (subfieldExp N) ≤ r * (r + 1) + r * subfieldExp N := by
    rw [← Nat.mul_add]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (max_le (by omega) (by omega))

    (Nat.mul_div_le_mul_div_assoc r n (L + 1)).trans (Nat.div_le_div_right hrn)
  have hnt : n * symDegree N ≤ N / (ℓ + 1) :=
    calc n * symDegree N ≤ T * (ℓ + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul hnT le_rfl
      _ ≤ N / (ℓ + 1) := hT ▸ Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _

    Nat.div_le_div_right (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hrn)

private theorem four_mul_numBlocks_le_of_prod_le {N : ℕ}
    (hcheb : 64 * (3 * primeBound N + 3) *
      (4 * primeBound N + 1) ^ (8 * Nat.sqrt (primeBound N) + 10) ≤ 2 ^ primeBound N)
    (hP : (primesIoc (primeBound N) (4 * primeBound N)).prod ≤ fieldDegree N) :
    4 * ((Nat.log 2 N + 1) * (numBlocks N * (numBlocks N + 1))) ≤ N := by
  set ℓ := Nat.log 2 N
  set L := primeBound N
  have hL : L = ℓ / 3 := rfl
  set r := numBlocks N
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with hr0 | hr0
  · simp [hr0]
  set P := (primesIoc L (4 * L)).prod
  have hPpos : 0 < P := List.prod_pos fun p hp => (mem_primesIoc.1 hp).2.2.pos
  have h16 : 16 ^ L ≤ (4 * L + 1) ^ (8 * Nat.sqrt L + 10) * P ^ 2 :=
    calc 16 ^ L = (4 ^ L) ^ 2 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul]; norm_num
      _ ≤ ((4 * L + 1) ^ (4 * Nat.sqrt L + 5) * P) ^ 2 :=
        Nat.pow_le_pow_left (four_pow_le_mul_prod_primesIoc L) 2
      _ = (4 * L + 1) ^ (8 * Nat.sqrt L + 10) * P ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
        ring_nf
  have hP2 : 64 * (3 * L + 3) * 8 ^ L ≤ P ^ 2 := by
    refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (by positivity : 0 < (4 * L + 1) ^ (8 * Nat.sqrt L + 10))
    calc (4 * L + 1) ^ (8 * Nat.sqrt L + 10) * (64 * (3 * L + 3) * 8 ^ L)
        = 64 * (3 * L + 3) * (4 * L + 1) ^ (8 * Nat.sqrt L + 10) * 8 ^ L := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ L * 8 ^ L := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hcheb
      _ = 16 ^ L := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
      _ ≤ _ := h16
  have h8L : N < 8 * 8 ^ L :=
    calc N < 2 ^ (ℓ + 1) := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self one_lt_two N
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (3 * L + 3) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos (by omega)
      _ = 8 * 8 ^ L := by rw [pow_add, pow_mul]; norm_num; ring
  have hNP : 8 * (ℓ + 1) * N ≤ P ^ 2 := by
    have : ℓ + 1 ≤ 3 * L + 3 := by omega
    nlinarith
  have hrP : r * P ≤ N := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left r hP).trans (numBlocks_mul_le N)
  have h8 : 8 * (ℓ + 1) * r ^ 2 ≤ N := by
    refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ (by positivity : 0 < P ^ 2)
    calc 8 * (ℓ + 1) * r ^ 2 * P ^ 2 = 8 * (ℓ + 1) * (r * P) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ 8 * (ℓ + 1) * N ^ 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hrP 2)
      _ = 8 * (ℓ + 1) * N * N := by ring
      _ ≤ P ^ 2 * N := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hNP
      _ = N * P ^ 2 := by ring
  nlinarith

private theorem eventually_four_mul_numBlocks_le :
    ∀ᶠ N in atTop, 4 * ((Nat.log 2 N + 1) * (numBlocks N * (numBlocks N + 1))) ≤ N := by
  obtain ⟨ℓ₁, hℓ₁⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 (Nat.eventually_mul_add_one_pow_le_pow 16 7 one_lt_two)
  obtain ⟨L₂, hL₂⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 eventually_chebyshevFactor_le
  filter_upwards [Nat.eventually_le_log (ℓ₁ + 3 * L₂ + 3) one_lt_two] with N hN
  set ℓ := Nat.log 2 N
  have hpow := hℓ₁ ℓ (by omega)
  have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp [ℓ] at hN
  have hNℓ : 2 ^ ℓ ≤ N := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hN0
  set L := primeBound N
  have hL : L = ℓ / 3 := rfl
  set T := N / (ℓ + 1) ^ 2
  set n := fieldDegree N
  set r := numBlocks N
  have hn0 : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fieldDegree_ne_zero N)
  have hn : n = (selectBelow T (primesIoc L (4 * L))).prod := fieldDegree_eq_prod N
  -- the number of blocks is small
  have hps : ∀ p ∈ primesIoc L (4 * L), 0 < p ∧ p ≤ 4 * L := fun p hp => by
    obtain ⟨-, h2, h3⟩ := mem_primesIoc.1 hp
    exact ⟨h3.pos, h2⟩
  rcases prod_le_or_lt_mul_prod_selectBelow T hps with hP | hTn
  · -- every prime in `(L, 4 L]` is chosen
    rw [← hn] at hP
    exact four_mul_numBlocks_le_of_prod_le (hL₂ L (by omega)) hP
  · -- the greedy choice stops within a factor `4 L` of its budget
    rw [← hn] at hTn
    have h1 : N < (ℓ + 1) ^ 2 * (T + 1) := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ N (by positivity)
    have h2 : N < (ℓ + 1) ^ 2 * (4 * L) * n :=
      calc N < (ℓ + 1) ^ 2 * (T + 1) := h1
        _ ≤ (ℓ + 1) ^ 2 * (4 * L * n) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hTn
        _ = (ℓ + 1) ^ 2 * (4 * L) * n := by ring
    have hrlt : r < (ℓ + 1) ^ 2 * (4 * L) := (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn0).2 h2
    have h4L : 4 * L ≤ 2 * (ℓ + 1) := by omega
    have hr1 : r + 1 ≤ 2 * (ℓ + 1) ^ 3 := by
      have : (ℓ + 1) ^ 2 * (4 * L) ≤ (ℓ + 1) ^ 2 * (2 * (ℓ + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h4L
      have : (ℓ + 1) ^ 2 * (2 * (ℓ + 1)) = 2 * (ℓ + 1) ^ 3 := by ring
      omega
    calc 4 * ((ℓ + 1) * (r * (r + 1)))
        ≤ 4 * ((ℓ + 1) * (2 * (ℓ + 1) ^ 3 * (2 * (ℓ + 1) ^ 3))) := by
          gcongr
          omega
      _ = 16 * (ℓ + 1) ^ 7 := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ ℓ := hpow
      _ ≤ N := hNℓ

theorem eventually_explicitThreshold_le :
    ∀ᶠ N in atTop, (Nat.log 2 N + 1) * explicitThreshold N ≤ 6 * N := by
  obtain ⟨ℓ₁, hℓ₁⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 (Nat.eventually_mul_add_one_pow_le_pow 1 2 one_lt_two)
  filter_upwards [eventually_four_mul_numBlocks_le,
    Nat.eventually_le_log (ℓ₁ + 1) one_lt_two] with N hkey hN
  set ℓ := Nat.log 2 N
  have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp [ℓ] at hN
  have hNℓ : 2 ^ ℓ ≤ N := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hN0
  have hsq : (ℓ + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ ℓ := by simpa using hℓ₁ ℓ (by omega)
  set L := primeBound N
  have hL : L = ℓ / 3 := rfl
  set T := N / (ℓ + 1) ^ 2
  have hT : T = N / (ℓ + 1) / (ℓ + 1) := by
    change N / (ℓ + 1) ^ 2 = _
    rw [Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, sq]
  have hT1 : 1 ≤ T := (Nat.one_le_div_iff (by positivity)).2 (hsq.trans hNℓ)
  have hthr := explicitThreshold_le_add N hT1
  set r := numBlocks N
  -- assembling the bound
  have hA : (ℓ + 1) * T ≤ N / (ℓ + 1) := hT ▸ Nat.mul_div_le _ _
  have hB : (ℓ + 1) * (N / (L + 1)) ≤ 3 * N :=
    calc (ℓ + 1) * (N / (L + 1)) ≤ 3 * (L + 1) * (N / (L + 1)) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
      _ = 3 * ((L + 1) * (N / (L + 1))) := by ring
      _ ≤ 3 * N := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_div_le N (L + 1))
  have hC : (ℓ + 1) * (N / (ℓ + 1)) ≤ N := Nat.mul_div_le N (ℓ + 1)
  have hD : N / (ℓ + 1) ≤ N / 2 := Nat.div_le_div_left (by omega) two_pos
  calc (ℓ + 1) * explicitThreshold N
      ≤ (ℓ + 1) * (T + 2 * (r * (r + 1)) + N / (L + 1) + 2 * (N / (ℓ + 1))) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hthr
    _ = (ℓ + 1) * T + 2 * ((ℓ + 1) * (r * (r + 1))) + (ℓ + 1) * (N / (L + 1)) +
        2 * ((ℓ + 1) * (N / (ℓ + 1))) := by ring
    _ ≤ 6 * N := by omega

theorem exists_sdiff [DecidableEq V] {k r : ℕ} (hg : IsGrading E (2 ^ k) g) (hr : r ≤ k) :
    ∃ F ⊆ E, k * #F ≤ r * #E ∧ ∃ g' : V → ℕ, IsGrading (E \ F) (2 ^ (k - r)) g' := by
  induction r generalizing E g k with
  | zero => exact ⟨∅, empty_subset _, by simp, g, by simpa using hg⟩
  | succ r ih =>
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨F₁, hF₁, hcard₁, g₁, hg₁⟩ := exists_sdiff_one hg
    obtain ⟨F₂, hF₂, hcard₂, g₂, hg₂⟩ := ih hg₁ (by omega)
    refine ⟨F₁ ∪ F₂, union_subset hF₁ (hF₂.trans sdiff_subset), ?_, g₂, ?_⟩
    · -- the bound for the union
      have hdisj : Disjoint F₁ F₂ := disjoint_of_subset_right hF₂ disjoint_sdiff
      have hE : #(E \ F₁) + #F₁ = #E := card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card hF₁
      have hy : #F₂ ≤ #(E \ F₁) := card_le_card hF₂
      rw [card_union_of_disjoint hdisj]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
      · obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
        omega
      · -- multiply by `k`; the slack is `(k - r) (#(E \ F₁) - k #F₁) ≥ 0`
        refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ hk
        have h₁ : k * #F₁ ≤ #(E \ F₁) := by linarith
        have h₃ : r ≤ k := by omega
        have key : (k + 1) * (k * #F₂) ≤ (k + 1) * (r * #(E \ F₁)) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hcard₂
        have slack : (k - r) * (k * #F₁) ≤ (k - r) * #(E \ F₁) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h₁
        zify [h₃] at slack ⊢
        rw [← hE]
        push_cast
        nlinarith [key, slack]
    · rw [show k + 1 - (r + 1) = k - r by omega,
        show E \ (F₁ ∪ F₂) = (E \ F₁) \ F₂ by ext; simp [and_assoc]]
      exact hg₂

theorem walk_affinePlane_twice (f : K × K → ℝ) (a b : K) :
    (affinePlane K).walk ((affinePlane K).walk f) (a, b) =
      (𝔼 p, f p) + (f (a, b) - 𝔼 y, f (a, y)) / Fintype.card K := by
  classical
  simp only [walk_affinePlane]
  rw [expect_comm]
  have hrow (d : K) : (𝔼 c, f (d, c * d - (a * c - b))) =
      (𝔼 y, f (d, y)) + if d = a then f (a, b) - 𝔼 y, f (a, y) else 0 := by
    by_cases h : d = a
    · subst d
      simp [show ∀ c : K, c * a - (a * c - b) = b by intro c; ring]
    · simp only [h, ite_false, add_zero]
      refine Fintype.expect_equiv
        ((Equiv.mulRight₀ (d - a) (sub_ne_zero.mpr h)).trans (Equiv.addRight b)) _ _ ?_
      intro c
      congr 2
      change c * d - (a * c - b) = c * (d - a) + b
      ring
  simp only [hrow, expect_add_distrib]
  rw [← Fintype.expect_prod_type, Fintype.expect_ite_eq']
  simp [NNRat.smul_def, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

theorem spectralExpansion_eq_secondEigenvalue_of_nonneg
    (h : ∀ f : V → ℝ, 0 ≤ 𝔼 v, f v * G.walk f v) :
    G.spectralExpansion = G.secondEigenvalue := by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ G.secondEigenvalue_le_spectralExpansion
  have hlam : 0 ≤ G.secondEigenvalue := by
    rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial V with hV | hV
    · rw [G.secondEigenvalue_eq_zero_of_subsingleton]
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hf0⟩ := exists_expect_eq_zero_ne_zero (V := V)
    exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left ((h f).trans (G.expect_mul_walk_le_secondEigenvalue_mul hf))
      (expect_sq_pos hf0)
  refine (spectralExpansion_le_iff hlam).2 fun f hf ↦ ?_
  have hW : 𝔼 v, f v * G.walk (G.walk f) v = 𝔼 v, G.walk f v ^ 2 := by
    rw [G.expect_mul_walk_comm]
    exact expect_congr rfl fun v _ ↦ (sq _).symm
  have h1 := G.expect_mul_walk_le_secondEigenvalue_mul hf
  have h2 := G.expect_mul_walk_le_secondEigenvalue_mul (G.expect_walk_eq_zero hf)
  have hcs := G.sq_expect_mul_walk_le h f (G.walk f)
  rw [hW] at hcs
  have ha : 0 ≤ 𝔼 v, G.walk f v ^ 2 := expect_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _
  rcases ha.eq_or_lt with ha | ha
  · rw [← ha]
    positivity
  refine le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ ha
  calc
    _ = (𝔼 v, G.walk f v ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := hcs
    _ ≤ (G.secondEigenvalue * 𝔼 v, f v ^ 2) * (G.secondEigenvalue * 𝔼 v, G.walk f v ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul h1 h2 (h _) (le_trans (h f) h1)
    _ = _ := by ring

private theorem two_mul_mul_sum_le_sum_abs_sub {c : ℝ} (T : Finset V) {ψ : V → ℝ}
    (hψ : ∀ v, 0 ≤ ψ v) (hT : ∀ v ∉ T, ψ v = 0)
    (hc : ∀ S ⊆ T, c * #S ≤ #(G.interedges S Sᶜ)) :
    2 * c * ∑ v, ψ v ≤ ∑ p : V × D, |ψ p.1 - ψ (G.neighbor p.1 p.2)| := by
  classical
  induction T using Finset.strongInduction generalizing ψ with | H T ih =>
  rcases T.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · have h0 : ∀ v, ψ v = 0 := fun v ↦ hT v (notMem_empty v)
    simp only [h0, sum_const_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, abs_zero, le_refl]
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀, hmin⟩ := T.exists_min_image ψ hne
  set ψ' : V → ℝ := fun v ↦ if v ∈ T then ψ v - ψ v₀ else 0 with hψ'_def
  have hψ' (v : V) : 0 ≤ ψ' v := by
    by_cases hv : v ∈ T
    · simpa [ψ', hv] using hmin v hv
    · simp [ψ', hv]
  have hT' (v : V) (hv : v ∉ T.erase v₀) : ψ' v = 0 := by
    rw [mem_erase, not_and_or, not_ne_iff] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | hv
    · simp [ψ', hv₀]
    · simp [ψ', hv]
  have ih' := ih _ (erase_ssubset hv₀) hψ' hT' fun S hS ↦ hc S (hS.trans (erase_subset _ _))
  have hsum : ∑ v, ψ' v = ∑ v, ψ v - #T * ψ v₀ := by
    rw [hψ'_def, sum_ite_mem, univ_inter, sum_sub_distrib, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul,
      sum_subset (subset_univ T) fun v _ hv ↦ hT v hv]
  have he : ∑ p : V × D, ((if p ∈ G.interedges T Tᶜ then (1 : ℝ) else 0) +
      if p ∈ G.interedges Tᶜ T then 1 else 0) = 2 * #(G.interedges T Tᶜ) := by
    rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_boole, sum_boole, filter_mem_eq_inter, filter_mem_eq_inter,
      univ_inter, univ_inter, ← G.card_interedges_comm T Tᶜ]
    ring
  rw [sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ G.abs_sub_eq_add_mul_ite_interedges hψ hT hmin p, sum_add_distrib,
    ← mul_sum, he]
  have hμ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hc T subset_rfl) (hψ v₀)
  rw [hsum] at ih'
  linarith

private theorem sq_mul_sum_sq_le {c : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c) (T : Finset V) {φ : V → ℝ}
    (hφ : ∀ v, 0 ≤ φ v) (hT : ∀ v ∉ T, φ v = 0)
    (hc : ∀ S ⊆ T, c * #S ≤ #(G.interedges S Sᶜ)) :
    c ^ 2 * ∑ v, φ v ^ 2 ≤
      Fintype.card D * ∑ p : V × D, (φ p.1 - φ (G.neighbor p.1 p.2)) ^ 2 := by
  have h₁ := G.two_mul_mul_sum_le_sum_abs_sub T (ψ := fun v ↦ φ v ^ 2) (fun v ↦ sq_nonneg _)
    (fun v hv ↦ by rw [hT v hv, sq, mul_zero]) hc
  have h₂ (p : V × D) : |φ p.1 ^ 2 - φ (G.neighbor p.1 p.2) ^ 2| =
      |φ p.1 - φ (G.neighbor p.1 p.2)| * (φ p.1 + φ (G.neighbor p.1 p.2)) := by
    rw [sq_sub_sq, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg (hφ _) (hφ _)), mul_comm]
  simp only [h₂] at h₁
  have h₃ := sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq univ (fun p : V × D ↦ |φ p.1 - φ (G.neighbor p.1 p.2)|)
    fun p ↦ φ p.1 + φ (G.neighbor p.1 p.2)
  simp only [sq_abs] at h₃
  have h₄ : ∑ p : V × D, (φ p.1 + φ (G.neighbor p.1 p.2)) ^ 2 ≤
      4 * Fintype.card D * ∑ v, φ v ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ p : V × D, 2 * (φ p.1 ^ 2 + φ (G.neighbor p.1 p.2) ^ 2) :=
        sum_le_sum fun p _ ↦ by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (φ p.1 - φ (G.neighbor p.1 p.2))]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← mul_sum, sum_add_distrib, sum_fst fun v ↦ φ v ^ 2,
          G.sum_neighbor fun v ↦ φ v ^ 2]
        ring
  have hA : 0 ≤ ∑ v, φ v ^ 2 := sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _
  have hE : 0 ≤ ∑ p : V × D, (φ p.1 - φ (G.neighbor p.1 p.2)) ^ 2 :=
    sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _
  have h₅ := (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h₁ 2).trans
    (h₃.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₄ hE))
  rcases hA.eq_or_lt with hA | hA
  · rw [← hA, mul_zero]
    positivity
  refine le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * ∑ v, φ v ^ 2)
  linarith

/-- The hard half of Cheeger's inequality in sums: for `f` summing to zero,
`c² ∑ f² ≤ |D| ∑ (f u - f w)²` over the darts `(u, w)`, if `c ≥ 0` and at least `c |S|` edges
leave every set `S` of at most half of the vertices. Split `f` at a median `m`: the positive and
negative parts of `f - m` vanish outside sets of at most half of the vertices. -/

private theorem sq_mul_sum_sq_le_of_sum_eq_zero {c : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c)
    (hc : ∀ S : Finset V, 2 * #S ≤ Fintype.card V → c * #S ≤ #(G.interedges S Sᶜ))
    {f : V → ℝ} (hf : ∑ v, f v = 0) :
    c ^ 2 * ∑ v, f v ^ 2 ≤
      Fintype.card D * ∑ p : V × D, (f p.1 - f (G.neighbor p.1 p.2)) ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm₁, hm₂⟩ := exists_median f
  have hp := G.sq_mul_sum_sq_le hc₀ {v | m < f v} (φ := fun v ↦ max (f v - m) 0)
    (fun v ↦ le_max_right _ _)
    (fun v hv ↦ max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.2 (not_lt.1 fun h ↦ hv (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ v, h⟩))))
    fun S hS ↦ hc S ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (card_le_card hS)).trans hm₁)
  have hn := G.sq_mul_sum_sq_le hc₀ {v | f v < m} (φ := fun v ↦ max (-(f v - m)) 0)
    (fun v ↦ le_max_right _ _)
    (fun v hv ↦ max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.2 (sub_nonneg.2
      (not_lt.1 fun h ↦ hv (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ v, h⟩)))))
    fun S hS ↦ hc S ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (card_le_card hS)).trans hm₂)
  have hsq : ∑ v, f v ^ 2 ≤ ∑ v, max (f v - m) 0 ^ 2 + ∑ v, max (-(f v - m)) 0 ^ 2 := by
    rw [← sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [sq_max_add_sq_max]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ v, f v ^ 2 + Fintype.card V * m ^ 2 := le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [sub_sq, sum_add_distrib, sum_sub_distrib, ← sum_mul, ← mul_sum, hf, sum_const,
          card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
        ring
  have hdir : ∑ p : V × D, (max (f p.1 - m) 0 - max (f (G.neighbor p.1 p.2) - m) 0) ^ 2 +
      ∑ p : V × D, (max (-(f p.1 - m)) 0 - max (-(f (G.neighbor p.1 p.2) - m)) 0) ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ p : V × D, (f p.1 - f (G.neighbor p.1 p.2)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← sum_add_distrib]
    exact sum_le_sum fun p _ ↦ (sq_max_sub_max_add_sq_max_sub_max_le _ _).trans_eq (by ring)
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card D := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (sq_nonneg c), mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdir hd]

/-- If each new vertex has an original representative, contraction retains the original
unnormalized edge-expansion lower bound. -/
theorem le_card_interedges_compl_contract
    (hcover : Function.Surjective (fun v => (encode v).1)) {S : Finset W}
    (hS : 2 * #S ≤ Fintype.card W) :
    (1 - G.spectralExpansion) * Fintype.card D * #S / 2 ≤
      #((contract encode decode h G).interedges S Sᶜ) := by
  classical
  have hcard (T : Finset W) : #T ≤ #{v | (encode v).1 ∈ T} := by
    apply card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun v => (encode v).1)
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hcover w
    exact ⟨v, by simpa only [mem_coe, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, hv] using hw, hv⟩
  let A : Finset V := {v | (encode v).1 ∈ S}
  have hAc : Aᶜ = ({v | (encode v).1 ∈ Sᶜ} : Finset V) := by ext; simp [A]
  have hcross := card_interedges_le_contract encode decode h G S Sᶜ
  rw [← hAc] at hcross
  have hgap : 0 ≤ 1 - G.spectralExpansion := sub_nonneg.mpr G.spectralExpansion_le_one
  refine le_trans (b := (#(G.interedges A Aᶜ) : ℝ)) ?_ (Nat.cast_le.mpr hcross)
  by_cases hA : 2 * #A ≤ Fintype.card V
  · refine le_trans ?_ (G.le_card_interedges_compl_of_two_mul_card_le hA)
    gcongr
    exact_mod_cast hcard S
  · have hA' : 2 * #Aᶜ ≤ Fintype.card V := by
      have := card_add_card_compl A
      lia
    have hSS : #S ≤ #Sᶜ := by
      have := card_add_card_compl S
      lia
    have hc : #S ≤ #Aᶜ := by rw [hAc]; exact hSS.trans (hcard Sᶜ)
    rw [G.card_interedges_comm A Aᶜ]
    have hb := G.le_card_interedges_compl_of_two_mul_card_le hA'
    rw [compl_compl] at hb
    refine le_trans ?_ hb
    gcongr

  have hℓ₁ := G.spectralExpansion_le_one

    (expect_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) ?_ ?_ |>.trans_eq (by ring)
  · calc 𝔼 v, (if v ∈ B then α else 0) ^ 2 = dens B * α ^ 2 := by
          rw [← Fintype.expect_boole_mem B, expect_mul]
          exact expect_congr rfl fun v _ => by split_ifs <;> simp
      _ ≤ μ * (μ * 𝔼 v, x v ^ 2) := by

          gcongr

      (G.expect_walk_sub_one_sub_spectralExpansion_sq_le x)

      (univ : Finset (K ↪ S)).biUnion fun g ↦ {σ : Perm V | ∀ v : K, σ v = g v} := by
    intro σ hσ
    rw [mem_filter] at hσ
    exact mem_biUnion.2 ⟨⟨fun v ↦ ⟨σ v, hσ.2 v v.2⟩,
      fun a b h ↦ Subtype.ext (σ.injective (congrArg Subtype.val h))⟩, mem_univ _,
      mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩⟩
  calc #{σ : Perm V | ∀ v ∈ K, σ v ∈ S}
      ≤ ∑ g : K ↪ S, #{σ : Perm V | ∀ v : K, σ v = g v} :=
        (card_le_card h).trans card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _g : K ↪ S, (Fintype.card V - #K)! :=
        sum_le_sum fun g _ ↦ card_filter_forall_eq_le K (fun v ↦ g v)
          fun a b h ↦ g.injective (Subtype.ext h)
    _ = _ := by
        rw [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_embedding_eq, Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_coe,
          smul_eq_mul]

/-- At most `C(s, k) s (s - 1) ⋯ (s - k + 1) (n - k)!` permutations of an `n`-element type keep at

private theorem card_filter_le_card_filter_mem_le (S : Finset V) (k : ℕ) :
    #{σ : Perm V | k ≤ #{v ∈ S | σ v ∈ S}} ≤
      (#S).choose k * ((#S).descFactorial k * (Fintype.card V - k)!) :=
  calc #{σ : Perm V | k ≤ #{v ∈ S | σ v ∈ S}}
      ≤ #((S.powersetCard k).biUnion fun K ↦ {σ : Perm V | ∀ v ∈ K, σ v ∈ S}) := by
        refine card_le_card fun σ hσ ↦ ?_
        obtain ⟨K, hK, hKc⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq (mem_filter.1 hσ).2
        exact mem_biUnion.2 ⟨K, mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨hK.trans (filter_subset _ _), hKc⟩,
          mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, fun v hv ↦ (mem_filter.1 (hK hv)).2⟩⟩
    _ ≤ ∑ K ∈ S.powersetCard k, #{σ : Perm V | ∀ v ∈ K, σ v ∈ S} := card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ K ∈ S.powersetCard k, (#S).descFactorial k * (Fintype.card V - k)! :=
        sum_le_sum fun K hK ↦ (mem_powersetCard.1 hK).2 ▸ card_filter_forall_mem_le K S
    _ = _ := by rw [sum_const, card_powersetCard, smul_eq_mul]

/-- The arithmetic of the union bound: for `1 ≤ s`, `2 s ≤ n` and `9 s ≤ 10 k`, the `C(n, s)`
sets of size `s`, each failed by thirty permutations with probability at most
`(3^s (s / 2n)^k)^30`, are failed with probability at most `2^{-s} / 4` in total. -/

variable (V) in
/-- **Random permutations move small sets**: there are thirty permutations of a finite type `V` such
that every set `S` of at most half of the points has at least a tenth of its points moved out of `S`
by one of them. This is the counting form of the probabilistic proof that constant-degree expanders
exist [Hoory, Linial and Wigderson, Theorem 4.16][HooryLinialWigderson2006]
[Arora and Barak, Chapter 21][AroraBarak09]. -/
theorem exists_perms_card_le_mul_card_filter_notMem :
    ∃ σ : Fin 30 → Perm V, ∀ S : Finset V, 2 * #S ≤ Fintype.card V →
      ∃ i, #S ≤ 10 * #{v ∈ S | σ i v ∉ S} := by
  by_contra! h
  set n := Fintype.card V
  set 𝒮 : Finset (Finset V) := {S | 0 < #S ∧ 2 * #S ≤ n}
  -- Every tuple fails some nonempty set `S ∈ 𝒮`: each of its permutations keeps more than nine
  -- tenths of `S` inside `S`.
  have hcover : (univ : Finset (Fin 30 → Perm V)) ⊆ 𝒮.biUnion fun S ↦
      Fintype.piFinset fun _ ↦ {τ : Perm V | #S - (#S - 1) / 10 ≤ #{v ∈ S | τ v ∈ S}} := by
    intro σ _
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hσ⟩ := h σ
    have hpos : 0 < #S := by
      have := hσ 0
      omega
    refine mem_biUnion.2 ⟨S, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, hpos, hS⟩,
      Fintype.mem_piFinset.2 fun i ↦ mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, ?_⟩⟩
    have := hσ i
    have := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := S) fun v ↦ σ i v ∈ S
    omega
  have hlow : ((n ! : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 30 ≤
      ∑ S ∈ 𝒮, (#{τ : Perm V | #S - (#S - 1) / 10 ≤ #{v ∈ S | τ v ∈ S}} : ℝ) ^ 30 := by
    have := (card_le_card hcover).trans card_biUnion_le
    simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_pi, Fintype.card_perm, prod_const, Fintype.card_fin,
      Fintype.card_piFinset] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hup := sum_card_filter_pow_thirty_le (V := V)
  have : (0 : ℝ) < (n ! : ℝ) ^ 30 := by positivity
  linarith

theorem spectralExpansion_reingoldStep_le {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : RotationMap V B) :
    (reingoldStep H e G).spectralExpansion ≤
      (1 - (1 - G.spectralExpansion) * (1 - H.spectralExpansion) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
  rw [reingoldStep, spectralExpansion_relabel]
  exact ((G.zigzag H).spectralExpansion_pow_le 2).trans
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (spectralExpansion_nonneg _) (G.spectralExpansion_zigzag_le_one_sub H) 2)

/-- **The spectral gap grows**, as in the proof of [Reingold, Lemma 3.2][Reingold2008]: if
`λ(H) ≤ 1 / 5` and the
spectral gap of `G` is at least `γ ≥ 0`, one step of the transformation has spectral gap at least
`min (6 γ / 5) (1 / 5)`. -/

theorem min_le_one_sub_spectralExpansion_reingoldStep {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    (hH : H.spectralExpansion ≤ 1 / 5) (G : RotationMap V B) {γ : ℝ} (hγ₀ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hγ : γ ≤ 1 - G.spectralExpansion) :
    min (6 / 5 * γ) (1 / 5) ≤ 1 - (reingoldStep H e G).spectralExpansion := by
  have hμ₀ := G.spectralExpansion_nonneg
  have hμ₁ := G.spectralExpansion_le_one
  have hν₀ := H.spectralExpansion_nonneg
  set x := (1 - G.spectralExpansion) * (1 - H.spectralExpansion) ^ 2 with hx
  have hν : (16 / 25 : ℝ) ≤ (1 - H.spectralExpansion) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hx₁ : x ≤ 1 :=
    (mul_le_mul (by linarith) (pow_le_one₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)) (sq_nonneg _)
      zero_le_one).trans_eq (one_mul 1)
  have hxγ : 16 / 25 * γ ≤ x := by
    rw [hx]
    calc 16 / 25 * γ ≤ (1 - H.spectralExpansion) ^ 2 * γ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hν hγ₀
      _ ≤ (1 - H.spectralExpansion) ^ 2 * (1 - G.spectralExpansion) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hγ (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  have hstep : (reingoldStep H e G).spectralExpansion ≤ (1 - 16 / 25 * γ) ^ 2 :=
    (spectralExpansion_reingoldStep_le H e G).trans
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith) 2)
  have hγ₁ : γ ≤ 1 := by linarith
  rcases le_total γ (1 / 6) with h | h
  · refine (min_le_left _ _).trans ?_
    nlinarith
  · refine (min_le_right _ _).trans ?_
    nlinarith

/-- **The spectral gap grows geometrically** [Reingold, Lemma 3.2][Reingold2008]: if `λ(H) ≤ 1 / 5`
and the spectral gap of `G` is at least `γ ≥ 0`, the `ℓ`-th graph of the transformation has spectral
gap at least `min ((6 / 5) ^ ℓ γ) (1 / 5)`. -/

theorem min_pow_le_one_sub_spectralExpansion_reingold {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (hH : H.spectralExpansion ≤ 1 / 5) (G : RotationMap V B) {γ : ℝ} (hγ₀ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hγ : γ ≤ 1 - G.spectralExpansion) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    min ((6 / 5) ^ ℓ * γ) (1 / 5) ≤ 1 - (reingold H e G ℓ).spectralExpansion := by
  induction ℓ with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul]
    exact (min_le_left _ _).trans hγ
  | succ ℓ ih =>
    have h₀ : 0 ≤ min ((6 / 5) ^ ℓ * γ) (1 / 5) := le_min (by positivity) (by norm_num)
    refine le_trans ?_ (min_le_one_sub_spectralExpansion_reingoldStep H e hH _ h₀ ih)
    refine le_min ?_ (min_le_right _ _)
    rcases le_total ((6 / 5) ^ ℓ * γ) (1 / 5) with h | h
    · rw [min_eq_left h, pow_succ]
      exact (min_le_left _ _).trans_eq (by ring)
    · rw [min_eq_right h]
      exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (by norm_num)

theorem exists_neighbor_pow_reingold_eq {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (hH : H.spectralExpansion ≤ 1 / 5) (G : RotationMap V B)
    (hG : ∀ v, Fintype.card B ≤ 2 * G.edgeCount v v) {ℓ T : ℕ}
    (hℓ : 2 * Fintype.card V ^ 2 * Fintype.card B ^ 2 * 5 ^ ℓ ≤ 5 * 6 ^ ℓ)
    (hT : Fintype.card V * Fintype.card B ^ ℓ * 4 ^ T ≤ 5 ^ T)
    {x y : IteratedProd V B ℓ} (hxy : G.toSimpleGraph.Reachable x.root y.root) :
    ∃ k : Fin T → B, ((reingold H e G ℓ).pow T).neighbor x k = y := by
  classical
  have : Nonempty V := ⟨x.root⟩
  set C := {v | G.toSimpleGraph.Reachable x.root v}
  have hxC : x.root ∈ C := SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _
  have hCV : Fintype.card C ≤ Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_subtype_le _
  have hC : 0 < Fintype.card C := Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 ⟨⟨x.root, hxC⟩⟩
  have hB : 0 < Fintype.card B := Fintype.card_pos
  have hlam := spectralExpansion_reingold_componentGraph_le H e hH G hG hℓ x.root
  -- walks of length `T` reach every vertex of the transform of the component
  have hwalk : (reingold H e (G.componentGraph x.root) ℓ).spectralExpansion ^ T *
      (Fintype.card (IteratedProd C B ℓ) - 1) < 1 := by
    rw [IteratedProd.card]
    have hM : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card C * Fintype.card B ^ ℓ := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.mul_ne_zero hC.ne' (pow_pos hB ℓ).ne')
    have hMV : (Fintype.card C * Fintype.card B ^ ℓ : ℝ) * 4 ^ T ≤ 5 ^ T := by
      have : (Fintype.card C * Fintype.card B ^ ℓ * 4 ^ T : ℝ) ≤
          Fintype.card V * Fintype.card B ^ ℓ * 4 ^ T := by gcongr
      exact this.trans (by exact_mod_cast hT)
    have hlam₀ := (reingold H e (G.componentGraph x.root) ℓ).spectralExpansion_nonneg
    push_cast
    calc (reingold H e (G.componentGraph x.root) ℓ).spectralExpansion ^ T *
          ((Fintype.card C : ℝ) * Fintype.card B ^ ℓ - 1) ≤
          (4 / 5) ^ T * ((Fintype.card C : ℝ) * Fintype.card B ^ ℓ - 1) := by
          gcongr
      _ < (4 / 5) ^ T * ((Fintype.card C : ℝ) * Fintype.card B ^ ℓ) := by
          gcongr
          linarith
      _ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [div_pow, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_one (by positivity)]
          linarith
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (reingold H e (G.componentGraph x.root) ℓ).exists_neighbor_pow_eq hwalk
    (x.setRoot (⟨x.root, hxC⟩ : C)) (y.setRoot (⟨y.root, hxy⟩ : C))
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  have h := (((G.componentHom x.root).reingold H e ℓ).pow T).neighbor_map
    (x.setRoot (⟨x.root, hxC⟩ : C)) k
  simp only [Hom.pow_apply, Hom.reingold_apply, hk, IteratedProd.map_setRoot, componentHom_apply,
    IteratedProd.setRoot_root] at h
  exact h

/-- **Undirected connectivity by short walks in Reingold's transform** [Reingold][Reingold2008]
[Arora and Barak, Section 21.4][AroraBarak09]: if `λ(H) ≤ 1 / 5`, at least half of the edges at
every vertex of `G` are self-loops, `2 |V|² |B|² 5 ^ ℓ ≤ 5 · 6 ^ ℓ` and
`|V| |B| ^ ℓ 4 ^ T ≤ 5 ^ T`, then `t` is reachable from `s` in `G` exactly when some walk of length
`T` in `G_ℓ` from the vertex `(⋯ (s, b) ⋯, b)` ends over `t`. -/

private theorem expect_mul_three_word_le (h f : V × D → ℝ)
    {T₁ T₂ T₃ : Module.End ℝ (V × D → ℝ)}
    (h₁ : ∀ g, 𝔼 p, T₁ g p ^ 2 ≤ 𝔼 p, g p ^ 2)
    (h₂ : ∀ g, 𝔼 p, T₂ g p ^ 2 ≤ 𝔼 p, g p ^ 2)
    (h₃ : ∀ g, 𝔼 p, T₃ g p ^ 2 ≤ 𝔼 p, g p ^ 2) :
    𝔼 p, h p * (T₁ * T₂ * T₃) f p ≤ √(𝔼 p, h p ^ 2) * √(𝔼 p, f p ^ 2) :=
  (expect_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt univ _ _).trans <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ((h₁ _).trans ((h₂ _).trans (h₃ f))))
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
