private theorem expect_mul_walk_balancedReplacement_pow_three_le [Nonempty E] (h : V × D → ℝ)
    {f : V × D → ℝ} (hf : 𝔼 p, f p = 0) :
    𝔼 p, h p * ((G.balancedReplacement H).pow 3).walk f p ≤
      (7 / 8 + (G.zigzag H).spectralExpansion / 8) * (√(𝔼 p, h p ^ 2) * √(𝔼 p, f p ^ 2)) := by
  -- `B̃` and `Ã` do not increase the second moment
  have hB (g : V × D → ℝ) : 𝔼 p, ((loops V Unit).tensor H).walk g p ^ 2 ≤ 𝔼 p, g p ^ 2 :=
    ((loops V Unit).tensor H).expect_walk_sq_le g
  have hA (g : V × D → ℝ) : 𝔼 p, LinearMap.funLeft ℝ ℝ G.rot g p ^ 2 ≤ 𝔼 p, g p ^ 2 :=
    (expect_comp_rot G fun p ↦ g p ^ 2).le
  -- the cube contains the zig-zag walk `B̃ Ã B̃` once
  have hZ : 𝔼 p, h p * (G.zigzag H).walk f p ≤
      (G.zigzag H).spectralExpansion * (√(𝔼 p, h p ^ 2) * √(𝔼 p, f p ^ 2)) := by
    refine (expect_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt univ _ _).trans ?_
    rw [mul_left_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sqrt_le_mul_sqrt (spectralExpansion_nonneg _)
      ((G.zigzag H).expect_walk_sq_le_spectralExpansion_sq_mul hf)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  set B := ((loops V Unit).tensor H).walk
  set A : Module.End ℝ (V × D → ℝ) := LinearMap.funLeft ℝ ℝ G.rot
  rw [walk_zigzag, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc] at hZ
  have hexp : (B + A) ^ 3 = B * B * B + B * B * A + B * A * B + B * A * A + A * B * B +
      A * B * A + A * A * B + A * A * A := by
    noncomm_ring
  rw [walk_pow, walk_balancedReplacement, smul_pow, hexp]
  calc
    _ = (2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ 3 * (𝔼 p, h p * (B * B * B) f p + 𝔼 p, h p * (B * B * A) f p +
          𝔼 p, h p * (B * A * B) f p + 𝔼 p, h p * (B * A * A) f p +
          𝔼 p, h p * (A * B * B) f p + 𝔼 p, h p * (A * B * A) f p +
          𝔼 p, h p * (A * A * B) f p + 𝔼 p, h p * (A * A * A) f p) := by
      simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.add_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, ← expect_add_distrib, mul_expect]
      exact expect_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ by ring
    _ ≤ _ := by
      have h₁ := expect_mul_three_word_le h f hB hB hB
      have h₂ := expect_mul_three_word_le h f hB hB hA
      have h₄ := expect_mul_three_word_le h f hB hA hA
      have h₅ := expect_mul_three_word_le h f hA hB hB
      have h₆ := expect_mul_three_word_le h f hA hB hA
      have h₇ := expect_mul_three_word_le h f hA hA hB
      have h₈ := expect_mul_three_word_le h f hA hA hA
      have h₃ : 𝔼 p, h p * (B * A * B) f p ≤
          (G.zigzag H).spectralExpansion * (√(𝔼 p, h p ^ 2) * √(𝔼 p, f p ^ 2)) := hZ
      rw [show (2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ 3 = 8⁻¹ by norm_num]
      linarith

/-- The cube of the spectral expansion of the balanced replacement product is at most
`7 / 8 + λ(G ⓩ H) / 8` [Reingold, Vadhan and Wigderson, Theorem 6.7][ReingoldVadhanWigderson2002]:
the zig-zag walk is one of the eight terms of the cube of its walk operator. -/

private theorem reachable_slotGraph_zpow (v w : V) (i : ℤ) :
    (slotGraph G σ).toSimpleGraph.Reachable (v, w) (v, (σ ^ i) w) := by
  induction i using Int.induction_on with

  | succ i ih =>
    rw [add_comm, zpow_add, zpow_one, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

  | pred i ih =>

      Equiv.Perm.inv_def]
    exact ih.trans ((slotGraph G σ).reachable_neighbor (v, (σ ^ (-(i : ℤ))) w)
      (.inr ((), (), true)))

theorem reachable_fst_of_reachable_slotGraph {p q : V × V}
    (h : (slotGraph G σ).toSimpleGraph.Reachable p q) : G.Reachable p.1 q.1 := by
  rw [SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen] at h
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ hxy ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, i, rfl⟩ := hxy
    refine ih.trans ?_
    rcases i with _ | ⟨_, _, _ | _⟩
    · rw [neighbor_slotGraph_inl, slotSwap]
      split_ifs with hadj
      · exact hadj.reachable
      · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl

theorem reachable_slotGraph_iff (hσ : ∀ a b, σ.SameCycle a b) {v w a b : V} :
    (slotGraph G σ).toSimpleGraph.Reachable (v, a) (w, b) ↔ G.Reachable v w := by
  refine ⟨reachable_fst_of_reachable_slotGraph G σ, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  have hcycle (u a b : V) : (slotGraph G σ).toSimpleGraph.Reachable (u, a) (u, b) := by
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hσ a b
    exact reachable_slotGraph_zpow G σ u a i
  rw [SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen] at h
  induction h generalizing b with
  | refl => exact hcycle v a b
  | @tail x y _ hxy ih =>
    have hswap : (slotGraph G σ).neighbor (x, y) (.inl ()) = (y, x) := by
      rw [neighbor_slotGraph_inl, slotSwap, ite_eq_left hxy]
      rfl
    exact (@ih y).trans ((hswap ▸ (slotGraph G σ).reachable_neighbor (x, y) (.inl ())).trans
      (hcycle y x b))

private theorem le_secondEigenvalue_of_mul_norm_sq_le_inner [Nonempty V]
    {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ V} (hu_ne : u ≠ 0) (hu_exp : 𝔼 v, u.ofLp v = 0) {μ : ℝ}
    (hu_quad : μ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, G.walkEuclidean u⟫) :
    μ ≤ G.secondEigenvalue := by
  set f : V → ℝ := u.ofLp
  have hf_ne : f ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hu_ne (WithLp.ofLp_injective 2 h)
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := Function.ne_iff.1 hf_ne
  have hpos : 0 < 𝔼 v, f v ^ 2 :=
    expect_pos' (fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _) ⟨v₀, mem_univ v₀, sq_pos_iff.2 hv₀⟩
  have hinner : ⟪u, G.walkEuclidean u⟫ = (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * 𝔼 v, f v * G.walk f v :=
    (card_mul_expect_mul u (G.walkEuclidean u)).symm
  have hnorm : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * 𝔼 v, f v ^ 2 :=
    (card_mul_expect_sq u).symm
  rw [hinner, hnorm, mul_left_comm] at hu_quad
  have hle₁ := le_of_mul_le_mul_left hu_quad (Nat.cast_pos.2 Fintype.card_pos)
  have hle₂ := G.expect_mul_walk_le_secondEigenvalue_mul hu_exp
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right (hle₁.trans hle₂) hpos

theorem spectralExpansion_tensor_le :
    (G.tensor H).spectralExpansion ≤ max G.spectralExpansion H.spectralExpansion := by
  have hG := le_max_left G.spectralExpansion H.spectralExpansion
  have hH := le_max_right G.spectralExpansion H.spectralExpansion
  have hG0 := G.spectralExpansion_nonneg
  have hH0 := H.spectralExpansion_nonneg
  refine spectralExpansion_le (hG0.trans hG) fun f hf ↦ ?_
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty D' with hD' | hD'
  · have : (G.tensor H).walk f = 0 := funext fun p ↦ by simp [walk_tensor_apply]
    rw [this]
    simpa using mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (expect_nonneg fun p _ ↦ sq_nonneg (f p))
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty V' with hV' | hV'
  · simp
  obtain ⟨f₁, f₂, rfl, hf₂, hf₁, hff⟩ := exists_eq_add_expect_fiber_eq_zero f
  rw [hf] at hf₁
  have hW : (G.tensor H).walk (fun p ↦ f₁ p.1 + f₂ p) =
      fun p ↦ G.walk f₁ p.1 +
        (G.tensor (loops V' Unit)).walk (((loops V Unit).tensor H).walk f₂) p := by
    rw [walk_tensor, LinearMap.comp_apply, walk_loops_tensor_add,
      show (fun p ↦ f₁ p.1 + ((loops V Unit).tensor H).walk f₂ p) =
        (fun p : V × V' ↦ f₁ p.1) + ((loops V Unit).tensor H).walk f₂ from rfl, map_add]
    exact funext fun p ↦ by simp [walk_tensor_loops_apply]
  rw [hW, expect_add_sq_of_expect_fiber_eq_zero _
      (G.expect_walk_tensor_loops_eq_zero (H.expect_walk_loops_tensor_eq_zero hf₂)),
    expect_comp_fst (fun v ↦ G.walk f₁ v ^ 2), hff]
  calc
    _ ≤ G.spectralExpansion ^ 2 * 𝔼 v, f₁ v ^ 2 +
          H.spectralExpansion ^ 2 * 𝔼 p, f₂ p ^ 2 := by
      gcongr
      · exact expect_walk_sq_le_spectralExpansion_sq_mul hf₁
      · exact ((G.tensor (loops V' Unit)).expect_walk_sq_le _).trans
          (H.expect_walk_loops_tensor_sq_le hf₂)
    _ ≤ max G.spectralExpansion H.spectralExpansion ^ 2 * 𝔼 v, f₁ v ^ 2 +
          max G.spectralExpansion H.spectralExpansion ^ 2 * 𝔼 p, f₂ p ^ 2 := by
      have h₁ : 0 ≤ 𝔼 v, f₁ v ^ 2 := expect_nonneg fun v _ ↦ sq_nonneg (f₁ v)
      have h₂ : 0 ≤ 𝔼 p, f₂ p ^ 2 := expect_nonneg fun p _ ↦ sq_nonneg (f₂ p)
      gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem spectralExpansion_zigzagTower_le {c : ℝ}
    (hc : c ^ 2 + H.spectralExpansion + H.spectralExpansion ^ 2 ≤ c) (n : ℕ) :
    (zigzagTower H e n).spectralExpansion ≤ c := by

theorem rot_pow_walkDrop (p : V × (Fin t → D)) (n : ℕ) :
    (G.pow (t - n)).rot (G.walkDrop p n) =
      (((G.pow t).rot p).1, Fin.take (t - n) (Nat.sub_le t n) ((G.pow t).rot p).2) := by
  refine Prod.ext ?_ (funext fun j ↦ ?_)
  · have h : G.walkAt (G.walkDrop p n) (t - n) = G.walkAt p t := by
      rw [walkAt_walkDrop]
      rcases le_total n t with h | h
      · rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le h]
      · rw [G.walkAt_of_le p (by omega : t ≤ n + (t - n))]
    exact (G.walkAt_length (G.walkDrop p n)).symm.trans (h.trans (G.walkAt_length p))
  · have h₁ := congrArg Prod.snd (G.walkDart_rot_pow (G.walkDrop p n) j)
    have h₂ := congrArg Prod.snd (G.walkDart_rot_pow p (Fin.castLE (Nat.sub_le t n) j))
    simp only [walkDart_snd] at h₁ h₂
    dsimp only
    rw [Fin.take_apply, h₁, h₂, walkDart_walkDrop]
    congr 3
    ext
    simp only [Fin.val_rev, Fin.val_castLE]
    omega

    (Q : V × D → (Fin (t - (i + 1)) → D) → Prop) [∀ q, DecidablePred (P q)]

theorem sq_expect_walkDart_mul_walkDart_sub_le {i j : Fin t} (hij : i < j) (f g : V × D → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 p : V × (Fin t → D), f (G.walkDart p i) * g (G.walkDart p j) - (𝔼 q, f q) * 𝔼 q, g q) ^ 2 ≤
      G.spectralExpansion ^ (2 * (j - (i + 1) : ℕ)) * (𝔼 q, f q ^ 2 - (𝔼 q, f q) ^ 2) *
        (𝔼 q, g q ^ 2 - (𝔼 q, g q) ^ 2) := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty D with hD | hD
  · have : IsEmpty (Fin t → D) := ⟨fun k ↦ hD.false (k i)⟩
    simp
  set φ : V → ℝ := fun v ↦ 𝔼 a, f (G.rot (v, a))
  set ψ : V → ℝ := fun w ↦ 𝔼 a, g (w, a)
  have hφ : 𝔼 v, φ v = 𝔼 q, f q := by
    rw [← G.expect_comp_rot f, Fintype.expect_prod_type]
  have hψ : 𝔼 w, ψ w = 𝔼 q, g q := (Fintype.expect_prod_type g).symm
  have hφ₂ : 𝔼 v, φ v ^ 2 ≤ 𝔼 q, f q ^ 2 := by
    rw [← G.expect_comp_rot fun q ↦ f q ^ 2, Fintype.expect_prod_type]
    exact expect_le_expect fun v _ ↦ sq_expect_le_expect_sq _ _
  have hψ₂ : 𝔼 w, ψ w ^ 2 ≤ 𝔼 q, g q ^ 2 := by
    rw [Fintype.expect_prod_type fun q ↦ g q ^ 2]
    exact expect_le_expect fun v _ ↦ sq_expect_le_expect_sq _ _
  have hmix := G.sq_expect_mul_walk_pow_sub_le (j - (i + 1)) φ ψ
  rw [hφ, hψ] at hmix
  rw [G.expect_walkDart_mul_walkDart hij]
  refine hmix.trans ?_
  have := G.spectralExpansion_nonneg
  have h₂ : 0 ≤ 𝔼 w, ψ w ^ 2 - (𝔼 q, g q) ^ 2 := hψ ▸ sub_nonneg.2 (sq_expect_le_expect_sq _ ψ)
  have h₃ : 0 ≤ 𝔼 q, f q ^ 2 - (𝔼 q, f q) ^ 2 := sub_nonneg.2 (sq_expect_le_expect_sq _ f)
  gcongr

private theorem mul_add_le_one_sub_mul {μ ν a b A B : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (hν₁ : ν ≤ 1)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (haA : a ≤ A) (hbB : b ≤ B) :
    (1 - ν) ^ 2 * (a * (μ * b)) + (1 - ν) * (a * (ν * B)) + (1 - ν) * (ν * A * b) +
        ν * A * (ν * B) ≤ (1 - (1 - μ) * (1 - ν) ^ 2) * (A * B) := by
  have h₁ : a * b ≤ A * B := mul_le_mul haA hbB hb (ha.trans haA)
  have h₂ : a * B ≤ A * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right haA (hb.trans hbB)
  have h₃ : A * b ≤ A * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbB (ha.trans haA)
  have hν' : 0 ≤ 1 - ν := sub_nonneg.2 hν₁
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₁ (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (1 - ν)) hμ),
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₂ (mul_nonneg hν' hν),
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₃ (mul_nonneg hν' hν)]

private theorem expect_mul_walk_zigzag_le [Nonempty D] [Nonempty E] (h : V × D → ℝ)
    {f : V × D → ℝ} (hf : 𝔼 p, f p = 0) :
    𝔼 p, h p * (G.zigzag H).walk f p ≤
      (G.spectralExpansion + H.spectralExpansion + H.spectralExpansion ^ 2) *
        (√(𝔼 p, h p ^ 2) * √(𝔼 p, f p ^ 2)) := by
  have hμ := G.spectralExpansion_nonneg
  have hν := H.spectralExpansion_nonneg
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, rfl, hh₂, -, hhh⟩ := exists_eq_add_expect_fiber_eq_zero h
  obtain ⟨f₁, f₂, rfl, hf₂, hf₁, hff⟩ := exists_eq_add_expect_fiber_eq_zero f
  rw [hf] at hf₁
  rw [hhh, hff, ← Real.sq_sqrt (expect_nonneg fun v _ ↦ sq_nonneg (h₁ v)),
    ← Real.sq_sqrt (expect_nonneg fun p _ ↦ sq_nonneg (h₂ p)),
    ← Real.sq_sqrt (expect_nonneg fun v _ ↦ sq_nonneg (f₁ v)),
    ← Real.sq_sqrt (expect_nonneg fun p _ ↦ sq_nonneg (f₂ p))]
  refine le_trans ?_ (add_mul_le_mul_sqrt_mul_sqrt hμ hν (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  rw [expect_mul_walk_zigzag_eq]
  simp only [add_mul]
  simp only [mul_add, expect_add_distrib]
  rw [← add_assoc]
  -- the walk on the clouds shrinks the parts of average zero over the clouds by `λ(H)`
  have hqh := sqrt_le_mul_sqrt hν (H.expect_walk_loops_tensor_sq_le hh₂)
  have hqf := sqrt_le_mul_sqrt hν (H.expect_walk_loops_tensor_sq_le hf₂)
  gcongr ?_ + ?_ + ?_ + ?_
  · exact G.expect_mul_comp_rot_le h₁ hf₁
  · refine (expect_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt univ _ _).trans ?_
    rw [expect_comp_fst (fun v ↦ h₁ v ^ 2),
      expect_comp_rot G (fun p ↦ ((loops V Unit).tensor H).walk f₂ p ^ 2)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqf (by positivity)
  · refine (expect_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt univ _ _).trans ?_
    rw [expect_comp_rot G (fun p ↦ f₁ p.1 ^ 2), expect_comp_fst (fun v ↦ f₁ v ^ 2)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqh (by positivity)
  · refine (expect_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt univ _ _).trans ?_
    rw [expect_comp_rot G (fun p ↦ ((loops V Unit).tensor H).walk f₂ p ^ 2)]
    exact mul_le_mul hqh hqf (by positivity) (by positivity)

private theorem expect_mul_walk_zigzag_le_one_sub [Nonempty D] [Nonempty E] (h : V × D → ℝ)
    {f : V × D → ℝ} (hf : 𝔼 p, f p = 0) :
    𝔼 p, h p * (G.zigzag H).walk f p ≤
      (1 - (1 - G.spectralExpansion) * (1 - H.spectralExpansion) ^ 2) *
        (√(𝔼 p, h p ^ 2) * √(𝔼 p, f p ^ 2)) := by
  have hμ := G.spectralExpansion_nonneg
  have hν := H.spectralExpansion_nonneg
  have hν₁ : 0 ≤ 1 - H.spectralExpansion := sub_nonneg.2 H.spectralExpansion_le_one
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, rfl, hh₂, -, hhh⟩ := exists_eq_add_expect_fiber_eq_zero h
  obtain ⟨f₁, f₂, rfl, hf₂, hf₁, hff⟩ := exists_eq_add_expect_fiber_eq_zero f
  rw [hf] at hf₁
  rw [expect_mul_walk_zigzag_eq, hhh, hff]
  -- `B̃ h = (1 - λ(H)) h₁ + u` with `‖u‖ ≤ λ(H) ‖h‖`, and the same for `f`
  set u : V × D → ℝ := fun p ↦ H.spectralExpansion * h₁ p.1 + ((loops V Unit).tensor H).walk h₂ p
  set w : V × D → ℝ := fun p ↦ H.spectralExpansion * f₁ p.1 + ((loops V Unit).tensor H).walk f₂ p
  have hsplit (p : V × D) :
      (h₁ p.1 + ((loops V Unit).tensor H).walk h₂ p) *
          (f₁ (G.rot p).1 + ((loops V Unit).tensor H).walk f₂ (G.rot p)) =
        (1 - H.spectralExpansion) ^ 2 * (h₁ p.1 * f₁ (G.rot p).1) +
          (1 - H.spectralExpansion) * (h₁ p.1 * w (G.rot p)) +
          (1 - H.spectralExpansion) * (u p * f₁ (G.rot p).1) + u p * w (G.rot p) := by
    simp only [u, w]
    ring
  simp only [hsplit, expect_add_distrib, ← mul_expect]
  have hu := H.sqrt_expect_mul_add_walk_loops_tensor_sq_le h₁ hh₂
  have hu' := H.sqrt_expect_mul_add_walk_loops_tensor_sq_le f₁ hf₂
  have ha : √(𝔼 v, h₁ v ^ 2) ≤ √(𝔼 v, h₁ v ^ 2 + 𝔼 p, h₂ p ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (le_add_of_nonneg_right (expect_nonneg fun p _ ↦ sq_nonneg (h₂ p)))
  have hb : √(𝔼 v, f₁ v ^ 2) ≤ √(𝔼 v, f₁ v ^ 2 + 𝔼 p, f₂ p ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (le_add_of_nonneg_right (expect_nonneg fun p _ ↦ sq_nonneg (f₂ p)))
  refine le_trans ?_ (mul_add_le_one_sub_mul hμ hν H.spectralExpansion_le_one
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ha hb)
  gcongr _ * ?_ + _ * ?_ + _ * ?_ + ?_
  · exact G.expect_mul_comp_rot_le h₁ hf₁
  · refine (expect_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt univ _ _).trans ?_
    rw [expect_comp_fst (fun v ↦ h₁ v ^ 2), expect_comp_rot G (fun p ↦ w p ^ 2)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu' (by positivity)
  · refine (expect_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt univ _ _).trans ?_
    rw [expect_comp_rot G (fun p ↦ f₁ p.1 ^ 2), expect_comp_fst (fun v ↦ f₁ v ^ 2)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu (by positivity)
  · refine (expect_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt univ _ _).trans ?_
    rw [expect_comp_rot G (fun p ↦ w p ^ 2)]
    exact mul_le_mul hu hu' (by positivity) (by positivity)

private theorem failure_power_le_half (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    2 * (q - 1) ^ q ≤ q ^ q := by

    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    exact inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) Real.exp_one_gt_two.le
  have hr : (1 - 1 / (q : ℝ)) = (q - 1 : ℕ) / (q : ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_one]
    field_simp

    ∃ H : Finset α, H ⊆ S ∧ H.card * L ≤ S.card ∧
      ∀ x, (∀ i : Fin L, f^[i.val] x ∈ S) →
        Repeats f x L ∨ ∃ d < 2 * L, f^[d] x ∈ H := by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.strongInductionOn with
  | _ S ih =>
    by_cases hex : ∃ a, (∀ i : Fin L, f^[i.val] a ∈ S) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i : Fin L => f^[i.val] a)
    · obtain ⟨a, ha, hinj⟩ := hex
      let P := Finset.univ.image (fun i : Fin L => f^[i.val] a)
      have hPS : P ⊆ S := by

        obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
        exact ha i

theorem exists_cover_packing [Finite α] (hac : Acyclic σ) (r : α → ℕ) :
    ∀ S : Finset α, ∃ H ⊆ S, ∃ P : Finset (FPath α),
      Covers σ r S H ∧ Packing σ r S P ∧ P.card = H.card := by
  classical
  intro S
  induction S using Finset.strongInduction with
  | H S ih =>
  let E : Set α := {v | ∃ p : FPath α, p.Required (σ := σ) r ∧ p.Within (σ := σ) S ∧
    p.End (σ := σ) v}
  by_cases hE : E.Nonempty
  swap
  · refine ⟨∅, Finset.empty_subset _, ∅, ?_, ⟨by simp, by simp⟩, rfl⟩
    intro p hreq hin
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hr⟩ := hreq
    exact (hE ⟨v, p, ⟨v, hv, hr⟩, hin, hv⟩).elim
  obtain ⟨v, ⟨W, hWreq, hWin, hWv⟩, hmin⟩ := (before_wellFounded σ hac).has_min E hE
  have hvS : v ∈ S := hWin v ⟨W.len - 1, by have := hWv.1; omega, hWv.2⟩
  obtain ⟨H', hH'S, P', hcov, hpack, hcard⟩ := ih (S.erase v) (Finset.erase_ssubset hvS)
  have avoid : ∀ q : FPath α, q.Required (σ := σ) r → q.Within (σ := σ) (S.erase v) →
      ∀ u, q.Mem (σ := σ) u → ¬ W.Mem (σ := σ) u := by
    intro q hqreq hqin u hqu hWu
    obtain ⟨w, hqw, hrw⟩ := hqreq
    rcases shared_vertex σ hqw hWv hqu hWu with hqv | hbef
    · exact (Finset.notMem_erase v S) (hqin v hqv)
    · exact hmin w ⟨q, ⟨w, hqw, hrw⟩, fun x hx => Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (hqin x hx), hqw⟩
        hbef
  have hWv_mem : W.Mem (σ := σ) v := ⟨W.len - 1, by have := hWv.1; omega, hWv.2⟩
  have hWP' : W ∉ P' := by
    intro hW
    exact (Finset.notMem_erase v S) ((hpack.1 W hW).2 v hWv_mem)
  have hvH' : v ∉ H' := fun h => Finset.notMem_erase v S (hH'S h)
  refine ⟨insert v H', ?_, insert W P', ?_, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact Finset.insert_subset hvS (hH'S.trans (Finset.erase_subset v S))
  · intro q hqreq hqin
    by_cases hqv : q.Mem (σ := σ) v
    · exact ⟨v, Finset.mem_insert_self v H', hqv⟩
    · have hin' : q.Within (σ := σ) (S.erase v) := by
        intro x hx

        rintro rfl
        exact hqv hx

      exact ⟨x, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hx, hqx⟩
  · intro p hp
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hp with rfl | hp
    · exact ⟨hWreq, hWin⟩
    · exact ⟨(hpack.1 p hp).1, fun x hx => Finset.mem_of_mem_erase ((hpack.1 p hp).2 x hx)⟩
  · intro p hp q hq hne x hpx hqx
    have avoid' : ∀ p' ∈ P', ∀ y, p'.Mem (σ := σ) y → ¬ W.Mem (σ := σ) y := fun p' hp' =>
      avoid p' (hpack.1 p' hp').1 (hpack.1 p' hp').2
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hp with hpW | hpP <;>
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hq with hqW | hqP
    · exact hne (hpW.trans hqW.symm)
    · exact avoid' q hqP x hqx (hpW ▸ hpx)

theorem forest_edge_interior_inj {x y : α} {d e : ℕ}
    (hx : IsForestEdge f H x d) (hy : IsForestEdge f H y e)
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < d) (hj : j < e) (he : f^[i] x = f^[j] y) :
    x = y ∧ i = j := by
  induction i generalizing j with
  | zero =>
    cases j with
    | zero => exact ⟨he, rfl⟩
    | succ j =>
      have hnot := hy.interior (j + 1) (by lia) hj
      exact (hnot (he ▸ hx.start_mem)).elim
  | succ i ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero =>
      have hnot := hx.interior (i + 1) (by lia) hi
      exact (hnot (he.symm ▸ hy.start_mem)).elim
    | succ j =>
      have hpred : f^[i] x = f^[j] y := by
        apply forestPredecessor_unique f H (hx.source f H (by lia)) (hy.source f H (by lia))
          (z := f^[i + 1] x)
        · exact (Function.iterate_succ_apply' f i x).symm
        · exact (Function.iterate_succ_apply' f j y).symm.trans he.symm
        · exact hx.interior (i + 1) (by lia) hi

      exact ⟨hxy, by lia⟩

    phase f (f^[t] x) = (phase f x + t) % cycleLength f x := by

    rw [iterate_add_apply, canonicalTime_spec, canonicalCycle_iterate]
  have hd : transientDepth f x ≤ b + t := by
    rw [← iterate_mem_periodicPts_iff, hb]
    exact canonicalCycle_periodic f x
  have hm : b + t ≡ canonicalTime f x [MOD ell] :=
    (iterate_eq_iterate_iff_modEq f x hd (transientDepth_le_canonicalTime f x)).mp
      (hb.trans (canonicalTime_spec f x).symm)
  have hx := phase_add_canonicalTime_modEq f x
  have hy := phase_add_canonicalTime_modEq f y
  rw [cycleLength_iterate] at hy
  have hboth : phase f y + (b + t) ≡ (phase f x + t) + (b + t) [MOD ell] := by
    have hxt : phase f x + (b + t) ≡ 0 [MOD ell] := (hm.add_left (phase f x)).trans hx
    have hc : (phase f x + t) + b ≡ 0 [MOD ell] := by
      convert hxt using 1

    convert (hy.trans hc.symm).add_right t using 1 <;> ac_rfl
  have he := Nat.ModEq.add_right_cancel' (b + t) hboth
  have hlt : phase f y < ell := by simpa only [y, ell, cycleLength_iterate] using phase_lt f y
  simpa only [Nat.ModEq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt] using he

theorem card_filter_le_card_filter_sub_half_le (R : Finset ι) (c : Bool) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :

    have := card_filter_le (univ : Finset (ι → Bool)) fun x => t ≤ D x
    rw [card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool] at this
    exact_mod_cast this

  · exact hall.trans_eq (by simp [hR])
  set m : ℝ := (#R : ℝ)
  have hm : 0 < m := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hR

    exact exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mem_filter.mp hx).2 (by positivity))
  have hcosh : cosh (s / 2) ^ #R ≤ exp (2 * t ^ 2 / m) := by
    calc cosh (s / 2) ^ #R ≤ exp ((s / 2) ^ 2 / 2) ^ #R :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (cosh_pos _).le (cosh_le_exp_half_sq _) _
      _ = exp (2 * t ^ 2 / m) := by

          congr 1

          field_simp
          ring
  have hexp : exp (s * t) = exp (2 * t ^ 2 / m) * exp (2 * t ^ 2 / m) := by
    rw [← exp_add]
    congr 1
    simp only [s]
    field_simp
    ring

theorem card_mul_sum_card_inter_mul_sub_one_powersetCard (hU : U ⊆ s) :
    #s * (#s - 1) * ∑ J ∈ s.powersetCard ℓ, #(U ∩ J) * (#(U ∩ J) - 1) =
      #U * (#U - 1) * (ℓ * (ℓ - 1)) * (#s).choose ℓ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge ℓ 2 with hℓ | hℓ

    have hzero : ∀ J ∈ s.powersetCard ℓ, #(U ∩ J) * (#(U ∩ J) - 1) = 0 := fun J hJ => by
      have : #(U ∩ J) ≤ 1 :=
        (card_le_card inter_subset_right).trans ((mem_powersetCard.1 hJ).2.trans_le (by omega))
      rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.1 this with h | h <;> simp [h]
    rw [sum_eq_zero hzero, show ℓ * (ℓ - 1) = 0 by
      rcases (show ℓ = 0 ∨ ℓ = 1 by omega) with h | h <;> simp [h]]
    simp
  obtain ⟨ℓ, rfl⟩ : ∃ ℓ', ℓ = ℓ' + 2 := ⟨ℓ - 2, by omega⟩
  rw [sum_card_inter_mul_sub_one_powersetCard hU hℓ, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
    show ℓ + 2 - 1 = ℓ + 1 by omega]
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge #s 2 with hs | hs
  · rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (n := #s) (k := ℓ + 2) (by omega), show #s * (#s - 1) = 0 by
      rcases (show #s = 0 ∨ #s = 1 by omega) with h | h <;> simp [h]]
    simp
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, #s = n + 2 := ⟨#s - 2, by omega⟩
  rw [hn, Nat.add_sub_cancel, show n + 2 - 1 = n + 1 by omega]
  have h₁ := Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq n ℓ
  have h₂ := Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq (n + 1) (ℓ + 1)
  calc (n + 2) * (n + 1) * (#U * (#U - 1) * n.choose ℓ)
      = #U * (#U - 1) * ((n + 2) * ((n + 1) * n.choose ℓ)) := by ring
    _ = #U * (#U - 1) * ((n + 2) * (n + 1).choose (ℓ + 1) * (ℓ + 1)) := by rw [h₁]; ring
    _ = #U * (#U - 1) * ((n + 2).choose (ℓ + 2) * (ℓ + 2) * (ℓ + 1)) := by rw [h₂]

  have hac : a ≤ c := by simp only [a, c]; exact_mod_cast card_le_card hU
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by positivity
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by positivity

theorem card_avoiders_mul_le_card_filter (x : ℕ → Finset U) (K : ℕ)
    (hK : ∑ j ∈ (range K).filter (fun j => ¬ Disjoint (x j) (x K)),
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ #(x j \ x K) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (#(avoiders x K) : ℝ) * (1 / 2) ^ (#(x K) + 1) ≤
      #((avoiders x K).filter (x K ⊆ ·)) := by

  set C := (range K).filter (fun j => ¬ Disjoint (x j) s)
  set D : Finset (Finset U) := univ.filter fun y => ∀ j < K, Disjoint (x j) s → ¬ x j ⊆ y
  have hAD : avoiders x K ⊆ D := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, D] at hy ⊢
    exact fun j hj _ => hy j hj
  have hD : ∀ y, y ∈ D ↔ y \ s ∈ D := by
    intro y
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, D]
    refine forall₂_congr fun j _ => imp_congr_right fun hj => not_congr ?_
    rw [subset_sdiff]
    exact (and_iff_left hj).symm

    intro a b hba ha
    simp only [coe_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, D] at ha ⊢
    exact fun j hj hjs hsub => ha j hj hjs (hsub.trans hba)

    have := card_filter_subset_mul_two_pow hD
    rw [one_div, inv_pow, ← div_eq_mul_inv, eq_div_iff (by positivity)]
    exact_mod_cast this
  -- the overlapping pairs, by Harris–Kleitman
  have hpair : ∀ j ∈ C, (#(D ∩ univ.filter (s ∪ x j ⊆ ·)) : ℝ) ≤
      #D * (1 / 2) ^ #s * (1 / 2) ^ #(x j \ s) := by
    intro j _
    have hup : IsUpperSet ((univ.filter (s ∪ x j ⊆ ·) : Finset (Finset U)) : Set (Finset U)) := by
      intro a b hab ha
      simp only [coe_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at ha ⊢
      exact ha.trans hab
    have hHK := hDlow.card_inter_le_finset hup
    have hcnt := card_filter_subset_univ_mul_two_pow (s ∪ x j)
    have hunion : #(s ∪ x j) = #s + #(x j \ s) := by

    have hcnt' : (#((univ : Finset (Finset U)).filter (s ∪ x j ⊆ ·)) : ℝ) * 2 ^ (#s + #(x j \ s))

    have hpow : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ #s * (1 / 2) ^ #(x j \ s) * 2 ^ (#s + #(x j \ s)) = 1 := by
      rw [← pow_add, ← mul_pow]; norm_num
    have hb : (#((univ : Finset (Finset U)).filter (s ∪ x j ⊆ ·)) : ℝ) =

      (avoiders x K).filter (s ⊆ ·) ∪ C.biUnion fun j => D ∩ univ.filter (s ∪ x j ⊆ ·) := by
    intro y hy

  have hg : ∀ y, (if ¬ Disjoint t y then (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ #(t \ y) else 0) = g (t ∩ y) := by
    intro y

    rw [hK, pow_mul]

theorem sum_prod_add_mul_pow_eq_zero [CharP K 2] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {r s : ℕ}
    (hK : Fintype.card K = 2 ^ (r + s)) (u v : ι → K) (e : ι → ℕ)
    (he : ∑ i, (2 ^ r * (e i % 2 ^ s) + e i / 2 ^ s) < Fintype.card K - 1) :
    ∑ x : K, ∏ i, (u i + x * v i) ^ e i = 0 := by

  have hbij : Function.Bijective fun y : K => y ^ 2 ^ r := by
    refine Finite.injective_iff_bijective.mp
      (Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := fun y : K => y ^ 2 ^ s) fun y => ?_)
    change (y ^ 2 ^ r) ^ 2 ^ s = y
    rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add, ← hK, FiniteField.pow_card]
  let P : K[X] := ∏ i, (C (u i) + C (v i) * X ^ 2 ^ r) ^ (e i % 2 ^ s) *
    (C (u i ^ 2 ^ s) + C (v i ^ 2 ^ s) * X) ^ (e i / 2 ^ s)
  have hP (y : K) : ∏ i, (u i + y ^ 2 ^ r * v i) ^ e i = P.eval y := by
    simp only [P, eval_prod, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_add, eval_C, eval_X]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.mod_add_div (e i) (2 ^ s), pow_add, pow_mul, add_pow_char_pow,
      mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add, ← hK, FiniteField.pow_card]
    ring
  have hdeg : P.natDegree ≤ ∑ i, (2 ^ r * (e i % 2 ^ s) + e i / 2 ^ s) := by
    refine (natDegree_prod_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    refine natDegree_mul_le.trans (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
    · refine (natDegree_pow_le_of_le _ ?_).trans (mul_comm _ _).le
      rw [natDegree_C_add]
      exact natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _
    · refine (natDegree_pow_le_of_le _ ?_).trans (mul_one _).le
      rw [natDegree_C_add]

theorem exists_collisionCut {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (P : V → Prop) (bad : Finset V)
    (h : ∀ v ∈ bad, P v ∨ ∃ w, G.Adj v w) :
    ∃ S ⊆ bad, #bad ≤ 2 * #S ∧ ∀ v ∈ S, P v ∨ ∃ w ∉ S, G.Adj v w := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨F, hFG, hF, hreach⟩ := G.exists_isAcyclic_reachable_eq_le
  let c := hF.coloringTwo
  -- A vertex with a neighbor in `G` has a neighbor in the forest, of the other color.
  have opposite : ∀ v w, G.Adj v w → ∃ w', c v ≠ c w' ∧ G.Adj v w' := by
    intro v w hvw
    have hvw' : F.Reachable v w := hreach ▸ hvw.reachable
    obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := (F.mem_support).mp (SimpleGraph.mem_support_of_reachable hvw.ne hvw')
    exact ⟨w', c.valid hw', hFG hw'⟩
  have witness : ∀ a, ∀ v ∈ bad.filter (c · = a),
      P v ∨ ∃ w ∉ bad.filter (c · = a), G.Adj v w := by
    intro a v hv
    obtain ⟨hv, hva⟩ := mem_filter.mp hv
    refine (h v hv).imp_right fun ⟨w, hw⟩ => ?_
    obtain ⟨w', hne, hw'⟩ := opposite v w hw
    exact ⟨w', fun hw'a => hne (hva.trans (mem_filter.mp hw'a).2.symm), hw'⟩
  have hsum : #(bad.filter (c · = 0)) + #(bad.filter (c · = 1)) = #bad := by
    rw [filter_congr fun v _ => (by decide : ∀ a : Fin 2, a = 1 ↔ ¬a = 0) (c v)]
    exact card_filter_add_card_filter_not _
  by_cases h0 : #bad ≤ 2 * #(bad.filter (c · = 0))
  · exact ⟨_, filter_subset _ _, h0, witness 0⟩
  · exact ⟨_, filter_subset _ _, by omega, witness 1⟩

theorem card_filter_forall_mem_le {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α]
    (S : Finset ι) (A : ({i // i ∉ S} → α) → ι → Finset α) (M : ℕ)
    (hA : ∀ y, ∀ i ∈ S, #(A y i) ≤ M)
    [DecidablePred fun x : ι → α => ∀ i ∈ S, x i ∈ A (fun j => x j) i] :
    #{x : ι → α | ∀ i ∈ S, x i ∈ A (fun j => x j) i} ≤
      Fintype.card α ^ (Fintype.card ι - #S) * M ^ #S := by
  classical
  set T : Finset (ι → α) := {x | ∀ i ∈ S, x i ∈ A (fun j => x j) i}
  let outside : (ι → α) → {i // i ∉ S} → α := fun x j => x j
  calc #T = ∑ y, #{x ∈ T | outside x = y} :=
        card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise fun _ _ => mem_coe.mpr (mem_univ _)
    _ ≤ ∑ _y : {i // i ∉ S} → α, M ^ #S := sum_le_sum fun y _ => ?_
    _ = Fintype.card α ^ (Fintype.card ι - #S) * M ^ #S := by
        rw [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_subtype_compl,
          Fintype.card_coe, smul_eq_mul]
  -- Each fiber injects into the allowed values on `S`.
  calc #{x ∈ T | outside x = y}
      ≤ #(Fintype.piFinset fun i : {i // i ∈ S} => A y i) := by
        refine card_le_card_of_injOn (fun x i => x i) (fun x hx => ?_) fun x hx x' hx' hxx' => ?_
        · obtain ⟨hxT, rfl⟩ := mem_filter.mp hx
          exact Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr fun i => (mem_filter.mp hxT).2 i i.2
        · have hy : outside x = outside x' :=
            (mem_filter.mp hx).2.trans (mem_filter.mp hx').2.symm
          funext i
          by_cases hi : i ∈ S
          · exact congrFun hxx' ⟨i, hi⟩
          · exact congrFun hy ⟨i, hi⟩
    _ = ∏ i : {i // i ∈ S}, #(A y i) := Fintype.card_piFinset _
    _ ≤ M ^ #(univ : Finset {i // i ∈ S}) := prod_le_pow_card _ _ _ fun i _ => hA y i i.2
    _ = M ^ #S := by rw [card_univ, Fintype.card_coe]

theorem card_majTree_ne_le {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (val : Ω → α) (y : α)

    (#{V : Fin (3 ^ L) → Ω | majTree L (val ∘ V) ≠ y} : ℝ) ≤
      (3 * ρ) ^ (2 ^ L) / 3 * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L) := by

  induction L with
  | zero =>
    have : #{V : Fin (3 ^ 0) → Ω | majTree 0 (val ∘ V) ≠ y} = #{ω | val ω ≠ y} := by
      refine card_nbij' (fun V => V ⟨0, by simp⟩) (fun ω _ => ω) (fun V hV => ?_)
        (fun ω hω => ?_) (fun V _ => ?_) (fun ω _ => rfl)
      · rw [mem_coe, mem_filter] at hV ⊢
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, hV.2⟩
      · rw [mem_coe, mem_filter] at hω ⊢
        exact ⟨mem_univ _, hω.2⟩
      · funext k
        have hk : k = ⟨0, by simp⟩ := Fin.ext (Nat.lt_one_iff.1 (k.2.trans_eq (pow_zero 3)))
        rw [hk]
    rw [this]
    simpa using hρ
  | succ L ih =>
    set N := (#{V : Fin (3 ^ L) → Ω | majTree L (val ∘ V) ≠ y} : ℕ)
    set B : Finset (Fin (3 ^ L) → Ω) := {V | majTree L (val ∘ V) ≠ y}
    -- the three blocks of a tuple
    let e : (Fin (3 ^ (L + 1)) → Ω) ≃ (Fin 3 → Fin (3 ^ L) → Ω) :=
      (Equiv.arrowCongr (tripleEquiv L).symm (Equiv.refl Ω)).trans (Equiv.curry _ _ _)
    have he : ∀ V j k, e V j k = V (tripleEquiv L (j, k)) := fun V j k => rfl
    have hcard : #{V : Fin (3 ^ (L + 1)) → Ω | majTree (L + 1) (val ∘ V) ≠ y} ≤
        #(Fintype.piFinset ![B, B, univ]) + #(Fintype.piFinset ![B, univ, B]) +
          #(Fintype.piFinset ![univ, B, B]) := by
      calc #{V : Fin (3 ^ (L + 1)) → Ω | majTree (L + 1) (val ∘ V) ≠ y}
          ≤ #(Fintype.piFinset ![B, B, univ] ∪ Fintype.piFinset ![B, univ, B] ∪
              Fintype.piFinset ![univ, B, B]) := by
            refine card_le_card_of_injOn e (fun V hV => ?_) (e.injective.injOn)
            rw [mem_coe, mem_filter] at hV
            have h := two_ne_of_maj3_ne hV.2
            rw [mem_coe]
            rcases h with ⟨h₀, h₁⟩ | ⟨h₀, h₂⟩ | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
            · refine mem_union_left _ (mem_union_left _ (Fintype.mem_piFinset.2 fun j => ?_))
              fin_cases j
              · exact mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, h₀⟩
              · exact mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, h₁⟩
              · exact mem_univ _
            · refine mem_union_left _ (mem_union_right _ (Fintype.mem_piFinset.2 fun j => ?_))
              fin_cases j
              · exact mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, h₀⟩
              · exact mem_univ _
              · exact mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, h₂⟩
            · refine mem_union_right _ (Fintype.mem_piFinset.2 fun j => ?_)
              fin_cases j
              · exact mem_univ _
              · exact mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, h₁⟩
              · exact mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, h₂⟩
        _ ≤ _ := (card_union_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (card_union_le _ _) _)
    have hB : (#B : ℝ) ≤ (3 * ρ) ^ (2 ^ L) / 3 * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L) := ih
    simp only [Fintype.card_piFinset, Fin.prod_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
    have hcard' : (#{V : Fin (3 ^ (L + 1)) → Ω | majTree (L + 1) (val ∘ V) ≠ y} : ℝ) ≤
        3 * ((#B : ℝ) * #B * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L)) := by
      have : (#{V : Fin (3 ^ (L + 1)) → Ω | majTree (L + 1) (val ∘ V) ≠ y} : ℝ) ≤
          (#B * #B * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L) + #B * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L) * #B +
            Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L) * #B * #B : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard
      push_cast at this
      linarith
    have hB0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ #B := by positivity
    have hX : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (3 * ρ) ^ (2 ^ L) / 3 * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L) := hB0.trans hB
    calc (#{V : Fin (3 ^ (L + 1)) → Ω | majTree (L + 1) (val ∘ V) ≠ y} : ℝ)
        ≤ 3 * ((#B : ℝ) * #B * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L)) := hcard'
      _ ≤ 3 * (((3 * ρ) ^ (2 ^ L) / 3 * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L)) *
            ((3 * ρ) ^ (2 ^ L) / 3 * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L)) * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L)) := by
          have := mul_le_mul hB hB hB0 hX
          have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L) := by positivity
          nlinarith
      _ = (3 * ρ) ^ (2 ^ (L + 1)) / 3 * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ (L + 1)) := by
          rw [pow_succ 2 L, pow_mul, pow_succ 3 L, pow_mul]

theorem exists_forall_majTree_eq {X Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (S : Finset X) (val : X → Ω → α) (target : X → α) {ρ : ℝ}
    (hρ : ∀ x ∈ S, (#{ω | val x ω ≠ target x} : ℝ) ≤ ρ * Fintype.card Ω)
    (h3 : 3 * ρ ≤ 1 / 2) {L : ℕ} (hS : #S ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ L)) :
    ∃ V : Fin (3 ^ L) → Ω, ∀ x ∈ S, majTree L (val x ∘ V) = target x := by
  classical
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ := by
    by_cases hS0 : S.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS0
      have := hρ x hx
      have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card Ω := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
      nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ #{ω | val x ω ≠ target x} from by positivity]
    · simp only [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hS0
      subst hS0
      obtain ⟨V⟩ : Nonempty (Fin (3 ^ L) → Ω) := inferInstance
      obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hcon V
      exact absurd hx (notMem_empty x)
  have hcover : (univ : Finset (Fin (3 ^ L) → Ω)) ⊆
      S.biUnion fun x => {V | majTree L (val x ∘ V) ≠ target x} := by
    intro V _
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hne⟩ := hcon V
    exact mem_biUnion.2 ⟨x, hx, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, hne⟩⟩
  have hcard := (card_le_card hcover).trans card_biUnion_le
  rw [card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
  have hsum : (Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L) : ℝ) ≤
      #S * ((3 * ρ) ^ (2 ^ L) / 3 * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L)) := by
    calc (Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L) : ℝ) ≤
          ∑ x ∈ S, (#{V : Fin (3 ^ L) → Ω | majTree L (val x ∘ V) ≠ target x} : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast hcard
      _ ≤ ∑ _x ∈ S, (3 * ρ) ^ (2 ^ L) / 3 * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L) :=
          sum_le_sum fun x hx => card_majTree_ne_le (val x) (target x) (hρ x hx) L
      _ = _ := by rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hpow : (3 * ρ) ^ (2 ^ L) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (2 ^ L) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h3 _

    rw [one_div, inv_pow, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_one (by positivity)]
    exact_mod_cast hS

    have : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card Ω := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
    positivity
  have : #S * ((3 * ρ) ^ (2 ^ L) / 3 * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L)) ≤
      (1 / 3 : ℝ) * Fintype.card Ω ^ (3 ^ L) := by
    have h1 : (#S : ℝ) * (3 * ρ) ^ (2 ^ L) ≤ 1 :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)).trans hS'
    nlinarith
  linarith

theorem card_filter_card_filter_le_le (G : Finset Ω) (hG : 2 * Fintype.card Ω ≤ 3 * G.card)
    (r : ℕ) :
    9 ^ r * (univ.filter fun ω : Fin (2 * r) → Ω => (univ.filter fun i => ω i ∈ G).card ≤ r).card
      ≤ 8 ^ r * Fintype.card Ω ^ (2 * r) := by
  set N := Fintype.card Ω
  set bad := univ.filter fun ω : Fin (2 * r) → Ω => (univ.filter fun i => ω i ∈ G).card ≤ r
  -- A bad tuple has weight at least `2 ^ r`.
  have hweight : ∀ ω ∈ bad, 2 ^ r ≤ ∏ i, (if ω i ∈ G then 1 else 2) := by
    intro ω hω
    have hω := (mem_filter.1 hω).2
    rw [Finset.prod_ite, Finset.prod_const_one, Finset.prod_const, one_mul]
    refine Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) ?_
    have := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (Fin (2 * r))))
      (fun i => ω i ∈ G)
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at this
    omega
  have hmarkov : 2 ^ r * bad.card ≤ (G.card + 2 * (N - G.card)) ^ (2 * r) := by
    rw [← sum_prod_weight, mul_comm, ← smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.sum_const]
    exact (Finset.sum_le_sum hweight).trans
      (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (subset_univ _) fun _ _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
  have hG' : G.card ≤ N := Finset.card_le_univ G
  have hthree : 3 * (G.card + 2 * (N - G.card)) ≤ 4 * N := by omega
  have key : 2 ^ r * (9 ^ r * bad.card) ≤ 2 ^ r * (8 ^ r * N ^ (2 * r)) := by
    calc 2 ^ r * (9 ^ r * bad.card) = 9 ^ r * (2 ^ r * bad.card) := by ring
      _ ≤ 9 ^ r * (G.card + 2 * (N - G.card)) ^ (2 * r) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hmarkov
      _ = (3 * (G.card + 2 * (N - G.card))) ^ (2 * r) := by rw [mul_pow, pow_mul 3 2 r]; norm_num
      _ ≤ (4 * N) ^ (2 * r) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hthree _
      _ = 2 ^ r * (8 ^ r * N ^ (2 * r)) := by
        rw [mul_pow, pow_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]; norm_num
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left key (by positivity)

    (hgood : ∀ x, 2 * Fintype.card Ω ≤ 3 * (good x).card) :

theorem card_edist_eq_add_one_le (hD : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ D) (u : V) (d : ℕ) :
    #{v | G.edist u v = d + 1} ≤ D * (D - 1) ^ d := by
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    refine (card_edist_eq_add_one_le_sum u 0).trans ?_
    have h0 : ({w | G.edist u w = ((0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)} : Finset V) = {u} := by
      ext w
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_singleton, Nat.cast_zero,
        edist_eq_zero_iff]
      exact eq_comm
    rw [h0, sum_singleton, pow_zero, mul_one]
    exact (card_filter_le _ _).trans ((G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree u).trans_le (hD u))
  | succ d ih =>
    refine (card_edist_eq_add_one_le_sum u (d + 1)).trans ?_
    calc _ ≤ ∑ w with G.edist u w = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞), (D - 1) :=
          sum_le_sum fun w hw => by
            have hw' : G.edist u w = d + 1 := by
              rw [(mem_filter.mp hw).2, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
            simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using card_filter_neighborFinset_le hD hw'
      _ = (D - 1) * #{w | G.edist u w = d + 1} := by
          rw [sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      _ ≤ (D - 1) * (D * (D - 1) ^ d) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ih
      _ = D * (D - 1) ^ (d + 1) := by ring

private theorem containsSunflower_aux {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    ∀ (w : ℕ) (F : Finset (Finset α)), (∀ s ∈ F, s.card ≤ w) →
      sunflowerBound p w < F.card → ContainsSunflower p F
  | 0, F, hF, hlarge => by
    have : F ⊆ {∅} := fun s hs => mem_singleton.2 (card_eq_zero.1 (Nat.le_zero.1 (hF s hs)))
    have := card_le_card this
    simp only [sunflowerBound, pow_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, mul_one, card_singleton]
      at hlarge this
    omega
  | w + 1, F, hF, hlarge => by
    classical
    -- A maximal subfamily of pairwise disjoint sets.
    obtain ⟨D, hDmax⟩ := (F.powerset.filter fun D : Finset (Finset α) =>
      (D : Set (Finset α)).Pairwise Disjoint).exists_maximal ⟨∅, by simp⟩
    have hDF : D ⊆ F := mem_powerset.1 (mem_filter.1 hDmax.1).1
    have hD : (D : Set (Finset α)).Pairwise Disjoint := (mem_filter.1 hDmax.1).2
    have hmax : ∀ E ⊆ F, (E : Set (Finset α)).Pairwise Disjoint → D ⊆ E → E ⊆ D :=
      fun E hE hEd hDE => hDmax.2 (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_powerset.2 hE, hEd⟩) hDE
    by_cases hpD : p ≤ D.card
    · obtain ⟨S, hSD, hS⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq hpD
      exact ⟨S, hSD.trans hDF, hS, ∅, isSunflower_empty_of_pairwise_disjoint (hD.mono hSD)⟩
    -- A set disjoint from the nonempty sets of `D` is in `D`.
    set U := (D.erase ∅).biUnion id
    have hmemD : ∀ s ∈ F, Disjoint s U → s ∈ D := by
      intro s hs hdisj
      by_contra hsD
      refine hsD (hmax (insert s D) (insert_subset hs hDF) ?_ (subset_insert s D)
        (mem_insert_self s D))
      rw [coe_insert]
      refine hD.insert fun t ht _ => ?_
      by_cases ht0 : t = ∅
      · subst ht0
        exact ⟨disjoint_empty_right s, disjoint_empty_left s⟩
      · have := hdisj.mono_right (subset_biUnion_of_mem id (mem_erase.2 ⟨ht0, ht⟩))
        exact ⟨this, this.symm⟩
    -- So every nonempty set of `F` meets `U`, which is small.
    have hmeet : ∀ s ∈ F, s ≠ ∅ → ∃ x ∈ U, x ∈ s := by
      intro s hs hne
      by_contra! h
      have hdisj : Disjoint s U := disjoint_left.2 fun x hxs hxU => h x hxU hxs
      exact hne (disjoint_self.1 (hdisj.mono_right
        (subset_biUnion_of_mem id (mem_erase.2 ⟨hne, hmemD s hs hdisj⟩))))
    have hU : U.card ≤ (D.erase ∅).card * (w + 1) :=
      card_biUnion_le_card_mul _ _ _ fun s hs => hF s (hDF (mem_of_mem_erase hs))
    -- Some point of `U` lies in more than `sunflowerBound p w` sets of `F`.
    set B := sunflowerBound p w
    have hB : 1 ≤ B := sunflowerBound_pos hp w
    obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ : ∃ x ∈ U, B < (F.filter (x ∈ ·)).card := by
      by_contra! h
      have hcover : F ⊆ F.filter (· = ∅) ∪ U.biUnion fun x => F.filter (x ∈ ·) := fun s hs => by
        by_cases hs0 : s = ∅
        · exact mem_union_left _ (mem_filter.2 ⟨hs, hs0⟩)
        · obtain ⟨x, hxU, hxs⟩ := hmeet s hs hs0
          exact mem_union_right _ (mem_biUnion.2 ⟨x, hxU, mem_filter.2 ⟨hs, hxs⟩⟩)
      have hF' : F.card ≤ (F.filter (· = ∅)).card + U.card * B :=
        (card_le_card hcover).trans ((card_union_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left
          ((card_biUnion_le.trans (sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ h)).trans_eq (smul_eq_mul _ _)) _))
      have hUB : U.card * B ≤ (D.erase ∅).card * ((w + 1) * B) :=
        (Nat.mul_le_mul_right B hU).trans_eq (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _)
      have hsucc : sunflowerBound p (w + 1) = (p - 2) * ((w + 1) * B) + (w + 1) * B := by
        rw [← Nat.succ_mul, show (p - 2).succ = p - 1 by omega]
        simp only [B, sunflowerBound, pow_succ, Nat.factorial_succ]
        ring
      have hX : 1 ≤ (w + 1) * B := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (by positivity)
      by_cases hE : ∅ ∈ F
      · have h1 : (F.filter (· = ∅)).card = 1 := by
          simp [filter_eq' F ∅, hE]
        have h2 : (D.erase ∅).card ≤ p - 2 := by
          have := hmemD ∅ hE (disjoint_empty_left _)
          rw [card_erase_of_mem this]
          omega
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ((w + 1) * B) h2
        omega
      · have h1 : (F.filter (· = ∅)).card = 0 := by
          simp [filter_eq' F ∅, hE]
        have h2 : (D.erase ∅).card ≤ p - 1 :=
          (card_le_card (erase_subset _ _)).trans (by omega)
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ((w + 1) * B) h2
        have : (p - 1) * ((w + 1) * B) = (p - 2) * ((w + 1) * B) + (w + 1) * B := by
          rw [← Nat.succ_mul, show (p - 2).succ = p - 1 by omega]
        omega
    -- Remove `x`, apply the lemma for size `w`, and put `x` back.
    set G := F.filter (x ∈ ·)
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun s : Finset α => s.erase x) G := fun s hs t ht hst => by
      rw [← insert_erase (mem_filter.1 hs).2, ← insert_erase (mem_filter.1 ht).2]
      exact congrArg (insert x) hst
    obtain ⟨S, hSG, hS, K, hSK⟩ := containsSunflower_aux hp w (G.image (·.erase x))
      (fun s hs => by
        obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hs
        rw [card_erase_of_mem (mem_filter.1 ht).2]
        have := hF t (mem_filter.1 ht).1
        omega)
      (by rwa [card_image_of_injOn hinj])
    have hxS : ∀ s ∈ S, x ∉ s := fun s hs => by
      obtain ⟨t, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 (hSG hs)
      exact notMem_erase x t
    refine ⟨S.image (insert x), fun _ hs' => ?_, ?_, insert x K, hSK.image_insert x⟩
    · obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hs'
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 (hSG hs)
      rw [insert_erase (mem_filter.1 ht).2]
      exact (mem_filter.1 ht).1
    · rw [card_image_of_injOn fun s hs t ht hst => by
        rw [← erase_insert (hxS s hs), ← erase_insert (hxS t ht)]
        exact congrArg (·.erase x) hst, hS]

    ¬ ContainsSunflower (Fintype.card β + 1) (graphFamily ι β) := by
  rintro ⟨S, hSF, hS, K, hK⟩
  have h2 : 2 ≤ #S := by have := Fintype.card_pos (α := β); omega
  have hKsub : ∀ s ∈ S, K ⊆ s := fun s hs => hK.subset_of_mem h2 hs
  -- every set of `S` is the graph of `φ s`
  set φ : Finset (ι × β) → ι → β := Function.invFun functionGraph
  have hmem {s} (hs : s ∈ S) {y : ι × β} : y ∈ s ↔ φ s y.1 = y.2 := by
    have h := mem_functionGraph (f := φ s) (x := y)
    rwa [Function.invFun_eq (mem_graphFamily.1 (hSF hs))] at h
  -- every petal is contained in the core
  have hsub : ∀ s ∈ S, s ⊆ K := by
    intro s hs x hx
    obtain ⟨u, hu, u', hu', hne, huu'⟩ := exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to
      (t := (univ : Finset β)) (f := fun u => φ u x.1)
      (by rw [card_univ, hS]; omega) fun _ _ => mem_coe.2 (mem_univ _)
    have hK' : (x.1, φ u x.1) ∈ K := by
      rw [← hK hu hu' hne]
      exact mem_inter.2 ⟨(hmem hu).2 rfl, (hmem hu').2 huu'.symm⟩
    have hval : φ s x.1 = φ u x.1 := (hmem hs).1 (hKsub s hs hK')
    rwa [show x = (x.1, φ u x.1) from Prod.ext rfl (((hmem hs).1 hx).symm.trans hval)]
  obtain ⟨s, hs, t, ht, hst⟩ := one_lt_card.1 (show 1 < #S by omega)
  exact hst ((hsub s hs).trans (hKsub t ht) |>.antisymm ((hsub t ht).trans (hKsub s hs)))

    ∀ {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n → Bool)), S.Nonempty →
      2 ^ n ≤ ∑ σ ∈ S, 2 ^ isolation S σ
  | 0, S, hS => by
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hS
    calc
      2 ^ 0 = 1 := rfl
      _ ≤ 2 ^ isolation S σ := Nat.one_le_two_pow
      _ ≤ ∑ σ ∈ S, 2 ^ isolation S σ :=
        single_le_sum (f := fun σ => 2 ^ isolation S σ) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hσ
  | n + 1, S, hS => by
    rw [sum_split S fun σ => 2 ^ isolation S σ]
    by_cases h0 : (slice S false).Nonempty <;> by_cases h1 : (slice S true).Nonempty
    · -- Both slices are nonempty.
      have ih0 := two_pow_le_sum_two_pow_isolation (slice S false) h0
      have ih1 := two_pow_le_sum_two_pow_isolation (slice S true) h1
      have e0 := sum_slice_le S false
      have e1 := sum_slice_le S true
      rw [Fintype.sum_bool, pow_succ]
      omega
    · -- Only the slice with first coordinate `false` is nonempty.
      have ih0 := two_pow_le_sum_two_pow_isolation (slice S false) h0
      rw [Fintype.sum_bool, not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h1, sum_empty, zero_add, pow_succ]
      exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_right 2 ih0).trans (sum_slice_mul_two_le_of_not_nonempty S false h1)
    · -- Only the slice with first coordinate `true` is nonempty.
      have ih1 := two_pow_le_sum_two_pow_isolation (slice S true) h1
      rw [Fintype.sum_bool, not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h0, sum_empty, add_zero, pow_succ]
      exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_right 2 ih1).trans (sum_slice_mul_two_le_of_not_nonempty S true h0)
    · -- Both slices are empty, so `S` is empty.
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hS
      cases hb : σ 0
      · exact h0 ⟨Fin.tail σ, mem_slice.mpr (by rw [← hb, Fin.cons_self_tail]; exact hσ)⟩
      · exact h1 ⟨Fin.tail σ, mem_slice.mpr (by rw [← hb, Fin.cons_self_tail]; exact hσ)⟩

theorem binaryValue_injective_of_length_eq {u v : List Bool} (hlen : u.length = v.length)
    (h : binaryValue u = binaryValue v) : u = v := by
  induction u using List.reverseRecOn generalizing v with
  | nil => exact (List.length_eq_zero_iff.1 hlen.symm).symm
  | append_singleton u b ih =>
    obtain ⟨v, c, rfl⟩ : ∃ w b, v = w ++ [b] := by
      rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat v with h' | ⟨w, b, h'⟩
      · simp [h'] at hlen
      · exact ⟨w, b, by simpa using h'⟩
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hlen
    rw [binaryValue_snoc, binaryValue_snoc] at h
    have hb : b = c := by
      cases b <;> cases c <;> simp only [Bool.toNat_false, Bool.toNat_true] at h <;>
        first | rfl | lia
    subst hb
    rw [ih hlen (by lia)]

theorem foldl_bne_eq_parity (w : List Bool) :
    w.foldl bne false = parity w.length (fun i => w[i]) := by
  have hcount : w.foldl bne false = decide (w.count true % 2 = 1) := by
    have hgen (b : Bool) (l : List Bool) :
        l.foldl bne b = (b != decide (l.count true % 2 = 1)) := by
      induction l generalizing b with
      | nil => cases b <;> simp
      | cons a l ih =>
        rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.count_cons]
        cases a <;> cases b <;>
        · by_cases h : l.count true % 2 = 1
          · have h0 : (l.count true + 1) % 2 = 0 := by omega
            simp [h, h0]
          · have h1 : (l.count true + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
            simp [h, h1]
    simpa using hgen false w
  rw [hcount, parity, parityOn, Bool.eq_iff_iff, decide_eq_true_eq, decide_eq_true_eq,
    Finset.card_filter]
  have hcard (l : List Bool) :
      (∑ i : Fin l.length, if l[i] = true then 1 else 0) = l.count true := by
    induction l with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a l ih =>
      rw [List.count_cons, ← ih]
      refine (Fin.sum_univ_succ fun i : Fin (l.length + 1) =>
        if (a :: l)[i] = true then (1 : ℕ) else 0).trans ?_
      cases a <;> simp [Nat.add_comm]
  rw [hcard w]

theorem card_filter_extensions_free_subset (ρ₀ : PartialAssignment ι) (ℓ : ℕ)
    {U : Finset ι} (hU : U ⊆ ρ₀.free) :
    #{ρ ∈ ρ₀.extensions ℓ | ρ.free ⊆ U} = (#U).choose ℓ * 2 ^ (#ρ₀.free - ℓ) := by
  rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := free) (t := powersetCard ℓ U)
    fun ρ hρ => by
      obtain ⟨hρ_ext, hρ_sub⟩ := mem_filter.1 hρ
      exact mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨hρ_sub, (mem_extensions.1 hρ_ext).2⟩]
  rw [sum_congr rfl (g := fun _ => 2 ^ (#ρ₀.free - ℓ)), sum_const, card_powersetCard, smul_eq_mul]
  intro S hS
  obtain ⟨hSsub, hScard⟩ := mem_powersetCard.1 hS
  have hfilter :
      {ρ ∈ {ρ ∈ ρ₀.extensions ℓ | ρ.free ⊆ U} | ρ.free = S} =
        {ρ ∈ ρ₀.extensions ℓ | ρ.free = S} := by
    ext ρ
    simp only [mem_filter]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨⟨h1, _⟩, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, h2⟩, fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨⟨h1, h2 ▸ hSsub⟩, h2⟩⟩
  rw [hfilter]
  exact card_filter_extensions_free_eq ρ₀ ℓ (mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨hSsub.trans hU, hScard⟩)

theorem mul_card_filter_withFree_le {n c G H G' ℓ ℓ' : ℕ} (hℓ'ℓ : ℓ' ≤ ℓ) (hℓn : ℓ ≤ n)
    {B B' : PartialAssignment (Fin n) → Prop} [DecidablePred B] [DecidablePred B']
    (h₁ : c * #{ρ ∈ withFree (Fin n) ℓ | B ρ} ≤ G * #(withFree (Fin n) ℓ))
    (h₂ : ∀ ρ ∈ withFree (Fin n) ℓ, ¬ B ρ →
      c * #{ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' | B' ρ'} ≤ H * #(ρ.extensions ℓ'))
    (hG : G + H ≤ G') :
    c * #{ρ ∈ withFree (Fin n) ℓ' | B' ρ} ≤ G' * #(withFree (Fin n) ℓ') := by
  set W := withFree (Fin n) ℓ
  set F := (n - ℓ').choose (ℓ - ℓ')
  have hF : 0 < F := Nat.choose_pos (by omega)
  set T := ℓ.choose ℓ' * 2 ^ (ℓ - ℓ')
  have hT : ∀ ρ ∈ W, #(ρ.extensions ℓ') = T := fun ρ hρ => by
    rw [card_extensions, mem_withFree.1 hρ]
  -- each restriction with `ℓ` free bits has few bad extensions, unless it satisfies `B`
  have hper : ∀ ρ ∈ W, c * #{ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' | B' ρ'} ≤
      (if B ρ then c else 0) * T + H * T := fun ρ hρ => by
    by_cases hb : B ρ
    · simp only [hb, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [← hT ρ hρ]
      exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (card_filter_le _ _)).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
    · simp only [hb, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul, zero_add]
      rw [← hT ρ hρ]
      exact h₂ ρ hρ hb
  -- double counting the extensions, with and without the condition
  have hdc := sum_card_filter_extensions B' hℓ'ℓ
  have hall := sum_card_filter_extensions (ι := Fin n) (fun _ => True) hℓ'ℓ
  simp only [filter_true] at hall
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hdc hall
  rw [sum_congr rfl hT, sum_const, smul_eq_mul] at hall
  refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right (?_ : _ * F ≤ _ * F) hF
  calc c * #{ρ ∈ withFree (Fin n) ℓ' | B' ρ} * F
      = ∑ ρ ∈ W, c * #{ρ' ∈ ρ.extensions ℓ' | B' ρ'} := by
        rw [mul_assoc, ← hdc, mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ ρ ∈ W, ((if B ρ then c else 0) * T + H * T) := sum_le_sum hper
    _ = c * #{ρ ∈ W | B ρ} * T + #W * H * T := by
        rw [sum_add_distrib, ← sum_mul, sum_ite, sum_const_zero, add_zero, sum_const,
          smul_eq_mul, sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
    _ ≤ G * #W * T + #W * H * T := by gcongr
    _ = (G + H) * #(withFree (Fin n) ℓ') * F := by
        rw [mul_assoc _ #(withFree (Fin n) ℓ'), ← hall]
        ring
    _ ≤ G' * #(withFree (Fin n) ℓ') * F := by gcongr

theorem propagate_sorted_eq_true_iff {κ : Type*} [LinearOrder κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (key : ℕ → κ) (source : ℕ → Bool) (count : ℕ)
    (sorted : MonotoneOn key (Set.Iio count)) :
    propagate source (keyLinks key) count = true ↔
      ∃ start, start < count ∧ source start = true ∧ key start = key (count - 1) := by
  rw [propagate_eq_true_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨start, startBefore, starts, links⟩
    have connected : ∀ index, start ≤ index → index < count → key start = key index := by
      intro index after
      induction index, after using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => intro _; rfl
      | succ index after ih =>
        intro before
        have adjacent : key index = key (index + 1) := by
          simpa [keyLinks] using links (index + 1) (by lia) before
        exact (ih (by lia)).trans adjacent
    exact ⟨start, startBefore, starts, connected (count - 1) (by lia) (by lia)⟩
  · rintro ⟨start, startBefore, starts, sameKey⟩
    refine ⟨start, startBefore, starts, ?_⟩
    intro index after before
    have hprev : index - 1 < count := by lia
    have hlast : count - 1 < count := by lia
    have previousLe : key (index - 1) ≤ key index := sorted hprev before (by lia)
    have firstLe : key start ≤ key (index - 1) := sorted startBefore hprev (by lia)
    have lastLe : key index ≤ key (count - 1) := sorted before hlast (by lia)
    have equal : key (index - 1) = key index :=
      le_antisymm previousLe (lastLe.trans (sameKey.symm.le.trans firstLe))
    simp only [keyLinks, ite_eq_right (by lia : index ≠ 0), decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact equal

theorem two_pow_mul_card_filter_card_filter_block_le {m e R : ℕ} (hR : R = 6 * e)
    (g : BitString m → Prop) [DecidablePred g] (hg : 2 * 2 ^ m ≤ 3 * #{s | g s}) :
    2 ^ e * #{x : BitString (2 * R * m) | #{i | g (block x i)} ≤ R} ≤ 2 ^ (2 * R * m) := by
  have hmaj := card_filter_card_filter_le_le (univ.filter g)
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool] using hg) R
  rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm m] at hmaj
  have hc : 9 ^ R * #{x : BitString (2 * R * m) | #{i | g (block x i)} ≤ R} ≤
      8 ^ R * 2 ^ (2 * R * m) := by
    refine (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ?_).trans hmaj
    rw [← card_map blocksEquiv.toEmbedding]
    refine card_le_card fun ω hω => ?_
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 hω
    refine mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    simpa only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, blocksEquiv_apply] using hx
  have hq : 2 ^ e * 8 ^ R ≤ 9 ^ R := by
    subst hR
    simp only [pow_mul, ← mul_pow]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by norm_num) _
  refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (by positivity : 0 < 9 ^ R)
  calc 9 ^ R * (2 ^ e * #{x : BitString (2 * R * m) | #{i | g (block x i)} ≤ R})
      = 2 ^ e * (9 ^ R * #{x : BitString (2 * R * m) | #{i | g (block x i)} ≤ R}) := by
        ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ e * (8 ^ R * 2 ^ (2 * R * m)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hc
    _ = 2 ^ e * 8 ^ R * 2 ^ (2 * R * m) := by ring
    _ ≤ 9 ^ R * 2 ^ (2 * R * m) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hq

theorem two_pow_mul_card_filter_exists_le {R M e' : ℕ}
    {Bad : (Fin R → Bool) → (Fin M → Bool) → Prop}
    [∀ r x, Decidable (Bad r x)]
    (h : ∀ x, 2 ^ e' * (univ.filter fun r => Bad r x).card ≤ 2 ^ R) :
    2 ^ e' * (univ.filter fun r => ∃ x, Bad r x).card ≤ 2 ^ M * 2 ^ R := by
  classical
  have hsub : (univ.filter fun r => ∃ x, Bad r x) ⊆
      univ.biUnion fun x => univ.filter fun r => Bad r x := by
    intro r hr
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hr
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hr
    exact mem_biUnion.2 ⟨x, mem_univ _, by simpa using hx⟩
  calc 2 ^ e' * (univ.filter fun r => ∃ x, Bad r x).card
      ≤ 2 ^ e' * ∑ x, (univ.filter fun r => Bad r x).card :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ((card_le_card hsub).trans card_biUnion_le)
    _ = ∑ x : Fin M → Bool, 2 ^ e' * (univ.filter fun r => Bad r x).card := mul_sum ..
    _ ≤ ∑ _x : Fin M → Bool, 2 ^ R := sum_le_sum fun x _ => h x
    _ = 2 ^ M * 2 ^ R := by simp

theorem card_filter_filter_ne_eq (x : ∀ i, β i) (S : Finset ι) :
    #{y : ∀ i, β i | ({i | x i ≠ y i} : Finset ι) = S} = ∏ i ∈ S, (Fintype.card (β i) - 1) := by
  have h : #{y : ∀ i, β i | ({i | x i ≠ y i} : Finset ι) = S} =
      Fintype.card (∀ i, {b : β i // (i ∈ S ↔ x i ≠ b)}) := by
    rw [← Fintype.card_coe]
    refine Fintype.card_congr ((Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun y => ?_).trans
      Equiv.subtypePiEquivPi)
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Finset.ext_iff]
    exact forall_congr' fun i => Iff.comm
  rw [h, Fintype.card_pi]
  have hi (i : ι) : Fintype.card {b : β i // (i ∈ S ↔ x i ≠ b)} =
      if i ∈ S then Fintype.card (β i) - 1 else 1 := by
    by_cases hiS : i ∈ S
    · simp only [hiS, true_iff, ↓reduceIte]

    · simp only [hiS, false_iff, not_not, ↓reduceIte]

theorem henselCoeff_eq {d D : ℕ} {Q : F[X][Y]}
    (hQ : Sudan.WeightedDegreeLE d D Q) (hD : D < Fintype.card F)
    {P : F[X]} (hQP : Q.eval P = 0) {τ : F}
    (hlam : (derivative Q).evalEval τ (P.eval τ) ≠ 0) {A : F[X]} {k : ℕ} (hk : k < d)
    (hA : A.natDegree ≤ k) (hAP : ∀ i ≤ k, A.coeff i = (taylor τ P).coeff i) :
    henselCoeff Q τ ((derivative Q).evalEval τ (P.eval τ)) A (k + 1) =
      (taylor τ P).coeff (k + 1) := by
  set lam := (derivative Q).evalEval τ (P.eval τ)
  set φ := (taylorAlgHom τ : F[X] →+* F[X])
  set G := Q.map φ
  -- `P(X + τ) = A + X ^ (k + 1) * R`
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : X ^ (k + 1) ∣ taylor τ P - A := X_pow_dvd_iff.2 fun i hi => by
    rw [coeff_sub, hAP i (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 hi), sub_self]
  have hPA : taylor τ P = A + X ^ (k + 1) * R := by rw [← hR]; ring
  have hG : G.eval (taylor τ P) = 0 := by
    change (Q.map φ).eval (φ P) = 0
    rw [eval_map, eval₂_hom, hQP, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_mul_sq_add_linear_part_eq_eval_add G A (X ^ (k + 1) * R)
  rw [← hPA, hG] at hc
  have hcoeff := congrArg (coeff · (k + 1)) hc
  simp only [coeff_add, coeff_zero] at hcoeff
  -- the quadratic term vanishes at degree `k + 1`
  have hsq : (c * (X ^ (k + 1) * R) ^ 2).coeff (k + 1) = 0 := by
    rw [show c * (X ^ (k + 1) * R) ^ 2 = X ^ (k + 1 + (k + 1)) * (c * R ^ 2) by ring,
      coeff_X_pow_mul', ite_eq_right]
    omega
  -- the linear term
  have hlin := coeff_derivative_eval_mul_X_pow_mul Q hA (hAP 0 (Nat.zero_le _)) hPA
  -- the constant term, from values
  have hconst : (G.eval A).coeff (k + 1) =
      ∑ s, coeffWeight (k + 1) s * Q.evalEval (s + τ) (A.eval s) := by
    change (shiftEval Q τ A).coeff (k + 1) = _
    rw [← sum_coeffWeight_mul_eval
      ((natDegree_shiftEval_le hQ τ (hA.trans hk.le)).trans_lt hD)]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun s _ => by rw [eval_shiftEval]
  rw [hsq, hlin, hconst, zero_add] at hcoeff
  have hS : ∑ s, coeffWeight (k + 1) s * Q.evalEval (s + τ) (A.eval s) =
      -(lam * (taylor τ P).coeff (k + 1)) := by linear_combination hcoeff
  rw [henselCoeff, hS, neg_neg, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hlam]

theorem henselValue_eq {d D : ℕ} {Q : F[X][Y]}
    (hQ : Sudan.WeightedDegreeLE d D Q) (hD : D < Fintype.card F)
    {P : F[X]} (hP : P.natDegree ≤ d) (hQP : Q.eval P = 0) {τ : F}
    (hlam : (derivative Q).evalEval τ (P.eval τ) ≠ 0) :
    henselValue Q τ (P.eval τ) d = P.eval 0 := by
  set lam := (derivative Q).evalEval τ (P.eval τ)
  have key : ∀ k ≤ d, (henselTrunc Q τ (P.eval τ) lam k).natDegree ≤ k ∧
      ∀ i ≤ k, (henselTrunc Q τ (P.eval τ) lam k).coeff i = (taylor τ P).coeff i := by
    intro k hk
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨by simp [henselTrunc], fun i hi => ?_⟩
      rw [Nat.le_zero.1 hi, henselTrunc, coeff_C_zero, taylor_coeff_zero]
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨hdeg, hcoeff⟩ := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hk)
      have hstep := henselCoeff_eq hQ hD hQP hlam (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hk) hdeg hcoeff
      refine ⟨?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
      · rw [henselTrunc]
        refine natDegree_add_le_of_degree_le (hdeg.trans (Nat.le_succ k)) ?_
        exact natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _
      · rw [henselTrunc, coeff_add, coeff_C_mul_X_pow, hstep]
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi) with hi | rfl
        · rw [ite_eq_right (by omega), add_zero, hcoeff i (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 hi)]
        · rw [ite_eq_left rfl, coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega), zero_add]
  obtain ⟨hdeg, hcoeff⟩ := key d le_rfl
  have heq : henselTrunc Q τ (P.eval τ) lam d = taylor τ P := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i ≤ d
    · exact hcoeff i hi
    · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega), coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
        (by rw [natDegree_taylor]; omega)]
  rw [henselValue, heq, taylor_eval, neg_add_cancel]

private theorem card_mul_sq_le {κ : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (L : Finset κ)
    (B : κ → Finset ι) {a t : ℕ} (hB : ∀ c ∈ L, #(B c) = a)
    (hinter : ∀ c ∈ L, ∀ c' ∈ L, c ≠ c' → #(B c ∩ B c') ≤ t) :
    #L * a ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι * (a + (#L - 1) * t) := by
  classical
  -- `m i` codewords agree with the word at the coordinate `i`
  let m : ι → ℕ := fun i => #{c ∈ L | i ∈ B c}
  have hsum : ∑ i, m i = #L * a := by
    simp only [m, card_filter]
    rw [sum_comm]
    simp only [← card_filter, filter_mem_eq_inter, univ_inter]
    rw [sum_congr rfl hB, sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
  have hsq : ∑ i, m i ^ 2 = ∑ c ∈ L, ∑ c' ∈ L, #(B c ∩ B c') := by
    simp only [m, card_filter, sq, sum_mul_sum]
    rw [sum_comm]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    rw [sum_comm]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun c' _ => ?_
    simp only [ite_zero_mul_ite_zero, mul_one, ← card_filter]
    congr 1
    ext i
    simp
  have hrow : ∀ c ∈ L, ∑ c' ∈ L, #(B c ∩ B c') ≤ a + (#L - 1) * t := by
    intro c hc
    rw [← add_sum_erase L _ hc, inter_self, hB c hc]
    gcongr
    calc ∑ c' ∈ L.erase c, #(B c ∩ B c') ≤ ∑ _c' ∈ L.erase c, t :=
          sum_le_sum fun c' hc' => hinter c hc c' (mem_of_mem_erase hc') (ne_of_mem_erase hc').symm
      _ = (#L - 1) * t := by rw [sum_const, card_erase_of_mem hc, smul_eq_mul]
  have hcs := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := (univ : Finset ι)) (f := m)
  rw [hsum, hsq, card_univ] at hcs
  rcases L.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hL
  · simp
  have hL0 : 0 < #L := hL.card_pos
  have : (#L * a) ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι * (#L * (a + (#L - 1) * t)) :=
    hcs.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ((sum_le_sum hrow).trans_eq (by rw [sum_const, smul_eq_mul])))
  rw [mul_pow, sq (#L), mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm (Fintype.card ι) (#L)] at this
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left this hL0

and says nothing otherwise. -/

theorem card_filter_hammingDist_le_mul_le {C : Finset (ι → α)} {d : ℕ}
    (hd : (d : ℕ∞) ≤ minDist (C : Set (ι → α))) (w : ι → α) (e : ℕ) :
    #{c ∈ C | hammingDist c w ≤ e} *
        ((Fintype.card ι - e) ^ 2 - Fintype.card ι * (Fintype.card ι - d)) ≤
      Fintype.card ι * (d - e) := by
  classical
  set n := Fintype.card ι
  set L : Finset (ι → α) := {c ∈ C | hammingDist c w ≤ e}
  -- each codeword in the ball agrees with `w` on a set `B c` of exactly `n - e` coordinates
  have hagree : ∀ c ∈ L, n - e ≤ #({i | c i = w i} : Finset ι) := by
    intro c hc
    have h1 := card_filter_eq_add_hammingDist c w
    have h2 := (mem_filter.1 hc).2
    omega
  choose! B hBsub hBcard using fun c hc => exists_subset_card_eq (hagree c hc)
  -- two distinct codewords agree on at most `n - d` coordinates
  have hinter : ∀ c ∈ L, ∀ c' ∈ L, c ≠ c' → #(B c ∩ B c') ≤ n - d := by
    intro c hc c' hc' hne
    have hsub : B c ∩ B c' ⊆ ({i | c i = c' i} : Finset ι) := by
      intro i hi
      have h1 := (mem_filter.1 (hBsub c hc (mem_inter.1 hi).1)).2
      have h2 := (mem_filter.1 (hBsub c' hc' (mem_inter.1 hi).2)).2
      exact mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ i, h1.trans h2.symm⟩
    have h1 := card_filter_eq_add_hammingDist c c'
    have h2 := Nat.cast_le.1 (le_minDist_iff.1 hd c (mem_filter.1 hc).1 c' (mem_filter.1 hc').1 hne)
    have := card_le_card hsub
    omega
  have key := card_mul_sq_le L B hBcard hinter
  -- arithmetic, with `a = n - e` and `t = n - d`
  have hmain : #L * ((n - e) ^ 2 - n * (n - d)) ≤ n * ((n - e) - (n - d)) := by
    rcases le_or_gt ((n - e) ^ 2) (n * (n - d)) with h | h
    · rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le h, mul_zero]
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos #L with hL | hL
    · rw [hL, zero_mul]
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    have ht : n - d ≤ n := Nat.sub_le _ _
    have hat : n - d ≤ n - e := by
      by_contra hlt
      have : (n - e) ^ 2 ≤ (n - d) * (n - d) := by
        rw [sq]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
      exact absurd h (not_lt.2 (this.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ht)))
    zify [h.le, hat, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hL.ne'] at key ⊢
    nlinarith
  exact hmain.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega))

`e < n - √(n * (n - d))`, a Hamming ball of radius `e` contains at most `n * (d - e)` codewords of a
code of length `n` and minimum distance at least `d`, whatever the alphabet. -/

theorem le_minDist_justesenCode (φ : F ≃+ BitString b) (K r : ℕ) :
    (((Fintype.card F - K - ∑ j ∈ range (r + 1), (2 * b).choose j) * (r + 1) : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤
      minDist (justesenCode φ K) := by
  classical
  refine le_minDist_iff.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ _ ⟨c', hc', rfl⟩ hne
  have hcc' : c ≠ c' := fun h => hne (h ▸ rfl)
  -- the outer codewords differ at `#S ≥ q - K` positions
  let S : Finset Fˣ := {u | c u ≠ c' u}
  have hS : Fintype.card F - K ≤ #S := by
    have h := le_minDist_iff.1 (le_minDist_reedSolomon (F := F) Units.val_injective K) c hc c' hc'
      hcc'
    rw [Nat.cast_le, Fintype.card_units] at h
    change _ ≤ hammingDist c c'
    omega
  -- where the inner blocks differ by the encodings of the nonzero differences
  let g : Fˣ → Fin 2 × Fin b → Bool := fun u => wozencraft φ u (c' u - c u)
  have hg : Set.InjOn g S := by
    intro u hu u' _ h
    have hu : c' u - c u ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 fun h' => (mem_filter.1 hu).2 h'.symm
    exact Units.val_injective (wozencraft_inj φ hu h).1
  have hball : #{x : Fin 2 × Fin b → Bool | hammingNorm x ≤ r} =
      ∑ j ∈ range (r + 1), (2 * b).choose j := by
    simp only [← BitString.weight_eq_hammingNorm, BitString.card_filter_weight_le,
      Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hweight := sub_card_mul_le_sum_hammingNorm hg r
  rw [hball] at hweight
  refine Nat.cast_le.2 ((Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hS _)).trans
    (hweight.trans ?_))
  rw [justesen, justesen, hammingDist_concat]
  calc ∑ u ∈ S, hammingNorm (g u) ≤ ∑ u, hammingNorm (g u) := sum_le_sum_of_subset (subset_univ _)
    _ = ∑ u : Fˣ, hammingDist (wozencraft φ (u : F) (c u)) (wozencraft φ (u : F) (c' u)) := by

          xu.2 ≠ 0 ∧ (lineAgree {y | g y = p y} xu.1 xu.2 : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ)} +
        Fintype.card F ^ m * (#(normDirs m F) * (D - d)) := by
  set A : Finset (Fin m → F) := {y | g y = p y}
  have hswap : (∑ z : Fin m → F, #{x | lineListDecode g d D z (p z) x ≠ p x}) =
      ∑ x : Fin m → F, #{z | lineListDecode g d D z (p z) x ≠ p x} := by
    simp only [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter]; exact sum_comm
  have hpt (x : Fin m → F) : #{z | lineListDecode g d D z (p z) x ≠ p x} ≤
      1 + #{u : Fin m → F | u ≠ 0 ∧ (lineAgree A x u : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ)} +
        #(normDirs m F) * (D - d) := by
    have hsub : ({z | lineListDecode g d D z (p z) x ≠ p x} : Finset _) ⊆
        ({x} : Finset _) ∪ ({z | z ≠ x ∧ lineAgree A x (z - x) ≤ D} : Finset _) ∪
          ({z | z ≠ x ∧ D < lineAgree A x (z - x) ∧
            lineListDecode g d D z (p z) x ≠ p x} : Finset _) := by
      intro z hz
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_union, mem_singleton] at hz ⊢
      by_cases hzx : z = x; · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hzx)
      by_cases hlow : lineAgree A x (z - x) ≤ D; · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨hzx, hlow⟩)
      exact Or.inr ⟨hzx, not_le.1 hlow, hz⟩
    have hshift : #{z | z ≠ x ∧ lineAgree A x (z - x) ≤ D} =
        #{u : Fin m → F | u ≠ 0 ∧ (lineAgree A x u : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ)} := by
      simp only [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter]
      exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.subRight x) _ _ fun z => by
        simp [Equiv.subRight_apply, sub_ne_zero]
    calc #{z | lineListDecode g d D z (p z) x ≠ p x}
        ≤ #({x} : Finset _) + #{z | z ≠ x ∧ lineAgree A x (z - x) ≤ D} +
            #{z | z ≠ x ∧ D < lineAgree A x (z - x) ∧ lineListDecode g d D z (p z) x ≠ p x} :=
          (card_le_card hsub).trans
            ((card_union_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (card_union_le _ _) _))
      _ ≤ 1 + #{u : Fin m → F | u ≠ 0 ∧ (lineAgree A x u : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ)} +
            #(normDirs m F) * (D - d) := by
          rw [card_singleton, hshift]
          exact Nat.add_le_add_left
            (card_filter_lineListDecode_ne_of_lt_lineAgree_le hd hn hDq hp g x) _
  have hS₂ : (∑ x : Fin m → F, #{u : Fin m → F | u ≠ 0 ∧ (lineAgree A x u : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ)}) =
      #{xu : (Fin m → F) × (Fin m → F) | xu.2 ≠ 0 ∧ (lineAgree A xu.1 xu.2 : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ)} := by
    simp only [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rw [hswap]; refine (sum_le_sum fun x _ => hpt x).trans ?_
  simp only [sum_add_distrib, sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_one, hS₂, le_rfl]

theorem lowDegreeExtension_mem_reedMuller (h : H ↪ F) (f : (Fin m → H) → F) :
    lowDegreeExtension h f ∈ reedMuller F m (m * (Fintype.card H - 1)) := by
  classical
  let L : H → Polynomial F := fun a => Lagrange.basis univ h a
  have hL : ∀ a, (L a).natDegree = Fintype.card H - 1 := fun a => by
    rw [Lagrange.natDegree_basis h.injective.injOn (mem_univ a), card_univ]
  -- a univariate polynomial in the variable `i` has total degree at most its degree
  have hdeg : ∀ (i : Fin m) (p : Polynomial F), (p.toMvPolynomial i).totalDegree ≤ p.natDegree := by
    intro i p
    conv_lhs => rw [p.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow]
    rw [map_sum]
    refine MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetSum_le fun k hk => ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.toMvPolynomial_C, Polynomial.toMvPolynomial_X]
    calc (MvPolynomial.C (p.coeff k) * MvPolynomial.X i ^ k : MvPolynomial (Fin m) F).totalDegree
        ≤ (MvPolynomial.C (p.coeff k) : MvPolynomial (Fin m) F).totalDegree +
            (MvPolynomial.X i ^ k : MvPolynomial (Fin m) F).totalDegree :=
          MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _
      _ = k := by rw [MvPolynomial.totalDegree_C, MvPolynomial.totalDegree_X_pow, zero_add]
      _ ≤ p.natDegree := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hk)
  let P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) F := ∑ u : Fin m → H,
    MvPolynomial.C (f u) * ∏ i, (L (u i)).toMvPolynomial i
  refine mem_reedMuller.2 ⟨P, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetSum_le fun u _ => ?_
    refine (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _).trans ?_
    rw [MvPolynomial.totalDegree_C (σ := Fin m) (f u), zero_add]
    refine (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetProd _ _).trans ?_
    calc ∑ i, ((L (u i)).toMvPolynomial i).totalDegree ≤ ∑ _i : Fin m, (Fintype.card H - 1) :=
          sum_le_sum fun i _ => (hdeg i _).trans (hL _).le
      _ = m * (Fintype.card H - 1) := by rw [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
  · funext x
    simp only [P, lowDegreeExtension, map_sum, map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_C, map_prod,
      MvPolynomial.eval_toMvPolynomial, L]

theorem exists_isMultilinear_hammingDist_le_of_slices (f : (Fin (n + 1) → F) → F) {t₁ t₂ : F}
    (h12 : t₁ ≠ t₂) {g₁ g₂ : (Fin n → F) → F} (hg₁ : IsMultilinear g₁) (hg₂ : IsMultilinear g₂) :
    ∃ g, IsMultilinear g ∧ hammingDist f g ≤ #(wrongPoints f 0) +
      Fintype.card F * (hammingDist (fun y => f (Fin.cons t₁ y)) g₁ +
        hammingDist (fun y => f (Fin.cons t₂ y)) g₂) := by
  have hd : t₂ - t₁ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h12.symm
  -- The interpolation of `g₁` and `g₂` in the first coordinate.
  let g : (Fin (n + 1) → F) → F := fun x =>
    g₁ (Fin.tail x) + (x 0 - t₁) / (t₂ - t₁) * (g₂ (Fin.tail x) - g₁ (Fin.tail x))
  have hg0 (x : Fin (n + 1) → F) : lineRestrict g x 0 = fun t =>
      g₁ (Fin.tail x) + (t - t₁) / (t₂ - t₁) * (g₂ (Fin.tail x) - g₁ (Fin.tail x)) := by
    funext t
    simp only [g, lineRestrict, Fin.tail_update_zero, update_self]
  have hg : IsMultilinear g := by
    intro x i
    induction i using Fin.cases with
    | zero =>
      rw [hg0]
      exact ⟨(g₂ (Fin.tail x) - g₁ (Fin.tail x)) / (t₂ - t₁),
        g₁ (Fin.tail x) - t₁ * ((g₂ (Fin.tail x) - g₁ (Fin.tail x)) / (t₂ - t₁)),
        fun t => by ring⟩
    | succ j =>
      have : lineRestrict g x j.succ = fun t => lineRestrict g₁ (Fin.tail x) j t +
          (x 0 - t₁) / (t₂ - t₁) *
            (lineRestrict g₂ (Fin.tail x) j t - lineRestrict g₁ (Fin.tail x) j t) := by
        funext t
        simp only [g, lineRestrict, Fin.tail_update_succ,
          update_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm]
      rw [this]
      exact (hg₁ _ j).add (((hg₂ _ j).sub (hg₁ _ j)).const_mul _)
  refine ⟨g, hg, ?_⟩
  -- Every point where `f` and `g` differ is wrong in direction `0`, or lies over a point where
  -- one of the two slices differs from its approximation.
  let bad (t : F) (h : (Fin n → F) → F) : Finset (Fin (n + 1) → F) :=
    {x | f (Fin.cons t (Fin.tail x)) ≠ h (Fin.tail x)}
  have hsub : ({x | f x ≠ g x} : Finset (Fin (n + 1) → F)) ⊆
      wrongPoints f 0 ∪ (bad t₁ g₁ ∪ bad t₂ g₂) := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [wrongPoints, bad, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_union] at hx ⊢
    by_contra! hc
    obtain ⟨haff, h1, h2⟩ := hc
    have hcons (t : F) : update x 0 t = Fin.cons t (Fin.tail x) := by
      rw [← Fin.update_cons_zero (x 0) (Fin.tail x) t, Fin.cons_self_tail]
    have hline := haff.eq_of_eq_of_eq (hg x 0) h12
      (by rw [hg0]; simp only [lineRestrict, hcons, h1, sub_self, zero_div, zero_mul, add_zero])
      (by rw [hg0]; simp only [lineRestrict, hcons, h2, div_self hd, one_mul,
        add_sub_cancel])
    exact hx (by simpa using congrFun hline (x 0))
  have hcard (t : F) (h : (Fin n → F) → F) :
      #(bad t h) = Fintype.card F * hammingDist (fun y => f (Fin.cons t y)) h := by
    rw [card_filter_zero_tail (fun _ y => f (Fin.cons t y) ≠ h y), sum_const, card_univ,
      smul_eq_mul, hammingDist]
  calc hammingDist f g = #({x | f x ≠ g x} : Finset (Fin (n + 1) → F)) := rfl
    _ ≤ #(wrongPoints f 0) + (#(bad t₁ g₁) + #(bad t₂ g₂)) :=
      (card_le_card hsub).trans ((card_union_le _ _).trans
        (Nat.add_le_add_left (card_union_le _ _) _))
    _ = _ := by rw [hcard, hcard, mul_add]

/-- **Quantitative soundness of the multilinearity test**, with a constant exponential in the
dimension (an original bound): some multilinear `g` differs from `f` on at most
`∑ i, 2 ^ i * #(wrongPoints f i)` points of `F ^ n`. The proof interpolates multilinear
approximations of the two best slices `x 0 = t₁` and `x 0 = t₂` and inducts on the dimension.
This adapts the interpolation step in the proof of
[Babai, Fortnow, Lund, Lemma 5.11][BabaiFortnowLund1991], without their self-improvement lemma. -/

theorem exists_isMultilinear_hammingDist_le (f : (Fin n → F) → F) :
    ∃ g, IsMultilinear g ∧ hammingDist f g ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, 2 ^ (i : ℕ) * #(wrongPoints f i) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨f, fun _ i => i.elim0, by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    choose gs hgs hdist using fun t : F => ih fun y => f (Fin.cons t y)
    obtain ⟨t₁, t₂, h12, hD⟩ :=
      exists_two_mul_le_sum fun t => hammingDist (fun y => f (Fin.cons t y)) (gs t)
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hfg⟩ := exists_isMultilinear_hammingDist_le_of_slices f h12 (hgs t₁) (hgs t₂)
    refine ⟨g, hg, ?_⟩
    calc hammingDist f g ≤ #(wrongPoints f 0) +
          2 * ∑ t, hammingDist (fun y => f (Fin.cons t y)) (gs t) :=
        hfg.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left hD _)
      _ ≤ #(wrongPoints f 0) + 2 * ∑ t, ∑ j : Fin n,
            2 ^ (j : ℕ) * #(wrongPoints (fun y => f (Fin.cons t y)) j) :=
        Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (sum_le_sum fun t _ => hdist t)) _
      _ = ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), 2 ^ (i : ℕ) * #(wrongPoints f i) := by
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, sum_comm, mul_sum]
        simp only [card_wrongPoints_succ, mul_sum, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul,
          Fin.val_succ, pow_succ]
        congr 1
        refine sum_congr rfl fun j _ => sum_congr rfl fun t _ => by ring

/-- **Quantitative soundness of the multilinearity test**, as a probability: some multilinear `g`
is within relative distance `n * 2 ^ (n - 1) * ρ` of `f`, where `ρ` is the rejection probability
of the test. The constant is exponential in the dimension; the polynomial bound of
[Babai, Fortnow, Lund, Theorem 5.13][BabaiFortnowLund1991] is
`Cslib.Code.exists_isMultilinear_hammingDist_lt`. -/

theorem IsMultilinear.hammingDist_le_of_two_mul_le {f g : (Fin n → F) → F} (hg : IsMultilinear g)
    (h : 2 * hammingDist f g ≤ Fintype.card F ^ n) :
    hammingDist f g ≤
      (2 * n + 1) * ∑ i, #(wrongPoints f i) + 2 * n ^ 2 * Fintype.card F ^ (n - 1) := by
  let B : Finset (Fin n → F) := {x | f x ≠ g x}
  let W : Finset (Fin n → F) := univ.biUnion (wrongPoints f)
  let I : Finset (Fin n → F) := univ.biUnion (agreePoints f g)
  let S : Finset (Fin n → F) := B \ W
  have hB : #B = hammingDist f g := rfl
  -- A point outside `S` on a line through a point of `S` is wrong or an agreement point.
  have hcl : lineClosure S \ S ⊆ W ∪ I := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_lineClosure] at hy
    obtain ⟨⟨i, t, hs⟩, hyS⟩ := hy
    simp only [S, B, W, mem_sdiff, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_biUnion,
      not_exists] at hs hyS
    simp only [W, I, mem_union, mem_biUnion, mem_univ, true_and]
    by_cases hyW : ∃ j, y ∈ wrongPoints f j
    · exact Or.inl hyW
    right
    push Not at hyW
    have hfy : f y = g y := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hyS ⟨hne, hyW⟩
    have hcorr : IsAffineFun (lineRestrict f y i) := by
      have := hs.2 i
      simp only [wrongPoints, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, not_not] at this
      rwa [lineRestrict_update] at this
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    simp only [agreePoints, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    refine ⟨hcorr, fun heq => hs.1 ?_, hfy⟩
    have := congrFun heq t
    simpa [lineRestrict] using this
  have hexp : #S ≤ 2 * n * #(lineClosure S \ S) := by
    refine card_le_two_mul_card_lineClosure_sdiff ?_
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (card_le_card sdiff_subset)).trans (hB ▸ h)
  have hW : #W ≤ ∑ i, #(wrongPoints f i) := card_biUnion_le
  have hI : #I ≤ n * Fintype.card F ^ (n - 1) := by
    refine card_biUnion_le.trans ?_
    calc ∑ i, #(agreePoints f g i) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, Fintype.card F ^ (n - 1) :=
          sum_le_sum fun i _ => card_agreePoints_le hg i
      _ = n * Fintype.card F ^ (n - 1) := by simp
  have hBS : #B ≤ #S + #W := by
    refine (card_le_card ?_).trans (card_union_le S W)
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxW : x ∈ W
    · exact mem_union_right _ hxW
    · exact mem_union_left _ (mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hx, hxW⟩)
  have hcl' := (card_le_card hcl).trans (card_union_le W I)
  rw [← hB]
  calc #B ≤ 2 * n * (#W + #I) + #W := by nlinarith
    _ ≤ 2 * n * (∑ i, #(wrongPoints f i) + n * Fintype.card F ^ (n - 1)) +
          ∑ i, #(wrongPoints f i) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring
