theorem card_sub_mul_pow_le_mul_hammingNorm_of_mem_reedMuller {f : (Fin m → F) → F}
    (hf : f ∈ reedMuller F m d) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) :
    (Fintype.card F - d) * Fintype.card F ^ m ≤ Fintype.card F * hammingNorm f := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩ := mem_reedMuller.1 hf
  have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hf0 (funext fun _ => map_zero _)
  have hq : 0 < Fintype.card F := Fintype.card_pos
  -- at most a `d / q` fraction of the points are zeros
  have hsz := schwartz_zippel_totalDegree hP0 (univ : Finset F)
  rw [Fintype.piFinset_univ, card_univ, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)] at hsz
  have hzero : Fintype.card F * #{x | eval x P = 0} ≤ d * Fintype.card F ^ m := by
    have : (#{x | eval x P = 0} * Fintype.card F : ℚ≥0) ≤ d * Fintype.card F ^ m :=
      hsz.trans (by gcongr)
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact_mod_cast this
  -- the zeros and the nonzeros make up all `q ^ m` points
  have hsum : #{x | eval x P = 0} + hammingNorm (fun x => eval x P) = Fintype.card F ^ m := by
    rw [hammingNorm, card_filter_add_card_filter_not, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun,
      Fintype.card_fin]
  have hmul := congrArg (Fintype.card F * ·) hsum
  simp only [mul_add] at hmul
  rw [Nat.sub_mul]
  omega

/-- **Schwartz–Zippel distance.** Two distinct codewords of the Reed–Muller code of degree `d` in
`m` variables over a field with `q` elements differ on at least a `1 - d / q` fraction of the
`q ^ m` points: `(q - d) * q ^ m ≤ q * hammingDist f g`. -/

theorem minDist_reedMuller (hd : d < Fintype.card F) :
    minDist (reedMuller F (m + 1) d : Set ((Fin (m + 1) → F) → F)) =
      ((Fintype.card F - d) * Fintype.card F ^ m : ℕ) := by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ le_minDist_reedMuller
  -- the product of `X 0 - t` over `d` field elements `t`
  obtain ⟨T, -, hT⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq (s := (univ : Finset F)) (n := d)
    (by rw [card_univ]; omega)
  let P : MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 1)) F := ∏ t ∈ T, (X 0 - C t)
  have hP : P.totalDegree ≤ d := by
    refine (totalDegree_finsetProd _ _).trans ?_
    calc ∑ t ∈ T, (X 0 - C t : MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 1)) F).totalDegree
        ≤ ∑ _t ∈ T, 1 :=
          sum_le_sum fun t _ => (totalDegree_sub_C_le _ _).trans (totalDegree_X 0).le
      _ = d := by rw [sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, hT]
  -- it vanishes exactly where the first coordinate is in `T`
  have hne : ({x | eval x P ≠ 0} : Finset (Fin (m + 1) → F)) =
      Fintype.piFinset (Fin.cons (univ \ T) fun _ => univ : Fin (m + 1) → Finset F) := by
    ext x
    simp [P, Fintype.mem_piFinset, Fin.forall_fin_succ, prod_ne_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero]
  have hnorm : hammingNorm (fun x => eval x P) = (Fintype.card F - d) * Fintype.card F ^ m := by
    rw [hammingNorm, hne, Fintype.card_piFinset, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    simp [card_univ_sdiff, hT]
  have hP0 : (fun x => eval x P) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hammingNorm_pos_iff, hnorm]
    exact Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (pow_pos Fintype.card_pos _)
  calc minDist (reedMuller F (m + 1) d : Set ((Fin (m + 1) → F) → F))
      ≤ hammingDist (fun x => eval x P) 0 :=
        minDist_le_hammingDist (eval_mem_reedMuller hP) (Submodule.zero_mem _) hP0
    _ = ((Fintype.card F - d) * Fintype.card F ^ m : ℕ) := by
        rw [hammingDist_zero_right, hnorm]

theorem card_lagrangeDecode_ne_le (ν : Fin (d + 1) ↪ F) (hν : ∀ i, ν i ≠ 0)
    {p : (Fin m → F) → F} (hp : p ∈ reedMuller F m d) (w : (Fin m → F) → F) (x : Fin m → F) :
    #{v | lagrangeDecode ν w x v ≠ p x} ≤ (d + 1) * #{y | w y ≠ p y} := by
  set E : Finset (Fin m → F) := {y | w y ≠ p y}
  have hsub : ({v | lagrangeDecode ν w x v ≠ p x} : Finset (Fin m → F)) ⊆
      univ.biUnion fun i => univ.filter fun v => x + ν i • v ∈ E := by
    intro v hv
    rw [mem_filter] at hv
    by_contra hnot
    simp only [mem_biUnion, mem_univ, true_and, mem_filter, not_exists, E, ne_eq,
      not_not] at hnot
    refine hv.2 ((sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_).trans (lagrangeDecode_eq_of_mem_reedMuller ν hp x v))
    rw [hnot i]
  refine (card_le_card hsub).trans ((card_biUnion_le).trans ?_)
  calc ∑ i, #(univ.filter fun v => x + ν i • v ∈ E) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin (d + 1), #E :=
        sum_le_sum fun i _ => card_le_card_of_injOn (fun v => x + ν i • v)
          (fun v hv => by simpa using hv)
          (fun v _ v' _ h => smul_right_injective _ (hν i) (add_left_cancel h))
    _ = (d + 1) * #E := by rw [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]

theorem add_one_mul_add_two_le_two_mul_mul_card_monomials {w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (D : ℕ) :
    (D + 1) * (D + 2) ≤ 2 * w * #(monomials w D) := by
  -- the monomials of weighted degree `j`
  let fiber : ℕ → Finset (ℕ × ℕ) := fun j => {ab ∈ monomials w D | ab.1 + w * ab.2 = j}
  have hcard : #(monomials w D) = ∑ j ∈ range (D + 1), #(fiber j) :=
    card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise fun ab hab =>
      mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (mem_monomials.1 hab).2.2)
  have hfiber (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ range (D + 1)) : j / w + 1 ≤ #(fiber j) := by
    have hjD := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hj)
    calc j / w + 1 = #((range (j / w + 1)).image fun b => (j - w * b, b)) := by
          rw [card_image_of_injective _ fun b b' h => (Prod.ext_iff.1 h).2, card_range]
      _ ≤ #(fiber j) := by
          refine card_le_card fun ab hab => ?_
          obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hab
          have hb : w * b ≤ j :=
            (Nat.mul_le_mul_left w (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hb))).trans (Nat.mul_div_le j w)
          have hbj : b ≤ j := (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left b hw).trans hb
          refine mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_monomials.2 ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩ <;> dsimp only <;> omega
  calc (D + 1) * (D + 2) = ∑ j ∈ range (D + 1), 2 * (j + 1) := (sum_range_two_mul_add_one _).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (D + 1), 2 * w * #(fiber j) := by
        refine sum_le_sum fun j hj => ?_
        rw [mul_assoc]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 ((Nat.lt_mul_div_succ j hw).trans_le
          (Nat.mul_le_mul_left w (hfiber j hj)))
    _ = 2 * w * #(monomials w D) := by rw [← mul_sum, hcard]

private theorem kernelVecUpTo_ne_zero {α w : ι → F} {d D : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) {Q : F[X][Y]}
    (hQ : IsInterpolant α w d D Q) {j : ℕ} (hj : Q.natDegree ≤ j) :
    kernelVecUpTo α w d D j ≠ 0 := by
  have hsupp : ∀ a b, (Q.coeff b).coeff a ≠ 0 → (a, b) ∈ monomialsUpTo d D j := fun a b hab =>
    mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_monomials_of_isInterpolant hd hQ hab,
      (le_natDegree_of_ne_zero fun h => hab (by rw [h, coeff_zero])).trans hj⟩
  refine kernelVec_ne_zero _ ⟨fun m =>
    (Q.coeff ((monomialsUpTo d D j).equivFin.symm m : ℕ × ℕ).2).coeff
      ((monomialsUpTo d D j).equivFin.symm m : ℕ × ℕ).1, ?_, funext fun t => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, Q.coeff b ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      exact hQ.ne_zero (Polynomial.ext fun b => by rw [h b, coeff_zero])
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, (Q.coeff b).coeff a ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      exact hb (Polynomial.ext fun a => by rw [h a, coeff_zero])
    intro h0
    have := congrFun h0 ((monomialsUpTo d D j).equivFin ⟨(a, b), hsupp a b ha⟩)
    simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at this
    exact ha this
  · change interpMatrix α w (monomialsUpTo d D j) t ⬝ᵥ _ = 0
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (Fintype.equivFin ι).surjective t
    rw [interpMatrix_dotProduct, ← hQ.evalEval_eq_zero i]
    congr 1
    refine (bivariateOf_congr fun m hm => ?_).trans (eq_bivariateOf hsupp).symm
    simp only [coeffsOf, dite_eq_left hm, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

/-- If `(a₀, b₀)` maximizes the `(1, d)`-weighted degree of `S` and `b₀` is largest among those
maximizers, then `X ^ a₀ * Y ^ (b₀ + 1)` has a nonzero coefficient in `(Y - C P) * S`. -/
private theorem coeff_X_sub_C_mul_ne_zero {d a₀ b₀ : ℕ} {P : F[X]} (hP : P.natDegree ≤ d)
    {S : F[X][Y]} (ha₀ : (S.coeff b₀).coeff a₀ ≠ 0)
    (hle : ∀ a b, (S.coeff b).coeff a ≠ 0 → a + d * b ≤ a₀ + d * b₀)
    (hbmax : ∀ a b, (S.coeff b).coeff a ≠ 0 → a + d * b = a₀ + d * b₀ → b ≤ b₀) :
    (((Y - C P) * S).coeff (b₀ + 1)).coeff a₀ ≠ 0 := by
  rw [mul_comm, coeff_mul_X_sub_C, coeff_sub, mul_comm, coeff_mul]
  have hzero : ∑ x ∈ antidiagonal a₀, P.coeff x.1 * (S.coeff (b₀ + 1)).coeff x.2 = 0 := by
    refine sum_eq_zero fun ⟨i, j⟩ hij => ?_
    rw [mem_antidiagonal] at hij
    by_cases hPi : P.coeff i = 0
    · rw [hPi, zero_mul]
    by_cases hSj : (S.coeff (b₀ + 1)).coeff j = 0
    · rw [hSj, mul_zero]
    exfalso
    have hi : i ≤ d := (le_natDegree_of_ne_zero hPi).trans hP
    have hj := hle j (b₀ + 1) hSj
    have hjM : j + d * (b₀ + 1) = a₀ + d * b₀ := by nlinarith
    have := hbmax j (b₀ + 1) hSj hjM
    omega
  rw [hzero, sub_zero]
  exact ha₀

  have hmem : ∀ a b, (S.coeff b).coeff a ≠ 0 ↔ (a, b) ∈ supp := by
    intro a b
    simp only [supp, mem_biUnion, mem_image, mem_support_iff, Prod.mk.injEq]
    constructor
    · intro hab
      exact ⟨b, fun h => hab (by rw [h, coeff_zero]), a, hab, rfl, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨b', -, a', ha', rfl, rfl⟩
      exact ha'

  have hne : supp.Nonempty := ⟨(a, b), (hmem a b).1 hab⟩
  -- the largest weighted degree, and the largest `Y`-degree attaining it
  set M₀ := supp.sup' hne fun p => p.1 + d * p.2
  have hle : ∀ p ∈ supp, p.1 + d * p.2 ≤ M₀ := fun p hp => le_sup' (fun p => p.1 + d * p.2) hp
  have htop : (supp.filter fun p => p.1 + d * p.2 = M₀).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpeq⟩ := exists_mem_eq_sup' hne fun p => p.1 + d * p.2
    exact ⟨p, mem_filter.2 ⟨hp, hpeq.symm⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨a₀, b₀⟩, hp₀, hb₀⟩ := exists_mem_eq_sup' htop Prod.snd
  obtain ⟨hp₀, hM₀⟩ := mem_filter.1 hp₀
  have hbmax : ∀ p ∈ supp, p.1 + d * p.2 = M₀ → p.2 ≤ b₀ := fun p hp hpM => by
    rw [show b₀ = (a₀, b₀).2 from rfl, ← hb₀]
    exact le_sup' Prod.snd (mem_filter.2 ⟨hp, hpM⟩)
  simp only at hM₀

    (fun a' b' hab' => hM₀ ▸ hle (a', b') ((hmem a' b').1 hab'))

theorem Fin.exists_ne_apply_eq_iff_adjacent {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α] {count : ℕ}
    (f : Fin count → α) (ordered : Monotone f) (i : Fin count) :
    (∃ j, j ≠ i ∧ f j = f i) ↔
      ((∃ positive : 0 < i.val, f ⟨i.val - 1, by lia⟩ = f i) ∨
        (∃ fits : i.val + 1 < count, f ⟨i.val + 1, fits⟩ = f i)) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, different, same⟩
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne different with before | after
    · refine Or.inl ⟨by lia, ?_⟩
      exact (ordered.eq_of_ge_of_le same (by change j.val ≤ i.val - 1; lia)
        (by change i.val - 1 ≤ i.val; lia)).trans same
    · have fits : i.val + 1 < count := (Nat.succ_le_of_lt after).trans_lt j.isLt
      exact Or.inr ⟨fits, ordered.eq_of_ge_of_le same.symm
        (by change i.val ≤ i.val + 1; lia) (by exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt after)⟩
  · rintro (⟨positive, same⟩ | ⟨fits, same⟩)
    · refine ⟨⟨i.val - 1, by lia⟩, ?_, same⟩
      intro equal
      have := congrArg Fin.val equal
      dsimp only at this
      lia
    · refine ⟨⟨i.val + 1, fits⟩, ?_, same⟩
      intro equal
      have := congrArg Fin.val equal
      dsimp only at this
      lia

theorem expect_add_sq_le {X Y : ι → 𝕜} {a b α β A : 𝕜} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hα : 0 ≤ α)

  have hXY : 𝔼 i, X i * Y i ≤ α * β * A := by
    refine (le_abs_self _).trans (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq ?_ (by positivity))
    calc (𝔼 i, X i * Y i) ^ 2 ≤ (𝔼 i, X i ^ 2) * 𝔼 i, Y i ^ 2 := expect_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _
      _ ≤ (α ^ 2 * A) * (β ^ 2 * A) :=

      _ = (α * β * A) ^ 2 := by ring

    _ = (a * α + b * β) ^ 2 * A := by ring

  obtain ⟨hps, hlo⟩ := mem_filter.mp hp

theorem IsTotallyRegular.eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero [Fintype n] [NoZeroDivisors R]
    (hA : A.IsTotallyRegular) {rows : Finset m} {cols : Finset n} (hcard : cols.card ≤ rows.card)
    {v : n → R} (hv : ∀ j ∉ cols, v j = 0) (hAv : ∀ i ∈ rows, (A *ᵥ v) i = 0) : v = 0 := by
  classical
  -- Pair the columns with some of the rows.
  obtain ⟨r⟩ : Nonempty (cols ↪ rows) :=
    Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le (by simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using hcard)
  let f : cols → m := fun j => r j
  let g : cols → n := Subtype.val
  have hf : f.Injective := Subtype.val_injective.comp r.injective
  -- On the rows `f`, the vector `A v` is the submatrix on `f` and `g` applied to `v ∘ g`.
  have hzero : A.submatrix f g *ᵥ (v ∘ g) = 0 := by
    funext j
    rw [Pi.zero_apply, ← hAv _ (r j).2]
    simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, submatrix_apply, Function.comp_apply, g]
    rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort cols fun j' => A (f j) j' * v j']
    exact Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ cols) fun j' _ hj' => by simp [hv j' hj']
  have hvc := Matrix.eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero
    ((isTotallyRegular_iff_fintype A).1 hA cols f g hf Subtype.val_injective) hzero
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j ∈ cols
  · simpa using congrFun hvc ⟨j, hj⟩
  · exact hv j hj

  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι

  suffices h : ∀ S : Finset ι, μ (w S) ≤ t ∨ ∃ w, t < μ w ∧ μ w ≤ t + B by
    refine (h Finset.univ).resolve_left fun hle => ?_
    have : w Finset.univ = v := funext fun i => by simp [w]
    exact absurd (this ▸ hle) (not_le.2 hv)
  intro S
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact Or.inl (by simpa [w] using hu)
  | @insert i S hi ih =>
    have e : w (insert i S) = Function.update (w S) i (v i) := funext fun j => by
      by_cases hj : j = i

      · exact Or.inl hnext

  have hprim : 0 < (primorial L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast primorial_pos L
  -- Chebyshev's bounds `θ (4 L) ≥ 4 L log 2 - log (4 L + 1) - 2 √(4 L) log (4 L)`, `θ L ≤ L log 4`

theorem radix_affine_carries_iff {B d b c₀ : ℕ} (hB : 1 < B) (hb : b ≤ B)
    (hc₀ : c₀ ≤ B) (x y z : Fin d → ℕ)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i < B) (hy : ∀ i, y i < B) (hz : ∀ i, z i < B) :
    (∃ c : Fin (d + 1) → ℕ, c 0 = c₀ ∧ c (Fin.last d) = 0 ∧
      (∀ i, c i ≤ B) ∧ ∀ i : Fin d,
        x i * b + y i + c i.castSucc = z i + B * c i.succ) ↔
      b * ofDigits B (List.ofFn x) + ofDigits B (List.ofFn y) + c₀ =
        ofDigits B (List.ofFn z) := by
  induction d generalizing c₀ with
  | zero =>
    simp only [List.ofFn_zero, ofDigits_nil, mul_zero, zero_add]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc, he, _, _⟩
      exact hc.symm.trans he
    · intro hc
      subst c₀
      exact ⟨fun _ => 0, rfl, rfl, fun _ => by lia, fun i => i.elim0⟩
  | succ d ih =>
    rw [ofDigits_ofFn_succ, ofDigits_ofFn_succ, ofDigits_ofFn_succ]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc, he, hcb, hstep⟩
      have ht := (ih (hcb 1) (fun i => x i.succ) (fun i => y i.succ)
        (fun i => z i.succ) (fun i => hx i.succ) (fun i => hy i.succ)
        (fun i => hz i.succ)).mp
        ⟨fun i => c i.succ, rfl, he, fun i => hcb i.succ, fun i => hstep i.succ⟩
      have h0 := hstep 0
      simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, hc] at h0
      nlinarith [congrArg (B * ·) ht]
    · intro he
      let t := x 0 * b + y 0 + c₀
      obtain ⟨he0, he1⟩ := radix_carry_split (by lia : 0 < B) (hz 0)
        (show t + B * (b * ofDigits B (List.ofFn (fun i => x i.succ)) +
            ofDigits B (List.ofFn (fun i => y i.succ))) =
            z 0 + B * ofDigits B (List.ofFn (fun i => z i.succ)) by
          dsimp [t]
          nlinarith [he])
      have hc : t / B ≤ B := add_mul_add_div_le hB hb hc₀ (hx 0) (hy 0)
      obtain ⟨c, hc0, hce, hcb, hstep⟩ :=
        (ih hc (fun i => x i.succ) (fun i => y i.succ) (fun i => z i.succ)
          (fun i => hx i.succ) (fun i => hy i.succ) (fun i => hz i.succ)).mpr he1
      refine ⟨Fin.cons c₀ c, rfl, by simpa using hce, fun i => Fin.cases hc₀ hcb i, ?_⟩
      intro i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simpa only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one,
          Fin.cons_one, hc0] using he0
      · simpa only [← Fin.succ_castSucc, Fin.cons_succ] using hstep j

theorem isLinearized_subspacePoly {m : ℕ} (b : Fin m → F) : IsLinearized (subspacePoly b) := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    have : subspacePoly b = X := by simp [subspacePoly]
    rw [this, ← pow_one X, ← pow_zero 2]
    exact IsLinearized.X_pow_two_pow 0
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [← Fin.snoc_init_self b, subspacePoly_snoc]
    set P := subspacePoly (Fin.init b)
    have hP : IsLinearized P := ih _
    have hcomp : P.comp (X - C (b (Fin.last m))) = P + C (P.eval (-b (Fin.last m))) := by
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← C_neg, hP.comp_add, comp_X, comp_C]
    rw [hcomp, mul_add, ← pow_two, mul_comm]
    exact hP.sq.add (hP.C_mul _)

vanishes on the values of `P`, then `P ∘ Q = X ^ |F| - X`. -/

private theorem comp_eq_X_pow_card_sub_X [Fintype F] {P Q : F[X]}
    (hP : IsLinearized P) (hPm : P.Monic) (hQm : Q.Monic)
    (hPdeg : P.natDegree ≠ 0) (hdeg : Q.natDegree * P.natDegree = Fintype.card F)
    (hker : ∀ x, Q.eval (P.eval x) = 0) :
    P.comp Q = X ^ Fintype.card F - X := by
  have hq1 : 1 < Fintype.card F := Fintype.one_lt_card
  -- `Q ∘ P = X ^ q - X`
  have hQP : Q.comp P = X ^ Fintype.card F - X := by
    have hmon : IsMonicOfDegree (Q.comp P) (Fintype.card F) :=
      ⟨by rw [natDegree_comp, hdeg], hQm.comp hPm hPdeg⟩
    have hX : IsMonicOfDegree (X ^ Fintype.card F - X : F[X]) (Fintype.card F) := by
      rw [isMonicOfDegree_iff]
      refine ⟨(FiniteField.X_pow_card_sub_X_natDegree_eq F hq1).le, ?_⟩
      have h1 : (1 : ℕ) ≠ Fintype.card F := hq1.ne
      simp [coeff_X, h1]
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    refine eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero _ (f := id) Function.injective_id
      (fun x => by simp [eval_comp, hker x, FiniteField.pow_card])
      (hmon.natDegree_sub_lt hq1.ne_bot hX)
  -- hence `P ∘ Q = X ^ q - X`
  have h1 : (P.comp Q).comp P = (X ^ Fintype.card F - X : F[X]).comp P := by
    rw [comp_assoc, hQP, hP.comp_sub, ← expand_eq_comp_X_pow,
      FiniteField.Polynomial.expand_card, comp_X, sub_comp, X_pow_comp, X_comp]
  have h2 : (P.comp Q - (X ^ Fintype.card F - X)).comp P = 0 := by
    rw [sub_comp, h1, sub_self]
  rcases comp_eq_zero_iff.1 h2 with h | ⟨-, h⟩
  · exact sub_eq_zero.1 h
  · have := congrArg natDegree h
    rw [natDegree_C] at this
    exact absurd this hPdeg

/-- **Image-subspace polynomial** [BenSassonKopparty2012, Lemma 3.7]: every `𝔽₂`-subspace `W` of a
finite field `F` is the image of a monic linearized polynomial of degree
`2 ^ (dim F - dim W)`. -/

text:
theorem exists_isLinearized_range_eq [Finite F] (W : Submodule (ZMod 2) F) :
    ∃ Q : F[X], IsLinearized Q ∧ Q.Monic ∧
      Q.natDegree = 2 ^ (finrank (ZMod 2) F - finrank (ZMod 2) W) ∧
      ∀ y, y ∈ W ↔ ∃ x, Q.eval x = y := by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype F
  have hcard : Fintype.card F = 2 ^ finrank (ZMod 2) F := by
    rw [Module.card_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod 2) (V := F), ZMod.card]
  have hdn : finrank (ZMod 2) W ≤ finrank (ZMod 2) F := Submodule.finrank_le W
  -- the kernel-subspace polynomial `P` of `W`
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hPm, hPdeg, hkerP⟩ := exists_isLinearized_ker_eq W
  -- `Q` is the kernel-subspace polynomial of the image of `P`
  have hK' : finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range hP.toLinearMap) =
      finrank (ZMod 2) F - finrank (ZMod 2) W := by
    have := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker hP.toLinearMap
    rw [hkerP] at this
    omega
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQm, hQdeg₀, hkerQ⟩ := exists_isLinearized_ker_eq (LinearMap.range hP.toLinearMap)
  have hQdeg : Q.natDegree = 2 ^ (finrank (ZMod 2) F - finrank (ZMod 2) W) := hK' ▸ hQdeg₀
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, hQm, hQdeg, ?_⟩
  -- `P ∘ Q = X ^ q - X`
  have hPQ : P.comp Q = X ^ Fintype.card F - X :=
    comp_eq_X_pow_card_sub_X hP hPm hQm (hPdeg ▸ pow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero)
      (by rw [hQdeg, hPdeg, ← pow_add, hcard, Nat.sub_add_cancel hdn]) fun x => by
        have hx : P.eval x ∈ LinearMap.range hP.toLinearMap := ⟨x, rfl⟩
        rwa [← hkerQ, LinearMap.mem_ker, IsLinearized.toLinearMap_apply] at hx
  have hrange : ∀ x, Q.eval x ∈ W := fun x => by
    rw [← hkerP, LinearMap.mem_ker, IsLinearized.toLinearMap_apply, ← eval_comp, hPQ]
    simp [FiniteField.pow_card]
  -- the image of `Q` is all of `W`, by counting
  have hle : LinearMap.range hQ.toLinearMap ≤ W := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact hrange x
  have heq : LinearMap.range hQ.toLinearMap = W := by
    refine Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hle ?_
    have := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker hQ.toLinearMap
    rw [hkerQ] at this
    omega
  intro y
  refine ⟨fun hy => ?_, fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => hx ▸ hrange x⟩
  rw [← heq] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

/-- **Root bound for linearized functions**: if the coefficients of `b` vanish from position `m`
on and the function vanishes on at least `2 ^ m` points, then `b = 0`. -/
theorem eq_zero_of_linearizedEval_eq_zero {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {b : ZMod n → F} {m : ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ j, m ≤ j.val → b j = 0) (S : Finset F) (hS : 2 ^ m ≤ S.card)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ S, linearizedEval b x = 0) : b = 0 := by
  classical
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
  · funext j
    exact hb j (Nat.zero_le _)
  set p : F[X] := ∑ j, C (b j) * X ^ 2 ^ j.val with hp
  have heval : ∀ x, p.eval x = linearizedEval b x := fun x => by
    simp [hp, linearizedEval, eval_finsetSum]
  have hdeg : p.natDegree < S.card := by
    have : p.natDegree ≤ 2 ^ (m - 1) := by
      refine natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun j _ => ?_
      by_cases hj : b j = 0
      · simp [hj]
      · have : j.val < m := not_le.1 fun h => hj (hb j h)
        exact (natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos (by omega))
    calc p.natDegree ≤ 2 ^ (m - 1) := this
      _ < 2 ^ m := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ ≤ S.card := hS
  have hp0 : p = 0 := by
    refine eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero p (f := ((↑) : S → F))
      Subtype.val_injective (fun x => ?_) (by simpa using hdeg)
    rw [heval]
    exact h x x.2
  funext j
  have := congrArg (fun q => q.coeff (2 ^ j.val)) hp0
  simp only [hp, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_zero] at this
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j] at this
  · simpa using this
  · intro j' _ hj'
    rw [ite_eq_right_iff]
    intro h
    exact absurd (ZMod.val_injective _ (Nat.pow_right_injective le_rfl h).symm) hj'
  · simp

/-- If every element `y` of a subspace `W` satisfies `y ^ 2 ^ k = c * y` with `0 < k < n`, then
`W` embeds into the proper subfield fixed by the `k`-th power of Frobenius. -/

private theorem coeffPattern_gap [Finite F] {n s d : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hn : finrank (ZMod 2) F = n) (hs : ∀ K : Subfield F, K ≠ ⊤ → Nat.card K ≤ 2 ^ s)
    {W : Submodule (ZMod 2) F} (hd : finrank (ZMod 2) W = d) (hsW : s < d) {a : ZMod n → F}
    (hWa : ∀ y ∈ W, ∃ x, linearizedEval a x = y)
    (hlead : a ((n - d : ℕ) : ZMod n) = 1)
    (hcan : ∀ c, 1 ≤ c → c < d → a ((n - d + c : ℕ) : ZMod n) = 0)
    {S : Finset F} (hScard : 2 ^ (n - d) ≤ S.card)
    (hSzero : ∀ x ∈ S, linearizedEval a x = 0)
    (ρ : ℕ) (hρ1 : 1 ≤ ρ) (hρd : ρ + d ≤ n) :
    ∃ c < d - 1, a ((ρ + c : ℕ) : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := by
  by_contra hall
  push Not at hall
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ := linearizedEval_pow_eq_mul_of_gap hn hρ1 hρd hlead hcan hScard hSzero hall
  have hW' : ∀ y ∈ W, y ^ 2 ^ (n - d + 1 - ρ) = c₀ * y := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hWa y hy
    exact hc₀ x
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hcard⟩ := exists_subfield_card_le hn (by omega) (by omega) W c₀ hW'
  have hWcard : Nat.card W = 2 ^ d := by
    rw [Module.natCard_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod 2) (V := W), Nat.card_zmod, hd]
  have := (hWcard ▸ hcard).trans (hs K hK)
  exact absurd ((Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right (by norm_num)).1 this) (by omega)

theorem linearIndependent_prod_pow {ι σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] (e : ι → σ → ℕ)
    (he : Function.Injective e) (hlt : ∀ i j, e i j < Fintype.card K) :
    LinearIndependent K fun i (x : σ → K) => ∏ j, x j ^ e i j := by
  classical
  let d : ι → σ →₀ ℕ := fun i => Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm (e i)
  have hd : LinearIndependent K fun i => MvPolynomial.monomial (d i) (1 : K) :=
    (MvPolynomial.basisMonomials σ K).linearIndependent.comp d
      (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm.injective.comp he)
  have hspan : Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i => MvPolynomial.monomial (d i) (1 : K)) ≤
      MvPolynomial.restrictDegree σ K (Fintype.card K - 1) := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree]
    intro t ht j
    obtain rfl := Finset.mem_singleton.mp (MvPolynomial.support_monomial_subset ht)
    exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (hlt i j)
  -- Evaluation is injective on polynomials of degree below `Fintype.card K` in each variable.
  convert hd.map (f := MvPolynomial.evalₗ K σ) ?_ using 1
  · funext i x
    simp [d, MvPolynomial.eval_monomial, Finsupp.prod_fintype]
  · rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro p hp hker
    refine MvPolynomial.eq_zero_of_eval_zero_at_prod_finset p (fun _ => Finset.univ)
      (fun j => ?_) fun x _ => by simpa using congrFun (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hker) x
    rw [Finset.card_univ, MvPolynomial.degreeOf_lt_iff Fintype.card_pos]
    intro t ht
    exact ((MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree _ _ _).mp (hspan hp) t ht j).trans_lt
      (Nat.sub_lt Fintype.card_pos one_pos)

theorem card_subfield_le_of_lt_prime {n L : ℕ} (hn : finrank (ZMod 2) F = n)
    (hL : ∀ q, q.Prime → q ∣ n → L < q) (K : Subfield F) (hK : K ≠ ⊤) :
    Nat.card K ≤ 2 ^ (n / (L + 1)) := by
  cases nonempty_fintype F
  have : CharP K 2 := K.subtype.charP Subtype.val_injective 2
  have : Fintype K := Fintype.ofFinite K
  obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := FiniteField.card K 2
  have hF : Nat.card F = 2 ^ n := by
    rw [Module.natCard_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod 2) (V := F), Nat.card_zmod, hn]
  -- `|F| = |K| ^ e` with `e = [F : K] ≥ 2`, so `n = a e`
  have hFe : Nat.card F = Nat.card K ^ finrank K F := Module.natCard_eq_pow_finrank (K := K)
  rw [hF, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := K), ha, ← pow_mul] at hFe
  have hne : n = a * finrank K F := Nat.pow_right_injective le_rfl hFe
  have hsq := card_sq_le_of_ne_top hK
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := K), ha, hF, ← pow_mul] at hsq
  have he2 : 2 ≤ finrank K F := by
    have := (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right (by norm_num : 1 < 2)).1 hsq
    rw [hne] at this
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left this a.pos
  -- a prime factor `q` of `e` divides `n`, so `q > L` and `a ≤ n / q`
  have hq := Nat.minFac_prime (by omega : finrank K F ≠ 1)
  have hqL : L < (finrank K F).minFac :=
    hL _ hq ((Nat.minFac_dvd _).trans (hne ▸ dvd_mul_left _ _))
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := K), ha]
  refine Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos ((Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).2 ?_)
  calc a * (L + 1) ≤ a * finrank K F :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (hqL.trans_le (Nat.minFac_le (by omega)))
    _ = n := hne.symm

    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hyx : κ ≤ ⟪y, x⟫) (hzx : κ ≤ ⟪z, x⟫) :
    2 * κ ^ 2 - 1 ≤ ⟪y, z⟫ := by

  have hyx' : angle y x ≤ arccos κ := by
    rw [angle_eq_arccos_inner_of_norm_eq_one hy hx]
    exact arccos_le_arccos hyx
  have hxz' : angle x z ≤ arccos κ := by
    rw [angle_comm, angle_eq_arccos_inner_of_norm_eq_one hz hx]
    exact arccos_le_arccos hzx

theorem le_sum_offDiag_inner {x : V} (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) {s : Finset ι} {y : ι → V}
    (hy : ∀ i ∈ s, ‖y i‖ = 1) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hyx : ∀ i ∈ s, κ ≤ ⟪y i, x⟫) :
    (#s : ℝ) ^ 2 * κ ^ 2 - #s ≤ ∑ p ∈ s.offDiag, ⟪y p.1, y p.2⟫ := by
  have hlin : #s * κ ≤ ‖∑ i ∈ s, y i‖ :=
    calc #s * κ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ⟪y i, x⟫ := by simpa using card_nsmul_le_sum s _ κ hyx

  have hn : ∑ i ∈ s, ‖y i‖ ^ 2 = #s := by
    rw [sum_congr rfl fun i hi => by rw [hy i hi, one_pow], sum_const, nsmul_one]
  have hsq := norm_sum_sq_real s y
  rw [hn] at hsq

    have hs' : (#s : ℝ) * (#s - 1) = 0 := by

    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ #s := by exact_mod_cast hs

    rw [offDiag_card, Nat.cast_sub (Nat.le_mul_self _), Nat.cast_mul]

theorem infix_head_pair_getD {r : Route} (hn : r.Nodup) {a b : Point}
    (hp : [a, b] <:+: r) (hh : r.head? = some a) (d : Point) :
    2 ≤ r.length ∧ r.getD 1 d = b := by
  obtain ⟨tail, rfl⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.1 hh
  obtain ⟨start, hlen, hitems⟩ := List.infix_iff_getElem?.1 hp
  have hs : start < (a :: tail).length := by
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hlen ⊢
    omega
  have ha : (a :: tail)[start] = a := by
    have h := hitems 0 (by simp)
    change (a :: tail)[0 + start]? = some a at h
    simpa only [Nat.zero_add, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hs, Option.some.injEq] using h
  have hz : start = 0 := hn.getElem_inj_iff.1 (ha.trans (show (a :: tail)[0] = a from rfl).symm)
  subst start
  refine ⟨by simpa using hlen, ?_⟩
  have hb := hitems 1 (by simp)
  change (a :: tail)[1 + 0]? = some b at hb
  simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hb, Option.getD_some]

  have hs : start + 1 < (initial ++ [b]).length := by
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hlen
    omega
  have hb : (initial ++ [b])[start + 1] = b := by
    have h := hitems 1 (by simp)
    change (initial ++ [b])[1 + start]? = some b at h
    simpa only [Nat.add_comm 1 start, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hs, Option.some.injEq] using h
  have hl : initial.length < (initial ++ [b]).length := by simp
  have he : (initial ++ [b])[initial.length] = b := by simp
  have hz : start + 1 = initial.length := hn.getElem_inj_iff.1 (hb.trans he.symm)

theorem segmentWalk_straight {a b p : Point} (haxis : a.1 = b.1 ∨ a.2 = b.2)

  have hap : a.1 = p.1 ∨ a.2 = p.2 := by
    rcases haxis with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (by omega)
    · exact Or.inr (by omega)
  have hindex : 0 < length a p ∧ length a p < length a b := by
    rcases a with ⟨ax, ay⟩
    rcases b with ⟨bx, by'⟩
    rcases p with ⟨px, py⟩
    simp only [length, ne_eq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hpa hpb ⊢
    omega

    unfold direction
    simp only [ne_eq, Prod.ext_iff] at hpa hpb

theorem segmentWalk_infix_subdivide {r : Route} (hr : IsOrthogonal r) {e : Point × Point}
    (he : e ∈ r.consecutivePairs) : segmentWalk e.1 e.2 <:+: subdivide r := by
  induction r with
  | nil => simp [List.consecutivePairs] at he
  | cons a r ih =>
    cases r with
    | nil => simp [List.consecutivePairs] at he
    | cons b r =>
      have hab := (hr (a, b) (by simp [List.consecutivePairs])).1
      have htail : IsOrthogonal (b :: r) := by
        intro f hf
        exact hr f (by simpa only [List.consecutivePairs, List.tail_cons,
          List.zip_cons_cons, List.mem_cons] using Or.inr hf)
      have hpairs : (a :: b :: r).consecutivePairs = (a, b) :: (b :: r).consecutivePairs := rfl
      rw [hpairs, List.mem_cons] at he
      rcases he with rfl | he
      · rw [subdivide]
        exact List.infix_append_left
      · have ht := ih htail he
        have hj : subdivide (b :: r) <:+: subdivide (a :: b :: r) := by
          obtain ⟨initial, hwalk⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.1 (segmentWalk_last hab)
          obtain ⟨rest, hrest⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.1 (subdivide_head (b :: r))
          rw [subdivide, hwalk, hrest]
          exact ⟨initial, [], by simp⟩
        exact ht.trans hj

private theorem sq_sum_mul_le_card_mul_sum_sq [Fintype α] (P : Finset α) (g H : α → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ p, |g p| ≤ 1) :
    (∑ p ∈ P, g p * H p) ^ 2 ≤ #P * ∑ p, H p ^ 2 := by
  classical

  refine (Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq P g H).trans ?_
  have hg2 : ∑ p ∈ P, g p ^ 2 ≤ #P := by
    calc ∑ p ∈ P, g p ^ 2 ≤ ∑ _p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ => by
          have := hg p
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg (g p), sq_abs (g p)]
      _ = #P := by simp
  have hH2 : ∑ p ∈ P, H p ^ 2 ≤ ∑ p, H p ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (subset_univ P) fun p _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  have := Finset.sum_nonneg fun p (_ : p ∈ P) => sq_nonneg (H p)
  calc (∑ p ∈ P, g p ^ 2) * ∑ p ∈ P, H p ^ 2 ≤ #P * ∑ p ∈ P, H p ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hg2 this

    (B : Matrix α β (ZMod 2)) (P : Finset (α → ZMod 2))
    (Q : Finset (β → ZMod 2)) (g : (α → ZMod 2) → ℝ) (h : (β → ZMod 2) → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ p, |g p| ≤ 1) (hh : ∀ q, |h q| ≤ 1) :
    (∑ p ∈ P, ∑ q ∈ Q, g p * h q * (-1) ^ (p ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ q).val) ^ 2 * 2 ^ B.rank ≤
      #P * #Q * 2 ^ Fintype.card α * 2 ^ Fintype.card β := by
  classical
  set H : (α → ZMod 2) → ℝ := fun p => ∑ q ∈ Q, h q * (-1) ^ (p ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ q).val
  set K := #{z : β → ZMod 2 | B *ᵥ z = 0}
  have hsum : ∑ p ∈ P, ∑ q ∈ Q, g p * h q * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (p ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ q).val =
      ∑ p ∈ P, g p * H p := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
    simp only [H, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
  have hCS : (∑ p ∈ P, g p * H p) ^ 2 ≤ #P * ∑ p, H p ^ 2 :=
    sq_sum_mul_le_card_mul_sum_sq P g H hg
  -- Only pairs in a common fibre survive, and fibres have the size of the kernel.
  have hfibre : ∑ p, H p ^ 2 ≤ #Q * K * (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card α := by
    rw [sum_sq_sum_bilinear_eq B Q h]
    calc _ ≤ ∑ _q ∈ Q, K * (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card α :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun q _ => sum_fibre_row_le B Q h hh q
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
  have hK : (K : ℝ) * 2 ^ B.rank = 2 ^ Fintype.card β := by
    exact_mod_cast card_ker_mul_two_pow_rank B
  rw [hsum]
  have hpow : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ B.rank := by positivity
  calc (∑ p ∈ P, g p * H p) ^ 2 * 2 ^ B.rank
      ≤ #P * (#Q * K * (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card α) * 2 ^ B.rank := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCS.trans ?_) hpow
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfibre (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = #P * #Q * 2 ^ Fintype.card α * ((K : ℝ) * 2 ^ B.rank) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hK]

theorem exists_submatrixRobust_of_lt {t : ℕ} (ht : 3 * k < (t + 1) ^ 2) :
    ∃ R : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) (ZMod 2), R.SubmatrixRobust t := by
  classical
  let bad := (univ ×ˢ univ : Finset (Finset (Fin k) × Finset (Fin k))).biUnion
    fun p => deficientOn t p.1 p.2
  have hbad : #bad * 2 ^ ((t + 1) ^ 2) ≤ 2 ^ k * 2 ^ k * (2 ^ k * 2 ^ (k * k)) := by
    calc #bad * 2 ^ ((t + 1) ^ 2)
        ≤ (∑ p ∈ (univ ×ˢ univ : Finset (Finset (Fin k) × Finset (Fin k))),
            #(deficientOn t p.1 p.2)) * 2 ^ ((t + 1) ^ 2) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ card_biUnion_le
      _ = ∑ p ∈ (univ ×ˢ univ : Finset (Finset (Fin k) × Finset (Fin k))),
            #(deficientOn t p.1 p.2) * 2 ^ ((t + 1) ^ 2) := Finset.sum_mul ..
      _ ≤ ∑ _p ∈ (univ ×ˢ univ : Finset (Finset (Fin k) × Finset (Fin k))),
            2 ^ k * 2 ^ (k * k) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ => card_deficientOn_mul_le t p.1 p.2
      _ = 2 ^ k * 2 ^ k * (2 ^ k * 2 ^ (k * k)) := by
          rw [sum_const, smul_eq_mul, card_product, card_univ, Fintype.card_finset,
            Fintype.card_fin]
  have hlt : #bad < Fintype.card (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) (ZMod 2)) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_congr Matrix.of.symm, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fun, ZMod.card,
      Fintype.card_fin, ← pow_mul]
    by_contra hge
    push Not at hge
    have h1 : 2 ^ (k * k) * 2 ^ ((t + 1) ^ 2) ≤ 2 ^ k * 2 ^ k * (2 ^ k * 2 ^ (k * k)) :=
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hge).trans hbad
    have h2 : 2 ^ k * 2 ^ k * (2 ^ k * 2 ^ (k * k)) < 2 ^ (k * k) * 2 ^ ((t + 1) ^ 2) := by
      rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]
      exact Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    omega
  obtain ⟨R, -, hR⟩ := exists_mem_notMem_of_card_lt_card hlt
  refine ⟨R, fun S T hST => ?_⟩
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  apply hR
  refine mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨(S.toFinset, T.toFinset), mem_product.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, mem_univ _⟩, ?_⟩
  refine mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
    exact hST
  · simp only [Set.coe_toFinset]
    rw [← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
    exact hcon

private theorem finrank_lowerZero [FiniteDimensional K M] (V : Submodule K (Fin r → M)) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : m < r) :
    finrank K (lowerZero V m) =
      finrank K (pivotSpace V ⟨m, hm⟩) + finrank K (lowerZero V (m + 1)) := by
  let f : lowerZero V m →ₗ[K] M := (LinearMap.proj ⟨m, hm⟩).comp (lowerZero V m).subtype
  have hrange : LinearMap.range f = pivotSpace V ⟨m, hm⟩ := by
    ext y
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_range, mem_pivotSpace, f, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      Submodule.coe_subtype, LinearMap.coe_proj, Function.eval]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨v, (mem_lowerZero.1 hv).1, fun j hj => (mem_lowerZero.1 hv).2 j hj, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, hlow, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨v, mem_lowerZero.2 ⟨hv, fun j hj => hlow j hj⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  have hle : lowerZero V (m + 1) ≤ lowerZero V m := fun v hv =>
    mem_lowerZero.2 ⟨(mem_lowerZero.1 hv).1, fun j hj => (mem_lowerZero.1 hv).2 j (by omega)⟩
  have hker : LinearMap.ker f = (lowerZero V (m + 1)).comap (lowerZero V m).subtype := by
    ext ⟨v, hv⟩
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, f, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      Submodule.coe_subtype, LinearMap.coe_proj, Function.eval, Submodule.mem_comap,
      mem_lowerZero]
    constructor
    · intro h0
      refine ⟨(mem_lowerZero.1 hv).1, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hj with hj | hj
      · exact (mem_lowerZero.1 hv).2 j hj
      · rw [show j = ⟨m, hm⟩ from Fin.ext hj]
        exact h0
    · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
      exact h ⟨m, hm⟩ (Nat.lt_succ_self m)
  have := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker f
  rw [hrange, hker, (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe hle).finrank_eq] at this
  exact this.symm

theorem prime_of_le_of_gcd {n r : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hgcd : ∀ a, 1 ≤ a → a ≤ r → a.gcd n = 1 ∨ a.gcd n = n) (hnr : n ≤ r) : n.Prime := by

  · exact hq.one_lt.ne' (hg ▸ h)

theorem card_image_aeval_linProd [NeZero r] {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ r) (hB : B < p)
    {S : Finset (ZMod r)} (hSB : B < S.card)
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ m : ℕ, (m : ZMod r) = x ∧
      ∀ s : Sym (Fin (B + 1)) B, Introspective K r m (linProd p s)) :
    (univ.image fun s : Sym (Fin (B + 1)) B => aeval ζ (linProd p s)).card = B.centralBinom := by
  classical
  rw [card_image_of_injective _ ?inj, card_univ, Sym.card_sym_eq_choose, Fintype.card_fin,
    show B + 1 + B - 1 = 2 * B by omega, Nat.centralBinom_eq_two_mul_choose]
  intro s s' hss'
  simp only at hss'
  by_contra hne
  have hdiff : linProd p s - linProd p s' ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr fun h => hne
    (linProd_injective hB h)

    obtain ⟨m, rfl, hm⟩ := hS x hx
    rw [mem_roots hF, IsRoot, eval_map_algebraMap, map_sub, sub_eq_zero, ZMod.val_natCast,
      pow_eq_pow_of_modEq (Nat.mod_modEq m r) hζr, ← hm s ζ hζr, ← hm s' ζ hζr, hss']

    exact hζ.pow_inj (ZMod.val_lt x) (ZMod.val_lt y) hxy

theorem card_image_aeval_linProd_le {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ r) {m₁ m₂ : ℕ}

theorem prime_of_passes {n r : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hr : Real.logb 2 n ^ 2 < orderOf (n : ZMod r)) (h : Passes n r) : n.Prime := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hpow, hgcd, hcase⟩ := h
  rcases hcase with hnr | hcong
  · exact prime_of_le_of_gcd hn hgcd hnr
  by_contra hnp
  have hn4 : 4 ≤ n := by
    by_contra h4
    interval_cases n <;> exact hnp (by decide)
  -- Logarithms.
  have hlog2 : 2 ≤ Real.logb 2 n := by
    rw [Real.le_logb_iff_rpow_le one_lt_two (by positivity)]
    norm_num
    exact_mod_cast hn4
  have hord_pos : 0 < orderOf (n : ZMod r) := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < orderOf (n : ZMod r) := lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) hr
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hcop : n.Coprime r := coprime_of_orderOf_pos hord_pos
  have hr2 : 2 ≤ r := by
    rcases r with _ | _ | r
    · rw [Nat.coprime_zero_right] at hcop
      omega
    · have : orderOf (n : ZMod 1) = 1 := orderOf_eq_one_iff.mpr (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
      rw [this, Nat.cast_one] at hr
      nlinarith
    · omega
  have : NeZero r := ⟨by omega⟩
  -- The least prime factor `p` of `n` exceeds `r`.
  set p := n.minFac
  have hp : p.Prime := Nat.minFac_prime (by omega)
  have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hpn : p ∣ n := Nat.minFac_dvd n
  have hplt : p < n := (Nat.not_prime_iff_minFac_lt hn).mp hnp
  have hrp : r < p := by
    by_contra hle
    replace hle := not_lt.mp hle
    have hg : p.gcd n = p := Nat.gcd_eq_left hpn
    rcases hgcd p hp.one_lt.le hle with h | h
    · exact hp.one_lt.ne' (hg ▸ h)
    · exact hplt.ne (hg ▸ h)
  set q := n / p
  have hqp : q * p = n := Nat.div_mul_cancel hpn
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul] at hqp
    omega
  have hcopq : q.Coprime r := Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hpn) hcop
  have hcopp : p.Coprime r := Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left hpn hcop
  -- The residues of the introspective numbers `q^i p^j`.
  set S : Finset (ZMod r) := univ.filter fun x => ∃ i j : ℕ, x = ((q ^ i * p ^ j : ℕ) : ZMod r)
  set t := S.card
  have hord_t : orderOf (n : ZMod r) ≤ t := by
    have hsub : ((range (orderOf (n : ZMod r))).image fun i => (n : ZMod r) ^ i) ⊆ S := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
      simp only [S, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
      exact ⟨i, i, by rw [← hqp]; push_cast; ring⟩
    calc
      orderOf (n : ZMod r) =
          ((range (orderOf (n : ZMod r))).image fun i => (n : ZMod r) ^ i).card := by
        rw [card_image_of_injOn, card_range]
        intro i hi j hj hij
        exact pow_injOn_Iio_orderOf (by simpa using hi) (by simpa using hj) hij
      _ ≤ t := card_le_card hsub
  have ht_tot : t ≤ r.totient := by
    rw [Nat.totient_eq_card_coprime]
    refine card_le_card_of_injOn (fun x => x.val) ?_ (fun x _ y _ hxy => ZMod.val_injective r hxy)
    intro x hx
    simp only [S, coe_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx
    obtain ⟨i, j, rfl⟩ := hx
    simp only [coe_filter, mem_range, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    refine ⟨ZMod.val_lt _, ?_⟩
    rw [ZMod.val_natCast]
    exact (coprime_mod_of_coprime
      (Nat.coprime_mul_iff_left.mpr ⟨hcopq.pow_left i, hcopp.pow_left j⟩)).symm
  have htot_lt : r.totient < r := Nat.totient_lt r (by omega)
  -- The parameter `B = ⌊√t log₂ n⌋`.
  have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) < t := by
    have : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le hord_pos hord_t
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hlogt : Real.logb 2 n < Real.sqrt t := by
    rw [Real.lt_sqrt (by linarith)]
    exact hr.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hord_t)
  set B := ⌊Real.sqrt t * Real.logb 2 n⌋₊
  have hBreal : (B : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt t * Real.logb 2 n := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hBt : B < t := by
    have : (B : ℝ) < t := by

        (B : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt t * Real.logb 2 n := hBreal
        _ < Real.sqrt t * Real.sqrt t := by gcongr
        _ = t := Real.mul_self_sqrt ht0.le
    exact_mod_cast this

    Nat.floor_mono (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by exact_mod_cast ht_tot)) (by linarith))
  have hBp : B < p := by omega
  have hB3 : 3 ≤ B := by
    apply Nat.le_floor
    have : (2 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt t := by linarith
    push_cast
    nlinarith
  -- A primitive `r`-th root of unity in characteristic `p`.
  have : NeZero ((r : ℕ) : ZMod p) := ⟨by
    rw [Ne, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    intro hd
    exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd) (by omega)⟩
  set K := CyclotomicField r (ZMod p)
  have hζ := IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec r (ZMod p) K
  set ζ := IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta r (ZMod p) K
  -- Every `q^i p^j` is introspective for every product of the `X + a`, `a ≤ B`.
  have hintro : ∀ i j : ℕ, ∀ s : Sym (Fin (B + 1)) B,
      Introspective K r (q ^ i * p ^ j) (linProd p s) := by
    intro i j s
    apply Introspective.multiset_prod
    intro f hf
    obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hf
    have hn' : Introspective K r n (X + C ((a : ℕ) : ZMod p)) := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (a : ℕ) with ha | ha
      · rw [ha, Nat.cast_zero, C_0, add_zero]
        exact introspective_X r n
      · exact introspective_of_congruence hpn (hcong a ha (by have := a.isLt; omega))
    exact ((hn'.div_prime hpn).pow i).mul ((introspective_prime r _).pow j)
  -- The lower bound `C(2B, B)`.
  have hlow := card_image_aeval_linProd (K := K) hζ hBp (S := S) hBt (fun x hx => by
    simp only [S, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hx
    obtain ⟨i, j, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨_, rfl, hintro i j⟩)
  -- Two of the numbers `q^i p^j`, `i, j ≤ ⌊√t⌋`, agree modulo `r`.
  set k := Nat.sqrt t
  have hk : t < (k + 1) * (k + 1) := Nat.lt_succ_sqrt t
  obtain ⟨⟨i, j⟩, hij, ⟨i', j'⟩, hij', hne, heq⟩ :=
    exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to (s := range (k + 1) ×ˢ range (k + 1)) (t := S)
      (f := fun ij => ((q ^ ij.1 * p ^ ij.2 : ℕ) : ZMod r))
      (by rw [card_product, card_range]; exact hk)
      (fun ij _ => by simp only [S, coe_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
                      exact ⟨ij.1, ij.2, rfl⟩)
  simp only [mem_product, mem_range] at hij hij'
  -- They are distinct as numbers, since `n` is not a power of `p`.
  have hm_ne : q ^ i * p ^ j ≠ q ^ i' * p ^ j' := by
    intro hm
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_eq_pow_of_pow_mul_pow_eq hp hq0 hne hm
    have hns : n = p ^ (s + 1) := by rw [← hqp, hs, pow_succ]
    rcases s with _ | s
    · exact hnp (by rw [hns, zero_add, pow_one]; exact hp)
    · exact hpow ⟨p, s + 1 + 1, by omega, hns.symm⟩
  -- The upper bound `n^{⌊√t⌋}`.
  have hup := card_image_aeval_linProd_le (K := K) hζ hm_ne heq (hintro i j) (hintro i' j')
  have hmk : ∀ i j, i ≤ k → j ≤ k → q ^ i * p ^ j ≤ n ^ k := by
    intro i j hi hj
    calc
      q ^ i * p ^ j ≤ q ^ k * p ^ k :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hq0) hi)
          (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hp.pos hj)

    rw [← hlow]
    exact hup.trans (max_le (hmk i j (by omega) (by omega)) (hmk i' j' (by omega) (by omega)))
  -- But `n^{⌊√t⌋} ≤ n^{√t} = 2^{√t log₂ n} < 2^{B + 1} ≤ C(2B, B)`.

    have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ n)
    calc

      _ ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ Real.sqrt t :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hn1 (Real.nat_sqrt_le_real_sqrt)
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (Real.logb 2 n * Real.sqrt t) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_mul zero_le_two, Real.rpow_logb two_pos (by norm_num) (by linarith)]
      _ < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((B + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        apply Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt one_lt_two
        push_cast
        rw [mul_comm]
        exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
      _ = 2 ^ (B + 1) := Real.rpow_natCast _ _
  have hnat : n ^ k < 2 ^ (B + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hreal
  have := two_pow_succ_le_centralBinom hB3
  omega

theorem not_dvd_choose_of_prime_dvd {n q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hqn : q ∣ n) (hlt : q < n) :
    ¬ n ∣ n.choose q := by
  rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := hq.one_lt.le
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hqn
  have hk : 1 ≤ k := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
    · simp at hlt
    · exact hk
  -- `n · C(n - 1, q - 1) = C(n, q) · q`.
  have hid := Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq (q * k - 1) (q - 1)
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.mul_ne_zero hq.ne_zero (by omega))),
    Nat.sub_add_cancel hq1, hm] at hid
  -- Hence `C(n - 1, q - 1) = m q`.
  have hdiv : q ∣ (q * k - 1).choose (q - 1) := by
    refine ⟨m, Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.mul_pos hq.pos (by omega : 0 < k)) ?_⟩
    rw [hid]
    ring
  -- But Lucas's theorem gives `C(n - 1, q - 1) ≡ 1 (mod q)`.
  have := Fact.mk hq
  have hlucas := Choose.choose_modEq_choose_mod_mul_choose_div_nat (n := q * k - 1) (k := q - 1)
    (p := q)
  have hmod : (q * k - 1) % q = q - 1 := by
    have : q * k - 1 = (q - 1) + q * (k - 1) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_sub, mul_one]
      have : q ≤ q * k := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right q hk
      omega
    rw [this, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  rw [hmod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : q - 1 < q), Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega : q - 1 < q),
    Nat.choose_self, Nat.choose_zero_right, mul_one] at hlucas
  have h1 := (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mpr hdiv).symm.trans hlucas
  rw [Nat.ModEq, Nat.zero_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hq.one_lt] at h1
  exact absurd h1 (by norm_num)

theorem exists_lt_orderOf {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ r, 2 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ 4 * Nat.clog 2 n ^ 5 ∧ Nat.clog 2 n ^ 2 < orderOf (n : ZMod r) := by
  classical
  set c := Nat.clog 2 n
  have hc1 : 1 ≤ c := Nat.clog_pos one_lt_two (by omega)
  have hnc : n ≤ 2 ^ c := Nat.le_pow_clog one_lt_two n
  rcases (show c = 1 ∨ 2 ≤ c by omega) with hc | hc
  · -- `n = 2`: take `r = 3`.
    have hn2 : n = 2 := by rw [hc, pow_one] at hnc; omega
    have h3 : orderOf ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) = 2 := by
      rw [orderOf_eq_iff (by norm_num)]
      exact ⟨by decide, fun m hm hm0 => by interval_cases m; decide⟩
    refine ⟨3, by norm_num, by rw [hc]; norm_num, ?_⟩
    rw [hc, hn2, h3]
    norm_num
  set L := c ^ 2
  set M := 4 * c ^ 5
  set K := Nat.log 2 M
  set N := ∏ i ∈ Icc 1 L, (n ^ i - 1)
  set X := n ^ K * N
  have hfac : ∀ i ∈ Icc 1 L, 1 ≤ n ^ i - 1 := by
    intro i hi
    have : 2 ≤ n ^ i := le_trans hn (Nat.le_self_pow (by simp at hi; omega) n)
    omega
  have hN : N ≠ 0 := prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i hi => by have := hfac i hi; omega
  have hX : X ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by omega)) hN
  -- Some `s ≤ M` does not divide `X`.
  have hex : ∃ s, 1 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ M ∧ ¬ s ∣ X := by
    by_contra hall
    push Not at hall
    have hdvd : (2 * c ^ 5).centralBinom ∣ X :=
      centralBinom_dvd_of_forall_dvd (m := 2 * c ^ 5) hX fun s hs hsM => hall s hs (by omega)
    have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hX) hdvd
    have hcb := Nat.four_pow_le_two_mul_add_one_mul_centralBinom (2 * c ^ 5)
    -- Size bounds.
    have hcpow : c ^ 5 < 2 ^ (5 * c) := by
      rw [pow_mul']
      exact Nat.pow_lt_pow_left (Nat.lt_two_pow_self) (by norm_num)
    have hK : K < 2 + 5 * c := by
      apply Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (by positivity)
      rw [pow_add]
      omega
    have hNle : N ≤ n ^ (c ^ 4) := by
      calc
        N ≤ ∏ _i ∈ Icc 1 L, n ^ L :=
          prod_le_prod fun i hi => (Nat.sub_le _ _).trans
            (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by simp at hi; omega))
        _ = n ^ (c ^ 4) := by
          rw [prod_const, Nat.card_Icc, Nat.add_sub_cancel, ← pow_mul]
          congr 1
          ring
    have hXle : X ≤ 2 ^ (c * (2 + 5 * c) + c ^ 5) := by
      calc
        X ≤ n ^ (2 + 5 * c) * n ^ (c ^ 4) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hK.le) hNle
        _ ≤ (2 ^ c) ^ (2 + 5 * c) * (2 ^ c) ^ (c ^ 4) := by gcongr
        _ = 2 ^ (c * (2 + 5 * c) + c ^ 5) := by
          rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
          congr 1
          ring
    have hcoef : 2 * (2 * c ^ 5) + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (3 + 5 * c) := by
      rw [pow_add]
      omega
    have hfour : 4 ^ (2 * c ^ 5) = 2 ^ (4 * c ^ 5) := by
      rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, ← pow_mul]
      ring_nf
    have hchain : 4 ^ (2 * c ^ 5) ≤ 2 ^ (3 + 5 * c) * 2 ^ (c * (2 + 5 * c) + c ^ 5) :=
      hcb.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul hcoef (hle.trans hXle))
    rw [hfour, ← pow_add] at hchain
    have := Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right (by norm_num : 1 < 2) |>.mp hchain
    have := exponent_lt hc
    nlinarith
  -- Take the least such `s`.
  have hex' : ∃ s, 1 ≤ s ∧ ¬ s ∣ X := let ⟨s, hs, _, hsX⟩ := hex; ⟨s, hs, hsX⟩
  set s := Nat.find hex'
  have hs : 1 ≤ s ∧ ¬ s ∣ X := Nat.find_spec hex'
  have hsM : s ≤ M := by
    obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀, hs₀M, hs₀X⟩ := hex
    exact (Nat.find_min' hex' ⟨hs₀, hs₀X⟩).trans hs₀M
  have hmin : ∀ s', 1 ≤ s' → s' < s → s' ∣ X := fun s' hs' hlt => by
    by_contra h
    exact Nat.find_min hex' hlt ⟨hs', h⟩
  have hs2 : 2 ≤ s := by
    by_contra h
    have h1 : s = 1 := by omega
    rw [h1] at hs
    exact hs.2 (one_dvd X)
  -- `s` is coprime to `n`.
  have hcop : s.Coprime n := by
    by_contra hnc
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpg⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hnc
    have hps : p ∣ s := hpg.trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_left s n)
    have hpn : p ∣ n := hpg.trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_right s n)
    set v := s.factorization p
    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hv : 1 ≤ v := (hp.dvd_iff_one_le_factorization hs0).mp hps
    have hsplit : p ^ v * (s / p ^ v) = s := Nat.ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self s p
    have hpv : 2 ≤ p ^ v := le_trans hp.two_le (Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) p)
    have hlt : s / p ^ v < s := Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) (by omega)
    have hpos : 1 ≤ s / p ^ v := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (s / p ^ v) with h | h
      · rw [h, mul_zero] at hsplit; omega
      · exact h
    have hvK : v ≤ K := by
      apply Nat.le_log_of_pow_le one_lt_two
      calc
        2 ^ v ≤ p ^ v := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hp.two_le v
        _ ≤ s := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.ordProj_dvd s p)
        _ ≤ M := hsM
    have hpvX : p ^ v ∣ X :=
      ((pow_dvd_pow p hvK).trans (pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd hpn K)).trans (dvd_mul_right _ _)
    have hcop' : (p ^ v).Coprime (s / p ^ v) := (Nat.coprime_ordCompl hp hs0).pow_left v
    exact hs.2 (hsplit ▸ hcop'.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd hpvX (hmin _ hpos hlt))
  -- The order of `n` modulo `s` exceeds `c²`.
  refine ⟨s, hs2, hsM, ?_⟩
  have : NeZero s := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hunit : IsUnit (n : ZMod s) := (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime n s).mpr hcop.symm
  have hord : 0 < orderOf (n : ZMod s) := hunit.isOfFinOrder.orderOf_pos
  by_contra hle
  replace hle := not_lt.mp hle
  have hmem : orderOf (n : ZMod s) ∈ Icc 1 L := mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hord, hle⟩
  have hsdvd : s ∣ n ^ orderOf (n : ZMod s) - 1 := by
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff, Nat.cast_sub (Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)), Nat.cast_pow,
      pow_orderOf_eq_one, Nat.cast_one, sub_self]
  exact hs.2 ((hsdvd.trans (dvd_prod_of_mem (fun i => n ^ i - 1) hmem)).trans
    (dvd_mul_left N (n ^ K)))

/-- **A small modulus of large order, with logarithms**: for `n ≥ 2`, some `2 ≤ r ≤ 128 log₂⁵ n`
has `ord_r(n) > log₂² n` [Agrawal, Kayal, Saxena, Lemma 4.3][AKS2004], up to the constant. -/

    ChangesAtMost (fun u : α => decide (θ ≤ u)) 1 := by
  intro z hz S hS

    have hn : ¬ θ ≤ z i := by
      intro hc

/-- **Each function is nonconstant on few groups.** Cut the positions into consecutive groups
of `L`. A function with at most `T` changes along the nondecreasing sequence `z` is nonconstant
on at most `T` of the first `G` groups. -/
private theorem card_nonconstant_groups_le {Ψ : α → β} {T : ℕ} (h : ChangesAtMost Ψ T)
    {z : ℕ → α} (hz : Monotone z) (L G : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.range G).filter fun g =>
      ∃ j < L, ∃ j' < L, Ψ (z (g * L + j)) ≠ Ψ (z (g * L + j'))).card ≤ T := by
  classical
  set bad := (Finset.range G).filter fun g =>
    ∃ j < L, ∃ j' < L, Ψ (z (g * L + j)) ≠ Ψ (z (g * L + j'))
  -- Every nonconstant group contains a change position.
  have hchange : ∀ g ∈ bad, ∃ c, g * L ≤ c ∧ c < g * L + L ∧ Ψ (z c) ≠ Ψ (z (c + 1)) := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨j, hj, j', hj', hne⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hg).2
    by_contra hno
    push Not at hno
    have hconst := eq_of_forall_not_change (s := fun i => Ψ (z i)) (a := g * L) (m := L - 1)
      (fun c hc1 hc2 => hno c hc1 (by omega))
    exact hne ((hconst j (by omega)).trans (hconst j' (by omega)).symm)
  choose! chg hchg using hchange
  have inj : Set.InjOn chg bad := by
    intro g hg g' hg' heq
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, -⟩ := hchg g hg
    obtain ⟨b1, b2, -⟩ := hchg g' hg'
    have hL : 0 < L := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos L with h0 | h0
      · subst h0; simp at a2
      · exact h0
    have e1 : chg g / L = g := Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le a1 (by rw [Nat.succ_mul]; exact a2)
    have e2 : chg g' / L = g' := Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le b1 (by rw [Nat.succ_mul]; exact b2)
    rw [← e1, ← e2, heq]
  calc bad.card = (bad.image chg).card := (Finset.card_image_of_injOn inj).symm
    _ ≤ T := h z hz _ (by
      intro i hi
      obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi

private theorem exists_sorted_list {ι : Type*} (P : Finset ι) (key : ι → α) :
    ∃ l : List ι, l.length = P.card ∧ l.Nodup ∧ (∀ a, a ∈ l ↔ a ∈ P) ∧
      ∀ (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) (hj : j < l.length), i ≤ j → key l[i] ≤ key l[j] := by
  have htrans : ∀ a b c : ι, decide (key a ≤ key b) = true → decide (key b ≤ key c) = true →
      decide (key a ≤ key c) = true := by
    intro a b c hab hbc
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hab hbc ⊢
    exact hab.trans hbc
  have htotal : ∀ a b : ι, (decide (key a ≤ key b) || decide (key b ≤ key a)) = true := by
    intro a b
    simpa using le_total (key a) (key b)
  let l := P.toList.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (key a ≤ key b))
  have hperm : l.Perm P.toList := List.mergeSort_perm _ _
  have hsorted : l.Pairwise (fun a b => decide (key a ≤ key b) = true) :=
    List.pairwise_mergeSort htrans htotal _
  refine ⟨l, by rw [hperm.length_eq, Finset.length_toList],
    hperm.nodup_iff.mpr (Finset.nodup_toList P),
    fun a => hperm.mem_iff.trans Finset.mem_toList, ?_⟩
  intro i j hi hj hij
  rcases hij.lt_or_eq with h | h
  · simpa using List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hsorted i j hi hj h
  · subst h; exact le_rfl

theorem mem_support_iff_exists [hne : ∀ q, Nonempty (spec q)] {program : ProbOracleComp spec α}
    {result : α} :
    result ∈ support program ↔
      ∃ (State : Type) (oracle : (q : Query) → StateT State PMF (spec q)) (s s' : State),
        (result, s') ∈ ((OracleComp.interpret
          (handler (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle n)) oracle) program).run s).support
    := by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨State, oracle, s, s', h⟩ => mem_support_of_mem oracle h⟩
  induction program with
  | pure a =>
    refine ⟨Unit, fun q _ => PMF.pure (Classical.choice (hne q), ()), (), (), ?_⟩
    rw [eq_of_mem_supportWith_pure h]
    exact (PMF.mem_support_pure_iff _ _).mpr rfl
  | liftBind q cont ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp h
    obtain ⟨State, oracle, s, s', hrun⟩ := ih a ha
    have hrun' {S : Type} (oracle : (q : Query) → StateT S PMF (spec q)) (state : S) :
        (OracleComp.interpret (handler (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle n)) oracle)
          (PFunctor.FreeM.liftBind q cont)).run state =
        ((handler (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle n)) oracle q).run state).bind
          fun first => (OracleComp.interpret
            (handler (fun n => StateT.lift (ProbComp.unifOracle n)) oracle) (cont first.1)).run
              first.2 := rfl
    cases q with
    | inl n =>
      refine ⟨State, oracle, s, s', ?_⟩
      rw [hrun', PMF.mem_support_bind_iff]
      refine ⟨(a, s), ?_, hrun⟩
      simp [handler, ProbComp.unifOracle]
    | inr q =>
      let first (q' : Query) : spec q' :=
        if hq : q' = q then hq ▸ a else Classical.choice (hne q')
      let oracle' (q' : Query) : StateT (Option State) PMF (spec q') := fun
        | none => PMF.pure (first q', some s)
        | some state => (oracle q' state).map fun (b, state') => (b, some state')
      have hlift := run_interpret_map_state oracle oracle' some (fun q' state => by
        simp [oracle']) (cont a) s
      refine ⟨Option State, oracle', none, some s', ?_⟩
      rw [hrun' oracle', PMF.mem_support_bind_iff]
      refine ⟨(a, some s), ?_, ?_⟩
      · change (a, some s) ∈ (PMF.pure (first q, some s)).support
        simp [first]
      · rw [← hlift, PMF.mem_support_map_iff]
        exact ⟨(result, s'), hrun, rfl⟩

theorem memoize_cache_bounds (distribution : Query → PMF Value)
    (program : OracleComp (fun _ : Query => Value) α) (size : Query → ℕ) (calls maxSize : ℕ)
    (hcalls : program.IsQueryBounded calls) (hsize : program.QueriesSatisfy (size · ≤ maxSize))
    (cache cache' : List (Query × Value)) (result : α)
    (h : (result, cache') ∈
      ((OracleComp.interpret (memoize distribution) program).run cache).support) :
    cache'.length ≤ cache.length + calls ∧
      ∀ entry ∈ cache', entry ∈ cache ∨
        (size entry.1 ≤ maxSize ∧ entry.2 ∈ (distribution entry.1).support) := by
  rw [← OracleComp.run_interpret_withTranscript (memoize distribution) program cache [],
    PMF.mem_support_map_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨value, state⟩, hstate, heq⟩ := h
  cases heq
  obtain ⟨hcount, hentries⟩ := run_interpret_memoize_transcript distribution program cache state.1
    result state.2 hstate
  refine ⟨hcount.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left
    (hcalls.length_transcript_le (memoize distribution) hstate) _), ?_⟩
  intro entry hentry
  rcases hentries entry hentry with h | ⟨hseen, hsupport⟩
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hsize.forall_mem_transcript (memoize distribution) hstate _ hseen, hsupport⟩

theorem toOuterMeasure_bad_choose_two_le {ι σ β : Type} {spec : ι → Type}
    {handler : (q : ι) → StateT σ PMF (spec q)} {bad : σ → Prop}
    (size : σ → ℕ) (δ : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hstep : ∀ q s, ¬bad s → (handler q s).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2} ≤ size s * δ)
    (hgrow : ∀ q s, ¬bad s → ∀ x ∈ (handler q s).support, ¬bad x.2 → size x.2 ≤ size s + 1)
    {program : OracleComp spec β} {n : ℕ} (hn : IsQueryBounded program n)
    {s : σ} (hs : ¬bad s) :
    ((OracleComp.interpret handler program).run s).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2} ≤
      (n * size s + n.choose 2 : ℕ) * δ := by
  induction hn generalizing s with
  | pure a n =>
    simp only [run_interpret_pure, Probability.PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure,
      PMF.toOuterMeasure_pure_apply, ite_eq_right (show (a, s) ∉ {x : β × σ | bad x.2} from hs)]
    exact zero_le
  | liftBind q cont n _ ih =>
    classical
    simp only [run_interpret_bind, run_interpret_query,
      Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.toOuterMeasure_bind_apply]
    set K : ℝ≥0∞ := (n * (size s + 1) + n.choose 2 : ℕ) * δ
    have hterm (y : spec q × σ) :
        (handler q s) y *
          ((OracleComp.interpret handler (cont y.1)).run y.2).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2} ≤
        (handler q s) y * ({x : spec q × σ | bad x.2}.indicator 1 y + K) := by
      by_cases hmem : y ∈ (handler q s).support
      · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ zero_le
        by_cases hy : bad y.2
        · have : y ∈ {x : spec q × σ | bad x.2} := hy
          rw [Set.indicator_of_mem this, Pi.one_apply]
          exact (Probability.PMF.toOuterMeasure_le_one _ _).trans le_self_add
        · have : y ∉ {x : spec q × σ | bad x.2} := hy
          rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem this, zero_add]
          refine (ih y.1 hy).trans ?_
          simp only [K]
          gcongr
          exact hgrow q s hs y hmem hy
      · rw [(PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr hmem, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    calc ∑' y, (handler q s) y *
          ((OracleComp.interpret handler (cont y.1)).run y.2).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2}
        ≤ ∑' y, (handler q s) y * ({x : spec q × σ | bad x.2}.indicator 1 y + K) :=
          ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hterm
      _ = (handler q s).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2} + K := by
          simp only [mul_add, ENNReal.tsum_add, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.tsum_coe, one_mul,
            PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
          congr 1
          refine tsum_congr fun y => ?_
          by_cases hy : y ∈ {x : spec q × σ | bad x.2}
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy, Set.indicator_of_mem hy, Pi.one_apply, mul_one]
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, mul_zero]
      _ ≤ size s * δ + K := add_le_add (hstep q s hs) le_rfl
      _ = ((n + 1) * size s + (n + 1).choose 2 : ℕ) * δ := by
          simp only [K, Nat.choose_succ_succ' n 1, Nat.choose_one_right, Nat.cast_add,
            Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_one]
          ring

theorem abs_sub_uniformPerm_forgetful_le {β γ : Type}
    {program : OracleComp (PermOracleSpec α) β} {Q : ℕ}
    (hQ : IsQueryBounded program Q) (next : β → PMF γ) (c : γ) :
    |(((do
        let π ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (Equiv.Perm α)
        OracleComp.interpret (fun q => PMF.pure (evalPerm π q)) program).bind next) c).toReal -
      (((((OracleComp.interpret forgetfulAnswer program).run []).map
        Prod.fst).bind next) c).toReal| ≤
      (Q.choose 2 : ℝ) * (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
  rw [uniform_interpret_eq_lazy,
    ← run_interpret_exactWithBad_map_fst program [] false isPartialBijection_nil,
    ← run_interpret_forgetfulWithBad_map_fst program [] false]
  simp only [PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def, PMF.bind_map]
  have hdiff := identicalUntilBad_exactWithBad_forgetfulWithBad.abs_sub_le
    program ([], false) (fun x => next x.1) c
  rw [identicalUntilBad_exactWithBad_forgetfulWithBad.bad_eq] at hdiff
  refine hdiff.trans ?_
  have hbad := toOuterMeasure_bad_forgetfulWithBad_le hQ []
  simp only [List.length_nil, mul_zero, zero_add] at hbad
  have htop : ((Q.choose 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * (Fintype.card α : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.mul_ne_top (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _)
      (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero))
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_natCast, ENNReal.toReal_inv] using
    ENNReal.toReal_mono htop hbad

structure IdenticalUntilBad (first second : (q : ι) → StateT σ PMF (spec q)) (bad : σ → Prop) :

  /-- From a good state, answers with good next states are equally likely. -/
  agree : ∀ q s, ¬bad s → ∀ a s', ¬bad s' → first q s (a, s') = second q s (a, s')
  /-- Bad states are absorbing for the first handler. -/
  absorb_first : ∀ q s, bad s → ∀ x ∈ (first q s).support, bad x.2
  /-- Bad states are absorbing for the second handler. -/
  absorb_second : ∀ q s, bad s → ∀ x ∈ (second q s).support, bad x.2

theorem run_apply (h : IdenticalUntilBad first second bad) (program : OracleComp spec α)
    (s : σ) (a : α) (s' : σ) (hs' : ¬bad s') :
    (interpret first program).run s (a, s') = (interpret second program).run s (a, s') := by
  induction program using OracleComp.induction generalizing s with
  | pure b => rfl
  | query_bind q cont ih =>
    simp only [run_interpret_bind, run_interpret_query,
      Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.bind_apply]
    refine tsum_congr fun y => ?_
    by_cases hy : bad y.2
    · have hzero (handler : (q : ι) → StateT σ PMF (spec q))
          (habsorb : ∀ q s, bad s → ∀ x ∈ (handler q s).support, bad x.2) :
          (interpret handler (cont y.1)).run y.2 (a, s') = 0 :=
        (PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr fun hmem =>
          hs' (bad_of_mem_support_run habsorb (cont y.1) hy _ hmem)
      rw [hzero first h.absorb_first, hzero second h.absorb_second, mul_zero, mul_zero]
    · by_cases hs : bad s
      · have hzero (handler : (q : ι) → StateT σ PMF (spec q))
            (habsorb : ∀ q s, bad s → ∀ x ∈ (handler q s).support, bad x.2) :
            handler q s y = 0 :=
          (PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr fun hmem => hy (habsorb q s hs y hmem)
        rw [hzero first h.absorb_first, hzero second h.absorb_second, zero_mul, zero_mul]
      · rw [show y = (y.1, y.2) from rfl, h.agree q s hs y.1 y.2 hy, ih y.1 y.2]

theorem bind_apply_le (h : IdenticalUntilBad first second bad) (program : OracleComp spec α)
    (s : σ) {β : Type} (next : α × σ → PMF β) (b : β) :
    ((interpret first program).run s).bind next b ≤
      ((interpret second program).run s).bind next b +
        ((interpret first program).run s).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2} := by
  classical
  simp only [PMF.bind_apply, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
  rw [← ENNReal.tsum_add]
  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => ?_
  by_cases hx : bad x.2
  · have hbad : x ∈ {x : α × σ | bad x.2} := hx
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hbad]
    calc ((interpret first program).run s) x * next x b
        ≤ ((interpret first program).run s) x * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (PMF.coe_le_one _ _) zero_le
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [mul_one]; exact le_add_self
  · have hgood : x ∉ {x : α × σ | bad x.2} := hx
    rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hgood, add_zero, show x = (x.1, x.2) from rfl,
      h.run_apply program s x.1 x.2 hx]

theorem bad_eq (h : IdenticalUntilBad first second bad) (program : OracleComp spec α) (s : σ) :
    ((interpret first program).run s).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2} =
      ((interpret second program).run s).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2} := by
  have hgood : ((interpret first program).run s).toOuterMeasure {x | ¬bad x.2} =
      ((interpret second program).run s).toOuterMeasure {x | ¬bad x.2} := by
    simp only [PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
    refine tsum_congr fun x => ?_
    by_cases hx : bad x.2
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show x ∉ {x : α × σ | ¬bad x.2} from fun h => h hx),
        Set.indicator_of_notMem (show x ∉ {x : α × σ | ¬bad x.2} from fun h => h hx)]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show x ∈ {x : α × σ | ¬bad x.2} from hx),
        Set.indicator_of_mem (show x ∈ {x : α × σ | ¬bad x.2} from hx),
        show x = (x.1, x.2) from rfl, h.run_apply program s x.1 x.2 hx]
  have hfirst := toOuterMeasure_bad_add_good (bad := bad) ((interpret first program).run s)
  have hsecond := toOuterMeasure_bad_add_good (bad := bad) ((interpret second program).run s)
  rw [hgood] at hfirst
  exact (ENNReal.add_left_inj (Probability.PMF.toOuterMeasure_ne_top _ _)).mp
    (hfirst.trans hsecond.symm)

theorem abs_sub_le (h : IdenticalUntilBad first second bad) (program : OracleComp spec α)
    (s : σ) {β : Type} (next : α × σ → PMF β) (b : β) :
    |(((interpret first program).run s).bind next b).toReal -
        (((interpret second program).run s).bind next b).toReal| ≤
      (((interpret first program).run s).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2}).toReal := by
  have hle := h.bind_apply_le program s next b
  have hle' := h.symm.bind_apply_le program s next b
  rw [← h.bad_eq] at hle'
  have hbad := Probability.PMF.toOuterMeasure_ne_top ((interpret first program).run s)
    {x | bad x.2}
  have h1 := ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨PMF.apply_ne_top _ _, hbad⟩) hle
  have h2 := ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨PMF.apply_ne_top _ _, hbad⟩) hle'
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _) hbad] at h1 h2
  exact abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

theorem toOuterMeasure_bad_le {handler : (q : ι) → StateT σ PMF (spec q)} {bad : σ → Prop}
    (cost : ι → ℕ) (budget : σ → ℝ≥0∞) (δ : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hstep : ∀ q s, ¬bad s → (handler q s).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2} ≤ cost q * budget s)
    (hgrow : ∀ q s, ¬bad s → ∀ x ∈ (handler q s).support, ¬bad x.2 →
      budget x.2 ≤ budget s + δ)
    {program : OracleComp spec α} {n k : ℕ} (hn : IsQueryBounded program n)
    (hk : IsCostBounded cost program k) {s : σ} (hs : ¬bad s) :
    ((interpret handler program).run s).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2} ≤
      k * (budget s + n * δ) := by
  induction hn generalizing s k with
  | pure a n =>
    simp only [run_interpret_pure, Probability.PMF.monad_pure_eq_pure,
      PMF.toOuterMeasure_pure_apply, ite_eq_right (show (a, s) ∉ {x : α × σ | bad x.2} from hs)]
    exact zero_le
  | liftBind q cont n _ ih =>
    classical
    obtain ⟨hle, hcont⟩ := IsCostBounded.liftBind_iff.mp hk
    simp only [run_interpret_bind, run_interpret_query,
      Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.toOuterMeasure_bind_apply]
    set K : ℝ≥0∞ := (k - cost q : ℕ) * (budget s + δ + n * δ)
    have hterm (y : spec q × σ) : (handler q s) y *
        ((interpret handler (cont y.1)).run y.2).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2} ≤
        (handler q s) y * ({x : spec q × σ | bad x.2}.indicator 1 y + K) := by
      by_cases hmem : y ∈ (handler q s).support
      · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ zero_le
        by_cases hy : bad y.2
        · have : y ∈ {x : spec q × σ | bad x.2} := hy
          rw [Set.indicator_of_mem this, Pi.one_apply]
          exact (Probability.PMF.toOuterMeasure_le_one _ _).trans le_self_add
        · have : y ∉ {x : spec q × σ | bad x.2} := hy
          rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem this, zero_add]
          refine (ih y.1 (hcont y.1) hy).trans ?_
          simp only [K]
          gcongr
          exact hgrow q s hs y hmem hy
      · rw [(PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr hmem, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    calc ∑' y, (handler q s) y * ((interpret handler (cont y.1)).run y.2).toOuterMeasure
          {x | bad x.2}
        ≤ ∑' y, (handler q s) y * ({x : spec q × σ | bad x.2}.indicator 1 y + K) :=
          ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hterm
      _ = (handler q s).toOuterMeasure {x | bad x.2} + K := by
          simp only [mul_add, ENNReal.tsum_add, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, PMF.tsum_coe, one_mul,
            PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
          congr 1
          refine tsum_congr fun y => ?_
          by_cases hy : y ∈ {x : spec q × σ | bad x.2}
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy, Set.indicator_of_mem hy, Pi.one_apply, mul_one]
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, mul_zero]
      _ ≤ cost q * (budget s + (n + 1 : ℕ) * δ) +
            (k - cost q : ℕ) * (budget s + (n + 1 : ℕ) * δ) := by
          refine add_le_add ((hstep q s hs).trans ?_) (le_of_eq ?_)
          · gcongr
            exact le_self_add
          · simp only [K, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
            ring
      _ = k * (budget s + (n + 1 : ℕ) * δ) := by
          rw [← add_mul, ← Nat.cast_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hle]

def compEquiv [Finite κ] (J : Interpretation L' L'' κ)
    (I : Interpretation L L' ι) : J.Model (I.Model M) ≃[L''] (J.comp I).Model M where
  toFun x := ⟨fun p => (x.1 p.1).1 p.2, by
    simp only [comp, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_iInf, Formula.realize_relabel]
    exact ⟨fun j => (x.1 j).2, (realize_onFormula J.domain x.1).2 x.2⟩⟩
  invFun z := ⟨fun j => ⟨fun i => z.1 (j, i), by
    have h := z.2
    simp only [comp, Formula.realize_inf, Formula.realize_iInf, Formula.realize_relabel] at h
    exact h.1 j⟩, by
    have h := z.2
    simp only [comp, Formula.realize_inf] at h
    exact (realize_onFormula J.domain _).1 h.2⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_fun' f := isEmptyElim f
  map_rel' R x := by
    change ((I.onFormula (J.rel R)).relabel (Equiv.prodAssoc _ _ _)).Realize _ ↔
      (J.rel R).Realize fun p => (x p.1).1 p.2
    rw [Formula.realize_relabel, ← realize_onFormula]

        EncodesNode m.val h.val w (u 0).val (u 6).val (a 1).val ∧
        EncodesNode m.val h.val w (u 2).val (u 1).val (a 2).val ∧
        (a 0).val + (a 1).val = (a 2).val)

    (hz : EncodesNode m.val h.val w j q z) : z = BitString.sumTree x.val.testBit j q := by

    have hp' : 2 ^ (m.val - j) ≤ k.val := by

    have hl : 2 * q < 2 ^ (m.val - j) := by rw [he, pow_succ]; lia
    have hr : 2 * q + 1 < 2 ^ (m.val - j) := by rw [he, pow_succ]; lia

      ⟨rfl, by dsimp [u]; lia, rfl, hq, by dsimp [u]; lia, rfl⟩
    have ha' := ih (by lia) hl ha

private theorem satisfies_of_colorable {f : coloringInterpretation.Model M → Fin 3}
    (hf : ∀ a c, Edge a c → f a ≠ f c) : IsThreeCNF M ∧ Satisfiable M := by
  have hTF : f trueVertex ≠ f falseVertex :=
    hf _ _ ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl, fun j => j.elim0⟩
  have hTB : f trueVertex ≠ f baseVertex :=
    hf _ _ ⟨_, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl,
      fun j => j.elim0⟩
  have hFB : f falseVertex ≠ f baseVertex :=
    hf _ _ ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl, fun j => j.elim0⟩
  have hgood : ¬M ⊨ badSentence := fun hbad => hf trueVertex trueVertex
    ⟨_, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self),
      Formula.realize_relabel.2
        ((congrArg (Formula.Realize badSentence) (Subsingleton.elim _ default)).mpr hbad),
      _, rfl, fun j => j.elim0⟩ rfl
  obtain ⟨h3, hne⟩ := not_not.1 ((not_congr realize_badSentence).1 hgood)
  have hlitB (p : Bool) (x : M) : f (litVertex p x) ≠ f baseVertex := by
    cases p
    · exact hf _ _ ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl, fun j => j.elim0⟩
    · exact hf _ _ ⟨_, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl,
        fun j => j.elim0⟩
  have hlit (p : Bool) (x : M) :
      f (litVertex p x) = f trueVertex ∨ f (litVertex p x) = f falseVertex := by
    by_contra h
    simp only [not_or] at h
    exact hlitB p x (fin_three_eq hTB hFB hTF h.1 h.2)
  have hneg (x : M) : f (litVertex true x) ≠ f (litVertex false x) :=
    hf _ _ ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl,
      fun j i hj => by cases Option.some.inj hj; rfl⟩
  refine ⟨h3, fun x => f (litVertex true x) = f trueVertex, (satisfies_iff _).2 fun c => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hsurj⟩ := exists_triple_of_encard_le_three (hne c) (h3 c)
  let ps : Fin 3 → Bool := fun i => (l i).1
  let d : Fin 4 → M := ![c, (l 0).2, (l 1).2, (l 2).2]
  have hd : GadgetDomain ps d := by
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun m hm => ?_⟩
    · fin_cases i <;> exact hl _
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hsurj m hm
      refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hdom (g : Fin 6) : (coloringInterpretation.domain (.gadget g ps)).Realize d :=
    (realize_gadgetDomain ps d).2 hd
  let G : Fin 6 → coloringInterpretation.Model M := fun g => ⟨.gadget g ps, d, hdom g⟩
  have hP : GadgetProper (f (litVertex (ps 0) (d 1))) (f (litVertex (ps 1) (d 2)))
      (f (litVertex (ps 2) (d 3))) (fun g => f (G g)) (f falseVertex) (f baseVertex) := by
    refine ⟨hf (G 0) _ ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl, fun j i hj => ?_⟩,
      hf (G 1) _ ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl, fun j i hj => ?_⟩,
      hf (G 0) (G 1) ⟨_, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl,
        fun j i hj => ?_⟩,
      hf (G 0) (G 2) ⟨_, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self),
        formula_realize_top, _, rfl, fun j i hj => ?_⟩,
      hf (G 1) (G 2) ⟨_, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl,
        fun j i hj => ?_⟩,
      hf (G 2) (G 3) ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl, fun j i hj => ?_⟩,
      hf (G 4) _ ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl, fun j i hj => ?_⟩,
      hf (G 3) (G 4) ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl, fun j i hj => ?_⟩,
      hf (G 3) (G 5) ⟨_, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl,
        fun j i hj => ?_⟩,
      hf (G 4) (G 5) ⟨_, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl,
        fun j i hj => ?_⟩,
      hf (G 5) _ ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl, fun j => j.elim0⟩,
      hf (G 5) _ ⟨_, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self, formula_realize_top, _, rfl,
        fun j => j.elim0⟩⟩ <;>
    cases Option.some.inj hj <;> rfl

    rcases gadget_forces (hlit _ _) (hlit _ _) (hlit _ _) hP with h | h | h

private theorem encard_le_three_of_subset {α : Type*} {s : Set α} {a b c : α}
    (h : s ⊆ {a, b, c}) : s.encard ≤ 3 := by
  refine (Set.encard_le_encard h).trans ?_
  refine (Set.encard_insert_le _ _).trans ?_
  have := Set.encard_insert_le ({c} : Set α) b
  rw [Set.encard_singleton] at this
  calc ({b, c} : Set α).encard + 1 ≤ 1 + 1 + 1 := by gcongr
    _ = 3 := by norm_num

theorem isThreeCNF_cnfInterpretation : IsThreeCNF (cnfInterpretation.Model M) := by
  rintro ⟨t, d, hd⟩
  have hlit (l : Bool × cnfInterpretation.Model M) (hl : l ∈ literals (⟨t, d, hd⟩ : _)) :
      ∃ τ ∈ coloringClauseTemplates t l.1, ∃ y, l.2.toSigma = ⟨τ.target, y⟩ ∧ τ.Compat d y := by
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, -, y, hy, hc⟩ := (relMap_lit_of_templates cnfInterpretation_rel_lit l.1 _ _).1 hl
    exact ⟨τ, hτ, y, hy, hc⟩
  cases t with
  | var c =>
    refine encard_le_three_of_subset (a := (true, ⟨.var c, d, hd⟩)) (b := (false, ⟨.var c, d, hd⟩))
      (c := (false, ⟨.var c, d, hd⟩)) fun ⟨b, e⟩ hl => ?_
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, y, hy, hc⟩ := hlit _ hl
    obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.1 hτ
    have he : e = ⟨.var c, d, hd⟩ := Model.ext_toSigma (hy.trans (by
      congr 1
      exact funext fun j => hc j j rfl))
    subst he
    cases b <;> simp
  | vertex =>
    refine encard_le_three_of_subset (a := (true, varElt 0 (d 0))) (b := (true, varElt 1 (d 0)))
      (c := (true, varElt 2 (d 0))) fun ⟨b, e⟩ hl => ?_
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, y, hy, hc⟩ := hlit _ hl
    cases b
    · simp [coloringClauseTemplates] at hτ
    · simp only [coloringClauseTemplates, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hτ
      rcases hτ with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · obtain rfl : y = fun _ => d 0 :=
          funext fun j => (hc j j rfl).trans (congrArg d (Subsingleton.elim _ _))
        exact .inl (Prod.ext rfl (Model.ext_toSigma hy))
      · obtain rfl : y = fun _ => d 0 :=
          funext fun j => (hc j j rfl).trans (congrArg d (Subsingleton.elim _ _))
        exact .inr (.inl (Prod.ext rfl (Model.ext_toSigma hy)))
      · obtain rfl : y = fun _ => d 0 :=
          funext fun j => (hc j j rfl).trans (congrArg d (Subsingleton.elim _ _))
        exact .inr (.inr (Prod.ext rfl (Model.ext_toSigma hy)))
  | edge c =>
    refine encard_le_three_of_subset (a := (false, varElt c (d 0))) (b := (false, varElt c (d 1)))
      (c := (false, varElt c (d 1))) fun ⟨b, e⟩ hl => ?_
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, y, hy, hc⟩ := hlit _ hl
    cases b

      rcases hτ with rfl | rfl

        subst hy'

      · have hy' : y = fun _ => d 1 := funext fun j => hc j 1 rfl
        subst hy'
        exact .inr (.inl (Prod.ext rfl (Model.ext_toSigma hy)))
