theorem independentSet_copies_iff [Finite J] [Finite M] [Nonempty J] :
    (Bundled.of (Copies J M) : Bundled.{w} sizedGraph.Structure) ∈ IndependentSet ↔
      (Bundled.of M : Bundled.{w} sizedGraph.Structure) ∈ IndependentSet := by
  have hsize : {x : Copies J M | RelMap sizedGraph.size ![x]}.ncard =
      Nat.card J * {x : M | RelMap sizedGraph.size ![x]}.ncard := by
    rw [← Copies.ncard_set_val]
    congr 1
    ext x
    exact Copies.relMap_copies_one _ x
  simp only [mem_IndependentSet]
  have := Fintype.ofFinite J
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S, hS, hind⟩
    have hS : S.ncard = Nat.card J * {x : M | RelMap sizedGraph.size ![x]}.ncard :=
      hS.trans hsize
    have hsum : S.ncard = ∑ j, {v : M | (⟨j, v⟩ : Copies J M) ∈ S}.ncard := by
      rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
      simp only [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
      rw [← Nat.card_sigma]
      exact Nat.card_congr
        { toFun := fun x => ⟨x.1.idx, x.1.val, x.2⟩
          invFun := fun p => ⟨⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩, p.2.2⟩
          left_inv := fun _ => rfl
          right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, {x : M | RelMap sizedGraph.size ![x]}.ncard ≤
        {v : M | (⟨j, v⟩ : Copies J M) ∈ S}.ncard := by
      by_contra h
      simp only [not_exists, not_le] at h
      have hlt := Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty (Finset.univ_nonempty (α := J)) fun j _ => h j
      rw [← hsum, hS, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
        at hlt
      exact lt_irrefl _ hlt
    obtain ⟨t, hts, ht⟩ := Set.exists_subset_card_eq hj
    refine ⟨t, ht, fun x hx y hy hxy hadj => ?_⟩
    refine hind (hts hx) (hts hy) (fun h => hxy (congrArg Copies.val h)) ?_
    exact (Copies.relMap_copies_two _ _ _).2 ⟨rfl, hadj⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hind⟩
    refine ⟨{x | x.val ∈ s},
      ((Copies.ncard_set_val (J := J) (N := M) s).trans (congrArg _ hs)).trans hsize.symm,
      fun x hx y hy hxy hadj => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hidx, hadj⟩ := (Copies.relMap_copies_two _ _ _).1 hadj
    refine hind hx hy (fun h => hxy ?_) hadj
    obtain ⟨i, a⟩ := x
    obtain ⟨j, b⟩ := y
    simp_all

theorem mem_independentSet_iff_satisfiable [Finite M] [Nontrivial M] :
    (Bundled.of (independentSetInterpretation.Model M) : Bundled.{w} sizedGraph.Structure) ∈
      sizedGraph.IndependentSet ↔ Satisfiable M := by
  rw [sizedGraph.mem_IndependentSet]
  change (∃ s : Set (independentSetInterpretation.Model M), _ ∧ _) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hind⟩
    have hs : s.ncard = Nat.card M := hs.trans ncard_size
    have hind : ∀ ⦃a⦄, a ∈ s → ∀ ⦃b⦄, b ∈ s → a ≠ b → ¬OccEdge a b :=
      fun a ha b hb hab h => hind ha hb hab ((relMap_adj_iff a b).2 h)
    -- every vertex of `s` is an occurrence
    have hocc : ∀ a ∈ s, a.1 ≠ .sizeV := by
      rintro ⟨t, d, hd⟩ ha (rfl : t = _)
      have h2 : 1 < s.ncard := by
        rw [hs]
        exact Finite.one_lt_card
      obtain ⟨a', ha', hne⟩ := Set.exists_ne_of_one_lt_ncard h2 ⟨.sizeV, d, hd⟩
      have hsv : (⟨.sizeV, d, hd⟩ : independentSetInterpretation.Model M) = sizeVertex (d 0) :=
        Model.ext_toSigma (Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq (funext fun (i : Fin 1) => by
          obtain rfl : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _; rfl)))
      exact hind ha ha' hne.symm (hsv ▸ occEdge_sizeVertex (d 0) a')
    -- each clause has exactly one vertex in `s`
    have hinj : Function.Injective fun a : s => vertexClause a.1 := by
      rintro ⟨⟨t, d, hd⟩, ha⟩ ⟨⟨t', d', hd'⟩, ha'⟩ h
      by_contra hne
      have hne' : (⟨t, d, hd⟩ : independentSetInterpretation.Model M) ≠ ⟨t', d', hd'⟩ :=
        fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h)
      cases t with
      | sizeV => exact hocc _ ha rfl
      | occ b =>
        cases t' with
        | sizeV => exact hocc _ ha' rfl
        | occ b' => exact hind ha ha' hne' (occEdge_of_clause_eq h)
    have hbij := hinj.bijective_of_nat_card_le (by rw [Nat.card_coe_set_eq, hs])
    refine ⟨fun x => ∃ a ∈ s, ∃ d hd, a = (⟨.occ true, d, hd⟩ : _) ∧ d 1 = x,
      (satisfies_iff _).2 fun c => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨t, d, hd⟩, ha⟩, hac⟩ := hbij.2 c
    cases t with
    | sizeV => exact (hocc _ ha rfl).elim
    | occ b =>
      have hl : (b, d 1) ∈ literals c := by
        rw [← hac]
        exact Formula.realize_rel₂.1 hd
      refine ⟨(b, d 1), hl, ?_⟩
      cases b
      · refine iff_of_false ?_ Bool.false_ne_true
        rintro ⟨a', ha', d', hd', rfl, hd1⟩
        exact hind ha ha' (fun h => absurd (congrArg Sigma.fst h) (by simp))
          (occEdge_of_complementary hd1.symm)
      · exact iff_of_true ⟨_, ha, d, hd, rfl, rfl⟩ rfl
  · rintro ⟨A, hA⟩
    choose l hl htrue using (satisfies_iff A).1 hA
    let f : M → independentSetInterpretation.Model M := fun c => occVertex c (l c) (hl c)
    have hf : Function.Injective f := fun c c' h => by
      have := congrArg vertexClause h
      exact this
    refine ⟨Set.range f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Eq.trans ?_ ncard_size.symm
      rw [← Set.image_univ, Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ hf, Set.ncard_univ]
    · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩ _ ⟨c', rfl⟩ hne h
      rcases occEdge_cases ((relMap_adj_iff _ _).1 h) with h | ⟨hb, hx⟩
      · change c' = c at h
        exact hne (h ▸ rfl)
      · change (l c').2 = (l c).2 at hx
        have h₁ := htrue c
        have h₂ := htrue c'
        rw [hx, hb] at h₂
        cases (l c).1 <;> simp_all

theorem trans [L''.IsRelational] {K : Set (Bundled.{w} L.Structure)}
    {K' : Set (Bundled.{w} L'.Structure)} {K'' : Set (Bundled.{w} L''.Structure)}
    (h : Reduces K K') (h' : Reduces K' K'') (hK'' : IsoClosed K'') : Reduces K K'' := by
  obtain ⟨ι, _, I, hI⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨κ, _, J, hJ⟩ := h'
  refine ⟨κ × ι, inferInstance, J.comp I, fun M _ => ?_⟩
  rw [hI M, hJ (Bundled.of (I.Model M))]
  exact hK'' (Interpretation.compEquiv J I)

    {K' : Set (Bundled.{w} L'.Structure)} (I : Interpretation L L' Unit)
    (h : ∀ (M : Bundled.{w} L.Structure) [Finite M],

    (hK' : IsoClosed K') (hdom : ∀ (M : Type w) [L.Structure M] [Finite M] (x : M),

theorem subformulas_subset {n k : ℕ} {φ : L.BoundedFormula α n} {ψ : L.BoundedFormula α k}
    (h : ⟨k, ψ⟩ ∈ subformulas φ) : subformulas ψ ⊆ subformulas φ := by
  induction φ with
  | falsum | equal | rel =>
    cases Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 h
    exact subset_rfl
  | imp φ₁ φ₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    rcases h with h | h | h
    · cases h
      exact subset_rfl
    · exact (ih₁ h).trans (Set.subset_union_left.trans (Set.subset_insert _ _))
    · exact (ih₂ h).trans (Set.subset_union_right.trans (Set.subset_insert _ _))
  | all φ₁ ih =>
    rcases h with h | h
    · cases h
      exact subset_rfl
    · exact (ih h).trans (Set.subset_insert _ _)

theorem disjoint_agreeOffForced {x x' : BitString N} (hx : φ.eval x = true) (hx' : φ.eval x' = true)
    (hne : x ≠ x') : Disjoint (φ.agreeOffForced σ x) (φ.agreeOffForced σ x') := by
  refine disjoint_left.2 fun y hy hy' => ?_
  -- the first variable where `x` and `x'` differ
  have hdiff : (univ.filter fun v => x v ≠ x' v).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Function.ne_iff.1 hne
    exact ⟨v, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ v, hv⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hmin⟩ := exists_min_image _ (fun v => σ v) hdiff
  have hxv : x v ≠ x' v := (mem_filter.1 hv).2
  have hagree : ∀ u, σ u < σ v → x u = x' u := fun u hu => by

private theorem factorial_le_card_mul_card_filter_mem_forced {x : BitString N} {i : Fin N}
    {c : Clause (Fin N)} (hc : c ∈ φ) (hcrit : Critical x c i) :
    N.factorial ≤ (c.map Prod.fst).toFinset.card *
      (univ.filter fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) => i ∈ φ.forced σ x).card := by
  obtain ⟨hic, hrest⟩ := hcrit
  set S := (c.map Prod.fst).toFinset
  have hiS : i ∈ S := List.mem_toFinset.2 (List.mem_map.2 ⟨_, hic, rfl⟩)
  have hlast := Equiv.Perm.card_mul_card_filter_forall_le_eq_factorial hiS
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hlast
  refine hlast.ge.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (card_le_card ?_))
  intro σ hσ
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hσ
  refine mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ σ, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ i, c, hc, hic, fun l hl hne => ?_⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨hli, hxl⟩ := hrest l hl hne
  have hle := hσ l.1 (List.mem_toFinset.2 (List.mem_map.2 ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩))
  exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun h => hli (σ.injective h), hxl⟩

    (hi : φ.eval (Function.update x i (!x i)) = false) :
    N.factorial ≤ k * (univ.filter fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) => i ∈ φ.forced σ x).card := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcrit⟩ := exists_critical hx hi
  have hS : (c.map Prod.fst).toFinset.card ≤ k :=
    (List.toFinset_card_le _).trans ((List.length_map _).trans_le (hk c hc))
  exact (factorial_le_card_mul_card_filter_mem_forced hc hcrit).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hS)

theorem eval_implicationCycle (σ : V → Bool) (vs : List V) :
    (implicationCycle vs).eval σ = true ↔ ∀ x ∈ vs, ∀ y ∈ vs, σ x = σ y := by
  cases vs with
  | nil => simp [implicationCycle]
  | cons first rest =>
    constructor
    · intro h x hx y hy
      have he (z) (hz : z ∈ first :: rest) : σ z = σ first :=
        le_antisymm (path_each_le_first σ first first rest h z hz)
          (root_le_path σ first first first rest le_rfl h z hz)
      exact (he x hx).trans (he y hy).symm
    · intro h
      have hp (current : V) (tail : List V) (hc : current ∈ first :: rest)
          (ht : ∀ x ∈ tail, x ∈ first :: rest) :
          (implicationPath first current tail).eval σ = true := by
        induction tail generalizing current with
        | nil =>
          simpa only [implicationPath, eval_cons, eval_nil, Bool.and_true,
            eval_implication] using (le_of_eq (h current hc first List.mem_cons_self))
        | cons next tail ih =>
          simp only [implicationPath, eval_cons, Bool.and_eq_true, eval_implication]
          exact ⟨(le_of_eq (h current hc next (ht next List.mem_cons_self))),
            ih next (ht next List.mem_cons_self)
              (fun x hx => ht x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))⟩
      exact hp first rest List.mem_cons_self (fun _ hx => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)

      rw [ih next]

    (fallback : W) (τ : V → Bool) (σ : W → Bool)
    (hne : ∀ o ∈ Cslib.Logic.PL.occurrences φ, wire o ≠ [])
    (hcompat : ∀ o ∈ Cslib.Logic.PL.occurrences φ, ∀ c ∈ wire o,
      σ c.1 = τ o.2.2.1 ∧ σ c.2 = τ o.2.2.1)

    intro c hc
    have hclause := (eval_eq_true_iff τ φ).1 h c.1 (List.fst_mem_of_mem_zipIdx hc)
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hv⟩ := (Clause.eval_eq_true_iff τ c.1).1 hclause

    refine ⟨li, hli, ?_⟩

    intro o ho

theorem eval_formula_iff (σ : Variable → Bool) :
    formula.eval σ = true ↔
      Crossover.splitFormula.eval (σ ∘ representative) = true ∧
        ∀ s, σ (terminal s 0) = σ (terminal s 1) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hc := CNF.eval_eq_true_iff σ formula |>.1 h
    have hr : ∀ v i, σ (.copy v i) = σ (.copy v 0) := by
      intro v
      apply (Crossover.eval_ring_iff (σ ∘ representative) v).1
      rw [← CNF.eval_relabel]
      exact (CNF.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).2 fun c hc' => hc c (ring_mem v c hc')
    have hp : ∀ s, σ (terminal s 0) = σ (terminal s 1) := by
      intro s
      have hchain := (CNF.eval_eq_true_iff σ (chain s)).2 fun c hc' => hc c (chain_mem s c hc')
      have heq : σ (chainStart s) = σ (chainEnd s) := by
        fin_cases s <;> exact (hr _ _).trans (hr _ _).symm
      exact (eval_chain hchain heq).1.trans (eval_chain hchain heq).2.symm
    refine ⟨?_, hp⟩
    rw [formula, CNF.eval_append, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    rw [eval_mapped σ hp] at h
    exact h.1
  · rintro ⟨h, hp⟩
    rw [formula, CNF.eval_append, Bool.and_eq_true, eval_mapped σ hp]
    refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
    simp only [terminal] at hp
    simp [bridges, CNF.eval, Clause.eval, Literal.eval, ← hp]

    σ = canonicalExtension (σ (terminal 0 0)) (σ (terminal 2 0)) := by
  obtain ⟨hb, hp⟩ := (eval_formula_iff σ).1 h

  funext v
  cases v with
  | center => exact congrFun heq .center
  | copy v i => exact congrFun heq (.copy v i)
  | port s l =>
    have hs : σ (terminal s 0) = canonicalExtension (σ (terminal 0 0))
        (σ (terminal 2 0)) (terminal s l) := by
      fin_cases s
      · exact congrFun heq .aLeft
      · exact congrFun heq .aRight
      · exact congrFun heq .bTop
      · exact congrFun heq .bBottom
    fin_cases l
    · exact hs
    · exact (hp s).symm.trans hs

      intro x hx

theorem modelCount_toThreeOccurrence [DecidableEq V] (φ : CNF V) :
    φ.toThreeOccurrence.modelCount = φ.modelCount := by
  classical
  have hmem (x : V × ℕ × ℕ) :
      x ∈ φ.toThreeOccurrence.vars ↔ x ∈ φ.occurrenceClauses.vars := by
    simp only [← List.count_pos_iff, count_vars_toThreeOccurrence]
    omega
  have hfst {x : V × ℕ × ℕ} (hx : x ∈ φ.occurrenceClauses.vars) : x.1 ∈ φ.vars := by
    rw [← map_fst_vars_occurrenceClauses]
    exact List.mem_map.2 ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hex (v : φ.vars.toFinset) : ∃ x ∈ φ.occurrenceClauses.vars, x.1 = v := by
    apply List.mem_map.1
    simpa only [map_fst_vars_occurrenceClauses] using List.mem_toFinset.1 v.2
  let copy (v : φ.vars.toFinset) : V × ℕ × ℕ := Classical.choose (hex v)
  have hcopy (v : φ.vars.toFinset) : copy v ∈ φ.occurrenceClauses.vars ∧ (copy v).1 = v :=
    Classical.choose_spec (hex v)
  let f (τ : V × ℕ × ℕ → Bool) (v : φ.vars.toFinset) : Bool := τ (copy v)
  refine modelCount_eq_card_filter f (fun τ => φ.eval (φ.extendAssignment τ) = true)
    (fun σ τ hσ hτ => ?_) fun τ => ?_
  · constructor
    · intro he x hx
      have hx := (hmem x).1 hx
      let v : φ.vars.toFinset := ⟨x.1, List.mem_toFinset.2 (hfst hx)⟩
      calc σ x = σ (copy v) := copies_agree hσ hx (hcopy v).1 (hcopy v).2.symm
        _ = τ (copy v) := congrFun he v
        _ = τ x := copies_agree hτ (hcopy v).1 hx (hcopy v).2
    · intro he
      exact funext fun v => he (copy v) ((hmem _).2 (hcopy v).1)
  · constructor
    · intro hτ
      refine ⟨φ.extendAssignment τ ∘ Prod.fst, ?_, funext fun v => ?_⟩
      · exact (eval_toThreeOccurrence_iff φ _).2 ⟨φ.extendAssignment τ, hτ, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
      · change φ.extendAssignment τ (copy v).1 = τ v
        rw [(hcopy v).2, extendAssignment_of_mem _ (List.mem_toFinset.1 v.2)]
    · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩
      rw [← eval_occurrenceClauses]

        intro x hx
        change φ.extendAssignment (f σ) x.1 = σ x

      simp only [toThreeOccurrence, eval_append, Bool.and_eq_true] at ht
      exact (eval_congr he).trans ht.1

/-- **A formula of width at most two is satisfiable** when it has no empty clause and no variable
`x` with a path from `x` to `¬x` and one back [Aspvall, Plass and Tarjan][AspvallPlassTarjan1979].
-/
theorem CNF.satisfiable_of_width_le_two {φ : CNF V} (hw : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length ≤ 2)
    (hnil : [] ∉ φ)
    (hreach : ∀ v, ¬ (Relation.ReflTransGen φ.Implies (v, true) (v, false) ∧
      Relation.ReflTransGen φ.Implies (v, false) (v, true))) :
    φ.Satisfiable := by
  -- induction on the number of variables
  induction hn : φ.vars.toFinset.card using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing φ with
  | _ n ih =>
  by_cases hvars : φ.vars = []
  · -- without variables every clause is empty, so there is none
    have hφ : φ = [] := by
      rcases φ with _ | ⟨c, φ⟩
      · rfl
      · have hc : c ≠ [] := fun h => hnil (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self)
        obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil c hc
        have : l.1 ∈ CNF.vars (c :: φ) := CNF.mem_vars.mpr ⟨c, List.mem_cons_self, l.2, hl⟩
        rw [hvars] at this
        exact absurd this (List.not_mem_nil)
    subst hφ
    exact ⟨fun _ => true, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hvars
  -- a literal of `x` with no path to its negation
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓx, hℓ⟩ : ∃ ℓ : Literal V, ℓ.1 = x ∧
      ¬ Relation.ReflTransGen φ.Implies ℓ ℓ.negate := by
    by_cases h : Relation.ReflTransGen φ.Implies (x, true) (x, false)
    · exact ⟨(x, false), rfl, fun h' => hreach x ⟨h, h'⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨(x, true), rfl, h⟩
  -- the literals reachable from `ℓ` are made true
  let R : Literal V → Prop := fun m => Relation.ReflTransGen φ.Implies ℓ m
  have hcons : ∀ m, R m → ¬ R m.negate := by
    intro m hm hm'
    have h' := CNF.reach_negate hm'
    rw [negate_negate] at h'
    exact hℓ (hm.trans h')
  -- the remaining clauses
  let ψ : CNF V := φ.filter fun c => ∀ m ∈ c, ¬ R m ∧ ¬ R m.negate
  have hψφ : ∀ c ∈ ψ, c ∈ φ := fun c hc => (List.mem_filter.mp hc).1
  have hψvars : ψ.vars.toFinset ⊂ φ.vars.toFinset := by
    rw [Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset]
    · refine ⟨x, List.mem_toFinset.mpr hx, fun hx' => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨c, hc, b, hb⟩ := CNF.mem_vars.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp hx')
      have hall := of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.mp hc).2
      have hm := hall _ hb
      have : (x, b) = ℓ ∨ (x, b) = ℓ.negate := by
        obtain ⟨y, b'⟩ := ℓ
        simp only at hℓx
        subst hℓx
        cases b <;> cases b' <;> simp [Std.Sat.Literal.negate]
      rcases this with h | h
      · exact hm.1 (h ▸ .refl)
      · exact hm.2 (by rw [h, negate_negate])
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨c, hc, b, hb⟩ := CNF.mem_vars.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp hy)
      exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (CNF.mem_vars.mpr ⟨c, hψφ c hc, b, hb⟩)
  obtain ⟨σ', hσ'⟩ := ih _ (hn ▸ Finset.card_lt_card hψvars)
    (fun c hc => hw c (hψφ c hc)) (fun h => hnil (hψφ _ h))
    (fun v ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => hreach v
      ⟨Relation.ReflTransGen.mono (fun _ _ (h : ψ.Implies _ _) => h.mono hψφ) _ _ h₁,
        Relation.ReflTransGen.mono (fun _ _ (h : ψ.Implies _ _) => h.mono hψφ) _ _ h₂⟩) rfl
  -- the combined assignment
  let σ : V → Bool := fun v => if R (v, true) then true else if R (v, false) then false else σ' v
  have hR : ∀ m, R m → σ m.1 = m.2 := by
    rintro ⟨v, b⟩ hm
    cases b
    · have : ¬ R (v, true) := fun h => hcons _ hm (by simpa [Std.Sat.Literal.negate] using h)
      simp [σ, this, hm]
    · simp [σ, hm]
  refine ⟨σ, (CNF.eval_eq_true_iff σ φ).mpr fun c hc => ?_⟩
  by_cases hcψ : ∀ m ∈ c, ¬ R m ∧ ¬ R m.negate
  · -- an untouched clause, satisfied by `σ'`
    have hcψ' : c ∈ ψ := List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hc, decide_eq_true hcψ⟩
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmσ⟩ := (Clause.eval_eq_true_iff σ' c).mp
      ((CNF.eval_eq_true_iff σ' ψ).mp hσ' c hcψ')
    refine (Clause.eval_eq_true_iff σ c).mpr ⟨m, hm, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨v, b⟩ := m
    have h := hcψ _ hm
    have h₁₂ : ¬ R (v, true) ∧ ¬ R (v, false) := by
      cases b
      · exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
      · exact h
    simpa [σ, h₁₂.1, h₁₂.2] using hmσ
  · -- a clause with a literal made true or false
    push Not at hcψ
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmR⟩ := hcψ
    refine (Clause.eval_eq_true_iff σ c).mpr ?_
    by_cases hRm : R m
    · exact ⟨m, hm, hR m hRm⟩
    · obtain ⟨b, hb, hcb⟩ := exists_other (hw c hc) hm
      have harc : φ.Implies m.negate b :=
        ⟨c, hc, by rwa [negate_negate], hb, fun y hy => by rw [negate_negate]; exact hcb y hy⟩
      exact ⟨b, hb, hR b ((hmR hRm).tail harc)⟩

theorem CNF.IsExactThreeDistinct.unsatVal_le_one_eighth {φ : CNF V}
    (hφ : φ.IsExactThreeDistinct) : φ.unsatVal ≤ 1 / 8 := by
  classical
  let S : Finset V := φ.vars.toFinset
  let toVar (v : V) : Option S := if h : v ∈ S then some ⟨v, h⟩ else none
  have hφ' : (φ.relabel toVar).IsExactThreeDistinct := by
    intro c' hc'
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hc'
    refine (hφ c hc).relabel_of_injOn fun x hx y hy hxy => ?_
    obtain ⟨lx, hlx, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
    obtain ⟨ly, hly, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy
    have hxS : lx.1 ∈ S := List.mem_toFinset.2 (CNF.mem_vars.2 ⟨c, hc, lx.2, hlx⟩)
    have hyS : ly.1 ∈ S := List.mem_toFinset.2 (CNF.mem_vars.2 ⟨c, hc, ly.2, hly⟩)
    simp only [toVar, hxS, hyS, ↓reduceDIte, Option.some.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq] at hxy
    exact hxy
  have hle : φ.unsatVal ≤ (φ.relabel toVar).unsatVal := by
    refine le_ciInf fun τ => ?_
    rw [CNF.countUnsat_relabel, CNF.relabel, List.length_map]
    exact φ.unsatVal_le (τ ∘ toVar)
  refine hle.trans ?_
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (φ.relabel toVar).length with h0 | hpos
  · have hsat : (φ.relabel toVar).Satisfiable :=
      ⟨fun _ => false, by rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff.1 h0]; rfl⟩
    rw [(CNF.unsatVal_eq_zero_iff _).2 hsat]
    norm_num
  · have hlen : (0 : ℝ) < (φ.relabel toVar).length := by exact_mod_cast hpos
    have hle' : (φ.relabel toVar).unsatVal ≤
        𝔼 σ : Option S → Bool, ((φ.relabel toVar).countUnsat σ : ℝ) / (φ.relabel toVar).length := by
      simpa only [Fintype.expect_const] using
        expect_le_expect (s := univ) fun σ _ => (φ.relabel toVar).unsatVal_le σ
    rw [← expect_div, hφ'.expect_countUnsat, div_right_comm, div_self hlen.ne'] at hle'
    exact hle'

theorem ClauseSet.sparsification (k : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (φ : ClauseSet V),
      (∀ C ∈ φ, C.card ≤ k) →
      ∃ Ψ : Finset (ClauseSet V), (Ψ.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (ε * Fintype.card V) ∧
        (∀ ψ ∈ Ψ, (∀ C ∈ ψ, C.card ≤ k) ∧ (∀ v, ψ.occurrences v ≤ c) ∧
          ψ.solutions ⊆ φ.solutions) ∧
        φ.solutions ⊆ Ψ.biUnion ClauseSet.solutions := by
  set K := max k 1
  have hK : 1 ≤ K := le_max_right _ _
  obtain ⟨α, hα, hcount⟩ := Sparsification.exists_sum_choose_le hK hε
  have hθ := Sparsification.one_le_threshold hK hα
  refine ⟨2 * ∑ j ∈ range K, Sparsification.threshold K α j, fun V _ _ φ hφ => ?_⟩
  have hφK : ∀ C ∈ φ, C.card ≤ K := fun C hC => (hφ C hC).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hcard, hleaves, hcover⟩ := Sparsification.exists_leaves hK hα φ hφK
  refine ⟨Ψ, (Nat.cast_le.mpr hcard).trans (by exact_mod_cast hcount (Fintype.card V)),
    fun ψ hψ => ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨hsparse, hrefine, hsat⟩ := hleaves ψ hψ
    have hψK : ∀ C ∈ ψ, C.card ≤ K := fun C hC => by
      obtain ⟨D, hD, hCD⟩ := hrefine C hC
      exact (card_le_card hCD).trans (hφK D hD)
    refine ⟨fun C hC => ?_, Sparsification.occurrences_le_of_sparse hθ hsparse hψK, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨D, hD, hCD⟩ := hrefine C hC
      exact (card_le_card hCD).trans (hφ D hD)
    · exact mem_solutions.mpr (hsat x (mem_solutions.mp hx))
  · obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hψx⟩ := hcover x (mem_solutions.mp hx)
    exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨ψ, hψ, mem_solutions.mpr hψx⟩

    ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (φ : CNF V), (∀ cl ∈ φ, cl.length ≤ k) →

        (∀ F ∈ Fs, (∀ cl ∈ F, cl.length ≤ k) ∧ (∀ v, F.occurrences v ≤ c) ∧
          ∀ x, F.eval x = true → φ.eval x = true) ∧
        ∀ x, φ.eval x = true → ∃ F ∈ Fs, F.eval x = true := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ClauseSet.sparsification k hε
  refine ⟨c, fun V _ _ φ hφ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hcard, hleaves, hcover⟩ := hc V φ.toClauseSet fun C hC => by
    obtain ⟨cl, hcl, hle⟩ := CNF.exists_card_le_of_mem_toClauseSet hC

    rw [← CNF.sat_toClauseSet_iff, ← ClauseSet.mem_solutions]

private theorem card_introduced_le (P : Path (threshold k α) V) (hk0 : ∀ C ∈ P.node 0, C.card ≤ k)
    (hleaf : Sparse (threshold k α) (P.node P.len)) (U : Finset V)
    (hU : ∀ C ∈ P.node 0, ∀ l ∈ C, l.1 ∈ U) :
    P.introduced.card ≤ U.card * (k * base k α ^ (2 * k)) := by
  have hθ := one_le_threshold hk hα
  calc P.introduced.card = ∑ c ∈ Ico 1 k, (P.introducedOfCard c).card :=
        P.card_introduced_eq_sum hθ hk0
    _ ≤ ∑ _c ∈ Ico 1 k, U.card * base k α ^ (2 * k) := by
        refine sum_le_sum fun c hc => ?_
        obtain ⟨hc1, hck⟩ := mem_Ico.mp hc
        refine (card_introducedOfCard_le_pow hk hα P hleaf U hU c hc1 hck.le).trans ?_
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (one_le_base hk hα) (by omega))
    _ ≤ U.card * (k * base k α ^ (2 * k)) := by
        rw [sum_const, Nat.card_Ico, smul_eq_mul]
        calc (k - 1) * (U.card * base k α ^ (2 * k))
            ≤ k * (U.card * base k α ^ (2 * k)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.sub_le k 1)
          _ = U.card * (k * base k α ^ (2 * k)) := by ring

theorem card_node_le (P : Path (threshold k α) V) (hk0 : ∀ C ∈ P.node 0, C.card ≤ k)
    (hleaf : Sparse (threshold k α) (P.node P.len)) (U : Finset V)
    (hU : ∀ C ∈ P.node 0, ∀ l ∈ C, l.1 ∈ U) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ P.len) :
    (P.node i).card ≤ (P.node 0).card + U.card * (k * base k α ^ (2 * k)) := by
  have hθ := one_le_threshold hk hα
  have hsub : ∀ i ≤ P.len, P.node i ⊆ P.node 0 ∪ P.introduced := by
    intro i hi
    induction i with
    | zero => exact subset_union_left
    | succ i ih =>
      refine (P.node_succ_subset (by omega)).trans (union_subset (ih (by omega)) ?_)
      exact (subset_biUnion_of_mem P.introAt (mem_range.mpr (by omega))).trans
        subset_union_right
  calc (P.node i).card ≤ (P.node 0 ∪ P.introduced).card := card_le_card (hsub i hi)
    _ ≤ (P.node 0).card + P.introduced.card := card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ (P.node 0).card + U.card * (k * base k α ^ (2 * k)) :=
        Nat.add_le_add_left (card_introduced_le hk hα P hk0 hleaf U hU) _

theorem mul_card_petal_le (P : Path (threshold k α) V) (hk0 : ∀ C ∈ P.node 0, C.card ≤ k)
    (hleaf : Sparse (threshold k α) (P.node P.len)) (U : Finset V)
    (hU : ∀ C ∈ P.node 0, ∀ l ∈ C, l.1 ∈ U) :
    α * ((range P.len).filter fun i => P.dir i = true).card ≤ (k - 1) * U.card := by
  have hθ := one_le_threshold hk hα
  have hj : ∀ j ∈ Ico 1 k, α * (P.petalSteps j).card ≤ U.card := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨hj1, hjk⟩ := mem_Ico.mp hj
    have h1 := P.mul_card_petalSteps_le hθ j
    have h2 := card_introducedOfCard_le_pow hk hα P hleaf U hU j hj1 hjk.le
    rw [threshold_of_one_le hj1] at h1
    have hpos : 0 < base k α ^ (2 * j - 1) := pow_pos (one_le_base hk hα) _
    have : α * (P.petalSteps j).card * base k α ^ (2 * j - 1) ≤
        U.card * base k α ^ (2 * j - 1) := by
      calc α * (P.petalSteps j).card * base k α ^ (2 * j - 1)
          = α * base k α ^ (2 * j - 1) * (P.petalSteps j).card := by ring
        _ ≤ U.card * base k α ^ (2 * j - 1) := h1.trans h2
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right this hpos
  calc α * ((range P.len).filter fun i => P.dir i = true).card
      ≤ α * ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 k, (P.petalSteps j).card :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (P.card_petal_le_sum hθ hk0)
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 k, α * (P.petalSteps j).card := mul_sum _ _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Ico 1 k, U.card := sum_le_sum hj
    _ = (k - 1) * U.card := by rw [sum_const, Nat.card_Ico, smul_eq_mul]

theorem card_le_of_isLeafWord (W : Finset (List Bool)) (hW : ∀ w ∈ W, R.IsLeafWord s w) :
    W.card ≤ ∑ j ∈ range ((k - 1) * U.card / α + 1),
      (U.card * (k * base k α ^ (2 * k))).choose j := by
  classical
  set Λ := U.card * (k * base k α ^ (2 * k))
  set ρ := (k - 1) * U.card / α
  let pos (w : List Bool) : Finset ℕ := (range Λ).filter fun i => w.getD i false = true
  have hpos : ∀ w ∈ W, pos w ∈ (range Λ).powerset.filter (·.card ≤ ρ) := by
    intro w hw
    have hlen := (hW w hw).length_le hk hα hred hk0 U hU
    refine mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_powerset.mpr (filter_subset _ _), ?_⟩
    refine (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).mpr ((Nat.mul_comm _ _).trans_le
      ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left α (card_le_card fun i hi => ?_)).trans
        ((hW w hw).mul_card_le hk hα hred hk0 U hU)))
    obtain ⟨-, hi⟩ := mem_filter.mp hi
    refine mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr ?_, hi⟩
    by_contra hge
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)] at hi
    exact Bool.false_ne_true hi
  have hinj : Set.InjOn pos W := by
    intro w hw w' hw' h
    refine (hW w hw).eq_of_getD_eq (hW w' hw') fun i => ?_
    by_cases hi : i < Λ
    · have := congrArg (i ∈ ·) h
      simp only [pos, mem_filter, mem_range, hi, true_and, eq_iff_iff] at this
      cases hwi : w.getD i false <;> cases hw'i : w'.getD i false <;> simp_all
    · have hl := (hW w hw).length_le hk hα hred hk0 U hU
      have hl' := (hW w' hw').length_le hk hα hred hk0 U hU
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega),
        List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]
  calc W.card = (W.image pos).card := (card_image_of_injOn hinj).symm
    _ ≤ ((range Λ).powerset.filter (·.card ≤ ρ)).card :=
        card_le_card fun t ht => by
          obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp ht
          exact hpos w hw
    _ ≤ ((range (ρ + 1)).biUnion fun j => (range Λ).powersetCard j).card := by
        refine card_le_card fun t ht => ?_
        obtain ⟨htΛ, htρ⟩ := mem_filter.mp ht
        exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨t.card, mem_range.mpr (by omega),
          mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨mem_powerset.mp htΛ, rfl⟩⟩
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (ρ + 1), ((range Λ).powersetCard j).card := card_biUnion_le
    _ = ∑ j ∈ range (ρ + 1), Λ.choose j := by
        refine sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        rw [card_powersetCard, card_range]

theorem occurrences_le_of_sparse {θ : ℕ → ℕ} (hθ : ∀ j, 1 ≤ θ j) {ψ : ClauseSet V}
    (hsparse : Sparse θ ψ) (hk : ∀ C ∈ ψ, C.card ≤ k) (v : V) :
    ψ.occurrences v ≤ 2 * ∑ c ∈ range k, θ c := by
  have hsub : ψ.filter (fun C => ∃ l ∈ C, l.1 = v) ⊆
      (univ : Finset Bool).biUnion fun p =>
        (Ico 1 (k + 1)).biUnion fun c => flower ψ c {⟨v, p⟩} := by
    intro C hC
    obtain ⟨hCψ, l, hl, hlv⟩ := mem_filter.mp hC
    have hCpos : 1 ≤ C.card := card_pos.mpr ⟨l, hl⟩
    have hleq : l = ⟨v, l.2⟩ := by cases l; simp_all
    refine mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨l.2, mem_univ _, mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨C.card,
      mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hCpos, by have := hk C hCψ; omega⟩, mem_flower.mpr ⟨hCψ, rfl, ?_⟩⟩⟩
    rw [singleton_subset_iff, ← hleq]
    exact hl
  calc ψ.occurrences v ≤ ((univ : Finset Bool).biUnion fun p =>
        (Ico 1 (k + 1)).biUnion fun c => flower ψ c {⟨v, p⟩}).card := card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ p : Bool, ((Ico 1 (k + 1)).biUnion fun c => flower ψ c {⟨v, p⟩}).card :=
        card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _p : Bool, ∑ c ∈ Ico 1 (k + 1), θ (c - 1) := by
        refine sum_le_sum fun p _ => card_biUnion_le.trans (sum_le_sum fun c hc => ?_)
        exact card_flower_singleton_le_of_sparse hθ hsparse (mem_Ico.mp hc).1 _
    _ = 2 * ∑ c ∈ range k, θ c := by
        rw [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_bool, smul_eq_mul, sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
        simp

private theorem exists_mem_hearts {k : ℕ} {C : Clause V} (hk : C.length ≤ k)
    {H' : Finset (Literal V)} (hH' : H' ⊆ C.toFinset) : ∃ H ∈ hearts k C, H.toFinset = H' := by
  set S := (C.zipIdx.filter fun p => decide (p.1 ∈ H')).map Prod.snd
  have hS : S ∈ (List.range k).sublists := by
    refine List.mem_sublists.mpr (List.Sublist.trans ?_ (List.range_sublist.mpr hk))
    rw [List.range_eq_range', ← List.zipIdx_map_snd]
    exact List.filter_sublist.map _
  -- an entry of the clause is selected exactly when its literal is in `H'`
  have hsel : ∀ p ∈ C.zipIdx, (S.any fun i => i == p.2) = decide (p.1 ∈ H') := by
    intro p hp
    rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, List.any_eq_true, decide_eq_true_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, hip⟩
      rw [beq_iff_eq] at hip
      obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hi
      obtain ⟨hqz, hqH⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hq
      have h₁ := List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mp hqz
      have h₂ := List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mp hp
      rw [hip, h₂, Option.some_inj] at h₁
      rw [h₁]
      exact of_decide_eq_true hqH
    · intro hpH
      exact ⟨p.2, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p, List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hp, decide_eq_true hpH⟩, rfl⟩,
        beq_self_eq_true _⟩
  refine ⟨_, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [List.filter_congr hsel]
  ext l
  rw [List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.mp hp).2
  · intro hl
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp (hH' hl))
    exact ⟨(C[i], i), List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mpr
      (List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi), decide_eq_true hl⟩, rfl⟩

theorem choice_spec {θ : ℕ → ℕ} (hθ : ∀ j, 1 ≤ θ j) {k : ℕ} {ψ : CNF V} (h : Normalized k ψ)
    (hns : ¬ Sparse θ ψ.toClauseSet) :
    Choice θ ψ.toClauseSet (choice θ k ψ).1 (choice θ k ψ).2.toFinset ∧
      (choice θ k ψ).2.Nodup := by
  set hc := (candidates k ψ).filter (heavy θ ψ)
  set g : ℕ → List (ℕ × Clause V) := fun r => hc.filter fun x => rank k x == r
  -- every heavy heart is a heavy candidate in the block of its rank
  have hcand : ∀ c H', Heavy θ ψ.toClauseSet c H' →
      ∃ y ∈ hc, y.1 = c ∧ y.2.toFinset = H' ∧ y ∈ g (rank k y) := by
    intro c H' hH'
    obtain ⟨H, hH, hHeq⟩ := h.exists_mem_candidates hθ hH'
    have hy : (c, H) ∈ hc := List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hH, (heavy_eq_true_iff h
      (h.nodup_of_mem_candidates hH)).mpr (hHeq ▸ hH')⟩
    exact ⟨(c, H), hy, rfl, hHeq, List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hy, beq_self_eq_true _⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨c₀, H₀, hH₀⟩ : ∃ c H, Heavy θ ψ.toClauseSet c H := by
    simpa [Sparse] using hns
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, -, hy₀g⟩ := hcand c₀ H₀ hH₀
  have hy₀R : rank k y₀ < (k + 1) * (k + 1) + 1 := rank_lt h (List.mem_filter.mp hy₀).1
  -- the head of the blocks
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, ((List.range ((k + 1) * (k + 1) + 1)).flatMap g).head? = some x := by
    rcases hhead : ((List.range ((k + 1) * (k + 1) + 1)).flatMap g).head? with _ | x
    · exfalso
      have := List.flatMap_eq_nil_iff.mp (List.head?_eq_none_iff.mp hhead) (rank k y₀)
        (List.mem_range.mpr hy₀R)
      rw [this] at hy₀g
      simp at hy₀g
    · exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hchoice : choice θ k ψ = x := by
    simp only [choice]
    rw [show (List.range ((k + 1) * (k + 1) + 1)).flatMap g = _ from rfl, hx, Option.getD_some]
  obtain ⟨r, -, hxr, hmin⟩ := exists_of_head?_flatMap_range g hx
  obtain ⟨hxhc, hxr'⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hxr
  rw [beq_iff_eq] at hxr'
  obtain ⟨hxcand, hxheavy⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hxhc
  have hxnd := h.nodup_of_mem_candidates hxcand
  -- a heavy candidate `y` has rank at least that of `x`
  have hle : ∀ y ∈ hc, y ∈ g (rank k y) → rank k x ≤ rank k y := by
    intro y _ hyg
    by_contra hlt
    rw [hmin (rank k y) (by omega)] at hyg
    simp at hyg
  have hlen (y : ℕ × Clause V) (hy : y ∈ candidates k ψ) : y.2.length ≤ k := by
    obtain ⟨C, hC, -, hsub⟩ := mem_candidates hy
    exact hsub.length_le.trans (h.length_le C hC)
  rw [hchoice]
  refine ⟨⟨(heavy_eq_true_iff h hxnd).mp hxheavy, fun c' H' hH' => ?_, fun H' hH' => ?_⟩, hxnd⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl, -, hyg⟩ := hcand c' H' hH'
    exact (le_of_rank_le (hlen x hxcand) (hlen y (List.mem_filter.mp hy).1)
      (hle y hy hyg)).1
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hy1, rfl, hyg⟩ := hcand x.1 H' hH'
    have hynd := h.nodup_of_mem_candidates (List.mem_filter.mp hy).1
    rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hynd, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hxnd]
    exact (le_of_rank_le (hlen x hxcand) (hlen y (List.mem_filter.mp hy).1)
      (hle y hy hyg)).2 hy1.symm

private theorem normalized_child {θ : ℕ → ℕ} (hθ : ∀ j, 1 ≤ θ j) {k : ℕ} {ψ : CNF V}
    (h : Normalized k ψ) {c : ℕ} {H : Clause V} (hH : H.Nodup)
    (hheavy : Heavy θ ψ.toClauseSet c H.toFinset) (b : Bool) : Normalized k (child ψ c H b) := by
  have hsub : child ψ c H b <+ ψ ++ intro ψ c H b := reduce_sublist _
  -- the introduced clauses are new, distinct, without repetitions and narrower
  have hintro : ∀ C ∈ intro ψ c H b, C.Nodup ∧
      ∃ D ∈ ψ, C.toFinset ⊂ D.toFinset := by
    intro C hC
    have hC' : C.toFinset ∈ ClauseSet.Sparsification.intro ψ.toClauseSet c H.toFinset b := by
      rw [← toClauseSet_intro h.nodup]
      exact mem_toClauseSet.mpr ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨D', hD', hlt⟩ := exists_flower_ssuperset hθ hheavy hC'
    obtain ⟨D, hD, rfl⟩ := mem_toClauseSet.mp (flower_subset _ _ _ hD')
    refine ⟨?_, D, hD, hlt⟩
    cases b
    · simp only [intro, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, List.mem_singleton] at hC
      exact hC ▸ hH
    · simp only [intro, ite_true, petals, List.mem_map] at hC
      obtain ⟨E, hE, rfl⟩ := hC
      exact (h.nodup E (List.filter_sublist.subset hE)).filter _
  have hnodupIntro : ((intro ψ c H b).map List.toFinset).Nodup := by
    cases b
    · simp [intro]
    · simp only [intro, ite_true, petals, List.map_map]
      refine List.Nodup.map_on ?_ (((List.filter_sublist).map _).nodup h.nodup_toFinset |>.of_map _)
      intro E hE F hF heq
      have hE' := List.mem_filter.mp hE
      have hF' := List.mem_filter.mp hF
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, subclause_eq_true_iff] at hE' hF'
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, toFinset_filter_not_mem] at heq
      have hEF : E.toFinset = F.toFinset := by
        rw [← sdiff_union_of_subset hE'.2.2, ← sdiff_union_of_subset hF'.2.2, heq]
      exact List.inj_on_of_nodup_map h.nodup_toFinset hE'.1 hF'.1 hEF
  refine ⟨fun C hC => ?_, fun C hC => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases List.mem_append.mp (hsub.subset hC) with hC | hC

    · exact (hintro C hC).1

        rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup (h.nodup D hD)]; exact h.length_le D hD)

    rw [List.map_append, List.nodup_append]

    obtain ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hA
    obtain ⟨E, hE, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hB

private theorem toClauseSet_dedupClauses (ψ : CNF V) :
    (dedupClauses ψ).toClauseSet = ψ.toClauseSet := by
  refine Finset.Subset.antisymm (toClauseSet_mono (dedupClauses_sublist ψ).subset) ?_
  intro C' hC'
  obtain ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩ := mem_toClauseSet.mp hC'
  -- the first clause with the same literals is kept
  classical
  have hex : ∃ i, ∃ hi : i < ψ.length, ψ[i].toFinset = C.toFinset := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hC
    exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
  set i := Nat.find hex
  obtain ⟨hi, hieq⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  refine mem_toClauseSet.mpr ⟨ψ[i], List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(ψ[i], i), List.mem_filter.mpr
    ⟨List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mpr (List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi), ?_⟩, rfl⟩, hieq⟩
  refine List.all_eq_true.mpr fun q hq => ?_
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjq⟩ : ∃ j, ∃ hj : j < ψ.length, q = (ψ[j], j) := by
    have := List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mp hq
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at this
    obtain ⟨hj, hjq⟩ := this
    exact ⟨q.2, hj, by rw [hjq]⟩
  subst hjq
  by_cases hji : j < i
  · have hne : ψ[j].toFinset ≠ ψ[i].toFinset := fun heq =>
      Nat.find_min hex hji ⟨hj, heq.trans hieq⟩
    have hsub : ¬ (subclause ψ[j] ψ[i] = true ∧ subclause ψ[i] ψ[j] = true) := fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ =>
      hne (Finset.Subset.antisymm (subclause_eq_true_iff.mp h₁) (subclause_eq_true_iff.mp h₂))
    cases h₁ : subclause ψ[j] ψ[i] <;> cases h₂ : subclause ψ[i] ψ[j] <;> simp_all

theorem Refines.trans {α β γ : ClauseSet V} (h₁ : Refines α β) (h₂ : Refines β γ) :
    Refines α γ := by
  intro a ha

theorem card_newContaining_lt {j c : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ P.len) {b : Finset (Literal V)}
    (hb1 : 1 ≤ b.card) (hbc : b.card < c) :
    (P.newContaining j c b).card < 2 * θ (c - b.card) := by
  set γ := P.newContaining j c b
  by_contra hge
  push Not at hge
  have hγ0 : ∀ a ∈ γ, a ∉ P.node 0 ∧ a.card = c ∧ b ⊆ a := fun a ha => (mem_filter.mp ha).2
  have hex : ∃ m, γ ⊆ P.node m := ⟨j, filter_subset _ _⟩
  set x := Nat.find hex
  have hxsub : γ ⊆ P.node x := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hxle : x ≤ j := Nat.find_min' hex (filter_subset _ _)
  have hγne : γ.Nonempty := by
    rw [← card_pos]; have := hθ (c - b.card); omega
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hγne
    exact (hγ0 a ha).1 (hx ▸ hxsub ha)
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ : ∃ x', x = x' + 1 := ⟨x - 1, by omega⟩
  have hx'len : x' < P.len := by omega
  have hnotsub : ¬ γ ⊆ P.node x' := Nat.find_min hex (by omega)
  -- some clause of `γ` is introduced at step `x'`, so the flower size there exceeds `c`
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀γ, ha₀⟩ := not_subset.mp hnotsub
  have ha₀intro : a₀ ∈ P.introAt x' := by
    have := node_succ_subset hx'len (hx' ▸ hxsub ha₀γ)
    exact (mem_union.mp this).resolve_left ha₀
  have hcsize : c < P.size x' := by
    have := (card_of_mem_intro (heavy hx'len) ha₀intro).2
    rwa [(hγ0 a₀ ha₀γ).2.1] at this
  -- so `b` is not heavy at node `x'`
  have hlight : (flower (P.node x') c b).card < θ (c - b.card) := by
    by_contra hheavy
    push Not at hheavy
    have := (P.choice x' hx'len).2.1 c b ⟨hb1, hbc, hheavy⟩
    omega
  have hold : (γ.filter (· ∈ P.node x')).card < θ (c - b.card) := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (card_le_card fun a ha => ?_) hlight
    obtain ⟨haγ, hax'⟩ := mem_filter.mp ha
    exact mem_flower.mpr ⟨hax', (hγ0 a haγ).2.1, (hγ0 a haγ).2.2⟩
  set Q := γ.filter (· ∉ P.node x')
  have hsplit : (γ.filter (· ∈ P.node x')).card + Q.card = γ.card :=
    card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := γ) (· ∈ P.node x')

  have hQintro : Q ⊆ P.introAt x' := by

    obtain ⟨haγ, hax'⟩ := mem_filter.mp ha
    have := node_succ_subset hx'len (hx' ▸ hxsub haγ)
    exact (mem_union.mp this).resolve_left hax'
  cases hdir : P.dir x' with
  | false =>
    have : Q.card ≤ 1 := by
      have h1 := card_le_card hQintro
      simp only [introAt, hdir, intro, card_singleton] at h1
      exact h1
    have := hθ (c - b.card)
    omega
  | true =>
    -- the clauses whose petals lie in `Q` all contain the larger heart `heart ∪ b`
    have hQpetal : ∀ q ∈ Q, q ∈ petals (P.node x') (P.size x') (P.heart x') := by
      intro q hq
      have := hQintro hq
      simpa only [introAt, hdir, intro] using this
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩ : Q.Nonempty := by rw [← card_pos]; omega
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, hC₀q⟩ := mem_petals.mp (hQpetal q₀ hq₀)
    have hbq₀ : b ⊆ q₀ := (hγ0 q₀ (mem_filter.mp hq₀).1).2.2
    have hdisj : Disjoint (P.heart x') b := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_right]
      intro l hlb hlH
      have := hbq₀ hlb
      rw [← hC₀q] at this
      exact (mem_sdiff.mp this).2 hlH

      rw [← (hγ0 q₀ (mem_filter.mp hq₀).1).2.1]

    have hQle : Q.card ≤ (flower (P.node x') (P.size x') (P.heart x' ∪ b)).card := by
      have hsub : Q ⊆ ((flower (P.node x') (P.size x') (P.heart x')).filter (b ⊆ ·)).image

        have hbq : b ⊆ C \ P.heart x' := (hγ0 _ (mem_filter.mp hq).1).2.2

      obtain ⟨hCf, hbC⟩ := mem_filter.mp hC
      obtain ⟨hCψ, hCcard, hHC⟩ := mem_flower.mp hCf
      exact mem_flower.mpr ⟨hCψ, hCcard, union_subset hHC hbC⟩
    have hheavy : Heavy θ (P.node x') (P.size x') (P.heart x' ∪ b) := by
      refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      have heq : P.size x' - (P.heart x' ∪ b).card = c - b.card := by omega
      rw [heq]
      omega
    have := (P.choice x' hx'len).2.2 (P.heart x' ∪ b) hheavy
    omega

theorem card_introducedOfCard_le (hleaf : Sparse θ (P.node P.len)) (U : Finset V)
    (hU : ∀ C ∈ P.node 0, ∀ l ∈ C, l.1 ∈ U) {c : ℕ} (hc : 1 ≤ c) :
    (P.introducedOfCard c).card ≤
      2 * U.card * θ (c - 1) +
        ∑ h ∈ Ico 1 c, 2 * θ (c - h) * (P.introducedOfCard h).card := by
  -- every introduced clause of size `c` survives to the leaf or is eliminated later
  have hcover : P.introducedOfCard c ⊆ (P.node P.len).filter (·.card = c) ∪
      (range P.len).biUnion fun m =>
        ((P.introAt m).filter (·.card < c)).biUnion fun b => P.newContaining m c b := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨haI, hac⟩ := mem_filter.mp ha
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hai⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp haI
    have hi' := mem_range.mp hi
    have hnew := notMem_node_zero_of_mem_introduced hθ haI
    by_cases hleafa : a ∈ P.node P.len
    · exact mem_union_left _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hleafa, hac⟩)
    · refine mem_union_right _ ?_
      have hex : ∃ m, i + 1 ≤ m ∧ a ∉ P.node m := ⟨P.len, hi', hleafa⟩
      obtain ⟨m₀, ⟨hm₀i, hm₀a⟩, hm₀min⟩ : ∃ m₀, (i + 1 ≤ m₀ ∧ a ∉ P.node m₀) ∧
          ∀ m < m₀, ¬ (i + 1 ≤ m ∧ a ∉ P.node m) :=
        ⟨Nat.find hex, Nat.find_spec hex, fun m hm => Nat.find_min hex hm⟩
      have hm₀le : m₀ ≤ P.len := by
        by_contra hlt
        exact hm₀min P.len (by omega) ⟨hi', hleafa⟩
      have hm₀ne : m₀ ≠ i + 1 := fun h => hm₀a (h ▸ introAt_subset hθ hi' hai)
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, m₀ = m + 1 := ⟨m₀ - 1, by omega⟩
      have hma : a ∈ P.node m := by
        by_contra hna
        exact hm₀min m (by omega) ⟨by omega, hna⟩
      have hmlen : m < P.len := by omega
      have hred := reduced_node m hmlen.le
      have hstep : a ∉ child (P.node m) (P.size m) (P.heart m) (P.dir m) := by
        rw [← P.step m hmlen, ← hm]; exact hm₀a
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := exists_ssubset_of_notMem_reduce hred hma hstep
      refine mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨m, mem_range.mpr hmlen, mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨hb, hac ▸ card_lt_card hba⟩
      · exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨hma, hnew, hac, hba.subset⟩
  have hmaps : ∀ b ∈ P.introduced.filter (·.card < c), b.card ∈ Ico 1 c := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨hbI, hbc⟩ := mem_filter.mp hb
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hbi⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hbI
    exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨(card_of_mem_intro (heavy (mem_range.mp hi)) hbi).1, hbc⟩
  have hsum : ∑ m ∈ range P.len, ∑ b ∈ (P.introAt m).filter (·.card < c),
      (P.newContaining m c b).card ≤
        ∑ h ∈ Ico 1 c, 2 * θ (c - h) * (P.introducedOfCard h).card := by
    calc ∑ m ∈ range P.len, ∑ b ∈ (P.introAt m).filter (·.card < c),
          (P.newContaining m c b).card
        ≤ ∑ m ∈ range P.len, ∑ b ∈ (P.introAt m).filter (·.card < c), 2 * θ (c - b.card) := by
          refine sum_le_sum fun m hm => sum_le_sum fun b hb => ?_
          obtain ⟨hbm, hbc⟩ := mem_filter.mp hb
          have hb1 := (card_of_mem_intro (heavy (mem_range.mp hm)) hbm).1
          exact (card_newContaining_lt hθ (mem_range.mp hm).le hb1 hbc).le
      _ = ∑ b ∈ P.introduced.filter (·.card < c), 2 * θ (c - b.card) := by
          rw [introduced, filter_biUnion, sum_biUnion]
          intro i hi j hj hne
          exact Finset.disjoint_filter_filter (pairwiseDisjoint_introAt hθ hi hj hne)
      _ = ∑ h ∈ Ico 1 c, ∑ b ∈ (P.introduced.filter (·.card < c)).filter (·.card = h),
            2 * θ (c - h) := (sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to' hmaps fun h => 2 * θ (c - h)).symm
      _ = ∑ h ∈ Ico 1 c, 2 * θ (c - h) * (P.introducedOfCard h).card := by
          refine sum_congr rfl fun h hh => ?_
          have hhc := (mem_Ico.mp hh).2
          rw [sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
          congr 2
          ext b
          simp only [introducedOfCard, mem_filter]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨⟨hb, -⟩, hbh⟩; exact ⟨hb, hbh⟩
          · rintro ⟨hb, hbh⟩; exact ⟨⟨hb, hbh ▸ hhc⟩, hbh⟩
  calc (P.introducedOfCard c).card
      ≤ ((P.node P.len).filter (·.card = c) ∪
          (range P.len).biUnion fun m =>
            ((P.introAt m).filter (·.card < c)).biUnion fun b => P.newContaining m c b).card :=
        card_le_card hcover
    _ ≤ ((P.node P.len).filter (·.card = c)).card +
          ((range P.len).biUnion fun m =>
            ((P.introAt m).filter (·.card < c)).biUnion fun b => P.newContaining m c b).card :=
        card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ 2 * U.card * θ (c - 1) + ∑ m ∈ range P.len, ∑ b ∈ (P.introAt m).filter (·.card < c),
          (P.newContaining m c b).card := by
        refine add_le_add (card_filter_card_eq_le_of_sparse hθ hleaf U (fun C hC l hl => ?_) hc) ?_
        · obtain ⟨D, hD, hCD⟩ := refines_of_le hθ (Nat.zero_le _) le_rfl C hC
          exact hU D hD l (hCD hl)
        exact card_biUnion_le.trans (sum_le_sum fun m _ => card_biUnion_le)
    _ ≤ 2 * U.card * θ (c - 1) +
          ∑ h ∈ Ico 1 c, 2 * θ (c - h) * (P.introducedOfCard h).card :=
        Nat.add_le_add_left hsum _

theorem card_compl_isolatedDirections_le {ψ : ClauseSet (Fin N)} {Δ D : ℕ}
    (hdeg : ∀ u, (ψ.neighbors u).card ≤ Δ)
    (hfree : ¬ ContainsSubcube (ψ.solutions : Set (BitString N)) D) {x : BitString N}
    (hx : x ∈ ψ.solutions) :
    (univ \ isolatedDirections ψ.solutions x).card ≤ (D - 1) * (Δ + 1) := by
  set NI := univ \ isolatedDirections ψ.solutions x with hNI
  have hmemNI : ∀ i, i ∈ NI ↔ flipOn {i} x ∈ ψ.solutions := by
    intro i
    simp [hNI, isolatedDirections]
  let Ind : Finset (Finset (Fin N)) := NI.powerset.filter fun M =>
    ∀ u ∈ M, ∀ w ∈ M, u ≠ w → w ∉ ψ.neighbors u
  have hInd : (∅ : Finset (Fin N)) ∈ Ind := by simp [Ind]
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hmax⟩ := Ind.exists_max_image card ⟨∅, hInd⟩
  simp only [Ind, mem_filter, mem_powerset] at hM
  obtain ⟨hMNI, hMind⟩ := hM
  have hmove : ∀ i ∈ M, flipOn {i} x ∈ ψ.solutions := fun i hi => (hmemNI i).mp (hMNI hi)
  -- the independent set is small
  have hMcard : M.card ≤ D - 1 := by
    by_contra hlt
    push Not at hlt
    obtain ⟨J, hJM, hJcard⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq (s := M) (n := D) (by omega)
    exact hfree ⟨x, J, hJcard, fun T hT =>
      flipOn_mem_solutions_of_independent hx hmove hMind (hT.trans hJM)⟩
  -- every non-isolated direction is in its closed neighbourhood
  have hcover : NI ⊆ M ∪ M.biUnion ψ.neighbors := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases hiM : i ∈ M
    · exact mem_union_left _ hiM
    · refine mem_union_right _ (mem_biUnion.mpr ?_)
      by_contra hnone
      push Not at hnone
      have hins : insert i M ∈ Ind := by
        simp only [Ind, mem_filter, mem_powerset]
        refine ⟨insert_subset hi hMNI, fun u hu w hw hne => ?_⟩
        rw [mem_insert] at hu hw
        by_cases hui : u = i
        · subst hui
          rcases hw with hwi | hwM
          · exact absurd hwi.symm hne
          · exact fun h => hnone w hwM (mem_neighbors_comm.mp h)
        · have huM : u ∈ M := hu.resolve_left hui
          by_cases hwi : w = i
          · subst hwi
            exact hnone u huM
          · exact hMind u huM w (hw.resolve_left hwi) hne
      have := hmax _ hins
      rw [card_insert_of_notMem hiM] at this
      omega
  calc NI.card ≤ (M ∪ M.biUnion ψ.neighbors).card := card_le_card hcover
    _ ≤ M.card + (M.biUnion ψ.neighbors).card := card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ M.card + ∑ m ∈ M, (ψ.neighbors m).card := by gcongr; exact card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ M.card + ∑ _m ∈ M, Δ := by gcongr with m; exact hdeg m
    _ = M.card * (Δ + 1) := by rw [sum_const, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    _ ≤ (D - 1) * (Δ + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hMcard

neighbours. -/

theorem card_neighbors_le {ψ : ClauseSet (Fin N)} {k : ℕ} (hk : ∀ C ∈ ψ, C.card ≤ k)
    (u : Fin N) : (ψ.neighbors u).card ≤ ψ.occurrences u * (k - 1) := by
  let Cu := ψ.filter fun C => ∃ l ∈ C, l.1 = u
  have hsub : ψ.neighbors u ⊆ Cu.biUnion fun C => (C.image Prod.fst).erase u := by
    intro w hw
    simp only [neighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hw
    obtain ⟨hne, C, hC, hu, l, hl, hlw⟩ := hw
    exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨C, mem_filter.mpr ⟨hC, hu⟩, mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne, mem_image.mpr
      ⟨l, hl, hlw⟩⟩⟩
  calc (ψ.neighbors u).card
      ≤ (Cu.biUnion fun C => (C.image Prod.fst).erase u).card := card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ C ∈ Cu, ((C.image Prod.fst).erase u).card := card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _C ∈ Cu, (k - 1) := by
        refine sum_le_sum fun C hC => ?_
        obtain ⟨hCψ, l, hl, hlu⟩ := mem_filter.mp hC
        rw [card_erase_of_mem (mem_image.mpr ⟨l, hl, hlu⟩)]
        exact Nat.sub_le_sub_right (card_image_le.trans (hk C hCψ)) 1
    _ = ψ.occurrences u * (k - 1) := by rw [sum_const, smul_eq_mul]; rfl

directions of `x`. -/

theorem card_solutions_le_of_neighbors {ψ : ClauseSet (Fin N)} {k Δ D : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k)
    (hk : ∀ C ∈ ψ, C.card ≤ k) (hdeg : ∀ u, (ψ.neighbors u).card ≤ Δ)
    (hfree : ¬ ContainsSubcube (ψ.solutions : Set (BitString N)) D) :
    (ψ.solutions.card : ℝ) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 - 1 / (k : ℝ)) * N + (((D - 1) * (Δ + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / k) := by
  set m : ℕ := (D - 1) * (Δ + 1)
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk1
  -- each solution has at least `N - m` isolated directions
  have hiso : ∀ x ∈ ψ.solutions,
      ((N : ℝ) - m) / k ≤ ((isolatedDirections ψ.solutions x).card : ℝ) / k := by
    intro x hx
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hkpos.le
    have hle := card_compl_isolatedDirections_le hdeg hfree hx
    have hsplit : (univ \ isolatedDirections ψ.solutions x).card +
        (isolatedDirections ψ.solutions x).card = N := by
      rw [card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (subset_univ _), card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    have : (N : ℝ) = ((univ \ isolatedDirections ψ.solutions x).card : ℝ) +
        (isolatedDirections ψ.solutions x).card := by exact_mod_cast hsplit.symm
    have hle' : ((univ \ isolatedDirections ψ.solutions x).card : ℝ) ≤ m := by
      exact_mod_cast hle
    linarith
  have hlower : (ψ.solutions.card : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (((N : ℝ) - m) / k) ≤ 2 ^ N := by
    calc (ψ.solutions.card : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (((N : ℝ) - m) / k)
        = ∑ _x ∈ ψ.solutions, (2 : ℝ) ^ (((N : ℝ) - m) / k) := by
          rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ ψ.solutions,
            (2 : ℝ) ^ (((isolatedDirections ψ.solutions x).card : ℝ) / k) :=
          sum_le_sum fun x hx => Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (hiso x hx)
      _ ≤ 2 ^ N := sum_two_rpow_card_isolatedDirections_div_le hk1 hk
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (((N : ℝ) - m) / k) := by positivity
  rw [← le_div_iff₀ hpos, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_sub (by norm_num)] at hlower
  refine hlower.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring

/-- **Formulas without large subcubes of solutions have few solutions**: for every width `k ≥ 1`
and every `ε > 0` there is a constant `C` such that every clause set of width `k` over `N`
variables whose solutions contain no subcube of dimension `D` has at most
`2 ^ ((1 - 1 / k + ε) N + C D)` solutions. -/

text:
theorem card_solutions_le_of_not_containsSubcube (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (φ : ClauseSet (Fin N)) (D : ℕ), (∀ C ∈ φ, C.card ≤ k) →
      ¬ ContainsSubcube (φ.solutions : Set (BitString N)) D →
      (φ.solutions.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ ((1 - 1 / (k : ℝ) + ε) * N + C * D) := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ClauseSet.sparsification.{0} k hε
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  refine ⟨((c * (k - 1) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / k, by positivity, fun N φ D hφ hfree => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hcard, hleaves, hcover⟩ := hc (Fin N) φ hφ
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
  set E : ℝ := (1 - 1 / (k : ℝ)) * N + ((c * (k - 1) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / k * D
  have hpiece : ∀ ψ ∈ Ψ, (ψ.solutions.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ E := by
    intro ψ hψ
    obtain ⟨hwidth, hocc, hsol⟩ := hleaves ψ hψ
    have hdeg : ∀ u, (ψ.neighbors u).card ≤ c * (k - 1) := fun u =>
      (card_neighbors_le hwidth u).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hocc u))
    have hfree' : ¬ ContainsSubcube (ψ.solutions : Set (BitString N)) D :=
      fun h => hfree (h.mono (by exact_mod_cast hsol))
    refine (card_solutions_le_of_neighbors hk hwidth hdeg hfree').trans ?_
    refine Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) ?_
    simp only [E]
    gcongr
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    gcongr
    have : (D - 1) * (c * (k - 1) + 1) ≤ (c * (k - 1) + 1) * D := by
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.sub_le D 1)
    exact_mod_cast this
  calc (φ.solutions.card : ℝ) ≤ ((Ψ.biUnion solutions).card : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast card_le_card hcover
    _ ≤ ∑ ψ ∈ Ψ, (ψ.solutions.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _ψ ∈ Ψ, (2 : ℝ) ^ E := sum_le_sum hpiece
    _ = (Ψ.card : ℝ) * 2 ^ E := by rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (ε * N) * 2 ^ E := by gcongr
    _ = 2 ^ ((1 - 1 / (k : ℝ) + ε) * N + ((c * (k - 1) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / k * D) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num)]
        congr 1
        simp only [E]
        ring

theorem DNF.card_isolatedInputs_le_length {g : BitString n → Bool} {D : DNF (Fin n)}
    (hD : ∀ x, D.eval x = g x) :
    #(BitString.isolatedInputs g true) ≤ D.length := by
  set S := BitString.isolatedInputs g true
  -- an isolated true input chooses a term holding there
  have hchoose : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ t ∈ D, t.eval x = true :=
    fun x hx => (DNF.eval_eq_true_iff x D).1 ((hD x).trans (BitString.mem_isolatedInputs.1 hx).1)
  choose! T hT hTx using hchoose
  -- such a term mentions every variable, so it determines the input
  have hall : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ i : Fin n, ∃ b, (i, b) ∈ T x := fun x hx i => by
    by_contra h'
    have h := not_exists.1 h'
    have hflip : (T x).eval (update x i !x i) = true :=
      (Term.eval_update_of_forall_ne (fun l hl hli => h l.2 (hli ▸ hl)) x _).trans (hTx x hx)
    have h1 := (hD _).symm.trans ((DNF.eval_eq_true_iff _ D).2 ⟨T x, hT x hx, hflip⟩)
    rw [(BitString.mem_isolatedInputs.1 hx).2 i] at h1
    exact Bool.false_ne_true h1
  have hinj : Set.InjOn T S := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    funext i
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hall x hx i
    have h₁ := (Term.eval_eq_true_iff x _).1 (hTx x hx) _ hb
    have h₂ := (Term.eval_eq_true_iff y _).1 (hTx y hy) _ (hxy ▸ hb)
    exact h₁.trans h₂.symm
  calc #S
      = #(S.image T) := (card_image_of_injOn hinj).symm
    _ ≤ #D.toFinset := card_le_card fun t ht => by
        obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 ht
        exact List.mem_toFinset.2 (hT x hx)
    _ ≤ D.length := List.toFinset_card_le D

theorem DNF.not_forall_eval_eq_parity_fill_bne {ρ : BitString.PartialAssignment (Fin n)}
    {D : DNF (Fin n)} (hD : ∀ t ∈ D, t.length < #ρ.free) (hρ : ρ.free.Nonempty) (c : Bool) :
    ¬ ∀ y, DNF.eval y D = (parity n (ρ.fill y) != c) := by
  intro h
  -- flipping a free bit flips restricted parity
  have hflip : ∀ y i, i ∈ ρ.free → parity n (ρ.fill (update y i !y i)) = !parity n (ρ.fill y) :=
    fun y i hi => by
      have hρi := BitString.PartialAssignment.mem_free.1 hi
      rw [BitString.PartialAssignment.fill_update_of_eq_none hρi,
        ← BitString.PartialAssignment.fill_of_eq_none hρi y, parity_update_not]
  -- some input makes the right side true
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hρ
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, (parity n (ρ.fill y) != c) = true := by
    by_cases h0 : (parity n (ρ.fill fun _ => false) != c) = true
    · exact ⟨_, h0⟩
    · refine ⟨update (fun _ => false) i₀ (!false), ?_⟩
      rw [hflip _ i₀ hi₀]
      revert h0
      cases parity n (ρ.fill fun _ => false) <;> cases c <;> simp
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hty⟩ := (DNF.eval_eq_true_iff y D).1 ((h y).trans hy)
  -- the term misses a free bit, and stays true when it flips
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hit⟩ : ∃ i ∈ ρ.free, i ∉ t.map Prod.fst := by
    by_contra! hsub
    have hle : #ρ.free ≤ t.length :=
      (card_le_card fun i hi => List.mem_toFinset.2 (hsub i hi)).trans
        ((List.toFinset_card_le _).trans_eq (by simp))
    exact absurd (hD t ht) (by omega)
  have hty' : t.eval (update y i !y i) = true :=
    (Term.eval_update_of_forall_ne (fun l hl hli => hit (List.mem_map.2 ⟨l, hl, hli⟩)) y _).trans
      hty
  have h1 := (h _).symm.trans ((DNF.eval_eq_true_iff _ D).2 ⟨t, ht, hty'⟩)
  rw [hflip y i hi] at h1
  revert hy h1
  cases parity n (ρ.fill y) <;> cases c <;> simp

theorem CNF.card_isolatedInputs_mul_two_rpow_le_of_any {k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k)
    {g : BitString n → Bool} {Fs : List (CNF (Fin n))} (hk : ∀ φ ∈ Fs, ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length ≤ k)
    (hFs : ∀ x, (Fs.any fun φ => φ.eval x) = g x) :
    (#(BitString.isolatedInputs g true) : ℝ) *
      2 ^ ((n : ℝ) / k) ≤ Fs.length * 2 ^ n := by

  let I : CNF (Fin n) → Finset (BitString n) := fun φ =>
    BitString.isolatedInputs φ.eval true
  have hcover : BitString.isolatedInputs g true ⊆
      Fs.toFinset.biUnion I := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hgx, hiso⟩ := BitString.mem_isolatedInputs.1 hx
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφx⟩ := List.any_eq_true.1 ((hFs x).trans hgx)
    refine mem_biUnion.2
      ⟨φ, List.mem_toFinset.2 hφ, BitString.mem_isolatedInputs.2 ⟨hφx, fun i => ?_⟩⟩
    by_contra h
    have := (hFs _).symm.trans (List.any_eq_true.2 ⟨φ, hφ, Bool.eq_true_of_not_eq_false h⟩)
    rw [hiso i] at this
    exact Bool.false_ne_true this
  have hcard := card_le_card hcover |>.trans card_biUnion_le
  calc (#(BitString.isolatedInputs g true) : ℝ) *
        2 ^ ((n : ℝ) / k)
      ≤ (∑ φ ∈ Fs.toFinset, (#(I φ) : ℝ)) * 2 ^ ((n : ℝ) / k) := by
        gcongr
        exact_mod_cast hcard
    _ = ∑ φ ∈ Fs.toFinset, (#(I φ) : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((n : ℝ) / k) := sum_mul ..
    _ ≤ ∑ _φ ∈ Fs.toFinset, (2 : ℝ) ^ n :=
        sum_le_sum fun φ hφ => CNF.card_isolatedInputs_mul_two_rpow_le hk1 (hk φ
          (List.mem_toFinset.1 hφ))
    _ = #Fs.toFinset * 2 ^ n := by rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ Fs.length * 2 ^ n := by
        gcongr
        exact_mod_cast List.toFinset_card_le Fs

theorem CNF.exists_any_eval_eq_parity {k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ∣ n) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ Fs : List (CNF (Fin n)), Fs.length = 2 ^ (n / k - 1) ∧
      (∀ φ ∈ Fs, ∀ c ∈ φ, c.length ≤ k) ∧ ∀ x, (Fs.any fun φ => φ.eval x) = parity n x := by
  have hm : 1 ≤ n / k := (Nat.one_le_div_iff hk1).2 (Nat.le_of_dvd hn hkn)
  -- the blocks of `k` consecutive variables
  let B : Fin (n / k) → Finset (Fin n) := fun j => {i | i.val / k = j.val}
  have hBcard (j : Fin (n / k)) : #(B j) ≤ k := by
    calc #(B j)

            have hi := (mem_filter.1 hi).2

private theorem sum_inv_critWidth_mul_two_pow_le_card_clauses
    {Fs : List (CNF (Fin n))} {P : Finset (BitString n × Fin n)}
    {F : BitString n → CNF (Fin n)} (hF : ∀ p ∈ P, F p.1 ∈ Fs)
    (hcrit : ∀ p ∈ P, ∃ c ∈ F p.1, CNF.Critical p.1 c p.2) :
    (∑ p ∈ P,
      1 / (((F p.1).critWidth p.1 p.2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ (n - (F p.1).critWidth p.1 p.2))) ≤
      #(Fs.flatten.map List.toFinset).toFinset := by
  have hcl : ∀ p ∈ P, ∃ c ∈ F p.1, CNF.Critical p.1 c p.2 ∧
      (c.map Prod.fst).toFinset.card = (F p.1).critWidth p.1 p.2 := fun p hp =>
    CNF.exists_critical_card_eq_critWidth (hcrit p hp)
  choose! cl hclF hclc hclw using hcl
  have hvars (c : Clause (Fin n)) : (c.map Prod.fst).toFinset = c.toFinset.image Prod.fst := by
    ext
    simp
  have hmaps : ∀ p ∈ P, (cl p).toFinset ∈ (Fs.flatten.map List.toFinset).toFinset := fun p hp =>
    List.mem_toFinset.2 (List.mem_map.2 ⟨cl p, List.mem_flatten.2 ⟨F p.1, hF p hp, hclF p hp⟩, rfl⟩)
  rw [← sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps]
  refine (sum_le_sum fun C _ => ?_).trans_eq (by rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one])
  rcases ({p ∈ P | (cl p).toFinset = C} : Finset _).eq_empty_or_nonempty with he | ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩
  · rw [he, sum_empty]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨hp₀P, hp₀C⟩ := mem_filter.1 hp₀
  set v := ((cl p₀).map Prod.fst).toFinset.card
  have hℓ : ∀ p ∈ ({p ∈ P | (cl p).toFinset = C} : Finset _),
      (F p.1).critWidth p.1 p.2 = v := fun p hp => by
    obtain ⟨hpP, hpC⟩ := mem_filter.1 hp
    rw [← hclw p hpP, hvars, hpC, ← hp₀C, ← hvars]
  have hv : 0 < v := by
    rw [← hℓ p₀ hp₀]
    exact CNF.critWidth_pos (hcrit p₀ hp₀P)
  have hfib : #{p ∈ P | (cl p).toFinset = C} ≤ v * 2 ^ (n - v) := by
    refine (card_le_card fun p hp => ?_).trans (CNF.card_filter_critical_prod_le (cl p₀))
    obtain ⟨hpP, hpC⟩ := mem_filter.1 hp
    refine mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, (CNF.critical_congr fun l => ?_).1 (hclc p hpP)⟩
    rw [← List.mem_toFinset, ← List.mem_toFinset (l := cl p₀), hpC, hp₀C]
  rw [sum_congr rfl fun p hp => show
      1 / (((F p.1).critWidth p.1 p.2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ (n - (F p.1).critWidth p.1 p.2)) =
        1 / ((v : ℝ) * 2 ^ (n - v)) by rw [hℓ p hp],
    sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one_div,
    div_le_one (mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.2 hv) (by positivity))]
  exact_mod_cast hfib

/-- **ORs of formulas in conjunctive normal form need many gates per isolated true input**, by the
argument of [Paturi, Pudlák and Zane, Theorem 6][PaturiPudlakZane1999]: if an OR of `m` formulas
with `K` distinct clauses (as sets of literals) computes `g`, then each isolated true input of `g`
is a solution of one of them, isolated in every direction, and if there are `s` of them then
`s min (2 ^ μ) (μ 2 ^ (n / μ)) ≤ 2 ^ n (m + K)` for every `0 < μ ≤ n log 2`. A depth-three circuit
with an OR at the top, AND gates in the middle and OR gates of literals at the bottom has at least
`m + K` gates, as sharing bottom gates only lowers `K`. -/

theorem CNF.card_isolatedInputs_mul_min_le {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hμn : μ ≤ n * Real.log 2)
    {g : BitString n → Bool} {Fs : List (CNF (Fin n))}
    (hFs : ∀ x, (Fs.any fun φ => φ.eval x) = g x) :
    (#(BitString.isolatedInputs g true) : ℝ) *
      min (2 ^ μ) (μ * 2 ^ (n / μ)) ≤
      2 ^ n * (Fs.length + #(Fs.flatten.map List.toFinset).toFinset) := by
  set S := BitString.isolatedInputs g true
  -- each isolated true input is a solution of one of the formulas, isolated in every direction
  have hchoose : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ φ ∈ Fs, φ.eval x = true := fun x hx =>
    List.any_eq_true.1 ((hFs x).trans (BitString.mem_isolatedInputs.1 hx).1)
  choose! F hF hFx using hchoose
  have hiso : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ i, (F x).eval (update x i !x i) = false := fun x hx i => by
    by_contra h
    have := (hFs _).symm.trans (List.any_eq_true.2 ⟨F x, hF x hx, Bool.eq_true_of_not_eq_false h⟩)
    rw [(BitString.mem_isolatedInputs.1 hx).2 i] at this
    exact Bool.false_ne_true this
  have hcrit : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ i, ∃ c ∈ F x, CNF.Critical x c i := fun x hx i =>
    CNF.exists_critical (hFx x hx) (hiso x hx i)
  set w : BitString n → ℝ := fun x => ∑ i, 1 / ((F x).critWidth x i : ℝ)
  set S₁ := S.filter fun x => μ ≤ w x
  set S₂ := S.filter fun x => ¬ μ ≤ w x
  set Cl := (Fs.flatten.map List.toFinset).toFinset
  -- inputs of weight at least `μ`: each formula has few solutions of large weight
  have h₁ : (#S₁ : ℝ) * 2 ^ μ ≤ Fs.length * 2 ^ n := by
    set A : CNF (Fin n) → Finset (BitString n) := fun φ =>
      {x | φ.eval x = true ∧ μ ≤ ∑ i, 1 / (φ.critWidth x i : ℝ)}
    have hsub : S₁ ⊆ Fs.toFinset.biUnion A := fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨hxS, hxw⟩ := mem_filter.1 hx
      exact mem_biUnion.2 ⟨F x, List.mem_toFinset.2 (hF x hxS),
        mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, hFx x hxS, hxw⟩⟩
    calc (#S₁ : ℝ) * 2 ^ μ ≤ (∑ φ ∈ Fs.toFinset, (#(A φ) : ℝ)) * 2 ^ μ := by
          gcongr
          exact_mod_cast (card_le_card hsub).trans card_biUnion_le
      _ = ∑ φ ∈ Fs.toFinset, (#(A φ) : ℝ) * 2 ^ μ := sum_mul ..
      _ ≤ ∑ _φ ∈ Fs.toFinset, (2 : ℝ) ^ n :=
          sum_le_sum fun φ _ => CNF.card_filter_le_sum_inv_critWidth_mul_two_rpow_le φ μ
      _ = #Fs.toFinset * 2 ^ n := by rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ Fs.length * 2 ^ n := by
          gcongr
          exact_mod_cast List.toFinset_card_le Fs
  -- inputs of weight below `μ`: their shortest critical clauses are many
  have h₂ : (#S₂ : ℝ) * (μ * 2 ^ (n / μ)) ≤ #Cl * 2 ^ n := by
    set P := S₂ ×ˢ (univ : Finset (Fin n))
    have ha :
        (∑ p ∈ P,
          1 / (((F p.1).critWidth p.1 p.2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ (n - (F p.1).critWidth p.1 p.2))) ≤ #Cl :=
      sum_inv_critWidth_mul_two_pow_le_card_clauses
        (fun p hp => hF p.1 (mem_filter.1 (mem_product.1 hp).1).1)
        (fun p hp => hcrit p.1 (mem_filter.1 (mem_product.1 hp).1).1 p.2)
    have hb : ∀ x ∈ S₂, μ * 2 ^ (n / μ) ≤
        2 ^ n * ∑ i, 1 / (((F x).critWidth x i : ℝ) * 2 ^ (n - (F x).critWidth x i)) :=
      fun x hx => by
        obtain ⟨hxS, hxw⟩ := mem_filter.1 hx
        have hwx := (not_le.1 hxw).le
        dsimp only [w] at hwx
        exact CNF.mul_two_rpow_div_le_two_pow_mul_sum_critWidth hμ hμn (hcrit x hxS) hwx
    calc (#S₂ : ℝ) * (μ * 2 ^ (n / μ)) = ∑ _x ∈ S₂, μ * 2 ^ (n / μ) := by
          rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ S₂,
          2 ^ n * ∑ i, 1 / (((F x).critWidth x i : ℝ) * 2 ^ (n - (F x).critWidth x i)) :=
        sum_le_sum hb
      _ = 2 ^ n *
          ∑ p ∈ P, 1 / (((F p.1).critWidth p.1 p.2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ (n - (F p.1).critWidth p.1 p.2)) :=
        by rw [← mul_sum, sum_product]
      _ ≤ 2 ^ n * #Cl := by gcongr
      _ = #Cl * 2 ^ n := mul_comm _ _
  -- the isolated true inputs split into the two kinds
  have hS : (#S₁ : ℝ) + #S₂ = #S := by
    exact_mod_cast card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := S) (fun x => μ ≤ w x)
  have hm₁ : min (2 ^ μ) (μ * 2 ^ (n / μ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ μ := min_le_left _ _
  have hm₂ : min (2 ^ μ) (μ * 2 ^ (n / μ)) ≤ μ * 2 ^ (n / μ) := min_le_right _ _
  calc (#S : ℝ) * min (2 ^ μ) (μ * 2 ^ (n / μ))
      = #S₁ * min (2 ^ μ) (μ * 2 ^ (n / μ)) + #S₂ * min (2 ^ μ) (μ * 2 ^ (n / μ)) := by
        rw [← hS, add_mul]
    _ ≤ #S₁ * 2 ^ μ + #S₂ * (μ * 2 ^ (n / μ)) := by gcongr
    _ ≤ Fs.length * 2 ^ n + #Cl * 2 ^ n := add_le_add h₁ h₂
    _ = 2 ^ n * (Fs.length + #Cl) := by ring

/-- **ORs of formulas in conjunctive normal form for parity need many gates**: if an OR of `m`
formulas with `K` distinct clauses computes the parity of `n ≥ 1` bits, all of whose `2 ^ (n - 1)`
true inputs are isolated, then `2 ^ (n - 1) min (2 ^ μ) (μ 2 ^ (n / μ)) ≤ 2 ^ n (m + K)` for every
`0 < μ ≤ n log 2`. -/

theorem DNF.rpow_mul_two_rpow_sqrt_sub_one_le_of_all_eval_eq_parity (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    {Gs : List (DNF (Fin n))} (hGs : ∀ x, (Gs.all fun ψ => ψ.eval x) = parity n x) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * 2 ^ (√(n : ℝ) - 1) ≤
      Gs.length + #(Gs.flatten.map List.toFinset).toFinset := by
  have hFs (x : BitString n) : ((Gs.map DNF.negate).any fun φ => φ.eval x) = !parity n x := by
    rw [← hGs x, List.any_map, Bool.eq_iff_iff]
    simp [List.any_eq_true]
  have h := CNF.card_isolatedInputs_mul_rpow_mul_two_rpow_sqrt_le hn hFs
  rw [card_isolatedInputs_not_parity (by omega), Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at h
  -- negating the terms does not merge them
  have hK : #((Gs.map DNF.negate).flatten.map List.toFinset).toFinset ≤
      #(Gs.flatten.map List.toFinset).toFinset := by
    refine (card_le_card fun C hC => ?_).trans (card_image_le (f := image fun l => (l.1, !l.2)))
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map, List.mem_flatten, DNF.negate] at hC
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨_, ⟨ψ, hψ, rfl⟩, hc⟩, rfl⟩ := hC
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hc
    exact mem_image.2 ⟨t.toFinset, List.mem_toFinset.2 (List.mem_map.2
      ⟨t, List.mem_flatten.2 ⟨ψ, hψ, ht⟩, rfl⟩), by ext; simp [Term.negate]⟩
  rw [Real.rpow_sub_one two_ne_zero, ← mul_div_assoc]
  refine (div_two_le_of_two_pow_sub_one_mul_le (by omega) h).trans ?_
  rw [List.length_map]
  gcongr

theorem satisfiable_pigeonhole_iff : (pigeonhole m n).Satisfiable ↔ m ≤ n := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ⟩
    obtain ⟨hp, hh⟩ := (eval_pigeonhole_eq_true_iff σ).1 hσ
    choose g hg using hp
    by_contra! hlt
    obtain ⟨i, i', hne, heq⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt g (by simpa using hlt)
    exact hne (hh i i' (g i) (hg i) (heq ▸ hg i'))
  · intro hmn
    refine ⟨fun x => decide (x.1.val = x.2.val), (eval_pigeonhole_eq_true_iff _).2 ⟨fun i =>
      ⟨⟨i.val, i.isLt.trans_le hmn⟩, by simp⟩, fun i i' j hi hi' => ?_⟩⟩
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hi hi'
    exact Fin.ext (hi.trans hi'.symm)

theorem Connective.natDegree_apply_le (o : Connective) (p q : R[X]) :
    (o.apply p q).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree + q.natDegree := by
  cases o
  · exact natDegree_mul_le
  · exact (natDegree_one_sub_le _).trans (natDegree_mul_le.trans
      (Nat.add_le_add (natDegree_one_sub_le p) (natDegree_one_sub_le q)))

theorem Operator.natDegree_apply_le (o : Operator) (t : R) {p q : R[X]} {d : ℕ}
    (hp : p.natDegree ≤ d) (hq : q.natDegree ≤ d) :
    (o.apply (C t) p q).natDegree ≤ o.degMul * d := by
  cases o
  · refine (natDegree_one_sub_le _).trans (natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_)
    have := natDegree_one_sub_le p
    have := natDegree_one_sub_le q
    simp only [degMul]
    omega
  · refine natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
    simp only [degMul]
    omega
  · refine (natDegree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
    · refine natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
      rw [← C_1, ← C_sub, natDegree_C, degMul, one_mul, zero_add]
      exact hp
    · refine natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
      rw [natDegree_C, degMul, one_mul, zero_add]
      exact hq

theorem Operator.natDegree_apply_X_le (o : Operator) (a b : R) :
    (o.apply X (C a) (C b)).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
  cases o
  · refine (natDegree_one_sub_le _).trans (natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_)
    have := natDegree_one_sub_le (C a)
    have := natDegree_one_sub_le (C b)
    rw [natDegree_C] at *
    omega
  · refine natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
    rw [natDegree_C, natDegree_C]
    omega
  · refine (natDegree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
    · refine natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
      rw [natDegree_C, add_zero]
      exact (natDegree_one_sub_le X).trans natDegree_X_le
    · refine natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
      rw [natDegree_C, add_zero]
      exact natDegree_X_le

theorem natDegree_restrict_le (x : V) : (e.restrict r x).natDegree ≤ e.degBound x := by
  induction e generalizing r with
  | var v =>
    by_cases h : v = x
    · simp only [restrict, degBound, h, ↓reduceIte]
      exact natDegree_X_le
    · simp only [restrict, degBound, h, ↓reduceIte, natDegree_C, le_refl]
  | top => simp only [restrict, degBound, natDegree_one, le_refl]
  | bot => simp only [restrict, degBound, natDegree_zero, le_refl]
  | not e ih => exact (natDegree_one_sub_le _).trans (ih r)
  | bin o e₁ e₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    exact (Connective.natDegree_apply_le o _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add (ih₁ r) (ih₂ r))
  | op o v e ih =>
    by_cases h : v = x
    · simp only [restrict, degBound, h, ↓reduceIte]
      exact Operator.natDegree_apply_X_le o _ _
    · simp only [restrict, degBound, h, ↓reduceIte]
      exact Operator.natDegree_apply_le o _ (ih _) (ih _)

theorem roundDegree_le_ops_mul : e.roundDegree ≤ e.ops * e.maxRoundDegree := by
  induction e with
  | var v => exact le_refl 0
  | top => exact le_refl 0
  | bot => exact le_refl 0
  | not e ih => exact ih
  | bin o e₁ e₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    simp only [roundDegree, ops, maxRoundDegree, Nat.add_mul]
    exact Nat.add_le_add (ih₁.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (le_max_left _ _)))
      (ih₂.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (le_max_right _ _)))
  | op o v e ih =>
    simp only [roundDegree, ops, maxRoundDegree, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    have := ih.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left e.ops (le_max_right (e.degBound v) e.maxRoundDegree))
    have := le_max_left (e.degBound v) e.maxRoundDegree
    omega

private theorem roundDegree_arithmetize_op_le {xs : List V} {φ : QBF V}
    (hxs : ∀ v ∈ φ.vars, v ∈ xs) (o : Operator) (ho : o.degMul ≤ 2) (v : V) :

  | top => simp [arithmetize, ArithQBF.roundDegree]
  | bot => simp [arithmetize, ArithQBF.roundDegree]
  | not φ ih =>

    exact (ih hxs).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_succ _) 2))

    have h₂ := ihψ fun v hv => hxs v (Or.inr hv)

private theorem isCrit_update {P : Finset (Fin m)} {H : Finset (Fin n)} {g : Fin n → Fin m}
    (hg : IsCrit P H g) {i₀ : Fin m} (hi₀ : i₀ ∈ P) (h₀ : i₀ ∉ H.image g) {j : Fin n} :
    IsCrit P H (Function.update g j i₀) := by
  refine ⟨fun y hy => ?_, fun y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ heq => ?_⟩
  · by_cases hyj : y = j
    · subst hyj
      simpa using hi₀
    · simpa [hyj] using hg.1 y hy
  · by_cases h₁ : y₁ = j <;> by_cases h₂ : y₂ = j
    · exact h₁.trans h₂.symm
    · subst h₁
      simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne h₂] at heq
      exact absurd (heq ▸ mem_image_of_mem g hy₂) h₀
    · subst h₂
      simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne h₁] at heq
      exact absurd (heq.symm ▸ mem_image_of_mem g hy₁) h₀
    · simp only [Function.update_of_ne h₁, Function.update_of_ne h₂] at heq
      exact hg.2 hy₁ hy₂ heq

private theorem sub_le_card_filter_satPairs {P : Finset (Fin m)} {H : Finset (Fin n)}
    (hP : #P = #H + 1) {c : Clause (Fin m × Fin n)} {i₀ : Fin m}
    (hi₀ : i₀ ∈ falsifiedPigeons P H c) :
    #P - #(falsifiedPigeons P H c) ≤ #((satPairs P H c).filter fun p => p.1 = i₀) := by
  set S := falsifiedPigeons P H c
  obtain ⟨hi₀P, g, hg, h₀, hc₀⟩ := mem_falsifiedPigeons.1 hi₀
  -- every `i₁ ∈ P \ S` is `g j` for a hole `j ∈ H` with `(i₀, j) ∈ satPairs P H c`
  have hsub : P \ S ⊆ (H.filter fun j => (i₀, j) ∈ satPairs P H c).image g := by
    intro i₁ hi₁
    obtain ⟨hi₁P, hi₁S⟩ := mem_sdiff.1 hi₁
    have hne : i₁ ≠ i₀ := fun h => hi₁S (h ▸ hi₀)
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 (mem_image_of_ne_of_isCrit hP hg hi₀P h₀ hi₁P hne)
    refine mem_image_of_mem g (mem_filter.2 ⟨hj, ?_⟩)
    -- swapping `i₀` into hole `j` gives a critical assignment with missing pigeon `g j ∉ S`
    have hc₁ : c.eval (critAssign H (Function.update g j i₀)) = true := by
      by_contra hc₁
      exact hi₁S (mem_falsifiedPigeons.2 ⟨hg.1 j hj, _, isCrit_update hg hi₀P h₀,
        not_mem_image_update hg h₀ hj, Bool.eq_false_iff.2 hc₁⟩)
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hl₁⟩ := (Clause.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).1 hc₁
    have hne' : critAssign H g l.1 ≠ critAssign H (Function.update g j i₀) l.1 := fun h =>
      Bool.false_ne_true (hc₀.symm.trans ((Clause.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).2 ⟨l, hl, h.trans hl₁⟩))
    exact mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_product.2 ⟨hi₀P, hj⟩, l, hl,
      hl₁ ▸ matchPair_eq_some_of_critAssign_ne hj hne'⟩
  have hSP : S ⊆ P := falsifiedPigeons_subset P H c
  calc #P - #S = #(P \ S) := (card_sdiff_of_subset hSP).symm
    _ ≤ #((H.filter fun j => (i₀, j) ∈ satPairs P H c).image g) := card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ #(H.filter fun j => (i₀, j) ∈ satPairs P H c) := card_image_le
    _ ≤ #((satPairs P H c).filter fun p => p.1 = i₀) := by
      refine card_le_card_of_injOn (fun j => (i₀, j)) (fun j hj => ?_)
        fun _ _ _ _ heq => (Prod.mk.inj heq).2
      exact mem_filter.2 ⟨(mem_filter.1 hj).2, rfl⟩

private theorem card_falsifiedPigeons_mul_le_card_satPairs {P : Finset (Fin m)} {H : Finset (Fin n)}
    (hP : #P = #H + 1) (c : Clause (Fin m × Fin n)) :
    #(falsifiedPigeons P H c) * (#P - #(falsifiedPigeons P H c)) ≤ #(satPairs P H c) := by
  set S := falsifiedPigeons P H c

    _ ≤ ∑ i₀ ∈ S, #((satPairs P H c).filter fun p => p.1 = i₀) :=
      sum_le_sum fun i₀ hi₀ => sub_le_card_filter_satPairs hP hi₀
    _ = #(S.biUnion fun i₀ => (satPairs P H c).filter fun p => p.1 = i₀) := by
      refine (card_biUnion fun i₁ _ i₂ _ hne => disjoint_left.2 fun p hp₁ hp₂ => ?_).symm
      exact hne ((mem_filter.1 hp₁).2.symm.trans (mem_filter.1 hp₂).2)
    _ ≤ #(satPairs P H c) := card_le_card fun p hp => by
      obtain ⟨_, -, hp⟩ := mem_biUnion.1 hp
      exact (mem_filter.1 hp).1

private theorem exists_restrict_countP_satPairs {P : Finset (Fin m)} {H : Finset (Fin n)} {C d : ℕ}
    (hP : P.Nonempty) (hH : H.Nonempty) (hd : 0 < d) (hC : #P * #H ≤ C * d)
    {ls : List (Clause (Fin m × Fin n))} (h : (pigeonholeOn P H).IsProof ls) (hnil : [] ∈ ls) :
    ∃ i₀ ∈ P, ∃ j₀ ∈ H, ∃ ls',
      (pigeonholeOn (P.erase i₀) (H.erase j₀)).IsProof ls' ∧ [] ∈ ls' ∧
        C * ls'.countP (fun c => d ≤ #(satPairs (P.erase i₀) (H.erase j₀) c)) ≤
          (C - 1) * ls.countP (fun c => d ≤ #(satPairs P H c)) := by
  set F := ls.filter (fun c => d ≤ #(satPairs P H c))
  have hFlen : F.length = ls.countP (fun c => d ≤ #(satPairs P H c)) := by
    rw [List.countP_eq_length_filter]
  obtain ⟨⟨i₀, j₀⟩, hpU, hmany⟩ := exists_le_countP_mem (P ×ˢ H) (satPairs P H) d F
    (hP.product hH) (fun c _ => filter_subset _ _)
    (fun c hc => by simpa using (List.mem_filter.1 hc).2)
  obtain ⟨hi₀, hj₀⟩ := mem_product.1 hpU
  rw [card_product, hFlen] at hmany
  obtain ⟨ls', h', hsub, ks, hks, hfree, hF⟩ := h.restrictBy (matchPair i₀ j₀)
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀, hsub₀⟩ := hsub [] hnil (by simp)
  have hc₀' : c₀ = [] := List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.2 fun l hl => List.not_mem_nil (hsub₀ l hl)
  refine ⟨i₀, hi₀, j₀, hj₀, ls', h'.mono (restrictBy_pigeonholeOn_subset hj₀), hc₀' ▸ hc₀, ?_⟩
  -- lines of `ls'` are subclauses of lines of `ks`, which are not satisfied by `matchPair i₀ j₀`
  have hle₁ : ls'.countP (fun c => d ≤ #(satPairs (P.erase i₀) (H.erase j₀) c)) ≤
      ks.countP (fun c => (i₀, j₀) ∉ satPairs P H c ∧ d ≤ #(satPairs P H c)) := by
    refine (countP_le_of_forall₂ (q := fun c => decide (d ≤ #(satPairs P H c))) hF
      fun c' c hcc' hw => ?_).trans ?_
    · simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hw ⊢
      exact hw.trans (card_le_card (satPairs_subset (erase_subset _ _) (erase_subset _ _) hcc'))
    · refine le_of_eq (List.countP_congr fun c hc => ?_)
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, iff_and_self]
      intro _ hmem
      obtain ⟨_, l, hl, hmatch⟩ := mem_filter.1 hmem
      exact hfree c hc l hl hmatch
  have hle₂ := hle₁.trans hks.countP_le
  have hsplit := List.countP_and_not_add_countP_and (fun c => d ≤ #(satPairs P H c))
    (fun c => (i₀, j₀) ∈ satPairs P H c) ls
  have hcnt : F.countP (fun c => (i₀, j₀) ∈ satPairs P H c) =
      ls.countP (fun c => d ≤ #(satPairs P H c) ∧ (i₀, j₀) ∈ satPairs P H c) := by
    rw [List.countP_filter]
    congr 1
    funext c
    simp [Bool.and_comm]
  rw [hcnt] at hmany
  set f := ls.countP (fun c => d ≤ #(satPairs P H c))
  set f' := ls'.countP (fun c => d ≤ #(satPairs (P.erase i₀) (H.erase j₀) c))
  set g := ls.countP (fun c => d ≤ #(satPairs P H c) ∧ (i₀, j₀) ∈ satPairs P H c)
  have hfg : f' + g ≤ f := by omega
  have hdg : d * f ≤ d * (C * g) := by
