theorem IsProof.restrict (h : φ.IsProof ls) (v : V) (b : Bool) :
    ∃ ls', (φ.restrict v b).IsProof ls' ∧ ls'.length ≤ ls.length ∧
      (∀ c ∈ ls, (v, b) ∉ c → ∃ c' ∈ ls', ∀ l ∈ c', l ∈ c) ∧
      ∀ w, ls'.countP (fun c => w < c.width) ≤ ls.countP (fun c => (v, b) ∉ c ∧ w < c.width) := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], .nil, le_rfl, by simp, by simp⟩
  | @mem ls c _ hc ih =>
    obtain ⟨ls', h', hlen, hsub, hcount⟩ := ih
    by_cases hvc : (v, b) ∈ c
    · refine ⟨ls', h', hlen.trans (Nat.le_succ _), fun e he hve => ?_,
        fun w => countP_le_cons (hcount w)⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      exacts [absurd hvc hve, hsub e he hve]
    · refine ⟨c.filter (· ≠ (v, !b)) :: ls', h'.mem (mem_restrict.2 ⟨c, hc, hvc, rfl⟩),
        Nat.succ_le_succ hlen, fun e he hve => ?_, fun w => countP_cons_le_cons (hcount w) ?_⟩
      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
        · exact ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, fun l hl => (List.mem_filter.1 hl).1⟩
        · obtain ⟨c', hc', hsub'⟩ := hsub e he hve
          exact ⟨c', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc', hsub'⟩
      · intro hw
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hw ⊢
        exact ⟨hvc, hw.trans_le (Clause.width_le_width fun l hl => (List.mem_filter.1 hl).1)⟩
  | @resolvent ls c₁ c₂ u _ h₁ h₂ hu₁ hu₂ ih =>
    obtain ⟨ls', h', hlen, hsub, hcount⟩ := ih
    by_cases hvc : (v, b) ∈ c₁.resolvent c₂ u
    · refine ⟨ls', h', hlen.trans (Nat.le_succ _), fun e he hve => ?_,
        fun w => countP_le_cons (hcount w)⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      exacts [absurd hvc hve, hsub e he hve]
    -- the new line to add, if any: a subclause of the resolvent derivable from `ls'`
    have key : ∃ c', (c' ∈ ls' ∨ ∃ c₁' c₂', c₁' ∈ ls' ∧ c₂' ∈ ls' ∧ (u, true) ∈ c₁' ∧
        (u, false) ∈ c₂' ∧ c' = c₁'.resolvent c₂' u) ∧ ∀ l ∈ c', l ∈ c₁.resolvent c₂ u := by
      have hne (c' : Clause V) (hc' : c' ∈ ls') (l : Literal V) (hl : l ∈ c') :
          l.1 ≠ v := h'.fst_ne_of_restrict hc' hl
      by_cases hv₁ : (v, b) ∈ c₁
      · -- `v = u` and `b = true`: the second premise is not satisfied, and its subclause will do
        have huv : (v, b) = (u, true) := by
          by_contra hne'
          exact hvc (Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inl ⟨hv₁, hne'⟩))
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj huv
        obtain ⟨c₂', hc₂', hsub₂⟩ := hsub c₂ h₂ fun hv₂ =>
          hvc (Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inr ⟨hv₂, by simp⟩))
        refine ⟨c₂', Or.inl hc₂', fun l hl => Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inr ⟨hsub₂ l hl, ?_⟩)⟩
        rintro rfl
        exact hne _ hc₂' _ hl rfl
      by_cases hv₂ : (v, b) ∈ c₂
      · have huv : (v, b) = (u, false) := by
          by_contra hne'
          exact hvc (Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inr ⟨hv₂, hne'⟩))
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj huv
        obtain ⟨c₁', hc₁', hsub₁⟩ := hsub c₁ h₁ hv₁
        refine ⟨c₁', Or.inl hc₁', fun l hl => Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inl ⟨hsub₁ l hl, ?_⟩)⟩
        rintro rfl
        exact hne _ hc₁' _ hl rfl
      obtain ⟨c₁', hc₁', hsub₁⟩ := hsub c₁ h₁ hv₁
      obtain ⟨c₂', hc₂', hsub₂⟩ := hsub c₂ h₂ hv₂
      by_cases hu₁' : (u, true) ∈ c₁'
      · by_cases hu₂' : (u, false) ∈ c₂'
        · refine ⟨_, Or.inr ⟨c₁', c₂', hc₁', hc₂', hu₁', hu₂', rfl⟩, fun l hl => ?_⟩
          rcases Clause.mem_resolvent.1 hl with ⟨hl, hne'⟩ | ⟨hl, hne'⟩
          · exact Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inl ⟨hsub₁ l hl, hne'⟩)
          · exact Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inr ⟨hsub₂ l hl, hne'⟩)
        · refine ⟨c₂', Or.inl hc₂', fun l hl => Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inr ⟨hsub₂ l hl, ?_⟩)⟩
          rintro rfl
          exact hu₂' hl
      · refine ⟨c₁', Or.inl hc₁', fun l hl => Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inl ⟨hsub₁ l hl, ?_⟩)⟩
        rintro rfl
        exact hu₁' hl
    obtain ⟨c', hc' | ⟨c₁', c₂', hc₁', hc₂', hu₁', hu₂', rfl⟩, hsub'⟩ := key
    · refine ⟨ls', h', hlen.trans (Nat.le_succ _), fun e he hve => ?_,
        fun w => countP_le_cons (hcount w)⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      exacts [⟨c', hc', hsub'⟩, hsub e he hve]
    · refine ⟨_ :: ls', h'.resolvent u hc₁' hc₂' hu₁' hu₂', Nat.succ_le_succ hlen,
        fun e he hve => ?_, fun w => countP_cons_le_cons (hcount w) ?_⟩
      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
        · exact ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, hsub'⟩
        · obtain ⟨e', he', hsub''⟩ := hsub e he hve
          exact ⟨e', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he', hsub''⟩
      · intro hw
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hw ⊢
        exact ⟨hvc, hw.trans_le (Clause.width_le_width hsub')⟩

theorem IsProof.comp (hψ : ψ.IsProof ls') (h : φ.IsProof ls) (hψφ : ∀ c ∈ ψ, c ∈ ls) :
    ∃ ls'', φ.IsProof (ls'' ++ ls) ∧ (∀ c ∈ ls', c ∈ ls'' ++ ls) ∧ ∀ c ∈ ls'', c ∈ ls' := by
  induction hψ with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], h, by simp, by simp⟩
  | @mem ls' c _ hc ih =>
    obtain ⟨ls'', h'', hup, hdown⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨ls'', h'', fun e he => ?_, fun e he => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (hdown e he)⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
    exacts [List.mem_append_right _ (hψφ _ hc), hup e he]
  | @resolvent ls' c₁ c₂ v _ h₁ h₂ hv₁ hv₂ ih =>
    obtain ⟨ls'', h'', hup, hdown⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨_ :: ls'', h''.resolvent v (hup _ h₁) (hup _ h₂) hv₁ hv₂, fun e he => ?_,
      fun e he => ?_⟩
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      exacts [List.mem_cons_self, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (hup e he)]
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      exacts [List.mem_cons_self, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (hdown e he)]

        fun e he => ?_, .cons (fun l hl => (List.mem_filter.1 hl).1) hF⟩

      rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he

    obtain ⟨ls', h', hsub, ks, hks, hfree, hF⟩ := ih

      rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he

theorem RefutableInWidth.of_restrict {v : V} {b : Bool} {w : ℕ}
    (hφ : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.width ≤ w + 1) (h₁ : (φ.restrict v b).RefutableInWidth w)
    (h₂ : (φ.restrict v (!b)).RefutableInWidth (w + 1)) : φ.RefutableInWidth (w + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨ls₁, hp₁, hnil₁, hw₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨ls, hp, hup, hdown⟩ := hp₁.lift
  have hw : ∀ c ∈ ls, c.width ≤ w + 1 := fun c hc => by
    obtain ⟨c', hc', hsub⟩ := hdown c hc
    exact (Clause.width_le_width_add_one hsub).trans (Nat.succ_le_succ (hw₁ c' hc'))
  -- lifting the first refutation derives a clause `c₀` whose literals are all `(v, !b)`
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀, -, hc₀v⟩ := hup [] hnil₁
  have hc₀v : ∀ l ∈ c₀, l = (v, !b) := fun l hl => (hc₀v l hl).resolve_left List.not_mem_nil
  by_cases hx : (v, !b) ∈ c₀
  swap
  · have : c₀ = [] := List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.2 fun l hl => hx (hc₀v l hl ▸ hl)
    exact ⟨ls, hp, this ▸ hc₀, hw⟩
  have hfilter : c₀.filter (· ≠ (v, !b)) = [] :=
    List.filter_eq_nil_iff.2 fun l hl => by simpa using hc₀v l hl
  -- the clauses of the second restricted formula are clauses of `φ` or resolvents with `c₀`
  have hψ : φ.IsProof (φ.restrict v (!b) ++ (φ ++ ls)) := by
    refine ((IsProof.of_forall_mem fun e he => he).append hp).append_of_forall fun e he => ?_
    obtain ⟨d, hd, -, rfl⟩ := mem_restrict.1 he
    by_cases hvd : (v, b) ∈ d
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      cases b
      · refine ⟨c₀, List.mem_append_right _ hc₀, d, List.mem_append_left _ hd, v, hx, hvd, ?_⟩
        simp only [Clause.resolvent, Bool.not_false, Bool.not_true] at hfilter ⊢
        rw [hfilter, List.nil_append]
      · refine ⟨d, List.mem_append_left _ hd, c₀, List.mem_append_right _ hc₀, v, hvd, hx, ?_⟩
        simp only [Clause.resolvent, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false] at hfilter ⊢
        rw [hfilter, List.append_nil]
    · refine Or.inl ?_
      rw [Bool.not_not, List.filter_eq_self.2 fun l hl => by
        simp only [ne_eq, decide_eq_true_eq]
        rintro rfl
        exact hvd hl]
      exact hd
  obtain ⟨ls₂, hp₂, hnil₂, hw₂⟩ := h₂
  obtain ⟨ls'', hp'', hup'', hdown''⟩ := hp₂.comp hψ fun c hc => List.mem_append_left _ hc
  refine ⟨_, hp'', hup'' _ hnil₂, fun c hc => ?_⟩
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hc with hc | hc
  · exact hw₂ c (hdown'' c hc)
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hc with hc | hc
  · exact width_le_of_mem_restrict hφ hc
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hc with hc | hc
  exacts [hφ c hc, hw c hc]

/-! ### Wide lines -/

/-- **Double counting**: summing over literals the number of clauses of a list containing them
gives the total width, when the literals of the clauses are among the summed literals. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
private theorem exists_lt_countP_mem (U : Finset (Literal V)) (d : ℕ) (F : List (Clause V))
    (hF : ∀ c ∈ F, ∀ l ∈ c, l ∈ U) (hwide : ∀ c ∈ F, d < c.width) (hne : F ≠ []) :
    ∃ l ∈ U, d * F.length < F.countP (fun c => l ∈ c) * U.card := by
  by_contra! h
  have hsum := sum_countP_mem_eq_sum_width U F hF
  have hle : (F.map Clause.width).sum * U.card ≤ U.card * (d * F.length) := by
    rw [← hsum, Finset.sum_mul]
    exact (Finset.sum_le_sum h).trans (by simp)
  have hge : F.length * (d + 1) ≤ (F.map Clause.width).sum := by
    have := List.sum_le_sum (l := F) (f := fun _ => d + 1) (g := Clause.width)
      fun c hc => hwide c hc
    simpa using this
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil F hne
  have hU : 0 < U.card := by
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil c fun hnil => by
      have := hwide c hc
      simp [hnil] at this
    exact Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨l, hF c hc l hl⟩
  have hlen : 0 < F.length := List.length_pos_iff.2 hne
  have key := (Nat.mul_le_mul_right U.card hge).trans hle
  have := Nat.mul_pos hlen hU
  nlinarith

/-- The literals of the lines of a proof from `φ` are literals of variables of `φ`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
private theorem refutableInWidth_of_countP_wide (N d k : ℕ) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : CNF V) (ls : List (Clause V)) (b : ℕ), φ.vars.toFinset.card ≤ n → n ≤ N →
      φ.IsProof ls → [] ∈ ls → (∀ c ∈ φ, c.width ≤ k) →
      ls.countP (fun c => d < c.width) * (2 * N - d) ^ b < (2 * N) ^ b →
      φ.RefutableInWidth (max d k + b) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro φ ls b hn _ h hnil _ _
    refine ⟨ls, h, hnil, fun c hc => ?_⟩
    have := width_le_of_isProof h hc
    omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro φ ls b hn hnN h hnil hk hcount
    set f := ls.countP (fun c => d < c.width) with hf
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos f with hf0 | hfpos
    · -- no wide lines
      refine ⟨ls, h, hnil, fun c hc => ?_⟩
      have := List.countP_eq_zero.1 hf0 c hc
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, not_lt] at this
      omega
    -- the wide lines, and a literal `(v, β)` occurring in many of them
    set F := ls.filter (fun c => d < c.width)
    have hFlen : F.length = f := by rw [hf, List.countP_eq_length_filter]
    have hFne : F ≠ [] := by
      intro hF
      rw [hF, List.length_nil] at hFlen
      omega
    obtain ⟨⟨v, β⟩, hU, hmany⟩ := exists_lt_countP_mem _ d F
      (fun c hc => mem_literals_of_isProof h c (List.mem_filter.1 hc).1)
      (fun c hc => by simpa using (List.mem_filter.1 hc).2) hFne
    rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_bool, hFlen] at hmany
    have hv : v ∈ φ.vars.toFinset := (Finset.mem_product.1 hU).1
    -- there are wide lines, so `d < 2N`, and `b` is positive
    have hdN : d < 2 * N := by
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil F hFne
      have h1 := (List.mem_filter.1 hc)
      have := width_le_of_isProof h h1.1
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h1
      omega
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b', b = b' + 1 := by
      rcases b with _ | b
      · simp only [pow_zero, mul_one, Nat.lt_one_iff] at hcount
        omega
      · exact ⟨b, rfl⟩
    have hvars (γ : Bool) : (φ.restrict v γ).vars.toFinset.card ≤ n := by
      have := (Finset.card_le_card (vars_restrict_subset (b := γ))).trans_eq
        (Finset.card_erase_of_mem hv)
      omega
    have hk' (γ : Bool) : ∀ c ∈ φ.restrict v γ, c.width ≤ k := fun c hc =>
      width_le_of_mem_restrict hk hc
    -- the restrictions of the refutation
    have hres (γ : Bool) : ∃ ls', (φ.restrict v γ).IsProof ls' ∧ [] ∈ ls' ∧
        ls'.countP (fun c => d < c.width) ≤
          ls.countP (fun c => (v, γ) ∉ c ∧ d < c.width) := by
      obtain ⟨ls', h', -, hsub, hcount'⟩ := h.restrict v γ
      obtain ⟨c', hc', hsub'⟩ := hsub [] hnil List.not_mem_nil
      have : c' = [] := List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.2 fun l hl => List.not_mem_nil (hsub' l hl)
      exact ⟨ls', h', this ▸ hc', hcount' d⟩
    -- fixing the literal to be true removes the many wide lines containing it
    obtain ⟨ls₁, h₁, hnil₁, hcount₁⟩ := hres β
    have hsplit := List.countP_and_not_add_countP_and (fun c => d < Clause.width c)
      (fun c => (v, β) ∈ c) ls
    have hcnt : F.countP (fun c => (v, β) ∈ c) = ls.countP (fun c => d < c.width ∧ (v, β) ∈ c) := by
      rw [List.countP_filter]
      congr 1
      funext c
      simp [Bool.and_comm]
    rw [hcnt] at hmany
    have hpow : (2 * N - d) * (2 * N) ^ b ≤ (2 * N) ^ (b + 1) := by
      rw [pow_succ, mul_comm]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.sub_le _ _)
    have hwidth₁ : (φ.restrict v β).RefutableInWidth (max d k + b) := by
      refine ih _ ls₁ b (hvars β) (by omega) h₁ hnil₁ (hk' β) ?_
      -- `f₁ * 2N < f * (2N - d)`, hence `f₁ (2N - d)^b < (2N)^b`
      have hf₁ : ls₁.countP (fun c => d < c.width) * (2 * N) < f * (2 * N - d) := by
        have h₂ : ls₁.countP (fun c => d < c.width) +
            ls.countP (fun c => d < c.width ∧ (v, β) ∈ c) ≤ f := by
          simp only [hf]
          omega
        rw [Nat.mul_sub, Nat.lt_sub_iff_add_lt]
        nlinarith
      have hpos : 0 < 2 * N := by omega
      refine Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right (a := 2 * N) ?_
      calc ls₁.countP (fun c => d < c.width) * (2 * N - d) ^ b * (2 * N)
          = ls₁.countP (fun c => d < c.width) * (2 * N) * (2 * N - d) ^ b := by ring
        _ < f * (2 * N - d) * (2 * N - d) ^ b :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hf₁ (Nat.pow_pos (by omega))
        _ = f * (2 * N - d) ^ (b + 1) := by ring
        _ < (2 * N) ^ (b + 1) := hcount
        _ = (2 * N) ^ b * (2 * N) := pow_succ _ _
    -- fixing it to be false keeps at most the same wide lines, over fewer variables
    obtain ⟨ls₀, h₀, hnil₀, hcount₀⟩ := hres (!β)
    have hwidth₀ : (φ.restrict v (!β)).RefutableInWidth (max d k + (b + 1)) := by
      refine ih _ ls₀ (b + 1) (hvars _) (by omega) h₀ hnil₀ (hk' _) ?_
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ?_) hcount
      exact hcount₀.trans (List.countP_mono_left fun c _ hc => by
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hc ⊢
        exact hc.2)
    exact RefutableInWidth.of_restrict (w := max d k + b) (fun c hc => (hk c hc).trans (by omega))
      hwidth₁ hwidth₀

/-- **Refutations with few wide lines can be made narrow** [Ben-Sasson and Wigderson, Theorem 3.5]
[BenSassonWigderson2001]. Let the clauses of `φ` have width at most `k`, and let `φ` have at most
`N` variables. If `φ` has a refutation of `s` lines, and `s (2N - d) ^ b < (2N) ^ b`, then `φ` is
refutable in width at most `max d k + b`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem RefutableInWidth.of_refutableInSize {k s N d b : ℕ} (hk : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.width ≤ k)
    (hN : φ.vars.toFinset.card ≤ N) (hs : φ.RefutableInSize s)
    (hsdb : s * (2 * N - d) ^ b < (2 * N) ^ b) : φ.RefutableInWidth (max d k + b) := by
  obtain ⟨ls, h, hnil, hlen⟩ := hs
  refine refutableInWidth_of_countP_wide N d k N φ ls b hN le_rfl h hnil hk ?_
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (List.countP_le_length.trans hlen)) hsdb

/-! ### The size–width tradeoff -/

/-- **The size–width tradeoff** [Ben-Sasson and Wigderson, Theorem 3.5 and Corollary 3.6]
[BenSassonWigderson2001].
A formula whose clauses have width at most `k`, with at most `N` variables, that has a refutation
of `s` lines has a refutation of width at most `k + 2 √(2 N log s) + 2`. Equivalently, a formula
that needs width `w ≥ k + 2`, with `N > 0`, needs refutations of at least
`exp ((w - k - 2)² / 8N)` lines. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem exists_refutableInWidth_le_of_refutableInSize {k s N : ℕ} (hk : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.width ≤ k)
    (hN : φ.vars.toFinset.card ≤ N) (hs : φ.RefutableInSize s) :
    ∃ w : ℕ, φ.RefutableInWidth w ∧
      (w : ℝ) ≤ k + 2 * √(2 * N * Real.log s) + 2 := by
  obtain ⟨ls, h, hnil, hlen⟩ := hs
  have hL : 0 ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.log s := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ s := by
      have := List.length_pos_of_mem hnil
      exact_mod_cast this.trans_le hlen
    have := Real.log_nonneg this
    positivity
  have hpos : 0 ≤ k + 2 * √(2 * N * Real.log s) + 2 := by positivity
  -- without variables or with a single line, every line of the refutation is empty
  by_cases htriv : N = 0 ∨ s ≤ 1
  · refine ⟨0, ⟨ls, h, hnil, fun c hc => ?_⟩, by exact_mod_cast hpos⟩
    rcases htriv with hN0 | hs1
    · have := width_le_of_isProof h hc
      omega
    · obtain rfl : ls = [[]] := by
        rcases ls with _ | ⟨c₀, _ | ⟨c₁, ls⟩⟩
        · simp at hnil
        · simpa using hnil
        · simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
          omega
      simp_all
  push Not at htriv
  obtain ⟨hN0, hs1⟩ := htriv
  set L := 2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.log s with hLdef
  have hLpos : 0 < L := by
    have : 0 < Real.log s := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hs1)
    positivity
  set d := ⌈√L⌉₊ with hd
  set b := ⌊L / d⌋₊ + 1 with hb
  have hsqrt : 0 < √L := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hLpos
  have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < d := hsqrt.trans_le (Nat.le_ceil _)
  have hLd : L / d ≤ √L := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hdpos]
    calc L = √L * √L := (Real.mul_self_sqrt hLpos.le).symm
      _ ≤ √L * d := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Nat.le_ceil _) hsqrt.le
  -- `s (2N - d)^b < (2N)^b`, from `(1 - d/2N)^b ≤ exp (-db/2N) < 1/s`
  have hsdb : s * (2 * N - d) ^ b < (2 * N) ^ b := by
    rcases le_or_gt (2 * N) d with hdN | hdN
    · rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hdN, zero_pow (by omega), mul_zero]
      positivity
    have hN' : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * N := by positivity
    have hdb : L < d * b := by
      rw [← div_lt_iff₀' hdpos]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_floor_add_one (L / d)
    have h1 : ((2 * N - d : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * N * (1 - d / (2 * N)) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hdN.le]
      field_simp
      push_cast
      ring
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ 1 - (d : ℝ) / (2 * N) := by
      rw [sub_nonneg, div_le_one hN']
      exact_mod_cast hdN.le
    have hx1 : 1 - (d : ℝ) / (2 * N) ≤ Real.exp (-(d / (2 * N))) := by
      linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (-((d : ℝ) / (2 * N)))]
    have hexp : ((2 * N - d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ b ≤ (2 * N) ^ b * Real.exp (b * -(d / (2 * N))) := by
      rw [h1, mul_pow, Real.exp_nat_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ hx0 hx1 b) (by positivity)
    have hlt : (s : ℝ) * Real.exp (b * -(d / (2 * N))) < 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < s), ← Real.exp_add, Real.exp_lt_one_iff]
      have : Real.log s < d * b / (2 * N) := by
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ hN']
        linarith
      have h2 : (b : ℝ) * -(d / (2 * N)) = -(d * b / (2 * N)) := by ring
      linarith
    have : (s : ℝ) * ((2 * N - d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ b < (2 * N) ^ b := by
      calc (s : ℝ) * ((2 * N - d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ b
          ≤ s * ((2 * N) ^ b * Real.exp (b * -(d / (2 * N)))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by positivity)
        _ = (2 * N) ^ b * (s * Real.exp (b * -(d / (2 * N)))) := by ring
        _ < (2 * N) ^ b * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt (by positivity)
        _ = (2 * N) ^ b := mul_one _
    exact_mod_cast this
  refine ⟨_, RefutableInWidth.of_refutableInSize hk hN ⟨ls, h, hnil, hlen⟩ hsdb, ?_⟩
  -- `max d k + b ≤ k + (√L + 1) + (√L + 1)`
  have hd' : (d : ℝ) ≤ √L + 1 := (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (Real.sqrt_nonneg L)).le
  have hb' : (b : ℝ) ≤ √L + 1 := by
    rw [hb, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    linarith [(Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hLpos.le hdpos.le)).trans hLd]
  have hmax : ((max d k + b : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ d + k + b := by
    push_cast
    have := max_le_add_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) d) (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k)
    linarith
  linarith

/-- **Width lower bounds give size lower bounds** [Ben-Sasson and Wigderson, Corollary 3.6]
[BenSassonWigderson2001]. Let the clauses of `φ` have width at most `k`, and let `φ` have at most
`N` variables. If every resolution refutation of `φ` has width at least `W ≥ k + 2`, then every
resolution refutation of `φ` has at least `exp ((W - k - 2)² / 8N)` lines. -/

theorem eval_toDecisionTree : {c : Clause V} → (d : φ.Derivation c) → {σ : V → Bool} →
    c.eval σ = false →
      d.toDecisionTree.eval σ ∈ φ ∧ (d.toDecisionTree.eval σ).eval σ = false
  | _, mem hc, _, hσ => ⟨hc, hσ⟩
  | _, resolvent (c₁ := c₁) (c₂ := c₂) v d₁ d₂ _ _, σ, hσ => by
    have hσ' : ∀ l ∈ c₁.resolvent c₂ v, σ l.1 ≠ l.2 := fun l hl h =>
      Bool.false_ne_true (hσ.symm.trans ((Clause.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).2 ⟨l, hl, h⟩))
    simp only [toDecisionTree, DecisionTree.eval]
    cases hv : σ v
    · refine d₁.eval_toDecisionTree (Bool.eq_false_iff.2 fun h => ?_)
      obtain ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩ := (Clause.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).1 h
      by_cases hlv : l = (v, true)
      · subst hlv
        simp [hv] at hl'
      · exact hσ' l (Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inl ⟨hl, hlv⟩)) hl'
    · refine d₂.eval_toDecisionTree (Bool.eq_false_iff.2 fun h => ?_)
      obtain ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩ := (Clause.eval_eq_true_iff _ _).1 h
      by_cases hlv : l = (v, false)
      · subst hlv
        simp [hv] at hl'
      · exact hσ' l (Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inr ⟨hl, hlv⟩)) hl'

text:
theorem RefutableInWidth.of_derivation {k b : ℕ} (hk : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.width ≤ k) {c : Clause V}
    (d : φ.Derivation c) (hc : c = []) (hd : d.size ≤ 2 ^ b) : φ.RefutableInWidth (k + b) := by
  induction hn : d.size using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing φ c b with
  | _ n ih =>
  cases d with
  | mem hmem =>
    subst hc
    exact RefutableInWidth.mono ⟨[[]], IsProof.nil.mem hmem, List.mem_singleton_self _,
      by simp⟩ (Nat.zero_le _)
  | @resolvent c₁ c₂ v d₁ d₂ hv₁ hv₂ =>
    simp only [Derivation.size_resolvent] at hn hd
    -- the premises are the unit clauses of `v` and of its negation
    have hl₁ : ∀ l ∈ c₁, l = (v, true) := fun l hl => by
      by_contra hne
      have : l ∈ c₁.resolvent c₂ v := Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inl ⟨hl, hne⟩)
      rw [hc] at this
      exact List.not_mem_nil this
    have hl₂ : ∀ l ∈ c₂, l = (v, false) := fun l hl => by
      by_contra hne
      have : l ∈ c₁.resolvent c₂ v := Clause.mem_resolvent.2 (Or.inr ⟨hl, hne⟩)
      rw [hc] at this
      exact List.not_mem_nil this
    obtain ⟨c₁', d₁', hsub₁, hsize₁⟩ := d₁.restrict v false fun h => by simpa using hl₁ _ h
    obtain ⟨c₂', d₂', hsub₂, hsize₂⟩ := d₂.restrict v true fun h => by simpa using hl₂ _ h
    have hc₁' : c₁' = [] := List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.2 fun l hl =>
      d₁'.fst_ne_of_restrict hl (by rw [hl₁ l (hsub₁ l hl)])
    have hc₂' : c₂' = [] := List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.2 fun l hl =>
      d₂'.fst_ne_of_restrict hl (by rw [hl₂ l (hsub₂ l hl)])
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b', b = b' + 1 := by
      rcases b with _ | b
      · have := d₁.size_pos
        simp only [pow_zero] at hd
        omega
      · exact ⟨b, rfl⟩
    have hk' (γ : Bool) : ∀ c ∈ φ.restrict v γ, c.width ≤ k := fun c hc =>
      width_le_of_mem_restrict hk hc
    have hφ : ∀ c ∈ φ, c.width ≤ k + b + 1 := fun c hc => (hk c hc).trans (by omega)
    rw [pow_succ] at hd

private theorem atom_iff_realize [Nonempty M] {A : Φ.groundInterpretation.Model M → Prop}
    (hA : cnf.Satisfies A) {k : ℕ} (ψ : (L.sum (varLanguage Φ.arity)).BoundedFormula Empty k)
    (hs : ⟨k, ψ⟩ ∈ subformulas Φ.matrix) (a : Fin k → M) :
    A (atom ⟨⟨k, ψ⟩, hs⟩ a) ↔
      (letI := varLanguage.structure (assignmentRel A); ψ.Realize default a) := by
  let _ := varLanguage.structure (assignmentRel A)
  induction ψ with
  | falsum =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := exists_init_eq a
    exact iff_of_false ((clauseSat_falsum A x hs (realize_domain_clause hs 0 x)).1 (hA _)) id
  | equal t₁ t₂ =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := exists_init_eq a
    rw [(clauseSat_equal A x hs (realize_domain_clause hs 0 x)).1 (hA _)]
    change _ ↔ t₁.realize _ = t₂.realize _
    rw [term_realize, term_realize]
  | rel R ts =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := exists_init_eq a
    rcases R with R | r
    · rw [(clauseSat_relInl A x hs (realize_domain_clause hs 0 x)).1 (hA _)]
      change _ ↔ RelMap R fun i => (ts i).realize _
      simp only [term_realize]
    · have h₀ := (clauseSat_relInr₀ A x hs (realize_domain_clause hs 0 x)).1 (hA _)
      have h₁ := (clauseSat_relInr₁ A x hs (realize_domain_clause hs 1 x)).1 (hA _)
      refine Iff.trans ⟨h₀, h₁⟩ ?_
      change _ ↔ A (relAtom r.1 fun j => (ts (Fin.cast r.2 j)).realize _)
      simp only [term_realize]
      rfl
  | imp ψ χ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := exists_init_eq a
    have h₀ := (clauseSat_imp₀ A x hs (realize_domain_clause hs 0 x)).1 (hA _)
    have h₁ := (clauseSat_imp₁ A x hs (realize_domain_clause hs 1 x)).1 (hA _)
    have h₂ := (clauseSat_imp₂ A x hs (realize_domain_clause hs 2 x)).1 (hA _)
    have e₁ := ih₁ (mem_subformulas_of_imp_left hs) (Fin.init x)
    have e₂ := ih₂ (mem_subformulas_of_imp_right hs) (Fin.init x)
    rw [BoundedFormula.realize_imp]
    exact ⟨fun h hψ => e₂.1 (h₀ h (e₁.2 hψ)),
      fun h => h₁.elim id fun h' => h₂ (e₂.2 (h (e₁.1 h')))⟩
  | all ψ ih =>
    rw [BoundedFormula.realize_all]
    constructor
    · intro h b
      refine (ih (mem_subformulas_of_all hs) _).1 ?_
      have := (clauseSat_all₀ A (Fin.snoc a b) hs (realize_domain_clause hs 0 _)).1 (hA _)
      rw [Fin.init_snoc] at this
      exact this h
    · intro h
      have := (clauseSat_all₁ A (Fin.snoc a (Classical.arbitrary M)) hs
        (realize_domain_clause hs 1 _)).1 (hA _)
      simp only [Fin.init_snoc] at this
      exact this fun b => (ih (mem_subformulas_of_all hs) _).2 (h b)

theorem realize_independentSetSentence [Finite M] :
    independentSetSentence.Realize M ↔ ∃ s : Set M,
      s.ncard = {x : M | RelMap sizedGraph.size ![x]}.ncard ∧
        s.Pairwise fun x y => ¬RelMap sizedGraph.adj ![x, y] := by
  change (∃ R : ∀ i, Set (Fin (independentSetArity i) → M),
    letI := varLanguage.structure R; M ⊨ independentSetMatrix) ↔ _
  simp only [realize_independentSetMatrix]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨R, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆⟩
    refine ⟨{x | ![x] ∈ R 0}, ?_, fun x hx y hy hxy => h₆ x y hx hy hxy⟩
    choose f hf using h₄
    refine Set.ncard_congr (fun x hx => f x hx) (fun x hx => (h₁ _ _ (hf x hx)).2)
      (fun x y hx hy hxy => h₃ x y _ (hf x hx) (hxy ▸ hf y hy)) fun y hy => ?_
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h₅ y hy
    exact ⟨x, (h₁ _ _ hx).1, h₂ _ _ _ (hf x _) hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hind⟩
    rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq] at hs
    obtain ⟨g⟩ := Finite.card_eq.1 hs
    let R : ∀ i, Set (Fin (independentSetArity i) → M) := fun i =>
      Fin.cases (motive := fun i => Set (Fin (independentSetArity i) → M)) {v | v (0 : Fin 1) ∈ s}
        (fun j => Fin.cases (motive := fun j => Set (Fin (independentSetArity j.succ) → M))
          {v | ∃ h : v (0 : Fin 2) ∈ s, (g ⟨v (0 : Fin 2), h⟩).1 = v (1 : Fin 2)}
          (fun k => k.elim0) j) i
    refine ⟨R, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro x y ⟨hx, hxy⟩
      change x ∈ s at hx
      change (g ⟨x, hx⟩).1 = y at hxy
      subst hxy
      exact ⟨hx, (g ⟨x, hx⟩).2⟩
    · rintro x y z ⟨hx, hxy⟩ ⟨hx', hxz⟩
      change x ∈ s at hx hx'
      change (g ⟨x, hx⟩).1 = y at hxy
      change (g ⟨x, hx'⟩).1 = z at hxz
      exact hxy.symm.trans hxz
    · rintro x y z ⟨hx, hxz⟩ ⟨hy, hyz⟩
      change x ∈ s at hx
      change y ∈ s at hy
      change (g ⟨x, hx⟩).1 = z at hxz
      change (g ⟨y, hy⟩).1 = z at hyz
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (g.injective (Subtype.ext (hxz.trans hyz.symm)))
    · intro x hx
      exact ⟨(g ⟨x, hx⟩).1, hx, rfl⟩
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxy⟩ := g.surjective ⟨y, hy⟩
      exact ⟨x, hx, congrArg Subtype.val hxy⟩
    · intro x y hx hy hxy
      exact hind hx hy hxy

    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, neg_zero, zero_div, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ n := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  set c : ℝ := 2 * Real.exp (-(m * θ ^ 4) / 32) with hcdef
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by positivity
  have hγ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ θ ^ 2 / 4 := by positivity
  have hexp : -(m * (θ ^ 2 / 4) ^ 2) / 2 = -(m * θ ^ 4) / 32 := by ring
  -- one bucket estimate
  have hbucket (J S : Finset ι) :
      μ {ω | θ ^ 2 / 4 ≤ |bucketEstimate f ω J S - bucketWeight F J S|} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c := by
    have h := PMF.uniform_abs_sum_div_sub_expect_ge_le
      (fun p : (ι → Bool) × (ι → Bool) × (ι → Bool) =>
        F (J.piecewise p.1 p.2.2) * chi ℝ S p.1 * (F (J.piecewise p.2.1 p.2.2) * chi ℝ S p.2.1))
      (fun p => abs_signVal_mul_chi_mul_le_one _ _ S _ _) hm hγ
    rw [← bucketWeight_eq_expect_sample, hexp] at h
    exact h
  -- one sample coefficient
  have hcoeff (S : Finset ι) :
      μ {ω | θ ^ 2 / 4 ≤ |sampleCoeff f ω S - fourierCoeff F S|} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c := by
    have h := PMF.uniform_abs_sum_div_sub_expect_ge_le
      (fun p : (ι → Bool) × (ι → Bool) × (ι → Bool) => F p.1 * chi ℝ S p.1)
      (fun p => by rw [abs_mul, abs_signVal, abs_chi, one_mul]) hm hγ
    have hmean : 𝔼 p : (ι → Bool) × (ι → Bool) × (ι → Bool), F p.1 * chi ℝ S p.1 =
        fourierCoeff F S := by
      rw [← univ_product_univ, expect_product]
      exact expect_congr rfl fun x _ => expect_const univ_nonempty (F x * chi ℝ S x)
    rw [hmean, hexp] at h
    exact h
  -- the union bound
  clear_value c
  set A := (searchLevels (univ : Finset ι).toList).toFinset
  have hA : (#A : ℝ) ≤ n + 1 := by
    have := List.toFinset_card_le (searchLevels (univ : Finset ι).toList)
    rw [length_searchLevels, length_toList, card_univ] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hsub : {ω : Fin m → (ι → Bool) × (ι → Bool) × (ι → Bool) |
      ¬ KMAccurate f (θ ^ 2 / 4) ω} ⊆
      (⋃ J ∈ A, ⋃ S ∈ (univ : Finset (Finset ι)),
        {ω | θ ^ 2 / 4 ≤ |bucketEstimate f ω J S - bucketWeight F J S|}) ∪
      ⋃ S ∈ (univ : Finset (Finset ι)),
        {ω | θ ^ 2 / 4 ≤ |sampleCoeff f ω S - fourierCoeff F S|} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, KMAccurate, not_and_or, not_forall, not_lt] at hω
    rcases hω with ⟨J, hJ, S, hS⟩ | ⟨S, hS⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Set.mem_biUnion (List.mem_toFinset.2 hJ)
        (Set.mem_biUnion (mem_univ S) hS))
    · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_biUnion (mem_univ S) hS)
  have hpow : ((#(univ : Finset (Finset ι)) : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 ^ n := by
    rw [card_univ, Fintype.card_finset]
    push_cast
    rfl
  calc μ _ ≤ μ ((⋃ J ∈ A, ⋃ S ∈ (univ : Finset (Finset ι)),
          {ω | θ ^ 2 / 4 ≤ |bucketEstimate f ω J S - bucketWeight F J S|}) ∪
        ⋃ S ∈ (univ : Finset (Finset ι)),
          {ω | θ ^ 2 / 4 ≤ |sampleCoeff f ω S - fourierCoeff F S|}) := μ.mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ J ∈ A, ∑ S ∈ (univ : Finset (Finset ι)),
          μ {ω | θ ^ 2 / 4 ≤ |bucketEstimate f ω J S - bucketWeight F J S|} +
        ∑ S ∈ (univ : Finset (Finset ι)),
          μ {ω | θ ^ 2 / 4 ≤ |sampleCoeff f ω S - fourierCoeff F S|} := by
        refine (MeasureTheory.measure_union_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
        · refine (MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset_le A _).trans (sum_le_sum fun J _ => ?_)
          exact MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
        · exact MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _J ∈ A, ∑ _S ∈ (univ : Finset (Finset ι)), ENNReal.ofReal c +
        ∑ _S ∈ (univ : Finset (Finset ι)), ENNReal.ofReal c :=
        add_le_add (sum_le_sum fun J _ => sum_le_sum fun S _ => hbucket J S)
          (sum_le_sum fun S _ => hcoeff S)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ _J ∈ A, ∑ _S ∈ (univ : Finset (Finset ι)), c +
          ∑ _S ∈ (univ : Finset (Finset ι)), c) := by
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sum_nonneg fun _ _ => hc0)
          (sum_nonneg fun _ _ => hc0),
          ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg fun _ _ => sum_nonneg fun _ _ => hc0,
          ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg fun _ _ => hc0]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (n + 2) * 2 ^ n * Real.exp (-(m * θ ^ 4) / 32)) := by
        refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
        simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hpow]
        have h2n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ n * c := by positivity
        calc (#A : ℝ) * (2 ^ n * c) + 2 ^ n * c = (#A + 1) * (2 ^ n * c) := by ring
          _ ≤ (n + 1 + 1) * (2 ^ n * c) := by gcongr
          _ = 2 * (n + 2) * 2 ^ n * Real.exp (-(m * θ ^ 4) / 32) := by rw [hcdef]; ring

/-- **The Kushilevitz–Mansour theorem** [KushilevitzMansour1993]
[O'Donnell, Theorem 3.38][ODonnell2014]: for `n` coordinates, the Kushilevitz–Mansour algorithm
with threshold `ε / (2 L)` from `m ≥ (512 L⁴ / ε⁴) log (2 (n + 2) 2 ^ n / δ)` samples, hence
`m (2 n + 3)` membership queries (`kmLearner_queriesAtMost`), learns the Boolean functions whose
spectral norm, read as signs, is at most `L`, with error `ε` and confidence `1 - δ`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem kmLearner_learns {L ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : 512 * L ^ 4 / ε ^ 4 *
      Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι + 2) * 2 ^ Fintype.card ι / δ) ≤ m) :
    (kmLearner ι m (ε / (2 * L))).Learns (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) (spectralNormClass ι L) ε δ := by
  rw [QueryLearner.learns_iff]
  intro f hf
  simp only [eval_kmLearner]
  set n := Fintype.card ι
  have hL1 : 1 ≤ L := (one_le_sum_abs_fourierCoeff_signVal f).trans hf
  have hL : 0 < L := one_pos.trans_le hL1
  rcases le_or_gt 1 ε with hε1 | hε1
  · -- an error above `ε ≥ 1` is impossible
    have hempty : {ω : Fin m → (ι → Bool) × (ι → Bool) × (ι → Bool) |
        ε < uniformError f (kmHypothesis f (ε / (2 * L)) ω)} = ∅ :=
      Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun ω hω =>
        absurd ((uniformError_le_one _ _).trans hε1) (not_le.2 hω)
    rw [hempty, MeasureTheory.measure_empty]
    exact zero_le
  set θ := ε / (2 * L)
  have hθ : 0 < θ := by positivity
  -- on accurate samples the error is at most `ε`
  have hsub : {ω : Fin m → (ι → Bool) × (ι → Bool) × (ι → Bool) |
      ε < uniformError f (kmHypothesis f θ ω)} ⊆ {ω | ¬ KMAccurate f (θ ^ 2 / 4) ω} := by
    intro ω hω hgood
    have hω' : ε < uniformError f (kmHypothesis f θ ω) := hω
    have h := uniformError_kmHypothesis_le f hθ hf ω hgood
    have hθL : θ * L = ε / 2 := by simp only [θ]; field_simp
    have hθ2 : θ ^ 2 / 4 ≤ ε / 16 := by
      have : θ ^ 2 = ε ^ 2 / (4 * L ^ 2) := by simp only [θ]; ring
      rw [this, div_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg L, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL1 hL.le]
    linarith
  refine ((PMF.uniformOfFintype _).toOuterMeasure.mono hsub).trans
    ((uniform_not_accurate_le f θ m).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_))
  -- the sample size makes the failure probability at most `δ`
  set K : ℝ := 2 * (n + 2) * 2 ^ n
  have hK : 0 < K := by positivity
  have hθ4 : θ ^ 4 / 32 = ε ^ 4 / (512 * L ^ 4) := by simp only [θ]; ring
  have hlog : Real.log (K / δ) ≤ m * ε ^ 4 / (512 * L ^ 4) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have := (div_mul_eq_mul_div (512 * L ^ 4) (ε ^ 4) (Real.log (K / δ))).symm.trans_le hm
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at this
    linarith
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(m * θ ^ 4) / 32) ≤ δ / K := by
    calc Real.exp (-(m * θ ^ 4) / 32) = Real.exp (-(m * (θ ^ 4 / 32))) := by ring_nf
      _ = Real.exp (-(m * ε ^ 4 / (512 * L ^ 4))) := by rw [hθ4, mul_div_assoc]
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-Real.log (K / δ)) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (neg_le_neg hlog)
      _ = δ / K := by rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity), inv_div]
  calc K * Real.exp (-(m * θ ^ 4) / 32) ≤ K * (δ / K) := by gcongr
    _ = δ := by field_simp

/-- **Learning decision trees with membership queries** [KushilevitzMansour1993]
[O'Donnell, Theorem 3.38][ODonnell2014]: for `n` coordinates, the Kushilevitz–Mansour algorithm
with threshold `ε / (2 L)` from `m ≥ (512 L⁴ / ε⁴) log (2 (n + 2) 2 ^ n / δ)` samples, hence
`m (2 n + 3)` membership queries, learns the functions computed by decision trees with at most
`L` leaves, with error `ε` and confidence `1 - δ`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem kmLearner_learns_decisionTree {L : ℕ} {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : 512 * (L : ℝ) ^ 4 / ε ^ 4 *
      Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card ι + 2) * 2 ^ Fintype.card ι / δ) ≤ m) :
    (kmLearner ι m (ε / (2 * L))).Learns (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) (decisionTreeClass ι L) ε δ := by
  refine (kmLearner_learns hε hδ hm).mono (fun f ⟨t, ht, hL⟩ => ?_) le_rfl le_rfl
  have hf : f = t.eval := (DecisionTree.computes_iff.1 ht).symm
  subst hf
  exact (DecisionTree.sum_abs_fourierCoeff_signVal_le_leafCount id t).trans
    (by exact_mod_cast hL)

theorem uniform_lt_uniformError_lowDegreeHypothesis_le (f : (ι → Bool) → Bool) (t m : ℕ) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hf : ∑ S with t < #S, fourierCoeff (fun x => signVal (f x)) S ^ 2 ≤ ε / 2) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin m → ι → Bool)).toOuterMeasure
      {x | ε < uniformError f (lowDegreeHypothesis t (examples f x))} ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * #{S : Finset ι | #S ≤ t} *
          Real.exp (-(m * ε) / (4 * #{S : Finset ι | #S ≤ t}))) := by
  set T : Finset (Finset ι) := {S : Finset ι | #S ≤ t} with hT
  set N : ℝ := (#T : ℝ)
  set F : (ι → Bool) → ℝ := fun x => signVal (f x)
  have hN1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := Nat.one_le_cast.2 (card_filter_card_le_pos t)
  have hN : 0 < N := one_pos.trans_le hN1
  set μ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin m → ι → Bool)).toOuterMeasure
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
  · -- without examples, the bound is at least one
    refine (PMF.toOuterMeasure_le_one _ _).trans ?_
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, neg_zero, zero_div, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    linarith
  set γ := Real.sqrt (ε / (2 * N))
  have hγ : 0 ≤ γ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hγsq : γ ^ 2 = ε / (2 * N) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  -- the samples on which the estimate of the coefficient on `S` is off by at least `γ`
  set bad : Finset ι → Set (Fin m → ι → Bool) := fun S =>
    {x | γ ≤ |empiricalCoeff (examples f x) S - fourierCoeff F S|}
  -- if every estimate is within `γ`, the hypothesis has error at most `ε`
  have hsub :
      {x : Fin m → ι → Bool | ε < uniformError f (lowDegreeHypothesis t (examples f x))} ⊆
        ⋃ S ∈ T, bad S := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hgood
    simp only [bad, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_exists, not_le] at hgood
    have herr := hammingDist_signRound_sum_mul_chi_div_le f T (empiricalCoeff (examples f x))
    have hcompl : Tᶜ = ({S : Finset ι | t < #S} : Finset (Finset ι)) := by
      rw [hT, compl_filter]
      simp only [not_le]
    rw [hcompl] at herr
    have hest : ∑ S ∈ T, (fourierCoeff F S - empiricalCoeff (examples f x) S) ^ 2 ≤ ε / 2 := by
      calc ∑ S ∈ T, (fourierCoeff F S - empiricalCoeff (examples f x) S) ^ 2
          ≤ ∑ _S ∈ T, γ ^ 2 := sum_le_sum fun S hS => by
            rw [← sq_abs, abs_sub_comm]
            exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hgood S hS).le 2
        _ = ε / 2 := by
            rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hγsq]
            change N * (ε / (2 * N)) = ε / 2
            field_simp
    have : uniformError f (lowDegreeHypothesis t (examples f x)) ≤ ε := by
      refine herr.trans ?_
      linarith
    exact absurd hx (not_lt.2 this)
  -- the union bound over the `N` estimates
  have hone (S : Finset ι) :
      μ (bad S) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.exp (-(m * ε) / (4 * N))) := by
    refine (uniform_abs_empiricalCoeff_sub_ge_le f S hm hγ).trans_eq ?_
    rw [hγsq]
    congr 3
    field_simp
    ring
  calc μ {x : Fin m → ι → Bool | ε < uniformError f (lowDegreeHypothesis t (examples f x))}
      ≤ μ (⋃ S ∈ T, bad S) := μ.mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ S ∈ T, μ (bad S) := MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset_le T _
    _ ≤ ∑ _S ∈ T, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.exp (-(m * ε) / (4 * N))) :=
        sum_le_sum fun S _ => hone S
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * N * Real.exp (-(m * ε) / (4 * N))) := by
        rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, ← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast,
          ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
        congr 1
        ring

/-- **The low-degree algorithm** [LinialMansourNisan1993], [O'Donnell, Section 3.4][ODonnell2014]:
let `N` be the number of sets of at most `t` coordinates (at most `(n + 1) ^ t`,
`BitString.card_filter_card_le_le_pow`). The low-degree algorithm of degree `t` from
`m ≥ (4 N / ε) log (2 N / δ)` uniform random examples learns, with error `ε` and confidence
`1 - δ`, every class of Boolean functions whose Fourier weight, read as signs, on the sets of more
than `t` coordinates is at most `ε / 2`. -/
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
theorem lowDegreeLearner_learns {t m : ℕ} {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hm : 4 * #{S : Finset ι | #S ≤ t} / ε * Real.log (2 * #{S : Finset ι | #S ≤ t} / δ) ≤ m)
    {C : ConceptClass (ι → Bool) Bool}
    (hC : ∀ f ∈ C, ∑ S with t < #S, fourierCoeff (fun x => signVal (f x)) S ^ 2 ≤ ε / 2) :
    Learns (lowDegreeLearner ι t m) C ε δ := by
  rw [learns_iff]
  intro f hf
  refine (uniform_lt_uniformError_lowDegreeHypothesis_le f t m hε.le (hC f hf)).trans
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
  set N : ℝ := (#{S : Finset ι | #S ≤ t} : ℝ)
  have hN : 0 < N := Nat.cast_pos.2 (card_filter_card_le_pos t)
  have hlog : Real.log (2 * N / δ) ≤ m * ε / (4 * N) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have := (div_mul_eq_mul_div (4 * N) ε (Real.log (2 * N / δ))).symm.trans_le hm
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hε] at this
    linarith
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(m * ε) / (4 * N)) ≤ δ / (2 * N) := by
    calc Real.exp (-(m * ε) / (4 * N)) = Real.exp (-(m * ε / (4 * N))) := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-Real.log (2 * N / δ)) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (neg_le_neg hlog)
      _ = δ / (2 * N) := by
          rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity), inv_div]
  calc 2 * N * Real.exp (-(m * ε) / (4 * N)) ≤ 2 * N * (δ / (2 * N)) := by gcongr
    _ = δ := by field_simp

theorem Learns.mono {A : QueryLearner ι Ω} {μ : PMF Ω} {C C' : ConceptClass (ι → Bool) Bool}
    {ε ε' δ δ' : ℝ} (hA : A.Learns μ C ε δ) (hC : C' ⊆ C) (hε : ε ≤ ε') (hδ : δ ≤ δ') :
    A.Learns μ C' ε' δ' :=
  fun f hf => (((μ.map fun ω => (A ω).eval f).toOuterMeasure.mono fun _ hh =>
    hε.trans_lt hh).trans ((hA f (hC hf)).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hδ)))

/-- A learner learns `C` when, for every target `f ∈ C`, the seeds on which it outputs a
hypothesis of error above `ε` have probability at most `δ`. -/

private theorem dens_wrongSeeds_le (hh : ∀ j, IsPairwiseIndependentHash (h j))
    (hY : ∀ j, Fintype.card (Y j) = 2 ^ j) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    dens (wrongSeeds h y S (r := r) j) ≤ (8 / 9) ^ r := by
  classical
  set G : Finset (ι j) := {i | y j ∈ S.image (h j i)}
  set Gc : Finset (ι j) := {i | ¬ y j ∈ S.image (h j i)}
  have hcount : ∀ v : Fin (2 * r) → ι j,
      #{k | y j ∈ S.image (h j (v k))} = #{k | v k ∈ G} := fun v => by
    simp only [G, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  refine (dens_le_dens fun ω hω => ?_).trans ((dens_filter_apply_mem_le j
    {v : Fin (2 * r) → ι j | ¬ ((8 * 2 ^ (j : ℕ) ≤ #S → r < #{k | v k ∈ G}) ∧
      (8 * #S ≤ 2 ^ (j : ℕ) → ¬ r < #{k | v k ∈ G}))}).trans ?_)
  · simp only [wrongSeeds, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, hcount] at hω ⊢
    exact hω
  have hYj : (Fintype.card (Y j) : ℚ≥0) = 2 ^ (j : ℕ) := by rw [hY, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  by_cases hhigh : 8 * 2 ^ (j : ℕ) ≤ #S
  · -- the mean cell size is at least `8`, and `S` misses `y j` with probability at most `1 / 8`
    have hS : S.Nonempty := card_pos.1 (by have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := (j : ℕ)); omega)
    have hG : 2 / 3 ≤ G.dens := by
      refine two_thirds_le_of_add_eq_one (dens_filter_add_dens_filter_not_eq_dens
        (s := (univ : Finset (ι j))) _ |>.trans dens_univ) ?_
      refine ((hh j).dens_filter_notMem_image_le hS (y j)).trans ?_
      rw [hYj, div_le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast hS.card_pos) (by norm_num)]
      exact_mod_cast (by omega : 2 ^ (j : ℕ) * 8 ≤ 1 * #S)
    refine le_trans (dens_le_dens fun v hv => ?_) (dens_filter_card_filter_le_le hG r)
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, not_and_or, not_imp, not_lt] at hv ⊢
    rcases hv with ⟨-, hv⟩ | ⟨hlow, -⟩
    · exact hv
    · have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := (j : ℕ))
      omega
  by_cases hlow : 8 * #S ≤ 2 ^ (j : ℕ)
  · -- the mean cell size is at most `1 / 8`, and `S` hits `y j` with probability at most `1 / 8`
    have hGc : 2 / 3 ≤ Gc.dens := by
      refine two_thirds_le_of_add_eq_one ((add_comm _ _).trans
        (dens_filter_add_dens_filter_not_eq_dens (s := (univ : Finset (ι j))) _ |>.trans
          dens_univ)) ?_
      refine ((hh j).dens_filter_mem_image_le S (y j)).trans ?_
      rw [hYj, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
      exact_mod_cast (by omega : #S * 8 ≤ 1 * 2 ^ (j : ℕ))
    refine le_trans (dens_le_dens fun v hv => ?_) (dens_filter_card_filter_le_le hGc r)
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, not_and_or, not_imp, not_lt] at hv ⊢
    rcases hv with ⟨hhigh', -⟩ | ⟨-, hv⟩
    · exact absurd hhigh' hhigh
    · have hsum := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (Fin (2 * r))))
        (fun k => v k ∈ G)
      have hGc' : ∀ k, v k ∈ Gc ↔ ¬ v k ∈ G := fun k => by simp [G, Gc]
      simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hsum
      simp only [hGc']
      omega
  · -- neither condition holds, so no seed is wrong
    refine le_trans (le_of_eq (dens_eq_zero.2 (eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun v hv => ?_)))
      (by positivity)
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hv
    exact hv ⟨fun h' => absurd h' hhigh, fun h' => absurd h' hlow⟩

/-- **The answers from hashing are correct with high probability**: if every `h j` is a pairwise
independent hash family into a set of `2 ^ j` elements, with seeds from a nonempty type `ι j`, then
for `2 r` independent uniform seeds per level `j ≤ n`, the majority answers are correct for `S`
except with probability at most `(n + 1) (8 / 9) ^ r`. -/

theorem dens_filter_not_answersCorrect_le (hh : ∀ j, IsPairwiseIndependentHash (h j))

theorem le_nthRoot_and_mul_nthRoot_le {k s e c p : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (hse : s ^ k ≤ e)
    (hes : e ≤ c * s ^ k) (hc : c * p ^ k ≤ (p + 1) ^ k) :
    s ≤ Nat.nthRoot k e ∧ p * Nat.nthRoot k e ≤ (p + 1) * s := by
  refine ⟨(Nat.le_nthRoot_iff hk).2 hse, ?_⟩

        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ((Nat.pow_nthRoot_le (.inl hk)).trans hes)

theorem uniformList_map_of_bijective (f : List Bool → List Bool) (hf : Function.Bijective f)
    (hlen : ∀ word, (f word).length = word.length) (n : ℕ) :
    (uniformList n).map f = uniformList n := by
  let e : List.Vector Bool n ≃ List.Vector Bool n :=
    (Equiv.ofBijective f hf).subtypeEquiv (fun word => by simp [hlen])
  let bits : (Fin n → Bool) ≃ (Fin n → Bool) :=
    (Equiv.vectorEquivFin Bool n).symm.trans (e.trans (Equiv.vectorEquivFin Bool n))
  have hbits (word : Fin n → Bool) : List.ofFn (bits word) = f (List.ofFn word) := by
    change List.ofFn (List.Vector.get (e (List.Vector.ofFn word))) = _
    rw [← List.Vector.toList_ofFn, List.Vector.ofFn_get]
    change f (List.Vector.ofFn word).toList = _
    rw [List.Vector.toList_ofFn]
  calc
    (uniformList n).map f = ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin n → Bool)).map bits).map List.ofFn := by
      simp only [uniformList, PMF.map_comp]
      congr 1
      funext word
      exact (hbits word).symm
    _ = uniformList n := by rw [PMF.uniformOfFintype_map_equiv]; rfl

private theorem sum_mul_exp_piecewise_le {f : (∀ i, α i) → ℝ} {c : ι → ℝ}
    (hf : HasBoundedDifferences f c) (p : ∀ i, PMF (α i)) (t : ℝ) (s : Finset ι)
    (x : ∀ i, α i) :
    ∑ y, (pi p y).toReal * Real.exp (t * (f (s.piecewise y x) -
      ∑ z, (pi p z).toReal * f (s.piecewise z x))) ≤
        Real.exp (t ^ 2 * (∑ i ∈ s, c i ^ 2) / 8) := by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing x with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.piecewise_empty, ← Finset.sum_mul, sum_toReal, one_mul, sub_self,
      mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, Finset.sum_empty, zero_div, le_refl]
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    let g (v : α i) := ∑ z, (pi p z).toReal * f (s.piecewise z (Function.update x i v))
    have hrange (v w : α i) : g v ≤ g w + c i := by
      have hdiff : g v - g w = ∑ z, (pi p z).toReal *
          (f (s.piecewise z (Function.update x i v)) -
            f (s.piecewise z (Function.update x i w))) := by
        simp only [g, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]
      have hle : g v - g w ≤ c i := by
        rw [hdiff]
        refine sum_mul_le _ _ _ fun z => ?_
        rw [← Finset.update_piecewise_of_notMem _ _ _ hi,
          ← Finset.update_piecewise_of_notMem _ _ _ hi,
          ← Function.update_idem w v (s.piecewise z x)]
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hf _ i v)
      linarith
    obtain ⟨least, -, hleast⟩ := Finset.univ.exists_min_image g
      (Finset.univ_nonempty_iff.mpr ⟨(p i).support_nonempty.some⟩)
    have hhoeffding := sum_mul_exp_sub_mean_le (p i) g
      (fun v => ⟨hleast v (Finset.mem_univ v), hrange v least⟩) t
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at hhoeffding
    have hstep (v : α i) : ∑ y, (pi p y).toReal * Real.exp (t * (f (s.piecewise y
        (Function.update x i v)) - ∑ w, (p i w).toReal * g w)) ≤
          Real.exp (t * (g v - ∑ w, (p i w).toReal * g w)) *
            Real.exp (t ^ 2 * (∑ j ∈ s, c j ^ 2) / 8) := by
      calc
        _ = Real.exp (t * (g v - ∑ w, (p i w).toReal * g w)) * ∑ y, (pi p y).toReal *
            Real.exp (t * (f (s.piecewise y (Function.update x i v)) - g v)) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => ?_
          rw [mul_left_comm, ← Real.exp_add]
          ring_nf
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih (Function.update x i v)) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    rw [sum_pi_piecewise_insert p hi x f,
      sum_pi_piecewise_insert p hi x fun z => Real.exp (t * (f z - ∑ v, (p i v).toReal * g v))]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ v, (p i v).toReal * (Real.exp (t * (g v - ∑ w, (p i w).toReal * g w)) *
          Real.exp (t ^ 2 * (∑ j ∈ s, c j ^ 2) / 8)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun v _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hstep v) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      _ = (∑ v, (p i v).toReal * Real.exp (t * (g v - ∑ w, (p i w).toReal * g w))) *
          Real.exp (t ^ 2 * (∑ j ∈ s, c j ^ 2) / 8) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * c i ^ 2 / 8) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 * (∑ j ∈ s, c j ^ 2) / 8) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhoeffding (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add, Finset.sum_insert hi]
        ring_nf

theorem mgf_pi_sum_le [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (α i)] [∀ i, MeasurableSingletonClass (α i)]
    (p : ∀ i, PMF (α i)) (score : ∀ i, α i → ℝ)
    (hscore : ∀ i a, a ∈ (p i).support → score i a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (t : ℝ) :
    mgf (fun outcome => ∑ i, score i (outcome i)) (pi p).toMeasure t ≤
      Real.exp ((∑ i, ∑ a, (p i a).toReal * score i a) * (Real.exp t - 1)) := by
  let μ := (pi p).toMeasure
  let X (i : ι) (outcome : ∀ i, α i) := score i (outcome i)
  have hindep : iIndepFun X μ :=
    (iIndepFun_pi p).comp score (fun _ => measurable_of_countable _)
  have hsum : (fun outcome => ∑ i, score i (outcome i)) = ∑ i, X i := by
    funext outcome
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, X]
  have hcoord (i : ι) : mgf (X i) μ t = ∑ a, (p i a).toReal * Real.exp (t * score i a) := by
    have hmap := integral_map (μ := μ) (measurable_pi_apply i).aemeasurable
      (f := fun a => Real.exp (t * score i a)) (measurable_of_countable _).aestronglyMeasurable
    change ∫ outcome, (fun a => Real.exp (t * score i a)) (outcome i) ∂μ = _
    rw [← hmap]
    simp only [μ, PMF.toMeasure_map _ _ (measurable_pi_apply i), pi_map_eval,
      PMF.integral_eq_sum, smul_eq_mul]
  have hle (i : ι) : mgf (X i) μ t ≤
      Real.exp ((∑ a, (p i a).toReal * score i a) * (Real.exp t - 1)) := by
    rw [hcoord]
    calc ∑ a, (p i a).toReal * Real.exp (t * score i a)
        ≤ ∑ a, (p i a).toReal * (1 + score i a * (Real.exp t - 1)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
          by_cases ha : a ∈ (p i).support
          · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (exp_mul_le_one_add_mul (hscore i a ha) t)
              ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
          · rw [PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff _ _ |>.mpr ha, ENNReal.toReal_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul]
      _ = 1 + (∑ a, (p i a).toReal * score i a) * (Real.exp t - 1) := by
          simp only [mul_add, mul_one, Finset.sum_add_distrib, sum_toReal, Finset.sum_mul,
            mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ _ := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp ((∑ a, (p i a).toReal * score i a) *
            (Real.exp t - 1))]
  rw [hsum, hindep.mgf_sum (fun _ => measurable_of_countable _), Finset.sum_mul, Real.exp_sum]
  exact Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun _ _ => mgf_nonneg) (fun i _ => hle i)

independent scores in `[0, 1]` is at least `ε` with probability at most
`exp (-t ε + mean * (exp t - 1))`. -/

theorem pi_sum_ge_le_exp (p : ∀ i, PMF (α i)) (score : ∀ i, α i → ℝ)
    (hscore : ∀ i a, a ∈ (p i).support → score i a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (ε : ℝ) :
    ((pi p).toOuterMeasure {outcome | ε ≤ ∑ i, score i (outcome i)}).toReal ≤
      Real.exp (-t * ε + (∑ i, ∑ a, (p i a).toReal * score i a) * (Real.exp t - 1)) := by
  let (i : ι) : MeasurableSpace (α i) := ⊤
  have h := measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf (μ := (pi p).toMeasure)
    (X := fun outcome => ∑ i, score i (outcome i)) ε ht Integrable.of_finite
  simp only [measureReal_def, PMF.toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply _
    ((Set.to_countable _).measurableSet)] at h
  rw [Real.exp_add]
  exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mgf_pi_sum_le p score hscore t) (Real.exp_pos _).le)

theorem pi_sum_ge_one_add_mul_le_exp_log (p : ∀ i, PMF (α i)) (score : ∀ i, α i → ℝ)
    (hscore : ∀ i a, a ∈ (p i).support → score i a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) {μ δ : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∑ i, ∑ a, (p i a).toReal * score i a ≤ μ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    ((pi p).toOuterMeasure {outcome | (1 + δ) * μ ≤ ∑ i, score i (outcome i)}).toReal ≤
      Real.exp (μ * (δ - (1 + δ) * Real.log (1 + δ))) := by
  have hpos : 0 < 1 + δ := by linarith
  refine (pi_sum_ge_le_exp p score hscore
    (Real.log_nonneg (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + δ by linarith)) _).trans ?_
  rw [Real.exp_log hpos, add_sub_cancel_left]
  gcongr
  nlinarith

`μ`, their sum is at least `(1 + δ) μ` with probability at most `exp (-δ² μ / (2 + δ))`, for every

theorem pi_sum_ge_one_add_mul (p : ∀ i, PMF (α i)) (score : ∀ i, α i → ℝ)
    (hscore : ∀ i a, a ∈ (p i).support → score i a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) {μ δ : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∑ i, ∑ a, (p i a).toReal * score i a ≤ μ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    ((pi p).toOuterMeasure {outcome | (1 + δ) * μ ≤ ∑ i, score i (outcome i)}).toReal ≤
      Real.exp (-(δ ^ 2 * μ / (2 + δ))) := by
  refine (pi_sum_ge_one_add_mul_le_exp_log p score hscore hμ hδ).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
  have hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ := (mean_nonneg p score hscore).trans hμ
  have hlog : 2 * δ / (δ + 2) ≤ Real.log (1 + δ) := Real.le_log_one_add_of_nonneg hδ
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 + δ := by linarith
  have hmul : μ * (δ - (1 + δ) * Real.log (1 + δ)) ≤ μ * (δ - (1 + δ) * (2 * δ / (δ + 2))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by nlinarith) hμ0
  refine hmul.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  field_simp
  ring

theorem pi_sum_ge_one_add_mul_of_le_one (p : ∀ i, PMF (α i)) (score : ∀ i, α i → ℝ)
    (hscore : ∀ i a, a ∈ (p i).support → score i a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) {μ δ : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∑ i, ∑ a, (p i a).toReal * score i a ≤ μ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ₁ : δ ≤ 1) :
    ((pi p).toOuterMeasure {outcome | (1 + δ) * μ ≤ ∑ i, score i (outcome i)}).toReal ≤
      Real.exp (-(δ ^ 2 * μ / 3)) := by
  refine (pi_sum_ge_one_add_mul p score hscore hμ hδ).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
  have hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ := (mean_nonneg p score hscore).trans hμ
  rw [neg_le_neg_iff]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by linarith) (by linarith)

theorem pi_sum_le_one_sub_mul (p : ∀ i, PMF (α i)) (score : ∀ i, α i → ℝ)
    (hscore : ∀ i a, a ∈ (p i).support → score i a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) {μ δ : ℝ}
    (hμ : μ ≤ ∑ i, ∑ a, (p i a).toReal * score i a) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    ((pi p).toOuterMeasure {outcome | ∑ i, score i (outcome i) ≤ (1 - δ) * μ}).toReal ≤
      Real.exp (-(δ ^ 2 * μ / 2)) := by
  rcases lt_or_ge μ 0 with hμ0 | hμ0
  · refine (ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal zero_le_one ?_).trans
      (Real.one_le_exp (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg δ]))
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    exact toOuterMeasure_le_one _ _
  refine (pi_sum_le_le_exp p score hscore (neg_nonpos.mpr hδ) _).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
  have hexp : Real.exp (-δ) - 1 ≤ 0 := by
    rw [sub_nonpos, Real.exp_le_one_iff]
    linarith
  have hmean : (∑ i, ∑ a, (p i a).toReal * score i a) * (Real.exp (-δ) - 1) ≤
      μ * (Real.exp (-δ) - 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_right hμ hexp
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (exp_neg_le_quadratic hδ) hμ0]

theorem sum_filter_le_sub_predIn {T : Finset ℝ≥0} {p : ℝ≥0} (hp : p ∈ T) :
    ∑ v ∈ T.filter (· ≤ p), (v - predIn T v) = p := by
  have hpred : ∀ v ∈ T.filter (· ≤ p), predIn T v = predIn (T.filter (· ≤ p)) v := by
    intro v hv
    rw [predIn, predIn, filter_filter]
    congr 1
    refine filter_congr fun u _ => ⟨fun h => ⟨h.le.trans (mem_filter.mp hv).2, h⟩, And.right⟩
  rw [sum_congr rfl fun v hv => by rw [hpred v hv], sum_sub_predIn]
  exact le_antisymm (Finset.sup_le fun v hv => (mem_filter.mp hv).2)
    (le_sup (f := id) (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hp, le_rfl⟩))

theorem isEmbeddable_diag_of_dist_le (J : PMF ((X × Y) × S)) (P₀ : PMF (X × Y)) {ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ}
    (h₁ : dist J (withKernel P₀ fun xy => condX J xy.1) ≤ ε₁)
    (h₂ : dist J (withKernel P₀ fun xy => condY J xy.2) ≤ ε₂) :
    IsEmbeddable P₀ (J.map fun z => (z.1, (z.2, z.2))) (7 * ε₁ + 2 * ε₂) := by
  obtain ⟨R, ρ, fA, fB, hemb⟩ :=
    isEmbeddable_withKernel P₀ (condX J) (condY J) (conditionalSnd J)
  refine ⟨R, ρ, fA, fB, ?_⟩
  set P := J.map Prod.fst
  set K := conditionalSnd J
  have hJ : withKernel P K = J := bind_conditionalSnd J
  -- The input laws are within `ε₁`.
  have hP : dist P P₀ ≤ ε₁ := by
    simpa only [withKernel, Cslib.Probability.PMF.map_fst_bind_pair] using
      (dist_map_le J (withKernel P₀ fun xy => condX J xy.1) Prod.fst).trans h₁
  have hK : dist J (withKernel P₀ K) ≤ ε₁ := by
    rw [← hJ]
    exact (dist_bind_le P P₀ _).trans hP
  set A := withKernel P₀ fun xy => condX J xy.1
  set B := withKernel P₀ fun xy => condY J xy.2
  set C := withKernel P₀ K
  have hX := dist_triangle_left A C J
  have hY := dist_triangle_left B C J
  set E := P₀.bind fun xy => ((K xy).map fun s => (s, s)).map (xy, ·)
  set Out := P₀.bind fun xy => ρ.map fun r => (xy, (fA xy.1 r, fB xy.2 r))
  set Tgt := J.map fun z => (z.1, (z.2, z.2))
  have hdiag : dist E Tgt ≤ ε₁ := by
    change dist E (J.map fun z => (z.1, (z.2, z.2))) ≤ ε₁
    rw [diag_eq, dist_comm]
    exact (dist_bind_le P P₀ _).trans hP
  have := dist_triangle Out E Tgt
  have hemb' : dist Out E ≤ 2 * dist A C + 2 * dist B C := hemb
  linarith

/-- **Holenstein's Lemma 10** [Holenstein, Lemma 10][Holenstein2009], for the factorized law it
characterizes: if `s` is drawn from `KS x` and `t` from `KT y`, independently, then `P₀` embeds
exactly. Shared randomness simulates the private coins: it draws a random function for each party.
-/

theorem dist_localSample_le (KX : X → PMF S) (KY : Y → PMF S) (K : X × Y → PMF S) (x : X)
    (y : Y) :
    dist (localSample KX KY K x y) ((K (x, y)).map fun s => (s, s)) ≤
      2 * dist (KX x) (K (x, y)) + 2 * dist (KY y) (K (x, y)) := by
  classical
  set F := embedFamily KX KY K
  set sA := sample F (.inl x)
  set sB := sample F (.inr (.inl y))
  set sAB := sample F (.inr (.inr (x, y)))
  have hK : (K (x, y)).map (fun s => (s, s)) = (shared F).map fun l => (sAB l, sAB l) :=
    calc (K (x, y)).map (fun s => (s, s))
        = (F (.inr (.inr (x, y)))).map (fun s => (s, s)) := rfl
      _ = ((shared F).map sAB).map (fun s => (s, s)) := by rw [map_sample]
      _ = (shared F).map fun l => (sAB l, sAB l) := PMF.map_comp _ _ _
  rw [hK, localSample]
  refine (Cslib.Probability.PMF.dist_map_map_le _ _ _).trans ?_
  have hsub : {l | (sA l, sB l) ≠ (sAB l, sAB l)} ⊆
      {l | sample F (.inl x) l ≠ sample F (.inr (.inr (x, y))) l} ∪
        {l | sample F (.inr (.inl y)) l ≠ sample F (.inr (.inr (x, y))) l} := by
    intro l hl
    by_contra h
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_or, not_not] at h
    exact hl (Prod.ext h.1 h.2)
  have hA := disagree_le (P := F) (.inl x) (.inr (.inr (x, y)))
  have hB := disagree_le (P := F) (.inr (.inl y)) (.inr (.inr (x, y)))
  exact (ENNReal.toReal_le_add
    ((MeasureTheory.measure_mono (μ := (shared F).toOuterMeasure) hsub).trans
      (MeasureTheory.measure_union_le _ _))
    (PMF.toOuterMeasure_ne_top _ _) (PMF.toOuterMeasure_ne_top _ _)).trans
      (add_le_add hA hB)

/-- **Holenstein's embedding lemma** [Holenstein, Lemma 8][Holenstein2009]. Draw `(x, y)` from `P`.
If Alice and Bob sample from their own kernels with shared randomness, the result `(x, y, s_A, s_B)`
is within statistical distance `2 ε₁ + 2 ε₂` of `(x, y, s, s)` with `s` drawn from `K (x, y)`, where
`ε₁` and `ε₂` are the distances of `P ⊗ KX` and `P ⊗ KY` from `P ⊗ K`. -/

theorem entropy_map_fst_add_entropy_map_snd_sub_entropy [Finite α] [Finite β]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (joint : PMF (α × β)) :
    entropy (joint.map Prod.fst) + entropy (joint.map Prod.snd) - entropy joint =
      (klDiv joint.toMeasure
        ((joint.map Prod.fst).toMeasure.prod (joint.map Prod.snd).toMeasure)).toReal /
          Real.log 2 := by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite α
  let := Fintype.ofFinite β
  rw [← toMeasure_bind_pair, toReal_klDiv_toMeasure (support_subset_bind_map_prodMk joint)]
  have hterm (pair : α × β) : (joint pair).toReal * Real.log ((joint pair).toReal /
      (((joint.map Prod.fst).bind fun a => (joint.map Prod.snd).map (a, ·)) pair).toReal) =
        -Real.negMulLog (joint pair).toReal -
          (joint pair).toReal * Real.log ((joint.map Prod.fst) pair.1).toReal -
            (joint pair).toReal * Real.log ((joint.map Prod.snd) pair.2).toReal := by
    by_cases hp : joint pair = 0
    · simp [hp]
    have hp' : (joint pair).toReal ≠ 0 := ENNReal.toReal_ne_zero.mpr ⟨hp, PMF.apply_ne_top _ _⟩
    have h1 : ((joint.map Prod.fst) pair.1).toReal ≠ 0 :=
      ENNReal.toReal_ne_zero.mpr ⟨ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hp)
        (le_map_apply joint Prod.fst pair)), PMF.apply_ne_top _ _⟩
    have h2 : ((joint.map Prod.snd) pair.2).toReal ≠ 0 :=
      ENNReal.toReal_ne_zero.mpr ⟨ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hp)
        (le_map_apply joint Prod.snd pair)), PMF.apply_ne_top _ _⟩
    rw [bind_map_prodMk_apply, ENNReal.toReal_mul, Real.log_div hp' (mul_ne_zero h1 h2),
      Real.log_mul h1 h2, Real.negMulLog]
    ring
  simp only [hterm, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [← sum_map_mul joint Prod.fst (fun a => Real.log ((joint.map Prod.fst) a).toReal),
    ← sum_map_mul joint Prod.snd (fun b => Real.log ((joint.map Prod.snd) b).toReal)]
  simp only [entropy_eq_sum, Real.negMulLog, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  ring

theorem entropy_map_of_injOn [Finite α] [Finite β] (p : PMF α) {f : α → β}
    (hf : Set.InjOn f p.support) : entropy (p.map f) = entropy p := by
  classical
  let : Nonempty α := ⟨p.support_nonempty.choose⟩
  have hmap : (p.map f).map (Function.invFunOn f p.support) = p := by
    rw [PMF.map_comp]
    exact (map_congr_on_support p _ id (fun a ha => hf.leftInvOn_invFunOn ha)).trans
      (PMF.map_id p)
  exact le_antisymm (entropy_map_le p f)
    (by simpa only [hmap] using entropy_map_le (p.map f) (Function.invFunOn f p.support))

theorem conditionalEntropy_map_le_of_determined [Fintype α] [Finite β] [Fintype γ]
    (p : PMF α) (observe : α → β) (value : α → γ) (bad : β → Prop) [DecidablePred bad]
    (hdetermined : ∀ x y, ¬bad (observe x) → observe x = observe y → value x = value y) :
    conditionalEntropy (p.map (fun x => (observe x, value x))) ≤
      ∑ x, (p x).toReal * (if bad (observe x) then Real.logb 2 (Fintype.card γ) else 0) := by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite β
  rw [← sum_map_mul p observe (fun b => if bad b then Real.logb 2 (Fintype.card γ) else 0),
    conditionalEntropy_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro b _
  let joint := p.map (fun x => (observe x, value x))
  have hmarginal : joint.map Prod.fst = p.map observe := by
    simp only [joint, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def]
  change ((joint.map Prod.fst) b).toReal * entropy (conditionalSnd joint b) ≤ _
  rw [← hmarginal]
  by_cases hb : b ∈ (joint.map Prod.fst).support
  · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    by_cases hbad : bad b
    · simpa [hbad] using entropy_le_log_card (conditionalSnd joint b)
    · suffices hzero : entropy (conditionalSnd joint b) = 0 by simp [hbad, hzero]
      apply entropy_eq_zero_of_subsingleton_support
      intro z hz w hw
      obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp
        ((mem_support_conditionalSnd_iff joint b hb z).mp hz)
      obtain ⟨y, _, hy⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp
        ((mem_support_conditionalSnd_iff joint b hb w).mp hw)
      rcases Prod.mk.inj hx with ⟨hxb, hxz⟩
      rcases Prod.mk.inj hy with ⟨hyb, hyw⟩
      exact hxz.symm.trans ((hdetermined x y (hxb ▸ hbad) (hxb.trans hyb.symm)).trans hyw)
  · have hz := (PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr hb
    simp [hz]

theorem pi_sum_conditionalSurprisal_le (joint : ∀ i, PMF (α i × β i))
    {bound ε : ℝ} (hbound : 0 ≤ bound)
    (hmass : ∀ i pair, pair ∈ (joint i).support →
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (-bound) ≤ (joint i pair).toReal) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    ((pi joint).toOuterMeasure {outcome |
      ∑ i, surprisal (conditionalSnd (joint i) (outcome i).1) (outcome i).2 ≤
        (∑ i, conditionalEntropy (joint i)) - ε}).toReal ≤
      Real.exp (-2 * ε ^ 2 / (Fintype.card ι * bound ^ 2)) := by
  let (i : ι) := Fintype.ofFinite (α i)
  let (i : ι) := Fintype.ofFinite (β i)

    {hash : Seed → Input → Output} (hhash : IsTwoUniversal seed hash) (source : PMF Input)
    {mass : ℝ} (hmass : 0 ≤ mass) :

        Real.sqrt (Fintype.card Output * (2 * mass)) / 2 := by

      (source.toOuterMeasure {x | mass < (source x).toReal}).toReal = 1 := by
    simpa only [good, Set.compl_ofPred, not_le] using
      toOuterMeasure_toReal_add_compl source good
  by_cases hbad : (source.toOuterMeasure {x | mass < (source x).toReal}).toReal < 1 / 2
  · have hgood : 0 < (source.toOuterMeasure good).toReal := by linarith
    have hhalf : 1 / 2 ≤ (source.toOuterMeasure good).toReal := by linarith
    obtain hevent := (toOuterMeasure_toReal_pos_iff source good).mp hgood
    let conditioned := source.filter good hevent

      rw [filter_apply_toReal]

      simpa only [conditioned, good, Set.compl_ofPred, not_le] using dist_filter source good hevent
    have h := (dist_triangle (seededHash seed source hash) (seededHash seed conditioned hash)
      (seed.bind (fun s => (PMF.uniformOfFintype Output).map (s, ·)))).trans
        (add_le_add (dist_seededHash_le seed source conditioned hash)
          (hhash.leftover_hash_of_mass_le conditioned hbounded))

      (a := source.toOuterMeasure {x | mass < (source x).toReal})]

      (seed.bind (fun s => (PMF.uniformOfFintype Output).map (s, ·)))

        (fun s => (fun i => (outcome i).1, s, hash s (fun i => (outcome i).2)))))

noncomputable def fork [DecidableEq H] (first : PMF S)
    (A : S → (Fin q → H) → Option (Fin q) × β) : PMF (Option (Fin q × β × β)) := do
  let s ← first
  let h ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin q → H)
  let h' ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin q → H)
  return match (A s h).1 with
    | none => none
    | some j => if (A s (splice j h h')).1 = some j ∧ h j ≠ h' j then
        some (j, (A s h).2, (A s (splice j h h')).2) else none

      ((fork first A).map Option.isSome true).toReal := by
  set N : ℝ := (Fintype.card H : ℝ)

    let s ← first
    let h ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin q → H)
    return decide ((A s h).1 = some j) : PMF Bool) true).toReal
  have hj (j : Fin q) : a j ^ 2 - a j / N ≤ ((do
      let s ← first
      let h ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin q → H)
      let h' ← PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin q → H)
      return decide ((A s h).1 = some j ∧ (A s (splice j h h')).1 = some j ∧ h j ≠ h' j) :
        PMF Bool) true).toReal := by
    simp only [a, acceptAt_eq_once, forkAt_eq_twice]
    exact Rewinding.sq_sub_le_twice _ _ _

          (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Prefix × Suffix) z).toReal * score s z := by

    Classical.choose (Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ
      (fun suffix => score s (initial, suffix)) Finset.univ_nonempty)

  have hbest (s : Seed) (initial : Prefix) (suffix : Suffix) :

      (fun suffix => score s (initial, suffix)) Finset.univ_nonempty)).2 suffix (Finset.mem_univ _)

    (bound := 1) (fun pair => by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (hscore _ _).1]

      (∑ initial, (PMF.uniformOfFintype Prefix initial).toReal * best (s, initial)) ≤

    have hcard : (Fintype.card Suffix : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero

        exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun suffix _ => (hscore _ _).1)
          (Finset.mem_univ (complete s initial))

private theorem pow_mul_pow_le {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) {r t u : ℕ} (ht : r ≤ t)
    (htu : t + u = 2 * r) : a ^ t * b ^ u ≤ (a * b) ^ r := by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le ht
  obtain rfl : r = u + d := by omega
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := ha.trans hab
  calc a ^ (u + d + d) * b ^ u = a ^ u * a ^ d * b ^ u * a ^ d := by ring
    _ ≤ a ^ u * a ^ d * b ^ u * b ^ d :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ ha hab d)
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg ha _) (pow_nonneg ha _)) (pow_nonneg hb _))
    _ = (a * b) ^ (u + d) := by ring

theorem val_eq_of_ambiguous {val : W → G} {w w' : U → W} {F : Finset (Finset U)} {i : U}
    (hw : ∀ j, j ≠ i → w j = w' j) (h : Ambiguous val w F i) (h' : Ambiguous val w' F i) :
    val (w i) = val (w' i) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨S, hS, hiS⟩, T, hT, hiT⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨⟨S', hS', hiS'⟩, T', hT', hiT'⟩ := h'
  rw [mem_minWeightSets] at hS hT hS' hT'
  have eT := setWeight_eq_of_notMem (val := val) hw hiT
  have eT' := setWeight_eq_of_notMem (val := val) hw hiT'
  have eS := setWeight_add_eq_of_mem (val := val) hw hiS
  have eS' := setWeight_add_eq_of_mem (val := val) hw hiS'
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hA : setWeight val w S ≤ setWeight val w' S :=
      (hS.2 _ hT'.1).trans (eT'.trans_le (hT'.2 _ hS.1))
    have : setWeight val w S + val (w i) ≤ setWeight val w S + val (w' i) := by
      rw [eS]
      exact add_le_add_left hA _
    exact le_of_add_le_add_left this
  · have hA : setWeight val w' S' ≤ setWeight val w S' :=
      (hS'.2 _ hT.1).trans (eT.symm.trans_le (hT.2 _ hS'.1))
    have : setWeight val w' S' + val (w' i) ≤ setWeight val w' S' + val (w i) := by
      rw [← eS']
      exact add_le_add_left hA _
    exact le_of_add_le_add_left this

private theorem card_filter_card_image_le [DecidableEq X] (S : Finset X) {m n : ℕ}
    (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    #{t ∈ piFinset fun _ : Fin n => S | #(univ.image t) ≤ m} ≤ m ^ n * #S ^ m := by
  classical
  calc #{t ∈ piFinset fun _ : Fin n => S | #(univ.image t) ≤ m}
      ≤ #(((piFinset fun _ : Fin n => (univ : Finset (Fin m))) ×ˢ
          (piFinset fun _ : Fin m => S)).image fun q => q.2 ∘ q.1) := by
        refine card_le_card fun t ht => ?_
        rw [mem_filter, mem_piFinset] at ht
        obtain ⟨htS, hcard⟩ := ht
        set I := univ.image t
        let e := I.equivFin
        have hmem (j : Fin n) : t j ∈ I := mem_image_of_mem t (mem_univ j)
        let v (r : Fin m) : X := if hr : r.1 < #I then (e.symm ⟨r, hr⟩).1 else
          t ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt r.2) hmn⟩
        refine mem_image.2 ⟨(fun j => Fin.castLE hcard (e ⟨t j, hmem j⟩), v), ?_, ?_⟩
        · refine mem_product.2 ⟨by simp, mem_piFinset.2 fun r => ?_⟩
          by_cases hr : r.1 < #I
          · obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := mem_image.1 (e.symm ⟨r, hr⟩).2
            simp only [v, hr, ↓reduceDIte, ← hj]
            exact htS j
          · simp only [v, hr, ↓reduceDIte]
            exact htS _
        · funext j
          have hlt : (Fin.castLE hcard (e ⟨t j, hmem j⟩)).1 < #I := (e ⟨t j, hmem j⟩).2
          simp only [Function.comp_apply, v, hlt, ↓reduceDIte]
          have : (⟨(Fin.castLE hcard (e ⟨t j, hmem j⟩)).1, hlt⟩ : Fin #I) = e ⟨t j, hmem j⟩ :=
            Fin.ext rfl
          rw [this, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    _ ≤ m ^ n * #S ^ m := card_image_le.trans (by simp [card_piFinset])

/-- **The `2 m`-th moment bound for limited independence**: for a `2 m`-wise independent family and
scores `Z x : Y → ℝ` with average `0` and values in `[-1, 1]` at the points `x` of a finite set
`S`, the `2 m`-th moment of `∑ x ∈ S, Z x (h i x)` is at most `m ^ (2 m) * #S ^ m`. Expanding the
power, only tuples of points in which every point occurs at least twice contribute, and these
tuples have at most `m` distinct entries. -/

theorem expect_sum_pow_le {m : ℕ} (hh : IsKWiseIndependentHash (2 * m) h)
    (S : Finset X) (Z : X → Y → ℝ) (hZ : ∀ x ∈ S, 𝔼 y, Z x y = 0)
    (hZ₁ : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y, |Z x y| ≤ 1) :
    𝔼 i, (∑ x ∈ S, Z x (h i x)) ^ (2 * m) ≤ m ^ (2 * m) * #S ^ m := by
  classical
  have := hh.nonempty
  simp only [sum_pow']
  rw [expect_sum_comm]
  have hterm : ∀ t ∈ piFinset fun _ : Fin (2 * m) => S,
      𝔼 i, ∏ j, Z (t j) (h i (t j)) ≤ if #(univ.image t) ≤ m then 1 else 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have htS : ∀ x ∈ univ.image t, x ∈ S := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hx
      exact mem_piFinset.1 ht j
    have hprod (i : ι) : ∏ j, Z (t j) (h i (t j)) =
        ∏ x ∈ univ.image t, Z x (h i x) ^ #{j | t j = x} :=
      prod_comp (fun x => Z x (h i x)) t
    simp only [hprod]
    rw [hh.expect_prod (card_image_le.trans (by simp)) fun x y => Z x y ^ #{j | t j = x}]
    split_ifs with hI
    · refine (le_abs_self _).trans ?_
      rw [abs_prod]
      refine prod_le_one₀ (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) fun x hx => ?_
      have : Nonempty Y := ⟨h (Classical.arbitrary ι) x⟩
      refine (abs_expect_le _ _).trans (expect_le univ_nonempty fun y _ => ?_)
      rw [abs_pow]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hZ₁ x (htS x hx) y)
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, hc⟩ : ∃ x ∈ univ.image t, #{j | t j = x} = 1 := by
        by_contra hne
        push Not at hne
        have hsum := card_eq_sum_card_image t (univ : Finset (Fin (2 * m)))
        have h2 : ∑ x ∈ univ.image t, 2 ≤ ∑ x ∈ univ.image t, #{j | t j = x} := by
          refine sum_le_sum fun x hx => ?_
          obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hx
          have hpos : 0 < #{j' | t j' = t j} := card_pos.2 ⟨j, by simp⟩
          have := hne (t j) hx
          omega
        rw [← hsum, sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul] at h2
        omega
      rw [prod_eq_zero hx (by simp only [hc, pow_one]; exact hZ x (htS x hx))]
  calc ∑ t ∈ piFinset (fun _ : Fin (2 * m) => S), 𝔼 i, ∏ j, Z (t j) (h i (t j))
      ≤ ∑ t ∈ piFinset (fun _ : Fin (2 * m) => S), if #(univ.image t) ≤ m then (1 : ℝ) else 0 :=
        sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = #{t ∈ piFinset fun _ : Fin (2 * m) => S | #(univ.image t) ≤ m} := by
        rw [sum_boole]
    _ ≤ m ^ (2 * m) * #S ^ m := by
        exact_mod_cast card_filter_card_image_le S (by omega)

/-- **The tail bound for limited independence**: for a `2 m`-wise independent family and scores
`Z x : Y → ℝ` with average `0` and values in `[-1, 1]` at the points of a finite set `S`, the sum
`∑ x ∈ S, Z x (h i x)` has absolute value at least `a > 0` with probability at most
`(m² #S / a²) ^ m`. -/

theorem dens_filter_le_abs_sum {m : ℕ} (hh : IsKWiseIndependentHash (2 * m) h)
    (S : Finset X) (Z : X → Y → ℝ) (hZ : ∀ x ∈ S, 𝔼 y, Z x y = 0)
    (hZ₁ : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y, |Z x y| ≤ 1) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    (dens {i | a ≤ |∑ x ∈ S, Z x (h i x)|} : ℝ) ≤ (m ^ 2 * #S / a ^ 2) ^ m := by
  have hmarkov := Fintype.mul_dens_filter_le_expect
    (f := fun i => (∑ x ∈ S, Z x (h i x)) ^ (2 * m))
    (fun _ => (even_two_mul m).pow_nonneg _) (a ^ (2 * m))
  have hsub : ({i | a ≤ |∑ x ∈ S, Z x (h i x)|} : Finset ι) ⊆
      ({i | a ^ (2 * m) ≤ (∑ x ∈ S, Z x (h i x)) ^ (2 * m)} : Finset ι) := by
    intro i hi
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hi ⊢
    rw [← (even_two_mul m).pow_abs (∑ x ∈ S, Z x (h i x))]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ ha.le hi _
  have hdens : (dens {i | a ≤ |∑ x ∈ S, Z x (h i x)|} : ℝ) ≤
      dens {i | a ^ (2 * m) ≤ (∑ x ∈ S, Z x (h i x)) ^ (2 * m)} := by
    exact_mod_cast dens_le_dens hsub
  have hpow : 0 < a ^ (2 * m) := pow_pos ha _
  calc (dens {i | a ≤ |∑ x ∈ S, Z x (h i x)|} : ℝ)
      ≤ m ^ (2 * m) * #S ^ m / a ^ (2 * m) := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hpow, mul_comm]
        exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdens hpow.le).trans
          (hmarkov.trans (hh.expect_sum_pow_le S Z hZ hZ₁))
    _ = (m ^ 2 * #S / a ^ 2) ^ m := by
        rw [div_pow, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, mul_comm 2 m]

independent family and scores `g x : Y → [0, 1]`, the sum `∑ x ∈ S, g x (h i x)` deviates from its
mean `∑ x ∈ S, 𝔼 y, g x y` by at least `a > 0` with probability at most `(m² #S / a²) ^ m`. -/

private theorem prod_mul_le_measureReal_union [DecidableEq ι]
    (hA : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) (x : ι → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, x i ≤ 1) {t u : Finset ι}
    (htu : Disjoint t u)
    (hP : ∀ s, t ⊆ s → s ⊆ t ∪ u → #s < #(t ∪ u) → ∀ i ∉ s,
      μ.real (A i ∩ ⋂ j ∈ s, (A j)ᶜ) ≤ x i * μ.real (⋂ j ∈ s, (A j)ᶜ)) :
    (∏ j ∈ u, (1 - x j)) * μ.real (⋂ j ∈ t, (A j)ᶜ) ≤ μ.real (⋂ j ∈ t ∪ u, (A j)ᶜ) := by
  induction u using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a u ha ih =>
    have hat : a ∉ t := disjoint_left.1 htu.symm (mem_insert_self a u)
    have hau : a ∉ t ∪ u := by simp [hat, ha]
    have hsub : t ∪ u ⊆ t ∪ insert a u := union_subset_union_right (subset_insert a u)
    have hcard : #(t ∪ u) < #(t ∪ insert a u) := by
      rw [union_insert, card_insert_of_notMem hau]
      omega
    have ih' := ih (htu.mono_right (subset_insert a u))
      fun s hts hsu hs => hP s hts (hsu.trans hsub) (hs.trans hcard)
    have hstep := one_sub_mul_le_measureReal_insert hA
      (hP (t ∪ u) subset_union_left hsub hcard a hau)
    rw [union_insert, prod_insert ha, mul_assoc]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih' (sub_nonneg.2 (hx a))).trans hstep
