private theorem measureReal_inter_iInter_compl_le
    (hA : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) (Γ : ι → Finset ι)
    (hΓ : ∀ i (s : Finset ι), i ∉ s → Disjoint s (Γ i) →
      μ.real (A i ∩ ⋂ j ∈ s, (A j)ᶜ) ≤ μ.real (A i) * μ.real (⋂ j ∈ s, (A j)ᶜ))
    (x : ι → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc 0 1)
    (hAx : ∀ i, μ.real (A i) ≤ x i * ∏ j ∈ Γ i, (1 - x j)) (s : Finset ι) :
    ∀ i ∉ s, μ.real (A i ∩ ⋂ j ∈ s, (A j)ᶜ) ≤ x i * μ.real (⋂ j ∈ s, (A j)ᶜ) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.strongInduction with
  | H s ih =>
  intro i hi
  set s₁ := s.filter (· ∈ Γ i)
  set s₂ := s.filter (· ∉ Γ i)
  have hunion : s₂ ∪ s₁ = s := by
    rw [union_comm]
    exact filter_union_filter_not_eq _ s
  have hchain := prod_mul_le_measureReal_union hA x (fun j => (hx j).2)
    (disjoint_filter_filter_not s s _).symm fun s' _ hs' hcard j hj =>
      ih s' (Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.2 ⟨hunion ▸ hs', fun h => by
        rw [h, hunion] at hcard
        exact lt_irrefl _ hcard⟩) j hj
  rw [hunion] at hchain
  have hmono : A i ∩ ⋂ j ∈ s, (A j)ᶜ ⊆ A i ∩ ⋂ j ∈ s₂, (A j)ᶜ := by
    refine Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ fun ω hω => ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at hω ⊢
    exact fun j hj => hω j (mem_filter.1 hj).1
  have hprod : ∏ j ∈ Γ i, (1 - x j) ≤ ∏ j ∈ s₁, (1 - x j) :=
    prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_le_one₀ (fun _ hj => (mem_filter.1 hj).2)
      (fun j _ => sub_nonneg.2 (hx j).2) fun j _ _ => sub_le_self _ (hx j).1
  calc μ.real (A i ∩ ⋂ j ∈ s, (A j)ᶜ)
      ≤ μ.real (A i ∩ ⋂ j ∈ s₂, (A j)ᶜ) := measureReal_mono hmono
    _ ≤ μ.real (A i) * μ.real (⋂ j ∈ s₂, (A j)ᶜ) :=
        hΓ i s₂ (fun h => hi (mem_filter.1 h).1)
          (disjoint_left.2 fun _ hj => (mem_filter.1 hj).2)
    _ ≤ (x i * ∏ j ∈ s₁, (1 - x j)) * μ.real (⋂ j ∈ s₂, (A j)ᶜ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((hAx i).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (hx i).1)) measureReal_nonneg
    _ = x i * ((∏ j ∈ s₁, (1 - x j)) * μ.real (⋂ j ∈ s₂, (A j)ᶜ)) := mul_assoc _ _ _
    _ ≤ x i * μ.real (⋂ j ∈ s, (A j)ᶜ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hchain (hx i).1

/-- **The Lovász Local Lemma**, asymmetric and lopsided form [Alon and Spencer, Lemma 5.1.1]
[AlonSpencer2016], [ErdosSpencer1991]: let `A i` be finitely many measurable events and let `Γ i`
be sets of indices such that `A i` is lopsidedly independent of the events outside `Γ i ∪ {i}`.
If `x i ∈ [0, 1]` and `μ (A i) ≤ x i ∏ j ∈ Γ i, (1 - x j)` for every `i`, then no event occurs with
probability at least `∏ i, (1 - x i)`, which is positive when every `x i < 1`. -/

private theorem exists_weights [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (K n : ℕ) (f : α → ℝ)
    (hn : (fractional f).card = n)
    (hf : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a ∧ f a ≤ 1) (hsum : ∑ a, f a = K) :
    ∃ w : {S : Finset α // S.card = K} → ℝ, (∀ S, 0 ≤ w S) ∧ ∑ S, w S = 1 ∧
      ∀ a, ∑ S ∈ univ.filter (fun S => a ∈ S.1), w S = f a := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing f with
  | _ n ih =>
  by_cases hempty : fractional f = ∅
  · -- Every weight is `0` or `1`, so `f` is the indicator of the set of its ones.
    have hint (a : α) : f a = 0 ∨ f a = 1 :=
      eq_zero_or_eq_one hf (by simp [hempty])
    have hcard : (univ.filter fun a => f a = 1).card = K := by
      have h := sum_eq_card_filter univ f fun a _ => hint a
      rw [hsum] at h
      exact_mod_cast h.symm
    refine ⟨fun S => if S = ⟨_, hcard⟩ then 1 else 0,
      fun S => by dsimp only; split_ifs <;> norm_num,
      by simp, fun a => ?_⟩
    rw [sum_ite_eq']
    rcases hint a with h | h <;> simp [h]
  · -- Split `f` along two distinct fractional coordinates.
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hempty
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ : ∃ y ∈ fractional f, y ≠ x := by
      by_contra! hsingle
      have hrest : ∑ a ∈ univ.erase x, f a = ((univ.erase x).filter fun a => f a = 1).card :=
        sum_eq_card_filter _ f fun a ha =>
          eq_zero_or_eq_one hf fun hmem => (mem_erase.mp ha).1 (hsingle a hmem)
      have htotal := add_sum_erase univ f (mem_univ x)
      rw [hsum, hrest] at htotal
      have hfx := mem_fractional.mp hx
      have hlt : ((univ.erase x).filter fun a => f a = 1).card < K := by
        exact_mod_cast (show (((univ.erase x).filter fun a => f a = 1).card : ℝ) < K by linarith)
      have hgt : K < ((univ.erase x).filter fun a => f a = 1).card + 1 := by
        exact_mod_cast (show (K : ℝ) < ((univ.erase x).filter fun a => f a = 1).card + 1 by
          linarith)
      omega
    obtain ⟨hf₁, hsum₁, hsub₁⟩ := transfer_spec hf hyx.symm hx hy
    obtain ⟨hf₂, hsum₂, hsub₂⟩ := transfer_spec hf hyx hy hx
    obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁, hone₁, hmass₁⟩ :=
      ih _ (hn ▸ card_lt_card hsub₁) _ rfl hf₁ (hsum₁.trans hsum)
    obtain ⟨w₂, hw₂, hone₂, hmass₂⟩ :=
      ih _ (hn ▸ card_lt_card hsub₂) _ rfl hf₂ (hsum₂.trans hsum)
    have hx' := mem_fractional.mp hx
    have hy' := mem_fractional.mp hy
    set d₁ := min (1 - f x) (f y)
    set d₂ := min (1 - f y) (f x)
    have hd₁ : 0 < d₁ := lt_min (by linarith) hy'.1
    have hd₂ : 0 < d₂ := lt_min (by linarith) hx'.1
    refine ⟨fun S => (d₂ * w₁ S + d₁ * w₂ S) / (d₁ + d₂),
      fun S => by have := hw₁ S; have := hw₂ S; positivity, ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
    · rw [← sum_div, sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, ← mul_sum, hone₁, hone₂]
      field_simp
      ring
    · rw [← sum_div, sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, ← mul_sum, hmass₁, hmass₂]
      field_simp
      simp only [transfer, d₁, d₂]
      split_ifs <;> ring

theorem IsTwoUniversal.leftover_hash_of_isSource {seed : PMF Seed}
    {hash : Seed → Input → Output} (hhash : IsTwoUniversal seed hash) {source : PMF Input}
    {k : ℝ} {ε : ℝ≥0} (hsource : IsSource source k ε) :
    dist (seededHash seed source hash)
        (seed.bind (fun s => (PMF.uniformOfFintype Output).map (s, ·))) ≤
      ε + Real.sqrt (Fintype.card Output * 2 ^ (-k)) / 2 := by
  obtain ⟨close, hclose, hdist⟩ := hsource
  calc
    _ ≤ dist (seededHash seed source hash) (seededHash seed close hash) +
        dist (seededHash seed close hash)
          (seed.bind (fun s => (PMF.uniformOfFintype Output).map (s, ·))) :=
      dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ ε + Real.sqrt (Fintype.card Output * 2 ^ (-k)) / 2 :=
      add_le_add ((dist_seededHash_le seed source close hash).trans hdist)
        (hhash.leftover_hash_of_mass_le close ((le_minEntropy_iff close).mp hclose))

/-- **Entropy loss of leftover hashing.** If the source is a `(k, ε)`-source with
`log₂ |Output| + 2 log₂ (1 / δ) ≤ k`, hashing with an independent public two-universal seed is
within `ε + δ / 2` of the seed paired with an independent uniform value. -/

theorem IsTwoUniversal.leftover_hash_of_isSource_of_logb_le {seed : PMF Seed}
    {hash : Seed → Input → Output} (hhash : IsTwoUniversal seed hash) {source : PMF Input}
    {k : ℝ} {ε : ℝ≥0} (hsource : IsSource source k ε) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hk : Real.logb 2 (Fintype.card Output) + 2 * Real.logb 2 δ⁻¹ ≤ k) :
    dist (seededHash seed source hash)
        (seed.bind (fun s => (PMF.uniformOfFintype Output).map (s, ·))) ≤ ε + δ / 2 := by
  have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card Output := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hmass : (Fintype.card Output : ℝ) * 2 ^ (-k) ≤ δ ^ 2 := by
    have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (Real.logb 2 (Fintype.card Output) + 2 * Real.logb 2 δ⁻¹) =
        Fintype.card Output * δ⁻¹ * δ⁻¹ := by
      rw [two_mul, Real.rpow_add two_pos, Real.rpow_add two_pos,
        Real.rpow_logb two_pos (by norm_num) hcard,
        Real.rpow_logb two_pos (by norm_num) (inv_pos.mpr hδ), mul_assoc]
    calc
      (Fintype.card Output : ℝ) * 2 ^ (-k) ≤ Fintype.card Output *
          2 ^ (-(Real.logb 2 (Fintype.card Output) + 2 * Real.logb 2 δ⁻¹)) := by
        gcongr
        norm_num
      _ = δ ^ 2 := by
        rw [Real.rpow_neg zero_le_two, hpow]
        field_simp
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (Fintype.card Output * 2 ^ (-k)) ≤ δ :=
    (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hmass).trans_eq (Real.sqrt_sq hδ.le)
  exact (hhash.leftover_hash_of_isSource hsource).trans (by linarith)

/-- **Leftover hashing with side information.** If every possible conditional source is a
`(k, ε)`-source, hashing with an independent two-universal seed hides the hash value up to
`ε + √(|Output| · 2⁻ᵏ) / 2`, even when the side information and the seed are revealed. -/

theorem exists_forall_sum_le_of_forall_exists_sum_le {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [Nonempty I] (M : I → J → ℝ) {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ q : StdSimplex ℝ J, ∃ i, ∑ j, q.weights j * M i j ≤ c) :
    ∃ p : StdSimplex ℝ I, ∀ j, ∑ i, p.weights i * M i j ≤ c := by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty J with hJ | hJ
  · exact ⟨.single (Classical.arbitrary I), fun j => isEmptyElim j⟩
  -- the expected payment, a bilinear function on pairs of weight vectors
  set φ : (I → ℝ) → (J → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x y => ∑ i, ∑ j, x i * y j * M i j
  have hφx (y : J → ℝ) : (fun x => φ x y) = fun x => ∑ i, x i * ∑ j, y j * M i j := by
    funext x
    simp only [φ, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
  have hφy (x : I → ℝ) : (fun y => φ x y) = fun y => ∑ j, y j * ∑ i, x i * M i j := by
    funext y
    simp only [φ, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
  have hcont : Continuous fun p : (I → ℝ) × (J → ℝ) => φ p.1 p.2 := by
    simp only [φ]
    fun_prop
  -- a saddle point of `φ` on the two simplices
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨p, rfl⟩, b, ⟨q, rfl⟩, hab⟩ := Sion.exists_isSaddlePointOn (f := φ)
    (Set.range_nonempty _) (convex_range_weights I) (isCompact_range_weights I)
    (fun y _ =>
      (hcont.comp (Continuous.prodMk_left y)).lowerSemicontinuous.lowerSemicontinuousOn _)
    (fun y _ r => by
      rw [hφx]
      exact (convex_range_weights I).inter (convex_halfSpace_le (isLinearMap_sum_mul _) r))
    (convex_range_weights J) (Set.range_nonempty _) (isCompact_range_weights J)
    (fun x _ =>
      (hcont.comp (Continuous.prodMk_right x)).upperSemicontinuous.upperSemicontinuousOn _)
    (fun x _ r => by
      rw [hφy]
      exact (convex_range_weights J).inter (convex_halfSpace_ge (isLinearMap_sum_mul _) r))
  -- against the column strategy `q` some row `i` pays at most `c`, and `p` does no worse
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h q
  refine ⟨p, fun j => ?_⟩
  have h₁ := hab _ ⟨.single i, rfl⟩ _ ⟨.single j, rfl⟩
  simp only [φ, weights_single, Finsupp.single_apply] at h₁
  simp only [mul_ite, ite_mul, mul_one, one_mul, mul_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
    Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, Finset.sum_ite_irrel, Finset.sum_const_zero] at h₁
  exact h₁.trans hi

theorem exists_mem_support_tsum_mul_le (μ : PMF α) (ν : PMF β) (loss : α → β → ℝ≥0∞)
    {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ b ∈ ν.support, ∑' a, μ a * loss a b ≤ ε) :
    ∃ a ∈ μ.support, ∑' b, ν b * loss a b ≤ ε := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hle⟩ := exists_mem_support_le_tsum_mul μ fun a => ∑' b, ν b * loss a b
  refine ⟨a, ha, hle.trans ?_⟩
  calc ∑' a, μ a * ∑' b, ν b * loss a b
      = ∑' b, ν b * ∑' a, μ a * loss a b := by
        simp only [← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
        rw [ENNReal.tsum_comm]
        exact tsum_congr fun b => tsum_congr fun a => by ring
    _ ≤ ∑' b, ν b * ε := by
        refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun b => ?_
        by_cases hb : b ∈ ν.support
        · gcongr
          exact h b hb
        · simp [(PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff ν b).mpr hb]
    _ = ε := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, ν.tsum_coe, one_mul]

theorem exists_mem_support_toOuterMeasure_le (μ : PMF α) (ν : PMF β) (E : α → β → Prop)
    {ε : ℝ} (h : ∀ b ∈ ν.support, (μ.toOuterMeasure {a | E a b}).toReal ≤ ε) :
    ∃ a ∈ μ.support, (ν.toOuterMeasure {b | E a b}).toReal ≤ ε := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := ν.support_nonempty
  have hε : 0 ≤ ε := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg.trans (h b₀ hb₀)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hle⟩ := exists_mem_support_tsum_mul_le μ ν
    (fun a b => if E a b then 1 else 0) (ε := ENNReal.ofReal ε) fun b hb => by
      have := h b hb
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hε, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (PMF.toOuterMeasure_ne_top μ _),
        toOuterMeasure_eq_tsum_mul_ite] at this
      simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using this
  refine ⟨a, ha, ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hε ?_⟩
  rw [toOuterMeasure_eq_tsum_mul_ite]
  simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using hle

theorem toOuterMeasure_abs_sub_ge_le (p : PMF α) (f : α → ℝ) (m ε : ℝ) :
    p.toOuterMeasure {a | ε ≤ |f a - m|} ≤
      p.toOuterMeasure {a | m + ε ≤ f a} + p.toOuterMeasure {a | f a ≤ m - ε} := by
  refine (MeasureTheory.measure_mono (μ := p.toOuterMeasure) fun a ha => ?_).trans
    (MeasureTheory.measure_union_le _ _)
  rcases le_abs.mp (show ε ≤ |f a - m| from ha) with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (add_comm m ε ▸ le_sub_iff_add_le.mp h)
  · exact Or.inr (le_sub_comm.mp (neg_sub (f a) m ▸ h))

the upper tail `m + ε ≤ f a` and the lower tail `f a ≤ m - ε`. -/

theorem toOuterMeasure_bind_failure_le (p : PMF α) (kernel : α → PMF β)
    (pre : Set α) (failure : Set β) (error : ENNReal)
    (hstep : ∀ a ∈ p.support, a ∈ pre → (kernel a).toOuterMeasure failure ≤ error) :
    (p.bind kernel).toOuterMeasure failure ≤ p.toOuterMeasure preᶜ + error := by
  classical
  rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_bind_apply, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑' a, ((preᶜ).indicator p a + p a * error) := by
      apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
      intro a
      by_cases ha : a ∈ pre
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show a ∉ preᶜ by simpa), zero_add]
        by_cases hs : a ∈ p.support
        · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hstep a hs ha) zero_le
        · have hz : p a = 0 := by simpa only [PMF.mem_support_iff, not_not] using hs
          simp [hz]
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem (show a ∈ preᶜ from ha)]
        exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (toOuterMeasure_le_one (kernel a) failure)
          zero_le).trans (by simp)
    _ = _ := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_add, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, p.tsum_coe, one_mul]

theorem toOuterMeasure_bind_ge_mul (p : PMF α) (kernel : α → PMF β)
    (pre : Set α) (event : Set β) {s₁ s₂ : ℝ} (hs₂ : 0 ≤ s₂)
    (hp : s₁ ≤ (p.toOuterMeasure pre).toReal)
    (hstep : ∀ a ∈ p.support, a ∈ pre → s₂ ≤ ((kernel a).toOuterMeasure event).toReal) :
    s₁ * s₂ ≤ ((p.bind kernel).toOuterMeasure event).toReal := by
  classical
  have hle : p.toOuterMeasure pre * ENNReal.ofReal s₂ ≤ (p.bind kernel).toOuterMeasure event := by
    rw [PMF.toOuterMeasure_bind_apply, PMF.toOuterMeasure_apply, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]
    refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun a => ?_
    by_cases ha : a ∈ pre
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem ha]
      by_cases hs : a ∈ p.support
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          ((ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal (toOuterMeasure_ne_top _ _)).mpr (hstep a hs ha))
          zero_le
      · have hz : p a = 0 := by simpa only [PMF.mem_support_iff, not_not] using hs
        simp [hz]
    · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem ha]
  have htoReal := ENNReal.toReal_mono (toOuterMeasure_ne_top _ _) hle
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hs₂] at htoReal
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp hs₂).trans htoReal

theorem map_any_range_true_le_sum (p : PMF α) (K : ℕ) (F : ℕ → α → Bool) :
    (p.map (fun a => (List.range K).any (fun j => F j a))) true ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, (p.map (F j)) true := by
  induction K with
  | zero =>
    simp [PMF.map_apply]
  | succ K ih =>
    have hsplit : ∀ a ∈ p.support, ((List.range (K + 1)).any (fun j => F j a)) = true →
        ((List.range K).any (fun j => F j a)) = true ∨ F K a = true := by
      intro a _ ha
      rw [List.range_succ, List.any_append, Bool.or_eq_true] at ha

    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    exact (map_true_le_add p hsplit).trans (add_le_add_left ih _)

theorem ofReal_two_mul_sq_measureReal_sub_le_klDiv {mα : MeasurableSpace α}
    {μ ν : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (μ.real s - ν.real s) ^ 2) ≤ klDiv μ ν := by
  by_cases hac : μ ≪ ν
  swap; · simp [klDiv_of_not_ac hac]
  by_cases hint : Integrable (llr μ ν) μ
  swap; · simp [klDiv_of_not_integrable hint]
  rw [klDiv_of_ac_of_integrable hac hint]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  simp only [probReal_univ, add_sub_cancel_right]
  set δ := μ.real s - ν.real s
  set t := 4 * δ
  let X : α → ℝ := s.indicator fun _ => 1
  have hX : Measurable X := measurable_const.indicator hs
  have hXmem (x : α) : X x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ s <;> simp [X, hx]
  have hexp : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (t * X x)) ν :=
    Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) (Real.exp |t|) (ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), Real.exp_le_exp]
      calc t * X x ≤ |t * X x| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |t| * X x := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hXmem x).1]
        _ ≤ |t| * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hXmem x).2 (abs_nonneg t)
        _ = |t| := mul_one _)
  have hfμ : Integrable (fun x => t * X x) μ := ((integrable_const 1).indicator hs).const_mul t
  -- Gibbs' inequality for the tilted measure `ν.tilted (t * X)`.
  have hgibbs : 0 ≤ ∫ x, llr μ (ν.tilted fun x => t * X x) x ∂μ := by
    have := isProbabilityMeasure_tilted hexp
    have h := integral_llr_add_sub_measure_univ_nonneg
      (hac.trans (absolutelyContinuous_tilted hexp))
      (integrable_llr_tilted_right hac hfμ hint hexp)
    simpa only [probReal_univ, add_sub_cancel_right] using h
  rw [integral_llr_tilted_right hac hfμ hexp hint] at hgibbs
  -- Hoeffding's lemma for the indicator of `s` under `ν`.
  have hmean : ∫ x, X x ∂ν = ν.real s := by
    rw [integral_indicator_const (1 : ℝ) hs, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hhoeffding : ∫ x, Real.exp (t * X x) ∂ν ≤ Real.exp (t * ν.real s + t ^ 2 / 8) := by
    have h := (hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc (μ := ν) hX.aemeasurable (ae_of_all _ hXmem)).mgf_le t
    rw [hmean, show (fun x => X x - ν.real s) = fun x => X x + -ν.real s from
      funext fun _ => sub_eq_add_neg _ _, mgf_add_const] at h
    rw [mgf] at h
    calc ∫ x, Real.exp (t * X x) ∂ν
        = ((∫ x, Real.exp (t * X x) ∂ν) * Real.exp (t * -ν.real s)) *
            Real.exp (t * ν.real s) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]; simp
      _ ≤ Real.exp ((‖(1 : ℝ) - 0‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp (t * ν.real s) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (t * ν.real s + t ^ 2 / 8) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add, sub_zero, nnnorm_one]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
  have hlog : Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (t * X x) ∂ν) ≤ t * ν.real s + t ^ 2 / 8 :=
    (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (integral_exp_pos hexp)).mpr hhoeffding
  have hint_f : ∫ x, t * X x ∂μ = t * μ.real s := by
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_indicator_const (1 : ℝ) hs, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [hint_f] at hgibbs
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg δ]

follows from the event form applied to a Hahn decomposition. -/

theorem pi_fin_succ {γ : Type*} [Finite γ] (count : ℕ) (p : PMF γ) :

      ext outcome

theorem toOuterMeasure_toReal_le_two_rpow (p : ∀ i, PMF (β i)) (W : Set (∀ i, β i))
    (hW : ∃ u ∈ W, u ∈ (pi p).support) :
    ((pi p).toOuterMeasure W).toReal ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (-∑ j, dist (((pi p).filter W hW).map fun u => u j) (p j) ^ 2) := by
  set w := ((pi p).toOuterMeasure W).toReal
  have hw0 : 0 < w := (toOuterMeasure_toReal_pos_iff _ W).mpr hW
  have hw1 : w ≤ 1 := by
    simpa using ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.one_ne_top (toOuterMeasure_le_one (pi p) W)
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / w) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hw0]; linarith)
  have hln2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
  -- `ln (1 / w) / 2 ≤ log₂ (1 / w)` because `ln 2 < 2`.
  have hle : Real.log (1 / w) / 2 ≤ Real.logb 2 (1 / w) := by
    rw [Real.logb, div_le_div_iff₀ two_pos hln2]
    have : Real.log 2 ≤ 2 := (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos two_pos).trans (by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  have hsum := (sum_sq_dist_map_filter_pi_le p W hW).trans hle
  calc w = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-Real.logb 2 (1 / w)) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_neg zero_le_two, Real.rpow_logb two_pos (by norm_num) (by positivity),
          one_div, inv_inv]
    _ ≤ _ := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le one_le_two (neg_le_neg hsum)

for `k` independent coordinates, by Cauchy–Schwarz. -/

theorem sum_dist_filter_sideJoint_le (μ : PMF T) (K : ∀ i, T → PMF (β i))
    (J : T → PMF ((∀ i, β i) × V)) (hJ : ∀ t, (J t).map Prod.fst = pi fun i => K i t)

        ((((sideJoint μ J).filter W hW).map Prod.fst).bind fun s => (K j s.1).map (s, ·)) ≤
      Real.sqrt (Fintype.card ι *
        Real.log (Fintype.card V / ((sideJoint μ J).toOuterMeasure W).toReal) / 2) := by

  set Pw := ((sideJoint μ J).toOuterMeasure W).toReal

  set w : T × V → ℝ := fun s => ((Q.map Prod.fst) s).toReal
  set c : T × V → ℝ := fun s => ((J s.1).toOuterMeasure (sliceEvent W s.1 s.2)).toReal
  set k : ℝ := (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)

    map_fst_filter_sideJoint_toReal μ J W hW s.1 s.2
  have hw0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ w s := fun s => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hwsum : ∑ s, w s = 1 := sum_toReal _
  have hc1 : ∀ s, c s ≤ 1 := fun s => by
    simpa using ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.one_ne_top (toOuterMeasure_le_one _ _)
  -- Per point bound.
  set B : T × V → ℝ := fun s => k * Real.log (1 / c s) / 2
  have hB0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ B s := fun s => by
    have : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / c s) := by
      rcases (show 0 ≤ c s from ENNReal.toReal_nonneg).eq_or_lt with h | h
      · rw [← h]
        simp
      · exact Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ h]; linarith [hc1 s])
    positivity
  have hpoint : ∀ s, w s * ∑ j, dist ((conditionalSnd Q s).map fun u => u j) (K j s.1) ≤
      w s * Real.sqrt (B s) := by

    rcases (hw0 s).eq_or_lt with h0 | hpos
    · rw [← h0, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (hw0 s)
    have hcpos : 0 < c s := by
      rw [hw] at hpos
      by_contra hc
      have : c s = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hc) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      rw [this] at hpos
      simp at hpos
    have hs : s ∈ (Q.map Prod.fst).support := by
      refine (PMF.mem_support_iff _ _).mpr fun h => ?_
      have : w s = 0 := by simp only [w, h, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
      linarith

      (toOuterMeasure_toReal_pos_iff _ _).mp hcpos

    have hside := sum_sq_dist_map_filter_le (fun i => K i s.1) (J s.1) (hJ s.1) _ hWs
    have hmap : ∀ j, (conditionalSnd Q s).map (fun u => u j) =
        ((J s.1).filter (sliceEvent W s.1 s.2) hWs).map fun x => x.1 j := fun j => by
      rw [hcond, PMF.map_comp]
      rfl
    simp only [hmap]
    refine Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le ?_

      (f := fun j => dist (((J s.1).filter (sliceEvent W s.1 s.2) hWs).map fun x => x.1 j)

    rw [hw] at hpos

    have : c s = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hc) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    rw [this] at hpos
    simp at hpos

  have hsub : ∀ f : T × V → ℝ, (∀ s, w s = 0 → f s = 0) → ∑ s, f s = ∑ s ∈ S, f s := by

    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_lt] at hs

    rw [← hsub w fun s h => h]

    have := strictConcaveOn_log_Ioi.concaveOn.le_map_sum (t := S) (w := w)

        exact one_div_pos.mpr (hcpos s hs)

    calc ∑ s ∈ S, w s * (1 / c s) = ∑ s ∈ S, (μ s.1).toReal / Pw := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs => ?_
          simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hs
          rw [hw]
          field_simp [(hcpos s hs).ne']
      _ ≤ ∑ s : T × V, (μ s.1).toReal / Pw := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (f := fun s : T × V => (μ s.1).toReal / Pw)
            (Finset.subset_univ S) fun s _ _ => ?_
          exact div_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hPw.le
      _ = Fintype.card V / Pw := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_div, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum, sum_toReal, mul_one]
  have hratio_pos : 0 < ∑ s ∈ S, w s * (1 / c s) := by
    have hne : S.Nonempty := by
      by_contra h
      rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h, Finset.sum_empty] at hwS
      exact zero_ne_one hwS
    refine Finset.sum_pos (fun s hs => ?_) hne
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hs
    exact mul_pos hs (one_div_pos.mpr (hcpos s hs))
  have hkey : ∑ s, w s * B s ≤ k * Real.log (Fintype.card V / Pw) / 2 := by
    rw [hsub (fun s => w s * B s) fun s h => by simp [h]]
    calc ∑ s ∈ S, w s * B s = k / 2 * ∑ s ∈ S, w s * Real.log (1 / c s) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
          simp only [B]
          ring

          gcongr
          exact hjensen.trans (Real.log_le_log hratio_pos hratio)
      _ = _ := by ring
  -- Jensen for the square root.
  have hsqrt : ∑ s, w s * Real.sqrt (B s) ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ s, w s * B s) := by
    have := (Real.strictConcaveOn_sqrt).concaveOn.le_map_sum (t := Finset.univ) (w := w)
      (p := B) (fun s _ => hw0 s) hwsum fun s _ => Set.mem_Ici.mpr (hB0 s)
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using this
  calc ∑ j, dist (Q.map fun z => (z.1, z.2 j)) ((Q.map Prod.fst).bind fun s => (K j s.1).map (s, ·))
      = ∑ j, ∑ s, w s * dist ((conditionalSnd Q s).map fun u => u j) (K j s.1) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
          dist_map_pair_bind_eq Q (fun u => u j) fun s => K j s.1
    _ = ∑ s, w s * ∑ j, dist ((conditionalSnd Q s).map fun u => u j) (K j s.1) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ s, w s * Real.sqrt (B s) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ => hpoint s
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ s, w s * B s) := hsqrt
    _ ≤ _ := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hkey

noncomputable def twice [DecidableEq T] (first : PMF S) (challenge : S → PMF T)
    (answer : S → T → PMF A) (ok : S → T → A → Bool) : PMF Bool := do
  let s ← first
  let t ← challenge s
  let t' ← challenge s
  let a ← answer s t
  let a' ← answer s t'
  return (ok s t a && ok s t' a' && t != t')

private theorem sq_sub_le_pairs [DecidableEq T] (μ : PMF T) (p : T → ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ p t) (h1 : ∀ t, p t ≤ 1) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : ∀ t, (μ t).toReal ≤ κ) :
    (∑ t, (μ t).toReal * p t) ^ 2 - κ * (∑ t, (μ t).toReal * p t) ≤
      ∑ t, (μ t).toReal * ∑ t', (μ t').toReal *
        (if t = t' then 0 else p t * p t') := by
  set q : T → ℝ := fun t => (μ t).toReal * p t
  have hq0 (t : T) : 0 ≤ q t := mul_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (h0 t)
  have hqκ (t : T) : q t ≤ κ :=
    (mul_le_of_le_one_right ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (h1 t)).trans (hκ t)
  have hdiag : ∑ t, q t * q t ≤ κ * ∑ t, q t := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun t _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hqκ t) (hq0 t)
  have hoff (t : T) : ∑ t', (if t = t' then 0 else q t * q t') =
      q t * ∑ t', q t' - q t * q t := by
    have hite : (fun t' => if t = t' then 0 else q t * q t') = fun t' =>
        q t * q t' - if t = t' then q t * q t' else 0 := by
      funext t'
      split_ifs <;> ring
    rw [hite, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
      ite_eq_left (Finset.mem_univ t)]
  have hpair (t t' : T) :
      (μ t).toReal * ((μ t').toReal * (if t = t' then 0 else p t * p t')) =
        if t = t' then 0 else q t * q t' := by
    dsimp only [q]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  calc (∑ t, q t) ^ 2 - κ * (∑ t, q t)
      ≤ (∑ t, q t) ^ 2 - ∑ t, q t * q t := sub_le_sub_left hdiag _
    _ = ∑ t, ∑ t', (if t = t' then 0 else q t * q t') := by
      simp only [hoff, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      ring
    _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.mul_sum, hpair]

/-- **Rewinding with bounded challenge atoms.** If each conditional challenge law has atoms of
mass at most `κ`, one-run success `ε` and two-run success at distinct challenges `δ` satisfy
`ε² − κ * ε ≤ δ`. The bound is needed only on possible first-stage outcomes.

This is an original extension of [BonehShoup2023], Lemma 19.2, to biased challenges depending on
the saved state. It concerns experiment laws, with no efficiency claim. -/
theorem sq_sub_mul_le_twice [Finite T] {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ first.support, ∀ t, (challenge s t).toReal ≤ κ) :
    (once first challenge answer ok true).toReal ^ 2 -
        κ * (once first challenge answer ok true).toReal ≤
      (twice first challenge answer ok true).toReal := by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite T
  set p := pass answer ok
  set g : S → ℝ := fun s => ∑ t, (challenge s t).toReal * p s t
  set h : S → ℝ := fun s => ∑ t, (challenge s t).toReal *
    ∑ t', (challenge s t').toReal * (if t = t' then 0 else p s t * p s t')
  have hg (s : S) : 0 ≤ g s ∧ g s ≤ 1 :=
    average_mem_Icc (challenge s) _ (pass_nonneg answer ok s) (pass_le_one answer ok s)
  have hpair (s : S) (t t' : T) :
      0 ≤ (if t = t' then 0 else p s t * p s t') ∧ (if t = t' then 0 else p s t * p s t') ≤ 1 := by
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
    · exact ⟨mul_nonneg (pass_nonneg _ _ _ _) (pass_nonneg _ _ _ _),
        (mul_le_mul (pass_le_one _ _ _ _) (pass_le_one _ _ _ _) (pass_nonneg _ _ _ _)
          zero_le_one).trans_eq (one_mul 1)⟩
  have hh (s : S) : 0 ≤ h s ∧ h s ≤ 1 := by
    refine average_mem_Icc (challenge s) _
      (fun t => (average_mem_Icc (challenge s) _ (fun t' => (hpair s t t').1)
        fun t' => (hpair s t t').2).1)
      fun t => (average_mem_Icc (challenge s) _ (fun t' => (hpair s t t').1)
        fun t' => (hpair s t t').2).2
  have hm : Summable fun s => (first s).toReal := Probability.PMF.summable_toReal first
  have hsum {f : S → ℝ} (f0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ f s) (f1 : ∀ s, f s ≤ 1) :
      Summable fun s => (first s).toReal * f s :=
    hm.of_nonneg_of_le (fun s => mul_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (f0 s))
      fun s => mul_le_of_le_one_right ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (f1 s)
  have hsumg := hsum (fun s => (hg s).1) fun s => (hg s).2
  have hsumg2 := hsum (fun s => sq_nonneg (g s)) fun s => pow_le_one₀ (hg s).1 (hg s).2
  have hsumh := hsum (fun s => (hh s).1) fun s => (hh s).2
  have hpoint (s : S) :
      (first s).toReal * g s ^ 2 - κ * ((first s).toReal * g s) ≤ (first s).toReal * h s := by
    by_cases hs : s ∈ first.support
    · calc _ = (first s).toReal * (g s ^ 2 - κ * g s) := by ring
           _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
             (sq_sub_le_pairs (challenge s) (p s) (pass_nonneg answer ok s)
               (pass_le_one answer ok s) (hκ s hs)) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    · simp [(PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff first s).mpr hs]
  rw [toReal_once, toReal_twice]
  calc (∑' s, (first s).toReal * g s) ^ 2 - κ * (∑' s, (first s).toReal * g s)
      ≤ ∑' s, (first s).toReal * g s ^ 2 - κ * (∑' s, (first s).toReal * g s) := by
        gcongr
        exact sq_tsum_le_tsum_sq first (fun s => (hg s).1) fun s => (hg s).2
    _ = ∑' s, ((first s).toReal * g s ^ 2 - κ * ((first s).toReal * g s)) := by
        rw [hsumg2.tsum_sub (hsumg.mul_left κ), tsum_mul_left]
    _ ≤ ∑' s, (first s).toReal * h s :=
        (hsumg2.sub (hsumg.mul_left κ)).tsum_le_tsum hpoint hsumh

/-- The bounded-atom rewinding inequality solved for one-run success: `ε ≤ κ + √δ`.
The conditional atom hypothesis implies `κ ≥ 0`; no separate sign assumption is needed. -/
theorem le_add_sqrt_twice [Finite T] {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ first.support, ∀ t, (challenge s t).toReal ≤ κ) :
    (once first challenge answer ok true).toReal ≤
      κ + √(twice first challenge answer ok true).toReal := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := first.support_nonempty
  obtain ⟨t, -⟩ := (challenge s).support_nonempty

  set ε := (once first challenge answer ok true).toReal

theorem dist_bind_left_le [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β) (q : PMF β) :
    dist (p.bind f) q ≤ ∑ a, (p a).toReal * dist (f a) q := by

    rw [PMF.map_bind]

    exact (PMF.map_comp _ _ _).trans (PMF.map_id _)
  have h2 : (p.bind fun a => q.map (a, ·)).map Prod.snd = q := by
    rw [PMF.map_bind]
    have hq : (fun a : α => (q.map (a, ·)).map Prod.snd) = fun _ => q :=
      funext fun a => (PMF.map_comp _ _ _).trans (PMF.map_id _)
    rw [hq, PMF.bind_const]

    dist (p.bind f) q
      = dist ((p.bind fun a => (f a).map (a, ·)).map Prod.snd)
          ((p.bind fun a => q.map (a, ·)).map Prod.snd) := by rw [h1, h2]

    dist (p.map f) (p.map g) ≤ (p.toOuterMeasure {a | f a ≠ g a}).toReal := by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite α
  rw [dist_eq, toOuterMeasure_apply_toReal]
  have hmap : ∀ (h : α → β) (b : β),
      ((p.map h) b).toReal = ∑ a, if h a = b then (p a).toReal else 0 := by
    intro h b
    rw [PMF.map_apply, tsum_fintype,
      ENNReal.toReal_sum fun a _ => by split_ifs <;> simp [PMF.apply_ne_top]]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by by_cases hab : b = h a <;> simp [hab, eq_comm]
  have hpt : ∀ b, |((p.map f) b).toReal - ((p.map g) b).toReal| ≤
      ∑ a, (p a).toReal * |(if f a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if g a = b then 1 else 0)| := by
    intro b
    rw [hmap, hmap, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_))
    have hp := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (a := p a)

  have hinner : ∀ a, ∑ b, |(if f a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if g a = b then 1 else 0)| =
      if f a ≠ g a then 2 else 0 := by
    intro a
    by_cases hfg : f a = g a
    · simp [hfg]
    · rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ (f a)),
        Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (g a) (by simp [Ne.symm hfg])]
      · simp only [↓reduceIte, Ne.symm hfg, sub_zero, abs_one, hfg, zero_sub, abs_neg, ne_eq,
          not_false_eq_true]
        norm_num
      · intro b hb hbg
        have hbf : b ≠ f a := by simpa using hb
        simp [Ne.symm hbf, Ne.symm hbg]
  calc (∑ b, |((p.map f) b).toReal - ((p.map g) b).toReal|) / 2
      ≤ (∑ b, ∑ a, (p a).toReal *

        gcongr with b

        rw [Finset.sum_div]

    calc

        gcongr with s _

/-!
# Automation for first-order interpretations and reductions

A first-order reduction through an explicit interpretation is proved by syntactic side
conditions and a semantic argument. The tactics of this file prove the former and unfold the
latter, so that a new reduction costs only its semantic argument.

* `fo_qf` proves quantifier-freeness of formulas (`BoundedFormula.IsQF`,
  `BoundedFormula.IsAtomic`), interpretations (`Interpretation.IsQF`), projection formulas
  (`ProjectionFormula.IsQF`) and projections (`Projection.IsQF`) built from Boolean connectives,
  equality, relation symbols, the combinators of `Complexity.Logics.FirstOrder.Basic`, relabeling,
  finite conjunctions and disjunctions, pullback and composition. It searches the Aesop rule set
  `FirstOrder`. A concrete interpretation or projection, defined as a structure instance, is
  split into its domain and relation definitions, with a case for each relation symbol of a
  concrete vocabulary.
* `fo_iso_closed` runs the same search on closure of a class under isomorphism (`IsoClosed`),
  whose lemmas are registered in the rule set `FirstOrder` too.
* `fo_simp` simplifies with the simp set `fo_realize`, unfolding the realization of formulas,
  projection formulas and the relations of interpreted structures to propositions about the
  input structure. The relation and domain formulas of concrete interpretations and projections
  are unfolded by the simprocs `reduceInterpretationDomain`, `reduceInterpretationRel`,
  `reduceProjectionNumeric` and `reduceProjectionRel`. Composites `J.comp I` are not unfolded
  into raw pullback formulas: the domains, relations and input relations of composite
  interpretations and projections are rewritten through the iterated interpretation or projection
  (`Interpretation.realize_comp_domain`, `Interpretation.relMap_comp_model`,
  `Projection.comp_numeric_domain`, `Projection.comp_numeric_rel`,
  `Projection.relMap_comp_inputStructure`), simplifying directly to the full tuple domain
  `ι → M` when `I.domain` holds of every tuple
  (`Interpretation.realize_comp_domain_tupleStructure`,
  `Interpretation.realize_comp_rel_tupleStructure`,
  `Projection.realize_comp_rel_tupleStructure`).
* `fo_reduction I` reduces a goal `FO.QFReduces K K'` or `FO.Reduces K K'` to the semantic
  statement about the interpretation `I`, proving the side conditions it can. When `K'` is
  closed under isomorphism and the domain formula of `I` always holds, the semantic statement is
  about the input universe itself (`FO.QFReduces.of_unitStructure`,
  `FO.Reduces.of_unitStructure`) for one-dimensional `I`, or about the full tuple domain `ι → M`
  (`FO.QFReduces.of_tupleStructure`, `FO.Reduces.of_tupleStructure`) for higher-dimensional or
  composite `I`.

Relation symbols inside the formulas of an interpretation should be written as terms of their
declared type `L.Relations n`, such as Mathlib's `Language.adj`, rather than as bare constructors
such as `.adj`, whose type is the inductive type of symbols: `simp` cannot instantiate its lemmas
at terms that are well typed only after unfolding the language. Patterns `| .adj => …` in the
definition of the relations are unaffected.

## Main definitions

* `fo_qf`, `fo_iso_closed`, `fo_simp`, `fo_reduction`: the tactics above.
* `reduceInterpretationDomain`, `reduceInterpretationRel`, `reduceProjectionNumeric`,
  `reduceProjectionRel`: simprocs unfolding concrete interpretations and projections.

## Implementation notes

The simprocs unfold a projection of `Interpretation` or `Projection` only when its argument
unfolds to a structure instance, and a relation definition only when the match on the relation
symbol reduces, so they never expose auxiliary matchers; for quantifier-freeness, composites are
unfolded too. Aesop's simplifier is disabled in `fo_qf`: the default simp set would rewrite the
formulas whose shape the rules inspect. Relation symbols are split by a safe rule, as Aesop's
normalisation rules may not produce several goals.

## References

The organization follows the `polytime` automation of `Complexity.Tactic.PolyTime`: an Aesop
rule set declared in `Complexity.Tactic.FirstOrder.Init` and populated where lemmas are proved.
-/

  if stopAtComp && (e.isAppOf ``Cslib.Logic.FO.Interpretation.comp ||

/-!
# Rule sets and certificates for polynomial-time programs

`polytime` searches the Aesop rule set `PolyTime`. A certificate for a named program is registered
with `@[program_certificate]`. Certificates are indexed by their efficiency predicate and by the
constant at the head of the program, looking through an output encoding. A goal's certificates
are looked up using its own program head, so similarly implemented algorithms do not unfold into
each other's rules.
Certificates are also registered with `fun_prop`, reusing any existing global registration, so the
same annotation supports calls inside larger functional programs without duplicating search rules.
Parameterized `IsPPT` certificates are uncurried to the definitionally equal `IsPPTOn` statement
before registration, keeping both tactic interfaces on the same encoded-input contract.

The certificate index is adapted from the cslib `crypto` branch. Both computation predicates use
separate input and output encodings. `Tactic.PPT` combines the `PPT` and `PolyTime`
rule sets for closed probabilistic programs; machine witnesses remain behind their certificates.

## Main definitions

* `program_certificate`: register a named efficiency theorem before its implementation unfolds.

Aesop's index cannot see inside the program, which is a function, so the lookup is a single tactic
rule for each efficiency predicate rather than one `apply` rule for each certificate.

## References

Adapted from Cslib/Tactic/PolyTime/Init.lean on the cslib `crypto` branch at
`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`, sharing routine-call matching between both tactics.
-/

open Mathlib.Meta.FunProp in
/-- Preserve an existing `fun_prop` entry, including its priority. Distinct certificates for the
same function are still registered independently. -/
private def hasGlobalFunProp (decl : Name) : CoreM Bool := do
  return (← hasGlobalEntry functionTheoremsExt (·.thmOrigin.name) decl) ||
    (← hasGlobalEntry lambdaTheoremsExt (·.thmName) decl) ||
    (← hasGlobalEntry morTheoremsExt (·.thmName) decl) ||
    (← hasGlobalEntry transitionTheoremsExt (·.thmName) decl)

/-- `@[program_certificate]` registers an efficiency certificate for `polytime` and `ppt`. Its
conclusion must be a `ComputableInPolyTime`, `ComputableTidilyInPolyTime`, `IsPPTOn` or `IsPPT`
statement, or one of the word-RAM predicates `WordRAM.Refines`, `WordRAM.ComputableInPolyTime`,
`WordRAM.UniformComputableInPolyTime` used by `Tactic.WordRAM`. The indexed argument must apply
a constant, possibly under an output encoding. Other predicates are rejected rather than indexed
by an unrelated final argument.
Certificates are also registered with `fun_prop` for use in larger compositions, unless the same
declaration already has a global registration.

`@[program_certificate h₁ … hₙ]` additionally solves the hypotheses `h₁ … hₙ` immediately after the
certificate is applied. This is needed when such a hypothesis determines an encoding that other
hypotheses mention, so that proof search does not reach those goals with the encoding unknown. -/

initialize registerBuiltinAttribute {
  name := `programCertificate
  descr := "an efficiency certificate used by `polytime` and `ppt`, indexed by program head"
  applicationTime := .afterCompilation
  add := fun declName stx kind => do
    unless stx.isOfKind ``programCertificate do throwUnsupportedSyntax
    let eager := stx[1].getArgs.map (·.getId)
    let (certificate, key) ← MetaM.run' do
      let certificate ← encodedCertificate declName
      let key ← forallTelescope (← getConstInfo certificate).type fun _ conclusion =>
        efficiencyKey conclusion
      return (certificate, key)
    if key.1 == `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInPolyTime ||
        key.1 == `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime ||
        key.1 == `Cslib.Probability.IsPPTOn then
      unless ← hasGlobalFunProp certificate do
        Attribute.add certificate `fun_prop .missing kind
    certificateExt.add (key, certificate, eager) kind
}

/-- Solve the goal tagged `name`, or else one whose tag ends in `name` as for `case`, by proof
search: `PPT` and `PolyTime` rules for a PPT goal, and `PolyTime` rules otherwise. -/

def solveTagged (name : Name) : TacticM Unit := do
  let goals ← getGoals
  let some goal ← (do
      if let some goal ← goals.findM? fun goal => return (← goal.getTag) == name then
        return some goal
      goals.findM? fun goal => return name.isSuffixOf (← goal.getTag))
    | throwError "no goal named `{name}`"
  let target := (← instantiateMVars (← goal.getType)).consumeMData
  let isPPTGoal :=
    target.isAppOf `Cslib.Probability.IsPPTOn || target.isAppOf `Cslib.Probability.IsPPT
  let tactic ← if isPPTGoal then
    `(tactic| solve |
      aesop (config := { terminal := true, assumptionTransparency := .reducible })
        (rule_sets := [PPT, PolyTime]))
  else
    `(tactic| solve |
      aesop (config := { terminal := true, assumptionTransparency := .reducible })
        (rule_sets := [PolyTime]))
  let remaining ← evalTacticAt tactic goal
  unless remaining.isEmpty do throwError "proof search did not discharge `{name}`"
  -- Nested tactic elaboration can recover an error by admitting its goal. Reject that candidate
  -- before Aesop records it as a successful certificate application.
  if ← Aesop.hasSorry (mkMVar goal) then
    throwError "proof search did not discharge `{name}`"
  setGoals (goals.filter (· != goal))

/-- Preserve premise names even when Lean's `apply` gives a lone remaining goal its parent's
tag. The applied proof records the actual argument metavariables, including inferred ones. -/

def applyCertificates (predicate : Name) : Aesop.RuleTac := fun input => input.goal.withContext do
  let target := (← instantiateMVars (← input.goal.getType)).consumeMData
  unless target.isAppOf predicate do throwError "expected an efficiency goal for {predicate}"
  let key ← efficiencyKey target
  let initial ← saveState
  let mut applications := #[]
  for (certificate, eager) in (certificateExt.getState (← getEnv)).getD key #[] do
    try
      let goals ← (Lean.Elab.Tactic.run input.goal <|
          Term.withoutErrToSorry <| withoutRecover do
        liftMetaTactic fun goal => applyNamedCertificate goal certificate
        eager.forM solveTagged).run'
      if ← Aesop.hasSorry (mkMVar input.goal) then
        throwError "certificate application contains an admitted premise"
      let goals ← goals.toArray.mapM (Aesop.mvarIdToSubgoal input.goal)
      applications := applications.push {
        goals
        postState := ← saveState
        scriptSteps? := none
        successProbability? := none }
    catch _ => pure ()
    finally initial.restore
  if applications.isEmpty then throwError "no certificate for `{key.2.1}` applies"
  return ⟨applications⟩

/-- Apply a rule with known arguments, leaving all remaining hypotheses as goals. -/

def applyKnownCall (predicate : Name) (programIndex : Nat) (rule : Name)
    (argumentName certificateName : Name) : Aesop.RuleTac := fun input =>
  input.goal.withContext do
    let target := (← instantiateMVars (← input.goal.getType)).consumeMData
    unless target.isAppOf predicate do throwError "expected an efficiency goal for {predicate}"
    let program := target.getAppArgs[programIndex]!
    if program.hasExprMVar then throwError "the called program is not determined"
    let head ← lambdaTelescope (← Core.betaReduce (← etaExpand program)) fun _ body =>
      pure body.getAppFn
    let initial ← saveState
    let mut applications := #[]
    for decl in ← getLCtx do
      if decl.isImplementationDetail || !decl.type.isAppOf predicate then continue
      let certified := decl.type.getAppArgs[programIndex]!
      let called ← lambdaTelescope (← Core.betaReduce (← etaExpand certified)) fun _ body =>
        pure body.getAppFn
      unless called == head do continue
      try
        let goals ← (Lean.Elab.Tactic.run input.goal <|
            Term.withoutErrToSorry <| withoutRecover do
          let domain := target.getAppArgs[0]!
          let argument ← prepareArgument domain decl.type.getAppArgs[0]!
          let composed ← withLocalDeclD `input domain fun input =>
            mkLambdaFVars #[input] (mkApp certified (mkApp argument input))
          unless ← isDefEq (← withReducible (reduce composed)) program do
            throwError "the certificate does not match this call"
          let argument ← instantiateMVars argument
          let idArg := mkLambda `x .default domain (mkBVar 0)
          if !argument.hasExprMVar && (← withReducible (isDefEq argument idArg)) then
            unless ← withReducible (isDefEq decl.type target) do
              throwError "the certificate encoding does not match this call"
            input.goal.assign decl.toExpr
            replaceMainGoal []
          else
            applyWithArguments rule #[(argumentName, argument), (certificateName, decl.toExpr)]
            if ← (← getGoals).anyM (fun goal => do isDefEq (← goal.getType) target) then
              throwError "composition made no progress").run'
        if ← Aesop.hasSorry (mkMVar input.goal) then
          throwError "routine application contains an admitted premise"
        let goals ← goals.toArray.mapM (Aesop.mvarIdToSubgoal input.goal)
        applications := applications.push {
          goals
          postState := ← saveState
          scriptSteps? := none
          successProbability? := none }
      catch _ => pure ()
      finally initial.restore
    if applications.isEmpty then throwError "no applicable local routine certificate"
    return ⟨applications⟩

/-- Apply a scan through each matching supplied callback before checking its list. Argument
preparation must prove the callback's exact encoding contract. Each application is independent;
ordinary certificate lookup remains a separate fallback if a later obligation rejects it. -/

def applyScanWithLocalCallback (predicate certificate : Name) : Aesop.RuleTac := fun input =>
  input.goal.withContext do
    let initial ← saveState
    let mut applications := #[]
    try
      let goals ← applyNamedCertificate input.goal certificate
      let some callback ← goals.findM? fun goal => return (`htest).isSuffixOf (← goal.getTag)
        | throwError "scan has no callback premise"
      let knownCalls ← applyKnownCall predicate 2 (predicate ++ `comp) `g `hf
        { input with goal := callback }
      for matched in knownCalls.applications do
        try
          matched.postState.restore
          let remaining ← (Lean.Elab.Tactic.run input.goal <|
              Term.withoutErrToSorry <| withoutRecover do
            setGoals (matched.goals.toList.map (·.mvarId))
            evalTactic (← `(tactic| all_goals solve |
              aesop (config := { terminal := true, assumptionTransparency := .reducible })
                (rule_sets := [PolyTime])))
            if ← Aesop.hasSorry (mkMVar callback) then
              throwError "callback preparation contains an admitted premise"
            setGoals (← goals.filterM fun goal => return !(← goal.isAssigned))
            solveTagged `hlist).run'
          if ← Aesop.hasSorry (mkMVar input.goal) then
            throwError "scan application contains an admitted premise"
          applications := applications.push {
            goals := ← remaining.toArray.mapM (Aesop.mvarIdToSubgoal input.goal)
            postState := ← saveState
            scriptSteps? := none
            successProbability? := none }
        catch _ => pure ()
        finally initial.restore
    catch _ => pure ()
    finally initial.restore
    if applications.isEmpty then throwError "no supplied callback guides this scan"
    return ⟨applications⟩

/-!
# Reusing RAM controller certificates

Named `Refines`, `ComputableInPolyTime` and `UniformComputableInPolyTime` proofs can be
registered with `program_certificate`.
The `stateful` and `polytime` tactics respectively retrieve them through the existing certificate
index. Predicate and program heads are separate keys: a RAM certificate cannot discharge a
Turing-machine polynomial-time goal. Local certificates remain ordinary hypotheses.

Use `Refines.bind`, `branch`, `prepend`, and `call` explicitly to choose intermediate assertions,
representations and charged preparation code; automation then reuses the named subroutine proofs.
No rule evaluates arbitrary host-language continuations for free or guesses an implementation.

def ramControllerCertificate : Aesop.RuleTac := fun input => do
  let result ← applyCertificates ``WordRAM.Refines input
  let saved ← Lean.Meta.saveState
  for app in result.applications do
    try
      app.postState.restore
      for goal in app.goals do
        goal.mvarId.assumption
      let completed ← Lean.Meta.saveState
      saved.restore
      return ⟨#[{ app with goals := #[], postState := completed }]⟩
    catch _ => saved.restore
  throwError "no controller certificate closes from local hypotheses"

example (k c_R d_R c_M d_M : ℕ) : True := by
  let f (n : ℕ) : ℕ := n ^ (k + 1) + 1
  have hf : ComputableInPolyTime f encUnary encUnary := by
    unfold f
    fun_prop
  let m_bound (n : ℕ) : ℕ := c_R + (f n + 2) * d_R
  let s_bound (n : ℕ) : ℕ := c_M * (2 * n + 1 + m_bound n + 1) ^ d_M + 2

    unfold s_bound m_bound f
    fun_prop
  have hg : ComputableInPolyTime g encUnary encUnary := by
    unfold g certLength s_bound m_bound f
    fun_prop
  trivial

theorem growing_generator : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
    (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (Circuit.balanced (csa4to2 p.2) (csa3to2 p.2) (growingLeaves p)).code)
      (encPair encUnary encUnary) encCode := by
  have hn : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.2 + (p.2 + p.2))
      (encPair encUnary encUnary) encNat := by
    have hw := unary_to_binary.comp (snd encUnary encUnary)
    fun_prop
  have hl : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
      (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (growingLeaves p).map Circuit.code)
      (encPair encUnary encUnary) (encList encCode) := by
    simp only [growingLeaves, List.map_append, List.map_replicate, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
    have hlarge : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (largerLeaf p.2).code)
        (encPair encUnary encUnary) encCode :=
      largerLeaf_native.comp (snd encUnary encUnary)
    have hsmall : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (csa3to2 p.2).code)
        (encPair encUnary encUnary) encCode :=
      computableInPolyTime_csa3to2.tidy.comp (snd encUnary encUnary)
    have hrep : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
        (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => List.replicate p.1 (csa3to2 p.2).code)
        (encPair encUnary encUnary) (encList encCode) := replicate (fst _ _) hsmall
    have htail : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => [(largerLeaf p.2).code])
        (encPair encUnary encUnary) (encList encCode) :=
      cons' hlarge (const [])
    exact listAppend' hrep htail
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, balancedCode_eq_code] using
    (computableInPolyTime_balancedCode (.of_tidy hn)
      (.of_tidy (computableInPolyTime_csa4to2.tidy.comp (snd _ _)))
      (.of_tidy (computableInPolyTime_csa3to2.tidy.comp (snd _ _))) (.of_tidy hl)).tidy

example (hLWE : DecisionLWE dimension samples width (fun k => noiseLaw (width k) (noise k))) :
    ∃ circuits : ∀ k, Circuit Boolean.signature
        ((3 * secretWidth k + 1) + (ciphertextWidth k + 1)) 1,
      PolynomiallyBounded (fun k => (circuits k).size) ∧
      ∃ shallow deep : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ k, 2 ≤ shallow k ∧ k ≤ deep k) ∧
        (Leveled.scheme decryptionCircuits shallow).decrypt =
          (Leveled.scheme decryptionCircuits deep).decrypt ∧
        ∀ k sk c, sk.length = 3 * secretWidth k + 1 → c.length = ciphertextWidth k + 1 →
          (circuits k).eval Boolean.interpretation
              (BitString.ofList ((3 * secretWidth k + 1) + (ciphertextWidth k + 1)) (sk ++ c)) 0 =
            (Leveled.scheme decryptionCircuits deep).decrypt k sk c := by
  obtain ⟨circuits, hsize, hcircuits, -, -, -, hleveled⟩ := exists_leveled_of_decisionLWE hLWE
  obtain ⟨shallow, -, hshallow, hdecShallow, -⟩ := hleveled _ (PolynomiallyBounded.const 2)
  obtain ⟨deep, -, hdeep, hdecDeep, -⟩ := hleveled _ PolynomiallyBounded.id
  refine ⟨circuits, hsize, shallow, deep, fun k => ⟨hshallow k, hdeep k⟩,
    hdecShallow.trans hdecDeep.symm, fun k sk c hsk hc => ?_⟩

  refine ⟨fun ⟨s, hs, hcl⟩ => ?_, fun ⟨t, ht, hcov⟩ => ?_⟩

example : ∃ (c : Circuit (fullSignature 8 Bool) 8 1) (S : Set (Fin 8 → Bool)),
    c.FanInAtMost 8 ∧ c.Decides fullInterpretation {true} S ∧ RectangleFree S 2 ∧
      Nat.card Bool * 2 ^ 2 ≤ S.ncard := by
  let S : Set (Fin 8 → Bool) := {x | {i | x i = true}.ncard = 1}
  -- Two set bits of an input of `S` coincide.
  have huniq {x} (hx : x ∈ S) {i j} (hi : x i = true) (hj : x j = true) : i = j := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ncard_eq_one.mp hx
    exact ((hk ▸ hi : i ∈ ({k} : Set _))).trans (hk ▸ hj : j ∈ ({k} : Set _)).symm
  refine ⟨⟨Program.empty.gate ⟨.fn fun x => decide ({i | x i = true}.ncard = 1),
    fun k => .input k⟩, fun _ => .gate 0⟩, S, ⟨trivial, le_rfl⟩, fun x => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change _ ↔ decide ({i | x i = true}.ncard = 1) = true
    simp [S]
  · -- A rectangle with two distinct sides on `X` forces every side on `Xᶜ` to be zero.
    refine rectangleFree_iff.mpr fun X A B hAB => ?_
    by_contra! h
    obtain ⟨a, a', ha, ha', hne⟩ := (one_lt_ncard_iff).mp (by omega : 1 < A.ncard)
    obtain ⟨b, b', hb, hb', hne'⟩ := (one_lt_ncard_iff).mp (by omega : 1 < B.ncard)
    classical
    let z (a : X → Bool) (b : ↥Xᶜ → Bool) : Fin 8 → Bool :=
      fun i => if h : i ∈ X then a ⟨i, h⟩ else b ⟨i, h⟩
    have hz {a b} (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B) : z a b ∈ S := by
      refine hAB ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · convert ha using 1; funext ⟨i, hi⟩; simp [z, hi]
      · convert hb using 1; funext ⟨i, hi⟩; simp [z, show i ∉ X from hi]
    have hzero {a} (ha : a ∈ A) {i : X} (hi : a i = true) {b} (hb : b ∈ B) :
        b = fun _ => false := by
      funext j
      by_contra hj
      have := huniq (hz ha hb) (i := i) (j := j) (by simp [z, i.2, hi])
        (by simpa [z, show (j : Fin 8) ∉ X from j.2] using hj)
      exact j.2 (this ▸ i.2)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hne
    rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (a i) with h₁ | h₁
    · exact hne' ((hzero ha h₁ hb).trans (hzero ha h₁ hb').symm)
    · have h₂ : a' i = true := by simpa [h₁] using hi
      exact hne' ((hzero ha' h₂ hb).trans (hzero ha' h₂ hb').symm)
  · -- The eight unit vectors lie in `S`.
    let e (i : Fin 8) : Fin 8 → Bool := fun j => decide (j = i)
    have he : Function.Injective e := fun i i' h => by simpa [e] using congrFun h i
    calc Nat.card Bool * 2 ^ 2 = (range e).ncard := by simp [ncard_range_of_injective he]
      _ ≤ S.ncard := ncard_le_ncard (range_subset_iff.mpr fun i => by simp [S, e]) (toFinite _)

example : ∃ c, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (fun l => l.foldl resetStep []) encBits encBits
    (fun l => c * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range l.length,
      (((l.take i).foldl resetStep []).length + 1)) + 1))
    (fun l => c * (l.length + 1)) := by
  have hgrowth (state : List Bool) (bit : Bool) :
      (resetStep state bit).length ≤ state.length + 1 := by cases bit <;> simp [resetStep]
  have hlength (l state : List Bool) :
      (l.foldl resetStep state).length ≤ state.length + l.length := by
    induction l generalizing state with
    | nil => simp
    | cons b l ih =>
      have h := ih (resetStep state b)
      have hg := hgrowth state b
      simpa only [List.foldl_cons, List.length_cons] using (show
        (l.foldl resetStep (resetStep state b)).length ≤ state.length + (l.length + 1) by lia)
  have hfst : ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace Prod.fst
      (encPair encBits encBool) encBits := Internal.NormalForm.linear (PairEncoding.fst encBool)
  have hsnd : ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace Prod.snd
      (encPair encBits encBool) encBool := Internal.NormalForm.linear (PairEncoding.snd encBits)
  have happend : ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace
      (fun p : List Bool × Bool => p.1 ++ [false]) (encPair encBits encBool) encBits :=
    hfst.append
      (ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace.const (encMid := encBool) false) (fun _ => rfl)
  have hstep : ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace
      (fun p : List Bool × Bool => resetStep p.1 p.2) (encPair encBits encBool) encBits :=
    hsnd.ite
      (ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace.const []) (happend.restrict _)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hstep
  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := hk.foldl_bits_stream_sum (step := resetStep) []
    (R := fun l i => (3 * k + 2) * (((l.take i).foldl resetStep []).length + 1))
    (Q := fun l => k * (2 * l.length + 3)) (B := List.length)
    (fun l i hi => by
      have hg := hgrowth ((l.take i).foldl resetStep []) l[i]
      simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton,
        List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hi, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
      nlinarith)
    (fun l i hi => by
      have hl := hlength (l.take i) []
      simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add, List.length_take] at hl
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left k
      simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton]
      lia)
    (fun l i hi => by
      have hl := hlength (l.take i) []
      simpa only [encBits_apply, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add, List.length_take] using
        hl.trans (by simp))
  have hn (l : List Bool) : l.length ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range l.length,
      (((l.take i).foldl resetStep []).length + 1) := by
    simpa using (Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.range l.length)
      (f := fun _ => 1) (g := fun i => ((l.take i).foldl resetStep []).length + 1)
      (fun _ _ => Nat.le_add_left 1 _))
  refine ⟨c * (3 * k + 3), h.mono (fun l => ?_) (fun l => ?_)⟩
  · rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Nat.mul_assoc]
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left c
    have hl := hn l
    nlinarith

theorem ggm_eval_quantitative {generator : List Bool → List Bool}
    {tChild sChild : List Bool × Bool → ℕ}
    (hchild : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace
      (fun p : List Bool × Bool => Cslib.Crypto.GGM.child generator p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encBits encBool) encBits tChild sChild)
    {Q : List Bool × List Bool → ℕ}
    (hspace : ∀ p : List Bool × List Bool, ∀ i < p.2.length,
      sChild (Cslib.Crypto.GGM.eval generator p.1 (p.2.take i), p.2[i]?.getD false) ≤ Q p) :
    (∃ c, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace
      (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => Cslib.Crypto.GGM.eval generator p.1 p.2)
      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits
      (fun p => c * (p.1.length + p.2.length +
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.2.length,
          (tChild (Cslib.Crypto.GGM.eval generator p.1 (p.2.take i), p.2[i]?.getD false) +
            p.1.length + 1)) + 1))
      (fun p => c * (Q p + p.1.length + 1))) ∧
      ∀ p : List Bool × List Bool,
        (Cslib.Crypto.GGM.eval generator p.1 p.2).length ≤ p.1.length := by
  obtain ⟨⟨c, h⟩, hpost⟩ := hchild.foldl_bits_pair_stream_sum_spec
    (invariant := fun p i state =>
      state = Cslib.Crypto.GGM.eval generator p.1 (p.2.take i) ∧ state.length ≤ p.1.length)
    (fun _ => ⟨rfl, le_rfl⟩)
    (fun p i hi state ⟨heq, hle⟩ => by
      refine ⟨?_, (Cslib.Crypto.GGM.length_child_le generator state p.2[i]).trans hle⟩
      rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hi, Cslib.Crypto.GGM.eval_append,
        Cslib.Crypto.GGM.eval_cons, Cslib.Crypto.GGM.eval_nil, ← heq])
    (R := fun p i =>
      3 * (tChild (Cslib.Crypto.GGM.eval generator p.1 (p.2.take i), p.2[i]?.getD false) +
        p.1.length + 1))
    (Q := Q)
    (B := fun p => p.1.length)
    (fun p i hi state ⟨heq, hle⟩ => by
      have hnext_le : (Cslib.Crypto.GGM.child generator state p.2[i]).length ≤ p.1.length :=
        (Cslib.Crypto.GGM.length_child_le generator state p.2[i]).trans hle
      subst heq
      have hsp := hspace p i hi
      simp only [encBits_apply, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, Option.getD_some] at hsp ⊢
      exact ⟨by omega, hsp⟩)
    (fun _ _ _ _ ⟨_, hle⟩ => by simpa using hle)
  refine ⟨⟨3 * c, h.mono (fun p => ?_) (fun p => ?_)⟩, fun p => (hpost p).2⟩
  · have hsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.2.length,
        (tChild (Cslib.Crypto.GGM.eval generator p.1 (p.2.take i), p.2[i]?.getD false) +
          p.1.length + 1) := Nat.zero_le _
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum]
    nlinarith
  · nlinarith

example : ∃ L : Language Bool, ∀ᶠ N in atTop,
    IsAverageCaseHard (encodedSlice L (blockFactor (1 / 2)) N)
      (2 ^ (N / hardnessDivisor (1 / 2))) := by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ n, 16 ≤ n → ∃ f : BooleanFunction n,
      2 ^ n / (5 * n) < complexity interpretation (single f) := fun n hn => by
    have h := two_pow_two_pow_le_two_mul_ncard_setOf_lt_complexity hn
    have hne : {f : BooleanFunction n |
        2 ^ n / (5 * n) < complexity interpretation (single f)}.ncard ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0] at h
      have : 0 < 2 ^ 2 ^ n := by positivity
      omega
    exact Set.nonempty_of_ncard_ne_zero hne
  let F : ∀ n, BooleanFunction n := fun n =>
    if h : 16 ≤ n then (hex n h).choose else fun _ => false
  refine ⟨Language.ofSlices F, eventually_isAverageCaseHard_encodedSlice (by norm_num) ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_five_mul_le, eventually_ge_atTop 16] with n hn h16
  rw [Language.slice_ofSlices]
  have hF := (hex n h16).choose_spec
  have hFn : F n = (hex n h16).choose := by simp only [F, dite_eq_left h16]
  rw [hFn]
  -- `2 ^ (n / 2) ≤ 2 ^ n / (5 n) < ⌊2 ^ n / (5 n)⌋ + 1 ≤ complexity`
  set q := 2 ^ n / (5 * n)
  have hq : 2 ^ n < (q + 1) * (5 * n) := by
    have := Nat.lt_div_mul_add (a := 2 ^ n) (b := 5 * n) (by omega)
    rw [add_mul, one_mul]
    exact this
  have hq' : (2 : ℝ) ^ n < ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (5 * n) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hc : ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ complexity interpretation (single (hex n h16).choose) := by
    exact_mod_cast hF
  have hsplit : (2 : ℝ) ^ n = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * n) * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * n) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_natCast]
    congr 1
    ring
  have h5 : (0 : ℝ) < 5 * n := by
    have : (16 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast h16
    linarith
  have hpow : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * n) := by positivity
  have key : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * n) * (5 * n) ≤ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (5 * n) := by
    nlinarith
  exact (le_of_mul_le_mul_right key h5).trans hc

    ∃ circuit : ∀ security, Circuits.Circuit Circuits.Boolean.signature
        ((3 * secretWidth security + 1) + (ciphertextWidth security + 1)) 1,
      PolynomiallyBounded (fun security => (circuit security).size) ∧
      PolynomiallyBounded (fun security => 3 * secretWidth security + 1) ∧
      PolynomiallyBounded (fun security => ciphertextWidth security + 1) ∧
      NativeInDepth
        (fun d => Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits (fun _ => d)) ∧
      (∀ d : ℕ,
        (∀ security, (ProbComp.eval
          ((Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits (fun _ => d)).keyGen
            security)).map
            (fun keys => (Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe (Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe keys.1),
              Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe keys.2)) = keyGeneration security) ∧
        EncryptsAndDecrypts
          (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits (fun _ => d))
          (leveledEncryption Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe)
          (leveledDecryption Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe Turing.MultiTapeTM.dropFrame) ∧
        DecryptsWith
          (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits (fun _ => d))
          (fun security => 3 * secretWidth security + 1)
          (fun security => ciphertextWidth security + 1) circuit ∧
        Homomorphic
          (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits (fun _ => d))
          (fun _ C => C.2.depth ≤ d) ∧
        FixedWidths
          (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits (fun _ => d))
          (fun _ C => C.2.depth ≤ d)
          (fun security => 3 * secretWidth security + 1)
          (fun security => ciphertextWidth security + 1) ∧
        Native (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits (fun _ => d)) ∧
        ChosenMessageSecure
          (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits (fun _ => d))) ∧
      ∀ budget : ℕ → ℕ, Computation.PolyTime budget Encoding.encUnary Encoding.encUnary →
        (∀ security,
          (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits budget).keyGen security =
            (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits
              (fun _ => budget security)).keyGen security ∧
          (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits budget).evaluate security =
            (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits
              (fun _ => budget security)).evaluate security) ∧
        (∀ security, (ProbComp.eval
          ((Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits budget).keyGen security)).map
            (fun keys => (Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe (Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe keys.1),
              Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe keys.2)) = keyGeneration security) ∧
        EncryptsAndDecrypts (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits budget)
          (leveledEncryption Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe)
          (leveledDecryption Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe Turing.MultiTapeTM.dropFrame) ∧
        DecryptsWith (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits budget)
          (fun security => 3 * secretWidth security + 1)
          (fun security => ciphertextWidth security + 1) circuit ∧
        Homomorphic (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits budget)
          (fun security C => C.2.depth ≤ budget security) ∧
        FixedWidths (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits budget)
          (fun security C => C.2.depth ≤ budget security)
          (fun security => 3 * secretWidth security + 1)
          (fun security => ciphertextWidth security + 1) ∧
        Native (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits budget) ∧
        ChosenMessageSecure (Leveled.scheme GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits budget) := by
  let D := GSW.DepthParameters.decryptionCircuits
  have hD := GSW.DepthParameters.computableInPolyTime_decryptionCircuits
  have hkeyGen := GSW.DepthParameters.isPPTOn_keyGen
  have hencrypt := GSW.DepthParameters.isPPTOn_encrypt
  have hevaluate := GSW.DepthParameters.isPPTOn_evaluate
  obtain ⟨circuits, hsize, hcircuits⟩ := Leveled.exists_decrypt_circuits D hD
  obtain ⟨hsecret, hciphertext, hkgJoint, hencJoint, hdecJoint, hevalJoint⟩ :=
    Leveled.schemeFamily_spec D hkeyGen hencrypt hevaluate
      GSW.DepthParameters.computableInPolyTime_decryptionCircuits
  have hforBudget (budget : ℕ → ℕ) (hb : ComputableInPolyTime budget encUnary encUnary) :
      (∀ security, (ProbComp.eval
        ((Leveled.scheme D budget).keyGen security)).map
          (fun keys => (Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe (Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe keys.1),
            Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe keys.2)) = keyGeneration security) ∧
      EncryptsAndDecrypts (Leveled.scheme D budget)
        (leveledEncryption Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe)
        (leveledDecryption Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe Turing.MultiTapeTM.dropFrame) ∧
      DecryptsWith (Leveled.scheme D budget)
        (fun security => 3 * secretWidth security + 1)
        (fun security => ciphertextWidth security + 1) circuits ∧
      Homomorphic (Leveled.scheme D budget)
        (fun security C => C.2.depth ≤ budget security) ∧
      FixedWidths (Leveled.scheme D budget)
        (fun security C => C.2.depth ≤ budget security)
        (fun security => 3 * secretWidth security + 1)
        (fun security => ciphertextWidth security + 1) ∧

      fun security => hcircuits budget security,
      homomorphic_of_correct hcorrect fun _ _ h => h,
      fixedWidths_of_fixedWidth hwidth fun _ _ h => h,
      native_of (Leveled.isPPTOn_scheme_keyGen hkeyGen hencrypt D budget hb)
        (Leveled.isPPTOn_scheme_encrypt hencrypt D budget)
        (Leveled.computableInPolyTime_scheme_decrypt D hD budget)
        (Leveled.isPPTOn_scheme_evaluate hencrypt D hD hevaluate budget hb),
      chosenMessageSecure_of_indCPA hsecure⟩

    fun d => hforBudget (fun _ => d) (by fun_prop),
    fun budget hbudget =>
      ⟨fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩,
        hforBudget budget (.of_tidy (CryptographyBridge.polyTime_iff.mp hbudget))⟩⟩

theorem tqbf_mem_PSPACE (S : Presentation) (h : Laws S) :
    {p : S.Formula | S.freeVars p = ∅ ∧ S.eval (fun _ => false) p = true} ∈
      PSPACE (encQBF S h) := by
  classical
  let e : QBF ℕ ≃ S.Formula :=
    Equiv.ofBijective (toFormula S) ⟨toFormula_injective S h, toFormula_surjective S⟩
  have hmem : Cslib.Complexity.TQBF ∈ PSPACE Cslib.Complexity.encQBF :=
    mem_PSPACE_iff.mpr Cslib.Complexity.TQBF_mem_PSPACE
  rcases hmem with ⟨f, t, s, hs, ⟨k, State, hfin, tm, htm⟩, hA⟩
  refine ⟨fun p => f (e.symm p), fun p => t (e.symm p), s, hs,
    ⟨k, State, hfin, tm, fun p => ?_⟩, fun p => ?_⟩
  · have hp : encodeQBF S p = Cslib.Complexity.encQBF (e.symm p) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← e.apply_symm_apply p]
      exact encodeQBF_toFormula S h (e.symm p)
    simpa [encQBF, hp] using htm (e.symm p)
  · conv_lhs => rw [show p = toFormula S (e.symm p) from (e.apply_symm_apply p).symm]
    exact (mem_TQBF_toFormula_iff S h (e.symm p)).trans (hA (e.symm p))

/-- Transfer of `TQBF` PSPACE-hardness to presentation `S`. -/

theorem tqbf_pspaceHard (S : Presentation) (h : Laws S) :
    ∀ (α : Type) (encA : α ↪ List Bool) (A : Set α),
      A ∈ PSPACE encA →
        PolyTimeReducible encA (encQBF S h) A
          {p : S.Formula | S.freeVars p = ∅ ∧ S.eval (fun _ => false) p = true} := by
  intro α encA A hA
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hiff⟩ := Cslib.Complexity.TQBF_pspaceHard encA A (mem_PSPACE_iff.mp hA)
  obtain ⟨t, s, ht, hs, k, State, hfin, tm, htm⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨fun a => toFormula S (f a), ⟨t, s, ht, hs, k, State, hfin, tm, fun a => ?_⟩, fun a => ?_⟩
  · simpa [encQBF, encodeQBF_toFormula S h (f a)] using htm a
  · exact (hiff a).trans (mem_TQBF_toFormula_iff S h (f a)).symm

theorem halts_iff_executes {S : Presentation} (h : Laws S) {w : ℕ} {q : Program .exact r}
    {v n : ℕ} {pc : ℕ} {reg : Fin r → ℕ} {mem : ℕ → ℕ} :
    S.Halts w (S.programOf q) (S.state pc reg mem) v n ↔ Executes w q ⟨pc, ⟨reg, mem⟩⟩ v n := by
  induction n generalizing pc reg mem with
  | zero => exact ⟨fun hh => (h.halts_zero hh).elim, fun he => absurd he.pos (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [executes_succ_iff]
    by_cases hnr : ∀ j, q[pc]? = some j → j.IsRandFree
    · rcases S.step_matches_at h w q pc reg mem hnr with
        ⟨_, _, _, h₁, h₂⟩ | ⟨x, h₁, h₂⟩ | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
      · rw [h.halts_next h₁, h₂]
        exact ih
      · rw [h.halts_halted h₁, h₂]
      · rw [h₂]
        exact iff_false_intro (h.halts_fault h₁)
    · rcases hq : q[pc]? with _ | j
      · exact absurd (fun _ hj => by simp [hq] at hj) hnr
      have hj : ¬j.IsRandFree := fun hj =>
        hnr fun _ hj' => Option.some.inj (hq.symm.trans hj') ▸ hj
      cases j with
      | op _ | jump _ | branch _ _ | halt _ => exact (hj trivial).elim
      | rand dst src =>
        have hget : (S.programOf q)[pc]? = some (S.jump q.length) := by
          simp [programOf, hq, instrOf]
        have hstep1 := h.step_jump (w := w) (reg := reg) (mem := mem) hget
        have hfault2 : Cslib.WordRAM.step w q ⟨pc, ⟨reg, mem⟩⟩ = .fault := by
          simp [Cslib.WordRAM.step, hq]
        rw [hfault2]
        refine iff_false_intro fun hh => ?_
        rw [h.halts_next hstep1] at hh
        cases n with
        | zero => exact h.halts_zero hh
        | succ k =>
          have hnone : (S.programOf q)[q.length]? = none :=
            List.getElem?_eq_none (by simp [programOf])
          exact h.halts_fault (h.step_none hnone) hh

/-- A `rand`-free library program and its translation run alike. -/

#doc (Manual) "A Guide to Complexitylib" =>
%%%
shortTitle := "Complexitylib guide"
%%%

Complexitylib is a Lean 4 library of computational complexity theory, built on [CSLib][cslib] and
Mathlib. This guide introduces the library one area at a time, in the order a newcomer needs it:
what the objects are, how to state an ordinary claim, and how to prove one. Every Lean example is
elaborated against the library when the guide is built, so an example that no longer matches the
library fails the build.

Names in the examples link to the [API documentation][api], which lists every declaration with its
docstring and source. Other entry points:

* The README's [Start here][start] table points to checked examples for each kind of task.
* The [selected formal abstracts][abstracts] state the library's headline results with every
  definition they use, also as [PDFs][pdfs].
* [ROADMAP.md][roadmap] records outstanding work, and [CONTRIBUTING.md][contributing] explains how
  to propose and review changes.

The guide is new: after first steps, it has a chapter on NP-completeness. Further areas follow
one at a time, and each chapter's friction points are fixed in the library rather than documented
around.

#doc (Manual) "NP-Completeness" =>
%%%
tag := "np-completeness"
%%%

This chapter states and proves NP-completeness results the way the library does: problems with
explicit encodings, polynomial time on multi-tape Turing machines, verifiers, polynomial-time
reductions and the Cook–Levin theorem. It ends by proving that `Clique` is NP-complete, step by
step, which is the outline every new NP-completeness proof follows.

Each problem lives in its own module under `Complexity.Computability.Complexity.Problems`, so a
development imports the problems it uses. The first examples need only these:

```
import Complexity.Computability.Complexity.CookLevin.Completeness
import Complexity.Computability.Complexity.Problems.Clique
import Complexity.Tactic.PolyTime
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
# Polynomial Time
%%%
tag := "polynomial-time"
%%%

{name}`ComputableInPolyTime` `f encIn encOut` says that some multi-tape Turing machine with a
binary alphabet and finitely many states computes `f`, reading `encIn a` and writing
`encOut (f a)`, within time and space bounded by polynomials in the length of `encIn a`. This is
the notion that definitions and theorems use.

You rarely build machines. Closure rules for the usual operations are registered with
`fun_prop`, so a function written with certified operations gets its certificate automatically:

```lean
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
example : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1 * p.2 + 1)
    (encPair encNat encNat) encNat := by
  fun_prop
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
example : ComputableInPolyTime (fun l : List ℕ => l.map (· + 1))
    (encList encNat) (encList encNat) := by
  fun_prop
```

Loops whose body depends on the rest of the input, such as a filter that compares each element
with another part of the input, need the `polytime` tactic, which chooses loop rules and composes
certificates. Membership tests and their negations are certified too:

```lean
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
example : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : List ℕ × ℕ => p.1.filter (· ≤ p.2))
    (encPair (encList encNat) encNat) (encList encNat) := by
  polytime
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
example : ComputableInPolyTime
    (fun p : List ℕ × List ℕ => p.1.filter fun x => x ∉ p.2)
    (encPair (encList encNat) (encList encNat)) (encList encNat) := by
  polytime
```

Both tactics prove only the cost. That `f` computes what you intend is a separate proof.
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
example : {l : List ℕ | 0 ∈ l} ∈ P (encList encNat) :=
  ⟨fun l => decide (0 ∈ l), by polytime, fun l => by simp⟩
```

{name}`NP` is defined by verifiers. A verifier `V : α × List Bool → Bool` reads an instance
together with a certificate. {name}`IsVerifier` `enc p V A` says that `a ∈ A` exactly when some
certificate of length `p.eval (enc a).length` makes `V` accept, so certificates are polynomially
long in the encoded instance. A problem is in {name}`NP` when it has a verifier that is
computable in polynomial time on the encoded pair ({name}`mem_NP`):

```lean
context_confidence: repository top-level command scanner; not parsed or elaborated

text:
example : PolyTimeReducible (encPair encNat encNat) encNat
    {p : ℕ × ℕ | p.1 ≤ p.2} {0} :=
  ⟨fun p => p.1 - p.2, by fun_prop,
    fun p => by simp [Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le]⟩
```

Reductions compose ({name}`PolyTimeReducible.trans`), and {name}`P` is closed under them
({name}`PolyTimeReducible.mem_P`). The library's
[checked NP-completeness examples](https://github.com/cslib-community/complexitylib/blob/main/ComplexityTests/NPCompleteness.lean)
state deciders, verifiers and reductions in the same plain form.

# NP-Hardness and NP-Completeness
%%%
tag := "np-hardness"
%%%

{name}`NPHard` `encB B` says that every problem in {name}`NP`, over any type of instances and with
any encoding of them, reduces to `B`; {name}`NPComplete` adds that `B` is itself in {name}`NP`.
Hardness transfers along reductions ({name}`NPHard.trans`), which is how almost every hardness
proof goes. An NP-complete problem is in {name}`P` exactly when {name}`P` and {name}`NP` coincide
({name}`NPComplete.mem_P_iff`), so two NP-complete problems are both in {name}`P` or both outside
it ({name}`NPComplete.mem_P_iff_mem_P`):

```lean
